(Ɛksodɔs 34:18-26; Ditɛronɔmi 16:1-17)
14Kafɛ kikɛ to men baa wora kejigboŋ be yiri yiri asa a bunyaŋ ma. 15Men baa wora bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi na be kejigboŋ nchɛ ashunu kananɛ ŋ ŋini menyi na, Abib be kufɔl nɛ men daŋ lar kumo to ashi Ijipt be kasawule so na to. Loŋ be nchɛnshunu na to ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ ji bodobodo nɛ b ta yiisi n wora. Ekama malɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ ta enɔfuloŋ m ba ma anishito, ama e bar kusɔ ko m ba lara sarga n sa ma. 16Kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ baa fo, men wora Kasɔteŋi be Kejigboŋ. Kafɛ na ya kaa loge be saŋɛ nɛ menyee chala men be adɔjibi abar so na, men wora Kechala Abarso be Kejigboŋ na. 17Kafɛ kikɛ to, a daga fanɛ menyi to be benyɛn kikɛ ka shɛr Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be anishito ale asa. 18Men sa maŋ shin nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ men ta n lara sarga n sa ma na be ŋklaŋ nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k kɔ yiisi e wea abar to. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ shin nɛ kare e chɛ asɔbɔya nɛ men ta n lara sarga n sa ma kejigboŋana na to na be nfɔ so. 19Kafɛ kikɛ men baa ta men be adɔjibi juŋkparso lelaana a bar ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ashi kakpa nɛ menyee bunyaŋ ma na. Men sa maŋ kaŋ daŋɛ kaboe fɔlbi kumo nio be kenyipochu to.
Nnɔ naseso be asheŋ
20Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Meeŋ shin nɛ malaika ko e baa juŋkpar menyi ŋ kuŋ menyi ekpa to loŋ n ya fo kaboŋ nɛ n lɔŋɛ n yili menyi na. 21Men baa kaŋ kusoe a nu mbe ebɔl nsaa wora mo kasonu. Men sa maŋ kaŋ wora kulubi kikɛ ŋ gbiti mo. Nɛ men baŋ wora kulubi ŋ gbiti mo, e maaŋ yige m paŋ menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma eleŋ wɔ mo so nna. 22Ama nɛ men baŋ wora mo kasonu kashenteŋto nseŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi na, kumo ere, men doŋana beeŋ ki ma doŋana nɛ n kɔ bekama nɛ baa kɔ menyi. 23Nɛ ma malaika na e juŋkpar menyi n yɔ Amɔriebi nɛ Hitebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Keenanebi nɛ Hivebi nɛ Jebusiebi be nsawule so nɛ m mur bumo kikɛ. 24Men sa maŋ kaŋ bunyaŋ bumo be agbir na ŋko n shuŋ amo ŋko m bɛ bumo be edaŋkaresheŋ so. Men jija bumo agbirana na cheche nseŋ bure bumo be agbirjembu na to burburbi. 25Nɛ men baa shuŋ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, men be Ebɔrɛ na, ma alɛ beeŋ nɛfa men be ajibi nɛ men be nchu nseŋ lara alɔana kikɛ ashi menyi to. 26Eche kikɛ be kedampo maaŋ gboŋi, ekama malɛ maaŋ ki egbentepo ashi men be kasawule so. Ma alɛ beeŋ sa menyi ŋkpa tenteŋ. 27Meeŋ shin nɛ kufu nɛ keyeŋiyeŋi e tɔr basa nɛ menyee tu na so. Meeŋ shin nɛ men doŋana e kilgi n shile menyi. 28Meeŋ shin nɛ edundumbɔfo e juŋkpar n ya ju Hivebi nɛ Keenanebi nɛ Hitebi. 29Ama m maaŋ ju bumo kafɛ koŋwule to, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ n wora loŋ, kasawule na beeŋ ki kiyitokpaŋ nɛ asɔbɔya lubi e wora keshi n sɔ kumo be kaplɛkama. 30Amoso, gbrɛgbrɛ nɛ meeŋ baa ju bumo loŋ n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ menyeeŋ wora keshi nseŋ tiŋ n suge kasawule na kikɛ na. 31Meeŋ shin nɛ men be ekar e yili teku peper na n ya fo Filistiebi be teku na nseŋ naŋ yili keshishɛrsawule na so n ya fo Yufreetes be lɔr na to. Meeŋ ta nsawule na so ebi m bɔɔ menyi enɔ nɛ men ju bumo ashi to. 32Men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ menyi nɛ bumo nɛ bumo be agbirana e wora kɔnɔkoŋwule kikɛ. 33Men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ b chena men be kasawule so, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, baaŋ shin nɛ men wora kulubi ŋ gbiti ma, ŋkpal manɛ so menyeeŋ baa shuŋ bumo be agbirana na, nɛ k ki fanɛ kejigbelɛ n sa menyi.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 24
Content:
Ebɔrɛ nɛ Israɛlebi be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be asheŋ
1Kachako nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Fo nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Nadab nɛ Abihu nɛ Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpo adushunu e ba ma kutɔ ashi kebee ere ase nfe. Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ men fo kumo men feŋ n yili m bunyaŋ ma. 2Fo Mosis nawule e firgi n taga ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to. Bumo nɛ b ka na bre e sa maŋ kaŋ firgi n taga to, ŋko m bɛ mo so n dii kebee na m ba.” 3Mosis ka shi kebee na so m ba nɛ e ba kaŋɛ basa na mmalga nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malga kikɛ nɛ mbraana nɛ e nase kikɛ. Nɛ basa na kikɛ kpaŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mmalga nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malga na kikɛ, anyeeŋ bɛ amo so.” 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis sibɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mmalga na kikɛ n nase. Kare ka chɛ kachipurdidi nɛ e wule ŋ koso n ya yuu bɔrɛsure ashi kebee na be kaseto nseŋ ta ajembu tenteŋ kuduanyɔ n yuu nɛ a yili n sa Israɛlebi be eyiri kuduanyɔ na. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ Mosis lara Israɛl be basa na to be mbrantiɛbia nɛ b ya lara sarga chɔɔso nseŋ ta ana n lara kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be esarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 6Nɛ Mosis ta loŋ be asɔbɔya na be ŋklaŋ be bargato n wɔtɔ ntishaŋ to nseŋ ta bargato nɛ a ka na malɛ ŋ ŋmenyaŋ bɔrɛsure na so. 7Kede be kaman nɛ e ta kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be kawɔl na ŋ kraŋ kumo awɔrso nɛ basa na nu nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mmalga nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malga na kikɛ, anyeeŋ bɛ amo so nseŋ wora kasonu n sa amo.” 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis ta ŋklaŋ na be amo nɛ a wɔ ntishaŋ to na malɛ ŋ ŋmenyaŋ basa na so nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Men keni kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bɔla mmalga ere kikɛ so n nase na be ŋklaŋ nna na.” 9Asheŋ ere kikɛ be kaman nɛ Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Nadab nɛ Abihu nɛ Israɛlebi na be bejuŋkparpo adushunu dii kebee na be esoso. 10Ndoŋ nɛ b wu Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ kaboŋ dɛdɛso nɛ k du fanɛ yawukpakpaso be kejembu nɛ baa tre safiri na nseŋ fulto parr fanɛ awɔlpa na, ka wɔ mbe aya be kaseto. 11Ama Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ teŋi mbe enɔ m bar tɔrɔ Israɛl be bejuŋkparpo na be ekama so. B daŋ wu mo kenishiso nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ a ji a nuu.
Mosis ka dii n yɔ Sainai be kebee na so be asheŋ
12Nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis: “Dii m ba kaa jo ma kebee ere be esoso nɛ n sa fo ajembu pantraŋ pantrambi nɛ n sibɛ mbra nɛ ma mmalga n deŋi so nɛ a baa ŋini Israɛlebi kananɛ baaŋ ba wora asheŋ.” 13Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis nɛ mbe kayɛrbi Joshuwa wora shiriya nɛ Mosis dii n yɔ Ebɔrɛ be kebee na so. 14Ama le nɛ Mosis daŋ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpo na: “Men baa wɔ keeyi ere to a jo anyi hale nɛ an ya bɛta m ba. Ama Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Hur bre beeŋ baa wɔ menyi kutɔ nfe, amoso nɛ men be ekama nya demu e beeŋ tiŋ n ta kumo n yɔ bumo kutɔ nɛ b keni kumo to n sa mo.” 15Kede be kaman nɛ Mosis yɔ kebee na so nɛ kuwɔlpa buu kebee na kikɛ so. 16Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura gbelge m ba Sainai be kebee na so nɛ kuwɔlpa na buu kumo so hale n ya fo nchɛnshe. Kachɛ shunusopo na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shi kuwɔlpa na be nferinto n tre Mosis. 17Israɛlebi na bre kutɔ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura nɛ k daŋ nyaŋɛ n yuu kebee na so daa du fanɛ edɛgboŋ ko ka bee chɔɔ na. 18Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis luri kuwɔlpa na to n yɔ kebee na be esoso n ya ji kebee na so nchɛ adena nɛ nnyɛ adena.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 25
Content:
Wajɛbu cheembi na be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 35:4-9)
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe kaŋɛ Mosis: 2“Kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na fanɛ b bar ma ŋkɛ ashi bumo be kagbene to nɛ fo sɔ amo n sa ma. 3Ŋkɛ nɛ a daga fanɛ fo sɔ bumo kutɔ e la shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ 4nɛ ago lela nɛ afuibi nɛ b nyɔɔ buru ŋko kepeper kpaw nɛ wajɛchɛbi fuful nɛ wajɛ nɛ b ta kaboe be afuibi n lue 5nɛ kpakpa be kawɔl nɛ b nyɔɔ kepeper nɛ churu be kawɔl nɛ b gbiti nɛnɛ nɛ kedibi nɛ baa tre akasia na 6nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ baaŋ baa ta a wɔtɔ efitila to nɛ efɛa belbelso be asɔ nɛ b kɔ a wɔtɔ ŋku nɛfaso to nɛ asɔ nɛ baa ta a wora duwu nɛ amo be efɛa wɔ ebel na 7nɛ yawu kpakpaso be awarabi nyɛkpɛso nɛ baa tre ɔniks na nɛ yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso fanɛ amaŋkanibi nɛ baa ta a mata bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be piŋi tenteŋ nɛ baa tre ɛfɔd na so na nɛ ajembu nɛ baa ta a mata demuji be kɔlgu na so. 8Ade be kaman nɛ fo shin nɛ basa na e yuu wajɛbu cheembi n sa ma, saŋɛ na so, meeŋ ba kaa wɔ bumo to. 9A daga fanɛ men yuu kumo nseŋ lɔŋɛ kumo kananɛ meeŋ ŋini fo na gbagba chap.”
Kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 37:1-9)
10Kede be kaman nɛ fo shin nɛ b ta akasiadibi n lɔŋɛ deka, nɛ kumo be nteŋ to e baa la ayadra ana nɛ bargato nɛ kumo be mparto e baa la ayadra anyɔ nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ e baa la ayadra anyɔ. 11Kumo be kaman nɛ b ŋalga shuwa gbagba m mata deka na be epunto nɛ kaman kikɛ nseŋ lɔŋɛ shuwa be kekrande m mata ŋ kulti kumo 12nseŋ naŋ bɛl shuwa be mpinibi ana n wɔtɔ kumo be aya ana na to nɛ anyɔ e baa wɔ kaba ko so nɛ anyɔ malɛ e baa wɔ kaba ko so. 13B kaŋ wora loŋ n loge na nɛ b shɛl akasiadibi tenteŋ anyɔ nseŋ ŋalga shuwa m mata amo kikɛ so. 14Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta ndibi nɛ b shɛl na n yishi n wɔtɔ mpinibi nɛ a wɔ deka na be akel to na to a pɛ amo a maŋ kumo so. 15A daga fanɛ loŋ be ndibi tenteŋ na e baa wɔ mpinibi na to saŋkikɛ. 16B kaŋ lɔŋɛ deka na n loge nɛ fo ta ajembu pantraŋ pantrambi nɛ ma mbraana deŋi so nɛ meeŋ ta n sa fo ere n wɔtɔ kumo to. 17Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta shuwa nɛ a maŋ kɔ eyurpi amo to n lɔŋɛ deka na be buuso nɛ kumo be nteŋ to e baa la ayadra ana nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ e baa la ayadra anyɔ. Buuso na be ketre e la ‘kuwɔr be kakpa’. 18Shin nɛ b ta shuwa m bɛl asɔ anyɔ ko nɛ a du fanɛ emalaika nɛ baa tre chɛrubim na n yuu deka na be buuso na so. 19B ta chɛrubim na be kuko n yili buuso na be ekarso be kaba ko nseŋ ta kenyɔsopo na malɛ n yili kaba nɛ k ka na. B lɔŋɛ buuso na nɛ chɛrubim na n chɔga abar so nɛ a baa la kukoŋwule, 20nɛ chɛrubim na e parga bumo be atɛ to m buu deka na be buuso na so nseŋ kilgi anishito n shoŋi abar ŋ keni kuwɔr be kakpa. 21Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ b ta ajembu pantraŋ pantrambi anyɔ nɛ ma mbraana deŋi so na n wɔtɔ deka na to nseŋ ta buuso nɛ baa tre kuwɔr be kakpa na m buu so. 22Ndoŋ nɛ ma nɛ menyi beeŋ baa shɛr nɛ m baa bɔla chɛrubim anyɔ na be nferinto ashi buuso na so a ta ma mbra nɛ ma mmalga a sa fo nɛ fo alɛ e baa ta amo a sa Israɛlebi na.
Sarga be bodobodo be teebɔl be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 37:10-16)
23“Kumo be kaman nɛ fo shin nɛ b ta akasia be etaabodibi n lɔŋɛ teebɔl nɛ kumo be nteŋ to e baa la ayadra asa nɛ mparto e baa la keyadra koŋwule nɛ bargato, nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ e baa la ayadra anyɔ. 24Men ŋalga shuwa n wurge kumo kikɛ so, 25nseŋ ta shuwa n wora kekrande nɛ kumo be mpar sa fanɛ enɔ be mparto ŋ kulti kumo be ekarso kikɛ. 26-27Kumo be kaman nɛ men wora shuwa be mpinibi ana n chɔga teebɔl na be abonfu ana be aya na kikɛ so, saŋɛ na so baaŋ baa ta ndibi nɛ b shɛl na a wɔtɔ amo to a maŋ teebɔl na so. 28Men ta akasiadibi n shɛl ndibi nɛ baaŋ pɛ to a maŋ teebɔl na so a keta na nseŋ ŋalga shuwa n wurge amo kikɛ so. 29Men ta shuwa gbagba n lɔŋɛ teebɔl na so be eprete nɛ mba nɛ echeenshi nɛ kapugboŋ nɛ baa ta sarga be asɔnuuso a wɔtɔ na. 30Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta teebɔl na n yili kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na be anishito nsaa ta bodobodo nɛ b kɔ a lara sarga a sa ma na a deŋi kumo so saŋkikɛ.”
Kefitilatɔl na be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 37:17-24)
31“Shin nɛ b ta shuwa gbagba m bɛl kefitilatɔl, nɛ kumo be ayabi nɛ a kɔ asɔ ko fanɛ atoto be alambu na nɛ amo kikɛ e baa la kukoŋwule. 32Men wora kefitilatɔl na be ayabi na ashe nɛ amo be asa e baa yuu kekel ko so nɛ asa malɛ e baa yuu kekel nɛ k ka na so. 33Ayabi ashe na be kekama daga fanɛ k baa kɔ asɔ ko nɛ a du fanɛ atoto be alambu na be asa. 34Kefitilatɔl na be nteto na malɛ gbagba daga kebaakɔ asɔ nɛ a du fanɛ atoto be alambu na be ana. 35Ade be kaman nɛ ayabi asa na a bee barga to anyɔnyɔ na be kekama be kaseto gba e baa kɔ atoto be kelambu na be kukoŋwule. 36B ŋalga shuwa gbagba n lɔŋɛ kefitilatɔl na nɛ kumo be ayabi na, nɛ amo kikɛ e baa la kukoŋwule. 37Men ta shuwa gbagba n lɔŋɛ efitila wurbi ashunu nɛ baaŋ baa chɔɔ a yili kefitilatɔl na so nɛ k baa fulto anishito na kikɛ. 38Men ta shuwa m bɛl asɔ nɛ b kɔ a lɔŋɛ efitila na be achɛbi so nɛ eprete nɛ b kɔ a suse amo be nsunɔ na gba. 39Shuwa nɛ menyeeŋ ta n lɔŋɛ kefitilatɔl na nɛ kumo be kusɔ kama nyam be egbɛ e baa sa fanɛ kilo adesa nɛ anu. 40Shin nɛ b wora amo kananɛ ŋ ŋini fo ashi kebee na so na gbagba chap.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 26
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 36:8-38)
1“Le e daga fanɛ men lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na, men ta ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi nɛ ejese nɛ a la buru nɛ kepeper kpaw n lue epatisa kudu nseŋ shin nɛ esa nɛ e nyi kajɔ e ta kebasibi nɛ jese n jɔ chɛrubim be kaduli n deŋi n deŋi epatisa na so. 2Men shin nɛ epatisa na kikɛ e baa sasa nɛ amo be kekama be nteŋ to e baa la ayadra be nteŋ kuduana nɛ anyɔ nɛ amo be kekama be mparto malɛ e baa la keyadra be nteŋ ashe. 3Kumo be kaman nɛ men baa epatisa na be anu n chɛ abar so nɛ a ki fanɛ patisagboŋ koŋwule nseŋ naŋ baa anu nɛ a ka na malɛ n chɛ abar so nɛ amo alɛ gba e ki fanɛ patisagboŋ koŋwule. 4Men ta wajɛchɛbi nɛ k la buru m baa asɔ kulkulso fanɛ afirgi m mata m mata epatisagboŋ anyɔ na be kekama be kekilso. 5Men baa wajɛ buru be afirgi na be adunu m mata patisagboŋ ko be kekilso nseŋ baa adunu malɛ m mata kenyɔsopo na be kekelso nɛ afirgi na e karga abar so nseŋ shoŋi abar. 6Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta shuwa m bɛl akɔltobi adunu, ŋ kɔl epatisagboŋ anyɔ na be afirgi adununu na to, nɛ epatisagboŋ anyɔ na e ki wajɛbu koŋwule. 7Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta mboe be afuibi n lue ewajɛ kudukako nɛ a ki Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be buuso. 8Men shin nɛ amo kikɛ e baa sasa nɛ amo be kekama be nteŋ e baa la ayadra adena nɛ anu nɛ amo be mpar malɛ e baa la ayadra ashe. 9Nɛ men baa ewajɛ na be anu n chɛ abar so nɛ a ki patisagboŋ koŋwule nseŋ baa ashe nɛ a ka na malɛ nɛ a ki patisagboŋ koŋwule nɛ men bɔɔ kenyɔsopo na be wajɛ shesopo na to nɛ kumo be kaba e chulgi Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be anishito. 10Men baa asɔ kulkulbi fanɛ afirgi adununu m mata m mata epatisagboŋ anyɔ na be akel so. 11Kede be kaman nɛ men ta danyaŋ m bɛl akɔltobi adunu, nseŋ ta amo ŋ kɔl afirgi adununu na to, nɛ epatisagboŋ anyɔ na e ki wajɛbu koŋwule. 12Men shin nɛ patisa na be kaba nɛ k ka na malɛ e chulgi wajɛbu na be kaman to. 13Men shin nɛ epatisa na be kananɛ a chul na e baa sa fanɛ keyadra koŋwule nɛ bargato ashi kaba kama so. Saŋɛ na so Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na beeŋ pɛ abar ŋ keta nɛnɛ. 14Ade be kaman nɛ men ta ekpakpa be nwɔl nɛ b nyɔɔ m pere n naŋ lɔŋɛ wajɛbu na be buuso nyɔsopo, nseŋ ta echuru be nwɔl nɛ b gbiti nɛnɛ ŋ ki lalaloge be buuso. 15Kede malɛ be kaman, men ta akasiadibi niŋiso ŋ ki Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be ndibi yuuso. 16Ndibi yuuso na be kekama be nteŋ e baa la ayadra kuduanu nɛ bumburuŋ malɛ e baa la ayadra anyɔ. 17Nɛ men gbir ayir anyɔnyɔ ndibi yuuso na be kekama ase nɛ ayir na e bɛ abar so. A daga fanɛ men yuu Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be ndibi yuuso na kikɛ loŋ. 18Men yuu ndibi yuuso be adunyɔ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so. 19Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta gbiti n lɔŋɛ ndibi yuuso na be atɔl adena, nɛ atɔl anyɔ e baa wɔ kedibi yuuso kama be kaseto. 20Kede be kaman nɛ men yuu ndibi yuuso adunyɔ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so 21nseŋ naŋ ta gbiti n lɔŋɛ amo be atɔl adena n shin nɛ atɔl anyɔ e baa wɔ kedibi yuuso kama be kaseto. 22Kede be kaman nɛ men wora Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so malɛ be ndibi yuuso ashe 23nɛ kumo be abonfu to be ndibi yuuso anyɔ. 24Men wora amo be kekama anyɔnyɔ n shin nɛ ndibi anyɔ kama e fara kaseto m mata abar n ya fo esoso nseŋ ta kepinibi n wɔtɔ amo to be esoso 25nɛ ndibi yuuso na e wora aburwa nɛ amo be gbiti be atɔl malɛ e wora kuduashe. 26Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ men ta akasiadibi blɔmbi tentembi kuduanu ŋ ki ndibi deŋiso nseŋ ta amo be anunu n deŋi Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kelargato be esoso nɛ kaseto be ndibi yuuso na so 27nseŋ ta anu malɛ ŋ deŋi kumo be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be ndibi yuuso so. 28K daga fanɛ kedibi deŋiso nɛ k wɔ ndibi blɔmbi deŋiso anu na be nferinto na ka fara kebonfu ko n ya fo kuko. 29Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta shuwa m mata ndibi yuuso na kikɛ so nseŋ ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ amo be mpinibi nɛ a bee pɛ ndibi blɔmbi deŋiso na to a keta na nseŋ ta shuwa m mata ndibi blɔmbi deŋiso na gba so. 30Men lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu nɛ k baa kɔ ebu anyɔ fanɛ kananɛ ŋ ŋini fo ashi kebee na so na gbagba chap. 31Men ta ejese nɛ a la buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ ago nɛ ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi n lue patisa ko nseŋ shin nɛ esa nɛ e nyi kajɔ e ta kebasibi nɛ jese n jɔ chɛrubim be nduli ŋ deŋi n deŋi epatisa na so. 32Men ta epatisa nɛ b jɔ na n shiga akasiadibi yuuso ana nɛ b ta shuwa m mata amo so nɛ a yil gbiti be atɔl ana so nsaa kɔ shuwa be akɔltobi na so. 33Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta patisa na ŋ kuŋ to nɛ k barga acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na ashi kakpa cheembi na to nseŋ ta kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na n yili patisa na be kaman 34n ta buuso nɛ baa tre kuwɔr be kakpa na m buu deka na so ashi acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to. 35Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta sarga be bodobodo be teebɔl na n yili kakpa cheembi na to ashi Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so, nseŋ ta kefitilatɔl na malɛ n yili a laŋɛ kumo be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so. 36Men shin nɛ esa nɛ e nyi kajɔ e ta ejese buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ ago nɛ ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi n lue Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kabuna be epatisa. 37Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta patisa na n shiga akasiadibi yuuso anu nɛ b ta shuwa m mata amo nɛ a kɔ shuwa be akɔltobi nɛ danyaŋ be atɔl anu na so.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 27
Content:
(Ɛksodɔs 38:1-7)
1Kede be kaman nɛ men naŋ ta akasiadibi n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure n shin nɛ kumo be nteŋ to nɛ kumo be mparto kikɛ e baa sasa nsaa la ayadra ashunu nɛ bargato, nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ e baa la ayadra ana nɛ bargato. 2Men wora kumo be esoso be abonfu ana na nɛ a baa du fanɛ alambɛ n shin nɛ bɔrɛsure na nɛ alambɛ na kikɛ e chɔga abar so a la kukoŋwule. Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta danyaŋ m mata bɔrɛsure na kikɛ so. 3Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta danyaŋ n lɔŋɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ kumo so fanɛ nsunɔ be mpuliya nɛ eshabɔl nɛ ntishaŋgboŋ, nɛ kusɔ nɛ baa ta a chule eblaŋ nɛ kusɔ chɔ edɛ. 4Kede be kaman nɛ men ta danyaŋ n lɔŋɛ kusɔ ŋeseasɔ nseŋ lɔŋɛ danyaŋ be mpinibi ana m mata kumo be abonfu ana na kikɛ so. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta kusɔ ŋeseasɔ na n wɔtɔ bɔrɛsure na be nferinto. 6Men ta akasiadibi n shɛl ndibi tenteŋ nɛ baaŋ baa ta a sulɔ bɔrɛsure na nseŋ ta danyaŋ n mata amo so. 7Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta amo n yisi n wɔtɔ bɔrɛsure na be akel to be mpinibi anyɔ na to a pɛ amo to a ta kumo. 8Men ta ndibi peŋgeleŋ peŋgeleŋ n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure na nɛ k baa kɔ kelaŋ kumo to fanɛ kananɛ ŋ ŋini menyi ashi kebee na so na gbagba chap.
Wajɛbu na be kelɔnɛ be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 38:9-20)
9Men lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kelɔnɛ gba nɛ kumo be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so be nteŋ to e fo fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ adunu, nseŋ ta ago lueso lela be patisa ŋ kulti kumo. 10-11Men shin nɛ kumo be kelargato be esoso be kaba so be nteŋ to e baa la ayadra kalfa nɛ adunu nɛ mba anyɔ na kikɛ e nya ndibi yuuso adunyɔnyɔ nɛ amo be danyaŋ be atɔl adunyɔnyɔ. Men ta gbiti n lɔŋɛ ndibi yuuso be anyembi nɛ akɔltobi nɛ a kɔl patisa na to na. 12Kelɔnɛ na be mparto nɛ a laŋɛ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na be nteŋ to e baa la ayadra adushunu nɛ anu nɛ amo be ndibi yuuso nɛ atɔl e baa la kudu kudu. 13Bɔrɛsure na be anishito a yɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na malɛ be mparto e baa la ayadra adushunu nɛ anu. 14Men shin nɛ kumo be kabuna to be kaba ko be patisa be nteŋ to e baa la ayadra adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nɛ bargato nsaa kɔ ndibi yuuso asa nɛ atɔl asa. 15Kaba nɛ k ka na malɛ gba be patisa be nteŋ to e baa la ayadra adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nɛ bargato nsaa kɔ ndibi yuuso asa nɛ atɔl asa. 16Kumo be kaman, men shin nɛ esa nɛ e nyi kajɔ e ta ejese nɛ a la buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi n lue Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kelɔnɛ so be kabuna to gbagba be patisa nɛ kumo be nteŋ to e baa la ayadra adesa, nsaa kɔ ndibi yuuso ana nɛ amo be atɔl ana. 17Men ta gbiti m mata ndibi yuuso nɛ a kulti kelɔnɛ na kikɛ nseŋ ta gbiti n lɔŋɛ amo be akɔltobi, nseŋ ta danyaŋ malɛ n lɔŋɛ amo be atɔl. 18Men shin nɛ kelɔnɛ na be nteŋ to e baa la ayadra kalfa nɛ adunu nɛ kumo be mparto e baa la ayadra adushunu nɛ anu nɛ kumo be ago be patisa be nteŋ malɛ e baa la ayadra ashunu nɛ bargato. A daga fanɛ b ta danyaŋ n lɔŋɛ atɔl na kikɛ 19nɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na to nɛ kelɔnɛ na so nɛ ayir nɛ b yuu ŋ kulti kumo na kikɛ nyam.
Kefitilatɔl na be kekeniso be asheŋ
(Levitikɔs 24:1-4)
20Ade kikɛ be kaman kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na kenishipereso fanɛ b baa bar fo ɔlif be ŋku nɛ a maŋ kɔ eyurpi nɛ fo baa ta a chɔɔ efitiliana na so a yili saŋkikɛ. 21Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnso e daga fanɛ b baa chɔɔ efitila na so a yili patisa nɛ k kuŋ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na be anishito na. B baa chɔɔ efitila na so kaaseso kikɛ nɛ a baa fuli to ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na to a klade. A daga fanɛ Israɛlebi nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi kikɛ e baa bɛ mbra ere so mbaanaayɔ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 28
Content:
Bɔrɛmatapoana be asɔbuuso be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 39:1-7)
1Naniere shin nɛ fo da Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnso Nadab nɛ Abihu nɛ Eliazaa nɛ Itama e lar Israɛlebi na to m ba fo kutɔ, saŋɛ na so baaŋ ba kaa la bɔrɛmatapoana a shuŋ ma. 2Nɛ fo baa epiŋi cheembi lela n sa fo da Ɛɛrɔn nɛ a shin nɛ e baa kɔ bunyaŋ nsaa walɛ keyɛrbi. 3Shin nɛ basa nɛ ma ere Ebɔrɛ sa bumo enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi na, e lɔŋɛ Ɛɛrɔn be epiŋi na. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta Ɛɛrɔn m bɔɔ ma Ebɔrɛ enɔ nɛ e shuŋ ma fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo. 4Shin nɛ b lɔŋɛ kusɔ kuŋ kagbeneso fanɛ kɔlgu, nɛ kale nɛ k maŋ kɔ mbre nɛ baa tre ɛfɔd na nɛ piŋi tenteŋ nɛ k bee fo aya so nɛ danshiki nɛ b ta jese n lue nɛnɛ nɛ neemu nɛ kreso peŋgeleŋ. Loŋ be asɔbuuso na e daga fanɛ b lɔŋɛ n sa fo da Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnso, a ŋini fanɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana nna a shuŋ ma. 5Shin nɛ enyipo e chaŋɛ shuwa fanɛ ejese n wea ejese buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi to n lue m baa asɔbuuso na. 6-8Shin nɛ benyipo e ta le be ejese m baa nseŋ jɔɔ kale nɛ baa tre ɛfɔd na nɛ kumo be abatimu so be efɔl anyɔ nɛ a pɛ ɛfɔd na be anishito nɛ kamanto a mata abar na, nɛ kashɛr to be kreso na gba. Loŋ na amo kikɛ beeŋ baa la kukoŋwule. 9Kumo be kaman nɛ men shin nɛ enyipo e chaŋ Jeekɔb be mbinyɛnso kuduanyɔ na be atre n deŋi yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso nɛ baa tre ɔniks na be anyɔ so. 10E chaŋ mbinyɛnso juŋkparso ashe be atre m bɛ abar so kenimuso kenimuso kejembu koŋwule so nseŋ chaŋ ashe nɛ a ka na gba kenimuso kenimuso kejembu nyɔsopo na so. 11-13Kumo be kaman nɛ enyipo na e nyisi ajembu na n wɔtɔ shuwa be mpinibi to m ba m mata kabɔrɛmata be piŋi be abatimu anyɔ na so. Saŋɛ na so saŋkama nɛ Ɛɛrɔn yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito e beeŋ sulɔ Israɛlebi be atre mbe abatimu anyɔ so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e nyiŋi bumo be asheŋ. 14Shin nɛ b naŋ ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi wurbi lela anyɔ ŋ kɔl shuwa be mpinibi anyɔ na to.
Demuji be kɔlgu be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 39:8-21)
15Men lɔŋɛ kagbeneso be kɔlgu n sa bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nɛ k baa la kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ baa ta a pin Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ. Men ta ejese be yiri ana nɛ men daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ ɛfɔd na n lue wajɛ nseŋ jɔ kumo. 16Men bɔɔ wajɛ na to nɛ k ki kɔlgu nɛ kumo be nteŋ to nɛ mparto kikɛ e baa la enɔ be mpar koŋwule nɛ bargato. 17Ade malɛ kikɛ be kaman nɛ men ta yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso n yuu n yuu kumo so nɛ a bɛ m bɛ abar so a la egbaŋ ana. Gbaŋ nɛ k juŋkpar na be ajembu e baa la amo nɛ baa tre rubi nɛ topas nɛ gaanet na. 18Gbaŋ nyɔsopo na malɛ be ajembu e baa la ɛmeraldi nɛ safaya nɛ daimɔnd na. 19Gbaŋ sasopo malɛ be ajembu e baa la amo nɛ baa tre turkoyis nɛ agate nɛ ametiste na. 20Nɛ gbaŋ nasopo malɛ be ajembu e baa la amo nɛ baa tre berɛl nɛ kameliya nɛ jaspa na. Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ mpinibi nseŋ nyisi n nyisi ajembu na n wɔtɔ amo to. 21A daga fanɛ b chaŋ n chaŋ Israɛlebi be nnaŋ kuduanyɔ na be ketre kama n deŋi ajembu kuduanyɔ na be kekama so. 22Amo be kaman nɛ men naŋ ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi lela n chulgi kɔlgu na so 23nseŋ naŋ ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ kɔlgu na be mpinibi anyɔ n chɔga kumo be esoso be nnɔkar anyɔ na so. 24Kede be kaman nɛ men ta shuwa be ŋgbɛlɛbi anyɔ be nnɔso anyɔ n wɔtɔ shuwa be mpinibi anyɔ na nɛ a wɔ kɔlgu na be esoso be nnɔkar anyɔ na to, 25nseŋ ta nnɔso anyɔ nɛ a ka na malɛ n wɔtɔ piŋi na be mpinibi anyɔ na to. 26Amo be kaman nɛ men naŋ ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ mpinibi anyɔ n wɔtɔ kɔlgu na be kaseto be nnɔkar anyɔ na be kamanto. 27Kumo be kaman nɛ men naŋ lɔŋɛ shuwa be mpinibi anyɔ n wɔtɔ piŋi na be abatimu so be efɔl anyɔ na be nnɔso. 28Ade be kaman nɛ men ta efɔl farso nɛ k la buru ŋ kɔl kɔlgu na be mpinibi na nɛ piŋi na be mpinibi na to, n chɛ m mata abar nɛ kɔlgu na e sa maa filito.
29Saŋɛ na so, saŋkikɛ nɛ Ɛɛrɔn buu demuji be kɔlgu nɛ Israɛlebi be nnaŋ kuduanyɔ na be atre deŋ so n luri wajɛbu cheembi na to, kumo ere e bee bar bumo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito kanyiŋiso nna na. 30Saŋkama nɛ Ɛɛrɔn bee yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito, a daga fanɛ e di demuji be kɔlgu nɛ Urim nɛ Tumim wɔ kumo to na nɛ a baa chɛ mo to nɛ e baa pin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be nfɛra.
Bɔrɛmatapoana be epiŋi nɛ a ka na be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 39:22-31)
31Ale e daga fanɛ men lɔŋɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be piŋi tenteŋ nɛ ɛfɔd deŋ kumo so na. Men ta jese nɛ a la buru n lue wajɛ m ba kumo, 32nɛ k baa kɔ kubɔ. Men ta kechɛbi lueso m muya kubɔ na ŋ kulti nɛ k baa kɔ eleŋ ga. 33Men ta ejese nɛ a la buru nɛ ago nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ n lɔŋɛ asɔ kulkulbi nɛ a du fanɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre pomegranates na m ba n chulgi n chulgi piŋi na be kaseto be ekarso. Kumo be kaman nɛ men ba shuwa be adulombi n chulgi pomegranates anyɔ kama be nfɛato. 34Men shin nɛ a bɛ abar so ŋ kulti piŋi na kikɛ n chambɔ. 35A daga fanɛ Ɛɛrɔn e baa buu piŋi na saŋkama nɛ e bee yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito ashi acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to, saŋɛ na so adulombi na beeŋ baa shu a ŋini fanɛ e maŋ wu. 36Men ta shuwa lela n lɔŋɛ kusɔ paŋgelambi nseŋ chaŋ le be nsibɛ n deŋ kumo so: ‘Cheembi n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na’ 37nseŋ ta jese nɛ k la buru m baa kumo m mata neemu na be anishito. 38A daga fanɛ Ɛɛrɔn e baa chɛ neemu na nɛ kasibɛ na e baa wɔ mbe kasɔto so saŋkama a ŋini fanɛ e ta Israɛlebi be alubi nɛ b wora saŋɛ nɛ baa lara sarga a sa ma na n deŋi mbe kumu so nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e baa sɔ bumo be esarga na. 39Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi n lue Ɛɛrɔn be danshiki nɛ neemu nseŋ shin nɛ enyipo e jɔ mbe kreso. 40Men baa nle nɛ ekreso nɛ eneemu n sa Ɛɛrɔn be bibinyɛn na malɛ nɛ a shin nɛ b baa kɔ bunyaŋ nsaa walɛ ayɛrbi. 41Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ men ta le be asɔbuuso ere m buu fo da Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn na nseŋ ta ŋku ŋ gbiti bumo n ta bumo m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ, saŋɛ na so baaŋ ki bɔrɛmatapoana cheembi a shuŋ ma. 42Men ta ago be wajɛ m ba ewondoŋshiimbi n sa bumo nɛ b baa dela a buu bumo be wulo so. Men shin nɛ amo be nteŋ to e yili kashɛr to m ba fo amuli to. 43A daga fanɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnso na e baa wɔtɔ loŋ be ewondoŋshiimbi ere saŋkama nɛ baa luri Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to ŋko saŋkama nɛ baa ba bɔrɛsure na ase nɛ b ba shuŋ ma ashi kakpa cheembi na to, saŋɛ na so b maaŋ wu ŋkpal b ka na kayurkpaŋ so. Le be mbra ere beeŋ baa dese n sa Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe kaman to ebi hale mbaanaayɔ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 29
Content:
Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnso be keta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ be asheŋ
(Levitikɔs 8:1-36)
1Men kaa shin nɛ men ta Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn na m bɔɔ ma enɔ fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana, men ta gbolu fɔlbi koŋwule nɛ ekpakpa anyɔ nɛ a maŋ kɔ ndulgi kikɛ. 2Men ta ayunyifu nɛ a pe nɛnɛ n wora bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi. Men ta ɔlif be ŋku n wora bodobodo na be ako nseŋ wora ako malɛ loŋ, nseŋ ta nyifu na be ako malɛ n wora ekrakashi n ta ɔlif be ŋku n wurge amo so. 3Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta amo n wɔtɔ kelantaŋɛ n ti gbolu fɔlbi na nɛ ekpakpa anyɔ na so m ba lara sarga n sa ma. 4Kede be kaman nɛ men shin nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn na e ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kabuna to m ba bɛr daŋkare be ekpa so. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be asɔbuuso nɛ a la danshiki nɛ piŋi tenteŋ na nɛ kale nɛ k maŋ kɔ mbre nɛ baa tre ɛfɔd na nɛ demuji be kɔlgu na m buu Ɛɛrɔn. Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta ɛfɔd be kreso nɛ enyipo ta ejese n lue nɛnɛ na ŋ kre mo so. 6Amo be kaman nɛ men ta neemu na m mɛa mbe kumu so nseŋ naŋ ta kusɔ paŋgelambi nɛ b sibɛ so na m mata neemu na so. 7Asɔ buuso na be kaman, nɛ men ta ŋku nɛfaso na n do Ɛɛrɔn be kumu so nɛ e ki Ebɔrɛ be esa laraso. 8Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta edanshiki m buu Ɛɛrɔn be bibinyɛn na malɛ 9nseŋ buu bumo nwuro n ta ekreso ŋ kre bumo so. Nɛ men wora loŋ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi kikɛ beeŋ ki bɔrɛmatapoana a shuŋ ma hale mbaanaayɔ. 10Men baŋ mɛa bumo to n loge, a daga fanɛ men ta gbolu na m ba Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be kabuna to m ba shin nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn na e ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi kumo be kumu so. 11Kumo be kaman nɛ men mɔ gbolu na ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito ndoŋ 12nɛ fo ta keshilbi n nyɔ gbolu fɔlbi na be ŋklaŋ na to n do n do bɔrɛsure na be alambɛ na so nseŋ chulgi ŋklaŋ na be amo nɛ a ka na malɛ kikɛ n wurge bɔrɛsure na be kaseto. 13Kede be kaman nɛ men lara apuntosɔ be nfɔ na kikɛ ŋ ku kegberche na be kaseto be kaba nseŋ lara achɛbi anyɔ na nɛ amo be nfɔ kikɛ n chɔɔ bɔrɛsure na so n lara sarga n sa ma. 14Ama men yɛr gbolu na be eblaŋ nɛ kawɔl nɛ apumbi bre keeyi na be ekarso n ya chɔɔ. Loŋ be sarga na e naa bar bɔrɛmatapoana be alubi be ketampaŋ na. 15Kumo be kaman nɛ men shin nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn na e ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi kpakpa nɛ baaŋ mɔ na be kumu so 16nɛ men mɔ kumo nseŋ suse ŋklaŋ na ŋ ŋmenyaŋ ŋ ŋmenyaŋ bɔrɛsure na be mba ana na kikɛ so. 17Kumo be kaman nɛ men kuya kpakpa na to wurwurbi nseŋ fɔr kumo be apuntosɔ nɛ ayawɔrta so nseŋ ta amo n deŋi kumu na nɛ eblaŋ kuyatoso na so 18n chɔɔ bɔrɛsure na so n lara sarga n sa ma. Loŋ be sarga chɔɔso na be efɛa bee par ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna. 19Kede be kaman nɛ men shin nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn e naŋ ta bumo enɔana n deŋi kpakpa nɛ k ka na be kumu so 20nɛ men mɔ kumo nseŋ suse ŋklaŋ na be ako n do n do Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛnana na be jisa so be asoe be nseto nɛ bumo be enɔjisaana be ashilbinio so nɛ bumo be ayajiso be anashibinio so nseŋ ta ŋklaŋ nɛ a ka na malɛ kikɛ ŋ ŋmenyaŋ ŋ ŋmenyaŋ bɔrɛsure na be mba ana na kikɛ so. 21Kede malɛ be kaman nɛ men nyia bɔrɛsure na so be ŋklaŋ na be ako n wea ŋku nɛfaso na be ako to ŋ ŋmenyaŋ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ bibinyɛn na nɛ bumo be asɔbuusoana kikɛ so. Saŋɛ na so Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛnana na beeŋ ki ma, Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso nɛ bumo be asɔbuuso e ki asɔ cheembi ashi ma anishito. 22Ŋkpal kpakpa ere ka la keta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ be kewora be kusɔbɔya na so, men lara kumo be kpandu nɛ k kɔ nfɔ nɛ apuntosɔ be nfɔ nɛ kegberche na be kaseto be kaba nɛ achɛbi anyɔ na nɛ amo be nfɔ nɛ kumo be jisa be kebɛaŋ 23n ti bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi na nɛ bodobodo nɛ a kɔ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ amo nɛ a maŋ kɔ nɛ krakashi na so n lara sarga n sa ma. 24Men shin nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn na e maŋ amo so ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito fanɛ kakɛ cheembi be sarga. 25Kumo be kaman nɛ men sɔ amo bumo kutɔ n chɔɔ bɔrɛsure na so ashi kakpa nɛ baa chɔɔ sarga chɔɔso na. Loŋ be sarga be efɛa bee par ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna. 26Kumo alɛ be kaman nɛ fo maŋ kpakpa nɛ b ta n lara Ɛɛrɔn be keta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ be sarga na be kagbene so ashi ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito. Kusɔbɔya na be kagbene na la fo kachige nna. 27Kpakpa na be kagbene be kaba nɛ jisa be kebɛaŋ nɛ b maŋ so ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito na malɛ la Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn na peya nna. 28Saŋkama nɛ menyi, ma basa Israɛlebi baŋ mɔ kusɔbɔya n lara kɔnɔkoŋwule be sarga, kusɔbɔya na be kagbene nɛ kebɛaŋ la Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn peya nna. Loŋ be eblaŋ na la meya nna, ama bɔrɛmatapoana e naaŋ baa ji amo hale mbaanaayɔ. 29Nɛ Ɛɛrɔn baŋ wu, mbe mbinyɛnbi na be eko e naŋ ta mbe kabɔrɛmata be piŋi na. 30Emo nɛ e sɔ mo so ŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo nimuso a luri Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to be kakpa cheembi na, daga fanɛ e buu kabɔrɛmata be piŋi na saŋkama nɛ e bee luri ndoŋ hale n ya fo nchɛnshunu. 31Men daŋɛ kpakpa nɛ men ta n lara Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛnana be keta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ be sarga na be eblaŋ wajɛbu na be kelɔnɛ so 32nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn na e yili nshɛr be wajɛbu na be kabuna to n we eblaŋ na nɛ bodobodo nɛ a ka a wɔ kelantaŋɛ na to na. 33Bumo e daga b ka ji asɔ nɛ b ta n lara alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga na saŋɛ nɛ b ta bumo m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nɛ b ki bɔrɛmatapoana na. A maŋ daga esa pɔtɛ kama ka ji loŋ be asɔ na, ŋkpal manɛ so a la asɔ cheembi nna. 34Ama nɛ fanɛ amo be ako ka nseŋ di ŋklade, men chɔɔ amo nɛ esa kama e sa maŋ kaŋ ji amo, ŋkpal manɛ so, a la asɔ cheembi nna. 35Ta nchɛnshunu dede n wora Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn be keta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ be kasheŋwora na fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo na gbagba chap. 36Nchɛnshunu na be karechɛ kama malɛ, men ta gbolu n lara alubi be ketampaŋ nɛ bɔrɛsure na be kefɔrso be sarga. Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta ɔlif be ŋku ŋ gbiti bɔrɛsure na so nɛ k ki cheembi. 37Nchɛnshunu na be karechɛ kama men lara alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga bɔrɛsure na so, saŋɛ na so, bɔrɛsure na beeŋ baa du cheembi nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k beta kumo gba e baa du cheembi.
Karechɛ kikɛ be sarga be asheŋ
(Nɔmbɛs 28:1-8)
38Karechɛ kikɛ men baa ta nfɛ koko be ekpakpafɔlbi anyɔ anyɔ a lara sarga bɔrɛsure na so. 39Men ta kukoŋwule n lara sarga na kachipurso nseŋ ta kumo nɛ k ka malɛ n lara sarga kaaseso. 40Men ta ɔlif be ŋku lela fanɛ lita koŋwule m baga bodobodo be nyifu lela fanɛ kilo koŋwule nseŋ ta wain fanɛ lita koŋwule nɛ a baa la asɔnuuso be sarga n ti sososo be kpakpafɔlbi na so n lara sarga na. 41Kumo be kaman nɛ men naŋ ta kpakpafɔlbi nyɔsopo na nɛ asɔ nɛ men daŋ ta n ti chipurso peya na so na gbagba chap n ti so n chɔɔ n lara sarga kaaseso n sa ma. Loŋ be sarga chɔɔso na be efɛa bee wora ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ebel ga. 42Le be sarga chɔɔso ere beeŋ baa la sarga nɛ menyi nɛ men be kaman to ebi kikɛ beeŋ baa lara saŋkama mbaanaayɔ ashi Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be kabuna to ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito. Ndoŋ nɛ meeŋ baa tu menyi nsaa malga fo kutɔ. 43Ndoŋ nɛ ma nɛ Israɛl be basa beeŋ baa shɛr nɛ ma kemaŋkura e shin nɛ ndoŋ e ki ma kakpa cheembi. 44Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na nɛ bɔrɛsure na e ki ma asɔ cheembi. Nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn na malɛ gba e ki basa laraso cheembi a shuŋ ma fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana. 45Saŋɛ na so, nɛ ŋ gbelge m baa kaa wɔ Israɛlebi na to a la bumo be Ebɔrɛ. 46Aloŋ nɛ baaŋ ba pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ n lara bumo ashi Ijipt nsaa wɔ bumo to na. Ma e la Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 30
Content:
Duwu be bɔrɛsure na be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 37:25-28)
1“Men ta akasiadibi n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ menyeeŋ baa chɔɔ duwu kumo so 2nɛ kumo be nteŋ nɛ mparto kikɛ e baa sasa fanɛ keyadra koŋwule nɛ bargato nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ e baa la ayadra asa. Men wora esoso be abonfu ana na nɛ a baa du fanɛ alambɛ nɛ amo nɛ kumo kikɛ e baa chɔ abar so a la kukoŋwule. 3Men ta shuwa lela m mata kumo be awɔlto nɛ akel to nɛ alambɛ na kikɛ so ŋ kulti, nseŋ ŋalga shuwa ŋ kulti kumo be nnɔkar kikɛ nɛ a baa du gbuntelin. 4Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ mpinibi anyɔ n chɔga kumo be akel to, shuwa gbuntelin na be kaseto nsaa yisi ndibi tentembi a wɔtɔ amo to a maŋ kumo so. 5Men ta akasiadibi n wora loŋ be ndibi tentembi na nseŋ ta shuwa m mata amo kikɛ so. 6Kede be kaman nɛ men ta bɔrɛsure na n yili kakpa nɛ ma nɛ fo beeŋ baa shɛr na be patisa nɛ k kuŋ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na nɛ kumo be buuso nɛ baa tre kuwɔr be kakpa na be anishito na. 7Ɛɛrɔn baŋ ba nɛ e ba lɔŋɛ efitila na so, kachipurso kikɛ a daga fanɛ e chɔɔ duwu nɛ amo be efɛa wɔ ebel na bɔrɛsure na so. 8Nɛ Ɛɛrɔn naŋ ba kaaseso malɛ nɛ e ba chɔɔ efitila na so, a daga fanɛ e naaŋ wora loŋ koŋwule na. Menyi nɛ men be kaman to ebi kikɛ beeŋ baa lara duwu be sarga ere a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kachɛ kama hale mbaanaayɔ. 9Men sa maŋ kaŋ chɔɔ duwu kama nɛ a maŋ daga ashi loŋ be bɔrɛsure na so, ŋko n lara kusɔbɔya ŋko ayu ŋko asɔnuuso nɛ a maŋ daga be sarga kikɛ kumo so. 10Kafɛ kikɛ malɛ a daga fanɛ Ɛɛrɔn e ta asɔbɔya nɛ b ta n lara kulubi be sarga na be ŋklaŋ n do bɔrɛsure na so kela koŋwule nɛ k ki cheembi. Le be kesheŋ ere la kusɔ nɛ menyi nɛ menyi be kaman to ebi beeŋ baa wora nna hale mbaanaayɔ. Bɔrɛsure ere la kusɔ cheembi nna n sa ma, Eyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu be toto be asheŋ
11Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis le: 12“Fo kaa karga Israɛl be basa nɛ fo pin bumo be kɔnɔ, fo shin nɛ bumo be ekama e ka kusɔ ko ŋkpal mbe ŋkpa so, saŋɛ na so kulubi kama maaŋ tu mo kekarga na to. 13Ekama nɛ e ti basa nɛ baa karga na so daga fanɛ e ka amansherbi fanɛ kananɛ baa ka lampo ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na to na. 14Esa kama nɛ b karga nɛ e ji fanɛ nfɛ adunyɔ a yɔ, daga fanɛ e ka loŋ be amansherbi na n sa ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ sarga. 15Loŋ be toto na to, a daga fanɛ damawura nɛ etirpo kikɛ e ka a sasa, ŋkpal manɛ so ekama bee ka nna ŋkpal mbe ŋkpa so. 16Sɔ le be amansherbi ere ashi Israɛlebi na kutɔ nɛ a baa la alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga nɛ b ta amo a shuŋ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to be kushuŋ.”
Danyaŋ be katishaŋgboŋ be asheŋ
17Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le: 18“Men lɔŋɛ danyaŋ be katishaŋgboŋ nɛ kumo be ketɔl n jɔ nchu n wɔtɔ n yili Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na nɛ bɔrɛsure na be kefɛato. 19Loŋ be nchu na nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn na beeŋ baa kɔ a fɔr bumo be enɔ nɛ aya so. 20-21K daga fanɛ b baa fɔr bumo be enɔana nɛ aya pɔɛŋ nsaa luri Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to n ya kaa lara sarga chɔɔso bɔrɛsure so, saŋɛ na so b maaŋ wu. Le be kesheŋ ere beeŋ baa la mbra nna a dese n sa bumo nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi kikɛ.”
Ŋku nɛfaso na be asheŋ
22Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le: 23-25“Men ta efɛa belbelso be asɔ n wora ŋku nɛfaso cheembi. Men karga asɔ na fanɛ kananɛ baa karga asɔ ashi Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na to na. Men ta asɔ nɛ baa tre mir na fanɛ kilo ashe nɛ asɔ nɛ baa tre sinamɔn na kilo asa nɛ asɔ nɛ baa tre keen na kilo asa nɛ amo nɛ baa tre kashia na kilo ashe, n wea ɔlif be ŋku lita ana to n wora amo fanɛ kananɛ esa nɛ e nyi tulale be kewora bee wora na, nɛ a ki ŋku nɛfaso cheembi nɛ amo be efɛa wɔ ebel. 26Men wora loŋ be ŋku na ŋ gbiti n nɛfa Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na 27nɛ teebɔl na nɛ kumo be asɔwurbi kikɛ nɛ kefitilatɔl na nɛ kumo alɛ gba be asɔwurbi nɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ baa chɔɔ duwu kumo so na 28nɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ baa chɔɔ sarga be asɔ kumo so na nɛ kumo be asɔwurbi kikɛ nɛ katishaŋgboŋ nɛ baa jɔ nchu kumo to a fɔr enɔ nɛ aya na nɛ kumo be ketɔl. 29Men ta asɔ na kikɛ m bɔɔ ma enɔ nɛ amo kikɛ e ki cheembi nɛ kusɔ kama malɛ gba nɛ k beta amo e ki cheembi. 30Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ men ta ŋku na n do n do Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn na gba so n ta bumo m bɔɔ ma enɔ nɛ b ki bɔrɛmatapoana a shuŋ ma. 31Nɛ fo, Mosis e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: ‘Ŋku ere e naaŋ baa la ma ŋku nɛfaso cheembi n sa menyi nɛ menyi be kaman to ebi kikɛ. 32Men sa maŋ kaŋ ta amo m gbiti esa pɔtɛ be eyur, menyi alɛ be ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ wora amo be kaduli kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, a la ŋku cheembi nna, amoso men baa ta amo fanɛ asɔ cheembi. 33Esa kama nɛ e pel n wora amo be kaduli ŋko n ta amo ŋ gbiti esa pɔtɛ nɛ e maŋ la bɔrɛmatapo, a daga fanɛ b lara mo ashi mbe basa to.’ ”
Duwu be kewora be asheŋ
34Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Men ta duwu be asɔ nɛ amo be efɛa wɔ ebel nɛ amo kikɛ be keshi e baa sasa. Amo a la, stakte nɛ onika nɛ galbanum nɛ fraŋkinsensi nɛ a maŋ kɔ eyurpi amo to na. 35Shin nɛ esa nɛ e nyi tulale be kewora e ta amo n wea abar to n wora duwu nɛ a baa dufɛ fanɛ tulale. Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta nfɔl n wea amo to n lara amo be eyurpi nɛ a baa du cheembi. 36Shin nɛ b kɔr ako nɛ a pe fanɛ nyifu na n ta amo ŋ ŋmenyaŋ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na be anishito ashi Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to be kakpa nɛ ma nɛ fo beeŋ baa tu abar na. A daga fanɛ men baa ta duwu na fanɛ asɔ cheembi. 37Duwu ere la asɔ cheembi nna nsaa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ peya. Men sa maŋ kaŋ bɔla ekpa nɛ baa bɔla so a wora duwu cheembi so n wora duwu kama n sa men gbagba be amu. 38Esa kama nɛ e kpal amo be efɛa belbelso so n wora amo be kaduli, daga fanɛ b lara mo ashi mbe basa to.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 31
Content:
Basa nɛ baaŋ wora Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be kushuŋ be asheŋ
1Le be asheŋ ere kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis, 2“Keni, n lara Besalɛl nɛ e la Yuri pibinyɛn nsaa la Hur mo nanabi ashi Juda be kanaŋ to na 3nɛ n ta ma kiyoyu n wɔtɔ mo to nseŋ sa mo kasɔwora kikɛ be kenyi nɛ ketiŋ n wora be eleŋ nɛ kasɔlɔŋɛ be kepinto kikɛ nyam be nfɛra na. 4Saŋɛ na so e beeŋ baa tiŋ a ta nfɛra a chaŋ asɔ nsaa ta shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ nɛ yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso 5nɛ ndibi a lɔŋɛ asɔ. 6Ma alɛ naŋ lara Oholiab nɛ e la Ahisamak malɛ pibinyɛn ashi Dan be kanaŋ to nna fanɛ e baa chɛ Besalɛl to a shuŋ. Bekama malɛ gba nɛ b ti so a kɔ enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi na, n sa bumo kikɛ kenyi damta, saŋɛ na so, baaŋ tiŋ n wora asɔ kama nyam nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ b wora na. 7Loŋ be asɔ na e la Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na, kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na nɛ kumo be buuso nɛ baa tre kuwɔr be kakpa na 8nɛ shuwa lela be kefitilatɔl na nɛ kumo be asɔwurbi kikɛ nɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ baa chɔɔ duwu kumo so 9nɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ baa lara esarga chɔɔso kumo so na nɛ kumo be asɔwurbi kikɛ nɛ katishaŋgboŋ nɛ kumo be ketɔl na 10nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn be asɔbuuso cheembi nɛ baa buu saŋkama a shuŋ kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ na 11nɛ ŋku nɛfaso cheembi nɛ duwu nɛ amo be efɛa wɔ ebel nɛ baa chɔ wajɛbu cheembi na to na. A daga fanɛ b wora asɔ kama nyam kananɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ b wora na.”
Kewushiachɛ na be asheŋ
12Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le: 13“Kaŋɛ Israɛlebi fanɛ b baa bɛ ma kewushiachɛ be daŋkare so nsaa ta kumo fanɛ kachɛ cheembi, ŋkpal manɛ so, kewushiachɛ na la ma nɛ menyi nɛ menyi be kaman to ebi kikɛ be kanyiŋi be kachɛ nna a ŋini fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara menyi fanɛ ma basa. 14Men baa bɛ loŋ be kewushiachɛ na be daŋkare so nsaa ta kumo fanɛ kachɛ cheembi. A daga b ka mɔ esa kama nɛ e kini kebɛ kumo so nseŋ shuŋ kumo be kamɔnchɛ. 15Nchɛnshe e daga fanɛ men ta n shuŋ menyi be ashuŋ. Kachɛ shunusopo na bre la kachɛ cheembi n sa ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nna nɛ esa kama daga e ka wushi kamɔnchɛ. Esa kama nɛ e shuŋ kushuŋ kikɛ kumo be kamɔnchɛ daga b ka mɔ mo. 16Amoso a daga fanɛ Israɛlebi nɛ bumo nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi kikɛ ka bɛ ma kewushiachɛ be daŋkare na so nsaa ji kumo fanɛ ma nɛ bumo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be kanyiŋi be kachɛ. 17K beeŋ baa la ma nɛ menyi Israɛlebi be kanyiŋi be kachɛ nna hale mbaanaayɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta nchɛ ashe nna n to esoso nɛ kasawule nseŋ wushi kachɛ shunusopo na.” 18Ebɔrɛ ka malga Mosis kutɔ n loge ashi Sainai be kebee na so nɛ e ta ajembu pantraŋ pantrambi anyɔ nɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ gbagba sibɛ mbe mbra n deŋi so na n sa Mosis.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 32
Content:
Shuwa be kenabi be asheŋ
(Ditɛronɔmi 9:6-25)
1Mosis ka daŋ chɛr kebee na so nsaa maŋ ba manaŋ na nɛ basa na ba shɛr ŋ kulti Ɛɛrɔn nseŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Koso n lɔŋɛ ebɔrɛ ko n sa anyi nɛ e baa juŋkpar anyi. Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k wora Mosis, nɛ e juŋkpar anyi n lar Ijipt be kasawule so na.” 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛɛrɔn kaŋɛ bumo: “Men lara n lara shuwa be abitasɔ nɛ men be beche nɛ mbia kikɛ wɔtɔ na m bar ma.” 3Epul na to nɛ basa na kikɛ lara shuwa be akonde nɛ a wɔ bumo be asoe to na n sa Ɛɛrɔn 4nɛ Ɛɛrɔn sɔ amo kikɛ ŋ ŋalga n lɔŋɛ kegbir nɛ k du fanɛ kenabi. Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kaŋɛ le: “O Israɛlebi, menyi be ebɔrɛ nɛ e lara menyi ashi Ijipt be kasawule so na nde.” 5Ɛɛrɔn ka wu kusɔ nɛ k wora na nɛ e yuu bɔrɛsure n yili shuwa be kenabi na be anishito nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Echefo anyeeŋ wora bunyanso be kanyiŋi be kejigboŋ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.” 6Kumo be ŋklade, chipurdidi nɛ basa na lara esarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be esarga. Kumo be kaman nɛ b chena n ji nseŋ nuu nsa mboo ŋ koso a wora kusɔjigaya be asheŋ. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis: “Gbelge to manaŋ n yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo basa nɛ fo keta n lar Ijipt be kasawule so na wora kulubi m pal kaman n sa ma. 8B teŋ kini kebɛ mbra nɛ n sa bumo na so nseŋ ŋalga shuwa n lɔŋɛ kenabi a shuŋ nsaa lara esarga a sa kumo a kaŋɛ fanɛ bumo be ebɔrɛ mo nɛ a lara bumo ashi Ijipt be kasawule so na nna na.” 9Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis: “N nyi kananɛ basa ere kɔ kusoe kpakpaso. 10Amoso sa maŋ kaŋ kuŋ ma ekpa a laŋɛ kusɔ nɛ mee shin nɛ n wora bumo ere be kaplɛa so. Ŋkpal b ka shin nɛ ma kagbene kaa ga so, meeŋ mur bumo nseŋ shin nɛ fo nɛ fo kaman to ebi e ki kanaŋgboŋ.” 11Ama Mosis daŋ kule mo Nyɛnpe nɛ mbe Ebɔrɛ na nna ga, nseŋ kaŋɛ: N Nyɛnpe, manɛ e ba nɛ fo shin nɛ fo kagbene kaa ŋkpal fo basa mo nɛ fo ta fo eleŋgboŋ nɛ fo enɔ lempo na n lara ashi Ijipt be kasawule so so? 12Nuso nɛ Ijiptebi na beeŋ kaŋɛ a yɔ fo kaplɛa so? B maaŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo lara bumo nna ashi Ijipt be kasawule so nna m ba abee to nɛ fo ba mur a? Amoso shin nɛ fo kagbene e dese nɛ fo chɛrga fo nfɛra nsaa maŋ shin nɛ le be tɔrɔ ere e ba fo basa so. 13Nyiŋi le be kɔnɔ nɛ fo nase n sa fo nyɛrbi Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb: “Meeŋ shin nɛ menyi be kaman to ebi e wora keshi fanɛ achɛkpabi nɛ a wɔ awɔlpa to na ta kasawule ere kikɛ n sa bumo nɛ k ki bumo be kapetɛ mbaanaayɔ na.” 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ chɛrga mbe nfɛra nsaa maŋ naŋ bar tɔrɔ na bumo so. 15Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Mosis ta ajembu pantraŋ pantrambi anyɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ sibɛ mbra na n deŋi amo be kekama be mba anyɔ so na n shi kebee na so ŋ gbelge to m ba. 16Ebɔrɛ gbagba e daŋ lɔŋɛ ajembu pantraŋ pantrambi na nseŋ sibɛ kasibɛ na n deŋi amo so. 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ Joshuwa nu basa ka bee cha awɔr nɛ e kaŋɛ Mosis: “N nu kena be awɔr ka bee cha keeyi to.” 18Nɛ Mosis malɛ kaŋɛ Joshuwa: “Awɔr ere maŋ la kekɔmpɔɔso be awɔr ŋko kekɔntɔr be awɔr. Kashɛ be awɔr nɛ ma ere bee nu.” 19Mosis ka ba kaa fo keeyi na to nseŋ wu kenabi ka yil nɛ kacha yilso nɛ agbo pɛ mo ga nɛ e yige ajembu na to n lɛ kebee na be kaseto nɛ a buri to. 20Kumo be kaman nɛ e ta kenabi nɛ basa na lɔŋɛ na malɛ n wɔtɔ edɛ to nɛ k ŋalga nɛ e kɔr kumo to fanɛ nyifu na nseŋ ta kumo n wɔtɔ nchu to n shin nɛ Israɛlebi na nuu amo. 21Kumo be loŋ be kaman nɛ Mosis bishi Ɛɛrɔn: “Manɛ nɛ basa ere wora fo nɛ fo shin nɛ le be kulubi gboŋgboŋi ere ba bumo so?” 22Nɛ Ɛɛrɔn kaŋɛ mo le: “Sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ fo agbo e koso. Fo nyi kananɛ basa ere be nfɛra baa yuu kulubi so. 23Amoso kusɔ nɛ b daŋ kaŋɛ ma nde: ‘Lɔŋɛ ebɔrɛ ko n sa anyi nɛ e baa juŋkpar anyi, ŋkpal manɛ so anyi maŋ naa nyi kusɔ nɛ k wora Mosis nɛ e juŋkpar anyi n lar Ijipt be kasawule so na.’ 24Ndoŋ nna nɛ ma alɛ kaŋɛ bumo: ‘Ekama nɛ e kɔ shuwa be abitasɔ e lara amo m ba.’ Nɛ b lara n lara amo m ba sa ma nɛ n ta amo n wɔtɔ edɛ to nɛ a ŋalga. To, kananɛ kenabi na wora m ba nna na.” 25Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis wu fanɛ Ɛɛrɔn e shin nɛ basa na nya bumo be aparsheŋ nseŋ ta bumo be amu n wora jenfembi ashi bumo doŋana be anishito. 26Nɛ e yili keeyi na be kakpa nɛ baa bɔla a luri kumo to nseŋ kaŋɛ awɔrso: “Ekama nɛ e wɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kaba so, e ba ma kutɔ nfe!” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Livaiebi na kikɛ lar m ba shɛr ŋ kulti mo. 27Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: ‘Men be ekama e kre to n ta mbe tokobi m bɛta n luri keeyi na to a kulti a mɔ esa kama nɛ e tu, hale nɛ amodoŋwura la mo da ŋko mo sipo ŋko mo teri ŋko mbe bechenashapo gba nna.’ ” 28Ndoŋ nna nɛ Livaiebi nu Mosis be kɔnɔ nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ b wora na, nɛ basa beeŋ wora fanɛ ŋgboŋ asa kikɛ wu. 29Kumo be kaman nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ Livaiebi na: “Kabre men lara men be amu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna. Ŋkpal men ka tiŋ m mɔ men be mbinyɛnbi nɛ men daana nɛ men sipoana so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛfa menyi kabre.” 30Kumo be ŋklade kachipurso nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ basa na le: “Men wora kulubi gboŋgboŋi ga, ama meeŋ naŋ bɛta n dii kebee na so n ya kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋ keni ashere e beeŋ ta men be alubi m paŋ menyi.” 31Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis bɛta n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo: “Kashenteŋto, basa na wora kulubi gboŋgboŋi, ŋkpal manɛ so b ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ bumo gbagba be ebɔrɛ nsaa shuŋ kumo. 32Jande ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo, nɛ loŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora, kumo ere fo lara ma ketre ashi kawɔl nɛ fo sibɛ fo basa be atre n wɔtɔ na to.” 33Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis: “Bekama nɛ b wora alubi ŋ gbiti ma na be atre nɛ mee lara ashi kawɔl na to. 34Amoso, bɛta n ya juŋkpar basa na n yɔ kakpa nɛ ŋ ŋini fo na nsaa nyi fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ ma malaika e baa juŋkpar menyi, ama meeŋ gberge basa na kusoe kachako, ŋkpal bumo be kulubi na so.” 35Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bar kulɔ lubi ko m ba lɛ basa na so, ŋkpal b ka daŋ nyaŋ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ e lɔŋɛ shuwa be kenabi na so.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 33
Content:
Israɛlebi ka lar Sainai be kebee na ase be asheŋ
1Kachako nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis: “Fo nɛ basa nɛ fo juŋkpar n lar Ijipt be kasawule so na e koso nfe n yɔ efuli nɛ n nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ ta n sa Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi kikɛ na so. 2Loŋ be kasawule na e kɔ kanya alegaiso nsaa wora ajibi nɛnɛ na. Meeŋ shin nɛ ma malaika e juŋkpar menyi nɛ men ju Keenanebi nɛ Amɔriebi nɛ Hitebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Hivebi nɛ Jebusiebi na kikɛ ashi loŋ be kasawule na so. 3Ama ma ere gbagba bre maaŋ naŋ tu menyi n yɔ, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ meeŋ mur menyi ekpa to n loge, ŋkpal men be amukpakpaso so.” 4Basa na ka nu loŋ be baru lubi na nɛ b fara a shu keeli nsaa lara bumo be shuwa be abitasɔ nɛ b daŋ wɔtɔ na a lɛ. 5B daŋ wora ade kikɛ nna ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le so: “Men la amukpakpasowuraana nna. M baŋ tu menyi n yɔ anishito gbrɛ kama gba, meeŋ mur menyi kuraa, amoso ekama e lara mbe abitasɔ mo so pɔɛŋ nɛ n yili kusɔ nɛ meeŋ wora menyi na.” 6Amoso b ka baŋ lar Sainai be kebee na ase n yɔ anishito, Israɛlebi na maŋ naŋ wɔtɔ shuwa ŋko gbiti be abitasɔ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be asheŋ
7Saŋkama nɛ Israɛlebi na baŋ ya yuu bumo be keeyi, Mosis daa ta wajɛbu ko nna n lar ekarso m barga n yuu ŋ kɔr nsaa tre kumo, ‘nshɛr be wajɛbu.’ Ekama nɛ e daa sha kekule Ebɔrɛ daa yɔ nshɛr be wajɛbu na ase nna n ya kule. 8Saŋkama malɛ nɛ Mosis lar a yɔ nshɛr be wajɛbu na ase, basa na kikɛ bee lar nna n yili bumo be ewajɛbuana be mbuna to a keni mo loŋ hale nɛ e ya luri kumo to. 9Mosis malɛ baŋ luri nshɛr be wajɛbu na to, kuwɔlpa nɛ k niŋi serr fanɛ shabɔrɛ na bee ba nna m ba yili wajɛbu na be kabuna to nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e bɔla kuwɔlpa na to nɛ mo nɛ Mosis e malga. 10Saŋkama nɛ basa na baŋ wu kuwɔlpa na ka yili nshɛr be wajɛbu na be kabuna to, bumo kikɛ bee gbir bumo be wajɛbu be kabuna to nna a bunyaŋ. 11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ Mosis daa malga abar kutɔ nna fanɛ esa nɛ mo teri na. Kumo be kaman nɛ Mosis e bɛta m ba keeyi to. Mbe kayɛrbi, nɛ baa tre Joshuwa nɛ e la Nun pibinyɛn na bre daa shir a wɔ nshɛr be wajɛbu na to nna.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ baa wɔ mbe basa kutɔ be asheŋ
12Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ le: “Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ fo e kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n ya keta basa ere n yɔ kɔnɔ naseso be kasawule na so, ama fo alɛ maŋ ŋini ma esa nɛ e beeŋ ba chɛ ma to. Fo baŋ kaŋɛ ma nna fanɛ: ‘N nyi fo nɛnɛ nɛ fo asheŋ bee par ma.’ 13To, nɛ ma shɛŋ bee par fo bre, ŋini ma fo ekpaana nɛ m pin fo nfɛra, nsaa shuŋ fo a wora fo aparsheŋ. Baa nyiŋi fanɛ fo gbagba e lara basa ere nɛ b la feya.” 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “Meeŋ tu fo n yɔ, nɛ fo kagbene e wushi.” 15Nɛ Mosis malɛ kaŋɛ mo: “Nɛ fo baa maaŋ tu anyi n yɔ, kumo ere, fo sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ an lar nfe. 16Nɛ fo maŋ tu anyi n yɔ, nuso nɛ esa beeŋ wora m pin ma nɛ fo basa be asheŋ ka bee par fo? Fo kebaawɔ anyi kutɔ e naaŋ shin nɛ an baa kɔr bomin kikɛ to ashi durnya ere to.” 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis: “Ŋkpal ŋ ka nyi fo nɛnɛ nɛ fo asheŋ malɛ bee par ma so, meeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ na gbagba chap.” 18Kede be kaman nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ: “Kumo ere, jande, shin nɛ n wu fo kemaŋkura.” 19Nɛ e kaŋɛ Mosis: “Meeŋ shin nɛ ma kemankura kikɛ e bɔla fo anishito n choŋ nɛ n ti ma ketre ŋ ŋini fo. Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ mee wu kuwɔr nsaa lara ma kasha a ŋini bekama nɛ n lara na. 20Ama m maaŋ shin nɛ fo wu ma anishito bre, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n wu ma anishito nseŋ ji efute. 21Amoso yili kefalta ere ase, 22saŋɛ na so nɛ ma kemaŋkura na ba kaa choŋ, meeŋ ta fo n wɔtɔ kefalta laŋ to n ta ma enɔ m buu fo so pɔɛŋ nseŋ choŋ. 23Kumo be kaman nɛ m bugi ma enɔ ashi fo so nɛ fo wu ma kaman, ama fo maaŋ wu ma anishito bre.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 34
Content:
Ajembu pantraŋ pantrambi popɔr na be asheŋ
(Ditɛronɔmi 10:1-5)
1Asheŋ nɛ a wora na be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis: “Naŋ ku ajembu pantraŋ pantrambi anyɔ nɛ a baa du fanɛ sososo peya na nɛ n naŋ sibɛ mmalga koŋwule nɛ n daŋ sibɛ adra nɛ fo bure na so na n deŋi amo so. 2Wora shiriya echefo kachipurso m ba tu ma Sainai be kebee na be esoso. 3Esa kama e sa maŋ kaŋ tu fo m ba kebee na be esoso ŋko n shin nɛ n wu mo ashi kebee na ekpa kikɛ. Sa maŋ shin nɛ mbolpɔ ŋko mboe ŋko ana gba e ji m mata kebee na.” 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis shɛl ajembu anyɔ na fanɛ sososo peya na gbagba chap. Kumo be ŋklade kachipurso nɛ e wule ŋ koso n ta amo n yɔ Sainai be kebee na so, kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baŋ kaŋɛ mo na gbagba chap. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bɔla kuwɔlpa to m ba yili Mosis kutɔ ndoŋ nseŋ ti mbe ketre cheembi na: ‘Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ.’ 6nseŋ choŋ Mosis be anishito ŋ kaŋɛ awɔrso: “Ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ. Ebɔrɛ nɛ kuwɔrwu bɔlɔ ma to nɛ m maa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ nɛ ma kasha shi ga nɛ mee yɛ nsaa wora na. 7Ma e naa ŋini benananyɛn ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto kasha nsaa ta basa be edalubi nɛ kumukpakpaso nɛ alubi a paŋ bumo na. Ama ma alɛ maa kplaŋ alubiworapoana be kewora n jija so a maa gberge bumo kusoe. Ma e naa kpal betuto nɛ benio be alubi so e gberge bumo be mbia kusoe hale n ya fo bumo be kenanafofo nɛ kenana gbiramuli na.” 8Epul na to nɛ Mosis gbir m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na 9nseŋ kaŋɛ: “O, n Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ ma asheŋ bee par fo, kumo ere mee kule fo nna nɛ fo tu anyi n yɔ. N nyi basa ere ka kɔ amu kpakpaso, ama ta anyi be ashuŋ lubi nɛ alubi kikɛ m paŋ anyi nseŋ ta anyi ŋ ki fo gbagba be basa.”
Kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre popɔr na be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 23:14-19; Ditɛronɔmi 7:1-5; 16:1-17)
10Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis: “Naniere ma nɛ Israɛlebi wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre, ma alɛ beeŋ wora asheŋgboŋ nɛ a maŋ naŋ wora basa kama to ashi durnya to kikɛ bumo be anishito. Efuliana nɛ a kulti menyi na be basa beeŋ wu asheŋ tumase nɛ a bee keta kufu nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ wora n sa menyi. 11Amoso, nɛ men bɛ ma mmalga nɛ mee ta a sa menyi kabre ere so, meeŋ ju Amɔriebi nɛ Keenanebi nɛ Hitebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Hivebi nɛ Jebusiebi ashi kasawule ere so. 12Ama men baa da so nɛ menyi nɛ kasawule na so be basa e sa maŋ kaŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre kikɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ men wora loŋ, k beeŋ ki katiyɛ lubi m pɛ menyi. 13Ama men bure m bure bumo be agbirana nɛ amo be elambuana nseŋ ku kegbirche Ashira be ndulgi be ndibiana na n lɛ. 14Men sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ kegbir kama, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ ma nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maa ji kechamana na. 15Men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ menyi nɛ kasawule na so be basa e wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre kikɛ, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, b baa lɔŋɛ bumo be agbirana, baaŋ tre menyi n fule menyi nɛ men ji agbirjibi na be ako. 16Men baŋ ta kasawule na so be mbichesobi n sa men be mbinyɛnsobi loŋ be mbichebi nɛ baa bɛ agbir so na beeŋ shin nɛ men be mbinyɛnsobi na gba e shuŋ bumo be agbir na. 17Men sa maŋ kaŋ ta kebɛlso n lɔŋɛ kegbir a bunyaŋ kumo. 18Men baa bɛ bodobodo nɛ k maŋ kɔ yiisi be daŋkare be kejigboŋ na so fanɛ kananɛ n nase n sa menyi na. Kufɔl nɛ baa tre Abib na baŋ fo, men we bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi bɔkwe lelemu, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be kufɔl na to nɛ men daŋ lar Ijipt be kasawule so. 19Menyi alɛ e baa nyi fanɛ men be wurkoŋnyɛn kikɛ, n ta men be asɔbɔya fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ mboe nɛ ana gba peya n ti so, la meya nna. 20Ama men ta kubolpɔbi n tal kurma bre peya to nɛ mannɛ aloŋ men bu kumo be kubɔ. Ama men be wurkoŋ nyɛnso bre, menyee tɔ bumo nna n yige.
Men be ekama malɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ ta enɔfuloŋ m ba ma anishito m ba bunyaŋ ma. 21Nchɛnshe e daga fanɛ men ta n shuŋ menyi be ashuŋ nseŋ wushi kachɛ shunusopo na. Hale k la kudɔ ŋko kasɔteŋi be saŋɛ gba, a daga fanɛ men wushi kumo be kamɔnchɛ. 22Men baŋ ba kaa teŋi men be ayu juŋkparsoana na, men wora Kasɔteŋi be daŋkare be Kejigboŋ na. Kafɛ na malɛ naŋ ya kaa fo ekar nɛ menyee chala men be adɔjibi na, men wora Abuu to be daŋkare be Kejigboŋ na malɛ. 23Ade kikɛ be buushi, kafɛ kikɛ to ale asa nɛ men be benyɛn beeŋ ba bunyaŋ ma Enyɛnpetale Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na. 24Meeŋ ju efuli pɔtɛana be basa kikɛ nseŋ kpalga men be kasawule to. Esa kama malɛ beeŋ baa ŋana keta men be nsawule jemanɛ nɛ men yɔ nɛ men ya bunyaŋ ma, men Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ale asa kafɛ kikɛ to na. 25Men sa maŋ kaŋ ta kusɔ kama nɛ k kɔ yiisi n ti kusɔbɔya so n lara sarga n sa ma. Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ Kebansonchoŋ be Kejigboŋ be kusɔbɔya be eblaŋ kama e yili ŋklade. 26Kafɛ kikɛ men baa ta men be adɔjibi nɛ menyee juŋkpar n teŋi a ba ma, Enyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na be kowu to. Men sa maŋ kaŋ ta kusɔbɔya kikɛ be kenyipochu n daŋɛ kumo pibi.” 27Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ Mosis le: “Sibɛ mmalga nɛ ma nɛ fo nɛ Israɛlebi na yili so n wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na n nase.” 28Nchɛ adena nɛ nnyɛ adena nɛ Mosis daŋ ta a wɔ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nsaa maa ji ŋko a nuu. Loŋ be saŋɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ sibɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be mmalga na n deŋi ajembu pantraŋ pantrambi anyɔ na so. Amo e la mbra kudu na.
Mosis ka shi kebee na so m ba be asheŋ
29Mosis ka daŋ shi Sainai be kebee na so ŋ keta Mbra Kudu na m ba na, mbe anishiakpa daa kpa edɛ nna ŋkpal e ka yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito nɛ mo nɛ mo malga na so, ama mo alɛ daa maŋ nyi mbe anishiakpa ka du loŋ. 30Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Israɛlebi nɛ b ka na kikɛ ka wu kananɛ mbe anishiakpa bee kpa edɛ na, nɛ kufu pɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ tiŋ nɛ b yɔ mo kutɔ. 31Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis tre bumo nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nɛ basa na be bejuŋkparpoana na kikɛ ba mo kutɔ nɛ mo nɛ bumo malga. 32Kumo be kaman nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ ba shɛr ŋ kulti mo nɛ e ta mbra nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa mo Sainai be kebee na so na kikɛ n sa bumo. 33Mosis ka malga bumo kutɔ n loge nɛ e ta shata m buu mbe anishi so. 34Ama saŋkama nɛ Mosis bee yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito ashi nshɛr be wajɛbu na to nɛ mo nɛ mo e ya malga, e bee bugi shata na nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ e baŋ lar m ba nɛ e ba kaŋɛ Israɛlebi kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na, 35baa wu mbe anishiakpa ka bee kpa edɛ nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ Mosis naŋ ta shata na m buu hale n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ e beeŋ naŋ yɔ n ya malga Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 35
Content:
Kewushiachɛ na be asheŋ
1Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Mosis tre Israɛlebi na kikɛ m ba shɛr ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Asɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yili fanɛ men baa wora nde: 2Nchɛnshe e daga fanɛ men shuŋ menyi be ashuŋ. Kachɛ shunusopo na bre la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be Kewushiachɛ cheembi nna. Esa kama nɛ e shuŋ kushuŋ kama kamɔnchɛ, daga fanɛ b mɔ mo. 3Men sa maŋ kaŋ puga edɛ gba menyi be elaŋana to loŋ be kachɛ na.”
Asɔ nɛ baaŋ ta n lɔŋɛ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 25:1-9)
4Kede be kaman nɛ Mosis naŋ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ le: “Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ nde: 5‘Men lara kusɔ kama be kakɛ m bar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Esa kama nɛ e yili kumo mbe kagbene to fanɛ e beeŋ bar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kakɛ, e bar shuwa ŋko gbiti ŋko danyaŋ 6ŋko ago be jese lela ŋko buru be jese ŋko jese peper kpaw ŋko ejese peper kunɔkunɔ ŋko ago be wajɛchɛbi mɔlmɔlbi ŋko wajɛ nɛ b ta kaboe be afuibi n wora 7ŋko kpakpa be kawɔl nɛ b nyɔɔ kepeper ŋko churu be kawɔl nɛ b gbiti nɛnɛ ŋko akasiadibi 8ŋko ɔlif be ŋku nɛ baaŋ baa ta a chɔɔ efitila so ŋko asɔ nɛ baa ta a wora ŋku nɛfaso ŋko efɛa belbelso be duwu 9ŋko yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso nɛ amo nɛ baa tre ɔniks na ŋko amaŋkanibi nɛ baa ta a mata bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be piŋi nɛ baa tre ɛfɔd na nɛ demuji be kɔlgu na so na.’ ”
Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na to be asɔ be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 39:3-43)
10“Amoso, menyi to be bekama nɛ b nyi ashuŋwurbi be kushuŋ na e ba m ba wora asɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ere: 11Loŋ be asɔ na e la Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na nɛ kumo be buuso nɛ kumo be akɔltobi nɛ kumo be eshabɔrɛ nɛ elarbeŋ nɛ eyɔri nɛ ndibi yuuso nɛ amo be atɔl, 12nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na nɛ kumo be ndibi nɛ b kɔ a ta kumo na nɛ kumo be buuso nɛ baa tre kuwɔr be kakpa na nɛ patisa kuŋso na 13nɛ teebɔl na nɛ kumo be ndibi nɛ b kɔ a ta kumo na nɛ kumo be asɔwurbi kikɛ nɛ bodobodo nɛ b kɔ a lara sarga a sa Ebɔrɛ na, 14nɛ kefitilatɔl nɛ efitila na nɛ amo be ŋku nɛ asɔwurbi 15nɛ duwu be bɔrɛsure na nɛ kumo be ndibi nɛ b kɔ a ta kumo nɛ ŋku nɛfaso nɛ efɛa belbelso be duwu nɛ wajɛbu na be kabuna to be patisa na 16nɛ sarga chɔɔso be bɔrɛsure nɛ kumo be danyaŋ be kenyembi ŋeseasɔ nɛ kumo be ndibi nɛ b kɔ a ta kumo na nɛ kumo be asɔwurbi kikɛ nɛ danyaŋ be katishaŋgboŋ nɛ kumo be ketɔl 17nɛ kelɔnɛ na be epatisa nɛ kumo be ndibi yuuso nɛ amo be atɔl nɛ kumo be kabuna to be patisa 18nɛ wajɛbu na nɛ kelɔnɛ na be ayirbi nɛ amo be efɔlana 19nɛ epiŋi lueso lela cheembi nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn beeŋ baa buu saŋɛ nɛ baa shuŋ wajɛbu cheembi na to na.”
Basa na ka bar bumo be ŋkɛ be asheŋ
20Le be mmalga ere be kaman nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ lar Mosis kutɔ. 21Ekama nɛ e daa sha kesa kusɔ ko, daŋ bar mbe kakɛ nna fanɛ b ta n wora Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na nɛ asɔbuuso cheembi na. 22Beche nɛ benyɛn kikɛ, daŋ bar shuwa be akonde nɛ mpinibi nɛ abɔtoshembi nɛ abitasɔ be yiri yiri kikɛ nna m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 23Bumo to be ekama nɛ e daa kɔ ago be jese lela nɛ buru be jese nɛ jese peper kpaw nɛ ejese peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ago be wajɛchɛbi mɔlmɔlbi nɛ kaboe be afuibi be wajɛ nɛ kpakpa be kawɔl nɛ b nyɔɔ kepeper nɛ churu be kawɔl daŋ bar kumo nna. 24Bekama malɛ nɛ b daa beeŋ tiŋ n nya gbiti ŋko danyaŋ daŋ bar amo m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fanɛ bumo be kakɛ, ekama malɛ nɛ e daa kɔ akasiadibi nɛ k beeŋ tiŋ n shuŋ kushuŋ na gba daŋ bar kumo. 25Bumo to be beche nyiashempo nɛ b nyi kafɛaŋ na kikɛ daŋ bar ago be ejese lela nɛ ejese nɛ a la buru nɛ ejese peper kpaw nɛ ejese peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ago be wajɛchɛbi mɔlmɔlbi nɛ kusɔbɔya be afuibi peper nna. 26Beche na to be bekama nɛ b daa sha kechɛto n shuŋ nsaa kɔ kafɛaŋ be kenyi daŋ ta mboe be afuibi nna n wora ejese. 27Bejuŋkparpoana na malɛ daŋ bar yawukpakpaso be ajembu be yiriyiri nɛ baa ta amo a mata bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be ɛfɔd nɛ mbe demuji be kɔlgu na so nna. 28B daŋ bar efɛa belbelso be asɔ warabi nɛ b ta n wea ɔlif be ŋku to a wɔtɔ efitila na nɛ ŋku nɛfaso na to. 29Israɛlebi na be benyɛn nɛ beche nɛ b daa sha nɛ b chɛ kushuŋ na to na, daa bar bumo be ŋkɛ nna fanɛ b ta n shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kushuŋ nɛ e ta n sa Mosis na.
Basa nɛ baaŋ wora Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be kushuŋ be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 31:1-11)
30Ade be kaman nɛ Mosis kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na le: “Men nu nfe, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara Besalɛl nɛ e la Yuri pibinyɛn nsaa la Hur mo nanabi na nna ashi Juda be kanaŋ to na 31n ta mbe kiyoyu n wɔtɔ mo to nseŋ sa mo kasɔwora kikɛ be kenyi nɛ ketiŋ n wora be eleŋ nɛ kasɔlɔŋɛ be kepinto kikɛ nyam be nfɛra. 32Saŋɛ na so e beeŋ baa tiŋ a ta nfɛra a chaŋ asɔ nsaa ta shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ a lɔŋɛ asɔ na 33nsaa tiŋ a shɛl yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso a nyisi a wɔtɔ amo be mpinibi to nseŋ naa tiŋ a ta ndibi a shɛl asɔ. 34Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa mo ere Besalɛl nɛ Oholiab nɛ e la Ahisamak pibinyɛn ashi Dan be kanaŋ to na kenyi nna nɛ b tiŋ n ta bumo be kasɔwora be kenyi na ŋ ŋini basa pɔtɛ. 35E sa bumo kasɔwora be kenyi nna nɛ b baa tiŋ a ta ago be jese lela nɛ buru be jese nɛ jese peper kpaw nɛ ejese peper kunɔkunɔ a jɔ asɔ ŋko a lue ewajɛ be yiriyiri. Bumo alɛ bee tiŋ a wora ashuŋ be yiriyiri kikɛ nyam nsaa tiŋ a ji asɔ kebita kenyiso.”

Title: ƐKSODƆS 36
Content:
1Besalɛl nɛ Oholiab nɛ bekama nɛ mo ere Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa kenyi nɛ kepinto nɛ b nyi kusɔ kama nɛ k daga fanɛ b wora a laŋɛ wajɛbu cheembi na be kaplɛa so na beeŋ wora asheŋ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ gbagba chap.
Israɛlebi na ka bar bumo be ŋkɛana be asheŋ
2Kumo be kaman nɛ Mosis tre Besalɛl nɛ Oholiab nɛ benyiashempo kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ sa kasɔwora be kenyi nɛ basa nɛ baa sha kechɛto n shuŋ na kikɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b fara kushuŋ na. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis ta ŋkɛ nɛ Israɛlebi na bugi ŋgbene n lara m ba fanɛ b ta n shuŋ wajɛbu cheembi na be kushuŋ na kikɛ m bɔɔ bumo enɔ. Ama karechɛ kikɛ, Israɛlebi na daŋ baa bar ŋkɛ nna m ba kaa sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. 4Kumo be kaman nɛ benyiashempo nɛ b daa wora wajɛbu cheembi na be kushuŋ na yɔ Mosis kutɔ 5n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Keni, basa na kraŋ baa bar ŋkɛ nna, hale naniere gba asɔ na naŋ baŋ so kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ an ta n wora kushuŋ na.” 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mosis sa ebɔl keeyi na to fanɛ ekama e sa maŋ naŋ bar kusɔ kama a yɔ wajɛbu cheembi na be kewora be kaplɛa so. Kumo be kaman pɔɛŋ nɛ basa na yige kenaabar asɔ, 7ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔ nɛ b daŋ bar na gba daa beeŋ tiŋ n shuŋ kushuŋ na kanaŋkamaso.
Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu be keyu be asheŋ
(Ɛksodɔs 26:1-37)
8Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ basa nɛ b daa shuŋ kushuŋ na be bumo nɛ b daa kɔ kenyi na, lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na. B daŋ ta ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi nɛ ejese nɛ a la buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nna n lue epatisa kudu nseŋ shin nɛ esa nɛ e nyi kajɔ ta kebasibi nɛ jese n jɔ n jɔ chɛrubim n deŋi n deŋi epatisa na so. 9Epatisa na kikɛ daa sasa nna. Amo be kekama be nteŋ to daa la fanɛ ayadra adena nɛ anyɔ nɛ amo be mparto malɛ daa la ayadra ashe nna. 10B daŋ baa epatisa na be anunu nna n chɛ abar so. 11Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta wajɛchɛbi buru m baa asɔ kulkulbi fanɛ afirgi na m mata m mata epatisagboŋ anyɔ na be akel to. 12B baa wajɛ buru be afirgi adunu m mata patisagboŋ ko be kekilso nseŋ baa adunu malɛ m mata kenyɔsopo na be kekilso nɛ afirgi na karga abar so nseŋ shoŋi abar. 13Ade malɛ be kaman nɛ b ta shuwa m bel akɔltobi adunu, ŋ kɔl epatisagboŋ anyɔ na be afirgi adununu na to, nɛ epatisagboŋ anyɔ na ki wajɛbu koŋwule. 14Kumo alɛ be kaman nɛ b ta mboe be afuibi n lue ewajɛ kudukako nɛ a ki Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be buuso. 15B daŋ shin nɛ amo kikɛ sasa nna nɛ amo be kekama be nteŋ la ayadra adena nɛ anyɔ nɛ mpar malɛ la ayadra ashe, 16nɛ b baa ewajɛ na be anu n chɛ abar so nɛ a ki patisagboŋ koŋwule nseŋ baa ashe nɛ a ka na malɛ nɛ a ki patisagboŋ koŋwule 17nseŋ baa asɔ kulkulbi fanɛ afirgi na be adununu n chɛ m mata m mata epatisagboŋ anyɔ na be akel so. 18Amo be kaman nɛ b ta danyaŋ m bɛl akɔltobi adunu, nseŋ ta amo ŋ kɔl afirgi adununu na to, nɛ epatisagboŋ anyɔ na ki koŋwule. 19Ade be kaman nɛ b naŋ ta ekpakpa be nwɔl nɛ b nyɔɔ m pere n lɔŋɛ wajɛbu na be buuso nyɔsopo, nseŋ ta echuru be nwɔl nɛ b gbiti nɛnɛ ŋ ki kumo be lalaloge be buuso. 20Kumo alɛ be kaman nɛ b ta akasiadibi niŋiso ŋ ki Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be ndibi yuuso. 21Ndibi yuuso na be kekama be nteŋ to daa la ayadra kuduanu nna nɛ amo be bumburuŋ malɛ daa la ayadra anyɔ. 22Nɛ b gbir ayir anyɔnyɔ ndibi yuuso na be kekama ase nɛ ayir na bɛ abar so. Loŋ nɛ b daŋ yuu Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be ndibi yuuso na kikɛ. 23B daŋ yuu ndibi yuuso na be adunyɔ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nna. 24B daŋ ta gbiti nna n lɔŋɛ ndibi yuuso na be atɔl adena, nɛ atɔl anyɔ wɔ kedibi yuuso kama be kaseto. 25Kede be kaman nɛ b yuu ndibi yuuso adunyɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so, 26nseŋ lɔŋɛ gbiti be atɔl adena nɛ atɔl anyɔ wɔ kedibi yuuso kama be kaseto. 27Kumo be kaman nɛ b lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so malɛ be ndibi yuuso ashe, 28nɛ kumo be abonfu to be ndibi yuuso anyɔnyɔ 29nseŋ shin nɛ a fara kaseto m mata abar hale n ya fo esoso nɛ b ta kepinibi n wɔtɔ amo to esoso. 30Amo so ndibi yuuso na daŋ wora aburwa nna na nɛ amo be gbiti be atɔl malɛ wora kuduashe. Atɔl na be anyɔnyɔ e wɔ ndibi yuuso na be kekama be kaseto. 31Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ b ta akasiadibi blɔmbi tentembi kuduanu ŋ ki ndibi deŋiso, nseŋ ta amo be anunu n deŋi Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be kelargato be esoso nɛ kaseto be ndibi yuuso na so 32nseŋ ta anu malɛ n deŋi kumo be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be ndibi yuuso na so. 33B daŋ shin nɛ kedibi deŋiso nɛ k wɔ ndibi blɔmbi deŋiso anu na be nferinto na fara kebonfu ko nna n ya fo kuko. 34Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta shuwa m mata ndibi yuuso na kikɛ so nseŋ ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ amo be mpinibi nɛ a bee pɛ ndibi blɔmbi deŋiso na to a keta na, nseŋ ta shuwa m mata ndibi blɔmbi deŋiso na gba so. 35Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ b ta ejese nɛ a la buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi n lue patisa nseŋ shin nɛ esa nɛ e nyi kajɔ ta kebasibi nɛ jese n jɔ n jɔ chɛrubim na n deŋi n deŋi epatisa na so. 36Nseŋ ta akasiadibi n lɔŋɛ ndibi yuuso ana n ta shuwa m mata amo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ amo be akɔltobi nseŋ ta gbiti n lɔŋɛ amo be atɔl ana. 37B daŋ shin nna nɛ esa nɛ e nyi kalue ta ejese buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi n lue Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kabuna be patisa na nseŋ jɔɔ kumo. 38Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta patisa na n shiga akasiadibi yuuso anu nɛ b ta shuwa m mata amo so nɛ a kɔ shuwa be akɔltobi nɛ danyaŋ be atɔl anu na so.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 37
Content:
Kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka be asheŋ
1Besalɛl daŋ ta akasiadibi n lɔŋɛ deka nɛ kumo be nteŋ to la ayadra ana nɛ bargato nɛ mparto malɛ la ayadra anyɔ nɛ jeŋgreŋ la ayadra anyɔ. 2Kumo be kaman nɛ e ta shuwa gbagba m mata m mata deka na be epunto nɛ kaman kikɛ nseŋ lɔŋɛ shuwa be kekrande m mata kumo ŋ kulti 3nseŋ bɛl shuwa be mpinibi ana n wɔtɔ kumo be aya ana na to. 4E ka wora loŋ n loge na nɛ e naŋ shɛl akasiadibi tenteŋ anyɔ nseŋ ta shuwa m mata m mata amo so. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ e yisi ndibi na n wɔtɔ mpinibi nɛ a wɔ deka na be akel to na to nɛ b baa pɛ to a maŋ kumo so. 6Kede be kaman nɛ e ta shuwa gbagba n lɔŋɛ deka na be buuso nɛ baa tre kuwɔr be kakpa na nɛ kumo be nteŋ to la ayadra ana nɛ mparto malɛ la ayadra anyɔ. 7Kumo alɛ be kaman nɛ e bɛa shuwa to n lɔŋɛ chɛrubim anyɔ n yuu kuwɔr be kakpa na be nteŋ to be ekarso na. 8E lɔŋɛ chɛrubim anyɔ na nna nɛ amo nɛ buuso na kikɛ la kukoŋwule. 9Chɛrubim na daŋ kilgi anishito nna n shoŋi abar nseŋ parga atɛ to m buu deka na be buuso na so.
Teebɔl na be asheŋ
10Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta akasiadibi n lɔŋɛ teebɔl nɛ kumo be nteŋ to la ayadra asa nɛ mparto la keyadra koŋwule nɛ bargato, nɛ jeŋgreŋ malɛ la ayadra anyɔ, 11nseŋ ŋalga shuwa n wurge kumo kikɛ so 12nseŋ naŋ ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ kekrande nɛ kumo be mpar sa fanɛ enɔ be mparto ŋ kulti kumo be ekarso kikɛ. 13-14Kumo be kaman nɛ b wora shuwa be mpinibi ana n chɔga teebɔl na be abonfu ana be aya na kikɛ so, saŋɛ na so baaŋ baa ta ndibi nɛ b shɛl na a wɔtɔ amo to a maŋ teebɔl na so. 15B ta akasiadibi nna n shɛl ndibi nɛ baaŋ pɛ to a maŋ teebɔl na so a keta na nseŋ ŋalga shuwa n wurge amo kikɛ so. 16Nɛ b ta shuwa gbagba n lɔŋɛ teebɔl na so be eprete nɛ mba nɛ echeenshi nɛ kapugboŋ nɛ baa ta sarga be asɔnuuso a wɔtɔ na.
Kefitilatɔl na be asheŋ
17B ta shuwa gbagba nna m bɛl kefitilatɔl na nɛ kumo be ayabi nɛ a kɔ asɔ ko fanɛ atoto be alambu na nɛ amo kikɛ la kukoŋwule. 18B daŋ wora kefitilatɔl na be ayabi na ashe nna nɛ amo be asa daa yuu kekel ko so nɛ asa malɛ yuu kekel nɛ k ka na so. 19Ayabi ashe na be kekama daa kɔ asɔ ko nɛ a du fanɛ atoto be alambu na be asa nna. 20Kefitilatɔl na be nteto na malɛ gbagba daa kɔ asɔ nɛ a du fanɛ atoto be alambu na be ana nna. 21Nɛ ayabi asa nɛ a bee barga to a ki anyɔnyɔ na be kekama be kaseto gba daa kɔ atoto be kelambu na be kukoŋwule. 22B daŋ ŋalga shuwa gbagba nna n lɔŋɛ kefitilatɔl na nɛ kumo be ayabi na, nɛ amo kikɛ la kukoŋwule. 23B ta shuwa gbagba n lɔŋɛ efitila wurbi ashunu nɛ asɔ nɛ baa ta a lɔŋɛ efitila na be achɛbi so nɛ eprete nɛ b kɔ a suse amo be nsunɔ na. 24Shuwa gbagba nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo adesa nɛ anu nɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ kefitilatɔl na nɛ kumo be kusɔ kama nyam.
Duwu be bɔrɛsure be asheŋ
25B daŋ ta akasiadibi nna n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ baaŋ ba chɔɔ duwu kumo so. Kumo be nteŋ to nɛ mparto kikɛ daa sasa fanɛ keyadra koŋwule nɛ bargato nna nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ daa la ayadra asa. B daŋ wora kumo be esoso be abonfu ana na nna fanɛ alambɛ n shin nɛ amo nɛ kumo kikɛ chɔ abar so a la kukoŋwule. 26B daŋ ta shuwa gbagba nna m mata kumo be awɔlto nɛ akel to nɛ alambɛ na kikɛ so ŋ kulti, nseŋ ŋalga shuwa ŋ kulti kumo be nnɔkar kikɛ nɛ a du gbuntelin. 27Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ mpinibi anyɔ n chɔga kumo be akel to, shuwa gbuntelin na be kaseto, a yisi ndibi tentembi na a wɔtɔ amo to a maŋ kumo so. 28Akasiadibi nɛ b daŋ ta n shɛl ndibi tentembi na nseŋ ta shuwa m mata amo kikɛ so. 29Ade be kaman nɛ basa nɛ b nyi tulale be kewora wora ŋku nɛfaso nɛ efɛa belbelso be duwu.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 38
Content:
Sarga chɔɔso be bɔrɛsure be asheŋ
1Kede be kaman b daŋ naŋ ta akasiadibi nna n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure n shin nɛ kumo be nteŋ to nɛ mparto kikɛ sasa nsaa la ayadra ashunu nɛ bargato, nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ la ayadra ana nɛ bargato. 2B daŋ wora kumo be esoso be abonfu ana na nɛ a du fanɛ alambɛ nna nseŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛsure na nɛ alambɛ na kikɛ chɔga abar so a la kukoŋwule. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta danyaŋ m mata bɔrɛsure na kikɛ so. 3Kumo be kaman nɛ b naŋ ta danyaŋ n lɔŋɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ kumo so fanɛ nsunɔ be mpuliya nɛ eshabɔl nɛ ntishaŋgboŋ, nɛ kusɔ nɛ baa ta a chule eblaŋ nɛ kusɔ chɔɔ edɛ. 4-5Amo be kaman nɛ b naŋ ta danyaŋ n lɔŋɛ kusɔ ŋeseasɔ nseŋ lɔŋɛ danyaŋ be mpinibi ana m mata kumo be abonfu ana na kikɛ so. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta kusɔ ŋeseasɔ na n wɔtɔ bɔrɛsure na be nferinto. 6Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta akasiadibi n shɛl ndibi tenteŋ nɛ baaŋ baa ta a sulɔ bɔrɛsure na nseŋ ta danyaŋ n mata amo so. 7B daa ta amo nna a yisi n wɔtɔ bɔrɛsure na be akel to be mpinibi anyɔ na to a ta kumo. B daŋ ta ndibi peŋgeleŋ peŋgeleŋ nna n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure na nɛ k kɔ kelaŋ kumo to.
Eyurso be kefɔr be katishaŋgboŋ
8B daŋ ŋalga beche nɛ baa shuŋ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be kabuna to be danyaŋ be edigi nna n lɔŋɛ katishaŋgboŋ na nɛ kumo be ketɔl.
Wajɛbu cheembi na be kelɔnɛ be asheŋ
9-10Kumo be kaman nɛ b lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kelɔnɛ na gba. Kumo be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so be nteŋ to daa la ayadra kalfa nɛ adunu nna nɛ b ta ago lueso lela be epatisa ŋ kulti kumo be ndibi yuuso adunyɔ nɛ a kɔ danyaŋ be atɔl adunyɔ nɛ gbiti be ayir nɛ akɔltobi nɛ a bee kɔl patisa na to. 11Nɛ kumo be kelargato be esoso be kaba so be nteŋ to malɛ gba daa la ayadra kalfa nɛ adunu nɛ b ta ago lueso lela be epatisa ŋ kulti kumo be ndibi yuuso adunyɔ nɛ a kɔ danyaŋ be atɔl adunyɔ nɛ gbiti be ayir nɛ akɔltobi nɛ a kɔl patisa na to na. 12Kelɔnɛ na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be mparto daa la ayadra adushunu nɛ anu nna, nɛ b ta ago lueso lela be epatisa ŋ kulti kumo be ndibi yuuso kudu nɛ a kɔ danyaŋ be atɔl kudu nɛ gbiti be ayir nɛ akɔltobi nɛ a kɔl patisa na to na. 13Kelɔnɛ na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be mparto malɛ daa la ayadra adushunu nɛ anu nna. 14Kumo be kabuna to be kaba ko so be patisa daa la ayadra adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nɛ bargato nna nsaa kɔ ndibi yuuso asa nɛ atɔl asa. 15Kaba nɛ k ka na malɛ gba be patisa daa la ayadra adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nɛ bargato nna nsaa kɔ ndibi yuuso asa nɛ atɔl asa. 16B daŋ ta ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi nna n lue epatisa nɛ a kulti kelɔnɛ na kikɛ 17nseŋ daŋ ta danyaŋ n lɔŋɛ ndibi yuuso be atɔl n ta gbiti n lɔŋɛ amo be ayir nɛ akɔltobi nseŋ ta gbiti m mata ndibi yuuso na gbagba so. Amoso, kelɔnɛ na be ndibi yuuso na kikɛ daa kɔ gbiti be ayir nna. 18Esa nɛ e nyi kajɔ e daŋ ta ejese nɛ a la buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi n lue Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kelɔnɛ so be kabuna to gbagba be patisa nɛ kumo be nteŋ to la ayadra adesa, nsaa kɔ ndibi yuuso ana nɛ amo be atɔl ana na. 19Ndibi yuuso ana na daa kɔ danyaŋ be atɔl ana nɛ gbiti be akɔltobi nɛ ayir nna, nɛ b ta gbiti m mata ndibi yuuso na be esoso. 20Danyaŋ nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na nɛ kelɔnɛ na kikɛ be ayir.
Asɔ nɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu be asheŋ
21-23Besalɛl nɛ e la Uri pibinyɛn nseŋ naa la Hur nɛ e shi Juda be kanaŋ to na mo nanabi na e wora kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Mosis na kikɛ. Esa nɛ e daŋ chɛ mo to e daa la Oholiab nɛ e la Ahisamak nɛ e shi Dan be kanaŋ to na pibinyɛn nɛ e kɔ enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi a tiŋ a ta ago be ejese lela nɛ ejese buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ a lue ŋko a jɔ. Asɔ nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka na nɛ asɔ nɛ a daa wɔ kumo to na be kananɛ a sa nde. Mosis e daŋ bɔla Itama nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo Ɛɛrɔn pibinyɛn na so n shin nɛ Livaiebi sibɛ amo be egbɛ nɛ kananɛ a sa. 24Shuwa nɛ basa daŋ sa fanɛ b shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be kushuŋ na be egbɛ daa la kilo kagboŋ nna. 25Gbiti nɛ b daŋ sɔ jemanɛ nɛ b daa karga basa na sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ asa nɛ alfa ana nɛ adesa nna. 26Esa kama nɛ b daŋ karga kikɛ daŋ ka kukɔ nɛ b ku na nna. Bumo alɛ daa sa fanɛ basa ŋgboŋ alfa ashe nɛ asa nɛ alfa anu nɛ adunu nseŋ ji nfɛ adunyɔ ŋko m baŋ so nna. 27Gbiti nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo adesa nɛ ana nɛ b daŋ ta n wora wajɛbu na nɛ patisa na be atɔl kalfa na. 28Gbiti nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ ndibi yuuso na be akɔltobi nɛ ayir nɛ amo nɛ b ta m mata ndibi na be esoso malɛ be egbɛ daa sa fanɛ kilo adunyɔ nna. 29Danyaŋ nɛ b daŋ sa kikɛ be egbɛ daa sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ alfa ana nɛ adunyɔ nɛ anu. 30B daŋ ta danyaŋ na be ako nna n lɔŋɛ Enyɛnpe be wajɛbu na be kabuna to be atɔl, nɛ danyaŋ be bɔrɛsure nɛ kumo be kusɔ ŋeseasɔ nɛ asɔwurbi kikɛ. 31Amo be ako nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ ndibi yuuso na be atɔl nɛ ayir kikɛ.

Title: ƐKSODƆS 39
Content:
Bɔrɛmatapoana be asɔbuuso be asheŋ
1Ejese buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nɛ b lue m baa bɔrɛmatapoana be asɔbuuso n sa Ɛɛrɔn nɛ e baa buu a luri Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na to a shuŋ fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na.
Ɛfɔd be asheŋ
2B daŋ chaŋɛ shuwa fanɛ ejese nna n wea ejese buru nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nɛ kepeper kpaw nɛ ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi to n lue m baa kale nɛ baa tre ɛfɔd na. 3B daŋ bɛa shuwa gbagba to nna ŋ kuya amo milimilibi fanɛ ejese n wea ejese buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi n lue m baa kumo. 4B daŋ lɔŋɛ kumo nɛ abatimu so be efɔl anyɔ m pɛ m pɛ ɛfɔd na be anishito nɛ kamanto m mata abar na. 5B daŋ ta shuwa be ejese nɛ ejese buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ago be ejese lela mɔlmɔlbi nna n lue ɛfɔd be kashɛr to be kreso, nɛ kumo nɛ ɛfɔd na la kukoŋwule fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na. 6Kumo be kaman nɛ b chaŋ Jeekɔb be mbinyɛnso kuduanyɔ na be atre n deŋi yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso nɛ baa tre ɔniks na be anyɔ so, nseŋ yisi amo n wɔtɔ shuwa be mpinibi na to 7nseŋ baa amo m mata ɛfɔd na be abatimu anyɔ na so, saŋɛ na so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ba wu amo nsaa nyiŋi Israɛlebi na be asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ e kaŋɛ Mosis na.
Demuji be kɔlgu be asheŋ
8Asɔ nɛ b ta m baa ɛfɔd na be ako nɛ b ta n wora kagbeneso be kɔlgu na gba nseŋ jɔ kumo fanɛ kananɛ b jɔ ɛfɔd na. 9B daŋ bɛ kechɛbi na to nna nɛ k ki kɔlgu nɛ kumo be nteŋ to nɛ mparto kikɛ daa la enɔ be mpar koŋwule nɛ bargato. 10Ade malɛ kikɛ be kaman nɛ b ta yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso n yuu n yuu kumo so nɛ a bɛ m bɛ abar so a la egbaŋ ana. Gbaŋ nɛ k juŋkpar na be ajembu nyɛkpɛso daa la amo nɛ baa tre rubi nɛ topas nɛ berɛl nna. 11Gbaŋ nyɔsopo na malɛ be ajembu daa la ajembu nyɛkpɛso nɛ baa tre turkoyis nɛ safaya nɛ ɛmeraldi nna. 12Gbaŋ sasopo malɛ be ajembu daa la amo nɛ baa tre jasinɛf nɛ agate nɛ ametiste nna. 13Nɛ gbaŋ nasopo malɛ be ajembu daa la krisolit nɛ ɔniks nɛ jaspa na. B daŋ ta shuwa nna n lɔŋɛ mpinibi kuduanyɔ nseŋ yisi n yisi ajembu na n wɔtɔ amo to. 14Ajembu nyɛkpɛso kuduanyɔ so nɛ b chaŋ n chaŋ Israɛlebi be nnaŋ kuduanyɔ na be atre n deŋi so. 15Amo be kaman nɛ b ta shuwa gbagba n lɔŋɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi lela n chulgi kɔlgu na so 16nseŋ naŋ ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ kɔlgu na be mpinibi anyɔ n chɔga kumo be esoso be nnɔkar anyɔ na so, 17nseŋ ta shuwa be ŋgbɛlɛbi anyɔ na be nnɔso anyɔ n wɔtɔ shuwa be mpinibi anyɔ nɛ a wɔ kɔlgu na be esoso be nnɔkar anyɔ na to, 18nseŋ naŋ ta nnɔso anyɔ nɛ a ka na malɛ n wɔtɔ piŋi na be mpinibi anyɔ na to. 19Amo be kaman nɛ b naŋ ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ mpinibi anyɔ n wɔtɔ kɔlgu na be kaseto be nnɔkar anyɔ nɛ a mata ɛfɔd na so. 20Kumo be kaman nɛ b naŋ lɔŋɛ shuwa be mpinibi anyɔ n wɔtɔ piŋi na be abatimu so be efɔl anyɔ na be nnɔso. 21Ade be kaman nɛ b ta efɔl farso nɛ k la buru na ŋ kɔl kɔlgu na be mpinibi na nɛ piŋi na be mpinibi na to n chɛ amo m mata abar, nɛ kɔlgu na e sa maa filito fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Mosis na.
Bɔrɛmatapoana be epiŋi nɛ a ka na be asheŋ
22Jese buru nawule nɛ b daŋ ta n lue wajɛ m ba bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be piŋi tenteŋ nɛ ɛfɔd na bee deŋi kumo so na. 23Kechɛbi lueso gbɛgbɛso nɛ b daŋ ta m muya piŋi na be kubɔ ŋ kulti nɛ k baa kɔ eleŋ. 24B daŋ ta ejeseana buru nɛ ago nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nna n lɔŋɛ asɔ kulkulbi nɛ a du fanɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre pomegranates m baa n chulgi n chulgi piŋi na be kaseto be ekarso ŋ kulti. 25Shuwa gbagba nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ adulombi n chɛ n chulgi n chulgi piŋi na be ekarso, pomegranates anyɔ kama be nferinto. 26A daŋ bɛ abar so nna ŋ kulti piŋi nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso bee buu a shuŋ kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ na kikɛ n chambɔ fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na. 27Kumo be kaman nɛ b naŋ shin nɛ esa nɛ e nyi kelue nɛnɛ ta ago be jese lela mɔlmɔlbi n lue m baa Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe bibinyɛn be edanshiki 28nɛ Ɛɛrɔn be neemu nɛ mbe bibinyɛn be nwuro nɛ bumo be ewondoŋ. 29Kede be kaman nɛ enyipo naŋ ta ejese buru nɛ ago nɛ kepeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nna m muya asɔbuuso na be kreso fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na.
30Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ b naŋ ta shuwa gbagba n lɔŋɛ kusɔ peŋgelembi nseŋ chaŋ le be nsibɛ n deŋi kumo so: ‘Cheembi n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.’ 31nseŋ ta efɔl buru ŋ kre kusɔ peŋgelembi na m mata neemu na be anishito fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na.
B ka lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be asheŋ
