11Gad be yiri na daŋ chena Baashan be kasawule so nna a yɔ Ruben be yiri na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so n ta n ya fo Saleka be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so. 12Bumo be mbuna be bejuŋkparpo e daa la Jowɛl nɛ Shaafam nɛ Janai nɛ Shaafat. 13Bumo kurgepoana ko e daa la Maikel nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Sheeba nɛ Jorai nɛ Jaakan nɛ Ziya nɛ Heba. 14B daa la Huuri nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Jarowa nɛ Giliad nɛ Maikel nɛ Jeshishai nɛ Jaado nɛ Buz pibinyɛn Abihail be kaman to ebi nna. 15Abdiɛl pibinyɛn Ahi nɛ e la Guni mo nanabi na e daa la mbuna ere be enimu. 16Bashan nɛ Giliad be kasawule so be nde to, nɛ kakpa nɛ Sharɔn be asɔbɔya bee ji nɛ Gad be basa daa wɔ. 17Saŋɛ so nɛ ewura Jotam daa ji Juda be efuli so be kuwura nɛ ewura Jeroboam nyɔsopo malɛ bee ji Israɛl be kuwura na nɛ b sibɛ bumo kanaŋ to be asheŋ ere kikɛ n wɔtɔ nwɔl to.
Epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be yiriana be benapo na be asheŋ
18Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase be basa nɛ b wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na daa kɔ benapo ŋgboŋ adena nɛ ana nɛ alfa ashunu nɛ adeshe nɛ b ŋini bumo kananɛ baa ta abɛlso be asɔ kuŋso nɛ etokobi nɛ ata nɛ atanyembi a kɔ kena. 19B daŋ ya kɔ Hagebi nɛ Jetur nɛ Nafish nɛ Nadab be eyiriana na kena nna. 20B daŋ ta bumo be yirda nna n deŋi Ebɔrɛ so ŋ kule mo fanɛ e chɛ bumo to. Nɛ Ebɔrɛ nu bumo be kekule nseŋ chɛ bumo to nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ Hagebi nɛ basa nɛ b chɛ bumo to a kɔ kena na kikɛ so. 21B ka daŋ kɔ Hagebi na kena na, b daŋ sɔ bumo enyɔma ŋgboŋ adunu nɛ mbolpɔ ŋgboŋ alfa anyɔ nɛ adunu nɛ ekurma ŋgboŋ anyɔ nseŋ pɛ basa ŋgboŋ kalfa kena na to n yɔ bumo be efuli so. 22Hag be basa damta daŋ wu kena na to nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ chɛ to ŋ kɔ bumo so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be basa sɔ bumo be efuli na n chena so n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ b pɛ bumo n yɔ Asiriya be efuli so.
Manase be yiri nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na be asheŋ
23Manase be yiri nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na daa shibi ga, ŋkpal loŋ so bumo be basa daŋ chena Bashan be efuli na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so a yɔ Baal Hɛɛmɔn nɛ Senir nɛ kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hɛɛmɔn na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so nna. 24Efa nɛ Ishi nɛ Elliɛl nɛ Azriɛl nɛ Jɛremaya nɛ Hodaviya nɛ Jadiɛl e daa la bumo be kabuna na be bejuŋkparpo. B daa la benapo lempo nna ashi bumo be kabuna na.
B ka kɔ m pɔɔ epeŋilarkpa be eyiri na so be asheŋ
25Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase be epeŋilarkpa be eyiriana na daa maa ji kashenteŋ a sa bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ shile mo n ya kaa shuŋ efuliana nɛ Ebɔrɛ ju ashi Keenan be kasawule so na be agbirana. 26Amoso Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nna nɛ Asiriya be ewura Puul nɛ mbe ketre ko bee ji Tiglaf Pilesa na, ya kɔ bumo be efuli na m pɔɔ bumo so. E daŋ pɛ Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be basa nna n tintiŋ bumo n yɔ nde wɔfɔ nɛ baa tre Haala nɛ Haabɔ nɛ Haara nɛ a mata Gozan be Lɔr na n shin nɛ b chena ndoŋ hale kabre.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 6
Content:
Bɔrɛmatapowura nimusoana be kanaŋ be asheŋ
1Livai daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e daa la Gɛshɔn nɛ Kohaf nɛ Mɛrari.
2Kohaf daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la Amram nɛ Izha nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ Uziɛl.
3Amram malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la: Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Mosis nɛ ebicheso nɛ baa tre mo Miriam.
Ɛɛrɔn daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Nadab nɛ Abihu nɛ Eliaza nɛ Itama.
4Eliaza be kaman to ebi e la Finihas nɛ Abishuwa 5nɛ Buuki nɛ Uzzi nɛ 6Zerahiya nɛ Mɛrayɔf nɛ 7Amariya nɛ Ahitub nɛ 8Zadɔk nɛ Ahimaaz nɛ 9Azariya nɛ Johanan nɛ 10Azariya mo nɛ e daa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu nɛ Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ pɔr ashi Jerusalɛm na to na, 11nɛ Amariya nɛ Ahitub nɛ 12Zadɔk nɛ Shalɔm nɛ 13Hilkiya nɛ Azariya nɛ 14Sɛraya nɛ Jehozadak. 15Ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ pɛ Jehozadak nna n tintiŋ mo n yɔ kade wɔfɔ nɛ baa tre Babilɔn saŋɛ so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ b pɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so na.
Livai be kaman to ebi ko be asheŋ
16Livai daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Gɛshɔn nɛ Kohaf nɛ Mɛrari. 17Bumo be ekama daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi. Gɛshɔn be mbia e daa la Libni nɛ Shimei. 18Kohaf malɛ be mbia e daa la Amram nɛ Iza nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ Uziɛl. 19Mɛrari malɛ be mbia e daa la Maali nɛ Muushi.
20Gɛshɔn be kaman to ebi e daa la Libni nɛ Jahaaf nɛ Zimma nɛ 21Jɔa nɛ Iddo nɛ Zɛra nɛ Jeaterai.
22Kohaf malɛ be kaman to ebi e la Aminadab nɛ Koora nɛ Asiir nɛ 23Ɛlkana nɛ Ebiasaf nɛ Asiir nɛ 24Tahaaf nɛ Yuriɛl nɛ Uziya nɛ Shawul.
25Ɛlkana daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Amasai nɛ Ahimɔf. 26Ahimɔf malɛ be kaman to ebi e daa la Ɛlkana nɛ Zofaya nɛ Nahaf nɛ 27Eliab nɛ Jeroham nɛ Ɛlkana.
28Samuɛl daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Jowɛl e daa la mo pibi nimuso nɛ Abija malɛ la ebibiso.
29Mɛrari be kaman to ebi e daa la, Maali nɛ Libni nɛ Shimei nɛ Uzza nɛ 30Shimeya nɛ Hagiya nɛ Asaya.
Bɔrɛlambu to be beshɛbompo be asheŋ
31Saŋɛ so nɛ ewura Deevid shin nɛ b ta ŋkre be deka na n yɔ Jerusalɛm na, e daŋ lara basa ko nna fanɛ bumo e naŋ baa boŋ nshɛ nsaa laŋ alaŋsɔ ashi kakpa nɛ baa bunyaŋ Eyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 32B daa boŋ nshɛ ashi wajɛbu cheembi na ase nna pɔɛŋ nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ba pɔr bɔrɛlambu na. 33Le nɛ basa nɛ baa boŋ nshɛ na be kaman to ebi lar.
Kohaf be kabuna be basa nɛ b daa la beshɛbompo na nde. Hɛman e daa la beshɛbompo be katuŋ juŋkparso na be ejuŋkparpo. Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi e daa la mo. Mo tuto e daa la Jowɛl nɛ Jowɛl malɛ mo tuto daa la Samuɛl, 34nɛ Samuɛl malɛ mo tuto daa la Ɛlkana nɛ Ɛlkana mo tuto daa la Jeroham nɛ Jeroham mo tuto daa la Eliɛl nɛ Eliɛl mo tuto daa la Toa, 35Toa mo tuto e daa la Zuuf nɛ Zuuf mo tuto la Ɛlkana nɛ Ɛlkana mo tuto daa la Mahaf nɛ Mahaf mo tuto daa la Amasai nɛ Amasai mo tuto daa la 36Ɛlkana nɛ Ɛlkana mo tuto daa la Jowɛl nɛ Jowɛl mo tuto daa la Azariya nɛ Azariya mo tuto daa la Zifanaya nɛ Zifanaya mo tuto daa la 37Tahaaf nɛ Tahaaf mo tuto daa la Asiir nɛ Asiir malɛ mo tuto daa la Ebiasaf nɛ Ebiasaf malɛ mo tuto daa la Koora nɛ Koora malɛ mo tuto daa la, 38Iza nɛ Iza malɛ mo tuto daa la Kohaaf nɛ Kohaf malɛ mo tuto daa la Livai nɛ Livai malɛ mo tuto daa la Jeekɔb.
39Asaf e daa la beshɛbompo be katuŋ nyɔsopo na be ejuŋkparpo. E daŋ shi Livai be kanaŋ to nna. Asaf be kanaŋ to ebi e daa la Bɛrekaya nɛ Shimeya nɛ 40Maikel nɛ Basia nɛ Malkija nɛ 41Ɛfni n ta Zɛra nɛ Adaya nɛ 42Ɛtan nɛ Ziima nɛ Shimei nɛ 43Jahaaf nɛ Gɛshɔn nɛ Livai.
44Mɛrari be kabuna nɛ Etan nɛ e la beshɛbompo be katuŋ sasopo na to be ejuŋkparpo na daŋ shi. Kananɛ mbe kanaŋ daŋ lar ashi Livai be yiri na to nde. Kishi pibinyɛn e daa la Etan nɛ Abdi malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Kish nɛ Maluk malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Abdi, 45nɛ Hashabia malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Maluk nɛ Amaziya malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Hashabia nɛ Hilkiya malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Amaziya, 46nɛ Amzi malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Hilkiya nɛ Bani malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Amzi nɛ Shema malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Bani, 47nɛ Maali malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Shema nɛ Muushi malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Maali nɛ Mɛrari malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Muushi nɛ Livai malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Mɛrari.
48Livaiebi nɛ b ka na bre, b daŋ lara bumo nna fanɛ b baa shuŋ wajɛbu cheembi na to.
Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi be asheŋ
49Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe kaman to ebi nawule e daa lara duwu be sarga nɛ esarga chɔɔso bɔrɛsure na so. Bumo be kushuŋ e daa la kebaakeni acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na be kabɔrɛshuŋ so nsaa yili Israɛlebi be katelamu to a lara alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kayɛrbi Mosis kaŋɛ bumo na gbagba. 50Kananɛ Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi lar nde. Ɛɛrɔn pibinyɛn e daa la Eliaza nɛ Eliaza malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Finihas nɛ Finihas malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Abishuwa, 51nɛ Abishuwa malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Buuki nɛ Buuki malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Uzzi nɛ Uzzi malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Zerahiya 52nɛ Zerahiya malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Mɛriɔf nɛ Mɛriɔf malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Amariya nɛ Amariya malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Ahitub 53nɛ Ahitub malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Zadɔk nɛ Zadɔk malɛ pibinyɛn daa la Ahimaaz.
Livaiebi be nde be asheŋ
54Mboŋ nɛ b daŋ ta n sa Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi nɛ b shi Kohaf be kabuna nseŋ juŋkpar n nya kasawule be kachige nɛ b daŋ ta n sa Livaiebi na nde: 55B daŋ ta Hibrɔn nɛ k wɔ Juda be efuli so na nɛ asɔbɔya be ejikpa nɛ a kulti kumo na kikɛ nna n sa bumo. 56Ama b daŋ ta kumo be adɔsawule nɛ ndewurbiana nɛ a chena ŋ kulti kumo na bre n sa Jefune pibinyɛn Kalɛb nna. 57-59B daŋ ta le be kesɔnyige be nde nɛ esa nɛ e maŋ kute m mɔ esa beeŋ tiŋ n shile n ya ŋana ndoŋ nna n sa Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe kaman to ebi. Amo e la: Hibrɔn nɛ Jatiir nɛ Libna nɛ Eshtemɔa nɛ Hilɛn nɛ Dɛbir nɛ Ashan nɛ Bɛf Shɛmɛsh, n ta mboŋ nɛ bumo be asɔbɔya bee ya ka ji be nsawule n ti so. 60B daŋ ta Gɛba nɛ Alemɛf nɛ Anatɔf nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule ashi Bɛnjamin be yiri to nna n sa Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi. Nde nɛ b daŋ ta n sa Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi kikɛ daa wɔ nde kuduasa. 61B daŋ ta nde kudu nna ashi Manase be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so n sa Kohaf be kabuna nɛ k ka ashi Livai be yiri to na.
62B daŋ ta nde kuduasa ashi Isaaka nɛ Ashɛr nɛ Naftali nɛ Manase nɛ k wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so ashi Bashan be efuli so na nna n sa Gɛshɔn be kabuna nɛ b shi Livai be yiri to na. 63Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ b ta nde kuduanyɔ nɛ a wɔ Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Zɛbyulɔn be yiri be nsawule so na nna n sa Mɛrari be kabuna ebi. 64Kananɛ Israɛlebi na daŋ sa Livaiebi na nde nɛ asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule nɛ a kulti ndoŋ nna na. 65B daŋ to beri nna n fin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nfɛra pɔɛŋ nseŋ chige nde nɛ a wɔ Juda nɛ Simiɔn nɛ Bɛnjamin be eyiri to be nsawule so na.
66Kohaf be kanaŋ na be kabuna ko bre daŋ nya bumo be nde nɛ asɔbɔya be ejikpa nna ashi Efrayim be yiri na be kasawule so. 67Nde nɛ b daŋ ta n sa bumo e daa la Shɛkɛm nɛ k wɔ Efrayim be abee so be efuli so nsaa la kesɔnyige be nde na be kuko na, nɛ Gɛzɛr 68nɛ Jokmiam nɛ Bɛf Hɔrɔn 69nɛ Aijalɔn nɛ Gaf Rimmɔn. 70B daŋ ta Manase be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be nsawule nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa nɛ a wɔ Ana nɛ Biliam na gba nna n sa bumo.
71B daŋ ta Manase be yiri to be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be kade nɛ baa tre Golan nɛ k wɔ Bahan be kasawule so na nɛ Ashterɔf, nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule nna n sa Gɛshɔnebi.
72Nseŋ ta 73Kadɛsh nɛ Daberaf nɛ Ramɔf nɛ Anɛm ashi Isaaka malɛ be yiri to n ti bumo so.
74Nde nɛ b daŋ nya ashi Ashɛr malɛ be yiri na to nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule e daa la Mashaal nɛ Abdɔn 75nɛ Hukɔk nɛ Rehɔb.
76Nde nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule nɛ Gɛshɔnebi na daŋ nya ashi Naftali malɛ be yiri na to e daa la Kadɛsh nɛ k wɔ Galili na nɛ Hammɔn nɛ Kiriataim.
77Nde nɛ Mɛrari malɛ be kabuna nɛ k ka na daŋ nya e daa la,
Rimmɔn nɛ Tabo nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule nɛ a wɔ Zɛbyulɔn be yiri to be kasawule be kaba so na.
78B daŋ naŋ nya nde ana ashi Ruben be yiri na kutɔ ashi Jɔɔdan be Lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so a mata Jɛriko. Nde na e la Bɛza nɛ k wɔ kebeesawule so na nɛ Jaaza 79nɛ Kɛdɛmɔf nɛ Mɛfaaf nɛ amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule. 80Nde nɛ Mɛrariebi na daŋ nya ashi Gad malɛ be yiri na to e daa la Ramɔf nɛ k wɔ Galiad na nɛ Mahanaim 81nɛ Hishbɔn nɛ Jaaza n ta amo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be nsawule n ti so.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 7
Content:
Isaaka be kaman to ebi be asheŋ
1Isaaka daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana. Bumo e la Tola nɛ Puwa nɛ Jashub nɛ Shimrɔn.
2Tola malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ashe nna. Bumo e la Uzzi nɛ Refaya nɛ Jeriɛl nɛ Jamai nɛ Ibsam nɛ Shemuɛl. Bumo e daa la Tola be kabuna na be bejuŋkparpo nɛ benapo lempo. Jemanɛ nɛ ewura Deevid daa ji kuwura na nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi daa la basa ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nɛ alfa ashe nna.
3Uzzi malɛ daa kɔ ebinyɛn koŋwule nna. Mo e la Izrahiya. Mbinyɛnsobi ana nɛ Izrahiya malɛ daa kɔ nɛ bumo kikɛ daa la bumo be nnaŋ na to be bejuŋkparpo. Bumo e la Maikel nɛ Obadaya nɛ Jowɛl nɛ Ishiya. 4B daa kɔ beche damta nɛ mbia damta ga, ŋkpal loŋ so bumo be kanaŋ na to be benapo nawule daa wɔ ŋgboŋ adesa nɛ ashe.
5B ka karga Isaaka be kanaŋ na to be basa nɛ b fo kena to be keyɔ, b daa wɔ benapo ŋgboŋ aduburwa nɛ ashunu.
Bɛnjamin nɛ Dan be mman to ebi be asheŋ
6Bɛnjamin daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Bɛla nɛ Bɛka nɛ Jediɛl.
7Bɛla daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anu nna. Bumo e la Ezbɔn nɛ Uzzi nɛ Uziɛl nɛ Jɛrimɔf nɛ Iri. Bumo kikɛ daa la bejuŋkparpo nɛ benapo lempo nna ashi bumo be kanaŋ na to. Bumo be kanaŋ na to be benapo nɛ b daŋ fo kena to be keyɔ daa wɔ benyɛn ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nɛ adesa nɛ ana.
8Bɛka daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi akpanu nna. Bumo e la Zimira nɛ Jɔash nɛ Elieza nɛ Elionai nɛ Omri nɛ Jɛrimɔf nɛ Abija nɛ Anatɔf nɛ Alemɛf. 9B ka daŋ karga bumo be benapo nɛ b daŋ fo kena to be keyɔ, b daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ alfa anyɔ.
10Jediɛl daa kɔ ebinyɛn koŋwule nna. Mo e la Bilhan. Mbinyɛnsobi ashunu nɛ Bilhan malɛ daa kɔ. Bumo e la Jewush nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Ehud nɛ Chenani nɛ Zeetan nɛ Tashish nɛ Ahishaha. 11Bumo kikɛ daa la bejuŋkparpo nɛ benapo lempo nna ashi bumo be kanaŋ na to. Bumo be kanaŋ na to be bumo nɛ b fo kena to b keyɔ daa wɔ benyɛn ŋgboŋ kuduashunu nɛ alfa anyɔ. 12Shuppim nɛ Hupim bumo tuto e daa la Irr nɛ b la Aher be kaman to ebi.
Dan daa kɔ ebinyɛn koŋwule nna. Mo e daa la Hushim.
Naftali be kaman to ebi be asheŋ
13Naftali daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana. Bumo e daa la Jaziɛl nɛ Guni nɛ Jɛza nɛ Shallum. Naftali mo nio e daa la Bilha.
Manase be kaman to ebi be asheŋ
14Manase daŋ ta Aremiya be eche nna ŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ. Bumo e daa la Asriɛl nɛ Makiir. Makiir pibi e daa la Giliad. 15Makiir e daŋ fin eche n sa Huppim nɛ Shuppim. Mo sipoche be ketre e daa la Maaka. Makiir pibinyɛn nyɔsopo e daa la Zelofehad. Mbichesobi nawule nɛ Zelofehad daa kɔ.
16Makiir be eche Maaka daŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna nseŋ nase bumo be atre Pɛrɛsh nɛ Shɛrɛsh. Pɛrɛsh malɛ gba daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Ulam nɛ Rakɛm. 17Ulam malɛ pibinyɛn e daa la Bɛdan. Makiir pibinyɛn Giliad nɛ e la Manase mo nanabi na be kaman to ebi e daa la bumo.
18Giliad mo sipoche Hamolɛchɛf daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Ishɔd nɛ Abieza nɛ Maala. 19Shamida malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Ahian nɛ Shɛkɛm nɛ Likhi nɛ Aniam.
Efrayim be kaman to ebi be asheŋ
20Efrayim be kaman to ebi e daa la Shutɛla nɛ Bɛrɛd nɛ Tahaaf nɛ Elɛada nɛ 21Zabad nɛ Shutɛla. Shutɛla be kaman, Efrayim daŋ naŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Eza nɛ Eliad nɛ b daa sha keyuri Gaaf be ndetobia be asɔbɔya nɛ b mɔ bumo na. 22Bumo tuto Efrayim daŋ shu bumo be keeli nchɛ damta nna nɛ mo kurgepoana ba lolo mo. 23Mo nɛ mbe eche ka di keche nɛ kenyɛn nɛ eche na di kedampo ŋ kurge ebinyɛn nɛ b nase mbe ketre Bɛriya ŋkpal asheŋ kraŋ kraŋ ka ba bumo be kanaŋ na to so.
24Efrayim pibiche e daa la Sheera. Mo e daŋ pɔr Bɛf Hɔrɔn be kelargato be esoso nɛ kaseto be kaba so be ndeana na nɛ Uzzen Sheera.
25Efrayim daŋ naa kɔ ebinyɛn ko nɛ baa tre mo Refa. Mbe kaman to ebi e daa la Reshɛf nɛ Tɛla nɛ Tehan nɛ 26Ladan nɛ Amihuud nɛ Eliashama nɛ 27Nun nɛ Joshuwa.
28B daŋ sɔ Bɛtɛl nɛ kumo be ndewurbiana nɛ a kulti kumo n ya fo Naraan be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nɛ Gɛza be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nɛ nde nɛ a kulti amo na kikɛ nɛ amo be nsawule nna n chena so. Shɛkɛm nɛ Aya nɛ nde nɛ a kulti amo na kikɛ gba daŋ ti so.
29Manase be kaman to ebi na e daa ji Bɛf Shan nɛ Taanak nɛ Majido nɛ Dɔɔ nɛ nde nɛ a kulti kumo na kikɛ so eleŋ.
Le be nde ere to nɛ Jeekɔb pibinyɛn Josɛf be kaman to ebi daa wɔ.
Asha be kaman to ebi be asheŋ
30Ashɛr daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Imna nɛ Ishva nɛ Ishvi nɛ Bɛriya, nseŋ ta ebiche koŋwule nɛ baa tre mo Sɛra.
31Bɛriya malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Hɛba nɛ Malchiɛl. Malchiɛl e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Birzaf be kade to.
32Hɛba daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Jaflɛt nɛ Shoma nɛ Hotam nɛ ebiche koŋwule nɛ baa tre mo Shuwa.
33Jaflɛt daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Pasak nɛ Bimhaal nɛ Ashvaf.
34Shoma daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Ahi nɛ Rooga nɛ Jehuba nɛ Aram. 35Mo da Hotam daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Zofa nɛ Imna nɛ Shɛlɛsh nɛ Amal.
36Zofa be kaman to ebi e daa la Suwa nɛ Hanɛfa nɛ Shuwal nɛ Bɛri nɛ Imra nɛ 37Bɛza nɛ Hɔɔd nɛ Shaama nɛ Shilsha nɛ Itran nɛ Beera.
38Jɛta be kaman to ebi e daa la Jefune nɛ Pispa nɛ Ara. 39Ulla malɛ be kaman to ebi e daa la Ara nɛ Haniɛl nɛ Riziya.
40Ashɛr be kaman to ebi kikɛ nna na. Bumo kikɛ daa la kanaŋ na to be bejuŋkparpo nɛ b kɔ bunyaŋ ga nɛ benapo lempo nna. Ashɛr be kaman to ebi na be bumo nɛ b fo kena to be keyɔ daa wɔ benapo ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ ashe.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 8
Content:
Bɛnjamin be kaman to ebi be asheŋ
1Bɛnjamin daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anu nna. Le nɛ b bɛ abar so kenimuso. Bɛla e daa la enimu n ta Ashbel m bɛ so nɛ Ahara nɛ 2Noha nɛ Raafa.
3Bɛla be kaman to ebi e daa la Ada nɛ Gɛra nɛ Abihuud nɛ 4Abishuwa nɛ Neeman nɛ Ahɔa nɛ 5Gɛra nɛ Shɛfufan nɛ Huram.
6-7Ehud be kaman to ebi e daa la Neeman nɛ Abija nɛ Gɛra. Bumo kikɛ daa la kanaŋ na to be bejuŋkparpoana nna nsaa wɔ Gɛba ama saŋko b daŋ ba tintiŋ bumo nna n lara bumo n yɔ Manahaf. B ka daa sha k lar na, Uzza mo tuto Gɛra nɛ Ahihuud e daŋ juŋkpar bumo.
8-9Shaharaim daŋ kini mbe beche anyɔ nɛ baa tre Hushim nɛ Baraa na nna. E ka yɔ Mowab be efuli so na, nɛ e ya ta Hodɛsh nseŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi ashunu. Bumo e la Jobaab nɛ Zibia nɛ Mɛsha nɛ Malkam nɛ 10Jewush nɛ Sakiya nɛ Mirma. Mbe mbinyɛnsobiana e daŋ ba ki kanaŋ na to be bejuŋkparpoana.
11Mo nɛ Hushim daŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Abitub nɛ Elpaal.
12Elpaal malɛ gba daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Eba nɛ Misham nɛ Shemɛd. Shemɛd e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Ono nɛ Lɔd nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti amo na.
Bɛnjaminebi nɛ b wɔ Gaaf nɛ Aijalɔn be asheŋ
13Bɛriya nɛ Shema e daa la kanaŋ nɛ b chena Aijalɔn na be benimu. Bumo e ju basa nɛ b wɔ Gaaf be kasawule so na. 14Bɛriya be kaman to ebi e daa la Ahio nɛ Shashak nɛ Jɛrimɔf nɛ 15Zebadiya nɛ Arad nɛ Eda nɛ 16Maikel nɛ Ishpa nɛ Joha.
Bɛnjaminebi nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm na be asheŋ
17Epal be kaman to ebi e daa la Zebadiya nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Hizki nɛ Hɛba nɛ 18Ishmeraya nɛ Izliya nɛ Jobaab.
19Shimei be kaman to ebi e daa la Jakim nɛ Zikri nɛ Zabdi nɛ 20Elianaya nɛ Ziletai nɛ Eliɛl nɛ 21Adaya nɛ Bɛraya nɛ Shimraf.
22Shashak be kaman to ebi e daa la Ishpan nɛ Eba nɛ Eliɛl nɛ 23Abdɔn nɛ Zikri nɛ Hana nɛ 24Hananiya nɛ Elam nɛ Antotija nɛ 25Ipdeya nɛ Penuɛl.
26Jaarashiya be kaman to ebi e daa la Shamsheraya nɛ Shehariya nɛ Atalia nɛ 27Jaarashiya nɛ Elaija nɛ Zikri.
28Bumo kikɛ daa la kanaŋ to be benimu nna nɛ bumo nananyɛnana daŋ chena Jerusalɛm.
29Gibiɔn mo tuto Jeɛl daa wɔ Gibiɔn be kade to nna. Mbe eche e daa la Maaka, 30nɛ mo pibi nimuso malɛ daa la Abdɔn. Mbe mbinyɛnsobi ko e daa la Zur nɛ Kish nɛ Baal nɛ Nɛrr nɛ Nadab nɛ 31Gɛdɔ nɛ Ahio nɛ Zeka nɛ 32Miklɔf nɛ mo pibi la Shimia na. Bumo be kenan to ebi ko daŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm nna n ya chena bumo kurgepoana kutɔ.
Ewura Sɔɔl be kaman to ebi
33Neer pibi e daa la Kish, nɛ Kish malɛ pibi daa la ewura Sɔɔl. Ewura Sɔɔl malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Jonatan nɛ Malchishuwa nɛ Abinadab nɛ Eshbaal. 34Jonatan pibi e daa la Mɛribaal nɛ Mɛribaal malɛ pibi daa la Maika.
35Maika daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Pitɔn nɛ Mɛlɛk nɛ Tariya nɛ Ahaz. 36Ahaz pibi e daa la Jehowada. Jehowada daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Alɛmɛf nɛ Azmavɛf nɛ Zimri. Zimri pibi e daa la Moza. 37Moza pibi e daa la Binia nɛ Binia malɛ pibi daa la Rafa nɛ Rafa malɛ pibi daa la Eliaza nɛ Eliaza malɛ pibi daa la Azɛl.
38Azɛl daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ashe nna. Bumo e la Azrikam nɛ Bokɛru nɛ Ishmaɛl nɛ Sheriya nɛ Obadaya nɛ Hanan. 39Azɛl mo daa Eshɛk da kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Ulaam nɛ Jewush nɛ Elifelɛt.
40Ulaam be mbinyɛnsobi na daa la benapo nɛ bekpampogboŋ nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn ga nna. Mbe mbinyɛnsobi nɛ mo nanabinyɛnsoana kikɛ daa wɔ basa kalfa nɛ adunu. Bumo kikɛ daa la Bɛnjamin be kaman to ebi nna.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 9
Content:
Basa nɛ b pɛ kena to n yɔ efuli ko so na ka bɛta m ba be asheŋ
1B daŋ sibɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ be atre kanaŋ kanaŋ so nna n wɔtɔ Israɛl be bewura be nwɔl to.
Judaebi na ka daŋ wora alubi ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ na so nɛ b daŋ pɛ bumo nseŋ tintiŋ bumo n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli wɔfɔ na so na. 2B ka bɛta a ba na be bumo nɛ b juŋkpar m ba bumo be nde to e daa la Israɛl be ndetobia na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo na. 3Bumo be basa nɛ b shi Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Efrayim nɛ Manase be yiri to na daŋ ya chena Jerusalɛm nna.
4-6Juda be yiri to be basa nɛ b daŋ ya chena Jerusalɛm na daa wɔ nnaŋ alfa ashe nɛ adekpanu.
Bumo kikɛ ere daa la Juda be mbinyɛnsobi asa na be kaman to ebi nna. Bumo e la Pɛrɛs nɛ Shela nɛ Zɛra na. Bumo be bejuŋkparpoana e daa la Utai nɛ Asaya nɛ Jewuɛl. Amihuud pibinyɛn e daa la Utai. Utai be kaman to ebi e daa la Omri nɛ Imri nɛ Bani nɛ Pɛrɛs. Shɛla be kaman to be esa e daa la Asaya, nɛ Zɛra malɛ be kanaŋ to be esa daa la Jewuɛl.
7-8Bɛnjamin be yiri to be basa nɛ b daŋ ya chena Jerusalɛm na e la Sallu nɛ mo tuto daa la Mɛshulam nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto daa Hodaviya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la
Hassenuwa na, n ta
Ibneya nɛ mo tuto daa la Jeroham, n ta
Ela nɛ mo tuto la Uzzi nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Mikri na,
n ta Mɛshulam nɛ mo tuto la Shefatiya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Rewuɛl nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Ibnija na.
9Bɛnjamin be yiri to be nnaŋ nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm na kikɛ daa wɔ basa alfa akpanu nɛ adunu nɛ ashe. Benyɛn nɛ b sibɛ bumo be atre nfe ere kikɛ daa la kanaŋ na to be benimuana nna.
Bɔrɛmatopoana nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm na be asheŋ
10-12Bɔrɛmatopoana nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm na e la
Jedaya nɛ Jehowarib nɛ Jakin,
nɛ Hilkiya pibinyɛn Azariya nɛ e daa la bɔrɛlambu to be ekrachi be enimu na nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Mɛshulam nɛ Zadɔk nɛ Mɛrayɔf nɛ Ahitub na; nɛ
Jeroham pibinyɛn Adaya nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Pashɔr nɛ Malkija na; nɛ
Adiɛl pibinyɛn Maasai nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Jazera nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Mɛshillemif nɛ Imma na.
13Bɔrɛmatapowuraana nɛ b daa la kanaŋ na to be benimu na kikɛ daa wɔ basa kagboŋ nɛ alfa ashunu nɛ adeshe. B daa la basa nɛ b kɔ kenyi nna a shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to be kushuŋ kikɛ.
Livaiebi nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm na be asheŋ
14-16Livaiebi nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm na e la Shemaya nɛ e shi Mɛrari be kabuna nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Hashuub nɛ Azrikam nɛ Hashabia na;
n ta Bakbakar nɛ Hɛrɛs nɛ Galaal nɛ
Mika pibinyɛn Mataniya nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Zikri nɛ Asaf na;
n ta Shemaya pibinyɛn Obadaya nɛ mo nananyɛnana daa la Galaal nɛ Jedutum na;
n ta Asa pibinyɛn Bɛrekaya nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Elkana nɛ e daa wɔ efuli nɛ k wɔ Netofa be ndekarso na.
Bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm na be asheŋ
17Bɔrɛlambu na be mbuna be bekumpo e daa la: Shallɔm nɛ Akuub nɛ Talmɔn nɛ Ahiman. Bumo be ejuŋkparpo e daa la Shallɔm. 18B daŋ keni kakpa nɛ baa tre ewura be kabuna nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na so na n chɛr. Sososo bre, bumo nananyɛnana daa keni Livaiebi na be echenakpaana be mbuna so.
19Kɔr pibinyɛn Shallɔm nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Ebiasaf na nɛ Koora be kabuna be basa ko e daa keni kabuna nɛ baa bɔla a luri bɔrɛlambu na to na so fanɛ kananɛ bumo nananyɛnana daa keni wajɛbu cheembi na be kabuna so na. 20Jemanɛ nɛ Eliaza pibinyɛn Finihas daa keni mbunakumpoana na so na, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daa wɔ mo kutɔ nna.
21Mɛshɛlemiya pibinyɛn Zakareya gba daa keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be mbuna na be kuko so nna.
22Basa nɛ b daŋ lara fanɛ b baa keni mbuna so nseŋ sibɛ bumo be ketre n wɔtɔ bumo be nnaŋ nɛ nde be nwɔl to na kikɛ daa wɔ benyɛn alfa anyɔ nɛ kuduanyɔ. Ewura Deevid nɛ anebi Samuɛl e daŋ lara bumo nananyɛnana fanɛ b baa shuŋ loŋ be kushuŋ na. 23Bumo nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi be kushuŋ e la kebaakeni bɔrɛlambu na be mbunaana na so. 24Mbuna na be kuko daa wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so nna nɛ kuko wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nɛ kuko wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nɛ kuko malɛ wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so, nɛ amo alɛ be kekama kɔ kumo be bekumpo be enimu. 25Mbunakenipoana be bekurgepoana daa shi bumo be nde nɛ a wɔ kadegboŋ na be ekarso na nna m ba kaa chɛ bumo to a shuŋ nchɛnshunu shunu pɔɛŋ nɛ beko malɛ e ba ka sɔ bumo so. 26B daŋ ta ebuana nɛ a wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to na nɛ ekpanjawu nɛ a wɔ kumo to na kikɛ be kushuŋ nna n sa mbunakenipoana be benimu ana nɛ b la Livaiebi na nna. 27B daa keni bɔrɛlambu na so kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ nna nsaa bugi kumo be mbuna na kachipurso kikɛ.
Livaiebi nɛ b ka na be asheŋ
28Livaiebi na be beko be kushuŋ e daa la kebaakeni ntishaŋ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu to na so. Pɔɛŋ nɛ b ta amo n shuŋ, baa karga amo nna. B naŋ ta amo n shuŋ n loge, nɛ b naŋ karga amo pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta amo n ya yili. 29Bumo be beko malɛ e naa keni bɔrɛlambu na be asɔ cheembi nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ kumo to na, nɛ kumo to be nyifu nɛ nsa nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ duwu nɛ asɔ nɛ a bee shin nɛ ajibi bee wora ebel na kikɛ so. 30Bɔrɛmatapoana na nawule e kɔ ekpa nɛ b ta asɔ nɛ a bee shin nɛ ajibi bee wora ebel na n wea abar to.
31Matatiya nɛ e la Shallɔm pibinyɛn nimuso nsaa la Livai nseŋ shi Koora be kabuna na be kushuŋ e daa la kebaawora bodobodo nɛ baa ta a lara sarga a sa Ebɔrɛ na. 32Livaiebi nɛ b shi Kohaf be kabuna na be kushuŋ e daa la kebaawora bodobodo cheembi a deŋi teebɔl na so kewushiachɛ kikɛ.
33Livai be kanaŋ na to be bejuŋkparpo nɛ b la bɔrɛlambu na to be beshɛbompo na daa wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to nna. Bumo ere daa maŋ naa kɔ kushuŋ kikɛ a shuŋ ŋkpal manɛ so kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to nna.
34Le be basa ere kikɛ daa la Livai be kanaŋ na to be bejuŋkparpo nna nɛ b sibɛ bumo be kekurge to be asheŋ n nase. Jerusalɛm nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpoana na kikɛ daŋ chena.
Ewura Sɔɔl be kanaŋ to ebi be asheŋ
35Jeɛl e juŋkpar n chena Gibiɔn. Mbe eche be ketre e daa la Maaka. 36Mo pibinyɛn nimuso e daa la Abdɔn nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobiana ko malɛ daa la Zur nɛ Kish nɛ Baal nɛ Neer nɛ Nadab nɛ 37Gɛdɔ nɛ Ahio nɛ Zakareya nɛ Miklɔf 38nɛ e la Shimiya mo tuto na. Bumo kikɛ daŋ chena m mata bumo be kabuna be basa nna ashi Jerusalɛm to.
39Neer pibi e daa la Kish nɛ Kish malɛ pibi daa la Sɔɔl, nɛ e daŋ ba ki Israɛl be ewura na. Sɔɔl daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la Jonatan nɛ Malkishuwa nɛ Abinadab nɛ Eshbaal. 40Jonatan pibi e daa la Mɛribaal nɛ Mɛribaal malɛ pibi daa la Maika. 41Maika daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la Pitɔn nɛ Mɛlɛk nɛ Tariya nɛ Ahaz. 42Ahaz pibi e daa la Jaara. Jaara daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e daa la Alɛmɛf nɛ Azmavɛf nɛ Zimri. Zimri pibi e daa la Moza. 43Moza malɛ pibi e daa la Binia nɛ Binia pibi daa la Refaya nɛ Refaya malɛ pibi daa la Eliaza nɛ Eliaza malɛ pibi daa la Azɛl.
44Azɛl daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ashe nna. Bumo e la Azrikam nɛ Bocheru nɛ Ishmaɛl nɛ Sheriya nɛ Obadaya nɛ Haran.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 10
Content:
Ewura Sɔɔl be luwu be asheŋ
(1 Samuɛl 31:1-13)
1Kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Gilbɔa na so nɛ Filistiebi na daŋ yili a kɔ Israɛlebi na. B daŋ mɔ Israɛlebi na be bedamta kena na to nna nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na nɛ ewura Sɔɔl nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi shile. 2Filistiebi na daŋ ju m buu Sɔɔl nɛ mbe mbia na so nna n ya mɔ Sɔɔl be mbinyɛnsobi asa, Jonatan nɛ Abinadab nɛ Malkishuwa. 3Kena na be kenishipere be kakpa nɛ Sɔɔl daa wɔ, ŋkpal loŋ so bedoŋ na be atanyembi daŋ da mo nna n doro mo alegaiso. 4Nɛ Sɔɔl kaŋɛ enapo nɛ e bee sulɔ mbe akɔsɔ na le: “Pee fo tokobi m mɔ ma! M maa sha Filistiebi, nnyamase ere ka wora ma eyurto nseŋ mɔ ma.” Ama enapo na daŋ kini kewora loŋ nna ŋkpal kufu ka daŋ pɛ mo ga so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Sɔɔl ta mo gbagba be tokobi be kumu ase n yuu kasawule nseŋ tɔr kumo so. 5Enapo nɛ e bee sulɔ Sɔɔl be akɔsɔ na ka wu fanɛ Sɔɔl wu na, nɛ mo alɛ gba wora kananɛ Sɔɔl wora na gbagba m mɔ mbe kumu. 6Kananɛ Sɔɔl nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi asa nɛ mo kurgepoana nyɛnso kikɛ daŋ wu kachɛ koŋwule nna na. Kachɛ koŋwule na nɛ Sɔɔl nɛ mbe benapo na kikɛ daŋ wu. 7Israɛlebi nɛ b wɔ Jizreel be ketaŋɛ to na ka nu fanɛ Israɛl be benapo shile nɛ b mɔ Sɔɔl nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi, nɛ bumo alɛ gba shile ŋ ka bumo be nde, nɛ Filistiebi na ba sɔ amo n chena.
8B ka kɔ kena na ŋ ŋklade na nɛ Filistiebi na yɔ nɛ b ya muu bubuni na be asɔ, nseŋ ya wu Sɔɔl nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi asa na nɛ b wu a dese kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Gilbɔa na so. 9Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filistiebi na ku Sɔɔl be kumu nseŋ gbaŋ mbe kenyɛnkale nseŋ shuŋi mbɔ fanɛ b nite Filisti be efuli so be agbirlambu to nɛ kaplɛkama nɛ bumo be basa wɔ m bɔ baru lela ere. 10Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta mbe kena to be akɔsɔ na n ya yili bumo be agbir be lambu ko to nseŋ ta mbe kumu na malɛ n shiga bumo be kegbir Dagɔn be lambu to.
11Jabesh be basa nɛ b wɔ Giliad na ka nu kusɔ nɛ Filistiebi na wora Sɔɔl na, 12nɛ bumo be basa nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn ga na koso n ya ta Sɔɔl nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi na be kebuni n yɔ Jabesh n ya puli kedibi gboŋgboŋi ko be kifito, nseŋ kishi nchɛ ashunu a ŋini kananɛ bumo be ŋgbene daŋ jija bumo.
13Sɔɔl ka daa maa ji kashenteŋ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so nɛ e daŋ wu na. E daŋ kini kebɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra so nna nsaa yɔ belejipo kutɔ n ya ka kpal. 14Loŋ so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ e wu nɛ e ta mbe kuwurji n sa Jɛsi pibinyɛn Deevid na.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 11
Content:
Deevid ka ki Israɛl nɛ Juda be ewura be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 5:1-10)
1Israɛlebi na kikɛ daŋ ba Deevid kutɔ ashi Hibrɔn m ba kaŋɛ mo le: “Fo nio pibiana e la anyi. 2Dra na kikɛ, hale saŋɛ so nɛ Sɔɔl daa la anyi be ewura na gba, fo e juŋkpar Israɛlebi na n yɔ kena to. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ yili kumo fanɛ, fo e naŋ ba ki anyi be ejuŋkparpo nɛ ewura a keni anyi so fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapo bee keni mbe mbolpɔ so na.” 3Amoso Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ b daŋ ba Deevid kutɔ ashi Hibrɔn na shin nɛ bumo nɛ mo wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta ŋku n do mbe kumu so m buu mo Israɛl be kuwura fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋini anebi Samuɛl na gbagba.
4Ewura Deevid daŋ keta Israɛl be benapo kikɛ nna n ya kɔ Jerusalɛmebi. Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ b daa tre Jerusalɛm Jebusi nna. Jebusiebi na e daŋ juŋkpar n chena Jerusalɛm be kasawule na so. 5Jebusiebi na daŋ kaŋɛ Deevid nna fanɛ e maaŋ tiŋ n luri bumo be kade na to kikɛ, ama Deevid daŋ ya tiŋ ŋ kɔ n sɔ kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na be kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo kikɛ nna nɛ kade na ki Deevid be kade to. 6Ewura Deevid daŋ kaŋɛ mbe benapo nna le: “Ekama nɛ e baŋ juŋkpar m mɔ Jebusi be esa e naŋ ki ma benapo kikɛ be enimu!” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jɔab nɛ mo nio la Zeruwa na, juŋkpar n yɔ kena na to nɛ b ta mo ŋ ki benapo na kikɛ be enimu. 7Deevid daŋ ya chena kumɔlga be kakpa lempo na nna amoso nɛ b daa tre kumo “Deevid be kadegboŋ na.” 8E daŋ shin nna nɛ b yili kebee na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be kakpa nɛ b sulɔ shishɛr m mata na n lɔŋɛ kade na m pɔr nɛ Jɔab malɛ pɔr kakpa nɛ k ka na n chɛ so. 9Ŋkpal Enyɛnpetale ka daa wɔ Deevid kutɔ so, mbe kuwurji daŋ baa nya eleŋ nna a ti so saŋkikɛ.
Deevid be benapo lempo be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 23:8-39)
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ nna fanɛ Deevid beeŋ ki ewura nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ e yili mbe kaman. Mbe kuwurji daŋ ji eleŋ ga ŋkpal benapo lempo ko ka daŋ chɛ mo to so.
11Benapo lempo na be ejuŋkparpo e daa la Jashobiam nɛ e la Hachmɔn pibinyɛn na. Mo e daa la benapo lempo na to be bekpakpaso asa be enimu na. Mo e daŋ ta kekpa m mɔ benapo alfa asa ashi kena koŋwule to na. 12Benapo lempo asa na to be emo nɛ e naŋ bɛ so e la Dodo pibinyɛn Eliaza nɛ e shi Aho be kabuna na. 13E daŋ chɛ Deevid to nna ŋ kɔ Filistiebi na kena ashi Pas Dummin. Ayu be kudɔ to nɛ e daa wɔ nɛ Israɛlebi na fara a shile, 14ndoŋ nna nɛ mo nɛ mbe benapo yili kudɔ na be nferinto ŋ kɔ Filistiebi na kena nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ Filistiebi na so nɛnɛ.
15Kachako nɛ benapo lempo adesa to be benapo asa yɔ Deevid kutɔ kefalta ko ase ashi Adulam be kebeelaŋ ase nɛ Filistiebi malɛ be benapo wora bumo be keeyi to ashi Refaebi be Ketaŋɛ to. 16Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ Deevid malɛ wɔ kumɔlga be kakpa lempo ashi kebee na so nɛ Filistiebi ko malɛ wɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm. 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ achukoŋ pɛ Deevid nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Nɛ esa ko daa beeŋ ya jɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm be kabunagboŋ na ase be ketirbu na be nchu m bar ma nɛ n nu nna, k daa beeŋ par ma ga!” 18Nɛ benapo lempo asa na ŋana n yɔ Filistiebi na be keeyi to n ya jɔ ketirbu nɛ k wɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm be kabunagboŋ na ase na be nchu m bar Deevid nɛ e kini amo be kenu nseŋ chulgi amo n wurge kasawule fanɛ sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, 19ŋ kaŋɛ le: “M maaŋ nuu nchu ere! M baŋ nuu amo, k beeŋ baa du fanɛ ŋ ka nuu basa nɛ b ta bumo be amu ŋ kpa kelara ere be ŋklaŋ nna!” Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kini amo be kenu. Benapo lempo asa na be kenyɛn nɛ b daŋ ji nna na.
20Jɔab mo da Abishai e daa la benapo adesa na be ejuŋkparpo. Mo e daŋ ta mbe kekpa m mɔ benapo alfa asa kikɛ na. Amoso mbe ketre daŋ dii nna fanɛ benapo lempo asa na. 21Mbe ketre e daŋ dii ga ashi benapo adesa na to, hale nɛ e ki bumo be ejuŋkparpo ama k daa maŋ dii n fo benapo lempo asa na peya so.
22Jehowada pibinyɛn Bɛnaya nɛ e shi Kabziil na daa la enapo lempo nna. E daŋ ji kenyɛn ekpa damta so ga hale m mɔ Mowab be benapo lempo anyɔ ko. Kachako nɛ e daŋ lar bɔrɛ nɛ abɔrɛjembubi to n ya gbelge kejamaŋ to m mɔ buluŋ. 23E daŋ mɔ Ijipt be kanyɛn gboŋgboŋi ko nɛ mbe nteŋ du fanɛ ayadra ashunu nɛ bargato nɛ e daŋ keta kekpa gboŋgboŋi ko a kɔ mo, ama Bɛnaya bre daŋ ta kaprɛ nna ŋ kɔ mo nseŋ suge Ijipt be esa na be kekpa na ashi mbe enɔ to nseŋ mɔ mo. 24Le be kenyɛn nɛ Bɛnaya nɛ e daa la benapo lempo adesa na to be eko na daŋ ji. 25Mbe ketre daŋ dii ga ashi benapo adesa na kikɛ to ama mo alɛ daa maŋ fo benapo lempo asa na so. Mo nɛ ewura Deevid daŋ ta ŋ ki basa nɛ baa kuŋ mo na be enimu.
26-47Benapo lempo Adesa na be beko e la: Asahɛl nɛ e la Jɔab mo sipo na, nɛ Dodo nɛ e shi Bɛtlɛhɛm na pibinyɛn Elhanan, nɛ Shamma nɛ e shi Haarɔd na nɛ Hɛlɛz nɛ mo alɛ shi Pɛlɛt na, nɛ Ikkish nɛ e shi Tekua na pibinyɛn Ira, nɛ Abieza nɛ e shi Anatɔf na, nɛ Sibika nɛ e shi Husha na, nɛ Ilai nɛ e shi Aho, nɛ Maharai nɛ e shi Nɛtofa na, nɛ Baana nɛ e shi Nɛtofa na pibinyɛn Hɛlɛb, nɛ Ribai nɛ e shi Gibia nɛ k wɔ Bɛnjamin be efuli so na pibinyɛn Itai, nɛ Bɛnaya nɛ e shi Piratɔn na, nɛ Hurai nɛ mo alɛ shi ketaŋɛ nɛ k mata Gaash na, nɛ Abiɛl nɛ e shi Aba na, nɛ Azmavɛf nɛ e shi Bahurim na, nɛ Eliab nɛ e shi Shaalbɔn na kikɛ daa la Hashɛn nɛ e shi Gizɔn na be mbinyɛnsobi nna. Shagee nɛ e shi Haraa na pibinyɛn Jonatan, nɛ Saaka nɛ e shi Haara na pibinyɛn Ahiam, nɛ Ur pibinyɛn Elifal nɛ Hifa nɛ e shi Mɛkera na, nɛ Ahija nɛ e shi Pɛlɔn na, nɛ Hɛzro nɛ e shi Kamɛl na, nɛ Ezbai pibinyɛn Narai nɛ Neetan mo sipo Jowɛl nɛ Hagri pibinyɛn Mibha nɛ Zɛlɛk nɛ e shi Ammɔn na, nɛ Naharai nɛ e shi Bɛɛrɔf nseŋ daa keta Zeruwa pibinyɛn Jɔab be akɔsɔ na, nɛ Ira nɛ Garɛb nɛ b shi Jatiir na, nɛ Yuriya nɛ e la Hiti be esa na, nɛ Alai pibinyɛn Zabad nɛ Shiza pibinyɛn Adina, nɛ e daa la Ruben be yiri na to be ejuŋkparpo nsaa juŋkpar benapo adesa na, nɛ Maaka pibinyɛn Haanan nɛ Joshafat nɛ e shi Mitan na, nɛ Uziya nɛ e shi Ashtira na nɛ Hotam nɛ e shi Arowa na be mbinyɛnsobi Shaama nɛ Jiɛl nɛ Shimri nɛ e shi Tiiz na be mbinyɛnsobi Jediɛl nɛ Joha nɛ Eliɛl nɛ e shi Mahava na nɛ Elnaam be mbinyɛnsobi Jeribai nɛ Joshaviya nɛ Itma nɛ mo alɛ shi Mowab na nɛ Eliɛl nɛ Obɛd nɛ Jaasiɛl nɛ e shi Zoba na.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 12
Content:
Deevid be bebɛsopo nɛ b shi Bɛnjamin be yiri to na be asheŋ
1Jemanɛ ko Deevid daŋ yɔ Ziklag nna n ya ŋana Kish pibinyɛn ewura Sɔɔl so. Ndoŋ nɛ benapo lempo ko ba tu mo. 2Benapo na daŋ shi Bɛnjamin be yiri nɛ Sɔɔl gba shi kumo to na nna. B daa nyi ata nɛ atababu be keto ga. B daa tiŋ a ta enɔjiso nɛ enɔ bena kikɛ a to ata. 3-7Shema nɛ e shi Gibia na be mbinyɛnsobi Ahieza nɛ Jɔash e daa la bumo be bejuŋkparpo.
Benapo na e daa la Azmavɛf be mbinyɛnsobi Jeziɛl nɛ Pɛlɛt nɛ
Berika nɛ Jehu nɛ b shi Anatɔf na nɛ
Ishmaya nɛ e la enapo lempo nseŋ shi Gibiɔn n daa la benapo adesa na be ejuŋkparpo na,
nɛ Jɛremaya nɛ Jahaziɛl nɛ Johanan nɛ Jozabad nɛ e shi Gɛdera na,
nɛ Eluzai nɛ Jɛrimɔf nɛ Bialia nɛ Shamariya nɛ Shefatiya nɛ e shi Harif na,
nɛ Ɛlkana nɛ Isshaya nɛ Azarɛl nɛ Joeza nɛ Joshabim nɛ e shi Koora be kabuna na,
nɛ Jeroham nɛ e shi Gɛdɔ na be mbinyɛnsobi Jola nɛ Zebadiya.
Deevid be bebɛsopo nɛ b shi Gad be yiri to na be asheŋ
8Gad be yiri na to be basa ko gba daŋ ya tu Deevid ashi mbe kumɔlga be kakpa lempo keshishɛrsawule na so nna nseŋ ki mbe benapo. Bumo alɛ gba daa la benapo lempo nna nsaa nyi kananɛ baa ta asɔ kuŋso nɛ ekpa a kɔ kena nsaa gbir kenishi fanɛ ebuluŋ nseŋ naa du wurɛwurɛbi malɛ fanɛ kebee so be chibir. 9-13Kananɛ b bɛ abar so nde. Eza e daa la bumo be ejuŋkparpo, n ta Obadaya m bɛ so n ta Eliab nɛ Mishmana nɛ Jɛremaya nɛ Attai nɛ Eliɛl nɛ Johanan nɛ Elzabad nɛ Jɛremaya nɛ Makbanaya.
14Gad be yiri to be basa ere be beko daa la benapo be benimugboŋ nɛ b daa keni benapo be katuŋ kagboŋ so nna nɛ beko malɛ la benimu nɛ baa keni benapo be katuŋ kalfa so. 15Bumo e daŋ dii Jɔɔdan be lɔr na saŋɛ nɛ k bɔlɔ n lar apla kafɛ be kufɔl juŋkparso to na n ju basa nɛ b wɔ kumo be epeŋilarkpa nɛ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be kepla so na nɛ b pesaŋ to.
Deevid be bebɛsopo nɛ b shi Bɛnjamin nɛ Juda na be asheŋ
16Saŋko Bɛnjamin nɛ Juda be benapo be katuŋ ko daŋ yɔ Deevid kutɔ nna ashi kumɔlga be kakpa lempo na. 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ Deevid daŋ lar n ya tu bumo nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Nɛ men la beteri nɛ baa ba nɛ b ba chɛ ma to ŋ kɔ nna bre, kumo ere mee wora menyi ansaŋ nɛ keba. Ama nɛ fanɛ men ba nna nɛ men ba debɔr ma ŋ ŋini ma doŋana saŋɛ nɛ m maŋ wora menyi kulubi kikɛ ere, an nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge menyi kusoe.”
18Ebɔrɛ be kiyoyu daŋ gbelge Amasai nɛ e la bumo be eko nseŋ ba ki benapo adesa na be enimu na so nna, nɛ e kaŋɛ:
“Jɛsi pibinyɛn Deevid, an la feya nna!
Fo nɛ fo basa beeŋ ba kɔ a pɔso saŋkama!
Ŋkpal manɛ so Ebɔrɛ wɔ fo kaman.”
Nɛ Deevid sɔ bumo nɛnɛ nseŋ ta bumo ŋ ki mbe benapo nɛ baa ta kena a purgi basa na be benimu.
Deevid be bebɛsopo nɛ b shi Manase be yiri to na be asheŋ
19Manase be yiri to be benapo ko daŋ ya ti Deevid be benapo so nna saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ lar n ya tu Filistiebi na nɛ e kɔ ewura Sɔɔl kena na. E daa maŋ naŋ chɛ Filistiebi na to ŋkpal manɛ so b daa fɛ nna fanɛ e beeŋ debɔr bumo ŋ ŋini mo nyɛnpe dra Sɔɔl. Amoso b daŋ shin nna nɛ Deevid bɛta n yɔ Ziklag. 20Benapo nɛ b daŋ shi Manase be yiri to n ya ti Deevid so saŋɛ so nɛ e bɛta a yɔ Ziklag na e daa la Adna nɛ Jozabad nɛ Jedial nɛ Maikel nɛ Jozabad nɛ Elihu nɛ Zilletai. Bumo b ekama daa keni benapo kagboŋ be katuŋ so ashi Manase be yiri to nna. 21B daa la benapo lempo nna. Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ Deevid ta bumo ŋ ki mbe benapo be benimu. Bumo e daa chɛ mo to a kɔ mo doŋana nɛ baa ta kena a purgi basa na.
22Saŋkama benapo popɔr daa ti Deevid be benapo na so nna ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ mbe benapo na wora kishi ga.
Deevid be benapo be asheŋ
23-37Saŋɛ so nɛ Deevid daa wɔ Hibrɔn na, benapo damta ko daŋ ba ti mbe benapo so nna nseŋ ta Deevid ŋ ki ewura n tal Sɔɔl be katelamu fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na gbagba. Kananɛ benapo na daa sa nde.
Juda be benapo daa wɔ ŋgboŋ ashe nɛ alfa aburwa nsaa kɔ akɔsɔ damta nseŋ keta asɔ kuŋso nɛ akpa.
Simiɔn be yiri to be benapo nɛ b nyi kena be kekɔ nɛnɛ daa wɔ ŋgboŋ ashunu nɛ kalfa.
Livai be yiri to be benapo daa wɔ ŋgboŋ ana nɛ alfa ashe.
Ɛɛrɔn mo nanabi Jehowada be benapo nɛ b daa bɛ mo so daa la ŋgboŋ asa nɛ alfa ashunu nna.
Zadɔk nɛ e la enapo lempo na malɛ mo kurgepoana nɛ b la benapo daa wɔ basa adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ.
Bɛnjamin be yiri nɛ k la Sɔɔl gbagba be yiri na daa kɔ benapo ŋgboŋ asa. Bɛnjamin be yiri na to be basa damta daa shuŋ Sɔɔl nna.
Efrayim be yiri to be benapo lempo nɛ bumo be kanaŋ to be mbuna nɛ ekama nyi bumo be asheŋ daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ alfa aburwa.
Manase be yiri na to be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be benapo nɛ b daŋ lara fanɛ b ya buu Deevid kuwura m ba na daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduaburwa.
Isaaka be yiri to be bejuŋkparpo nɛ basa nɛ b daa juŋkpar a ŋini kusɔ nɛ k daga kewora nɛ kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ k daga b ka wora kumo na kikɛ daa wɔ basa alfa anyɔ.
Zɛbyulɔn be yiri to be benapo nɛ b nyi akɔsɔ be yiri kikɛ be keta ŋ kɔ kena nseŋ wora kena to be keyɔ be shiriya saŋkama malɛ daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ adunu,
Naftali be yiri to be benapo juŋkparpo daa wɔ kagboŋ, nɛ bumo nɛ bumo be benapo nɛ b nyi asɔkuŋso nɛ ekpa b keta ŋ kɔ kena nɛnɛ malɛ daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ adesa nɛ ashunu.
Dan be yiri na to be benapo nɛ b koya kena be kekɔ nɛnɛ daa wɔ ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ aburwa nɛ alfa ashe.
Asha be yiri to be benapo nɛ b wora shiriya nɛ b yɔ kena to saŋkama daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ adena.
Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase be epeŋilarkpa be yiri nɛ b daa wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na be benapo nɛ b nyi akɔsɔ be yiri kikɛ b k ta ŋ kɔ kena na, daa wɔ ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ adunyɔ.
38Benapo na kikɛ daŋ yɔ Hibrɔn nna nɛ b ya buu Deevid Israɛl be kuwura. Israɛlebi kikɛ gba daa sha kumo be loŋ nna. 39Bumo nɛ Deevid kikɛ daŋ ji ndoŋ nchɛ asa nna nsaa ji ajibi a nuu asɔnuuso nɛ bumo kurgepoana bar bumo na. 40Isaaka nɛ Zɛbyulɔn nɛ Naftali be eyiri nɛ b wɔ kufɔ na daŋ sulɔ ajibi nɛ nyifu nɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be awɔlso nɛ asɔnuuso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku, ekurma nɛ enyɔma nɛ egbolufɛlso so nna. B daŋ bar ana nɛ mbolpɔ gba ndoŋ m ba mɔ n ji. Ade kikɛ daa ŋini kagbenefuli nɛ b nya efuli na so nna.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 13
Content:
B bar ŋkre be deka na Kiriaf Jearim be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 6:1-11)
1Ewura Deevid daŋ tre mbe benapo be benimu nɛ baa keni benapo be ntuŋ kagboŋ kagboŋ nɛ kalfa kalfa so na nna nɛ mo nɛ bumo to jina. 2Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ le: “Nɛ kepar menyi nsaa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gba be kepar, kumo ere men shin nɛ an shuŋi mbɔ anyi be basa nɛ b ka na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi nɛ b wɔ bumo be nde to na kutɔ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b ba anyi kutɔ nfe. 3Saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ ya ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka nɛ an daŋ kplaŋ so saŋɛ so nɛ Sɔɔl daa la ewura na.” 4E ka sa le be nfɛra ere n loge, nɛ kumo be loŋ par basa na kikɛ ga nɛ b shuli kumo be loŋ.
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid tre Israɛl be basa ashi efuli na so kikɛ, yili lɔr nɛ baa tre Shihɔ nɛ k wɔ Ijipt be kasawule so na n ya fo Lebo Hamaf ashi kelargato be esoso be kaba so nɛ b ya ta ŋkre be deka na ashi Kiriaf Jearim m ba Jerusalɛm. 6Deevid nɛ mbe basa daŋ yɔ Baala nɛ baa tre kumo Kiriaf Jearim nɛ k wɔ Juda be efuli so na nna nɛ b ya ta Enyɛnpe be ŋkre be deka nɛ mbe ketre Enyɛnpetale deŋ mbe kuwurputi so ashi emalaika anyɔ na be nferinto kumo so na. 7B daŋ lara ŋkre be deka na Abinadab be laŋ to nna m ba deŋi turko popɔr ko so. Uzza nɛ Ahio e daa keni turko na so. 8Nɛ Deevid nɛ Israɛlebi na ta bumo be eleŋ kikɛ a cha nsaa boŋ nshɛ a maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. B daa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ ŋkure nɛ echakachaka nna nsaa foŋ mbel.
9B ka fo kakpa nɛ Kidɔn bee bri mbe ayu na nɛ egbolufɛlso na fiti nɛ ŋkre be Deka na bee shin nɛ k tɔr nɛ Uzza teŋi enɔ nɛ e suse kumo to. 10Epul na to nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nya agbo n wɔtɔ Uzza nseŋ mɔ mo ŋkpal e ka teŋi enɔ m beta deka na so. E daŋ tɔr Ebɔrɛ be anishito nna n wu. 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ Deevid nya agbo ga ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka nya agbo m mɔ Uzza so. Hale nɛ mbre Enyɛnpe nɛ mbe agbo mɔ Uzza na nɛ b kraa tre loŋ be kakpa na.
12Nɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ pɛ Deevid kufu ga nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Nuso nɛ meeŋ wora n ta ŋkre be deka ere n yɔ naniere.” 13Amoso Deevid daa maŋ ta ŋkre be deka na n yɔ Jerusalɛm to. E daŋ yige kumo kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Obɛd Edɔm nɛ e la Gaaf be kadetobia na be laŋ to nna. 14Ŋkre be deka na daa wɔ ndoŋ nna n ya fo afɔl asa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛfa Obɛd Edɔm nɛ mbe kanaŋ nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ e kɔ kikɛ.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 14
Content:
Kaboŋ nɛ ewura Deevid daa wɔ ashi Jerusalɛm be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 5:11-16)
1Tai be ewura Hiram daŋ shuŋi mbɔ ewura Deevid kutɔ nna. E daŋ shuŋi ekapɛnta nɛ basa nɛ baa ta ajembu a pɔr nna nseŋ ta ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na n ti so fanɛ b ya pɔr ewura be laŋ n sa Deevid. 2Nɛ Deevid pin fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e yili kumo kashenteŋto fanɛ e ki Israɛl be ewura nseŋ kpal mbe basa Israɛlebi so a nɛfa mbe kuwurji.
3Deevid ka lar Hibrɔn m ba Jerusalɛm na, e daŋ ta beche damta nna ŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi nɛ mbichesobi damta. 4Mbia nɛ e daŋ kurge Jerusalɛm to e la Shamua nɛ Shobab nɛ Neetan nɛ Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ 5Ibhar nɛ Elishuwa nɛ Elpelɛt nɛ 6Noga nɛ Nefɛg nɛ Jafaya nɛ 7Elishama nɛ Beeliada nɛ Elefilɛt.
Ewura Deevid ka kɔ m pɔɔ Filistiebi na so be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 5:17-25)
8Filistiebi na ka nu fanɛ Deevid e ki Israɛl be efuli so kikɛ be ewura, nɛ bumo be benapo kikɛ ya ka fin mo nɛ b pɛ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid bela ase nɛ e ya n ya tu bumo. 9Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ Filistiebi be benapo na ta kena n ya purgi Refaebi be ketaŋɛ to be ndeana nsaa muu bumo be asɔ. 10Kumo be kaman nɛ Deevid bishi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ le: “K daga ŋ ka ya kɔ Filistiebi ere kena a? Feeŋ chɛ ma to nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so a?”
Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mm, ya kɔ bumo! Ŋkpal manɛ so, meeŋ shin nɛ fo kɔ m pɔɔ so kashenteŋto!”
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ Deevid nɛ mbe benapo yɔ Baal Pɛrazim n ya kɔ m pɔɔ Filistiebi na so, nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bure n luri ma doŋana na to fanɛ kananɛ nchu bee bɔlɔ a luri kakpa na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e nase kaboŋ na Baal Perazim. Kumo be kifito e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee bure e luri to na.” 12Filistiebi be benapo na ka shile n yige bumo be agbir na nɛ Deevid kaŋɛ mbe benapo na fanɛ b ya chɔɔ amo.
13K maŋ chɛr ko nɛ Filistiebi be benapo na naŋ bɛta n ta kena n ya purgi Refaebi be ketaŋɛ na to be nde kikɛ. 14Nɛ Deevid naŋ bishi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ mo le: “Men sa maŋ kaŋ ta kena n tu bumo nfe, ama men wora shiriya a kulti bumo a yɔ ndibi nɛ baa tre balsam ere ase n ya kɔ bumo ndoŋ. 15Men ka baŋ nu awɔr ka shi ndibi na so a ba fanɛ benapo ka bɛ abar so a nite na, kumo ere men fara a kɔ bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so meeŋ juŋkpar menyi n ya kɔ m pɔɔ Filistiebi be benapo na so.” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Deevid wora kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na nseŋ yili Gibiɔn n ju Filisti be benapo na kikɛ n ya fo Gɛza. 17Amoso Deevid be ketre daŋ dii n yɔ kaplɛkama nna, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ efuli kama so ebi bee ŋana mo.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 15
Content:
B ka ta ŋkre be deka na m ba Jerusalɛm to be asheŋ
1Ewura Deevid daŋ pɔr nwu damta nna ashi Jerusalɛm nseŋ shin nɛ b yuu wajɛbu nɛ b ta ŋkre be deka na bre n yili ndoŋ. 2Kumo be kaman nɛ Deevid kaŋɛ le: “Livaiebi na nawule a daga fanɛ b baa sulɔ ŋkre be deka na ŋkpal manɛ so bumo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ b baa sulɔ kumo nsaa shuŋ mo mbaanaayɔ.” 3Kumo be kaman nɛ Deevid tre Israɛlebi na kikɛ m ba Jerusalɛm, nɛ b ya ta ŋkre be deka na m ba wajɛbu nɛ e yuu ŋkpal kumo so na to. 4Kede be kaman nɛ e tre Ɛɛrɔn malɛ be kaman to ebi nɛ Livaiebi na. 5E daŋ tre Kohaf be kabuna nɛ b shi Livai be yiri to na be ejuŋkparpo nɛ baa tre Yuriɛl nɛ e bee juŋkpar mbe kabuna be basa kalfa nɛ adunyɔ na, 6nɛ Asaya nɛ e bee juŋkpar basa alfa anyɔ nɛ adunyɔ ashi Mɛrari be kabuna na, 7nɛ Jowɛl nɛ e bee juŋkpar basa kalfa nɛ adesa ashi Gɛshɔn be kabuna na, 8nɛ Shamaya nɛ e bee juŋkpar basa alfa anyɔ ashi Elizafan be kabuna na 9Eliɛl nɛ e daa juŋkpar basa aduburwa ashi Hibrɔn be kabuna na, 10nɛ Aminadab nɛ mo alɛ daa juŋkpar basa kalfa nɛ kuduanyɔ ashi Uziɛl be kabuna na.
11Ewura Deevid daŋ shuŋi n tre Zadɔk nɛ Abiata nɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livai be basa ashe nna. Bumo e la Yuriɛl nɛ Asaya nɛ Jowɛl nɛ Shemaya nɛ Eliɛl nɛ Aminadab. 12Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ Livaiebi na: “Menyi e la Livaiebi na be kabuna be bejuŋkparpoana. Amoso menyi nɛ men braana Livaiebi na e lara alubi ashi menyi be ŋgbene to nseŋ ki cheembi, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tiŋ n ta Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be ŋkre be deka na n yɔ kakpa nɛ n lɔŋɛ fanɛ b ta kumo m ba yili na. 13Ŋkpal men ka daa maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ men sulɔ kumo sososo na so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ gberge anyi kusoe nna ŋkpal anyi ka daa maŋ wora kusɔ nɛ k daga so.”
14Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na lara alubi bumo be ŋgbene to nseŋ ki cheembi, saŋɛ na so baaŋ tiŋ n sulɔ Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be ŋkre be deka na. 15Livaiebi na daa ta ndibi tentembi nna a wɔtɔ kumo to a maŋ so a deŋi bumo be abatimu so a sulɔ fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baaŋ kaŋɛ Mosis na gbagba.
16Ewura Deevid daŋ kaŋɛ Livaiebi be bejuŋkparpo na kenishipereso nna fanɛ b lara Livaiebi na be beko nɛ b baa boŋ nshɛ nsaa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ echakachaka kagbenefuliso 17-21Beshɛbompo nɛ b daa laŋ danyaŋ be echakachaka e daa la Jowɛl pibinyɛn Heman, nɛ mo kurgepo Asaf nɛ e la Berekia pibinyɛn na, nɛ Kushiya pibinyɛn Etan nɛ e shi Mɛrari be kabuna na. Basa nɛ b daa chɛ bumo to a laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ wurbi e daa la Zakareya nɛ Jaziɛl nɛ Shemiramɔf nɛ Jehiɛl nɛ Yuni nɛ Eliab nɛ Maseya nɛ Bɛnaya.
Bumo nɛ bumo alɛ daa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ gboŋgboŋi na e daa la, Matitiya nɛ Elifilehu nɛ Mikneya nɛ Azaziya n ta Obɛd Edɔm nɛ Jeɛl nɛ b la bɔrɛlambu na to be mbuna be bekenipo na n ti so.
22Ŋkpal Chɛnanaya ka daa kɔ nshɛ be keboŋ be kakɛ so, mo nɛ b daŋ lara fanɛ e baa la Livaiebi na be beshɛbompo be ejuŋkparpo. 23-24Bɛrekaya nɛ Ɛlkana nɛ Obɛd Edɔm nɛ Jehiya nɛ b daŋ lara fanɛ b baa keni ŋkre be deka na so. Bɔrɛmatapoana Shebaniya nɛ Joshafat nɛ Netanɛl nɛ Amaziya nɛ Zakareya nɛ Bɛnaya nɛ Elieza nɛ b daŋ lara fanɛ b baa foŋ mbel ashi ŋkre be deka na be anishito.
B ka bar ŋkre be deka na Jerusalɛm to be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 6:12-22)
25Ewura Deevid nɛ Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ benapo be benimuana na daŋ yɔ Obɛd Edɔm be laŋ to nna nɛ b ya ta ŋkre be deka na nseŋ ji eyur ndoŋ ga. 26Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ chɛ Livaiebi na to nɛ b tiŋ n sulɔ Enyɛnpe be ŋkre be deka na so, egbolu ashunu nɛ ekpakpa ashunu nɛ b daŋ ta n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 27Deevid nɛ beshɛbompo be enimu Chɛnanaya nɛ Livaiebi nɛ b daŋ sulɔ ŋkre be deka na daŋ buu ago be kechɛbi lela be epiŋi nna. Ewura Deevid bre daŋ buu kabɔrɛmata be piŋi nɛ baa tre ɛfɔd na nna n daŋi mbe piŋi so. 28B ka ta ŋkre be deka na a ba na, Israɛlebi na kikɛ daa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso nna nsaa foŋ mbel a laŋ echakachaka nɛ ejaŋjilaŋ hale m ba luri Jerusalɛm to.
29B ka ta ŋkre be deka na a luri kade na to na, nɛ Sɔɔl pibiche Mikaal keni tokuro to n wu ewura Deevid ka bee cha a tɛto, nɛ mbe asheŋ nu mo agbo alegaiso nɛ e maŋ naa keni mo a bɔlɔ kenishi.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 16
Content:
1B daŋ ta ŋkre be deka na nna n ya yili wajɛbu nɛ Deevid yuu ŋkpal kumo so na to, nseŋ lara esarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be esarga n sa Ebɔrɛ. 2Ewura Deevid ka lara esarga chɔɔso na n loge nɛ e nɛfa basa na ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ketre to, 3nseŋ sa bumo kikɛ ajibi. E daŋ sa Israɛl be eche nɛ enyɛn kikɛ bodobodo lelemu nɛ eblaŋ tɔso nɛ greep be asɔrso wɔlso nna.
4Deevid daŋ lara Livaiebi na be beko nna fanɛ b baa shuŋ Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kushuŋ nsaa boŋ nshɛ a maŋkura mo ashi ŋkre be deka na ase. 5Asaf e daa la bumo be ejuŋkparpo nɛ Zakareya bɛso. Jeɛl nɛ Shemiramɔf nɛ Jehiɛl nɛ Matitiya nɛ Eliab nɛ Benaya nɛ Obɛd Edɔm nɛ Jeɛl e daa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ. Asaf malɛ e daa laŋ echakachaka 6nɛ Bɛnaya nɛ Jahaziɛl nɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana na malɛ daa foŋ mbel ashi ŋkre be deka na be anishito saŋkama. 7Kumo be jemanɛ nɛ ewura Deevid ta nshɛ be keboŋ n di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ be kushuŋ n sa Asaf nɛ mo braana Livaiebi na.
Kapandi be kashɛ
(Nshɛ 105:1-15; 96:1-13; 106:1, 47-48)
8Men ta kechɔrɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nsaa maŋ mbe ketregboŋ na so,
men kaŋɛ basa mbe asheŋ woraso ŋ ŋini ekama.
9Men boŋ kapandi be nshɛ m maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ;
nseŋ kaŋɛ mbe mamachi be asheŋ woraso be asheŋ.
10Men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa fuli menyi ŋkpal anyi ka la mo peya so;
nɛ bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo na malɛ be ŋgbene e fuli bumo!
11Men ta men be yirda n deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so,
nsaa bunyaŋ mo saŋkikɛ.
12-13Menyi Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be anya nɛ menyi Israɛl be kaman to ebi nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara na, men baa nyiŋi Ebɔrɛ be emamachisheŋ
nɛ kananɛ e bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so be asheŋ.
14Enyɛnpe na e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ;
nɛ mbe mbra wɔtɔ n sa durnya kikɛ.
15Men sa maŋ kaŋ teŋ Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre nɛ
e kre mbaanaayɔ na kikɛ so,
16loŋ be ŋkre na nɛ mo nɛ Eebraham kre,
nɛ e nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa Aizek malɛ na.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ Jeekɔb gba daŋ kre ŋkre
nɛ k beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
18E yɛ: “Meeŋ ta Keenan be kasawule na n sa menyi,
nɛ k baa la menyi be kapetɛ.”
19Kumo be jemanɛ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa daa maŋ shi,
nseŋ daa la befɔ ashi Keenan be kasawule so.
20B daŋ baa wɔtɔ nna
a kilgi to efuliana nɛ nsawuleana so.
21Ama Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ shuli nɛ ekama mɛaŋ bumo.
E daŋ kpele ndoŋ be bewura kusoe nna
saŋɛ na so b maaŋ wora bumo shɛŋ,
22nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men sa maŋ kaŋ tɔrɔ ma basa laraso,
ŋko n tɔrɔ ma anebiana.”
23Ekama nɛ e wɔ durnya ere to e boŋ kashɛ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Men baa malga kananɛ e mɔlga menyi na be asheŋ karechɛ kikɛ.
24Men malga kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura du n sa efuliana kikɛ,
nseŋ malga mbe asheŋgboŋ nɛ e bee wora ŋ ŋini basa kikɛ.
25Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kɔ eleŋ nseŋ daga kemaŋkura.
Mo e daga bunyaŋ a chɔ agbir.
26Agbir nɛ efuli pɔtɛana bre be basa bee shuŋ,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule.
27Kemaŋkura nɛ kuwurji daga mo nna, nɛ
eleŋ nɛ kagbenefuli kikɛ bɔlɔ mbe bɔrɛlambu to.
28Ekama nɛ e wɔ durnya ere to e di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ,
men ta mbe kemaŋkura nɛ mbe eleŋ n sa mo.
29Enyɛnpe be ketre daga bunyaŋ, amoso men shin nɛ an maŋkura mo.
Men ta men be sarga m ba mbe lambu to.
Enyɛnpe cheembi na kaŋ lar a ba,
a daga fanɛ men bunyaŋ mo.
30Esa kama nɛ e wɔ durnya ere to beeŋ chicha ashi mbe anishito!
Durnya na yil kiŋkiŋ nna nsaa maa gbuŋgbuŋ.
31Esoso nɛ kasawule so ebi, men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa fuli!
Men kaŋɛ efuliana na fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura.
32Teku nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ kumo to e baa cha awɔr;
Ndɔana nɛ asɔ kama nɛ a wɔ amo to, men baa kɔ kagbenefuli!
33Ndibi nɛ a wɔ kupo to beeŋ baa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuli
ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe na bee ba nɛ e ba ji durnya be basa demu.
34Men ta kechɔrɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal manɛ so, e walɛ,
nɛ mbe kasha malɛ wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
35Men kaŋɛ mo le: “Anyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ anyi be emɔlgapo, mɔlga anyi.
Gbegbar anyi abar so nseŋ mɔlga anyi ashi efuli pɔtɛ ana be enɔ to,
saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ ta kechɔrɔ n sa fo,
nseŋ di fo ketre cheembi ere epaŋ.”
36Men di Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ!
Men di mo epaŋ naniere hale mbaanaayɔ!
Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kikɛ shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Amɛn” Nseŋ di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.
B ka bee shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ Gibiɔn be asheŋ
37Ewura Deevid daŋ lara Asaf nɛ Livaiebi nɛ b la kabuna koŋwule ebi na nna fanɛ b baa keni kakpa nɛ ŋkre be deka na yil na be kushuŋ so karechɛ kikɛ. 38Jedutum pibinyɛn Obɛd Edɔm nɛ mbe kabuna be basa adeshe nɛ aburwa e daa chɛ bumo to. Hosa nɛ Obɛd Edɔm e daa keni mbuna na so.
39Bɔrɛmatapowura Zadɔk nɛ mo braana bɔrɛmatapoana e daa keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na so ashi Gibiɔn. 40Kachipurso nɛ kaaseso kikɛ b daa lara sarga chɔɔso nna a deŋi bɔrɛsure na so fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na mbe mbra to na gbagba. 41Heman nɛ Jedutum e daa la bumo be bechɛtopo, n ta bumo nɛ b daŋ lara fanɛ b baa boŋ nshɛ a maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal mbe kasha ka maŋ kɔ ekarso na n ti so. 42Heman nɛ Jedutum malɛ gba e daŋ naa foŋ mbel nsaa laŋ echakachaka nɛ alaŋsɔ nɛ baa laŋ nsaa boŋ nshɛ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ jemanɛ kikɛ. Basa nɛ b shi Jedutum be kabuna na e daa keni bumo be mbunaana so.
43Ndoŋ nna nɛ ekama yɔ epe nɛ Deevid malɛ yɔ mbe kanaŋ kutɔ.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 17
Content:
Neetan ka ta kubɔya m ba sa ewura Deevid be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 7:1-17)
1Ewura Deevid ka ya kaa wɔ mbe kuwura laŋ popɔr na to nɛ e tre anebi Neetan ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Keni! Ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na nɛ b ta m pɔr ewura be laŋ nɛ n wɔtɔ ere, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na bre wɔ wajɛbu to nna!”
2Nɛ Neetan shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Wora kusɔ kama nɛ fee fɛ fanɛ feeŋ wora, ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ fo kutɔ.”
3Kumo be kanyɛso, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Neetan le: 4“Ya kaŋɛ ma kayɛrbi Deevid fanɛ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa kaŋɛ mo na fanɛ mannɛ mo nɛ mee sha fanɛ e pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa ma nɛ m baa wɔtɔ. 5Yili jemanɛ so nɛ n lara Israɛlebi ashi Ijipt be efuli so dra dra na m ba fo kabre, m maŋ naŋ chena bɔrɛlambu to kikɛ. Kaplɛkama nɛ n yɔ malɛ, wajɛbu to nɛ mee luri. 6Enite damta nɛ ma nɛ Israɛlebi nite ere kikɛ, m maŋ naŋ bishi bumo be bejuŋkparpo nɛ n tre fanɛ b baa keni ma basa so fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapo bee keni mbe mbolpɔ so na be ekama kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ b maŋ ta ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na m pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa ma.”
7Amoso ya kaŋɛ ma kayɛrbi Deevid fanɛ le nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale na kaŋɛ: “N lara fo ashi mbolpɔkpapo be kushuŋ to nna n ta fo ŋ ki ma basa Israɛlebi na be ejuŋkparpo. 8Kaplɛkama nɛ fo daŋ yɔ, ma nɛ fo nna. Nɛ ma alɛ bee pɔɔ fo doŋana kikɛ so a sa fo. Kananɛ basa ko be atre dii ga durnya ere to na, loŋ gbagba nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ fo alɛ gba be ketre e dii. 9-10N sa ma basa Israɛlebi bumo gbagba be kakpa nɛ baaŋ chena nɛ basa lubi maaŋ naŋ mɛaŋ bumo. Baŋ yili saŋɛ nɛ b ba chena kasawule ere so nɛ saŋɛ nɛ n sa bumo bejuŋkparpo na kikɛ, basa lubi maŋ yige bumo, ama loŋ maaŋ naŋ wora kikɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, meeŋ pɔɔ fo doŋana so n sa fo nseŋ shin nɛ fo kaman to ebi e baa ji kuwura. 11Fo kaŋ wu nɛ b ta fo n ya nase fo nananyɛnana be edesekpa, meeŋ shin nɛ fo mbinyɛnsobi ere be eko e ki ewura, nɛ n shin nɛ mbe kuwurji malɛ e baa kɔ eleŋ ga. 12Mo e naŋ pɔr ma bɔrɛlambu n sa ma. Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ mbe kuwurji e baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. 13Meeŋ ki mo tuto, nɛ mo alɛ e baa la m pibinyɛn. M maaŋ yige kebaachɛ mo to fanɛ kananɛ n yige Ewura Sɔɔl mo nɛ n lara kuwurji to nseŋ ta fo n yuu to na. 14Meeŋ ta mo ŋ ki ma basa be ejuŋkparpo nɛ e baa keni ma efuli kikɛ so. Mbe mbia e naŋ ba ji kuwura a ka a sa abar so mbaanaayɔ.”
15Kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Neetan na gbagba chap nɛ e kaŋɛ ewura Deevid.
Ewura Deevid be kabɔrɛchɔrɔ be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 7:18-29)
16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ewura Deevid ya luri Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na to n ya chena ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ma nɛ ma kanaŋ maŋ daga kenya kusɔ nɛ fo wora n sa anyi ere. 17Kede be kaman, fo kraŋ nase kɔnɔ n sa ma kaman to ebi. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fee keni ma a bɔlɔ kenishi fanɛ esagboŋ ko nna. 18Manɛ nɛ n naa kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ? Fo nyi ma, fo kenya nɛnɛ. Ama fo kraŋ ta ma n yili kemaŋkura be eyilikpa. 19Fo keparso nɛ fo wora asheŋ ere n sa ma nseŋ nase le be nnɔgboŋ ere n sa ma. 20Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ fanɛ fo Enyɛnpe na. Fo nawule nɛ an nyi fo ka la Ebɔrɛ. 21Efuli kikɛ maŋ naa wɔ kasawule ere so fanɛ Israɛl be efuli nɛ fo lara ashi kenyaya to nseŋ shin nɛ b ki fo basa na. Mamachi be asɔ damta nɛ fo wora n sa bumo na e shin nɛ fo ketre dii durnya ere to. Fo mɔlga fo basa ashi Ijipt be kasawule so, m bar bumo nfe nseŋ ju efuli ere so ebi n shin nɛ fo basa chena bumo be nsawule so. 22Dra dra na kikɛ nɛ fo ta Israɛlebi ŋ ki fo gbagba be basa mbaanaayɔ, nseŋ ki bumo be Ebɔrɛ.
23N nyɛnpe nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ fo nase n sa ma nɛ ma kaman to ebi na e bɔlɔ so. Enyɛnpe, jande wora kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ na. 24Saŋɛ na so fo ketre beeŋ dii nɛ ekama e baa kaŋɛ le: ‘Enyɛnpetale na e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ.’ Feeŋ yili ma kuwurji mbaanaayɔ. 25Ŋkpal fo ka la ma Ebɔrɛ nseŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ ma kaman to ebi beeŋ baa la bewura na so nɛ fo kayɛrbi maa pɔ aba nɛ kebaakule fo na. 26Enyɛnpe, fo e la Ebɔrɛ nseŋ nase le be kɔnɔ fanɛ feeŋ wora asɔ lela ere n sa ma. 27Enyɛnpetale nɛfa ma kaman to ebi, saŋɛ na so feeŋ baa lara fo bewura bumo to saŋkama. Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ fo nɛfa beeŋ baa wɔ ma kaman to ebi so hale mbaanaayɔ.”

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 18
Content:
Deevid be kekɔmpɔɔso be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 8:1-18)
1Kede be kaman be jemanɛ ko ewura Deevid naŋ lɔŋɛ n ya kɔ Filistiebi na kena nna nseŋ pɔɔ bumo so. E daŋ kɔ n sɔ Gaf be kade nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti kumo na kikɛ nna. 2Ewura Deevid daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ Mowabebi gba so nna nseŋ shin nɛ b sɔ mo ŋ ki bumo be ewura a ka lampo a sa mo.
3Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid lar n ya kɔ m pɔɔ Zoba nɛ k mata Hamaf nɛ k wɔ Siriya be efuli so na be ewura nɛ baa tre Hadadeza na so, saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ ya kaa shin nɛ e sɔ Yufreetes be Lɔr na ase be efuli na ŋ ki mo peya na. 4Kena na to nɛ ewura Deevid suge egbaŋɛturko kagboŋ nseŋ pɛ egbaŋɛdiipoana ŋgboŋ ashunu nɛ benapo nɛ b na ayaso malɛ ŋgboŋ adunyɔ. E daŋ tuge egbaŋɛ na kikɛ be achin nna nseŋ yige bumo to be kalfa nɛ baa gberge eturko na.
5Siriyaebi nɛ b shi Damaskɔs na ka shuŋi benapo fanɛ b ya chɛ Zoba be ewura Hadadeza to ŋ kɔ kena, nɛ ewura Deevid mɔ bumo be basa ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ. 6Kede be kaman nɛ Deevid shin nɛ mbe benapo na be beko chena Damaskɔs n shin nɛ Siriyaebi na sɔ Deevid ŋ ki bumo be ewura a ka lampo a sa mo. Kaplɛkama nɛ ewura Deevid daŋ baŋ yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daa shin nɛ e bee kɔ a pɔɔ so nna. 7Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid ta Hadadeza be benimu be shuwa be asɔ kuŋso na n yɔ Jerusalɛm. 8E daŋ sɔ danyaŋ damta gba ashi Tibhaf nɛ Kun be nde nɛ Hadadeza daa ji kuwura amo so na gba to nna. Amo nɛ ewura Deevid pibi Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be katishaŋgboŋ nɛ baa tre teku na, nɛ eshabɔrɛ nɛ danyaŋ be ntishaŋ jito na.
9Hamaf be kade to be ewura Toi ka nu fanɛ ewura Deevid kɔ m pɔɔ Hadadeza be benapo kikɛ so na, 10nɛ e shuŋi mo pibinyɛn Joram fanɛ e ya chɔrɔ ewura Deevid nseŋ sa mo ansaŋ nɛ kushuŋ ŋkpal e ka kɔ m pɔɔ Hadadeza nɛ mo ere Toi kɔ mo kena alɛ damta nsaa maŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ mo so so. Asɔ nɛ b ta shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ n wora nɛ Joram daŋ ta m ba kɛ ewura Deevid. 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid ta asɔ na n ti shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ e kɔ Edɔm nɛ Mowab nɛ Ammɔn nɛ Filisti nɛ Amalɛk be efuliana n sɔ na so m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ.
12Ewura Deevid be enapo nɛ baa tre Abishai nɛ mo nio daa la Zuriya na e daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ Edɔmebi nɛ b daa wɔ Nfɔl be ketaŋɛ na ase nseŋ mɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduaburwa kikɛ. 13E daŋ wora benapo be echenakpaana nna ashi Edɔm be efuli so kikɛ nna n shin nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ sɔ ewura Deevid ŋ ki bumo be ewura. Kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ ewura Deevid daŋ yɔ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daa shin nna nɛ e bee kɔ a pɔɔ so.
14Ewura Deevid daa la Israɛl be efuli so kikɛ be ewura nna nseŋ daa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nsaa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi. 15Zeruwa pibinyɛn Jɔab e daa la benapo na be enimu, nɛ Ahilud malɛ pibinyɛn Jehoshafat daa la esa nɛ e bee sibɛ asheŋ a nase kawɔl to. 16Ahitub pibinyɛn Zadɔk nɛ Abiata pibinyɛn Ahimɛlɛk e daa la bɔrɛmatapoana. Sɛraya malɛ e daa la ewura be esibɛpo. 17Jehowada pibinyɛn Bɛnaya e daa la benapo nɛ baa kuŋ ewura Deevid na be enimu, nɛ ewura Deevid malɛ be mbinyɛnsobi daa la mbe ekrachigboŋ.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 19
Content:
Ewura Deevid ka kɔ m pɔɔ Ammɔnebi nɛ Siriyaebi so be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 10:1-19)
1K maŋ chɛr ko nɛ Ammɔn be ewura Nahaash wu, nɛ mo pibinyɛn Hanuun ki ewura. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid fɛ le: “A daga ŋ ka bugi kagbene n wora Hanuun kelela, fanɛ kananɛ, mo tuto Nahaash gba daŋ bugi mbe kagbene n wora ma kelela na.” Amoso Deevid daŋ shuŋi mbɔ nna fanɛ b ya wora Hanuun edaŋkena. B ka ya fo Ammɔn be kasawule so, 3nɛ Ammɔn be bewurbi na kaŋɛ ewura na le: “Fee fɛ fanɛ fo tuto be bunyaŋ so nɛ ewura Deevid shuŋi basa ere fanɛ b ba wora fo edaŋkena ere a? Manɛ loŋ so nna! E shuŋi bumo nna nɛ b ba dara anyi be efuli ere saŋɛ na so e beeŋ ba kɔ m pɔɔ anyi so!”
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ Hanuun shin nɛ b pɛ Deevid be mbɔ na n she bumo be ntɔl nseŋ ku bumo be epiŋi be aya ase n ya fo bumo be nshɛr to nseŋ yige bumo nɛ b choŋ. 5Nɛ mbɔ na fin kananɛ baaŋ naŋ bɛta n yɔ epe ŋ gben ŋkpal anishinyɔr so. Ewura Deevid ka nu kusɔ nɛ k wora na nɛ e shuŋi n ya kaŋɛ mbɔ na fanɛ b ya kaa wɔ Jɛriko n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ bumo be ntɔl na beeŋ kɔr pɔɛŋ nɛ b ba epe.
6Ewura Hanun nɛ Ammɔnebi na malɛ ka pin fanɛ ewura Deevid ki bumo doŋ, nɛ b ta gbiti be ndarbi nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ adesa nɛ ana n ya haya egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛturko be bediipoana ashi Mɛsopoteemia be efuli so nɛ Maaka nɛ Zoba nɛ a la Siriyaebi be efuli na. 7Egbaŋɛturko nɛ amo be bediipo ŋgboŋ adesa nɛ anyɔ nɛ b daŋ haya na, nɛ Maaka be ewura be benapo e daŋ ba wora bumo be keyi to m mata Mɛdiba. Nɛ Ammɔn be benapo na malɛ lar bumo be nde to n ya bela ase nɛ b kɔ kena.
8Ewura Deevid ka nu kusɔ nɛ k bee wora na, nɛ e shuŋi Jɔab nɛ mbe benapo kikɛ nɛ b ya tu bumo. 9Nɛ Ammɔn be benapo kre kena n yili bumo be kade Raba be kabunagboŋ na ekpa nɛ Siriya be benapoana na malɛ kre n yili kade na be laŋgar.
10Jɔab ka wu fanɛ mo doŋana na wɔ mbe anishito nɛ kaman kikɛ na, nɛ e lara Israɛl be benapo lempo na fanɛ b ya kɔ Siriyaebi na, 11nseŋ shin mo sipo Abishai malɛ juŋkpar benapo nɛ b ka na n ya kaa kɔ Ammɔnebi na. 12Le nɛ Jɔab kaŋɛ Abishai: “Fo baŋ wu fanɛ Siriyaebi na bee pɔɔ ma so, fo wora ania m ba chɛ ma to, nɛ Ammɔnebi na kaa pɔɔ fo alɛ so, ma alɛ beeŋ ba chɛ fo to. 13Baa kɔ eleŋ nsaa leŋ fo kumo to kpakpa! Men shin nɛ an pere kenishi ŋ kɔ n sa anyi be basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nde, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ e wora.”
14Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jɔab nɛ mbe benapo yɔ nɛ b ya kɔ Siriyaebi na kena, nɛ b shile. 15Ammɔnebi na ka wu fanɛ Siriyaebi na bee shile, nɛ bumo alɛ gba lara keya fuful Abishai nɛ mbe benapo be anishito n shile n luri kade to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jɔab bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm.
16Siriyaebi na ka wu fanɛ Israɛlebi na pɔɔ bumo so na nɛ b shuŋi n tre Siriyaebi nɛ b wɔ lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na be kaba ndoŋ na. Shobak nɛ e bee juŋkpar Zoba be ewura Hadadeza be benapo na e daa la bumo be ejuŋkparpo. 17Ewura Deevid ka nu loŋ nɛ e shin nɛ Israɛl be benapo na kikɛ chala abar so n dii Jɔɔdan be Lɔr na, n ya tu Siriyaebi na. Kena na ka fara na, 18nɛ Israɛlebi na ju m buu Siriyaebi be benapo na so nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ mbe benapo mɔ Siriyaebi na be egbaŋɛturkodiipo ŋgboŋ ashunu nɛ benapo nɛ b na ayaso malɛ ŋgboŋ adena. B daŋ mɔ Shobak nɛ e la Siriyaebi be benapo be enimu na gba kena na to nna. 19Bewura mo nɛ b daa bɛ ewura Hadadeza so na ka pin fanɛ Israɛlebi na pɔɔ bumo so nɛ b fara a fin kagbenewushi ewura Deevid kutɔ, hale n shin nɛ e ki bumo be ewura. Kumo be kaman nɛ Siriyaebi na kini fanɛ b maaŋ naŋ chɛ Ammɔnebi na to kikɛ.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 20
Content:
Ewura Deevid ka kɔ n sɔ Raaba be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 12:26-31)
1Dɔchubɔrɛ be saŋɛ nɛ bewura bee yɔ kena to na nɛ Jɔab juŋkpar Israɛl be benapo nɛ e ya kɔ n sɔ Ammɔn be kasawule. Ewura Deevid bre daŋ shir a wɔ Jerusalɛm nna. Benapo na daŋ pugi ŋ kulti kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Raaba na nna n wɔtɔ ŋ kɔ m mur kumo. 2Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid yɔ Raaba n ya ta bumo be kegbir nɛ baa tre Mɔlɛk na be kuwurwuro nɛ b ta shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo adesa nɛ ana n lɔŋɛ na. Kuwuro na to daa kɔ kemaŋkanibi lela ko nna nɛ ewura Deevid ta kumo m mata mbe kuwurwuro so. E daŋ tintiŋ nna m muu kade na to be asɔ lela kikɛ gba n yɔ. 3Nseŋ tintiŋ kade na to be basa nɛ baa ta ekapɛnta be nsaŋɛgboŋ nɛ abɛlso be ntekpa nɛ akpanfu a shuŋ. Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ e daŋ wora nde nɛ a wɔ Ammɔn be efuli so na kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ mo nɛ mbe benapo bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm.
4Kede be kaman nɛ Israɛlebi na kɔ Filistiebi na kena ashi Gɛza. Loŋ be kena na to nɛ Sibikai nɛ e shi Husha na mɔ kanyɛn tenteŋ gboŋgboŋi ko nɛ baa tre Sipaya na nseŋ pɔɔ Filistiebi na so.
5Kena ko ka naŋ koso Israɛlebi na nɛ Filistiebi na be kefɛato nɛ Jair pibinyɛn Ɛlhanan mɔ Lami nɛ e la Goliɛf nɛ e shi Gaaf na mo da na. Mbe kekpa be kedibi be bumburuŋ daa du fanɛ keyapuye nna.
6Kena nyɔsopo ka naŋ koso ashi Gaaf, nɛ kanyɛn tenteŋ gboŋgboŋi ko nɛ e la Filisti be enapo nsaa kɔ ashilbi nɛ anashibi asheshe wɔ ndoŋ. E daa la dra na be basa tenteŋ gboŋgboŋiana nɛ baa tre Rafa na be kenana nna. 7Mo e daŋ wora Israɛlebi na eyurto nɛ ewura Deevid mo da Shamaa pibinyɛn Jonatan mɔ mo na.
8Basa asa nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ mbe benapo mɔ ere kikɛ daa la Gaaf be basa tenteŋ gboŋgboŋi na be kenana nna.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 21
Content:
Ewura Deevid ka karga mbe basa be asheŋ
(2 Samuɛl 24:1-25)
1Setani daa sha kebar tɔrɔ Israɛl be basa so nna, amoso e daŋ sa ewura Deevid nfɛra nna fanɛ e karga basa na. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid kaŋɛ Jɔab nɛ benimuana na le: “Meeŋ ya yili Dan be kade to ashi efuli na so be kelargato be esoso ŋ karga Israɛlebi na kikɛ n ya fo Bɛshiba ashi kelargato be kaseto. Saŋɛ na so meeŋ pin bumo nɛ b fo kena to be keyɔ be kɔnɔ.”
3Nɛ Jɔab kaŋɛ ewura Deevid le: “Yiramu, hale nɛ Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ Israɛl be benapo wora kishi n ti so fanɛ ntuŋ kalfa a chɔ kananɛ b du naniere gba bumo kikɛ kra la fo nyɛrbi nna. Manɛ e ba nɛ fee sha fanɛ fo wora le be kesheŋ nɛ k maŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ere n shin nɛ nfɛra lubi ere e ba efuli ere so?” 4Ama ewura Deevid kini kechɛrga mbe nfɛra nseŋ shin nɛ Jɔab nu n sa mo nseŋ ya karga Israɛl be benapo na nseŋ bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm, 5m ba kaŋɛ ewura Deevid fanɛ benapo nɛ b fo kena be kekɔ ashi Israɛl be efuli so wɔ ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto be kagboŋ koŋwule nɛ ŋgboŋ kalfa, nɛ Juda malɛ be benapo la ŋgboŋ alfa ana nɛ adushunu. 6Ŋkpal ewura na be kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ na ka daŋ maŋ par Jɔab so, e daa maŋ karga Livai nɛ Bɛnjamin bre be eyiri na.
7Ŋkpal ewura Deevid ka shin nɛ b karga benapo na so Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna nseŋ gberge Israɛlebi kusoe. 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ le: “Kusɔ nɛ n wora ere bee ŋini nna fanɛ n wora kulubi gboŋgboŋi. Amoso jande, ta m paŋ ma ŋkpal manɛ so n wora kawulisheŋ.”
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ anebi Gad le: 10“Ya kaŋɛ Deevid fanɛ e lara asɔ asa nɛ mee sa mo ere to be kumo nɛ e bee sha fanɛ n ta ŋ gberge mo kusoe.”
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ anebi Gad yɔ ewura Deevid kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na. E yɛ: “Asɔ asa ere to be kumo nɛ feeŋ ba sha? 12Akoŋgboŋ be ketɔr fo kasawule so nfɛ asa ŋko fo keshile fo doŋana afɔl asa ŋko kulɔ be aleblawu ko be keba fo kasawule so m ba mɔ basa nchɛnsa? Fɛ kumo be asheŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ fee sha fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.”
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid kaŋɛ Gad le: “N wɔ kagbenejija be kebaawɔtɔ to nna ama maa sha dimɛdi ka gberge ma kusoe. Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka bee wu kuwɔr so, mo gbagba e gberge ma kusoe.”
14Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nna nɛ kulɔ be aleblawu ba Israɛlebi so nɛ bumo be basa ŋgboŋ adushunu kikɛ wu. 15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka shuŋi malaika fanɛ e ya mur Jerusalɛm na, nɛ kuwɔr naŋ pɛ mo nɛ e chɛrga mbe nfɛra a yɔ basa na be kasogberge be kaplɛa so nseŋ kaŋɛ malaika nɛ e bee mɔ bumo na le: “K nyalɛ loŋ, Lara fo enɔ ashi bumo be asheŋ to!” Kumo be jemanɛ na nɛ Malaika na teŋ fo Aruna nɛ e shi Jerusalɛm na be kugooro na ase. 16Deevid ka wu malaika na ka wɔ esoso ŋ keta mbe tokobi nɛ e mur Jerusalɛm na, nɛ mo nɛ Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ b buu kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso na tɔr epun so n dese kasawule. 17Nɛ Deevid kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ma e wora n jija nseŋ wora kulubi ŋkpal ŋ ka shin nɛ baa karga basa na so. Nɛ manɛ nɛ bebɔlpo ere malɛ wora? N nyɛnpe nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ. Ma nɛ ma kanaŋ e daga fo ka gberge kusoe nseŋ yige basa ere bre.”
18Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be malaika na kaŋɛ Gad fanɛ e ya kaŋɛ ewura Deevid le: “Yɔ Aruna be kugooro nɛ baa bri asɔ na so n ya pɔr bɔrɛsure n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.” 19Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid wora kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bɔla anebi Gad so ŋ kaŋɛ mo na. 20Aruna nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi ana ka wɔ kugooro na so a bri ayu nseŋ wu malaika na, nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi na shile n ya ŋana. 21Aruna ka wu ewura Deevid ka bee ba mo kutɔ na, nɛ e lar kugooro na so n ya gbir kasawule Deevid be anishito ŋ kur mbe kumu n yuu to. 22Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid kaŋɛ mo le: “M ba nna nɛ m ba tɔ fo kugooro ere m pɔr bɔrɛsure n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ ju aleblawu ere ashi anyi so. Meeŋ tɔ kumo kanaŋkama nɛ feeŋ fa kumo.”
23Nɛ Aruna kaŋɛ le: “Yiramu! Ta kumo n wora kusɔ kama nɛ kepar fo n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Ana gba nde! Feeŋ tiŋ n ta amo n lara sarga bɔrɛsure na so nseŋ ta ndibi nɛ b kɔ a bri ayu na malɛ m puga edɛ nseŋ ta ayu malɛ n lara ajibi be sarga. Amo kikɛ la feya nna.”
24Nɛ ewura Deevid malɛ kaŋɛ mo le: “M-m, meeŋ ka amo be kukɔ n sa fo ŋkpal manɛ so m maa sha k lara sarga nɛ m maŋ bɔ kukɔ kumo so n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.” 25Kede be kaman nɛ e tɔ kugooro na Aruna kutɔ shuwa be ndarbi alfa ashe. 26E daŋ pɔr bɔrɛsure ndoŋ nna n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nseŋ lara esarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be esarga, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ edɛ shi esoso m ba chɔɔ sarga na ashi bɔrɛsure na so.
27Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ malaika na fanɛ e ta mbe tokobi na n wɔtɔ kumo be efar to, nɛ e wora loŋ. 28Ewura Deevid ka wu malaika na ka wora loŋ a ŋini fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nu mbe kekule na, nɛ e naŋ lara esarga n ti so n sa Enyɛnpe na ashi Aruna be kugooro na so. 29Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu nɛ Mosis daŋ yuu ashi kiyi na to nɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ e pɔr nɛ b daa lara sarga chɔɔso kumo so na kikɛ daa wɔ kakpa nɛ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ loŋ be saŋɛ na ashi Gibiɔn na nna; 30ama ewura Deevid bre daa maŋ tiŋ n yɔ ndoŋ n ya bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal e ka daa ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be malaika na be tokobi na so.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 22
Content:
1Amoso le nɛ ewura Deevid daŋ kaŋɛ: “Kugooro ere so nfe ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ baaŋ pɔr Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na, nɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ Israɛlebi beeŋ baa lara esarga kumo so na gba e baa wɔ nfe.”
B ka wora bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr be shiriya be asheŋ
2Ŋkpal loŋ so ewura Deevid daŋ shin nɛ befɔ nɛ b wɔ Israɛl na kikɛ daŋ ba shɛr Jerusalɛm nna, nɛ e shin nɛ bumo be beko bee kuya ajembu be ebirkesi nɛ a shishi nɛ b pɔr bɔrɛlambu na. 3E daŋ fin abɛlso damta nɛ baaŋ ta n lɔŋɛ anyembi nɛ asɔ nɛ baaŋ ta ŋ gbir akuloŋ m mata nna, nseŋ bar danyaŋ damta nɛ b maŋ tiŋ ŋ karga amo be egbɛ. 4E daŋ ŋ kla nna n shoŋi Tayɛ nɛ Sidɔn be basa nɛ b bar mo sida be ndibi damta. 5Le nɛ ewura Deevid daŋ kaŋɛ: “Bɔrɛlambu nɛ m pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn beeŋ pɔr na beeŋ baa walɛ m baŋ so nɛ durnya kikɛ e nu kumo be asheŋ. Ama ŋkpal e ka kraa la kebia a maŋ naŋ pin asɔ damta to na so, a daga fanɛ n wora kumo be shiriya n yili mo.” Amoso ewura Deevid daŋ fin bɔrɛlambu na be kapɔr be asɔ damta nna n yili pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu.
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid shuŋi n tre mo pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn ŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na. 7Le nɛ Deevid kaŋɛ mo: “M pibinyɛn, n daa sha fanɛ m pɔr bɔrɛlambu nna m maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 8Ama Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ ma nna fanɛ ŋkpal ŋ ka kɔ ana damta nseŋ mɔ basa ga na so, e maaŋ shin nɛ m pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa mo. 9Enyɛnpe na malɛ teŋ juŋkpar n nase le be kɔnɔ n sa ma: Fo pibi kaŋ ba ki ewura meeŋ shin nɛ kagbenewushi e baa wɔ mbe kasawule so. Kebia na be ketre e naŋ ba la Sɔlɔmɔn ŋkpal manɛ so mbe kuwurji be saŋɛ nɛ meeŋ kuŋ Israɛl nɛnɛ nɛ kagbenewushi e baa wɔ kumo to. 10Mo e naŋ pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa ma. Meeŋ tre mo m pibi nɛ mo alɛ gba e tre ma mo tuto. Mbe mbia e naa baa ji Israɛl be kuwura a ka a sa abar mbaanaayɔ.”
11Kumo be kaman nɛ Deevid yɛ: “M pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn, Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ fo kutɔ n shin nɛ kɔnɔ nɛ e nase fanɛ e beeŋ chɛ fo to nɛ fo pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa mo na e bɔlɔ so. 12Enyɛnpe nɛ e la fo Ebɔrɛ na e sa fo kanyiasheŋ nɛ nfɛra nɛ fo baa wora asheŋ amo be ekpa so, nseŋ juŋkpar Israɛl ashi mbe mbra be ekpa so nɛnɛ. 13Fo baa bɛ mbra nɛ keŋini nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta n sa an nananyɛn Mosis dra dra na fanɛ e ta n sa Israɛlebi na so bre, asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa fo. Ama baa yil to kpakpa a leŋ fo kumu to nsaa maa lɔ kufu. 14N wora ania n gama asɔ damta nɛ a daga fanɛ b ta m pɔr bɔrɛlambu na abar so. Ŋ kɔ shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto be ŋgboŋ asa nɛ ŋgboŋ alfa ana, nɛ gbiti nɛ amo alɛ be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto be ŋgboŋ adesa nɛ ana, nɛ fo ta n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na. Ŋ kɔ ndibi nɛ ajembu lela nɛ danyaŋ nɛ abɛlso damta nɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga amo be egbɛ gba. Ama fo alɛ gba kraŋ beeŋ tiŋ m bishi kusɔ kama nɛ fee sha n ti so. 15Men kɔ beshumpo damta. Basa nɛ baa bure ajembu to nɛ bepɔrpo nɛ ekapɛnta nɛ basa damta nɛ b nyi enɔ to be ashuŋ damta 16nsaa tiŋ a ta shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ nɛ kebɛlso a lɔŋɛ asɔ. K daga fanɛ men fara kushuŋ na naniere nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e chɛ menyi to.”
17Kede be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid kaŋɛ Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana nna fanɛ b chɛ Sɔlɔmɔn to. 18E yɛ: “Enyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na e chɛ menyi to nseŋ sa menyi kagbenewushi ekpa kama so. E chɛ ma to nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ basa nɛ b daa wɔ kasawule na so nseŋ shin nɛ baa shuŋ ma nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 19Men ta men be ŋgbene nɛ men be ayoyu kikɛ a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ. Men fara a pɔr bɔrɛlambu na saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na nɛ asɔ cheembi nɛ b kɔ a bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na n ya yili kumo to.”

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 23
Content:
1Deevid ka bel, nɛ e ta mo pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn ŋ ki Israɛl be ewura.
Livaiebi na be kushuŋ be asheŋ
2Saŋko ka ba fo, nɛ ewura Deevid shin nɛ Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na kikɛ ba shɛr abar so. 3E daŋ karga Livaiebi be benyɛn nɛ b daŋ fo nfɛ adesa ŋko m baŋ so na nna. Bumo kikɛ daa la basa ŋgboŋ adesa nɛ aburwa nna. 4E daŋ shin nna nɛ Livaiebi na be basa ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ ana bee shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ basa ŋgboŋ ashe malɛ la nwɔlsibɛpoana nɛ demujipoana, 5nɛ basa ŋgboŋ ana malɛ bee kuŋ bɔrɛlambu na nɛ ŋgboŋ ana malɛ bee ta alaŋsɔ nɛ ewura sa bumo na a laŋ a maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.
6Ewura Deevid daŋ barga Livaiebi na to mbuna ntuŋ asa nna. Amo e la Gɛshɔn be kabuna nɛ Kohaf be kabuna nɛ Mɛrari be kabuna.
7Ladan nɛ Shimei daŋ shi Gɛshɔn be kabuna nna. 8Ladan daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e daa la Jehiɛl nɛ Zetam nɛ Jowɛl. Bumo e daa la Ladan be kabuna na be benimu. 9Shimei malɛ daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e la Shelomɔf nɛ Haziɛl nɛ Haran. 10-11Bede be kaman nɛ Shimei naŋ nya mbinyɛnsobi ana. Bumo e la Jahaf nɛ Zina nɛ Jewush nɛ Beriya. Jewush nɛ Beriya bre be mbia daa maŋ shi amoso b daŋ ta bumo nna m ber abar so fanɛ kanaŋ koŋwule be basa.
12Kohaf daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e daa la Amram nɛ Izha nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ Uziɛl. 13Amram nɛ e daa la mo pibinyɛn nimuso na be mbia e daa la Ɛɛrɔn nɛ Mosis. Ɛɛrɔn nɛ mbe kaman to ebi nɛ b daŋ lara n yili fanɛ b baa keni asɔ cheembi na so mbaanaayɔ. Bumo alɛ e naaŋ baa chɔɔ duwu saŋɛ so nɛ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nsaa shuŋ mo a kule mo fanɛ e baa nɛfa mbe basa. 14Ama Mosis nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be esa na be mbinyɛnsobiana bre, daŋ ti Livaiebi na so nna. 15Mosis be mbinyɛnsobi e daa la Gɛshɔm nɛ Eliaza. 16Gɛshɔm pibinyɛn nimuso e daa la Shebuwɛl. 17Ebinyɛn koŋwule nɛ Eliaza daa kɔ. Mbe ketre e daa la Rahabiya. Rahabiya bre daa kɔ kaman to ebi damta nna.
18Kohaf pibinyɛn nyɔsopo e daa la Izha nɛ Izha pibinyɛn nimuso daa la Shelomif. 19Hibrɔn nɛ e la Kohaf pibinyɛn sasopo na daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Jeriya nɛ Amariya nɛ Jehaziɛl nɛ Jekamiɛm. 20Uziɛl nɛ e la Kohaf pibinyɛn nasopo na daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Maika nɛ Ashiya.
21Mɛrari daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e la Maali nɛ Mushi. Maali gba daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nna. Bumo e daa la Eliaza nɛ Kish. 22Eliaza bre daa maŋ kurge mbinyɛnsobi, mbichesobi nawule nɛ e daŋ kurge nɛ bumo alɛ kil bumo tutokar Kish be mbia. 23Mushi nɛ e la Mɛrari pibinyɛn nyɔsopo na daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna. Bumo e daa la Maali nɛ Eda nɛ Jerɛmɔf.
24Livai be kabuna nɛ mbe kaman to ebi nɛ b daŋ karga nna na. B daŋ shin nna nɛ bumo be bumo nɛ b fo nfɛ adunyɔ ŋko m baŋ so na bre daa shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na to.
25Ŋkpal manɛ so Deevid yɛ, Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na sa mbe basa kagbenewushi, mo alɛ Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa wɔ Jerusalɛm mbaanaayɔ. 26Amoso Livaiebi na maaŋ naa sulɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na nɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ ashuŋ kumo to na a nite. 27Kusɔ nɛ Deevid yili e la fanɛ Livaiebi kama nɛ b fo nfɛ adunyɔ na daga fanɛ b sibɛ bumo be atre nɛ b fara a shuŋ. 28Livaiebi na be kushuŋ e daa la kebaachɛ Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi to ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na be kushuŋ to. Bumo e naŋ baa lɔŋɛ kumo nsaa keni kumo be alɔnɛ nɛ ebuana nɛ asɔ cheembi na so nɛ a saa maa wora eyurpi. 29Bumo koŋwule na e naaŋ naa keni bodobodo nɛ b ta n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ nyifu nɛ b kɔ a lara sarga na nɛ ekrakashi nɛ a maaŋ kɔ yiisi na so, nsaa wora bodobodo nɛ baa ta n lara sarga na. Bumo koŋwule na e naa karga kusɔ kama, nsaa ta duwu nɛ asɔ warabi nɛ nyifu nɛ ɔlif be ŋku a wea abar to a wora asɔ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to. 30Bumo Livaiebi na e naaŋ baa chɔrɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nsaa boŋ nshɛ e di mo epaŋ kachipurso nɛ kaaseso kikɛ. 31Bumo koŋwule na e naŋ baa ta kechɔrɔ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nsaa di mo epaŋ saŋkama nɛ baa lara kewushiachɛ nɛ kufɔl popɔr be nchɛgboŋ nɛ nchɛgboŋana kikɛ be esarga na. Kushuŋ nɛ b sa Livaiebi be katuŋ kama na e daga fanɛ b baa shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito saŋkama. 32Saŋko bumo e daa keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na so, ama naniere bre bumo e naa keni bɔrɛlambu na so nsaa chɛ Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ nɛ b shi kebɔrɛmata be kanaŋ na to na to a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na to.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 24
1 KRONIKƐLS 25
Content:
Bɔrɛlambu to be beshɛbompoana be asheŋ
1Ewura Deevid nɛ Livaiebi be bejuŋkparpoana daŋ lara Asaf nɛ Heman nɛ Jedutum nna fanɛ b baa la bɔrɛlambu to be beshɛbompo. Bumo e naŋ baa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ echakachaka nɛ egoji a maŋkura Ebɔrɛ nsaa juŋkpar basa a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ. Basa nɛ b lara fanɛ b baa juŋkpar basa a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na be atre nde.
2Asaf e daa juŋkpar mbe mbinyɛnsobi ana nɛ baa laŋ alaŋsɔ nsaa boŋ nshɛ saŋkama nɛ ewura na bee sha kashɛ be kenu. Bumo e daa la Zakuur nɛ Josɛf nɛ Netaniya nɛ Asharila.
3Jedutum malɛ e daa juŋkpar mbe mbinyɛnsobi ashe nɛ baa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nsaa boŋ nshɛ a maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Bumo e daa la Gedaliya nɛ Zeeri nɛ Jeshaya nɛ Shimei nɛ Hashabia nɛ Matatiya.
4Heman bre daa kɔ mbinyɛnso kuduana nna. Bumo e daa la Buukiya nɛ Mataniya nɛ Uziɛl nɛ Shebuwɛl nɛ Jerimɔf nɛ Hananiya nɛ Hanani nɛ Eliata nɛ Gidalti nɛ Romamti Eza nɛ Joshbekasha nɛ Malooti nɛ Hotiir nɛ Mahaziɔf. 5Heman daa la ewura na be anebi ko nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mbinyɛnsobi kuduana ere nɛ mbicheso asa n nɛfa mo. 6Heman e daa juŋkpar mbe mbia kuduana na nɛ baa laŋ echakachaka nɛ ejaŋjilaŋ a bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi bɔrɛlambu na to. Ama ewura Deevid gbagba e daa ŋini Asaf nɛ Jedutum nɛ Heman bre kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ b wora.
7Bumo nɛ bumo braana Livaiebi nɛ bumo kikɛ koso basa alfa anyɔ nɛ aduburwa nɛ aburwa na kikɛ daa nyi nshɛ be keboŋ nɛnɛ nna.
