8B daa to beri nna a lara ekama be kushuŋ a sa mo. K maŋ tir fanɛ fo la kebia ŋko enimu ŋko eŋinipo ŋko ekoyapo.
9-31B daŋ barga benyɛn alfa anyɔ nɛ aduburwa nɛ aburwa na to ntuŋ adunyɔ nɛ ana nna nɛ katuŋ kama to la basa kuduanyɔ nsaa kɔ kumo be ejuŋkparpo. Katuŋ kama be ejuŋkparpo be ketre nɛ b daŋ ta n nase kumo, nɛ baa shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ kebɛso kebɛso le. Josɛf be katuŋ e juŋkpar nseŋ ta Gɛdaliya nɛ Zakuur nɛ Zeeri nɛ Netaniya nɛ Buukiya nɛ Asarila nɛ Jeshaya nɛ Mataniya nɛ Shimei nɛ Uziɛl nɛ Hashabia nɛ Shebuwɛl nɛ Matatiya nɛ Jerimɔf nɛ Hananiya nɛ Joshbekasha nɛ Hanani nɛ Malooti nɛ Eliata nɛ Hotiir nɛ Gidalti nɛ Mahaziɔf nɛ Romamti Eza be ntuŋana m bɛso.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 26
Content:
Bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo be asheŋ
1B daŋ yili mbuna mbuna so nna mbarga bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpo na to ntuŋ ntuŋ so. Koora pibinyɛn Mɛshɛlemiya nɛ e shi Koora be kabuna na daa la Asaf be kenana nna. 2E daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ashunu nɛ b bɛ abar so kenimu kenimuso le. Zakareya nɛ Jedial nɛ Zebadiya nɛ Jafniɛl nɛ 3Elaam nɛ Jehohanan nɛ Eliehonaya.
4Obɛd Edɔm gba daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi aburwa nna. Kananɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi na bɛ abar so kenimu kenimuso nde. Shemaya nɛ Jehozabad nɛ Jowa nɛ Saaka nɛ Natanɛl 5nɛ Ammiɛl nɛ Isaaka nɛ Pelletai.
6-7Obɛd Edɔm pibinyɛn nimuso Shemaya daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ashe nna. Bumo e la Ofni nɛ Refɛl nɛ Obɛd nɛ Elzabad nɛ Elihu nɛ Samakiya. B daa la basagboŋ nna bumo be kanaŋ to ŋkpal kenyi nɛ b daa kɔ so. Mbe mbia anyɔ nɛ b shir kaman na bre e daa kɔ kenyi ga.
8Benyɛn adeshe nɛ anyɔ nɛ b nyi kushuŋ nɛnɛ a kɔ eleŋ nɛ b shuŋ bekumpo be kushuŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to na daŋ shi Obɛd Edɔm be kabuna nna.
9Benyɛn kuduaburwa nɛ bumo alɛ gba nyi kushuŋ nɛnɛ e daŋ shi Mɛshɛlemiya be kabuna.
10-11Hoosa nɛ e shi Mɛrari be kabuna na daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna. Bumo e la Shimri nɛ Hilkiya nɛ Tebaliya nɛ Zakareya. Hoosa daŋ ta Shimri nna ŋ ki bumo be ejuŋkparpo, ama mannɛ mo e daa la mbe wurkoŋ. Basa kuduasa e daŋ shi Hoosa be kanaŋ to a kuŋ bɔrɛlambu na.
12B daŋ yili kanaŋ kanaŋ so nna mbarga bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpo na to ntuŋ ntuŋ so nseŋ sa bumo ashuŋ fanɛ bumo braana Livaiebi nɛ b ka na. 13Kanaŋ kama daa to beri nna a pin kabuna nɛ baaŋ baa keni so. K maŋ tir kananɛ kanaŋ na sa. 14Shelemaya e daa keni epeŋilarkpa be kabuna na so nɛ mo pibinyɛn Zakareya nɛ e daa sa kasotoji lela na daa keni kelargato be esoso be kaba so be kabuna na so. 15Kelargato be kaseto be kaba so be kabuna nɛ Obɛd Edɔm daa keni so nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobiana malɛ bee keni ebuana nɛ bumo be asɔ bee yili to ashi loŋ be kabuna ase na so. 16Shuupim nɛ Hoosa nɛ b daŋ ta epeŋitɔrkpa be kabuna na nɛ Shalekɛf be kabuna nɛ k wɔ esoso be kubɔrbi na ase na n sa nɛ baa keni so. B daŋ barga kushuŋ na to nna n sa bekumpo na nɛ baa shuŋ kumo kebɛso kebɛso. 17Karechɛ kama bekumpo ashe e daa keni bɔrɛlambu na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nɛ bena malɛ bee keni kumo be kelargato be esoso be kaba so nɛ bekumpo ana malɛ bee keni kelargato be kaseto be kaba so. Bekumpo ana malɛ e daa keni ebuana nɛ baa ta bumo be asɔ a yili to na so. Basa anyɔ anyɔ e daa keni ebu koŋwule so. 18Bekumpo ana e daa keni kubɔrbi nɛ k bee yɔ kelɔnɛ nɛ k dese epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na so nɛ benyɔ malɛ bee keni kelɔnɛ na gbagba so. 19Mbuna be kekeniso be kushuŋ nɛ b ta n sa Koora nɛ Mɛrari be mbunaebi nna na.
Bɔrɛlambu to be ashuŋ nɛ a ka na be asheŋ
20Livaiebi nɛ bumo kurgepoana la Koora nɛ Mɛrari be mbunaebi na e daa keni bɔrɛlambu na to be ebuana nɛ baa yili amansherbi nɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ amo to na so. 21Ladan nɛ e shi Gɛshɔn be kabuna na pibinyɛn e daa la Jehiɛl. Mo alɛ be kaman to ebi be galenga daa la nnaŋ be benimuana nna ashi kabuna na. 22Jehiɛl be mbinyɛnsobi Zetam nɛ Jowɛl e daa keni bɔrɛlambu na be amansherbi nɛ asɔ be ebuana so.
23Amram nɛ Iza nɛ Hibrɔn nɛ Uziɛl nɛ b shi Koha be kabuna na gba daŋ ti basa nɛ baa keni amansherbi nɛ asɔ be ebuana so na nna.
24Shebuwɛl daa la Mosis pibinyɛn Gɛshɔm be kenana nna. Mo e daa la bɔrɛlambu na to be amansherbi nɛ asɔ be ebuana be bekenipoana na be enimu. 25Gɛshɔm mo da Eliaza mo kurgepo e daa la Shelomif. Eliaza pibi e daa la Rehabiya, nɛ Rehabiya malɛ pibi daa la Jeshaya nɛ Jeshaya malɛ pibi daa la Joram nɛ Joram malɛ pibi daa la Zikri nɛ Zikri malɛ pibi daa la Shelomif. 26Shelomif nɛ mo kurgepoana e daa keni ŋkɛ kama nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ kanaŋ be benimuana nɛ mbuna be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ benapo be benimuana ta m ba sa Ebɔrɛ na so. 27Saŋkama nɛ b kɔ kena n sɔ asɔ, baa ta amo be alela nna m ba bɔrɛlambu na to m ba bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ. 28Shelomif koŋwule na nɛ mo kurgepoana e naa keni ŋkɛ nɛ anebi Samuɛl nɛ ewura Sɔɔl nɛ Neer pibinyɛn Abna nɛ Zeruwa pibinyɛn Jɔab bar bɔrɛlambu na to na nɛ amo nɛ basa pɔtɛ bar na kikɛ gba so. 29Chanania nɛ e la Iza be kenana na nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobiana e daa la ekrachi nimuso a sibɛ asheŋ a nase nwɔl to nseŋ naa la demujipoana ashi Israɛl be efuli so, ama b daa maa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na bre to.
30Hashabia nɛ e shi Hibrɔn be kanaŋ to na nɛ mo kurgepoana kagboŋ nɛ alfa ashunu nɛ b kɔ kenyi ga na e daa juŋkpar kabɔrɛshuŋ nɛ ekrachisheŋ kikɛ ashi Israɛl be efuli nɛ k wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na. 31Jeriya e daa la Hibrɔn be kaman to ebi be ejuŋkparpo. Deevid ka daŋ ji kuwura na be kafɛ adenasopo to nɛ b keni Hibrɔn be kaman to ebi to nɛnɛ n wu fanɛ benapo lempo ko shi kanaŋ na to a wɔ Jaza ashi Giliad be kasawule so. 32Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Deevid lara Jeriya be kanaŋ to be bejuŋkparpo nɛ baa tiŋ a wora asheŋ nɛnɛ na be basa ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ alfa ashunu nɛ baa juŋkpar kabɔrɛshuŋ nɛ ekrachi be asheŋ ashi Israɛl be kasawule nɛ k wɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nsaa la Ruben nɛ Gad nɛ Manase be yiri be bargato be nsawule na so.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 27
Content:
Benapo be katuŋ be asheŋ
1Kufɔl kikɛ benyɛn ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ ana nɛ b daa lara nɛ baa shuŋ fanɛ benapo ashi Israɛl be efuli so. Kanaŋ to be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ benapo be benimu nɛ ewura be beyaasepo gba daŋ ti loŋ be basa na so a shuŋ.
2-15Basa nɛ b daa juŋkpar benapo na kufɔl kufɔl e daa la,
Zabdiɛl pibinyɛn Jashobiam nɛ e shi Pɛrɛs be kabuna na e daa juŋkpar benapo ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ ana na kufɔl juŋkparso na to.
Dodai nɛ e la Ahohi be kanaŋ to be esa na e daa la benapo na be enimu kufɔl nyɔsopo na to. Miklɔf malɛ e daa chɛ mo to a juŋkpar katuŋ na,
nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada pibinyɛn Bɛnaya daa la benapo na be enimu kufɔl sasopo na to. Bɛnaya ere daa la benapo adesa nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn ga na to be eko nna. Mo pibinyɛn Amizabad malɛ e daŋ sɔ mo so a juŋkpar benapo na.
Jɔab mo sipo Asahɛl e daa la benapo na be enimu kufɔl nasopo na to. Mo pibinyɛn Zebadiya e daŋ sɔ mo so ŋ ki benapo na be ejuŋkparpo.
Shamhuuf nɛ e shi Izha be kanaŋ to na e daa la benapo na be enimu kufɔl nusopo na to.
Ikkish nɛ e shi Tekua na pibinyɛn Ira e daa la benapo na be enimu kufɔl shesopo na to.
Hɛlɛz nɛ e la Efrayim be esa nsaa shi Pelɔn na e daa la benapo na be enimu kufɔl shunusopo na to.
Sibbekai nɛ e shi Husha na e daa la benapo na be enimu kufɔl burwasopo na to. E daa la Zɛra be kabuna be esa nna nsaa shi Juda be yiri to.
Abieza nɛ e shi Anatɔf nsaa la Bɛnjamin be yiri to be esa na, e daa la benapo na be enimu kufɔl kpanusopo na to.
Maharaya nɛ e shi Netofa nsaa la Zɛra be kabuna be esa na e daa la benapo na be enimu kufɔl kudusopo na to.
Bɛnaya nɛ e shi Piratɔn nɛ k wɔ Efrayim be yiri to be efuli so na e daa la benapo na be enimu kufɔl kudukakosopo na to.
Hɛldaya nɛ e shi Netofa nsaa la Ofniɛl be kenanabi na e daa la benapo na be enimu kufɔl kuduanyɔsopo na to.
Eyiriana na be benimuana be asheŋ
16-22Israɛl be eyiriana to be ekrachi nde:
Zikri pibinyɛn Eliaza e daa la Ruben be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
Maaka pibinyɛn Shefatiya e daa la Simiɔn be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
Kemuɛl pibinyɛn Hashabia e daa la Livai be yiri to be ekrachi nimuso.
Zadɔk e daa la Ɛɛrɔn be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
Ewura Deevid mo da Elihu e daa la Juda be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
Maikel pibinyɛn Omri e daa la Isaaka be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
Obadaya pibinyɛn Ishmaya e daa la Zɛbyulɔn be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
Azriɛl pibinyɛn Jɛrimɔf e daa la Naftali be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
Azaziya pibinyɛn Hoshiya e daa la Efrayim be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
Pɛdaya pibinyɛn Jowɛl e daa la Manase be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
Zakareya pibinyɛn Iddo e daa la Manase be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
Abna pibinyɛn Jaasiɛl e daa la Bɛnjamin be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
Jeroham pibinyɛn Azarɛl e daa la Dan be yiri to be krachi nimuso.
23Ewura Deevid daa maŋ karga Israɛl be basa nɛ b daa maŋ naŋ fo nfɛ adunyɔ na ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be basa e wora kishi fanɛ achɛkpabi nɛ a wɔ awɔlpa to. 24Jɔab nɛ mo nio daa la Zeruwa na, e daŋ fara a karga bumo ama e maŋ tiŋ n loge ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka daa gberge Israɛlebi kusoe ŋkpal kabasakarga na so so. Amoso b daa maŋ sibɛ kananɛ basa na sa n nase ewura Deevid be nwɔl to.
Ekrachi nɛ baa keni ewurkpa be asɔ so be asheŋ
25-31Basa nɛ b daa keni ewurkpa be asɔ so na nde:
Adiɛl pibinyɛn Asmavɛf e daa keni ewurkpa be ebuana nɛ baa ta ewura gbagba be asɔ a yili to na so.
Uziya pibinyɛn Jonatan e daa keni asɔ be ebuana nɛ a wɔ ndekarso nɛ ndegboŋ to na nɛ atempreŋ jeŋgreŋ nɛ bekumpo bee yili so na kikɛ so.
Chɛlub pibinyɛn Ezri e daa keni basa nɛ baa shuŋ ewura be ndɔ to na so.
Shimei nɛ e shi Rama na e daa keni asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be kudɔ so.
Zabdi nɛ mo alɛ shi Shefam na e daa keni greep be asɔrso na be asɔnuuso so.
Baal Haanan nɛ e la Gɛda be esa na e daa keni ndibi nɛ baa tre ɔlif nɛ sikamɔɔ nɛ a wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be abee be efuli so na so.
Jɔash e daa keni kakpa nɛ baa yili ɔlif be ŋku na so.
Shatai nɛ e shi Sharɔn na e daa keni ana nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ be keplasawule so na so.
Adlai pibinyɛn Shafat malɛ e daa keni ana nɛ b wɔ kebeemase na so.
Obil nɛ e la Ishmaɛl be kanaŋ to be esa na e daa keni bumo be enyɔma so.
Jedaya nɛ e shi Mɛrinɔf na e daa keni bumo be ekurma so.
Jaaziz nɛ e la Hag be esa na e daa keni bumo be mbolpɔ nɛ mboe so.
Ewura Deevid be asoetojipoana be asheŋ
32Ewura Deevid mo wɔpa Jonatan daa la asoetojipo lela nɛ enyipo nna. Mo nɛ Hakmoni pibinyɛn Jehiɛl e daa ŋini ewura be mbinyɛnsobi. 33Ahitofɛl e daa la ewura na be asoetojipo nɛ Hushai nɛ e la Aki be esa na, daa la ewura na mo teri nɛ asoetojipo. 34Ahitofɛl ka wu be kaman, Abiata nɛ Bɛnaya pibinyɛn Jehowada e daŋ ki ewura na be besoetojipo. Jɔab malɛ e daa la ewura be benapo be enimu.

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 28
Content:
Ewura Deevid ka ŋini kananɛ baaŋ pɔr bɔrɛlambu na be asheŋ
1Pɔɛŋ nɛ b pɔr bɔrɛlambu na ewura Deevid daŋ tre Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ eyiriana na be benimuana nɛ ekrachi nimuso nɛ benapo be benimuana nɛ benimu nɛ baa keni ewura na nɛ mbe mbia be asɔ nɛ asɔbɔya so na nɛ ewurkpa be benimuana nɛ benapo nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn ga na m ba shɛr Jerusalɛm nna.
2Ewura Deevid daŋ niŋito nna n yili bumo be anishito nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma basa, men nu nfe. N daa sha kepɔr bɔrɛlambu nɛ ŋkre be deka na beeŋ baa wɔtɔ ndoŋ nna mbaanaayɔ, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ baa yɔ ndoŋ n ya ka bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. N wora asɔ kama nɛ a daga fanɛ an ta m pɔr loŋ be bɔrɛlambu na be shiriya 3ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ shuli fanɛ n wora loŋ ŋkpal ŋ ka la enapo nseŋ mɔ basa damta so. 4Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e lara ma nɛ ma kaman to ebi fanɛ an baa ji Israɛl be kuwura mbaanaayɔ. N tuto be kanaŋ ashi Juda be yiri na to nɛ e lara fanɛ b baa la bejuŋkparpo. Mbe keparso nɛ e keni n tuto be kanaŋ na kikɛ to n lara ma fanɛ ŋ ki Israɛl be ewura. 5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta mbinyɛnsobi damta n nɛfa ma ama m pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ e lara fanɛ e ki Israɛl be ewura ma kaman.
6Le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ ma: ‘Fo pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn e naŋ pɔr ma bɔrɛlambu n sa ma. Ma e lara mo fanɛ e baa la ma kebia nɛ ma alɛ e baa la mo tuto. 7Nɛ e beeŋ baa bɛ ma mbraana so nɛnɛ nsaa wora kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ mo saŋkama bre, mbe kuwurji beeŋ baa wɔtɔ hale mbaanaayɔ.’ ”
8“Amoso mee kaŋɛ menyi nna ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ Israɛlebi kikɛ nɛ b shɛr nfe ere be anishito fanɛ men baa de so nsaa bɛ kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ anyi na so. Saŋɛ na so kasawule lela ere kraa beeŋ ba la menyi peya, nɛ menyi alɛ gba e ta kumo n sa men be kaman to ebi nɛ k ki bumo be kapetɛ mbaanaayɔ.”
9Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ Sɔlɔmɔn malɛ le: “M pibinyɛn, ta fo kagbene nɛ fo nfɛra kikɛ a shuŋ fo tuto be Ebɔrɛ na. Mo e nyi anyi be nfɛra nɛ kusɔ nɛ anyee sha kikɛ. Nɛ fo ba mo kutɔ, e beeŋ sɔ fo, ama nɛ fo shile mo bre, mo alɛ beeŋ kplaŋ fo so mbaanaayɔ. 10Baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara fo fanɛ fo pɔr mbe bɔrɛlambu cheembi na n sa mo. Amoso a daga fo ka nya kagbene m pɔr kumo nɛnɛ.”
11Ewura Deevid daŋ ŋini Sɔlɔmɔn kananɛ baŋ pɔr bɔrɛlambu na nɛ kumo be ebuana nɛ baa ta asɔwurbi a yili to na nɛ kumo be epunto be ebuana nɛ acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi nɛ baa ta alubi a paŋ na nna. 12E daŋ ŋini mo kananɛ e beeŋ wora kumo be kelɔnɛ na nɛ ebuana nɛ a kulti kumo na nɛ kakpa nɛ baa ta bɔrɛlambu na to be amansherbi nɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na nɛ ŋkɛ nɛ b ta m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na a wɔtɔ na nna. 13Ewura Deevid daŋ naŋ ŋini mo kananɛ e beeŋ barga bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na to ntuŋ ntuŋ so nɛ b baa shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to nsaa keni bɔrɛlambu na to be asɔ nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so na nna. 14E daŋ ŋini mo shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ a daga fanɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ asɔwurbi nɛ 15nɛ efitilatɔl na kikɛ, 16nɛ shuwa be teebɔl nɛ baaŋ baa ta bodobodo nɛ a la Ebɔrɛ peya na a deŋi so na nɛ gbiti be eteebɔl nɛ a ti so na nna. 17E daŋ naŋ ŋini mo shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ a daga fanɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ ntoe chɛgato nɛ ntishaŋ nɛ asɔnuunchu nɛ ntishaŋ jito kikɛ, 18nɛ shuwa nɛ baaŋ ta n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ baaŋ baa chɔɔ duwu kumo so na nɛ kananɛ e beeŋ lɔŋɛ asɔ nɛ a du fanɛ emalaika nɛ b parga bumo be aba m buu Enyɛnpe be ŋkre be deka na be buuso so na nna. 19Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid naŋ kaŋɛ Sɔlɔmɔn le: “Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋini ma bɔrɛlambu na be kananɛ k daga fanɛ b pɔr kumo nna na.”
20Kede be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid naŋ kaŋɛ mo pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn le: “Sa maa lɔ kufu ŋko a pɔ aba, ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ mee shuŋ na beeŋ chɛ fo to. E maaŋ kplaŋ fo so kikɛ, ama fo pɔr bɔrɛlambu na n loge nna. 21Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na tea nyi ashuŋ nɛ baaŋ shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to. Basa kama nɛ b kɔ enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi na gba kikɛ wora shiriya fanɛ baaŋ chɛ to n shuŋ kushuŋ na. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ fo kaŋɛ basa na nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpoana fanɛ b wora, baaŋ wora.”

Title: 1 KRONIKƐLS 29
Content:
Ŋkɛ nɛ b ta m pɔr bɔrɛlambu na be asheŋ
1Kede be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid kaŋɛ basa na malɛ le: “M pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ e pɔr bɔrɛlambu na ama mo alɛ kra la kebia nna, e maŋ naŋ pin asheŋ nɛnɛ. Bɔrɛlambu na malɛ be kushuŋ maŋ la alefasha, ŋkpal manɛ so k maŋ la edimɛdi peya, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu nna. 2Amoso nɛ n wora ania n fin shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ nɛ abɛlso nɛ ndibi nɛ yawu kpakpaso be ajembu be yiri yiri nɛ abitasɔ nɛ ajembu kpakpaso lela nɛ baa ta a pɔr na, nɛ e beeŋ ta m pɔr kumo na. 3Ade kikɛ be kaman, n lara ŋ gbagba be gbiti nɛ shuwa n sa, nɛ loŋ bee ŋini kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu ere be asheŋ tir ma. 4Shuwa lela nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ kalfa, nɛ gbiti nɛ amo alɛ be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ alfa anyɔ nɛ adena nɛ n ta n sa fanɛ b ji bɔrɛlambu na be egbalana kebita, 5nseŋ ta ako malɛ n sa basa nɛ b kɔ enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi nɛ b lɔŋɛ asɔ warabi. Naniere, wanɛ e naŋ bugi kagbene n sa kusɔ ko nɛ b ta m pɔr Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na?”
6Ewura Deevid ka malga n loge na, nɛ kanaŋ kanaŋ be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ eyiri to be benimuana nɛ benapo be benimuana nɛ ekrachi nimuso kikɛ bugi ŋgbene n sa asɔ. 7B daŋ sa shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ adushunu, nɛ gbiti nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ alfa asa nɛ adena, nɛ danyaŋ nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ ŋgboŋ alfa ashe nɛ adunyɔ, nɛ abɛlso nɛ amo alɛ be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto be ŋgboŋ asa nɛ ŋgboŋ alfa ana. 8Ekama nɛ e daa kɔ yawu kpakpaso be ajembu daŋ ta amo nna n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be amansherbi nɛ asɔ be ebu nɛ Jehiɛl nɛ e la Livai be esa nsaa shi Gɛshɔm be kabuna na bee keni so na to nna. 9Ewura Deevid nɛ basa na kikɛ be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo ga nna nɛ b ji eyur ŋkpal ŋkɛ nɛ b daŋ bugi ŋgbene n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so.
Ewura Deevid ka di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ be asheŋ
10Ewura Deevid daŋ yili basa na kikɛ be anishito nna n di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la an nana Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na, kapandi e baa la fo peya mbaanaayɔ! 11Fo kuwurgboŋ nɛ eleŋ nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ kuwurji wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ. Fo e kɔ esoso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ be eleŋ nsaa ji kusɔ kama so kuwura. 12Fo e naa sa basa kedamaya nɛ eleŋ nɛ kemaŋkura. Fo gbagba be eleŋ nɛ yuku so nɛ fee ji kusɔ kama so kuwura. 13Anyi be Ebɔrɛ, kechɔrɔ nɛ kapandi e baa la fo peya.
14Ma nɛ ma basa maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ an ji eyur ŋkpal ŋkɛ nɛ an sa fo ere so, ŋkpal manɛ so asɔ na kikɛ chɛr a la fo peya nna. 15An la befɔ nna a wɔ durnya ere to fanɛ kananɛ an nananyɛnana gba daa wɔ kumo to na. Anyi be nchɛ du nna fanɛ kiyoyul na, k maa chɛr nsaa choŋ. 16O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, asɔ damta nɛ an ta m ba nɛ an ba pɔr bɔrɛlambu m maŋkura fo ketre ere kikɛ la fo peya nna. Fo e wɔ amo nseŋ ta amo n sa anyi. 17N nyi fo ka nyi ekama be kagbene. Ma nɛ ma basa nɛ b wɔ nfe ere kikɛ bugi ŋgbene kagbenefuliso nna m bar asɔ ere kikɛ m ba sa fo. 18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la an nananyɛn Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na, shin nɛ fo basa e baa kɔ kakɛ be ŋgbene nsaa ji kashenteŋ a sa fo loŋ mbaanaayɔ. 19Jande sa m pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn kasonu be kagbene nseŋ shin nɛ e ta kenishipere m pɔr bɔrɛlambu nɛ n chala kumo be kepɔr be asɔ kikɛ ere.”
20Kede be kaman nɛ ewura Deevid kaŋɛ basa na kikɛ le: “Men di Enyɛnpe men nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kikɛ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nseŋ jɔŋɛ ŋ kurgi bumo be amu n yuu to m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ ewura Deevid kikɛ.
21Kumo be ŋklade, nɛ b mɔ asɔbɔya n lara esarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Kumo be kaman nɛ b mɔ egbolu kagboŋ nɛ ekpakpa kagboŋ nɛ ekpakpafɔlbi kagboŋ n chɔɔ n lara sarga bɔrɛsure na so n sa mo. B daŋ ta asɔnuuso gba n ti so n lara sarga na. 22Kumo be kamɔnchɛ ekama be kagbene daŋ fuli mo ga nɛ b ji nseŋ nuu ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito.
Ndoŋ nɛ b lara Sɔlɔmɔn kelɛ nyɔsopo fanɛ ewura nseŋ yili Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ketre to n ta ŋku n do mo so n lara mo ŋ ki bumo be ewura nseŋ ta ŋku n do Zadɔk malɛ so n lara mo ŋ ki bumo be bɔrɛmatapo.
23Amoso Sɔlɔmɔn e daŋ sɔ mo tuto so n ji kuwura nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yili n sa bumo na, nɛ asheŋ nite nɛnɛ nɛ Israɛl be efuli na so ebi kikɛ bee nu a sa mo. 24Benimuana nɛ benapo na nɛ ewura Deevid be mbinyɛnsobi na kikɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ baaŋ baa nu a sa mo fanɛ bumo be ewura. 25Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ maŋ Sɔlɔmɔn so nna nseŋ shin nɛ mbe kuwurji daa kɔ kemaŋkura a chɔ Israɛl be ewura kama peya; nɛ kumo be loŋ daŋ chinchiŋ efuli na so ebi kikɛ ga.
Ewura Deevid be lalaloge be asheŋ
26Jɛsi pibinyɛn Deevid nɛ e la Sɔlɔmɔn mo tuto na e daa la Israɛl kikɛ be ewura. 27Nfɛ adena nɛ e daŋ ji kuwura ashi Israɛl be efuli so kikɛ. E daŋ ji kuwura Hibrɔn be kade to nfɛ ashunu nna nseŋ ji kuwura nfɛ adesa nɛ asa malɛ Jerusalɛm be kade to. 28E daa la damawura nna nsaa kɔ kemaŋkura basa kutɔ, nseŋ bel pɔɛŋ n wu nɛ mo pibinyɛn Sɔlɔmɔn sɔ mo so n ji kuwura. 29Kusɔ kama nɛ Deevid wora saŋɛ so nɛ e daa la ewura na be asheŋ kikɛ daa wɔ anebi Samuɛl nɛ Neetan nɛ Gad be nwɔl to. 30Asheŋ nɛ b daŋ sibɛ n wɔtɔ nwɔl na to daa ŋini kananɛ e daŋ ji kuwura, nɛ kananɛ e ji eleŋ, nɛ asheŋ nɛ a tu mo nɛ Israɛl be efuli, nɛ efuliana nɛ a kulti kumo na kikɛ.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 1
Content:
1Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ e la ewura Deevid pibinyɛn na daŋ ji Israɛl be efuli na so eleŋ ga ŋkpal Enyɛnpe nɛ e la mbe Ebɔrɛ na ka daŋ nɛfa mo nseŋ sa mo eleŋ ga so.
2Kachako nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kaŋɛ mbe benapo be benimuana nɛ b daa keni benapo kagboŋ be katuŋ so nɛ benapo kalfa be katuŋ so nɛ ekrachi nimuso nɛ kanaŋ to be benimuana nɛ basa nɛ b ka na kikɛ nna kenishipereso 3fanɛ b tu mo n yɔ kakpa nɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ ashi Gibiɔn na. B daŋ yɔ ndoŋ nna ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu nɛ mbe kayɛrbi Mosis daŋ lɔŋɛ ashi kiyi to dra dra na ka daa wɔ ndoŋ so. 4Loŋ be saŋɛ na nɛ b ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na ashi Kiriaf Jearim m ba yili wajɛbu nɛ ewura Deevid wora ashi Jerusalɛm na to. 5Danyaŋ be bɔrɛsure nɛ Yuri pibinyɛn Bezalɛl nɛ e la Hur mo nanabi daŋ lɔŋɛ na gba daa yil Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na be anishito nna ashi Gibiɔn. Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ basa na kikɛ daŋ yɔ ndoŋ nna n ya bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. 6Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ta asɔbɔya kagboŋ nna n chɔɔ n lara sarga danyaŋ be bɔrɛsure na so n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.
7Kumo be kanyɛso na gbagba nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini Sɔlɔmɔn edare to nseŋ bishi mo le: “Manɛ nɛ fee sha nɛ n wora n sa fo?”
8Nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe na le: “Kasha nɛ fo kɔ n sa fo kayɛrbi, n tuto Deevid maa chɛrga kikɛ. Naniere fo alɛ ta ma n tal mbe katelamu to nɛ ŋ ki ewura. 9O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande shin nɛ fo nnɔ nɛ fo nase n sa n tuto na e bɔlɔ so. Fo ta ma nna ŋ ki basa nɛ b shibi m baŋ so kekarga ere be ewura, 10amoso jande sa ma kanyiasheŋ nɛ nfɛra nɛ meeŋ ta n ji bumo so kuwura nɛnɛ, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, nuso nɛ meeŋ wora n tiŋ n ji fo basa lempo ere kikɛ so kuwura?”
11Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ kaŋɛ Sɔlɔmɔn le: “Fo kule kusɔ nɛ k walɛ. Fo maŋ kule kedamaya ŋko amansherbi ŋko fo ketre be kedii ŋko fo doŋana be luwu ŋko ŋkpa tenteŋ n sa fo kumu ama kanyiasheŋ nɛ nfɛra nɛ fo kule ma nɛ fo tiŋ n ji ma basa nɛ n ta fo ŋ ki bumo be ewura na so kuwura nɛnɛ. 12Meeŋ sa fo kanyiasheŋ nɛ nfɛra nseŋ naŋ ta kedamaya nɛ amansherbi n ti fo so. Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ fo ketre e dii a chɔ bewura kama nɛ b juŋkpar fo nɛ bumo nɛ baaŋ bɛ fo so kikɛ.”
Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be eleŋ nɛ mbe kedamaya be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 10:26-29)
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn lar kakpa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na daa wɔ ashi Gibiɔn na m bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya kaa ji Israɛl be kuwura. 14Mbe egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛ daŋ baa wora keshi nna hale m ba fo egbaŋɛturko kagboŋ nɛ alfa ana nɛ egbaŋɛ malɛ ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ. E daŋ yige beko Jerusalɛm nna nseŋ yige beko malɛ ndegboŋ na be ako to. 15Jemanɛ nɛ e daa ji kuwura na, shuwa nɛ gbiti bre daŋ gbigi nna fanɛ ajembu ashi Jerusalɛm be kade to, nɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na malɛ daŋ gbigi fanɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre sikamɔɔ nɛ a wɔ Juda be abee be efuli so na. 16Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be ewurkpa be eyawujipoana e daa tɔ mbe ewurkpa be egbaŋɛ ashi efuli wɔfɔana nɛ baa tre Musri nɛ Silishiya na a bar mo. 17Gbiti be ndarbi alfa ashe nɛ b daŋ tɔ mbe gbaŋɛturko na be kekama nseŋ tɔ gbaŋɛ kama malɛ gbiti be ndarbi kalfa nɛ adunu. Bumo e daa fa egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko a sa Hitebi nɛ Siriyaebi be bewura gba.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 2
Content:
Kebelase m pɔr bɔrɛlambu na be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 5:1-18)
1Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn yili kumo nna fanɛ e beeŋ pɔr bɔrɛlambu nɛ baaŋ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kumo to nseŋ pɔr ewura malɛ be laŋ n sa mo gbagba be kumu. 2E daŋ shin nna nɛ beshumpo ŋgboŋ adushunu bee sulɔ bɔrɛlambu na be asɔ nɛ b kɔ a pɔr kumo na nseŋ shin nɛ basa ŋgboŋ aduburwa malɛ bee bure ajembu to ashi abee be efuli na so. Benyɛn ŋgboŋ asa nɛ alfa ashe nɛ e daŋ ta nɛ baa keni kushuŋ na so nɛ k baa nite nɛnɛ.
3Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ ta le be kubɔya ere nna n ya sa Tayɛ be Ewura Hiram: “Shin nɛ ma nɛ fo e baa ji yawu fanɛ kananɛ fo nɛ n tuto ewura Deevid daa ji yawu na, nɛ fo baa fa ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na a sa ma fanɛ kananɛ fo daŋ fa amo n sa mo nɛ e pɔr mbe ewura be laŋ na. 4Mee pɔr lambu nna nɛ m maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. K beeŋ baa la kakpa cheembi nɛ ma nɛ ma basa beeŋ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nsaa chɔɔ duwu nɛ a kɔ efɛa belbelso nsaa lara bodobodo cheembi be sarga a sa mo saŋkikɛ. Ndoŋ malɛ gba nɛ anyeeŋ baa lara sarga chɔɔso kachipurso nɛ kaaseso kikɛ nɛ kewushiachɛ kikɛ nɛ kufɔl popɔr to be kachɛ juŋkparso kikɛ nɛ ewushi be nchɛ a maŋkura an Enyɛnpe nɛ an be Ebɔrɛ na. Mo e kaŋɛ Israɛlebi kenishipereso fanɛ b baa wora loŋ mbaanaayɔ. 5Mee sha kepɔr bɔrɛlambu nɛ k shibi ga nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na kɔ eleŋ a chɔ kegbir kikɛ. 6Ama esa kama maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ m pɔr lambu nɛ k beeŋ tiŋ n sɔ Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, esoso kikɛ gba kra du fimbi nɛ k tiŋ n sɔ mo. Kakpa nɛ ma ere beeŋ tiŋ m pɔr e la lambu nɛ baaŋ baa chɔɔ duwu kumo to a sa Ebɔrɛ. 7Lara esa nɛ e kɔ kenyi a tiŋ a wora asɔ a deŋi shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ nɛ abɛlso be asɔ so nsaa kɔ ewajɛ buru nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nɛ apeper kpaw be kelue be kenyi nɛ mo nɛ basa nɛ b kɔ enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi nɛ n tuto Deevid lara nɛ b wɔ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm na e baa kaa shuŋ. 8N nyi fo basa nɛ baa ku ndibi na ka nyi bumo be kushuŋ nɛnɛ, amoso mee kule fo nna nɛ fo sa ma ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na nɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre seprɛs na nɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre junipa nɛ a wɔ Lebanɔn na be ndishaŋ. N wora shiriya nɛ n shuŋi ma basa nɛ b ba chɛ fo basa to 9n fin ndibi nɛ b kɔ a wora ebu na be adamta m ba, ŋkpal manɛ so bɔrɛlambu nɛ mee sha kepɔr na beeŋ ba shibi nsaa walɛ ga. 10Meeŋ sa fo beshumpo na ayu ebɔtɛ ŋgboŋ alfa anyɔ nɛ ayu peper be ebɔtɛ ŋgboŋ alfa anyɔ nɛ nsa edurɔm ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ kudu nɛ ɔlif be ŋku be edurɔm ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ kudu.”
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Hiram sibɛ kawɔl n sa ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kasha nɛ e kɔ n sa mbe basa so nɛ e ta fo ŋ ki bumo be ewura. 12Kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ be etopo na peya! Mo e sa ewura Deevid ebinyɛn nyiashempo nɛ e kɔ asheŋ be kepinto nɛ kasheŋwora be kenyi nsaa sha kepɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ ewura be laŋ n sa mbe kumu. 13Meeŋ shin nɛ esa nɛ e nyi asheŋ nsaa kɔ enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi nɛnɛ nɛ baa tre mo Huram na e ba fo kutɔ. 14Mo nio shi Dan be yiri to nna nɛ mo tuto malɛ la Tayɛ be kadetobia. E nyi kananɛ baa ta shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ danyaŋ nɛ abɛlso nɛ ajembu nɛ ndibi a lɔŋɛ asɔ damta. E beeŋ tiŋ n lue ewajɛ buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ago. E kɔ kenyi a laŋɛ kebaachaŋ asɔ a deŋi asɔ so nsaa beeŋ tiŋ n wora ndulgi kama nɛ b ŋini mo fanɛ e wora. Shin nɛ e tu fo beshumpo nɛ b kɔ enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi ga na nɛ bumo nɛ b daa shuŋ a sa fo tuto ewura Deevid na a shuŋ. 15Amoso wora ania n ta ayu nɛ ayu peper nɛ nsa nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ fo nase kɔnɔ fanɛ feeŋ sa na n chise beshumpo na. 16Anyeeŋ ku ndibi nɛ baa tre sida nɛ fee sha na ashi Lebanɔn be abee so nseŋ ta amo n yɔ teku be kɔnɔ ase n ya kre amo nɛ eyɔri to n ta amo m bɔla teku so n yɔ Jɔpa, nɛ fo ya ta amo ndoŋ n yɔ Jerusalɛm.”
B ka fara bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 6:1-38)
17Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ karga befɔ nɛ b wɔ Israɛl be kasawule so kikɛ na nna, fanɛ kananɛ mo tuto Deevid daŋ wora na. Befɔ na daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ adunu nɛ asa nɛ alfa ashe. 18E daŋ lara bumo be ŋgboŋ adushunu nna fanɛ b baa sulɔ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a pɔr bɔrɛlambu na, nseŋ lara basa ŋgboŋ aduburwa malɛ fanɛ b baa shɛl ajembu abee so, nseŋ lara basa ŋgboŋ asa nɛ alfa ashe malɛ fanɛ b baa keni ashuŋ na so.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 3
Content:
1Ewura Deevid nɛ e la Sɔlɔmɔn mo tuto na daŋ lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kakpa nna ashi Jerusalɛm be kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Moriya na so. Ndoŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini mo ashi kugooro nɛ Aruna nɛ e la Jerusalɛm be esa na daa bri mbe ayu so na. 2Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn malɛ e fara bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr saŋɛ nɛ e ji kuwura na be kafɛ nasopo be kufɔl nyɔsopo na be kachɛ nyɔsopo na. 3Bɔrɛlambu nɛ Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn pɔr na be nteŋ daa la ayadra adekpanu nna nɛ kumo be mpar malɛ daa la ayadra adesa. 4Bɔrɛlambu na be anishito daa kɔ kedɛdɛ nɛ baa bɔla to a luri kumo to nna, nɛ kedɛdɛ na be mpar la ayadra adesa nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ la ayadra adesa. B daŋ ta shuwa nna m mata kedɛdɛ na be epunto be egbal kikɛ so. 5B daŋ ta sida be ndibi nna m mata ebugboŋ na be egbal so ŋ kulti n ta shuwa lela m mata m mata amo so nseŋ wora abii be ndibi nɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi be efoto n deŋi amo so. 6Ewura na daŋ ta ajembu nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa nna nɛ shuwa nɛ b tɔ ashi Parvaim be kasawule so na nna n ji bɔrɛlambu na kebita. 7E daŋ ta shuwa na nna m mata m mata bɔrɛlambu na be egbal so nɛ kumo be eyɔri so nɛ kabuna to nɛ kumo be akuloŋ so. Beshumpo na malɛ daŋ wora asɔ anyɔ ko nɛ a du fanɛ emalaika nɛ baa tre amo chɛrubim be ndulgi nna n deŋi egbal na so. 8Ebu nɛ baa tre acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na be nteŋ daa la ayadra adesa nna nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ gba daa la ayadra adesa. Shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ anu nɛ b daŋ ta m mata m mata acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na be egbalana so. 9Shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo be bargato nɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ kumo be anyembi nseŋ ta shuwa m mata m mata kumo be esoso be ebuana na be egbalana so.
10Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ kaŋɛ mbe beshumpo nna fanɛ b ta kebɛlso n lɔŋɛ emalaika anyɔ be mpɔrduli nseŋ ta shuwa m mata m mata amo so n ta amo n yili acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to 11-13nɛ b yili ŋ karga abar so, nɛ bumo be anishito e baa keni kabuna to be kaba so. Amo be kekama daa kɔ aba anyɔ nyɔ nna nɛ aba na be kekama be nteŋ daa sa fanɛ ayadra ashunu nɛ bargato. Amo be kekama parga aba to nna nɛ keba ko bee chute ebu na be kaba ko be egbal nɛ kuko malɛ bee chute kumo barkasa be keba ashi ebu nɛ kumo be nteŋ la ayadra adesa na be nferinto. 14Ago be kechɛbi nɛ achɛbi ko nɛ b nyɔ amo buru nɛ apeper kpaw nɛ apeper kunɔkunɔ nɛ b jɔ emalaika be ndulgi n deŋi so na nɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ patisa ŋ kuŋ acheembiana be kakpa cheembi na be kabuna to.
Danyaŋ be eshabɔrɛ anyɔ na be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 7:15-22)
15Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ shin nna nɛ b yuu eshabɔrɛ anyɔ ashi bɔrɛlambu na be anishito nna nɛ amo be kekama be nteŋ daa sa fanɛ ayadra adunu nɛ anyɔ. Amo be kekama malɛ daa kɔ kuwuro nɛ kumo be nteŋ la ayadra ashunu nɛ bargato nna. 16B daŋ wora ŋgbɛlɛbi nɛ a mɛa abar be ndulgi nɛ asɔ kulkulbi ko nɛ a du fanɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre pomegranates na be kalfa kalfa nna n deŋi n deŋi eshabɔrɛ na be kekama be esoso n ji amo kebita. 17B daŋ yuu eshabɔrɛ na be kuko bɔrɛlambu na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nɛ baa tre kumo Jakin na nna, nseŋ yuu kuko malɛ kumo be kelargato be esoso be kaba so nɛ baa tre kumo alɛ Boaz.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 4
Content:
Asɔ nɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ n bɔrɛlambu na to be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 7:23-51)
1Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ shin nɛ b lɔŋɛ danyaŋ be bɔrɛsure nɛ kumo be nteŋ daa la ayadra adesa nɛ kumo be mpar gba la ayadra adesa nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ la ayadra kuduanu nna. 2E daŋ lɔŋɛ danyaŋ be katishaŋgboŋ kulkulso nɛ baa tre Teku nna nɛ kumo be mpar daa sa fanɛ ayadra kuduanu, nɛ kumo be chuŋguluŋ malɛ daa sa fanɛ ayadra ashunu nɛ bargato nɛ kumo be kɔnɔkarso ŋ kulti daa la ayadra adena nɛ anu. 3B daŋ wora asɔ ko nna fanɛ egbolu nɛ a bɛ abar so esoso nɛ kaseto egbaŋ anyɔ n deŋi ketishaŋgboŋ na be kɔnɔkarso n ji kumo kebita n chambɔ. 4Katishaŋgboŋ na daa bɛ egbolu kuduanyɔ nɛ b ta danyaŋ n lɔŋɛ so nna. Danyaŋ be egbolu na daŋ pal mman nna n sa abar nɛ besa be anishito kilgi n shoŋi kelargato be esoso be kaba so nɛ besa kilgi n shoŋi kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nɛ besa malɛ kilgi n shoŋi epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nɛ besa kilgi anishito n shoŋi epeŋilarkpa be kaba so. 5Katishaŋgboŋ na be gbenteliŋ daa sa fanɛ enɔ be epunto be mpar nna. Nɛ kumo be kɔnɔkarso malɛ daa du fanɛ kusɔnuunchu nseŋ naŋ to n lar kaman fanɛ atoto na. K daa beeŋ tiŋ n sɔ egalɔn ŋgboŋ kuduanu be asɔ. 6B daŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ ntishaŋgboŋ kudu nna n ti katishaŋgboŋ na so nseŋ ta amo be anu n yili bɔrɛlambu na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nseŋ ta anu nɛ a ka na malɛ n yili kelargato be esoso be kaba so. B daa ta amo to be nchu nna a nyɛlpɔ asɔ nɛ baa ta a lara sarga chɔɔso na so. Katishaŋgboŋ na to bre be nchu na la bɔrɛmatapoana na peya nna nɛ baa ta a wora daŋkare be kefɔrso be asheŋ.
7-8Kananɛ b daŋ yili kumo fanɛ baaŋ lɔŋɛ shuwa be efitilatɔl kudu nɛ eteebɔl kudu na gbagba chap nɛ b daŋ lɔŋɛ amo nseŋ ta amo n yili bɔrɛlambu na be ebu gboŋ na to. B daŋ ta eteebɔl na be anu nɛ efitilatɔl anu nna n yili ebu na be kaba nseŋ ta anu malɛ efitilatɔl anu n yili kumo be kaba ko. B daŋ lɔŋɛ shuwa be ntishaŋ nɛ baa ta asɔ be ŋklaŋ a wɔtɔ a ŋmenyaŋ asɔbɔya so na be kalfa gba n ti so.
9B daŋ wora kelɔnɛ laŋ na be epunto nna n sa bɔrɛmatapoana nawule nseŋ wora kuko malɛ kowushina. B daŋ ta danyaŋ nna m mata akuloŋ nɛ a wɔ alɔnɛ anyɔ na be kefɛato na so. 10B daŋ ta katishaŋgboŋ nɛ baa tre Teku na nna n yili bɔrɛlambu na be kukɔlɔ to ashi kelargato be kaseto be kaba so a laŋɛ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na.
11-16Hiram e daŋ lɔŋɛ mpuliya nɛ eshabɔl nɛ ntishaŋ. Asɔ nɛ e daŋ nase kɔnɔ n sa ewura Sɔlɔmɔn fanɛ e beeŋ lɔŋɛ n sa bɔrɛlambu na nseŋ lɔŋɛ amo n loge na be ako e daa la,
Eshabɔrɛ anyɔ na nɛ
amo be ebuuso nɛ a deŋ amo be esoso na,
nɛ Asɔ nɛ b chaŋ fanɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi nɛ a mɛa abar n deŋ shabɔrɛ na be kekama so na
nɛ asɔ alfa ana nɛ a du fanɛ asɔrso kulkulbi nɛ baa tre amo pomegranates nɛ b ta danyaŋ n lɔŋɛ n deŋi eshabɔrɛ na be kekama so na;
nɛ eturko kudu nɛ ebɔtɛ kudu na,
nɛ katishaŋgboŋ nɛ baa tre teku na,
nɛ edanyaŋ be egbolu kuduanyɔ nɛ katishaŋgboŋ na yil so na,
nɛ mpuliya nɛ eshabɔl nɛ ntoe chɛgato na.
Huram nɛ e kɔ enɔ to be kushuŋ be kenyi ga na e daŋ lɔŋɛ asɔ ere kikɛ. Danyaŋ nɛ k bee nyɛpkɛso nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ amo fanɛ b ta a shuŋ ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na to fanɛ kananɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ŋini fanɛ b wora na gbagba.
17Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn na daŋ shin nna nɛ b ŋalga danyaŋ na nseŋ chulgi amo n wɔtɔ mpuliya nɛ b pɔr n yili lɔr nɛ baa tre Jɔɔdan na be keplasawule nɛ k wɔ Sukɔf nɛ Zereda be kefɛato na. 18B daŋ ta danyaŋ nna n lɔŋɛ asɔ damta ga hale bumo gbagba maŋ naa nyi kananɛ amo be egbɛ sa gba.
19Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ ta shuwa nna n ji asɔ nɛ a wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to kebita. Amo e la, bɔrɛsure na nɛ eteebɔl nɛ baa ta ebodobodo a deŋi so a sa Ebɔrɛ na; 20nɛ kefitilatɔl na nɛ efitila nɛ b ta shuwa lela n lɔŋɛ nɛ baa chɔ amo e yili acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na, 21nɛ asɔ ko nɛ b wora fanɛ atoto na nɛ efitila na nɛ ntoe chɛgato, 22nɛ asɔ nɛ baa ta a duŋ efitila na nɛ ntishaŋ nɛ eduwu be mba nɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a chɔɔ edɛ na. Shuwa lela nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ asɔ ere kikɛ. Shuwa nɛ b daŋ ta m mata m mata bɔrɛlambu na be kowushina be akuloŋana nɛ kumo be acheembiana to be ebu cheembi na be akuloŋana na so kikɛ.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 5
Content:
1Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ka wora bɔrɛlambu na to be kushuŋ kikɛ n loge, nɛ e ta asɔ nɛ mo tuto ewura Deevid daŋ ta m bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ na n wɔtɔ bɔrɛlambu na be ebuana nɛ baa ta asɔwurbi a yili na to. Amo e la gbiti nɛ shuwa nɛ asɔ nɛ baa ta a shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to na.
B ka ta ŋkre be deka na m ba bɔrɛlambu to be asheŋ
2Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn shuŋi n tre bejuŋkparpoana na kikɛ nɛ Israɛl be eyiriana nɛ mbuna mbunaana kikɛ fanɛ b ba shɛr Jerusalɛm to, saŋɛ na so baaŋ lara Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka ashi Zayɔn nɛ k la Deevid be kade to na n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to. 3Saŋɛ so nɛ baa ji ewajɛbu to be kejigboŋ na nɛ b daŋ shɛr kufɔl shunusopo na to. 4Bejuŋkparpoana na kikɛ ka shɛr abar so na, nɛ Livaiebi na maŋ ŋkre be deka na so 5n ta kumo n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to. Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na gba daŋ ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu na nɛ kumo be asɔ nɛ baa ta a shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kumo to na kikɛ nna n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to. 6Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ daŋ shɛr Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na be anishito nna m mɔ mbolpɔ nɛ ana damta nɛ b maŋ kɔ kekarga gba n lara sarga. 7Bɔrɛmatapoana na e daŋ ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na n ya yili m mata emalaika anyɔ na be aya ase ashi acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to. 8Bumo be atɛ daŋ parga to nna m buu deka na nɛ ndibi nɛ b kɔ a sulɔ kumo na so. 9Ndibi na daa wɔ nteŋ nna ga nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yili acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na be kabuna to n wu amo ama manɛ kakpa kikɛ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yili n wu amo. Loŋ be ndibi na yili ndoŋ n chɛr ga. 10Shɛŋ shɛŋ daa maŋ wɔ ŋkre be deka na to ama ajembu paŋgelambi anyɔ nɛ Mosis daŋ ta n wɔtɔ kumo to ashi kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sainai na ase saŋɛ so nɛ Israɛlebi na lar Ijipt be efuli so nɛ bumo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yili ŋkre n sa abar na.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura be asheŋ
11-14Bɔrɛmatapoana na kikɛ daŋ lara kulubi bumo be ŋgbene to nna nsaa du cheembi. Katuŋ nɛ bumo be ekama daa wɔtɔ to na be asheŋ daŋ maŋ tir bumo. Asaf nɛ Heman nɛ Jedutum nɛ bumo be kabuna be basa nɛ b la Livaiebi na e daa la beshɛbompo. B daa buu ago be kechɛbi lela be asɔbuuso nna. Livaiebi na daŋ yili bɔrɛsure na be epeŋilarkpa nna a laŋ echakachaka nɛ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana kalfa nɛ adunyɔ malɛ bee foŋ mbel. Beshɛbompoana na ka bee boŋ nshɛ a maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ basa nɛ baa foŋ mbel na nɛ bumo nɛ baa laŋ echakachaka nɛ alaŋsɔ be yiri kikɛ na bee laŋ a kukwe nshɛ na so. Beshɛbompoana na daa boŋ nshɛ a maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna a kaŋɛ le: “Men maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ŋkpal manɛ so e walɛ, nɛ mbe kasha malɛ wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.”
Bɔrɛmatapoana na ka bee lar bɔrɛlambu na to na, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bɔla kuwɔlpa to m luri m bɔlɔ bɔrɛlambu na to epul to a nyɛkpɛ so pɛlpɛl nɛ b maŋ naŋ tiŋ m bunyaŋ mo gba.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 6
Content:
Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ka malga n sa basa na be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 8:12-21)
1Ade be kaman nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kule Ebɔrɛ le:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e kaŋɛ fanɛ feeŋ baa wɔ awɔlpa lembir ere to.
2Naniere bre, m pɔr kemaŋkura be bɔrɛlambu
nɛ feeŋ baa wɔ ndoŋ mbaanaayɔ.”
3Israɛlebi na kikɛ daŋ shɛr abar so a yil ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn na kilgi mbe anishito n shoŋi bumo nseŋ nɛfa bumo. 4Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ: “Kapandi e baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na peya! Mo e daŋ shin nɛ mbe nnɔ naseso bɔlɔ so n sa n tuto ewura Deevid nseŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ, 5yili saŋɛ so nɛ n lara ma basa ashi Ijipt be efuli so na hale m ba fo kabre, maŋ lara kade kama ashi Israɛl be kasawule so fanɛ k baa la kakpa nɛ baaŋ pɔr bɔrɛlambu nsaa bunyaŋ ma ndoŋ, ma alɛ maŋ lara esa kama fanɛ e baa juŋkpar ma basa Israɛlebi. 6Naniere bre Jerusalɛm nɛ n lara fanɛ k baa la kade nɛ baaŋ baa bunyaŋ ma kumo to, nɛ fo alɛ Deevid e baa juŋkpar ma basa.”
7Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn kaŋɛ le: “N tuto ewura Deevid e daŋ yili kumo fanɛ e beeŋ pɔr bɔrɛlambu nɛ b baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na ndoŋ, 8ama le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ mo: ‘Fo ka yɛ feeŋ pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa ma ere, k kɔ ekpa ga, 9ama mannɛ fo e naaŋ pɔr kumo, fo pibinyɛn nɛ e la fo gbagba be ŋklaŋ na e naaŋ ba pɔr ma bɔrɛlambu na n sa ma.’
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ nɛ e nase na bɔlɔ so naniere bre. Ma e sɔ n tuto so n ji Israɛl be kuwura, ma alɛ e pɔr bɔrɛlambu nɛ baaŋ ba bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na kumo to na. 11N ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na n yili bɔrɛlambu na to, nseŋ ta ajembu paŋgelambi anyɔ nɛ b sibɛ ŋkre n deŋi so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ an nananyɛnana kre saŋɛ nɛ e lara bumo ashi Ijipt be efuli so dra dra na n wɔtɔ kumo to.”
Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 8:22-53)
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn yili bɔrɛsure na be anishito Israɛlebi na kikɛ be anishito m maaŋ mbe enɔana so ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ. 13Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ wora danyaŋ be ketempreŋ nɛ kumo be nteŋ la ayadra ashunu nɛ bargato nɛ kumo be mparto gba la ayadra ashunu nɛ bargato nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ la ayadra anu nna n yili kelɔnɛ na be kowushina be nferinto. E daŋ yuu kusɔ jeŋgreŋ ere nna nseŋ gbir kumo so m maŋ mbe enɔana so esoso, kakpa nɛ ekama beeŋ baa wu mo, 14ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ le: “Enyɛnpe nɛ fo la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na, Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ fanɛ fo ashi esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ. Fo maa teŋ ŋkre nɛ fo nɛ fo basa nase n sa abar na so kikɛ. Fo alɛ bee ŋini bumo fo kasha saŋɛ so nɛ b ta bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ a wora kasonu a sa fo na nna. 15Fo shin nɛ fo kɔnɔ nɛ fo nase n sa n tuto ewura Deevid na bɔlɔ so kabre. 16Naniere, Enyɛnpe nɛ fo la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ fo kɔnɔ nɛ fo nase n sa n tuto ewura Deevid fanɛ nɛ mbe kaman to ebi baa wora fo kasonu bre, bumo e naŋ baa ji Israɛl be kuwura na e bɔlɔ so. 17Enyɛnpe nɛ fo la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na, shin nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ fo nase kumo be kɔnɔ n sa fo kenya ewura Deevid na a bɔlɔ so.
18Fo Ebɔrɛ beeŋ tiŋ a wɔ edimɛdi to durnya ere to a? Esoso kikɛ gba maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ fo. Nɛ nuso nɛ bɔrɛlambu nɛ m pɔr ere bre beeŋ tiŋ n sɔ fo? 19N nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n la fo kayɛrbi nna, nu ma kabɔrɛkule ere nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ mee kule ere n sa ma. 20Ba keni bɔrɛlambu ere so kapa nɛ kanyɛ. Fo nase kɔnɔ n sa ma fanɛ, ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ ba bunyaŋ fo. Amoso saŋkama nɛ m baŋ kilgi anishito n shoŋi bɔrɛlambu ere ŋ kule fo, fo nu ma kekule. 21Saŋkama nɛ ma nɛ fo basa Israɛlebi baŋ kilgi anishito n shoŋi kakpa ere a kule fo Ebɔrɛ, fo yili fo pe ebɔrɛso n nu n sa anyi nseŋ ta anyi be alubi m paŋ anyi.
22Nɛ fanɛ b ku asheŋ nna n deŋi esa fanɛ e wora mo barkasa kulubi nseŋ bar mo bɔrɛsure ase ashi fo bɔrɛlambu ere to m ba kaŋɛ fanɛ e bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ e maŋ wora shɛŋ, 23kumo ere Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo yili esoso n ji fo nyɛrbi demu nseŋ gberge esa nɛ e ji n tɔr na kusoe nseŋ yige emo nɛ e maŋ ji n tɔr na.
24Nɛ bedoŋ baaŋ kɔ m pɔɔ fo basa Israɛlebi so ŋkpal b ka wora alubi ŋ gbiti fo so, nɛ b baaŋ chɛrga bumo be nfɛra nseŋ ba fo kutɔ bɔrɛlambu ere to m ba kule fo alubi be ketampaŋ, 25kumo ere fo yili esoso n nu bumo be kekule nseŋ ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo nseŋ bɛta bumo m ba kasawule nɛ fo ta n sa bumo nɛ bumo nananyɛnana na so.
26Fo baaŋ pɛ bɔrɛ ŋ keta ŋkpal fo basa ka wora kulubi ŋ gbiti fo so nɛ b baaŋ tuba nseŋ kilgi bumo be anishito n shoŋi bɔrɛlambu m bar bumo be amu ase ŋ kule fo, 27kumo ere, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yili esoso n nu bumo be kekule nseŋ ta fo basa Israɛlebi be alubi m paŋ bumo nseŋ ŋini bumo kusɔ nɛ k daga nseŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛ e ba fo kasawule nɛ fo ta n sa fo basa fanɛ bumo be kapetɛ mbaanaayɔ ere so.
28Nɛ akoŋ baŋ tɔr kasawule ere so, ŋko aleblawu ko e ba ŋko afugboŋ tushiso ŋko elotɔr e ba jija bumo be adɔjibi, ŋko bedoŋ ko e ba kaa kɔ bumo kena ŋko kayurnyaŋ ŋko kulɔ ko e ba luri bumo to, 29kumo ere fo nu bumo be kekule. Nɛ fo basa Israɛlebi baŋ ta kagbenejija n teŋi bumo be enɔana kabɔrɛkule to n shoŋi bɔrɛlambu ere, 30fo yili esoso n nu bumo be kekule nseŋ ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo. Fo nawule e nyi dimɛdi be kagbene to. Shin nɛ ekama e nya mbe asheŋ woraso be kakɔka, 31saŋɛ na so fo basa beeŋ baa bunyaŋ fo nsaa nu a sa fo ashi kasawule nɛ fo ta n sa an nananyɛnana ere so.
32Befɔ nɛ b shi kufɔ na kaŋ nu eleŋ nɛ fo kɔ nɛ kananɛ fee teŋi fo enɔ lempo na a wora asheŋ na, kaŋ baŋ ba bɔrɛlambu ere to m ba kule fo, 33kumo ere fo yili esoso n nu bumo be kekule nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ baa sha n sa bumo saŋɛ na so durnya be basa kikɛ beeŋ pin fo nsaa nu a sa fo fanɛ kananɛ fo basa Israɛlebi bee nu a sa fo na. Loŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ bɔrɛlambu nɛ m pɔr ere e la kakpa nɛ k daga fanɛ b baa bunyaŋ fo na.
34Fo kaŋ kaŋɛ fo basa kenishipereso fanɛ b ya kɔ bumo doŋana kena nɛ b yili kaplɛkama ŋ kilgi bumo be anishito n shoŋi kade nɛ fo lara nɛ bɔrɛlambu nɛ m pɔr n sa fo ere ŋ kule fo, 35kumo ere fo yili esoso n nu bumo be kekule n shin nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so.
36Ekama bee wora alubi, amoso hale nɛ fo basa wora alubi ŋ gbiti fo nɛ fo nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo nseŋ ta bumo m bɔɔ bumo doŋana enɔ nɛ b pɛ bumo n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ nɛ k wɔ kufɔ so gba, 37fo nu fo basa be kabɔrɛkule. Nɛ fanɛ b chɛrga bumo be nfɛra nseŋ kule fo a bugi to e kaŋɛ bumo be alubi kananɛ b la basa lubi nɛ kananɛ b la amu kpakpasowuraana ashi efuli na so, kumo ere Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nu bumo be kekule. 38Nɛ fanɛ b chɛrga bumo be nfɛra kashenteŋto nna ashi efuli na so bre nseŋ kilgi bumo be anishito n shoŋi kasawule nɛ fo ta n sa an nananyɛnana na nɛ kade nɛ fo lara ere nɛ bɔrɛlambu nɛ m pɔr n sa fo ere nseŋ kule fo, 39kumo ere fo yili esoso n nu bumo be kekule nseŋ wu bumo kuwɔr n ta fo basa be alubi kikɛ m paŋ bumo.
40O Ebɔrɛ, keni anyi so nseŋ nu anyi be kabɔrɛkule nɛ anyee kule nfe ere. 41Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, koso m bɔla ŋkre be deka nɛ k yili a sa eleŋ nɛ fo kɔ na so n luri bɔrɛlambu ere to, nsaa wɔ ndoŋ mbaanaayɔ. Nɛfa fo bɔrɛmatapoana ashi kusɔ kama nɛ baa wora to nseŋ shin nɛ fo basa malɛ kikɛ be ŋgbene e fuli bumo ŋkpal fo kelela nɛ fee wora a sa bumo so. 42Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ kini ewura nɛ fo lara na n lɛ. Baa nyiŋi kasha nɛ fo kɔ n sa fo kayɛrbi ewura Deevid na.”

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 7
Content:
Keta bɔrɛlambu na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 8:62-66)
1Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ka kule Ebɔrɛ n loge, nɛ edɛ shi esoso m ba chɔɔ sarga nɛ b lara na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kefulto nyaŋɛ n fulto bɔrɛlambu na kikɛ to. 2Bɔrɛmatapoana na daŋ maŋ tiŋ n luri bɔrɛlambu na to ŋkpal kefulto gboŋgboŋi nɛ k nyaŋɛ a wɔ kumo to na so. 3Israɛlebi na kikɛ ka wu edɛ na ka shi esoso m ba sɔ bɔrɛlambu na kikɛ to na, nɛ b gbir m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ a di mo epaŋ ŋkpal mbe kelela nɛ mbe kasha nɛ k wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ so. 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ basa na kikɛ lara esarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. 5Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ mɔ ana ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ mboe malɛ ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nna n lara kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be sarga pɔɛŋ nɛ mo nɛ basa na kikɛ ta bɔrɛlambu na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ. 6Israɛlebi na kikɛ daŋ niŋi to a yil nna. Bɔrɛmatapoana na daa yil kakpa nɛ b sa bumo na nna. Nɛ Livaiebi na malɛ yili ŋ kilgi anishito n shoŋi bumo nsaa laŋ alaŋsɔ nɛ ewura Deevid sa bumo na a maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ a boŋ nshɛ a kaŋɛ: “Mbe kasha wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ!” Bɔrɛmatapoana na malɛ daa foŋ mbel nna.
7Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ ta kelɔnɛ na be nferinto a mata bɔrɛlambu na be anishito ase na nna m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nseŋ lara kechɔɔ m mur be esarga nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be asɔbɔya be esarga be nfɔ nɛ ajibi be sarga. E daŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal danyaŋ be bɔrɛsure nɛ e daŋ pɔr na ka daa maŋ shibi ga nɛ b baa lara esarga na kikɛ kumo so so.
8Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ daŋ ji abuu to be kebaawɔtɔ be kejigboŋ nchɛnshunu nna m bɛ abar so. Basa damta na be beko daŋ shi Hamaf Paas ashi kelargato be esoso be kaba so nna nɛ beko malɛ shi Israɛl nɛ Ijipt be kasawule be egbaŋ to ashi kelargato be kaseto be kaba so. 9B daŋ ji nchɛnshunu nna ŋkpal bɔrɛsure na be keta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ so nseŋ naŋ ji nchɛ ashunu malɛ ŋkpal abuu to be kebaawɔ be kejigboŋ na so n ti so. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta kachɛ koŋwule n ti so n shɛr m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ. 10Kumo be ŋklade nɛ k la kufɔl shunusopo na be nchɛ adunyɔ nɛ asa na, nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn shin nɛ basa na kikɛ yɔ bumo peana. Bumo be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo ga ŋkpal kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nɛfa mbe basa Israɛlebi, nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn so.
Ebɔrɛ ka naŋ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 9:1-9)
11Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ka pɔr bɔrɛlambu na nɛ ewura be laŋ na n loge, nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ e kre n yili a yɔ amo be kaplɛa so na nite nɛnɛ, 12nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini mo edare to kanyɛso nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “N nu fo kabɔrɛkule nseŋ shuli fanɛ bɔrɛlambu ere to nɛ baaŋ baa lara esarga a sa ma. 13Nɛ fanɛ m pɛ bɔrɛ ŋko n shin nɛ elotɔr ba ji menyi be adɔjibi ŋko n shin nɛ aleblawu ko ba ma basa so, 14nɛ ma basa bar bumo be amu kaseto ŋ chɛrga bumo be nfɛra a laŋɛ alubi nɛ baa wora na be kaplɛa so nseŋ kule ma bre, meeŋ yili esoso n nu bumo be kekule nseŋ ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo nseŋ naŋ nɛfa bumo be kasawule n shin nɛ k baa wora adɔjibi nɛnɛ. 15Meeŋ nu kekule kama nɛ b kule bɔrɛlambu ere to, 16ŋkpal manɛ so k la meya nna. Baaŋ baa shuŋ ma ndoŋ hale mbaanaayɔ, ma alɛ maaŋ yige kumo be kekeni so kikɛ. 17Fo tuto Deevid daa kɔ kasonu nna n sa ma amoso fo alɛ gba, Sɔlɔmɔn e baa wora loŋ. Baa bɛ ma mbra nɛ ma keŋini so, 18saŋɛ na so ma kɔnɔ nɛ n nase n sa fo tuto fanɛ mbe kanaŋ to be esa e naŋ baa ji Israɛl be kuwura saŋkama na beeŋ bɔlɔ so. 19Ama nɛ fanɛ fo ŋko Israɛl be basa ko kini kebɛ ma mbra so nsaa shuŋ efuli pɔtɛana so be agbir, 20kumo ere meeŋ lara menyi ashi kasawule nɛ n ta n sa menyi ere so nseŋ lar bɔrɛlambu nɛ n nɛfa ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ baa wɔ ndoŋ nɛ men baa bunyaŋ ma na to nɛ basa kikɛ e ta kumo fanɛ epel be kakpa nsaa keni kumo jiga. 21Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ bɔrɛlambu na walɛ, ama nɛ kumo be loŋ kaŋ ba wora, k beeŋ chinchiŋ basa kama nɛ baa bɔla kumo ase a choŋ nɛ b baa bishi le: ‘Manɛ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wora mbe basa nɛ b wɔ mbe bɔrɛlambu to le?’ 22Nɛ basa e kaŋɛ bumo le: ‘Ŋkpal b ka kplaŋ Enyɛnpe bumo tutoana be ebɔrɛ nɛ e lara bumo ashi Ijipt be efuli so na so nseŋ ya kaa shuŋ agbir pɔtɛana so nɛ e shin nɛ le be aleblawu ba bumo so na.’ ”

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 8
Content:
Kusɔ nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn tiŋ n wora be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 9:10-28)
1Nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ ta m pɔr bɔrɛlambu na nɛ ewura be laŋ n loge. 2Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr nde nɛ ewura Hiram nɛ e la Tayɛ be ewura daŋ ta n sa mo na gba nseŋ shin nɛ Israɛlebi na ya chena amo to.
3Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ ya kɔ Hamaf Zoba kena nna n sɔ ndoŋ be kaba na so kikɛ. 4E daŋ shin nna nɛ mbe beshumpo lɔŋɛ m pɔr kade nɛ baa tre Tadmɔ nɛ k wɔ keshishɛrsawule so na nɛ nde nɛ a wɔ Hamaf nɛ e bee yili mbe ajibi ndoŋ na. 5E daŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr Bɛf Hɔrɔn nɛ k wɔ esoso be kaba so na nɛ Bɛf Hɔrɔn nɛ kumo alɛ wɔ kaseto be kaba so na nseŋ shin nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti amo nseŋ wɔtɔ amo be mbunagboŋana kikɛ abersobi. 6Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ e wora n sa Baalaf nɛ nde nɛ e bee ta ajibi nɛ egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛ a yili na. Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ shin nna nɛ mbe beshumpo pɔr asɔ nɛ e bee sha n yili Jerusalɛm nɛ Lebanɔn nɛ mbe efuli so be kaplɛkama.
7-8Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ shin nna nɛ Keenan be efuli so b basa nɛ Israɛlebi daa maŋ mɔ saŋɛ nɛ b daŋ lar Ijipt m ba sɔ kasawule na bee shuŋ a sa mo. Bumo e daa la Hitebi nɛ Amɔriebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Hivebi nɛ Jebusiebi nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi la anya hale m ba fo loŋ be jemanɛ na so. 9Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa maa tintiŋ Israɛlebi na bre nɛ baa shuŋ ashuŋ kpakpaso ama e daŋ ta bumo be beko nna ŋ ki benapo nseŋ ta beko malɛ ŋ ki benapo be benimu nseŋ ta beko ŋ ki egbaŋɛturko nɛ bumo nɛ bumo baa dii egbaŋɛ a kɔ kena nɛ benapo nɛ baa nite ayaso a kɔ kena be benimu nna.
10Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ lara ekrachi alfa anyɔ nɛ adunu nna nɛ baa keni beshumpo nɛ baa pɔr mbe asɔ na kikɛ so.
11Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be eche nɛ e la Ijipt be ewura pibiche na, daŋ koso Jerusalɛm be kaba ko nɛ baa tre Deevid be kade to na nna n yɔ ewura be laŋ popɔr nɛ Sɔlɔmɔn pɔr na to. B ka daŋ ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka na n ya yili Deevid be kade to na, kumo be loŋ e daŋ shin nɛ ewura be laŋ na ki cheembi nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be eche na maŋ naŋ tiŋ n chena kumo to.
12Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ lara esarga bɔrɛsure nɛ b pɔr bɔrɛlambu na be anishito nna n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. 13E daŋ bɛ kananɛ Mosis ŋini fanɛ b baa lara esarga kewushiachɛ na, nɛ kufɔl popɔr kikɛ be kachɛ sososo nɛ bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi be kachɛgboŋ nɛ kasɔteŋi be kachɛgboŋ nɛ abuu to be kebaawɔ be kachɛgboŋ so nna.
14Kananɛ mo tuto ewura Deevid nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be esa na daŋ kaŋɛ mo na, nɛ mo alɛ gba bɛ so nseŋ nyiŋi m barga kushuŋ na to n sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ baa chɛ bɔrɛmatapoana to a boŋ nshɛ nseŋ naa chɛ bumo to a shuŋ karechɛ kikɛ na. E daŋ barga bɔrɛlambu na be mbuna be bekenipo na to ntuŋ ntuŋ so nna n yili nɛ baa shuŋ mbunagboŋ na be kekama ekpa karechɛ kikɛ. 15B daŋ bɛ asheŋ nɛ ewura Deevid daŋ kaŋɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na a laŋɛ ajibi be ebuana nɛ asheŋ ko ana gba be kaplɛa so nna dede.
16Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ e kre fanɛ e beeŋ wora na kikɛ nna n loge, baŋ yili saŋɛ so nɛ b fara Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na be gbaltɔlase hale nɛ k ya loge.
17Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn yɔ Eziɔngɛba nɛ Elaf nɛ a la Edɔm be kasawule so be ndegboŋ anyɔ nɛ a wɔ teku peper na be kɔnɔ ase na. 18Ewura Hiram daŋ shin nna nɛ mbe basa nɛ b nyi nchu to be asheŋ nɛnɛ na ta ekuloŋgboŋana ko m ba sa ewura Sɔlɔmɔn. Bumo nɛ Sɔlɔmɔn be basa e daŋ bɔla nchu so n yɔ efuli nɛ baa tre Ɔfir na. B ka bɛta a ba, nɛ b bar ewura Sɔlɔmɔn shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ kuduanu.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 9
Content:
Shɛba be ewurche ka ba bɔɔ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn so be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 10:1-13)
1Shɛba be ewurche ka nu kananɛ Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be ketre daŋ dii ga nna nɛ e keta mbe benimu damta nseŋ kre asɔ nɛ a kɔ efɛa belbelso nɛ shuwa damta ko n deŋi enyɔma so n yɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ e ya bishi ewura Sɔlɔmɔn mmalga kpakpaso. Mo nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ka tu abar nɛ e bishi mo asheŋ nɛ e wɔ mbe nfɛra to kikɛ. 2Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ sa mmalga na kikɛ be atuwebi nna. Asheŋ bishiso na be kekama daa maŋ du mo so kpakpa. 3Shɛba be ewurche na daŋ nu ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be kanyiasheŋ be mmalga nseŋ wu ewura be laŋ nɛ e pɔr na gba. 4E ka wu ajibi nɛ b chige n yili ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be teebɔl so na, nɛ ebuana nɛ mbe benimuana wɔtɔ na, nɛ kananɛ ewura be laŋ na be beshumpo be asheŋ bee bɛ abar so nɛnɛ nɛ epiŋi nɛ nyɛrbi nɛ baa chige ajibi kejigboŋ nɛ esarga be kelara be jemanɛ ashi bɔrɛlambu to na bee buu na, nɛ k chinchiŋ mo alegaiso.
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn le: “Kusɔ nɛ n nu ma efuli so a laŋɛ fo kaplɛa so nɛ kanyiasheŋ nɛ fo kɔ kikɛ la kashenteŋ nna! 6N daa maŋ yirda kumo be loŋ, ama ŋ gbagba ka ba wu kumo be kashenteŋ ere pɔɛŋ nɛ n yirda. M maŋ nu fo kanyiasheŋ ere be asheŋ be bargato gba. Fo kanyiasheŋ chɔ kananɛ n nu kumo be asheŋ basa kutɔ na ga. 7Basa nɛ baa shuŋ fo nsaa wɔ fo kutɔ saŋkikɛ a nu fo kanyiasheŋ be mmalga na nu ebel pasaa! 8Kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na peya. Mbe kagbene fuli fo so ga nna so nɛ e ta fo ŋ ki Israɛlebi be ewura nɛ fo baa ji bumo so eleŋ. Ŋkpal e ka bee sha mbe basa Israɛlebi nsaa sha kebaakuŋ bumo saŋkama nɛ so e ta fo ŋ ki bumo be ewura nɛ fo baa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nsaa wora asɔ nɛ a niŋi ekpa a sa bumo na.
9Ewurche na daŋ ta shuwa kilo ŋgboŋ ana nɛ abitasɔ damta nɛ asɔ nɛ a kɔ efɛa belbelso nɛ amo be efɛa maŋ kɔ sara nna m ba sa ewura Sɔlɔmɔn. Asɔ nɛ a kɔ efɛa belbelso kikɛ daa maŋ walɛ n fo amo nɛ Shɛba be ewurche na ta m ba sa ewura Sɔlɔmɔn na so”.
10Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ sa Shɛba be ewurche na kusɔ kama nɛ e daa sha nna. Asɔ nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ sa mo na daa chɔ kakɛ nɛ ewurche na daŋ bar mo na. Ade be kaman nɛ Shɛba be ewurche na nɛ mbe basa bɛta n yɔ bumo be efuli so. 11Ewura Hiram nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be basa nɛ baa shuŋ nchu so na shi efuli nɛ baa tre Ɔfir na nna m bar ewura Sɔlɔmɔn shuwa nɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre junipa na nɛ abitasɔ.
12Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ ta ndibi na nna n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na nɛ ewura be laŋ be asɔ nɛ baa bɔla so a dii a luri amo to na nseŋ ta amo be ako n lɔŋɛ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ ejirgo n sa beshɛbompoana. Loŋ be asheŋ maŋ naŋ wora ashi Juda be kasawule so kikɛ.
13Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa nya shuwa kilo ŋgboŋ adunyɔ ashi lampo nɛ e bee sɔ to nna. 14Ama eyawujipo nɛ benitepo be asɔ nɛ baa sa mo bre maŋ ti so. Areebia be efuli so be bewura nɛ Israɛl be efuli so be abonfu to be gomena be benimu gba daa sa mo gbiti nɛ shuwa nna.
15Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ lɔŋɛ benapo be abɛlso be asɔkuŋso gboŋgboŋi alfa anyɔ nɛ b bɛa shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo asa m mata amo be kekama so nna, 16nseŋ wora amo be awurbi alfa asa nɛ b bɛa shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo koŋwule nɛ bargato m mata amo alɛ be kekama so. E daŋ shin nna nɛ b ta asɔkuŋso na kikɛ n yili ewura be laŋ to be ebugboŋ nɛ baa tre Lebanɔn be kupo na to.
17Kusɔlnyi nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ mbe kuwurputi be echenakpa gboŋgboŋi nseŋ ta shuwa lela malɛ m mata m mata kumo kikɛ so. 18Atemprembi ashe nɛ baa dii so a yɔ kuwurputi na be echenakpa. B daŋ ta shuwa nna mata kabɛ nɛ mbe aya bee yili so nɛ echenakpa na be kakpa nɛ enɔ bee deŋi so na kikɛ nna. Ebuluŋ be mpɔrduli malɛ daa yil kuwurputi na be bena nɛ jisoso kikɛ nna. 19Ebuluŋ be mpɔrduli kuduanyɔ e daa yil atemprembi ashe na ase. Ketemprembi kama be kaba kama daa kɔ buluŋ be kapɔrduli nna m mata kumo. Loŋ be ewura be echenakpa na be kaduli maŋ wɔ efuli kikɛ so.
20Shuwa lela nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be asɔ nuu nchu nɛ laŋ to be asɔjito nɛ a wɔ mbe laŋ to be ebugboŋ nɛ baa tre Lebanɔn be kupo na to. Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be jemanɛ so b daa maa keni gbiti a bɔlɔ kenishi ŋkpal shuwa ka daŋ chase kaplɛkama so. 21Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa kɔ nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ damta nɛ amo nɛ ewura Hiram be nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ bee nite nchu so. Nfɛ asa kikɛ mbe nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ na daa sulɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ asɔlnyii nɛ enyare nɛ efɛate nna a bɛta a ba.
22Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa kɔ kedamaya nɛ kanyiasheŋ a chɔ ewura kikɛ durnya to. 23Bewura kikɛ daa ba mo kutɔ nna m baa kaa a nu mbe kanyiasheŋ be mmalga nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n sa mo na. 24Bewura nɛ baa ba mo kutɔ na be ekama daa bar mo kakɛ nna. Beko daa bar mo gbiti nɛ shuwa nɛ epiŋi tenteŋ nɛ akɔsɔ nɛ asɔ nɛ a kɔ efɛa belbelso nɛ egbaŋɛ nɛ ekurma. Loŋ nɛ bekama nɛ baa ba mo kutɔ kafɛ kafɛ kikɛ na daa wora.
25Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa kɔ egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛ be eyilikpa ŋgboŋ ana nna, nsaa kɔ egbaŋɛ nawule malɛ ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ. E daŋ shin nna nɛ amo be ako wɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ ako malɛ wɔ mbe nde pɔtɛana to. 26Mo e daa ji bewura nɛ b wɔ Lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na ashi kelargato be esoso n ya fo Filistiebi be efuli so ashi kelargato be kaseto n ta n ya fo Ijiptebi be kasawule be egbaŋ to kikɛ so eleŋ. 27Mbe jemanɛ so gbiti daŋ baŋ gbigi Jerusalɛm nna fanɛ ajembu na, nɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na malɛ gba daŋ gbigi fanɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre sikamɔɔ nɛ e wɔ Juda be kebeemase na. 28Ijipt nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa tɔ mbe egbaŋɛ.
Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be lalaloge be kamalga be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 11:41-43)
29B daŋ sibɛ kusɔ kama nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn naŋ wora saŋɛ nɛ e daa la ewura na nna n wɔtɔ anebi Neetan nɛ anebi Abija nɛ e shi Shilo na nɛ anebi Iduu nɛ e sibɛ Nebat pibinyɛn Jeroboam be asheŋ na be nwɔl to. 30Nfɛ adena nɛ Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ ji Israɛl be kasawule so kikɛ be kuwura ashi Jerusalɛm to. 31E ka wu nɛ b ya puli mo Jerusalɛm nɛ baa tre Deevid be kade to na, nɛ mo pibinyɛn, Rehoboam, malɛ sɔ mo so ŋ ki ewura.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 10
Content:
Eyiriana nɛ a wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na ka kini kenu n sa ewura Rehoboam be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 12:1-20)
1Rehoboam daŋ yɔ Shɛkɛm nna nɛ Israɛlebi nɛ b wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so chala abar a jo mo ndoŋ nɛ b buu mo kuwura. 2Jeroboam nɛ e la Nebat pibinyɛn nseŋ daŋ shile n ya ŋana Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn so ashi Ijipt na ka nu loŋ nɛ e bɛta m ba epe. 3Kelargato be esoso be kaba so be eyiriana na e daŋ shuŋi n tre mo, nɛ bumo nɛ mo kikɛ yɔ Rehoboam kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: 4“Fo tuto bre daŋ shin nɛ anyee gben ga. Fo baaŋ ku anyi be ashuŋ so nseŋ shin nɛ asheŋ bɔ n sa anyi bre, kumo ere anyi alɛ beeŋ baa shuŋ fo saŋkama.”
5Nɛ Rehoboam kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men sa ma nchɛ asa nɛ n fɛ kesheŋ ere be asheŋ. Kumo be kaman nɛ men bɛta m ba nu kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na bɛta n yɔ.
6Kumo be kaman nɛ Rehoboam ya bishi benimu nɛ b daa la mo tuto be asoetojipoana na le: “Manɛ nɛ menyee sha fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ basa ere?”
7Nɛ bumo alɛ kaŋɛ le: “Fo baa wora basa ere kelela nsaa wora kusɔ nɛ baa sha a sa bumo, kumo ere bumo alɛ beeŋ baa shuŋ fo saŋkikɛ.”
8Ama e daŋ kini benyɛnnimu na be kasotoji nna nseŋ ya sɔ mo braana mbifɔlbi nɛ mo nɛ bumo la sarato na be kasotoji. 9Le nɛ e daŋ bishi bumo: “Manɛ be kasotoji nɛ men kɔ n sa ma? Manɛ nɛ menyee sha ŋ ka kaŋɛ basa nɛ baa kaŋɛ ma fanɛ ŋ ku bumo be kushuŋ so n sa bumo ere?”
10Ndoŋ nna nɛ mo braana nɛ mo nɛ bumo koso kebiato na kaŋɛ e kaŋɛ basa na le: “Men sa maa ta n tuto a ber ma. 11Nɛ n tuto daa ta ashuŋ damta a sa menyi nna ma ere beeŋ naŋ wora amo keshi n ti so. Nɛ e daa ta kuchuchɔ fuloŋ a kuya menyi so, ma ere beeŋ ta gbaŋɛ be kuchuchɔ a kuya menyi so!”
12Nchɛ asa na ka fo nɛ Jeroboam nɛ basa na kikɛ bɛta m ba Rehoboam kutɔ fanɛ kananɛ e yili bumo na gbagba. 13Ewura na daŋ kini benyɛnnimu na be kasotoji nna nsaa malga basa na m malga jiga 14fanɛ kananɛ mbrantiɛbia na kaŋɛ mo na, a kaŋɛ le: “Nɛ n tuto daa shin nɛ menyee shuŋ ga, ma ere beeŋ shin nɛ men shuŋ a chɔ loŋ. Nɛ e daa ta kuchuchɔ fuloŋ a kuya menyi so, ma ere beeŋ ta gbaŋɛ be kuchuchɔ ŋ kuya menyi so!” 15K daa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kepar nna fanɛ kusɔ nɛ e bɔla anebi Ahija nɛ e shi Shilo na so ŋ kaŋɛ Nebat pibinyɛn Jeroboam na e bɔlɔ so. Kumo alɛ be loŋ so nɛ ewura na be shɛŋ daa maŋ wɔ basa na to na. 16Basa na ka wu fanɛ ewura na maŋ nu n sa bumo na, nɛ b ponte ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Anyi nɛ Deevid nɛ mbe kanaŋ maŋ kɔ shɛŋ! Manɛ nɛ b daŋ wora n sa anyi? Israɛlebi, men shin nɛ an yɔ epe! Men yige Rehoboam nɛ e baa ji mbe laŋ to ebi nawuleso kuwura.”
Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛlebi na kini kenu n sa mo 17nɛ Juda be kaba so nawule ebi sɔ Rehoboam fanɛ bumo be ewura.
18Kede be kaman nɛ ewura Rehoboam shuŋi Adoniram nɛ e bee keni beshumpo so na fanɛ e ya malga Israɛlebi na kutɔ. E ka yɔ nɛ b kpa mo ajembu m mɔ. Nɛ Rehoboam nya manaŋ n luri mbe gbaŋɛturko to n shile n yɔ Jerusalɛm. 19Baŋ yili loŋ be saŋɛ m ba fo kabre, basa nɛ b wɔ Israɛl be kelargato be esoso be kaba so na bee kini kebaanu a sa ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to be kuwurji be mbra nna.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 11
Content:
Shemaya be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 12:21-24)
1Ewura Rehoboam ka ba Jerusalɛm na, nɛ e tre Bɛnjamin nɛ Juda be yiri na to be benapo lempo ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ aduburwa m ba abar so. E daa sha keyɔ n ya kɔ Israɛl be eyiri nɛ a wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na kena nna saŋɛ na so efuli na kikɛ beeŋ baa kraa la kukoŋwule. 2Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kaŋɛ anebi Shemaya 3nna fanɛ e ta le be kubɔya ere n sa ewura Rehoboam nɛ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be yiri to be basa na kikɛ. 4E yɛ: “Men sa maŋ kaŋ kɔ menyi gbagba be basa Israɛlebi na kena. Menyi kikɛ e baa yɔ epe. Ma keparso nɛ le be asheŋ ere kikɛ wora na.” Nɛ b nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ bumo na nseŋ yige keya kɔ Jeroboam nɛ mbe basa kena.
Rehoboam ka pɔr egbal ŋ kulti ndeana na be asheŋ
5Nɛ ewura Rehoboam shir a wɔ Jerusalɛm nseŋ shin nɛ b pɔr egbalana ŋ kulti Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be yiri to be nde ere. 6Amo ale Bɛtlɛhɛm nɛ Etam nɛ Tekua 7nɛ Bɛfzur nɛ Soko nɛ Adulam 8nɛ Gaaf nɛ Marɛsha nɛ Ziif 9nɛ Adoraim nɛ Lakish nɛ Azeka 10nɛ Zora nɛ Aijalɔn nɛ Hibrɔn. 11E daŋ shin nna nɛ baa kuŋ amo nɛnɛ nseŋ lara benapo be benimu nɛ baa keni nde na be kekama so nseŋ ta ajibi nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ asɔnuuso, 12nɛ abɛlso be asɔkuŋso nɛ akpaana n wɔtɔ amo to. Ŋkpal loŋ so e daŋ ji eleŋ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be nde so ga.
Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi ka ba Juda be kasawule so be asheŋ
13Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ b shi Israɛl be kelargato be esoso be kaba so be eyiri to na kikɛ daa bɛ ewura Rehoboam so nna. 14Livaiebi na yige bumo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa nɛ nsawule ko nna n lɛ nseŋ koso n yɔ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm ŋkpal ewura Jeroboam nɛ e bee ji Israɛl be kuwura na nɛ bewura nɛ b bɛ mo so na kikɛ ka maŋ shuli fanɛ b baa shuŋ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapoana so. 15Ewura Jeroboam daŋ lara mo gbagba be bɔrɛmatapoana nna fanɛ b baa shuŋ kakpa nɛ nnyamase na bee lɔŋɛ bumo be agbir na nsaa sha fanɛ b baa shuŋ ayoyu lubi nɛ egbolufɔlbi nɛ e lɔŋɛ fanɛ agbir na. 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛl be eyiriana na to be basa nɛ b daa sha kebaashuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kashenteŋto na bɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na so n yɔ Jerusalɛm, saŋɛ na so baaŋ tiŋ a lara esarga a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na. 17Ŋkpal loŋ so Juda be kuwurji na daŋ ji eleŋ ga nɛ b chɛ Sɔlɔmɔn Pibinyɛn Rehoboam to nfɛ asa, nɛ bumo nɛ mo chena fanɛ kananɛ bumo nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daa wɔtɔ na.
18Ewura Rehoboam e daŋ ta Mahalaf nɛ mo tuto daa la Jerimɔf nɛ e la ewura Deevid pibinyɛn na. Mo nio e daa la Eliab pibiche Abiheel nɛ e la Jɛsi nɛ e la ewura Deevid mo tuto na mo nanabi na. 19Ewura Rehoboam nɛ Mahalaf daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi asa nna: Bumo e la, Jewush nɛ Shemariya nɛ Zaham. 20Kumo be kaman nɛ Rehoboam ta Absalɔm pibiche Maaka. Mo nɛ Maaka daa kɔ mbinyɛnsobi ana nna, bumo e daa la: Abija nɛ Attai nɛ Ziza nɛ Shelomif.
21Ewura Rehoboam daa kɔ beche kuduaburwa nɛ bejipo malɛ adeshe. E daa kɔ bibinyɛn adunyɔ nɛ aburwa nɛ bibiche malɛ adeshe. Mbe beche nɛ bejipo kikɛ to Maaka nɛ e daa sha ga. 22Mbe mbia malɛ kikɛ to, Maaka be pibinyɛn Abija nɛ e daa sha ga hale n lara mo fanɛ esa nɛ e beeŋ ba sɔ mo so n ji kuwura mbe kaman. 23Ewura Rehoboam daŋ wora kanyiasheŋ nna n shin nɛ mbe mbinyɛnso na be ekama bee keni Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be eyiriana be nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na so. E daŋ sa bumo asɔ kama nɛ baaŋ ta a keni ndeana na so nna nseŋ ta beche damta n sa bumo n ti so.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 12
Content:
Ijipt be esa ka kɔ m pɔɔ Juda so be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 14:25-28)
1Rehoboam be kuwura ka baŋ yili nɛnɛ, nɛ mo nɛ mbe basa kini kebaabɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra so. 2Rehoboam ka ji kuwura be kafɛ nusopo to, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gberge bumo kusoe n shin nɛ Ijipt be ewura Shishak ba kɔ n sɔ Jerusalɛm ŋkpal b ka maa wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kasonu so. 3Benapo nɛ baa ta egbaŋɛturko a kɔ kena na be basa kagboŋ nɛ alfa anyɔ nɛ egbaŋɛdiipoana malɛ ŋgboŋ adeshe nɛ benapo damta nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga nɛ b shi Libiya nɛ Sukkit nɛ Itiopia nɛ ewura na daŋ ta n ya kɔ kena na. 4E daŋ kɔ n sɔ Juda be nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na kikɛ nna hale n ya fo Jerusalɛm.
5Anebi Shemaya daŋ yɔ ewura Rehoboam nɛ Juda be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ b shile n ya ŋana Shishak so ashi Jerusalɛm na kutɔ nna n ya kaŋɛ bumo le: “Enyɛnpe be kubɔya nɛ e kɔ a sa menyi nde. E yɛ: ‘Ŋkpal men ka kini ma so, ma alɛ gba yige menyi m bɔɔ Shishak enɔ.’ ”
6Nɛ ewura na nɛ mbe bejuŋkparpoana shuli fanɛ b wora kulubi nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wora na kɔ akpa.”
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka nu loŋ, nɛ e kaŋɛ Shemaya le: “Ŋkpal b ka shuli fanɛ b wora kulubi so, m maaŋ mur bumo. Hale Shishak bee kɔ bumo gba, baaŋ pete. Ma agbo maaŋ naŋ ba Jerusalɛm so ga, 8ama Shishak beeŋ pɔɔ bumo so, loŋ nɛ baaŋ pin kebaashuŋ ma nɛ kebaashuŋ durnya ere to be bewura ere be mbarga.”
9Ewura Shishak daŋ ba Jerusalɛm nna m ba ta bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ ewura be laŋ to be asɔ lela kikɛ. E daŋ ta asɔ kikɛ nna nseŋ ta benapo be shuwa be asɔkuŋso nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn lɔŋɛ na gba n ti so. 10Ewura Rehoboam daŋ lɔŋɛ danyaŋ be asɔkuŋso nna n tal amo na to nseŋ ta amo n wɔtɔ bekumpo nɛ baa keni ewurkpa be mbunagboŋ so na be benimu be enɔ to. 11Saŋkama nɛ ewura na baaŋ yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to, bekumpo na bee ta asɔkuŋso na nna a keta, ewura na baaŋ bɛta n yɔ epe nɛ b naŋ bɛta amo n ya wɔtɔ ebu nɛ baa kuŋ na to. 12Ŋkpal ewura Rehoboam ka naŋ bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ so, Enyɛnpe na be agbo daa maŋ mur mo cheche, nɛ asheŋ naŋ nyalɛ ashi Juda be efuli so.
13Ewura Rehoboam daŋ ji kuwura ashi Jerusalɛm nna nɛ mbe kuwura malɛ ji eleŋ ga. E daa la nfɛ adena nɛ kako nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ ji kuwura nfɛ kuduashunu ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara ashi Israɛl be efuli so kikɛ fanɛ b baa bunyaŋ mo ndoŋ na. Ewura Rehoboam mo nio e daa la Naama nɛ e shi Ammɔn be efuli so na. 14E daŋ wora alubi nna ŋkpal e ka daa maa wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ so.
15B sibɛ ewura Rehoboam be kusɔ nɛ e wora saŋɛ so nɛ e daa la ewura na nɛ mbe kanaŋ to be asheŋ kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ anebi Shemaya nɛ anebi Iddo be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to. Saŋɛ so nɛ Rehoboam daa la Juda be ewura na, mo nɛ Israɛl be ewura Jeroboam daa kɔ abar kena nna saŋkikɛ. 16Ewura Rehoboam ka wu, kakpa nɛ baa puli bewurbi ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ k la ewura Deevid be kade to na nɛ b daŋ puli mo. Ndoŋ nna nɛ mo pibinyɛn Abija sɔ mo so ŋ ki ewura.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 13
Content:
Abija ka kɔ Jeroboam kena be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 15:1-8)
1Ewura Jeroboam ka ji kuwura ashi Israɛl be efuli so be kafɛ kuduaburwasopo be jemanɛ so nɛ Abija malɛ ki Juda be efuli so be ewura 2nseŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ asa. Mo nio e daa la Yuriya nɛ e shi Gibia na pibiche Mikaya. Ndoŋ nna nɛ kena tɔr ewura Abija nɛ ewura Jeroboam so. 3Abija be benapo daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ alfa ana, nɛ Jeroboam daŋ keta benapo ŋgboŋ alfa aburwa n ya kɔ mo kena.
4Benapo na daŋ ya tu abar abee so be efuli nɛ k wɔ Efrayim na nna. Ewura Abija daŋ dii kebeegboŋ nɛ baa tre Zemariam na nna n yɔ kumo be esoso n ya tre Jeroboam nɛ Israɛlebi na m ponte ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Men nu nfe! 5Men maŋ nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ kpakpaso n sa ewura Deevid fanɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ na ta Israɛl be kuwurji nna n sa mbe kaman to ebi mbaanaayɔ a? 6Nebat pibinyɛn Jeroboam daŋ kini kenu n sa mbe ewura Sɔlɔmɔn nna.” 7Kumo be kaman nɛ e chala befɛpo nɛ basa fuloŋ be katuŋ ko nɛ b tintiŋ Rehoboam nɛ e baa wora kusɔ nɛ baa sha ŋkpal e ka kra la kebia nsaa maaŋ tiŋ n yili asheŋ kananɛ a daga loŋ be saŋɛ na so. 8Naniere, fee fɛ fanɛ feeŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ kuwurji nɛ Enyɛnpe ta n sa ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi ere so nna? Menyi alɛ kɔ benapo damta nɛ agbir nɛ Jeroboam ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ fanɛ egbolu fɔlbi na nna nɛ e baa la menyi be agbirana. 9Fo ju Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b la Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi na nseŋ ju Livaiebi na gba. Fo lara basa pɔtɛ ko nna nɛ b sɔ bumo be kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ be eyilikpa fanɛ kananɛ efuli pɔtɛ ko be basa bee wora na. Ekama malɛ nɛ e baŋ ta gbolu ŋko mbolpɔ ashunu m ba, fo shin nɛ e bee ki menyi be agbirana nɛ a maŋ la shɛŋ na be kegbirwura nna.
10“Ama anyi ere kraa shuŋ Enyɛnpe nɛ e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ na nna. Anyi alɛ maaŋ kini mo kikɛ. Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi e kraa shuŋ kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ na nɛ Livaiebi na malɛ bee chɛ bumo to. 11Kachipurso nɛ kaaseso kikɛ, baa chɔɔ duwu nɛ asɔbɔya be kechɔɔ m mur be esarga nna a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Baa ta bodobodo be sarga na nna a deŋi teebɔl nɛ k du cheembi na so daŋkare be ekpa so nsaa chɔɔ efitila nɛ a yil shuwa be kefitilatɔl na malɛ so kaaseso kikɛ. Anyi ere bee bɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra na so nna, ama menyi ere kini mo. 12Ebɔrɛ gbagba e la anyi be ejuŋkparpo nɛ mbe bɔrɛmatapoana malɛ wora shiriya nɛ b foŋ bumo be mbel n tre anyi nɛ anyi nɛ menyi e kɔ kena. Israɛlebi, men sa maŋ kaŋ kɔ an nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na kena ŋkpal manɛ so menyi maaŋ pɔɔ so kikɛ!”
13Jemanɛ ere so nɛ ewura Jeroboam shin nɛ mbe benapo ko ya pugi Judaebi na be benapo na be kaman to nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na malɛ wɔ bumo be anishito a jo nɛ b kɔ bumo kena. 14Judaebi na ka keni n wu fanɛ b kulti bumo n wɔtɔ na, nɛ b shu n tre Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e chɛ bumo to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na foŋ bumo be mbel 15nɛ Judaebi na cha kena to be awɔr ga. Kede be kaman nɛ ewura Abija juŋkpar bumo n ya kɔ kena na nɛ Ebɔrɛ chɛ bumo to nɛ b pɔɔ Jeroboam nɛ Israɛlebi be benapo na so m mɔ bumo. 16Israɛlebi na daŋ kilgi nna a shil nɛ Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ Judaebi na ju m bɛ bumo so a mɔ bumo. 17Ewura Abija nɛ mbe benapo daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ Israɛlebi na so nna nseŋ mɔ bumo be benapo ŋgboŋ alfa anu kikɛ. 18Ŋkpal Juda be basa ka ta bumo be yirda n lɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na so so, nɛ b daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ Israɛlebi na so na.
19Ewura Abija daŋ ju m buu Jeroboam be benapo na so nna hale n ya sɔ bumo be nde ko ana. Nde na e la Bɛtɛl nɛ Jeshana nɛ Efrɔn nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti amo na kikɛ. 20Jemanɛ nɛ Abija daa ji Juda be efuli so be kuwura na, Jeroboam daa maŋ naŋ nya eleŋ kikɛ. Amo kikɛ be lalaloge, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e wu.
21Abija bre be kuwurji be eleŋ daŋ baa ti so nna ga. E daa kɔ beche kuduana nɛ mbinyɛnsobi adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nɛ mbichesobi kuduashe nna. 22B daŋ sibɛ Abija be mmalga nɛ mbe aworbi kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ anebi Iddo be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 14
Content:
Ewura Asa ka kɔ m pɔɔ Itiopiaebi na so be asheŋ
1Ewura Abija ka wu, kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura na nɛ b ta mo n ya puli ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ baa tre ewura Deevid be kade to na. Mo pibinyɛn Asa e daŋ sɔ mo so n ji kuwura. Asa be jemanɛ to, efuli na kikɛ daŋ nya kagbenewushi nfɛ kudu kikɛ nna. 2Ewura Asa daŋ wora kusɔ nɛ k niŋi nsaa walɛ Enyɛnpe mbe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito nna. 3E daŋ bure efuli pɔtɛana so be ebɔrɛsureana nɛ mboŋ nɛ baa shuŋ bumo be agbirana kikɛ nna nseŋ bure agbirjembu nɛ eshabɔrɛ be mboŋ nɛ basa bee shuŋ kegbirche Ashira na ashi mbe efuli so. 4Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ Juda be basa kenishipereso fanɛ b baa bɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na be keŋini nɛ mbe mbra so. 5Ŋkpal e ka bure agbirana nɛ ebɔrɛsureana nɛ baa chɔɔ duwu amo so ashi Juda be nde kikɛ to na so, mbe kuwurji be jemanɛ daa kɔ kagbenewushi nna. 6Mbe jemanɛ to e daŋ shin nna nɛ b naŋ pɔr egbalana n deŋi deŋi egbalana nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti Juda be nde na so nɛ nde na nya eleŋ n ti so. Amoso nfɛ damta nɛ b daa maŋ naa kɔ kena ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka sa bumo kagbenewushi so. 7Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ Juda be basa: “Men shin nɛ an pɔr atempreŋ jeŋgreŋ nseŋ pɔr egbalana ŋ kulti anyi be ndeana, nseŋ wɔtɔ amo ekuloŋgboŋ nɛ anyeeŋ baa ti nsaa ta ndibi gboŋgboŋi a laga amo to. An kɔ kasawule na so be eleŋ. Ŋkpal an ka bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ so, E kuŋ anyi be ŋkpa ekpa kikɛ so.” Amoso b daŋ pere kenishi nna m pɔr ga nseŋ nya nɛfa malɛ ga. 8Ewura Asa be benapo nɛ b shi Juda n daa kɔ abɛlso be asɔkuŋso nɛ ekpa na daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ alfa asa nɛ bumo nɛ bumo alɛ daa shi Bɛnjamin nsaa kɔ abɛlso be asɔkuŋso wurbi nɛ ata na daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ alfa anyɔ nɛ aduburwa. Bumo kikɛ daa kɔ kenyɛn ga nsaa nyi kena be kekɔ nɛnɛ.
9Zɛra nɛ e shi Itiopia be efuli so na e daŋ juŋkpar benapo damta nɛ b maŋ kɔ kekarga na nɛ egbaŋɛturko nɛ b kɔ a kɔ kena be benapo alfa asa n ya kɔ Juda hale ŋ kɔ n ya lar kade nɛ baa tre Marɛsha na kikɛ. 10Nɛ ewura Asa nɛ mbe benapo lar n ya yili ŋ karga abar so n wora shiriya nɛ b tu mo ŋ kɔ kena ashi Zefata be ketaŋɛ nɛ k mata Marɛsha na ase. 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Asa kule Enyɛnpe mbe Ebɔrɛ na ŋ kaŋɛ le: “O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nawule e naa tiŋ a chɛ benapo pɔshipo to nɛ baa tiŋ a kɔ a pɔɔ benapo lempo so. Amoso, an Nyɛnpe nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ, ba chɛ anyi to naniere, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo nɛ anyee fute a yige so. Fo ketre be eleŋ na malɛ to nɛ an ba nɛ an ba kɔ benapo damta ere na. Enyɛnpe, fo e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ. Esa kama malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ fo so.”
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ chɛ Asa nɛ mbe benapo to nna nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ Itiopiaebi na so nɛ bumo be benapo kikɛ shile, 13nɛ Asa nɛ mbe benapo ju m buu bumo so hale n ya fo Gɛra. B daŋ pɔɔ bumo so cheche nna hale Itiopiaebi na daa maŋ naŋ tiŋ nɛ b kɔ gba. B daŋ mɔ bumo be bedamta nna. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so n sa benapo na nɛ b muu Itiopiaebi na be asɔ kikɛ. 14Kumo be kaman nɛ Asa be benapo na kɔ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti Gɛra na kena m pɔɔ amo kikɛ so ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kusɔ nɛ e wora na ka shin nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ga so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juda be benapo na muu bumo be asɔ lela kikɛ n yɔ. 15B daŋ yɔ mbolpɔkpapoana be echenakpaana nɛ a mata nde na gba to nna n ya kɔ bumo kena nseŋ pɛ bumo be mbolpɔ nɛ mboe nɛ enyɔma damta. Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ b bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 15
Content:
Ewura Asa ka lɔŋɛ asheŋ be asheŋ
1Asheŋ ere ka wora n choŋ na, nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kiyoyu gbelge Odɛd pibinyɛn Azariya so, 2nɛ e yɔ ewura Asa kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Ewura Asa nɛ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be basa, men kikɛ e nu nfe! Men baa nu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, mo alɛ beeŋ baa wɔ menyi kutɔ saŋkikɛ. Men baa fin mo, menyeeŋ wu mo, ama nɛ men baŋ pal kaman n sa mo bre, mo alɛ beeŋ yige menyi to. 3Israɛlebi na daŋ yige keshuŋ kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na n chɛr ga. B daa maŋ naa kɔ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ baa ŋini bumo Ebɔrɛ be akpa. Amoso b daa maŋ naa bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra so. 4Ama saŋkama nɛ b luri tɔrɔ to baa fin Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na nna nsaa wu mo. 5Loŋ be jemanɛ na so, esa kikɛ daa maaŋ tiŋ n nite yɛlyɛla so ŋkpal manɛ so kena daŋ baa wɔ kaplɛkama nna. 6Efuliana kikɛ daŋ baa mɛaŋ abar nna nɛ ndegboŋana na gba bee mɛaŋ abar ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka daa bar awurfoŋ nɛ etɔrɔ bumo so na so. 7Ama menyi ere e baa kɔ eleŋ nsaa maa pɔ aba ŋkpal manɛ so menyi be kushuŋ nɛ menyee wora na beeŋ bar tɔnɔ.”
8Ewura Asa ka nu kewuŋkaŋɛ nɛ Odɛd pibinyɛn Azariya kaŋɛ na, nɛ e nya keleŋto. E daŋ mur agbir nɛ a wɔ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be kasawule so nna nɛ amo nɛ a wɔ nde nɛ e kɔ n sɔ Efrayim be abee be efuli so na kikɛ. E daŋ lɔŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛsure nɛ k daa yil bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ so ashi Jerusalɛm na gba nna m pɔr.
9Basa damta nɛ b shi Efrayim nɛ Manase nɛ Simiɔn be kasawule so daŋ ba ka wɔ ewura Asa be kasawule so nna ŋkpal b ka wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka wɔ mo kutɔ so. Ewura Asa daŋ tre bumo nɛ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be basa kikɛ nna m ba abar so. 10Asa be kuwurji be kafɛ kuduanusopo be kufɔl sasopo to nɛ bumo kikɛ ba shɛr Jerusalɛm to. 11Kumo be kamɔnchɛ nɛ b daŋ ta asɔ nɛ b daŋ muu kena to ashi Gɛra na m ba lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Asɔ na e daa la ana alfa ashunu nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ mboe ŋgboŋ ashunu. 12B daŋ nase nnɔ nna n sa abar a laŋɛ kananɛ baaŋ ta bumo be ŋgbene nɛ ayoyu kikɛ a bunyaŋ bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na. 13B yɛ a daga b ka mɔ ekama nyam nna, kebia, ŋko enimu ŋko enyɛn ŋko eche nɛ e maa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna. 14B daŋ bɔ ntaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ketre to awɔrso nna fanɛ baaŋ bɛ kɔnɔ naseso nɛ b nase na so kpakpa nsaa foŋ mbel a cha awɔr nsaa ji bumo be eyur. 15Juda be basa kikɛ be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo nna ŋkpal b ka ta bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ n nase nnɔ n sa abar na so. Saŋkama nɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ, bumo be ŋgbene daa fuli bumo nna ŋkpal e ka daŋ sɔ bumo nseŋ sa bumo kagbenewushi ashi kusɔ kama to so.
16Ewura Asa mo nanache Maaka daŋ yuu kedibi nna a shuŋ kegbirche nɛ baa tre Ashira na nɛ ewura Asa tia kumo ŋ kuya to n chɔɔ ashi Kidrɔn be ketaŋɛ to. Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Maaka wora na so nɛ ewura Asa lara mo ashi eyilikpa nɛ e daa kɔ efuli na so to. 17Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ ewura Asa daa maŋ tiŋ m mur agbirana kikɛ ashi Israɛl be kasawule so, ama mbe ŋkpa kikɛ to e daŋ ji kashenteŋ nna n sa Ebɔrɛ. 18E daŋ ta asɔ nɛ mo tuto Abija daŋ ta m bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ na nna, nɛ gbiti nɛ shuwa be asɔ nɛ mo alɛ gbagba ta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ na kikɛ n wɔtɔ bɔrɛlambu na to. 19B daa maŋ naŋ kɔ kena kikɛ hale n ya fo Asa be kuwurji be nfɛ adesa nɛ anu.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 16
Content:
Ewura Asa be lalaloge be nchɛ be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 15:17-22)
1Juda be ewura Asa ka ji kuwura be kafɛ adesa nɛ ashesopo to, nɛ Israɛl be ewura Baasha kɔ n sɔ kade nɛ baa tre Raama na ashi Juda be efuli so nseŋ fara a pɔr egbal a kulti kumo, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ kuŋ basa nɛ baa luri Juda to a lar na akpa.
2Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Asa shin nɛ b lara gbiti nɛ shuwa ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ ewurkpa n ya sa ewura Bɛnhadad nɛ e la Siriya be ewura na ashi Damaskɔs na, nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: 3“Shin nɛ anyi nɛ fo e wora kɔnɔkoŋwule fanɛ kananɛ an tutoana daŋ wora na. Gbiti nɛ shuwa na bre la fo kakɛ nna. A daga fanɛ fo ku fo nɛ Israɛl be ewura Baasha be kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ men kɔ na to, nɛ kumo be loŋ e shin nɛ e lara mbe benapo ashi ma kasawule so.”
4Nɛ ewura Bɛnhadad shuli kusɔ nɛ Asa kaŋɛ na nseŋ shuŋi mbe benapo nɛ bumo be benimu fanɛ b ya kɔ Israɛl be ndegboŋana na. B daŋ ya kɔ m pɔɔ Ijɔn nɛ Dan nɛ Abel Mayim nɛ Naftali be ndegboŋana nɛ b daa ta bumo be asɔ a yili to na kikɛ so nna. 5Ewura Baasha ka nu kusɔ nɛ k bee wora na, nɛ e shin nɛ b yige egbal na be kepɔr ŋ kulti Raama be kushuŋ na nseŋ bɛta n yɔ epe. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Asa tre Juda be efuli so be benyɛn n shɛr abar so ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b muu ajembu nɛ ndibi nɛ Baasha kɔ a shuŋ ashi Raama na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b muu amo m ya pɔr egbal ŋ kulti Gɛba nɛ Mizpa be nde.
Anebi Hanani be asheŋ
7Loŋ be saŋɛ na nɛ anebi Hanani yɔ ewura Asa kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Ŋkpal fo ka ta fo yirda n deŋi Siriya be ewura so nseŋ kini keta fo yirda n deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so so, fo maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m pɔ Siriya be benapo so kikɛ. 8Etopiya be efuli so ebi nɛ Libiya be efuli so ebi kɔ benapo damta nɛ egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛdiipo damta. Ama ŋkpal fo ka ta fo yirda n deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so so nɛ e shin nɛ fo kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so na. 9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nyi kusɔ nɛ durnya to ebi kikɛ bee wora, nsaa sa bekama nɛ b kɔ kasonu a sa mo na eleŋ. Ama ŋkpal fo ka wora kawulisheŋ so, yili kabre a yɔ, feeŋ baa kɔ kena nna saŋkama.”
10Ewura Asa ka nu loŋ nɛ e nya agbo n wɔtɔ anebi na n shin nɛ b pɛ mo n ya ti ebu. Loŋ be jemanɛ na so nɛ ewura Asa fara a mɛaŋ basa na be beko.
Asa be kuwurji be ekar be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 15:23-24)
11B sibɛ Asa ka ji kuwura hale n ya loge be asheŋ kikɛ n wɔtɔ Juda nɛ Israɛl be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to. 12Asa ka ji kuwura be kafɛ adesa nɛ akpanusopo to nɛ kulɔ lubi ko pɛ mbe aya nɛ e ki bobi; ŋkeshin nɛ amo nɛ amo kikɛ e daa maŋ fin kechɛto ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ. Edɔkta kutɔ nɛ e daŋ ya kaa fin kechɛto. 13E ka naŋ ji nfɛnyɔ n ti so, nɛ e wu 14nɛ b ta mo n ya puli mo gbagba be kejembu laŋ be nchaŋ nɛ e shin nɛ b kur n nase mo ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ k wɔ Ewura Deevid be kade to na to. B daŋ ta efɛa belbelso be duwu nna nɛ etulale be ŋkuana n ya gbiti mbe kebuni pɔɛŋ n ta mo m puli, nseŋ puga edɛgboŋ mbe keelibuna n shu mbe keeli bunyanso.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 17
Content:
Jehoshafat ka ki Ewura be asheŋ
1Ewura Asa pibinyɛn Jehoshafat e daŋ sɔ mo tuto so n ji kuwura nseŋ bela mbe kumu ase nɛnɛ nɛ e kɔ Israɛl kena. 2E daŋ ta benapo nna n yili Juda be nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na nɛ ndekarso ko ashi Juda be kasawule so nɛ nde nɛ mo tuto Asa kɔ n sɔ ashi Efrayim be kasawule so na. 3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nɛfa ewura Jehoshafat nna ŋkpal e ka daŋ bɛ kebaawɔtɔ lela nɛ mo tuto daa kɔ nseŋ kini kebunyaŋ Baal be kegbir na so. 4E daŋ shuŋ mo tuto be Ebɔrɛ nseŋ bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra so, a maŋ wora kananɛ Israɛl be bewuraana daŋ wora na. 5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa ewura Jehoshafat eleŋ nna nɛ Juda be efuli so be kusɔ kikɛ daa wɔ mbe kuwura be kaseto. Basa na kikɛ daŋ bar mo ŋkɛ nna nɛ e ki damawura nseŋ nya bunyaŋ n ya baŋ so. 6E daŋ shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kashenteŋto ga nseŋ jija nnyamase na be ademaŋana nɛ kakpa nɛ baa shuŋ kegbirche nɛ baa tre Ashira ashi Juda be efuli so na kikɛ.
7Jehoshafat ka ji kuwura be kafɛ sasopo nɛ e lara benimu ere fanɛ b ya ka ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra na ashi nde nɛ a wɔ Juda be efuli so na kikɛ to. Bumo e la Bɛnheel nɛ Obadaya nɛ Zakareya nɛ Natanɛl nɛ Mikaya. 8Livai be basa akpanu nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana anyɔ e daŋ shuŋi bumo n yɔ. Livai be basa na e daa la Shemaya nɛ Netanaya nɛ Zebadiya nɛ Asahɛl nɛ Shamiramɔf nɛ Jehonatan nɛ Adonija nɛ Tobija nɛ Tobadonija.
