Bɔrɛmatapoana na malɛ e daa la Elishaama nɛ Jehoram. 9B daŋ ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra be kawɔl na nna n yɔ Juda be ndeana kikɛ to n ya ka ŋini basa na.
Jehoshafat ka la esagboŋ be asheŋ
10Enyɛnpe daŋ shin nɛ kufu pɛ efuli nɛ a kulti Juda na nna nɛ b maŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ Ewura Jehoshafat kena. 11Filistiebi na be beko daŋ ta gbiti damta nɛ ŋkɛ ko nna m ba sa ewura Jehoshafat a ŋini fanɛ b sɔ mo ŋ ki bumo be ewura. Nlɔrbu ko gba daŋ ta mbolpɔ ŋgboŋ ashunu nɛ alfa ashunu nɛ mboe ŋgboŋ ashunu nɛ alfa ashunu nna m ba sa mo. 12Ewura Jehoshafat be kuwurji be eleŋ daŋ baa ti so nna saŋkikɛ. E daŋ pɔr egbalana nna ŋ kulti Juda be nde nseŋ pɔr nde nɛ baaŋ baa yili 13bumo be asɔ amo to, nseŋ shin nɛ benapo be benimu ko nɛ b nyi kena be kekɔ nɛnɛ chena Jerusalɛm. 14Adna e daa la Juda be kabuna be benapo be enimu, nseŋ daa kɔ benapo ŋgboŋ alfa asa a keni so. 15Jehohanan e daa la enimu nyɔsopo m bɛ mo so nsaa keni benapo ŋgboŋ alfa anyɔ nɛ aduburwa so. 16Enimu sasopo e daa la Zikri pibinyɛn Amaziya nɛ mo alɛ daa keni benapo ŋgboŋ alfa anyɔ so. Amaziya daŋ lara mbe kumu nna n yili fanɛ e beeŋ shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.
17Benapo be enimu nɛ e daa keni Bɛnjamin be kabuna be benapo so e daa la Eliada nɛ e daa la enapo lempo nsaa keni benapo ŋgboŋ alfa anyɔ nɛ b kɔ abɛlso be asɔkuŋso nɛ ata a kɔ kena na so. 18Emo nɛ e bɛ mo so nsaa juŋkpar benapo ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ aduburwa nɛ b kɔ kena to be adoŋsɔ nɛnɛ na, e daa la Jehozabad. 19Le be basa ere kikɛ daa shuŋ ewura na ashi Jerusalɛm nna, ama e daŋ naŋ ta benapo ko gba n chena nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti ashi Juda be efuli so na kikɛ nna.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 18
Content:
Anebi Mikaya ka kpla ewura Ahab kusoe be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 22:1-28)
1Ewura Jehoshafat nɛ e daa la Juda be ewura na ka ki damawura nɛ mbe ketre dii ga na, nɛ mo nɛ Israɛl be ewura Ahab wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ mo pibinyɛn e ta Ahab pibiche ŋ ki mbe eche. 2B ka wɔtɔ n ya fo saŋko, nɛ ewura Jehoshafat yɔ Samɛria be kade to nɛ e ya bɔɔ Ahab so. Ewura Ahab daŋ mɔ mbolpɔ nɛ ana damta nna n wora kejigboŋ ŋ keta ewura Jehoshafat nɛ mbe basa kefɔ. E daa lɔlɔ Jehoshafat nna nɛ e tu mo n ya kɔ Ramɔfebi nɛ b wɔ Giliad be kasawule so na kena. 3Le nɛ e daŋ bishi mo: “Feeŋ tu ma n ya kɔ Ramɔfebi kena a?”
Nɛ ewura Jehoshafat kaŋɛ: “Saŋkama nɛ fo wora shiriya, ma alɛ gba wora shiriya, nɛ ma benapo gba wora shiriya. Anyeeŋ tu fo n yɔ. 4Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ an wora loŋ, a daga an ka pin Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nfɛra.”
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ahab tre anebiana alfa ana m bishi bumo le: “N ya kɔ Ramɔf ebi kena ŋko n sa maŋ yɔ?”
Nɛ bumo alɛ kaŋɛ le: “Ya kɔ kumo, ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ fo kɔ m sɔ kumo.”
6Nɛ Jehoshafat naaŋ bishi: “Ama anebi kama maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ an ya sɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nfɛra mo kutɔ n ti so a?”
7Nɛ ewura Ahab kaŋɛ le: “Ekoŋwule ko kraa wɔtɔ nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n wu mo, mo e la Imla pibinyɛn Mikaya ama ŋ kishi mbe asheŋ ga ŋkpal manɛ so kusɔ kama nɛ e wu ŋ kaŋɛ ma maa walɛ.”
Nɛ ewura Jehoshafat kaŋɛ: “Sa maŋ kaŋ kaŋɛ loŋ!”
8Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Ahab tre mbe benimu na be eko n shuŋi mo fanɛ e ya tre Mikaya m ba epul na to.
9Bewura anyɔ na daŋ buu bumo be ewurpiŋi nna a tase bumo nwurputi so ashi kugooro nɛ baa bri asɔ nɛ k wɔ Samɛria be kabunagboŋ na be ekarso na so, nɛ anebiana na kikɛ yil bumo be anishito a kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ. 10Chinana pibinyɛn Zɛdikaya nɛ e la anebiana na be eko bre, daŋ bɛl abɛlso be alambɛ nna nseŋ kaŋɛ Ahab le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ, le be kusɔ ere nɛ feeŋ ta ŋ kɔ Siriyaebi na kena m pɔɔ bumo so cheche.” 11Anebiana na kikɛ daŋ kaŋɛ le nna: “Men ya kɔ Ramɔf ebi; Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ men kɔ m pɔɔ so.”
12Esa nɛ e daŋ yɔ Mikaya kutɔ na daŋ ya kaŋɛ mo nna le: “Anebiana na kikɛ daŋ wu ŋ kaŋɛ nna fanɛ ewura na beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so, amoso fo alɛ gba e ya kaŋɛ loŋ.”
13Ama le nɛ Mikaya daŋ kaŋɛ: “Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na kaŋɛ ma nɛ meeŋ kaŋɛ!”
14Amoso e ka yɔ ewura Ahab kutɔ, le nɛ e daŋ bishi mo: “Mikaya, k daga fanɛ ma nɛ ewura Jehoshafat ka ya kɔ Ramɔf ebi kena ŋko k maŋ daga?”
Nɛ Mikaya kaŋɛ: “Men ya kɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so menyeeŋ pɔɔ so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ men kɔ m pɔɔ so.”
15Nɛ ewura Ahab naŋ kaŋɛ: “Ŋ kaŋɛ fo ale damta fanɛ, fo baŋ yili Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to a malga, a daga fanɛ fo baa malga kashenteŋ! Ale fanɛ nɛ fee sha ŋ ka kaŋɛ fo le be kesheŋ ere?”
16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mikaya naŋ kaŋɛ le: “N wu Israɛl be benapo na ka pesaŋ to n sɔ abee so fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ b maŋ kɔ ekpapo na.” Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le: “Basa ere maŋ kɔ ejuŋkparpo, shin nɛ b ta kagbenewushi a yɔ epe.”
17Nɛ ewura Ahab kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ ewura Jehoshafat le: “N chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ e maa wu asheŋ lela kikɛ a kaŋɛ ma kaplɛa so. Saŋkama asheŋ lubi nɛ e bee kaŋɛ a yɔ ma kaplɛa so!”
18Nɛ Mikaya kraa malga nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Nu! N wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka chena mbe kuwurputi so nɛ mbe emalaika kikɛ kulti mo ashi ebɔrɛso, 19nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: ‘Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ Ahab e yɔ Ramɔf nɛ b ya mɔ mo ndoŋ?’ Nɛ emalaika na be beko malga asheŋ ko nɛ beko malɛ malga asheŋ pɔtɛ. 20Kumo be kaman nɛ kiyoyu ko lar m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito m ba kaŋɛ le: ‘Meeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ e yɔ.’ Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bishi mo le: ‘Ekpa mo so nɛ feeŋ bɔla n shin nɛ e yɔ?’ 21Nɛ kiyoyu na kaŋɛ: ‘Meeŋ ya shin nɛ Ahab be anebiana kikɛ e fule mo.’ Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: ‘Ya wora loŋ. Feeŋ pɔɔ so.’
22Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mikaya malga mbe lalaloge be kamalga ŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Kusɔ nɛ k wora e la fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ fo gbagba be anebiana kini keji fo kashenteŋ. Ama mo alɛ gbagba nyi fo ka beeŋ mur!’ ”
23Ndoŋ nna nɛ Anebi Zɛdikaya yɔ Mikaya kutɔ n ya kpa mo etaŋ anishito m bishi mo le: “Saŋɛ mo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kiyoyu yige ma n ya malga fo kutɔ?”
24Nɛ Mikaya kaŋɛ mo le: “Kachɛ nɛ feeŋ shile ŋkpal fo doŋana so n ya ŋana ebu nɛ k wɔ ketamanto na, nɛ feeŋ pin kumo be kashenteŋ.”
25Nɛ ewura Ahab ponte ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Men pɛ Mikaya n yɔ Ammɔn nɛ e la Samɛria be kade to be gomena na, nɛ ewurbi Jɔash kutɔ, 26n ya kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b ti mo ebu n sa maŋ kaŋ sa mo ajibi kikɛ ama bodobodo nɛ nchu nawule hale nɛ n ya bɛta m ba nɛ alenfia pɔɛŋ.”
27Nɛ Mikaya kaŋɛ le: “Fo baŋ bɛta m ba nɛ alenfia bre, kumo ere mannɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga n sa ma!” Nseŋ kilgi kaŋɛ jimaŋ na le: “Men sa maŋ kaŋ teŋ kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ ere so.”
Ewura Ahab ka wu ashi Ramɔf be asheŋ
28Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛl be ewura Ahab nɛ Juda be ewura Jehoshafat yɔ nɛ b ya kɔ Siriya be ewura kena ashi Ramɔf nɛ k wɔ Giliad na. 29Nɛ ewura Ahab kaŋɛ ewura Jehoshafat le: “An kaŋ baŋ yɔ kena na to, meeŋ chɛrga ma ewurpiŋi saŋɛ na so b maaŋ naŋ pin fanɛ n la ewura, ama fo ere beeŋ tiŋ m buu fo peya.” Amoso Israɛl be ewura na bre daa maŋ buu mbe ewurpiŋi n yɔ kena na to.
30Siriya be ewura na daŋ kaŋɛ mbe benapo nɛ baa ta egbaŋɛturko a kɔ kena na be benimu nna fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ kɔ esa kikɛ ama Israɛl be ewura na nawule. 31-32Amoso b ka wu Jehoshafat na, nɛ b fɛ fanɛ mo e la Israɛl be ewura na nsaa shin nɛ b kɔ mo kena. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Jehoshafat shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ benapo na yige mo.
33Ama kena na to nɛ Siriya be enapo ko to keta n lɛ kanaŋkama, nɛ k ya bɔla ewura Ahab be asɔkuŋso anyɔ be kefɛato n da mo. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ahab kaŋɛ mbe gbaŋɛturko diipo le: “B doro ma! Ta ma n lar kena ere to manaŋ!” 34Kena na ka bee kɔ na, nɛ ewura Ahab gbar mbe gbaŋɛturko to a keni Siriyaebi na. Epeŋi ka yaa kaa tɔr nɛ e wu.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 19
Content:
Anebi ka kpele ewura Jehoshafat kusoe be asheŋ
1Juda be ewura Jehoshafat bɛta n yɔ mbe kuwura laŋ to ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ wora mo. 2Nɛ anebi Jehu nɛ e la Hanani pibinyɛn na yɔ mo kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Fee fɛ fanɛ fo ka chɛ ewura Ahab esa lubi nɛ e kishi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ to ere walɛ a? Kusɔ nɛ fo wora ere shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo ga. 3Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ asheŋ lela ko wɔ fo to. Fo jija kegbirche Ashira be mpɔrduli nɛ basa bee shuŋ na kikɛ, fo alɛ gbagba nsaa wora ania a bɛ Ebɔrɛ be ekpa so.”
4Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ ewura Jehoshafat daa wɔ Jerusalɛm nna, ama e daa yili Bɛshiba nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na nna a nite a bɔɔ basa na so n ya ka fo Efrayim be kebee be efuli na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so be ekarso saŋkama a leŋ bumo to fanɛ b naŋ bɛta a shuŋ bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na. 5E daŋ lara demujipoana nna n wɔtɔ nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti amo ashi Juda be efuli so na be kekama to 6nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men ba de so kananɛ menyee ji basa demu, ŋkpal manɛ so mannɛ dimɛdi be eleŋ so nɛ menyee bɔla a ji demu, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ peya. Ebɔrɛ na malɛ wɔ menyi kutɔ saŋɛ nɛ menyee ji demu na. 7Men baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa de so, ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe nɛ e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ na maa sha kapuni nɛ ŋkpɛato nɛ brɔbu be asheŋ.”
8Ewura Jehoshafat daŋ lara Livaiebi nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ nnaŋ be bejuŋkparpo malɛ nna ashi Jerusalɛm to fanɛ b baa ji basa nɛ baa kini kebaabɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra be ekpa so na nɛ basa nɛ bumo nɛ bumo braana ndetobia kɔ asheŋ na demu. 9Le be asheŋ ere nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Men ba wora men be ashuŋ nɛnɛ ashi kabɔrɛŋana nɛ kashenteŋji be ekpa so. 10Saŋkama nɛ men braana ndetobia na baŋ ta bumo be asheŋ fanɛ kamɔ ŋko kekini kenu n sa Ebɔrɛ be keŋini nɛ mbe mbra be asheŋ m ba menyi kutɔ, k daga men ka fɛa bumo so nɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ wora kulubi ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ saŋɛ na so mbe agbo maaŋ ba menyi nɛ bumo kikɛ so. Men baa wora loŋ bre, Ebɔrɛ maaŋ wu menyi kulubi. 11Bɔrɛmatapowura nimuso Amariya e naaŋ baa ji kabɔrɛshuŋ be kaplɛa so be asheŋ to, nɛ Zebadiya nɛ e la Ishmaɛl pibinyɛn nɛ e la Juda be gomena na malɛ e baa ji asheŋ nɛ a ka na to. Livaiebi na malɛ e naŋ baa keni nɛ kananɛ b nase asheŋ na a shuŋ. Men ba leŋ men be amu to nsaa bɛ keŋini ere so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e baa wɔ bekama nɛ b kɔ kashenteŋ be kaman!”

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 20
Content:
B ka kɔ m pɔɔ Mowab nɛ Ammɔn so be asheŋ
1Jemanɛ ko ka ba fo nɛ Mowab nɛ Ammɔn be benapo ya ti Meuniebi nɛ b wɔ Edɔm be efuli so na so nɛ b kɔ Judaebi kena. 2Nɛ mbɔ ko ba kaŋɛ ewura Jehoshafat le: “Benapo damta ko nɛ b shi Edɔm be efuli so na lar Teku wuso na be kaba ndoŋ m ba nɛ b ba kɔ fo kena. B tiŋ n ya kɔ m pɔɔ Engedi bre so.” 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ kufu pɛ Jehoshafat ga nɛ e kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e ŋini mo kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora. Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ efuli na be basa kikɛ kishi ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa mo. 4Amoso Juda be efuli so be basa daŋ ba shɛr Jerusalɛm nna nɛ b fin kechɛto ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ.
5Bumo kikɛ ka ba shɛr bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ popɔr na so nɛ ewura Jehoshafat ya yili bumo be anishito 6nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ le: “O Enyɛnpe nɛ fo la an nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ. Fo e naa ji ebɔrɛso nɛ durnya ere be efuli kikɛ so kuwura. Fo alɛ kɔ eleŋ ga nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ fo so. 7Fo e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ. Fo basa Israɛlebi na ka koso m ba kasawule ere so na, fo e ju basa nɛ b daa wɔ nfe na nseŋ ta kasawule na n sa fo teri Eebraham be kaman to ebi nɛ k baa la bumo peya mbaanaayɔ. 8B chena kasawule ere so nna m ba pɔr bɔrɛlambu ere nɛ k baa la kemaŋkura n sa fo, 9saŋɛ na so nɛ kena ŋko alɔ ŋko akoŋ be jɛrbi kaŋ ba bumo so, baaŋ tiŋ m ba kakpa nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo na ashi bɔrɛlambu ere be anishito m ba kule fo ashi bumo be etɔrɔ be jemanɛ nɛ fo nu nseŋ mɔlga bumo.
10Naniere Ammɔn nɛ Mowab nɛ Edɔm be basa ba nɛ b ba kɔ anyi kena. An nananyɛnana ka lar Ijipt be efuli so a ba na, fo daa maŋ shuli nɛ b kɔ n sɔ loŋ be nsawule na, ŋkpal loŋ so an nananyɛnana daŋ maŋ mur bumo. 11Kukɔ nɛ baa ka anyi a tal to nna na. B ba nɛ b ba ju anyi ashi kasawule nɛ fo ta n sa anyi na so nna. 12Fo e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ! Gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal manɛ so anyi ere maŋ kɔ eleŋ nɛ an kɔ benapo damta nɛ baa ba nɛ b ba kɔ anyi kena ere. Anyi maŋ nyi kananɛ anyeeŋ wora ama anyee kule fo nna nɛ fo chɛ anyi to.”
13Le be saŋɛ so nɛ Juda be benyɛn nɛ bumo be beche nɛ mbia yil bɔrɛlambu na ase. 14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kiyoyu na daŋ gbelge Livai be kanyɛn ko so nna saŋɛ so nɛ e daa wɔ jimaŋ na to na. Mbe ketre e daa la Jahaziil nɛ mo tuto la Zakareya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Bɛnaya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Jaɛl nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Mataniya ashi Asaf be kabuna. 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jahaziil kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ, fo nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa kikɛ e sa maa lɔ kufu ŋko a pɔ aba ŋkpal benapo damta ere so. Mannɛ men gbagba e naŋ kɔ kena ere. Ebɔrɛ e naŋ kɔ n sa menyi. 16Kusɔ nɛ menyeeŋ wora e la fanɛ, echefo nɛ men doŋana be benapo na kaŋ bɔla keshishɛrsawule nɛ k dese ŋ kulti Jeruwɛl be kade na a ba, menyi alɛ gba e ya tu bumo ashi Ziz be kade to saŋɛ so nɛ b bɔla ketaŋɛ na ase a ba na. 17Mannɛ menyi e naŋ kɔ kena ere. Menyi ere e bela ase a yil. Menyeeŋ wu kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so n sa menyi. Juda nɛ Jerusalɛmebi, men sa maa lɔ kufu. Men lar n yɔ kena na to, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ba wɔ menyi kutɔ!”
18Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Jehoshafat nɛ basa na kikɛ kurgi amu n yuu to, m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. 19Livaiebi nɛ b shi Kohaf nɛ Koora be kabuna na be beko daŋ koso n yili nna a cha awɔr a maŋkura Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na.
20Ŋklade kachipurdidi saŋɛ so nɛ ekama lar a yɔ keshishɛrsawule nɛ k mata Tekua na, nɛ ewura Jehoshafat niŋi to ŋ kaŋɛ jimaŋ na le: “Menyi Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm ebi! Men ta men be yirda n deŋi Enyɛnpe nɛ e la menyi be Ebɔrɛ na so nsaa yili to kpakpa. Men yirda kusɔ nɛ mbe anebiana na kaŋɛ menyi na saŋɛ na so asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi.” 21Ewura na ka malga basa na kutɔ n loge, nɛ e shin nɛ beshɛbompo ko ta epiŋi nɛ baa buu nchɛgboŋ achɛ na m buu n juŋkpar benapo na nsaa a boŋ nshɛ a kaŋɛ le, “Kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya! Mbe kasha wɔtɔ nna hale mbaanaayɔ!”
22B ka baŋ fara a boŋ nshɛ na, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ keyeŋiyeŋi tɔr bedoŋ be benapo na so nɛ b wulto epul to. 23Ammɔnebi nɛ Mowabebi daŋ kilgi nna ŋ kɔ Edɔmebi na be benapo kena nna m mur bumo cheche. Kumo be kaman nɛ b kilgi a mɔ abar. 24Judaebi be benapo na ka fo ketempreŋ jeŋgreŋ nɛ k wɔ keshishɛrsawule na ase na, nɛ b wu kananɛ bumo doŋana kikɛ wu a dese kasawule. Bumo be ekoŋwule gba daa maŋ naŋ ka.
25Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Jehoshafat nɛ mbe benapo ya muu bumo be asɔ damta nseŋ ta ana damta nɛ ajibi nɛ epiŋi nɛ asɔ damta n ti so. Nchɛ asa nɛ b daŋ ta a muu asɔ na ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ b daa maŋ tiŋ m muu amo n loge. 26Kumo be kachɛ nasopo na, nɛ b shɛr Bɛraka be ketaŋɛ na to nseŋ di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora so. Amoso nɛ baa tre ketaŋɛ na Bɛraka na. Kumo be kifito ashi Hibruwebi be ŋgbar to e la, kapandi. 27Kumo be kaman nɛ Ewura Jehoshafat juŋkpar mbe benapo n yɔ Jerusalɛm kagbenefuliso ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka pɔɔ bumo doŋana so n sa bumo so. 28B ka fo kade to nɛ b ta ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ nlopi nɛ mbel m boŋ nshɛ n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to. 29Ndoŋ nna nɛ kufu pɛ efuli kama nɛ k nu kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kɔ m pɔɔ Israɛlebi bumo doŋana so na ga. 30Amoso Jehoshafat daŋ ji mbe kuwura kagbenewushiso nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kuŋ mo ekpa kama so.
Ewura Jehoshafat ka ji mbe kuwura n ya fo ekar be asheŋ
(1 Bewura 22:41-50)
31Ewura Jehoshafat daŋ fo nfɛ adesa nɛ anu nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki Juda be ewura, ama nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ anu nɛ e daŋ chena Jerusalɛm n ji kuwura. Mo nio e daa la Shilhi pibiche Azuba. 32Kananɛ ewura Jehoshafat mo tuto Asa daa kɔ kasonu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, loŋ nɛ mo alɛ gba daa du, 33ama e daa maŋ mur ndoŋ be mboŋ nɛ baa shuŋ agbir na kikɛ. Ŋkpal loŋ so basa na daa maŋ ta bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ m bɛ bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na so.
34B daŋ sibɛ kusɔ kama nɛ Jehoshafat daŋ wora saŋɛ so nɛ e daa la ewura na nna n wɔtɔ Hanani pibinyɛn Jehu be adrasheŋ be nwɔl nɛ amo alɛ gba ti Israɛl be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl so na to.
35Jemanɛ ko, Juda be ewura Jehoshafat nɛ Israɛl be ewura Ahaziya nɛ e daŋ wora asheŋ lubi damta ga na, daŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nna. 36B daŋ lɔŋɛ teku so be ekuloŋgboŋana nna ashi kade nɛ baa tre Eziɔngɛba nɛ k wɔ teku peper na be kɔnɔ ase na. 37Ama Eliaza nɛ e la Dodavahu pibinyɛn nsaa la anebi a shi Mɛrasha be kade to na daŋ kpele ewura Jehoshafat kusoe nna ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ŋkpal fo nɛ ewura Ahaziya ka wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mur ekuloŋgboŋ nɛ fo lɔŋɛ ere.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo be nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋana jija nɛ b lɔŋɛ amo ŋ gben.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 21
Content:
1Ewura Jehoshafat ka wu, kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura ashi ewura Deevid be kade to Jerusalɛm na, nɛ b puli mo alɛ gba, nɛ mo pibinyɛn Jehoram sɔ mo so n ji kuwura.
Juda be ewura Jehoram be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 8:17-24)
2Ewura Jehoshafat pibinyɛn Jehoram daa kɔ besipo nyɛnso ashe nna. Bumo e daa la Azariya nɛ Jehiɛl nɛ Zakareya nɛ Azariahu nɛ Maikel nɛ Shefatiya. 3Bumo tuto, ewura Jehoshafat, daŋ ta shuwa nɛ gbiti damta nɛ asɔ lela ko gba n ti so n sa bumo nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be ekoŋwule kikɛ bee keni kade kama nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti kumo ashi Juda be efuli so so, ama Jehoram e daŋ sɔ mo tuto Jehoshafat so n ji kuwura ŋkpal e ka la mbe wurkoŋ so. 4Jehoram be kuwurji ka nya eleŋ, nɛ e shin nɛ b mɔ mo sipoana na kikɛ nɛ Israɛl be benimuana na be beko.
5Nfɛ adesa nɛ anyɔ nɛ Jehoram daŋ ji pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki ewura nseŋ chena Jerusalɛm to n ji kuwura nfɛ aburwa. 6Ŋkpal ewura Jehoram ka ta ewura Ahab pibiche so e daa kɔ kumukpakpaso nna fanɛ ewura Ahab nɛ Israɛl be bewura ko nseŋ wora alubi ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, 7ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daa maa sha fanɛ e mur ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi na, ŋkpal mo nɛ ewura Deevid ka wora ŋkre nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi e naaŋ baa ji kuwura mbaanaayɔ so.
8Saŋɛ so nɛ Jehoram daa la ewura na, Edɔm be basa na daa kini kebaanu a sa Judaebi na nna nsaa lara bumo gbagba be bewura. 9Ŋkpal loŋ so ewura Jehoram nɛ mbe benapo be benimuana na daŋ ta egbaŋɛturko nna n ya kɔ Edɔmebi na kena nɛ Edɔmebi na kulti bumo n wɔtɔ. Kanyɛ ka biri, nɛ Judaebi na ŋana n shile. 10Yili loŋ be saŋɛ na, nɛ Edɔmebi sɔ bumo be amu ashi Judaebi be enɔ to. Kumo be saŋɛ nɛ Libna be kade to ebi gba kini kebaanu a sa ewura Jehoram ŋkpal e ka kini kebaanu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la mo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na so. 11Ewura Jehoram daŋ pɔr agbir be mboŋ ashi Juda be abee be efuli so nna nseŋ shin nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa wora alubi ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.
12Kachako nɛ Anebi Elaija sibɛ kawɔl n sa ewura Jehoram a kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la fo nananyɛn ewura Deevid be Ebɔrɛ na yɛ fo maŋ wora nɛnɛ ŋkpal fo ka maŋ bɛ fo tuto ewura Jehoshafat nɛ fo nananyɛn ewura Asa be ekpa so na so. 13Fo bɛ Israɛl be bewura na be ekpa so nna nseŋ shin nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa maŋ naa ji kashenteŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kananɛ Ahab nɛ mbe kaman to ebi daŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be efuli so ebi maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ na. Fo mɔ fo sipo nyɛnsoana nɛ b bɔ fo na. 14Ŋkpal loŋ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge fo basa nɛ fo kanaŋ to ebi kikɛ kusoe nseŋ mur fo asɔ kikɛ gba n ti so. 15Fo alɛ gbagba beeŋ nya epunto be kulɔ kpakpaso nɛ k tɔrɔ fo hale nɛ fo ya wu.”
16Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ Filistiebi nɛ Nlɔrbu nɛ b chena m mata Itiopiaebi na ya kɔ Jehoram kena. 17B daŋ kɔ nna n sɔ Juda nseŋ muu ewura be laŋ to be asɔ kikɛ, m pɛ mbe beche nɛ mbinyɛnsobi kikɛ n yɔ. Mbe pibinyɛn Ahaziya nɛ e la kaluge na nawule nɛ b daa maŋ pɛ.
18Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ epunto be ebesa tɔr ewura na so. 19Kumo be nfɛ anyɔ be kefɛato, nɛ mbe kulɔ na nyaŋɛto nɛ e wu ebesa damta to. Mbe beyaasepo daa maŋ puga edɛgboŋ mbe keelibuna m maŋkura mo fanɛ kananɛ b wora n sa mo nananyɛnana na.
20Nfɛ adesa nɛ anyɔ nɛ Jehoram daŋ ji pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki ewura, ama e daŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ aburwa nna. E ka daŋ wu, k daa maŋ jija ekama be kagbene. Jerusalɛm nɛ k la ewura Deevid be kade to na nɛ b daŋ puli mo, ama b daa maŋ puli mo kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura na.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 22
Content:
Juda be ewura Ahaziya be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 8:25-29; 9:21-28)
1Nlɔrbu na ka daŋ ta kena n ya purgi Juda na nɛ b mɔ ewura Jehoram be mbinyɛnsobi kikɛ ŋ ka Ahaziya nɛ e la mbe kaluge na nawule. Amoso Jerusalɛm be basa daŋ shin nna nɛ Ahaziya sɔ mo tuto so n ji kuwura. 2-3Ahaziya daa la nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki ewura. Mo alɛ daŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to kafɛ koŋwule nna. Ahaziya gba daŋ bɛ ewura Ahab be kanaŋ to ebi be ekpa so nna n wora alubi ŋkpal mo nio Atalia nɛ e la Israɛl be ewura Ahab pibiche nsaa la Omri mo nanabi na ka ji mo asoeto lubi so. 4Ahaziya mo tuto ka wu na be kaman, e daŋ wora kulubi nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal e ka daŋ lara Ahab be kanaŋ na to be basa ko ŋ ki mbe asoetojipoana so. Bumo be kasotoji na malɛ e shin nɛ e tɔr. 5E daŋ bɛ bumo be kasotoji so nna n tu Israɛl be ewura Joram n yɔ nɛ b ya kɔ Siriya be ewura Haziɛl kena. Ramɔf nɛ k wɔ Giliad na nɛ b daŋ tu abar ŋ kɔ kena na nɛ b doro Joram ashi kena na to. 6E ka doro na, nɛ e bɛta n yɔ Jezreel be kade to nɛ e ya chɛ mbe doro na, nɛ Ahaziya yɔ ndoŋ nɛ e ya bɔ mo so.
7Ahaziya be keya bɔɔ Joram so na, e daŋ da mo n lɛ. E ka ba Joram kutɔ na, nɛ mo nɛ Joram ya tu Nimshi pibinyɛn Jehu nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ e mur Ahab be kuwurji na. 8Jehu ka bee wora kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ mo na, nɛ e wu Juda be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ Ahaziya mo wɔpabiana nɛ b daŋ tu mo m ba nɛ b ba bɔ Joram so na. Nɛ Jehu mɔ Ahaziya mo wɔpabiana na nɛ benimuana na be beko 9nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b ya fin Ahaziya malɛ, nɛ b ya wu mo nɛ e ŋana Samɛria. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ mo n yɔ ewura Jehu kutɔ n ya mɔ. B daŋ puli Ahaziya nna ŋkpal b ka daa sa mo nananyɛn wura Jehoshafat bunyaŋ ŋkpal e ka daŋ wora ania n shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛnɛ so. Esa kikɛ malɛ daa maŋ naŋ ka Ahaziya be kanaŋ to nsaa kɔ eleŋ nɛ e tiŋ n ji kuwura na.
Juda be ewurche Atalia be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 11:1-3)
10Juda be Ewura Ahaziya mo nio Atalia ka nu fanɛ mo pibinyɛn wu nna, nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ b mɔ basa nɛ b shi Juda be ewura be kanaŋ to na kikɛ. 11Ahaziya daa kɔ esipoche nɛ baa tre mo Jehosheba nɛ e daa kil bɔrɛmatapo ko nɛ baa tre mo Jehowada. Mo e daŋ mɔlga Ahaziya pibinyɛn Jɔash nɛ e la Ahaziya be mbinyɛnsobi nɛ b daa sha kemɔ na be eko. E daŋ ta mo nna ŋ ŋana Enyɛnpe be bɔrɛlambuna be ebu deseto to. Ŋkpal loŋ so, Atalia daa maŋ nya mo m mɔ. 12Nfɛ ashe nɛ Jɔash ŋana bɔrɛlambu na to. Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ Atalia malɛ bee ji kuwurche ashi efuli na so.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 23
Content:
Judaebi ka kini kenu n sa ewura Atalia be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 11:4-16)
1Ahaziya pibinyɛn Jɔash ka ŋana bɔrɛlambu na to nfɛ ashe na, nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada wu fanɛ k daga e ka wora kusɔ ko. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e ya fin benapo be benimu nɛ baaŋ yili mo kaman. Bumo e daa la Joram pibinyɛn Azariya nɛ Jehohanan pibinyɛn Ishmaɛl nɛ Obɛd pibinyɛn Azariya nɛ Adaya pibinyɛn Maaseia nɛ Zikri pibinyɛn Elishafat. 2Basa ere kikɛ daŋ yɔ Juda be efuli so be nde kikɛ to nna n ya bar Livaiebi nɛ mbuna mbuna be bejuŋkparpoana na kikɛ ashi Jerusalɛm.
3Bumo kikɛ daŋ ba shɛr bɔrɛlambu na to nna nɛ bumo nɛ ewura pibinyɛn Jɔash wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jehowada kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ewura nɛ e wu na pibinyɛn nde. Mo e naŋ ki ewura naniere ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ nna fanɛ ewura Deevid be kaman to ebi e naaŋ baa ji kuwura saŋkikɛ. 4Ama kusɔ nɛ k daga an ka wora nde. Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na kaŋ ba kushuŋ to kewushiachɛ ere, kananɛ b barga bumo to ntuŋ asa so na be katuŋ koŋwule e naaŋ baa keni bɔrɛlambu na be mbunaana so, 5nɛ katuŋ koŋwule malɛ e baa keni ewura be laŋ to so nɛ katuŋ koŋwule nɛ k ka na malɛ e baa keni kabuna nɛ baa tre Gbaltɔlase be kabuna na so. Nɛ menyi nɛ men ka na a yili a keni bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ na so. 6Ekama maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ e luri bɔrɛlambu na to ama bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ baa shuŋ kumo to kamɔnchɛ na nawule. Bumo ere beeŋ tiŋ ŋ luri ŋkpal b ka lara kulubi bumo be ŋgbene to nsaa du cheembi so. Ama menyi nɛ men ka ere bre daga fanɛ men bɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be keŋini so nseŋ yili kowushina. 7Livaiebi na beeŋ keta bumo be etokobi n wora shiriya n yili a kuŋ ewura na. Kaplɛkama nɛ ewura na bee yɔ nɛ b bɛ mo so. Ekama malɛ nɛ e pɛl n luri bɔrɛlambu na to daga luwu.”
8Livaiebi nɛ Juda be basa na kikɛ daŋ wora kusɔ nɛ Jehowada kaŋɛ na nna. B daa maŋ sa basa nɛ b shuŋ bumo b kushuŋ kewushiachɛ n loge na ekpa fanɛ b yɔ epe amoso bumo nɛ basa nɛ b ba nɛ b ba sɔ bumo so na kikɛ daa wɔ ndoŋ nna. Amoso benapo be benimu na daŋ gbargbar basa nɛ b koso kushuŋto nɛ bumo nɛ b ba nɛ b ba sɔ bumo so na kikɛ ndoŋ nna. 9Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jehowada ta ekpa nɛ abɛlso be asɔkuŋso nɛ a daa la ewura Deevid peya nsaa yil bɔrɛlambu na to na n sa benapo be benimu na. 10E daŋ shin nna nɛ bekumpo na ta bumo be etokobi ŋ keta n yili ŋ kulti bɔrɛsure na ashi bɔrɛlambu na be anishito a kuŋ ewura na. 11Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Jehowada nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi ya keta Jɔash n lar kowu nseŋ ta kuwurwuro m buu mo. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta bewura be mbra be kawɔl n sa mo n ta mo ŋ ki ewura. Bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi e daŋ duga ŋku n do Jɔash be kumu so n ta mo ŋ ki ewura, nɛ ekama cha awɔr ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ebɔrɛ e teŋi ewura be ŋkpa so!”
12Ewurche Atalia ka nu basa na ka bee dele ewura na, nɛ e nya manaŋ n yɔ kakpa nɛ jimaŋ na shɛr na ashi bɔrɛlambu na to. 13E ka ya wu ewura popɔr na nɛ e yil eshabɔrɛ na ekpa ashi bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna be anishito be kakpa nɛ bewura bee chena na, nɛ benapo be benimu nɛ mbelfompoana yili ŋ kulti mo, nɛ basa na kikɛ bee cha awɔr kagbenefuliso nsaa foŋ mbel nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be beshɛbompoana bee juŋkpar kasheŋwora na kikɛ na, nɛ e kpɛa mbe asɔbuuso to kagbenejijaso nseŋ boŋto ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Menyi bedebɔrpo ere!”
14Jehowada daa maa sha b ka mɔ ewurche Atalia bɔrɛlambu na ase, ŋkpal loŋ so, e daŋ tre benapo be benimuana na nna ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men ta mo m bɔla bekumpo na to n yɔ. Esa kama malɛ nɛ e kaŋ pɛl a sha k sɔ mo n yige, men mɔ amodoŋwura.”
15Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ mo n ta mo n yɔ ewura be laŋ to be kelɔnɛ so be kakpa nɛ baa tre Egbaŋɛ be Kabuna na, n ya mɔ mo ndoŋ.
Jehowada ka chɛrga asheŋ
16Bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada daŋ shin nna nɛ mo nɛ ewura Jɔash nɛ basa na wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre fanɛ baaŋ baa ji kashenteŋ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. 17Kumo be kaman nɛ b ya da Baal be lambu na n lɛ nseŋ bure kumo be ebɔrɛsure nɛ agbirana nɛ a wɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ nseŋ mɔ Maatan nɛ e la Baal be kegbirwura na ashi ebɔrɛsureana na ase gbagba. 18Ewura Jehowada daŋ shin nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na bee keni bɔrɛlambu na be kushuŋ so fanɛ kananɛ ewura Deevid yili n sa bumo na. Bumo be kushuŋ e la kebaachɔɔ esarga nɛ b lara n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi Mosis be mbra be ekpa so, nɛ kebaajuŋkpar a boŋ nshɛ kasheŋwora kikɛ to. 19Ewura Jehowada daŋ ta bekumpo nna nɛ baa keni bɔrɛlambu na be mbunaana so saŋɛ na so basa kama nɛ b kɔ eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so na, maaŋ luri kumo to.
20Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ benapo be benimuana nɛ Juda be kade to be benimuana nɛ ekrachiana nɛ basa nɛ b ka na kikɛ ba ewura Jehowada kutɔ nɛ b bɛ abar so n ya keta ewura na bɔrɛlambu na to m ba ewura be laŋ to. Kabunagboŋ na to nɛ b daŋ bɔla n luri laŋ na to nɛ ewura na ya chena mbe kuwurputi so. 21Basa na kikɛ be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo nna ga nɛ kade na kikɛ wora shruum ŋkpal ewurche Atalia ka wu na so.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 24
Content:
Juda be ewura Jɔash be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 12:1-16)
1Jɔash ka ki Juda be efuli so be ewura nɛ e la nfɛ ashunu nna, nseŋ ji kuwura nfɛ adena ashi Jerusalɛm to. Mo nio e daa la Zibia nɛ e shi Bɛshiba be kade to na. 2E daa wora kusɔ nɛ k walɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito saŋɛ so nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada daa wɔ ŋkpa to na nna. 3Jehowada daŋ ta beche anyɔ nna n sa ewura Jɔash nɛ mo nɛ bumo kurge bibinyɛn nɛ bibiche.
4Jɔash ka ji kuwura n ya fo saŋko na, nɛ e yili kumo fanɛ e beeŋ lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na nɛnɛ. 5E daŋ shin nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na yɔ Juda be efuli so be nde to, n ya sɔ basa na kikɛ kafɛ kafɛ be lampo nɛ baa sɔ a lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na. E kaŋɛ bumo nna fanɛ b wora kumo manaŋ ama Livaiebi na daa maŋ ta kumo to manaŋ. 6Amoso e daŋ shuŋi nna n tre Jehowada nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na m bishi mo le: “Manɛ nna nɛ fo maŋ shin nɛ Livaiebi na sɔ lampo ashi Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa na kutɔ fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kenya Mosis daŋ shin nɛ baa ka nɛ baa ta a chɛ Enyɛnpe be Nshɛr be wajɛbu na be kushuŋ to na?”
7Ewurche Atalia nɛ e la kumu kpakpasowura na be mbinyɛnsobi e daŋ jija bɔrɛlambu na nseŋ ta kumo to be asɔ cheembi na a shuŋ kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal na.
8Ewura na daŋ kaŋɛ Livaiebi na nna fanɛ b lɔŋɛ amansherbi be kadekabi, nɛ baaŋ ta n yili bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna to a sɔ etoto. 9E daŋ sa ebɔl Jerusalɛm nɛ Juda kikɛ to nna fanɛ b ta bumo be etoto m ba bɔrɛlambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na to fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kenya Mosis daŋ yili kumo kiyi to fanɛ b baa sɔ Israɛlebi na kutɔ a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 10Nɛ benimuana na nɛ basa na kikɛ shuli kumo be loŋ nseŋ ta bumo be amansherbi m ba kaa wɔtɔ deka na to hale nɛ k ya bɔlɔ. 11Karechɛ kikɛ Livaiebi na bee ta deka na nna n yɔ ewura na be krachi nɛ esa nɛ e bɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na so kutɔ nɛ b lara amansherbi na ŋ karga amo. Kumo be kaman nɛ b naŋ bɛta deka na n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to. Ŋkpal b ka bee wora loŋ karechɛ kikɛ so, amansherbi damta nɛ b daŋ chala. 12Ewura na nɛ Jehowada e daa ta amansherbi na a sa basa nɛ baa keni bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ be kushuŋ so na, nɛ bumo alɛ e ta amo n haya bepɔrpo nɛ ekapɛnta nɛ ebɔyɛpo nɛ b ta abɛlso nɛ danyaŋ n lɔŋɛ asɔwurbi n wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na to. 13Basa na daŋ shuŋ kenishipereso nna nseŋ lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na fanɛ kananɛ k daa du sososo na gbagba, nɛ k naaŋ nya eleŋ ga n ti so. 14B ka lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na n loge na, nɛ b ta amansherbi nɛ a ka na m ba sa ewura na nɛ Jehowada. Loŋ be amansherbi nɛ a ka na malɛ nɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ asɔwurbi nɛ shuwa nɛ gbiti be ntishaŋ nɛ b kɔ a wora asheŋ ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na to.
Bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada ka daa wɔ ŋkpa to na, b daa mɔ asɔbɔya nna a lara sarga chɔɔso bɔrɛlambu na to a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ saŋkama. 15Ewura Jehowada daŋ ji nfɛ kalfa nɛ adesa pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu. 16Kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura ashi ewura Deevid be kade to Jerusalɛm na, nɛ b daŋ puli mo alɛ gba ŋkpal kushuŋ lela nɛ e daŋ wora n sa Israɛl be basa nɛ kushuŋ nɛ e shuŋ ashi Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na to so.
17Ewura Jehowada ka wu na be kaman nɛ Juda be bejuŋkparpoana na ya bunyaŋ ewura Jɔash nseŋ lɔlɔ mo nɛ e bee bɛ bumo be kasotoji so. 18Basa na daa maŋ naa yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya kaa bunyaŋ bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na. B daŋ naŋ fara nna a shuŋ agbir nɛ kegbirche Ashira be kegbir be kapɔrduli. Ŋkpal kulubi nɛ b wora ere so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be agbo daŋ ba Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa so nna. 19Amo nɛ amo kikɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shuŋi anebiana nna fanɛ b ya kpele bumo kusoe n shin nɛ b bɛta m ba mo kutɔ nɛ b kini kenu. 20Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kiyoyu ba bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada pibinyɛn Zakareya so. Nɛ e yili kakpa nɛ basa na beeŋ wu mo ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ, manɛ nna nɛ men kini kebɛ mbe mbra so nsaa kil kasogberge a sa menyi be amu loŋ! Men ka kini mo na so nɛ mo alɛ gba kini menyi na.” 21-22Ewura Jɔash daŋ teŋ kelela nɛ Zakareya mo tuto Jehowada daŋ wora mo na so nna nseŋ ti bejuŋkparpo na so nɛ b kre fanɛ b mɔ Zakareya. Ewura na e daŋ sa ekpa nɛ b kpa Zakareya ajembu m mɔ ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ so.
Zakareya ka bee wu nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wu kusɔ nɛ fee wora ere kikɛ. Mo alɛ beeŋ gberge fo kusoe n tal to!”
Ewura Jɔash be kuwurji be lalaloge be asheŋ
23Kpanchali be jemanɛ ka fo, nɛ Siriya be benapo yɔ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm n ya kɔ bumo kena m mɔ bumo be bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ nseŋ muu bumo be asɔ damta kena na to n ya sa bumo be ewura ashi Damaskɔs. 24Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ Siriya be benapo na daa maŋ shibi, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nna nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ Juda be benapo damta na so ŋkpal b ka kini mo Enyɛnpe bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na so. Kananɛ Enyɛnpe na daŋ gberge ewura Jɔash kusoe nna na. 25Ewura Jɔash daŋ doro kena na to nna ga, ama bedoŋ na ka bɛta, nɛ mbe benimuana na be benyɔ ya mɔ mo ashi ebu nɛ e dese to na to m bishi kuwule ŋkpal e ka mɔ bɔrɛmatapo Jehowada pibinyɛn na so. Ewura Deevid be kade to nɛ b daŋ ta mo n ya puli, ama b daa maŋ puli mo kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura na. 26Basa nɛ b daŋ wora loŋ na, e daa la kache nɛ e shi Ammɔn be efuli so nɛ baa tre mo Shimish na pibinyɛn Zabad na nɛ Mowab be efuli so be kache nɛ baa tre mo Shimrif na pibinyɛn Jehozabad. 27Bewura be adrasheŋ gba bee malga Jɔash be mbinyɛnsobi be asheŋ nɛ kananɛ anebiana na malga mbe asheŋ nɛ kananɛ e lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na nɛnɛ be asheŋ kikɛ. Jɔash ka wu, mo pibinyɛn Amaziya e sɔ mo so n ji kuwura.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 25
Content:
Juda be ewura Amaziya be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 14:2-6)
1Amaziya ka ki ewura, nɛ e la nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ anu nna nseŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ akpanu. Mo nio be ketre e daa la Jehɔadin nɛ e shi Jerusalɛm na. 2Amaziya daŋ wora kusɔ nɛ k par Ebɔrɛ, ama mo alɛ daa maŋ wora kumo nɛ kagbene koŋwule. 3Mbe kuwurji ka baŋ yili to nɛnɛ, nɛ e mɔ benimu nɛ b mɔ mo tuto ewura Jɔash na epul to. 4E daa maŋ mɔ bumo be mbia bre, ŋkpal manɛ so e daŋ bɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ashi Mosis be mbra to na so nna. E yɛ: “B sa maŋ kaŋ mɔ ekurgepo ŋkpal kulubi nɛ bumo be mbia wora so. Loŋ koŋwule nɛ a maŋ daga b ka mɔ mbia ŋkpal kulubi nɛ bumo kurgepoana wora so. Ekama nɛ e wora kulubi, mo e daga kumo be kasogberge.” 5Ewura Amaziya daŋ shuŋi nna n tre Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be eyiriana to be benyɛn nɛ b fo nfɛ adunyɔ m baŋ so na n shin nɛ b barga to n yili mbuna mbuna so, nɛ e lara benapo be benimu nɛ baaŋ baa keni basa kagboŋ kagboŋ be ntuŋ so nɛ basa kalfa kalfa be ntuŋ so n sa bumo. Benyɛn nɛ b daŋ fo ekpa nɛ abɛlso be asɔkuŋso be keta ŋ kɔ kena na kikɛ daa la basa ŋgboŋ alfa asa nna. 6E daŋ ta gbiti nɛ amo be egbɛ sa fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ asa nɛ alfa ana nna n haya benapo ŋgboŋ kalfa ashi Israɛl be efuli so n ti bumo so. 7Ama Ebɔrɛ be anebi daŋ yɔ ewura na kutɔ nna n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Yiramu, sa maŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be benapo ere e bɛ fo so n yɔ kena to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maŋ wɔ bekama nɛ b shi Israɛl be efuli so be kelargato be esoso be kaba so na be kaman. 8Menyee fɛ nna fanɛ bumo e naŋ shin nɛ men baa kɔ eleŋ, ama Ebɔrɛ na e naa shin nɛ basa bee kɔ a pɔɔ so. Nɛ men shin nɛ b bɛ menyi so e beeŋ shin nɛ men doŋana e kɔ m pɔɔ menyi so.” 9Nɛ ewura Amaziya bishi anebi na le: “Nɛ gbiti nɛ n teŋ ta n sa bumo fanɛ bumo be kakɔka na malɛ a?”
Nɛ anebi na malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tiŋ n sa fo kusɔ nɛ k chɔ loŋ!” 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Amaziya shin nɛ benapo nɛ b haya na kikɛ bɛta n yɔ bumo peana. Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ b yɔ na b daŋ nya agbo nna ga n wɔtɔ Juda be basa.
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Amaziya leŋ mbe kumu to nseŋ juŋkpar mbe benapo n yɔ Nfɔl be Ketaŋɛ na to n ya kɔ kena m mɔ Edɔm be efuli so be benapo ŋgboŋ kudu kikɛ, 12nseŋ naŋ pɛ basa ŋgboŋ kudu malɛ gba. B daŋ ta bumo nna n yɔ kade nɛ baa tre Sɛla na be kebeegboŋ na be kakpa chulgiso n ya da bumo n lɛ to nɛ b tɔr afalta so kaseto n wu.
13Loŋ be jemanɛ na Israɛlebi be benapo nɛ ewura Amaziya daa maŋ shuli nɛ b tu mo n yɔ kena na to na, ya kɔ Juda be nde nɛ a wɔ Samɛria nɛ Bɛf Hɔrɔn be kefɛato na nna nseŋ mɔ basa ŋgboŋ asa m muu bumo be asɔ damta kena na to.
14Ewura Amaziya ka ya kɔ m pɔɔ Edɔmebi na so na nɛ e ta bumo be agbir m ba yili ŋ ki mbe agbir nsaa shuŋ amo a lara sarga a sa amo. 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nya agbo ga ŋkpal le be asheŋ ere so nseŋ shuŋi anebi ewura Amaziya kutɔ n ya bishi mo le: “Manɛ nna nɛ fee shuŋ efuli pɔtɛana so be agbir nɛ a maŋ tiŋ m mɔlga amo gbagba be basa ashi fo enɔ to ere?”
16Nɛ ewura Amaziya ku mbe kamalga na to ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Saŋɛ mo nɛ an ta fo ŋ ki ewura be asoetojipo? Lo fo kɔnɔ na pɔɛŋ nɛ n shin nɛ b ba mɔ fo ndoŋ!”
Anebi na ka jo nɛ e malga n loge, nɛ mo alɛ kaŋɛ le: “Naniere nɛ m pin fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha kemur fo nna ŋkpal fo ka kplaŋ ma kasotoji so nseŋ wora asheŋ ere kikɛ so.”
B ka kɔ Israɛl kena be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 14:8-20)
17Juda be ewura Amaziya nɛ mbe besoetojipoana daŋ kre nɛ b ya kɔ Israɛl kena nna, nseŋ ta kubɔya n ya sa Israɛl be ewura Jehɔash nɛ e la Jehowahaz pibinyɛn nsaa la Jehu mo nanabi na, a to mo emaŋ fanɛ b kɔ kena. 18Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Jehɔash malɛ ta le be kubɔya ere n sa ewura Amaziya. E yɛ: “Kachako nɛ Lebanɔn be abee so be ewidibi ko ta kubɔya n sa kedibi nɛ baa tre Sida na fanɛ e ta mo pibiche n sa mo pibinyɛn nɛ e kil. Ndoŋ nna nɛ kupuŋ to be kusɔbɔya ko ba fefɛa ewidibi na to n lɛ. 19Naniere Amaziya fee wu fo kumu nna, ŋkpal fo ka pɔɔ Edɔmebi so so, ama mee kaŋɛ fo nna fanɛ fo shir a wɔ laŋ to. Sa maŋ kil asheŋ nɛ a beeŋ bar jɛrbi m ba sa fo nɛ fo basa.”
20Ama ewura Amaziya daŋ kini kenu nna ŋkpal manɛ so Ebɔrɛ e daa sha fanɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ mo so ŋkpal e ka daa shuŋ Edɔmebi be agbir so. 21Amoso Israɛl be ewura Jehɔash nɛ Juda be ewura Amaziya daŋ ya kɔ abar kena nna. Bɛf Shɛmɛsh ashi Juda be efuli so nɛ b daŋ ya kɔ kena na. 22Israɛlebi na daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ Juda be efuli so be benapo na so nna nɛ b shile n yɔ bumo pe ana. 23Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jehɔash pɛ Amaziya ŋ keta mo n yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya yili Efrayim be kabuna na ekpa m bure Jerusalɛm be egbal na fanɛ ayadra alfa ashe n ya fo kukɔlɔbi to be kabuna na ase. 24E daŋ muu bɔrɛlambu na to be shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ kumo to be asɔwurbi kikɛ nɛ ewura be laŋ to be ekpanjawu nɛ Obɛd Edɔm be kaman to ebi daa keniso na kikɛ nna, nseŋ pɛ basa gba n ti so m bɛta n yɔ Samɛria. 25Israɛl be ewura Jehɔash ka wu be kaman nɛ Juda be ewura Amaziya naŋ ji nfɛ kuduanu n ti so. 26Asɔ kama nɛ Amaziya wora saŋɛ so nɛ e daa la ewura na hale m ba wu na kikɛ be asheŋ wɔ Juda nɛ Israɛl be bewura be nwɔl to. 27Baŋ yili saŋɛ so nɛ ewura Amaziya kini kebaanu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ b fara a fin mo nɛ kulubi ashi Jerusalɛm. Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ e shile n yɔ Lakish nɛ mo doŋana malɛ bɛ mo so n yɔ ndoŋ n ya mɔ mo. 28B daŋ ta mbe kebuni nna n deŋi gbaŋɛ so m ba puli kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura na ashi Deevid be kade to Jerusalɛm.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 26
Content:
Juda be ewura Uziya be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 14:21-22; 15:1-7)
1-3Ewura Amaziya ka wu na nɛ Juda be efuli so ebi kikɛ lara Amaziya pibinyɛn Uziya nɛ e daa la nfɛ kuduashe na ŋ ki ewura. Uziya daŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ adunu nɛ anyɔ nna. Mo nio e daa la Jekolia nɛ e shi Jerusalɛm na. Mbe saŋɛ so nɛ e naaŋ kɔ n sɔ Elɛf nseŋ lɔŋɛ kumo m pɔr. 4E daŋ bɛ mo tuto be aya so nna n wora kusɔ nɛ k bee par Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 5Ewura Uziya be asoetojipo e daa la Zakareya. Saŋɛ so nɛ Zakareya daa wɔ ŋkpa to na ewura Uziya daa ji kashenteŋ nna a sa Ebɔrɛ, nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ daa nɛfa mo.
6Ewura Uziya daŋ ya kɔ Filistiebi na kena nna nseŋ da Gaaf nɛ Jamnia nɛ Ashdɔd be nde na kikɛ be egbalana n lɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ e wora nde popɔr m mata Ashdɔd nseŋ pɔr egbalana ŋ kulti amo nɛ Filisti be efuli so be nde ko. 7Ebɔrɛ e daŋ chɛ mo to nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ Filistiebi nɛ Nlɔrbu nɛ b daa wɔ Gurbaal na nɛ Meuniebi nɛ b shi Edɔm be efuli so na kikɛ so. 8Ammɔnebi na daa ka lampo nna a sa ewura Uziya ŋkpal loŋ so e daŋ ji eleŋ ga nna nɛ mbe ketre daŋ dii hale nɛ Ijipt be kasawule so ebi nu mbe asheŋ.
9Ewura Uziya daŋ naŋ shin nna nɛ b pɔr atempreŋ jeŋgreŋ n yili Jerusalɛm be egbal na be kukɔlɔ to be kabuna na so nɛ Ketaŋɛ be kabuna na so nɛ egbal na be kebonfu ko so, n shin nɛ a naŋ wora eleŋ n ti so. 10Mo alɛ daŋ m pɔr atempreŋ jeŋgreŋ nna ashi efuli na be kiyi to nseŋ kur edampu damta ŋkpal e ka kɔ asɔbɔya damta nɛ b wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be abee be efuli nɛ keplasawule so na so. Ŋkpal e ka bee sha kudɔ ga so, e daŋ leŋ basa na to nna fanɛ b baa dɔ ndibi nɛ baa tre greep na be adɔ ashi abee be efuli na so nsaa dɔ adɔjibi ndoŋ be kasawule lela na so.
11E daa kɔ benapo damta nɛ b wora shiriya nɛ b ya kɔ kena saŋkama nna. Hananiya nɛ e daa la ewura be benimuana to be eko na e daa keni Jeɛl nɛ Maaseia nɛ b daa sibɛ benapo na nɛ kena to be asheŋ a wɔtɔ nwɔl to na so. 12-13Benapo be benimu ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ alfa ashe e daa keni benapo ŋgboŋ alfa asa nɛ ashunu nɛ alfa anu nɛ b nyi kena be kekɔ nɛnɛ nsaa kɔ ewura na mo doŋana na so. 14Ewura Uziya e daa sa benapo na abɛlso be asɔkuŋso nɛ ekpa nɛ abɛlso be akpaŋwuro nɛ kena to be epiŋi nɛ ata nɛ atanyembi nɛ atababu be ajembu. 15Mbe beshumpo nɛ b nyi kushuŋ nɛnɛ na be beko daŋ lɔŋɛ akɔsɔ ko nɛ baa ta a to atanyembi nɛ ajembu gboŋgboŋi nna. Ewura Uziya daŋ ta loŋ be akɔsɔ na nna n yili atempreŋ jeŋgreŋ nɛ a wɔ Jerusalɛm be egbal na be abonfu na so nna. Ebɔrɛ daŋ chɛ ewura Uziya to nna nɛ e ji eleŋ ga nɛ mbe ketre malɛ dii ashi durnya ere be efuli kikɛ so.
16Ewura Uziya ka nya eleŋ nɛ mbe ketre dii ga na, nɛ kamoowu luri mo to nɛ kumo be loŋ shin nɛ e tɔr. E daŋ wora kusoe kpakpaso nna n sa Enyɛnpe mbe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ ya luri bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ e chɔɔ duwu bɔrɛsure nɛ baa chɔɔ duwu kumo so na so. 17Ndoŋ nna bɔrɛmatapo Azariya nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana aduburwa nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn ga daŋ bɛ ewura na so 18nɛ b ya kuŋ mo akpa. B yɛ: “Uziya, fo maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ fo chɔɔ duwu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ. Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ to na nawule e kɔ ekpa nɛ b tiŋ n wora loŋ. Lar kakpa cheembi ere ŋkpal manɛ so fo wora kulubi ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe nɛfa maŋ naa wɔ fo so.”
19Ewura Uziya daa yil bɔrɛlambu na to nna m mata bɔrɛsure nɛ baa chɔɔ duwu kumo so na a kɔ kusɔ chɔɔ duwu to. E ka nu bɔrɛmatapoana na be kefiɛso nɛ e nya agbo nɛ keboti pɛ mbe kasɔto epul na to. 20Bɔrɛmatapo Azariya nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na ka wu kulɔ lubi na mbe kasɔto nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ e lar bɔrɛlambu na to epul na to. Mo gbagba ka pin fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa gberge mo kusoe so, nɛ e wora manaŋ n lar ndoŋ.
21Ewura Uziya daŋ ki botipo nna hale n ya wu. Amoso b daa maŋ naŋ sa mo ekpa nɛ e luri bɔrɛlambu na to kikɛ. E daa wɔ laŋ pɔtɛ to nna nɛ mo pibinyɛn Jotam sɔ mo so a wɔ ewura be laŋ to a ji efuli na so be kuwura.
22Anebi Aizaaya nɛ e la Amɔz pibinyɛn na e daŋ sibɛ kusɔ kama nɛ ewura Uziya daŋ wora saŋɛ so nɛ e daa ji kuwura na. 23Ewura Uziya ka wu, b daa maŋ puli mo kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura gbagba na. B daŋ ya puli mo kakpa pɔtɛ nɛ kumo alɛ gba la bewura be kakpa nna ŋkpal e ka kɔ keboti so. Mo pibinyɛn Jotam malɛ e daŋ sɔ mo so n ji kuwura.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 27
Content:
Juda be ewura Jotam be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 15:32-38)
1Nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ anu nɛ Jotam daŋ ji pɔɛŋ nseŋ ji kuwura ashi Jerusalɛm to nfɛ kuduashe. Mo nio e daa la Zadɔk pibiche Jerusha. 2Kananɛ mo tuto ewura Uziya daŋ wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ na, gbagba na chap nɛ mo alɛ gba daŋ wora; ama mo ere daa maŋ wora kulubi n chɔɔ duwu bɔrɛlambu to. Basa na bre daa wɔtɔ nna a wora alubi a ti so saŋkama.
3Ewura Jotam e daŋ pɔr Kabuna nɛ k wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so na nseŋ lɔŋɛ Jerusalɛm be egbal nɛ baa tre Ɔfɛl na nɛnɛ ga n ti so. 4E daŋ pɔr ndegboŋana nna ashi Juda be abee so nseŋ pɔr kumɔlga be mboŋ lempo nɛ atempreŋ jeŋgreŋ n yili kupo to. 5E daŋ ya kɔ Ammɔn be ewura nɛ mbe benapo kena nna nseŋ pɔɔ bumo so n tintiŋ Ammɔnebi na nɛ baa ka lampo a sa mo kafɛ kafɛ kikɛ hale n ya fo nfɛ asa. Asɔ nɛ b daa ka a sa mo na e la, gbiti kilo ŋgboŋ asa nɛ alfa ana nɛ ayu ebɔtɛ ŋgboŋto be kagboŋ koŋwule nɛ ayu peper malɛ ebɔtɛ ŋgboŋto gboŋto be kagboŋ koŋwule. 6Ewura Jotam daŋ ji eleŋ ga ŋkpal e kaa daa ji kashenteŋ nsaa bɛ Enyɛnpe mbe Ebɔrɛ na so so. 7Kusɔ kama nɛ Jotam wora saŋɛ so nɛ e daa la ewura na nɛ ana nɛ e daŋ kɔ na kikɛ be asheŋ daa wɔ Israɛl nɛ Juda be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to nna. 8Nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ anu nɛ Jotam daŋ ji pɔɛŋ m ba ki ewura, nseŋ ji kuwura ashi Jerusalɛm to nfɛ kuduashe. 9E ka wu, ewura Deevid be kade to Jerusalɛm nɛ b daŋ puli mo nɛ mo pibinyɛn Ahaz sɔ mo so n ji kuwura.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 28
Content:
Juda be ewura Ahaz be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 16:1-4)
1Nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ Ahaz daŋ ji pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki ewura, mo alɛ daŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ kuduashe nna. E daa maŋ bɛ kebaawɔtɔ lela nɛ mo nananyɛn ewura Deevid daa kɔ na so n wora kusɔ nɛ k bee par Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 2E daŋ bɛ Israɛl be bewura be kebaawɔtɔ lubi so nna. E daŋ ta abɛlso nna n lɔŋɛ Baal be kegbir na be mpɔrduli. 3E daa chɔɔ duwu ashi kepla nɛ baa tre Hinnɔm na so nna hale n ta mo gbagba be mbinyɛnsobi n lara sarga chɔɔso n sa agbir. Mo alɛ daa kute basa nɛ b daa wɔ Israɛl be efuli so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ju bumo saŋɛ so nɛ Israɛlebi daŋ ba kasawule na so sososo na be asheŋ woraso lubi nɛ Ebɔrɛ kishi ga na to nna. 4Ewura Ahaz daa lara mbe esarga nsaa chɔɔ duwu, ashi nnyamase be mboŋ nɛ baa shuŋ bumo be agbir nɛ abee so nɛ ndibi be afito nna.
Siriya nɛ Israɛl be kena be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 16:5)
5-6Ŋkpal ewura Ahaz ka wora kulubi nɛ Juda be basa malɛ kini Enyɛnpe bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na so, Ebɔrɛ shin nna nɛ Siriya be ewura kɔ m pɔɔ mo so nseŋ pɛ Judaebi be basa damta n yɔ kabuti to ashi Damaskɔs. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ naŋ shin nna nɛ Israɛl be ewura Pɛka nɛ e la Remaliya pibinyɛn na kɔ m pɔɔ ewura Ahaz so nseŋ mɔ Juda be benapo nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn ga na be ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ adunyɔ kachɛ koŋwule be epeŋi to. 7Loŋ be kena na to, nɛ Israɛl be enapo ko nɛ baa tre Zikri na mɔ benyɛn asa nɛ b kɔ eyilikpagboŋ ashi Juda be efuli so na. Bumo e la Mɛseya nɛ e la ewura na pibinyɛn nɛ Azrikam nɛ e bee keni ewura be laŋ so na nɛ Ɛlkana nɛ e la enimu a bɛ ewura na so na. 8Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ Judaebi na nɛ Israɛlebi daa la bekurgepoana gbagba nna, ama Israɛlebi be benapo na daŋ pɛ Judaebi na be beche nɛ mbia ŋgboŋ alfa anyɔ nna nseŋ muu asɔ damta kena na to m bɛta n yɔ Samɛria.
Anebi Odɛd be asheŋ
9Kede be kaman nɛ kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Odɛd nɛ e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anebi a wɔ Samɛria be kade to na lar n ya shɛr Israɛlebi be benapo nɛ b keta Juda b basa nɛ b pɛ kena to a ba Samɛria na to, saŋɛ so nɛ b daa shin nɛ b luri kade to na, nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Enyɛnpe men nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ Juda nseŋ shin nɛ men kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so, ama mo alɛ naŋ wu kananɛ men maŋ wu bumo kuwɔr nseŋ mɔ bumo alegaiso. 10Naniere menyeeŋ sha keta Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be benyɛn nɛ beche nna ŋ ki men be anya na. Menyi maŋ nyi fanɛ nɛ men wora loŋ menyi alɛ gba wora alubi ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na nna ere a? 11Men nu nfe! Basa nɛ men pɛ ere la men siponyɛn nɛ men sipocheana nna, amoso men shin nɛ b bɛta a yɔ epe, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, Enyɛnpe na b agbo beeŋ kaa, nɛ e gberge menyi kusoe.”
12Loŋ be saŋɛ na gbagba nɛ Azariya nɛ e la Jehohanan pibinyɛn na nɛ Bɛrekaya nɛ mo alɛ la Mɛshillemɔf pibinyɛn na nɛ Jehizkia nɛ e la Shallɔm pibinyɛn na nɛ Amasa nɛ mo alɛ la Hadlai pibinyɛn nɛ b la Israɛl be benimu ana na gba ba kaŋɛ fanɛ Israɛl be benapo na maŋ wora n nyalɛ. 13B yɛ: “Men sa maŋ ta basa nɛ men pɛ kena to na m ba nfe! An tiŋ n wora alubi ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ wɔtɔ mo agbo to n daga mbe kasogberge. Naniere, menyee shin nɛ men wora kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ shin nɛ anyi be kulubi na e wora alegai nna na.” 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ benapo na ta basa nɛ b pɛ na nɛ asɔ nɛ b muu kena to na n sa bumo be benimuana na ashi jimaŋ na be anishito, 15nɛ benimuana na lara epiŋi ashi asɔ nɛ b muu na to n sa basa nɛ b pɛ kena to na b bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ asɔbuuso na. Kumo be kaman nɛ b sa bumo kikɛ epiŋi nɛ asɛbta nɛ ajibi nɛ nchu nseŋ wora ɔlif be ŋku a wɔtɔ bumo be achuuana to. Kede be kaman nɛ b ta bumo bekama nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ na n chena ekurma so nseŋ keta bumo n yɔ Jɛriko be kade nɛ baa tre abii be ndibi be kade na to. Kumo be kaman nɛ Israɛlebi na bɛta n yɔ bumo pe Samɛria.
16-18K maŋ chɛr ko nɛ Edɔmebi naŋ ya kɔ Judaebi kena nseŋ pɛ bumo be basa damta. Loŋ be saŋɛ na gbagba nɛ Filistiebi na ta kena n ya purgi epeŋitɔrkpa be kebeemase be nde na nɛ Juda be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so be nde. B daŋ kɔ nna n sɔ Bɛf Shimɛsh nɛ Aijalɔn nɛ Gɛdɛrɔf nɛ Soko be nde nɛ Timna nɛ Gimzo nɛ amo be ndewurbiana kikɛ nseŋ chena ndoŋ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Ahaz ya kule Tiglaf Pilesa nɛ e la Asiriya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na fanɛ e wora bumo kechɛto. 19Ŋkpal Juda be ewura Ahaz ka daŋ maŋ wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu nseŋ yige mbe basa nɛ baa wora alubi so nɛ Enyɛnpe na daŋ bar le be etɔrɔ Juda be efuli so na. 20Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na ka beeŋ chɛ Ahaz to na, nɛ e naŋ kilgi a fin asheŋ a sa mo. 21Amoso ewura Ahaz daŋ ta shuwa nna ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ ewura be laŋ to nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na pe n ya sa Asiriya be ewura na, ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ ewura na daŋ maŋ chɛ mo to.
22Ewura Ahaz ka luri etɔrɔ damta ere to be kaman, nɛ e naaŋ wora alubi ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ga a chɔ sososo na gba. 23E daŋ lara esarga nna n sa Siriyaebi nɛ b daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ mo so na be agbirana. Le nɛ e daŋ fɛ: “Siriya be agbirana na a chɛ Siriya be bewura to, amoso nɛ m baŋ lara sarga n sa amo, a beeŋ chɛ ma alɛ gba to.” Aloŋ so nɛ mo nɛ mbe efuli so ebi ji jɛrbi ga na. 24E daŋ muu bɔrɛlambu na to be asɔwurbiana nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na nna m bure to kpachɛrkpachɛrbi nseŋ ti kumo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ e yuu agbir be ebɔrɛsureana ashi Jerusalɛm to be kaplɛkama. 25E daŋ pɔr mboŋ nɛ baaŋ baa shuŋ agbir nɛ kakpa nɛ baaŋ baa chɔɔ duwu a sa efuli pɔtɛana so be agbir ashi ndegboŋ nɛ ndewurbi kikɛ nɛ a wɔ Juda be efuli so na nna. Kumo be loŋ e daŋ shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la mo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na be agbo ba mo so na.
26B daŋ sibɛ kusɔ nɛ ewura Ahaz wora saŋɛ so nɛ e ji kuwura na kikɛ be asheŋ nna n wɔtɔ Juda nɛ Israɛl be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to. 27Ewura Ahaz ka wu nɛ b puli mo Jerusalɛm to ama b daa maŋ puli mo kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura na. Mo pibinyɛn Hɛzekaya e daŋ sɔ mo so n ji kuwura.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 29
Content:
Juda be ewura Hɛzekaya be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 18:1-3)
1Nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ anu nɛ Hɛzekaya daŋ fo pɔɛŋ nseŋ ŋ ki Juda be ewura. Mo alɛ daŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ akpanu nna. Mo nio e daa la Zakareya pibiche Abija. 2E daŋ bɛ mo nananyɛn ewura Deevid be aya so nna nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ keniŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito.
B ka fɔr bɔrɛlambu na so daŋkare be ekpa so be asheŋ
3Kafɛ nɛ Hɛzekaya ki ewura na be kufɔl juŋkparso to nɛ e shin nɛ b lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na be akuloŋana nseŋ bugi amo. 4E daŋ shin nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na, nɛ Livaiebi na shɛr bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so 5nɛ e malga bumo kutɔ ndoŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Livaiebi, men lara alubi men be ŋgbene to a du cheembi nseŋ luri Enyɛnpe nɛ e la men nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na to n lara kusɔ kama nɛ k wora eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so ashi kumo to. 6An nananyɛnana daa maŋ ji kashenteŋ, bumo alɛ daa maŋ wora kasonu n sa Enyɛnpe an be Ebɔrɛ na. Mannɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule nɛ b daŋ kini, b daŋ kplaŋ mbe bɔrɛlambu na gba so nna. 7B daŋ ti bɔrɛlambu na be akuloŋana so nna nseŋ duŋ kumo to be efitila nseŋ yige eduwu gba be kebaachɔɔ nɛ kebaalara sarga chɔɔso a sa Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na. 8Ŋkpal le be asheŋ ere so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna ga n wɔtɔ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm ebi nseŋ wora bumo kusɔ nɛ k pɛ ekama kufu nseŋ mɔ ekama kɔnɔ. Men gbagba ere nyi le be kesheŋ ere nɛnɛ. 9B daŋ mɔ an tutoana ashi kena to nna nseŋ pɛ anyi be beche nɛ mbia kena to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so.
10Naniere bre ma nɛ Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tiŋi ŋkre dra na to. Ashere nɛ n wora loŋ, mbe agbo maaŋ naa wɔ anyi so. 11Ma mbinyɛnsobi, men sa maa jija saŋɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara fanɛ men baa chɔɔ duwu a sa mo nsaa juŋkpar basa nɛ b baa shuŋ mo.”
12-14Livaiebi nɛ b daa wɔ kushuŋ na to e daa la
Mahaf nɛ e la Amasai pibinyɛn na nɛ Jowɛl nɛ e la Azariya pibinyɛn na e daŋ shi Kohaf be kabuna.
Kish nɛ e la Abdi pibinyɛn na nɛ Azariya nɛ e la Jehalelɛl pibinyɛn na e daŋ shi Mɛrari be kabuna.
Jowanɛ e la Zimna pibinyɛn na nɛ Edɛn nɛ e la Jowa pibinyɛn na e daŋ shi Gɛshɔn be kabuna.
Shimri nɛ Jeuɛl daa la Elizafan be kaman to ebi nna.
Zakareya nɛ Mataniya daa la Asaf be kaman to ebi nna.
Jehuɛl nɛ Shimei daa la Heman be kaman to ebi nna.
Shemaya nɛ Uziɛl daa la Jedutum be kaman to ebi nna.
15Basa ere kikɛ daŋ tre bumo braana Livaiebi na nna n shɛr nɛ bumo kikɛ fɔr bumo be amu so daŋkare be ekpa so. Kumo be kaman nɛ b wora kusɔ nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ fanɛ b wora na nseŋ luri n ya lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na to daŋkare be ekpa so fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra bee ŋini na. 16Bɔrɛmatapoana na ka luri bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ b ya lɔŋɛ kumo to daŋkare be ekpa so na, nɛ b lara kusɔ kama nɛ k maŋ walɛ so na kikɛ m ba kumo be kelɔnɛ so. Nɛ Livaiebi na malɛ ta amo ndoŋ n ya lɛ Kidrɔn be ketaŋɛ na to.
17Kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ juŋkparso nɛ b fara kushuŋ na nseŋ ta nchɛ aburwa n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ so n ta nchɛ aburwa malɛ n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na gbagba to, nɛ kushuŋ na kikɛ loge kachɛ kuduashesopo na.
18Kubɔya nɛ Livaiebi na daŋ ta m ba sa ewura Hɛzekaya nde: “Yiramu, an lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ baa chɔɔ sarga kumo so na nɛ teebɔl nɛ baa ta bodobodo cheembi a deŋi so na nɛ asɔwurbiana nɛ b kɔ a shuŋ kumo to na kikɛ daŋkare be ekpa so n loge. 19An naŋ bɛta asɔwurbi kama nɛ Ewura Ahaz daŋ ta saŋɛ so nɛ e daa maa ji kashenteŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ m ba bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ. Amo kikɛ wɔ Enyɛnpe be bɔrɛsure na be anishito.”
20Epul to nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya tre kade na to be benimuana na nɛ b yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to. 21B daŋ bar egbolu ashunu nɛ ekpakpa ashunu nɛ ekpakpafɔlbi ashunu nɛ mboe ashunu nna fanɛ b ta n lara Hɛzekaya nɛ mbe kanaŋ nɛ Juda be basa be alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga nseŋ fɔr bɔrɛlambu na gba so daŋkare be ekpa so. Kede be kaman nɛ Hɛzekaya kaŋɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b la Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi na fanɛ b ta loŋ be asɔbɔya na n lara sarga bɔrɛsure na so. 22Egbolu na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na juŋkpar m mɔ n ta ekpakpa na m bɛ so nseŋ ta ekpakpafɔlbi na malɛ m bɛso. B daŋ chulgi asɔbɔya na be kekama be ŋklaŋ nna n wurge bɔrɛsure na so. 23B daŋ ta mboe na bre nna n yɔ ewura na nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nɛ b ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi n deŋi bumo so. 24Kumo be kaman nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na mɔ mboe na nseŋ chulgi amo be ŋklaŋ n wurge bɔrɛsure na so fanɛ alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga, ŋkpal manɛ so, ewura na kaŋɛ nna fanɛ b ta amo n lara Israɛl be efuli so ebi kikɛ be sarga chɔɔso nɛ alubi be ketampaŋ be sarga.
25Ewura na daŋ bɛ keŋini nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla anebi Gad nɛ nɛ anebi Neetan so ŋ kaŋɛ ewura Deevid na so nna n shin nɛ Livaiebi na ta ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ echakachaka a wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to. 26Livaiebi na daŋ bela ase nna nɛ b laŋ ewura Deevid be alaŋsɔ na, nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana malɛ wora shiriya nɛ b foŋ bumo be mbel. 27Ewura Hɛzekaya ka baŋ sa ekpa fanɛ b lara sarga chɔɔso na; nɛ basa na fara a boŋ nshɛ a di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nɛ beshɛbompo na malɛ fara a foŋ bumo be mbel nsaa laŋ alaŋsɔ 28Bekama nɛ b daa wɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ daŋ ti bumo so nna a bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa boŋ nshɛ a laŋ alaŋsɔ hale nɛ b lara sarga chɔɔso na n loge. 29Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ basa na kikɛ gbir m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ. 30Ewura na nɛ efuli na so be bejuŋkparpoana na daŋ kaŋɛ Livaiebi na nna fanɛ b baa boŋ nshɛ nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ anebi Asaf daŋ sibɛ n nase na. B ka bee boŋ amo nɛ ekama be kagbene fuli nɛ b gbir m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ.
31Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya kaŋɛ basa na le: “Naniere bre men ka nyalɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so ere, men ta men be kabɔrɛchɔrɔ be esarga m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.” Nɛ basa na wora loŋ, nɛ bumo be beko malɛ bar asɔbɔya m ba lara sarga chɔɔso bumo be keparso nɛ esa kama maŋ bishi bumo. 32B daŋ ta egbolu adushunu nɛ ekpakpa kalfa nɛ ekpakpafɔlbi alfa anyɔ nna n lara sarga chɔɔso n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, 33nseŋ ta egbolu alfa ashe nɛ ekpakpa ŋgboŋ asa n lara sarga ŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa. 34Ŋkpal bɔrɛmatapoana ka daa maŋ shibi nɛ b bɛ asɔbɔya na so, Livaiebi na e daŋ chɛ bumo to m bɛ asɔbɔya na kikɛ. Loŋ be jemanɛ na, nɛ Livaiebi damta tiŋ n fɔr bumo be amu so daŋkare be ekpa so nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na bre be damta daa maŋ naŋ wora loŋ. 35Kechɔɔ m mur be sarga na be buushi, bɔrɛmatapoana na be kushuŋ e daŋ naa la kebaachɔɔ sarga nɛ basa kɔ ekpa nɛ b ji na be nfɔ, nɛ kebaachulgi asɔnuuso nɛ a ti sarga chɔɔso so na a wurge bɔrɛsure na so.
Amoso b daŋ naŋ fara kabɔrɛshuŋ nna ashi bɔrɛlambu to 36Ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ basa na kikɛ be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka chɛ bumo to nɛ b wora loŋ be asheŋ na manaŋ manaŋ so.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 30
Content:
K bela ase n ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na be asheŋ
1-3Basa na daa maŋ tiŋ n ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na kufɔl juŋkparso na to, ŋkpal manɛ so bɔrɛmatapoana na be bedamta daa maŋ fɔrso n lar so daŋkare be ekpa so nɛ basa damta malɛ daa maŋ ba Jerusalɛm to. Ŋkpal loŋ so, ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ mbe benimuana nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa daŋ shuli nna fanɛ b ji kejigboŋ na kufɔl nyɔsopo na to. Kumo be kaman b sa Israɛl nɛ Judaebi nɛ Efrayim nɛ Manase be eyiri na ebɔl fanɛ b ba nɛ b ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na ashi Jerusalɛm be bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ k baa la kemaŋkura n sa Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na. 4Ewura na nɛ basa na kikɛ be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo nna ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b kre na so. 5B daŋ yili Dan be kasawule so be kelargato be esoso be kaba so nna n tre Israɛlebi na kikɛ n ya fo Bɛshiba be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so fanɛ b chala abar a chɔ kananɛ b daa chala abar na m ba Jerusalɛm m ba ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na kananɛ mbra na ŋini na. 6Ewura na nɛ mbe benimuana na daŋ shin nna nɛ mbɔ ta le be kubɔya ere n yɔ Juda nɛ Israɛl be efuli so kikɛ:
“Menyi Israɛl be basa nɛ men nya men be amu saŋɛ so nɛ Asiriyaebi daŋ kɔ n sɔ kasawule ere na, e bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la an nananyɛnana Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nɛ mo alɛ gba e sɔ menyi. 7Menyi ere e sa maŋ kaŋ ki fanɛ men nananyɛnana nɛ men braana Israɛlebi nɛ b daa maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na. Men gbagba wu kananɛ e gberge bumo kusoe alegaiso. 8Menyi ere e sa maŋ wora amu kpakpaso fanɛ kananɛ men nananyɛnana daŋ wora na, ama men baa nu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Men ba men Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu cheembi nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na to m ba bunyaŋ mo saŋɛ na so e maaŋ naŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ menyi. 9Men baŋ bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ, kumo ere basa kama nɛ b kɔ n sɔ men kurgepoana na beeŋ wu bumo kuwɔr nseŋ shin nɛ b naŋ bɛta m ba epe. Men Nyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na la esa ga nsaa wu kuwɔr, amoso nɛ men baaŋ bɛta m ba mo kutɔ, mo alɛ gba beeŋ sɔ menyi.”
10Mbɔ na daŋ yɔ nde nɛ a wɔ Efrayim nɛ Manase be eyiriana na be efuli so kikɛ to nna hale n ta n ya fo Zɛbyulɔn be yiri na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so kikɛ, ama basa daŋ mushe bumo nna nseŋ wora bumo amɔmɔshiasheŋ. 11Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, eyiri nɛ b daa shi Ashɛr nɛ Manase nɛ Zɛbyulɔn be kaba so na be basa ko bre daa sha keba Jerusalɛm nna. 12Ebɔrɛ daŋ shuŋ mbe kushuŋ ashi Juda nna nseŋ leŋ basa na to nɛ b nya kɔnɔkoŋwule a wora ania a wora mo kasonu nsaa bɛ ewura na nɛ mbe benimuana na malɛ be mbra so.
B ka ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na be asheŋ
13Basa damta daŋ ba shɛr Jerusalɛm kufɔl nyɔsopo na to nna nɛ b ji bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi na be kejigboŋ na. 14B daŋ lara efuli pɔtɛana so be ebɔrɛsure nɛ b daa lara esarga nsaa chɔɔ eduwu amo so na nna n lɛ Kidrɔn be ketaŋɛ na to. 15B daŋ mɔ ekpakpafɔlbi nɛ b kɔ a lara kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ be sarga kufɔl na be kachɛ kuduanasopo na to nna. Anishinyɔr daŋ pɛ Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ b daa maŋ walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so na nna nɛ b ta bumo be amu n bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ pɔɛŋ nseŋ tiŋ n lara sarga chɔɔso bɔrɛlambu na to. 16Kede be kaman nɛ b fara a shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ bɔrɛlambu to fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kenya Mosis be mbra yili n sa bumo na. Livaiebi na e ta asɔbɔya nɛ b ta n lara esarga na be ŋklaŋ n sa bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ bumo alɛ ta amo ŋ ŋmenyaŋ bɔrɛsure na so. 17Ŋkpal basa na be bedamta ka daa maŋ walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so na so, b daa maŋ tiŋ m mɔ kebansonchoŋ be ekpakpafɔlbi na. Amoso Livaiebi na e daŋ mɔ bumo be asɔbɔya nseŋ ta amo m bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na enɔ n sa bumo. 18Amo nɛ amo kikɛ basa na be bedamta nɛ b shi Efrayim nɛ Manase nɛ Isaaka nɛ Zɛbyulɔn be eyiri to na daa maŋ fɔr bumo be amu so daŋkare be ekpa so nseŋ ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na ekpa nɛ k maŋ daga so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya kule le be kabɔrɛkule ere n sa bumo. 19E yɛ: “O! Enyɛnpe an nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo walɛ, ta bekama nɛ baa shuŋ fo nɛ kagbene koŋwule na be alubi m paŋ bumo, hale b ka maŋ walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so kikɛ ere gba.” 20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nu ewura Hɛzekaya be kabɔrɛkule nna nseŋ ta basa na be alubi m paŋ bumo nsaa maŋ tɔrɔ bumo. 21Basa nɛ b daŋ ba shɛr Jerusalɛm na daŋ ta nchɛ ashunu nna n ji bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi be kejigboŋ na kagbenefuliso nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na bee boŋ nshɛ nsaa laŋ alaŋsɔ a di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ karechɛ kikɛ. 22Ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ chɔrɔ Livaiebi na nna ŋkpal kenyi nɛ b daa kɔ a juŋkpar basa nɛ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so.
Kejigboŋ nyɔsopo na be asheŋ
Nchɛ ashunu nɛ b ta n lara sarga n di Enyɛnpe bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ na be kaman, 23nɛ bumo kikɛ naŋ yili kumo fanɛ b naŋ ji kejigboŋ na nchɛ ashunu n ti so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ji kumo kagbenefuliso nchɛ ashunu n ti so. 24Ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ sa basa na egbolu kagboŋ nɛ ekpakpa ŋgboŋ ashunu nna fanɛ b mɔ n we. Nɛ benimuana na malɛ sa bumo egbolu kagboŋ nɛ ekpakpa ŋgboŋ kudu, nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana damta fɔr bumo be amu so daŋkare be ekpa so. 25Amoso Judaebi na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na, nɛ Livaiebi na, nɛ Israɛlebi na, nɛ befɔ nɛ b wɔ Israɛl nɛ Juda be efuli so kikɛ be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo nna. 26Kagbenefuli daŋ baa wɔ Jerusalɛm kikɛ to nna, ŋkpal manɛ so yili ewura Deevid pibinyɛn, ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be jemanɛ so kikɛ, loŋ be asheŋ maŋ naŋ wora kikɛ. 27Bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na daŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa nna n sa basa na, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shi esoso n nu bumo be kekule.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 31
Content:
Hɛzekaya ka naŋ lɔŋɛ kabɔrɛshuŋ n yili to be asheŋ
1Kejigboŋ na ka loge, nɛ Israɛlebi na yɔ Juda be efuli so be kade kikɛ to, n ya bure ndoŋ be ajembu be eshabɔrɛ nɛ kegbirche Ashira be mpɔrduli be ndibi n lɛ nseŋ mur ndoŋ be ebɔrɛsure nɛ kakpa nɛ nnyamase bee shuŋ bumo be agbirana na kikɛ. B daŋ wora loŋ nna ashi Juda be efuli so kikɛ nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Efrayim nɛ Manase be kaba so kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b bɛta n yɔ epe.
2Ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ nna n yili bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na be ntuŋ nɛ ashuŋ nɛ baa shuŋ. Ashuŋ na be ako e la kebaalara esarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be esarga nɛ kebaabunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ kebaadi Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nsaa juŋkpar kabɔrɛchɔrɔ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to. 3Ewura na daa lara mo gbagba be mbolpɔ nɛ ana nna a sa nɛ baa lara sarga chɔɔso kachipurso nɛ kaaseso kikɛ, nɛ kewushiachɛ be sarga nɛ kufɔl popɔr be kejigboŋ nɛ kabɔrɛshuŋ kikɛ be kejigboŋ be esarga nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra ŋini fanɛ b baa lara na.
4E daŋ kaŋɛ Jerusalɛm be basa nna fanɛ b baa ta esarga nɛ baa lara a sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na n sa bumo, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya saŋɛ nɛnɛ a shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kushuŋ na. 5Israɛlebi na ka baŋ nu loŋ, epul to nɛ b ta ayu nɛ asɔnuuso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ mushoŋ nɛ sososo be adɔjibiana be ŋkɛana nɛ bumo be kudukudusopo m ba. 6Basa nɛ b daa wɔ Juda be nde nɛ a ka na to gba daŋ ta bumo be ana nɛ mbolpɔ be kudukudusopo nɛ ŋkɛ damta ko nna m ba sa Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na. 7Kafɛ to be kufɔl sasopo na to nɛ basa na fara a bar bumo be ŋkɛana nseŋ kɛ le hale afɔl ana kikɛ nɛ baa koli bumo be ŋkɛ abar so. 8Ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ mbe benimuana ka wu kananɛ basa na sa na, nɛ b di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nseŋ chɔrɔ Israɛlebi gba. 9Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na bishi bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na ŋkɛ na be asheŋ 10nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Azariya nɛ e la Zadɔk be kaman to ebi be esa na kaŋɛ mo le: “Baŋ yili saŋɛ so nɛ basa na fara a bar bumo be ŋkɛ bɔrɛlambu to na, an bee nya ajibi nna a ji yɛlyɛla so. An daa nya amo kikɛ nna ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka nɛfa mbe basa so. Keni amo be amo nɛ a ka.”
11Nɛ ewura na shin nɛ b pɔr ebuana nɛ baaŋ ba ta asɔ a yili to ashi bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ na be ekarso, 12nsaa ta ŋkɛ na nɛ kudukudusopo na n yili ndoŋ, saŋɛ na so shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n ta amo. B daŋ ta Livainyɛn nɛ baa tre Konaniya na nna fanɛ e baa keni amo so nseŋ ta mo sipo Shimei malɛ m bɛ mo so. 13Ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Azariya daŋ lara Livaiebi kudu malɛ nna fanɛ b baa chɛ bumo to a shuŋ. Bumo e la Jehiɛl nɛ Azariya nɛ Nahaf nɛ Asahɛl nɛ Jerimɔf nɛ Jozabad nɛ Elliɛl nɛ Ismakaya nɛ Mahaf nɛ Bɛnaya. 14Imna pibinyɛn Kɔr nɛ e la Livai be esa nsaa keni bɔrɛlambu na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be kabuna na so na e daa sɔ ŋkɛ nɛ baa bar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nsaa barga amo to a sa Livaiebi na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na. 15Nde kama nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana daa wɔ na, Livaiebi ko e daŋ bugi ŋgbene a chɛ mo to. Bumo e la, Edɛn nɛ Miniamin nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Shemaya nɛ Amariya nɛ Shekanaya. B daa yili kananɛ bumo braana Livaiebi be kushuŋ du so nna a chige ajibi na to dede a sa bumo. 16B daa maa chige amo mbuna mbuna so. B daa yili ekama be kare chɛ kikɛ be kushuŋ nɛ e bee shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to so nna a chige amo a sa bumo be benyɛn nɛ b fo nfɛ adesa m baŋ so na. 17Mbuna mbuna so nɛ b daŋ yili m barga kushuŋ na to n sa bɔrɛmatapoana na, ama Livaiebi nɛ b fo nfɛ adunyɔ m baŋ so na bre, ntuŋ ntuŋ so nɛ b daŋ yili m barga kushuŋ na to n sa bumo. 18B daŋ sibɛ bumo nɛ bumo be beche nɛ mbia nɛ basa kama nɛ b wɔ bumo kutɔ kikɛ be atre nna nase, ŋkpal manɛ so bumo alɛ gba daga fanɛ b baa du cheembi nna nsaa beeŋ tiŋ n shuŋ loŋ be kushuŋ na saŋkikɛ. 19Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b daa wɔ nde nɛ b ta n sa Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi ŋko nde na be asɔbɔya be ejikpa be mboŋ na, benyɛn ko nɛ baa tiŋ a keta bumo be amu daa wɔ loŋ be nde nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b la Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi wɔ ndoŋ a chige ajibi a sa benyɛn nɛ b wɔ kebɔrɛmata be kanaŋ to na nna nɛ beko malɛ ti Livaiebi be kabuna ebi na so.
20Ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nsaa par Enyɛnpe mbe Ebɔrɛ na nna ashi Juda be efuli so kikɛ. 21Kusɔ kama nɛ e bee wora daa yɔ anishito nna ŋkpal bɔrɛlambu na to be kusɔ kama nɛ e wora ka daa walɛ nɛ mo alɛ naa kɔ kasonu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra na so.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 32
Content:
Asiriyaebi ka kre k kɔ Jerusalɛm be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 18:13-37; 19:14-19, 35-37; Aizaaya 36:1-22; 37:8-38)
1Ewura Hɛzekaya ka wora kasonu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ n wora asheŋ ere kikɛ na be kaman nɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ Sennakerɛb ba kɔ Juda be efuli kena. Mbe benapo daŋ kulti Juda be nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na nna n wɔtɔ, ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b bure nde na be egbalana na n luri. 2Hɛzekaya ka wu fanɛ ewura Sennakerɛb bee shin nɛ e kɔ Jerusalɛm gba kena, 3-4nɛ mo nɛ mbe benimuana yili kumo fanɛ baaŋ ti bumo be nchu nɛ a bee shile a yɔ kade na be ekarso na saŋɛ na so Asiriyaebi na kaŋ fo Jerusalɛm nɛ b ba kɔ bumo kena, b maaŋ nya nchu. Ndoŋ nna nɛ benimuana na juŋkpar basa damta nɛ b ya ti abuyeana na kikɛ nɛ a maŋ naa bul nchu. 5Ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ shin nna nɛ b naŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr kade na be egbal na nseŋ pɔr atempreŋ jeŋgreŋ n yili kumo so nseŋ naŋ pɔr egbal nyɔsopo kedra na be kaman. Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ b sulɔ asɔ n ti kemaŋ nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na nseŋ pɔr egbal n yili ndoŋ. E daŋ shin nna nɛ b lɔŋɛ ekpa nɛ abɛlso be asɔkuŋso damta gba. 6Kumo be kaman nɛ e lara benapo be benimu nɛ baa keni basa na kikɛ so n shin nɛ bumo kikɛ shɛr kade na be kabunagboŋ na be kelɔnɛ so nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: 7“Men ba kɔ eleŋ nsaa leŋ men be amu to. Men saa maa ŋana Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na nɛ mbe benapo nɛ e bee juŋkpar na. Eleŋ nɛ k wɔ anyi be kaba so na chɔ bumo peya na. 8Dimɛdi be eleŋ nɛ mo ere kɔ, ama anyi ere kɔ Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na nna nɛ e bee kɔ anyi be ana a sa anyi. Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na nya keleŋto ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ ewura kaŋɛ na so.”
9Jemanɛ nɛ ewura Sennakerɛb nɛ mbe benapo kraa wɔ Lakish na nɛ e ta le be kubɔya ere n sa ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ Juda be basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na: 10“Ma Sennakerɛb nɛ n la Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na e naa bishi menyi kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ men nya kagbene a wɔ Jerusalɛm to saŋɛ so nɛ benapo kulti menyi n wɔtɔ ere. 11Men be ewura Hɛzekaya bee kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mɔlga menyi ashi anyi be enɔ to, ama e bee fule menyi nna nɛ akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ e mɔ menyi. 12Mannɛ mo e daŋ bure agbir nɛ ebɔrɛsure na nseŋ kaŋɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa fanɛ b baa chɔɔ duwu ashi bɔrɛsure koŋwule so na a? 13Men maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ ma nɛ n nananyɛnana daŋ wora efuli pɔtɛ so ebi na a? Efuli pɔtɛ so be agbirana na be kumo a tiŋ m mɔlga bumo be basa ashi Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na be enɔ to? 14Saŋɛ mo nɛ efuliana be agbirana daŋ mɔlga amo be basa ashi anyi be enɔ to? Amoso manɛ bre so nɛ menyee fɛ fanɛ menyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga menyi ashi ma enɔ to ere? 15Men sa maŋ shin nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya e fule menyi nseŋ shin nɛ men foe akpa. Men sa maŋ yirda mo! Efuliana ere be kekama be kegbir maŋ naŋ tiŋ m mɔlga kumo be efuli be basa ashi Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na be enɔ to. Amoso menyi be Ebɔrɛ ere gba maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga menyi!”
16Asiriya be benimuana na gba daŋ malga asheŋ lubi dama ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mbe kayɛrbi Hɛzekaya. 17Kede be kaman nɛ Asiriya be ewura sibɛ kawɔl a fɛl Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na a kaŋɛ le: “Efuli pɔtɛana so be agbirana na gba maŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo ashi ma enɔ to, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya gba be Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga mbe basa ashi ma enɔ to.” 18Asiriya be benimuana na daa ponte Hibruw be ŋgbar to nna a kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ kawɔl na bee kaŋɛ na saŋɛ na so kufu beeŋ pɛ Jerusalɛm be basa nɛ b wɔ kade na be egbal na so na nɛ b pɔ aba nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so. 19Kananɛ b daŋ baa malga Jerusalɛm be Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ du nna fanɛ kananɛ b daa malga basa pɔtɛana be agbir nɛ b ta bumo be enɔana n lɔŋɛ na be asheŋ na.
20Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ Amɔz pibinyɛn, anebi Aizaaya kule Ebɔrɛ n shu n fin kechɛto mo kutɔ. 21Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shuŋi malaika nɛ e ya mɔ Asiriya be benapo na nɛ bumo be benapo be benimuana na kikɛ. Nɛ ewurgboŋ na ta anishinyɔr m bɛta n yɔ epe. Kachako e ka wɔ mbe kegbir be lambu to nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi ko ta bumo be etokobi m ba mɔ mo.
22Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mɔlga ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa ashi Asiriya be ewurgboŋ Sennakerɛb nɛ bumo doŋana nɛ b ka na be enɔ to nna na. Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ kayurwushi ba bumo nɛ efuliana nɛ b chena m mata bumo na kikɛ to. 23Basa damta daŋ shi Jerusalɛm nna n ta bumo be esarga m ba sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ ta ŋkɛ malɛ m ba sa ewura Hɛzekaya. Yili loŋ be saŋɛ na efuliana kikɛ daa sa ewura Hɛzekaya bunyaŋ nna.
Ewura Hɛzekaya be kulɔ nɛ mbe kamoowu be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 20:1-3, 12-19; Aizaaya 38:1-3; 39:1-8)
24Jemanɛ ko ka ba fo nɛ kulɔ pɛ ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ e bee sha nɛ e wu. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ sa mo tɔɔnɛ fanɛ e beeŋ nya alenfia. 25Ama ewura Hɛzekaya daa wu mbe kumu na ga nseŋ kini keta kechɔrɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ a laŋɛ kusɔ nɛ e wora n sa mo na so. Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo nsaa shin nɛ e gberge ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa kusoe. 26Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa na bar bumo be amu kaseto nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ alubi be ketampaŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta m paŋ bumo nseŋ maŋ naŋ gberge bumo kusoe n ya fo saŋɛ so nɛ Hɛzekaya wu pɔɛŋ.
Ewura Hɛzekaya be kedamaya nɛ mbe kela be asheŋ
27Ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ dii dama nna ga nɛ ekama daa sa mo bunyaŋ. E daŋ shin nna nɛ b pɔr asɔ be ebuana nɛ baa ta mbe shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ yawukpakpaso be ajembu nɛ efɛa belbelso be asɔ nɛ abɛlso be asɔkuŋso nɛ asɔ lela kikɛ a wɔtɔ ndoŋ. 28Ade be kaman e daa kɔ asɔ be ebuana nɛ e bee ta mbe ayu nɛ asɔnuuso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku a wɔtɔ nsaa kɔ ana nɛ mbolpɔ be aluu be yiriyiri. 29Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nna nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya dii dama ga n tɔ mbolpɔ nɛ mboe nɛ ana n ti so nseŋ pɔr nde damta. 30Ewura Hɛzekaya e daŋ wora nchu be kubɔr nɛ nchu bee shi Gihɔn be kebuye to a bɔla to a yɔ Jerusalɛm be kade to na. Ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ ji kɔŋkɔŋ kusɔ kama nɛ e bee wora to nna. 31Babilɔn be bejuŋkparpoana ka shuŋi mbɔ fanɛ b ya bishi ewura Hɛzekaya etɔɔnɛsheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa mo na, Ebɔrɛ daŋ wora mo nna ŋ keni e bee ji kashenteŋ a sa mo nseŋ shin nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya sa bumo mo gbagba atuwebi.
Ewura Hɛzekaya be kuwura be lalaloge be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 20:20-21)
32B daŋ sibɛ kusɔ kama nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ wora nɛ kananɛ e ji kashenteŋ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna n wɔtɔ Amɔz pibinyɛn Aizaaya be kewuŋkaŋɛ be nwɔl nɛ Juda nɛ Israɛl be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to. 33Ewura Hɛzekaya ka wu, kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura nɛ b kɔ bunyaŋ ga na nɛ b ya puli mo. Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa kikɛ daŋ sa mbe keeliwora kemaŋkura ga. Mo pibinyɛn Manase e daŋ sɔ mo so n ji kuwura.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 33
Content:
Juda be ewura Manase be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 21:1-9)
1Manase daŋ ji nfɛ kuduanyɔ nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki Juda be ewura, nseŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ adunu nɛ anu. 2E daŋ kini kenu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nna nseŋ bɛ efuliana nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ju kasawule na so, saŋɛ so nɛ mbe basa Israɛlebi bee ba kumo so sososo na be asheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kishi ga na so. 3E daŋ lɔŋɛ nna m pɔr efuli pɔtɛana so be agbir nɛ mo tuto ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ mur na nna, nɛ ebɔrɛsure n sa Baal be kegbir na, nseŋ yuu kegbirche Ashira be mpɔrduli, nsaa shuŋ achɛkpabi gba. 4E daŋ pɔr agbir be ebɔrɛsure ashi bɔrɛlambu, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ ba shuŋ mo mbaanaayɔ na, to nna. 5E daŋ pɔr ebɔrɛsure bɔrɛlambu na be alɔnɛ anyɔ na so nna a shuŋ achɛkpabi. 6E daŋ ta mbe mbia nna n lara sarga chɔɔso ashi ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Hinnɔm na to. E daa wora kegbaya nɛ ŋkilgisheŋ nna nsaa yɔ belejipo kutɔ n ya ka kpal nsaa shuŋ bubuni gba a ti so. E daŋ wora alubi damta nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ n shin nɛ mbe agbo kaa ga. 7E daŋ ta kegbir be kapɔrduli nna n yili bɔrɛlambu nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ kumo be asheŋ le n sa ewura Deevid nɛ mo pibinyɛn ewura Sɔlɔmɔn na to. E yɛ: “Bɔrɛlambu ere to ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ n lara ashi Israɛl be efuli so kikɛ fanɛ b baa bunyaŋ ma kumo to mbaanaayɔ. 8Nɛ ma basa Israɛlebi beeŋ bɛ ma mbra nɛ ma keŋini nɛ ma kayɛrbi Mosis ta n sa bumo dra dra na so bre, kumo ere maaŋ shin nɛ b ju bumo ashi kasawule nɛ n ta n sa bumo nananyɛnana na so.” 9Ewura Manase daŋ shin nna nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa wora alubi a chɔ amo nɛ efuliana nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ju kasawule na so saŋɛ so nɛ mbe basa daa ba kumo so sososo na wora na.
10Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kpele ewura Manase nɛ mbe basa kusoe a laŋɛ bumo be alubi be kaplɛa so ama b daa maŋ nu n sa mo. 11Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shin nna nɛ Asiriya be benapo be benimuana ya kɔ n sɔ Juda be efuli na, nseŋ pɛ ewura Manase n ta kekɔltobi ŋ kɔl mbe kamuna to nseŋ ta ŋgbɛlɛbi ŋ kre mo n ta mo n yɔ Babilɔn. 12Ewura Manase ka wɔ kabuti to ashi Babilɔn na nɛ e bar mbe kumu kaseto n sa Enyɛnpe mbe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ kule mo fanɛ e chɛ mo to. 13Nɛ ewura Manase be asheŋ pɛ Ebɔrɛ kuwɔr nɛ e nu mbe kekule nseŋ shin nɛ e bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya kaa ji mbe kuwura. Ndoŋ nɛ ewura Manase pin fanɛ Enyɛnpe na e la Ebɔrɛ.
14Kede be kaman nɛ ewura Manase lɔŋɛ m pɔr ewura Deevid be kade be egbal nyɔsopo na n shin nɛ k dii n ti so. E daŋ fara kebuye nɛ k dese m mata Gihɔn be kaba so na nna m pɔr kumo n ya fo kelargato be esoso be kaba so be kabuna nɛ baa tre Kɔrɔtɔ be Kabuna na be kaba so a mata kade na be kaba nɛ baa tre Kebeegboŋ Ɔfɛl na. Mo alɛ daŋ naŋ shin nna nɛ benapo be benimu nɛ bumo be benapo chena Juda be nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na be kekama to. 15E daŋ lara efuli pɔtɛana so be agbirana nɛ kegbir be kapɔrduli nɛ e daŋ ta n yili bɔrɛsure na ase na nna ashi bɔrɛlambu na to. Nseŋ lara agbir be ebɔrɛsureana nɛ e pɔr n yili kebee nɛ b pɔr bɔrɛlambu na n yili so na nɛ Jerusalɛm be kade to kikɛ, n ta amo kikɛ n lar kade na be ekarso n ya lɛ. 16E daŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ baa lara kɔnɔkoŋwuleso nɛ kechɔrɔ be esarga kumo so na nna n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nseŋ kaŋɛ Juda be basa kikɛ fanɛ b baa shuŋ Enyɛnpe nɛ Ebɔrɛ na. 17Nɛ basa na bɛ kusɔ nɛ ewura Manase kaŋɛ na so, ama b daŋ ya ka shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nna ashi kakpa nɛ baa shuŋ bumo be agbirana na. 18Kusɔ kama nɛ ewura Manase daŋ wora na, nɛ mbe kabɔrɛkule, nɛ abɔya kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na daŋ bɔla anebiana so n sa mo na kikɛ be asheŋ wɔ Israɛl be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl na to. 19Ewura Manase be kabɔrɛkule nɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ nu mbe kekule, nɛ alubi nɛ e wora kikɛ pɔɛŋ nseŋ chɛrga, nɛ nnyamase be agbirana nɛ e shuŋ nɛ mboŋ nɛ e pɔr kegbirche Ashira nɛ agbirana be mpɔrduli, nɛ asheŋ nɛ e wora kikɛ be asheŋ wɔ anebiana be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to. 20Manase ka wu, ewura be laŋ to nɛ b daŋ puli mo, nɛ mo pibinyɛn Ammɔn sɔ mo so n ji kuwura.
Juda be ewura Ammɔn be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 21:19-26)
21Ammɔn daa la nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki Juda be ewura, mo alɛ nseŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ anyɔ. 22E daŋ wora alubi nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kananɛ mo tuto ewura Manase daŋ wora na gbagba. Agbir nɛ mo tuto daŋ shuŋ na, amo nɛ mo alɛ gba daŋ shuŋ. 23Ammɔn bre daa maŋ chɛrga mbe nfɛra m bar mbe kumu ase n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kananɛ mo tuto daŋ wora na. Mo ere be kulubi gba daa chɔ mo tuto peya ga.
24Ewura Ammɔn be benapo be benimuana daŋ we n wɔtɔ abar nna n ya mɔ mo ashi ewura be laŋ to. 25Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juda be basa mɔ basa nɛ b mɔ ewura Ammɔn na nseŋ ta mo pibinyɛn Josaya ŋ ki ewura.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 34
Content:
Juda be ewura Josaya be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 22:1-2)
1Josaya daŋ ji nfɛ aburwa nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki Juda be ewura, mo alɛ daŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ adesa nɛ kako nna. 2E daa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito nna nsaa bɛ mo nananyɛn ewura Deevid be aya so nɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra na kikɛ so dede.
3Josaya ka ji kuwura be kafɛ burwasopo to, jemanɛ nɛ e kra la kabrantiɛfɔlbi na, nɛ e fara a bunyaŋ mo nananyɛn ewura Deevid be Ebɔrɛ na. Mbe kuwurji be kafɛ kuduanyɔsopo to, nɛ e fara a jija mboŋ nɛ nnyamase bee shuŋ bumo be agbir, nɛ kegbirche Ashira be mpɔrduli nɛ agbir nɛ b shɛl, nɛ amo nɛ b ŋalga asɔ n wora na kikɛ ashi Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm to. 4E daŋ shin nna nɛ b bure kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal na be ebɔrɛsure nɛ ebɔrɛsure nɛ baa chɔɔ duwu amo so na. Nseŋ shin nɛ b bɛa kegbirche Ashira be mpɔrduli nɛ agbir nɛ a ka na kikɛ to n lɛ basa nɛ b daa shuŋ amo na be nchaŋana so. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Josaya shin nɛ b chɔɔ agbirwuraana na be awibi ashi ebɔrɛsure nɛ b daa shuŋ agbir na so. Nɛ kumo be loŋ shin nɛ Juda be efuli so ebi nɛ Jerusalɛm to ebi lar kagbirshuŋ be eyurpi to. 6E daŋ wora loŋ koŋwule na nna ashi ndegboŋana nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a wɔ Manase be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nɛ Efrayim nɛ Simiɔn be eyiri be nsawule so hale n ya fo Naftali be kelargato be esoso be kaba so kikɛ. 7E daŋ bure ebɔrɛsure nɛ kegbirche Ashira be mpɔrduli nɛ a wɔ Israɛl be kelargato be esoso be kaba so be efuli so kikɛ nna nseŋ kɔr agbir na to nseŋ bɛa ebɔrɛsure nɛ baa chɔɔ eduwu amo so na to kpachɛrkpachɛrbi. E ka wora loŋ n loge nɛ e bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm.
8Ewura Josaya ka ji kuwura be kafɛ kuduaburwasopo to saŋɛ so nɛ e lara asɔ lubi kikɛ ashi kasawule na so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be lambu to na, nɛ e shuŋi mbe benimuana asa fanɛ b ya shin nɛ b lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na to. Benimu na e daa la Shafan nɛ e la Azaliya pibinyɛn na nɛ Gomena Maseya nɛ e shi Jerusalɛm na nɛ Jɔa nɛ e la Jɔahaz pibinyɛn nɛ e bee sibɛ gomena be asɔ a nase nwɔl to na. 9Le be basa asa ere daŋ ta amansherbi nɛ Livaiebi nɛ baa keni bɔrɛlambu be mbunaana so na daŋ sɔ ashi Manase be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so be basa, nɛ Efrayim nɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b ka na, nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Jerusalɛm na, nna n ya sa bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Hilkiya. 10Loŋ be amansherbi na nɛ b ta n sa benyɛn asa nɛ baa keni bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ be kushuŋ so na, nɛ bumo alɛ ta amo n sa 11ekapɛnta nɛ bepɔrpo na fanɛ b tɔ ajembu nɛ ndibi n lɔŋɛ ebu nɛ Juda be bewura na shin nɛ k jija na. 12Basa nɛ b daŋ shuŋ kushuŋ na daŋ ji kashenteŋ ga. Livai be basa ana e daa keni bumo so. Basa ana na e daa la Jahaf nɛ Obadaya nɛ b shi Mɛrari be kabuna na, nɛ Zakareya nɛ Meshulam nɛ b shi Kohaf be kabuna na. Livaiebi ko malɛ nɛ b nyi nshɛ be keboŋ ga na 13e daa keni basa nɛ baa sulɔ ajembu nɛ ndibi nɛ b kɔ a pɔr na nɛ bumo nɛ baa shuŋ ashuŋ be yiri yiri na so, nɛ beko malɛ la besibɛpo nɛ beko malɛ bee keni mbunaana na so.
14B ka lara amansherbi na ebu nɛ baa ta asɔ a wɔtɔ na to, nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Hilkiya wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra be kawɔl nɛ e ta n sa Mosis dra dra na ashi keshishɛrsawule na so na. 15Hilkiya daŋ ta kawɔl na nna n sa Shafan nɛ e la esibɛpo ashi ewura be laŋ to na nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “N wu mbra be kawɔl ere bɔrɛlambu to nna.” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Shafan ta kumo n ya sa ewura na nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Yiramu, an wora kusɔ kama nɛ fo kaŋɛ anyi na kikɛ. 17An ta amansherbi nɛ a wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to na n sa beshumpo na nɛ basa nɛ baa keni bumo so na kikɛ.” 18Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Bɔrɛmatapo Hilkiya e ta kawɔl ere n sa ma.” Nseŋ kraŋ kumo awɔrso n sa ewura na.
19Ewura na ka nu kusɔ nɛ k wɔ mbra be kawɔl na to na, nɛ e kpɛa mbe epiŋi to kagbenejijaso, 20nseŋ tre Hilkiya nɛ Shafan nɛ Ahikam nɛ e la Shafan pibinyɛn na nɛ Abdɔn nɛ e la Maika pibinyɛn na n ta Asaya nɛ e la mo gbagba be kenya na m ba shɛr abar so epul na to nseŋ kaŋɛ le: 21“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo beeŋ ba wɔ ma nɛ ma basa kama nɛ b kra wɔ Israɛl nɛ Juda na so ga ŋkpal an nananyɛnana ka maŋ nu n sa mo nseŋ kini kewora kusɔ nɛ kawɔl ere bee ŋini fanɛ b wora na so. Amoso men ya bishi n fin kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha fanɛ an wora.”
22Ndoŋ nna nɛ Hilkiya nɛ basa nɛ ewura na shuŋi na yɔ anebiche nɛ baa tre Hulda nɛ e wɔ Jerusalɛm be kelargato be esoso be kaba so na kutɔ. Hulda mo kul Shallum nɛ e la Tikva pibinyɛn nsaa la Hahas mo nanabi na e daa keni bɔrɛlambu na be epiŋi so. B daŋ kaŋɛ anebi na kusɔ nɛ k wora kikɛ nna, 23nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b bɛta n yɔ ewura na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo 24le be kubɔya nɛ k shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ere. E yɛ Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Meeŋ gberge Juda be basa kikɛ kusoe fanɛ kananɛ b kraŋ kawɔl na to ashi Juda be ewura be anishito na. 25Ŋkpal b ka kini ma nsaa lara esarga a sa efuli pɔtɛana be agbirana so ma agbo kaa ga. Kusɔ nɛ b wora na so, ma agbo maaŋ wushi kikɛ. 26Ewura na bre, kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo nde.
