Fo ere nu kusɔ nɛ b sibɛ n wɔtɔ kawɔl na to 27nseŋ chɛrga fo nfɛra m bar fo kumu kaseto ŋ kpɛa fo asɔbuuso to kagbenejijaso a shu ŋkpal ŋ ka kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ gberge Juda be basa kusoe so. N nu fo kabɔrɛkule, 28amoso kasogberge nɛ ŋ kɔ a ba Juda be basa so na maaŋ ba, ama fo wu kagbenewushiso nna pɔɛŋ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na ta kubɔya na m ba sa ewura Josaya.
Ewura Josaya ka kre kewora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kasonu be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 23:1-20)
29Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura Josaya tre Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be bejuŋkparpo na kikɛ m ba abar so 30nɛ mo nɛ bumo nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ basa nɛ b ka na, damawuraana nɛ betirpo kikɛ, n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to. B ka shɛr na nɛ ewura na kraŋ Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be kawɔl nɛ b daŋ wu bɔrɛlambu na to na bumo kikɛ be anishito. 31Kumo be kaman nɛ e yili shabɔrɛ na be kakpa nɛ bewura bee chena na n nase kɔnɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ e beeŋ bugi mbe kagbene kikɛ n wora kasonu n sa mo nseŋ bɛ mbe mbra nɛ asheŋ nɛ e yili n sa bumo na nɛ kɔnɔ naseso be ŋkre be asheŋ nɛ b sibɛ n wɔtɔ kawɔl na to na kikɛ so. 32E daŋ shin nna nɛ Bɛnjamin be yiri to be basa nɛ bekama nɛ b daa wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to na kikɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ baaŋ baa bɛ kɔnɔ naseso be ŋkre na so. Amoso Juda be basa daa bɛ bumo nananyɛnana nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso be ŋkre na so nna. 33Ewura Josaya daŋ mur agbir nɛ Ebɔrɛ kishi ga na nna ashi Israɛl be kasawule na so kikɛ. Mo alɛ ka daa wɔ ŋkpa to na, e daŋ shin nna nɛ basa na bee shuŋ Enyɛnpe bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na nna.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 35
Content:
Ewura Josaya ka ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 23:21-23)
1Ewura Josaya daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ b ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na ashi Jerusalɛm m maŋkura Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na; nɛ b mɔ kejigboŋ na be kubɔlpo na kufɔl sososo na be nchɛ kuduana na. 2E daŋ sa bɔrɛmatapoana na kushuŋ nɛ k daga fanɛ b baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to nna, nseŋ leŋ bumo to fanɛ b baa shuŋ kumo nɛnɛ. 3Kusɔ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ Livaiebi nɛ b ta m bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ nɛ b la Israɛlebi be mbra ŋinipoana na nde: “Men maaŋ naa sulɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ŋkre be deka cheembi na a nite a kilgi to, ŋkpal manɛ so k tea yil bɔrɛlambu nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ e la ewura Deevid pibinyɛn na pɔr nɛ menyeeŋ baa shuŋ Enyɛnpe men be Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mbe basa Israɛlebi na to nna. 4Men wora shiriya mbuna mbuna so n shuŋ kushuŋ nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ mo pibinyɛn ewura Sɔlɔmɔn sa menyi na, 5nseŋ barga men be amu to, saŋɛ na so Israɛl be kanaŋ kikɛ beeŋ baa nya kechɛto men kutɔ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to. 6Basa baŋ bar kebansonchoŋ be ekpakpafɔlbi nɛ mboe, menyi e daga fanɛ men mɔ amo n lɔŋɛ amo nseŋ fɔr menyi be amu so daŋkare be ekpa so pɔɛŋ n ta amo n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ shin nɛ Israɛlebi e bɛ keŋini nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta n sa Mosis na so n ji kejigboŋ na. Amoso men keta men be amu nɛnɛ, n sa maŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ k beeŋ shin nɛ men wora eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so.”
7Mbɔlpo nɛ mboe ŋgboŋ adesa, nɛ egbolu malɛ ŋgboŋ asa nɛ ewura Josaya gbagba daŋ lara n sa fanɛ b ta n lara kebansonchoŋ be sarga na. 8Mbe benimuana na gba daŋ lara asɔbɔya nna n sa basa na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na. Hilkiya nɛ Zakareya nɛ Jehiɛl nɛ baa keni bɔrɛlambu na so na gba daŋ ta ekpakpafɔlbi nɛ mboe ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ alfa ashe nɛ egbolu alfa asa nna n sa bɔrɛmatapoana na fanɛ b ta n lara sarga kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na be kachɛ na. 9Konaya nɛ Shemaya nɛ Natanɛl nɛ b la Konaya mo sipoana na, nɛ Hashabia nɛ Jeɛl nɛ Jozabad nɛ b la Livaiebi be benimu na gba daŋ bar ekpakpafɔlbi nɛ mboefɔlbi ŋgboŋ anu nɛ egbolu alfa anu nna m ba sa Livaiebi na fanɛ b ta n lara sarga.
10B ka daŋ bela kusɔ kama ase n loge nsaa shin nɛ b ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na, nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na ya yili bumo be eyilikpa nɛ ewura na daŋ sa bumo na. 11B ka mɔ ekpakpafɔlbi na nɛ mboe na n loge, nɛ Livaiebi na bɛ amo nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na malɛ ta amo be ŋklaŋ ŋ ŋmenyaŋ bɔrɛsure na so. 12Ndoŋ nna nɛ b barga eblaŋ nɛ baaŋ ta n lara sarga chɔɔso na to n sa basa na kanaŋ kanaŋ nɛ ntuŋ ntuŋ so fanɛ kananɛ Mosis ŋini mbe mbra na to na gbagba chap. Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ b daŋ ta egbolu na gba n wora. 13Livaiebi na daŋ tɔ kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ be esargablaŋ na edɛ to nna fanɛ kananɛ mbra na ŋini na gbagba chap, nseŋ chige amo manaŋ manaŋ n sa basa na. Mpuliya nɛ edadishani nɛ echeenshi nɛ b daŋ ta n daŋɛ eblaŋ nɛ a ka na bre. 14Bɔrɛmatapoana na daŋ chɔɔ asɔbɔya nɛ baa chɔɔ kelelemuto na nna, nɛ asɔbɔya be eblaŋ lela nɛ baa chɔɔ a lara sarga na bɔrɛsure na so nna hale nɛ kanyɛ ya biri. B ka wora ade kikɛ n loge, nɛ Livaiebi na chige eblaŋ nɛ a ka na to n sa bumo be amu nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b la Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi na. 15Livaiebi nɛ b la beshɛbompo nsaa shi Asaf be kabuna na bre daa wɔ kaboŋ nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ Asaf nɛ Heman nɛ Jedutum nɛ e la ewura Deevid be anebi na daŋ yili fanɛ b baa wɔ na nna. Bekumpo nɛ baa keni bɔrɛlambu na be mbuna so na gba daa maŋ yige bumo be ashuŋ, ŋkpal bumo braana Livaiebi na ka shuŋ kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na be kushuŋ n sa bumo so. 16Ewura Josaya daŋ shin nna nɛ b ji Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na, nseŋ chɔɔ esarga bɔrɛsure na so m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kananɛ b yili kumo dra dra na gbagba chap. 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛl be basa na ta nchɛ ashunu m bɛ abar so n ji Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na. Kumo koŋwule nɛ baa tre Bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi na be kejigboŋ na. 18Baŋ yili anebi Samuɛl be jemanɛ so kikɛ, basa daŋ maŋ naŋ shɛr alegaiso n ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ loŋ kikɛ. Bewura nɛ b ji n choŋ na be ekama daŋ maŋ ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ fanɛ kananɛ ewura Josaya nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ Juda nɛ Israɛl nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa kikɛ chala n ji kumo na. 19Ewura Josaya ka ji kuwura be kafɛ kuduaburwasopo to nɛ b daŋ ji le be kejigboŋ ere.
Ewura Josaya be kuwurji be lalaloge be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 23:28-30)
20Ade kikɛ be kaman, saŋɛ nɛ ewura Josaya lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na to n loge na, nɛ ewura Neeko nɛ e shi Ijipt be efuli so, juŋkpar mbe benapo n yɔ Kachimish nɛ k wɔ Yufreetes be lɔrgboŋ na ase na nɛ b ya kɔ kena. Nɛ ewura Josaya gba nɛ mbe benapo lar n yɔ nɛ b ya tu bumo ŋ kɔ, 21nɛ ewura Neeko ta le be kubɔya ere n sa ewura Josaya. E yɛ: “Juda be ewura, fo kɔnɔ maŋ ti kena nɛ mee kɔ ere so. Mannɛ fo nɛ m ba nɛ m ba kɔ, ndoŋana nɛ m ba nɛ m ba kɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n wora loŋ manaŋ. Ebɔrɛ wɔ ma kaman, amoso sa maŋ kuŋ ma akpa, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e beeŋ mur fo.” 22Ama ewura Josaya bre daŋ baa yili kena na be kekɔ so nna. E daŋ kini kenu kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla ewura Neeko so ŋ kaŋɛ na nna nseŋ chɛrga mbe asɔbuuso n yɔ Magido be kepla na so n ya kɔ ewura Neeko kena.
23Kena na to nɛ Ijipt be benapo ko to atanyembi n da ewura Josaya. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ mbe nyɛrbi le: “Men keta ma n lar nfe, ŋkpal manɛ so n doro ga!” 24Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lara mo gbaŋɛturko nɛ e daa wɔtɔ na to n wɔtɔ mbe gbaŋɛturko pɔtɛ to n yɔ Jerusalɛm. E ka wu, nɛ b ya puli mo kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura na, nɛ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa kikɛ shu mbe keeli.
25Ndoŋ nna nɛ anebi Jɛremaya wora ewura Josaya be keeli be kashɛ. Israɛl be benyɛn nɛ beche kra boŋ kashɛ na a nyiŋi ewura Josaya be luwu saŋkama. Loŋ be kashɛ na wɔ Israɛlebi be nli be nshɛ be kawɔl to.
26Ewura Josaya be kananɛ e ta mbe kumu m bɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ nɛ kananɛ e daa wora kasonu a sa Enyɛnpe be mbra na, 27nɛ mbe sososo nɛ lalaloge kikɛ be kusɔ nɛ e wora kikɛ wɔ Israɛl nɛ Juda be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to.

Title: 2 KRONIKƐLS 36
Content:
Juda be ewura Jehowahaz be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 23:30-35)
1Ewura Josaya ka wu be kaman nɛ Juda be basa lara mo pibinyɛn Jehowahaz ŋ ki Juda be ewura. 2Jehowahaz daa la nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ asa nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki Juda be ewura nseŋ ji kuwura afɔl asa ashi Jerusalɛm to. 3Ijipt be ewura Neeko daŋ pɛ Jehowahaz nna nseŋ tintiŋ Judaebi nɛ b ka gbiti kilo ŋgboŋ asa nɛ alfa ana nɛ shuwa kilo adesa nɛ ana n sa mo. 4Ewura Neeko daŋ shin nna nɛ Jehowahaz mo da Eliakim ki Juda be ewura nɛ e chɛrga mbe ketre ŋ ki Jehowakim. E daŋ ta Jehowahaz nna n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so n ya ti ebu.
Juda be ewura Jehowakim be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 23:36—24:7)
5Jehowakim daa la nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ anu nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki Juda be ewura nseŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ kudukako. E daŋ wora alubi nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe mbe Ebɔrɛ na. 6Jemanɛ nɛ Jehowakim bee ji kuwura na nɛ Babilɔn be ewura Nebukadneeza kɔ n sɔ Juda nseŋ pɛ Jehowakim n ta danyaŋ be ŋgbɛlɛbi ŋ kre mo n yɔ Babilɔn. 7Ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ ta Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛ lambu na to be asɔ lela nna n ya wɔtɔ mbe laŋ to ashi Babilɔn. 8B daŋ sibɛ asɔ kama nɛ ewura Jehowakim daŋ wora, nɛ asheŋ lubi nɛ Ebɔrɛ kishi ga kama nɛ e daŋ wora na kikɛ n wɔtɔ Israɛl nɛ Juda be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to nna. Mo pibinyɛn Jehowachin e daŋ sɔ mo so n ji kuwura.
9Jehowachin daa la nfɛ kuduaburwa nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki Juda be ewura. Mo alɛ daŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to afɔl asa nɛ nchɛ kudu nna. Mo alɛ gba daŋ wora kulubi nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 10Dɔchubɔrɛ be jemanɛ ka fo nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza pɛ Jehowachin nseŋ ta bɔrɛlambu na to be asɔ lela n ti mo so n yɔ Babilɔn nseŋ ta Jehowachin mo wɔpa Zɛdikaya ŋ ki Jerusalɛm be ewura.
11Zɛdikaya daa la nfɛ adunyɔ nɛ kako nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki Juda be ewura, mo alɛ nseŋ ji kuwura Jerusalɛm to nfɛ kudukako. 12E daŋ wora kulubi nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nseŋ kini kebar mbe kumu kaseto n nu anebi Jɛremaya be kubɔya nɛ k shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na.
13Ewura Zɛdikaya daŋ kini kenu n sa ewura Nebukadneeza nɛ e daŋ tintiŋ mo nɛ e bɔ Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e beeŋ bugi kagbene a shuŋ mo na nna. E daa kɔ kumu kpakpaso nna nseŋ kini kechɛrga m bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juda be basa nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na wora alubi damta nɛ Ebɔrɛ kishi ga na. B daa shuŋ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a chena m mata bumo na be agbirana nna, nsaa wora eyurpisheŋ a gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu cheembi nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm to na. 15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la bumo nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na daa shuŋi anebiana nna, nɛ baa kpele bumo kusoe ŋkpal e ka daa maa sha kemur mbe basa nɛ mbe bɔrɛlambu nɛ e wɔ kumo to na so. 16Ama b daŋ kplaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga so nna nsaa wora mbe mbɔ nɛ e daa shuŋi bumo kutɔ na amɔmɔshiasheŋ nsaa mushe mbe anebiana na, hale nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be agbo kaa alegaiso nɛ shɛŋ maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ k sɔ basa na.
17Ŋkpal loŋ so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nna nɛ Babilɔn be ewura nɛ mbe benapo ba kɔ bumo kena, nseŋ mɔ Juda be mbrantiɛbia nɛ b wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to na. E daa maŋ wu esa kikɛ kuwɔr, nseŋ mɔ mbifɔlbi nɛ benimu nɛ benyɛn nɛ beche nɛ belɔpo nɛ alenfiawuraana kikɛ. Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nna nɛ e mɔ basa kikɛ kade na to. 18Ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ ta bɔrɛlambu na to be amansherbi nɛ kumo to be asɔ nɛ a ka kikɛ nna n ta ewura na nɛ mbe benimuana be amansherbi kikɛ n ti so m bɛta n yɔ Babilɔn. 19Ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ chɔɔ bɔrɛlambu na nɛ ewura be laŋ nɛ kade na kikɛ nna nseŋ da kumo be egbal n lɛ. 20E daŋ pɛ basa nɛ b maŋ wu kena to na nna n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli wɔfɔ na nɛ b ya ki mo nɛ mbe mbia be anya hale n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ Pɛshiya be efuli so be kuwurji fara a ji eleŋ na. 21Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛl be kasawule na dese nfɛ adushunu nɛ esa maŋ wɔ kumo so, nɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla anebi Jɛremaya so ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kasawule na beeŋ ki keshishɛrsawule n dese nfɛ adushunu na, bɔlɔ so.
Ewura Sairus ka shin nɛ Juwebi na bɛta m ba Juda be asheŋ
(Ɛzra 1:1-4)
22Pɛshiya be ewurgboŋ nɛ baa tre Sairus na be kuwurji be kafɛ juŋkparso to nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e sibɛ kubɔya ere n wɔtɔ nwɔl to nseŋ chige nwɔl na n sa mbe efuli so kikɛ ebi nɛ b kraŋ nwɔl na awɔrso, saŋɛ na so kusɔ nɛ e bɔlɔ anebi Jɛremaya so m malga na beeŋ bɔlɔ so.
23“Ma Sairus nɛ n la Pɛshiya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na e naa kaŋɛ menyi le na fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na e ta durnya ere kikɛ be kuwura m buu ma nseŋ ta bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ k wɔ Juda be efuli so na be kushuŋ n sa ma. Amoso, menyi bekama nɛ men la Ebɔrɛ be basa na e yɔ n ya lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na m pɔr. Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ menyi kutɔ.”

Title: ƐZRA 1
Content:
Ewura Sairus ka shin nɛ Juwebi bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm be asheŋ
1Sairus ka ji Pɛshiya be kuwura be kafɛ juŋkparso to nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ mbe kamalga nɛ e bɔla anebi Jɛremaya so m malga n nase na bɔlɔ so. E daŋ shin nna nɛ Pɛshiya be ewura Sairus sa ebɔl fanɛ b sibɛ n sa efuli na so ebi kikɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ 2kusɔ nɛ Pɛshiya be ewura, Sairus, kaŋɛ nde: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na e ta efuliana nɛ e wɔ durnya ere kikɛ to be kuwura m buu ma, nseŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n ya pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa mo ashi Jerusalɛm nɛ k wɔ Juda be efuli so na. 3Bekama nɛ b la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa beeŋ tiŋ n yɔ n ya lɔŋɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ Jerusalɛm to na be bɔrɛlambu na m pɔr. 4Bekama nɛ bumo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa chena n sha abar e ta shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ asɔ lela be yiri kikɛ nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ baaŋ ta n ya lara sarga ashi Ebɔrɛ be lambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm to na n chɛ bumo to.”
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be nnaŋ to be benimuana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ bekama nɛ bumo be ŋgbene daa wɔ kebɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm to na bela ase nɛ b yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya pɔr Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be lambu na. 6Basa nɛ b tu bumo n chena na kikɛ daŋ ta shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ asɔ lela be yiri kikɛ nɛ asɔbɔya be yiri kikɛ nna n chɛ bumo enɔ so. Yawu kpakpaso be asɔ nɛ asɔ nɛ baaŋ ta n ya lara sarga ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ b daŋ sa bumo. 7Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ ewura Sairus bɛta echeenshi nɛ ekurwa nuunchu nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ ta bɔrɛlambu na to ashi Jerusalɛm n ya wɔtɔ mbe agbir be ebu to na n sa bumo. 8Mitrɛdat nɛ e daa la basa nɛ baa keta ewura be amansherbi be enimu na nɛ e shin nɛ e karga amo m bɔɔ Shɛshbaza nɛ e daa la Juda be efuli so be gomena na enɔ. 9-10Kananɛ asɔ na daa sa nde: Shuwa be echeenshi daa wɔ adesa nɛ gbiti be echeenshi daa wɔ kagboŋ koŋwule nɛ gbiti be echeenshigboŋ daa wɔ adunyɔ nɛ akpanu, nɛ shuwa be echeenshiwurbi daa wɔ adesa, nɛ gbiti be echeenshiwurbi daa wɔ alfa ana nɛ kudu, nɛ asɔ pɔtɛ malɛ daa wɔ kagboŋ koŋwule.
11Shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ asɔ pɔtɛ nɛ a ti so na kikɛ daa wɔ ŋgboŋ anu nɛ alfa ana. Nɛ Shɛshbaza nɛ mo braana nɛ b yɔ kenyaya to na bɛta amo n shi Babilɔn m ba Jerusalɛm.

Title: ƐZRA 2
Content:
Basa nɛ b shi Babilɔn be efuli so m ba na be asheŋ
1Basa nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ pɛ n yɔ kenyaya to ashi Babilɔn be efuli so nɛ bumo be galeŋga daŋ naŋ bɛta m ba bumo ndeana to ashi Juda be efuli so na e daa la. 2Bumo e la: Zerubabel nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Nehemaya nɛ Seraya nɛ Reelaya nɛ Mɔdikaya nɛ Bilshan nɛ Mispa nɛ Bigvai nɛ Rehum nɛ Baana.
Israɛl be mbuna ebi nɛ kananɛ b sa nseŋ bɛta m ba bumo be efuli so e daa la 3Parush be kaman to ebi daa la basa ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ kalfa nɛ adushunu nɛ anyɔ. 4Shɛfatiya be kaman to ebi daa la basa alfa asa nɛ adushunu nɛ anyɔ. 5Ara be kaman to ebi daa la basa alfa ashunu nɛ adushunu nɛ anu. 6Pahaf Mowab be kaman to ebi nɛ b shi Joshuwa nɛ Jɔab be mbuna na malɛ daa la basa ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ alfa aburwa nɛ kudu anyɔ. 7Elam be kaman to ebi daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ alfa anyɔ nɛ adunu nɛ ana. 8Zatu be kaman to ebi daa la basa alfa akpanu nɛ adena nɛ anu. 9Zakayi be kaman to ebi daa la basa alfa ashunu nɛ adeshe. 10Bani be kaman to ebi daa la basa alfa ashe nɛ adena nɛ asa. 11Bebaye be kaman to ebi daa la basa alfa ashe nɛ adunyɔ nɛ asa. 12Azgad be kaman to ebi daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ alfa anyɔ nɛ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ. 13Adonikam be kaman to ebi daa la basa alfa ashe nɛ adeshe nɛ ashe. 14Bigvai be kaman to ebi daa la basa ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ adunu nɛ ashe. 15Adin be kaman to ebi daa la basa alfa ana nɛ adunu nɛ ana. 16Atɛɛ, nɛ mo koŋwule na la Hɛzekaya na, be kaman to ebi daa la basa adekpanu nɛ aburwa. 17Bezayi be kaman to ebi daa la basa alfa asa nɛ adunu nɛ asa. 18Jora be kaman to ebi daa la basa kalfa nɛ kudu anyɔ. 19Hashum be kaman to ebi daa la basa alfa anyɔ nɛ adunyɔ nɛ asa. 20Giba be kaman to ebi daa la basa adekpanu nɛ anu. 21Nde nɛ amo to be basa bɛta m ba malɛ e daa la: Bɛtlɛhɛm ebi daa la basa kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ asa. 22Netofa ebi daa la basa adunu nɛ ashe. 23Anatɔf ebi daa la basa kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ aburwa. 24Azmavɛf ebi daa la basa adena nɛ anyɔ. 25Kiriaf Jeerim nɛ Kɛfira nɛ Beerɔt ebi daa la basa alfa ashunu nɛ adena nɛ asa. 26Rama nɛ Geba ebi daa la basa alfa ashe nɛ adunyɔ nɛ kako. 27Mikmash ebi daa la basa kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ. 28Bɛtɛl nɛ Ai ebi daa la basa alfa anyɔ nɛ adunyɔ nɛ asa. 29Nebo ebi daa la basa adunu nɛ anyɔ. 30Magbish ebi daa la basa kalfa nɛ adunu nɛ ashe. 31Elam nyɔsopo na ebi malɛ daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ alfa anyɔ nɛ adunu nɛ ana. 32Hiram ebi daa la basa alfa asa nɛ adunyɔ. 33Lɔd nɛ Hadid nɛ Ono ebi daa la basa alfa ashunu nɛ adunyɔ nɛ anu. 34Jɛriko ebi daa la basa alfa asa nɛ adena nɛ anu. 35Sɛnaa ebi daa la basa ŋgboŋ asa nɛ alfa ashe nɛ adesa. 36Basa nɛ b daŋ shi bɔrɛmatapoana be kanaŋ to m ba malɛ nde: Jedaya nɛ e shi Joshuwa be kanaŋ to be kaman to ebi daa la basa alfa akpanu nɛ adushunu nɛ asa. 37Imma be kaman to ebi daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ adunu nɛ anyɔ. 38Pashɔ be kaman to ebi daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ alfa anyɔ nɛ adena nɛ ashunu. 39Hiram be kaman to ebi daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ kudu ashunu. 40Livai be kabuna ebi nɛ b bɛta m ba nde: Joshuwa nɛ Kadmiɛl nɛ b shi Hodaviya be kanaŋ to be kaman to ebi daa la basa adushunu nɛ ana. 41Beshɛbompo nɛ b shi Asaf be kanaŋ to m bɛta m ba daa la basa kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ aburwa. 42Basa nɛ b daa keni bɔrɛlambu na be mbuna so nseŋ shi Shalum nɛ Atɛ nɛ Talmɔn nɛ Akuub nɛ Hatita Shobayi be nnaŋ to na daa la basa kalfa nɛ adesa nɛ akpanu. 43Bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo nɛ bumo be mbuna ebi bɛta m ba na nde: Ziha nɛ Hasufa nɛ Tabaof, 44nɛ Kɛros nɛ Siaha nɛ Padon, 45nɛ Lebana nɛ Hegaba nɛ Akuub, 46nɛ Hegab nɛ Shalmayi nɛ Hanan, 47nɛ Gidɛl nɛ Gaha nɛ Rɛaya, 48nɛ Rezin nɛ Nekoda nɛ Gazam, 49nɛ Yuza nɛ Pasea nɛ Besaya, 50nɛ Asna nɛ Mɛyunim nɛ Neefusim, 51nɛ Bakbuk nɛ Hakufa nɛ Haahɔɔ, 52nɛ Bazlɔt nɛ Mehida nɛ Haasha, 53nɛ Baakɔs nɛ Sisɛra nɛ Tɛma, 54nɛ Nezia nɛ Hatifa. 55Sɔlɔmɔn be nyɛrbi be kaman to ebi nɛ b bɛta m ba e daa la Sotayi be kaman to ebi nɛ Hasofɛrɛt be kaman to ebi nɛ Pɛruda be kaman to ebi 56nɛ Jaala be kaman to ebi nɛ Dakɔn be kaman to ebi nɛ Gidɛl be kaman to ebi nɛ 57Shefatiya be kaman to ebi nɛ Hatil be kaman to ebi nɛ Pokerɛf Hazabeem nɛ Ami be kaman to ebi.
58Bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpoana be kaman to ebi nɛ Sɔlɔmɔn be nyɛrbi be kaman to ebi kikɛ daa la basa alfa asa nɛ adekpanu nɛ anyɔ nna.
59Basa nɛ b daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini Israɛl be kanaŋ nɛ b shi kumo to kikɛ ama nseŋ shi Tɛl Mɛla nɛ Tɛl Hasha nɛ Kerub nɛ Adɔn nɛ Imma be nde to m ba na e daa la.
60Delaya be kaman to ebi nɛ Tobaya be kaman to ebi nɛ Nekoda be kaman to ebi. Bumo kikɛ daa la basa alfa ashe nɛ adunu nɛ anyɔ.
61Bumo nɛ b shi bɔrɛmatapoana be kabuna ama bumo alɛ be asheŋ daa maŋ wɔ nwɔl to a ŋini fanɛ b shi bɔrɛmatapoana be kanaŋ to na malɛ e daa la Hobaya be kaman to ebi nɛ Hakkoz be kaman to ebi nɛ Baazilaya be kaman to ebi. B daa tre mo Baazilaya nna ŋkpal e ka daŋ ta Giliad be efuli so be eche nɛ e shi Baazilaya be kanaŋ to so.
62Ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ ka maŋ wɔ nwɔl to fanɛ b shi bɔrɛmatapoana be kabuna so, b daŋ maŋ sɔ bumo fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana. Amoso b daa maŋ sa bumo ekpa fanɛ b shuŋ bɔrɛmatapoana be kushuŋ. 63Ndoŋ nna Juwebi be gomena yili fanɛ b maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ b ji ajibi nɛ b ta n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ na n ya fo fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana ka beeŋ ba bishi Ebɔrɛ m pin fanɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana nna ŋko b maŋ la.
64Basa nɛ b daŋ shi Babilɔn m ba na daŋ fo basa ŋgboŋ adena nɛ anyɔ nɛ alfa asa nɛ adeshe nna. 65Nɛ bumo be nyɛrbi nɛ mbita malɛ daa la basa ŋgboŋ ashunu nɛ alfa asa nɛ adesa nɛ ashunu. Beshɛbompo malɛ daa la basa alfa anyɔ. 66Bumo be egbaŋɛ daa la alfa ashunu nɛ adesa nɛ ashe nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ kurma nɛ gbaŋɛ gama ŋ kurge na malɛ daa la alfa anyɔ nɛ adena nɛ anu. 67Enyɔma daa la alfa ana nɛ adesa nɛ anu, nɛ ekurma malɛ daa la ŋgboŋ ashunu nɛ alfa ashunu nɛ adunyɔ.
68Basa na ka fo kakpa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na daa yil ashi Jerusalɛm to na nɛ nnaŋ be benimuana na bugi ŋgbene n lara keparso be esarga n sa fanɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na m pɔr n yili kumo be epul dra na to. 69Kananɛ ekama daa beeŋ tiŋ nɛ e daŋ sa nɛ amo kikɛ koso shuwa be ndarbi alfa anu nɛ gbiti be ndarbi ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ alfa aburwa, nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana be epiŋi malɛ kalfa. 70Kumo be kaman, nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ beshɛbompo na nɛ basa nɛ baa keni bɔrɛlambu na be mbuna so na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpoana na nɛ basa na to be beko gba kikɛ yɔ n ya chena bumo be ndeana to. Nɛ Israɛlebi nɛ b ka na malɛ gba yɔ bumo be ndeana to n ya chena.

Title: ƐZRA 3
Content:
Bɔrɛsure na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr be asheŋ
1Israɛlebi na daŋ ta afɔl ashunu nna n chena bumo be ndeana to n loge. Kumo be kaman nɛ bumo kikɛ ba shɛr Jerusalɛm to. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jozadak pibinyɛn Joshuwa nɛ mo braana bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Shɛɛltiɛl pibinyɛn, Zerubabel, nɛ mo kurgepoana fara nɛ b pɔr Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛsure, saŋɛ na so baŋ tiŋ a lara esarga kumo so fanɛ kananɛ Mosis be mbra bee ŋini na. 3Kufu nɛ k daa wɔ bumo to ŋkpal basa nɛ b kulti bumo na kikɛ be kaman, b daŋ pɔr bɔrɛsure na n yili kumo be gbaltɔlase dra na so nna. Kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ b daa lara esarga bɔrɛsure na so nna a sa Ebɔrɛ. 4B daŋ ji Abuu to be kachɛgboŋ na nna fanɛ kananɛ mbra na bee ŋini na gbagba chap. Esarga nɛ a daga b lara karechɛ kama be kachipurso nɛ kaaseso kikɛ na nɛ b daŋ lara. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ b lara sarga chɔɔso nɛ k daga na malɛ gba. Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ lara kufɔl popɔr be esarga nɛ esarga kama nɛ a daga fanɛ b baa lara nchɛgboŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yili n sa bumo na kikɛ. 6Kufɔl shunusopo na be kachɛ juŋkparso na nɛ b fara sarga chɔɔso be kelara n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ama loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ b maŋ naŋ tɔl Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na be gbaltɔlase gba.
Bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr be asheŋ
7Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ basa na sa bepɔrpo nɛ ekapɛnta amansherbi nseŋ ta ajibi nɛ asɔnuuso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku n shuŋi n ya sa Sidɔnebi nɛ Tayɛebi fanɛ b ku sida be ndibi n yili Lebanɔn n ta amo m bɔla teku so m bar bumo ashi Jɔpa fanɛ kananɛ Pɛshiya be ewura, Sairus, kaŋɛ na.
8Kafɛ nɛ Israɛlebi na ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be lambu na ase ashi Jerusalɛm to na be kufɔl nyɔsopo to nɛ Shɛɛltiɛl pibinyɛn, Zerubabel nɛ Jozadak pibinyɛn, Joshuwa nɛ bumo kurgepoana, nɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ bekama nɛ b bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm to na, fara bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr. B daŋ lara Livaiebi nɛ b fo nfɛ adunyɔ m baŋ so na nna fanɛ b baa keni kushuŋ na so. 9Joshuwa nɛ mo bibinyɛn nɛ mo kurgepoana nɛ Kadmiɛl nɛ mo bibinyɛn, nɛ b la Hodaviya be kaman to ebi na, n ta Hɛnadad nɛ mo bibinyɛn nɛ mo kurgepoana nɛ bumo kikɛ shi Livai be kabuna na e daŋ ber abar so a keni basa nɛ baa pɔr Ebɔrɛ be lambu na so.
10Bepɔrpo na ka baŋ tɔl Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be lambu na be gbaltɔlase na n loge, nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana ta bumo be epiŋi m buu nseŋ ta mbel nɛ Asaf be mbinyɛnso nɛ b la Livaiebi na malɛ ta edawuro, nɛ bekama yili bumo be eyilikpa nseŋ fara a boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ Ebɔrɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ketande nɛ ewura Deevid nase n sa bumo nna na. 11Le be kapandi be kashɛ nɛ b daa boŋ a fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na walɛ;
Kasha nɛ e kɔ n sa Israɛl na maŋ kɔ ekar.”
Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kikɛ fara a kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na awɔrso, ŋkpal b ka tɔl mbe lambu na be gbaltɔlase so. 12Basa kpar nɛ b daa la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ nnaŋ be benimuana na be galeŋga ka daa nyi kananɛ lambu dra na daa du so, b ka wu kepopɔr ere be gbaltɔlase na nɛ b shu awɔrso; ama beko bre daa wora awɔr kagbenefuliso nna. 13K daa du kpakpa nɛ kepin awɔr nɛ b daa wora na be kumo nɛ k daa la kagbenefuli peya nɛ kumo nɛ k daa la kushu peya. Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa na kikɛ daa wora awɔr na nna ga nɛ k daa yɔ kufɔ kufɔ.

Title: ƐZRA 4
Content:
Beko ka maŋ shuli fanɛ b pɔr bɔrɛlambu na be asheŋ
1Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin ebi be bedoŋ ka nu fanɛ Israɛlebi na bɛta m ba nɛ b ba lɔŋɛ Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be lambu m pɔr, 2nɛ b yɔ Zerubabel nɛ mbuna mbuna be benimuana na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ le: “Men shin nɛ an chɛ menyi to n pɔr. Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi nɛ menyi kikɛ bee shuŋ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule nna. Yili jemanɛ nɛ Asiriya be ewura, Esahadɔn, bar anyi kasawule ere so hale m ba fo kabre; menyi be Ebɔrɛ ere nɛ anyi alɛ gba bee shuŋ nsaa lara sarga a sa.”
3Nɛ Zerubabel nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Israɛl be mbunaana na be benimuana na malɛ kaŋɛ bumo: “Anyi maa sha menyi be kechɛto ashi bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr n sa Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na to. Anyi nawule beeŋ tiŋ m pɔr kumo fanɛ kananɛ Pɛshiya be ewura, Sairus yili na.”
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ Judaebi be bechenashapoana na fara a funti bumo a fin kananɛ baaŋ wora m pɔ Judaebi na aba nseŋ shin nɛ kufu a pɛ bumo nɛ b yige lambu na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr. 5Nɛ b ya ber Pɛshiya be gomena be benimu ko paa fanɛ b ba funti Judaebi na n lara bumo lambu na be kapɔr to. Ewura Sairus be jemanɛ so nɛ b keta kumo loŋ hale m ba fo ewura Dariɔs be jemanɛ so.
Beko ka maŋ shuli fanɛ b lɔŋɛ Jerusalɛm m pɔr be asheŋ
6Kafɛ nɛ ewurgboŋ Zɛɛzɛs ji kuwura na nɛ basa nɛ b daa wɔ Juda nɛ Jerusalɛm to na be bedoŋ sibɛ kawɔl ŋ ku bumo kɔnɔ.
7Pɛshiya be ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs be jemanɛ to gba, Bishlam nɛ Mitrɛdat nɛ Tabil nɛ bumo braana sibɛ kawɔl nna n sa ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs. Aramaik be ŋgbar to nɛ b daŋ sibɛ kumo.
8Rehum nɛ e daa la gomena na nɛ Shimshayi nɛ mo alɛ daa la efuli na be esibɛpo na e sibɛ kawɔl na n sa ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs a malga Jerusalɛm be asheŋ a kaŋɛ le:
9“Rehum nɛ e la gomena na nɛ Shimshayi nɛ e la efuli na be esibɛpo na nɛ bumo braana demujipoana nɛ benimuana nɛ baa keni basa nɛ b shi Tripolis nɛ Pɛshiya nɛ Erɛk nɛ Babilɔn be efuliana so na, n ta Elam ebi nɛ b shi Susa na nɛ 10basa nɛ bunyaŋwura Ashubanipal daŋ shin nɛ b ba chena Samɛria be kadegboŋ to na nɛ nde nɛ a wɔ Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be kasawule so na kikɛ e naa sibɛ kawɔl ere na.
11Ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs, fo nyɛrbi nɛ fo basa nɛ b chena lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kasawule so na e naa sibɛ fo kawɔl ere:
12‘Yiramu, anyee sha fo pin fanɛ Juwebi nɛ b shi fo kutɔ m ba anyi kutɔ nfe na yɔ Jerusalɛm nna n ya kaa lɔŋɛ kade lubi nɛ k maŋ kɔ kasonu na a pɔr. B tiŋ n fara a pɔr kumo be egbalana nsaa lɔŋɛ kumo be gbaltɔlaseana gba. K maaŋ chɛr baaŋ pɔr kumo n loge.
13Yiramu, nɛ basa ere baŋ lɔŋɛ kade ere m pɔr nɛ kumo be egbalana kikɛ yili, kumo ere b maaŋ naŋ ka lampo ŋko toto kikɛ n sa ewura. Loŋ malɛ beeŋ shin nɛ ewura be kpanjawu to be amansherbi a duga so. 14Ŋkpal fo ka wɔ anyi a keni so nɛ anyi alɛ maa sha ewura ka ji nyɔmɔ so nɛ anyee sibɛ fo kawɔl ere na 15nɛ fo shin nɛ b keni fo nananyɛnana nɛ fo tutoana be nwɔl nɛ a dese na to. Feeŋ wu fanɛ le be kade ere la kade lubi nna nɛ k bee bar etɔrɔ bewura so. Kusɔ nɛ k bar kumo be kemur nna na. 16Yiramu, anyee sha fo baa nyi fanɛ nɛ b baŋ lɔŋɛ kade ere m pɔr, kumo ere shɛŋ maaŋ naa shi Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa a ba fo kutɔ.’ ”
17Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na malɛ ta ebɔl ere n shoŋi bumo. E yɛ: “Ebɔl ere shi ma, ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs, kutɔ nna a yɔ Rehum, nɛ e la gomena nɛ Shimshayi, nɛ mo alɛ la efuli na so be esibɛpo na nɛ bumo braana nɛ b wɔ Samɛria nɛ Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be kasawule so na kikɛ kutɔ.
Ma kechɔrɔ nde!”
18B daŋ kraŋ nseŋ kilgi kawɔl nɛ men sibɛ n shoŋi na n sa ma. 19Nɛ n shin nɛ b keni asheŋ na to nseŋ wu fanɛ kashenteŋ nɛ kade na la kade lubi dra dra kikɛ. B daa maa sa bewura kashuli. Bumo alɛ daa kɔ keŋkenshi nɛ kagbene kpakpaso ga. 20Bewura nɛ b daŋ ji eleŋ ga daŋ chena Jerusalɛm to nseŋ daŋ ji kuwura basa nɛ b daa tase Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be kasawule so, bumo alɛ daa tu bumo a sɔ elampo nɛ atoto nna. 21Men sa basa na ebɔl fanɛ b yige kade na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr na n ya fo fanɛ ŋ ka beeŋ naŋ sa bumo ekpa. 22Men baa de so nsaa maaŋ ta kesheŋ ere m pɛl n shin nɛ ewura e paŋ mbe kepar.
23B ka kraŋ ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs be kawɔl na n sa Rehum nɛ Shimshayi nɛ bumo braana na nɛ b wora manaŋ n ya tintiŋ Juwebi nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na fanɛ b yige kade na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr.
24Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kapɔr na shir n yili loŋ hale n ya fo Pɛshiya be ewurgboŋ Dariɔs be kuwurji be kafɛ nyɔsopo to.

Title: ƐZRA 5
Content:
1Heegai nɛ Iddo pibinyɛn, Zakareya, nɛ b daa la anebiana na daŋ bɔla Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee keni bumo so na be ketre so nna m malga n sa Juwebi nɛ b daa wɔ Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm to na. 2Kumo be kaman nɛ Shɛɛltiɛl pibinyɛn, Zerubabel, nɛ Jozadak pibinyɛn, Joshuwa, naŋ fara Ebɔrɛ be lambu na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr ashi Jerusalɛm to, nɛ anebiana na daa chɛ bumo to.
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kasawule so be gomena, Tatɛnayi, nɛ Shɛta Bozenayi nɛ bumo braana yɔ bumo kutɔ n ya bishi bumo le: “Wanɛ e sa menyi ekpa fanɛ men lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu ere m pɔr?” 4Kumo be kaman nɛ b bishi basa nɛ baa pɔr lambu na be atre. 5Ama ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka daa keni Israɛl be benimuana na so so, Pɛshiya be benimuana na daŋ maŋ tiŋ n ju bumo kapɔr na be kushuŋ to. B daa sha kesibɛ kawɔl nna n sa ewurgboŋ Dariɔs nseŋ nu kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ kaŋɛ pɔɛŋ.
6Kawɔl nɛ Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be efuli so be gomena, Tatɛnayi, nɛ Shɛta Bozenayi nɛ bumo braana nɛ benimu nɛ b wɔ Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be efuli so na sibɛ n chise ewurgboŋ Dariɔs nde: 7“Yiramu, anyi be bunyaŋ be kechɔrɔ nde!
8Yiramu, anyee sha nna nɛ fo pin fanɛ an yɔ Juda be efuli so n ya wu fanɛ basa na bee lɔŋɛ a pɔr Ebɔrɛ Ewurgboŋ na be bɔrɛlambu na. Ajembu gbɛgbɛso nɛ ndibi gbɛgbɛso nɛ b kɔ a pɔr kumo. Kenishipereso nɛ baa pɔr kumo, amoso kushuŋ na bee yɔ manaŋ manaŋ nna a sa bumo.
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ an bishi benimuana na fanɛ wanɛ e sa bumo ekpa fanɛ b lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na m pɔr? 10Anyi alɛ naŋ bishi m pin bumo be bejuŋkparpo be atre, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ sibɛ amo n chise fo.
11Ama kusɔ nɛ b kaŋɛ nde:
‘Anyi ere la Ebɔrɛ nɛ esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ la mo peya na be anya nna. Bɔrɛlambu nɛ Israɛl be ewurgboŋ ko daŋ pɔr nfɛ damta nɛ a choŋ na nɛ anyee lɔŋɛ a pɔr. 12Ŋkpal an tutoana ka daŋ wora n da Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ esoso na so so, e daŋ nya agbo nna nseŋ shin nɛ Babilɔn be Ewurgboŋ, Nebukadneeza, nɛ e shi Chaldian, ba kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ Nebukadneeza pɛ bumo anya n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so.
13Ama kafɛ nɛ ewurgboŋ Sairus ji Babilɔn be kuwura na, nɛ e sa kɔnɔ fanɛ a daga b naŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr Ebɔrɛ be lambu na. 14Mo alɛ daŋ naŋ bɛta Ebɔrɛ be lambu to be shuwa nɛ gbiti be asɔ nɛ ewurgboŋ Nebukadneeza daŋ ta ashi Jerusalɛm n ya wɔtɔ mbe agbir be ebu to ashi Babilɔn na n sa Shɛɛshbaza, nɛ e daa la Juda be gomena na nna. 15E ka ta amo n sa Shɛɛshbaza na nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ e ta asɔ ere n ya wɔtɔ bɔrɛlambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na to; nseŋ lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be lambu na m pɔr n yili kumo be epul dra na gbagba to. 16Nɛ Shɛɛshbaza ba tɔl bɔrɛlambu na be gbaltɔlase. Yili loŋ be jemanɛ na m ba fo kabre, kapɔr na bee pɔr gbrɛgbrɛbi nna. K maŋ naŋ loge bre. 17Yiramu, nɛ fee sha, fo shin nɛ b keni Babilɔn be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to, feeŋ wu fanɛ kashenteŋ nɛ ewurgboŋ Sairus daŋ sa ekpa fanɛ b lɔŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be lambu na m pɔr ashi Jerusalɛm to. Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura e shin nɛ an nu kusɔ nɛ e bee sha demu ere to.’ ”

Title: ƐZRA 6
Content:
Kusɔ nɛ Ewurgboŋ Dariɔs yili be asheŋ
1Nɛ Ewurgboŋ Dariɔs kaŋɛ fanɛ b keni Babilɔn be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to, nɛ b wora loŋ. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ b wu kawɔl ko ashi Midia be efuli so be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ɛkbatana na. Kubɔya nɛ k daa wɔ kawɔl na to nde:
3Kafɛ nɛ ewurgboŋ Sairus ji kuwura na nɛ e sa kɔnɔ a yɔ Ebɔrɛ be lambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm to na be kaplɛa so le:
“Bɔrɛlambu nɛ k daa wɔ Jerusalɛm to na daga kelɔŋɛ m pɔr nseŋ shin nɛ k baa la kakpa nɛ basa beeŋ baa lara esarga. Kumo be gbaltɔlase gba daga ketɔl. A daga kumo be jeŋgreŋ e baa la ayadra adekpanu nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ gba e baa la ayadra adekpanu. 4Nɛ b baa pɔr kumo be egbalana, a daga b ka ta ndibi kpakpaso m bɛ ajembu be egbal asa kama nɛ baaŋ pɔr m bɛ abar so so. Kumo be pɔr be kukɔ na beeŋ shi ewura be amansherbi be lɔkɔ to nna. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ b bɛta shuwa nɛ gbiti be asɔ nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza sulɔ n shi bɔrɛlambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm to n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na kikɛ n yɔ amo be mboŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.”
Ewura Dariɔs ka sa kɔnɔ fanɛ kushuŋ na e naŋ fara be asheŋ
6Kede be kaman nɛ ewurgboŋ Dariɔs sibɛ kawɔl n shoŋi Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be kasawule so be gomena, Tatɛnayi, nɛ Shɛta Bɔzanayi nɛ bumo braana nɛ b daa la efuli na be benimu na kikɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b sa maŋ naŋ yɔ bɔrɛlambu na ase kikɛ. 7E yɛ: “Men sa maŋ naŋ ta menyi be asheŋ n wea bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr na be asheŋ to. Men shin nɛ Juwebi be gomena nɛ bumo be benimuana na e lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na m pɔr n yili kumo be eyilikpa dra na.
8Ma alɛ naa yili kumo nna a sa menyi fanɛ men chɛ bumo to m pɔr bɔrɛlambu na. Kukɔ kama nɛ k ba kapɔr na be kaplɛa so, men lara amansherbi ashi amansherbi nɛ menyee sɔ Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be efuli so na to ŋ ka, nɛ kushuŋ na e sa maaŋ shir n yili. 9Karechɛ kikɛ, men baa sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na asɔ fanɛ egbolu nɛ ekpakpa nɛ ekpakpafɔlbi nɛ ayu nɛ nfɔl nɛ yabra belbelso nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ baa sha nɛ b ta n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na kikɛ. 10Loŋ e naŋ shin nɛ b lara esarga nɛ a beeŋ par Ebɔrɛ nɛ mo alɛ e nɛfa ma nɛ ma kaman to ebi kikɛ.
11Ma, ewura, bee yili kumo nna fanɛ esa kama nɛ e chɛrga ma kamalga ere, meeŋ shin nɛ b pee mbe ebu be keyɔri nseŋ shɛl kumo n da mo n futi m bɔl. Kumo be kaman nɛ b bure mbe kowu na kikɛ nɛ k ki kelambure. 12Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe ketre deŋ Jerusalɛm be bɔrɛlambu na so na malɛ e mur ewura kama ŋko basa kama nɛ baaŋ chɛrga kusɔ nɛ n yili ere ŋko n fin bɔrɛlambu ere be kejija.
Kusɔ nɛ ma, ewura Dariɔs yili nna na. Ekama daga fanɛ e nuu nseŋ bɛ kumo so.”
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ Tatɛnayi, nɛ e la gomena na nɛ Shɛta Bɔzanayi nɛ bumo braana nɛ benimuana na wora m bɛ kusɔ nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ na so. 14Juwebi be bejuŋkparpo na daŋ wora asɔ ga ashi bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr na to. Bumo alɛ daŋ naa nya keleŋto ashi anebi Heegai nɛ Zakareya, nɛ e shi Iddo be kanaŋ to na be keŋini to. Kananɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ bɔla Pɛshiya be bewura fanɛ Sairus nɛ Dariɔs nɛ Atazɛzɛs so ŋ ŋini bumo kananɛ e bee sha bɔrɛlambu na gbagba chap nɛ b daŋ pɔr kumo. 15Ewurgboŋ Dariɔs ka ji kuwura be kafɛ shesopo be kufɔl nɛ Juwebi bee tre Ada na be nchɛ asa to nɛ b pɔr bɔrɛlambu na n loge. Ada la Hibruwebi be kafɛ to be kufɔl kuduanyɔsopo nna.
16Kumo be kaman nɛ Israɛlebi na, bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ bekama nɛ b bɛta m ba na kikɛ, be ŋgbene fuli bumo ga nɛ b ta bɔrɛlambu na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ. 17Kachɛ nɛ b ta bɔrɛlambu na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ na, egbolu kalfa nɛ ekpakpa alfa anyɔ nɛ mbolpɔ alfa ana nɛ b ta n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ. B daŋ mɔ mboe kudu anyɔ nna n lara sarga ŋ kule alubi be ketampaŋ n sa Israɛl be nnaŋ kudu anyɔ na kikɛ. 18B daŋ ŋini bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na ashuŋ nɛ baŋ baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to ashi Jerusalɛm to fanɛ kananɛ anebi Mosis be mbra bee ŋini na nna.
Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na be asheŋ
19Juwebi be kebɛta m ba na be kufɔl juŋkparso na to be nchɛ kudu ana na nɛ b ji kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na. 20Bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na daŋ fɔr bumo be amu so daŋkare be ekpa so nna, nɛ kulubi kikɛ daŋ maŋ naŋ gbiti bumo. Nɛ Livaiebi na mɔ kebansonchoŋ be asɔbɔya na n sa bumo kurgepoana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ bumo gbagba. 21Basa nɛ b chena m mata Israɛlebi na nseŋ lara bumo be amu ashi nnyamase nɛ bumo be agbirsheŋ to nseŋ ta bumo be amu n sa Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na e tu Israɛlebi na n ji kejigboŋ na. 22Nchɛ ashunu nɛ baa ji bodobodo nɛ k maŋ kɔ yiisi na be kejigboŋ na kagbenefuliso Bumo be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo nna ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka chɛrga Asiriya be ewura be kagbene nseŋ shin nɛ e chɛ bumo to nɛ b lɔŋɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na m pɔr so.

Title: ƐZRA 7
Content:
Anebi Ɛzra ka ba Jerusalɛm to be asheŋ
1Asheŋ ere kikɛ be kaman nɛ anebi Ɛzra shi Babilɔn be efuli so m bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm Pɛshiya be ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs be jemanɛ to. Kananɛ anebi Ɛzra be kanaŋ to lar nde: Ɛzra mo tuto e daa la Seraya, nɛ Seraya malɛ mo tuto daa laa Azariya nɛ mo alɛ daa la Hilkiya pibinyɛn. 2Hilkiya mo tuto e daa la Shalum nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto daa la Zadɔk. Zadɔk mo tuto e daa la Ahitub. 3Ahitub malɛ mo tuto e daa la Amariya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto daa la Mɛrerɔf. 4Mɛrerɔf mo tuto e daa la Zerahiya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto daa la Uzzi nɛ e daa la Bukki pibinyɛn na. 5Bukki mo tuto e daa la Abishuwa nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto daa la Finihas. Finihas mo tuto e daa la Eliaza nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Ɛɛrɔn pibinyɛn. 6Ɛzra daŋ shi Babilɔn be efuli so nna m ba Jerusalɛm. E daa la eŋinipo nɛ e daa nyi Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be mbra nɛ e ta m bɔla Mosis so n sa mbe basa na ga nna. Ewura na daŋ sa Ɛzra kusɔ kama nɛ e daŋ kule mo na nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa ka daa wɔ mo so so. 7Ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs ka ji kuwura be kafɛ shunusopo to nɛ Israɛlebi na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ nshɛbompoana na nɛ mbunagboŋ kenipoana na nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be beshumpo na kikɛ shi Babilɔn be efuli so m bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm to.
8Loŋ be kafɛ shunusopo na be kufɔl nusopo na to nɛ Ɛzra bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm. 9Kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ juŋkparso na nɛ e daŋ koso Babilɔn be efuli so nseŋ ba fo Jerusalɛm kufɔl nusopo na be kachɛ juŋkparso. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr wu be nɛfa daa wɔ anebi Ɛzra so nna. 10Ɛzra bre daŋ ta Ebɔrɛ be mbra na be kekoya nɛ amo be kenu nseŋ wora, nɛ mbra na be atande be keta ŋ ŋini Israɛl be efuli so kenishipereso nna.
Kawɔl nɛ ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs sibɛ n sa Ɛzra na be asheŋ
11Kawɔl nɛ ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs sibɛ n ta m bɔɔ Ɛzra nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo nɛ eŋinipo nsaa nyi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be atande nɛ e ta n sa Israɛlebi na nde: 12“Ma, ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs, e naa sibɛ kawɔl ere a sa fo, Ɛzra, nɛ fo la bɔrɛmatapo nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na be mbra ŋinipo na. Fo kechɔrɔ nde! 13Mee sa kɔnɔ fanɛ Israɛlebi be esa kama, n ta bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi kikɛ n ti so, nɛ e bee sha ketu fo n yɔ Jerusalɛm be efuli so beeŋ tiŋ m bɛ fo so n yɔ. 14Ma, ewura nɛ ma ejinatopo ashunu, e naa shuŋi fo fanɛ fo ya keni Judiya nɛ Jerusalɛm be efuli so be asheŋ to a laŋɛ fo Ebɔrɛ be mbra nɛ e ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ na be kaplɛa so. 15Fo alɛ kaŋ yɔ fo ta shuwa nɛ egbiti nɛ ma nɛ ma ejinatopoana ta n sa Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe lambu wɔ Jerusalɛm to na a yɔ. 16Ta shuwa nɛ egbiti nɛ baaŋ sa fo ashi Babilɔn be efuli so na nɛ esarga nɛ basa na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na beeŋ lara a laŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kaplɛa so na gba n ti so. 17Ya ta amansherbi na be ako n tɔ egbolu nɛ ekpakpa nɛ mbolpɔ nseŋ ta ako malɛ n tɔ ajibi nɛ asɔnuuso n lara sarga bɔrɛsure nɛ k wɔ Ebɔrɛ be lambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na so. 18Amansherbi nɛ a beeŋ ka na malɛ, fo nɛ fo kurgepoana Juwebi na beeŋ ta amo n wora kusɔ kama nɛ k daga nsaa par men be Ebɔrɛ na. 19Asɔ kama nɛ b ta n sa fo fanɛ fo ta n ya shuŋ Ebɔrɛ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to na, daga fanɛ fo ta amo n ya wora loŋ. 20Kusɔ kama nɛ k daga fanɛ fo nya a laŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na be kepɔr be kaplɛa so, feeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni ewura be kpanjawu to n fin kumo. 21Ma, ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs, e naa sa bekama nɛ baa keni Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be efuli so be amansherbi so na ebɔl fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ Ɛzra, nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra na be eŋinipo na bee sha, b sa mo. 22Hale nɛ e bee sha gbiti nɛ amo be egbɛ fo fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ asa nɛ alfa ana ŋko ayu nɛ amo be egbɛ fo fanɛ kilo ŋgboŋ kudu ŋko yabra belbelso be egalɔn alfa ashe ŋko nfɔl kanaŋkamaso gba, a daga fanɛ b sa mo amo. 23Kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e bee sha, a daga fanɛ b wora kumo kananɛ e bee sha na manaŋ manaŋ n sa mo. Men sa maŋ shin e nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma ŋko bekama nɛ baaŋ ba ma kaman na. 24A maŋ daga fanɛ b tu bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ beshɛbompo na nɛ mbunagboŋ kenipoana na nɛ bekama nɛ baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to na kikɛ n sɔ toto be yiri kikɛ. 25Ɛzra, ta kanyiasheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa fo na ŋ keni to n lara sheriajipoana nɛ demujipoana nɛ b baa keni to a ji asheŋ ashi Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be efuli so ndoŋ. A daga fanɛ b baa la basa nɛ b nyi fo Ebɔrɛ na be mbra na. Fo alɛ e naaŋ baa ŋini bekama nɛ b maŋ nyi amo na. 26Esa kama nɛ e kini kewora m bɛ fo Ebɔrɛ na be mbra so ŋko ewura be mbra so daga luwu ŋko keju n lar efuli na so ŋko kesuge mbe kapetɛ kikɛ ŋko n ti amodoŋwura ebu be kasogberge nna.” 27Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛzra kaŋɛ le: “Kemaŋkura e baa la an nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na peya. Mo e sa ewura na le be nfɛra nɛ e ta bunyaŋ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be lambu nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na. 28Mo, Ebɔrɛ koŋwule, na be katiŋ to so nɛ ewura nɛ mbe benimu nɛ basa gboŋana na kikɛ wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ shin nɛ n nya le be ekpa ere na. N nyɛnpe nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ na so nɛ n nya kagbene n ta kenyɛn m malga n sa Israɛl be benimu kpakpaso nɛ b nu nseŋ bɛ ma so n yɔ Jerusalɛm na.”

Title: ƐZRA 8
Content:
Nnaŋ to be benimu nɛ b tu Ɛzra n yɔ na be asheŋ
1Israɛl be nnaŋ nɛ b daa wɔ kenyaya to ashi Babilɔn be efuli so nseŋ bɛ Ɛzra so m bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm na be benimu e daa la: 2Gɛɛshɔm nɛ e shi Finihas be kabuna na, nɛ Danɛl nɛ mo alɛ shi Itama be kabuna na, 3nɛ Shekanaya pibinyɛn, Hatush, nɛ mo alɛ gba shi Deevid be kabuna na; nɛ Zakareya nɛ e shi Parosh be kabuna na nɛ basa kalfa nɛ adunu e daŋ ba nɛ bumo kikɛ be atre daa dese nwɔl to; 4Zɛrahiya pibinyɛn, Eliɛhɔnayi, nɛ e shi Pahaf Mowab be kabuna nɛ basa alfa anyɔ ko e daŋ ba; 5Jahaziɛl pibinyɛn, Shekanaya, nɛ e shi Zaatu be kabuna nɛ basa alfa asa ko e daŋ ba; 6Jonatan pibinyɛn, Ebed, nɛ e shi Adin be kabuna nɛ basa adunu e daŋ ba; 7Atalia pibinyɛn, Jeshaya, nɛ e shi Elam be kabuna nɛ basa adushunu e daŋ ba; 8Maikel pibinyɛn, Zebadiya, nɛ e shi Shɛfatiya be kabuna nɛ basa aduburwa e daŋ ba; 9Jehiɛl pibinyɛn, Obadaya, nɛ e shi Jɔab be kabuna nɛ basa alfa anyɔ nɛ kuduaburwa e daŋ ba; 10Josifɛya pibinyɛn, Shɛlomit, nɛ e shi Bani be kabuna nɛ basa kalfa nɛ adeshe e daŋ ba; 11Bebaye pibinyɛn, Zakareya, nɛ e shi Bebaye be kabuna nɛ basa adunyɔ nɛ aburwa e daŋ ba; 12Hakatan pibinyɛn, Johanan, nɛ e shi Azgad be kabuna nɛ basa kalfa nɛ kudu e daŋ ba; 13Ɛlifɛlɛt nɛ Jeɛl nɛ Shemaya nɛ b shi Adonikam be kabuna, nseŋ ti bumo nɛ b shir kaman m ba na so na, nɛ basa adeshe k e daŋ ba; 14Utai nɛ Zakɔɔ nɛ b shi Bigvai be kabuna na nɛ basa adushunu malɛ e daŋ ba.
Ɛzra ka fin Livaiebi nɛ baaŋ baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to be asheŋ
15Ndoŋ nna nɛ n shɛr basa na kikɛ kabombi nɛ k bee shile a yɔ kade nɛ baa tre Ahava na nɛ an daŋ ji nchɛ asa ndoŋ na ase. Ŋ ka keni basa na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na to n daa maŋ wu Livaiebi bumo to. 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ n shuŋi n tre Eliaza nɛ Ariɛl nɛ Shemaya nɛ Ɛlnatan nɛ Jarib nɛ Ɛlnatan nɛ Netan nɛ Zakareya nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ b daa la bejuŋkparpo na. Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ tre Jowarib nɛ Ɛlnatan nɛ b daa la basa nɛ b koya nsaa kɔ kenyi ga na nna. 17Kumo be kaman nɛ n shuŋi bumo Kasifiya be efuli so be enimu nɛ baa tre Iddo nɛ mo braana, nɛ b la bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo na, kutɔ fanɛ b sa anyi basa nɛ baaŋ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be kushuŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to. 18Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔrwu ka daa wɔ anyi so so, Livainyɛn ko nɛ e shi Maali be kabuna nɛ baa tre mo Shɛribiya na nɛ b daŋ lara n sa anyi. E daa shuŋ ga. Mo nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi nɛ mo siponyɛnsoana kuduaburwa e daŋ ba. 19Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ shin nɛ Hashabia nɛ Jeshaya nɛ b shi Mɛrari be kabuna malɛ nɛ bumo kurgepoana adunyɔ gba ba. 20Kumo be kaman, b daŋ naŋ shin nɛ basa nɛ ewura Deevid nɛ mbe benimu daŋ yili kumo fanɛ b baa chɛ Livaiebi na to na to be basa alfa anyɔ nɛ adunyɔ ba nɛ b baa ka chɛ to a shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to.
21Ahava be kabombi na ase nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ a daga an kikɛ ka kishi nseŋ bar anyi be amu kaseto ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito nseŋ kule mo nɛ e juŋkpar anyi nseŋ keni anyi nɛ anyi be mbia nɛ anyi be asɔ kikɛ so ashi anyi be enite to. 22K daa beeŋ baa la nyɔmɔ nna n sa ma, fanɛ an ka beeŋ kaŋɛ ewura fanɛ e sa anyi esoji nɛ b baa kuŋ anyi ashi an doŋana kutɔ ashi anyi be enite ere to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, n daŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ an be Ebɔrɛ na bee nɛfa esa kama nɛ e ta mo yirda ŋ wɔtɔ mo to nna. Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kagbene maa fuli esa kama nɛ e kplaŋ mo so so. E bee gberge loŋ be esa kusoe nna. 23Ndoŋ nna nɛ an kishi ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e kuŋ anyi nɛ mo alɛ nu anyi be kekule.
24Nɛ ŋ keni bɔrɛmatapoana na to n lara Shɛribiya nɛ Hashabia nɛ bumo kurgepoana kudu ko n ti bumo so. 25Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ karga gbiti nɛ shuwa nɛ asɔ nɛ ewura nɛ mbe benimu na nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ daŋ ta n chɛ anyi enɔ so fanɛ an ta n ya lara sarga ashi bɔrɛlambu na to na n sa bumo. 26Gbiti be ndarbi alfa ashe nɛ adunu nɛ gbiti be echeenshi kalfa nɛ shuwa be ndarbi kalfa; 27nɛ shuwa be echeenshi adunyɔ, nɛ amo be yawu beeŋ fo fanɛ pɔŋ kagboŋ, nseŋ ta danyaŋ be echeenshi anyɔ, nɛ amo nɛ shuwa be echeenshi be yawu sasa na, n ti so n sa bumo. 28Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Menyi nɛ asɔ ere kikɛ ki asɔ cheembi nna n sa Enyɛnpe men nanaana be Ebɔrɛ na. Shuwa nɛ gbiti na kikɛ la kagbene koŋwule so be sarga nna nɛ an lara n sa Enyɛnpe men tutoana be Ebɔrɛ na. 29Men baa de amo so nɛnɛ hale nɛ men ya fo Jerusalɛm nseŋ karga amo m bɔɔ bɔrɛmatapoana na enɔ ashi bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nɛ Livaiebi nɛ Israɛlebi be nnaŋ be benimu na kikɛ be anishito ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.” 30Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na sɔ gbiti nɛ shuwa be asɔ n ta n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to ashi Jerusalɛm.
Kebɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm be asheŋ
31Kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ kudu anyɔsopo na nɛ an fara n shi Ahava be kabombi na ase a yɔ Jerusalɛm. Anyi nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ e daa la nɛ e daa kuŋ anyi nɛ an doŋana maaŋ kuŋ anyi ekpa n tu anyi ŋ kɔ ŋko beyu e kuŋ anyi ekpa n suge anyi be asɔ. 32An ka ya fo Jerusalɛm nɛ an wushi nchɛ nsa. 33Kachɛ nasopo na nɛ an yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya karga gbiti nɛ shuwa nɛ echeenshi na kikɛ m bɔɔ Uriya pibinyɛn, Mɛremɔf, nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo na enɔ. Mo nɛ Finihas pibinyɛn, Eliaza, nɛ Joshuwa pibinyɛn, Jozabad, nɛ Binuyi pibinyɛn, Nowadiya nɛ b la Livaiebi na e daa la. 34An daŋ karga nseŋ ber kusɔ kama na nna nseŋ sibɛ amo be kananɛ a sa kikɛ n wɔtɔ nwɔl to loŋ be kamɔnchɛ na. 35Basa nɛ b daŋ bɛta m ba na kikɛ daŋ bar esarga nna m ba chɔɔ n sa Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na. B daŋ yili Israɛlebi kikɛ be katelamu to nna n ta egbolu kudu anyɔ nɛ ekpakpa adekpanu nɛ ashe nɛ ekpakpafɔlbi adushunu nɛ ashunu n lara sarga. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta mboe kudu anyɔ n lara sarga ŋ kule alubi be ketampaŋ. B daŋ chɔɔ le be asɔbɔya ere kikɛ nna n lara sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 36Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ ta kawɔl nɛ ewura na sibɛ n sa fanɛ b ta m ba sa Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be efuli so be gomena nɛ ndoŋ be benimu na nna n ya sa bumo. Nɛ bumo alɛ gba chɛ Israɛlebi na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kushuŋ to ga.

Title: ƐZRA 9
Content:
Anebi Ɛzra ka pin Juwebi nɛ basa pɔtɛ be kakil be asheŋ
1Asheŋ ere kikɛ ka wora n loge be kaman, nɛ Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpo na ba kaŋɛ ma fanɛ basa na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na kra maŋ lara bumo be amu ashi basa nɛ b chena ŋ kulti bumo na be asheŋ woraso lubi to. B ta bumo be amu n wɔtɔ Keenanebi nɛ Hitebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ Jebusiebi nɛ Ammɔnebi nɛ Mowabebi nɛ Ijiptebi nɛ Amɔriebi be mbushusheŋ nɛ b daa wora to nna. 2Juwebi be benyɛn nɛ bumo be bibinyɛnsobiana daa ta eyiri pɔtɛana be mbichesobi nna a kil nɛ loŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa maŋ naa du cheembi. Israɛlebi be benimuana na e daŋ sɔ kumo be kejuŋkpar. 3Ŋ ka nu loŋ be kubɔya na nɛ kpɛa ma piŋi to nseŋ gberge ma kumu so nɛ katɔl be emin n tia nseŋ chena kagbenejija to. 4Kagbenejija na to nɛ n chena loŋ hale n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ baa lara kaaseso be sarga na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa nɛ kufu kɔ bumo ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ a laŋɛ alubi be kaplɛa so na ba shɛr ŋ kulti ma. 5Kaaseso be sarga be kelara be jemanɛ ka fo, nɛ n ta kagbenejija nɛ ma asɔ kpɛatoso na loŋ ŋ koso n ya gbir nseŋ maŋ ma enɔana so kabɔrɛkule to ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ na 6nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “O ma Ebɔrɛ, k kɔ ma nyɔmɔ nɛ anishinyɔr nna fanɛ ŋ ka beeŋ maŋ ma enɔ so fo anishito, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be alubi shi m baŋ anyi so hale n dii n ya fo ebɔrɛso gba kuraa. 7Baŋ yili an nananyɛnana be jemanɛ so m ba fo kabre, anyi be alubi baa shi ga nna. Ŋkpal alubi na so, anyi nɛ anyi be bewura nɛ anyi be bɔrɛmatapoana kikɛ ki anya nna n sa efuli pɔtɛ so ebi nɛ baa mɔ anyi nsaa suge anyi be asɔ nseŋ naa pɛ anyi a yɔ kenyaya to. K shin nɛ an ji anishinyɔr ga nseŋ kra ji kumo kabre. 8Ama, O Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ, jemanɛ gbrɛbi nɛ k choŋ ere fo wu anyi kuwɔr nseŋ shin nɛ anyi be beko kra wɔ ŋkpa to ashi fo kakpa cheembi ere. Fo lara anyi kenyaya to nseŋ sa anyi ŋkpa popɔr. 9An daa la anya nna, ama fo maŋ yige anyi kenyaya na to. Fo shin nɛ Pɛshiya be bewura wu anyi kuwɔr nseŋ shin nɛ an kraa wɔ ŋkpa to hale nɛ m ba nya ekpa nɛ an ba lɔŋɛ m pɔr fo bɔrɛlambu nɛ k daŋ ki kelambure a dese na. Kumo be kaman, an naŋ nya anyi be amu a wɔ Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm be kade to. 10O Ebɔrɛ, asheŋ nɛ a wora ere kikɛ be kaman, manɛ nɛ anyeeŋ naŋ kaŋɛ? Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi maŋ wora m bɛ fo 11mbra nɛ fo bɔla anebiana nɛ b daa la fo mbɔ na so n nase n sa anyi na so. B daŋ kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ kasawule nɛ an daa yɔ nɛ an ya chena so na la kakpa nɛ eyurpisheŋ daa shi nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ b daa wɔ kumo so na daa wɔ mbushusheŋ nɛ eyurpisheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to nna. 12Anebiana na daŋ kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ nɛ anyee sha kenu kasawule na be ebel nseŋ ji kumo ŋ ka n yili anyi be kaman to ebi bre, an sa maŋ ta bumo be beche, ŋko ŋ kil bumo be benyɛn. B yɛ anyi alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ ji bumo keteri, ŋko n shin nɛ b ji eleŋ anyi so. 13Kusogberge nɛ k ba anyi so ŋkpal anyi be alubi so ere kikɛ be kaman, an wu fanɛ fo, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na, kraŋ shu anyi so nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ kasogberge nɛ k daga anyi nɛ fo sa anyi na. Fo kraŋ shin nɛ anyi to be beko kraa wɔ ŋkpa to. 14Nɛ manɛ so, nɛ anyeeŋ naŋ kini kebɛ fo mbra na so nseŋ ya ta ŋko ŋ kil le be basa nɛ b wɔ eyurpisheŋ to ere? Nɛ an wora loŋ feeŋ nya agbo n wora anyi nseŋ mur anyi gba kuraa. Fo alɛ maaŋ naŋ shin nɛ anyi to be ekoŋwule gba e baa wɔ ŋkpa to. 15Enyɛnpe Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ, kashenteŋ jipo e la fo. Fo maŋ shin nɛ an mur, ama fo shin nɛ an ji ŋkpa. Anyee shuli kewora n jija fo anishito nsaa nyi fanɛ an daa maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ an ba fo anishito gba kuraa.”

Title: ƐZRA 10
Content:
Israɛlebi ka kre keyige eyiri pɔtɛana be kakil be asheŋ
1Anebi Ɛzra ka wɔ nɛ alubi be ketampaŋ be kabɔrɛkule to nsaa shu ŋkpal bumo be alubi damta nɛ b wora na so na, nɛ Israɛlebi be benyɛn nɛ beche nɛ mbia damta ko ba yili ŋ kulti mo ŋ wɔtɔ a shu kenishipereso. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jehiɛl pibinyɛn, Shekanaya, nɛ e shi Elam be kabuna kaŋɛ anebi Ɛzra: “Anyi maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal befɔche nɛ an ta a kil ere so. Ama tama kra wɔtɔ n sa Israɛlebi. 3To, men shin nɛ an nase kɔnɔ fanɛ anyeeŋ yige loŋ be beche na nseŋ lara bumo nɛ bumo be mbia be asheŋ ashi anyi be asheŋ to nseŋ wora asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ fo nɛ bekama nɛ baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ bee kaa ji anyi asoe to a kaŋɛ na, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ wora asheŋ m bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra na so. 4Kusɔ kama bɔɔ fo enɔ nna na, amoso, koso to nɛ an pɛ fo kashɛr to. Baa kɔ kenyɛn nɛ kusɔ kama e nyalɛ.”
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ anebi Ɛzra koso n shin nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana be bejuŋkparpo nɛ Livaiebi be bejuŋkparpo kikɛ nase nnɔ fanɛ baaŋ wora kusɔ nɛ Shekanaya kaŋɛ na. 6Kumo be kaman nɛ e lar bɔrɛlambu na to n yɔ Eliyashib pibinyɛn, Jehohanan, be ebu to n ya ka wɔ ekishi to. Ajibi nɛ nchu daa maŋ beta mbe kɔnɔ, ŋkpal basa na ka maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ na so.
7Ndoŋ nna nɛ bejuŋkparpo na nɛ benimu na sa ebɔl Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm to fanɛ bekama nɛ b bɛta m ba na kikɛ e shɛr Jerusalɛm to. 8Nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ esa kama nɛ e kini keba nshɛr na to nchɛ asa be kefɛato, beeŋ paŋ mbe asɔ kikɛ. Kumo ba kaman nɛ an lara mo ashi anyi to nɛ e maaŋ naa la anyi to be eko. 9Nchɛ nsa na ka fo, kumo e la fanɛ, kufɔl kpanusopo na be kachɛ kudu anyɔsopo na nɛ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin be efuliana so ebi kikɛ ba shɛr bɔrɛlambu na ase. Ŋkpal nshɛr na ka la kenishipere n sa bumo so b daŋ kplaŋ bɔrɛ so nna nɛ gboŋgboŋi ko bri bumo hale nɛ baa gbugbo. 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛzra, nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo na, koso n yili nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Men maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so men ta befɔche a kil n shin nɛ Israɛl be alubi naŋ wora keshi n ti so. 11Amoso, men tuba n lar men be alubi to ashi men nananyɛnana be Ebɔrɛ na be anishito nseŋ fara a wora mbe aparsheŋ. Men lar basa pɔtɛ nɛ b wea men to ere be asheŋ to nseŋ yige befɔche nɛ men ta a kil na.”
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kikɛ boŋ to awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋ nɛ fo ji! Anyeeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ na. 13Ama basa nɛ b shɛr nfe ere shi ga nɛ bɔrɛ malɛ naa ba ŋkpal loŋ so anyi maaŋ tiŋ a yil kowushina loŋ. Kumo be kaman, kesheŋ na maaŋ la kachɛ koŋwule ŋko nchɛ nyɔ be kesheŋ nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ b wora alubi na shi ga. 14Men shin nɛ anyi be bejuŋkparpo a shir Jerusalɛm ŋ keni demu na to n sa anyi. Kumo be kaman, nɛ an yili kachɛ nɛ bekama nɛ b kɔ befɔche a kil na nɛ bejuŋkparpo na nɛ demujipoana na kikɛ e shɛr Jerusalɛm to nfe. Loŋ e naŋ shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo e wushi nseŋ lar anyi so ŋkpal demu ere so.” 15Asahɛl pibinyɛn, Jonatan, nɛ Tikva pibinyɛn, Jeezia nawule e daa maŋ shuli m bɛ kamalga na so; nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Shabetayi, nɛ e shi Livai be kabuna na, malɛ daa yil bumo be kaman. 16Ŋkpal galeŋga ka daŋ shuli n sa kamalga na so, Ɛzra, bɔrɛmatapo na, daŋ lara bejuŋkparpo na be beko nna n shin nɛ b sibɛ bumo be atre n nase. Kufɔl kudusopo na be kachɛ juŋkparso na nɛ b fara a keni asheŋ na to. 17Afɔl asa nɛ b ta ŋ keni bumo nɛ b daŋ ta befɔche a kil na be asheŋ to.
Benyɛn nɛ b kɔ eyiri pɔtɛ be beche a kil be asheŋ
18Benyɛn nɛ b shi bɔrɛmatapoana be kabuna nsaa kɔ eyiri pɔtɛ be beche a kil na e daa la Maaseia nɛ Eliaza nɛ Jarib nɛ Gɛdaliya nɛ b la Jehozadak be bibinyɛn nseŋ shi Joshuwa nɛ sipoana be kabuna na. 19Bumo kikɛ daŋ nase nnɔ nna fanɛ baaŋ yige eyiri pɔtɛ nɛ b kɔ a kil na. Kumo be kaman nɛ bumo be ekama na ta kpakpa n lara sarga ŋ kule alubi be ketampaŋ. 20Benyɛn nɛ b shi Imma be kabuna nseŋ daa kɔ eyiri pɔtɛ a kil na malɛ e daa la Hanani nɛ Zɛbadiya. 21Bumo nɛ bumo alɛ shi Harim be kabuna nseŋ daa kɔ eyiri pɔtɛ a kil na e daa la Maaseia nɛ Elaija nɛ Shɛmaaya nɛ Jehiɛl nɛ Uziya. 22Basa nɛ bumo alɛ shi Paashɛ be kabuna nseŋ ta eyiri pɔtɛ a kil na e daa la Ɛliyonayi nɛ Maaseia nɛ Ishmaɛl nɛ Netanɛl nɛ Jozabad nɛ Elasa. 23Basa nɛ b shi Livai be kabuna nseŋ ta eyiri pɔtɛ a kil na e daa la Jozabad nɛ Shimɛya nɛ Kɛlaiya, nɛ baa tre mo Kelita na, nɛ Pɛtahiya nɛ Juda nɛ Eliaza. 24Ɛliyashib nɛ e shi beshɛbompo be kabuna na gba daa kɔ yiri pɔtɛ nna a kil. Basa nɛ b daa yili bɔrɛlambu na be mbunagboŋ ase a kuŋ nseŋ ta eyiri pɔtɛ a kil e daa la Shalum nɛ Tɛlɛm nɛ Yuri. 25Basa nɛ b shi Israɛl be mbuna nɛ a ka na nseŋ daa kɔ eyiri pɔtɛ a kil na malɛ e daa la Ramiya nɛ Iziya nɛ Malkija nɛ Mijamin nɛ Eleyaza nɛ Malkija nɛ Bɛnaya nɛ b shi Parosh be kabuna. 26Bumo nɛ b shi Elam be kabuna malɛ e daa la Mataniya nɛ Zakareya nɛ Jehiɛl nɛ Abdi nɛ Jerɛmɔf nɛ Elaija. 27Bumo nɛ b shi Zaatu be kabuna e daa la Ɛliyonayi nɛ Ɛliyashib nɛ Mataniya nɛ Jerɛmɔf nɛ Zabad nɛ Aziza. 28Bumo nɛ b shi Bebaye be kabuna e daa la Jehohanan nɛ Hananiya nɛ Zabai nɛ Atlai. 29Bumo nɛ b shi Bani be kabuna e daa la Meshulam nɛ Maluk nɛ Adaya nɛ Jashub nɛ Shɛal nɛ Jerɛmɔf. 30Bumo nɛ b shi Pahaf Mowab be kabuna e daa la Adena nɛ Kɛlal nɛ Bɛnaya nɛ Maaseia nɛ Mataniya nɛ Bɛzalɛl nɛ Binuyi nɛ Manase. 31Bumo nɛ b shi Harim be kabuna e daa la Eliaza nɛ Ishija nɛ Malkija nɛ Shemaya nɛ Shimiyɔn 32nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Maluk nɛ Shemariya. 33Bumo nɛ b shi Hashum be kabuna e daa la Matɛnayi nɛ Matata nɛ Zabad nɛ Ɛlifɛlɛt nɛ Jerɛmayi nɛ Manase nɛ Shimeyi. 34Bumo nɛ b shi Bani be kabuna e daa la Maadai nɛ Amram nɛ Yuwɛl 35nɛ Benayi nɛ Bedaye nɛ Keluhi 36nɛ Vaniya nɛ Meremɔf nɛ Ɛliyashib 37nɛ Mataniya nɛ Matɛnayi nɛ Jaasu. 38Bumo nɛ b shi Binuyi be kabuna e daa la Shimɛyi 39nɛ Shelemaya nɛ Netan nɛ Adaya 40nɛ Maknadebayi nɛ Shashayi nɛ Sɛɛrai 41nɛ Azarɛl nɛ Shelemaya nɛ Shemariya 42nɛ Shalum nɛ Amariya nɛ Josɛf. 43Bumo nɛ b shi Nebo be kabuna e daa la Jeyɛl nɛ Matitiya nɛ Zabad nɛ Zebina nɛ Jadayi nɛ Jowɛl nɛ Benaya. 44Basa ere kikɛ e daa kɔ befɔche a kil hale nɛ bumo beko daŋ ta bumo ŋ kurge mbia, ama b daŋ ba yige beche na nɛ mbia na kikɛ nna.

Title: NEHEMAYA 1
Content:
1Ma e la Nehemaya Hakalia pibinyɛn. Asheŋ nɛ n wora nɛ amo nɛ m malga nɛ n sibɛ n wɔtɔ kawɔl ere to na.
Ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs ka ji kuwura Pɛshiya be efuli so be kafɛ adunyɔ to nɛ ma, Nehemaya daa wɔ kadegboŋ lempo nɛ baa tre Susa nɛ k la efuli na be kadegboŋ na to nna. Juwebi be kufɔl nɛ baa tre Kislɛv na to e daa la. 2N sipoana to be eko nɛ baa tre Hanani na daŋ keta benyɛn be katuŋ ko nna n shi Juda be efuli so m ba ndoŋ. Nɛ m bishi bumo Jerusalɛm be kade to nɛ ŋ kurgepoana Juwebi nɛ b shi Babilɔn nfe m bɛta n yɔ na be asheŋ. 3Nɛ b kaŋɛ ma fanɛ basa nɛ b bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm na wɔ tɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ to nna. B yɛ Jerusalɛm be egbal na bure n tɔr nɛ kumo be mbunagboŋana na malɛ gba ji edɛ. 4Ŋ ka nu loŋ nɛ n chena n shu nchɛ damta ŋkpal kumo so nseŋ kishi ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: 5“O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo wɔ ebɔrɛso, fo e kɔ eleŋ ga nɛ fo bunyaŋ shi m baŋ so. Fo alɛ e naa wora a bɛ fo nnɔ naseso so a sa bekama nɛ baa sha fo nsaa wora fo mmalga kasonu. 6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni ma so nseŋ nu ma kekule ŋkpal kananɛ mee kule fo kapa nɛ kanyɛ ere a sa fo nyɛrbi Israɛlebi na so. N shuli fanɛ anyi Israɛlebi nɛ an nanaana kikɛ wora alubi ŋ gbiti fo. 7Anyi alɛ maŋ naŋ wora fo mbra nɛ fo ta n sa an nananyɛn Mosis fanɛ e ta n sa anyi na gba kasonu. 8Jande nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ fo kayɛrbi Mosis na, fanɛ nɛ anyi Israɛlebi maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa fo, kumo ere feeŋ pesaŋ anyi to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana ko so. 9Ama nɛ fanɛ an bɛta m ba fo kutɔ nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ fo nase n sa anyi na bre, hale nɛ an pesaŋ to n sɔ durnya ere be efuli kikɛ so gba, feeŋ naŋ bɛta anyi m ba kakpa nɛ fo daŋ yili kumo fanɛ an baa shuŋ fo na. 10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nyɛrbi nɛ fo gbagba be basa nna na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo gbagba be eleŋgboŋ nɛ fo ta m mɔlga bumo nɛ b baa la fo basa. 11O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma nɛ fo nyɛrbi nɛ b kɔ kasha n sa fo nsaa ŋana fo ketre na be kabɔrɛkule. Chɛ ma to nɛ n nya kusɔ nɛ mee tama kabre ere nseŋ shin nɛ ewura malɛ gba e wu ma kuwɔr.”
Loŋ be jemanɛ nɛ ma e daa duga ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs be yabra a sa mo nɛ e bee nuu.

Title: NEHEMAYA 2
Content:
Nehemaya ka yɔ Jerusalɛm be asheŋ
1Juwebi be kufɔl nɛ baa tre Nisan na to nɛ ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs ka ji kuwura be kafɛ adunyɔ na to nɛ n ta yabra nɛ n ya sa mo. Mo alɛ daŋ maŋ naŋ wu ma anishiakpa ka chɛrga n duli esa nɛ mbe kagbenejija mo kikɛ. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ e bishi ma: “Manɛ nna nɛ fo anishiakpa chɛrga fanɛ esa nɛ mbe kagbenejija mo loŋ? Fo alɛ maa lɔ. N tama fanɛ fo kagbene e maŋ fuli fo?.”
Kedaŋ shin nɛ kufu pɛ ma ga. 3Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Yiramu, Ebɔrɛ e teŋi fo efute so! Ma kagbene maŋ fuli ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, kadegboŋ nɛ b puli n nanaana na bure a dese nɛ kumo be mbunagboŋana kikɛ ji edɛ.”
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ wura na naŋ bishi ma: “Manɛ nɛ fee sha fanɛ n wora n sa fo?”
Nɛ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ma kagbene to. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ ewura na le: “Yiramu, jande, nɛ k maaŋ tɔrɔ fo, sa ma ekpa nɛ n yɔ Juda be kasawule so n ya lɔŋɛ kadegboŋ nɛ b puli an nanaana kumo to na m pɔr.”
6Ewura na nɛ mbe eche e daa tase, nɛ e bishi ma le: “Nchɛ afanɛ nɛ feeŋ ta n lɔŋɛ m pɔr kumo n loge nseŋ bɛta m ba?” Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ bɛta m ba. Nɛ kumo be loŋ par ewura na, nɛ e shuli nseŋ sa ma akpa.
7Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Yiramu, jande, wora ania n sibɛ nwɔl n sa ma nɛ n ta n ya sa efuliana nɛ a wɔ Lɔr nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na be egomena nɛ b wɔ fo kaseto na, saŋɛ na so, meeŋ nya ekpa n yɔ Juda be efuli so nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ wora ma. 8Ma alɛ daa beeŋ baa sha kawɔl nɛ meeŋ ta n ya sa kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Asaf nɛ e bee keni ewura be kupo so na, saŋɛ na so Asaf beeŋ sa ma ekpa nɛ ŋ ku ndibi be kupo na to n lɔŋɛ mbuna n wɔtɔ ebu lempo jeŋgreŋ nɛ a yil m mata bɔrɛlambu na nɛ kadegboŋ na gba to be egbalana na nɛ laŋ nɛ ŋ gbagba beeŋ ya kaa wɔtɔ to na. Ebɔrɛ ka daa wɔ ŋ kutɔ so, ewura na daŋ shuli nna n sa ma kusɔ kama nɛ n daŋ kule mo.
9Ewura na daŋ lara benapo nimuso nɛ benapo nɛ baa dii egbaŋɛ nɛ b baa kuŋ ma nna; nɛ b tu ma m bɔla Yufreetes be Lɔrgboŋ na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so n ta nwɔl nɛ ewurgboŋ na sibɛ na n ya sa egomenaana nɛ b wɔ ekpa na so na. 10Ama kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Sanballat nɛ e shi kade nɛ baa tre Horɔn na nɛ Tobaya nɛ e la Ammɔn be efuli so be krachigboŋ ko na ka nu fanɛ m ba na, nɛ b nya agbo ga. Ŋkpal manɛ so, b maa sha fanɛ esa kikɛ e chɛ Israɛlebi to.”
Nehemaya ka ya keni ŋ keni Jerusalɛm be egbalana na be asheŋ
11An ka fo Jerusalɛm na be nchɛ asa be kaman, 12nɛ ma nɛ basa gbrɛbi ko koso kanyɛso a yɔ. Jemanɛ na so nɛ ma alɛ daŋ maŋ naŋ kaŋɛ esa kikɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n deŋi ma kagbene so fanɛ n wora n sa Jerusalɛmebi. Kurma nɛ n daŋ dii na nawule e daa la kusɔbɔya nɛ an keta n yɔ. 13Kabuna nɛ k wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa nɛ baa tre kumo Ketaŋɛ be kabunagboŋ na to nɛ m bɔla to n lar n sɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so n ya bɔla kechubu nɛ baa tre Dragɔn na ase n ya fo kabunagboŋ nɛ baa tre Epi be kabuna na ase. Jemanɛ nɛ n dii kurma a choŋ na nɛ mee dara egbalana nɛ e bure n tɔr nɛ mbunagboŋana nɛ e daŋ chɔɔ na kikɛ. 14Ŋ ka fo Kadegboŋ na be epeŋilarkpa na nɛ ŋ kilgi n yɔ kechubu be kabunagboŋ na ase nɛ ewura be Kepa na ase. Ama ekpa na daa maŋ naaŋ kpalga to a shi n sa kurma nɛ n daa dii na. 15Amoso nɛ ŋ kilgi n sɔ ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Kidrɔn na be kaba so n ya bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ nsaa maŋ kumu so a keni kadegboŋ na be egbal na. Kumo be kaman nɛ m bɛta m bɔla Ketaŋɛ be kabunagboŋ na to n luri kadegboŋ na to pɔɛŋ nɛ kakpa bugi to. 16Kadegboŋ na to be ekrachigboŋana na be ekama daa maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ n yɔ ŋko kusɔ nɛ mee wora. Le be jemanɛ ere kikɛ nɛ m maŋ naŋ kaŋɛ m braana Juwebi na shɛŋ, hale Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ ekrachigboŋana na nɛ Juwebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba bee chɛ to a shuŋ kushuŋ na kikɛ maŋ nu shɛŋ ŋ kutɔ. 17Ama ŋ ka bɛta n yɔ na nɛ n ya kaŋɛ bumo le: “Menyi alɛ gba wu tɔrɔ nɛ an wɔ kumo to ŋkpal Jerusalɛm ka bure a dese nɛ kumo be mbunagboŋana kikɛ chɔɔ n tɔr nna na! Men wora ania n shin nɛ an pɔr kadegboŋ ere be egbalana nɛ a tɔr ere, saŋɛ na so anyi maaŋ naŋ ji anishinyɔr.”
18Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ Ebɔrɛ wɔ ma kutɔ nseŋ chɛ ma to nɛ kusɔ nɛ ewurgboŋ na gba kaŋɛ ma.
Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ: “Men shin nɛ an fara kapɔr na naniere!” Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bela ase nɛ b fara kushuŋ na.
19Sanballat nɛ Tobaya nɛ kalɔrbunyɛn ko nɛ baa tre mo Gɛshem ka nu kusɔ nɛ an kre kewora na be asheŋ nɛ b mushe anyi ga nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Manɛ nɛ menyee fɛ fanɛ menyee wora ere? Menyee sha kelɔŋɛ kadegboŋ na be egbalana nna m pɔr nseŋ lar ewura kaman ŋ kɔ mo kena, ŋko?”
20Nɛ n shuli ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na beeŋ chɛ anyi to nɛ an pɔɔ so, ŋkpal manɛ so, an la mbe nyɛrbi nna. Mo e naŋ shin nɛ an tiŋ n shuŋ kushuŋ na n loge nɛ shɛŋ maŋ wora. Amoso anyeeŋ fara Jerusalɛm be egbalana na be kepɔr. Ama menyi ere maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ men nya kapetɛsɔ kikɛ ashi Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi maŋ ti kumo be edaŋkaresheŋ so.”

Title: NEHEMAYA 3
Content:
Jerusalɛm be egbalana be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr be asheŋ
1Kananɛ b lɔŋɛ m pɔr Jerusalɛm be egbalana na nde. Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Eliyashib nɛ mo braana bɔrɛmatapoana na e lɔŋɛ kakpa nɛ baa tre Mbolpɔ be Kabuna ekpa na m pɔr nseŋ wɔtɔ kumo akuloŋ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b yili ndoŋ n ta egbal na be mba nɛ baa tre Ebu jeŋgreŋ Kalfa nɛ Hanamɛl be Ebu jeŋgreŋ na kikɛ m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ. 2Jɛriko be kadegboŋ na be basa malɛ e shi ndoŋ m ba lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na. Zakuur nɛ e la Imri pibinyɛn e pɔr kaba nɛ kumo alɛ naŋ bɛ so na. 3Hassina be kaman to ebi e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ baa tre Kɔrɔtɔ be kabuna ekpa na. B daŋ ta mbunagboŋ na be ndibi nna n wɔtɔ nseŋ gbir akuloŋ na n wɔtɔ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b gbir abɛlso m mata akuloŋ na so nsaa ta ndibi gbɛgbɛso a kɔl amo to a ber so. 4Yuraya pibinyɛn, Mɛremɔf nɛ mo nananyɛn la Hakɔz na, e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na.
Bɛrekaya pibinyɛn, Mɛshulam nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Mɛshezabel na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na nɛ Baana pibinyɛn Zadɔk malɛ lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k wɔ kumo alɛ be kekel to na.
5Tekua be kade to ebi e daŋ daga fanɛ b lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k bɛ so na, ama bumo be bejuŋkparpoana na bre kini fanɛ b maaŋ shuŋ kushuŋ kpakpaso nɛ benimu nɛ baa keni beshumpo na so na sa bumo na. 6Pasea pibinyɛn Jowada nɛ Besodaya pibinyɛn Meshulam e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kabunagboŋ nɛ baa tre Jeshana be kabuna na. B daŋ ta mbuna be ndibi na nɛ amo be akuloŋ ana nna n wɔtɔ amo be kakpa nseŋ naŋ ta abersobi na malɛ gba n wɔtɔ akuloŋ ana na to nseŋ ta ndibi gbɛgbɛso ŋ kɔl amo to m ber so. 7Melataya nɛ e shi Gibiɔn be kade to nɛ Jadon nɛ e shi Mɛronɔt be kade to na, n ta basa nɛ b shi Gibiɔn nɛ Mizpa be ndeana to na e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na. B daŋ pɔr hale n fo Yufreetes be epeŋitɔrkpa be kebonfu na be gomena be kowu ekpa nna. 8Haahaya pibinyɛn Uziɛl nɛ e la shuwa be bɔyɛpo na e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na.
Hananaya nɛ e bee lɔŋɛ etulale na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k wɔ a yɔ egbal kpaŋgalaŋ na akpa.
9Hur pibinyɛn Refaya nɛ e daa keni Jerusalɛm be kebonfu be bargato na so na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na.
10Egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na daŋ mata Harumat pibinyɛn Jadaya be laŋ nna nɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr ndoŋ be egbal na.
Hashabnaya pibinyɛn Hatush malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k bɛ so na.
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ Harim pibinyɛn Malkija nɛ Pahaf Mowab pibinyɛn Hashuub malɛ lɔŋɛ m pɔr mba anyɔ nɛ a bɛ so na nɛ bodobodo be ebu Jeŋgreŋ na gba n ti so.
12Halohɛsh pibinyɛn Shalum, nɛ e daa keni Jerusalɛm be Kebonfu nyɔsopo na so na nɛ mbe mbichesobiana e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na.
13Hanuun nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Zanua be kade to e lɔŋɛ m pɔr Ketaŋɛ be kabuna na akpa. B daŋ wɔtɔ akuloŋ mbunagboŋ na to nna nseŋ ta abersobi n wɔtɔ amo to nseŋ ta ndibi gbɛgbɛso ŋ kɔl amo to m ber so. B daŋ lɔŋɛ egbal na m pɔr n fo fanɛ ayadra alfa ana nɛ adena nna hale n ya fo Epi be kabuna na ase.
14Rekkab pibinyɛn Malchija nɛ e daa keni Bɛf Hakkerɛm be kebonfu so na e daŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr Epi be Kabuna ekpa na be egbal. E daŋ ta mbuna na be akuloŋ ana kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ mbuna na to nseŋ ta abɛlso be abersobi malɛ gba m mata amo so nseŋ ta ndibi gbɛgbɛso ŋ kɔl amo to m ber so.
15Kolhoze pibinyɛn Shalum, nɛ e daa keni Mizpa be kebonfu so na e daŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr Kuchubu be Kabuna ekpa na. E daŋ ta kusɔ nna n ti mbuna na. Kumo be kaman nɛ e wɔtɔ akuloŋ nɛ amo be abɛlso be abersobi nseŋ ta ndibi gbɛgbɛso m ber amo so. Mo koŋwule na e daŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal nɛ k wɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Shɛla be Kepa na. K daŋ mata ewura be kambɔl na nna nseŋ ta hale n ya fo atemprembi nɛ e dii a yɔ ewura Deevid be kadegboŋ na to na.
16Azbuk pibinyɛn Nehemaya nɛ e daa keni Bet Zur be kebonfu na be bargato so na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal nɛ k bɛ so na, hale n ya fo kakpa nɛ baa puli bewura nɛ baa tre ndoŋ ewura Deevid be nchaŋ ase nɛ kepa nɛ b kur na nɛ benapo be echenakpa na ase.
Livaiebi nɛ b shuŋ egbal na be kushuŋ na be asheŋ
17Livaiebi nɛ b lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na n chɔga so na e daa la Bani pibinyɛn Rehum nɛ Hashabia nɛ e daa keni Keyila be kebonfu be bargato so na. Mo ere daŋ yili mbe kebonfu be katelamu to n shuŋ kushuŋ na nna. 18Henadad pibinyɛn Bavai nɛ e daa keni Keyila be kebonfu be bargato nɛ k ka na so na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na.
19Joshuwa pibinyɛn Eza nɛ e daa keni Mizpa be kade so na e daŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k wɔ kakpa nɛ b daa yili benapo be akɔsɔ na be anishito hale n ya fo kakpa nɛ b gbɛ egbal na. 20Zabai pibinyɛn Baruk malɛ e pere kenishi n lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k ka n ya fo bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Eliyashib be kowu ase na. 21Yuraya pibinyɛn Mɛremɔf nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Hakkoz na e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k niŋi teteri n ya fo Eliyashib be kowu be ekar na.
Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b chɛ to m pɔr egbal na be asheŋ
22Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b chɛ to n lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na e daa la: Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi Kebonfu nɛ k kulti Jerusalɛm na e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na. 23Nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Hashuub malɛ lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be mba nɛ a bɛ so nsaa wɔ bumo elaŋ be anishito na.
Maasaya pibinyɛn Azariya nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Ananaya na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be mba nɛ a bɛ so nsaa wɔ bumo be elaŋ be anishito na.
24Nɛ Henadad pibinyɛn Biniyu malɛ lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so nsaa wɔ yili Azariya be laŋ ase hale n ya fo kakpa nɛ b gbɛ egbal na. 25Uzaya pibinyɛn Palal e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal nɛ b gbɛ na n ya fo ewurkpa be ebu jeŋgreŋ nɛ k mata bekumpo be kelɔnɛ ase na.
Parosh pibinyɛn Pɛdaya malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k bɛ so na. 26E daŋ pɔr nna m ba fo kakpa nɛ k mata Nchu be kabuna nɛ k wɔ a laŋɛ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nɛ ebu jeŋgreŋ nɛ k mata bɔrɛlambu na ase na nna. K mata kadegboŋ na be kaba nɛ baa tre Ofɛl nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be beshumpo na daa wɔ ndoŋ na nna.
Bepɔrpoana na be beko be baru be asheŋ
27Kade nɛ baa tre Tekua na be benyɛn malɛ e daŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na. Kaba nyɔsopo nɛ b daŋ pɔr nna na. B daŋ yili kakpa nɛ k wɔ ebu jeŋgreŋ gboŋ nɛ k bee kuŋ bɔrɛlambu na be anishito hale n ya fo egbal nɛ k mata Ofɛl na nna.
28Bɔrɛmatapoana ko malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so na. B daŋ fara kakpa nɛ baa tre Egbaŋɛ be Kabuna nɛ k wɔ a laŋɛ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na nna. Bumo be ekama malɛ daŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ so nsaa wɔ mo gbagba be laŋ to be anishito nna.
29Imma pibinyɛn Zadɔk malɛ gba e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal nɛ k bɛ so a wɔ mbe laŋ be anishito na.
Nɛ Shekanaya pibinyɛn Shemaya nɛ e daa keni Epeŋilarkpa be kabuna so na malɛ lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k naŋ bɛ so na.
30Shɛlemaya pibinyɛn Hananaya nɛ Hanun nɛ e la Zalaf pibi shesopo na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kaba nɛ k bɛ kumo so na. Kumo a ti so bumo be kakpa nyɔsopo nɛ b pɔr.
Bɛrekaya pibinyɛn Mɛshulam e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ k bɛ kumo so so nsaa wɔ mo gbagba be laŋ be anishito na.
31Malkija nɛ e la shuwa be bɔyɛpo na e lɔŋɛ m pɔr kaba nɛ kumo alɛ bɛ kumo so na hale n ya fo laŋ nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be beshumpo nɛ eyawujipoana daa wɔtɔ to na ase. Kakpa ere daa wɔ kabuna nɛ baa tre Gama abar be Kabuna nɛ k mata ebu nɛ k wɔ egbal na so ashi kelargato be esoso be epeŋilarkpa be kebonfu na be anishito nna.
32Shuwa be ebɔyɛpo nɛ eyawujipoana na malɛ e lɔŋɛ m pɔr egbal na be kakpa lalaloge. Kumo alɛ yili ebu nɛ k wɔ kebonfu to be ebu na nna hale n ya fo kaboŋ nɛ baa tre Mbolpɔ be Kabuna na ase nna.

Title: NEHEMAYA 4
Content:
Kananɛ Nehemaya pɔɔ bedoŋ so be asheŋ
1Sanballat, nɛ e la Samɛria be efuli so be gomena na, ka nu fanɛ anyi Juwebi na fara a pɔr Jerusalɛm be egbalana na, nɛ e nya agbo nseŋ fara a wora anyi be basa eyurto. 2Le nɛ e kaŋɛ mo braana nɛ Samɛria be benapo be anishito: “Manɛ nɛ Juwebi, basa pɔso be katuŋ ere bee fɛ fanɛ baa wora ere? Baa sha keta kachɛ koŋwule nna n lɔŋɛ egbal na m pɔr nseŋ lara esarga loŋ be kachɛ koŋwule na gbagba a? Baa fɛ fanɛ baaŋ tiŋ n ta ajembu nɛ a chɔɔ m biti abar so ere n lɔŋɛ kusɔ ko a?”
3Jemanɛ na so nɛ Tobaya nɛ e shi Ammɔn be efuli so na yil mo kutɔ, nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Nuso bre be egbal nɛ baa sha kepɔr ere? Jiŋkaamu gba beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋin kumo n lɛ!”
4Ama n daŋ kule Ebɔrɛ nna ŋ kaŋɛ: “O Ebɔrɛ, basa ere kishi anyi nna nsaa sha fanɛ asheŋ lubi e tu anyi. Jande nu anyi be kekule nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be katege na e laŋɛ bumo be amu so! Shin nɛ b baa la basa nɛ bumo doŋana beeŋ pɛ bumo kena to ŋ gberge bumo n yɔ kabuti to. 5Sa maŋ kaŋ ta bumo be alubi nɛ kekeni jiga nɛ b keni bepɔrpo na m paŋ bumo kikɛ.”
6Beshumpo na daŋ shuŋ ga nɛ an naŋ pɔr Jerusalɛm be egbal na n fo nferinto. 7Sanballat nɛ Tobaya nɛ Nlɔrbu na nɛ Ammɔnebi na nɛ basa nɛ b shi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ashdɔd na daŋ wu fanɛ egbal na daa dii nna a shin nɛ k shɛrto. Amoso b daŋ nya agbo nna, 8nseŋ daŋ kre fanɛ baaŋ bar kebagato nseŋ kɔ Jerusalɛmebi na. 9Ama an kule anyi be Ebɔrɛ nseŋ lara benapo nɛ b baa keni so nsaa kuŋ egbal na kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ.
10Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ Juda be basa na daa kɔ bumo be kashɛ ko a boŋ nɛ k bee keta kebɔltofinfin. B yɛ:
“An gben a chul to ŋkpal an ka sulɔ esulɔ gbɛgbɛso so.
Ajembu burtoso na shi ga n sa anyi nɛ an sulɔ n ya lɛ.
Nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora n tiŋ m pɔr egbal na n loge kabre?”
11An doŋana malɛ daŋ naa kaŋɛ le nna: “Pɔɛŋ nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa ere e pin kusɔ nɛ k bee wora na, nɛ an ŋana n ya mɔ bumo kikɛ nɛ bumo be kushuŋ na e ba ekar.”
12Ama ale kudu kikɛ nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa nɛ b daŋ wea anyi doŋana to n chena na kpele anyi kusoe a laŋɛ kusɔ nɛ an doŋana na bee kre kewora anyi be kaplɛa so. 13Amoso nɛ n ta etokobi nɛ ekpa nɛ ata nɛ atanyembi n sa ma basa nseŋ gama bumo kakurge be ntuŋso a mata egbal na be kaba nɛ k maŋ naŋ pɔr n loge na nɛ b baa kuŋ. 14Kumo be kaman nɛ n wu fanɛ basa na be ŋgbene jija bumo, nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpo nɛ ekrachi na le: “Men sa maa ŋana anyi doŋana ere. Men baa nyiŋi kananɛ Enyɛnpe na be eleŋ shi ga nɛ kananɛ mbe asheŋ bee keta kufu. Amoso men leŋ menyi be amu to nseŋ kɔ kenishipereso n sa menyi be basa nɛ mbia nɛ beche nɛ elantoebi!”
15An doŋana daŋ mige to m pin fanɛ an nyi ŋkre lubi nɛ baa kre a laŋɛ anyi be kaplɛa so na kikɛ. Ebɔrɛ malɛ daŋ jija bumo be ŋkre na nna. Amoso anyi kikɛ naŋ bɛta n yɔ egbal na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr to nna. 16Yili loŋ be jemanɛ na mbrantiɛbia na be bargato bee shuŋ nna nɛ bargato malɛ e buu anyɛn kale gbɛgbɛso nseŋ keta ekpa nɛ abɛlso be asɔ kuŋ eyur so nɛ ata nɛ atanyembi a yil a kuŋ. Anyi be benapo be benimuana na malɛ daa yili bepɔrpo na be kaman nna. 17Basa nɛ b daa sulɔ kapɔr be asɔ na be ekama daŋ keta kekɔsɔ enɔ koŋwule to nna nseŋ ta enɔ koŋwule malɛ m pɛ asɔ na to. 18Bepɔrpo na malɛ ta etokobi nna n wɔtɔ efar to n chɛ bumo be nshɛr to. Esa nɛ e beeŋ foŋ kabel n juge anyi na bre daa wɔ ma kutɔ nna.
19Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ basa na nɛ bumo be ekrachi nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na le: “Ŋkpal anyi be kushuŋ na ka barga to a wɔ mboŋ damta so, an barga abar nna ga. 20Men baŋ nu kabel na be kushu, men wora manaŋ m ba shɛr ŋ kulti ma. Anyi be Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ chɛ anyi to ŋ kɔ.”
21Amoso anyi bee wule a koso kachipurdidi nna a shuŋ egbal na be kushuŋ hale nɛ kanyɛ e ya biri. Basa na be bargato bee shuŋ nna nɛ bargato malɛ e keta bumo be ekpa a yil a kuŋ. 22Loŋ be jemanɛ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ basa nɛ baa keni beshumpo na so na nɛ bumo be beshumpo kikɛ fanɛ baa b wɔ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na to kanyɛso kikɛ nsaa keni so a kuŋ kade na. Amoso b daa shuŋ kapaso nna nsaa keni kade na so a kuŋ kumo kanyɛso malɛ. 23Ma nɛ m braana nɛ beshumpo na nɛ bekumpo na kikɛ maa lara anyi be asɔbuuso kanyɛso nsaa dese. Anyi alɛ kikɛ maa shin nɛ anyi be akɔsɔ bee barga anyi kikɛ.

Title: NEHEMAYA 5
Content:
Kananɛ betirpo bee wu tɔrɔ be asheŋ
1Jemanɛ ko ka fo nɛ benyɛn nɛ beche na be beko fara a fubel a bile asheŋ a malga a gbiti bumo braana. 2Le nɛ beko daa kaŋɛ: “Nnaŋgboŋ nɛ anyi be beko kɔ a bela. Ayu damta nɛ e daga fanɛ an nya a ji nseŋ tiŋ a wɔ ŋkpa to.” 3Nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Akoŋ be jemanɛ na, anyi be adɔsawule nɛ ndibi sɔrso be adɔ nɛ nwu nɛ an daŋ ta n yili tarma nseŋ nya ayu n ji.”
4Kumo be kaman nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ le: “An paŋ amansherbi nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ tiŋ ŋ ka anyi be adɔsawule nɛ ndibi sɔrso be akɔ n sa ewura. 5Anyi alɛ gba la Juwebi nna, nɛ anyi be mbia nɛ bumo be mbia kikɛ la kukoŋwule. Ama anyi ere bee fa anyi be mbia nna nɛ baa ki anya. Naniere anyi maŋ naa kɔ kechɛto kikɛ be tama ŋkpal an ka ta anyi be adɔsawule nɛ ndibi sɔrso be adɔana ŋ n chɛr ayu so.” 6Ŋ ka nu b kaa bee fubel a bile asheŋ na nɛ agbo pɛ ma ga. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ n fɛ kumo be asheŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ ekrachiana na le: “Manɛ nna nɛ menyee paŋ menyi be basa gbagba amansherbi nsaa wɔtɔ bumo nchu?
Kumo be kaman nɛ n tre ekama n shɛr nseŋ malga ŋ gbiti bejuŋkparpoana na ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le, 8An wora ania n tɔ anyi be basa nɛ b pɛ anya n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so na m bɛta m ba. Ama naniere menyi e naa fa bumo be bedamta na, nɛ an naŋ ya tɔ bumo!” Ekrachi na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na daa maŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ, ŋkpal b ka nyi k kaa la kashenteŋ so.
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ nɛ men wora na maŋ daga kuraa! A daga fanɛ anyi be kebaawɔtɔ e baa sa Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ, saŋɛ na so nnyamase na maaŋ wu kulubi anyi to. 10Naniere n shin nɛ basa na paŋ amansherbi nɛ aboyu ma kutɔ nna. Nteriana nɛ basa nɛ baa shuŋ a sa ma na gba ti so. Naniere men shin nɛ an kikɛ e ta asɔ nɛ b paŋ anyi na ŋ kɛ bumo. 11Men yige menyi be akɔ kama nɛ b ji na ŋ kɛ bumo, hale nɛ a la amansherbi ŋko aboyu ŋko asɔnuuso ŋko ɔlif be ŋku gba. Men bɛta bumo be nsawule nɛ ndibisɔrso be adɔana nɛ ɔlif be ndibi be mboŋana nɛ bumo be elaŋana n sa bumo manaŋ.” 12Nɛ bejuŋkparpo na kaŋɛ le: “Kusɔ kama nɛ fo kaŋɛ, anyeeŋ wora loŋ. Anyi beeŋ ta bumo be mpetɛ n sa bumo, anyi alɛ maŋ naŋ bishi bumo anyi be akɔ nɛ b ji na gba.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ n tre bɔrɛmatapoana na nseŋ shin nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na nase kɔnɔ bumo be anishito saŋɛ na so baaŋ bɛ bumo be nnɔ nɛ b nase na so. 13Kumo be kaman nɛ n saŋɛ kreso nɛ n ta n chɛ ma kashɛr to na nseŋ gbaŋgbaŋ kumo to a ŋini fanɛ loŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gbaŋgbaŋ bekama nɛ b maa bɛ bumo be nnɔ nase so so na. Kumo alɛ be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sɔ men be ebuana nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ men kɔ, saŋɛ na so, men maa naa kɔ shɛŋ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ bekama nɛ b daa wɔ ndoŋ na shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Amɛn!” Kumo be kaman nɛ b di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ. Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na bɛ bumo be nnɔ naseso so.
Nehemaya ka maa fɛ mo nawule be asheŋ
14Atazɛzɛs ka ji kuwura be nfɛ adunyɔ n ya fo nfɛ adesa nɛ anyɔsopo to nɛ ma e la Juda be efuli so be gomena. Nfɛ kuduanyɔ nɛ n la gomena na kikɛ, ma ŋko ŋkurgepoana maŋ sɔ ajibi nɛ a daga ma fanɛ gomena na. 15Egomena kama nɛ b juŋkpar na daa tɔrɔ basa na nna ga. B daa sɔ gbiti be ndarbi adena nna a tɔ ajibi nɛ asɔnuuso karechɛ kikɛ nna. Bumo be nyɛrbi gba daa tɔrɔ basa na nna, ama ŋkpal ma ere ka bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ na so nɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ daa kɔr bumo to na. 16Ma ere ta ma eleŋ kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ egbal na be kepɔr to nsaa maa fin shɛŋ kumo to. Ma alɛ maŋ tɔ nsawule ŋko nwu n sa ma kumu. Bekama nɛ bumo alɛ bee shuŋ a sa ma na kikɛ chɛ to nna m pɔr egbal na. 17Basa nɛ b shi efuli pɔtɛana so m baa kaa chɔrɔ ma na be kaman, Jerusalɛm to be basa kalfa nɛ adunu nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpo nɛ n daa sa ajibi. 18Karechɛ kama mee sa kena koŋwule nɛ mbolpɔ lela ashe nɛ ŋkoshi damta nɛ ajibi nna, nsaa chige asɔnuuso popɔr nchɛ kudu kikɛ. Ama ade kikɛ be kaman n nyi asheŋ kpakpaso nɛ a beeŋ ba basa na so, amoso n daa maa sɔ gomena be kakɔka.
19O Ebɔrɛ, mee kule fo nna nɛ fo nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ n wora n sa basa ere nseŋ nɛfa ma.

Title: NEHEMAYA 6
Content:
Kananɛ baa kre Nehemaya nia lubi be asheŋ
1Sanballat nɛ Tobaya, nɛ Geshɛm nɛ an doŋana nɛ b ka na be beko nu fanɛ an pɔr egbal na n loge. Kusɔ nɛ an daa maŋ wora e la akuloŋ na be keta n wɔtɔ mbunaana na to. 2Ŋkpal Sanballat nɛ Geshɛm ka bee sha fanɛ b tɔrɔ ma so, b ta kubɔya nna n shoŋi ma fanɛ m ba nɛ ma nɛ bumo e wu abar ashi ndebiana nɛ e wɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Ono be Ketaŋɛ na be kuko to. 3Nɛ ma alɛ shuŋi mbɔ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ŋ kɔ kushuŋ kpakpaso nna a wora, amoso m maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ ndoŋ. M maaŋ tiŋ ŋkpal ma nɛ menyi be kewu abar so n yige kushuŋ ere.” 4Ale ana nɛ b kela n tre ma, ama saŋkama kamalga koŋwule na nɛ ma alɛ bee kaŋɛ bumo. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Sanballat naŋ shuŋi krachi ko fanɛ e ta kawɔl m ba sa ma. 6Le nɛ kawɔl na bee kaŋɛ: “Geshɛm kaŋɛ ma fanɛ basa bee kuli a malga asheŋ ko a kaŋɛ fanɛ fo nɛ fo basa bee kre anyi nia nna nɛ men lar Pɛshiya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na kaman. Aloŋ malɛ so nɛ fee lɔŋɛ a pɔr egbal na. Mo alɛ naa kaŋɛ gba fanɛ fee sha keta fo kumu nna ŋ ki Jerusalɛm be ewura. 7E naŋ kaŋɛ gba fanɛ fo nɛ anebiana ko wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nna fanɛ b baa malga a sa Jerusalɛm be kade to ebi fanɛ fo e la Juda be ewura. Kesheŋ ere la kusɔ nɛ Pɛshiya be ewurkpa ebi na tiŋ n nu nna, kumo so nɛ mee bar nfɛra fanɛ k daga fanɛ ma nɛ fo e chena m malga nɛnɛ a laŋɛ kumo be kaplɛa so na.” 8Kumo be kaman nɛ ma alɛ sa mo ebɔl nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Kashenteŋ maŋ wɔ kusɔ nɛ fee kaŋɛ ere to kikɛ. Fo gbagba be keblɔmbi nɛ fo wora na.” 9B daa sha fanɛ b funti anyi nna nɛ an sa maŋ tiŋ n loge kushuŋ na. Nɛ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ sa ma eleŋ naniere!” 10Kachako nɛ n yɔ nɛ n ya bɔɔ Delai pibinyɛn Shemaya nɛ e la Mehetabel mo nanabi nyɛnso nɛ e daŋ shir a wɔ mbe laŋ to na so nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: “A daga fanɛ ma nɛ fo ka ŋana bɔrɛlambu na be kakpa cheembi na nseŋ ti akuloŋ, ŋkpal fo doŋana kaa bee sha fanɛ b mɔ fo na so. Baŋ yili kanyɛ ere a yɔ baŋ ba mɔ fo.” 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma ere maŋ la basa nɛ baa shile a ŋana na be ako nna. Fee fɛ nna fanɛ meeŋ shile ŋ ŋana bɔrɛlambu ere to nna ŋkpal ma kumɔlga so a? M maaŋ wora loŋ kikɛ.” 12Ŋ ka lɔŋɛ n fɛ kesheŋ ere be nfɛra nɛnɛ na nɛ n pin fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ malga Shemaya kutɔ, ama Tobaya nɛ Sanballat e daŋ sa mo brɔbu nseŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e kpele ma kusoe. 13B daŋ ber mo paa nna fanɛ e funti ma nɛ n wora kulubi, saŋɛ na so ma ketre beeŋ jija nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ ma. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Tobaya nɛ Sanballat wora nɛ anebiche nɛ baa tre Nodaya nɛ anebiana nɛ b ka na be kananɛ b fin ekpa nɛ b funti ma. Jande gberge bumo kikɛ kusoe n sa ma.”
Kushuŋ na be lalaloge be asheŋ
15Nchɛ adunu nɛ anyɔ nɛ an ta m pɔr Jerusalɛm be egbalana na n loge. Juwebi be kufɔl nɛ baa tre Elul na be kachɛ adunyɔ nɛ anusopo na nɛ egbal na be kushuŋ loge. 16Anyi doŋana nɛ b wɔ efuli pɔtɛ so na ka nu loŋ nɛ kufu pɛ bumo, ŋkpal ekama na ka pin fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kechɛto so nɛ kushuŋ na tiŋ n loge. 17Loŋ be jemanɛ na so Juda be bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ Tobaya e daa sibɛ nwɔl a shoŋi abar. 18Basa damta daa yil Tobaya be kaman nna ŋkpal Ara pibinyɛn, Shekanaya ka la mo shanyɛn so.
