Kusɔ nɛ k naŋ ti so e la fanɛ mo pibinyɛn Jehohanan e ta Berekia pibinyɛn, Mɛshulam pibiche a kil. 19Basa bee kaŋɛ ma ashuŋ lela nɛ Tobaya bee wora kikɛ nna saŋɛ na so baaŋ nu ma kɔnɔ to be kamalga n ya kaŋɛ mo. Saŋkama mo alɛ bee sibɛ nwɔl nna a funti ma.

Title: NEHEMAYA 7
Content:
1Naniere b loge egbal na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr nseŋ ta mbuna na be akuloŋ na n wɔtɔ amo to. Kumo be kaman nɛ b sa bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo na nɛ beshɛbompo na nɛ Livaiebi nɛ b ka na kikɛ bumo be ashuŋ. 2Basa anyɔ nɛ n daŋ lara fanɛ b baa la benimu nsaa keni Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na so. Bumo e la n sipo Hanani nɛ Hananiya nɛ e la enapo nimuso nɛ e bee keni kakpa lempo na so na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Hananiya la esa nɛ feeŋ tiŋ n yirda nna, mo alɛ nseŋ naa kɔ kabɔrɛŋana a chɔ basa damta. 3Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bekumpo fanɛ b sa maa wule a bugi Jerusalɛm be mbuna na, ama epeŋi daŋ nna pɔɛŋ. A daga fanɛ b baa ti amo a ber amo so kaaseso pɔɛŋ nsaa koso kushuŋ to. Ma alɛ naŋ kaŋɛ bumo nna fanɛ b lara bumo gbagba to be basa nɛ b shi Jerusalɛm to nɛ b baa yili egbal na be mboŋ ko a kuŋ kumo nɛ beko malɛ e baa kuŋ bumo be nwuana.
Basa nɛ b shi kenyaya to m ba na be atre be asheŋ
(Ɛzra 2:1-70)
4Jerusalɛm daa la kade gboŋgboŋi nna, ama basa gbrɛbi ko e daa wɔ kumo to. Bumo alɛ daa maŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr bumo be nwu ndoŋ. 5Amoso Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa ma nfɛra nna fanɛ ŋ gama basa na nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpo nɛ ekrachi na ŋ keni basa nɛ ewurgboŋ Nebukadneeza pɛ n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so nɛ b bɛta m ba na be nnaŋ be atre be nwɔl to ŋ karga bumo. Kusɔ nɛ n wu nwɔl na to nde.
6Basa nɛ b pɛ n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be galeŋga bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm nɛ Juda be efuli so nna. Ekama daŋ yɔ mbe kade to nna. Jemanɛ nɛ ewurgboŋ Nebukadneeza daŋ pɛ bumo fanɛ anya n yɔ na, bumo be nnaŋ to be basa daa wɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Babilɔn na nna. 7Bumo be bejuŋkparpo e daa la Zerubabel nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Nehemaya nɛ Azariya nɛ Ramaya nɛ Nahamani nɛ Mɔdikaya nɛ Bilshan nɛ Misperɛf nɛ Bigvai nɛ Nehum nɛ Baana.
8-25Israɛl be basa nɛ b bɛta m ba na be kananɛ b sa mbuna mbuna so nde:
Parosh be kabuna ebi daa la basa ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ kalfa nɛ adushunu nɛ anyɔ nna.
Shefataya be kabuna ebi daa la basa alfa asa nɛ adushunu nɛ anyɔ nna.
Ara be kabuna ebi daa la basa alfa ashe nɛ adunu nɛ anyɔ nna.
Pahaf Mowab be kabuna ebi, fɔŋfɔŋ Joshuwa nɛ Jɔab be kaman to ebi daa la basa ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ alfa aburwa nɛ kuduaburwa nna.
Elam be kabuna ebi daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ alfa anyɔ nɛ adunu nɛ ana nna.
Zaatu be kabuna ebi daa la basa alfa aburwa nɛ adena nɛ anu nna.
Zakai be kabuna ebi daa la basa alfa ashunu nɛ adeshe nna.
Biniyu be kabuna ebi daa la basa alfa ashe nɛ adena nɛ aburwa nna.
Bebaye be kabuna ebi daa la basa alfa ashe nɛ adunyɔ nɛ aburwa nna.
Azgad be kabuna ebi daa la basa ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ alfa asa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nna.
Adonikam be kabuna ebi daa la basa alfa ashe nɛ adeshe nɛ ashunu nna.
Bigvai be kabuna ebi daa la basa ŋgboŋ anyɔ nɛ adeshe nɛ ashunu nna.
Adin be kabuna ebi daa la basa alfa ashe nɛ adunu nɛ anu nna.
Atɛr nɛ mbe ketre ko la Hɛzekaya na be kabuna ebi daa la basa adekpanu nɛ aburwa nna.
Hashum be kabuna ebi daa la basa alfa asa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ aburwa nna.
Bɛzai be kabuna ebi daa la basa alfa asa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ ana nna.
Harif be kabuna ebi daa la basa kalfa nɛ kudu anyɔ nna.
Gibiɔn be kabuna ebi daa la basa adekpanu nɛ anu nna.
26-38Benyɛn nɛ b daŋ shi nde ere to m bɛta m ba nde.
Bɛtlɛhɛm nɛ Netofa be benyɛn daa la basa kalfa nɛ aduburwa nɛ aburwa nna.
Anatɔf be benyɛn daa la basa kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ aburwa nna.
Bɛt Azmavɛf be benyɛn daa la basa adena nɛ anyɔ nna.
Kiriaf Jearim nɛ Kefira nɛ Berof be benyɛn daa la basa alfa ashunu nɛ adena nɛ asa nna.
Rama nɛ Gɛba be benyɛn daa la basa alfa ashe nɛ adunyɔ nɛ kako nna.
Mikmas be benyɛn daa la basa kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nna.
Bɛtɛl nɛ Ai be benyɛn daa la basa kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ asa nna.
Nibo be benyɛn daa la basa adunu nɛ anyɔ nna.
Elaam ko na be benyɛn daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ alfa anyɔ nɛ adunu nɛ ana nna.
Harim be benyɛn daa la basa alfa asa nɛ adunyɔ nna.
Jɛriko be benyɛn daa la basa alfa asa nɛ adena nɛ anu nna.
Lɔd nɛ Hadid nɛ Ono be benyɛn daa la basa alfa ashunu nɛ adunyɔ nɛ kako nna.
Senaa be benyɛn daa la basa ŋgboŋ asa nɛ alfa akpanu nɛ adesa nna.
39-42Bɔrɛmatapoana na be mbunaebi nɛ b bɛta m ba na nde.
Jedaya be kabuna ebi, fɔŋfɔŋ Joshuwa be kaman to ebi, daa la basa alfa akpanu nɛ adushunu nɛ asa nna.
Ima be kabuna ebi daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ adunu nɛ anyɔ nna.
Pashɔr be kabuna ebi daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ alfa anyɔ nɛ adena nɛ ashunu nna.
Harim be kabuna ebi daa la basa kagboŋ nɛ kudu ashunu nna.
43-45Livaiebi be mbunaebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba bɛta m ba nde.
Joshuwa nɛ Kadmiɛl nɛ b la Hodeva be kaman to ebi be mbunaebi daa la basa adushunu nɛ ana nna.
Bɔrɛlambu to be Nshɛbompoana nɛ b la Asaf be kaman to ebi daa la basa kalfa nɛ adena nɛ aburwa nna.
Bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo nɛ b la Shalum nɛ Atɛ nɛ Talmɔn nɛ Akuub nɛ Hatita nɛ Shobayi be kamanebi na be kabuna ebi daa la basa kalfa nɛ adesa nɛ aburwa nna.
46-56Bɔrɛlambu to be beshumpo be mbunaebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba daŋ bɛta m ba nde.
Ziha nɛ Hasufa nɛ Tabaof be kabuna ebi nɛ
Keros Sia nɛ Paadɔn be kabuna ebi, nɛ
Lebana nɛ Hegaba nɛ Shalmai be kabuna ebi
nɛ Hanan nɛ Gidɛl nɛ Gaha be kabuna ebi
Ria nɛ Rezin nɛ Nekoda be kabuna ebi
nɛ Gazam nɛ Uza nɛ Pasea be kabuna ebi
nɛ Bɛsai nɛ Mewunim nɛ Nefushesim be kabuna ebi
nɛ Bakbuk nɛ Hakufa nɛ Hahɔr be kabuna ebi
nɛ Bazlif nɛ Mehida nɛ Hasha be kabuna ebi
nɛ Bakos nɛ Sisɛra nɛ Tema be kabuna ebi
nɛ Nezia nɛ Hatifa be kabuna ebi
57-59Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be nyɛrbi be mbuna ebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba bɛta m ba nde.
Sotai nɛ Sofɛrɛ nɛ Pɛrida be kabuna ebi
nɛ Jaala nɛ Daakɔn nɛ Gidɛl be kabuna ebi
nɛ Shefatiya nɛ Hatil nɛ Pokerɛf Hazebem nɛ Ammɔn be kabuna ebi.
60Bɔrɛlambu to be beshumpo na nɛ Sɔlɔmɔn be nyɛrbi na be mbunaebi nɛ b bɛta na kikɛ daŋ koso basa alfa asa nɛ adekpanu nɛ anyɔ nna.
61-62Basa alfa ashe nɛ adena nɛ anyɔ e daŋ shi Delaya nɛ Tobaya nɛ Nekoda be mbuna m bɛta m ba, ama bumo alɛ daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini fanɛ b la Israɛl be basa gbagba nna. Nde nɛ b daŋ chena to e daa la Tɛl Mela nɛ Tɛl Hasha nɛ Cherub nɛ Adɔn nɛ Ima.
63-64Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b daa maŋ tiŋ n nya kawɔl nɛ k bee ŋini kananɛ bumo be nnaŋ lar e la Hobia nɛ Hakɔz nɛ Bazilai. Bazilai nɛ e shi bɔrɛmatapoana be kabuna ere mo nananyɛn daŋ ta Giliad be kasawule so be Bazilai be kabuna be eche nna nseŋ ta mo shanyɛn be ketre n nase mbe kabuna na. Ŋkpal b k daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini kananɛ bumo kekurge to lar so, b daa maŋ sa bumo ekpa nɛ b ki bɔrɛmatapoana. 65Gomena na daŋ kaŋɛ bumo ere nna fanɛ b maaŋ tiŋ n ji ajibi nɛ b ta n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ na ama bɔrɛmatapo ko baaŋ ta asɔ nɛ baa tre Urim nɛ Thummim na n to beri ŋ ŋini fanɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana kashenteŋto nna pɔɛŋ nɛ b tiŋ n ji esargajibi na.
66-69Basa nɛ b daŋ bɛta m ba na kikɛ daŋ koso basa ŋgboŋ adena nɛ anyɔ nɛ alfa asa nɛ adeshe nna.
Bumo be nyɛrbi nɛ mbita malɛ daa la basa ŋgboŋ ashunu nɛ alfa asa nɛ adesa nɛ ashunu nna.
Bumo be beshɛbompo nyɛnso nɛ becheso kikɛ daa la basa alfa anyɔ nɛ adena nɛ anu nna.
Bumo be egbaŋɛ malɛ daa la alfa ashunu nɛ adesa nɛ ashe nna.
Bumo be ekurma nɛ a duli egbaŋɛ na malɛ daa la alfa anyɔ nɛ adena nɛ anu nna.
Bumo be enyɔma daa la alfa ana nɛ adesa nɛ anu nna.
Nɛ bumo be ekurma gbagba malɛ daa la ŋgboŋ ashe nɛ alfa ashunu nɛ adunyɔ.
70-72Basa damta daŋ sa asɔ nna n chɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔŋɛ m pɔr be kushuŋ to. Gomena na gbagba daŋ sa shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ fo fanɛ kilo aburwa nɛ ntishaŋ peper adunu nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana be epiŋi alfa anu nɛ adesa. Mbuna be benimuana na malɛ daŋ sa shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ fo fanɛ kilo kalfa nɛ adunu nɛ asa nɛ gbiti nɛ amo alɛ be egbɛ daŋ fo fanɛ kilo kagboŋ nɛ alfa ana nɛ adunu nɛ aburwa. Kusɔ nɛ basa nɛ b ka na malɛ sa e la shuwa nɛ amo be egbɛ daŋ fo fanɛ kilo kalfa nɛ adunu nɛ asa nɛ gbiti malɛ fanɛ kilo kagboŋ nɛ alfa asa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ anu nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana be epiŋi adeshe nɛ ashunu.
73Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo na nɛ beshɛbompoana na nɛ basa na be beko nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be beshumpo na nɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ chena bumo be ndeana to ashi Juda be efuli so kikɛ.

Title: NEHEMAYA 8
Content:
Ɛzra ka kraŋ mbra na n sa basa na be asheŋ
1Afɔl ashunu nɛ Israɛlebi na daŋ ta n chena bumo be ndeana to n loge. Kufɔl shunusopo na to be kachɛ sososo na nɛ bumo kikɛ gama abar so ashi Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na to be kelɔnɛ nɛ k dese kabuna nɛ baa tre Nchu be Kabuna na ase. Kumo be kaman nɛ b kaŋɛ bɔrɛmatapo Ɛzra, nɛ e daa ŋini mbra nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla an nananyɛn Mosis so n ta n sa Israɛlebi na, fanɛ e ya ta mbra be kawɔl na m ba. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛzra ya ta mbra be kawɔl na m ba. Benyɛn nɛ beche nɛ mbia nɛ baa pin asheŋ to na kikɛ e daŋ shɛr ndoŋ. 3Yili kachipurdidi n ya fo kapiidi nɛ e yili kelɔnɛ nɛ k mata kabuna so a kraŋ mbra be kawɔl na a sa basa na nɛ baa nu kumo nɛnɛ. 4B daŋ ta ndibi n yuu kejaŋ nna nɛ Ɛzra yili kumo so loŋ be kachɛ nna. Basa nɛ b daa yil mbe jisoso a la Mattitia nɛ Shema nɛ Anaya nɛ Yuriya nɛ Hilkiya nɛ Maseya. Bumo nɛ bumo alɛ daa yil mbe bena so malɛ e daa la Pedaya nɛ Mishaal nɛ Malkiya nɛ Hashum nɛ Hash Badaana nɛ Zakareya nɛ Mɛshulam.
5Ɛzra daŋ yili kejaŋ jeŋgreŋ na so nna a keni basa na kaseto nɛ bumo alɛ gba be anishi yuu mo so. E ka bugi kawɔl na to a kraŋ na kikɛ nɛ basa na kikɛ yil nna. 6Ɛzra ka kraŋ kawɔl na n loge nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e shi ga na peya!” Nɛ basa na kikɛ maŋ bumo be enɔana esoso nseŋ shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Amɛn! Amɛn!” Kumo be kaman nɛ b gbir ŋ kurgi bumo be amu n yuu to m bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
7-8B ka wora loŋ n loge nɛ b koso n yili nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Bani nɛ Sherebia nɛ Jamin nɛ Akkub nɛ Shebataya nɛ Hodia nɛ Maaseia nɛ Kɛlita nɛ Azariya nɛ Jozabad nɛ Hanan nɛ Pɛleeyaa nɛ b la Livaiebi na luri basa na to n ya kaa kute mbra nɛ Ɛzra kraŋ na be afito a ŋini bumo.
9Basa na ka nu kusɔ nɛ mbra na bee kaŋɛ na nɛ k luri bumo to ga nɛ b fara a shu. Amoso Nehemaya nɛ e daa la gomena na nɛ bɔrɛmatapo Ɛzra nɛ e la mbra na be eŋinipo na nɛ Livaiebi nɛ baa kute mbra na be afito a sa basa na kaŋɛ: “Kabre la kachɛ cheembi nna n sa Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Amoso k maŋ daga fanɛ men baa shu a wora kuwɔr be asheŋ.” 10Kumo be kaman nɛ Nehemaya kaŋɛ basa na: “Naniere men yɔ epe n ya wora kejigboŋ n ji menyi be nnɔ nseŋ ku ajibi na be ako n sa bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ shɛŋ nɛ b ji na. Kabre la kachɛ cheembi nna n sa Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na. Amoso men sa maŋ shin nɛ men be ŋgbene a baa jija menyi. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa menyi kagbenefuli nɛ k beeŋ sa menyi eleŋ.”
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ Livaiebi na bee nite a kulti a leŋ basa na to fanɛ b yige kushu n saa maŋ shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e baa jija bumo kachɛ cheembi ere. 12Kumo be kaman nɛ basa na kikɛ lar n yɔ bumo peana n ya ji nseŋ nuu kagbenefuliso Bumo alɛ daŋ chige ajibi nɛ asɔnuuso nna n sa beko, ŋkpal manɛ so, b pin kusɔ nɛ mbra nɛ b kraŋ n sa bumo na bee ŋini.
Kebaawɔ Abuu to be Kachɛgboŋ na be asheŋ
13Kumo be ŋklade nɛ nnaŋ to be benimuana na kikɛ, nɛ bɔrɛmatopoana na nɛ Livaiebi na yɔ Ɛzra kutɔ nɛ e ya ŋini bumo mbra na. 14B ba pin fanɛ mbra nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla bumo nananyɛn Mosis so n sa bumo na bee ŋini fanɛ jemanɛ kama nɛ baa ji Abuu to be Kachɛgboŋ na kufɔl shunusopo na to na, a daga fanɛ b baa yuu abuu nɛ a maa chɛr nsaa wɔ amo to hale nɛ kachɛgboŋ na e fo ekar. 15Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ koya fanɛ a daga fanɛ b ber kebomboŋ efuli na kikɛ so fanɛ b yɔ kupuŋ to n ya ku ndibi nɛ amo be afantaŋ maa gbaŋgbaŋ fanɛ ɔlifdibi nɛ ŋkubadibi be ayabi m ba yuu abuu na.
16Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na ya ku ndibi nɛ amo be afantaŋ maa gbaŋgbaŋ na be ayabi m ba yuu abuu bumo be achoŋiana so nɛ bumo be elaŋ to be alɔnɛ so nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ so nɛ alɔnɛ nɛ a dese m mata mbuna nɛ baa tre Nchu be Kabuna nɛ Efrayim be Kabuna ase na so. 17Bekama nɛ b shi Babilɔn be kadegboŋ na to m bɛta m ba daŋ yuu abuu nna a wɔ amo to a ji Abuu to be Kachɛgboŋ na kagbenefuliso nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, yili Nun pibinyɛn Joshuwa, nɛ e fara n juŋkpar Israɛlebi na ŋ kɔ n sɔ kasawule na be jemanɛ na kikɛ b maŋ daŋ naŋ ji kachɛgboŋ na kikɛ ama loŋ be kachɛ na. 18Baŋ yili kachɛ nɛ b fara kachɛgboŋ na be keji n ya fo kumo be kachɛ shunusopo na, Ɛzra daa kraŋ mbra be kawɔl na nna a sa basa na karechɛ kikɛ. Kachɛ burwasopo na nɛ ekama gama abar so nɛ b bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ, fanɛ kananɛ mbra na ŋini na.

Title: NEHEMAYA 9
Content:
Basa na ka bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo be alubi be asheŋ
1Kufɔl shunusopo na be kachɛ adunyɔ nɛ ana na nɛ Israɛlebi na shɛr ŋ kishi nseŋ buu nli be nle nseŋ wora eshishɛr ŋ gbiti bumo be amu to a ŋini bumo be ŋgbene ka jija bumo ŋkpal bumo be alubi so so. 2B daŋ barga bumo amu ashi befɔ na kutɔ nna nseŋ ya yili m bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo nɛ bumo nanaana be alubi nɛ b wora. 3Awa asa nɛ b yil a nu b ka bee kraŋ Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na be mbra be kawɔl na. Kumo be kaman nɛ b naŋ ta awa asa malɛ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo be alubi nseŋ bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Kadmiɛl nɛ Bani nɛ Shebania nɛ Bunni nɛ Sherebia nɛ Bani nɛ Chenani dii n yili kejaŋ nɛ k yuu n sa Livaiebi na so ŋ kule Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na awɔrso. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Joshuwa nɛ Kadmiɛl nɛ Bani nɛ Hashabnaya nɛ Sherebia nɛ Hodia nɛ Shebania nɛ Petahiya nɛ b shi Livai be yiri to na kaŋɛ basa le:
“Men koso n yili nseŋ boŋ to m maŋkura
Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ na.
Men maŋkura mbe mamachi be Ketre na,
E shi ga nɛ kɔnɔ to be mmalga
maaŋ tiŋ n ji mbe asheŋ.”
Basa na ka kule Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Fo nawule e la Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na.
Fo e to ebɔrɛso nɛ achɛkpabi kikɛ,
Fo e to kasawule nɛ asɔ nɛ e wɔ kumo so kikɛ.
Fo e to teku nɛ kumo to be asɔ keniso kikɛ
Ŋkpa kikɛ shi fo kutɔ nna,
nɛ achɛkpabi nɛ a wɔ awɔlpa to kikɛ
bee fur fo a kpaŋ fo.
7Fo e la Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ
Fo e lara an nananyɛn Eebram dra dra na
ashi kade nɛ baa tre Ur nɛ k wɔ Babilɔn be efuli so
nseŋ chɛrga mbe ketre ŋ ki Eebraham na.
8Ŋkpal e ka daa ji kashenteŋ a sa fo so
fo nɛ mo daŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nna
fanɛ feeŋ ta Keenanebi nɛ Hitebi
nɛ Amɔriebi nɛ Pɛrizebi nɛ
Jebusiebi nɛ Giigaebi
be nsawule n sa mbe kaman to ebi.
Naniere fo wora fo kɔnɔ naseso na m bɔlɔ so
fanɛ kananɛ fee wora saŋkikɛ na.
9An nanaana ka daa wɔ Ijipt be efuli so na,
fo daŋ wu awurfoŋ nɛ b daa ji.
B ka ya fo Teku Peper na ase
nɛ b shu a fin fo kechɛto,
nɛ fo alɛ nu bumo be kushu
nseŋ chɛ bumo to.
10Fo daa nyi kananɛ Ijipt be ewurgboŋ Fɛɛro
nɛ mbe ekrachiana nɛ efuli na kikɛ be basa
daŋ kɔrfɛ fo basa.
Amoso fo daŋ wora emamachisheŋ
nɛ e bee keta kufu nna
ŋ gbiti Ijipt be efuli so be ewura Fɛɛro nɛ mbe basa
nseŋ nya ketre lela nɛ
k wɔtɔ hale nɛ mbre.
11Fo e daŋ shin nɛ Teku chiŋgeliŋ na ku to
nɛ fo basa nite kasawule wɔlso so
m bɔla kumo to n dii n choŋ.
Ama fo daŋ shin nna nɛ bumo doŋana
bre mur nchu na to nna
fanɛ kananɛ kejembu bee tɔr nchu to na.
12B ka dii teku na be kaman,
karechɛ kikɛ fo daa bɔla
awɔlpa to nna a juŋkpar fo basa kapaso,
nsaa bɔla edɛ be kabɔlpi so
a juŋkpar a ŋini bumo ekpa kanyɛso.
13Fo daŋ shi ebɔrɛso nna ŋ gbelge m ba
Sainai be kebee na so m ba sa fo basa
mbra nɛ keŋini nɛ a walɛ ga n sa bumo.
14Fo yili kumo n sa bumo fanɛ b baa
ta fo kewushiachɛ na fanɛ kachɛ cheembi.
Fo daŋ kaŋɛ fo kayɛrbi Mosis nna
fanɛ e ŋini bumo fo mbraana na.
15Akoŋ ka daŋ pɛ bumo
fo sa bumo ajibi nɛ a shi ebɔrɛso nna.
Achukoŋ ka daa kɔ bumo,
fo daŋ shin nɛ nchu lar kefalta to nna
nɛ b nuu.
Kumo be kaman nɛ fo kaŋɛ bumo
fanɛ b kɔ n suge kasawule nɛ
fo nase kumo be kɔnɔ na nna.
16-17Ama an nanaana nɛ b la
ŋgbene kpakpasowuraana na
daa maŋ wora fo kasonu.
B daŋ teŋ emamachisheŋ
nɛ fo daŋ wora n sa bumo na so nna,
nseŋ daŋ yili kumo fanɛ baaŋ bɛta
n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so n naŋ ya ki anya ndoŋ.
Ama fo, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee wu kuwɔr,
nsaa ta alubi a paŋ manaŋ manaŋ nna.
Fo la alelaworpo nna nsaa kɔ kasha nɛ kanyiti.
Jemanɛ nɛ b lɔŋɛ kenabi be kapɔrduli
a bunyaŋ kumo na,
18fo daa maŋ lar bumo kaman.”
B daa tege fo nna a kaŋɛ:
“Kegbir nɛ k kɔ n suge anyi
ashi Ijipt be efuli so nna na.”
19“Ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu ka shi ga so
fo daa ŋini bumo ekpa nna saŋkikɛ,
fo alɛ daa maŋ yige bumo n lɛ keshishɛrsawule so.
Fo daa bɔla kuwɔlpa so nna a ŋini bumo
ekpa kapaso nsaa bɔla
edɛ be kabɔlpi so a juŋkpar bumo kanyɛso.
20Fo Kiyoyu lela e ŋini bumo kusɔ nɛ k daga
nseŋ sa bumo ajibi nɛ baa tre manna na nɛ b ji.
Kumo be kaman nɛ fo sa bumo nchu nɛ b nuu.
21Fo daŋ keni bumo so nɛnɛ,
Nfɛ adena nɛ shɛŋ maŋ tir bumo.
Bumo be asɔbuuso daa maŋ wu.
Bumo be asɛbta daa maŋ ji,
nɛ bumo be aya malɛ daa maŋ puŋi.
22Fo daŋ chɛ bumo to nɛ b pɔɔ bewura so
n suge bumo be nsawule.
Hɛshbɔn be efuli so be ewura Sihɔn,
nɛ Baashan be efuli so be ewura Ɔg
gba daŋ ti bewura nɛ b daŋ pɔɔ so na so nna.
23Fo daŋ bar bumo kasawule
nɛ fo nase kumo be kɔnɔ
n sa bumo nanaana na so nna.
Kumo be kaman nɛ fo nɛfa bumo
nɛ k wora fanɛ bumo be efuli so be basa
ka daa shi a chɔ achɛkpabi nɛ e wɔ awɔlpa to na.
24Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ bumo nanaana
kɔ n suge Keenanebi be kasawule.
Fo e daŋ chɛ bumo to nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ
bewuraana nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so.
Fo e shin nɛ b tiŋ n wora bumo doŋana
kusɔ kama nɛ baa sha kikɛ.
25Kumo be kaman nɛ b suge
ndegboŋ nɛ egbalana kulti na
nɛ adɔsawule nɛ e walɛ.
B daŋ suge nwu nɛ basa daa wɔ amo to
nɛ atirbu nɛ b kur n laa to a saŋ nchu,
nɛ ndibi sɔrso be adɔana,
nɛ ɔlifs be ndibi be adɔana
nɛ ndibi sɔrso damtaana nna.
B daa ji nna a moɛ
nseŋ daa ji eyur ŋkpal fo enɛfa damta so.
26Ade kikɛ be kaman b kraŋ lar fo kaman
nseŋ kini kewora fo mbra kasonu.
B daŋ mɔ fo anebiana
nɛ b daŋ kpele bumo kusoe
fanɛ b bɛta m ba fo kutɔ na nna.
Kumo be kaman nɛ b shoduu fo ketre.
27Amoso fo ta bumo nna
m bɔɔ bumo doŋana enɔ,
nɛ b kɔrfɛ bumo ga.
Ama bumo be awurfoŋ na to,
b daŋ kule fo fanɛ fo chɛ bumo to nna.
Ebɔrɛso nɛ fo wɔ nseŋ nu bumo be kekule,
ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu ka shi ga so,
fo daŋ shuŋi bejuŋkparpo nna
nɛ b ba kɔ n suge bumo ashi bedoŋ be enɔ to.
28Ama b baŋ nya kayurwushi,
baa kilgi nna a wora alubi a da fo so,
nɛ fo naŋ ta bumo m bɔɔ
bumo doŋana enɔ.
Kumo be kaman nɛ b naŋ kule n fin fo kechɛto,
ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu ka shi ga so,
fo naŋ laŋɛ m mɔlga bumo.
29Fo kpele bumo kusoe fanɛ b bɛ fo keŋini so
ama ŋkpal bumo be kamoowuso,
b kini kebɛ fo mbra na so
amo nɛ esa beeŋ bɛ so nseŋ nya kebaawɔtɔ lela,
ama ŋkpal bumo be ŋgbene kpakpaso so
b kini kewora fo kasonu.
30Nfɛ damta nɛ fo kpele bumo kusoe kanyitiso,
fo Kiyoyu malɛ bɔla anebiana so m malga
kenishipereso n sa bumo, ama b kini kenu n sa fo.
Amoso nɛ fo ta bumo bɔɔ bumo doŋana enɔ na.
31Ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu kaa shi ga so,
fo maŋ pal kaman n sa bumo ŋko m mur bumo na,
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo la kuwɔrwu be Ebɔrɛ nna.
32O, anyi be Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ eleŋ kikɛ bɔɔ fo enɔ,
nɛ fo asheŋ kɔ kufu;
fo maa lar fo kamalga kaman kikɛ,
kasha malɛ bɔlɔ fo to kiŋkiŋ.
Nyiŋi awurfoŋ nɛ k ba anyi nɛ anyi be bewura nɛ
bejuŋkparpo nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ anebiana nɛ an nanaana
nɛ anyi be basa kikɛ so,
yili Asiriya be ewura be jemanɛ kikɛ so m ba fo kabre.
33Fo kɔ ekpa nɛ fo tɔrɔ anyi ŋkpal fo kashenteŋ so,
ama fo yige alubi nɛ an wora ere kikɛ m paŋ anyi.
34Anyi be bewura nɛ bejuŋkparpo nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana
nɛ an nanaana maŋ bɛ fo mbra nɛ mmalga
kpakpaso mo nɛ fo ŋini bumo fanɛ b bɛ so na so.
35Ŋkpal fo nɛfa nɛ fo daŋ ta n sa fo basa so
bewura e daa juŋkpar bumo.
Loŋ be saŋɛ na, nɛ b daa wɔ kasawule
nɛ fo ta n sa bumo na so,
ama b kini nsaa wɔ kulubi to.
36Kabre an ki anya ashi kasawule lela nɛ fo ta n sa
an nanaana fanɛ b baa ji kumo be tɔnɔ na;
an ki anya kashenteŋto.
37Kasawule na malɛ be asɔrso lela kikɛ ki
bewura nɛ fo lara fanɛ b baa ji kuwura anyi so
ŋkpal anyi be alubi so na peya nna;
bumo alɛ naa ji eleŋ anyi nɛ anyi be asɔbɔya so,
ŋkpal loŋ so an wɔ kagbenejija to nna.”
38Ŋkpal le so an sibɛ ŋkre kpakpaso n nase,
nɛ anyi be bejuŋkparpo nɛ Livaiebi
nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana shuli so nɛ ŋkre na yili.

Title: NEHEMAYA 10
Content:
1Basa nɛ b daŋ yisi enɔ nɛ ŋkre na yili e la Hakalia pibinyɛn Nehemaya nɛ e la gomena na nɛ Zɛdikaya nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana 2-8Seria nɛ Azariya nɛ Jɛremaya,
nɛ Paasha nɛ Amariya nɛ Malkija
nɛ Haatush nɛ Shebania nɛ Maluk
nɛ Harim nɛ Meremɔf nɛ Obadaya
nɛ Danɛl nɛ Ginetɔn nɛ Baruk
nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Abija nɛ Mijamin
nɛ Mazia nɛ Bilgai nɛ Shemaya.
9Livaiebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba yisi enɔ e la,
Azariya pibinyɛn Joshuwa
nɛ Binui nɛ e shi Henadad Kadmiɛl be kabuna,
10nɛ mo kurgepoana la Shebania
nɛ Hodia nɛ Kalita nɛ Pelaya nɛ Hanan
11nɛ Maika nɛ Rehɔb nɛ Hashabia
12nɛ Zakɔɔ nɛ Sherebia nɛ Shebania
13nɛ Hodia nɛ Bani nɛ Beninu na.
14Bejuŋkparpo na malɛ e daa la Parosh nɛ Pahaf Mowab nɛ Elaa nɛ Zaatu nɛ Bani,
15nɛ Buuni nɛ Azgad nɛ Bebai,
16nɛ Adonija nɛ Bigvai nɛ Adin,
17nɛ Atɛr nɛ Hɛzekaya nɛ Azzu,
18nɛ Hodia nɛ Haashum nɛ Bɛzai,
19nɛ Harif nɛ Anatɔf nɛ Nebai,
20nɛ Magpiash nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Heza,
21nɛ Meshezabe nɛ Zadɔk nɛ Jadua,
22nɛ Pelatia nɛ Hanan nɛ Anaya,
23nɛ Hoshia nɛ Hananiya nɛ Hashuub,
24nɛ Halohɛsh nɛ Pilha nɛ Shobek,
25nɛ Rehum nɛ Hashabna nɛ Maaseia,
26nɛ Ahia nɛ Hanan nɛ Anan,
27nɛ Maluk nɛ Harim nɛ Baana.
Kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be asheŋ
28-29Anyi Israɛlebi na kikɛ, ta bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo na nɛ beshɛbompoana na nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be beshumpo na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na n ta anyi be beche nɛ mbia nɛ b daŋ kikɛ n ti so, barga anyi be amu ashi befɔ nɛ b wɔ kasawule ere so to nna. Naniere an wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nna fanɛ anyeeŋ pin kusɔ nɛ anyee wora to nɛnɛ. Amoso nɛ an baŋ maŋ naŋ wora Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na be mbra nɛ keŋini nɛ e ta m bɔla mbe kayɛrbi Mosis so n sa anyi na kasonu, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔsho e ba anyi so.
30Anyi maaŋ shin nɛ anyi be mbicheso e kil befɔ.
31Anyi alɛ maaŋ tɔ asɔ, hale ajibi jiso gba esa kikɛ kutɔ Kewushiachɛ na ŋko kachɛ cheembi kikɛ.
Kafɛ shunusopo kikɛ, anyeeŋ shin nɛ anyi be adɔsawule e dese n wushi. Anyi alɛ beeŋ ta basa be akɔ nɛ b ji anyi ŋ kɛ bumo loŋ be jemanɛ na.
32An yili kumo nna fanɛ kafɛ kikɛ anyeeŋ sa gbiti be ndarbi gbrɛbi n chɛ Ebɔrɛ be lambu to be kushuŋ to.
33Amansherbi na beeŋ chɛ to ŋ ka ebodobodo cheembi na nɛ karechɛ kikɛ be esarga chɔɔso nɛ ayu be esarga na nɛ esargagboŋ nɛ baa lara Kewushiachɛ nɛ Kufɔl Popɔr be Kachɛgboŋ nɛ nchɛgboŋ nɛ a ka na kikɛ be kukɔ. Amo alɛ beeŋ naŋ ka anyi be alubi be ketampaŋ be esarga nɛ kabɔrɛshuŋ be kukɔ kikɛ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.
34Anyi alɛ naŋ yili kumo fanɛ kafɛ kikɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi nɛ basa na to be bebɔlpo na be nnaŋ to be basa beeŋ baa bar ndibi puga edɛ bɔrɛlambu na to nna, saŋɛ na so baaŋ tiŋ a lara esarga bɔrɛsure na so, fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yili kumo na. 35Kafɛ kikɛ anyeeŋ baa bar anyi be ayu nɛ asɔrso nɛ an juŋkpar n teŋi ŋko n chuge, bɔrɛlambu na to.
36Anyi alɛ beeŋ naŋ bar an gbagba be ewurkoŋ nyɛnso nɛ anyi be ana nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ mboe be ewurkoŋ nyɛnso bɔrɛlambu na to m ba sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ baa shuŋ ndoŋ na nɛ b ta m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k sibɛ a dese Ebɔrɛ be mbra to nna na.
37Anyi alɛ beeŋ naŋ bar aboyu nyifu nɛ an fara ŋ kɔr m ba sa bɔrɛmatapoana na ashi bɔrɛlambu na to. Amo nɛ asɔrso nɛ a walɛ ga na nɛ yabra popɔr nɛ ɔlif be ŋku.
Anyeeŋ bar anyi be ayu teŋiso be kudu kudusopo m ba sa Livaiebi nɛ baa nite a sɔ asɔ ashi ndeana na to na. 38A daga bɔrɛmatapo nɛ e shi Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ to ka wɔtɔ jemanɛ nɛ Livaiebi na beeŋ sɔ kudukudusopo na ashi nde nɛ baa shuŋ to na kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ Livaiebi na gba e lara bumo be kudukudusopo m ba sa Ebɔrɛ ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu nɛ kumo be ebu nɛ baa yili bumo be ajibi nɛ asɔwurbi na to. 39Israɛl be basa nɛ Livaiebi na daga fanɛ b bar bumo be nyifu nɛ asɔnuuso, nɛ ɔlif be ŋku kakpa nɛ baa yili bɔrɛlambu na to be asɔ nɛ b kɔ a daŋɛ nɛ asɔ jito na. Bɔrɛlambu na be kakpa nɛ bekenipo nɛ beshɛbompoana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na wɔ na.
Anyi maaŋ kplaŋ anyi be Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu so kikɛ.

Title: NEHEMAYA 11
Content:
Basa nɛ b naaŋ ba chena Jerusalɛm to na be asheŋ
1Basa na be bejuŋkparpoana na daa wɔ Jerusalɛm to nna nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na malɛ to beri n lara basa kudu kikɛ to be esa koŋwule nɛ e ya chena Jerusalɛm nɛ k la kade cheembi na to nɛ bekpanu nɛ b ka na malɛ a ya chena nde mo nɛ a ka na to. Ŋkpal manɛ so nwu daa maŋ shi Jerusalɛm to. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na nɛfa bekama nɛ b shuli fanɛ bumo ere beeŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya chena na. 3Bekama nɛ b wɔ nde nɛ a wɔ Juda be efuli so na daŋ chena bumo gbagba be nsawule so nna ashi bumo be nde to nsaa ji bumo be amu so. Bumo e daa la Israɛlebi na be beko nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo na nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be nyɛrbi be kaman to ebi. 4Juda mo nanabiana nɛ Bɛnjamin mo nanabiana ko daa wɔ Jerusalɛm to nna. Juda be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ b daŋ chena Jerusalɛm to na e daa la Ataya nɛ mo tuto la Uzaya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Zakareya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Amariya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Shefatiya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Mahalalɛl nɛ e la Pɛrez be kanaŋ to be esa na; 5nɛ Maaseia nɛ mo tuto la Baruk nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Kolhoze nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Hazaya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Adaya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Joarib, nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Zakareya nɛ e la Shela be kanaŋ to be esa na. 6Pɛrez mo nanabiana nɛ b daŋ chena Jerusalɛm daa la basa lempo alfa ana nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa nna. 7Bɛnjamin malɛ be kanaŋ to ebi e daa la Saalu nɛ e la Mɛshulam pibinyɛn nɛ mo nanabi malɛ la Joɛd na. Mbe kanaŋ to be basa ko malɛ e daa la Pɛdaya nɛ Kolaya nɛ Maaseia nɛ Itiɛl nɛ Jeshaya. 8Gabai nɛ Salai malɛ la basa nɛ bumo nɛ Sallu be kukurge mata abar nna nɛnɛ. Bumo be kanaŋ to ebi kikɛ la basa alfa akpanu nɛ adunyɔ aburwa nna. 9Zikri pibinyɛn Jowɛl e daa la bumo be ejuŋkparpo nɛ Hassenua pibinyɛn Juda malɛ la bumo be krachigboŋ nyɔsopo mo nɛ e bee keni bumo be kadegboŋ na so. 10Bɔrɛmatapoana bena e chena Jerusalɛm to. Emo nɛ e juŋkpar e la Jedaya nɛ mo tuto la Joarib nɛ mo tutokar la Jakin na.
11Enyɔsopo e daa la Seria nɛ mo tuto la Hilkiya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Mɛshulam nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Zadɔk nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Meriɔf nɛ mo tuto la Ahitub nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na. 12Bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo kikɛ daa la basa alfa aburwa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ nna.
Esasopo e daa la Jeroham pibinyɛn, Adaya nɛ mo nanaana la Pɛlaliya, nɛ Amzi nɛ Zakareya nɛ Pasha nɛ Malkija. 13Bumo nɛ b la kanaŋ na to be benimu kikɛ la basa alfa anyɔ nɛ adena nɛ anyɔ nna.
Bɔrɛmatapo nasopo e la Azarɛl pibinyɛn Amaslisa. Mo nanaana e daa la la Azai nɛ Meshlemɔf nɛ Imma. 14Bumo be kabuna ebi kikɛ daa la basa kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ aburwa nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda bumo kashenteŋto. Bumo ejuŋkparpo e daa la Zabdiɛl, Hegalion pibinyɛn.
15Livaiebi damta e daŋ chena Jerusalɛm to. Emo nɛ ejuŋkparso e la Hashub pibinyɛn, Shemaya nɛ mo nananyɛnana la Azrikam nɛ Hashabia nɛ Buuni. 16Bumo nɛ b bɛ so e la Shabbeta nɛ Jozabad nɛ b daa la Livaiebi na be benimu nsaa keni bɔrɛlambu na be kowushina be ashuŋ so na. 17Mika pibinyɛn Mataniya malɛ gba daŋ ti Livaiebi na so. Mo nananyɛnana e daa la Zaabdi nɛ Asaf. Mataniya e daa juŋkpar bɔrɛlambu na to be beshɛbompo be katuŋ nɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na. Esa nɛ e daa sɔ Mataniya so e la Bakbukia.
Shamua malɛ pibinyɛn Abda nɛ e la Galal mo nanabiana gba daa la Livaiebi nɛ b chena Jerusalɛm to na be eko nna. Le be Galal ere shi Jedutum be kanaŋ to nna.
18Livaiebi nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm to na kikɛ daa la basa alfa anyɔ nɛ aduburwa nɛ ana nna.
19Basa nɛ b daa keni mbunaana na so na malɛ e daa la Akuub nɛ Taalmɔn nɛ mo kurgepoana. B daa la basa kalfa nɛ adushunu nɛ anyɔ nna. 20Israɛlebi be basa nɛ b ka na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na kikɛ da chena bumo be amu so nna ashi Juda be efuli so be nde to. 21Jerusalɛm to be kaba nɛ baa tre Ofɛl na, nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo kikɛ na daa wɔ. Ziha nɛ Gishpa malɛ e daa la bumo be bejuŋkparpo. 22Bani pibinyɛn mo nɛ baa tre Uzzi nɛ e la Hashabia mo nanabi na e daa keni bumo so ashi Jerusalɛm. Mo nananyɛnana e la Mataniya nɛ Mika nɛ b shi Asaf be kanaŋ to nsaa la bɔrɛlambu na to be beshɛbompo be enimu. 23Ewura daŋ nase mbra nna n sa bumo a ŋini kananɛ baaŋ baa juŋkpar nshɛ kebɛso kebɛso ashi bɔrɛlambu na to karechɛ kama. 24Mɛshezabel pibinyɛn Pethalia nɛ e shi Zeera be kanaŋ to nsaa la Juda be yiri to be esa na e daa yili Israɛlebi be katelamu to ashi Pɛshiya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ be lambu to.
Basa nɛ b wɔ nde pɔtɛ to be asheŋ
25Basa na be beko daa wɔ ndegboŋ nɛ a mata bumo be ndɔana to na nna. Juda be yiri to ebi daa wɔ Kiriaf Aba nɛ Dibɔn nɛ Jekabzeel nɛ 26Joshuwa nɛ Molada nɛ Befpɛlɛt 27nɛ Hazashuwal nɛ Bɛshiba nɛ 28nɛ Ziklag nɛ Mɛkona 29nɛ Envimɔn nɛ Zora nɛ Jamaf 30nɛ Zanua nɛ Adulam nɛ Lakish nɛ Azika. Ndeana ere kikɛ daa dese Bɛshiba nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nna hale n ya lar Hinnɔm be ketaŋɛ nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso ashi Jerusalɛm be kekel to na. 31Nde nɛ Bɛnjamin be yiri to ebi malɛ daa wɔ e la Geeba nɛ Mikmash nɛ Ai nɛ Bɛtɛl nɛ kumo be ndewurbi nɛ 32Anatɔf nɛ Nɔb nɛ Anani 33nɛ Hazɔɔ nɛ Rama nɛ Gitaɛm, 34nɛ Hadid nɛ Zebotim nɛ Nebalaat 35nɛ Lɔd nɛ Ono, nɛ ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Enɔto be beshumpo be Ketaŋɛ na. 36B daŋ yɛr Livaiebi nɛ b daa wɔ Juda be kebonfu to na be galeŋga nna nɛ b ya tu Bɛnjamin be basa na n chena.

Title: NEHEMAYA 12
Content:
Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi be asheŋ
1Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi nɛ Shealtiɛl pibinyɛn, Zerubabel nɛ Joshuwa daŋ juŋkpar ŋ keta bumo n shi Babilɔn be efuli so kenyaya to m bɛta m ba na be atre nde. 2-7Bɔrɛmatapoana na e daa la
Seria nɛ Jɛremaya nɛ Ɛzra,
nɛ Amariya nɛ Maluk nɛ Hatush,
nɛ Shekanaya nɛ Rehum nɛ Meremɔf,
nɛ Iddo nɛ Ginetɔi nɛ Abija,
nɛ Mijamin nɛ Maadiya nɛ Bilga,
nɛ Shemaya nɛ Joirib nɛ Jedaya,
nɛ Sallu nɛ Amɔk nɛ Hilkiyah nɛ Jedaya.
Joshuwa be jemanɛ na, le be basa ere e daa la bejuŋkparpo ashi bumo braana bɔrɛmatapoana kikɛ to.
8Livaiebi nɛ bumo alɛ gba bɛta m ba e la Joshuwa nɛ Binui nɛ Kadmiɛl nɛ Sherebia nɛ Juda nɛ Mataniya. Bumo nɛ bumo be bechɛtopo e daa juŋkpar a boŋ kapandi be nshɛ. 9Bakbukia nɛ Uno nɛ bumo be bechɛtopo malɛ e daa shuli nshɛ nɛ b daa boŋ na so a sa bumo.
Bɔrɛmatapo Nimuso Joshuwa be kaman to ebi be asheŋ
10Joshuwa e daa la Joikim mo tuto, nɛ Joikim malɛ daa la Eliashib mo tuto; nɛ Eliashib malɛ daa la Joida mo tuto 11nɛ Joida malɛ daa la Jonatan mo tuto; nɛ Jonatan malɛ daa la Jadua mo tuto.
Bɔrɛmatapoana be mbuna be benimu be asheŋ
12Saŋɛ so nɛ Joikim daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na bɔrɛmatapoana ere e daa la bumo be mbuna be benimuana: Meeria e daa la Seiria be kabuna be benimu. Hanani malɛ e daa la Jɛremaya be kabuna be enimu. 13Ɛzra be kabuna be enimu e la Mɛshulam nɛ Amariya be kabuna be enimu la Jehohanan. 14Maluk be kabuna be enimu e la Jonatan nɛ Shebania be kabuna be enimu la Josɛf. 15Harim be kabuna be enimu e la Adna nɛ Meraɔf be kabuna be enimu la Helkia. 16Iddo be kabuna be enimu e la Zakareya nɛ Ginetɔn be kabuna be enimu la Mɛshulam. 17Abija be kabuna be enimu e la Zikri nɛ Miniamin nɛ Moadia be kabuna be enimu la Piltia. 18Bilga be kabuna be enimu e la Shamua nɛ Shemaya be kabuna be enimu la Jehonatan. 19Joirib be kabuna be enimu e la Mattenia nɛ Jedaya be kabuna be enimu e la Uzzi. 20Salai malɛ be kabuna be enimu e la Kallai nɛ Amɔk malɛ be kabuna be enimu la Eber. 21Hilkiya be kabuna be enimu e la Hashabia nɛ Jedaya malɛ be kabuna be enimu la Netanɛl.
Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi be nnaŋ be asheŋ
22Jemanɛ nɛ Eliashib nɛ Joida nɛ Johanan nɛ Jadua daŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo nimusoana kebɛso kebɛso nɛ ewurgboŋ Dariɔs daa ji Pɛshiya be efuli so be kuwura na, b daŋ sibɛ Livaiebi nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana be benimuana be atre n wɔtɔ kawɔl to n nase nna. 23Ama Johanan be luwu be kaman, b maŋ naŋ sibɛ Livaiebi be benimuana na be atre n wɔtɔ kawɔl to n nase.
24Hashabia nɛ Sherebia nɛ Kadmɛl pibinyɛn Joshuwa nɛ Binui nɛ basa nɛ baa sɔ bumo so a boŋ nshɛ na e daŋ juŋkpar Livaiebi na be ntuŋ anyɔ m boŋ kapandi be nshɛ m maŋkura Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kayɛrbi ewura Deevid daŋ yili kumo na.
25Mataniya nɛ Bakbukia nɛ Obadaya nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ Talmɔn nɛ Akuub e daa la basa nɛ b daa keni ebuana nɛ baa yili asɔ amo to ashi bɔrɛlambu na be mbuna ase na so.
26Joshuwa pibinyɛn, ewura Jowakim nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la ewura Jozadak na be jemanɛ to kikɛ nɛ basa ere wɔtɔ. Loŋ be jemanɛ na ma e daa la gomena nɛ Ɛzra nɛ e daa ŋini Mosis be mbra na malɛ daa la bɔrɛmatapo.
Nehemaya ka ta Jerusalɛm be egbal na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ be asheŋ
27Jemanɛ nɛ b daa ta Jerusalɛm be egbal nɛ b lɔŋɛ m pɔr na a bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ na, b daŋ kela n tre Livaiebi nɛ b wɔ Juda be efuli kikɛ so nna nɛ b ba ta alaŋsɔ be yiri yiri m boŋ kapandi be nshɛ m maŋkura Ebɔrɛ. 28-29Livaiebi nɛ b la beshɛbompo na daa wɔ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti Jerusalɛm na nna. Amoso bumo be ndeana to nɛ ndewurbi nɛ a kulti Netofa nɛ Bɛf Gilgaal nɛ Gɛba nɛ Azmavɛf na nɛ b daŋ shi m ba kesheŋ wora na to. 30Bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na daŋ fɔrso daŋkare be ekpa so nna ŋ ki cheembi. Kumo be kaman nɛ b wora loŋ n sa basa nɛ b ka na nɛ mbunaana na nɛ kadegboŋ na be egbalana, nɛ amo alɛ gba ki cheembi.
31N daŋ shin nɛ Juda be bejuŋkparpoana na dii kadegboŋ na be egbal na so nna nɛ n ta beshɛbompo be ntuŋ anyɔ nɛ b bɛ abar so a nite egbal na so a boŋ nshɛ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ na be kekeni so m bɔɔ bumo enɔ. Katuŋ ko daŋ bɛ abar so a nite a yɔ Epi be Kabuna na be kaba so be jisoso nna. 32Hoshiya malɛ nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na be bargato daŋ bɛ beshɛbompo na so a yɔ. 33Kumo be kaman nɛ Azariya nɛ Ɛzra nɛ Mɛshulam nɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana na 34nɛ Juda nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Shemaya nɛ Jɛremaya malɛ gba bee foŋ mbel a bɛ bumo so. 35Ndoŋ nna nɛ Zakareya nɛ mo tuto la Jonatan nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Shemaya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Mattania nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Mikaya nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Zakku nɛ mo alɛ mo tuto la Asaf na 36nɛ Shamaya nɛ Azarɛl nɛ Mikalai nɛ Gilalai nɛ Maai nɛ Netanɛl nɛ Juda nɛ Hanani kikɛ keta alaŋsɔ a laŋ a bɛ Ɛzra nɛ e la mbra ŋinipo na so. Alaŋsɔ na barkasa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kenya ewura Deevid daŋ laŋ dra dra na. 37B ka ta n ya fo Kechubu be Kabuna na ase nɛ b dii atemprembi nɛ baa diiso a yɔ ewura Deevid be Kadegboŋ na to na n ya baŋ mbe Lambu na so m bɛta n yɔ egbal nɛ k wɔ Nchu be Kabuna nɛ k wɔ kadegboŋ na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so ase na.
38Beshɛbompoana na be katuŋ nyɔsopo na malɛ bɛ abar so n sɔ bena so a nite egbal na so nna nɛ ma alɛ bɛ bumo so. Bumo nɛ Juda be bejuŋkparpoana na be bargato nɛ b ka na e daa nite a yɔ. An daŋ nite n ya baŋ Asure be Ebu jeŋgreŋ na so n ya fo Egbal Gboŋ na ase nna. 39An shi ndoŋ nna n ya baŋ Efrayim be Kabuna na nɛ Jeshana be Kabuna na nɛ Kɔrɔtɔ be Kabuna na nɛ Hananɛl be Ebu jeŋgreŋ na nɛ Kalfa be Ebu jeŋgreŋ na nɛ Mbolpɔ be Kabuna na so. Bekumpo be Kabuna nɛ k wɔ bɔrɛlambu na ase na nɛ an ya tar.
40Ntuŋ anyɔ nɛ b daa nite a boŋ nshɛ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ na kikɛ daŋ ba shɛr abar so bɔrɛlambu na ase nna. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ntuŋ na be kekama be basa ya yili bumo be eyilikpa ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ ma alɛ nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na be bargato malɛ yɔ anyi be kakpa. 41Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b daŋ ti anyi be katuŋ na so a foŋ mbel na e daa la Eliakim nɛ Maaseia nɛ Miniamin nɛ Mikaya nɛ Elionai nɛ Zakareya nɛ Hananiya. 42Bumo nɛ b daa yil ndoŋ saŋɛ nɛ Jezrahiya daa juŋkpar beshɛbompo nɛ b daa boŋ nshɛ awɔrso na e la Maaseia nɛ Shemaya nɛ Eleazar nɛ Uzzi nɛ Jehohanan nɛ Malkija nɛ Elaam nɛ Ezar. 43Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ basa na be ŋgbene fuli bumo nna ga, amoso b daŋ ji bumo be amu nna nseŋ lara esarga damta n sa Ebɔrɛ. Beche nɛ mbia kikɛ daŋ ti kayurji na so nna. Esa daa wɔ kufɔ nɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na gba e daa beeŋ nu awɔr nɛ basa na daa wora kagbene fuli so na.
44Loŋ be kamɔnchɛ na b daŋ lara basa ko nna fanɛ b baa keni ebuana nɛ baa yili ajibi nɛ asɔ wurbi ashi bɔrɛlambu na to na so nna. Bumo alɛ e naaŋ baa sɔ adɔjibi nɛ b juŋkpar n teŋi na nɛ adɔjibi nɛ asɔbɔya be kudu kudusopo nɛ b lara m ba sa Ebɔrɛ na. Bumo koŋwule na e naaŋ baa sɔ adɔjibi nɛ Mosis be mbra bee ŋini fanɛ b baa bar m ba kaa sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi na gba.
45Bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na be kushuŋ daŋ bɔlɔ ekama kenishi jemanɛ nɛ b daŋ wora edaŋkaresheŋ nɛ a shin nɛ basa na nyalɛ so nseŋ tiŋ n nya m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na nna. Beshɛbompoana na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpo na daŋ shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ nɛnɛ nna fanɛ kananɛ ewura Deevid nɛ mo pibinyɛn ewura Sɔlɔmɔn daŋ yili kumo n sa bumo na. 46Dra na kikɛ ashi ewura Deevid nɛ Asaf be jemanɛ to, beshɛbompo na e naa juŋkparpo basa na a boŋ nshɛ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ. 47Jemanɛ nɛ Zerubabel daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nɛ ma, Nehemaya, malɛ daa la gomena ashi Juda be efuli so na, ekama ashi Israɛl be efuli so daa sa kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ e sa nɛ beshɛbompo na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpo nɛ b shi Livaiebi be yiri to na e baa nya bumo be karechɛ kikɛ be kusɔ jiso nna. Basa na daa lara ŋkɛ cheembi nna a sa Livaiebi na nɛ bumo alɛ bee lara amo to be amo nɛ a daga na a sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b la Ɛɛrɔn be kaman to ebi na.

Title: NEHEMAYA 13
Content:
Israɛlebi ka barga bumo be amu ashi befɔ to be asheŋ
1Kachɛ nɛ b kraŋ Mosis be mbra na awɔrso n sa ekama na nɛ kelar efuli fanɛ Ammɔnebi nɛ Mowabebi maŋ daga fanɛ b ti Ebɔrɛ be basa so. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so b daŋ kini kesa Israɛl be basa ajibi nɛ nchu nna nseŋ naŋ ber Balaam paa fanɛ e shoduu bumo jemanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ lara bumo n shi Ijipt be efuli so a yɔ Keenan be kasawule so nɛ b ya kɔ n sɔ kasawule na. Ama anyi be Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kilgi Balaam be shoduu na nna ŋ ki nɛfa n sa anyi. 3B ka kraŋ Mosis be mbra na nɛ Israɛlebi na nu so, b daŋ fara a ju basa kama nɛ bumo nanaana daa la befɔ ashi bumo to na nna.
Nehemaya ka naŋ gama mbe basa abar so be asheŋ
4Bɔrɛmatapo Eliashib daa la Tobaya mo kurgepo nna nɛ e daŋ shin nɛ e daa keni bɔrɛlambu na to be ebuana nɛ baa yili asɔ amo to na so. 5E daŋ shin nna nɛ Tobaya daa wɔ ebuana na be kegboŋgboŋi nɛ baa yili asɔ be yiri yiri fanɛ esarga be aboyu nɛ duwu nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be asɔ daŋɛso nɛ ashuŋsɔ nɛ ayu nɛ yabra nɛ ɔlif be ŋku be kudu kudusopo nɛ b bar m ba sa Livaiebi nɛ beshɛbompo na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpo na nɛ ŋkɛ nɛ b bar m ba sa bɔrɛmatapoana na kikɛ na to.
6Ewurgboŋ Atazɛzɛs ka bee ji Babilɔn be efuli so be kuwura be kafɛ adesa nɛ anyɔ to nɛ le be kesheŋ ere daŋ wora. N daa maŋ wɔ Jerusalɛm to loŋ be jemanɛ na ŋkpal ŋ ka daŋ yɔ nɛ n ya bɔ ewura Atazɛzɛs kubɔya a laŋɛ kananɛ asheŋ nite ashi Juda be efuli so na so. Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kule ewurgboŋ na ekpa m bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm. 7Ŋ ka bɛta n yɔ na pɔɛŋ nɛ m pin kusɔ lubi nɛ Eliashib wora ŋkpal e ka shin nɛ Tobaya wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be ebu na to so. 8Kedaŋ nu ma agbo ga nna nɛ m bela Tobaya be asɔ kikɛ n lɛ kowu. 9Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b fɔr ebu na daŋkare be ekpa so nɛ k ki cheembi n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na pɔɛŋ nseŋ bɛta bɔrɛlambu na be asɔ daŋɛso na kikɛ nɛ esarga be ayu na nɛ duwu na n ya wɔtɔ kumo to.
10Ma alɛ naŋ nu fanɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be beshɛbompo nɛ Livaiebi na be galeŋga lar Jerusalɛm to nna m bɛta n yɔ bumo be adɔana to, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa na daa maŋ naa sa bumo ajibi nɛ a bee fo bumo. 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ n tre bejuŋkparpoana na nseŋ malga agbo so m bishi bumo: “Manɛ nna nɛ men kplaŋ bɔrɛlambu na so?” Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b fara a shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ. 12Kede be kaman nɛ ekama ashi Juda be efuli so bar ayu nɛ yabra nɛ ɔlif be ŋku be kudu kudusopo m ba wɔtɔ bɔrɛlambu na be ebuana nɛ baa yili ajibi amo to na to. 13B ka bar amo n loge nɛ n lara basa asa nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ walɛ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda bumo nseŋ shin nɛ baa keni asɔ nɛ basa na bar na so nsaa chige amo to a sa basa. Basa nɛ n lara na e la Shelemaya nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo na, nɛ Zadɔk nɛ e la mbra ŋinipo na, nɛ Pedaya nɛ e la Livai be esa na. Esa nɛ e daa chɛ bumo to e la Zakku pibinyɛn Hanan nɛ mo nananyɛn daa la Mataniya na.
14Ma, Nehemaya bee kule Ebɔrɛ nna fanɛ e nyiŋi ma ŋkpal asɔ lela nɛ mee wora a sa bɔrɛlambu ere nɛ basa nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo kumo to na so.
15Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ dara m pin kusɔ nɛ Juda be basa na bee wora Kewushiachɛ na. Mannɛ kebaachichi asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na so a wora yabra nawule nɛ b daa wora ama b daa teŋi ayu, nsaa chuge egreep nɛ figi be asɔrso nɛ adɔjibi pɔtɛana kikɛ n ti so nna Kewushiachɛ na. Bumo alɛ daa naa ta ekurma a sulɔ amo nna a yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya ka fa. Amoso n daŋ kpele bumo kusoe nna fanɛ b sa maŋ naa fa ajibi Kewushiachɛ. 16Basa nɛ b daŋ shi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Tayɛ nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm to na daa bar ekɔrɔtɔ nɛ asɔ pɔtɛana ko nna m ba ka fa ndoŋ Kewushiachɛ na. 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nya agbo n fɛa Juda be bejuŋkparpoana so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kulubi nɛ menyee wora ere, Kewushiachɛ na nɛ menyee keni jiga na! 18Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ gberge anyi nɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ be basa ere kusoe nna ŋkpal an nanaana ka daŋ wora asheŋ nɛ anyee wora ere so a? To menyee sha keŋaba Kewushiachɛ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo e koso, ŋko?”
19N daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ Kewushiachɛ na e fara kaaseso na, b ti Jerusalɛm be mbuna na kikɛ nsaa maŋ bugi amo hale nɛ Kewushiachɛ na e ji n choŋ pɔɛŋ. Kumo be kaman nɛ n ta mbuna na be kekeni so be kushuŋ m bɔɔ ŋ gbagba be benyɛn nɛ n lara fanɛ b sa maŋ shin nɛ sheŋ e luri kadegboŋ na to Kewushiachɛ na enɔ. 20Beeŋ wora fanɛ kela koŋwule ŋko ale anyɔ nɛ eyawujipo ko nɛ bumo be asɔ faso dese Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na be kowushina ŋklade. 21Ama n daŋ fɛa bumo so nna ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Nɛ men naŋ wora loŋ, meeŋ shin nɛ b pɛ menyi n ti ebu. Yili loŋ be kachɛ na a yɔ, b maŋ naŋ ba Jerusalɛm to Kewushiachɛ kikɛ. 22Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Livaiebi na fanɛ b baa wora bumo be amu cheembi nsaa kuŋ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na be mbuna na Kewushiachɛ kikɛ, saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ ta kumo ŋ ki kachɛ cheembi nsaa sa kumo bunyaŋ.
Ebɔrɛ la ewɔrwupo nna, mee kule mo fanɛ e wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ nɛfa ma ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ mee wora ere so.
23Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ wu fanɛ Juwebi na be benyɛn ko daŋ ta beche ashi Ashdɔd be kadegboŋ to nɛ Ammɔn nɛ Mowab be efuliana so nna. 24Bumo be mbia be bargato daa maa tiŋ a malga Hibruw be ŋgbar. Ashdɔd be ŋgbar nɛ ŋgbar pɔtɛana ko nɛ b daa gbar. 25Amoso n daŋ shoduu loŋ be benyɛn agbo so nna nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ b bri beko nseŋ gberge bumo be emin gba n tia. Kumo be kaman nɛ n shin nɛ b nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘An bɔ ntaŋ a nase kɔnɔ Ebɔrɛ be ketre to fanɛ anyi maaŋ shin nɛ anyi be mbinyɛnso ŋko mbicheso e ta ŋko ŋ kil befɔ.’ 26Ebɔrɛ daŋ sha Israɛl be ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ga nseŋ daŋ shin nɛ durnya to kikɛ be ewura kikɛ maŋ fo mo so, ama beche pɔtɛ nɛ e ta na daŋ shin nɛ e shuŋ agbir nseŋ tɔr kulubi to nna. 27Amoso anyeeŋ nu n sa fo nsaa maaŋ kil befɔ n lar anyi be Ebɔrɛ kaman n wora kulubi ŋ gbiti mo.”
28Joida nɛ mo tuto la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Eliashib na pibinyɛn ko daŋ ta Sanballat nɛ e shi Bɛf Hɔrɔn na pibiche nna nɛ n ju mo pibinyɛn na n lar Jerusalɛm to.
29Mee kule Ebɔrɛ nna fanɛ e gberge bumo kusoe ŋkpal b ka wora n da bumo be kabɔrɛmata be atande so nseŋ ŋaba Livai be yiri na so.
30Kumo be kaman nɛ n wora ania fanɛ befɔ maaŋ naŋ nya ekpa a leŋ basa na to a wɔtɔ asheŋ lubi to nseŋ naŋ sa bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ Livaiebi na ashuŋ nɛ baaŋ baa shuŋ jemanɛ kikɛ. 31Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ basa na beeŋ baa bar ndibi puga edɛ bɔrɛsure na ase karechɛ kikɛ nseŋ naa bar bumo be adɔjibi nɛ baaŋ teŋi sososo na bɔrɛlambu na to.
Mee kule Ebɔrɛ nna fanɛ e nɛfa ma ŋkpal asɔ lela nɛ mee wora ere so.

Title: ƐSTA 1
Content:
B ka gboŋi ewurche Vashti kuwurche to be asheŋ
1-2Pɛshiya be efuli so be ewura nɛ baa tre Sɛgsis na daa wɔ mbe kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Susa na nna a ji kuwura efuli na be abonfugboŋ kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ ashunu nɛ a yili Indiya be efuli so ashi epeŋilarkpa n ya fo Etopiya be efuli so ashi epeŋitɔrkpa na so. 3E ka ji kuwura be kafɛ sasopo to nɛ e wora kejigboŋ n sa mbe benimuana nɛ ekrachiana. Pɛshiya be efuli so nɛ Midia be efuli so be esoji be benimu, n ta bewura nɛ b wɔ efuli na so nɛ bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ e daŋ ba kejigboŋ na to. 4Afɔl lela ashe kikɛ nɛ e bee ŋini basa nɛ b ba kejigboŋ na to na mbe kedamaya nɛ mbe kuwura be kemaŋkura nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ mbe efuli so kikɛ. 5Afɔl ashe na be kaman, nɛ ewura na naŋ wora kejigboŋ m bɛ abar so nchɛ ashunu n sa Susa be kade to ebi kikɛ. Damawuraana nɛ betirpo kikɛ daŋ yɔ kejigboŋ na to nna ashi ewura na be laŋ nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti na be kelɔnɛgboŋ na so. 6B daŋ ta ago be kechɛbi fuful parr nɛ kumo be kechɛbi nɛ k du fanɛ buru nna n wora patisa ŋ kulti kaboŋ na, nseŋ ta kechɛbi peper kunɔkunɔ m bɔla gbiti be mpinibi to n chɛ n chɛ patisa na m mata eshabɔrɛ nɛ b ta yawu kpakpaso be ajembu m pɔr na so. Shuwa nɛ gbiti be asɔ chenaso daa yil ndoŋ be mboŋ nɛ b ta yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso be yiri yiri n lɔŋɛ kasawule na so nna. 7Shuwa be asɔnuunchu nɛ amo kikɛ kɔr abar to nɛ b daa kɔ a chige nsa a sa basa nɛ b yɔ kejigboŋ na to na. Ewura na daŋ bugi kagbene nna n wora asheŋ. 8E daŋ sa ekpa nna fanɛ ekama beeŋ tiŋ n nuu nsa kanaŋkamaso nɛ k par mo. E daŋ kaŋɛ ewurkpa be nyɛrbi na nna fanɛ b sa ekama nsa kanaŋkamaso nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n nuu. 9Jemanɛ nɛ benyɛn na nɛ ewura na bee ji na nɛ ewurche Vashti gba wora kejigboŋ n sa kade na to be beche kikɛ ashi ewura Sɛgsis be laŋ to. 10Kachɛ shunusopo na nɛ ewura na be kagbene fuli mo ga ŋkpal nsa nɛ e nuu na so, nɛ e tre mbe nyɛrbi ashunu nɛ b fɛl bumo nɛ b wɔ mo kutɔ saŋkikɛ a shuŋ mo na. Bumo e la Mehuman nɛ Bizta nɛ Harbona nɛ Bigta nɛ Abagta nɛ Zeta nɛ Kakas. 11E daŋ shuŋi bumo fanɛ b ya shin nɛ ewurche Vashti e buu mbe kuwurwuro m ba mo kutɔ. Ewura na daa sha keta ewurche na nna n ji njɔŋ n ŋini ekrachiana na nɛ mbe befɔ nɛ b ba ndoŋ na kikɛ ŋkpal mbe kebita so. 12Ewura na be nyɛrbi na ka ya kaŋɛ ewurche Vashti kusɔ nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ na, nɛ e kini keba. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ewura na nya agbo ga nseŋ tinto. 13Saŋkama malɛ, pɔɛŋ nɛ ewura na e wora kusɔ ko a laŋɛ bumo be daŋkare nɛ mbra be ekpa so, e bee tre mbe benyiashempo nna m bishi bumo kusɔ nɛ k daga kewora. Amoso e daŋ tre mbe basa nɛ baa ji mo asoeto nna m bishi bumo kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ e wora. 14Bumo e la Kashena nɛ Sheta nɛ Admata nɛ Tarshish nɛ Mɛrɛs nɛ Masena nɛ Memukan nɛ b la Pɛshiya nɛ Midia be efuli so be benimugboŋ ashunu nɛ e bee to jina saŋkikɛ na. 15Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma ewura Sɛgsis e shuŋi n tre ewurche Vashti nɛ e kini keba! Naniere nuso nɛ anyi be mbra bee ŋini fanɛ an wora mo?” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Memukan kaŋɛ ewura na nɛ mbe benimuana na le: “Mannɛ ewura ere nawule nɛ ewurche Vashti keni jiga na, ama mbe benimuana nɛ mbe efuli so ebi kikɛ nɛ e keni jiga na. 17Efuli ere so be beche baŋ nu kusɔ nɛ ewurche Vashti wora ere baaŋ fara a keni bumo kulana jiga. Baaŋ baa kaŋɛ le: ‘Ewura Sɛgsis tre ewurche Vashti nɛ e kini.’ 18Pɛshiya nɛ Midia be benimuana be beche baŋ nu kusɔ nɛ ewurche ere wora, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ fara a wora bumo kulana loŋ kabre kikɛ. Kaplɛkama malɛ be beche beeŋ fara a fɛl bumo kulana, nɛ bumo kulana malɛ e baa nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo. 19Yiramu, nɛ k par fo bre, fo nase mbra nɛ baaŋ sibɛ n wɔtɔ Pɛshiya nɛ Midia be efuli so be mbra be nwɔl to nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n chɛrga kumo, fanɛ Vashti e sa maŋ naŋ ta keya n cha ewura pe kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo ta mbe kuwurche na n sa eche nɛ e bɔ mo. 20Fo baŋ nase le be mbra ere n sa fo efuli gboŋgboŋi ere kikɛ so ebi bre, beche nɛ b wɔ efuli ere so kikɛ beeŋ baa sa bumo kulana bunyaŋ hale nɛ b la damawuraana ŋko betirpo gba.” 21Le be nfɛra nɛ Memukan bar ere daŋ par ewura na nɛ mbe benimuana ga, nɛ ewura na wora kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo na kikɛ. 22Ewura na daŋ sibɛ nwɔl yiri kikɛ be ŋgbarto nna n sa mbe efuli so ebi kikɛ fanɛ, k daga kowurnyɛn kikɛ be kamalga ka kɔ eleŋ mbe laŋ to.

Title: ƐSTA 2
Content:
B ka ta Ɛsta ŋ ki ewurche be asheŋ
1Ewura Sɛgsis be agbo ka wushi na kikɛ, nɛ e kraa fɛ kusɔ nɛ Vashti wora na nɛ mbra nɛ mo alɛ nase a yɔ mbe kaplɛa so na be asheŋ. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na be besoetojipo nɛ e yirda ga na be beko kaŋɛ mo le: “Shin nɛ b luri to n fin besuŋgurbi nɛ b walɛ abita nsaa maŋ nyi benyɛn m ba sa ewura. 3Lara fo efuli ere be kaba kama so be ekrachi n shin nɛ b fin besuŋgurbi nɛ b walɛ abita m ba Susa m baa wɔtɔ ewura be laŋ to be kaboŋ nɛ baa wɔtɔ beche nawule na. Nseŋ ta bumo m bɔɔ Heegai nɛ b fɛl nɛ e bee keni beche so na enɔ, nɛ e ŋini bumo kananɛ baŋ baa lɔŋɛ bumo be amu nɛnɛ n lar kebita n ti so. 4Saŋɛ na so feeŋ lara bumo to be emo nɛ fee sha nɛ e ki ewurche n tal Vashti to.” Ewura na ka nu le be kasotoji ere nɛ e wu fanɛ k walɛ nseŋ bɛ kumo so. 5Jemanɛ ere so nɛ Juw be kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Mɔdikaya na wɔ Susa. Mo tuto e daa la Jaɛr nɛ mo nananyɛn Shimei malɛ la Kish nɛ e shi Bɛnjamin be kanaŋ to na pibinyɛn. 6Mɔdikaya daŋ ti basa nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza nɛ e la Babilɔn be ewura na daŋ pɛ fanɛ anya ashi Jerusalɛm nseŋ tintiŋ bumo n yɔ mbe efuli so, saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ pɛ Juda be ewura Jehowachin na so nna. 7Mɔdikaya mo wɔpa pibiche ko nɛ e daa walɛ kebita ga nsaa la kumunibi nɛ mbe Juw be ketre la Hadasa nɛ mbe ketre ko malɛ la Ɛsta na, daa wɔ Mɔdikaya kutɔ nna. Mɔdikaya daŋ ta mo nna fanɛ mo gbagba pibi ŋkpal mo nio nɛ mo tuto kikɛ ka wu ŋ ka mo so. 8Ewura na ka sa ebɔl nɛ b bar besuŋgurbi damta ewura be laŋ to be kakpa nɛ baa wɔtɔ beche nawule ashi Susa na, Ɛsta gba daŋ ti bumo so. B daŋ yɛr mo alɛ gba Heegai nɛ e bee keni ewurkpa be beche so na kutɔ nna. 9Ɛsta be asheŋ daŋ par Heegai ga. Ŋkpal loŋ so, e daa sa mo abitasɔ nɛ ajibi lela nna. Kaboŋ nɛ b wɔtɔ beche na be kakpa lela nɛ e daŋ shin nɛ b ta mo n wɔtɔ nseŋ lara ewurkpa be mbita ashunu nɛ baa shuŋ mo. 10Ŋkpal Mɔdikaya ka ji Ɛsta asoeto so e daa maŋ lara mbe kumu efuli ŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ e la Juw be esa nna. 11Karechɛ kama malɛ Mɔdikaya daa nite nna a kulti ewurkpa be kakpa nɛ beche na kikɛ wɔ na be anishito a fin kepin kananɛ Ɛsta du nɛ kusɔ nɛ k bee wora mo. 12Kafɛ koŋwule nɛ b sa beche na fanɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ bumo be amu n nyalɛ kebita n ti so. Baaŋ ta ŋku nɛ baa tre mir na n lɔŋɛ bumo be eyur so afɔl ashe nseŋ ta etulale malɛ be ŋku n lɔŋɛ bumo be eyur afɔl ashe nɛ a ka na. Kumo be kaman nɛ b yɛr beche na be ekama ewura Sɛgsis be anishito kukoko to. 13Saŋkama nɛ beche na be ekama bee sha nɛ e yɔ ewura na be anishito, kusɔ kama nɛ k par eche na nɛ e bee buu a lar kakpa nɛ b wɔtɔ beche na a yɔ ewura na be anishito. 14Eche na beeŋ yɔ ewura na kutɔ kaaseso nseŋ ya bɛta m ba Shaashgaz nɛ b fɛl nɛ e bee keni ewura be beche so ashi kakpa nɛ beche nawule wɔ na kutɔ kachipurso. Mo alɛ maaŋ naŋ bɛta n yɔ ewura na kutɔ kikɛ ama mbe asheŋ baaŋ par Ewura na nna nɛ e ti mbe ketre n shuŋi n tre mo. 15Jemanɛ ka fo nɛ Mɔdikaya mo wɔpa nɛ baa tre Abihail na, pibiche Ɛsta nɛ e ta ŋ ki fanɛ mo gbagba pibiche na e yɔ ewura na kutɔ nɛ e buu nle nɛ Heegai nɛ e bee keni kakpa nɛ beche na wɔ so na kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e buu na. Ɛsta malɛ be asheŋ daa par ekama nna. 16Ewura Sɛgsis ka ji kuwura be kafɛ shunusopo be kufɔl kudusopo nɛ baa tre Tibez na nɛ b bar Ɛsta ewura na pe. 17Ɛsta be asheŋ daŋ par ewura na ga nseŋ bɔlɔ mo kenishi nɛ e sha mo a chɔ beche na be ekama. Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ e ta kuwurche be kuwurwuro n buu mo nɛ e ki ewurche n tal ewurche Vashti to. 18Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura na shin nɛ b wora kejigboŋ n sa benimuana na nɛ ekrachiana na ŋkpal Ɛsta so. Nseŋ sa ebɔl fanɛ kumo be kachɛ e baa la kewushiachɛ n sa mbe efuli so be basa kikɛ. Ewura na daŋ sa basa ŋkɛ damta gba n ti so.
Mɔdikaya ka mɔlga ewura na be ŋkpa be asheŋ
19Besuŋgurbi na ka naŋ ba gama abar so kela nyɔsopo na, nɛ ewura na teŋ ta Mɔdikaya ŋ ki ewurkpa be krachi. 20Ŋkpal Mɔdikaya ka kaŋɛ Ɛsta fanɛ e sa maŋ kaŋɛ esa kama yiri nɛ k la mo so, Ɛsta daa maŋ kaŋɛ esa kikɛ yiri nɛ k la mo. Ɛsta daŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal e ka bee wora Mɔdikaya kasonu mbe kebia to kikɛ so.
21Jemanɛ nɛ Mɔdikaya daa la ewurkpa be krachi na, nɛ Bigtana nɛ Terɛsh nɛ b fɛl bumo nɛ baa keni ewura be ebu dese to so be kabuna so na, nya agbo n wɔtɔ ewura Sɛgsis nsaa kre mbe kemɔ ŋgbalanto. 22Mɔdikaya ka pin kumo be loŋ, nɛ e nya manaŋ n ya kaŋɛ ewurche Ɛsta nɛ mo alɛ kaŋɛ ewura na kusɔ nɛ Mɔdikaya kaŋɛ mo. 23B ka lara basa nɛ b lege kesheŋ na to n ya wu fanɛ k la kashenteŋ nna nɛ b chɛ basa anyɔ na efɔl n shiga ndibi so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na shin nɛ b yili mbe anishi to n sibɛ loŋ be kesheŋ na n wɔtɔ bumo be adrasheŋ be nwɔl to nɛ k baa la kanyiŋi.

Title: ƐSTA 3
Content:
Heman ka kre Juwebi be kemɔ be asheŋ
1Asheŋ ere be kaman nɛ ewura Sɛgsis ta kenimu nɛ k bɛ ewura na so na n sa kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre mo Heman nɛ e la Hammedaata pibinyɛn nseŋ shi Agag be kanaŋ to na. 2Ewura na daŋ tre mbe benimu nɛ baa shuŋ ewurkpa na kikɛ nna, ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa bunyaŋ Heman nseŋ naa jɔŋɛ mo ase. Nɛ bumo kikɛ bɛ kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ na so ama Mɔdikaya nawule. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ benimu nɛ baa shuŋ ewurkpa na bishi Mɔdikaya le: “Manɛ nna nɛ fo ere maa bɛ kusɔ nɛ ewura nase n sa anyi na so?” 4Saŋkama nɛ b baŋ kaŋɛ Mɔdikaya fanɛ e jɔŋɛ Heman ase, e bee kini nna nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ mo ere la Juw be esa nna, amoso e maaŋ jɔŋɛ Heman ase. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ Heman kumo be asheŋ nsaa keni ŋko e beeŋ yige Mɔdikaya ŋkpal e ka la Juw so.
5Heman ka pin fanɛ Mɔdikaya kini kejɔŋɛ mo ase ŋko m bunyaŋ mo, nɛ e nya agbo ga. 6E ka pin fanɛ Mɔdikaya la Juw be esa nna nɛ e yili kumo fanɛ e maaŋ tɔrɔ Mɔdikaya nawule, nsaa kre nia fanɛ e beeŋ mɔ Juw kama nɛ e wɔ Ewura Sɛgsis be efuli so. 7Ewura Sɛgsis ka ji kuwura be kafɛ kuduanyɔsopo be kufɔl sososo nɛ baa tre Nisan na to, nɛ Heman shin nɛ b to beri a fin kachɛ nɛ k daga fanɛ e wora kusɔ nɛ e bee kre na. Nɛ beri na ya tɔr kufɔl kuduanyɔsopo nɛ baa tre Ada na be nchɛ kuduasa. 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ Heman kaŋɛ ewura Sɛgsis le: “Yiri ko ebi salga to m bɔlɔ fo efuli ere kikɛ so. Bumo alɛ be daŋkare kɔr basa kama peya to. B maa bɛ efuli ere be mbra gba so, amoso m baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ nɛ fo yige bumo, k maaŋ chɛ fo to. 9Nɛ k par fo, kumo ere, Yiramu, fo nase mbra fanɛ bumo kikɛ daga kemɔ. Nɛ fo shuli so n wora loŋ, ma alɛ beeŋ wora ania n fin amansherbi damta n wɔtɔ ewurkpa be amansherbi be kɔlgu na to nɛ ekrachi nɛ b wɔ ewurkpa na e ta amo n shuŋ.” 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na lara mbe kepinibi nɛ e kɔ a dulgi mbe nwɔl sibɛ so na n sa Hammedaata pibinyɛn Heman nɛ e la Juwebi bumo doŋ na 11nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Basa na nɛ bumo be amansherbi kikɛ la fo peya nna; amoso wora bumo kusɔ kama nɛ k par fo.” 12Amoso kufɔl sososo na to be kachɛ kuduasasopo na nɛ Heman tre ewura na be nwɔlsibɛpoana na ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b kilgi mbe mbra nɛ e nase na n wɔtɔ bumo be efuli na so be ŋgbarana nɛ nsibɛ be yiriana to n chige to n sa bewurbi nɛ benimu nɛ ekrachiana nɛ b wɔ efuli na so na kikɛ. Ewura Sɛgsis be ketre so nɛ b daŋ bɔla n sibɛ nwɔl na nseŋ ta mbe kepinibi n dulgi amo. 13Mbɔ nɛ b kɔ eleŋ a shile ga na, nɛ b ta nwɔl na n shuŋi fanɛ b chige efuli na so kikɛ. Kusɔ nɛ kawɔl na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ b mɔ Juwebi na kikɛ kufɔl kuduanyɔsopo nɛ baa tre Ada na be kachɛ kuduasasopo na to. Kawɔl na bee ŋini fanɛ b mɔ mbia nɛ benimu nɛ beche nɛ mbiwurbi kikɛ kumo be kamɔnchɛ na nseŋ muu bumo be asɔ nɛ b kɔ kikɛ. 14A daga fanɛ b yili jimaŋ to ŋ kraŋ kusɔ nɛ k wɔ kawɔl na to n sa efuli na so be kaba kama so ebi kikɛ. Saŋɛ na so ekama beeŋ bela ase a jo kumo be kachɛ. 15Ewura Sɛgsis e daŋ shin nɛ b yili jimaŋ to n wora mbra na manaŋ manaŋ ashi Susa be kade to. Ewura na nɛ Heman daŋ chena nna a nuu nsa, nɛ Susa be kade to ebi malɛ be nfɛra bee baga bumo to ŋkpal mbra na so.

Title: ƐSTA 4
Content:
Mɔdikaya ka bee fin kechɛto ashi Ɛsta kutɔ be asheŋ
1Mɔdikaya ka nu kusɔ nɛ ewura na wora na, nɛ e kpɛa mbe asɔbuuso to kagbenejijaso, nseŋ ta kagbenejijaso be kusɔbuuso m buu n wora nsunɔ n wurge mbe kumu so nsaa shu awɔrso ebesa so a na a kulti kade na to, 2hale m ba fo ewura na be lambu be kabuna ase. Mo alɛ daa maŋ nya ekpa n luri lambu na to ŋkpal manɛ so esa kama nɛ e buu kagbenejijaso be kusɔbuuso maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ e luri ndoŋ. 3Efuli na so be kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ b kraŋ kawɔl na jimaŋ to, Juwebi nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ bee teŋi keeli nna a boŋto a shu. B daŋ kishi nna nseŋ shu ga nɛ bumo be bedamta ta kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso m buu nseŋ dese nsunɔ to. 4Ɛsta be mbita nɛ benyɛn nɛ b fɛl nɛ baa shuŋ mo na ka kaŋɛ mo Mɔdikaya be asheŋ, nɛ mbe kagbenejija mo ga, nɛ e ta asɔbuuso lela n sa fanɛ b ya sa Mɔdikaya, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ lara kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso na, nɛ Mɔdikaya kini. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛsta shin nɛ ewura na be benyɛn nɛ b fɛl e la Ɛsta be kayɛrbi, nɛ baa tre mo Hataak na, ya bishi Mɔdikaya kusɔ nɛ k kɔ mo. 6Nɛ Hataak yɔ Mɔdikaya kutɔ ashi ewurkpa be kelɔnɛ so. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mɔdikaya kaŋɛ mo kusɔ nɛ k wora kikɛ nɛ kananɛ Heman nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ ta amansherbi damta n wɔtɔ ewurkpa be kɔlgu to, nɛ b mɔ Juwebi kikɛ. 8Kumo be kaman nɛ e ta kawɔl nɛ b sibɛ ashi Susa nɛ k bee kaŋɛ fanɛ a daga b ka mɔ Juwebi kikɛ na be kuko n sa Hataak fanɛ e ta n ya ŋini Ɛsta nseŋ bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ mo kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ kule ewura na nɛ e wu mbe basa kuwɔr. 9Nɛ Hataak wora loŋ. 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛsta sa ebɔl fanɛ e bɛta n ya kaŋɛ Mɔdikaya le: 11“Ewurkpa be mbra bee ŋini fanɛ esa kama nɛ e luri ewura kutɔ nɛ e maŋ tre mo, daga luwu. Ewura na be asoetojipoana nɛ mbe kasawule so be kaba kikɛ so ebi gba nyi kumo be loŋ. Ama ewura na baaŋ teŋi mbe shuwa be kuwurkpabi na nna ŋ shoŋi esa na. Loŋ bre, b maaŋ mɔ mo. Amoso k beeŋ baa du kpakpa n sa ma nɛ n wu ewura na ŋkpal manɛ so kufɔl lelemu nna na e ka maŋ shuŋi n tre ma.” 12Mɔdikaya ka nu Ɛsta be kubɔya na 13nɛ mo alɛ ta le be kubɔya ere n shoŋi mo: “Sa maŋ kaa fɛ fanɛ nɛ baa mɔ Juwebi kikɛ, fo ere beeŋ nya fo kumu ŋkpal fo ka wɔ ewura pe so. 14Nɛ fo baŋ maŋ wora shɛŋ le be jemanɛ ere, ashere, echɛtopo ko beeŋ shi kakpa ko m ba mɔlga anyi. Ama fo ere nɛ fo tuto be kanaŋ to ebi kikɛ beeŋ mur. Wanɛ e nyi fanɛ le bre so nɛ fo ki ewurche le be jemanɛ ere?” 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛsta shuŋi ŋ kaŋɛ Mɔdikaya le: 16“Shin nɛ Juwebi nɛ b wɔ Susa na kikɛ e ba abar so m ba kishi nchɛ asa nɛ nnyɛ asa ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa ma. Ma alɛ gba nɛ ma mbita beeŋ luri loŋ be ekishi na to. Kumo be kaman, nɛ n yɔ ewura na kutɔ. Hale nɛ mbra maŋ sa ma ekpa gba, meeŋ wora loŋ. Nɛ k la luwu nɛ n wu.” 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mɔdikaya ya wora kusɔ kama nɛ Ɛsta kaŋɛ mo na kikɛ.

Title: ƐSTA 5
Content:
Ɛsta ka tre ewura na nɛ Heman kejigboŋ to be asheŋ
1Ekishi na be kachɛ sasopo nɛ Ɛsta ta mbe kuwurche be kale m buu nseŋ ya yili ewura na be lambubi na be kabuna to. Ewura na malɛ daa tase mbe kuwurputi so nna lambu na to a keni kabuna to. 2Ewura na ka wu ewurche Ɛsta ka yil kabuna to na, nɛ mbe asheŋ par mo ga, nɛ e teŋi mbe shuwa be kuwurkpabi na ŋ shoŋi mo. Nɛ Ɛsta ya pɛ kuwurkpabi na be kɔnɔso. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na bishi le: “Ewurche Ɛsta, manɛ e kɔ fo? Manɛ nɛ fee sha? Kaŋɛ ma kusɔ kama nɛ k tir fo. Hale ma efuli ere be bargato gba nɛ fee sha, meeŋ ta n sa fo.” 4Nɛ Ɛsta kaŋɛ le: “Yiramu! Nɛ k par fo, kumo ere fo nɛ Heman e ba tu ma n ji kejigboŋ kabre kaaseso.” 5Nɛ ewura na shuŋi fanɛ b ya tre Heman manaŋ m ba nɛ b yɔ Ɛsta kutɔ. Nɛ Heman ba, nɛ mo nɛ ewura na yɔ Ɛsta be kejigboŋ na to. 6B ka bee nuu nsa nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ Ɛsta le: “Kaŋɛ kusɔ kama nɛ fee sha nɛ n sa fo kumo. Manɛ bre e tir fo? Hale ma efuli ere be bargato gba nɛ fee sha, meeŋ sa fo kumo.” 7Nɛ Ɛsta kaŋɛ: 8“Nɛ k par fo Yiramu, fo nɛ Heman e naŋ ba tu ma n ji kejigboŋ nfe echefo, saŋɛ na so, meeŋ kaŋɛ fo kusɔ nɛ mee sha.”
Heman ka kre kemɔ Mɔdikaya be asheŋ
9Nɛ Heman ta kagbenefuli nɛ kagbenewushi n lar Ɛsta kutɔ. E ka bee yɔ na nɛ e wu Mɔdikaya ewurkpa be kabuna na ase. Ama e ka wu fanɛ Mɔdikaya maŋ koso n yili n sa mo bunyaŋ nɛ e nya agbo ga. 10Ama e daŋ ji kanyiti nna n yɔ epe n ya tre mo teriana nɛ mbe eche Zɛrɛsh n shɛr, 11n ji njɔŋ ŋ ŋini bumo kananɛ e dii kedama nɛ kananɛ e kɔ mbinyɛnsobi damta nɛ kananɛ ewura maŋ mo so nseŋ sa mo kenimu a chɔ ekrachiana nɛ benimuana na be ekama. 12Kede be kaman nɛ Heman naŋ kaŋɛ: “Asɔ damta gba kraŋ ti so, ma nɛ ewura nawule nɛ ewurche Ɛsta tre mbe kejigboŋ to, e maŋ tre esa kikɛ n ti anyi so. E yɛ echefo gba an naaŋ ba tu mo n ji. 13Ama ade kikɛ kraa maa bɔlɔ ma kenishi ŋkpal Juwnyɛn na, Mɔdikaya, ka kraa chena ewurkpa be kabuna to na so.” 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ mo teriana nɛ mbe eche Zɛrɛsh kaŋɛ mo le: “Manɛ nna nɛ fo maaŋ ku kadebi nɛ kumo be nteŋ sa fanɛ ayadra adushunu nɛ anu n yuu nseŋ kule ewura ekpa echefo kachipurso n ya chɛ Mɔdikaya efɔl n shiga kumo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo ta kagbenefuli n tu ewura na n yɔ kejigboŋ na to.” Heman be kagbene daŋ fuli mo ga ŋkpal le be nfɛra nɛ b sa mo ere so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e shin nɛ b yuu kedibi na.

Title: ƐSTA 6
Content:
Ewura na ka sa Mɔdikaya bunyaŋ be asheŋ
1Kanyɛ ka biri nɛ ewura na di ŋ gben, nseŋ shin nɛ b bar mbe efuli na so be asheŋ nɛ a wora mbe kuwurji be jemanɛ so nɛ b sibɛ amo n wɔtɔ nwɔl to na kikɛ, m baa kaa kraŋ a ŋini mo. 2B ka bee kraŋ na, nɛ b ya lar kananɛ Mɔdikaya daŋ pin Bigtana nɛ Tɛrɛsh nɛ b daŋ fɛl nɛ baa yili a kuŋ ewura be ebu be kabuna to na, ka daa kre ewura be kemɔ ŋgblaŋto be asheŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ ewura na. 3Nɛ ewura na bishi bumo le: “Mɔdikaya ka wora le ere bre, manɛ be kakɔka nɛ kemaŋkura bre nɛ an sa mo n tal to?” Nɛ mbe nyɛrbi na yɛ: “B maŋ wora shɛŋ n sa mo.” 4Loŋ be jemanɛ so nɛ Heman baŋ ba luri ewurkpa nɛ e ba kule ewura ekpa n ya shin nɛ b chɛ Mɔdikaya efɔl n shiga kedibi nɛ e yuu na so. Nɛ ewura bishi le: “Wanɛ e wɔ lambu to ere?” 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe nyɛrbi na kaŋɛ: “Heman nna.” Nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ: “Men shin nɛ e baa luri.” 6Heman ka luri nɛ ewura na bishi mo le: “Manɛ e daga ŋ ka wora n sa esa nɛ mee sha keta n yili bunyaŋ be eyilikpa?” Nɛ Heman fɛ le: “M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ ma nɛ ewura bee sha kewora le be kusɔ ere n sa na.” 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ ewura na le: 8“Shin nɛ b ta fo piŋi tenteŋ nɛ fo buu ere be kuko m buu esa kama nɛ e daga le be bunyaŋ ere nseŋ shin nɛ b mɛa fo gbagba be egbaŋɛ ere be eko to, 9nseŋ shin nɛ fo benimuana na be eko e ta esa na n chena gbaŋɛ na so ŋ keta mo ŋ kulti kade ere be abɔrbi kikɛ so a kaŋɛ awɔrso le: ‘Men keni, kananɛ ewura bee ta esa a yili bunyaŋ be eyilikpa nna!.’ ” 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ Heman le: “Kumo ere wora manaŋ n ya fin piŋi na nɛ gbaŋɛ na m ba wora kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ ere gbagba n sa Mɔdikaya nɛ e la Juw na. Mo e naa chena ewurkpa be kabunagboŋ na ase na. Nyiŋi n wora kusɔ kama nɛ fo kaŋɛ ere n sa mo nsaa maaŋ teŋ shɛŋ so.” 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ Heman ta ewura be piŋi m buu Mɔdikaya nseŋ shin nɛ e chena gbaŋɛ nɛ b mɛa to fanɛ ewura peya na so nɛ e juŋkpar a nite a gberge Mɔdikaya nɛ gbaŋɛ na a kulti kade na to a kaŋɛ awɔrso le: “Men keni kananɛ ewura bee ta esa a yili bunyaŋ be eyilikpa!” 12B ka kilgi to n loge, nɛ Mɔdikaya bɛta n ya chena ewurkpa be kabunagboŋ na ase, nɛ Heman malɛ ta anishinyɔr gboŋgboŋi n jɔto n yɔ epe, 13n ya kaŋɛ mbe eche nɛ mo teriana kusɔ nɛ k nya mo kikɛ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe eche nɛ mo teriana na kaŋɛ mo le: “Mɔdikaya ka la Juw be esa ere bre fo maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ mo so kikɛ. Baa nyi fanɛ fo eleŋ baa fo ekar nna na. Feeŋ ki esa fuloŋ.” 14B kraa malga nna nɛ ewura be nyɛrbi ba shin nɛ Heman wora manaŋ nɛ b yɔ Ɛsta be kejigboŋ nɛ e wora n yili na to.

Title: ƐSTA 7
Content:
B ka Mɔ Heman be asheŋ
1Kede be kaman nɛ ewura na nɛ Heman yɔ Ɛsta kutɔ nɛ b ya ji. 2B kaa tase a nuu nsa kejigboŋ nyɔsopo na to na, nɛ ewura na naŋ bishi Ɛsta le: “Manɛ bre e tir fo? Kusɔ kama nɛ k tir fo, fo kaŋɛ ma nɛ n sa fo kumo. Hale ma efuli ere be bargato gba nɛ fee sha, feeŋ nya kumo.” 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewurche Ɛsta kaŋɛ: “Yiramu, nɛ k par fo bre, kumo ere fo wora le be kusɔ ere n sa ma. Mɔlga ma ŋkpa nseŋ sɔ ma basa n yige n sa ma. 4B fa ma nɛ ma basa kikɛ fanɛ b mɔ anyi nna. K daa la fanɛ baa fa anyi nna fanɛ anya gba, ndafanɛ maaŋ bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fo shɛŋ, ama baa kre kemɔ anyi kikɛ nna!” 5Nɛ ewura Sɛgsis bishi Ewurche Ɛsta le: “Wanɛ malɛ e nya kagbene a sha kewora le be kesheŋ ere? Nnɛ nɛ loŋ be esa na wɔ?” 6Nɛ Ɛsta yɛ: “Mo e la Heman ere. E la esa lubi nɛ edoŋ nɛ emɔpo nna.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ kufu pɛ Heman ga ashi ewura na nɛ ewurche na be anishito.
7Nɛ ewura na nya agbo ga ŋ koso n yige nsa na nseŋ yɔ ewurkpa be kelɔnɛ na so. Heman ka pin fanɛ ewura na beeŋ gberge mo kusoe nɛ e shir kaman a kule ewurche Ɛsta fanɛ e mɔlga mbe ŋkpa. 8Ewura na ka shi kelɔnɛ na so m bɛta a ba ebu na to nɛ e wu Heman ka jɔŋɛ ŋ gbasa Ɛsta be kuwurputi a kule mo kenishipereso fanɛ e chɛ mo to. Ewura na ka wu loŋ nɛ e ponte ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kanyɛn ere bee sha kepur ma eche ere ma anishito nna ashi ewurkpa nfe a?” Ewura na maŋ naŋ malga n loge gba nɛ mbe nyɛrbi ba nyaŋ Heman ŋ gberge mo ashi ewurche na kutɔ. 9Nɛ nyɛrbi na be emo nɛ baa tre Harbona na kaŋɛ le: “Yiramu, Heman koŋwule ere yuu kedibi nna mbe laŋ to fanɛ b chɛ Mɔdikaya nɛ e mɔlga fo ŋkpa na efɔl n shiga so. Kedibi na be nteŋ la ayadra adushunu nɛ anu nna!” Nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ: “Men chɛ Heman efɔl n shiga loŋ be kedibi na so!” 10Nɛ b ya chɛ Heman efɔl n shiga kedibi nɛ e yuu fanɛ b chɛ Mɔdikaya n shiga so na so. Nɛ ewura na be kagbene wushi mo.

Title: ƐSTA 8
Content:
Juwebi ka kɔ n sɔ bumo be amu be asheŋ
1Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Sɛgsis ta Heman nɛ e la Juwebi bumo doŋ na be kapetɛ kikɛ n sa ewurche Ɛsta kumo kamɔnchɛ kikɛ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ɛsta kaŋɛ ewura na kananɛ mo nɛ Mɔdikaya be kekurgeto lar kikɛ. Kumo be kamɔnchɛ nɛ ewura ta Mɔdikaya ŋ ki mbe ekrachi nimuso na be eko. 2Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura na ta mbe kepinibi nɛ k daa wɔ Heman kutɔ nɛ b kɔ a dulgi ewura be nwɔl sibɛso na n sa Mɔdikaya. Nɛ Ɛsta malɛ shin nɛ Mɔdikaya bee keni Heman be asɔ na so. 3Nɛ Ɛsta naŋ laŋɛ n yɔ Ewura na kutɔ n ya gbir mbe anishito n shu ŋ kule mo fanɛ e wora ania n laŋɛ Heman nɛ e la Agag be kaman to ebi be ŋkre lubi nɛ e daŋ kre Juwebi na. 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na teŋi mbe shuwa be kuwurkpabi na ŋ shoŋi Ɛsta nɛ e niŋi to n yili nseŋ kaŋɛ le: 5“Yiramu, nɛ k par fo nsaa walɛ n sa fo, nɛ fee fɛ ma asheŋ bre, kumo ere fo sibɛ nwɔl ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kananɛ Heman kre fanɛ b mɔ anyi Juwebi kikɛ ashi fo kasawule so na e sa maŋ naŋ wora. 6M maaŋ tiŋ n chena a keni nɛ ma basa e mur.” 7Nɛ ewura Sɛgsis kaŋɛ ewurche Ɛsta nɛ Mɔdikaya nɛ e la Juw be esa na le: “Ŋkpal Heman ka bee fin kewora Juwebi na kulubi so nɛ n shin nɛ b chɛ mo n shiga kedibi so, nseŋ ta mbe kapetɛ gba n sa Ɛsta na. 8Ŋkpal esa ka maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n chɛrga kawɔl kikɛ nɛ b sibɛ ashi ewura be ketre to nseŋ ta mbe kepinibi n dulgi so, n sa fo ekpa fanɛ fo ere gba e sibɛ kawɔl kananɛ k par fo nsaa beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga Juwebi na nseŋ ta ewura be kepinibi nɛ b kɔ a dulgi mbe nwɔl sibɛso na n dulgi kumo.” 9Kufɔl sasopo nɛ baa tre Sivan na be nchɛ adunyɔ nɛ asa nɛ b shɛr ewurkpa be nwɔlsibɛpoana na epul to, nɛ Mɔdikaya malga nɛ b sibɛ nwɔl n sa Juwebi na nɛ bejuŋkparpo nɛ ekrachiana nɛ benimuana nɛ b wɔ efuli na be abonfu kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ ashunu nɛ a yili Indiya be efuli so ashi epeŋilarkpa n ya fo Etopiya be efuli so ashi epeŋitɔrkpa na. Efuli kama so ebi be ŋgbar to nɛ Juwebi be ŋgbar to nɛ b daŋ sibɛ nwɔl na n sa bumo. 10Ewura Sɛgsis be ketre to nɛ Mɔdikaya daŋ shin nɛ b sibɛ nwɔl na kikɛ nseŋ ta ewura na be kepinibi nɛ b kɔ a dulgi nwɔl na n dulgi amo kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta amo n sa ewura be egbaŋɛ nɛ baa shile ga na be bediipo fanɛ b chige. 11Kusɔ nɛ nwɔl na kaŋɛ e la fanɛ ewura sa Juwebi ekpa fanɛ b kreto nɛnɛ ŋ kɔ m mɔlga bumo amu. E yɛ nɛ benapo ko koso nɛ b ba kɔ Juwebi be benyɛn ŋko beche ŋko mbia, Juwebi na kɔ ekpa nɛ b tu loŋ be bedoŋ na ŋ kɔ m mɔ bumo be kikɛ nseŋ ta bumo asɔ kikɛ ŋ ki bumo peya. 12Kufɔl kuduanyɔsopo nɛ baa tre Adar na be nchɛ kuduasa, nɛ b daŋ yili fanɛ baaŋ mɔ Juwebi kikɛ ashi ewura Sɛgsis be efuli so na nɛ mbra nɛ Mɔdikaya sa na gba daga fanɛ k shuŋ. 13A daga fanɛ efuli na so ebi kikɛ ka nu mbra na, saŋɛ na so Juwebi na beeŋ wora shiriya ŋ kɔ bumo doŋana na loŋ be kamɔnchɛ. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura sa ekpa nɛ egbaŋɛdiipoana na ta ewurkpa be egbaŋɛ na n lar n shile eleŋso n ya chige nwɔl na efuli na kikɛ so. Nɛ mbra na sɔ Susa gba be kade to kikɛ. 15Kumo be kaman nɛ Mɔdikaya ta kuwurpiŋi lela ko nɛ k la buru nɛ kefuful be weato m buu nseŋ ta ago be piŋi peper kunɔkunɔ m buu n deŋi kumo so, n ta shuwa be kuwurwuro nyɛkpɛso m buu nseŋ lar ewurkpa n yɔ. Nɛ Susa be kade to ebi be ŋgbene fuli bumo nɛ baa cha awɔr nsaa ponte to kagbenefuliso 16K daa la kagbenefuli nɛ kumu saŋɛ nna n sa Juwebi na kikɛ nɛ b nya tama fanɛ baaŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so. 17Efuli kama nɛ kade kama to nɛ ewura na be mbra na yɔ, Juwebi nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ be ŋgbene bee fuli bumo nna ga nɛ baa ji eyur nsaa wora kejigboŋ. Ŋkpal loŋ so basa damta daŋ ta bumo be amu nna ŋ ki Juwebi ŋkpal b ka bee ŋana Juwebi na so so.

Title: ƐSTA 9
Content:
Juwebi na ka kɔ m pɔɔ bumo doŋana so be asheŋ
1Kufɔl kuduanyɔsopo nɛ baa tre Adar na be nchɛ kuduasa nɛ sososo be mbra na daŋ daga fanɛ k shuŋ. Loŋ be kachɛ na nɛ Juwebi bumo doŋana na daŋ fɛ fanɛ baaŋ pɔɔ bumo so nseŋ wora bumo, bumo be kepar ama Juwebi na e daŋ kilgi m pɔɔ bedoŋana na so. 2Juwebi na daŋ chala abar so nna kade kama to nɛ b wɔ ashi efuli na so kikɛ, saŋɛ na so baaŋ kɔ basa kama nɛ baa sha ketɔrɔ bumo na. Basa nɛ b wɔ efuli na so na malɛ be bekama daŋ maŋ tiŋ n tu Juwebi na ŋ kɔ ŋkpal manɛ so b daa ŋana bumo nna. 3Abane b ekrachiana nɛ efuli na so be benimuana nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na kikɛ daa yil Juwebi na be kaman nna ŋkpal bumo kikɛ ka daa ŋana Mɔdikaya so. 4Mɔdikaya daŋ ki esagboŋ nna ashi ewurkpa na nɛ mbe ketre dii ashi efuli na so kikɛ nɛ mbe eleŋ malɛ bee ti so saŋkama. 5Ŋkpal loŋ so Juwebi na daŋ wora bumo doŋana na kusɔ k par bumo nna nseŋ ta etokobi m mɔ bumo kikɛ. 6Juwebi na daŋ mɔ basa alfa anu nna ashi Susa be kade to gbagba, ama b daa maŋ ta bumo be asɔ bre. 7-10Heman nɛ e daa la Juwebi bumo doŋ na daa kɔ mbia kudu nna. Bumo alɛ gba daŋ ti basa nɛ b mɔ na so. Mbe mbia na e daa la Pashandaata nɛ Dalfɔn nɛ Aspaata nɛ Poraata nɛ Adalia nɛ Aridaata nɛ Pamashta nɛ Arisai nɛ Aridai nɛ Vaizaata. 11Kumo be kamɔnchɛ gbagba nɛ b kaŋɛ ewura basa nɛ b mɔ ashi Susa be kade to. 12Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ ewurche Ɛsta le: “Basa alfa anu nɛ Juwebi na mɔ ashi Susa be kade to gbagba. Heman be mbinyɛnbi kudu kikɛ daŋ ti bumo so. Kusɔ nɛ b naŋ wora ma efuli na be mba nɛ a ka na bre m maŋ nyi. Manɛ nɛ fo naa sha ŋ ka naŋ wora n sa fo? Kaŋɛ ma! Meeŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ fee sha n sa fo.” 13Nɛ Ɛsta kaŋɛ mo le: “Yiramu, nɛ k par fo bre, fo naŋ shin nɛ Juwebi na e wora kusɔ nɛ b wora kabre ashi Susa ere echefo gba, nseŋ shin nɛ b chɛ Heman be mbinyɛnsobi kudu na be kebuni efɔl n shiga ndibi nɛ b yuu na so.” 14Nɛ Ewura na sa ekpa ashi Susa be kade to fanɛ b chɛ Heman be mbia na be kebuni efɔl n shiga nɛ esa kama e wu bumo. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b chɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi kudu na kikɛ be kebuni efɔl n shiga. 15Kufɔl nɛ baa tre Adar na be nchɛ kuduana nɛ Juwebi nɛ b wɔ Susa be kade to na naŋ chala abar m mɔ basa alfa asa kade na to, ama b maŋ ta bumo be kusɔ kama bre. 16Juwebi nɛ b wɔ ewura na be efuli na so be abonfu nɛ a ka na gba daŋ chala abar nna ŋ kɔ n sɔ bumo be amu ashi bumo doŋana kutɔ. Bumo alɛ daŋ mɔ basa ŋgboŋ adushunu nɛ anu ama, b daa maŋ ta bumo be kusɔ kama. 17Kufɔl nɛ baa tre Adar na be nchɛ kuduasa na nɛ loŋ daŋ wora. Kachɛ kuduanasopo na bre, b daa maŋ mɔ basa. B daŋ ta loŋ be kachɛ na nna ŋ ki kagbenefuli nɛ kejigboŋ be kachɛ. 18Juwebi nɛ b wɔ Susa na bre daŋ ta kufɔl na be nchɛ kuduanu na nna ŋ ki kagbenefuli nɛ kejigboŋ nɛ kewushiachɛ ŋkpal manɛ so bumo ere daŋ mɔ bumo doŋana nchɛ kuduasa nɛ kuduana na nna. 19Amoso nɛ Juwebi nɛ b wɔ ndekarso na yili kufɔl nɛ baa tre Adar na be nchɛ kuduana na fanɛ kagbenefuli nɛ kejigboŋ be kewushiachɛ nɛ kachɛ nɛ baa chige abar ajibi na. 20Mɔdikaya daŋ sibɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wora na kikɛ n wɔtɔ kawɔl to, nseŋ sa Juwebi nɛ b wɔ ewura Sɛgsis be efuli so na kikɛ nwɔl na, 21fanɛ kufɔl nɛ baa tre Adar na be nchɛ kuduana nɛ kuduanu na e baa la nchɛgboŋ kafɛ kikɛ to n sa bumo. 22Le be nchɛ ere nɛ Juwebi na daŋ pɔɔ bumo doŋana so nɛ bumo kagbenejija ki kagbenefuli na. E daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nna fanɛ b ta loŋ be nchɛ na nna ŋ ki kejigboŋ nɛ ajibi be kedaŋɛ n chige abar nɛ betirpo. 23Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na shuli n sɔ kusɔ kama nɛ Mɔdikaya sibɛ n sa bumo na, nseŋ ta loŋ be nchɛ na ŋ ki nchɛgboŋ kafɛ kikɛ to.
24Hammedaata nɛ e shi Agag be kanaŋ to na pibinyɛn Heman nɛ e la Juwebi bumo doŋ na e daŋ to beri m fin kachɛ nɛ k daga b ka mɔ Juwebi na kikɛ. 25Nɛ Ɛsta yɔ ewura kutɔ nɛ ewura na shin nɛ b sibɛ mbra nɛ k shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ Heman kre fanɛ e beeŋ wora Juwebi na laŋɛ n ji mo. Nɛ b chɛ mo nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi kikɛ efɔl n shiga ndibi nɛ b yuu na so. 26Ŋkpal kawɔl nɛ Mɔdikaya sibɛ na so, nɛ ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ k wora Juwebi na so, b daa tre nchɛgboŋ na Purim nna. Kumo be kifito e la keto beri. 27Juwebi na yili kumo nna fanɛ bumo nɛ bumo nanabiana kikɛ nɛ esa kama nɛ e beeŋ ba ki Juw be esa kachako so, beeŋ baa ji loŋ be nchɛgboŋ anyɔ na fanɛ kananɛ Mɔdikaya kaŋɛ bumo na gbagba. 28Amoso, baŋ yili loŋ be saŋɛ na a yɔ k ki mbra nna fanɛ Juwebi na nɛ bumo be kanaŋ kikɛ, nɛ bumo nɛ baaŋ koso kachako so kikɛ daga b ka bee nyiŋi nchɛgboŋ anyɔ nɛ baa tre Purim na nsaa ji amo kafɛ kikɛ. 29Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewurche Ɛsta nɛ e la Abihail pibiche na nɛ Mɔdikaya cha abar n sibɛ kawɔl kpakpaso ko nɛ k kɔ ewurche na be eleŋ na ti kawɔl nɛ Mɔdikaya teŋ sibɛ a laŋɛ nchɛgboŋ nɛ baa tre Purim na so. 30Kumo be kaman nɛ Mɔdikaya chige nwɔl na to n sa Juwebi nɛ b wɔ ewura Sɛgsis be efuli kalfa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ ashunu na so kikɛ. Kagbenewushi nɛ keleŋto gba be asheŋ daa wɔ kawɔl na to, 31nsaa nyiŋi Juwebi na nɛ bumo nanabiana fanɛ b baa nyiŋi a ji nchɛgboŋ nɛ baa tre Purim na fanɛ kananɛ baa ji ekishi nɛ nli be nchɛgboŋ na. Mɔdikaya nɛ ewurche Ɛsta e daŋ yili le be kesheŋ ere n sa bumo. 32Ewurche Ɛsta be eleŋ so nɛ b wora nchɛgboŋ nɛ baa tre Purim na be mbra n nase kanyiŋi be nwɔl to.

Title: ƐSTA 10
Content:
Mɔdikaya ka ki esagboŋ be asheŋ
1Ewura Sɛgsis yili lampo nna n sa basa nɛ b tase teku ase nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ tase teku ase ashi mbe efuli so kikɛ. 2B sibɛ kananɛ e ji eleŋ mbe kuwura to nɛ kananɛ e maŋ Mɔdikaya so n yili eyilikpagboŋ kikɛ n wɔtɔ Pɛshiya nɛ Midia be efuliana so be bewura be adrasheŋ be nwɔl kikɛ to nna. 3Mɔdikaya e daa la enimu m bɛ ewura Sɛgsis so. E daa la esagboŋ nna Juwebi na kutɔ nɛ b daa sha mbe asheŋ ga ŋkpal e ka daŋ chɛ bumo to nsaa malga a sɔ bumo a yige so.

Title: JOB 1
Content:
Job nɛ mbe kanaŋ be asheŋ
1Kanyɛn ko e daa wɔ Uz be kasawule so nɛ baa tre mo Job. Job daa la esa nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ tiŋ n wu mo kulubi nna. E daa la esa nɛ e bee bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nseŋ kishi kulubi be kewora nna. 2E daa kɔ bibinyɛn ashunu nɛ bibiche asa nna, 3nseŋ daa kɔ mbolpɔ ŋgboŋ ashunu nɛ enyɔma ŋgboŋ asa nɛ ana kagboŋ nɛ ekurma alfa anu nna. Mo alɛ daa naa kɔ beshumpo damta ga nseŋ daa la esa nɛ e dii dama a chɔ ekama ashi efuliana nɛ a wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na.
4Job be bibinyɛn ashunu na daa wora kejigboŋ bumo be elaŋana to kebɛso kebɛso nna nsaa tre bumo sipocheana besa na nɛ baa ba m ba kaa tu bumo a ji nsaa nuu. 5Mbia na baŋ ji kejigboŋ ŋklade kachipurso kikɛ, Job beeŋ shuŋi n tre bumo m ba lara esarga chɔɔso n sa Ebɔrɛ ŋ kule alubi be ketampaŋ n sa mbia na, a fɛ fanɛ ashere b kaa bee ji nsaa nuu na b wora kulubi ko n da Ebɔrɛ so nɛ b maŋ nyi.
Sososo be kewora ŋ keni nɛ k ba Job so be asheŋ
6Kachako nɛ Ebɔrɛ be emalaika ba shɛr Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ ashi ebɔrɛso nɛ Setani gba ba ti bumo so ndoŋ. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bishi Setani le: “Nnɛ nɛ fo shi! Manɛ nɛ fo daa wora?”
Nɛ Setani kaŋɛ: “N na a kulti durnya kikɛ to nna.”
8Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ bishi Setani le: “Manɛ nɛ fee fɛ a laŋɛ ma kayɛrbi Job be kaplɛa so? Durnya kikɛ to, esa kikɛ maŋ du fanɛ mo. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e la esa nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n wu mo kulubi nna. Mo alɛ bee bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nseŋ kishi kulubi be kewora nna.”
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ Setani malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Manɛ nna nɛ Job maaŋ baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ? 10Jemanɛ kikɛ fee kuŋ mo nɛ mbe kanaŋ nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ e kɔ nna nseŋ naa shin nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ e bee wora bee nyalɛ a sa mo, hale nɛ mbe mbolpɔ nɛ ana salga to n sɔ kaplɛkama. 11To, fo ere e mur mbe kusɔ nɛ e kɔ kikɛ ŋ keni a, e maaŋ yili fo gbagba be anishito n shoduu fo?”
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Setani le: “Yoo, n ta kusɔ kama nɛ e kɔ m bɔɔ fo enɔ, ama sa maŋ kaŋ doro Job gbagba bre.”
Nɛ Setani lar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ n choŋ.
Job be kusɔ nɛ e kɔ kikɛ ka mur be asheŋ
13Kachako nɛ Job be bibinyɛn ashunu nɛ bumo sipocheana besa na yaŋ wora kejigboŋ a ji nsaa nuu ashi Job be wurkoŋ be laŋ to. 14Ndoŋ nɛ nna kabɔ ko ber to m ba Job kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ mo le: “An daa kɔ ana na nna a dɔ nɛ ekurma na malɛ wɔ kupuŋ to m mata anyi a ji. 15Epul na to nɛ Sabiaebi ko ba lar anyi so m mɔ beshumpo na nseŋ kpa ana nɛ ekurma na kikɛ n choŋ. N nawule e tiŋ n nya n shile m ba nɛ m ba kaŋɛ fo kusɔ nɛ k wora.”
16Kabɔ na kraa malga nna nɛ enyɔsopo shile m ba kaŋɛ le: “Bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ nna m ponte mbolpɔ na nɛ mbolpɔkpapoana na m mɔ. N nawule e nya n shile m ba nɛ m ba kaŋɛ fo kusɔ nɛ k wora.”
17Mo alɛ gba kraa malga nna nɛ kabɔ sasopo ba kaŋɛ Job le: “Beyu nɛ b kɔ akɔsɔ be ntuŋ asa shi Babilɔn be efuli so nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso be epeŋilarkpa na nna m ba kɔ n suge fo enyɔma na nseŋ kpa amo kikɛ n choŋ. N nawule e nya n shile m ba nɛ m ba kaŋɛ fo kusɔ nɛ k wora.”
18Loŋ be kabɔ na gba kraa malga nna nɛ enasopo shile m ba kaŋɛ le: “Fo mbia daŋ wora kejigboŋ nna a ji nsaa nuu ashi fo wurkoŋ be laŋ to 19nɛ bɔrɛfugboŋ ko ber n shi keshishɛrsawule so epul to m ba da kowu na n lɛ fo mbia na kikɛ so m mɔ. N nawule e nya n shile m ba nɛ ba kaŋɛ fo kusɔ nɛ k wora.”
20Job ka nu le be asheŋ ere kikɛ, nɛ e pɛ mbe asɔbuuso ŋ kpɛa to nseŋ she mbe kumu so be emin kikɛ ŋkpal kagbenejija damta nɛ k tɔr mo so na so. Kumo be kaman nɛ e gbir m bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ 21nseŋ kaŋɛ le:
“B ka kurge ma m ba durnya to,
m maaŋ bar shɛŋ.
Ŋ ka naŋ wu a lar durnya to, m maaŋ ta shɛŋ n lar.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e sa, mo alɛ e sɔ;
Kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ peya!”
22Asheŋ nɛ e wora ere kikɛ to, Job daa maŋ wora kulubi m malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ.

Title: JOB 2
Content:
Job be kewora ŋ keni nyɔsopo be asheŋ
1Ebɔrɛ be emalaika ka naŋ ba shɛr Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito ashi ebɔrɛso, nɛ Setani gba naŋ ba tu bumo n shɛr ndoŋ. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bishi Setani le: “Nnɛ nɛ fo shi! Manɛ nɛ fo daa wora?”
Nɛ Setani kaŋɛ: “N na a kulti durnya kikɛ to nna.”
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ bishi mo: “Manɛ nɛ fee fɛ a laŋɛ ma kayɛrbi Job be kaplɛa so? Durnya kikɛ to esa kama maŋ du fanɛ mo. E la esa nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n wu mo kulubi nna nɛ mo alɛ bee bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nseŋ kishi kulubi be kewora. Fo ka kule ma ekpa n ya mur mbe asɔ kikɛ, nɛ e maŋ wora shɛŋ gba na, e kraa maŋ chɛrga mbe kebaawɔtɔ to.”
4Nɛ Setani kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ le: “Esa shuli e ka paŋ asɔ nɛ e kɔ kikɛ nsaa kɔ mbe ŋkpa a wɔtɔ. 5Fo ere e ta kayurnyaŋ n lɛ Job so ŋ keni, e beeŋ yili fo gbagba be anishito n shoduu fo.”
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ naŋ kaŋɛ le: “To, n nu! Feeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ kayurnyaŋ e tɔr Job so nɛ e ji awurfoŋ kananɛ fee sha, ama sa maŋ kaŋ mɔ mo bre!” 7Nɛ Setani lar Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito nseŋ ya ta achuu besa so n lɛ Job so. Yili mbe kumu so m ba fo mbe ayadra so kikɛ daŋ wora achuu nna.
8Ndoŋ nna nɛ Job lar n ya chena kumuni so nseŋ ta kapɛlanfu a kuti mbe achuu na to. 9Nɛ mbe eche ba kaŋɛ mo: “Manɛ nna nɛ fo kraŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ ashi awurfoŋ nɛ fee ji ere kikɛ to? Shoduu mo nseŋ wu nɛ k loge!”
10Ndoŋ nna nɛ Job kaŋɛ mbe eche le: “Sa maa malga fanɛ ewulpo! Nɛ anyeeŋ sɔ Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa nɛ enɔgboŋ anyɔ, manɛ nna nɛ anyi maaŋ sɔ etɔrɔ bre mo kutɔ?” Asheŋ ere kikɛ to, Job maŋ malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e maŋ wora n nyalɛ.
Job mo teriana besa na be asheŋ
11Job daa kɔ benekpana kpakpaso asa ko nna. Bumo e daa la Ɛlifaz nɛ e shi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Tɛman na nɛ Bildad nɛ e shi Shuuwa be kasawule so nɛ Zofa nɛ mo alɛ shi Naama be kasawule so na. B ka nu awurfoŋ nɛ Job bee ji na be asheŋ nɛ b kre keyɔ n ya leŋ mo to nseŋ wushi mo kagbene. 12B kraa wɔ kufɔ kufɔ nna nseŋ wu Job, ama b daa maŋ pin mo. B ka ba pin fanɛ Job nna nɛ b fara a shu a boŋ to awɔrso nseŋ kpɛa bumo be asɔbuuso to nsaa wora eshishɛr a wurge bumo be amu so a ŋini fanɛ bumo be ŋgbene jija bumo. 13Kumo be kaman nɛ b ya tu Job n chena kasawule nchɛ ashunu nɛ nnyɛ ashunu nɛ ekama maa bugi kɔnɔ a kaŋɛ shɛŋ, ŋkpal awurfoŋ gboŋgboŋi nɛ b wu e ka bee ji so.

Title: JOB 3
Content:
Job ka fubel n sa Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Kumo be lalaloge nɛ Job fara
m malga n shoduu mbe kakurgeachɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ le:
2-3O Ebɔrɛ, sho kachɛ nɛ b kurge ma na kɔnɔ,
nseŋ shoduu kanyɛ nɛ n nio sɔ ma kedampo na gba!
4Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ loŋ be kachɛ na e ki tentembiri plɔ.
Sa maŋ naa nyiŋi kumo be asheŋ kikɛ kuraa,
fo alɛ e sa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ k fulto kikɛ.
5Shin nɛ k baa la kachɛ nɛ k biri to a la tentembiri plɔ;
nseŋ shin awɔlpa e buu kumo so nɛ epeŋi e sa maŋ nyaŋɛ.
6Lara loŋ be kanyɛ na ashi kafɛ be nchɛ to,
nsaa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ b karga kumo n ti nchɛ so.
7Sa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ b kurge ebi le be kachɛ fanɛ kede ere,
ŋko n naŋ shin nɛ kusɔ ko e wora nɛ basa e baa wora awɔr
kagbenefuli so loŋ be kanyɛ kikɛ mbaanaayɔ.
8Sa belejipo ekpa nɛ b shoduu loŋ be kachɛ na.
Bumo e naa tiŋ a shin nɛ teku to
be kusɔbɔya gbeyeso gboŋgboŋi na bee nyaŋɛ to.
9Shin nɛ kachɛ na be kachipurso be kechɛkpabi e biri to,
nsaa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ k baa tama karechɛ kikɛ.
10Sho kanyɛ nɛ b kurge ma na kɔnɔ
ŋkpal k ka shin nɛ b kurge n wɔtɔ durnya
nɛ etɔrɔ bɔlɔ kumo to ere so.
11Manɛ nna nɛ n daa maŋ laŋɛ
kachɛ nɛ b kurge ma na bre?
12Manɛ nna nɛ n nio ta ma n deŋi mbe aya so,
nseŋ sa ma mbe kenyipo nɛ n nyipo?
13N daŋ wu n laŋɛ nna,
ndafanɛ n daa beeŋ ya tu
14bewura nɛ benimuana nɛ b wu
nseŋ ka bumo be ewurkpaana nɛ nwugboŋ
nɛ a bure a dese na.
15Ndoŋ nɛ meeŋ ya dese a di fanɛ bewura
nɛ b daŋ gbare eshuwa nɛ egbiti m bɔlɔ nwu,
16ŋko n ya dese nchaŋ to fanɛ kebia
nɛ b kurge nɛ e laŋɛ nsaa
maŋ wu kananɛ karechɛ du na.
17Basa lubi maŋ naa tiŋ a wora asheŋ lubi nchaŋ to,
