Ŋko n nite kumo be kaseto be kasawule so ŋ ku so a?
17Fo daŋ wu kakpa nɛ bubuni wɔ na
be kabuna kenishiso ŋ ku so a?
18Fo nyi kananɛ durnya be mparto sa a?
Kaŋɛ ma, nɛ fo nyi nna na!
19Fo nyi kakpa nɛ kefulto nɛ
tentembiri kikɛ bee shi a ba a?
20Feeŋ tiŋ n juŋkpar amo n yɔ kakpa nɛ e wɔ a?
Fo nyi ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ ndoŋ bre a?
21N nyi geeŋ fanɛ feeŋ tiŋ n wora loŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, b kurge fo nna pɔɛŋ
nɛ n to kusɔ kama.
22Fo daŋ yɔ mboŋ nɛ mee yili
abɔrɛjembubi nɛ kunyɔlɔ a?
23N yili amo nna a jo kebagato be jemanɛ
nɛ jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ gberge efuliana na kusoe.
24Nnɛ nɛ bɔrɛ be kenyɛkpɛ bee shi a lar,
ŋko nnɛ nɛ epeŋilarkpa be afu bee shi a ba?
25Wanɛ e chaŋ kubɔr n sa bɔrɛchugboŋ
nseŋ bugi ekpa n sa bɔrɛfugboŋ?
26Wanɛ e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba
keshishɛrsawule nɛ ekama maŋ wɔ so na?
27Wanɛ e naa wurge kasawule wɔlso so nchu
nɛ afitiri bumbuŋ bee kɔr kumo so?
28Wanɛ e la bunyaŋ nɛ bɔrɛ, amo tuto?
29-30Wanɛ e kurge abɔrɛjembubi be yiri kikɛ,
nɛ a bee shin nɛ nchu bee ki fanɛ ajembu
nɛ mbombi nɛ apa be nchu bee wushi a ki abɔrɛjembubi?
31Feeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ achɛkpabi e ba abar so
fanɛ amo nɛ baa tre koshi nɛ mbe bibi nna a?
32Feeŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini achɛkpabi kusɔ nɛ a beeŋ baa wora,
ŋko n ta achɛkpabi nɛ baa tre Shishirigboŋ nɛ
Shishiribi n yili amo be eyilikpa a?
33Fo nyi mbra nɛ e wɔtɔ n sa awɔlpa to be asɔ a?
Fo alɛ beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ mbra na
e shuŋ kasawule so a?
34Feeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ awɔlpa nɛ a shin nɛ bɔrɛgboŋ e ba a?
35Fo e naa kaŋɛ bɔrɛ nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ a?
Nɛ fo e naa kaŋɛ kumo, k bee nu a sa fo a?
36Fo e naa ŋini ebɔnbɔŋɛ kechali
nɛ ketar be jemanɛ nɛ a bee ba nsaa yɔ a?
37-38Feeŋ tiŋ ŋ karga awɔlpa ŋko n shin nɛ nchu nɛ a wɔ
amo to na e ba bɔrɛ kasawule wɔlso so a?
39Nɛ akoŋ kɔ ebuluŋ, fo e naa chɛ
amo to nɛ a bee nya asɔbɔya a pɛ a ji a?
40Fo e naa kaŋɛ ebuluŋ nɛ a bee
yɔ amo be edikpa a?
41Wanɛ e naa sa ejɔnɔkoso
nɛ amo be bibi ajibi
jemanɛ nɛ akoŋ kɔ amo nɛ
a bee shu a tre ma a fin ajibi na?

Title: JOB 39
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka kraa malga be asheŋ
1Fo nyi jemanɛ nɛ kebee so be mboe nɛ echibir bee kurge a?
Fo daŋ yili ŋ keni a kaa bee kurge amo be bibi a?
2-3Afɔl afanɛ nɛ a bee dii adampo nsaa kurge?
Fo nyi saŋɛ nɛ a bee kurge a?
4Amo be bibi maa chɛr nsaa nya eleŋ
nsaa yige amo nioana be kebɛ so n ya ka ji amo be amu so
nsaa maŋ naa bɛta a ba amo nioana kutɔ ashi kupuŋ to.
5Wanɛ e naa tuge kupuŋ to be ekurma afɔl so
nɛ a bee nya amo be amu a nite a kulti?
6Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule e naa chɛ emo to
nɛ a bee tiŋ a wɔ keshishɛrsawule nɛ nfɔl wɔ kumo be shishɛr to na.
7Kupuŋ to be ekurma ere barga ndegboŋ nna
a wɔ kupuŋ to wɔfɔ ŋkpal a ka maa sha awɔr so.
Amo alɛ maaŋ shuli nɛ esa e pɛ amo n ta amo n shuŋ.
8Ama a bee nite a kulti abee so nna
a fin afitiri bumbuŋ a ji.
9Kupuŋ to be kena beeŋ shuli
m ba kaa wɔ fo kenalu to nsaa shuŋ a sa fo a?
10Feeŋ tiŋ n ta kubɔ to be kebarga
n wɔtɔ kumo n shin nɛ k dɔ a?
Ŋko n shin nɛ k gberge katekpa
m pumpuŋ kudɔ to a?
11Feeŋ shuli n to eyur n lɛ kumo so nɛ k ta eleŋgboŋ
nɛ k kɔ na n shuŋ ashuŋ kpakpaso n sa fo a?
12Feeŋ shuli n yirda kumo nɛ k sulɔ fo
ayu teŋiso m bar fo nɛ fo wɔtɔ mpuro to a?
13Nyiŋgbeŋ bee ber atɛ to manaŋ manaŋ ga,
ama kumo alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n firgi n fo tɔkɔrkɔ so.
14Nyiŋgbeŋ bee yige kumo be afule nna
a nase kasawule nɛ kasawule na e bel amo edɛ.
15K maŋ nyi fanɛ esa ŋko kusɔbɔya ko
beeŋ tiŋ n chichi amoso m bure.
16K bee wora nna fanɛ
afule na ka maŋ la kumo peya na.
Kumo alɛ be kegben jiga be asheŋ
maŋ tir kumo.
17Ŋkpal manɛ so, mee to kumo
kusɔbɔya wulpo nɛ k maŋ nyi shɛŋ.
18Ama nɛ k baŋ fara a shile,
k bee choŋ egbaŋɛdiipo so nna nsaa mushe bumo.
19Fo, Job e sa egbaŋɛ eleŋ
ŋko amo be kubɔ so be afuibi na a?
20Fo e shin nɛ a bee tiŋ a tɛ fanɛ abamber a,
ŋko a fute eleŋso a funti basa na a?
21B baaŋ dii egbaŋɛ a yɔ kena to,
a bee mur aya kasawule nna ŋ kpa eshishɛr,
n shile eleŋso n luri kena na to.
22A maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ baa tre kufu,
amo alɛ maa wu tokobi nsaa shile kumo.
23Amo be bediipo be akɔsɔ bee kpla
abar nna nsaa nyɛkpɛ epeŋi so.
24Egbaŋɛ bre maaŋ tiŋ n yili boeŋ.
Kena to be mbel baŋ shu,
a bee yarase a yɔ kena to nna.
25Kabel baŋ shu, baa fute eleŋso nna.
Baa nu kena be asheŋ kufɔ nna,
nsaa nu amo be bediipoana be mmalga.
26Jemanɛ nɛ kɔl bee firgi a yɔ kelargato be kaseto
ketarso na, fo e ŋini kumo nɛ k keparga atɛ n firgi a?
27Fo e naa kaŋɛ kusore nɛ k bee firgi esoso
nsaa tɔ kumo be kesha abee be awɔlto a?
28K bee ta kebee be awɔlto nna a ki kumo pe,
nɛ kebee na be afalta na e baa kuŋ kumo.
29Ndoŋ nɛ k bee shi a keni kufɔ nɛ tatato,
nsaa wu kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ nya m pɛ n ji.
30Ejɔnɔkoso bee bar asɔ nɛ e bee pɛ nna
nɛ emo be bibi e baa chala a mel amo so a ji.

Title: JOB 40
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka kraa malga asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ Job le:
2“Ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na,
ama fo, Job malga ŋ kasar ma ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ
m maŋ wora n nyalɛ.
To, sa ma mmalga nɛ m bishi fo na be atuwebi naniere.”
Job ka tuge Ebɔrɛ be kamalga to be asheŋ
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Job kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ le:
4“Ma alɛ e la wanɛ nɛ n tiŋ n tuge fo mmalga?
Mee wora ma kɔnɔ kare nɛ m malga ŋ kasar fo.
5N daŋ malga kela koŋwule ŋko ale anyɔ ko nna,
ama m maaŋ naŋ malga kikɛ.”
6Kede be kaman nɛ bɔrɛfugboŋ ko ber m ba
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bɔla kumo to
ŋ kaŋɛ Job le:
7“Kilgi fo anishito n shoŋi ma nseŋ sa ma
asheŋ bishiso ere be atuwebi!
8Fee sha nɛ fo ŋini fanɛ m maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so.
Ma e maŋ wora n nyalɛ, fo ere e wora n nyalɛ, ŋko?
9Fo eleŋ fo ma eleŋ so a?
Fo ebɔl beeŋ tiŋ m ponte to fanɛ meya a?
10Kumo ere shin nɛ ekama e wu kemaŋkura
nɛ yukugboŋ nɛ fo kɔ na.
11Keni basa nɛ baa maŋ bumo be amu so,
nseŋ shin nɛ fo kanya agbogboŋ e bar
bumo kaseto nɛ ŋ keni!
12To, bar bumo nɛ kumukpakpaso wuraana
kaseto nseŋ chichi bumo so kakpa nɛ b wɔ na!
13Ta kesaŋɛ ŋ ŋmea bumo be ekama nseŋ gama bumo
n ya puli nchaŋ to!
14Nɛ fo tiŋ n wora ade kikɛ, ŋ gbagba beeŋ shuli so
fanɛ fo e kɔ kashenteŋ.
15Keni churu le.
Ma e to kumo nɛ fo kikɛ.
Ama afitiri nawule nɛ k bee ji fanɛ kena.
16Keni kananɛ k pɔl eyur to
nsaa kɔ eleŋ aya ase loŋ.
17Kumo be kodu yil nna fanɛ
kakubadibi,
nɛ kumo be ebɛaŋ malɛ pɔlto nɛnɛ.
18Kumo be awibi be eleŋ du fanɛ
danyaŋ peper ŋko kebɛlso nna.
19Ma e to kumo nɛ k kɔ eleŋ a chɔ
ma asɔ toso kikɛ,
ama ŋ kraa chɔ kumo eleŋ.
20Abee to nɛ k bee nya afitiri a ji
nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ a ka na malɛ e baa wɔ ndoŋ a pel.
21-22Ndibi nɛ a yil lɔrkar be kiyoyul to
nɛ k bee dese a wushi nsaa ŋana
agasa nɛ a yil kakpa nɛ k bee pete nchu na to.
23Jɔɔdan be Lɔr na bee da nchu a buu kumo gba,
k bee dese boeŋ nna a maa lɔ kufu.
24Wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ m buu kumo be anishi so m pɛ kumo?
Ŋko n ta kusɔ ŋ kɔl kumo be kamuna to m pɛ kumo?”

Title: JOB 41
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka kraa malga asheŋ
1Feeŋ tiŋ n ta kɔrɔtɔ be dariwa m pɛ
kusɔbɔya gboŋ lubi nɛ k wɔ teku to nna a?
Ŋko ŋ kre kumo be kɔnɔ afɔl n nase a?
2Feeŋ tiŋ n futi kumo be kamuna n wɔtɔ kumo efɔl a?
Ŋko n ta dariwa n da kumo be ketaya m bɔl a?
3K beeŋ shuli ŋ kule fo fanɛ fo wu kumo kuwɔr a?
Ŋko m malga boeŋ boeŋ n sa fo a?
4K beeŋ shuli fanɛ k beeŋ baa la
fo kenya mbaanaayɔ a?
5Feeŋ tiŋ n chɛ kumo afɔl fanɛ kabuibi
n sa fo mbia nɛ b keta a pɛl a?
6Eyawujipo beeŋ shuli n ji kumo be kebɛ a?
Baaŋ shuli ŋ kuya kumo to n fa a?
7Esa beeŋ tiŋ n da kumo kekpa
ŋko n to kumo malfa m mɔ a?
8Fo baŋ tu kumo ŋ kɔ kela koŋwule,
fo maaŋ naŋ shuli n tu kumo ŋ kɔ kikɛ.
9Esa kama nɛ e wu kusɔkpaŋ lubi gboŋgboŋi na
kenishiso bee paŋ mbe kenyɛn nna nseŋ tɔr kasawule.
10Nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ kɔ eleŋ nɛnɛ nɛ e tiŋ
n tu kumo ŋ kɔ,
kumo ere wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ n tu ma ŋ kɔ?
11Ma e naa yili asheŋ a sa durnya kikɛ,
ma alɛ maŋ ji esa kikɛ be kukɔ.
12Shin nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo kusɔ ko a laŋɛ kusɔkpaŋ lubi
gboŋgboŋi ere be aya be kaplɛa so
nseŋ bugi kumo be keshi nɛ eleŋ be asheŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ fo.
13Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n luu kumo be kawɔl,
ŋko n ta kebarga n wɔtɔ kumo be kɔnɔ to.
14Esa kikɛ maŋ shuli m bugi kumo be kɔnɔ,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
kumo be kɔnɔ to be anyi bee keta kufu nna.
15Abɛlso be asɔ kuŋkumuso e buu
kumo be kaman kikɛ so.
Amo alɛ pɛ abar nna a kɔ eleŋ fanɛ kejembu.
16Kekama pɛ kumo barkasa to be kpakpa nna,
afu gba maaŋ tiŋ n luri amo be kefɛato.
17Amo alɛ naŋ pɛ abar nna ga
nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ m marga amo ashi abar so.
18Kusɔkpaŋ lubi gboŋgboŋi ere
baŋ kpa kamuna to, edɛ e naa lar.
Kumo be anishi malɛ bee kpa edɛ nna
fanɛ epeŋi ka pete na.
19Edɛ wuloŋ wuloŋ e naa lar kumo be kɔnɔ to,
a shin nɛ edɛ be adondulombi bee parga to a sɔ kaplɛkama.
20Edishi malɛ bee lar kumo be kamuna to nna,
fanɛ kapuliya fuloŋ ka bɛ asure so nɛ edishi bee kaa kumo to na.
21K baŋ fute, kakpa bee suse edɛ nna,
ŋkpal edɛ be adondulombi kaa bee lar
kumo be kɔnɔ to so.
22Kumo be kubɔ kɔ eleŋ ga,
nɛ ekama nɛ e tu kumo,
kufu bee pɛ mo nna nɛ e baa chicha.
23Kumo be kawɔl be kaplɛkama maŋ du pɔtɔ pɔtɔ,
kumo kikɛ baa du kpakpa nna fanɛ kebɛlso na.
24Kumo be kagbene so du kpakpa ga nna
fanɛ kuboo.
25Kusɔkpaŋ lubi gboŋgboŋi ere
baŋ lara kumo be kumu efuli
kufu bee pɛ belempo gba nna
nɛ b baa shile.
26Tokobi ŋko kekpa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ
n doro kumo kikɛ.
27Danyaŋ ŋko abɛlso be akɔsɔ
du fanɛ agasa ŋko ndibi wuso
nna n sa kumo.
A maaŋ tiŋ n wora kumo shɛŋ.
28Atanyembi maa shin nɛ k bee shile,
ŋkpal manɛ so, k maa ŋana amo.
Ketababu be kejembu malɛ du
fanɛ kuyu be kewabi nna n sa kumo.
29Kaprɛ bre du fanɛ kegasa nna n sa kumo,
basa baa kpa kumo akpa, k bee mushe bumo nna.
30K baa gbeye depɔ to, kumo be epun so
be afɔfɔ nɛ a du fanɛ mpɛlanfu na
bee kori depɔ nna nsaa nase kubɔr.
31Nɛ k baŋ muni nchu be kechimbi to malɛ
nchu na bee fɔnɔto nna nɛ teku na to e baga to
fanɛ ŋku ka bɛ edɛ so a falte na.
32Nɛ kumo be kubɔr e baa nyɛkpɛ a bɛ kumo so
nɛ teku be nchu na e ka kupɔpɔ.
33Kupɔrso kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ durnya to
nɛ k kɔ kenyɛn n fo kumo so.
K maa ŋana kufu kikɛ.
34Kumo e la ewura asɔbɔya ŋana so kikɛ to.
Amoso k bee keni amo kikɛ jiga nna.

Title: JOB 42
Content:
Job ka tuge Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na to be asheŋ
Job
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Job malɛ kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ le:
2“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyi fanɛ fo e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.
Ma alɛ nyi fanɛ feeŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ kama nɛ fee sha.
3Fee bishi kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ mee malga ga,
jemanɛ nɛ ma mmalga maŋ kɔ shɛŋ amo to.
Kashenteŋto, asɔ nɛ a baŋ ma kepinto so ga
be asheŋ nɛ m malga.
4Fo kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n lo to n nu fo kutɔ
nseŋ sa asheŋ bishiso nɛ feeŋ bishi ma na
be atuwebi.
5Beko kutɔ nɛ n daŋ nu fo asheŋ,
ama naniere bre ŋ gbagba wu fo kenishiso.
6Amoso nɛ ŋ gbagba be asheŋ bee nu ma agbo
nɛ n tuba nseŋ chena nsunɔ to,
a ŋini kebɔltofinfin nɛ k kɔ ma.”
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka naŋ nɛfa Job be asheŋ
7Job ka malga n loge nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Job mo nekpa, Ɛlifaz nɛ e shi Teman be kadegboŋ to na le: “Kusɔ nɛ ma kayɛrbi Job kaŋɛ a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so na la kashenteŋ nna, ama n nya agbo nna n wora fo nɛ fo nekpaana benyɔ na, ŋkpal men ka kini keji kashenteŋ na so. 8Amoso mee sha fanɛ men ta egbolu ashunu nɛ ekpakpa ashunu n ya sa Job nɛ e ta amo n yili men be katelamu to n lara sarga chɔɔso nɛ k beeŋ par ma. Kumo be kaman nɛ ma kayɛrbi Job e kule Ebɔrɛ n sa menyi nɛ n sɔ mbe kekule na nsaa maaŋ naŋ wora menyi kusɔ nɛ k daga menyi ŋkpal menyi be kawuli so. Menyi maŋ malga kusɔ nɛ k daga a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so fanɛ kananɛ ma kayɛrbi Job bre wora na.”
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ Job mo nekpaana besa na, Ɛlifaz nɛ Bildad nɛ Zofa, wora kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ bumo na, nɛ Ebɔrɛ sɔ Job be kekule nɛ e kule n sa bumo na.
Asheŋ ka nyalɛ n sa Job be asheŋ
10Job ka kule Ebɔrɛ n sa mo nekpaana na be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ shin nɛ e naŋ nya asɔ nɛ e daa kɔ nseŋ paŋ amo na be kekama be ntuŋ anyɔso nseŋ naŋ dii kedama ga n ti so. 11Kumo be kaman nɛ Job wora kejigboŋ n sa mo niopibiana kikɛ nɛ mo teri draana kikɛ ashi mbe laŋ to. B daŋ ba wushi mo kagbene nseŋ lolo mo nna a laŋɛ etɔrɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ sa ekpa nɛ a ba mo so na kikɛ be kaplɛa so nna. Bumo be ekama daŋ sa mo amansherbi nɛ shuwa be kepinibi nna.
12Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ nɛfa Job a chɔ kananɛ e daŋ nɛfa mo dra na. E daŋ naŋ sa mo mbolpɔ ŋgboŋ kuduana nɛ enyɔma ŋgboŋ ashe nɛ egbolu dɔso be benyɔ nyɔ be ntuŋ kagboŋ nɛ ekurma kagboŋ nna.
13E daŋ naŋ sa Job bibinyɛn ashunu nɛ bibiche asa nna. 14Nɛ Job nase mo pibiche sososo na Jimaima nseŋ nase enyɔsopo na Keziya nɛ esasopo na malɛ Kɛren Happuk. 15Eche kikɛ daa maŋ wɔ kasawule na so nɛ e walɛ kebita n fo Job be bibiche asa na so. Bumo tuto malɛ daŋ yige kapetɛ nna n sa bumo nɛ bumo danyɛnsoana na.
16Ade kikɛ be kaman, Job daŋ ji nfɛ kalfa nɛ adena nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu. E daŋ nya benanabiana nna hale n ya fo bumo nɛ b bɛ so benasopo gba. 17E daŋ bel nɛnɛ nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu.

Title: NSHƐ 1
Content:
SOSOSO
(Nshɛ 1—41)
Kashenteŋ be kagbenefuli be asheŋ
1Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b maa sɔ
alubiworapoana be kasotoji,
ŋko a kute alubiworapoana to
a wora asheŋ,
ŋko a tu basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ saŋɛ
a sa Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.
2Bumo be kagbenefuli bee shi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be keŋini
be kebaawɔtɔ to nna;
nɛ kumo be loŋ malɛ
wɔ bumo be nfɛra to
kapa nɛ kanyɛ.
3Loŋ be basa du fanɛ
boŋkarase be ndibi
nɛ a bee sɔr asɔrso
saŋɛ nɛ k daga na nna.
Amo be afantaŋ maa
gbaŋgbaŋ kikɛ.
Kusɔ kama nɛ baa wora
bee nite nɛnɛ nna a sa bumo.
4Ama mannɛ loŋ nɛ k du
n sa alubiworapoana bre.
Bumo ere du fanɛ asɔ be afɔfɔ
nɛ afu bee foŋ n ya kaa lɛ nna.
5Ebɔrɛ be demujiachɛ na,
alubiworapoana kikɛ beeŋ ji n tɔr.
Ebɔrɛ beeŋ barga bumo
ashi basa nɛ baa ŋana mo
nsaa wora asheŋ
nɛ a niŋi ekpa na kutɔ.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa kuŋ
loŋ be basa nsaa ŋini bumo ekpa.
Ama alubiworapoana bre be ekpa
kɔ bumo nna a yɔ kemur to.

Title: NSHƐ 2
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be ewura laraso be asheŋ
1Manɛ nna nɛ efuliana na
bee kre ŋkre lubi loŋ?
Manɛ nna nɛ amo be basa
bee kre asheŋ fuloŋ?
2Nɛ manɛ nna nɛ amo be bewura
nɛ bejuŋkparpoana bee wora kɔnɔ
a kini kenu n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ mbe esa lara so na?
3Le nɛ baa kaŋɛ:
“Men shin nɛ an suge anyi be amu
ashi bumo be enɔ to,
nseŋ nya anyi be amu a ji.”
4Ebɔrɛ tase mbe kuwurputi so
esoso nna ŋ kplaŋ bumo so,
nsaa mushe bumo.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fɛa bumo so agbo so,
nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ga, nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le:
6“M buu ma ewura nna n chena Zayɔn
nɛ k la ma kebee cheembi na so
ashi Jerusalɛm to.”
7Nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ le:
“Meeŋ bɔ kɔnɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nase n sa ma na be kubɔya.”
E yɛ: “Fo e la m pibinyɛn na;
kabre, ŋ ki fo tuto.
8Amoso kule ma,
nɛ n ta efuliana ere kikɛ n sa fo;
nseŋ shin nɛ durnya ere kikɛ
e ki feya.
9Feeŋ ta fo kebɛlso be kuwurkpabi
n ji amo so kuwura.
Fo alɛ beeŋ bure amo to
fanɛ ebɔ be kapuya na
10Amoso menyi bewura e kaŋ asoe
n nu le be kefiɛso ere;
Menyi, durnya to be bejuŋkparpo
e koya le be asheŋ ere.
11Men ta kufu nɛ kechicha chicha
a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ, nseŋ shin nɛ
men be ŋgbene e fuli.
12Men baa jɔŋɛ a bunyaŋ mo pibi na,
nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e beeŋ nya agbo
epul to m mur menyi.
E bee nɛfa nsaa kuŋ bekama
nɛ baa shile a yɔ mo kutɔ na nna.”

Title: NSHƐ 3
Content:
Saŋɛ nɛ Ewura David bee shile mo pibinyɛn Absalɔm be kena na nɛ e boŋ kashɛ ere.
1N nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋ kɔ bedoŋ damta ga.
Basa damta e naa kɔ ma.
2Baa malga a gbiti ma nna
a kaŋɛ le:
“Ebɔrɛ maaŋ mɔlga mo.”
3Ama, fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e naa kuŋ ma saŋkikɛ.
Fo e naa shin nɛ mee kɔ a pɔɔ so,
nsaa shin nɛ mee nya
bunyaŋgboŋ nɛ keleŋto.
4N shu n tre fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na;
nɛ fo nu ma kushu
ashi fo kebee cheembi na so.
5Saŋkama nɛ n dese a di,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee keni ma so nna,
a kuŋ ma kanyɛ na kikɛ.
6Hale bedoŋ kagboŋ kulti ma gba,
m maa lɔ kufu.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga ma.
Gberge ma doŋana kusoe,
n shin nɛ bumo be eleŋ e yɔɔ,
nɛ b sa maŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ ma so.
Fɛta ma doŋana be atayamu,
nseŋ gbaŋ bumo be anyi.
8Kekuŋ shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna.
Enyɛnpe nɛfa fo basa.

Title: NSHƐ 4
Content:
Ewura Deevid be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ fo la ma ekumpo,
nu ma kekule.
N daa wɔ tɔrɔ to nna
nɛ fo chɛ ma to.
Amoso wu ma kuwɔr
nseŋ nu ma kekule.
2Saŋɛ mo nɛ menyi basa ere
beeŋ yige ma katege?
Saŋɛ mo nɛ menyeeŋ yige
asheŋ fuloŋ be kasha,
nɛ kebaaju a buu efɛ so?
3Men nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
ta basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso nna
ŋ ki mbe mbia;
saŋkama nɛ n shu n tre mo,
e bee nu ma kekule nna.
4Men ta kufu nɛ kechicha chicha
n lar men be alubi to.
Men keni men be ŋgbene to nɛnɛ,
saŋɛ nɛ men nawule dese kelaŋ so na.
5Men lara sarga nɛ k daga
n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nseŋ yirda mo.
6Basa damta bee kule
Ebɔrɛ nna a kaŋɛ le:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛfa anyi,
nseŋ wu anyi kuwɔr.”
7Kagbenefuli nɛ fo sa ma na chɔ
kumo nɛ aboyu damta be keburi
ŋko nsa damta be kenya
bee sa basa ga.
8Mee dese nna a di nɛ kagbenewushi,
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nawule e naa kuŋ ma.

Title: NSHƐ 5
Content:
Ewura Deevid be kashɛ
Kekuŋ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ;
nu ma kekule;
nɛ ma kushuto.
2Ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ ma ewura,
nu ma kushu.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
mee kule fo nna,
chɛ ma to.
3Kachipurso kikɛ
fee nu ma kekule nna.
Mee ta ma asheŋ tirso nna
a ba kaa nase fo anishito,
nsaa jo fo atuwebi.
4Alubi maa par fo.
Fo alɛ nɛ alubiworapo
maaŋ tiŋ n chena abar so.
5Ŋkpensheŋ wura maaŋ tiŋ
n yili fo anishito.
Fo kishi basa
nɛ baa wora alubi ga.
6Feeŋ mur befɛpo kikɛ.
Fo kishi kumukpakpaso
nɛ kafule ga.
7Ama ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu ka shi so,
meeŋ tiŋ m ba fo bɔrɛlambu to;
m ba gbir bunyanso,
m maŋkura fo.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, juŋkpar ma
ŋkpal fo ka bee wora asheŋ niŋiso so.
Ŋini ma fo ekpa niŋiso na,
ŋkpal ŋ ka kɔ bedoŋ damta so.
9M maaŋ tiŋ n yirda
kusɔ nɛ ma doŋana bee kaŋɛ.
Esa be kejija nɛ baa fin.
Efɛ e bɔlɔ bumo be mmalga to
fanɛ kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ asɔ buu so.
Bumo be adonduloŋ malɛ bee ku
efɛ nawule nna.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ b ji n tɔr.
Shin nɛ bumo gbagba be ŋkre
e shin nɛ b mur.
Ju bumo ashi fo anishito,
ŋkpal bumo be alubi nɛ
kumukpakpaso so.
11Ama bumo nɛ baa fin kekuŋ
ashi fo kutɔ na bre be ŋgbene
bee fuli bumo nna,
nɛ baa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso
saŋkama.
Baa kuŋ bumo nɛ baa sha fo na;
Shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene
e baa fuli bumo ŋkpal fo so.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fee nɛfa bekama nɛ baa wora
fo kasonu nsaa wora asɔ nɛ niŋi nna.
Fee kuŋ bumo nna fanɛ kananɛ
kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋso
bee kuŋ benapo na.

Title: NSHƐ 6
Content:
Ewura Deevid be kashɛ
Tɔrɔ to be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
sa maŋ nya agbo ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ
n wora n jija,
nseŋ gberge ma kusoe agbo so.
2Wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ sa ma eleŋ;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma eyur kikɛ chɛl ma nna
3nɛ mee shin nɛ n wu.
Saŋɛ mo nɛ feeŋ chɛ ma to,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ?
4Enyɛnpe, ba mɔlga ma.
Wu ma kuwɔr,
nseŋ mɔlga ma ashi luwu to.
5M baŋ wu,
m maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n fur fo,
ŋko n nyiŋi fo asheŋ.
6Kebɔltofinfin e naa mɔ ma.
Kanyɛso kikɛ, ma anishichubi
bee pɔ ma gedo nɛ kaputi nna.
7N doŋana shin nɛ
kagbenejija pɛ ma,
nɛ n shu nɛ ma anishi puŋi
a maŋ naa wu nɛnɛ.
8Basa lubi, men shile ma so!
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nu ma kushu.
9E nu ma kekule nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr,
n wora ma asheŋ tirso n sa ma.
10Anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ ma doŋana kikɛ
nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo ga nɛ b wulto,
nseŋ pal kaman n ta nyɔmɔ n shile n yɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 7
Content:
Ewura Deevid be kashɛ be asheŋ
1N nyɛnpe nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ,
m ba fo kutɔ nna nɛ fo kuŋ ma,
nseŋ mɔlga ma.
Sɔ ma n yige ashi basa nɛ b ju
a buu ma so na kutɔ.
2Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ baaŋ kpɛa ma to
fanɛ buluŋ ka kpɛa kusɔbɔya to na.
Esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ ma
ama fo nawule.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nɛ n wora kulubi n da
esa ko so,
4ŋko n lar nlɔpo kikɛ kaman,
ŋko ŋ kɔ n sɔ n doŋ be asɔ
nɛ e maŋ wora shɛŋ;
5nɛ n wora asɔ ere be kekama,
kumo ere fo shin nɛ
ma doŋana e ju ma n pɛ.
Shin nɛ b chichi ma so m mɔ
nseŋ yige ma n lɛ shishɛr to.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nya agbo ŋ kpa n niŋi to
n tu ma doŋana nɛ b nya agbo ga na;
yili to n shin nɛ kashenteŋji e di efuli.
7Shin nɛ basa kikɛ e shɛr fo anishito
nɛ fo yili esoso n ji bumo so kuwura.
8Fo e la durnya kikɛ be demujipo na.
Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ n ji n lar;
ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee ji kashenteŋ,
a maŋ wora n jija so.
9Fo la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee wora
asheŋ nɛ a niŋi nna,
a nyi esa be kagbene to
nɛ mbe nfɛra to be asheŋ kikɛ.
Shin nɛ alubiworapo e yige
alubi be kebaawora,
nseŋ kuŋ basa lela ashi alubi to.
10Fo, Ebɔrɛ e la ma ekumpo.
Fo e naa kuŋ
kagbene koŋwulewurana kikɛ.
11Fee ji asheŋ nɛ amo
be ekpa so nna,
nsaa nya agbo karechɛ kikɛ
ŋkpal alubi so.
12Nɛ alubiworapo maŋ tuba
ashi mbe alubi to,
fo yee fo tokobi nna
nseŋ gberge fo keta to;
13fo ta kudur lubi nna n daŋɛ
fo atanyembi nɛ fo gberge
alubiworapoana kusoe.
14Basa di alubi be dampo,
nseŋ bela ase nɛ b kurge
kafulesheŋ nɛ kumukpakpaso.
15Ama bumo gbagba
e naŋ kilgi n tɔr amaŋ chiŋgeliŋ
nɛ b kur n nase beko na to.
16Bumo gbagba be alubi beeŋ laŋɛ
n deŋi bumo be amu so,
nɛ kananɛ baa tintiŋ basa
a shin nɛ baa wora asheŋ na
e laŋɛ bumo so.
17Mee chɔrɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ga
ŋkpal e ka bee wora asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so so.
Meeŋ boŋ kashɛ n di
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e wɔ esoso na epaŋ.

Title: NSHƐ 8
Content:
Ewura Deevid be kashɛ be asheŋ
Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura nɛ dimɛdi be bunyaŋ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe, anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
fo keshi nɛ fo mamachi
be aworbi wɔ durnya ere
be kaplɛkama;
nɛ fo kemaŋkura wɔ esoso.
2Hale mbi popɔrbi nɛ mbiwurbi
kikɛ bee boŋ nshɛ a di fo epaŋ.
Fo kuŋ fo kumu
ashi fo doŋana be enɔ to.
Fo alɛ maaŋ sa
fo doŋ kikɛ kashuli.
3N baŋ keni awɔlpa nɛ fo to,
nɛ kananɛ fo ta kufɔl nɛ
achɛkpabi n yili amo be eyilikpa,
4kusɔ nɛ mee bishi e la fanɛ:
“Manɛ bre e baa la dimɛdi
nɛ mbe asheŋ tir fo,
nɛ fee fɛ mbe asheŋ loŋ?”
5Fo nawule e chɔ dimɛdi
ashi fo asɔ toso kikɛ to.
Fo alɛ e sa mo
kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ.
6Nseŋ shin nɛ e ki fo
asɔ toso kikɛ to be ejuŋkparpo.
Fo ta asɔ kikɛ fanɛ
7mbolpɔ nɛ ana
nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya,
8nɛ mbuibi nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ
nɛ teku to be asɔ kikɛ
m bɔɔ mo enɔ nna.
9Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
fo keshi nɛ fo mamachi be aworbi
wɔ durnya ere be kaplɛkama nna.

Title: NSHƐ 9
Content:
Ewura Deevid be kashɛ be asheŋ
Ebɔrɛ be kapandi be kashɛ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ bugi
ma kagbene kikɛ n fur fo,
nseŋ kaŋɛ etumasesheŋ
nɛ fo wora kikɛ.
2Ma kagbene beeŋ fuli ma
nɛ n ji eyur ŋkpal fo so.
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ boŋ kashɛ
n di fo ketre epaŋ.
3N doŋana baŋ wu fo,
baa kilgi nna a shile,
nsaa fiti a tɔr a wu.
4Eshenteŋjipo e la fo
nɛ fee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so.
Fo ji ma asheŋ kashenteŋ be ekpa so
n ŋini fanɛ n ji n lar.
5Fo fɛa efuliana so
nseŋ shin nɛ alubiworapoana mur;
nɛ fo bubɔ bumo be atre mbaanaayɔ.
6Ama doŋana mur cheche.
Fo jija bumo be ndeana kikɛ,
nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi
bumo hale mbaanaayɔ.
7Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa ji kuwura
durnya kikɛ so mbaanaayɔ,
nsaa tase fo kuwurputi so a ji demu.
8Feeŋ ji durnya ebi demu
nɛ kumo be ekpa so,
nseŋ ji basa so kuwura
ekpa niŋiso so.
9Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ
nɛ basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ
beeŋ tiŋ n shile m ba
nɛ fo kuŋ bumo.
Fo e la ekuŋkpa lempo
awurfoŋ be saŋɛ.
10Bumo nɛ b nyi fo na
beeŋ ta bumo be yirda n deŋi fo so;
Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
maŋ naŋ pal kama n sa bekama
nɛ baa fin fo kikɛ.
11Men boŋ nshɛ n fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e wɔ Zayɔn be kebee so
a ji basa so kuwura na,
n shin nɛ efuliana e nu kusɔ nɛ e wora.
12Mo e maŋ teŋ kegberge
alubiworapo kusoe so,
mo alɛ maa kplaŋ kenu
bumo nɛ b wɔ awurfoŋ to
be kushu so.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni kananɛ
ndoŋana shin nɛ mee ji awurfoŋ.
Wu ma kuwɔr,
m mɔlga ma ashi luwu to,
14nɛ n yili Jerusalɛmebi be anishito
n fur fo ŋ kaŋɛ asɔ nɛ fo wora,
nseŋ ji eyur ŋkpal fo kumɔlga so.
15Efuli pɔtɛana so ebi tɔr amaŋ
nɛ bumo gbagba kur to,
nɛ ajigbelɛ nɛ b sho na
kilgi m pɛ bumo.
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kebaaji
asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
nɛ baa ta a pin mo.
Ama alubiworapoana gbagba
be alubi e naa kilgi a ji bumo.
17Belubiworapo bee yɔ luwu to nna,
nɛ b ya tu efuli pɔtɛana so ebi
nɛ b kini fo na.
18Ama fo maaŋ teŋ bekama
nɛ asheŋ tir bumo na
bre so mbaanaayɔ;
ŋko n shin nɛ betentaŋasepo
be tama e loge cheche.
19Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, maŋ kumu so,
sa maŋ shin nɛ dimɛdi
e kini kebaanu a sa fo.
Shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana kikɛ so ebi
e yili fo anishito nɛ fo ji bumo demu.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ kufugboŋ
e tɔr efuli pɔtɛana na so,
nɛ b pin fanɛ b la edimɛdi nna
ashi fo anishito.

Title: NSHƐ 10
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin kechɛto be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
Manɛ nna nɛ k du fanɛ
fo ka kplaŋ ma so loŋ?
Manɛ nna nɛ fee ta
fo kumu a ŋana ma so
saŋɛ nɛ n wɔ tɔrɔ to?
2Ŋkpensheŋ e luri
m bɔlɔ basa lubi to
nɛ baa fin bebɔlpo
nɛ b baa tɔrɔ saŋkama.
Shin nɛ b tɔr ajigbelɛ
nɛ bumo gbagba sho na to.
3Belubiworapo bee ji njɔŋ nna
ŋkpal bumo be aparsheŋ lubi so.
Nɛ kejimuniwuraana malɛ kishi fo
nsaa shoduu fo.
4Belubiworapo be shɛŋ
maŋ wɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ to.
Bumo be kamoowu so,
b maa fɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ gba kuraa.
5Ama saŋkikɛ asheŋ
bee nite nɛnɛ nna a sa bumo.
Bumo be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ fo mbra to;
bumo alɛ naa keni bumo
doŋana jiga nna saŋkikɛ.
6Le nɛ baa kaŋɛ bumo be ŋgbene to:
“Shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora anyi.
Anyi be ŋgbene beeŋ baa fuli saŋkama.
Asheŋ lubi maaŋ tu anyi kikɛ.”
7Bumo be mmalga kikɛ la
shoduu nɛ kafule nɛ kafunti nna,
nɛ bumo be bare kikɛ malɛ yil
asheŋ lubi nɛ alubi be kewora so.
8Baa ŋana ndekarso be ekpa to nna a jo,
a fin esa nɛ e maŋ wora alubi nɛ b mɔ
kenyanyaŋɛso.
Baa dara nna a fin loŋ be esa.
9Baa jo bumo be eŋanakpa nna
fanɛ buluŋ na,
a tɛ basa nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga
bumo be amu
nɛ b tɔr bumo be ajigbelɛ to,
nɛ b pɛ bumo.
10Baa nyaŋ basa nɛ baa pɛ na nna
nɛ bumo be eleŋ kikɛ
nɛ b suge ŋ gben.
11Le nɛ baa kaŋɛ bumo be amu:
“Ebɔrɛ be shɛŋ maŋ wɔtɔ.
E buu mbe anishi so nna.
E maa wu anyi.”
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wora kusɔ ko.
Maŋ fo enɔ lempo na so
n chɛ bumo nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ
bumo be amu to na to.
13Manɛ nna nɛ belubiworapo
bee keni fo jiga
nsaa kaŋɛ bumo be ŋgbene to le:
“Ebɔrɛ maaŋ ji anyi demu
ŋ gberge anyi kusoe”?
14Ama fo Ebɔrɛ na bee wu
tɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ ere kikɛ,
nseŋ wora shiriya nɛ fo chɛ to.
Basa nɛ baa wu awurfoŋ na
bɔɔ fo enɔ nna.
Fo e naa chɛ amunibi to na.
15Jija belubiworapo
nɛ basa lubi be eleŋ.
Gberge bumo kusoe
ŋkpal bumo be alubi so,
nseŋ shin nɛ b yige
alubi be kebaawora.
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa ji
kuwura kusɔ kama so mbaanaayɔ.
Efuli pɔtɛana na beeŋ mur
ashi mbe kasawule so.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e naa nu
bumo nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ be kekule.
Feeŋ nu bumo be nfubel
nseŋ leŋ bumo to.
18Fo e naa kuŋ amunibi
nɛ basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ na;
saŋɛ na so, dimɛdi nɛ e la
shishɛr na maaŋ naa tɔrɔ
mo braana n shin nɛ
kufu e baa pɛ bumo ga.

Title: NSHƐ 11
Content:
Keta yirda ŋ deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so be asheŋ
1Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ka la ma ekumpo so,
k maŋ la kesheŋ tirso fanɛ
fo kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n firgi fanɛ
kabuibi n yɔ kebeegboŋ so
be kakpa nɛ meeŋ nya kekuŋ.
2Ŋkpal basa lubi ka ŋana
ayoyul to ŋ gberge bumo be ata
nɛ b to n da basa lela
be ŋgbene to so,
3manɛ nɛ basa lela
beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora
saŋɛ nɛ kusɔ kikɛ jija?
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ
mbe bɔrɛlambu cheembi na to.
E tase mbe kuwurputi so
ashi ebɔrɛso nna
a keni basa kaplɛkama.
E bee wu kusɔ
nɛ ekama bee wora.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee wora
basa lela nna a keni.
Ama e kishi kumu kpakpasowuraana
nɛ baa sha alubi be kebaawora
nsaa maa wu kuwɔr na nna.
6E beeŋ ta ajanwulɛ tushiso
nɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ n lɛ basa lubi so
nseŋ ta kawuliwuli tushiso
ŋ gberge bumo kusoe.
7Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna
nsaa sha kashenteŋji.
Bumo nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso
e naŋ baa wɔ mo kutɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 12
Content:
Kefin kechɛto be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, chɛ ma to.
Basa nɛ baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ
maŋ naa wɔtɔ.
Beshenteŋjipo
loge durnya to.
2Ekama bee fule
mo barkasa nna.
Mmalga belbelso
nɛ b kɔ a fule abar.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ kafule be
mmalga belbelso na e ku,
nɛ adonduloŋ nɛ a bee ji
njɔŋ a kaŋɛ fanɛ
4anyi be mmalga bee sa anyi
kusɔ kama nɛ anyee sha nna.
Anyeeŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ kama
nɛ k tir anyi nɛ esa kama
maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ an loto.
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le:
“Meeŋ koso,
ŋkpal bepɔshipo be kamɛaŋ,
nɛ basa nɛ asheŋ bee tɔrɔ
be kushuto so.
Meeŋ sɔ bumo n yige.”
6Enyɛnpe be nnɔ naseso
la kashenteŋ nna.
A du fanɛ gbiti nɛ b ta
n wɔtɔ edɛ to ale shunu
n lara amo to be eyurpi
kikɛ na nna.
7O, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, feeŋ kuŋ anyi,
n shin nɛ an nya kekuŋ ashi
loŋ be basa kutɔ mbaanaayɔ.
8Belubiworapo bee feŋ ŋgbene
a nite kamoowuso nna;
a kpaŋ bumo be asheŋ woraso
nsaa keni asɔ nɛ a daga
kemaŋkura jiga.

Title: NSHƐ 13
Content:
Kefin kechɛto be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
feeŋ teŋ ma so mbaanaayɔ a?
Feeŋ ŋana ma so n chɛr a?
2Nchɛ afanɛ nɛ fee sha fanɛ
ma nfɛra e sa maŋ dese ma?
Nchɛ afanɛ nɛ fee sha fanɛ
kagbenejija e baa wɔ ma to?
Feeŋ shin nɛ n doŋana
e pɔɔ ma so n chɛr a?
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋ kusoe
n nu ma kabɔrɛkule,
nseŋ wora kusɔ nɛ mee
kule fo ere n sa ma.
Shin nɛ ma anishito e saŋɛ to;
nɛ mannɛ aloŋ meeŋ wu,
4nɛ n doŋana e kaŋɛ fanɛ
b kɔ m pɔɔ ma so nna,
nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e fuli bumo
ŋkpal ŋ ka tɔr so.
5Ama ma tama deŋ fo kasha
nɛ k maa loge na so nna.
Ma kagbene beeŋ fuli ma
ŋkpal fo ka beeŋ mɔlga ma so.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ boŋ kashɛ m maŋkura fo,
ŋkpal fo ka wora ma kelela so.

Title: NSHƐ 14
Content:
Esa kikɛ ka maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kplaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so be asheŋ
1Ewulpo e naa kaŋɛ mbe
kagbene to fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ wɔtɔ.
Loŋ be basa maa wora asheŋ
nɛ a bee bɔla ekpa.
Bumo be asheŋ woraso kikɛ
la alubi nna.
Bumo be ekama maa wora
asheŋ lela.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wɔ ebɔrɛso
a keni a fin fanɛ basa ko wɔtɔ
a nyi asheŋ nsaa fin mo a?
3Ama basa kikɛ wora n foe ekpa.
Bumo kikɛ wora alubi.
Ekama maŋ wɔtɔ a wora alela;
esa koŋwule gba maŋ wɔtɔ.
4Ama alubiworapo maaŋ koya a?
Menyee suge ma basa nna a ji,
nsaa kini kekule Ebɔrɛ.
5Menyi alɛ nɛ kufu nɛ keyeŋiyeŋi nna,
ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ wɔ basa
nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso kutɔ nna.
6Menyi, alubiworapoana
e naa jija betirpo be ŋkre.
Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
e naa kuŋ bumo.
7Israɛl be kumɔlga beeŋ shi Zayɔn nna.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ shin nɛ
asheŋ e naa nite nɛnɛ n sa bumo;
nɛ Israɛlebi be ŋgbene e fuli bumo ga.

Title: NSHƐ 15
Content:
Esa nɛ e beeŋ shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wanɛ e naŋ nya ekpa
a wɔ fo bɔrɛlambu na to?
Wanɛ e naŋ chena
fo kebee cheembi na so?
2Basa nɛ baa wora Ebɔrɛ
kasonu kusɔ kama to na,
nɛ bumo nɛ bumo be asheŋ
woraso niŋi akpa na,
nɛ bumo nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ
ashi bumo be ŋgbene to
3nsaa maa ku efɛ
a deŋi bumo braana,
ŋko a malga asheŋ lubi
a gbiti bumo na;
nɛ bumo nɛ baa sa
basa bunyaŋ na,
4nɛ bumo nɛ bumo nɛ
alubiworapoana maŋ kɔ shɛŋ na.
Bumo e naa sa basa
nɛ baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ
nsaa wora a bɔlɔ
bumo be nnɔ naseso so,
hale k du kpakpa gba na.
5Bumo nɛ baa ta bumo
be amansherbi a paŋ basa
nsaa maa wɔtɔ nchu na;
ŋko a sɔ brɔbu nsaa ji
a chɛ alubiworapoana to na.
Loŋ be basa bre maaŋ ji
anishinyɔr kikɛ.

Title: NSHƐ 16
Content:
Kekuŋ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
baa keni ma so;
nsaa kuŋ ma.
2Enyɛnpe,
Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ
Asɔ lela nɛ ŋ kɔ kikɛ
shi fo kutɔ nna.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fo basa
la basa cheembi nna.
Ma kagbene beeŋ fuli ma ga
fanɛ n ti bumo so.
4Ama bekama nɛ b shil
a bɛ agbirana so na
bre be etɔrɔ beeŋ wora keshi ga.
M maaŋ tu bumo n lara
bumo be agbir na be esarga.
Ma alɛ maaŋ bunyaŋ amo.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fo nawule nɛ ŋ kɔ.
Fo alɛ bee sa ma kusɔ kama
nɛ k tir ma.
Fo enɔ to nɛ ma echefoso
be kebaawɔtɔ wɔ.
6Ŋkɛ nɛ fo sa ma na walɛ
nsaa a par ma ga.
7Meeŋ chɔrɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e bee ji ma asoeto na.
E bee bɔla ma kagbene to nna
a malga a sa ma kanyɛso gba.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
deŋ ma kagbene so nna saŋkama.
Ŋkpal e ka taga ma to so,
shɛŋ shɛŋ maa keta ma kufu.
9Amoso ma kagbene fuli ma nna,
nɛ mee ji eyur
ŋkpal ŋ ka nya kekuŋ so.
10Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fee kuŋ ma ashi luwu to.
Fo maaŋ shin nɛ fo kenya
e luri nchaŋ to;
ŋko n shin nɛ fo esa cheembi
e wu m bɛ.
11Fo shin nɛ m pin
fo ŋkpa be ekpa na.
Fo kebaawɔ ma kutɔ,
e naa shin nɛ ma kagbene
bee fuli ga saŋkama.

Title: NSHƐ 17
Content:
Deevid be kabɔrɛkule.
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nu ma kekule ere;
ŋkpal ŋ ka maŋ
wora n da so so,
Nu ma kushu.
Kaŋ kusoe n nu
ma kabɔrɛkule.
Mannɛ efɛ be
kudonduloŋ to nɛ k shi.
2Feeŋ ji n chɛ ma to;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo anishi e naa wu
asheŋ niŋiso.
3Fo nyi ma kagbene to.
Fo wora ma ŋ keni kanyɛso
n wu fanɛ maŋ wora n jija.
N yili kumo ma kagbene to
fanɛ m maaŋ ku efɛ kikɛ.
4M maa wora asheŋ
nɛ basa bee wora na.
Mee bɛ fo mbra na so nna.
M maa tu basa nɛ baa tintiŋ
basa a suge asɔ na a wora asheŋ.
5Saŋɛ kikɛ mee nite fo ekpa to nna.
M maa kple kumo kikɛ.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mee kule fo nna.
Ŋkpal fo ka beeŋ chɛ ma to so.
Kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kabɔrɛkule.
7Ŋini fo mamachi be kasha na.
Fo enɔ lempo na nɛ fee ta a mɔlga
bumo nɛ baa shile a ba fo kutɔ
ashi bumo doŋana be enɔ to.
8Kuŋ ma fanɛ fo kenishi na.
Ta ma ŋ ŋana fo atɛ to
9ashi basa lubi nɛ baa kɔ ma
nsaa fin ma nɛ b mɔ na,
nɛ ma doŋana nɛ b kulti
ma n wɔtɔ na so.
10B maa wu kuwɔr
nsaa ji njɔŋ.
11B ju ma m pɛ
nseŋ kulti ma n wɔtɔ,
a fin keŋin ma n lɛ nna.
12B du fanɛ ebuluŋ nɛ akoŋ kɔ
nɛ baa fin kusɔ ko nɛ b pɛ n ji nna;
ŋko ebulumbi nɛ b ŋana a dese
a jo kusɔ ko nɛ b pɛ n ji na.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ koso
ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so.
Ta fo tokobi m mɔlga ma
ashi amu kpakpasowuraana
be enɔ to.
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ta fo enɔ lempo na
m mɔlga ma ashi loŋ be basa be enɔ to.
Basa nɛ durnya ere be kebaawɔtɔ
nawule la bumo be tɔnɔ.
Fo e naa sa basa nɛ fee sha ajibi;
bumo be mbia beeŋ nya
n ji kanaŋkama so,
nɛ bumo nanabiana gba
e nya n ji kanaŋkama so.
15Meeŋ ba fo anishito,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
m maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ.
M baŋ tiŋi nseŋ wu
fanɛ fo wɔ ma kutɔ,
ma kagbene beeŋ fuli nna.

Title: NSHƐ 18
Content:
Kashɛ nɛ Deevid boŋ jemanɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ mɔlga mo ashi mo doŋana, fɔŋfɔŋ ewura Sɔɔl be enɔ to na.
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ mee sha fo;
fo kutɔ nɛ ma eleŋ bee shi.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e la ma kefalta gboŋ;
Mo kutɔ nɛ mee nya
kekuŋ nɛ kumɔlga.
Ma Ebɔrɛ na e la
kefaltagboŋ nɛ mee
ŋana mo to.
Mo e du fanɛ benapo
be kusɔ kuŋso a kuŋ ma.
Mo e naa kɔ a mɔlga ma
nsaa sa ma eleŋ.
3Meeŋ di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ;
ŋkpal e ka mɔlga ma ashi
ma doŋana be enɔ to.
4Luwu be ŋgbɛlɛbi chambɔ ma nna;
nɛ kemur be nchu kulti ma n wɔtɔ,
5nɛ luwu sho ma ajigbelɛ,
nɛ kenishipere gboŋgboŋi tɔr ma so.
6Nɛ n ta kebɔltofinfin
n shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.
N shu n tre ma Ebɔrɛ
fanɛ e chɛ ma to;
nɛ ma kushu tɔr mbe asoe to
nɛ e yili mbe bɔrɛlambu to
n nu ma ebɔl.
7Nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to m baŋɛ,
nɛ abeegboŋ be kaseto gbuŋgbuŋ.
A gbuŋgbuŋ nna ŋkpal
Ebɔrɛ ka nya agbo so.
8Edishi shi mbe
kamuna to nna a lar;
nɛ edɛ nɛ a bee chɔɔ a mɔ
malɛ shi mbe kɔnɔ to a lar,
fanɛ ajanwulɛ nɛ a bee suse na.
9Nɛ esoso bugi nɛ e lar m ba
nɛ awɔlpa jimajima wɔ
mbe aya ase.
10Nɛ e dii n chena asɔ firgiso
nɛ baa tre chɛrubim na so
n firgi afu to a ba.
11E ta tentembiri nna
ŋ kulti mbe kumu,
nɛ abɔrɛwɔlpa ta mo
ŋ ŋana awɔlpa to.
12Nɛ abɔrɛjembubi
nɛ bɔrɛ be kenyɛkpɛ
be edɛ juŋkpar mo
n fulto ashi awɔlpa
jimajima na to.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
shi esoso m ponte,
nɛ basa nu mbe ebɔl.
14Nɛ e to atanyembi,
nɛ mo doŋana kikɛ pesaŋ to,
nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ nɛ b lara aya fuful.
15Nɛ fo kaponte na shin
nɛ teku be kasawulebi
wɔlto a dese kpantaŋkpalaŋ,
nɛ kasawule be gbaltɔlase
lar n dese kpatokplo.
16Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
shi esoso n to m pɛ ma to,
ŋ gberge ma n chule
ashi nchu chiŋgeliŋ na to.
17E mɔlga ma ashi
bedoŋ lempoana na be enɔ to,
nɛ bumo nɛ b kishi ma
nsaa chɔ ma eleŋ na kutɔ.
18Saŋɛ nɛ kenishipere tu ma na,
nɛ b baa ka kɔ ma,
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ n sɔ ma.
19Mo e lara ma
ashi kenishipere na to,
nseŋ mɔlga ma ŋkpal ma
asheŋ ka bee bɔlɔ mo kenishi so.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wora loŋ nna
n sa ma ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee wora asheŋ
nɛ a niŋi so.
Ŋ ka maa wora alubi na
be kakɔka nna na.
21Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be ekpa so nɛ m bɛ.
Ma alɛ maŋ naŋ wora
kulubi nseŋ pal kaman
n sa mo.
22Mee bɛ mbe mbra kikɛ so nna.
Ma alɛ maŋ naŋ kini
kebɛ mbe keŋini so kikɛ.
23M maŋ naŋ wora
n da mo so kikɛ.
Saŋkama mee
gelge alubi nna.
24Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wora ma
kelela nna ŋkpal ŋ ka bee wora
asheŋ nɛ a niŋi ekpa so.
E wora loŋ nna ŋkpal e ka nyi
ŋ kaa maa wora alubi so.
25Fee ji kashenteŋ nna a sa
bekama nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ na.
Fo alɛ maa pɔlɔ bumo
nɛ b maŋ kɔ mpulɔ na.
26Fee ta kagbenekoŋwule nna
a wora asheŋ a sa
bumo nɛ b kɔ kagbenekoŋwule.
Ama fee gberge alubiworapoana
bre kusoe nna.
27Fee mɔlga bumo nɛ b kɔ
kamubrase nna,
nsaa bar kamoowuwuraana
kaseto.
28Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa ŋini ma kefulto be ekpa,
nsaa ta tentembiri a ki
kefulto a sa ma.
29Fo e naa sa ma eleŋ
nɛ mee kɔ ma doŋana.
Fo so nɛ mee pɔɔ
bumo so.
30Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
maa wora shɛŋ a foe.
Mbe kamalga la kashenteŋ nna.
E du fanɛ benapo
be kusɔ kuŋ so gboŋ nna,
a kuŋ ekama nɛ e bee shile
a ba mo kutɔ.
31Enyɛnpe na nawule
e la Ebɔrɛ.
Mo nawule e du fanɛ
kefalta gboŋ a kuŋ.
32Mo e naa sa ma eleŋ,
nsaa shin nɛ mee
wora asheŋ niŋiso.
33Mo e naa sa ma aya shileso
fanɛ chibir na,
a shin nɛ mee tiŋ a dii abee
a maa fiti a tɔr.
34Mo e naa ŋini ma
kananɛ baa kɔ kena;
nsaa chɛ ma to nɛ mee tiŋ a ta
danyaŋ be keta a kɔ kena.
35Mo e naa kuŋ ma nsaa mɔlga ma.
Mbe enɔ lempo na e naa pɛ ma to.
Mbe kechɛto so nɛ e ki esagboŋ.
36Mo e naa lɔŋɛ ekpa a sa ma
nɛ maa nite a fiti.
37N ju m bɛ ndoŋana so nna
n ya pɔɔ bumo so.
M maŋ bɛta kaman kikɛ;
m mur bumo cheche nna.
38Ŋ ŋmɛa bumo n lɛ
nɛ b koso ŋ gben,
nɛ n chichi bumo so n nase
ma aya to.
39Fo e sa ma eleŋ nɛ ŋ kɔ kena,
nseŋ shin nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ ma doŋana so.
40Fo shin nɛ ndoŋana kilgi
n lara aya fuful n shile,
nɛ ju m bɛ bumo so m mɔ
bekama nɛ b kishi ma na.
41B daa yɛla kenishi to nna
a fin kechɛto;
ama esa kama maŋ mɔlga bumo,
nɛ b shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ;
ama e daa maŋ tuge bumo.
42Nɛ n nɔkɔr bumo fanɛ
kepumpuŋ nɛ afu bee ta na,
nseŋ chichi bumo so fanɛ
ekpa to be depɔ na.
43Fo mɔlga ma ashi
kumukpakpaso wuraana
be enɔ to;
nseŋ ta ma ŋ ki efuli pɔtɛana
be ejuŋkparpo.
Basa nɛ n daa maŋ tama fanɛ
baaŋ shuli n sɔ ma
ŋ ki bumo be ewura na.
44Efuli pɔtɛ so ebi bee jɔŋɛ
ma ase nna.
M baŋ yili kesheŋ n sa bumo,
baa bɛ so nna.
45Bumo be aba pɔ bumo,
nɛ baa lar bumo be
ekuŋkpa lempoana to
a chicha kufuso a ba.
46Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
wɔ ŋkpa to nna.
Meeŋ fur fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ma kefaltagboŋ nɛ fee kuŋ ma.
Meeŋ maŋkura fo,
ma emɔlgapo.
47Fo e bishi kuwule n sa ma
nseŋ shin nɛ efuliana bee nu
a sa ma.
48Fo e mɔlga ma
ashi ndoŋana be enɔ to
nseŋ ta ma n yili eyilikpagboŋ.
Fo sɔ ma n yige ashi basa nɛ baa
ta tintiŋ a suge basa be asɔ na be enɔ to.
49Amoso, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ fur fo ashi efuli pɔtɛana kikɛ
be anishito to.
Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ n di fo epaŋ.
50Fo e shin nɛ fo ewura kɔ m pɔɔ so.
Fo ŋini fo esa laraso,
ewura Deevid, fo kasha
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na,
nseŋ wu mo nɛ mbe kaman to ebi
kuwɔr mbaanaayɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 19
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura ashi mbe asɔ toso to be asheŋ
1Esoso bee di Ebɔrɛ
be kemankura efuli nna,
nɛ awɔlpa malɛ bee ŋini
mbe asɔ toso.
2Karechɛ kikɛ bee shin nɛ
mbe kemaŋkura nɛ kenyi
malɛ bee di efuli nna,
nɛ kanyɛso kikɛ malɛ gba
bee wora loŋ.
3A maa bugi kɔnɔ a malga
ŋko a gbar ŋgbar kikɛ;
4ama durnya to ebi kikɛ bee wu
kusɔ nɛ a bee ŋini saŋkama nna.
Ebɔrɛ wora awɔlpa nna
fanɛ wajɛbu n sa epeŋi.
5Chipurso kikɛ k bee lar nna a ba
fanɛ kejafɔ mo kul ka bee lar ebu to,
ŋko fanɛ ekpampo ka bee lege
kusɔbɔya be kubɔr na.
6K bee fara awɔlpa to
be kaba ko so nna;
n ta loŋ n ya fo kaba ko.
Shɛŋ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋana
kumo be loŋ so.
Enyɛnpe be mbra na be asheŋ
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra na
bee niŋi ekpa nsaa sa ŋkpa nna.
Asɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe be mbra bee ŋini na
la asɔ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda nna.
Amo alɛ bee sa bebɔlpo,
kanyiasheŋ nna.
8Enyɛnpe be mbra na bee niŋi ekpa,
nsaa sa basa nɛ baa bɛ
amo so na kagbenefuli nna.
Enyɛnpe be mbra na di efuli nna,
a shin nɛ esa bee pin kebaawɔtɔ to nɛnɛ.
9Kabɔrɛŋana walɛ nna,
nsaa beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
Enyɛnpe be mbra na la kashenteŋ nna.
Amo alɛ maa wora a foe ekpa.
10A walɛ a chɔ shuwa lela kikɛ,
hale shuwa nɛ k maŋ
kɔ eyurpi gba.
Enyɛnpe be mbra wɔ ebel
a chɔ mushoŋchu,
hale mushoŋchu nɛ a maŋ
kɔ eyurpi gba.
11Enyɛnpe be mbra na
bee kpele basa kusoe nna.
Basa nɛ baa bɛ amo so
bee nya tɔnɔ gboŋgboŋi nna.
12Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin
alubi nɛ e wora kikɛ.
Ta ma alubi nɛ m maŋ kute
n wora na m paŋ ma.
13Nseŋ pete ma ashi alubi
be kekute n wora to.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ loŋ be alubi
e pɔɔ ma so.
Saŋɛ na so ma nfɛra maaŋ ji
m bri ma nɛ n ji n lar alubi to.
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la
ma kefaltagboŋ nɛ ma emɔlgapo.
Shin nɛ ma kɔnɔ to be mmalga
nɛ ma kagbene to be nfɛra,
e baa bɔlɔ fo kenishi.

Title: NSHƐ 20
Content:
Kekɔmpɔɔso be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e nu fo kekule saŋɛ so
nɛ kebaawɔtɔ ki fo so jiga na.
An nananyɛn Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na
e baa kuŋ fo.
2E shin nɛ kechɛto e shi
mbe bɔrɛlambu to m ba fo kutɔ;
nseŋ yili Zayɔn be kebeegboŋ na so
ashi Jerusalɛm to m mɔlga fo.
3E nyiŋi fo esarga nɛ fo lara na kikɛ,
nseŋ sɔ fo esarga chɔɔso.
4E shin nɛ fo nya fo kagbene
be aparsheŋ kikɛ;
nseŋ shin nɛ fo ŋkre kikɛ
bɔlɔ so.
5Nɛ asheŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa fo,
anyeeŋ cha awɔr kagbenefuliso;
nseŋ maŋ anyi be etuta so
ashi anyi be Ebɔrɛ be ketre to.
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e wora
asɔ nɛ fee bishi na n sa fo.
6N nyi geeŋ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ mɔlga mbe ewura lara so.
E beeŋ yili mbe ebɔrɛso
cheembi na n nu ma kekule
nseŋ ta mbe enɔ lempo na
m mɔlga ma.
7Basa ko bee wu bumo be amu nna
ŋkpal bumo be kena to
be egbaŋɛturko so.
Nɛ beko malɛ bee wu bumo be amu
ŋkpal bumo be kena to be egbaŋɛ so.
Ama anyi ere be yirda wɔ fo
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to nna.
8Loŋ be basa na beeŋ fiti n tɔr,
ama anyi ere baa yil nna kiŋkiŋ.
Shɛŋ shɛŋ maa gbuŋgbuŋ anyi.
9Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
mɔlga anyi be ewura.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nu anyi be kekule.

Title: NSHƐ 21
Content:
Kekɔmpɔɔso be kapandi be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ewura be kagbene fuli nna
ŋkpal fo ka sa mo eleŋ so.
Kechɛto nɛ fo sa mo na
e shin nɛ mbe kagbene fuli ga.
2Fo wora mbe kagbene be
aparsheŋ n sa mo.
Fo maŋ kini kewora kusɔ
nɛ e bishi fo na.
3Fo nɛfa mo kashenteŋto,
nseŋ ta shuwa be
kuwurwuro m buu mo.
4E kule fo ŋkpa tenteŋ
nɛ fo sa mo ŋkpa
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar.
5E nya bunyaŋ gboŋgboŋi
ŋkpal kechɛto nɛ fo sa mo na so.
Fo shin nɛ e nya ketre nɛ eleŋ.
6Kashenteŋto,
fo sa mo nɛfa mbaanaayɔ;
fo nɛ mo be kebaala na
malɛ bee fuli mo kagbene nna.
7Ewura na yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nna.
Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kasha
nɛ k maa loge na so,
shɛŋ shɛŋ maa gbuŋgbuŋ mo.
8Fo ta fo enɔ lempo na
ŋ ŋmɛa fo doŋana n lɛ.
Fo enɔ jisa nɛ feeŋ ta
m pɛ basa nɛ b kishi fo kikɛ.
9Fo kaŋ ba, feeŋ ta edɛ fuful
n chɔɔ bumo m mur,
nɛ fo agbo e shin nɛ b ki fanɛ
edɛ be kepa.
10Feeŋ mur bumo be kaman to ebi
kasawule ere so cheche;
nɛ b maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo
be asheŋ kuraa.
11Kanaŋkama so
nɛ b kre fo ŋkre lubi gba;
b maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ fo so kikɛ.
12Fo baŋ to bumo fo atanyembi,
baaŋ pal kaman n shile.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
kemaŋkura e baa la fo peya.
Anyeeŋ boŋ nshɛ m maŋkura fo
ŋkpal fo eleŋgboŋ na so.

Title: NSHƐ 22
Content:
Kebɔltofinfin be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Ma Ebɔrɛ,
manɛ nna nɛ fo kplaŋ ma so?
Manɛ nna nɛ fo wɔ kufɔ loŋ?
Fo maaŋ nu ma
kebɔltofinfin be kushuto,
nseŋ ba mɔlga ma a?
2Ma Ebɔrɛ, mee shu a tre fo
kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna,
fo alɛ maa nu.
Amoso ma kagbene
maŋ dese ma.
3Ama fo la esa cheembi nna
a tase fo kuwurputi so.
Fo nɛ Israɛlebi bee kpaŋ.
4Fo nɛ an nananyɛnana
ta bumo be yirda n deŋi so.
B yirda fo nna,
nɛ fo mɔlga bumo.
5B shu n tre fo,
nɛ fo lara bumo ashi tɔrɔ to.
B yirda fo,
nɛ fo alɛ maŋ shin nɛ
b ji anishinyɔr.
6Ama m maŋ naa du fanɛ dimɛdi.
Ŋ ki fanɛ kushushombi nna
nɛ basa bee keni ma jiga
nsaa wora ma eyurto.
7Ekama nɛ e wu ma
bee wora ma shia nna.
Baa fifi amu nna
nsaa tege ma a kaŋɛ:
8“Fo yɛ fo yirda Ebɔrɛ nna,
nɛ manɛ nna nɛ e maŋ mɔlga fo?
Nɛ fo asheŋ bee bɔlɔ mo kenishi,
manɛ nna nɛ e maŋ chɛ fo to.”
9Ŋkeshin nɛ fo
e shin nɛ b kurge ma.
Fo e keni ma so saŋɛ so nɛ
n la kebi nyiposo gba na.
10B ka kurge ma kikɛ
fo enɔ to nɛ n wɔ;
fo alɛ e la ma Ebɔrɛ
saŋkikɛ.
11Sa maŋ barga ma n yɔ kufɔ;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma nɛ tɔrɔ maŋ wɔ kufɔ.
Esa kama malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ
nɛ e chɛ ma to.
12Bedoŋ damta e kulti ma
n wɔtɔ fanɛ apuntona.
B kɔ eleŋ nna nseŋ lubi fanɛ
Bashan be efuli so be egbolu.
13N doŋana na du nna
fanɛ ebuluŋ nɛ b ya bumo be
nnɔ to a ponte to,
nsaa kpɛa kusɔ kama
nɛ b pɛ to na.
14Ma eleŋ kikɛ loge nna
fanɛ nchu ka feeto na,
nɛ ma echɛkpaana du
fanɛ ma awibi ka maŋ naa
chɔ abar so na.
Ma kagbene malɛ ki fanɛ
ŋku bumbuŋ ka ŋalga na nna.
15Ma eleŋ kikɛ loge fanɛ
kusɔ nuunchu ka baŋɛ to na;
nɛ ma kudonduloŋ wɔl
m mata ma anyifar to.
Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
yige ma nna nɛ n wu
n tɔr shishɛr to a?
16Basa lubi be katuŋ
kulti ma nna n wɔtɔ fanɛ njɔnɔ,
a chɛ a far ma aya nɛ enɔana.
17Meeŋ tiŋ ŋ karga ma awibi kikɛ,
nɛ ma doŋana mɛrge anishi
n yuu ma so a keni
nsaa mushe ma.
18B to beri nna
m barga ma asɔbuuso to
n sa abar.
19Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
sa maŋ barga ma ga.
Ma elempo,
ba manaŋ m ba chɛ ma to.
20N doŋana du fanɛ njɔnɔ nna.
Mɔlga ma nɛ b sa maŋ mɔ ma.
21Mɔlga ma ashi
ebuluŋ na kutɔ.
Sɔ ma n yige ashi
apuntona na kutɔ.
22Meeŋ kaŋɛ ma basa
kusɔ nɛ fo wora;
nseŋ yili fo basa
nɛ b shɛr to n fur fo.
23Menyi nɛ menyee ŋana
Ebɔrɛ na e fur mo.
Menyi nɛ men la an nananyɛn
Jeekɔb be kenana kikɛ
e bunyaŋ mo.
Israɛlebi, men shuŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bunyaŋ so.
24Ŋkpal manɛ so
e maŋ pal kaman n sa
bumo nɛ b wɔ awurfoŋ to na.
E maŋ kplaŋ bumo so
saŋɛ so nɛ b shu n tre mo na.
E nu bumo be kushu nna.
25Saŋɛ nɛ ma nɛ fo basa shɛr na,
nɛ meeŋ fur fo
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fo wora so;
nseŋ tia nnɔ nɛ n nase n sa fo na
ashi bumo be anishito.
26Betirpo beeŋ ji m moɛ,
nɛ bekama nɛ baa
bunyaŋ fo na e chɔrɔ fo.
Shin nɛ asheŋ e baa nyalɛ
a sa bumo saŋkama.
27Efuliana kikɛ so ebi
beeŋ nyiŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nɛ basa e shi durnya be kaplɛkama,
ŋ kilgi m bɛ mo so a bunyaŋ mo.
28Ŋkpal manɛ so
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa ji
kusɔ kama so eleŋ,
nsaa ji efuliana kikɛ so kuwura.
29Durnya to be amansherbiwuraana
nɛ b kɔ asɔ ga beeŋ bunyaŋ mo,
nɛ bumo nɛ b gbar nchaŋ
be kɔnɔ gba e fur mo.
30Echefosoebi kikɛ beeŋ bunyaŋ mo,
nseŋ ji mbe asheŋ be shɛda
n sa bumo be kaman to ebi.
31Bumo nɛ b kurge kaman to gba
beeŋ ba nu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e mɔlga anyi.

Title: NSHƐ 23
Content:
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa keni ma so,
fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapo bee keni
mbe mbɔlpo so na.
Amoso mee nya kusɔ kama
nɛ k tir ma nna.
2Kakpa nɛ afitiri bumbuŋ lela wɔ
nɛ e bee yɛr ma nɛ mee ya ka ji
nsaa dese a wushi.
Mo e naa juŋkpar ma a yɔ
eboŋ be kakpa nɛ nchu
maa shile eleŋso.
3Mo e naa sa ma eleŋ popɔr,
nsaa ŋini ma kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso
fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na.
4Hale nɛ n na
tentembiri to mina gba,
kufu maa pɛ ma.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo wɔ ma kutɔ.
Fo kuwurkpabi
nɛ fo kuchuchɔ
e naa kuŋ ma.
5N doŋana be anishito,
nɛ fee wora kejigboŋ a yili ma.
Fo sɔ ma fanɛ fo efɔgboŋ nna,
a keta ma kananɛ k daga so.
6Kashenteŋto,
feeŋ baa wora ma kelela,
nsaa ŋini ma kasha,
jemanɛ nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to kikɛ.
Meeŋ chena Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be laŋ to hale mbaanaayɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 24
Content:
Deevid be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Kasawule ere nɛ kusɔ kikɛ
nɛ k wɔ kumo so,
la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.
Basa nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to kikɛ,
la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.
2Mo e ta kumo n yili,
nseŋ ta teku nɛ nchuana
n wɔtɔ kumo be kaseto.
3Wanɛ e kɔ ekpa nɛ e dii n yɔ
Enyɛnpe be kebee na be esoso?
Wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ n luri n ya
yili mbe bɔrɛlambu cheembi na to?
4Basa nɛ bumo be ashuŋ shuŋso
nɛ nfɛra fɛso niŋi ekpa,
nɛ bumo alɛ maa shuŋ agbir,
ŋko a bɔ ntaŋ a ku efɛ na.
5Loŋ be basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee nɛfa nsaa mɔlga,
a shin nɛ baa ji a lar mbe anishito
fanɛ basa nɛ b maŋ wora n jija na.
6Loŋ be basa e naa fin
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ekpa,
nsaa shuŋ an nananyɛn
Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na.
7Men bugi kadegboŋ na
be mbuna dra na;
nɛ ewura nɛ kemankura
kulti mo na e luri to.
8Wanɛ e la le be kemankura
be ewura ere?
Mo e la an nyɛnpe nɛ e kɔ eleŋ
nsaa kɔ ana a pɔɔ so saŋkama na.
9Men bugi kadegboŋ na
be mbuna dra na
nɛ ewura nɛ kemankura
kulti na e luri.
10Wanɛ e la ewura
nɛ kemankura kulti ere?
Mo e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
elempo na.

Title: NSHƐ 25
Content:
1Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mee kule.
2Ma Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ n yirda.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr,
ŋko n shin nɛ ma doŋana
e pɔɔ ma so.
3Esa kama nɛ mbe tama deŋ fo so
maaŋ ji anishinyɔr kikɛ.
Ama bekama nɛ b kɔ kebɔrkɔnshi
bre beeŋ ji anishinyɔr.
4Enyɛnpe, ŋini ma fo ekpa na;
nseŋ ŋini ma kananɛ
meeŋ bɛ kumo so.
5Ta fo kashenteŋ na n ŋini ma ekpa.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo e la Ebɔrɛ a mɔlga ma,
nɛ ma tama deŋ fo so saŋkikɛ.
6N nyɛnpe, nyiŋi fo kuwɔrwu
nɛ fo kasha nɛ k maa loge,
nsaa wɔtɔ dra dra na kikɛ na.
7Ta ma kebiato be alubi
nɛ kusoe kpakpaso
be asheŋ woraso m paŋ ma,
nseŋ nyiŋi ma ŋkpal fo kasha
nɛ fo alelasheŋ so.
8Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka walɛ
nɛ mbe asheŋ woraso niŋi ekpa so,
e bee ŋini alubiworapoana
mbe ekpa nna nɛ b bɛ so.
9Nsaa ŋini basa nɛ b kɔ
kamubrase malɛ mbe ekpa
niŋiso nɛ kusɔ nɛ k daga na.
10E bee ji kashenteŋ nna
nsaa kɔ kasha.
E bee juŋkpar bekama
nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso
nsaa wora mbe mbra kasonu nna.
11O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ta alubi damta
nɛ n wora m paŋ ma,
ŋkpal fo ketre so.
12Fee ŋini basa nɛ baa ŋana
fo bunyaŋ so na ekpa
nɛ fo lara n sa bumo fanɛ
b bɔla so na nna.
13Asheŋ beeŋ baa nite
nɛnɛ a sa bumo,
nɛ bumo be mbia e ji
bumo be kasawule be kapetɛ.
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo nɛ basa nɛ baa ŋana fo
bee ji keteri nna.
Fo e naa shin nɛ baa pin
kɔnɔ naseso be ŋkre nɛ fo
nase dra na n sa fo basa na.
15Ma anishi yuu Enyɛnpe na so nna;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
mo e naa mɔlga ma ashi ajigbelɛ to.
16Kenawule nɛ awurfoŋ kɔ ma nna;
amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ba chɛ ma to.
17Mɔlga ma ashi etɔrɔ
nɛ ma kagbenejija gboŋgboŋi
nɛ k bee ti so ere to.
18Keni ma awurfoŋ
nɛ kebɔltofinfin ere so,
nseŋ ta ma alubi m paŋ ma.
19Keni kananɛ ma doŋana wora keshi,
nɛ kananɛ b kishi ma alegaiso.
20Kuŋ ma nseŋ mɔlga ma.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo kutɔ nɛ mee fin kechɛto.
21Keni ma alelasheŋ
nɛ aworbi nɛ a niŋi ekpa so,
nseŋ kuŋ ma ŋkpa.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma tama deŋ fo so nna.
22O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande mɔlga Israɛlebi
ashi bumo be awurfoŋ to.

Title: NSHƐ 26
Content:
Deevid be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe shin nɛ n ji n lar;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma kebaawɔtɔ maŋ kɔ mpulɔ kikɛ.
Ma yirda kikɛ deŋ fo so nna,
ma alɛ maa wora shikashika kikɛ.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wora ma ŋ keni;
mige ma asheŋ to ŋ keni
ma nfɛra to.
3M maaŋ teŋ fo kasha
nɛ k maa loge na so kikɛ.
Fo kashenteŋji e naa
juŋkpar ma saŋkikɛ.
4Ma nɛ befɛpo maa gama
abar so a wora asheŋ.
Ma nɛ kebirkɔnshiwuraana
malɛ maŋ kɔ shɛŋ.
5Ma nɛ belubiworapo maŋ kɔ shɛŋ.
Ma alɛ maa tu
kumukpakpasowuraana a chena.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n fɔr ma enɔ n lar,
nsaa kulti fo bɔrɛsure a bunyaŋ fo,
7nsaa boŋ kapandi be nshɛ,
a malga fo mamachi
be ashuŋ be asheŋ.
8Mee sha fo bɔrɛlambu na,
nɛ kakpa nɛ fo
kemaŋkura wɔ ga na.
9Sa maŋ gama ma nɛ alubiworapo
n ti abar so m mɔ.
Ŋko n ta ma n ti bemɔpo,
10nɛ baa wora asheŋ lubi,
nsaa sa basa brɔbu saŋkikɛ so.
11Ma ere maŋ du fanɛ bumo.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma kebaawɔtɔ niŋi nna.
Amoso wu ma kuwɔr
nseŋ mɔlga ma.
12Ŋkpal fo ka wɔ ŋ kutɔ
nsaa beeŋ chɛ ma to
saŋɛ nɛ k daga so,
meeŋ fur fo
ashi fo basa be nshɛr to.

Title: NSHƐ 27
Content:
Deevid be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e la ma kefulto,
mo alɛ e naa mɔlga ma;
amoso maaŋ ŋana esa kikɛ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na du fanɛ
ekuŋkpagboŋ nna a kuŋ ma;
amoso maa lɔ kufu.
2Basa lubi baa fin ma nɛ b mɔ,
ŋko nɛ bedoŋ bee kɔ ma gba,
baaŋ fiti n tɔr.
3Hale benapo damta
kulti ma n wɔtɔ gba,
kufu maaŋ pɛ ma.
Hale nɛ baa kɔ ma kena gba,
ŋ kraa beeŋ yirda fo.
4Kusɔ koŋwule nɛ mee fin
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ;
Kumo e la fanɛ,
ŋ ka beeŋ baa wɔ mbe laŋ to
saŋɛ so nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to ere;
saŋɛ na so mbe alelasheŋ
beeŋ baa bɔlɔ ma kenishi,
nɛ m baa wɔ mo kutɔ
ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu to.
5Saŋɛ na so e beeŋ baa kuŋ ma
tɔrɔ be jemanɛ;
a ta ma a ŋana mbe bɔrɛlambu to.
E beeŋ ta ma n yili kefaltagboŋ so,
nɛ n nya kekuŋ.
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ n doŋana so
nseŋ lara sarga ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu to;
nseŋ cha awɔr kagbenefuliso
m boŋ nshɛ m fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
7M baŋ shu n tre fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande nu ma ebɔl,
nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr n nu ma kekule.
8N yili ma kagbene to nna
fanɛ meeŋ fin fo;
amoso nɛ m pere kenishi
nɛ n wu fo na.
9Jande sa maŋ pal kaman n sa ma,
sa maŋ nya agbo n ju fo kenya n lɛ.
Fo e la ma echɛtopo,
amoso, ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ ma emɔlgapo;
sa maŋ kplaŋ ma so ŋko n yige ma.
10Hale nɛ tuto nɛ n nio kini ma gba;
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bre beeŋ keni ma so.
11Ŋini ma ekpa lela nɛ fee sha
fanɛ m baa bɔla so,
nɛ ma doŋana maaŋ nya ma.
12Sa maŋ yige ma n sa ma doŋana
nɛ b ta efɛ nɛ kafunti a kɔ ma,
nseŋ nya ma n wora kusɔ nɛ baa sha.
13M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ meeŋ ji efute,
nseŋ wu fo alelasheŋ durnya ere to.
14Yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
Baa kɔ eleŋ nseŋ nya kagbene
a keni mbe anishito.

Title: NSHƐ 28
Content:
Kechɛto be kefin be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e la kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ ma.
Amoso, nu ma kekule
nsaa maŋ kplaŋ ma so.
Fo baŋ kplaŋ ma so,
k maaŋ chɛr nɛ n wu
n yɔ nchaŋ to.
2Jande, nu ma kekule,
saŋɛ so nɛ m maŋ ma enɔana so
n shoŋi fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi na
a bunyaŋ fo nsaa kule fo,
a fin kechɛto ere.
3Sa maŋ ta ma n ti
kumukpakpasowuraana
nɛ basa lubi nɛ baa malga
bumo braana kutɔ kashaso
nsaa kre bumo ŋkre lubi
ashi bumo be ŋgbene to na so
ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n ji n tɔr.
4Gberge bumo kusoe
ŋkpal bumo be ashuŋ lubi so;
Shin nɛ b nya bumo
be asheŋ lubi be kakɔka;
n shin nɛ bumo be asheŋ lubi
nɛ b wora na kikɛ e laŋɛ bumo so.
5Bumo be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ to.
Amoso e beeŋ gberge bumo kusoe
nseŋ mur bumo cheche.
6Meeŋ di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ,
ŋkpal e ka nu ma kushu
nseŋ chɛ ma to so.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa
sa ma eleŋ nsaa kuŋ ma.
N yirda mo kashenteŋto.
E chɛ ma to n shin nɛ
ma kagbene fuli ma.
Amoso meeŋ ji eyur
nseŋ boŋ nshɛ
n di mo epaŋ.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa sa mbe basa eleŋ.
Mo e naa kuŋ nsaa mɔlga
mbe ewura laraso.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
mɔlga fo basa;
nɛfa fo basa laraso.
Baa keni bumo so
fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapo
bee keni mbe mbɔlpo so
na mbanaayɔ na.

Title: NSHƐ 29
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl ashi afugboŋ to be asheŋ
1Menyi emalaika nɛ men wɔ
ebɔrɛso e di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ,
ŋkpal mbe kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ so.
2Men di mbe ketre
nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na epaŋ;
nseŋ bunyaŋ mo ŋkpal e ka du
cheembi nsaa kɔ kemaŋkura so.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be ebɔl bee gbri teku so nna
fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee ponte na.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be ebɔl kɔ eleŋ nna;
nɛ mbe kamalga kɔ
yuku kumo to.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga
bee buri ndibi nɛ baa
tre sida na to nna.
K bee buri sida be ndibi
nɛ a wɔ Lebanɔn be kebeegboŋ
na so burburbi nna.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be kamalga e naa shin nɛ
Lebanɔn be kebeegboŋ na
bee tɛto fanɛ kenabi,
nɛ Hɛɛmɔn be kebeegboŋ
malɛ bee tɛto fanɛ gbolu fɔlbi.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga
bee nyɛkpɛ nna fanɛ
bɔrɛ ka nyɛkpɛ na.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga
bee shin nna nɛ keshishɛrsawule
bee gbuŋgbuŋ to.
Mbe kamalga e shin nɛ Kadɛsh
be keshishɛrsawule gbuŋgbuŋ to.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kamalga
e naa shin nɛ ndibigboŋ
bee gbuŋgbuŋ to;
nɛ kupo to be ndibi be afantaŋ
bee chuge a tɔr;
nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ mbe bɔrɛlambu na to
bee ponte a kaŋɛ fanɛ kemaŋkura
e baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ peya.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa ji kuwura
nchuaana nɛ a wɔ nchiŋ gba so.
E bee ji kuwura nna mbaanaayɔ.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa sa mbe basa eleŋ,
nsaa nɛfa bumo nɛ kagbenewushi.

Title: NSHƐ 30
Content:
Kechɔrɔ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ fur fo;
ŋkpal fo ka mɔlga ma
nsaa maŋ shin nɛ ma doŋana
ji eyur ŋkpal b ka pɔɔ ma so so.
2N shu n tre fo Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ;
nɛ fo chɛ ma to,
3nsaa maŋ shin nɛ n yɔ nchaŋ to.
N daa gbar nchaŋ be kɔnɔ nna,
nɛ fo mɔlga ma, a maŋ shin nɛ n wu.
4Menyi nɛ menyee ji kashenteŋ na
e boŋ nshɛ n chɔrɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋkpal asɔ lela nɛ e wora n sa anyi na so.
5E maa nya agbo a chɛr;
Mbe kelela bre wɔtɔ nna
n sa esa saŋɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to kikɛ.
Kushu beeŋ tiŋ m ba kanyɛso,
ama kare tea ka chɛ nɛ kagbenefuli ba.
6Ŋ ka daŋ nya asɔ nɛ mee sha na;
n daŋ fɛ nna fanɛ shɛŋ
maaŋ naŋ tir ma kikɛ.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo daŋ wora ma kelela,
n sa ma eleŋ fanɛ kebeegboŋ na.
Ama fo ka pal kaman n sa ma
nɛ kufu pɛ ma ga.
8Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ mee shu a tre,
fanɛ fo wu ma kuwɔr.
9Manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ ma luwu
kɔ n sa fo?
Manɛ nɛ ma keyɔ nchaŋ to
beeŋ wora fo?
Bubuni beeŋ tiŋ n fur fo a?
Baaŋ tiŋ m malga fo kashenteŋji
nɛ alelasheŋ be asheŋ a?
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande, nu ma kekule,
nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr n chɛ ma to.
11Fo e chɛrga ma kushu
ŋ ki kayurji;
nɛ m maŋ naŋ buu
kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso.
12Amoso m maaŋ lo ma kɔnɔ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ fur fo,
a di fo ketre epaŋ mbaanaayɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 31
Content:
Yirda be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
kutɔ nɛ m ba nɛ fo kuŋ ma.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr.
Enyɛnpe, jande, sɔ ma n yige;
ŋkpal fo ka la esa niŋiso so.
2Nu ma kekule
nseŋ mɔlga ma manaŋ.
Baa la ma kefaltagboŋ,
nɛ kumɔlga be kakpa lempo
nɛ mee nya kumɔlga fo kutɔ.
3Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e la ma kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ ma.
Amoso baa juŋkpar
a ŋini ma ekpa lela na;
nɛ fo ketre e nya kemaŋkura.
4Kuŋ ma ashi ajigbelɛ
nɛ ma doŋana sho ma to,
n shin nɛ n nya kumɔlga.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e naa keni ma so.
Jande mɔlga ma ŋkpal fo
ka la eshenteŋjipo so.
6Ŋ kishi basa nɛ baa shuŋ agbir
nɛ a maŋ la shɛŋ na ga.
Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ n yirda.
7Ma kagbene beeŋ fuli ma, nɛ n ji eyur
ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na so.
Fo wu ma etɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ
nseŋ chɛ ma to.
8Fo maŋ yige ma n wɔtɔ
ma doŋana be enɔ to.
Ama fo sɔ ma n yige,
nɛ n nya ma kumu a ji.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wu ma kuwɔr
ŋkpal tɔrɔ nɛ n wɔtɔ so.
N shu nɛ ma anishi puŋi m puŋi;
hale ma eyur to kikɛ bee besa ma.
10Kagbenejija shin nɛ n bel katiŋso;
nɛ kebɔltofinfin bee ku ma ŋkpa so.
Awurfoŋ shin nɛ ŋ ki esa pɔso,
nɛ ma awibi to maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ.
11N doŋana nɛ ma bechenashapo
kikɛ bee keni ma jiga nna.
Ŋ ki kusɔ ŋana so n teriana kutɔ,
nɛ baa wu ma nsaa shile.
12B teŋ ma so nna fanɛ esa nɛ e wu,
nɛ ŋ ki fanɛ kapɛlanfu na.
13N nu basa ka bee kuli ma,
nɛ kufu pɛ ma ga.
B yɛ, baa kre ma ŋkre nna,
a fin ma nɛ b mɔ.
14Ama ma yirda deŋ fo so nna.
Enyɛnpe, fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ.
15Ma ŋkpa wɔ fo enɔ to nna.
Mɔlga ma ashi ma doŋana
nɛ b ju a buu ma so
saŋkama na kutɔ.
16Wu fo kenya kuwɔr
nseŋ mɔlga ma,
ŋkpal fo kasha
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na so.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo nɛ mee shu a tre.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr
e ji ma.
Ama shin nɛ basa lubi bre
e ji anishinyɔr,
hale n ya wu n yɔ nchaŋ to.
18Shin nɛ befɛpo na
e lo bumo be nnɔ.
Bumo e naa wu bumo be amu
nsaa keni basa niŋiso jiga na.
19Fo kelela shi m baŋ so;
nɛ fee sha kebaawora basa
nɛ baa ŋana fo kelela.
Ekama nyi fo kelela nɛ kananɛ
fee kuŋ basa nɛ b yirda fo.
20Fee kuŋ bumo ashi basa
nɛ baa kre bumo ŋkre lubi
be enɔ to nna,
nsaa ta bumo a gelge katege
nɛ asheŋ nɛ bedoŋ bee ku
a deŋi bumo.
21Kapandi e baa la Enyɛnpe na peya.
Ŋkpal manɛ so e ŋini ma kashagboŋ,
saŋɛ so nɛ bedoŋ kulti ma n wɔtɔ
fanɛ kananɛ benapo bee kulti kadegboŋ
nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti a wɔtɔ na.
22Kufu daa kɔ ma nna,
nɛ n daa fɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ju ma
ashi mbe anishito nna.
Ama n shu n tre mo
fanɛ e chɛ ma to,
nɛ e nu ma kekule.
23Menyi Ebɔrɛ be basa
e baa sha Enyɛnpe na.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
e bee kuŋ beshenteŋjipo nna,
nsaa gberge kamoowuwuraana
bre kusoe kananɛ k daga bumo.
24Amoso menyi kikɛ nɛ men be yirda
deŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so na,
e baa kɔ eleŋ nsaa leŋ men be amu to.

Title: NSHƐ 32
Content:
Ketampaŋ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Kagbenefuli la bekama
nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta bumo be alubi
m paŋ bumo na peya nna.
Bumo nɛ e ta bumo
be aworandeso ŋ kɛ bumo na.
2Kagbenefuli la esa nɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maŋ naa nyiŋi
mbe alubi na peya nna.
Mo e maŋ ta kulubi kikɛ
ŋ ŋana mbe kagbene to na.
3Ŋ ka daa maŋ tuba
ashi ma alubi to na;
egbɛ ko daa deŋ ma so nna
ŋkpal kare chɛ kikɛ be kushu so.
4Fo kasogberge daa wɔ ma so
kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna;
nɛ ma eleŋ kikɛ loge fanɛ ketarso
be epeŋi ka shin nɛ nchu feeto na.
5Nɛ n tuba nseŋ kaŋɛ fo ma alubi kikɛ.
M maŋ naŋ ta kulubi kikɛ n ŋana;
nɛ fo ta ma alubi kikɛ m paŋ ma.
6Amoso fo kama nɛ fee ŋana Ebɔrɛ,
nsaa wɔ tɔrɔ to, fo kule mo.
Saŋɛ na so, tɔrɔ be awɔrfoŋ nɛ k du
fanɛ nchu ka to chufulgboŋ
a ba eleŋso na maaŋ sulɔ fo n yɔ.
7Fo e la ma eŋanakpa.
Fo alɛ beeŋ mɔlga ma ashi tɔrɔ to;
nɛ m boŋ nshɛ awɔrso
ŋkpal fo ka mɔlga ma so.
8Fo yɛ feeŋ ŋini ma
ekpa nɛ meeŋ bɔla so.
Feeŋ ji ma asoeto
nseŋ keni ma so.
9Amoso n sa maŋ wuli
fanɛ gbaŋɛ ŋko kurma;
nɛ baa wɔtɔ kebarga ŋko efɔl
pɔɛŋ nɛ e bee shuli
a sa mo nyɛnpe na.
10Belubiworapo beeŋ luri
awurfoŋ be yiri yiri to.
Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ ta mbe kasha
nɛ k maa loge na ŋ kuŋ
basa nɛ b yirda mo na bre.
11Amoso, menyi bekama
nɛ menyee wora asheŋ niŋiso na;
e shin nɛ men be ŋgbene
e fuli menyi nɛ men ji eyur;
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe na wora so.
Menyi nɛ menyee wora mo kasonu na
e boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso.

Title: NSHƐ 33
Content:
Kapandi be kashɛ be asheŋ
1A daga fanɛ menyi bekama
nɛ menyee wora asheŋ niŋiso na;
e boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe na wora so.
Menyi nɛ menyee wora mo kasonu na;
e boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso n fur mo.
2Men ta alaŋsɔ n fur mo.
Men ta ejaŋjilaŋ n laŋ
m boŋ nshɛ n dele mo.
3Men boŋ nshɛ popɔr n dele mo.
Men laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ kenyiso,
nseŋ cha awɔr kagbenefuliso.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga
la kashenteŋ nna.
Nɛ mbe asheŋ woraso niŋi,
nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda mo.
5Kusɔ nɛ k niŋi ekpa nɛ
kebaaji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so;
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha.
Mbe kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na
bɔlɔ durnya kikɛ to nna.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga so
nɛ e bɔla n to esoso.
E malga nna nɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl
nɛ achɛkpabi lar.
7Mo e gbargbar teku be nchu kikɛ
n wɔtɔ kakpa koŋwule.
Mo koŋwule na e koli nchu na
n wɔtɔ kakpa chiŋgeliŋ to fanɛ ebu na.
8Kasawule so ebi kikɛ
e shuŋ Enyɛnpe na,
nɛ durnya to be basa kikɛ
e bunyaŋ mo.
9Mo e malga nɛ durnya fara.
Mo e kaŋɛ nɛ kusɔ kama ba.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa jija efuliana be ŋkre.
Mo e naa kuŋ bumo be nfɛra
lubiana ekpa.
11Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe na kre bre
wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
Kusɔ nɛ e yili maa chɛrga kikɛ.
12Kagbenefuli la efuli kama so ebi
nɛ bumo be Ebɔrɛ la Enyɛnpe na
peya nna.
Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ e lara
fanɛ b baa la mbe basa na
peya nna.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ
ebɔrɛso nna a wu basa kikɛ.
14E wɔ kakpa nɛ e bee ji
kuwura na nna nsaa keni kaseto
a wu basa nɛ b wɔ durnya to kikɛ.
15Mo e sa bumo nfɛra nɛ baa fɛ asheŋ.
Amoso e nyi kusɔ kama nɛ baa fɛ.
16Mannɛ ewura be benapo be eleŋ so,
nɛ e bee tiŋ a kɔ a pɔɔ so.
Mannɛ benapo gba be eleŋ so,
nɛ baa tiŋ a kɔ kena a pɔɔ so.
17Egbaŋɛ nɛ b kɔ a kɔ kena
be eleŋgboŋ na maaŋ tiŋ
m mɔlga esa ŋko ŋ kuŋ mo.
18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee keni
bekama nɛ baa wora mo
kasonu so nna;
nɛ mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge na
malɛ wɔ bekama nɛ b yirda
mo na so.
19E bee mɔlga bumo nna
nɛ b maa wu manaŋ,
nsaa sa bumo ŋkpa
akoŋgboŋ be saŋɛ.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to
nɛ anyi be tama wɔ.
Mo e la anyi be ekumpo
nɛ echɛtopo.
21Anyi be ŋgbene fuli anyi nna;
ŋkpal an ka yirda mbe ketre so.
22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, an ka ta anyi
be yirda n wɔtɔ fo to ere,
shin nɛ fo kasha nɛ k wɔtɔ
mbaanaayɔ na e baa wɔ anyi so.

Title: NSHƐ 34
Content:
1Meeŋ baa fur Enyɛnpe na saŋkama.
M maaŋ yige mbe kechɔrɔ kikɛ.
2Meeŋ fur mo ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora so,
nɛ bekama nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ na
e nu kumo be loŋ nɛ bumo be ŋgbene
e fuli bumo.
3Men ba chɛ ma to nɛ an malga
Enyɛnpe na be keshi be asheŋ.
Men shin nɛ an cha abar
n fur mbe ketre.
4Ŋ kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ e nu ma kekule,
nseŋ sɔ ma n yige ashi asɔ
nɛ a bee da ma kufu na to.
5Bekama nɛ bumo be anishi
yuu mo so be ŋgbene
bee fuli bumo nna.
Bumo alɛ maaŋ ji nyɔmɔ kikɛ.
6Mo nɛ betentaŋasepo bee shu a tre,
nɛ e bee nu bumo be kushu,
nsaa mɔlga bumo ashi bumo
be etɔrɔ to na.
7Enyɛnpe be emalaika bee kulti
bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo nna a wɔtɔ,
nsaa mɔlga bumo ashi kenishipere to.
8Nɛ fo firgi n taga Enyɛnpe na to,
feeŋ wu fanɛ e walɛ.
Nɛfa la bekama nɛ baa nya kekuŋ
ashi Enyɛnpe na to peya nna.
9Bekama nɛ b la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be basa na e bunyaŋ mo.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
e bee sa bumo nɛ b yirda mo na
asɔ nɛ a tir bumo nna saŋkikɛ.
10Ebuluŋ gba bee kaa di akoŋ
ama bekama nɛ baa wora
Enyɛnpe na kasonu bre,
maa fin kusɔ lela a gben.
11Ma mbia, men kaŋ kusoe n nu;
nɛ n ŋini menyi kananɛ
menyeeŋ baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe na.
12Menyeeŋ baa sha kenu
kebaawɔtɔ to be ebel a?
Menyeeŋ baa sha
efute tenteŋ nɛ kagbenefuli a?
13Kumo ere men sa maa
tuge malga lubi,
ŋko n shin nɛ men be nnɔ
e baa ku efɛ.
14Men yige alubi be kebaawora
nsaa wora alela;
meeŋ baa kɔ a fin kagbenewushi
ashi men be ŋgbene to.
15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee keni
basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso so
nsaa nu bumo be kekule nna.
16Ama e bee pal kaman nna
a sa alubiworapo bre.
Bumo alɛ baŋ wu e bee
shin nɛ baa teŋ bumo so
kuraa nna.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee nu
esa nɛ e bee wora asheŋ niŋiso
be kushu nna,
nsaa mɔlga mo ashi mbe tɔrɔ to.
18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na taga basa
nɛ bumo be aba pɔ bumo na to nna.
E bee mɔlga bekama
nɛ b maŋ naa kɔ tama na nna.
19Basa lela bee kaa nya etɔrɔ damta nna.
Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ mɔlga bumo ashi etɔrɔ na kikɛ to.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa kuŋ bumo.
Bumo be kuwibi koŋwule gba maaŋ bu.
21Alubiworapoana be asheŋ lubi
bee kilgi nna a ji bumo.
Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge bekama
nɛ b kishi mbe basa kusoe.
22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ mɔlga mbe basa.
E beeŋ kuŋ bekama nɛ baa fin
kekuŋ ashi mo kutɔ na.

Title: NSHƐ 35
Content:
Kechɛto be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
kɔ bekama nɛ baa kɔ ma na;
nseŋ kuŋ bumo nɛ baa kuŋ ma
ekpa na ekpa.
2Chɛ ma to nseŋ kuŋ ma.
3Maŋ fo kekpa nɛ chutre so
ŋ kuŋ bumo nɛ b ju
a bɛ ma so na ekpa;
n shin nɛ m pin fanɛ
fo e la ma emɔlgapo.
Nase kɔnɔ fanɛ feeŋ
mɔlga ma.
4Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa
fin ma nɛ b mɔ na
e ji anishinyɔr nseŋ kɔ n tɔr.
Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa kre ma
ŋkre lubi na kikɛ e wulto
m bɛta kaman.
5Shin nɛ b ki fanɛ afɔfɔ
nɛ afu bee foŋ a lɛ na,
saŋɛ so nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika
bee ŋin bumo na.
6Shin nɛ bumo be ekpa to
e ki tentembiri nsaa fɛrge,
saŋɛ so nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika
ju a bɛ bumo so na.
7M maŋ wora bumo shɛŋ
nɛ b fe ma kejigbelɛ;
nseŋ kur kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ
n nase fanɛ n tɔr to.
8Ama kemur beeŋ purgi bumo.
Bumo gbagba be ajigbelɛ
nɛ b fe na beeŋ kilgi m pɛ bumo.
Baaŋ tur amaŋ nɛ bumo
gbagba kur na to.
9Nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma
ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so;
nɛ n ji eyur ŋkpal e ka mɔlga ma so.
10Nseŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ
ŋ kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe na le:
“Esa kama maŋ du fanɛ fo.
Fo e naa kuŋ bepɔshipo
ashi belempo be enɔ to,
nsaa mɔlga betirpo
ashi basa lempo be kamɛaŋ to.”
11Belubiworapo bee ku efɛ
a ji shɛda a gbiti ma.
Baa ku ma kɔnɔ a kaŋɛ fanɛ
n wora asɔ nɛ m maŋ nyi
amo be asheŋ gba.
12Baa ta alubi nna a ka
ma alela be kukɔ;
nɛ kenawule nɛ kebɔltofinfin
tɔr ma so.
13Ama b ka bee lɔ,
kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso nɛ m buu;
m mɔn ma kumu ajibi;
m bar ma kumu ase ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ
14fanɛ kananɛ meeŋ wora
n sa n teri ŋko n niopibi na.
N shu kagbenejijaso nna fanɛ
ŋ ka bee shu n nio be keeli na.
15Ama asheŋ ka tu ma ere
bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo nna
nɛ b shɛr a wora ma eyurto.
Nɛ befɔ kulti ma n wɔtɔ
a bri ma, nɛ b la ma to.
16B wora ma eyurto nna
fanɛ kananɛ basa nɛ b maa ŋana
Ebɔrɛ bee wora ebobi eyurto na;
nsaa keni ma yurkishi so.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, feeŋ ba tase a keni
nɛ b baa wora ma le a?
Mɔlga ma ashi basa lubi ere be enɔ to.
Mɔlga ma ŋkpa ashi basa nɛ b du fanɛ
ebuluŋ ere be enɔ to.
18Saŋɛ na so meeŋ chɔrɔ fo
ashi fo basa nɛ b shɛr be anishito;
nseŋ yili bumo to n fur fo.
19Sa maŋ shin nɛ ma doŋana,
befɛpo na, be ŋgbene e fuli bumo
ŋkpal b ka pɔɔ ma so so.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ b kishi ma
kenyanyaŋɛso na e mushe ma
ŋkpal ŋ ka wɔ tɔrɔ to so.
20B maa malga kelɔposo kikɛ.
B wɔtɔ nna a ku efɛ a sa basa
nɛ ma nɛ bumo wɔtɔ
kagbenewushiso na.
21Baa nya manaŋ a ku asheŋ
a deŋi ma nna; nsaa ponte a kaŋɛ le:
“An gbagba be kenishi e wu
kusɔ nɛ fo wora.”
22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo gbagba wu kesheŋ ere.
Amoso sa maŋ lo to.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
sa maŋ yɔ kufɔ ŋ ka ma.
23Niŋi to, ŋ koso m ba kuŋ ma.
Enyɛnpe, ma Ebɔrɛ;
ba kɔ n sɔ ma.
24Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋkpal fo ka la esa niŋiso so,
n shin nɛ b pin fanɛ m maŋ wora n foe.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ ma doŋana e mushe ma.
25Sa maŋ shin nɛ b kaŋɛ le:
“Mannɛ mo nde a?
An nya mo n wɔtɔ enɔ to a!”
26Shin nɛ bumo nɛ bumo be ŋgbene
bee fuli ŋkpal ma awurfoŋ so na
be nfɛra e wea to nɛ b kɔ n tɔr cheche.
Shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ
b bɔ ma na e ji nyɔmɔ nseŋ sipa.
27Shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa
fin fanɛ n ji n lar na e cha awɔr
kagbenefuliso ŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Kemaŋkura e baa la Enyɛnpe na peya,
Mbe kagbene e naa fuli
ŋkpal mbe kenya be nɛnɛ so na.”
28Nɛ m malga kananɛ fee wora
asheŋ niŋiso be asheŋ,
nseŋ fur fo kachɛ lelemu.

Title: NSHƐ 36
Content:
Dimɛdi be alubi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be alelasheŋ be asheŋ
1Belubiworapo maa sa Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ.
Alubi nawule be asheŋ nɛ baa fɛ
ashi bumo be ŋgbene to.
2Ŋkpal b kaa bee sha bumo gbagba
be amu ga so so;
b maa wu alubi nɛ baa wora,
hale nɛ baa kishi amo gba.
3Kafulesheŋ nɛ efɛ e bɔlɔ
bumo be nnɔ to.
Bumo be nfɛra maa ŋini
bumo kebaawɔtɔ lela;
bumo alɛ maa wora kelela.
4B dese bumo be edesekpa gba
alubi be kewora be ŋkre nɛ baa kre.
B maa wora asheŋ lela kikɛ.
Kulubi kama malɛ maa choŋ bumo so.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo kashenteŋji
nɛ kasha nɛ fo kɔ a sa basa shi ga.
Kumo alɛ maa chɛrga;
k bee fo kaplɛkama,
hale esoso nɛ awɔlpa to kikɛ.
6Fo asheŋ woraso niŋi ekpa nna
nsaa du fanɛ kebeegboŋ
nɛ k maa gbuŋgbuŋ na.
Kananɛ fee mige basa be asheŋ to
a ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
du chiŋgeliŋ fanɛ teku nna.
Fo enɔ to nɛ edimɛdi
nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ wɔ.
7Fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga
nsaa maa loge na du fanɛ shuwa nna;
nɛ bebɔlpo nɛ basagboŋ kikɛ
bee nya kekuŋ ashi fo kiyoyul to.
8Fee wora kejigboŋ nna a sa
fo befɔ ashi fo laŋ to.
Fo kasha nɛ fo kɔ a sa anyi na
baŋ anyi be nfɛra so.
9Fo kutɔ nɛ ŋkpa kikɛ shi;
nɛ fo kefulto bee bugi
anyi be anishi nɛ anyee pin fo.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa ŋini bekama
nɛ b nyi fo na kasha saŋkama;
nsaa wora bumo nɛ baa wora
asheŋ niŋiso na kelela.
11Sa maŋ shin nɛ kanyishawuraana
e baa kɔ ma, ŋko n shin nɛ
kumukpakpasowuraana
e ju ma n lɛ.
12Keni kakpa nɛ belubiworapoana,
tɔr a dese.
Bumo alɛ maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora
shɛŋ kikɛ.

Title: NSHƐ 37
Content:
Keyirda Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Sa maŋ shin nɛ belubiworapoana
be asheŋ woraso e baa fɔŋ fo,
ŋko n shin nɛ bumo be kanya be asheŋ
e baa besa fo.
2Ŋkpal manɛ so, b du fanɛ
afitiri ŋko afantaŋ bumbuŋ nna,
b maa chɛr nsaa wɔl a wu.
3Yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nsaa wora alelasheŋ.
Saŋɛ na so feeŋ chena
kasawule ere so n nya kekuŋ.
4Shin nɛ fo kagbene e baa fuli fo ga;
ŋkpal fo ka bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be aparsheŋ so.
Mo alɛ beeŋ baa wora kusɔ
nɛ fee sha a sa fo.
5Shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e baa juŋkpar fo kusɔ kama to.
Yirda fanɛ e beeŋ chɛ fo to.
6Shin nɛ fo asheŋ woraso niŋiso
e baa kpa edɛ fanɛ karechɛ,
nɛ kananɛ fee ji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so,
e baa di efuli fanɛ kapiidi be epeŋi.
7Baa kɔ kanyiti a jo Enyɛnpe be saŋɛ.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa tɔrɔ fo
ŋkpal asheŋ ka bee nite nɛnɛ
a sa belubiworapo so.
8Saa maa nya agbo
ŋko a wora asheŋ agbo so.
Agbo bee yɛra esa alubi to nna.
9Alubiworapoana kikɛ beeŋ mur.
Ama bekama nɛ b yirda
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bre
beeŋ ji kasawule ere so be tɔnɔ.
10K maaŋ chɛr nɛ alubiworapoana e mur,
nɛ fo keni n fin bumo ŋ gben.
11Ama bebɔlpo bre beeŋ ji
kasawule ere so be tɔnɔ;
nseŋ nya kagbenewushi gboŋgboŋi.
12Belubiworapo bee kre
basa lela asheŋ lubi nna,
nsaa keni bumo yurkishiso.
13Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee mushe belubiworapo nna,
ŋkpal bumo be kasogberge
be saŋɛ ka maaŋ chɛr nseŋ ba so.
14Belubiworapo bee pe nsaŋɛ nna
nsaa gberge bumo be ata to
a fin betirpo nɛ betentaŋasepo
nɛ basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso
nɛ b mɔ.
15Ama bumo gbagba be nsaŋɛ na
beeŋ kilgi n da bumo m mɔ,
nɛ bumo be ata na e buri to.
16Kebaa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso
nsaa la etirpo
bɔ kebaala damawura
nsaa la alubiworapo.
17Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ jija
belubiworapo be eleŋ kikɛ;
nseŋ sa bumo nɛ baa bɔla mbe
ekpa niŋiso so na eleŋ.
18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa keni
bekama nɛ baa wora mo kasonu so.
Kusɔ kama nɛ mo alɛ sa bumo
beeŋ baa la bumo peya mbaanaayɔ.
19B maaŋ ji awurfoŋ jɛrbi be saŋɛ.
Akoŋ be jemanɛ malɛ,
bumo ere beeŋ baa kɔ
ajibi yɛlyɛla so.
20Ama belubiworapo,
nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ mo doŋana na bre,
beeŋ foe fanɛ kananɛ edishi
bee shi edɛ to a lar a foe na.
21Belubiworapo bee paŋ asɔ nna,
nsaa kini keka.
Ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ
nɛ a niŋi na bre bee bugi
kagbene nna a kɛ basa asɔ saŋkama.
22Basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛfa na,
e naŋ ji kasawule ere so be tɔnɔ.
Ama bekama nɛ Ebɔrɛ sho kɔnɔ na
bre beeŋ mur.
23Nɛ esa be asheŋ woraso baa fuli
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kagbene;
e bee ŋini mo kananɛ e beeŋ baa
tia mbe aya nna.
24E fiti gba, e maaŋ tɔr;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba
e naŋ pɛ mo to n yili.
25Yili ma kebiato kikɛ m ba
fo ma mbel to;
m maŋ naŋ wu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
ka kplaŋ esa lela so;
ŋko n wu esa lela be mbia
ka ta kawie a na a kule ajibi.
26Ama baa nya a ji nɛnɛ nna,
nsaa bugi kagbene a kɛ
basa asɔ yɛlyɛla so;
nɛ bumo be mbia malɛ
bee nya nɛfa.
27Yige asheŋ lubi be kebaawora;
nseŋ fara a wora alelasheŋ.
Saŋɛ na so fo kaman to ebi
beeŋ nya kasawule ere so
n chena mbaanaayɔ.
28Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha
bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so na nna.
Mo alɛ maaŋ kplaŋ bekama
nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ so.
Enyɛnpe na beeŋ baa kuŋ bumo,
ama e beeŋ mur belubiworapo
bre be kaman to ebi.
29Kasawule ere beeŋ baa la basa
nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi na peya,
nɛ b chena kumo so mbaanaayɔ.
30Kanyiasheŋ be mmalga
e naa lar esa nɛ e bee wora
asheŋ nɛ a niŋi be kɔnɔ to,
nɛ mbe kudonduloŋ bee tuge
asheŋ nɛ a niŋi ekpa.
31E ta Ebɔrɛ be mbra na nna
n wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to;
amoso e bee pere kenishi nna
a bɛ kumo so saŋkikɛ.
32Belubiworapo bre bee
ŋana nna a fin
basa lela nɛ b mɔ.
33Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
wɔ basa lela kutɔ nna;
nsaa beeŋ malga n sɔ bumo n yige;
saŋɛ nɛ baŋ bar bumo demujikpa na.
34Ta fo yirda n wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe na to,
nsaa bɛ mo so.
E beeŋ shin nɛ fo chena kasawule ere so
n wu kananɛ belubiworapo beeŋ mur.
35N wu amukpakpasowuraana
ka puni basa n nyalɛ;
fanɛ kananɛ ndibi bee daŋ
a walɛ nɛnɛ ashi kasawule lela so na.
36Ama k maaŋ chɛr ko nɛ b foe;
nɛ ŋ keni nɛ b maaŋ naa wɔtɔ.
37Keni, asheŋ lela bee jo
basa nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ
nsaa maa wora a foe;
nsaa fin kayurwushi na
be kaman to ebi nna.
38Ama alubiworapoana
nɛ bumo be kaman to ebi kikɛ
beeŋ mur.
39Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa kuŋ mbe basa,
nsaa mɔlga bumo tɔrɔ be saŋɛ.
40Enyɛnpe na e naa mɔlga bumo;
ashi alubiworapoana be enɔ to,
ŋkpal b kaa bee fin kekuŋ
ashi mo kutɔ so.

Title: NSHƐ 38
Content:
Tɔrɔ be jemanɛ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
sa maŋ nya agbo n fiɛ ma so,
ŋko ŋ gberge ma kusoe.
2Fo to ma fo atanyembi
nseŋ ta fo enɔ ŋ ŋmɛa ma.
3Ma eyur kikɛ bee besa nna
ŋkpal fo agbo so,
nɛ mee nu ebesa ma awibi to,
4nɛ ma alubi wora ma so egbɛ
hale a buri ma to.
5Ŋkpal ma kawuli so,
ma eyur kikɛ kɔ achuu
nɛ a bɛ a dufɛ nna.
6Ma eyur banto nna nɛ n nyɔŋ to
a tekeŋto saŋkama.
7Ma kaman bel edɛ nna
a besa ma pelpelpel.
Ma eyur kikɛ maŋ kɔ alenfia.
8Ma eyur kikɛ bɛa ma to nna,
nɛ eleŋ fimbi kikɛ maŋ naa wɔ ma to.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo nyi ma asheŋ tirso
nɛ ma kushuto nɛ mee
shuto kikɛ.
10Ma kagbene bee to nna pep pep pep,
nɛ ma eleŋ kikɛ loge
nɛ ma anishi ki m pere
a maŋ naa wu.
11Ŋkpal ma achuu na so,
n nekpaana nɛ ŋ kurgepoana
bee gelge ma nna;
hale n niopibiana gba
maŋ naa taga ma to.
12Bumo nɛ baa fin ma luwu
bee sho ma ajigbelɛ nna;
nɛ bumo nɛ baa fin ma nɛ b jija
malɛ bee kre ma ŋkre lubi
karechɛ kikɛ.
13Ŋ ki fanɛ kpawu nna,
m maŋ naa nu.
Ŋ ki fanɛ neemu nna,
m maŋ naa tiŋ a malga.
14Ŋ ki kpawu nna nɛ ma kɔnɔ
maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n tuge shɛŋ.
15Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ n yirda;
amoso, jande wora kusɔ ko.
16Sa maŋ shin nɛ b wora ma eyurto;
ŋko a wu bumo be amu n wɔtɔ ma
ŋkpal ŋ ka fɛrge n tɔr so.
17Ŋkpal ma eyur to be ebesa damta so,
mee shin nɛ n lar n tɔr nna.
18Ŋ kaŋɛ fo ma alubi kikɛ,
nɛ kananɛ n tuba n lar amo to.
19Bedoŋ lempo damta
e kishi ma kenyanyaŋɛso.
20Baa ta kulubi nna a ka
ma kelela be kukɔ,
nsaa malga a gbiti ma
ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee wora alela so.
21Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
sa maŋ kini ma n lɛ!
N nyɛnpe, sa maŋ yɔ kufɔ ŋ ka ma.
22Fo e naa chɛ ma to saŋkama;
Amoso jande wora manaŋ
m mɔlga ma.

Title: NSHƐ 39
Content:
Alubi be ketampaŋ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ baa de so,
nɛ ma kudonduloŋ maaŋ wora alubi.
N yɛ, meeŋ kre ma kɔnɔ so,
saŋɛ nɛ ma nɛ basa lubi wɔtɔ na.
2Ŋ ka loto n yili shruum
a maa malga kelela na,
nɛ ma eyur to be ebesa
nɛ tɔrɔ na wora kishi n ti so.
3Nɛ kewora fanɛ edɛ
ka bee chɔɔ ma eyur to na.
M baa fɛ kumo be asheŋ,
k bee chɔɔ ma to ga nna.
Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le:
4“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande ŋini ma
kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora ma echefoso.
Meeŋ wu naniere nna a?”
5Fo wora ma ŋkpa shiŋgblembi nna;
nɛ nfɛ nɛ meeŋ ji maŋ la shɛŋ fo kutɔ.
Dimɛdi be ŋkpa du fanɛ
afu ka ber n choŋ nna.
6K bee choŋ manaŋ manaŋ nna
fanɛ kiyoyul na.
Awurfoŋ nɛ anyee ji ere
kikɛ la fuloŋ nna.
Anyee fin asɔ nna
a deŋi abar so a yili
nsaa maŋ nyi esa nɛ e beeŋ ba
ji amo be kapetɛ kachako so.
7Naniere, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
manɛ bre nɛ n naa fin?
Ma tama deŋ fo so nna.
8Mɔlga ma ashi ma alubi to.
Jande, sa maŋ shin nɛ
bewulpo e mushe ma.
9Fo e shin nɛ n ji le be awurfoŋ
n shin nɛ n loto
a maŋ bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ na.
10Fo maaŋ yige kebaa gberge
ma kusoe loŋ a?
Ebɔl lar ma.
11Fee gberge dimɛdi kusoe alegaiso
ŋkpal mbe alubi so nna.
Fee jija anyi be asɔ lela nna
fanɛ kananɛ elala bee jija asɔbuuso na.
Dimɛdi du fanɛ afu ka ber n choŋ nna.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande, nu ma kekule.
Nu ma kushu nseŋ chɛ ma to.
Anishichubi e bɔlɔ ma anishi kikɛ to.
N du fanɛ efɔ nna ashi fo kutɔ,
fanɛ kananɛ n nananyɛnana
daa la befɔ na.
13Sa maŋ naŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma,
saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya kagbenefuli gbrɛbi
pɔɛŋ nseŋ lar durnya ere to.

Title: NSHƐ 40
Content:
Kechɛto be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1N ta kanyiti nna n jo
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ
e chɛ ma to,
nɛ e nu ma kekule
nseŋ chɛ ma to.
2K du fanɛ n daŋ tɔr
kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ depɔ
bɔlɔ kumo to nna,
nɛ e gberge ma
n lara ashi kumo to.
Nseŋ ta ma n yili kefalta so;
kakpa nɛ m maaŋ naŋ nia.
3E sa ma kashɛ popɔr nna,
nɛ m boŋ n fur mo,
nɛ basa damta e wu kusɔ nɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora,
nsaa ŋana mo;
saŋɛ na so, baaŋ ta bumo
be yirda n deŋi mo so.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee nɛfa
bekama nɛ b yirda mo
nɛ bumo nɛ b maa shuŋ agbir
nɛ a la asɔ fuloŋ na nna.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo wora emamachisheŋ damta.
Ŋkre nɛ fo kɔ n sa anyi
shi m pɔɔ anyi be nfɛra so.
Esa kama maŋ du fanɛ fo.
M maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kute fo asheŋ
woraso kikɛ.
6Mannɛ basa be esarga nɛ ŋkɛ
e naa bɔlɔ fo kenishi.
Mannɛ esarga chɔɔso
nɛ alubi be ketampaŋ be esarga
nɛ amo be ŋkɛ nɛ fee fin.
Ama kusɔ nɛ k tir fo kashenteŋto
e la ŋ kaa beeŋ baa wora fo kasonu.
7Amoso nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ma nde na.
Meeŋ wora asheŋ nɛ b sibɛ n wɔtɔ
fo mbra be kawɔl na to fanɛ m bɛ so na;
Kumo e kaŋɛ le na:
8“Kebaa wora fo aparsheŋ
e naa fuli ma kagbene,
amoso n ta fo mbra n wɔtɔ
ma kagbene to nna.”
9Meeŋ kaŋɛ kananɛ fee
mɔlga anyi saŋkama
ashi fo basa be nshɛrgboŋ to.
Enyɛnpe, fo nyi ŋ ka maaŋ lo
ma kɔnɔ to kikɛ.
10M maŋ ta fo kumɔlga be asheŋ na
n wɔtɔ n nawule be kagbene to nna na.
Ŋ ji fo kumɔlga nɛ fo kashenteŋji
nɛ fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
be asheŋ be shɛda nna
ashi fo basa be nshɛrgboŋ to.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyi fo ka
maaŋ yige kebaawu ma kuwɔr.
Fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
nɛ fo kashenteŋji e naa
kuŋ ma saŋkama.
12Ma etɔrɔsheŋ shi alegaiso
nɛ ma alubi kulti ma
n wɔtɔ kaplɛkama
nɛ m maŋ naa nyi
kusɔ nɛ meeŋ wora.
Ma alubi shi a chɔ emin
nɛ a wɔ ma kumu so gba,
nɛ kumo be loŋ shin nɛ m pɔ aba.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande, mɔlga ma.
Ba chɛ ma to manaŋ.
14Wul basa nɛ baa fin ma
nɛ b mɔ na be nfɛra to
nseŋ shin nɛ b ji anishinyɔr.
Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa fin ma
luwu na e sipa.
15Shin nɛ anishinyɔr gboŋgboŋi e pɛ
bekama nɛ baa kaŋɛ ma le na:
“Men keni kananɛ e ki a.”
Nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo nɛ b baa chicha.
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo na
be ŋgbene e fuli bumo nɛ b ji eyur.
Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa sha fo
kumɔlga na e baa kaŋɛ le saŋkama:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shibi ga.”
17N la etirpo nɛ etentaŋasepo nna;
m maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ.
Ama ma asheŋ tir fo,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
Fo e la ma emɔlgapo,
amoso jande,
nya manaŋ m ba mɔlga ma.

Title: NSHƐ 41
Content:
Kulɔ be saŋɛ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fee nɛfa bekama
nɛ baa chɛ betirpo to nna,
nsaa mɔlga loŋ be basa
tɔrɔ be saŋɛ so.
2Bumo be ŋkpa wɔ fo enɔ to nna
nɛ fee kuŋ bumo saŋkikɛ.
Fee shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene bee fuli
kasawule ere so nfe nna.
Fo alɛ maa ta bumo a bɔɔ
bumo doŋana enɔ.
3B baa lɔ fee leŋ bumo to nna
nsaa chɛ bumo be alɔ.
4Enyɛnpe, jande wu ma kuwɔr!
Hale ŋ ka wora alubi
n da fo so ere gba kikɛ,
ta m paŋ ma.
5Bedoŋ bee malga asheŋ lubi
a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so nna
a kaŋɛ le: “Saŋɛ mo nɛ feeŋ wu
nɛ b teŋ fo ketre so?”
6Bekama nɛ baa ba kaa bɔɔ ma so na,
bee malga mmalga fuloŋ nawule nna.
B baŋ naŋ laŋɛ a yɔ malɛ
ŋkuli nɛ efɛ nɛ b kɔ a salga to a yɔ.
7Bedoŋ baa kuli ma,
nfɛra lubi nawule nɛ b kɔ
a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so;
8a kaŋɛ fanɛ kulɔ mɔso e kɔ mo,
amoso e maaŋ naŋ koso
ashi kakpa nɛ e dese ere.
9Nteri kpakpasoana nɛ n yirda ga,
nɛ b daa tu ma a ji gba
pal kaman nna n sa ma.
10Ama, Enyɛnpe, jande,
fo ere e wu ma kuwɔr,
n shin nɛ n niŋi to
n wora bumo n tal to.
11Sa maŋ shin nɛ ndoŋana
e pɔɔ ma so, nɛ m pin
fanɛ ma asheŋ bee bɔlɔ
fo kenishi kashenteŋto.
12Ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee wora
asheŋ niŋiso so,
feeŋ chɛ ma to, nseŋ shin nɛ
m baa wɔ fo kutɔ saŋkama.
13Kechɔrɔ e baa la Enyɛnpe
Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na peya
hale mbaanaayɔ.
Amɛn.

Title: NSHƐ 42
Content:
KENYƆSOPO
(Nshɛ 42—72)
Esa nɛ b pɛ n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Kananɛ achukoŋ bee pɛ chibir
nɛ e bee yɛla kenishi to a fin
eboŋ nɛ k kɔ nchu na,
aloŋ nɛ mee fin fo Ebɔrɛ
kenishipereso ashi ma
kagbene to.
2Kananɛ achukoŋ bee pɛ esa
nɛ e bee fin nchu na,
aloŋ nɛ mee fin fo
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ashi ma kagbene to.
Saŋɛ mo nɛ meeŋ wu fo?
3M ma anishichubi e ki ma
kapa nɛ kanyɛ be ajibi.
Nɛ saŋkama basa
bee bishi ma fanɛ
nnɛ nɛ fo Ebɔrɛ na wɔ.
4M baŋ nyiŋi kananɛ
n daa juŋkpar basa nɛ
baa bɛ abar so a yɔ
fo bɔrɛlambu to
nsaa cha awɔr a boŋ nshɛ
kagbenefuliso a bunyaŋ fo na,
ma kagbene bee jija
alegaiso nna.
5Manɛ nna nɛ ma aba pɔ ma?
Manɛ nna nɛ ma kagbene
maŋ dese ma?
Ŋ kraŋ yirda fo;
ma alɛ kraŋ beeŋ di fo epaŋ
ŋkpal fo ka chɛ ma to so.
6Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ.
M baŋ fɛ fo asheŋ
