ashi kakpa nɛ Jɔɔdan
be lɔr na fara ashi abeegboŋ
nɛ baa tre Hɛɛmɔn
nɛ Miza na ase,
ma aba bee pɔ ma nna.
7Fo agbo ba ma so nna fanɛ
teku be nchu ka baga to
m muni ma so na,
ŋko nchu ka shi kebee
be awɔlto a wurge waa waa na.
8Karechɛ kikɛ fee wora alela nna.
Kanyɛso malɛ kikɛ fee sa ma
kashɛ popɔr nna,
a ŋini ma fo kasha
nɛ k maa chɛrga na,
nɛ k la ma kabɔrɛkule
a yɔ fo kutɔ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo wɔ ŋkpa to nna.
9Fo e du fanɛ kefalta a kuŋ ma.
Manɛ nna nɛ fo teŋ ma so?
Manɛ nna nɛ bedoŋ bee mɛaŋ ma,
a shin nɛ ma kagbene maa fuli ma?
10Ma eyur to kikɛ bee besa ma nna
nɛ bedoŋ bee wora ma eyurto
a bishi fanɛ ma Ebɔrɛ na wɔ nnɛ?
11Manɛ nna nɛ ma aba pɔ ma?
Manɛ nna nɛ ma kagbene
maŋ dese ma?
Ŋ kraŋ yirda fo;
ma alɛ kraŋ beeŋ di fo epaŋ
ŋkpal fo ka chɛ ma to so.
Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ.

Title: NSHƐ 43
Content:
1Enyɛnpe, ŋini fanɛ m maŋ
wora n jija!
Malga ŋ kuŋ ma ashi basa
nɛ b maŋ nyi fo na kutɔ.
Mɔlga ma ashi befɛpo nɛ b kɔ
amu kpakpaso na kutɔ.
2Fo e la ma ekumpo lempo;
manɛ nna nɛ fee ju ma a lɛ?
Sa maŋ shin bedoŋ e baa mɛaŋ ma
n shin nɛ ma kagbene e baa jija.
3Shin nɛ fo kefulto nɛ k bee
shin nɛ mee pin fo na,
nɛ fo kashenteŋ na e baa
ŋini ma fo ekpa na.
Shin nɛ a baa juŋkpar ma a ba
fo lambu nɛ fo wɔ kumo to
ashi kebee cheembi nɛ baa tre
Zayɔn nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm na to.
4Saŋɛ na so meeŋ ya bunyaŋ fo
ashi fo bɔrɛsure na ase,
ŋkpal fo ka sa ma kagbenefuli
gboŋgboŋi so so.
Meeŋ ta ma jaŋjilaŋ
n laŋ m maŋkura fo,
ma Ebɔrɛ na.
5Manɛ nna nɛ ma aba pɔ ma?
Manɛ nna nɛ ma kagbene
maŋ dese ma?
Ŋ kraŋ yirda fo,
ma alɛ kraŋ beeŋ di fo epaŋ
ŋkpal fo ka chɛ ma to so.
Fo alɛ e la ma Ebɔrɛ.

Title: NSHƐ 44
Content:
Kefin kechɛto be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
an nananyɛnana kaŋɛ anyi
kusɔ nɛ fo wora dra dra na.
Nɛ anyi alɛ kaŋ asoe n nu,
2kananɛ fo ta fo eleŋ n ju basa
nɛ b daa wɔ efuli ere so dra dra na,
nseŋ shin nɛ an nananyɛnana
sɔ kasawule ere
nɛ kananɛ fo shin nɛ asheŋ nite
nɛnɛ n sa bumo.
3Mannɛ bumo gbagba be eleŋ nɛ akɔsɔ
e daŋ shin nɛ b sɔ kasawule ere,
ŋko n shin nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so.
Ama ŋkpal fo kagbene
ka fuli bumo so so,
nɛ fo chɛ bumo to
nɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ bumo
doŋana so.
4Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ ma ewura;
fo e shin nɛ Israɛlebi kɔ m pɔɔ so.
5Fo eleŋgboŋ na e shin nɛ
an ŋmɛa an doŋana n lɛ
nseŋ chichi bumo so.
6M maŋ ta ma yirda n deŋi
ma keta ŋko ma tokobi so,
fanɛ amo e naŋ mɔlga ma
ashi bedoŋ be enɔ to.
7Fo nɛ n yirda fanɛ feeŋ shin nɛ
ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bedoŋ so n shin nɛ
anishinyɔr e pɛ bumo nɛ
b kishi anyi na.
8Fo anyi be Ebɔrɛ na so
nɛ anyee ji njɔŋ
nsaa fur fo ketre
saŋkama.
9Ama naniere, fo pal kaman
n sa anyi
n shin nɛ an ki bebɔlpo.
Fo maŋ naa tu anyi
be benapo a yɔ kena to.
10Fo shin nɛ an bɛta n shile
an doŋana be anishito
nɛ b ba muu anyi be asɔ.
11Fo yige anyi nna
nɛ an ki fanɛ asɔbɔya
nɛ basa bee mɔ a ji,
nseŋ pesaŋ anyi to
n wɔtɔ efuli pɔtɛana to.
12K du fanɛ fo maŋ fa
fo basa yawu kpakpaso,
amoso fo maŋ nya tɔnɔ kikɛ.
13Fo shin nɛ an ki basa fuloŋ
ashi an braana be anishito nna.
Nseŋ shin nɛ anyi
be bechenashapo bee wora
anyi amɔmɔshiasheŋ
nsaa keni anyi jiga.
14Fo shin nɛ an ki basa
musheso ashi efuliana so,
nɛ baa wu anyi nsaa fifi amu
nsaa wora anyi eyurto.
15Sipa wɔ ma so kachɛ kama nna,
nɛ mee ji anishinyɔr saŋkama.
16Bedoŋ bee bishi ma kuwule nna,
nɛ basa bee jule a keni ma
nsaa wora ma eyurto.
17An maŋ teŋ fo so,
ŋko n lar anyi nɛ fo
be kɔnɔ koŋwule
be ŋkre na to.
Ama asheŋ ere
kikɛ tu anyi.
18An maŋ lar fo kaman,
ŋko ŋ kplaŋ fo keŋini so.
19Ama k du nna fanɛ fo yige
anyi n lɛ kakpa chil,
nɛ teŋtembiri mina buu anyi so
n wɔtɔ kakpa nɛ asɔkpaŋ wɔ,
nɛ anyi maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ.
20An daŋ teŋ fo so nna,
nseŋ ya kaa bunyaŋ efuli
pɔtɛana so be agbirana,
21fo daŋ beeŋ pin;
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo nyi
kagbene to be ashiri kikɛ.
22Ŋkpal fo so anyee luri
luwu to nna saŋkikɛ.
An du fanɛ mbolpɔ
nɛ b gberge a yɔ nɛ
b ya mɔ nna.
23Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande ba chɛ anyi to.
Wora kusɔ ko.
Sa maŋ kini anyi n lɛ.
24Manɛ nna nɛ fo ŋana anyi so,
nseŋ teŋ anyi be awurfoŋ
nɛ kamɛaŋ so?
25Bedoŋ pɔɔ anyi so cheche
nɛ an tɔr kasawule
a dese shishɛr to.
26Jande wora kusɔ ko n chɛ anyi to.
Mɔlga anyi ŋkpal fo kasha
nɛ k maa chɛrga na so.

Title: NSHƐ 45
Content:
Kijafo to be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Ŋ kɔ mmalga lela ma
nfɛra to nɛ n sa ewura.
Meeŋ ta ma kudonduloŋ
m boŋ amo fanɛ kananɛ
esibɛpo lela bee ta
kelembi a sibɛ na.
2Enyɛn kikɛ maŋ walɛ
keyɛrbi fanɛ fo.
Mmalga belbelso nawule
e naa shi fo kɔnɔ to.
Amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee
nɛfa fo.
3Ewurgboŋ, kemaŋkura wura
nɛ ejuŋkparpo,
ta fo tokobi n wɔtɔ kumo
be efar to ŋ kre kashɛr to.
4Nseŋ dii fo kediiso bunyaŋ so
ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so
a laŋɛ kashenteŋ nɛ kuwɔrwu
nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
be kaplɛa so.
Ta fo enɔjiso lempo na
n wora asheŋ nɛ a bee mɔ kɔnɔ.
5Shin nɛ fo atanyembi pelpelso na
e da ewura mo doŋana be ŋgbene to.
Shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so ebi
e tɔr fo aya ase.
6Kuwurji nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa fo na
beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
Nɛ fo baa ji basa be asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so.
7Fee sha asɔ nɛ a niŋi ekpa nna
nseŋ ŋ kishi alubi.
Amoso nɛ fo Ebɔrɛ lara fo,
nseŋ sa fo kagbenefuli nɛ
k chɔ fo braana peya na.
8Etulale lela dufɛso nɛ baa
tre mir nɛ alowe na be efɛa
a wɔ fo asɔbuuso so,
nɛ baa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ alaŋsɔ
a deŋi fo anishito ashi fo lambu
nɛ b ta ejebotenyi n ji kumo kebita na to.
9Bewura be mbichesobi
e wɔ fo lambu to,
nɛ eche nɛ fee shin nɛ fo ta na
wɔtɔ shuwa be abitasɔ
a yil fo kuwurputi be jisoso.
10Eche nɛ ewura bee shin nɛ
e ta na, e kaŋ kusoe n nu.
Teŋ fo basa nɛ fo tuto
be laŋ to ebi so.
11Fo kela e shin nɛ ewura
be kagbene pɛ fo ga na.
Amoso baa sa mo bunyaŋ
nsaa wora kusɔ kama nɛ
e bee sha a sa mo.
12Basa beeŋ shi Tayɛ be kade to
m bar fo ŋkɛ,
nɛ damawuraana e ta
mmalga belbelso m ba fule fo
nɛ fo wora asɔ nɛ baa sha n sa bumo.
13Ma ewura, eche nɛ fee
shin nɛ fo ta na be kebita
shi mbe kagbene to nna.
Shuwa be ejesebi nɛ b ta n jɔ
mbe kejafɔ to be kale.
14Kale nɛ b jɔ nɛnɛ nɛ e buu,
nɛ b keta mo m bar fo,
nɛ mo teriana nɛ b la etumbache
bɛ mo so m ba fo kutɔ.
15Nɛ b ta kagbenefuli m bɛ fo so
n luri ewura be laŋ to.
16Fo mbinyɛnsobi nɛ fo nanabiana
beeŋ ba ki bewura
fanɛ fo nananyɛnana.
Feeŋ ta bumo ŋ ki bejuŋkparpo
durnya be kaplɛkama.
17Yili kabre a yɔ meeŋ shin nɛ
fo ketre e dii nɛ ekama
e baa fur fo saŋkama mbaanaayɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 46
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka la an be ekumpogboŋ be asheŋ
1Ebɔrɛ e la anyi be
ekumpogboŋ saŋkikɛ,
nsaa sa anyi eleŋ.
Mo e wɔtɔ saŋkama a chɛ
anyi to tɔrɔ be jemanɛ.
2Amoso hale nɛ kasawule
gbuŋgbuŋ to nɛ abeegboŋ tia
n tɔr teku be kakpa chiŋgeliŋ gba,
kufu maŋ kɔ anyi.
3Hale teku bee baga to a kaa apɔpɔ
a gbuŋgbuŋ abeegboŋ a lɛ gba,
4eboŋ ko wɔtɔ nna a shile boeŋ boeŋ,
a bar kagbenefuli ashi Ebɔrɛ
be kadegboŋ cheembi
nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
wɔ kumo be basa to na so.
5Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka wɔ kadegboŋ na to so,
shɛŋ shɛŋ maa gbuŋgbuŋ kumo.
Kachipurdidi kikɛ e bee chɛ kumo to nna.
6Nɛ efuli pɔtɛana bee baga to,
nɛ kuwurjiana bee tɔr,
nɛ Ebɔrɛ ponte nɛ
kasawule ŋalga gba,
7Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
wɔ anyi kutɔ nna.
Ebɔrɛ nɛ an nananyɛn
Jeekɔb shuŋ na e la
anyi be ekumpogboŋ.
8Ba keni kusɔ nɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ wora.
E wora asheŋ gboŋgboŋi
ashi durnya to kikɛ.
9E shin nɛ kena loge durnya to.
E buri benapo be atanyembi
nɛ akpa to nseŋ chɔɔ
bumo be asɔ kuŋso kikɛ.
10E yɛ: “Wushi eyur boeŋ,
feeŋ wu fanɛ ma e la Ebɔrɛ!
Durnya to be efuliana so ebi kikɛ
malɛ beeŋ maŋkura ma.”
11Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
wɔ anyi kutɔ.
An nananyɛn Jeekɔb
be Ebɔrɛ na e la
anyi be ekumpogboŋ.

Title: NSHƐ 47
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka bee ji efuliana so kuwura be asheŋ
1Menyi efuliana na be basa
kikɛ e kpla enɔ,
nseŋ ponte kagbenefuliso
n di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.
2Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
woraso kɔ mamachi nɛ kufu nna.
Mo e la ewurgboŋ,
a ji durnya kikɛ so kuwura.
3Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ an pɔɔ
efuli kikɛ so nsaa
ji amo so eleŋ.
4Mo e lara kasawule
nɛ an nananyɛn Jeekɔb,
nɛ e bee sha ga na
bee puchi so na, n sa anyi.
5Kagbenefuli be awɔr be kecha,
nɛ mbel be kefoŋ be awɔr to
nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla so n dii n yɔ
mbe kuwurputi so
ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.
6Men boŋ nshɛ n di
an be ewura Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.
7Ŋkpal manɛ so mo, e la
durnya kikɛ be ewura nna.
Amoso men boŋ nshɛ
n di mo epaŋ.
8Ebɔrɛ tase mbe kuwurputi
cheembi so nna a ji
durnya kikɛ so kuwura.
9Durnya be bejuŋkparpo kikɛ
ba abar so nna m ba ki
an nananyɛn Eebraham
be Ebɔrɛ na be basa.
Durnya to be bewura kikɛ
la Ebɔrɛ peya nna.
Kemaŋkura e baa la
Ebɔrɛ na peya.

Title: NSHƐ 48
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shi
nseŋ daga an ka fur mo ga
ashi kadegboŋ nɛ e wɔ kumo to
nɛ k tase mbe kebeegboŋ cheembi
nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so na.
2Mbe kebeegboŋ cheembi na
du jeŋgreŋ nna nsaa walɛ.
Nɛ Ebɔrɛ Ewurgboŋ
nɛ e wɔ kumo so na
bee sa durnya to
be basa kikɛ kagbenefuli.
3Ebɔrɛ na e wɔ kumo so
a kuŋ kumo.
E shin nɛ basa pin fanɛ,
mo Ebɔrɛ na e la
kadegboŋ na be ekumpo.
4Bewura chala abar m ba
nɛ b ba kɔ kadegboŋ na kena,
5ama b ka wu kumo
nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ga
nɛ b shile.
6Kechichachicha nɛ ebesa
daŋ tɔr bumo so nna fanɛ
eche ka bee shin nɛ e kurge na.
7Ŋko fanɛ afugboŋ ka koso teku so
a kpata nchu so be kuloŋgboŋ
a yɔ a ba na.
8An daŋ nu kusɔ nɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora,
ama naniere an wu kumo ashi
Enyɛnpetale anyi be Ebɔrɛ na
be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre
Jerusalɛm na to.
Mo alɛ beeŋ baa
kuŋ kumo saŋkama.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, saŋkama nɛ
an yɔ fo bɔrɛlambu na to,
fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
be asheŋ bee ba anyi
be nfɛra to nna.
10Fo asheŋ woraso
niŋi saŋkama nna,
nɛ fo ketre dii nɛ basa bee fur fo
ashi durnya ere be kaplɛkama.
11Amoso Jerusalɛm nɛ Juda
be ndeana to ebi be ŋgbene
fuli bumo nna ŋkpal fo kaa
bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo
be ekpa so so.
12Ebɔrɛ be basa,
men nite ŋ kulti Jerusalɛm
ŋ karga kumo be atempreŋ jeŋgreŋ.
13Men keni kumo be egbal lempo
nɛ kumo be ekuŋkpa lempoana na.
Saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ
men be kaman to ebi le:
14“Ebɔrɛ ere e la anyi
be Ebɔrɛ mbaanaayɔ.
Mo alɛ beeŋ baa juŋkpar
anyi saŋkama.”

Title: NSHƐ 49
Content:
Sa maŋ ta fo egbɛ ŋ deŋi amansherbi so
1Esa kama nɛ e wɔ durnya to,
e kaŋ kusoe n nu kusɔ
nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere.
2Kanaŋkama nɛ fo du,
nɛ fo la etirpo
ŋko damawura nna,
fo kaŋ kusoe n nu.
3Kanyiasheŋ be mmalga
nɛ mee malga,
nɛ kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ
malɛ kɔ kifito.
4Aŋasa nɛ mee shin nɛ m bɔ,
ama meeŋ ŋini amo be afito
saŋɛ nɛ mee laŋ jaŋjilaŋ na.
5Saŋɛ nɛ kenishipere tu ma,
ŋko saŋɛ nɛ bedoŋ fɛpo
kulti ma n wɔtɔ na,
m maaŋ baa lɔ kufu.
6Bumo ere yirda asɔ nɛ b kɔ nna
nsaa puchi ŋkpal bumo
be kedamaya so.
7Esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ka dimɛdi kukɔ
n sɔ mo barkasa n yige,
ŋko ŋ ka Ebɔrɛ kukɔ n wora loŋ.
8Ŋkpal manɛ so,
ŋkpa be yawu du kpakpa ga.
Esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ka Ebɔrɛ
kumo be kukɔ,
9nseŋ nya a wɔ ŋkpa to
mbaanaayɔ;
ŋko nɛ e maaŋ wu kikɛ.
10Anyee wu benyiashempo
nɛ bewulpo kikɛ ka bee wu;
nɛ basa pɔtɛ e ta bumo be asɔ.
11Hale b daa kɔ bumo gbagba
be nsawule gba,
nchaŋ e naŋ ki bumo pe
mbaanaayɔ, nɛ b baa
wɔ ndoŋ saŋkama.
12Anyi edimɛdi be eyilikpa
maa chɛr nsaa loge nɛ an wu,
fanɛ kananɛ kusɔbɔya bee wu na.
13Kusɔ nɛ k dese a jo bekama
nɛ b yirda bumo gbagba be amu
nɛ kusɔ nɛ bumo be beyaasepo
bee kaŋɛ bumo na nna na.
14B du fanɛ mbolpɔ nna
nɛ luwu bee kpa bumo
a yɔ bumo be nchaŋ to.
Ebɔrɛ be basa e naŋ ji
bumo so kuwura chipurso
nɛ bumo be eyurana
e baa dese nchaŋ to a bɛ.
15Ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mɔlga ma ere
ashi nchaŋ to n ta ma
n yɔ mo kutɔ.
16Saŋ maŋ shin nɛ beko
be kebaala damawuraana,
a ji bumo be amu na e tir fo.
17K maaŋ chɛr nɛ b wu
nseŋ yige bumo be asɔ na kikɛ.
18Nɛ dimɛdi baa kɔ ŋkpa,
nɛ asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ a sa mo
nɛ basa bee fur mo,
k bee wora mo ebel nna.
19Ama an kikɛ beeŋ ya tu
an nananyɛnana,
nsaa maaŋ naŋ wu
karechɛ be kefulto kikɛ.
20Dimɛdi be eyilikpa
kikɛ beeŋ choŋ,
nɛ e wu fanɛ kusɔbɔya na.

Title: NSHƐ 50
Content:
Kashenteŋ be kabɔrɛbunyaŋ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, elempo na,
bee tre durnya to be basa kikɛ
nɛ b wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa nɛ
epeŋilarkpa na nna fanɛ b shɛr.
2Ebɔrɛ wɔ kadegboŋ nɛ k walɛ ga,
nɛ baa tre kumo Jerusalɛm na to
a kpa edɛ pɛlpɛl nna.
3Anyi be Ebɔrɛ na bee ba,
nɛ an nu mbe egbri,
nɛ edɛ be adondulombi
juŋkpar mo,
nɛ afugboŋ lempo kulti
mo n wɔtɔ.
4E tre esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ
fanɛ eshɛdajipo nna,
nɛ b keni kananɛ e bee ji
mbe basa demu.
5E yɛ: “Men tre ma basa nɛ
baa ji kashenteŋ a sa ma
nsaa lara sarga a sa ma na,
nɛ ma nɛ bumo e wora
kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre.”
6Esoso bee ŋini anyi nna fanɛ
Ebɔrɛ bee ji basa be asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so nna.
7Ma basa, men nu.
Israɛlebi, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na
bee ji demu nna a gbiti menyi.
8M maŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ men
wora n jija nna;
ŋkpal men ka bee lara
esarga chɔɔso nɛ ŋkɛ
a sa ma saŋkama na so.
9Mannɛ men be egbolu
nɛ mboe nɛ a shibi a wɔ
men be aluu to
nɛ mee sha.
10Ŋkpal manɛ so,
kupuŋ to be kusɔbɔya kikɛ
la meya nna,
aloŋ e la ana nɛ a wɔ abee
kagboŋ so na gba.
11N nyi mbuibi nɛ a wɔ
abeegboŋ so kikɛ,
nɛ kusɔ toso kikɛ la meya.
12Nɛ akoŋ kɔ ma gba
m maaŋ kaŋɛ menyi,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
durnya nɛ kusɔ kama
nɛ k wɔ kumo to kikɛ
la meya nna.
13M maa we egbolu be eblaŋ
ŋko a nuu mboe be ŋklaŋ.
14Ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.
Kechɔrɔ, nɛ k baa nase nnɔ
nsaa bɛ amo so be esarga
nɛ mee sha.
15Men shu n tre ma
ashi men be etɔrɔ to
nɛ n mɔlga menyi,
nɛ men bunyaŋ ma.
16Ama mee kaŋɛ alubiworapo bre
nna fanɛ, e maŋ kɔ ekpa
nɛ e malga ma mbra na be asheŋ
ŋko n ji ma kɔnɔ naseso
be ŋkre na be asheŋ.
17Men kini ma keŋini
nsaa kplaŋ ma mbra so.
18Beyu nɛ basa lubi nɛ
menyee ji keteri nsaa
sha basa nɛ b maa bɛ
bumo be kakil to
be nnɔ naseso so.
19Asheŋ lubi be kewora
nawule be bare nɛ menyee bir;
men be mmalga malɛ kikɛ la efɛ nna.
20Men tase nna a kuli
men kurgepoana nsaa jija
men niopibiana gbagba be atre.
21Men ka wora ade kikɛ,
m maŋ bugi kɔnɔ,
nɛ men fɛ fanɛ ma Ebɔrɛ
gba du fanɛ menyi nna.
Ama naniere bre meeŋ malga
ŋ gbiti menyi ashi men be anishito.
22Men kplaŋ ma so,
amoso men kaŋ kusoe n nu nfe,
nɛ mannɛ aloŋ meeŋ mur menyi
nɛ esa kama maaŋ chɛ menyi to.
23Sarga nɛ k bee bar ma kemaŋkura
e la kagbene nɛ k bee ji a chɔrɔ.
Men wora ma kasonu
nɛ ma, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na
e ŋini menyi kumɔlga be ekpa.

Title: NSHƐ 51
Content:
Alubi be ketampaŋ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu ma kuwɔr
ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na so.
Kpra ma alubi
ŋkpal fo kuwɔrwu na so.
2Fɔr ma alubi nɛ ma kewora
n da so kikɛ nɛ n nyalɛ so.
3Ŋkpal manɛ so, n nyi ma alubi
kikɛ be asheŋ.
Ma alɛ maaŋ teŋ asheŋ lubi
nɛ n wora na so kikɛ.
4Kashenteŋto, fo nɛ n wora n da so.
N wora n jija ŋkpal ŋ ka kini
kewora fo kasonu so.
Amoso k daga nna nsaa walɛ
fanɛ fo gberge ma kusoe
n niŋi ma ekpa.
5Kachɛ nɛ b kurge ma na kikɛ
nɛ n la alubiworapo.
6Kashenteŋ nawule nɛ
fo ere bee sha.
Amoso ŋini ma kashenteŋ
be kanyiasheŋ.
7Ta hisɔp n fɔr ma so
nɛ n nyalɛ so
n fuli fanɛ ateebi.
8Shin nɛ ma kagbene e fuli
nɛ n ji eyur.
Fo daŋ shin nɛ ma eyur
buri ma nna
ama naniere, shin nɛ
n ji ma kumu.
9Kplaŋ ma alubi so
nseŋ da m buu ma
kewora n da so so.
10Shin nɛ n nya nfɛra niŋiso
nseŋ shin nɛ n naa ji kashenteŋ.
11Sa maŋ ju ma ashi fo anishito.
Ŋko n lara fo kiyoyu cheembi na
ashi ma to.
12Shin nɛ ma kagbene e naŋ
fuli ma fanɛ kananɛ k daa du
saŋɛ so nɛ fo mɔlga ma na;
nseŋ shin nɛ n naa sha
kebaawora fo kasonu.
13Nɛ n ŋini alubiworapoana
fo mbra nɛ b bɛta m ba fo kutɔ.
14Mɔlga ma ashi kamɔ be kulubi to.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo nawule
e naŋ tiŋ m mɔlga ma.
Saŋɛ na so meeŋ boŋ
kashɛ awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ
fo kumɔlga be eleŋ na be asheŋ.
15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
bugi ma kɔnɔ nɛ n fur fo.
16Esarga nɛ etoto daa bɔlɔ fo
kenishi nna,
n daa beeŋ bar fo amo.
17Esa be kagbene be kejija mo ga
ŋkpal alubi so e naa bɔlɔ fo kenishi.
18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jande,
shin nɛ asheŋ e nyalɛ Zayɔn to,
nɛ b pɔr Jerusalɛm be egbal na.
19Saŋɛ na so baaŋ lara esarga cheembi
nɛ esarga chɔɔso nɛ a bee par fo,
nseŋ ta egbolu n lara sarga n sa fo.

Title: NSHƐ 52
Content:
Kusɔ kama ka wɔ Ebɔrɛ be enɔ to be asheŋ
1Feeŋ tiŋ a la elempo
nsaa ji njɔŋ ŋkpal fo alubi so.
Ama esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda
Ebɔrɛ saŋkama.
2Asheŋ lubi nɛ fee kre saŋkikɛ;
fo kudonduloŋ fɛpo na
bee ji fanɛ bɔrfɔ nna.
3Fee sha asheŋ lubi a chɔ asheŋ lela;
nsaa sha efɛ a chɔ kashenteŋ be keji.
4Asheŋ besaso nɛ fee sha kebaamalga,
nɛ kafule bɔlɔ fo kudonduloŋ to.
5Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ
jija fo mbaanaayɔ;
E beeŋ to m pɛ fo to
ŋ gberge fo n lar fo laŋ to.
E beeŋ tia fo ashi basa keniso
be kasawule so.
6Nɛ basa cheembi e wu loŋ be
kusɔ nɛ k bee keta kufu ere
nseŋ mushe ŋ kaŋɛ le:
7“Men keni basa nɛ b kini
keta bumo be yirda n deŋi Ebɔrɛ so,
nseŋ ta bumo be yirda n deŋi
bumo be kedamaya nɛ asheŋ lubi
be kewora so na.”
8Ama ma ere du fanɛ ɔlif be kedibi nna,
a daŋ nsaa walɛ saŋkama
ashi Ebɔrɛ be laŋ to.
Ma alɛ be yirda deŋ mbe kasha
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na so saŋkikɛ nna.
9Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fo wora so
meeŋ baa fur fo saŋkikɛ.
Ŋ kɔ tama ashi fo ketre to,
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo ketre walɛ.
Amoso meeŋ baa fur fo
ashi fo basa cheembi be anishito.

Title: NSHƐ 53
Content:
Esa kikɛ ka maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kplaŋ Ebɔrɛ so be asheŋ
1Ewulpo nawule e naa kaŋɛ
mbe kagbene to fanɛ
Ebɔrɛ maŋ wɔtɔ.
Loŋ be basa la basa fuloŋ,
nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr nna.
Bumo alɛ maa wora
asheŋ niŋiso kikɛ.
2Ebɔrɛ wɔ esoso nna a keni kaseto
a fin enyiashempo
nɛ e bee fin mo ere Ebɔrɛ!
3Ama esa kama maa
wora asheŋ niŋiso.
Ekama maa wora asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so.
Esa koŋwule gba maŋ
wɔtɔ a wora alela.
4Menyi alubiworapoana
maaŋ koya a?
Menyi nɛ men maa kule Ebɔrɛ
nsaa wɔtɔ a kpɛa ma basa to
fanɛ b ka bee we bodobodo na.
5Kufu beeŋ pɛ menyi a chɔ
kananɛ k daŋ pɛ menyi dra na.
Ebɔrɛ beeŋ farnyaŋ
mo doŋana be awibi to
nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ menyi
ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka kini menyi so.
6Mee jo saŋɛ nɛ esa
ko beeŋ shi Zayɔn
m ba mɔlga Israɛl nna.
Anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
fo baŋ naŋ nɛfa fo basa,
Jeekɔb be kanaŋ to ebi
be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo,
nɛ Israɛlebi e ji eyur.

Title: NSHƐ 54
Content:
Keyirda Ebɔrɛ ashi awurfoŋ to be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ta fo eleŋ na m mɔlga ma,
ŋ ŋini fanɛ m maŋ wora n jija.
2O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande, nu ma kekule;
jande nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ.
3Befɔ nɛ b la amukpakpasowuraana
e naa kɔ ma.
Bumo alɛ be ekama be shɛŋ
maŋ wɔ fo to.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fo e naŋ
chɛ ma to, ŋ kuŋ ma
nɛ n sa maŋ tɔr.
5Feeŋ gberge ma doŋana kusoe,
ŋkpal bumo be alubi nɛ b wora so.
Feeŋ mur bumo
ŋkpal fo kashenteŋji so.
6Meeŋ ber kagbene
n lara sarga n sa fo.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ fur fo ketre,
ŋkpal fo ka walɛ so.
7Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo mɔlga ma
ashi ma awurfoŋ kikɛ to,
nseŋ shin nɛ ŋ gbagba wu
ma doŋana ka kɔ n tɔr.

Title: NSHƐ 55
Content:
Esa nɛ b lar mo kaman be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma kekule.
Jande, sa maŋ kplaŋ kusɔ nɛ
mee bishi fo ere so.
2Wora ania n nu ma kekule ere;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma kagbene jija nna ga;
3ŋkpal bedoŋ ka bee cha awɔr
nsaa ponte to a kɔ ma agboso so.
4Ma kagbene bee to nna pep pep pep,
nɛ mee lɔ kufu fanɛ meeŋ wu.
5Kufu gboŋgboŋi nɛ kechicha chicha
tɔr ma so nna nɛ ma kagbene
maŋ dese ma kuraa.
6N daa kɔ atɛ fanɛ keli nna,
n daa beeŋ firgi n yɔ
kakpa nɛ meeŋ nya
kagbenewushi.
7N daa beeŋ ya kaa wɔ
keshishɛrsawule so kufɔ kufɔ.
8N daa beeŋ nya manaŋ n yɔ
kakpa nɛ meeŋ nya kekuŋ
ashi afugboŋ nɛ atiligboŋ so.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ ma doŋana e wulto to.
Jija bumo be ŋkre kikɛ.
Kumukpakpaso nɛ kebaamaashu
basa so nawule nɛ mee wu,
ashi kadegboŋ na to.
10B du nna fanɛ bekumpo
ka kulti kumo be egbal n wɔtɔ
kapa nɛ kanyɛ na.
Asheŋ lubi nɛ tɔrɔ e bɔlɔ
kadegboŋ na to.
11Durmu be keji nɛ kebaada
asheŋ a wea abar to
nɛ efɛ e sɔ kadegboŋ na
be agbembi so kikɛ.
12Nɛ bedoŋ e daa tege ma
nsaa wora ma eyurto,
n daa beeŋ tiŋ n nyiti
ŋko n shile ŋ ŋana bumo so.
13Ama nteri kpakpaso
nɛ n yirda,
14nɛ ma nɛ mo bee ji kakurge,
nsaa tu m braana a yɔ
anyi be Ebɔrɛ be lambu to na
e naa wora ma loŋ.
15Alubi e naa ji bekama
nɛ b kishi ma na so eleŋ.
Amoso shin nɛ luwu e purgi bumo
nɛ b yɔ nchaŋ to nɛ b kraa keni.
16Ama n shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e mɔlga ma.
17Chipurso nɛ kapaso
nɛ kanyɛso kikɛ,
e bee nu ma nfubel nna.
18Bedoŋ bee kɔ ma
kaba kama so nna;
ama e beeŋ mɔlga ma
ashi kena na to
nɛ m maaŋ nya doro kikɛ.
19Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee ji kuwura
saŋkama mbaanaayɔ na
beeŋ nu ma kushu.
E beeŋ shin nɛ m pɔɔ bedoŋ so
ŋkpal manɛ so, b maa bunyaŋ mo.
20N teri pal kaman n sa
mbe kɔnɔ naseso
nsaa kɔ ma.
21Mbe kamalga wɔ ebel nna
fanɛ mushoŋ;
ama kekishi e bɔlɔ mbe
kagbene to nɛ e wora shiriya
nɛ e ta tokobi ŋ kɔ ma.
22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, an la fo basa nna
nsaa kaŋɛ fo asheŋ nɛ a tir anyi.
Fo alɛ maaŋ shin nɛ an kɔ n tɔr.
23Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta
basa nɛ b maa shu basa so na bre
n lɛ kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na to,
pɔɛŋ nɛ bumo be saŋɛ e fo.
Ma ere yirda fo nna.

Title: NSHƐ 56
Content:
Yirda be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1O, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu ma kuwɔr.
Bedoŋ ju a buu ma so
kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna.
Saŋɛ kikɛ baa firgi
a taga ma to nna.
2Bumo be bedamta
baa yuu ma so nna,
a kɔ ma kamoowuso.
3Ama hale kufu kɔ ma gba
ŋ kraa beeŋ yirda fo.
4Meeŋ fur fo ŋkpal fo
kɔnɔ naseso so.
N yirda fo,
amoso kufu maŋ kɔ ma.
Manɛ nɛ dimɛdi beeŋ tiŋ
n wora ma?
5Karechɛ kikɛ bedoŋ bee
wu ma kulubi nna.
Bumo be nfɛra e baa la
kananɛ baaŋ wora n doro ma.
6Baa ŋana a pugi nna a kɔ ma.
Baa dara keya kama nɛ n tia nna,
a fin kananɛ baa nya ma m mɔ.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
sa maŋ shin nɛ b ta
bumo be amu n ji kikɛ.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo baaŋ nya agbo,
fee mur efuliana na nna.
8Awurfoŋ nɛ mee ji kikɛ
be asheŋ bɔɔ fo enɔ nna,
nɛ fo nyi ma anishichubi
nɛ a lar be asheŋ.
Amo kikɛ maŋ belaŋ fo so.
9Saŋkama nɛ m baŋ kule fo
ndoŋana bee bɛta kaman nna.
Kumo be loŋ e shin nɛ m pin
fanɛ fo wɔ ma kutɔ.
10Meeŋ fur fo ŋkpal fo
kɔnɔ naseso be mmalga na so.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ n yirda fo,
amoso kufu maŋ kɔ ma.
Manɛ nɛ dimɛdi beeŋ
tiŋ n wora ma?
12Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ bɛ
kɔnɔ nɛ n nase n sa fo na so.
Meeŋ ta ma kechɔrɔ
be kakɛ m bar fo.
13Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo mɔlga ma ashi luwu to,
a maŋ shin nɛ n fiti n tɔr.
Amoso meeŋ baa wora fo
aparsheŋ nsaa na fo kefulto
nɛ k bee yɛra esa ŋkpa to na to.

Title: NSHƐ 57
Content:
Kedi Ebɔrɛ epaŋ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande wu ma kuwɔr.
Wu ma kuwɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so
fo kutɔ nɛ mee nya kekuŋ.
Fo aba to nɛ mee shile a ŋana
nɛ kenishipere e choŋ
pɔɛŋ nɛ n lar.
2Fo Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ
nɛ fo la ma ekumpo na
nɛ mee shu a tre.
3Feeŋ shin nɛ kechɛto
e shi ebɔrɛso
m ba sɔ ma n yige.
Nseŋ shin nɛ tɔrɔ
e tɔr bumo nɛ baa kɔ ma
kenishipereso na bre so.
Fo la eshinteŋjipo nɛ esa
beeŋ tiŋ n yirda nna.
4N wɔ bedoŋ nɛ b du fanɛ ebuluŋ,
nɛ baa kpɛa basa to na to nna.
Bumo be anyii du fanɛ
atanyembi nɛ akpa nna.
Nɛ bumo be adonduloŋ
bee ji fanɛ etokobi.
5Shin nɛ basa e wu fo aworbigboŋ
ashi awɔlpa to,
nɛ fo kemaŋkuragboŋ
ashi kasawule so kikɛ.
6Bedoŋ bee fe ma ajigbelɛ nna
a da ma a lɛ.
Baa kur amaŋ chiŋgeliŋ
ma ekpa to nna, nsaa kilgi
a tɔr amo to bumo gbagba.
7Mee ji kashenteŋ nna a sa fo,
nɛ feeŋ tiŋ n yirda ma.
Meeŋ boŋ kashɛ nseŋ laŋ alaŋsɔ
n sa fo ma, Ebɔrɛ na.
8Edi maŋ wɔ ma anishi to,
meeŋ laŋ ma jaŋjilaŋ
hale nɛ kare e ya chɛ.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ fur fo
nɛ ekama e nu.
Nseŋ boŋ kabɔrɛshuŋ be nshɛ
ashi basa kikɛ be anishito.
10Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo kasha baŋ esoso so,
nɛ fo kemankura
choŋ awɔlpa so.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ
fo keshi e choŋ so esoso so
nɛ fo kemankura e baa wɔ
durnya be kaplɛkama.

Title: NSHƐ 58
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ nɛ e gberge bedoŋ kusoe be asheŋ
1Menyi bejuŋkparpo, bee ji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so a?
Menyee ji basa be asheŋ
kananɛ k daga so a?
2M-m, asheŋ lubi nawule be asheŋ
nɛ menyee kre ashi men be ŋgbene to,
nsaa ta men be enɔana a mɔ basa.
3Yili men be kakurgeachɛ kikɛ
m ba fo mbre, men wɔtɔ nna
a wora alubi nsaa ku efɛ.
4Men be mmalga du fanɛ kuwɔ
ka duŋ esa nna,
5nɛ e kini kenu esa nɛ e kɔ awɔ
be kudur be ebɔl nna.
6Mee ŋana bedoŋ nna fanɛ ebuluŋ na.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, buri bumo anyii
nɛ a du fanɛ ebuluŋ be anyii na.
7Shin nɛ b foe fanɛ kabombi to
be nchu ka wɔlto na.
B baŋ gberge bumo be ata to,
fo shin nɛ atanyembi na
be nnɔ e gbel.
8Shin nɛ b wɔlso fanɛ konte
nseŋ shin nɛ b sa maŋ wu epeŋi
fanɛ kebia nɛ e laŋɛ.
9Pɔɛŋ nɛ kapuliya nɛ k bɛ edɛ
wuloŋwuloŋ so beeŋ bel edɛ,
nɛ fo teŋ m mur bumo.
10Nɛ belelaworapo baŋ wu
alubiworapoana ka nya
bumo be alubi be kasogberge,
bumo be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo
nɛ b fɔr bumo be aya ashi
bumo doŋana na be ŋklaŋ to.
11Nɛ basa e kaŋɛ:
“Kashenteŋ, basa cheembi kraa
nya bumo be kakɔka.
Kashenteŋ, Ebɔrɛ kraa ji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so ashi durnya to.”

Title: NSHƐ 59
Content:
Kekuŋ be kabɔrɛkule
1Mɔlga ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
kuŋ ma ashi bedoŋ nɛ baa kɔ
ma na kutɔ.
2Kuŋ ma ashi kumukpakpasowuraana
nɛ baa fin ma nɛ b mɔ na kutɔ.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni kananɛ
b ŋana m pugi a jo ma.
Basa lubi bee kre ma
ŋkre lubi nna,
a fin ma nɛ b mɔ.
Ma alɛ maŋ wora bumo shɛŋ,
ŋko n wora kulubi ko
n da bumo so.
4M maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ,
ama b wora shiriya nɛ b kɔ ma.
Keni ma awurfoŋ nɛ mee ji ere so
nseŋ wora kusɔ ko n chɛ ma to.
5Enyɛnpetale Israɛlebi be Ebɔrɛ,
niŋi to ŋ gberge efuli pɔtɛana na
be basa kikɛ kusoe.
Sa maŋ wu basa lubi,
nɛ baa mɔ basa na kuwɔr.
6Baa bɛta a ba kaaseso kikɛ nna
m ba kaa na kade to
a gbu fanɛ njɔnɔ na.
7Nu mmalga nɛ a bee lar
bumo be nnɔ to.
Asɔ nɛ baa kaŋɛ bee besa nna
fanɛ b ka da esa kasaŋɛ na.
Baa kaŋɛ bumo be amu nna
fanɛ esa kama maa
nu kusɔ nɛ baa kaŋɛ na.
8Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bre bee mushe bumo nna,
nsaa wora efuliana na eyurto.
9Fo e la ma ekumpogboŋ
nɛ ma tama deŋ fo so.
10Ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sha ma na
beeŋ chɛ ma to,
n shin nɛ n wu bedoŋ ka kɔ n tɔr.
11Ama sa maŋ mɔ bumo.
Mannɛ aloŋ ekama beeŋ teŋ so.
Ta fo eleŋgboŋ na
n shin nɛ b chicha n tɔr.
Fo e la kusɔ kuŋsogboŋ
a kuŋ fo basa.
12Bedoŋ na la befɛpo nna,
amoso shin nɛ bumo
be njɔŋ fuloŋ nɛ baa ji na
e kilgi m pɛ bumo.
13Nya agbo m mur bumo cheche.
Saŋɛ na so efuli pɔtɛana na
kikɛ beeŋ pin fanɛ fo e naa
ji Israɛl so kuwura.
14Baa bɛta a ba kaaseso kikɛ nna,
m ba kaa na kade to
a gbu fanɛ njɔnɔ na.
15Baa nite nna a gbu
a yɛla kenishi to a fin ajibi,
ama b baŋ moɛ nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ yɔ.
16Ama ma ere beeŋ boŋ kasha
a laŋɛ fo Ebɔrɛ be
eleŋgboŋ na be kaplɛa so.
Chipurso kikɛ, meeŋ boŋ kashɛ
a laŋɛ fo kasha be kaplɛa so.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo e la ma ekumpo,
kakpa nɛ mee shile a ŋana
ashi tɔrɔ be jemanɛ.
17Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ n fur fo.
Fo e la ma ekumpogboŋ
nsaa sha ma.

Title: NSHƐ 60
Content:
Tama be keta n deŋi Ebɔrɛ so be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nya agbo nna
n wɔtɔ anyi nseŋ kini anyi,
n shin nɛ an tɔr m buri to.
Naniere naaŋ sa anyi eleŋ.
2Fo shin nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to
m baŋɛ to m bugi to.
Naniere shin nɛ kasawule na
e cha abar so nseŋ yige
kebaa gbuŋgbuŋ to.
3Fo shin nɛ saŋɛ kpakpaso
tu fo basa, nɛ afu bee ber
anyi nɛ anyee lente.
4Ama fo sa basa
nɛ baa ŋana fo bre tɔɔnɛ
nɛ b bɔla kumo so ŋ gelge
bedoŋ be atanyembi.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nu anyi be kekule
nseŋ ta fo enɔ lempo na
m mɔlga anyi nɛ an la
fo basa shaso na.
6An Nyɛnpe nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
fo nase kɔnɔ fanɛ feeŋ barga
kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre
Shɛkim na to,
nseŋ chige ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre
Sukɔf na to.
7Fo yɛ Giliad nɛ Manase la feya nna,
nɛ Efrayim la fo kebɛlso be kuwuro,
nɛ Juda malɛ la fo kekpabi.
8Nɛ Mowab la fo kusɔ fɔr enɔ,
nɛ fee ta fo asɛbta malɛ
a deŋi Edɔm so,
nsaa yili Filisti malɛ so a cha
kekɔmpɔɔso be awɔr.
9Wanɛ e naaŋ yɛr ma
kadegboŋ nɛ b pɔr
egbal ŋ kulti na to?
Wanɛ e naaŋ juŋkpar ma
n yɔ Edɔm be efuli so?
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo kini anyi kashenteŋto
nsaa maaŋ naŋ juŋkpar
anyi be benapo nna a?
11Chɛ anyi to nɛ an kɔ m pɔɔ
an doŋana so, ŋkpal manɛ so,
dimɛdi bre be kechɛto maŋ la shɛŋ.
12Fo Ebɔrɛ nawule e naŋ tiŋ n
shin nɛ an kɔ m pɔɔ so,
nɛ fo fifɛa an doŋana
m mata kasawule.

Title: NSHƐ 61
Content:
Kebaa wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kekuŋ to be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande nu ma kushu
nɛ ma kabɔrɛkule!
2Ma tama kikɛ loge
nɛ n wɔ efuli wɔfɔ so
a shu a tre fo.
Juŋkpar ma n yɔ kefalta gboŋ
nɛ k du jeŋgreŋ a chɔ ma na so.
3Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e la
ma ekuŋkpa lempo,
nɛ mee shile n ya kaa ŋana to
ashi ma doŋana so.
4Enyɛnpe, ma Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ m baa wɔ fo kutɔ
mbaanaayɔ,
saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya kekuŋ
ashi fo aba to.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo nu ma kɔnɔ naseso na
nseŋ nɛfa ma fanɛ
kananɛ fo nɛfa bumo nɛ
baa bunyaŋ fo na.
6Sa fo ewura ŋkpa tenteŋ
nɛ eyur be alenfia.
7Shin nɛ e baa ji kuwura
fo anishito mbaanaayɔ
nɛ fo kasha nɛ kashenteŋji
e baa kuŋ mo.
8Saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa di fo
ketre epaŋ saŋkama
nsaa wora a bɔlɔ ma kɔnɔ
naseso so saŋkama.

Title: NSHƐ 62
Content:
Enyɛnpe na ka kɔ eleŋ nsaa wu kuwɔr be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to
nɛ ma kiyoyu bee nya ewushi.
Mo nawule e naa mɔlga ma.
2Mo e la kefaltagboŋ nɛ emɔlgapo.
Mo e la ma ekuŋkpa lempo
a kuŋ ma.
3Nchɛ afanɛ nɛ menyeeŋ ta
m bri esa?
Menyeeŋ yili egbal
nɛ k kulti ere so
n ta mo n lɛ to a?
4Menyee fin kananɛ menyee lara mo
ashi mbe kemaŋkura be eyilikpa nna.
Efɛ nawule nɛ menyee kuu.
Nɛ mmalga lela lar menyi be nnɔ to gba,
kekishi nɛ shoduu e bɔlɔ men
be ŋgbene bre to.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule
e naa sa kagbenewushi;
amoso mo so nɛ ma tama yil so.
6Mo nawule e la ma kefaltagboŋ
nɛ ma emɔlgapo.
Mo e la maa ekuŋkpagboŋ,
amoso ma lɔ kufu.
7Mo e naa mɔlga ma
nsaa sa ma kemaŋkura.
Mo e la kefaltagboŋ nɛ mee nya
kekuŋ ashi kumo so na.
8Basa, men yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nsaa kaŋɛ mo men be asheŋ
tirso saŋkama.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ na nawule
e la anyi be ekumpo.
9Anyi edimɛdi baa du fanɛ
esa ka fute afu nna.
Anyi be ekama maŋ la shɛŋ.
Anyi kikɛ be egbɛ maŋ fo
esa be efute be egbɛ so.
10Sa maŋ ta fo tama n deŋi
kapuni be asɔ so,
ŋko a wu fo kumu ŋkpal
kayu be asɔ so.
Loŋ beeŋ tiŋ n sa fo asɔ damta,
ama sa maŋ ta fo kagbene n deŋi
amo so.
11Kusɔ koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ malga,
ama asɔ anyɔ nɛ n nu.
Amo e la fanɛ,
fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ eleŋ
12nsaa kɔ kasha.
Kashenteŋto malɛ nɛ feeŋ
yili kusɔ kama nɛ esa wora so
ŋ ka mo kumo be kukɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 63
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be kasha be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe, fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ.
Mee fin fo ma kagbene
to kashenteŋto;
fanɛ kananɛ meeŋ pere kenishi
n fin nchu ketarso kpantaŋkpalaŋ
ashi keshishɛrsawule so na.
2N wu fo eleŋ nɛ fo kemaŋkura
ashi fo bɔrɛlambu to.
3Ŋkpal fo kasha ka shi
a chɔ kebaawɔtɔ so
meeŋ di fo epaŋ.
4Meeŋ di fo epaŋ saŋɛ so
nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to kikɛ;
nseŋ maŋ ma enɔana so
ashi fo ketre to.
5Meeŋ boŋ kapandi be nshɛ
kagbenefuliso;
nɛ ma eyur e saŋɛ ma to
n shin nɛ m moɛ,
fanɛ b ka wora
kejigboŋ nɛ n ji na.
6Kanyɛso nɛ m baŋ dese
gedo so mee nyiŋi fo nna,
a fɛ fo asheŋ ashi ma
edesekpa saŋkama.
7Ŋkpal fo ka la ma echɛtopo so,
meeŋ chena fo aba be kiyoyul to,
m boŋ kagbenefuli be nshɛ.
8M baa mar fo nna,
nɛ fo enɔ lempo na,
e baa kɔ ma to.
9Bekama nɛ baa fin ma ŋkpa
be kelara na,
beeŋ wu n yɔ nchaŋ to.
10Etokobi nɛ baaŋ ta m mɔ bumo,
nɛ kupuŋ to be njɔnɔ e ji bumo.
11Ama ewura na nɛ bumo nɛ
b yirda fo na bre beeŋ ji eyur,
ŋkpal fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so.
Ama befɛpo bre beeŋ
lo bumo be nnɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 64
Content:
Baa ji eyur ŋkpal Enyɛnpe na so
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nu ma nfubel,
nseŋ kuŋ ma ashi
bedoŋ be enɔ to.
2Jande, kuŋ ma ashi
kumukpakpaso wuraana
nɛ basa lubi be katuŋ na
be ŋkre nɛ baa kre ma na to.
3Bumo be atuwebi bee besa nna
fanɛ b ka ŋe esa kasaŋɛ na,
nɛ bumo be mmalga du fanɛ
b ka da esa ketanyembi na.
4Baa ŋana kupuŋ to nna,
a to basa nɛ b maŋ wora alubi,
nɛ kumo be loŋ maŋ kɔ bumo kufu.
5Baa leŋ abar to nna a wɔtɔ
alubi be kewora to,
nsaa malga kananɛ baaŋ sho
bumo be ajigbelɛ ŋ ŋana,
nsaa kaŋɛ fanɛ esa kikɛ
maaŋ wu bumo.
6Baa kre asheŋ nɛ a maŋ
niŋi be kewora nna,
a kaŋɛ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ
b kre na walɛ ga.
Kashenteŋto dimɛdi
be kagbene nɛ mbe nfɛra lubi ga.
7Ama Ebɔrɛ gbagba beeŋ to bumo
atanyembi n doro bumo.
8Bumo gbagba be mmalga
beeŋ kilgi n ji bumo,
nɛ kufu e pɛ bekama
nɛ b wu bumo,
nɛ b fifi amu n chicha.
9Kufu beeŋ pɛ basa, nɛ b ji
Ebɔrɛ be ashuŋ shuŋso
be asheŋ be shɛda,
nsaa fɛ kusɔ nɛ
e wora na be asheŋ.
10Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ
niŋiso na beeŋ ji eyur ŋkpal
kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe na wora so;
nseŋ ta bumo be amu
ŋ ŋana Enyɛnpe na to.

Title: NSHƐ 65
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka bee nu kekule be asheŋ
1Anyi be Ebɔrɛ, k daga fanɛ
an fur fo ashi Zayɔn to.
Ndoŋ nɛ anyeeŋ bɛ nnɔ nɛ
an nase n sa fo na so.
2Ekama beeŋ ba fo kutɔ
ŋkpal fo ka bee nu kekule so.
3Anyi be alubi pɔɔ anyi so,
nɛ fo ta anyi be aworandeso
m paŋ anyi.
4Fo nɛfa bekama nɛ fo lara na nna,
n shin nɛ b chena n sha fo
ashi fo bɔrɛlambu to.
Anyeeŋ ji anyi be amu
ashi fo laŋ to nɛ fo
bɔrɛlambu cheembi na to.
5An be Ebɔrɛ, fo mɔlga anyi,
nɛ fo aworbi nɛ a bee keta kufu na
shin nɛ an pin fanɛ fo nu kekule
nɛ anyee kule a fin kashenteŋji na.
Fo e naa sa durnya ere be basa kikɛ tama,
hale bumo nɛ b wɔ teku be kaba
nɛ anyi maŋ nyi na kikɛ gba.
6Fo e kɔ eleŋ nɛ yuku n ta
abeegboŋ n yili amo be eyilikpa.
7Fo e naa shin nɛ teku be awɔr bee lo.
Fo e yɔɔ nchu be atili nɛ efuliana na
be awɔr nɛ baa cha.
8Fo aworbi nɛ a bee keta kufu na
bee chinchiŋ basa nɛ b wɔ kufɔ kufɔ gba.
Durnya ere to ebi kikɛ bee boŋ nshɛ
nsaa ji eyur nna ŋkpal fo so.
9Fo e naa keni kasawule ere so
nsaa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba a wushi kumo
nɛ asɔ duuso be yiri yiri kikɛ
bee wora kumo so.
Fo eboŋana maa wɔlto kikɛ;
fo alɛ e naa shin nɛ kasawule
bee wora ajibi nɛnɛ.
10Fo e naa wurge adɔana so nchu
a shin kasawule bee wushi
a ki pɔtɔ pɔtɔ nɛ asɔ bee tiŋ a kɔr.
11Fo e naa shin nɛ adɔjibi bee wora
nɛnɛ nɛ mpuro bee bɔlɔ a wurge.
12Fo e naa shin nɛ afitiri
nɛ a wɔ keshishɛrsawule so
bee daŋ nɛnɛ;
nsaa shin nɛ abeeana bee ji eyur.
13Fo shin nɛ asɔbɔya sɔ kaplɛkama
nɛ ataŋɛ to be ajibi bee wora alegaiso;
nɛ amo kikɛ bee boŋ nshɛ awɔrso
kagbenefuliso.

Title: NSHƐ 66
Content:
Kapandi nɛ kechɔrɔ be kashɛ
1Menyi basa nɛ men wɔ
kasawule ere so kikɛ
e cha awɔr n fur Ebɔrɛ.
2Men boŋ nshɛ m maŋkura mbe
ketre nseŋ ta kapandi n fur mo.
3Men kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ fanɛ mbe
aworbi kikɛ kɔ kufu nna,
nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ na bee
shin nɛ mo doŋana bee
chicha a jɔŋɛ mo ase kufuso.
4Durnya ere to be esa kikɛ
bee bunyaŋ fo nsaa fur fo.
5Ba keni kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora;
nɛ ashuŋ nɛ a bee keta kufu
nɛ e shuŋ dimɛdi be kaplɛa so.
6Mo e shin nɛ teku wɔlto ŋ ki kasawule,
nɛ an nananyɛnana nite kumo to n dii,
nɛ an ji eyur ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora na so.
7E kɔ mbe eleŋgboŋ nna
a ji kuwura mbaanaayɔ,
nɛ efuliana na maaŋ tiŋ
n wora shɛŋ shɛŋ ŋ ŋana mo so.
Amoso, amukpakpasowuraana
maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kre kena ŋ kɔ mo.
8Basa, men kikɛ e ba nɛ an fur
anyi be Ebɔrɛ na.
Men fur mo nɛ basa e nu.
9Mo e kuŋ anyi be ŋkpa
n shin nɛ an nya a wɔtɔ.
10Anyi be Ebɔrɛ, fo wora
anyi ŋ keni,
fanɛ kananɛ baa wora
gbiti a keni na.
11Fo shin nɛ an tɔr kashewu to;
fo sulɔ anyi esulɔ gbɛgbɛso.
12Fo shin nɛ an doŋana pɔɔ anyi so
nɛ an luri edɛ nɛ nchu to,
ama fo bar anyi kasawule
nɛ k kɔ asɔ damta so.
13-14Meeŋ wora m bɛ kɔnɔ
nɛ n nase n sa fo saŋɛ so
nɛ n daa wɔ tɔrɔ to na so.
Meeŋ ba lara sarga ashi fo
bɔrɛlambu to n sa fo.
15Meeŋ ta mbolpɔ lela n lara
sarga n sa fo,
nseŋ mɔ egbolu nɛ mboe n lara
sarga chɔɔso ashi fo bɔrɛsure so.
16Menyi nɛ menyee bunyaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ e ba,
nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kusɔ kama
nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora n sa ma.
17N shu n tre Enyɛnpe na
nseŋ fur mo.
18Alubi daa wɔ ma kagbene to,
e daa maaŋ nu ma kekule.
19Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nu ma kekule nseŋ wora
kusɔ nɛ ŋ kule mo na n sa ma.
20Meeŋ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ;
ŋkpal e ka bee nu ma kekule
nsaa wora ma kelela saŋkikɛ so.

Title: NSHƐ 67
Content:
Kechɔrɔ be kashɛ
1Anyi be Ebɔrɛ, wu anyi kuwɔr,
n shin nɛ fo kagbene e fuli anyi so,
nɛ fo wora anyi kelela nseŋ nɛfa anyi;
2nɛ ekama durnya ere to
e pin fo ekpa na,
nɛ efuliana na kikɛ be basa
e wu fo kumɔlga na.
3Shin nɛ basa kikɛ e fur fo awɔrso.
4Shin nɛ efuliana na be basa
kikɛ be ŋgbene e fuli bumo,
nɛ b boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso
Ŋkpal manɛ so, fee ji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so nna
nsaa ŋini efuliana na be basa
ekpa nɛ k daga.
5Shin nɛ ekama e fur fo awɔrso.
6Anyi be Ebɔrɛ na nɛfa kasawule
n shin nɛ k wora ajibi n sa anyi.
7Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nɛfa anyi,
nɛ durnya to be basa kikɛ
e bunyaŋ mo.

Title: NSHƐ 68
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so be asheŋ
1Ebɔrɛ koso,
n shin nɛ fo doŋana
e pesaŋ to n shile.
2Shin nɛ b pesaŋ to fanɛ edishi.
Shin nɛ b ŋalga fo anishito
fanɛ kananɛ kemushoŋmar
bee ŋalga edɛ to na.
3Ama shin nɛ basa nɛ baa wora
asheŋ niŋiso na bre
be ŋgbene e fuli bumo,
nɛ b ji eyur fo anishito.
4Men boŋ nshɛ n sa Ebɔrɛ,
men boŋ nshɛ n fur mbe ketre.
Mo e dii n chena awɔlpa so,
amoso men maŋkura mo.
Mbe ketre e la Enyɛnpe na,
nɛ anyee tiŋ n ji eyur
nseŋ maŋkura mo.
5Mo e wɔ mbe kakpa cheembi,
nsaa la amunibi bumo tuto
a kuŋ bekulpoche na.
6Mo e naa ta bumo nɛ b maŋ
kɔ basa a ki kanaŋ wurana.
Mo e naa sɔ basa nɛ b ti ebu
a yige, nsaa shin nɛ asheŋ
bee nite nɛnɛ a sa bumo.
Ama e bee yɛr bumo
nɛ b kɔ asoe kpakpaso
nsaa maa nu a sa mo na bre
epeŋi kpakpaso be
kasawule so nna.
7Fo e sa fo basa kamooji,
nseŋ juŋkpar bumo
m bɔla keshishɛrsawule so,
8nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ
nɛ bɔrɛ chulgi.
Fo nawule e la Ebɔrɛ,
nsaa tase kebee nɛ baa
tre Sainai na so a ji kuwura.
9Kasawule ka wɔl nɛ fo
shin nɛ bɔrɛ ba nɛ kaboŋ wushi.
10Nɛ fo basa chena kumo so,
nɛ fo sa bumo to be bumo
nɛ b maŋ kɔ shɛŋ na kusɔ jiso.
11Fo e sa mbra na,
nɛ beche damta cha awɔr,
ŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k wora.
12Bewura, nɛ bumo be benapo
kilgi n shile, nɛ b chige asɔ
nɛ b shile ŋ ka na to n sa abar.
13Abɛlso be ali nɛ b ta gbiti
m mata amo be aba so
nseŋ ta shuwa nɛ a bee kpa edɛ
n wora amo be atɛ
e ki basa nɛ b shir kaman a keni
mbolpɔ so na peya.
14Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ
efuli na so be bewura pesaŋ to,
fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛjembubi bee tɔr
kebee nɛ baa tre Zalmɔn na so
a pesaŋ to na.
15Bashan be kebeegboŋ na shi nna
nseŋ lar n lar ayabi.
16Kebeegboŋ, manɛ nna nɛ fee besa
Zayɔn be kebeegboŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe na
lara fanɛ mbe echenakpa nsaa
wɔ kumo so saŋkama na eyur?
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, egbaŋɛturko lempo
ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto nɛ fo ta n shi Sainai
be kebeegboŋ na so m ba fo
lambu cheembi na to.
18Fo keta basa nɛ b ti ebu nna
n dii n yɔ kebeegboŋ na be esoso.
Ndoŋ nɛ basa ya kɛ fo asɔ.
Fo doŋana nɛ b daa maa sha fanɛ fo
baa wɔ ndoŋ gba sa fo ŋkɛ.
19Anyee fur fo Enyɛnpe
nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ
fee mɔlga anyi nsaa wora
anyi kelela karechɛ kikɛ na.
20Saŋkikɛ fee kuŋ anyi nna,
nsaa mɔlga anyi ashi luwu to.
21Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bure
mo doŋana be amu to;
bumo nɛ b kini kelar bumo be
alubi to na be amu.
22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ,
e beeŋ lara bumo ashi
Bashan be kebeegboŋ na so
nɛ teku chiŋgeliŋ to m ba.
23Saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ chichi
bumo be ŋklaŋ to nɛ an be njɔnɔ
malɛ e bure bumo be awibi to.
24An Nyɛnpe nɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
an wu basa damta ka bɛ
abar so a yɔ fo bɔrɛlambu to.
25Beshɛbompo e juŋkpar
nɛ bumo nɛ baa laŋ alaŋsɔ bɛso
nɛ besuŋgurbi bee laŋ
echakachaka a chaŋ bumo.
26Le nɛ baa ponte a kaŋɛ:
“Men fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ashi
mbe basa Israɛlebi be nshɛr to.”
27Bɛnjamin be yiri to ebi
nɛ b maŋ shi na e juŋkpar
n ta Juda be yiri to
be benimu m bɛso.
Nɛ Zɛbyulɔn nɛ Naftali
malɛ bɛ benimu bɛso.
28Anyi be Ebɔrɛ, ŋini fo eleŋ;
naaŋ ŋini anyi fo eleŋ na.
29Nɛ bewura e ta ŋkɛ m ba
fo bɔrɛlambu to ashi Jerusalɛm.
30Gberge kusɔbɔya nɛ k wɔ
ketaŋɛ to na kusoe.
Gberge efuliana na be basa
nɛ bumo be bejuŋkparpo
du fanɛ apuntona na kusoe,
n shin nɛ b ta gbiti be ŋkɛ
ŋ gbeye amuli so m ba.
Shin nɛ efuliana nɛ amo be basa
bee sha kebaa ku kena na e pesaŋ to.
31Shin nɛ basa nɛ efuliana na
bee yɛr efuli pɔtɛ so nɛ b ya yili amo
be katelamu to a fin kɔnɔkoŋwule na
e shi Ijipt be efuli so m ba.
Nseŋ shin nɛ Itiopiaebi e ba bunyaŋ
fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
32Men boŋ nshɛ n fur Ebɔrɛ.
Durnya to be efuli kikɛ so ebi
e boŋ nshɛ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
33Men fur emo nɛ e yili
dra na kikɛ a dii awɔlpa na.
Men kaŋ kusoe n nu mbe ebɔl
nɛ k bee gbri fanɛ bɔrɛ
ka bee ponte na.
34Men kaŋɛ basa Ebɔrɛ be
eleŋgboŋ na be asheŋ.
Mbe kemaŋkura e buu Israɛl so
nɛ e wɔ awɔlpa to a ji kuwura na.
35O, Ebɔrɛ, fo asheŋ woraso bee
keta kufu ashi fo bɔrɛlambu to nna,
nɛ fee sa fo basa eleŋ nɛ yuku.
Men shin nɛ an fur anyi be Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 69
Content:
Esa ka beeŋ tiŋ n yirda Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga ma.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
nchu bɔlɔ n fo ma kubɔ
nsaa shin nɛ a mur ma.
2Mee nia depɔ to nna
nɛ ma aya maŋ naa mur efar.
N fo kakpa chiŋgeliŋ
nɛ nchu na bee muni ma so.
3N shu n tre fo hale ma eleŋ kikɛ loge,
nɛ ma ebɔl to wɔl.
N mɛrge anishi ŋ keni fo ekpa,
hale ma anishi bee kurge.
4Basa nɛ b kishi ma kenyanyaŋɛso
shibi a chɔ ma kumu so be emin.
Ebɔrɛ, bedoŋ lubi nɛ baa fin ma
nɛ b jija na shi alegaiso.
Baa tintiŋ ma nna nɛ ŋ ka
kusɔ nɛ m maŋ yuri be kukɔ.
5Fo nyi ma kawuliso be alubi kikɛ.
Amo be kukoŋwule kama
maŋ ŋana fo so.
6Enyɛnpetale Ewurgboŋ,
nɛ fee ji Israɛlebi so kuwura,
sa maŋ shin nɛ ekama
nɛ e bee bunyaŋ fo e ji
anishinyɔr ŋkpal ma so.
7Fo nawule so nɛ mee sɔ katege
nsaa ji nyɔmɔ na.
8Ŋ ki fanɛ efɔ ashi ŋ kurgepoana kutɔ nna;
nsaa du fanɛ esa nɛ e shi efuli pɔtɛ so
ashi n niopibiana to.
9Kasha nɛ ŋ kɔ n sa fo bɔrɛlambu na
bee chɔ ma to nna fanɛ edɛ,
nɛ basa baa tege fo,
k bee lɛa ma alɛ gba nna.
10Mee kishi nsaa shu;
ama b kraa tege ma.
11M buu kagbenejijaso
be asɔbuuso gba
basa bee wora ma eyurto nna.
12Bejuŋkparpo nɛ demujipoana
bee kuli ma nna,
nɛ basa nɛ baa nuu nsa a boo,
bee boŋ nshɛ a wora ma eyurto.
13Ama fo Enyɛnpe na
nɛ mee shu a tre.
Nu ma kekule saŋɛ nɛ k par fo
nseŋ yili fo kashagboŋ na so
m mɔlga ma.
14Sa maŋ shin nɛ n nia depɔ to.
Mɔlga ma ashi bedoŋ
nɛ nchu nɛ a bee shin nɛ
a mur ma na to.
15Sa maŋ shin nɛ chuful
e sulɔ ma n yɔ,
ŋko n shin nɛ teku e mur ma,
ŋko n shin nɛ luwu e ta ma m min.
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma kekule,
ŋkpal fo ka walɛ nsaa la esa so.
Chɛ ma to, ŋkpal fo
kuwɔrwu gboŋgboŋi na so.
17Saŋ maŋ pal kaman n sa fo kenya.
Jande nu ma kekule manaŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, n wɔ tɔrɔ to nna.
18Ba mɔlga ma ashi bedoŋ be enɔ to.
19Fo nyi kananɛ baa wora ma eyurto,
a tege ma nsaa wɔtɔ ma nyɔmɔ to.
Fo nyi n doŋana na be ekama.
20Ma kagbenejija ŋkpal katege so,
n shin nɛ ŋ ki elɔpo katinso.
N daa fɛ fanɛ baaŋ wu ma kuwɔr nna;
ma alɛ maŋ nya loŋ.
21Baa ta kɔrtɔ nna a wɔtɔ ma ajibi to
nsaa sa ma nsa nyaŋnyaŋso
fanɛ nchu nuuso.
22Shin nɛ bumo be ejikpa
e ki ajigbelɛ n sa bumo
nɛ bumo teriana.
23Shin nɛ tentembiri e tan bumo
nɛ b baa chicha.
24Shin nɛ b pin fo ka nya agbo ga,
nseŋ shin nɛ fo agbo e ba bumo so.
25Jija bumo be echenakpa.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ esa koŋwule gba
e ka a wɔ bumo be keeyi to.
26Ŋkpal manɛ so, baa malga nna
a gbiti basa nɛ fo gberge kusoe na;
nɛ bumo be ŋkuli bee tɔrɔ basa
nɛ fo doro na.
27Shin nɛ b ji n tɔr ekpa kama so.
Sa maŋ ta bumo be alubi
m paŋ bumo kikɛ.
28Bubɔ bumo be atre
ashi basa nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to na
be atre be kawɔl na to.
Lara bumo ashi bumo nɛ
b maŋ wora n jija to.
29B maa keta ma nɛnɛ
nɛ ebesa kɔ ma.
Ebɔrɛ kuŋ ma
nseŋ mɔlga ma.
30Meeŋ boŋ kashɛ n fur
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nseŋ chɔrɔ mo
ma kagbene to.
31Kumo be loŋ beeŋ par
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na a chɔ
keta gbolu fɛlso ŋko
gbolu danso n lara sarga
n sa mo.
32Betirpo beeŋ wu kumo be loŋ
nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e fuli bumo.
Saŋɛ na so basa nɛ baa bunyaŋ
Enyɛnpe na beeŋ nya keleŋto.
33Bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ epe baŋ shu
n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e beeŋ nu. Mo alɛ maaŋ teŋ mbe
basa nɛ b wɔ kabuti to na so.
34Esoso nɛ kasawule nɛ teku
nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ amo to kikɛ
beeŋ fur anyi be Ebɔrɛ na.
35Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sɔ Jerusalɛm n yige
nseŋ lɔŋɛ m pɔr Juda be ndeana,
nɛ mbe basa e baa wɔ amo to
ashi bumo gbagba be kasawule so.
36Kasawule na beeŋ ki bumo
be mbia be kapetɛ kachako.
Nɛ esa kama nɛ e bee sha Ebɔrɛ
e chena kumo so.

Title: NSHƐ 70
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka la mamachi be Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
jande, mɔlga ma.
Ba chɛ ma to manaŋ.
2Wul basa nɛ baa fin ma
nɛ b mɔ na be nfɛra to,
nseŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr
e pɛ bumo.
Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa
fin ma nɛ luwu na e sipa.
3Shin nɛ anishinyɔr nɛ nyɔmɔ
e ji bekama nɛ baa kaŋɛ ma le na:
“Men keni kananɛ e ki.”
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa
bunyaŋ fo na be ŋgbene e fuli bumo
nɛ b ji eyur.
Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa sha fo
kumɔlga na e baa kaŋɛ saŋkama
fanɛ Enyɛnpe na shibi.
5N la etirpo nɛ etentaŋasepo nna,
a maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ shɛŋ,
ama Enyɛnpe, ma asheŋ tir fo.
Fo e la ma emɔlgapo,
amoso jande, ba mɔlga ma manaŋ.

Title: NSHƐ 71
Content:
1Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nɛ m ba,
nɛ fo baa kuŋ ma.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr.
2Jande Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sɔ ma n yige;
ŋkpal fo ka la esa niŋiso so.
Nu ma kekule nseŋ
mɔlga ma manaŋ.
3Baa la ma kefaltagboŋ,
ma ekuŋkpagboŋ nɛ mee
nya kumɔlga fo kutɔ.
Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ma
kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ ma.
Amoso baa juŋkpar ma
a ŋini ma ekpa lela na,
nɛ fo ketre e nya kemaŋkura.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ba mɔlga
ma ashi kumukpakpaso wuraana
nɛ basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ ma be enɔ to.
5O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
fo e la ma tama kikɛ,
ma kebifɔlbi to kikɛ
nɛ n ta yirda n deŋi fo so.
6Ma kebiato kikɛ nɛ n ta ma
kumu n to fo so hale m ba fo mbre.
Fo e shin nɛ b kurge ma
nɛ kayurwushi; ma alɛ beeŋ
baa kpaŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.
7Ma kebaawɔtɔ ki tɔɔnɛ nna
n sa basa damta ŋkpal fo
ka la ma ekumpo lempo so.
8Meeŋ kpaŋ fo nsaa
ber fo kemaŋkura
be kebomboŋ karechɛ kikɛ.
9Mee kule fo nna, nɛ fo sa maŋ
pal kaman n sa ma jemanɛ
nɛ m bel ŋko ŋ kini ma n lɛ
jemanɛ nɛ ma eleŋ loge.
10Bedoŋ bee malga a gbiti ma nna;
b shɛr nna a kre ma kemɔ be nia.
11B yɛ: “Ebɔrɛ kini mo n lɛ;
men shin nɛ an ju m bɛ so n ya pɛ mo,
ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ
nɛ e kɔ m mɔlga mo.”
12O Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ barga ma n yɔ kufɔ;
O ma Ebɔrɛ, ba manaŋ m ba chɛ ma to!
13Shin nɛ basa nɛ baa fin ma
nɛ luwu na e kɔ n tɔr nseŋ mur.
Nseŋ shin nɛ basa nɛ baa kɔrfɛ ma
e ŋaba n ji anishinyɔr.
14Ma ere beeŋ ta ma
tama n wɔtɔ fo to;
ma alɛ maaŋ yige
kebaakpaŋ fo kikɛ.
15Karechɛ kikɛ meeŋ baa
malga fo alelasheŋ
nɛ fo kumɔlga be asheŋ;
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo wora
asheŋgboŋ nɛ a baŋ ma
kepinto so.
16O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
fo nawule be asheŋgboŋ
nɛ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso
be kubomboŋ nɛ meeŋ
baa ber.
17Ma kebiato kikɛ nɛ
fo ŋini ma asheŋ;
hale nɛ mbre,
ŋ kraa malga fo emamachisheŋ
be asheŋ a sa basa.
18Naniere, nɛ m bel n fuli kumu,
sa maŋ pal kaman n sa ma,
O Ebɔrɛ.
Shin nɛ m baa kraa wɔtɔ
a malga fo eleŋgboŋ
be asheŋ a sa kaman to ebi
nɛ baa ba na.
19O Ebɔrɛ, fo kebaawɔtɔ
niŋiso shi ga,
k salga to hale n ya fo awɔlpa to.
Fo e wora asheŋgboŋ ga,
esa kikɛ maŋ du fanɛ fo.
20Fo shin nɛ n ji awurfoŋ damta,
ama fo naŋ wɔtɔ ma eleŋ;
nseŋ kuŋ ma
nɛ m maŋ wu n yɔ nchaŋ to.
21Fo naŋ shin nɛ n nya
kemaŋkura n ti so,
nseŋ naŋ lolo ma nɛ
ma kagbene dese ma.
22Meeŋ ta jaŋjilaŋ m boŋ
nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo;
meeŋ kpaŋ fo ma Ebɔrɛ,
ŋkpal fo kashenteŋji so.
Meeŋ laŋ jaŋjilaŋ m boŋ
nshɛ belbelso n sa fo,
Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na.
23Meeŋ ta kagbenefuli m boŋ
nshɛ awɔrso ŋ kpaŋ fo,
ŋkpal fo ka mɔlga ma so.
24Meeŋ malga fo kebaawɔtɔ
niŋiso be asheŋ kachɛ lelemu.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
basa nɛ baa kɔrfɛ ma na
kɔ n tɔr nseŋ ji anishinyɔr.

Title: NSHƐ 72
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ a sa ewura be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ ewura
e baa ji kashenteŋ;
nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be
ekpa so fanɛ fo.
2Saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ baa ji
fo basa demu ekpa niŋiso so,
nsaa keni basa nɛ b wɔ tɔrɔ to
ekpa nɛ k daga so.
3Shin nɛ kayurwushi nɛ keji
asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
e baa wɔ basa nɛ b tase
abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi kikɛ so.
4Shin nɛ ewura na e baa
kɔ a sa betirpo, nsaa
kɔ a suge betentaŋasepo
nseŋ naa kɔ a pɔɔ bekama
nɛ baa kɔrfɛ bumo na so.
5Shin nɛ ewura e baa wɔtɔ
mbaanaayɔ fanɛ kananɛ
epeŋi nɛ kufɔl wɔtɔ na.
6Shin nɛ e baa kɔ kechɛto a sa
basa fanɛ kananɛ bɔrɛchu
bee sa adɔsawule kayul na.
7Shin nɛ ewura na e baa ji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so a sa ekama,
nseŋ shin nɛ kayurwushi nɛ
kedamaya e sɔ kaplɛkama
hale nɛ kufɔl e ya wu.
8Shin nɛ mbe kuwurji e yili
teku ko ase n salga to n ya fo
teku nyɔsopo ase.
Ŋko n yili Yufreetes be Lɔr na ase
n salga to n ya fo durnya be ekar.
9Saŋɛ na so keshishɛrsawule so
be basa beeŋ ba jɔŋɛ mo ase
m bunyaŋ mo.
Nɛ b tintiŋ mo doŋana nɛ b ba
dese kasawule ashi mbe anishito.
10Speen be efuli so nɛ mplasawule so
be bewuraana beeŋ bar bumo be ŋkɛ
m ba sa mo;
nɛ Areebia nɛ Itiopia be bewuraana gba
e bar bumo be ŋkɛ m ba sa mo.
11Kumo be kaman nɛ bewura kikɛ
e ba jɔŋɛ mo ase.
Nɛ efuliana na be basa kikɛ e shuŋ mo.
12Ŋkpal manɛ so, e beeŋ kɔ n suge
betentaŋasepo nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ
tɔrɔ to nseŋ shu n tre mo na n yige.
13Ewura na kɔ kushuso n sa
bepɔshipo nɛ betirpo nna,
mo alɛ e naa mɔlga betentaŋasepo
ashi luwu to.
14Mo e naa mɔlga bumo ashi
kamɛaŋ nɛ awurfoŋ to,
ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be ŋkpa
be asheŋ tir mo nna.
15Shin nɛ ewura na be ŋkpa
e teŋi so!
N shin nɛ e nya Areebia be
kasawule so be shuwa.
Shin nɛ basa e baa kule
Ebɔrɛ a sa mo jemanɛ kikɛ
nsaa nɛfa mo karechɛ kama.
16Shin nɛ ndegboŋ nɛ e wɔ
kasawule na so kikɛ e bɔlɔ ajibi,
nɛ abeeana so kikɛ e bɔlɔ aboyu
nɛ ayu be yiri kikɛ.
Shin nɛ kasawule na so
be ndibi sɔrso e wora ga,
fanɛ Lebanɔn be kebee so
be ndibi sɔrso peya,
nseŋ shin nɛ ndegboŋ na e bɔlɔ
basa fanɛ kupuŋ to be afitiri.
17Shin nɛ basa e baa nyiŋi
ewura na be ketre mbaanaayɔ,
n shin nɛ mbe kemaŋkura
e baa fulto fanɛ epeŋi.
Shin nɛ efuliana na be basa
e bɔla mo so n dii kedama
nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa n sa mo.
18Anyee kpaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe,
Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na nna.
Fo nawule e naa tiŋ
a wora emamachisheŋ.
19Anyeeŋ baa kpaŋ fo ketre
nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na jemanɛ kikɛ.
Shin nɛ fo kemaŋkuragboŋ na
e dii efuli durnya ere be kaplɛkama.
Amɛn! Amɛn!
20Jɛsi pibinyɛn, Ewura Deevid,
be kabɔrɛkule be ekar nna na.

Title: NSHƐ 73
Content:
KESASOPO
(Nshɛ 73—89)
Ebɔrɛ ka walɛ be asheŋ
1Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ walɛ n sa Israɛl
nɛ bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo
nɛ ŋgbene fuful na.
2Ama ma ere, a daŋ ka gbrɛ
nɛ n fɛrge n tɔr.
3Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ ka daŋ wu
kamoowuwuraana ka dii kedama na,
n daa besa bumo eyur nna.
4B maa ji awurfoŋ ŋko ebesa kikɛ;
b baa kɔ eyur be alenfia nɛ eleŋ nna.
5B maa ji awurfoŋ nɛ beko bee ji na;
bumo alɛ maŋ naa kɔ etɔrɔ
nɛ ekama kɔ na.
6Amoso kamoowu ki fanɛ kubɔtoshembi
ashi bumo be ebɔ to nna,
nɛ kebaanyaŋɛto a wora asheŋ
malɛ ki fanɛ bumo be asɔbuuso.
7Asheŋ lubi nawule e naa shi
bumo be ŋgbene to a lar,
nɛ ŋkre lubi malɛ bɔlɔ bumo
be nfɛra to.
8Baa tege basa nna nsaa malga
mmalga jiga,
nseŋ naa kre beko be kamɛaŋ
kamoowuso.
9Baa malga mmalga lubi
a gbiti Ebɔrɛ nna,
nsaa malga ŋkpensheŋ so
ekama kutɔ durnya to.
10Amoso Ebɔrɛ be basa gba
maŋ naa fɛ bumo be mmalga na
be asheŋ pɔɛŋ nsaa yirda bumo.
11Le nɛ baa kaŋɛ:
“Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ
tiŋ m pin kusɔ kikɛ!”
12Kananɛ kumukpakpasowuraana
du nna na.
B maŋ ta asheŋ lubi fanɛ asheŋ lubi;
bumo alɛ bee dii kedama a ti so nna.
13Manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ n nya ashi
ma kebaakɔ nfɛra lela,
nɛ kekini kewora asheŋ lubi to bre?
14O Ebɔrɛ, fo shin nɛ n ji
awurfoŋ kachɛ lelemu.
Kachipurso kikɛ fee gberge
ma kusoe nna.
15Nɛ n daŋ malga mmalga lubi nna,
ndafanɛ n daa beeŋ ki
edebɔrpo fo basa to.
16Kedaa du kpakpa n sa ma
nɛ n tiŋ m pin asheŋ ere kikɛ to.
17Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu to nɛ n yɔ
pɔɛŋ nseŋ ya pin kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ tu
kumukpakpasowuraana.
18Abaanaaworasheŋ feeŋ
shin nɛ b fɛrge n tɔr
nsaa maŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ koso kikɛ.
19Baaŋ mur epul to nɛ kufu e pɛ
bumo nɛ b baa chicha.
Bumo be lalaloge beeŋ lubi pasaa!
20Baaŋ baa du fanɛ edare
nɛ kare beeŋ chɛ nɛ k choŋ na nna.
O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo baŋ kpa n niŋi to,
baaŋ foe fanɛ afu.
21Ma kagbene to ka daa ji edɛ
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ k daa wora so na,
22kawulisheŋ nɛ kebaamaŋ nyi
asheŋ e daa kɔ ma,
nɛ n daa wora asheŋ fo anishito
fanɛ kusɔbɔya na.
23Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ ŋ kraa
wɔ fo kutɔ jemanɛ kikɛ.
Fo daa kɔ ma to fo enɔ jisa to nna.
24Fo kasotoji e daa ŋini ma
kananɛ meeŋ baa wora asheŋ,
kumo be lalaloge nɛ fo ba ta ma
n yɔ kemaŋkura to.
25M maŋ naa kɔ esa kikɛ ebɔrɛso
n naŋ ti fo so.
Ŋ ka baa kɔ fo ere, m maŋ naa
sha shɛŋ durnya ere to.
26Ma eyur nɛ nfɛra beeŋ tiŋ
n wora asheŋ ŋ gben,
ama Ebɔrɛ e la ma eleŋ
ashi ma kagbene to.
Mo alɛ be asheŋ a tir ma
jemanɛ kikɛ.
27O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
bekama nɛ b kplaŋ fo so
beeŋ mur cheche.
Fo alɛ beeŋ mur bekama
nɛ b maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa fo.
28Ama k walɛ ga ŋkpal ma ere
ka taga fo, Ebɔrɛ na, to so.
N ta fo, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na,
fanɛ ma ekumpo nna.
Ma alɛ beeŋ baa bɔ fo
emamachisheŋ na be kubɔya.

Title: NSHƐ 74
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n sa efuli na be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, manɛ nna nɛ fo
kplaŋ anyi so loŋ?
Feeŋ baŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo
basa mbaanaayɔ a?
2Baa nyiŋi fo basa nɛ fo lara n sa
fo kumu dra dra kikɛ na.
Basa nɛ fo lara kenyaya to na;
yiri nɛ fo lara fanɛ
fo gbagba be basa na.
Baa nyiŋi Zayɔn be kebee
nɛ b daa wɔ kumo so na gba.
3Naŋ bɛta m ba bɔla fo bɔrɛlambu
nɛ k bure a dese na ase;
kakpa nɛ an doŋana jija
kusɔ kama nyam na.
4Fo doŋana daŋ yili bɔrɛlambu na
to n ji njɔŋ nseŋ yuu bumo be etuta
a ŋini fanɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ so nna.
5B daa wora asheŋ fanɛ basa ka keta
akpanfu a ku kupo to be ndibi a lɛ nna.
6B daŋ ta bumo be akpanfugboŋ
nɛ awurbi m buri m buri asɔ nɛ b shɛl
n ta n ji bɔrɛlambu na kebita na nna.
7B daŋ chɔɔ fo bɔrɛlambu na
m mur cheche nna,
nseŋ shin nɛ kakpa nɛ basa daa
bunyaŋ fo na wora eyurpi
daŋkare be ekpa so.
8Le nɛ an doŋana na daŋ kaŋɛ
ashi bumo be ŋgbene to:
“Anyeeŋ mur bumo cheche!”
B daŋ chɔɔ kaplɛkama nɛ basa
bee bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na ashi
kasawule na kikɛ so nna
m mur cheche.
9Emamachisheŋ maŋ naa wɔtɔ,
anebiana na gba maŋ naa wɔtɔ.
Ekama malɛ maŋ nyi saŋɛ nɛ asheŋ na
beeŋ fo amo be ekar.
10O Ebɔrɛ, saŋɛ mo nɛ an doŋana
beeŋ yige kebaa tege anyi
nɛ kebaawora fo eyur to?
11Manɛ nna nɛ fo kini
kechɛ anyi to?
Manɛ nna nɛ fo maaŋ
gberge bumo kusoe?
12O Ebɔrɛ, sososo na kikɛ,
fo e la anyi be ewura;
fo alɛ e bar kumɔlga durnya kikɛ
be basa to.
13Fo eleŋgboŋ nɛ fo ta n nase
ekpa teku peper na to,
nseŋ bure nchu to be asɔ
keniso lubi gboŋgboŋi na
be amu to.
14Fo e daŋ bure teku to be
kusɔbɔya lubi gboŋgboŋi
nɛ baa tre Liviatan na
be kumu to.
Nseŋ shin nɛ k ki keji n sa
keshishɛrsawule so be asɔbɔya.
15Fo e daŋ shin nɛ kasawule
pante n lar nchu ŋ ki fanɛ
kebuye nɛ mbombi.
Nseŋ shin nɛ elɔr nɛ a daa
shile bre wɔlto na.
16Fo e to kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ,
nseŋ taŋɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl;
nɛ kekama kɔ kumo be eyilikpa.
17Fo e yili durnya be egbaŋ kikɛ,
nseŋ to kechali nɛ ketar.
18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
baa nyiŋi kananɛ fo doŋana
wora fo eyurto a mushe fo na,
nɛ kananɛ bewulpo
keni fo ketre jiga na.
19Sa maŋ yige fo basa nɛ b du
fanɛ alepɔ na n sa bedoŋ nɛ b du
fanɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi na.
Fo alɛ e sa maŋ teŋ basa nɛ baa ji
awurfoŋ na so.
20Baa nyiŋi kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre
nɛ anyi nɛ fo wora na.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, kebagato e sɔ durnya
be kukɔlɔbi kikɛ to, n shin nɛ
tentembiri sɔ kaplɛkama.
21Sa maŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr a ji
basa nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ.
Ama fo shin nɛ betirpo nɛ
betentaŋasepo e kpaŋ fo ketre na.
22O Ebɔrɛ, koso ŋ kɔ n sa fo kumu!
Baa nyiŋi kananɛ bewulpo na
wora fo eyurto kachɛ lelemu kikɛ na.
23Sa maŋ teŋ awɔr nɛ fo
doŋana wora na so,
awɔr nɛ b baa wora jemanɛ
kikɛ na so.

Title: NSHƐ 75
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka la demujipo be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, anyee di fo epaŋ,
ŋkpal fo ka taga anyi to so!
Ekama bee ji eyur nna a malga
fo mamachisheŋ be asheŋ.
2Fo yɛ:
“N lara demuji
be jemanɛ nna n yili;
ma alɛ beeŋ ji demu nɛ
kumo be ekpa so.
3Nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ
nɛ basa bee chicha gba,
ma e kraa kɔ kumo be gbaltɔlase
to a yil dindiŋ.
4Ma e naa kaŋɛ
kumukpakpasowura fanɛ
e sa maa kpeŋ a wu mbe kumu.
5Ma e naa kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ
b yige kebaapuchi a malga
bumo be keshi be asheŋ.”
6Esa kikɛ maŋ wɔ epeŋilarkpa
ŋko epeŋitɔrkpa ŋko durnya be
kaplɛkama nɛ e tiŋ n ta esa
n yili eyilikpagboŋ.
7Ebɔrɛ e naa ji kusɔ kama demu.
Mo e naa bar eko kaseto
nsaa maŋ eko so!
8K du fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ka kɔ kawiebi mbe enɔ to nna,
nɛ mbe agbo du fanɛ yabra kpakpaso
a wɔ kawiebi na to.
E bee duga mbe agbo na nna
a sa durnya to be amukpakpasowuraana,
nɛ baa chise amo kikɛ nyam a nuu.
9Ama ma ere beeŋ baa malga fo,
Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na, be asheŋ,
nsaa boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.
10O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
feeŋ mur basa lubi be eleŋ,
nseŋ shin nɛ basa niŋiso bre
be eleŋ e ti so.

Title: NSHƐ 76
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka bee kɔ a pɔɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ be asheŋ
1Ekama nyi Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
ashi Juda be efuli so,
nɛ mbe ketre malɛ bee nya
kemaŋkura Israɛl to.
2Zayɔn be kebee nɛ k wɔ
Jerusalɛm to na
e la kakpa nɛ e wɔ.
3Ndoŋ nɛ e buri m buri edompo na
be atanyembi nɛ etokobi nɛ
abɛlso be asɔkuŋso to.
4Fo kemaŋkura bee nyɛkpɛ nna
fanɛ edɛ;
kumo alɛ kɔ eleŋ a walɛ ga
a chɔ abee nɛ kupuŋ to
be asɔbɔya bee nite so na.
5Bedoŋ tiŋ n suge benapo lempo
nɛ b kɔ dama na gba be asɔ;
ama naniere bumo alɛ gba wu
n dese a di nchaŋ to nɛ bumo
be eleŋ nɛ kenyi kikɛ to jiga.
6Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ, fo ka ponte to,
egbaŋɛ nɛ bumo be bediipo
kikɛ tɔr nna n wu a dese shruum.
7Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daga fanɛ
ekama e baa ŋana fo.
Fo baŋ nya agbo,
esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ
n yili fo anishito.
8Ebɔrɛso nɛ fo wɔ nseŋ bɔ
fo demuji be kubɔya;
nɛ kufu tɔr durnya so,
nɛ kakpa kikɛ wora shruum.
9Jemanɛ nɛ fo kpa n niŋi to
nɛ fo fara demuji m mɔlga basa
nɛ baa ji awurfoŋ durnya to nna na.
10Kashenteŋto nɛ fo baŋ nya agbo,
basa nɛ b nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo gba
bee kpaŋ fo nna.
11Men nase nnɔ n sa Enyɛnpe,
menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.
Menyi alɛ e wora m bɔlɔ
men be nnɔ naseso na so.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daga keŋana,
mo e daga fanɛ efuli pɔtɛana
nɛ a kulti anyi na kikɛ be basa
ka bar ŋkɛ m ba sa mo.
12Mo e naa bar bewura kama
nɛ baa boo kenyɛn na kaseto;
a shin nɛ baa ki befupo.

Title: NSHƐ 77
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka wɔ mbe basa to tɔrɔ be jemanɛ be asheŋ
1N shu n tre Ebɔrɛ nna
a fin kechɛto.
Ŋ ka shu n tre mo,
nɛ e nu ma kushu na.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mee
kule tɔrɔ be jemanɛ;
mee maŋ ma enɔana so
kanyɛ na kikɛ nna
ashi kabɔrɛkule to,
ama n daa maŋ nya
kagbenewushi.
3N daŋ nyiŋi fo Ebɔrɛ na nna,
nseŋ tekeŋto;
n fɛ nfɛra ga, nɛ aba pɔ ma.
4Ŋkpal fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so,
m maŋ tiŋ nɛ n di.
Ewushi kikɛ maŋ wɔ ma to,
m maŋ tiŋ nɛ m malga gba.
5Mee fɛ nchɛ nɛ a choŋ na
nɛ nfɛ dra na be asheŋ nna.
6Mee nyiŋi kanyɛso kikɛ be
nshɛ nɛ n daa boŋ,
nsaa fɛ nfɛra ga na nna,
a bishi ma kumu le:
7“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kini anyi nna
n lɛ le mbaanaayɔ a?
E maaŋ naŋ wu anyi kuwɔr a?
8Mbe kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na
loge anyi so nna ere a?
Mbe nnɔ naseso na malɛ gba
ba ekar nna ere a?
9Ama Ebɔrɛ teŋ so kananɛ
baa wu kuwɔr nna a?
E kpal agbo so m pɛ mbe
kuwɔrwu be kasha nna ere a?”
10Ade be kaman nɛ n fɛ le:
“Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
kusɔ nɛ k baa tɔrɔ ma ga
e la fo ka maŋ naa ta fo
eleŋgboŋ na a chɛ anyi to na.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ baa nyiŋi fo asheŋgboŋ
nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ fo wora
dra dra na be asheŋ.
12Meeŋ baa fɛ asheŋ tumase
nɛ fo wora na kikɛ be asheŋ.
13O Ebɔrɛ, kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora
du cheembi nna.
Kegbir kikɛ maŋ shi nsaa kɔ
eleŋ fanɛ fo.
14Fo nawule e la Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e bee wora emamachisheŋ;
nsaa ŋini fo eleŋgboŋ
ashi efuliana na be basa to.
15Fo eleŋgboŋ na nɛ fo ta
m mɔlga fo basa nɛ b la
Jeekɔb nɛ Josɛf be
kaman to ebi na.
16O Ebɔrɛ, kewora fanɛ
teku be nchu na ka wu fo,
kufu pɛ amo nna nɛ kumo
be kechimbi to baga to
m pulgi to kufuso.
17Abɔrɛwɔlpa daŋ chulgi
bɔrɛchu nna n wurge to;
nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ awɔlpa to
nseŋ ponte to.
18Bɔrɛ na ka nyɛkpɛ m ponte to
nɛ kusɔ kikɛ nu kumo.
K ka nyɛkpɛ na
nɛ durnya kikɛ fulto.
K ka ponte to na
nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to
fanɛ k kaa bee chicha na.
19Fo daŋ nase ekpa teku be
nchugboŋ na to nna,
nɛ k wora fanɛ fo ka bɔla
kumo to n choŋ;
ama esa maŋ wu
fo aya ka dese.
20Fo daŋ bɔla Mosis
nɛ Ɛɛrɔn so nna n juŋkpar
fo basa fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo na.”

Title: NSHƐ 78
Content:
Kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora n sa mbe basa be asheŋ
1Ma basa, men nu ma keŋini ere,
nseŋ nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere nɛnɛ.
2Meeŋ ta kanyiasheŋ be
mmalga m bugi wulo to be
mmalga nɛ a choŋ na to.
3A la asheŋ nɛ an nu nsaa nyi nna,
nsaa la asheŋ nɛ an nanaana
kaŋɛ anyi na nna.
4Anyi maaŋ ta amo ŋ ŋana
anyi be mbia so.
Anyeeŋ malga Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be eleŋgboŋ nɛ mbe asheŋgboŋ
nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ e wora na
be asheŋ n sa anyi be mbia
nɛ baaŋ ba anyi be kaman na.
5Mo e ta mbe mbraana n sa
Israɛl be basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb
be kaman to ebi na.
Mo e kaŋɛ an nanaana fanɛ
b baa ŋini bumo be mbia
mbe mbraana na;
6saŋɛ na so mbia nɛ baaŋ ba
kaman to na beeŋ koya amo
nseŋ ŋini bumo alɛ be mbia amo.
7Aloŋ e naŋ shin nɛ mbia na gba
e ta bumo be yirda n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ to
nsaa maŋ teŋ asɔ nɛ e wora so.
Saŋɛ na so, jemanɛ kikɛ baaŋ baa
wora mbe mbraana na kasonu.
8Bumo ere maaŋ baa du fanɛ
bumo nanaana nɛ b daŋ lar
Ebɔrɛ kaman nseŋ kini kewora
mo kasonu, nɛ bumo be yirda
ashi Ebɔrɛ to daa maa yil to kpakpa,
nɛ b maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa mo na.
9Kena be kachɛ ka fo,
Efrayimebi nɛ b daa kɔ
ata nɛ atanyembi to na
daŋ lara keya nna n shile.
10B daa maŋ wora m bɔlɔ
bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔkoŋwule
be ŋkre na so.
B daŋ kini kewora mbe mbraana
kasonu nna.
11B daŋ teŋ kusɔ e wora so nna,
emamachisheŋ nɛ b daŋ wu
e ka wora na kikɛ nɛ b daŋ teŋ so.
12Bumo nanaana be anishito
nɛ e daŋ wora emamachisheŋ na.
Ijipt be efuli so be kebonfu
nɛ baa tre Zowan na so
nɛ e daŋ wora amo.
13E daŋ shin nɛ teku na ku to nna,
nseŋ shin nɛ nchu na ki
fanɛ egbal a yil,
nɛ e juŋkpar bumo m bɔla
kumo to n choŋ.
14E daa bɔla kuwɔlpa so nna
a ŋini bumo ekpa kapaso,
nseŋ daa bɔla edɛ be kabulpi so
a ŋini bumo ekpa kanyɛso malɛ.
15E daŋ shin nɛ afalta pante a lar
nchu a shile fanɛ mbombi nna
ashi keshishɛrsawule so nɛ b nya
nchu n nuu bumo be kepar.
16Mo e daŋ shin nɛ nchu
shi kefalta to n lar
a shile fanɛ lɔr na.
17Ama b kraŋ wora alubi
n da Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ so;
nseŋ lar mbe kaman ashi
keshishɛrsawule na so.
18B daŋ kute nna n wora
Ebɔrɛ ŋ keni;
jemanɛ nɛ b daa yil mo so
fanɛ e sa bumo ajibi
nɛ b daa sha ga na.
19B daŋ malga nna ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ
ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ beeŋ tiŋ n sa anyi
ajibi kiyi ere to nfe nna ere a?
20E ka daŋ shin nɛ kefalta na pante na,
nchu daŋ lar a shile fanɛ mbombi na.
Ama e kraa beeŋ tiŋ n sa
anyi ajibi nna ere a?
E beeŋ tiŋ n sa mbe basa
eblaŋ nna ere a?”
21Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka nu
kusɔ nɛ b kaŋɛ na,
nɛ e nya agbo ga
nseŋ shin nɛ mbe edɛ suse so
ashi mbe basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb
be kaman to ebi to,
22ŋkpal b ka daa maŋ yirda mo
nseŋ daŋ ji mbe kumɔlga
be eleŋ emɔrɔ so.
23Ama e daŋ naŋ malga
n sa awɔlpa nseŋ daŋ
bugi esoso be mbuna
24nɛ ajibi nɛ baa tre manna na
tɔr to nɛ basa na nya n ji.
Ebɔrɛso be ajibi nɛ
e daŋ sa bumo.
25Amoso emalaika be ajibi
nɛ b daŋ nya n ji;
Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa bumo ajibi
kama nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n ji nna.
26Kumo be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ
be eleŋgboŋ shin nɛ afu shi
epeŋilarkpa, a laŋɛ kelargato
be kaseto be kaba so na
ber m ba.
27Afu na daŋ sulɔ mbuibi ko nna
m ba sɔ kasawule na kikɛ so
fanɛ teku ase be eshishɛr na.
28Basa na be keeyi to gbagba
nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mbuibi na tɔr
ŋ kulti bumo be ewajɛbu n wɔtɔ.
29Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ bumo m mɔ
n we m moɛ.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e daŋ sa
bumo asɔ nɛ b daa sha ga
nseŋ daa kɔ a fin amo na.
30Ama b daa maŋ naŋ nya amo
n we bumo be keparso gba,
a kraa wɔ bumo be nnɔ to nna
31nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo koso bumo so,
nɛ e shin nɛ bumo to be belempo wu.
Israɛl be efuli so be mbifɔlbi
e daŋ wu na.
32Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ,
b kraa wora alubi nna.
Emamachisheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ
wora na kikɛ be kaman,
b kraa maŋ yirda mo.
33Amoso e daŋ shin nɛ bumo
be ŋkpa ku so nna,
nseŋ daŋ shin nɛ kufugboŋ ko
tɔr bumo so.
34Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ baŋ
shin nɛ bumo be beko wu,
bumo nɛ b ka na bee tuba nna
nsaa kule mo kenishipere so.
35B daŋ nyiŋi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ la
bumo be ekumpo nna,
nseŋ daŋ naŋ nyiŋi fanɛ
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e la
bumo be emɔlgapo.
36Ama bumo be nnɔ to
be mmalga kikɛ la efɛ nna.
Asheŋ kama nɛ baa malga
maa shi bumo be ŋgbene to.
37B daa maa ji kashenteŋ a sa mo;
bumo alɛ daa maa bɛ mo nɛ bumo
be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre so.
38Ama Ebɔrɛ kraa wu
mbe basa kuwɔr.
E daŋ ta bumo be alubi
m paŋ bumo nna,
nsaa maŋ mur bumo.
Ale damta nɛ e pɛ mbe kagbene,
a maŋ shin nɛ mbe agbo
koso bumo so alegaiso.
39E daŋ nyiŋi fanɛ b la
eyur nɛ ŋklaŋ nna.
B du fanɛ afu nɛ k bee ber
a yɔ a maŋ naa laŋɛ nna.
40Jemanɛ nɛ b daa wɔ
keshishɛrsawule na so na,
ale damta nɛ b daŋ lar
Ebɔrɛ kaman n jija mbe kagbene!
41B daŋ baa wɔtɔ nna
a wora mo a keni,
nsaa wɔtɔ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ
cheembi na ebesa to.
42B daa maa nyiŋi mbe
eleŋ nɛ e kɔ,
bumo alɛ daa maa nyiŋi
kachɛ nɛ e mɔlga bumo
ashi bumo doŋana be
enɔ to na gba.
43B daŋ teŋ emamachisheŋ
nɛ e wora ashi Zowan be
kebonfu so ashi Ijipt be
efuli so na nna.
44Ebɔrɛ e daŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be
elɔrana be nchu kilgi ŋ ki ŋklaŋ
nɛ b daa maŋ nya nchu nuuso na.
45E daŋ shin nɛ ashushombi
ba sɔ kaplɛkama a tɔrɔ bumo nna;
nɛ ebɔl lar bumo.
E daŋ shin nɛ epulo ba ta
kenishi m pere bumo ashi
kasawule na so nna ga.
46E daŋ shin nɛ elotɔr nɛ alonte
lar nna m ba mur bumo be
adɔjibi kikɛ kasawule na so.
47E daŋ shin nɛ abɔrɛjembubi ba mur
bumo be ndibi sɔrsoana nna,
nseŋ shin nɛ kunyɔlɔ malɛ mur
bumo be figi be ndibi kikɛ.
48Mo e shin nɛ abɔrɛjembubi bri
bumo be ana m mɔ,
nseŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ m mɔ
bumo be asɔbɔya nɛ a ka na.
49Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna
nɛ mbe kagbene koso bumo so ga,
fanɛ luwu be mbɔ damta
ka mel abar so na.
50E daa maŋ pɛ mbe kagbene
ashi mbe agbo na to,
ŋko n yige m paŋ bumo
nɛ b ji efute kikɛ.
E daŋ mɔ bumo nna
n shin nɛ kenishi pere bumo.
51E daŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be efuli so
be ewurkoŋnyɛn kikɛ wu nna.
52Kumo be kaman nɛ
Ebɔrɛ juŋkpar mbe basa
fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo n lar
Ijipt be efuli so m bɔla
keshishɛrsawule so n choŋ.
53E ka daa juŋkpar bumo so,
kufu daa maa kɔ bumo;
ama Teku Peper na daŋ mur
bumo doŋana bre nna.
54Ebɔrɛ daŋ juŋkpar mbe basa nna
n yɔ kepreŋsawule nɛ e bɔla mbe
eleŋgboŋ so n suge n sa bumo na so.
55E daŋ ju efuli pɔtɛana na
be basa nna n lar nseŋ barga
kasawule na nɛ bumo be
nwuana to n sa Israɛl be
eyiri yiri nɛ b la mbe basa na.
56Ama b daŋ lar Ebɔrɛ kaman
nseŋ wora Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
ŋ keni nna.
B daa maŋ bɛ mbe mbraana so.
57B daa du fanɛ bumo nanaana
nɛ b daa maa ji kashenteŋ
nseŋ paŋ yirda na nna.
Bumo alɛ daa du fanɛ
ketanyembi kɔnto nɛ esa maaŋ
tiŋ n fute n yige kumo so nna.
58B daŋ pɔr agbirana nna
n yili agurɔŋgu so a shuŋ;
n shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kukɔrkɔ
koso nɛ e nya agbo ga.
59Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora na so,
Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna
nseŋ kini Israɛl be basa na n lɛ.
60E daŋ kini mbe wajɛbu nɛ e
daa wɔ kumo to ashi mbe basa to
ashi Shilo be kade to nna n lɛ.
61Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ
an doŋana kɔ n suge kɔnɔkoŋwule
be ŋkre be deka nɛ k yili n sa
mbe kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋgboŋ na.
62E daŋ nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ mo
gbagba be basa nseŋ shin nɛ
bumo doŋana mɔ bumo.
63Edɛ e daŋ mur bumo be
mbrantiɛbia, nɛ bumo be
besuŋgurbi maŋ nya
benyɛn nɛ b kil.
64Bɔrɛmatapoana na daŋ wu
luwu nyaŋgraŋ nna,
bumo be bekulpoche maŋ nya
n shu bumo be nli gba.
65Kumo be kaman nɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kpa niŋi to
fanɛ esa ka tiŋi edi to,
ŋko enapo ka diewu ŋ koso na.
66E daŋ bri mo doŋana nna n ju,
n shin nɛ b ji nyɔmɔ mbaanaayɔ.
67Ama e daŋ kini kebaawɔ
an nananyɛn Josɛf be kaman to ebi to
nseŋ daŋ kini kelara Efrayim be yiri to
ebi n yili n sa mbe kumu nna.
68Juda be yiri to ebi nɛ Zayɔn be kebee
nɛ e daa sha ga ashi Jerusalɛm to na
nɛ e daŋ lara n yili n sa mbe kumu.
69Kumo be awɔlto,
nɛ e daŋ pɔr mbe bɔrɛlambu
nɛ kumo be gbaltɔlase daa kɔ
eleŋ fanɛ kasawule nɛ e to
n yili mbaanaayɔ na.
70Ewura Deevid nɛ e daa
kpa mbolpɔ na nɛ e daŋ
lara fanɛ mbe kayɛrbi.
71Mbolpɔ na be kekpa to nɛ e daa wɔ
nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara mo nseŋ buu mo
Israɛl be kuwura nɛ e baa juŋkpar
mbe basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb
be kaman to ebi na.
72Ewura Deevid malɛ daŋ ta
kagbene koŋwule n juŋkpar bumo
nseŋ wora asheŋ kanyiasheŋ so
ashi bumo to nna.

Title: NSHƐ 79
Content:
Efuli na be kesɔnyige be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, efuli pɔtɛana so ebi
ba kɔ n suge fo kasawule.
B shin nɛ fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi
na wora eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so,
nseŋ shin nɛ Jerusalɛm ki
kade bureso a dese fuloŋ.
2B ta fo basa nɛ b wu na
n sa ejita nɛ kupuŋ to
be asɔbɔya nɛ e bee ji.
3B chulgi ŋklaŋ n wurge
nɛ e bee shile fanɛ nchu
ashi Jerusalɛm to.
Esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ
nɛ e puli bubuni na.
4Efuliana nɛ a kulti anyi na
be basa bee mushe nsaa
wora anyi eyurto nna.
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo nya agbo n wɔtɔ
anyi nna mbaanaayɔ a?
Fo agbo kraa beeŋ baa
suse fanɛ edɛ nna a?
6Laŋɛ fo agbo na n deŋi
efuli pɔtɛana nɛ b maa bunyaŋ fo
ŋko a shu a tre fo ketre na so,
7ŋkpal b ka mɔ Jeekɔb
be kaman to ebi
nseŋ mur fo efuli na so.
8Sa maŋ gberge anyi kusoe
ŋkpal an nanaana be alubi so.
Wu anyi kuwɔr naniere.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
anyi maŋ naa kɔ tama kikɛ.
9O Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la anyi be emɔlgapo,
chɛ anyi to!
Ŋkpal fo ketre be kemaŋkura so,
mɔlga anyi nseŋ ta anyi be
alubi m paŋ anyi.
10Manɛ nna nɛ efuli pɔtɛana na
bee bishi anyi fanɛ,
nnɛ nɛ menyi be Ebɔrɛ na wɔ?
Shin nɛ an wu kasogberge
nɛ k bee ba efuliana na so,
ŋkpal b ka chulgi basa
nɛ b shuŋ fo be ŋklaŋ
n wurge so.
11Kaŋ kusoe n nu basa
nɛ b wɔ kabuti to be kushu.
Ta fo eleŋgboŋ na n sɔ basa
nɛ baa shin nɛ b mɔ na n yige.
12O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e naaŋ ka efuli pɔtɛana
nɛ a kulti anyi ere kukɔ
ale shunu so;
ŋkpal b ka tege fo na so.
13Saŋɛ na so anyi nɛ an la fo basa,
a du fanɛ fo mbolpɔ ere,
beeŋ baa di fo epaŋ
nsaa kpaŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 80
Content:
Kechɛ anyi be efuli to be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1O Israɛl be ekenipo,
nu anyi be kekule!
Fo nɛ fee juŋkpar Josɛf be
kaman to ebi fanɛ mbolpɔ
nseŋ chena fo kuwurputi so
ashi asɔ pɔrso nɛ baa tre
chɛrubim na be nferinto na,
2lara fo kumu ŋ ŋini Efrayim
nɛ Bɛnjamin nɛ Manase
be eyiri to ebi.
Ŋini fo eleŋ nseŋ ba mɔlga anyi!
3O Ebɔrɛ, naŋ shin nɛ an nya eleŋ!
Mushe n wɔtɔ anyi nseŋ mɔlga anyi.
4O Enyɛnpetale Ewurbɔrɛ,
jemanɛ mo nɛ fo basa be
kabɔrɛkule maaŋ naa nu fo agbo?
5Fo shin nɛ anishichubi ki
bumo be ajibi jiso
nɛ nchu nuuso.
6Fo shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana
nɛ a kulti anyi na bee kɔ abar
kena ŋkpal anyi be kasawule so,
nseŋ shin nɛ an doŋana bee tege
anyi nsaa mushe anyi.
7O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
naŋ mushe n wɔtɔ anyi,
nɛ an naŋ nya kumɔlga.
8An du fanɛ asɔrso nɛ baa
tre greeps na be kefeelebi nna,
nɛ fo keta anyi n lar Ijipt be efuli so
nseŋ ba ju efuli pɔtɛana so be basa
n lɛ nseŋ ta anyi n fɛa bumo
be kasawule so.
9Fo e lɔŋɛ kasawule na so,
nɛ kefeelebi na e tiŋ n daŋ;
nɛ kumo be nliŋi e nya
n luri kasawule to nɛnɛ.
Saŋɛ na so k beeŋ purge
m buu kasawule na kikɛ so.
10Nɛ kumo be kayul e daŋ m buu
abeeana na so nɛ kumo be ayabi
malɛ e daŋ m buu sida
be ndibigboŋ so.
11Nseŋ daŋ n ya fo Mɛditerenia
be teku na ase, n ta n ya fo
Yufreetes be lɔr na ase gba.
12Manɛ nna nɛ fo buri kunji
nɛ k bee kuŋ kumo na to,
nɛ ekama nɛ e bɔla ndoŋ
a choŋ bee nya kumo be
asɔrso a chuge?
13Kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya alubi gba
bee nya amo be asɔrso a ji.
14O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
naŋ bɛta m ba anyi kutɔ!
Shi ebɔrɛso n to kenishi
ŋ keni anyi nseŋ ba mɔlga
fo basa!
15Ba mɔlga kefeelebi popɔrbi
nɛ fo gbagba fɛa nseŋ shin nɛ
k daŋ n nya eleŋ ga na.
16Bedoŋ ba ku kefeelebi na n lɛ
nseŋ nya edɛ n wɔtɔ kumo to.
Naniere shin nɛ fo agbo e ba
mur bedoŋ na.
17Chɛ esa nɛ e chena fo
enɔ jisa so na to.
Mo e la nyiŋgbasa pibinyɛn
nɛ fo bela mo n sa fo kumu na.
18Anyi maaŋ naŋ lar fo
kaman kikɛ.
Sa anyi ŋkpa popɔr nɛ an baa
bunyaŋ fo.
19O Enyɛnpetale Ewurbɔrɛ,
naŋ bɛta anyi m ba fo kutɔ!
Mushe n wɔtɔ anyi n shin nɛ
an nya kumɔlga.

Title: NSHƐ 81
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka bee sa anyi eleŋ be asheŋ
1Men boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso
n sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa anyi
eleŋ na!
Men boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ
an nananyɛn Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na!
2Men fara a boŋ nshɛ nsaa
laŋ echakachaka a wɔtɔ;
men baa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ egoji
a boŋ nshɛ belbelso.
3Men foŋ mbel n fara kufɔl popɔr
be kejigboŋ be kasheŋwora na
kufɔl kikɛ be kachɛ sososo nɛ
kumo be kachɛ baŋɛto na.
4Mbra nɛ k dese Israɛl
be efuli so nna na;
an nananyɛn Jeekɔb be
Ebɔrɛ na e yili kumo.
5Mo e ta kumo n sa Israɛl be basa,
nɛ b la Josɛf be kaman to ebi na,
jemanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ juŋkpar bumo
n lar Ijipt be efuli so na.
N daŋ nu esa ko ka kaŋɛ ma
ashi ŋgbar nɛ m maŋ nyi to le:
6“Ma e daŋ bɛge esulɔ
gbɛgbɛso na ashi menyi so,
nseŋ sɔ nlantaŋɛ gbɛgbɛso na
menyi be enɔana to.
7Men ka daa wɔ etɔrɔ to,
ma nɛ men shu n tre,
nɛ m mɔlga menyi.
Abɔrɛwɔlpa to nɛ n daa wɔ
nseŋ nu menyi be kushu.
Kumo be kaman nɛ n wora
menyi ŋ keni ashi Mɛriba
be kebuye na ase.
8O ma basa, men nu ma
kasokpele ere.
Israɛlebi, n daa beeŋ baa sha
fanɛ men nu n sa ma!
9Men sa maŋ kaŋ shuŋ efuli pɔtɛ
kikɛ be kegbir, ŋko kegbir kikɛ
nɛ menyi maŋ nyi shɛŋ a laŋɛ
kumo kaplɛa so!
10Ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e lara menyi ashi Ijipt
be efuli so m ba na.
Menyi ere e bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ ma
kusɔ nɛ menyee sha de,
nɛ n wora kumo n sa menyi.
11Ama ma basa maa nu a sa ma;
Israɛl be basa na maa wora ma
kasonu.
12Ŋkpal loŋ so nɛ n yige bumo
n sa bumo be ŋkpensheŋ
be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ b wɔtɔ a wora
asheŋ nɛ baa sha.
13Ma basa, Israɛlebi,
daa beeŋ nu n sa ma
nseŋ bɛ ma ekpaana so nna,
14ndafanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
daa beeŋ nya manaŋ n ta ma
eleŋgboŋ na m pɔɔ bumo doŋana
kikɛ so n sa bumo.
15Bekama nɛ b kishi ma,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
beeŋ ta kufu m ba jɔŋɛ ma ase;
bumo alɛ be kasogberge beeŋ
baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
16Ama menyi ere, ayu lela
nɛ abee to be mushoŋchu
nɛ meeŋ ta m bela menyi
nɛ men ji m moɛ.”

Title: NSHƐ 82
Content:
Ebɔrɛ Ewurgboŋ na be asheŋ
1Ebɔrɛ e naa juŋkpar ebɔrɛso
be nshɛrgboŋ na;
mo e naa ji agbirana na demu
a kaŋɛ amo le:
2“A maŋ daga men baa ji demu
a kpɛa beko to;
men sa maa ji a chɛ
kumukpakpaso wuraana to!
3Men baa ji asheŋ nɛ amo
be ekpa so a sa bepɔshipo
nɛ amunibi nɛ betentaŋasepo
nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ
echɛtopo kikɛ na.
4Men baa kɔ a suge bepɔshipo
nɛ betentaŋasepo ashi
kumukpakpasowuraana be enɔ to.
5Menyi be ekama maŋ nyi shɛŋ
ŋko a pin asheŋ to!
Tentembiri to nɛ men wɔ
a nite a kulti;
saŋɛ so nɛ durnya kikɛ be
gbaltɔlase bee gbuŋgbuŋ.
6Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
e kaŋɛ fanɛ men kikɛ la
agbirana nna nsaa la
ŋ gbagba be asɔ toso.
7Ama menyeeŋ baa wu
fanɛ edimɛdi;
menyi alɛ be ŋkpa beeŋ baa
loge fanɛ ewurjipo kama peya.”
8O Ebɔrɛ, koso n ji durnya demu,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
efuliana na kikɛ la fo peya nna.

Title: NSHƐ 83
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka bee ji kuwura durnya kikɛ so be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ wora shruum,
n lo to a maa wora shɛŋ!
2Keni, fo doŋana e lar fo kaman
nseŋ koso a kɔ fo na.
3Baa kre fo basa ŋkre lubi
ashiri to nna;
Basa nɛ fee sha ga na be
ŋkre lubi nɛ baa kre.
4B yɛ: “Men ba nɛ an ya mur
bumo be efuli na,
nɛ esa maaŋ naa nyiŋi
Israɛl be asheŋ hale mbaanaayɔ.”
5B wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nna ŋ kre
fanɛ baaŋ chɛ abar ŋ kɔ fo.
6Basa nɛ b kre loŋ be ŋkre na
e la Edɔmebi nɛ Ishmaɛlebi,
nɛ Mowabebi nɛ Hegaebi,
7nɛ basa nɛ b shi Gebal nɛ Ammɔn
nɛ Amalɛk be efuliana so,
nɛ Filisti nɛ Tayɛ be ndegboŋana to.
8Asiriya be efuli so ebi gba shuli so
fanɛ baaŋ ya ti Ammɔnebi nɛ
Mowabebi, nɛ b la Lɔt be kaman to
ebi na so, nɛ b nya eleŋ n ti so.
9Wora bumo kusɔ nɛ fo wora
Midianebi nɛ basa nɛ baa tre
Sisɛra nɛ Jabin, ashi Kishɔn be
lɔr na ase na.
10Kakpa nɛ baa tre Ɛndɔ na
nɛ fo daŋ mur bumo;
bumo be kebuni daŋ dese
kasawule so nna m bɛ.
11Wora bumo be bejuŋkparpo
kusɔ nɛ fo daŋ wora Ɔrɛb nɛ Ziib na.
Pɔɔ bumo be bewuraana so
fanɛ kananɛ fo daŋ pɔɔ
Zeba nɛ Zalmuna gba so na.
12Kusɔ nɛ b daŋ kaŋɛ nde:
“Men shin nɛ an sɔ Ebɔrɛ be
kasawule na ŋ ki anyi peya.”
13O anyi be Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ b ki
fanɛ eshishɛr ŋko amimi nɛ afu
foŋ n ya lɛ na.
14Kananɛ edɛ baa ji kupo na,
ŋko a suse abee so na,
15aloŋ a daga fanɛ fo ta bɔrɛfugboŋ
n ju bumo n lɛ, nseŋ shin nɛ afugboŋ
a funti bumo nɛ b baa chicha.
16O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ b ji anishinyɔr,
saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ
yɛla kenishi to n fin fo.
17Shin nɛ b kɔ n tɔr nɛ kufu
e pɛ bumo mbaanaayɔ,
nseŋ shin nɛ b wu ŋaba be luwu.
18Shin nɛ b pin fanɛ fo e la
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ.
Fo alɛ nawule e naa ji kuwura
durnya kikɛ so.

Title: NSHƐ 84
Content:
Kabɔrɛshuŋ to be kagbenefuli be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
fo bɔrɛlambu na walɛ pasaa!
2Kumo to be keyɔ bee yɛlga ma ga!
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu to
be keyɔ wɔ ma kagbene to ga.
N ta ma kagbene nɛ ma eyur kikɛ nna
a boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso a sa Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na.
3Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la ma
Ewura nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ.
Etitibi nɛ abɔrɛpɔpɔbi kikɛ tɔ
bumo be asha nna m mata
fo bɔrɛsure nsaa to a bure ndoŋ.
4Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b wɔ
fo bɔrɛlambu to a boŋ nshɛ
jemanɛ kikɛ e kpaŋ fo na peya nna.
5Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ
baa nya eleŋ fo kutɔ nsaa pere
kenishi a yɔ Zayɔn be kebee so
n ya kaa shuŋ fo na peya nna.
6Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ b baŋ ya kaa
bɔla ketaŋɛ wɔlso nɛ baa
tre Baka na to, k bee ki kebuye
nna a shile.
Kpanchali so be bɔrɛ gba bee
shin nɛ k bee bɔlɔ nchu nna a shile.
7Fo basa bee nya eleŋ nna a ti so,
n ya fo fanɛ ekama ka beeŋ baa
tiŋ a ba Ebɔrɛ na be anishito
ashi Zayɔn be kebee na so.
8O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
nu ma kabɔrɛkule;
O Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ,
kaŋ kusoe n nu ŋ kutɔ!
9O Ebɔrɛ, nɛfa anyi be ewura,
nɛ fo gbagba lara n sa fo kumu na.
10Keji kachɛ koŋwule ashi
fo bɔrɛlambu to bɔ keji nchɛ
kagboŋ ashi kakpa pɔtɛ.
Ŋ ka yili ma Ebɔrɛ be lambu
be kabuna to bɔ ŋ ka wɔ
kumukpakpasowura pe.
11Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na du fanɛ epeŋi
nɛ kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋso nna.
Mo e naa wu kuwɔr nsaa ta
bunyaŋ a buu esa so,
mo alɛ maa ta kusɔ lela
a ŋana basa niŋiso so.
12O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
kagbenefuli la esa kama nɛ
e yirda fo na peya nna!

Title: NSHƐ 85
Content:
Efuli na be nɛnɛ be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e nɛfa fo kasawule
nseŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kama
nite nɛnɛ n sa Israɛlebi nɛ
b la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na.
2Fo e ta fo basa be alubi
m paŋ bumo nɛ kejimbri
maŋ naa wɔ bumo so.
3Fo daŋ kaa kagbene nna,
n nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo.
4O Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo la anyi be emɔlgapo,
naŋ bɛta anyi m ba fo kutɔ,
nsaa maŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ anyi!
5Feeŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ anyi nɛ
anyi be nnaŋ to ebi mbaanaayɔ a?
6Naŋ sa anyi eleŋ nɛ anyi,
nɛ an la fo basa na be ŋgbene
e baa fuli fo so nɛ an baa kpaŋ fo.
7O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋini anyi fo kasha nɛ
k maŋ kɔ ekar na,
nseŋ kumɔlga anyi.
8Mee kaŋ kusoe a nu kusɔ nɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nna.
E nase kayurwushi be kɔnɔ n sa
anyi, mbe basa; nɛ anyi maŋ naŋ
bɛta n yɔ anyi be kawulisheŋ to nna.
9Kashenteŋto e wora shiriya
nɛ e mɔlga bekama nɛ baa
ŋana mo na nna;
saŋɛ na so mo gbagba be
kemaŋkura beeŋ baa wɔ
anyi be kasawule so.
10Kasha nɛ kashenteŋji
beeŋ ba abar so,
nɛ alelasheŋ nɛ kayurwushi
malɛ e ki kukoŋwule.
11Edimɛdi be kashenteŋji
beeŋ shi kasawule so nna;
nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kebaawɔtɔ
niŋiso bee shi ebɔrɛso.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ
nɛfa anyi nɛ anyi be kasawule
e wora adɔjibi nɛnɛ.
13Kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso beeŋ juŋkpar
a lɔŋɛ akpa a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ e baa bɛ so.

Title: NSHƐ 86
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin kechɛto be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kekule,
ŋkpal manɛ so, etirpo nɛ
etentaŋasepo e la ma.
2Ŋkpal ŋ kaa bee nu a sa fo so,
mɔlga ma ashi luwu to.
Ŋkpal ŋ ka la fo kayɛrbi
nseŋ yirda fo so, baa kuŋ ma.
3O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu ma kuwɔr!
Kachɛ lelemu nɛ mee shu a tre fo.
4Shin nɛ fo kayɛrbi be kagbene
e fuli mo;
ŋkpal ŋ ka shi ma kagbene
to a kule fo so.
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo la esa lela
nɛ fee ta alubi a paŋ nna.
Fo alɛ kɔ kasha damta n sa
bumo nɛ baa shu a tre fo na nna.
6O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kabɔrɛkule,
nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr n chɛ ma to.
7M baa wɔ tɔrɔ to,
fo nɛ mee shu a tre;
ma alɛ nyi fanɛ fee
nu ma kabɔrɛkule.
8O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
agbirana kikɛ maŋ du fanɛ fo,
Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ
a du fanɛ fo.
Esa malɛ kikɛ maŋ naŋ wora
asheŋ nɛ fee wora ere be kekama.
9Efuliana nɛ fo to ere be basa
beeŋ ba jɔŋɛ fo ase m bunyaŋ fo
n shin nɛ fo ketre e nya kemaŋkura.
10Fo ka la Ebɔrɛ so,
fo nawule e naa wora
emamachisheŋ nɛ e
bee mɔ kɔnɔ.
11O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋini ma kusɔ nɛ fee sha fanɛ n wora.
Meeŋ baa nu a sa fo kashenteŋ na.
Ŋini ma kananɛ meeŋ ta ma kagbene
kikɛ a shuŋ fo nsaa bunyaŋ fo ketre na.
12O Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ bugi ma kagbene to ŋ kpaŋ fo,
nseŋ maŋkura fo ketre mbaanaayɔ.
13Ŋkpal manɛ so,
kasha nɛ fo kɔ n sa ma na
shi alegaiso!
Fo mɔlga ma ashi luwu
gbagba to.
14O Ebɔrɛ, kamoowuwuraana
koso ma so nna;
nɛ basa lubi cha abar a fin ma
nɛ b mɔ.
Bumo alɛ kikɛ maŋ ta fo n tre shɛŋ.
15Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
la ewɔrwupo nɛ kasha be Ebɔrɛ nna.
Fo la esa nna nsaa kɔ kanyiti,
a wu kuwɔr jemanɛ kikɛ.
16Keni ma nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr!
Sa fo kayɛrbi fo gbagba be eleŋ na
nseŋ mɔlga fo kenyache pibinyɛn.
17Shin nɛ ekama e pin alelasheŋ
nɛ fee wora a sa ma.
Saŋɛ na so ma doŋana beeŋ wu
kumo be loŋ nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ bumo.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e chɛ ma to nseŋ lolo ma
nɛ ma kagbene wushi ma.

Title: NSHƐ 87
Content:
Jerusalɛm be kekpaŋ be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na pɔr mbe
kadegboŋ n yili kebee
cheembi na so nna.
2Mo alɛ bee sha kadegboŋ na
a chɔ kade kikɛ ashi Israɛl
be efuli na kikɛ so.
3Jerusalɛm la Ebɔrɛ be kadegboŋ nna,
nɛ baa malga asheŋ lela damta ga
a laŋɛ kumo be kaplɛa so.
4Nɛ m baa ti efuliana nɛ a bee nu
a sa ma be atre, meeŋ ti Ijipt nɛ
Babilɔn be efuliana n ti so.
Nɛ m baa naa karga Jerusalɛm
to be basa, meeŋ karga Filisti nɛ
Itiopia be efuliana nɛ Tayɛ
be kadegboŋ to be basa gba n ti so.
5Kashenteŋto, kusɔ nɛ baaŋ baa kaŋɛ
a laŋɛ Jerusalɛm be kaplɛa so nde:
“Jerusalɛm to nɛ b kurge kuti nɛ kuti.
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na malɛ e naa
sa kumo eleŋ.”
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ
b sibɛ mbe basa be atre n nase
nseŋ ta bekama nɛ b kurge ndoŋ
gba be atre n ti so fanɛ b ka la
Jerusalɛm to be ndetobia na;
7nɛ bumo be bekama nɛ baaŋ
baa boŋ nshɛ a cha na e baa kaŋɛ le:
“Anyi alɛ gba la Jerusalɛm to be
ndetobia gbagba nna.”

Title: NSHƐ 88
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ be kechɛto be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ fo la ma emɔlgapo,
kapa nɛ kanyɛ,
fo nɛ mee shu a tre.
2Jande nu ma kabɔrɛkule
nseŋ kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kushu.
3Etɔrɔ damta e ba ma so,
hale nɛ n taga to luwu.
4Baa karga ma nna a ti
basa nɛ b wu so;
ŋ ki fanɛ esa nɛ e maŋ
naa kɔ eleŋ nna.
5Ŋ ki fanɛ ebuni nɛ b kplaŋ
mbe asheŋ so ŋko esa nɛ
b mɔ m puli nchaŋ to nna.
Ŋko esa nɛ fo maŋ naa
nyiŋi mbe asheŋ,
fo alɛ be kechɛto maŋ naa
tu mo na nna.
6Fo ta ma n lɛ nchaŋ chiŋgeliŋ
nɛ k biri to mina to nna.
7Fo kanya agbo muni ma so nna
fanɛ nchu ka muni esa so na.
8Fo shin nɛ nteriana kini ma n lɛ,
nɛ ma asheŋ bee nu bumo agbo.
M baŋ nyaŋto nna a wɔtɔ,
a maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n suge ma kumu.
9Ma alɛ shu nna m puŋi anishi,
ŋkpal awurfoŋ nɛ kagbenejijaso.
O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ mee maŋ
ma enɔana so a shu a tre
karechɛ kikɛ.
10Fo maa wora emamachisheŋ
a sa bubuni.
Bumo alɛ maa koso a kpaŋ fo.
11B maa malga fo kasha
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na
ŋko fo kashenteŋji be asheŋ
ashi bubuni to.
12B maa wu fo emamachisheŋ
ashi kakpa nɛ k biri to mina;
ŋko a nyi fo alelasheŋ be asheŋ
ashi kakpa nɛ b maŋ naa nyiŋi
shɛŋ be asheŋ.
