13Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ mee shu a tre kachipurso
kikɛ fanɛ fo chɛ ma to.
14O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
manɛ nna nɛ fee kini ma a lɛ,
nsaa ta fo kumu a ŋana ma so?
15Ma kebia to kikɛ nɛ n ji awurfoŋ,
hale a taga to luwu gba kuraa.
Fo kasogberge shin nɛ kufugboŋ
tɔr ma so, hale ma aba pɔ ma ga.
16Fo agbo ki fanɛ nchu nna
m muni ma so;
nɛ fo etɔrɔ malɛ mur ma cheche.
17Karechɛ kikɛ a kulti ma
n wɔtɔ kaba kama so nna.
18Fo shin nɛ nteri kpakpasoana
nɛ ma beshapo kikɛ kini ma n lɛ
nseŋ kplaŋ ma so, nɛ k wora fanɛ
tentembiri e ki nteri kpakpaso.

Title: NSHƐ 89
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ Deevid ka wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ baa boŋ nshɛ a laŋɛ
fo kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na
be kaplɛa so jemanɛ kikɛ.
Ma alɛ beeŋ naa ber fo
kashenteŋji na be kebomboŋ
mbaanaayɔ.
2Meeŋ kaŋɛ ekama fanɛ fo kasha
wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ,
nɛ fo kashenteŋji malɛ wɔ
ebɔrɛso jemanɛ kikɛ.
3Fo yɛ: “Ma nɛ esa nɛ n lara na
wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nna.
Ma alɛ nase kɔnɔ nna n sa ma
kayɛrbi Deevid fanɛ
4mbe kaman to ebi e naaŋ baa
ki bewura jemanɛ kikɛ.
Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ mbe kabuna
ebi e baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.”
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ ebɔrɛso
e baa kpaŋ fo emamachisheŋ,
nseŋ shin nɛ fo emalaika e baa
kpaŋ fo kashenteŋji.
6Ekama maŋ du fanɛ fo,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ashi ebɔrɛso;
Ekama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ta mbe
kumu m ber fo ashi ndoŋ.
7Fo nɛ ekama bee ŋana ga
ashi ebɔrɛso ndoŋ.
Fo asheŋ malɛ bee keta
kufu nsaa kɔ bunyaŋ ga
a chɔ bekama nɛ b wɔ
ebɔrɛso.
8Fo e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.
Ekama maŋ naa kɔ kasha
nsaa ji kashenteŋ fanɛ fo.
9Fo e naa ji kuwura ashi teku
nɛ k bee baga to na so,
a shin nɛ atili nɛ a bee koso
kumo so na bee wora shruum.
10Fo e daŋ to m pɛ teku to
be kusɔbɔya lubi gboŋgboŋi
nɛ baa tre Reehab na to kpakpa
nseŋ mɔ kumo na.
Fo gbagba be eleŋgboŋ nɛ fo ta
m pɔɔ fo doŋana so, nseŋ shin nɛ
b pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama.
11Ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so
kikɛ la feya nna;
fo e to durnya nɛ kusɔ
kama nɛ k wɔ kumo to.
12Fo e to kelargato be esoso
nɛ kaseto kikɛ.
K du fanɛ abee nɛ baa tre
Tabɔɔ nɛ Hɛɛmɔn na bee boŋ
nshɛ kagbenefuliso nna
a kpaŋ fo ketre.
13Fo shibi nsaa kɔ eleŋ pasaa!
14Fee ji kuwura ekpa niŋiso so,
nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna.
Kasha nɛ kashenteŋji bee dii efuli
kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora to nna.
15O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ baa
bugi ŋgbene to a bunyaŋ fo
nsaa wɔ fo kefultogboŋ na to
na peya nna.
16Baa ji eyur nna ashi fo ketre to
karechɛ lelemu kikɛ,
nsaa kpaŋ fo ŋkpal fo alelasheŋ so.
17Ŋkpal manɛ so,
bumo be kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ
shi fo kutɔ nna, nɛ fo
kuwɔrwu malɛ bee shin nɛ
anyee nya eleŋ a ti so.
18Kashenteŋto, anyi be kekuŋ
bee shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nna.
Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na
e la anyi be ewura.
19Le nɛ fo daŋ bɔla bɔrɛdare to
ŋ kaŋɛ fo bebɛsopo nɛ baa
ji kashenteŋ a sa fo na:
“Ma e naa sa enapo eleŋ.
Ma alɛ e ta kuwurputi na
n sa esa nɛ ŋ gbagba lara
ashi ma basa to.
20Ma e lara ma kayɛrbi Deevid
nseŋ duga ma ŋku cheembi
n do mbe kumu so n ta
mo ŋ ki ewura.
21Jemanɛ kikɛ ma eleŋ
beeŋ baa wɔ mo so,
nɛ ma eleŋgboŋ na
e baa sa mo eleŋ.
22Mo doŋana maaŋ tiŋ
m pɔɔ mo so kikɛ,
kumukpakpasowuraana gba
beeŋ kɔ mo ŋ gben.
23Meeŋ tɔrɔ mo doŋana ga
nseŋ mɔ ekama nɛ e kishi mo.
24Ma kashenteŋji be kasha na
beeŋ baa wɔ mo so;
ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ e baa
kɔ a pɔɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ.
25Meeŋ shin nɛ mbe kuwurji e yili
Teku nɛ baa tre Mɛditerenia na
n salga to n ya fo lɔr nɛ baa
tre Yufreetes na.
26Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le:
‘Fo e la n tuto nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ;
Fo e la ma ekumpo nɛ
ma emɔlgapo.’
27Meeŋ shin nɛ e ki ma wurkoŋnyɛn,
nseŋ ki esagboŋ a chɔ durnya to
be bewura kikɛ.
28Jemanɛ kikɛ meeŋ baa wora
a bɔlɔ ma nnɔ nɛ n nase a sa mo;
nɛ ma nɛ mo be kɔnɔkoŋwule
be ŋkre na e baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
29Meeŋ shin nɛ mbe kabuna ebi
e baa ji kuwura mbaanaayɔ;
mbe kanaŋ to be esa e naaŋ
baa ji kuwura jemanɛ kikɛ.
30Ama nɛ fanɛ mbe kaman to ebi
kini kewora ma mbraana kasonu,
nseŋ kini kewora m bɔlɔ ma
atande so,
31ŋko nɛ b kplaŋ ma keŋini so
nsaa maŋ bɛ ma mbraana so,
32kumo ere meeŋ gberge bumo
kusoe ŋkpal bumo be alubi so.
Meeŋ shin nɛ b ji awurfoŋ
ŋkpal bumo be kewora n jija so.
33Ama m maaŋ yige kebaasha Deevid,
ŋko ŋ kini kebɛ nnɔ nɛ n nase
n sa mo na so.
34Ma alɛ maaŋ ku ma nɛ mo
be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na to,
ŋko n lar nnɔ nɛ n nase n sa mo
na be kekama kaman.
35Kelekoŋwule pati nɛ n ta ma
Ketre cheembi na m bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ,
m maaŋ ku efɛ n sa Deevid kikɛ.
36Mbe kanaŋ to ebi e naaŋ baa
ji kuwura jemanɛ kikɛ.
Kananɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl baa
lar awɔlpa so ere,
aloŋ nɛ mbe kuwurji gba beeŋ baa
wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
37Mbe kuwurji na beeŋ baa wɔtɔ
mbaanaayɔ nna fanɛ kananɛ
kufɔl baa wɔ esoso mbaanaayɔ na.”
38Ama naniere fo, Ebɔrɛ na
nya agbo nna n wɔtɔ ewura
nɛ fo lara na nseŋ kini mo n lɛ,
nseŋ pal kaman n sa mo.
39Fo lar fo nɛ fo kayɛrbi be
kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na
kaman kuraa nseŋ shin nɛ
mbe kuwura terge m paŋ
kumo be kemaŋkura kikɛ.
40Fo shin nɛ egbal nɛ a kulti
kadegboŋ na kikɛ bure
nɛ kumo be mboŋ lempoana na
kikɛ ki alambure a dese.
41Bekama nɛ b bɔla kumo ase
a choŋ nya ewura na be asɔ ko n ta,
nɛ mbe bechenashapoana bee
mushe mo nsaa wora mo eyurto.
42Fo shin nɛ mo doŋana
sɔ kelempo mo so,
nɛ bumo kikɛ be ŋgbene
fuli bumo.
43Fo shin nɛ mbe akɔsɔ kikɛ
ki asɔ jiga,
nseŋ shin nɛ e kɔ kena n tɔr.
44Fo suge mbe kuwurwuro
n shin nɛ mbe kuwura paŋ
kumo be kemaŋkura.
45Fo shin nɛ e bel katinso
nɛ e kraa la kebifɔlbi,
nseŋ ta anishinyɔr be piŋi
m buu mo nɛ nyɔmɔ pɛ mo.
46O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
feeŋ ta fo kumu ŋ ŋana
mbaanaayɔ a?
Jemanɛ mo nɛ fo agbo
nɛ k bee suse fanɛ edɛ na
beeŋ wushi?
47Baa nyiŋi fanɛ ma ŋkpa
maŋ wɔ nteŋ.
Fo to anyi nna nɛ an baa wɔ ŋkpa
to gbrɛbi nseŋ wu!
48Dimɛdi kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n suge
mbe kumu ashi luwu nɛ nchaŋ
be eleŋana to.
49O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nnɛ nɛ kashagboŋ nɛ fo
daa kɔ na wɔ?
Nnɔ nɛ fo nase kashenteŋ
be ekpa so n sa Deevid
na wɔ nnɛ?
50Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baa nyiŋi
kananɛ basa tege ma
nseŋ wora fo kayɛrbi eyurto,
nɛ n ta amo kikɛ n wɔtɔ
kagbene to na be asheŋ.
51O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
fo doŋana bee tege ewura
nɛ fo lara n sa fo kumu nna na.
Kaplɛkama nɛ e yɔ, baa tege mo
nsaa wora mo eyurto nna.
52Men baa kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
mbaanaayɔ!
Amɛn! Amɛn!

Title: NSHƐ 90
Content:
KENASOPO
(Nshɛ 90—106)
Mosis be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo kutɔ e la anyi pe,
jemanɛ kikɛ.
2Pɔɛŋ nɛ fo to abeeana nɛ
kasawule nɛ durnya kikɛ na,
nɛ fo la Ebɔrɛ nna nsaa
wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
3Fo e yili kumo fanɛ an baa wu
nsaa bɛta a yɔ eshishɛr to.
4Nfɛ kagboŋ du fanɛ kachɛ
koŋwule fo kutɔ nna,
ŋko kanyɛso be jemanɛ
gbrɛbi ko ka choŋ nna.
5Fo e naa shin nɛ anyi be ŋkpa
bee ba ekar fanɛ edare na.
An du fanɛ kachipurso be afitiri
nɛ a purge a walɛ nna.
6Kachipurso, afitiri bee daŋ nna
a purge a walɛ;
ama ta a ba kaaseso nɛ a bolo
nseŋ wu n wɔl.
7Fo kanya agbo bee ta kufu nna
a da anyi nsaa mur anyi kuraa.
8Fo alɛ nyi anyi be alubi
kikɛ be asheŋ;
hale amo nɛ an ŋana n wora
ashiri to gba.
9Anyi be nchɛ bee ku so nna
ŋkpal fo agbo so,
nfubel damta malɛ e bɔlɔ nfɛ
nɛ anyee ji kikɛ to.
10Nfɛ nɛ anyee ji kikɛ la nfɛ
adushunu nna,
nɛ an baa kɔ eleŋ malɛ nɛ
an ji nfɛ aduburwa;
Ama etɔrɔ wurbi nɛ kagbenejija
damta e wɔ amo to,
ŋkpal manɛ so, a maa chɛr
nsaa choŋ fanɛ afu.
11Esa kikɛ maŋ nyi kananɛ
fo agbo be eleŋ sa.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, k shi alegaiso,
nseŋ daga fanɛ an baa ŋana fo
ŋkpal kumo so.
12Ŋini anyi kananɛ anyi be nchɛ sa,
saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ baa wora
asheŋ kanyiasheŋ so.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, chɛ anyi to!
Sa maŋ naŋ jo gbrɛbi kama!
Wu fo nyɛrbi kuwɔr,
n shu anyi so!
14Kachipurso kikɛ, shin nɛ fo kasha
nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na e kukwe anyi,
saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ baa ta kagbenefuli
a boŋ nshɛ anyi be kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to.
15Shin nɛ an nya kagbenefuli n tal
nchɛ nɛ anyi be ŋgbene jija anyi na to.
16Wora emamachisheŋ n sa anyi,
fo nyɛrbi, nseŋ shin nɛ anyi
be mbia e wu fo eleŋgboŋ na.
17Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ fo nɛfa e baa wɔ anyi so,
nseŋ shin nɛ asheŋ e baa nite
nsaa loge to nɛnɛ a sa anyi!

Title: NSHƐ 91
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka la anyi be ekumpo be asheŋ
1Esa kama nɛ e shile n ya
mata Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
e naŋ nya mbe kekuŋ.
2Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na le:
“Fo nɛ mee shile n ya kaa
mata nɛ fee kuŋ ma,
fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ n yirda fo.”
3Kashenteŋto, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ kuŋ fo ashi ajigbelɛ
nɛ alɔ mɔso kikɛ to.
4E beeŋ parga mbe atɛ m buu
fo so a kuŋ fo nɛ fo nya fo kumu,
Mbe kashenteŋji du fanɛ
kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋkumuso
ŋko egbal nɛ k bee kuŋ kade nna.
5Fo maaŋ naa ŋana kanyɛso
be asɔ nɛ a bee keta kufu
ŋko kapaso be kelantokɔ kikɛ,
6ŋko tentembiri to be alɔ mɔso
ŋko kapiidi be kayurnyaŋ lubi kikɛ.
7Basa kagboŋ beeŋ tiŋ n wu
n dese fo kekel ko so,
nɛ ŋgboŋ kudu e wu
n dese fo jisoso,
ama shɛŋ maaŋ wora fo ere.
8Fo anishi nɛ feeŋ
ta n wu kasogberge nɛ
kumukpakpasowuraana beeŋ nya.
9Nɛ fo ta Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
fanɛ esa nɛ fee shile n ya kaa mata
nɛ e baa kuŋ fo,
10kumo ere alɔ lubi maaŋ ba fo so,
ŋko ŋ bɔla fo kowu ase n choŋ gba.
11Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ
shin nɛ mbe emalaika e baa kuŋ
fo ashi kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora to.
12Baaŋ ta bumo be enɔana
n suse fo to,
nɛ fo maaŋ doro fo anashibi
kejembu so.
13Feeŋ pɔɔ ebuluŋ lempo so
nseŋ chichi awɔ lubi gba so,
nɛ e maaŋ tiŋ n wora fo shɛŋ.
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ:
“Nɛ fee sha ma nsaa nyi esa
nɛ e la ma kashenteŋto,
meeŋ mɔlga fo nsaa kuŋ fo.
15Nɛ fo luri asheŋ to nseŋ
shu n tre ma,
meeŋ nu fo kekule m ba mɔlga fo
nseŋ ta kemaŋkura m buu fo so.
16Meeŋ sa fo ŋkpa tenteŋ
nseŋ ŋini fo ma kumɔlga.”

Title: NSHƐ 92
Content:
Keboŋ nshɛ n fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
1Kekpaŋ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ keboŋ nshɛ n dele mo walɛ ga.
2Keber mbe kasha be asheŋ
be kebomboŋ kachipurso,
nɛ mbe kashenteŋji be asheŋ
kanyɛso gba walɛ ga.
3Keta alaŋsɔ be yiri kikɛ
a boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ fo ketre
bee wora ma ebel
nsaa par ma ga.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo asheŋ woraso bee wushi
ma kagbene nna, a shin nɛ
mee tiŋ a boŋ nshɛ
kagbenefuliso,
O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fee wora asheŋgboŋ pasaa,
fo nfɛra fɛso malɛ du
chiŋgeliŋ alegaiso!
6Esa nɛ e maŋ nyi asheŋ
maa pin fo asheŋ to;
ewulpo malɛ maaŋ tiŋ
m pin amo to fanɛ,
7kumukpakpasowura beeŋ tiŋ
m purge fanɛ afitiri,
nɛ belubiworapoana e nya asɔ
nseŋ dii dama.
E maŋ nyi fanɛ bumo kikɛ beeŋ
mur cheche mbaanaayɔ.
8Fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ baa
ji kuwura kusɔ kama so mbaanaayɔ.
9An nyi fanɛ fo doŋana beeŋ mur
kashenteŋto,
nɛ alubiworapoana kikɛ
e pesaŋ to.
10Fo shin nɛ n nya eleŋ
fanɛ kupuntona nna,
nɛ fo lara ma n yili n sa
fo gbagba be kumu.
11Ŋ gbagba be anishi wu,
nɛ ma asoe nu kumulubi
nɛ kemur nɛ a ba bedoŋ so.
12Basa lela beeŋ dii dama
fanɛ ŋkubadibi ka purge na;
baaŋ daŋ n yili fanɛ Lebanɔn
be ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na.
13Baaŋ mur achin ashi fo,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be laŋ to,
nseŋ nyalɛ ashi anyi be
Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu to.
14Baaŋ baa du fanɛ ndibi nɛ e bel
nseŋ kraa kɔ eleŋ a sɔr asɔrso.
15Saŋɛ na so nɛ b baa kaŋɛ le:
“Kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
wora niŋi nna!
Ebɔrɛ e la anyi be kefaltagboŋ
a kuŋ anyi,
kulubi kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to.”

Title: NSHƐ 93
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka la ewura be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura.
Kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ eleŋ
buu mo nna fanɛ kuwurpiŋi.
Mo e tɔl durnya n yili kpakpa,
nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n fifir kumo.
2Dra na kikɛ nɛ fee ji kuwura,
fo alɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
etekuana bee baga to nna
a wora awɔr fanɛ e ka
bugi ebɔl a boŋ nshɛ na!
Atiligboŋ bee koso
etekuana so nna pasaa!
4Teku so be atili bee wora
awɔr nna nsaa kɔ eleŋ ga,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be eleŋ shi a chɔ amo
be eleŋana.
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo mbraana wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ,
jemanɛ kikɛ fo bɔrɛlambu na du
cheembi nna nsaa walɛ kebita.

Title: NSHƐ 94
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka la ekama be demujipo be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ fee gberge
basa nɛ b wora n jija kusoe;
ŋini bumo esa nɛ e la fo
nseŋ gberge bumo kusoe!
2Fo e naa ji durnya kikɛ demu.
Ba chɛ anyi to!
Ka kamoowuwuraana kukɔ,
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora so.
3O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, saŋɛ mo nɛ
kumukpakpasowuraana
be kagbenefuliso be kamooji ere
beeŋ fo ekar?
4Basa lubi ere bee nite nna
a puchi bumo be asheŋ lubi so.
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
baa mɛaŋ basa nna a pira bumo;
fo gbagba be basa laraso
nɛ baa mɛaŋ.
6Baa mɔ bekulpoche nɛ amunibi
nɛ befɔ nɛ b wɔ kasawule na so nna.
7Kumo be kaman nɛ b kaŋɛ le:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa wu anyi.
Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na be shɛŋ
maŋ wɔ anyi to.”
8Ma basa, manɛ nna nɛ men
paŋ nfɛra loŋ?
Saŋɛ mo nɛ menyi beeŋ naŋ
nya kanyiasheŋ?
9Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to anyi be
asoe nɛ anishi na,
maŋ kɔ asoe a nu nɛ
anishi a wu nna a?
10Mo ere Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee
fɛa efuliana na so na;
nɛ b wora n da mo so,
e maaŋ gberge bumo kusoe a?
Mo ere nɛ e bee ŋini bumo
asheŋ na bre maŋ nyi asheŋ a?
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nyi
dimɛdi kikɛ be nfɛra ka la
nfɛra fuloŋ a maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ.
12Kagbenefuli la ekama nɛ fo
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee bela
nsaa ŋini mo fo mbra na peya nna!
13Fo e naa wushi mo kagbene
ashi mbe tɔrɔ to,
n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ kur
kemaŋ n nase nɛ
kumukpakpasowura e tɔr to.
14Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
maaŋ kini fo basa n lɛ;
fo alɛ maaŋ kplaŋ efuli nɛ fo
gbagba lara na so.
15Demujipoana beeŋ baa ji
asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so,
nɛ basa niŋiso malɛ e yili
bumo be kaman.
16Wanɛ e naŋ yili ma kaman
n tu ma ŋ kɔ basa lubi ere?
17Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
daa maŋ chɛ ma to,
ndafanɛ n wu n yɔ bubuni to.
18Ŋ ka daŋ fɛrge a shin nɛ tɔr
nseŋ boŋ to na,
fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e bɔla fo
kasha nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na so
n suse ma to nɛ n yili dindiŋ.
19Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ kafɔŋ
damta baŋ tɔr ma so,
fo e naa lolo ma a
wushi ma kagbene.
20Ama fo maa sa basa nɛ b maa
ta mbra a shuŋ na kashuli kikɛ.
21Loŋ be basa e naa kre
basa lela ŋkre lubi nsaa kaŋɛ
fanɛ basa nɛ b maŋ wora n jija
e daga luwu na.
22Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e ki kakpa lempo
nɛ kefaltagboŋ a kuŋ ma.
23Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge
kumukpakpasowuraana kusoe
nseŋ mur bumo ŋkpal bumo be
asheŋ lubi so.
Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na
e naŋ mur bumo.

Title: NSHƐ 95
Content:
Kapandi be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Men ba nɛ an boŋ kagbenefuli
be nshɛ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e bee kuŋ anyi na.
2Men shin nɛ an ta kapandi
m ba boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ mo.
3Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ewurgboŋ;
agbirana maŋ la shɛŋ mbe anishito.
4Asɔ nɛ a wɔ kasawule be
kechimbi to nɛ abee be awɔlto
kikɛ be eleŋ bɔɔ mbe enɔ nna.
5Teku la mo peya nna,
ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e to kumo.
Mo gbagba be enɔana
nɛ e ta n tɔl kasawule.
6Men ba nɛ an jɔŋɛ m bunyaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to anyi na!
7Mo e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
nɛ anyi alɛ la mbe basa.
An du fanɛ mbe mbolpɔ
nɛ e bee keni so nna.
Men baŋ nu mbe ebɔl kabre,
8men sa maŋ wora menyi
be ŋgbene kpakpa, fanɛ kananɛ
men nanaana daŋ wora ashi mboŋ
nɛ baa tre Mɛriba nɛ Maasa ashi
keshishɛrsawule so na.
9Asheŋ nɛ b daŋ wu Ebɔrɛ
ka wora na kikɛ be kaman,
b daŋ chɔ mo nseŋ wora mo
ŋ keni ndoŋana nna.
10Nfɛ adena nɛ bumo be asheŋ
daa nu Ebɔrɛ agbo, nɛ e kaŋɛ le:
“Saŋkikɛ basa ere bee wora
a foe ekpa nna;
bumo alɛ maa pin ma
asheŋ woraso to.”
11Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna
nseŋ bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le:
“B maaŋ luri ma
kewushi na to kikɛ!”

Title: NSHƐ 96
Content:
Men boŋ kashɛ popɔr n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
1Ekama nɛ e wɔ durnya to,
e boŋ kashɛ popɔr
n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
2Men boŋ kashɛ n sa
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nseŋ kpaŋ mbe ketre na.
Karechɛ kama men baa ber
mbe kumɔlga na be asheŋ
be kubomboŋ.
3Men baa malga mbe kemaŋkura
nɛ asheŋgboŋ be asheŋ a sa basa
nɛ b wɔ efuliana kikɛ so.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ shi ga,
nseŋ daga fanɛ ekama e baa kpaŋ mo
nsaa ŋana mo a chɔ agbirana kikɛ.
5Efuli pɔtɛana so ebi bee
shuŋ agbirana nna;
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e to ebɔrɛso.
6E kɔ kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋgboŋ,
nɛ eleŋgboŋ nɛ kela bɔlɔ
mbe bɔrɛlambu to.
7Durnya to be basa kikɛ e kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, nseŋ shuli so
fanɛ kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ la mo
peya nna.
8Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be ketre nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura na;
nseŋ ta esarga m ba
mbe bɔrɛlambu to.
9Men baa yili Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be kela nɛ kecheembiya so a bunyaŋ.
Durnya to ebi kikɛ e ta kechicha chicha
m ba mbe anishito.
10Men kaŋɛ efuliana na so ebi le:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ewura!
Mo e tɔl durnya na n yili dindiŋ
nɛ k maa fifir;
mo alɛ e naaŋ ji basa kikɛ demu
nɛ e maŋ puni eko.”
11Kaŋɛ esoso nɛ kasawule so ebi
fanɛ b shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene
e wushi bumo nɛ b baa ji eyur!
Shin nɛ teku nɛ kumo to be asɔ
keniso kikɛ e baa wora awɔr,
12nseŋ shin nɛ adɔsawule nɛ adɔjibi
nɛ a wɔ amo so na gba e ji eyur.
Kumo be kaman nɛ kupo to
be ndibi kikɛ e boŋ nshɛ
kagbenefuliso
13n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
E bee ba nɛ e ba bɔla
ekpa niŋiso nɛ kashenteŋ so nna
n ji basa nɛ b wɔ durnya to demu.

Title: NSHƐ 97
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ewura!
Shin nɛ durnya kikɛ e ji eyur
nɛ mplasawule kikɛ e wora awɔr.
2Bɔrɛwɔlpa nɛ tentembiri mina
e kulti mo n wɔtɔ kaplɛkama.
Mo alɛ bee ji mbe kuwura ekpa niŋiso
nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna.
3Edɛ e naa juŋkpar mo a chɔɔ
mo doŋana kaba kama so a mur.
4Mo e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛ bee
nyɛkpɛ nɛ durnya bee fulto,
nɛ kasawule so ebi bee
wu kumo a chicha.
5Abee bee ŋalga fanɛ kemar ashi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la durnya kikɛ
be Enyɛnpe na be anishito nna.
6Ebɔrɛso bee ber mbe kebaawɔtɔ
niŋiso be kebomboŋ nna,
nɛ efuliana na kikɛ be basa
bee wu mbe kemaŋkura.
7Bekama nɛ baa shuŋ agbirana ŋko
a puchi amo so na bee ŋaba nna;
ŋkpal manɛ so, agbirana kikɛ
maŋ la shɛŋ Ebɔrɛ be anishito.
8O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, Jerusalɛm to
nɛ Juda be efuli so be ndeana to
be basa be ŋgbene fuli nna,
nɛ baa ji eyur ŋkpal fo demuji so.
9Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa ji kuwura durnya kikɛ ebi so.
Fo alɛ shi ga a chɔ agbirana kikɛ.
10Bekama nɛ baa sha
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kishi kulubi nna.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa kuŋ mbe basa
nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ a sa mo na be ŋkpa
nsaa kɔ a suge bumo ashi
kumukpakpasowuraana be enɔ to.
11Kefulto bee nyaŋɛ a yuu
basa niŋiso so nna,
nɛ ŋgbenefufulwuraana malɛ
bee nya kagbenefuli.
12Menyi nɛ men wɔ kebaawɔtɔ
niŋiso to e shin nɛ menyi be
ŋgbene e fuli menyi ŋkpal kusɔ
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora so.
Men baa nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ
cheembi na bee wora
nsaa di mo epaŋ.

Title: NSHƐ 98
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka bee wora emamachisheŋ be asheŋ
1Men boŋ kashɛ popɔr n sa
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Mo e ta mbe enɔ lempo
cheembi na n wora
emamachisheŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so na.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara mbe
kumɔlga nɛ kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso
ŋ ŋini efuli pɔtɛana so be basa.
3E nyiŋi mbe kasha nɛ kashenteŋji
nɛ e kɔ n sa Israɛlebi na be asheŋ.
Bekama nɛ b wɔ kasawule so
be kaplɛkama wu anyi be
Ebɔrɛ na be kumɔlga.
4Durnya to be basa kikɛ e boŋ
nshɛ kagbenefuliso ŋ kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
5Men laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ m boŋ nshɛ
belbelso n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
6Men foŋ mbel m boŋ nshɛ
n ji eyur kagbenefuliso;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na
e la ewura!
7Shin nɛ teku nɛ kumo to
be asɔ keniso kikɛ,
nɛ kasawule nɛ kumo so
be basa kikɛ
e baa wora awɔr a kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
8Shin nɛ elɔrana e baa gbri fanɛ
a ka bee kpla enɔ na,
nɛ abeebi so e baa gbri fanɛ
a ka bee cha abar a boŋ nshɛ
kagbenefuliso ashi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishito.
9Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa ba nɛ
e ba ji kuwura kasawule so.
E beeŋ ba bɔla ekpa niŋiso so
n ji esa kama nɛ e wɔ kasawule
so demu nɛ e maŋ kpɛa ekama to.

Title: NSHƐ 99
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka la bewura to be ewura be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura!
Efuliana kikɛ so be basa e baa chicha.
E chena mbe kuwurputi nɛ
emalaika nɛ b kɔ aba wɔ kumo
be kaseto na so nna;
nɛ kasawule bee gbuŋgbuŋ.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la esagboŋ nna
ashi Jerusalɛm to;
mo e kɔ eleŋ efuliana na kikɛ so.
3Ekama beeŋ kpaŋ mbe ketregboŋ
nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga na.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, e du cheembi nna.
4Ewura na la esagboŋ nna,
nsaa sha kebaaji asheŋ nɛ
amo be ekpa so.
Mo e yili keji asheŋ nɛ amo
be ekpa so ashi Israɛl be
efuli so be kaplɛkama.
5Men baa maŋ Enyɛnpe
anyi be Ebɔrɛ na so,
nsaa bunyaŋ mo ashi mbe
kuwurputi ase.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
e du cheembi nna.
6Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn daa la
mbe bɔrɛmatapoana nna,
nɛ anebi Samuɛl malɛ daa la
esa nɛ e daa bɔla Ebɔrɛ
be ketre to a kule mo.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ bumo
kikɛ daa shu a tre,
nɛ e daa nu a sa bumo.
7E daŋ bɔla kuwɔlpa to nna
m malga n sa Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn;
nɛ bumo alɛ daŋ wora mbe
mbraana nɛ atande nɛ e ta
n sa bumo na kasonu.
8O Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ,
fo e daŋ nu bumo be kekule,
nseŋ ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo.
Ama b ka naŋ wora kusɔ
nɛ k maŋ daga na,
fo gberge bumo kusoe nna.
9Anyee kpaŋ fo,
Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na,
nsaa bunyaŋ fo ashi fo
kebee cheembi na ase.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na
du cheembi nna.

Title: NSHƐ 100
Content:
Kapandi be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Durnya to be basa kikɛ,
e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
2Men baa bunyaŋ mo
kagbenefuliso,
nsaa boŋ kagbenefuli be
nshɛ a sa mo.
3Men baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na
e la Ebɔrɛ!
Mo e to anyi nɛ an la mbe basa;
an du fanɛ mbe mbolpɔ nna
nɛ e bee keni so.
4Men bɔla mbe bɔrɛlambu na
be mbunagboŋ to n luri mbe
kelɔnɛ so m ba di mo epaŋ,
nseŋ kpaŋ mo.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na walɛ ga!
Mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge na,
nɛ mbe kashenteŋji malɛ wɔtɔ
nna mbaanaayɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 101
Content:
Ewura be kɔnɔ naseso be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ boŋ kashɛ a laŋɛ
fo kasha nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ
amo be ekpa so be kaplɛa so.
2Jande, chɛ ma to nɛ ŋ koya
kebaawora asheŋ niŋiso;
saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa ji
kashenteŋ nsaa maa kɔ
ŋkpɛato ashi ma kuwurji to.
3Ma alɛ beeŋ kishi kusɔ
nɛ basa nɛ b pal kaman
n sa Ebɔrɛ bee wora na kikɛ.
4Ma shɛŋ maaŋ baa wɔ basa
nɛ b maa ji kashenteŋ nsaa
wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ lubi to.
5M maaŋ sa ekama nɛ e bee
nite a ji basa be asheŋ
ekpa nɛ e baa wora loŋ.
Ma alɛ maaŋ sa kamoowuwura
ŋko keŋkenshiwura
kashuli kikɛ nɛ b baa du loŋ.
6Basa nɛ b kɔ kashenteŋji
nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ b baa
wɔ ŋ kutɔ a ji ma asoe to.
Basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ amoso
malɛ e naŋ ki ma ekrachi
a shuŋ a sa ma.
7Esa kama nɛ e bee puni
ŋko a fule kikɛ maaŋ nya
ma lambu to n chena.
8Karechɛ kikɛ, m maaŋ sa
kumukpakpasowuraana kashuli
ashi anyi be kasawule so.
Meeŋ ju basa lubi kikɛ ashi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kadegboŋ na to.

Title: NSHƐ 102
Content:
Esa nɛ e wɔ tɔrɔ to be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Mee kule fo nna,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ!
Jande, nu ma kekule.
2Sa maŋ ŋana ma so
jemanɛ nɛ n wɔ tɔrɔ to.
Kaŋ kusoe n nu ma kekule,
nseŋ tuge ma manaŋ manaŋ.
3Ma nchɛ bee choŋ nna
fanɛ edishi nɛ ma awibi to
bee chɔɔ ma to fanɛ edɛ.
4M baa wɔl fanɛ afitiri nna,
ajibi kikɛ malɛ maa yɛlga ma.
5M baa shu to awɔrso a tekeŋ nna,
nseŋ nyɔr ŋ ki fanɛ awibi nawule.
6M baŋ ki fanɛ gbuŋgbula koŋko
ashi keshishɛrsawule so nna.
7Mee dese a keni nna a klade;
n du fanɛ kabuibi koŋko
nɛ e jɔŋ ebu so nna.
8N doŋana bee tege ma
karechɛ kikɛ nna;
nɛ bumo nɛ baa wora ma
eyurto malɛ bee ti ma
ketre fanɛ shoduu be kusɔ na.
9-10Ŋkpal fo ka nya agbo ga
nseŋ ta ma n lɛ so,
nsunɔ e ki ma ajibi jiso,
nɛ anishichubi malɛ ki ma
nchu nuuso.
11Ma kebaawɔtɔ bee choŋ nna
fanɛ kaaseso be kiyoyul;
nɛ ŋ gbagba malɛ bee wɔl
fanɛ afitiri na.
12Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
la ewura nna mbaanaayɔ;
nɛ yili kenana ko m ba tu
kenana ko to ebi bee nyiŋi
fo asheŋ.
13Fo e naaŋ shu Jerusalɛmebi so,
ŋkpal manɛ so, jemanɛ fo nɛ feeŋ
wu bumo kuwɔr.
14Anyi fo anya bee sha kejembu kama
nɛ k wɔ kadegboŋ na to nna;
amoso kumo be kebure a dese loŋ na
shin nɛ kagbenejija tɔr anyi so ga.
15Efuli pɔtɛana so be basa beeŋ ŋana
fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, be ketre na.
Nɛ durnya to be bewuraana kikɛ
e ta bunyaŋ gboŋ gboŋi n sa fo.
16Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ lɔŋɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na
m pɔr nseŋ shin nɛ mbe kemaŋkura
e dii efuli.
17E beeŋ wu betentaŋasepo kuwɔr
nseŋ nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule.
18Men sibɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora
n nase n sa kaman to ebi nɛ baaŋ
ba echefoso na;
saŋɛ na so, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ
ba kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ŋ kaŋɛ le:
19“Ebɔrɛso nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ
nsaa to kenishi a keni kasawule so.
20E daŋ nu basa nɛ b wɔ kabuti to
ka bee shu to nna,
nseŋ sɔ bumo nɛ b daŋ daga
luwu na n yige.
21Amoso Jerusalɛmebi kikɛ
e ber mbe asheŋ be kubomboŋ,
nseŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be ketre na,
22jemanɛ nɛ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ
kuwurjiana kikɛ be basa
beeŋ shɛr abar so m bunyaŋ
mo na.
23Kebifɔlbi e kraa la ma,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
shin nɛ ŋ ki esa pɔso nɛ
ma nchɛ duga so.
24Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le:
O ma Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ ta ma,
nɛ ma nchɛ maŋ naŋ fo.
Fo ere wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
25Sososo na kikɛ nɛ fo to durnya
n yili kumo be gbaltɔlase so.
Fo gbagba be enɔ nɛ fo ta
n to ebɔrɛso gba.
26Amo kikɛ beeŋ choŋ
fanɛ asɔbuuso ka wu na.
Fee chɛrga amo nna
fanɛ esa ka bee chɛrga mbe
asɔbuuso dra nsaa kini amo na.
27Ama fo ere maa chɛrga kikɛ;
fo alɛ maa bel kikɛ.
28Basa nɛ baa shuŋ fo be mbia
beeŋ baa wɔ fo kutɔ,
nɛ fo baa kuŋ bumo nɛ bumo
be kaman to ebi kikɛ.”

Title: NSHƐ 103
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be kasha be asheŋ
1Meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ
n fur Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nseŋ ta ma kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ
ŋ kpaŋ mbe ketre cheembi na!
2Meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ
ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Ma alɛ maaŋ teŋ asheŋ lela
nɛ e wora ma na kikɛ so.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa
ta anyi be alubi a paŋ anyi.
Mo alɛ e naa chɛ
anyi be alɔana kikɛ,
4nsaa kuŋ anyi ashi luwu to.
Mbe kuwɔrwu nɛ kasha
malɛ shi anyi so ga.
5Karechɛ kikɛ e bee sa anyi
asɔ nɛ a tir anyi nna,
nsaa shin nɛ anyee nya eleŋ
a ti so fanɛ kusore fɔlbi na.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee ji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so nna a sa
bumo nɛ beko bee mɛaŋ na.
7Mo e daŋ juŋkpar an nananyɛn Mosis
dra dra na n wora asheŋ,
nseŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be basa wu
mbe asheŋgboŋ nɛ e wora na.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la ewɔrwupo nna,
nsaa kɔ kanyiti;
mbe kasha malɛ maa chɛrga kikɛ.
9E maa wu basa kulubi jemanɛ kikɛ;
mo alɛ maa nya agbo mbaanaayɔ.
10E maa gberge anyi kusoe
kananɛ a daga fanɛ e gberge
anyi kumo na;
ŋko a laŋɛ anyi be alubi
a ka anyi kukɔ.
11Kasha nɛ e kɔ n sa basa
nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo na shi ga;
k shi a chɔ yili kasawule so
n ya fo awɔlpa so.
12Kananɛ epeŋilarkpa nɛ epeŋitɔrkpa
barga abar a wɔ kufɔ na,
aloŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
lara anyi be alubi ashi anyi so.
13Kananɛ bekurgepo bee sha
bumo be mbia ga na,
aloŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gba bee sha
bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo na ga.
14Ŋkpal manɛ so, e nyi fanɛ
eshishɛr nɛ e ta m pɔr anyi.
15Anyi edimɛdi be nchɛ du fanɛ afitiri
ŋko kupuŋ to be atoto nɛ a bee
purge manaŋ manaŋ nna;
16ama afu baŋ chela amo so nɛ a bolo,
n wu n tɔr nseŋ bɛ n luri kasawule to;
nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ wu amo gba kuraa.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee lara mbe kasha
nɛ k maa chɛrga na a ŋini bekama
nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo mbaanaayɔ nna;
mo alɛ nsaa wora a bɔlɔ mbe nnɔ
naseso so a sa bumo be kaman to ebi
18nɛ basa nɛ baa bɛ mbe
kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre so
nsaa wora mbe mbraana
kasonu kashenteŋto na.
19Ebɔrɛ taŋɛ mbe kuwurji
ebɔrɛso nna,
mo alɛ nsaa ji kuwura asɔ
toso kikɛ so.
20Menyi emalaika lempoana,
nɛ menyee nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be kɔnɔ nsaa wora mo kasonu na
kikɛ e kpaŋ mo!
21Menyi ebɔrɛso be apɔrso
nɛ menyee shuŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ
nsaa wora mo kasonu na
kikɛ e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ!
22Menyi, Ebɔrɛ be asɔ toso kikɛ,
nɛ e bee ji kuwura menyi so na,
e baa kpaŋ men Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Ma ere be kagbene kikɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ
a kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 104
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka bee keni mbe asɔ toso so be asheŋ
1Ma kagbene kikɛ nɛ n ta a kpaŋ fo,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ŋkpal manɛ so,
kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ kela kikɛ
buu fo fanɛ kuwurpiŋi nna,
2nɛ kefulto kulti fo n wɔtɔ
kaplɛkama.
Fo e parga kuwɔlpa to n sɔ
kaplɛkama
fanɛ wajɛbu, a wɔ kumo to.
3Fo alɛ e pɔr fo kowu n shin nɛ
tekugboŋ wɔ kumo be kaseto.
Bɔrɛwɔlpa nɛ k bee bɔla afu so
a nite na du fanɛ gbaŋɛturko
nna n sa fo.
4Fo e ta afuana fanɛ fo mbɔ
nsaa ta bɔrɛ be kenyɛkpɛ malɛ
fanɛ fo nyɛrbi.
5Fo e to durnya n yili
kumo be gbaltɔlase so,
nɛ k maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gbuŋgbuŋ na.
6Fo alɛ e to eteku chiŋgeliŋana
nɛ e bee bɔlɔ a dii abee so,
nsaa buu durnya so fanɛ piŋi na.
7Ama nɛ fo baŋ ponte,
nchuana kikɛ bee shile nna
8a gbelge abee so a bɔla ataŋɛ to
a yɔ kakpa nɛ fo bela ase
n yili amo na.
9Fo e yili amo be egbaŋ n sa amo
nɛ a sa maŋ bɔlɔ n dii kepla
m buu kasawule na kikɛ so.
10Fo e shin nɛ abuye bee
pete ataŋɛ to a ki elɔr
a shile abee to a choŋ,
11saŋɛ na so ekurma nɛ
kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya beeŋ baa
nya nchu a nuu a tuge achukoŋ.
12Mbuibi malɛ beeŋ tɔ bumo be asha
ndibi nɛ a yil m mata eboŋana na
be ayabi to nsaa jɔŋɛ amo so a shu.
13Fo e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛchu bee shi
awɔlpa so a ba abee so nɛ kasawule
bee nya kayul nɛnɛ.
14Fo alɛ e naa shin nɛ afitiri bee kɔr
nɛ kowu be asɔbɔya bee nya a ji,
nɛ dimɛdi malɛ bee duu asɔ
kasawule so a nya ajibi a ji,
15nsaa nya yabra a nuu
nɛ mbe kagbene bee fuli mo,
mo alɛ naa nya ŋku a gbiti
mbe anishito nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ
nsaa nya ajibi be yiri kikɛ
a ji a nya eleŋ nɛ alenfia.
16An Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo ndibi bee nya nchu nna
jemanɛ kikɛ,
aloŋ nɛ ndibigboŋ nɛ
baa tre sida nɛ fo duu
Lebanɔn be efuli so na
gba bee nya nchu.
17Ndibi na so nɛ mbuibi bee
tɔ bumo be asha;
nɛ etɔkɔrkɔ malɛ gba bee
tɔ bumo be asha ashi ndibi
tenteŋ nɛ baa tre fir na so.
18Kupuŋ to be mboe wɔ
abee jeŋgreŋ so nna,
nɛ asɔbɔya wurbi
fanɛ eshiboe malɛ
wɔ abee na be afalta to.
19Fo e to kufɔl nɛ k bee ŋini anyi
kananɛ jemanɛ bee ba a yɔ;
nɛ epeŋi malɛ nyi saŋɛ
nɛ k bee tɔr.
20Fo e to tentembiri
nɛ kanyɛ bee biri,
nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya
bee nya lar a nite a kulti
a fin kusɔ jiso a ji.
21Ebuluŋ bee munto a shu nna
a fin keji, nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa bumo.
22Epeŋi baŋ pete, nɛ b naŋ
bɛta n yɔ bumo be edesekpaana.
23Kumo be kaman nɛ edimɛdi
e koso n yɔ ashuŋ to n ya shuŋ
n tɔr epeŋi.
24Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, kanyiasheŋ so
nɛ fo bɔla n to asɔ damta.
Fo asɔ to so nɛ e kɔ ŋkpa
sɔ kasawule so kikɛ nna.
25Asɔ keniso be yiri yiri damta
e wɔ teku nɛ k shi a dese palɛlɛ na to;
Asɔgboŋ nɛ asɔwurbi kikɛ e wɔ kumo to.
26Teku so nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ
bee nite a yɔ a ba;
Kubɔya lubi gboŋgboŋi
nɛ baa tre Liviatan na gba
wɔ teku to nna.
27Le be asɔ keniso ere kikɛ
bee keni fo anishito nna
nɛ fo sa amo kusɔ jiso
jemanɛ nɛ k daga.
28Fo alɛ bee bugi enɔ to nna
a sa amo kusɔ jiso
nɛ a bee nya a ji a moɛ.
29Ama nɛ fo baŋ pal kaman
n sa amo, kufugboŋ bee tɔr
amo so nna nɛ a chicha.
Fo alɛ baŋ naŋ lara amo be efute,
a bee wu nna a bɛta a yɔ eshishɛr to.
30Fo Kiyoyu so nɛ fo bɔla
n to amo be ekama
nsaa shin nɛ ŋkpa popɔr
bee ba kasawule so.
31An Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
anyee kule nna fanɛ fo
kemaŋkura e baa wɔtɔ
mbaanaayɔ;
saŋɛ na so, fo kagbene
beeŋ baa fuli kusɔ kama
nɛ fo wora so.
32Fo baŋ to kenishi ŋ keni
kasawule, k bee gbuŋgbuŋ nna.
Fo alɛ baŋ beta abee,
e bee kaa edishi nna.
33Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo
Enyɛnpe ma Ebɔrɛ na,
ashi ma kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to.
34Mee tama fanɛ ma nfɛra fɛso
beeŋ baa par fo,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma kagbene fuli fo so.
35Shin nɛ alubiworapoana kikɛ
e mur ashi kasawule ere so,
n shin nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana
e sa maŋ naa wɔtɔ kuraa.
Meeŋ kpaŋ fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ashi ma kagbene to kikɛ.

Title: NSHƐ 105
Content:
Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe basa be asheŋ
1Men baa di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ
nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ ashi mbe ketre to!
Men baa kaŋɛ efuli kikɛ so ebi
kusɔ nɛ e wora be asheŋ.
2Men baa boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na;
nsaa malga emamachisheŋ
nɛ e wora be asheŋ.
3Men baa ji eyur nsaa bunyaŋ
mbe ketre cheembi na
ashi men be ŋgbene to kikɛ.
4Men ta men be yirda n deŋi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mbe
eleŋgboŋ so nsaa bunyaŋ mo
jemanɛ kikɛ.
5-6Menyi nɛ men la Eebraham
nɛ e shuŋ Ebɔrɛ na,
nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara
dra dra na mo nanabiana na,
e baa nyiŋi Ebɔrɛ be mamachi
be asheŋ woraso
nɛ kananɛ e bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo
be ekpa so be asheŋ.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la
anyi be Ebɔrɛ.
E bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be
ekpa so nna kasawule so kikɛ.
8E bee nyiŋi a bɛ mbe
kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre
nɛ mbe nnɔ naseso nɛ e
nase n sa menyi na so
hale n ya fo yili kenana ko
m ba tu kenana ko be
ntuŋ kagboŋ so nna.
9Le be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ mo
nɛ men nananyɛn Eebraham kre,
nɛ e bɔ ntaŋ n nase kɔnɔ n sa
men nananyɛn Aizek malɛ dra dra na.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ an nananyɛn Jeekɔb gba
daŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre
nɛ k beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ nna.
11E yɛ: “Meeŋ ta Keenan be kasawule
n sa fo nɛ k baa la feya mbaanaayɔ.”
12Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ
be basa na daa maŋ shi,
bumo alɛ daa la befɔ ashi
Keenan be kasawule so nna.
13B daa nite nna a kilgi to
ashi efuli pɔtɛana so
nɛ bewuraana be nsawule so.
14Ama Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ shin nɛ
ekama mɛaŋ bumo.
E daŋ fɛa bewurjipo so nna
ŋkpal e ka daa kuŋ mo basa so.
15E yɛ: “Men sa maŋ kaa tɔrɔ
bejuŋkparpo nɛ n lara na,
ŋko ma anebiana!”
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ shin nɛ
ewule ba efuli na so nna nɛ
bumo be adɔjibi kikɛ mur.
17Ndoŋ nna nɛ e shin nɛ
bumo kurgepo Josɛf,
nɛ b daŋ fa fanɛ kenya na,
juŋkpar n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so.
18B daŋ wɔtɔ Josɛf be aya
nɛ mbe kubɔ to ŋgbɛlɛbi nna,
nɛ e pɛge so;
19nɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na bɔlɔ so.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga e shin nɛ
kusɔ nɛ Josɛf kaŋɛ na ki kashenteŋ.
20Kumo be kaman nɛ Ijipt be efuli so
be ewura shin nɛ b lara Josɛf
ashi kabuti to.
21Ewura na daŋ shin nna nɛ e
bee keni mbe laŋ nɛ asɔ kikɛ so.
22Josɛf e daa keni ekrachiana na so
nsaa ŋini benimuana na kasheŋwora.
23Kumo be kaman nɛ Jeekɔb
nɛ mbe kanaŋ ya ki befɔ n chena
Ijipt be efuli so.
24B ka la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be basa so,
e daŋ shin nna nɛ b salga to
nseŋ nya eleŋ a chɔ bumo doŋana.
25E daŋ shin nna nɛ Ijiptebi na
kishi mbe basa nsaa kre
bumo asheŋ lubi be nia.
26Kumo be kaman nɛ e shuŋi
mbe kayɛrbi Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn
nɛ mo gbagba daŋ lara na mbe basa kutɔ.
27B daŋ wora emamachisheŋ
nɛ asheŋ tumase gboŋ
ashi Ijipt be efuli so nna.
28Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ tentembiri
ba buu efuli na kikɛ so nna,
ama Ijiptebi na daa maŋ
nu n sa Ebɔrɛ.
29E daa naŋ shin nɛ bumo be
elɔrana be nchuana kilgi ŋklaŋ
nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ kikɛ wu nna.
30Epulo daŋ ba sɔ efuli na
kikɛ be kaplɛkama nna;
hale bumo be edesekpaana
nɛ ewurkpa gba daŋ bɔlɔ
epulo na nna.
31Ebɔrɛ daŋ malga nna
nɛ ashushombi firgiso
nɛ asɔ duŋso fanɛ epini
ba mel efuli na kikɛ so.
32Ade be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ
bumo be bɔrɛchu ki abɔrɛjembu
nɛ bɔrɛ bee nyɛkpɛ
kasawule na kikɛ so;
33e daŋ mur bumo be greep
be afeelebi nɛ ndibi nɛ baa
tre figi na nɛ ndibi nɛ a ka
na kikɛ gba nna.
34E daŋ malga gba nna
nɛ elotɔr ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto
ba sɔ efuli na kikɛ so.
35Elotɔr ere daŋ ji
afitiri bumbuŋ kikɛ
nɛ asɔ nɛ b duu ndɔana
kikɛ to nna m mur.
36Ade kikɛ nyam be kaman
nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ Ijiptebi be
ewurkoŋnyɛn kikɛ nyam wu.
37Kumo be kaman nɛ e juŋkpar
Israɛlebi na n lar Ijipt be efuli so.
Bumo be eyiriana na to
be esa koŋwule gba
daa maŋ ka kaman.
B daŋ sulɔ shuwa
nɛ gbiti nna n lar.
38Jemanɛ nɛ b lar a yɔ na,
Ijiptebi na be ŋgbene
daŋ fuli bumo nna,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
kufu daŋ pɛ bumo nna.
39Ebɔrɛ daa bɔla kuwɔlpa so
kapaso nɛ edɛ be kabulpi so
kanyɛso nna a ŋini bumo ekpa
ashi bumo be enite na to.
40B ka daŋ kule mo ajibi,
mbuibi nɛ baa tre kweels na
nɛ ebɔrɛso be ajibi nɛ baa
tre manna na nɛ e sa bumo,
nɛ b daa nya a ji a moɛ.
41E daŋ shin nɛ kefalta pante
nɛ nchu lar kumo to eleŋso,
a shile keshishɛrsawule na so
fanɛ lɔr na nna.
42E daa nyiŋi mbe nnɔ
naseso cheembi nɛ e nase
n sa mbe kayɛrbi
Eebraham na nna.
43Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka kɔ n suge
mbe basa laraso ashi Ijipt
be efuli so na, b daŋ boŋ nshɛ
n ji eyur kagbenefuliso nna.
44E daŋ suge efuli pɔtɛana ko
be nsawule nɛ asɔ kama nɛ
b gben n nya nna n sa
Israɛlebi na.
45E wora loŋ nna nɛ mbe basa
e baa wora mbe mbraana kasonu.
Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 106
Content:
Kelela nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora mbe basa be asheŋ
1Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Men ta kechɔrɔ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, e walɛ nna
nɛ mbe kasha malɛ maa chɛrga
hale mbaanaayɔ.
2Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m malga
mbe asheŋgboŋ be asheŋ
n ya loge kikɛ.
Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kpaŋ
mo gba n ya loge.
3Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ
baa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
nsaa wora asheŋ niŋiso
jemanɛ kikɛ na peya nna.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa nyiŋi ma,
jemanɛ nɛ fee chɛ fo basa to
nsaa mɔlga bumo na.
5Shin nɛ n ti fo basa laraso so n nyalɛ,
saŋɛ na so ma alɛ gba beeŋ ji eyur
fanɛ kananɛ baa ji eyur kagbenefuliso
ŋkpal b ka la fo basa so na.
6Anyi nɛ an nanaana kikɛ
wora asheŋ lubi ga.
7An nanaana ka daa wɔ
Ijipt be efuli so na,
bumo be lakal daa maa wɔ Ebɔrɛ
be mamachi be asheŋ woraso so;
ŋko kasha so.
Jemanɛ nɛ b daa dii teku peper na,
b daŋ pal kaman nna n sa mo.
8Ama e daŋ mɔlga bumo,
fanɛ kananɛ e nase kɔnɔ na;
nseŋ ŋini bumo mbe eleŋgboŋ.
9E daŋ kaŋɛ teku peper na nna
fanɛ k ku to, nɛ k ku to.
Ndoŋ nna nɛ e juŋkpar bumo
kasawule wɔlso so
m bɔla kumo to n choŋ.
10E daŋ mɔlga bumo kikɛ ashi basa
nɛ b kishi bumo be enɔ to nna,
11nseŋ shin nɛ nchu na ji bumo doŋana
nɛ b daa ju a buu bumo so na bre.
Hale ekoŋwule gba daa maŋ ji efute.
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe basa na
nyiŋi mbe nnɔ naseso
nseŋ naŋ yirda mo
a boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ mo.
13Ama k maŋ chɛr ko nɛ b naŋ teŋ
kusɔ nɛ e wora so
nsaa maŋ naa sɔ mbe kasotoji.
14Ajibi be kayɛlgagboŋ daŋ pɛ bumo
ashi keshishɛrsawule na so nna
nɛ b wora Ebɔrɛ ŋ keni.
15Amoso e daŋ sa bumo kusɔ
nɛ b daa sha na nna,
ama e daŋ ta kulɔ lubi nna
ŋ gberge bumo kusoe.
16Bumo be ekama ashi bumo
be keeyi to daa besa Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn,
nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ be nyɛrbi nɛ e lara
n sa mbe kumu na eyur nna.
17Epul na to nɛ kasawule baŋɛ
n ta Datan nɛ Abiram nɛ
bumo be nnaŋ m min.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ kini kenu
n sa Mosis nɛ Ɛɛrɔn nna.
18Kumo be kaman nɛ edɛ
suse n chɔɔ kumukpakpasowuraana
nɛ b daa bɛ bumo so na kikɛ m mur.
19B ka ya fo kebee nɛ baa tre Sainai
na ase, b daŋ ta shuwa nna n lɔŋɛ
gbolu fɔlbi nna a bunyaŋ kumo.
20B daŋ ta Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura nna
n sa gbolu fɔlbi nɛ k la kusɔbɔya
nɛ k bee ji afitiri na, be kapɔrduli.
21B daŋ teŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daŋ wora
asheŋgboŋ ashi Ijipt be efuli so
m mɔlga bumo na so nna.
22Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ teŋ
alemaŋkarsheŋ nɛ e wora
ashi teku peper na ase na
be asheŋ so nna.
23Ebɔrɛ daŋ nya agbo nna
ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ mur
mbe basa na; ama Mosis
nɛ e lara nɛ e baa la mbe
kayɛrbi na, e mata mo
nɛ e maŋ naŋ mur bumo.
24B daa maŋ yirda kɔnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ
nase n sa bumo, fanɛ e beeŋ sa bumo
bumo gbagba be kasawule na;
amoso kasawule lela na be asheŋ
daa maa tir bumo.
25B daŋ kini kewora Ebɔrɛ kasonu nna,
nseŋ daa munto a bile asheŋ
ashi bumo be ewajɛbu to.
26Amoso e daŋ kpele bumo kusoe
kenishipereso nna fanɛ e beeŋ
shin nɛ b wu n tɔr
keshishɛrsawule na so.
27E yɛ e beeŋ pesaŋ bumo kaman to ebi
nɛ baaŋ ka na n yɔ nnyamase to,
saŋɛ na so baaŋ ya wu n tɔr
efuli pɔtɛana so.
28Ebɔrɛ be basa na be beko
daŋ ya kaa bɛ kegbir nɛ baa
tre Baal Piyɔɔ na so nna,
nseŋ daa ji agbir be nlɔŋɛjibi.
29B daŋ wora asheŋ lubi ga nna
nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kagbene kaa,
nɛ e shin nɛ kulɔ lubi ko ba bumo so.
30Ama kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Finihas na
e koso ŋ gberge alubiworapoana na
kusoe, nɛ kulɔ lubi na kuu.
31Ŋkpal loŋ so, baa nyiŋi mo nna
jemanɛ kikɛ nsaa sa mo bunyaŋ ga.
32Basa na daŋ wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
agbo to nna ashi kubuye nɛ baa tre
Mɛriba na ase,
nɛ Mosis daŋ ŋkpal bumo so
n wora n da Ebɔrɛ so.
33B daŋ shin nɛ kabɔlar pɛ Mosis nna
nɛ e nya agbo a malga.
34B ka ya fo kɔnɔ naseso
be kasawule na so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nna
fanɛ b mur nnyamase na kikɛ
nɛ b kini.
35Ama b daŋ ji bumo keteri nna
hale a wora asheŋ nnyamase na
be edaŋkare be ekpa so.
36Ebɔrɛ be basa na daŋ shuŋ
agbirana nna, nɛ kumo be loŋ
shin nɛ kemur ba bumo so.
37B daŋ ta bumo be mbia n lara
esarga nna n sa ayoyu lubi.
38Bumo be mbia nɛ b maŋ nyi
kulubi nɛ kelela na be ŋklaŋ
nɛ b daŋ ta n lara esarga n sa
Keenan be efuli so be agbirana
n jija kasawule na.
39Kusɔ nɛ b daŋ wora na
shin nɛ b wora eyurpi
daŋkare be ekpa so nna.
B daa maŋ ji
kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ.
40Amoso Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
daŋ nya agbo n wora mbe basa nna
nseŋ daŋ kishi bumo be asheŋ.
41E daŋ kplaŋ bumo so nna
nseŋ yige bumo n sa efuli
pɔtɛana so be basa; nɛ bumo
doŋana daa ji kuwura bumo so.
42Bumo doŋana daŋ kɔrfɛ bumo
nseŋ ji eleŋ bumo so ga.
43Ale damta nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
daŋ mɔlga mbe basa;
ama b daŋ kute n lar mo kaman
a wora asheŋ gela m bɔla amo so
n tɔr alubi damta to.
44Ama b ka shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
kagbenejijaso, e daŋ nu bumo
be kushu na nna.
45E daŋ nyiŋi mbe kɔnɔkoŋwule
be ŋkre na nna, nseŋ kpal kashagboŋ
nɛ e kɔ n sa bumo na so n chɛrga
mbe nfɛra a maŋ gberge bumo kusoe.
46E daŋ shin nɛ bumo doŋana
shu bumo so nna.
47O Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga anyi,
nseŋ lara anyi efuli pɔtɛana so
m bɛta m ba epe.
Saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ di fo epaŋ
nseŋ kpaŋ fo ketre cheembi na.
48Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ,
fo e daga esa ka kpaŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.
Shin nɛ ekama e kaŋɛ, “Amɛn!”
Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 107
Content:
KENUSOPO
(Nshɛ 107—150)
Ebɔrɛ ka la esa n sa mbe basa be asheŋ
1Men di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, e walɛ,
nɛ mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na,
malɛ wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
2Basa kama nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ mɔlga
bumo ashi bumo doŋana
be enɔ to na e kpaŋ mo.
3Bekama nɛ b shi efuli pɔtɛana
nɛ a kulti na so m bɛta m ba na kikɛ,
e kpaŋ mo nseŋ di mo epaŋ.
4Menyi be beko daŋ foe
ashi keshishɛrsawule nɛ
k maŋ kɔ shɛŋ na so nna,
nsaa maŋ naŋ wu ekpa nɛ
men bɛta m ba chena
kadegboŋ na to.
5Akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ e daa mɔ menyi,
nɛ men daa shin nɛ men wu.
6Men ka daa wɔ kenishipere be tɔrɔ to
nseŋ shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e daŋ nu nna nseŋ mɔlga menyi.
7Kumo be kaman nɛ e juŋkpar
menyi tinini m ba chena
kadegboŋ na to.
8A daga fanɛ men di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ
ŋkpal mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga,
nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ e bee wora
a sa edimɛdi kikɛ na so.
9E bee sa ekama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ
kusɔnuuso nna nɛ e bee nuu.
Ekama malɛ nɛ akoŋ kɔ,
e bee sa mo kusɔ jiso lela nna.
10Menyi be beko daa wɔ kabuti to nna,
a ji awurfoŋ tentembiri mina to
nɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi kre menyi,
11ŋkpal men ka daŋ kini
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na n lɛ,
nseŋ kplaŋ mbe kasotoji so na so.
12Amoso nɛ men daŋ shuŋ fanɛ anya
ŋ gben a chul to,
nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ chɛ menyi to na.
13Men ka daa wɔ kenishipere be tɔrɔ to
nseŋ shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e daŋ nu nna nseŋ mɔlga menyi.
14Tentembiri mina to nɛ e lara menyi
nseŋ tuge menyi be ŋgbɛlɛbi
nɛ men nya menyi be amu a ji.
15A daga fanɛ men di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ
ŋkpal mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge
nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ e bee wora
a sa edimɛdi kikɛ so.
16Mo e naa bure danyaŋ
be mbunagboŋ to,
nsaa buri abɛlso be abersobi
to cheche na.
17Menyi to be beko wora alubi
kawuliso nna nsaa ji awurfoŋ.
18Men daa maa sha kewu
ajibi kenishiso gba,
a daŋ ka gbrɛ nɛ men wu gba.
19Men ka daa wɔ kenishipere be etɔrɔ to
nseŋ shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e daŋ nu nna nseŋ mɔlga menyi.
20Mo gbagba be kamalga be eleŋ to
nɛ e daŋ bɔla so n chɛ menyi to,
m mɔlga menyi ashi kemur to.
21A daga fanɛ men di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ
ŋkpal mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge
nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ e bee wora
a sa edimɛdi kikɛ na so.
22A daga fanɛ men lara esarga
n di mo epaŋ a boŋ nshɛ
kagbenefuliso a kaŋɛ asheŋ
nɛ e wora be asheŋ.
23Menyi to be beko be kebaawɔtɔ
baa yil kebaa luri nchu so be
ekuloŋgboŋ to a nite teku so
a ji yawu so nna.
24Menyi alɛ wu emamachisheŋ
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora
ashi teku na so.
25Mo e daŋ malga kenishipereso
n sa afugboŋ nɛ k ku
atili teku so na.
26Atili na daa kpata nchu so be
ekuloŋgboŋ na a yɔ
esoso nɛ kaseto nna,
nɛ kenishipere tu menyi
nɛ men paŋ tama.
27Men daa wɔ ekuloŋgboŋ na to nna,
a lente nchu na so fanɛ basa ka boo nsa
nseŋ paŋ tama kikɛ na.
28Men ka daa wɔ kenishipere be tɔrɔ to,
nseŋ shu n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e daŋ nu nna nseŋ mɔlga menyi.
29Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ
afugboŋ na yige kebaa ber eleŋso
nɛ atili na lo dindiŋ.
30Menyi be ŋgbene daŋ fuli menyi,
ŋkpal loŋ so, e keta menyi nna n yɔ
kakpa nɛ men daa sha keyɔ na.
31A daga fanɛ men di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ,
ŋkpal mbe kasha nɛ k maa loge
nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ e bee wora
a sa edimɛdi kikɛ na so.
32Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ men shɛr abar so,
men baa ji Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be keshi be asheŋ.
Menyi nɛ men be bejuŋkparpo
malɛ baŋ shɛr, men ta bunyaŋ
n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
33E shin nɛ elɔr wɔlto
ŋ ki keshishɛrsawule,
nɛ achubu malɛ ki
nsawule wɔlso,
34nɛ adɔsawule lela ki
nsawule wuso a dese,
ŋkpal basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ
be amu kpakpaso so.
35Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
kraa beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ
keshishɛrsawule e kilgi
kubuye a bul nchu,
nɛ kasawule wɔlso e ki
kabombi a shile.
36Nɛ akoŋ pɛ menyi,
menyeeŋ tiŋ n yuu menyi
be nde n chena mbombi na
ase n dɔ n ji.
37Menyeeŋ tiŋ n dɔ n duu
asɔduuso nɛ ndibi sɔrso,
nɛ a wora nɛnɛ nɛ men teŋi
ŋko n chuge amo ga.
38Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ nɛfa menyi,
nseŋ shin nɛ menyi
be mbia e wora keshi;
mo alɛ maaŋ shin nɛ menyi
be ana e duga so.
39Jemanɛ ko beeŋ ba nɛ tɔrɔ nɛ
awurfoŋ nɛ bedoŋ be kamɛaŋ
e shin nɛ men duga so
ŋ ki basa gbrɛbi.
40Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ sɔ menyi be kɔnɔ so
ŋ kɔ basa nɛ b daŋ pɔɔ
menyi so na n shin nɛ b baa nite
cham cham keshishɛrsawule so.
41Nɛ asheŋ baŋ tir menyi
nɛ menyee ji awurfoŋ,
e beeŋ ba mɔlga menyi
nseŋ shin nɛ menyi
be nnaŋ e salga fanɛ
mboe nɛ mbolpɔ.
42Menyeeŋ wu le be asheŋ ere
nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli,
ŋkpal men ka bee wora
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu so.
Ama kumukpakpasowuraana bre
maaŋ nya nnɔ bugi gba.
43Ekama nɛ e kɔ kanyiasheŋ,
e baa nyiŋi asheŋ ere
nsaa fɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kasha
nɛ k maa loge na be asheŋ.

Title: NSHƐ 108
Content:
Ebɔrɛ kaa wɔ anyi be kaman be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, ma kagbene kikɛ nɛ
ŋ kɔ a ji kashenteŋ a sa fo.
Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ nseŋ ta ma
kagbene kikɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo.
2Meeŋ fara a laŋ ma ejaŋjilaŋ
a sa fo pɔɛŋ nɛ epeŋi e pete.
3O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ di fo epaŋ
nɛ ekama e nu fo asheŋ ashi efuli kikɛ so.
Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo ashi basa to.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so,
k du fanɛ fo kasha,
nɛ k maa loge na,
choŋ ebɔrɛso nna;
fo kashenteŋji malɛ
bee chute awɔlpa nna.
5O Ebɔrɛ, shin nɛ fo asheŋgboŋ
e dii efuli ashi awɔlpa so kikɛ,
nseŋ shin nɛ basa e wu fo kemaŋkura
ashi kasawule ere kikɛ so.
6Nu anyi be kekule nseŋ chɛ anyi to;
ta fo eleŋgboŋ na m mɔlga anyi,
nɛ an tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so.
Saŋɛ na so fo basa shaso
beeŋ nya bumo be amu.
7O Ebɔrɛ, fo nase kɔnɔ ashi
fo kakpa cheembi na
fanɛ feeŋ barga kadegboŋ nɛ
baa tre Shɛkɛm na to nseŋ chige
Sukɔf be Ketaŋɛ na to
n sa fo basa kagbenefuliso.
8Fo yɛ, Giliad nɛ Manase be
nsawule la feya nna;
nɛ Efrayim la fanɛ fo kebɛlso be
kusɔ kuŋkumuso,
nɛ Juda malɛ la fanɛ fo kuwurkpabi.
9Ama Mowab be kasawule bre la
fanɛ fo kawie fɔr enɔ nna;
Edɔm be kasawule malɛ la
fanɛ kusɔ nɛ fee lɛ fo asɛbta
a deŋi so a ŋini fanɛ k la feya nna.
Fo alɛ bee yili Filistiebi to nna
a ponte to a kaŋɛ fo ka kɔ m pɔɔ so.
10O Ebɔrɛ, wanɛ e naŋ keta ma
m ba kadegboŋ lempo na to;
ŋko n juŋkpar ma n yɔ
Edɔm be kasawule so?
11Fo maŋ naa juŋkpar
anyi be benapo;
fo kini anyi nna n lɛ a?
12Chɛ anyi to nɛ an kɔ m pɔɔ
an doŋana so!
Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kikɛ maaŋ
tiŋ ŋ kɔ m mɔlga anyi,
nɛ mannɛ fo!
13Fo Ebɔrɛ na e naa shin nɛ
anyee kɔ a pɔɔ so,
nsaa chichi an doŋana so
a mata kasawule.

Title: NSHƐ 109
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin mbe kechɛto be asheŋ
1O Ebɔrɛ, mee kpaŋ fo nna.
Amoso sa maŋ lo to loŋ;
kaŋɛ ma kusɔ ko!
2Kumukpakpasowuraana nɛ befɛpo
bee kɔ ma nna a ku efɛ a deŋi ma,
3nsaa malga asheŋ lubi
a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so;
nɛ m maŋ wora bumo shɛŋ.
4Ma ere ta bumo fanɛ nteriana nna,
a kule Ebɔrɛ a sa bumo,
ama b kraa malga mmalga lubi nna
a gbiti ma.
5Kulubi nɛ baa ta a ka ma
kelela be kukɔ,
nsaa ta yurkishi a tal ma
kasha to.
6N doŋana yɛ: “Fin esa lubi ko
nɛ e wu mo kulubi ŋ kaŋɛ
fanɛ e wora kulubi ko nna.
7Ji mo demu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ
e ji n tɔr nna!
Wu mbe kabɔrɛkule fanɛ
efɛ nɛ e bee ku.
8Ku mbe ŋkpa so nseŋ shin nɛ
esa ko e sɔ mo so ashi
mbe eshuŋkpa.
9Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ mbe mbia
e ki amunibi,
nɛ mbe eche e ki ekulpoche,
10nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ mbe laŋ
e bure nɛ mbia na e ki mbi jiga
a di kowu nsaa na a kule a ji.
11Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ basa nɛ e ji bumo
be kukɔ e suge asɔ nɛ e kɔ kikɛ;
n shin nɛ befɔ chil e sɔ asɔ nɛ
e gben n nya na kikɛ mo kutɔ.
12Sa maŋ shin nɛ mbe asheŋ
e baa tir esa kikɛ,
ŋko n shin nɛ esa ko e sɔ mbe
amunibi m bela kikɛ.
13Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ mbe kanaŋ
nɛ kaman to ebi kikɛ e mur kuraa;
nseŋ shin nɛ b teŋ bumo be atre so
hale mbaanaayɔ.
14Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e sa maŋ ta
mo tutoana nɛ mo nanaana be alubi
m paŋ bumo kikɛ.
15Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e baa nyiŋi
mbe kanaŋ kikɛ be alubi;
nsaa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e nyiŋi
bumo be asheŋ kikɛ kuraa!
16Ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa maŋ la esa kikɛ;
e daa kɔrfɛ betirpo nɛ bematako
nɛ betentaŋasepo nna a mɔ bumo.
17E daa sha kebaasho basa kɔnɔ nna;
amoso shin nɛ kɔnɔsho e pɛ mo alɛ gba.
E daŋ kishi basa ga;
amoso mo alɛ gba maaŋ nya nɛfa!
18Kananɛ e bee buu mbe epiŋi
a chɛrga ale damta na,
aloŋ nɛ e bee shoduu basa.
Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ mbe shoduu na
e laŋɛ mo gbagba so!
19Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ mbe eshoduu na
e ki fanɛ epiŋi nɛ e bee buu
karechɛ kikɛ m buu mo kikɛ so.”
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ ka bedoŋ
nɛ baa wu ma kulubi nsaa malga
a gbiti ma na kukɔ.
21Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, chɛ ma to,
fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na;
nseŋ mɔlga ma ŋkpal fo kasha
nɛ k maa loge na so.
22N la etirpo nɛ etentaŋasepo nɛ
ebesa damta bɔlɔ ma kagbene to nna.
23Ma kebaawɔtɔ bee choŋ
fanɛ kaaseso be kiyoyul nna;
ŋko fanɛ afu ka bee kpata
kusɔ firgisobi nna.
24Ma amuli bee yɔɔ nna
ŋkpal akoŋ so;
nɛ ma kikɛ nyɔr ŋ ki awibi.
25Bedoŋ baŋ wu ma gba,
baa mushe nna nsaa fifi amu.
26O n Nyɛnpe nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ,
chɛ ma to nseŋ mɔlga ma
ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maa
loge na so.
27Shin nɛ bedoŋ e pin fanɛ
fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e la ma emɔlgapo.
28Bumo ere beeŋ tiŋ n shoduu ma,
ama fo ere bee nɛfa ma nna.
Nɛ bedoŋ bee kɔ ma gba,
fo maaŋ shuli nɛ b pɔɔ ma so;
fo alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ ma, nɛ n la
fo kayɛrbi na, be kagbene e fuli ma.
29Fo e naŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr
e ki fanɛ asɔbuuso m buu
basa nɛ baa wu ma kulubi na.
30O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
meeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo
nseŋ di fo epaŋ ga ashi fo
basa be nshɛrana to.
31Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo e naa chɛ bekama
nɛ asheŋ tir na to,
nsaa mɔlga bumo ashi
basa nɛ baa wu bumo
kulubi na be enɔ to.

Title: NSHƐ 110
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ewura laraso na be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
kaŋɛ n nyɛnpe, ewura na le:
“Chena ma jisa so
hale nɛ n ya shin nɛ fo ji eleŋ
fo doŋana so.”
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ n shin nɛ
fo kuwurji be eleŋ e shi
Jerusalɛm n salga to,
hale nɛ fo ji kuwura fo doŋana so.
3Kachɛ nɛ feeŋ kɔ fo doŋana kena na,
fo basa gbagba e naŋ shuli
n tu fo ŋ kɔ bumo.
Fo mbrantiɛfɔlbi beeŋ ba fo kutɔ
fanɛ kachipurdidi be bunyaŋ.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nase kɔnɔ
nɛ k maaŋ chɛrga kikɛ.
E yɛ: “Feeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapo
mbaanaayɔ, fanɛ Mɛlkizedɛk nɛ
e daa la bɔrɛmatapo na.”
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ fo jisa so nna;
kachɛ nɛ e beeŋ nya agbo,
e beeŋ pɔɔ bewura pɔtɛana so.
6E beeŋ ji basa nɛ b wɔ
efuli pɔtɛana so demu
nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be basa
e wu n deŋi abar so
kasawule ere so.
7E beeŋ nuu kabombi nɛ k dese
ekpakar na be nchu;
E beeŋ baa nya eleŋ a kɔ
a pɔɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ.

Title: NSHƐ 111
Content:
Kekpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
1Meeŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ashi ma kagbene to.
Ma alɛ beeŋ di mo epaŋ ashi
mbe basa be nshɛr to.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora
emamachisheŋ damta nna!
Ekama nɛ amo be asheŋ
bɔlɔ mo kenishi bee fɛ
amo be asheŋ nna.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
woraso kikɛ kɔ bunyaŋ
nɛ kemaŋkura nna.
Kusɔ kama nɛ e bee wora
malɛ niŋi nna mbaanaayɔ.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa shin nɛ
anyee teŋ mbe emamachisheŋ so;
Mo alɛ la esa nsaa wu kuwɔr nna.
5E bee sa bekama nɛ baa
bunyaŋ mo na ajibi nna.
Mo alɛ nsaa nyiŋi mo nɛ bumo
be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na
hale mbaanaayɔ.
6Mo e lara mbe eleŋgboŋ na
ŋ ŋini mbe basa,
jemanɛ nɛ e sɔ efuli pɔtɛana
be nsawule n sa bumo na.
7Ebɔrɛ be kasheŋwora kikɛ to,
e bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna.
Esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda mbe mbraana.
8Amo alɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
Kashenteŋ nɛ ekpa niŋiso so
nɛ e bɔla so n sa mbraana na.
9Ebɔrɛ e sɔ mbe basa n yige;
mo e wora mo nɛ bumo be
kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre mbaanaayɔ.
E la esa cheembi nɛ esa gboŋgboŋi
nɛ e daga bunyaŋgboŋ nna.
10Men baa bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
ŋkpal manɛ so, ekpa nɛ esa beeŋ bɔla
so n nya kanyiasheŋ nna na.
Bekama nɛ baa bɛ mbe mbraana so na
e naa pin asheŋ to nɛnɛ.
Kapandi e baa la mo peya
mbaanaayɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 112
Content:
Kagbenefuli nɛ esa lela kɔ be asheŋ
1Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na awɔrso!
Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ baa
bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nsaa wora mbe mbraana kasonu
kagbenefuliso na peya nna.
2Bumo be kaman to ebi beeŋ baa
kɔ eleŋgboŋ ga kasawule so;
ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee nɛfa bekama nɛ baa wora
asheŋ niŋiso na nna.
3Baaŋ nyalɛ nseŋ dii dama;
nɛ ekama malɛ e baa nyiŋi bumo
ŋkpal bumo be aworbi ka niŋi so.
4Basa nɛ baa wu kuwɔr nsaa la basa
a wora asheŋ niŋiso na du fanɛ
kefulto nna ashi tentembiri to.
5Kebaawɔtɔ bee nite nɛnɛ nna
a sa bekama nɛ baa bugi epunto
a ta asɔ a paŋ beko nsaa ji kashenteŋ
ashi bumo be keyawuji to na.
6Shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n chɛrga bumo
be kesheŋ wora;
basa malɛ maaŋ teŋ bumo
be alelasheŋ so kikɛ.
7B maaŋ baa ŋana baru lubi
ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be ŋgbene
baa yil kakpa koŋwule nna
nɛ baa yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
8Shɛŋ maa fɔŋ bumo
ŋko a da bumo kufu;
b baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ bumo
doŋana beeŋ ji n tɔr.
9Baa bugi ŋgbene nna
a kɛ betentaŋasepo asɔ
nɛ bumo be kelela be kewora
malɛ maŋ kɔ ekar.
Amoso basa bee nyiŋi
bumo jemanɛ kikɛ nna.
10Basa lubi baŋ wu basa nɛ
b kɔ le be kebaawɔtɔ ere,
baa nya agbo nna a we
anyi to yurkishi so nseŋ foe eyur to.
B maaŋ nya bumo be kepar kikɛ.

Title: NSHƐ 113
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka bee chɛ betentaŋasepo to be asheŋ
1Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na awɔrso!
Menyi nɛ menyee shuŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
e kpaŋ mbe ketre na.
2Men shin nɛ basa kikɛ e baa
kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be ketre naniere hale mbaanaayɔ.
3Baŋ yili karechɛ kikɛ be kachipurso
n ya fo kaaseso, ekama e baa kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre!
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa ji
kuwura efuliana na kikɛ so;
mbe kemaŋkura shi a chɔ
esoso be asɔ kikɛ peya.
5Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ta mbe kumu
m ber Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ na.
Mo e chena mbe kuwurputi so ebɔrɛso
6nsaa kurgi kumu a keni awɔlpa
nɛ kasawule nɛ a wɔ mbe kaseto na.
7Ebɔrɛ e naa lara betirpo
nɛ betentaŋasepo ashi
ketir nɛ ketentaŋase to
8nsaa shin nɛ baa tu mbe basa
nɛ be la bewurbi na a chena
a ji kekurge.
9Eche kilpo baa maa kɔ mbia,
Ebɔrɛ e naa nɛfa mo nɛ e bee
nya mbia nɛ mbe kagbene e fuli.
Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 114
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka bee wora emamachisheŋ be asheŋ
1Jemanɛ nɛ Israɛl be basa lar
basa nɛ baa gbar ŋgbar pɔtɛ
ashi Ijipt be efuli so to na,
2Juda be kebonfu nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta
ŋ ki mbe kakpa cheembi,
nsaa wɔ ndoŋ a ji kuwura Israɛl
be kasawule kikɛ so.
3K daŋ wora fanɛ Teku Peper na
ka wu Ebɔrɛ nna nseŋ ku to,
nɛ Jɔɔdan be Lɔr na malɛ wu mo
nseŋ shir n yili.
4Nɛ kewora fanɛ abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi
ka bee tɛto a kulti fanɛ mbolpɔbi na.
5Bishi teku na kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ k sa ekpa,
ŋko Jɔɔdan be Lɔr na manɛ nna
nɛ k maŋ naŋ tiŋ nɛ k shile?
6Bishi abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi na, fanɛ,
manɛ nna nɛ a bee tɛto a kulti fanɛ
mbolpɔbi?
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ men nananyɛn
Jeekɔb shuŋ dra na baŋ firgi n taga to,
kasawule bee gbuŋgbuŋ nna;
8ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa shin nɛ
kefalta kpakpaso bee pante a lar nchu
nɛ a bee dese fanɛ kepa
ŋko a shile fanɛ kabombi na.

Title: NSHƐ 115
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka daga kekpaŋ be asheŋ
1Anyi ere maŋ daga fanɛ
b kpaŋ anyi kuraa!
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule
e daga fanɛ ekama nyam
e kpaŋ mo;
ŋkpal mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga
nɛ mbe kashenteŋji so.
2Manɛ e ba nɛ efuliana na be basa
bee kaŋɛ le:
“Men be Ebɔrɛ na wɔ nnɛ?”
3Anyi be Ebɔrɛ na wɔ ebɔrɛso nna
a wora kusɔ nɛ e bee sha.
4Ama shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ efuli pɔtɛana
be basa bre ta n lɔŋɛ bumo
be agbirana a shuŋ.
5Agbirana na kɔ nnɔ,
ama a maa malga,
a kɔ anishi, ama a maa wu.
6A kɔ asoe, ama a maa nu,
nsaa kɔ mmuna,
ama a maa nu efɛa.
7Agbirana na kɔ enɔana,
ama a maaŋ tiŋ m pɛ shɛŋ to,
a kɔ aya, ama a maaŋ tiŋ n nite;
a maaŋ tiŋ m malga ŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ.
8Bekama nɛ b lɔŋɛ agbirana na
nɛ bumo nɛ b yirda amo na
du jiga fanɛ agbirana na nna;
b maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ.
9Israɛl be basa,
men yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa chɛ
menyi to nsaa kuŋ menyi.
10Menyi nɛ men la Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ to ebi
nsaa la bɔrɛmatapoana na,
a daga fanɛ men yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ e baa chɛ menyi to nsaa kuŋ menyi.
11Menyi nɛ menyee bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na,
a daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e yirda
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e baa chɛ
menyi to nsaa kuŋ menyi.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee nyiŋi
anyi be asheŋ;
mo alɛ beeŋ nɛfa anyi.
E beeŋ nɛfa Israɛl be basa kikɛ
nɛ Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ to ebi kikɛ.
13E beeŋ nɛfa bekama nɛ
baa bunyaŋ mo na;
bewurjipo nɛ bebɔlpo kikɛ.
14Ma kabɔrɛkule e la fanɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ
menyi nɛ men be kaman to ebi kikɛ
e salga n wora keshi.
15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to esoso
nɛ kasawule na e nɛfa menyi!
16Ebɔrɛso la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nawule peya nna,
ama e ta kasawule nna n sa
anyi edimɛdi.
17Basa nɛ b teŋ wu n yɔ bubuni to
maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
18Anyi nɛ an wɔ ŋkpa to ere
nawule e naŋ tiŋ a di mo epaŋ
naniere hale mbaanaayɔ.
Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 116
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka mɔlga esa be asheŋ
1Mee sha Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
ŋkpal e kaa bee nu ma kekule so.
Ŋ ka kule mo fanɛ e wu ma kuwɔr,
e daŋ nu ma kabɔrɛkule nna.
2Ŋkpal e ka bee kaŋ kusoe
a nu ma kekule so,
meeŋ baa shu a tre mo jemanɛ kikɛ
ashi ma kebaawɔtɔ to.
3Luwu daŋ kulti ma nna
n wɔtɔ a funti ma;
nɛ keyɔ nchaŋ to be kagbenejija
daŋ tɔr ma so.
Kufu nɛ kafɔŋ e daŋ bɔlɔ ma to.
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ n shu n tre
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
fanɛ e jande e mɔlga ma!
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee wu
kuwɔr nsaa walɛ;
Kashenteŋto Ebɔrɛ
kɔ kushuso pasaa.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa
kuŋ bekama nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ
n chɛ bumo be amu to.
Asheŋ ka tu ma, mo e mɔlga ma.
7Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka
wora ma kelela so,
shɛŋ be asheŋ maŋ naa fɔŋ ma
ashi ma kagbene to.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ mɔlga ma
ashi luwu to nna;
mo e daŋ kpra ma anishichubi,
nseŋ kuŋ ma nɛ m maŋ fiti n tɔr.
9Naniere ma nɛ mo e naŋ baa
bɔ aya a nite ashi basa
nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to be kasawule so.
10Ŋ ka daa ji awurfoŋ ga na gba,
m maŋ yige yirda nɛ ŋ kɔ
ashi mo to na.
11Jemanɛ nɛ kufu daa kɔ ma gba,
m maŋ ta ma yirda n deŋi esa kikɛ so.
12Manɛ bre nɛ meeŋ ta ŋ ka
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kukɔ,
ŋkpal alelasheŋ nɛ e bee
wora a sa ma so?
13Meeŋ bar yabra belbelso
be sarga m ba di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
epaŋ, ŋkpal e ka mɔlga ma so.
14Jemanɛ nɛ mbe basa kikɛ
beeŋ shɛr abar so na nɛ
meeŋ tia nnɔ nɛ n nase
n sa mo na kikɛ.
15Basa nɛ baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛnɛ na
be luwu be asheŋ tir ga n sa
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
16O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
n la fo kayɛrbi kashenteŋto nna;
kananɛ n nio shuŋ fo na nɛ ma alɛ
gba bee shuŋ fo na.
Fo e mɔlga ma ashi luwu to.
17Meeŋ lara sarga n di fo epaŋ
nseŋ shu n tre fo ashi
ma kabɔrɛkule to.
18-19Jemanɛ nɛ fo basa
beeŋ shɛr abar so fo bɔrɛlambu to
ashi Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ to na,
nɛ meeŋ tia kɔnɔ nɛ n nase n sa fo na.
Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 117
Content:
Kebaadi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ be asheŋ
1Menyi, efuli pɔtɛana so ebi,
men baa di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ!
Menyi, edimɛdi be yiri kikɛ,
men di mo epaŋ!
2Ŋkpal manɛ so,
kasha nɛ e kɔ n sa anyi na
shi ga;
nɛ mbe kashenteŋji malɛ maŋ
kɔ ekar.
Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 118
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka bee wu kuwɔr jemanɛ kikɛ be asheŋ
1Men di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, e walɛ nɛ mbe
kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
2Shin nɛ Israɛl be basa e kaŋɛ le:
“Mbe kasha wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.”
3Shin nɛ Ɛɛrɔn be laŋ to ebi,
nɛ b la bɔrɛmatapoana na e kaŋɛ le:
“Mbe kasha wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.”
4Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa
bunyaŋ mo na e kaŋɛ le:
“Mbe kasha wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.”
5Ma awurfoŋ nɛ ebesa to nɛ n shu
n tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nɛ e nu ma kabɔrɛkule nseŋ lara
kafɔŋ na ma so.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka wɔ ŋ kutɔ so,
m maaŋ naa ŋana kufu.
Manɛ nɛ dimɛdi beeŋ tiŋ n wora ma?
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka la ma echɛtopo so,
bedoŋ beeŋ kɔ n tɔr nɛ n wu bumo.
8Keta fo yirda n to Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so
nɛ e baa kuŋ fo bɔ fo ka ta
fo kumu n to nyiŋgbasa so
9ŋko edimɛdi be bejuŋkparpo
lempoana so.
10Efuli damtaana e kulti ma n wɔtɔ,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ so,
n tiŋ m mur bumo kikɛ nyam.
11B daa kɔ ma kaba kama so nna,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to,
n tiŋ m mur bumo.
12B daŋ ba mel ma so fanɛ emushoŋ nna,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre to,
b daŋ chɔɔ m mur nna fanɛ
edɛ ka tɔr afitiri wɔlso so na.
13B daa kɔ ma kenishipereso nna;
a daŋ ka gbrɛbi nɛ b pɔɔ ma so.
Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ chɛ ma to.
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e wɔtɔ ma eleŋ to
nseŋ sa ma kashɛ nɛ m boŋ;
mo e mɔlga ma.
15Ebɔrɛ be basa bee chena
bumo be elaŋana to nna
a boŋ kekɔmpɔɔso be nshɛ
awɔrso a kaŋɛ:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ na
e wora asheŋgboŋ!
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ na
e shin nɛ an kɔ m pɔɔ so.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ eleŋ pasaa!”
17Amoso m maaŋ wu,
meeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to,
a ber kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
wora be kubomboŋ.
18E daŋ gberge ma kusoe kenishipereso,
ama mo alɛ maŋ shin nɛ n wu.
19Men bugi kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso
be mbunagboŋ n sa ma nɛ n luri to
n di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be kabunagboŋ na nɛ n da na;
basa niŋiso nawule e naŋ tiŋ
m bɔla kumo to n luri.
21Meeŋ di fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ,
ŋkpal fo ka nu ma kabɔrɛkule
nseŋ shin nɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so so.
22Kejembu nɛ bepɔrpo kini n lɛ na
e ki ebu na be kebonfu to be
gbaltɔlase be kejembu lela na.
23Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e wora loŋ;
anyi alɛ wu kumo fanɛ
k la mamachi be kesheŋ nna.
24Kabre la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be kachɛ nna,
men shin nɛ anyi be ŋgbene e fuli,
nɛ an ji eyur!
25O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga anyi,
nseŋ shin nɛ asheŋ a nyalɛ n sa anyi!
26Nɛfa la esa nɛ e bee ba
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ketre to na peya nna.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo bɔrɛlambu na ase
nɛ an yil a nɛfa fo.
27Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Ebɔrɛ,
mo e shin nɛ mbe kefulto
nyaŋɛ n yuu anyi so!
Men shin nɛ an ta abii be ayabi
ŋ keta enɔ to nseŋ bɛ abar so a ji
eyur a kulti bɔrɛsure na.
28Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ma Ebɔrɛ,
ma alɛ beeŋ di mo epaŋ
nseŋ ber mbe keshi be kebomboŋ
n sa basa kikɛ nɛ b nu.
29Men di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, e walɛ
nɛ mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 119
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be Mbra be asheŋ
1Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ bumo
be kebaawɔtɔ maŋ kɔ saŋgre kikɛ
nɛ baa wora asheŋ a bɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be mbra be ekpa so na peya nna.
2Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ baa bɛ
mbe atande so, nsaa wora mo kasonu
ashi bumo be ŋgbene to na peya nna.
3B maa wora asheŋ lubi,
baa wora asheŋ nɛ a bɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ekpa so nna.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e sa anyi
fo mbraana na, nsaa sha fanɛ
an baa wora amo kasonu kashenteŋto.
5Ekpa kikɛ so, n daa sha ketiŋ m bɛ
fo mbraana so kashenteŋto nna!
6M maaŋ ji anishinyɔr jemanɛ nɛ
meeŋ baa bɛ fo mbraana so na.
7Ma kekoya fo mbra niŋiso na
e naŋ shin nɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo kagbenefuliso.
8Meeŋ wora fo mbraana kasonu,
amoso sa maŋ kaŋ pal kaman n sa ma!
Kewora Ebɔrɛ be mbra na kasonu be asheŋ
9Kebaawora fo kamalga kasonu
e naaŋ shin nɛ mbifɔlbi be kebaawɔtɔ
e baa walɛ nseŋ niŋi.
10Meeŋ shuŋ fo nɛ ma kagbene kikɛ;
sa maŋ shin nɛ n lar kebaawora
fo mbraana kasonu to.
11N ta fo mbra nna n wɔtɔ ma kagbene to,
saŋɛ na so m maaŋ wora kulubi ŋ gbiti fo.
12O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mee kpaŋ fo nna;
ŋini ma fo mbraana na.
13Meeŋ bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ beko awɔrso
fo mbraana nɛ fo sa na kikɛ be asheŋ.
14Kebaa bɛ fo mbraana so
bee fuli ma kagbene a chɔ
kebaakɔ kedama damta.
15Mee koya fo mbraana nna,
nsaa mige fo keŋini to a keni nɛnɛ.
16Ma kagbene bee fuli fo mbra so nna;
ma alɛ maaŋ teŋ fo mmalga so kikɛ.
Kagbenefuli nɛ k wɔ Ebɔrɛ be mbra to be asheŋ
17Wora fo kayɛrbi kelela;
saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa wɔtɔ
nsaa wora fo kamalga kasonu.
18Bugi ma nfɛra to nɛ n tiŋ m pin
emamachisheŋ nɛ e wɔ fo mbra to.
19Efɔ e la ma ashi kasawule ere so;
amoso sa maŋ ta fo mbraana
ŋ ŋana ma so.
20Kusɔ nɛ ma kagbene bee sha ga
e la fanɛ ŋ ka beeŋ baa nyi
fo mbraana na jemanɛ kikɛ.
21Fo e naa gberge kamoowuwuraana
nɛ b maŋ la shɛŋ nseŋ kini kewora
fo mbraana kasonu na kusoe.
22Lara ma ashi bumo be
katege nɛ kemɔmɔshia to;
ŋkpal ŋ ka bɛ fo mbraana so so.
23Bewurjipo shɛr a kre ma ŋkre lubi,
ama ma ere bee fɛ fo mbraana
be asheŋ nna.
24Fo mbraana e naa shin nɛ
ma kagbene bee fuli ma ga;
amo e naa ji ma asoe to.
25A ka gbrɛ nɛ n wu n yɔ eshishɛr to;
shin nɛ fo kamalga na e naŋ sa
ma ŋkpa popɔr.
26Ŋ ka kaŋɛ fo ma etɔrɔbi kikɛ na,
fo nu ma kabɔrɛkule nna.
Naniere ŋini ma fo atande.
27Chɛ ma to nɛ n tiŋ m pin fo mbraana to,
saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa fɛ
fo emamachisheŋ be asheŋ.
28Ma ebɔl to duŋi ma alegaiso nna;
leŋ ma to fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na.
29Shin nɛ m baa gelge kafulesheŋ;
wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ ŋini ma fo mbra na.
30Ma ere yili kumo fanɛ meeŋ baa wɔ
kashenteŋji be kebaawɔtɔ to nna;
nsaa sa fo mbraana bunyaŋ.
31O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ma ere bɛ fo mbraana so nna;
amoso sa maŋ shin nɛ n ji anishinyɔr.
32N wora shiriya kenishipereso nna
nɛ ŋ wora fo mbraana kasonu,
ŋkpal manɛ so, feeŋ chɛ ma to
nɛ n nya kepinto n ti so.
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin kepinto be asheŋ
33Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋini ma fo mbraana be kifi to,
saŋɛ na so, meeŋ baa wora amo
kasonu saŋkikɛ.
34Chɛ ma to nɛ m pin fo mbra to
nseŋ wora kumo kasonu;
saŋɛ na so, meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ
m bɛ kumo so.
35Ta fo mbraana na a ŋini ma ekpa,
ŋkpal manɛ so, amo e naa
fuli ma kagbene.
36Shin nɛ ma kagbene e kilgi
a sha kebaawora
fo mbraana kasonu a chɔ
kebaasha kedamaya.
37Lara ma lakal ashi asheŋ fuloŋ so;
nseŋ shin nɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ e baa du
fanɛ kananɛ fo kamalga bee ŋini na.
38N la fo kayɛrbi nna.
Wora kusɔ nɛ fo nase kɔnɔ
n sa bekama nɛ baa ŋana fo na
n sa ma alɛ gba.
39Baa kuŋ ma ashi ŋaba nɛ mee ŋana to;
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo mbraana walɛ nna.
40Mee sha kebaawora
fo mbraana kasonu ga;
Sa ma ŋkpa popɔr,
ŋkpal fo ka la esa niŋiso so.
Kebaa yirda Ebɔrɛ be mbraana be asheŋ
41Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ŋini ma fo kasha
nseŋ mɔlga ma,
fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na;
42saŋɛ na so meeŋ tiŋ n tuge bumo
nɛ baa tege ma na be mmalga to;
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo kamalga nɛ n yirda.
43Jemanɛ kikɛ sa maŋ kaŋ lara fo
kashenteŋ be mmalga na ma kɔnɔ to;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma tama wɔ fo mbraana to nna.
44Meeŋ baa wora fo mbra na kasonu,
hale mbaanaayɔ.
45Ŋkpal ŋ ka bee wora
fo mbraana kasonu so,
n nya ma kumu nna
a ji ma keparso.
46Ma alɛ beeŋ baa malga
fo mbraana be asheŋ
a sa bewurjipo nsaa maa
ŋana anishinyɔr.
47Ŋkpal ŋ ka bee sha fo mbraana na so,
amo be asheŋ bee par ma,
a fuli ma kagbene.
48Mee sha fo mbraana na
nsaa sa amo bunyaŋ,
amoso meeŋ ta amo n wɔtɔ
kumu to a fɛ amo be asheŋ.
Keta yirda n deŋi Ebɔrɛ be mbra so be asheŋ
49Baa nyiŋi kɔnɔ nɛ fo nase n sa ma,
fo kayɛrbi na;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
ma tama deŋ kumo so nna.
50Ashi ma etɔrɔ to gba,
n daŋ nya kelolo nna
ŋkpal fo kɔnɔ naseso
ka sa ma ŋkpa so.
51Kamoowuwuraana bee
wora ma eyurto nna,
ama ma alɛ maŋ lar fo mbra kaman.
52O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyiŋi fo mbra
nɛ e wɔtɔ dra dra na kikɛ na;
amo e naa bar ma kagbenewushi.
53M baŋ wu kumukpakpasowura
ka bee wora a da fo mbra so,
k bee kaa ma kagbene nna.
54Kaplɛkama nɛ n wɔ,
fo mbra be nshɛ nɛ mee boŋ.
55Kanyɛso gba mee fɛ fo,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ nna,
nsaa wora fo mbra kasonu.
56Kusɔ nɛ mee wora saŋkikɛ e la
kebaawora fo mbra na kasonu.
Keta fo kumu n deŋi Ebɔrɛ be mbra so be asheŋ
57Fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e la ma kusɔ kikɛ.
N nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ wora
fo mmalga kasonu.
58Mee kule fo nna ashi
ma kagbene to kikɛ fanɛ
fo wu ma kuwɔr fanɛ
kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na.
59Ŋ keni ŋ gbagba be asheŋ
woraso to nɛnɛ nseŋ nase kɔnɔ
fanɛ meeŋ bɛ fo mbraana so.
60Meeŋ baa nya manaŋ
a wora fo mbraana kasonu.
61Hale nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana
ta efɔl ŋ kre ma gba,
m maaŋ teŋ fo mbra so.
62Mee koso kiidiso nna a kpaŋ fo,
ŋkpal fo mbra niŋiso na so.
63Ekama nɛ e bee shuŋ fo ŋko a wora
fo mbraana kasonu na la n teri nna.
64O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na
bɔlɔ kasawule ere kikɛ so nna;
amoso ŋini ma fo mbraana na.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra na be tɔnɔ be asheŋ
65Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wora fo kayɛrbi kelela
fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ
ashi fo kamalga to na.
66Sa ma kanyiasheŋ nɛ nfɛra lela,
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo mbraana nɛ n yirda.
67N daŋ wora n da so nna
nɛ fo gberge ma kusoe,
ama naniere bre n wora
fo kamalga kasonu nna na.
68Fo la esa lela nna
nɛ fo asheŋ woraso
kikɛ la asheŋ lela;
amoso ŋini ma fo mbraana.
69Kamoowuwuraana ku efɛ
n deŋi ma a fin kejija ma ketre;
ama ma kagbene kikɛ nɛ
ŋ kɔ a bɛ fo mbraana na so.
70B maa pin fo asheŋ to,
ama ma ere be kagbene
bee fuli fo mbra so nna.
71Kasogberge nɛ n daŋ nya na
daŋ chɛ ma to;
k daŋ chɛ ma to nɛ ŋ koya
fo mbraana.
72Mbra nɛ fo ta n sa ma na
kɔ kechɛto n sa ma a chɔ
durnya to be amansherbi kikɛ.
Ebɔrɛ be mbra ka bee ji asheŋ nɛnɛ be asheŋ
73Fo e to ma nseŋ bela ma eyur
n chuge abar so;
sa ma kanyiasheŋ nɛ ŋ koya
fo mbraana na.
74Bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo beeŋ wu ma
nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e fuli bumo
ŋkpal ŋ ka ta ma tama n wɔtɔ
fo kamalga to so.
75Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyi fanɛ
fo mbra niŋi nna;
fo ekpa so nɛ fo gberge ma kusoe.
76Shin nɛ fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na
e baa lolo ma,
fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ n sa ma,
fo kayɛrbi na.
77Wu ma kuwɔr n shin nɛ
m baa wɔ ŋkpa to,
ŋkpal fo mbra ka bee fuli
ma kagbene so.
78Shin nɛ kamoowuwuraana
e ji anishinyɔr ŋkpal b kaa bee
ku efɛ a deŋi ma so;
ma ere beeŋ ta fo mbra n wɔtɔ
kumu to a fɛ amo be asheŋ.
79Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ fo
nsaa nyi fo mbraana na e ba ma kutɔ.
80Shin nɛ m baa sa fo mbraana
bunyaŋ kashenteŋto,
saŋɛ na so, m maaŋ ji anishinyɔr.
Kesɔnyige be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
81N jo fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nɛ fo sɔ ma n yige n ya gben;
ama ma tama kraa wɔ fo kamalga to.
82N to kenishi a keni fo
kɔnɔ naseso ekpa n ya gben.
Saŋɛ mo nɛ feeŋ wu ma kuwɔr
nseŋ chɛ ma to?
83M maaŋ naa kɔ tɔnɔ fanɛ
yabra be kapuya bureso;
ama ma alɛ kraa maŋ teŋ fo
mbraana so.
84Saŋɛ mo nɛ a daga fanɛ n jo n ya fo?
Jemanɛ mo nɛ feeŋ gberge basa
nɛ baa kɔrfɛ ma na kusoe?
85Kamoowuwuraana nɛ b maa
wora fo mbra kasonu
kur amaŋ nna n nase a jo ma
nɛ n tɔr to.
86Esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda fo mbraana kikɛ;
basa bee ku efɛ nna a tɔrɔ ma,
amoso chɛ ma to!
87A ka gbrɛbi nɛ b mɔ ma, ama
ŋ kraŋ maŋ kplaŋ fo mbraana so.
88Ŋini ma fo kasha n shin nɛ
m baa wɔ ŋkpa to;
saŋɛ na so, meeŋ wora fo
mbraana kikɛ kasonu.
Keyirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be mbra na be asheŋ
89O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo kamalga wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ;
ebɔrɛso nɛ k wɔ hale nɛ mbre.
90Fo kashenteŋji malɛ wɔtɔ nna
n sa kekurgeto kama to ebi.
Fo e to kasawule n nase
kumo be kakpa, nɛ k dese
dindiŋ a maa fifir.
91Asɔ kikɛ bee shuŋ fo nna
fanɛ fo nyɛrbi;
fo mbraana kraa shuŋ
hale kabre gba.
92Nɛ n daa maa nya kagbenefuli
ashi fo mbraana to nna,
ndafanɛ n wu ashi ma awurfoŋ to.
93M maaŋ teŋ fo keŋini so kikɛ;
ŋkpal manɛ so, amo nɛ fo bɔla so
n sa ma ŋkpa nɛ n wɔtɔ.
94Mɔlga ma, ŋkpal manɛ so,
n la feya nna!
Ma alɛ wora ania nna fanɛ
meeŋ wora fo mbraana kasonu.
95Kumukpakpasowuraana bee
jo ma nna nɛ b mɔ ma,
ama meeŋ wɔtɔ lakal fo mbraana to
n wora amo kasonu.
96N wu fanɛ kusɔ kama maŋ niŋi
kumo alɛ kɔ ekar;
fo mbraana nawule e niŋi
nsaa maa kɔ ekar.
97Mee sha fo mbraana na ga!
Mee fɛ amo be asheŋ
kachɛ lelemu kikɛ nna.
98Fo mbraana maa lar ma
nfɛra to kikɛ,
amo alɛ bee shin nɛ mee pin
asheŋ to a chɔ ma doŋana nna.
99Ŋ ka bee fɛ fo mbraana
be asheŋ ga so, mee pin asheŋ
a chɔ ma beŋinipoana kikɛ gba.
100Ŋkpal ŋ ka bee wora fo
mbraana kasonu so,
ŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ ga
a chɔ basakpar gba.
101Ŋ ka bee sha kelara
ma kumu asheŋ lubi to so,
mee wora fo mbraana kasonu nna.
102Ma alɛ maŋ yige fo mbraana n lɛ
ŋkpal fo gbagba ka la ma eŋinipo so.
103Fo mbraana bee wora ma ebel
a chɔ mushoŋchu gba.
104Fo mbraana so nɛ mee bɔla
a pin asheŋ to,
amoso nɛ ŋ kishi efɛsheŋ kikɛ na.
Kefulto nɛ k wɔ Ebɔrɛ be mbra to be asheŋ
105Fo kamalga du fanɛ fitila nna n sa ma,
kumo e naa shin nɛ ma ekpa so
bee fulto nɛ mee wu a wora asheŋ.
106M bɔ ntaŋ n nase kɔnɔ
nsaa yil kumo so fanɛ meeŋ wora
fo mbra niŋisoana na kasonu.
107Awurfoŋ damta nɛ n ji!
Amoso, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ m baa kraa wɔ ŋkpa to,
fanɛ kananɛ fo kaŋɛ fanɛ
feeŋ wora na.
108O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
sɔ ma kapandi be sarga
nseŋ ŋini ma fo mbraana na.
109Jemanɛ kikɛ mee ta
ma ŋkpa nna a pɛl,
ama m maaŋ teŋ fo
mbraana bre so kikɛ.
110Kumukpakpasowuraana
sho ma ajigbelɛ nna,
ama ma alɛ maŋ lar fo
mbraana kaman kikɛ.
111Fo mbraana na la ma
mpetɛsɔ nna mbaanaayɔ;
amo e naa shin nɛ ma
kagbene bee fuli ma.
112Ma ere yili kumo ma
kagbene to fanɛ meeŋ wora
fo mbraana kasonu hale n ya
fo ma kaluwuachɛ.
113Ŋ kishi nfɛraanyɔnyɔwuraana
be asheŋ ga;
ama mee sha fo mbra bre be asheŋ.
114Fo kutɔ nɛ mee nya ma kumu a ji,
fo alɛ e la ma ekumpo a kuŋ ma;
amoso nɛ n ta ma tama n deŋi
fo nnɔ naseso so na.
115Alubiworapoana,
men shile ma so!
Ma ere beeŋ wora ma
Ebɔrɛ be mbraana kasonu.
116Sa ma eleŋ fanɛ kananɛ
fo nase kɔnɔ na nseŋ shin nɛ
m baa wɔ ŋkpa to.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ ma tama
e to jiga nɛ n ji anishinyɔr.
117Baa keni ma so nɛ n nya
ma kumu a wɔtɔ,
nɛ jemanɛ kikɛ ma lakal e baa
wɔ fo mbraana so.
118Fee lar bekama nɛ baa kini
kebaawora fo mbraana
kasonu na kaman nna;
bumo alɛ be kafulesheŋ
la asheŋ fuloŋ nna.
119Fee wu kumukpakpasowuraana
fanɛ epi nna,
amoso nɛ meeŋ bɛ fo keŋini so.
120Ŋkpal kananɛ fo demuji
be mbraana du so,
kufu bee pɛ ma nna nɛ mee chicha.
121N wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nsaa walɛ;
sa maŋ yige ma n sa bedoŋ.
122Jande keni fo kayɛrbi so nɛnɛ;
sa maŋ shin nɛ kamoowuwuraana
e nya ma ŋ kɔrfɛ.
123Ŋ keni fo kumɔlga nɛ fo
nase kumo be kɔnɔ na ekpa
hale nɛ ma anishi gben a besa.
124Ŋini fo kayɛrbi fo kasha
nɛ k maa loge na,
nseŋ ŋini ma fo mbraana na.
125N la fo kayɛrbi nna a shuŋ fo,
sa ma asheŋ be kepinto nɛ m baa
pin fo mbraana to.
126O, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, jemanɛ fo
nɛ fo wora kusɔ ko!
Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa bee wora
a da fo mbraana so nna.
127Mee sha fo mbraana a chɔ shuwa,
mee sha amo a chɔ shuwa gbagba gba.
128Mee bɛ fo mbraana kikɛ so nna,
ŋ kishi ekpa lubi be yiri kikɛ
be kebɔla so n wora asheŋ.
129Fo mbraana la mamachi nna pasaa,
amoso nɛ mee wora amo kasonu na.
130Kebaapin fo mmalga to
bee bugi nfɛra to nna
nsaa sa basa nɛ b maŋ
nyi asheŋ kanyiasheŋ.
131Mee sha kepere kenishi nna m pin
kusɔ kama nɛ fee ŋini to.
132Naŋ laŋɛ fo nfɛra m ba ma so
nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr,
fanɛ kananɛ fee kaa wora
bekama nɛ fee sha na.
133Sa maŋ shin nɛ n tɔr fanɛ
kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na,
fo alɛ e sa maŋ shin nɛ
kulubi e pɔɔ ma so.
134Baa kuŋ ma nɛ basa e sa
maŋ nya ma ŋ kɔrfɛ;
saŋɛ na so meeŋ wora
fo mbraana kasonu.
135Mushe n wora ma, fo kayɛrbi,
nseŋ ŋini ma fo mbraana na.
136Mee kaa shu anishichubi nna,
ŋkpal basa ka maa wora
fo mbraana kasonu so.
137O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo niŋi nna
nɛ fo mbraana malɛ bɔla ekpa.
138Fo keŋini kikɛ la kashenteŋ nna
nseŋ daga esa ka yirda amo.
139Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ bedoŋ baŋ
kplaŋ fo mbraana so,
k bee chɔɔ ma to nna fanɛ edɛ.
140Fo kamalga du fanɛ shuwa nna
n sa fo kayɛrbi;
mee sha kumo nsaa keni kumo
a bɔlɔ kenishi alegaiso.
141Ekama maa ta ma a tre shɛŋ,
ama ma alɛ maa teŋ fo mbraana so.
142Fo kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso wɔtɔ nna
mbaanaayɔ;
nɛ fo mbra malɛ la kashenteŋ
jemanɛ kikɛ.
143Etɔrɔ nɛ kagbenejija damta
wɔ ma to;
ama fo mbraana bee sa ma
kagbenefuli nna.
144Fo mbraana niŋi nna jemanɛ kikɛ,
amoso chɛ ma to nɛ m pin amo to
nsaa wɔ ŋkpa to.
145O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ma kagbene kikɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ a tre fo,
nu ma ketre ere n shin nɛ n wora fo
mbraana kasonu.
146Fo nɛ mee shu a tre;
mɔlga ma nseŋ shin nɛ
n wora fo mbraana kasonu.
147Pɔɛŋ nɛ epeŋi e pete gba,
fo nɛ mee kule a fin kechɛto.
N ta ma tama nna n deŋi fo
kamalga naseso so.
148N dese nna a keni kanyɛ lelemu kikɛ,
a fɛ fo mmalga naseso be asheŋ.
149Ŋini ma fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na
nseŋ nu ma kekule;
wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ mɔlga ma ŋkpa
fanɛ kananɛ fo mbraana bee ŋini na.
150Basa nɛ b maa wora fo mbra kasonu
kre bumo be ŋkre lubiana nna
a fin ketɔrɔ ma.
151Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bre taga ma to nna,
nɛ fo mbraana kikɛ la kashenteŋ.
152Ŋ koya fo mbraana na m pin to
fanɛ dra kikɛ nɛ fo yili kumo fanɛ
a baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
153Keni awurfoŋ nɛ mee ji so
nseŋ mɔlga ma,
ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ teŋ fo
mbraana so.
154Kɔ n sa ma nseŋ sɔ ma n yige,
mɔlga ma fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na.
155Kumukpakpasowuraana
maaŋ nya kumɔlga,
ŋkpal b ka maa wora fo
mbraana kasonu so.
156O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo kuwɔrwu be kasha shi ga;
jande wu ma kuwɔr nseŋ mɔlga ma.
157Ŋ kɔ bedoŋ damta nɛ baa
fin ma nɛ kulubi,
ama m maa kini kebaawora
fo mbraana kasonu.
158Ŋ kishi basa kama nɛ b maŋ
kɔ yirda n sa fo,
ŋkpal manɛ so, b maa wora
fo mbraana kasonu.
159Keni kananɛ mee sha fo keŋini loŋ,
O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
ŋini ma fo kasha nɛ k maa loge na
nseŋ mɔlga ma.
160Fo mmalga kikɛ la kashenteŋ nna,
nɛ fo mbraana nɛ a niŋi na
wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
Keta kumu n to Ebɔrɛ be mbra so be asheŋ
161Kenyanyaŋɛso nɛ bewurjipo
bee kɔ ma;
ama ma ere bee sa fo kamalga
bunyaŋ ashi ma kagbene to nna.
162Fo nnɔ naseso bee fuli
ma kagbene nna fanɛ esa
nɛ e nya yawu kpakpaso
be asɔ lela kena to nna.
163Ŋ kishi efɛsheŋ ga;
maa sha amo be asheŋ,
ama mee sha fo mbra bre.
164Ale shunu nɛ mee
kpaŋ fo karechɛ kikɛ,
ŋkpal fo mbraana ka niŋi
nsaa maŋ kɔ ŋkpɛato so.
165Bekama nɛ baa sha fo
mbraana na bee nya
kayurwushi gboŋgboŋi nna;
shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ
b fiti n tɔr kikɛ.
166O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mee jo fo nna,
nɛ fo mɔlga ma nɛ m bɛ fo kanase so.
167Mee wora fo keŋini kasonu nna,
ŋkpal ŋ ka bee sha amo ga so.
168Mee wora fo kanase nɛ keŋini
kasonu nna;
fo alɛ bee wu kusɔ nɛ mee wora kikɛ.
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin kechɛto be asheŋ
169Jande Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nu ma kabɔrɛkule;
sa ma kepinto nɛ k shi fo
kamalga to.
170Nu ma kabɔrɛkule
nseŋ mɔlga ma
fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na.
171Meeŋ bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kpaŋ fo,
ŋkpal fo kaa bee ŋini ma fo
mbraana so.
172Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ a laŋɛ fo
mbra be kaplɛa so;
ŋkpal fo atande ka niŋi so.
173Wora shiriya n chɛ ma to,
ŋkpal ŋ ka bee bɛ fo kusɔ
nɛ fo yili so so.
174Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nɛ mee jo
nɛ fo mɔlga ma,
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo mbra e naa
fuli ma kagbene.
175Shin nɛ m baa wɔ ŋkpa to,
saŋɛ na so meeŋ baa kpaŋ fo.
Jande shin nɛ n nya
kechɛto ashi fo keŋini to.
176N la fo kayɛrbi nna
nseŋ foe n luri to fanɛ kubolpɔ.
Amoso jande fin ma, ŋkpal manɛ so,
m maaŋ teŋ fo mbraana so kikɛ.

Title: NSHƐ 120
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin kechɛto be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1M baa wɔ tɔrɔ to, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nɛ mee kule nɛ e bee nu ma kekule.
2O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga ma ashi
befɛpo nɛ kafulewuraana be enɔ to.
3Menyi befɛpo ere, manɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ
beeŋ wora menyi?
Nuso be kasogberge nɛ e beeŋ
sa menyi?
4Benapo be atanyembi nɛ e du
pɛlpɛlbi nɛ kedɛmurmur
nɛ e beeŋ ta ŋ gberge menyi kusoe!
5Ma kechena menyi to gba lubi nna,
fanɛ ŋ ka chena Mɛshɛk be efuli so,
kakpa wɔfɔ ŋko Kɛda be basa be
ewajɛbu nɛ a maŋ taga to nfe na to.
6N chena basa nɛ b kishi kayurwushi
be asheŋ na to n chɛr ga!
7N la esa nɛ mee sha kayurwushi nna,
ama m baa malga kayurwushi be asheŋ,
kusɔ nɛ baa sha kikɛ e la kena.

Title: NSHƐ 121
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ baa kuŋ mbe basa be asheŋ
1N to kenishi ŋ keni abee so;
Nnɛ nɛ ma kechɛto bee shi a ba?
2Ma kechɛto bee shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule na kutɔ nna.
3E maaŋ shin nɛ fo fɛrge n tɔr;
Edi maa la fo ekumpo na.
4Kashenteŋto edi maa la
Israɛl be ekumpo na.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa keni fo so;
mo alɛ wɔ fo kutɔ nna
a kuŋ fo saŋkama.
6Kapiidi be epeŋi maaŋ tiŋ n doro fo,
kanyɛso be kufɔl gba
maaŋ tiŋ n wora fo shɛŋ.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ kuŋ fo ashi
kusɔ kama nɛ k beeŋ tiŋ n doro fo,
ŋko m mɔ fo.
Saŋɛ na so, shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ wora fo.
8Fo keyɔ nɛ keba kikɛ to,
mo e naaŋ baa kuŋ fo mbaanaayɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 122
Content:
Ewura Deevid be kapandi be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Ma kagbene daŋ fuli nna ga
ŋkpal b ka kaŋɛ ma le so:
“An yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na pe!”
2Naniere an yil Jerusalɛm
be kadegboŋ na to be
mbunagboŋ na ase nna.
3B pɔr Jerusalɛm fanɛ kadegboŋ
nɛ k tir abar to a walɛ kebita nna.
4K la kakpa nɛ Israɛl be eyiriana na
bee wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kasonu nna,
nsaa ba ndoŋ m baa kaa di mo epaŋ.
5Ndoŋ nɛ Israɛl be bewura bee chena
a ji bumo be basa demu.
6Men kule kayurwushi n sa Jerusalɛm;
saŋɛ na so, asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa
bekama nɛ b kɔ kasha n sa kumo na.
7Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ kayurwushi
e baa wɔ kadegboŋ na to;
e shin nɛ kayurwushi e baa wɔ
ndoŋ be ewurkpaana.
8Mee kule kayurwushi nna
a sa Jerusalɛm
ŋkpal ŋ kurgepoana nɛ nteriana so.
9Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe anyi be Ebɔrɛ
be lambu na so,
nɛ mee kule Ebɔrɛ a fin
kadegboŋ na be nɛnɛ na.

Title: NSHƐ 123
Content:
Kekule n fin Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔrwu be asheŋ
1O an Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ma anishi yuu fo,
nɛ fo kuwurputi wɔ ebɔrɛso na so nna.
2Mbita bee keni bumo b bechepeana
be anishito nna.
Ama anyi ere bee keni fo,
Enyɛnpe, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na,
nɛ fo wu anyi kuwɔr nna.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu anyi kuwɔr!
An ji katege nɛ baa tege anyi na
be kanyiti n chɛr ga.
4Kamoowuwuraana wora anyi eyurto,
nseŋ fɛl anyi n chɛr nɛ an wora ania
n ji kumo be kanyiti.

Title: NSHƐ 124
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka la mbe basa be ekumpo be asheŋ
1Men shin nɛ Israɛl be basa e kaŋɛ le:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daa maa wɔ
anyi be kaman nna;
manɛ nɛ anyi daa beeŋ wora?
2Jemanɛ nɛ an doŋana daa kɔ anyi na,
e daa wɔ anyi kutɔ nna.
3B daa sha kemɔ anyi kikɛ nna m mur,
ŋkpal b ka daŋ nya agbo ga so.
4N dafanɛ bumo be agbo nɛ k daŋ koso
fanɛ lɔr ka bɔlɔ n dii kepla so na
daa beeŋ dii m muni anyi so.
5Nchu nɛ e daa baga to a shile ga ere
daa beeŋ sulɔ anyi n yɔ.
6Men shin nɛ an di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e maŋ sa an doŋana ekpa,
nɛ b we anyi m mur fanɛ
kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya na epaŋ.
7An nya anyi be amu n shile
fanɛ kusɔbɔya ka gbaŋ
ekpampo be kejigbelɛ n lɛ
nseŋ nya n shile na nna.
8Anyi be kechɛto bee shi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to esoso
nɛ kasawule na kutɔ nna.

Title: NSHƐ 125
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be basa ka nya bumo be amu be asheŋ
1Bekama nɛ b yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
du fanɛ Zayɔn be kebee na nna
ashi Jerusalɛm to,
nɛ k maa gbuŋgbuŋ na nna.
K yil nna mbaanaayɔ.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kulti
mbe basa n wɔtɔ a kuŋ bumo,
fanɛ kananɛ abee ana na kulti
Jerusalɛm n wɔtɔ na.
3E maaŋ shuli n shin nɛ
kumukpakpasowuraana
e ji kuwura mbe basa so,
ŋko n fule bumo nɛ b wora alubi.
4Men shin nɛ an kule
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e baa wora
bekama nɛ baa wora alelasheŋ
nsaa wora mbe mbraana
kasonu nɛnɛ na kelela.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na baa gberge
kumukpakpasowuraana kusoe,
e beeŋ gberge bekama nɛ b yige
mbe ekpaana n lɛ gba kusoe.
Kayurwushi e baa wɔ
Israɛl be basa so!

Title: NSHƐ 126
Content:
Kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ be kayurji be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ bɛta anyi
n shi kenyaya to m ba Jerusalɛm to,
k daŋ wora anyi nna
fanɛ edare nɛ anyee ku.
2Emushe nɛ kagbenefuli be nshɛ
nɛ an daŋ ta n ji eyur.
Ndoŋ nna nɛ efuli pɔtɛana be basa
ji anyi be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le:
