“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e wora
asheŋgboŋ n sa mbe basa na.”
3Kashenteŋto nɛ e wora
asheŋgboŋ n sa anyi;
nɛ anyi alɛ be ŋgbene fuli
anyi alegaiso!
4O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, anyee kule fo nna
nɛ fo naŋ bɛta n nɛfa anyi be basa
nseŋ shin nɛ an baa du fanɛ
keshishɛrsawule so be mbombi
nɛ e bee bɔlɔ nchu a shile kafɛ kikɛ.
5Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa
gben a du asɔduu so na,
e teŋi amo nɛ kagbenefuli
nseŋ ji eyur.
6Shin nɛ bekama nɛ baa
gben a sulɔ bumo be
asɔduu so a yɔ nɛ keduu to na,
e ta kagbenefuli be nshɛ
n ya teŋi amo n sulɔ m ba epe.

Title: NSHƐ 127
Content:
Kekpaŋ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal mbe alelasheŋ so be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na baa
maŋ chɛ to m pɔr kowu na,
bepɔrpo bee gben jiga nna.
Nɛ e baa maŋ kuŋ kadegboŋ na,
bekumpo na bee kuŋ kumo jiga nna.
2Kewule ŋ koso a shuŋ a fin kusɔ jiso
hale nɛ saŋko e ya fo na gba la jiga nna;
Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa sa basa nɛ e bee sha asɔ
jemanɛ nɛ b dese a di gba.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa basa mbia,
nɛ mbia na e baa la nɛfa n sa bumo.
4Mbia nɛ esa beeŋ nya
jemanɛ nɛ e kraa kɔ eleŋ na,
du fanɛ enapo be akɔsɔ nna.
5Kagbenefuli la ekama nɛ e kɔ
mbia damta na peya nna,
ŋkpal manɛ so, baaŋ kuŋ mo,
jemanɛ nɛ mo doŋana beeŋ tu mo
a ji asheŋ ashi demujikpa na.

Title: NSHƐ 128
Content:
Tɔnɔ nɛ k wɔ kewora Ebɔrɛ kasonu to asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nɛfa
ekama nɛ e bee nu a sa mo
nsaa wora asheŋ a bɛ mbe
mbra be ekpa so na.
2E beeŋ ji mbe kegben be tɔnɔ;
asheŋ beeŋ baa nite nɛnɛ a sa mo
nɛ mbe kagbene e fuli mo.
3Mbe eche beeŋ baa du fanɛ
kedibisɔrso nɛ k bee sɔr ga
ashi mbe laŋ to.
Mbe mbia malɛ beeŋ baa
du fanɛ ɔlif be ndibi popɔrbi
m bɔlɔ laŋ.
4Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee nɛfa esa kama nɛ e bee
nu a sa mo nna na.
5Ma kabɔrɛkule e la fanɛ,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shi Zayɔn
be kebee na so n nɛfa fo ashi
fo kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to;
nseŋ shin nɛ Jerusalɛm be
kadegboŋ na e nyalɛ.
6Ebɔrɛ e sa fo ŋkpa tenteŋ
nɛ fo chɛr nseŋ wu fo
nanabiana kenishiso.
Kayurwushi e baa wɔ
Israɛl be basa so!

Title: NSHƐ 129
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin kekuŋ be asheŋ
1Ma kebia to kikɛ,
bedoŋ baa kɔ ma nna!
Amoso ekama nɛ e wɔ
Israɛl e kaŋɛ le:
2“Ma kebia to kikɛ,
bedoŋ baa kɔrfɛ ma nna!
Ama bumo alɛ maŋ
tiŋ m pɔ ma so.
3Baa chaŋɛ a chaŋɛ ma kaman nna,
fanɛ kananɛ baa baŋɛ mburbi
kudɔsawule so na.
4Ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e niŋi
kusɔ kama to na tuge ma ashi
kumukpakpasowuraana be afɔl so.
5Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ bekama
nɛ b kishi Jerusalɛm nɛ k yil
Zayɔn be kebee so na
e ji anishinyɔr nseŋ bɛta
bumo be ayamu so n shile.
6Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ b wu
nsaa maaŋ nya n daŋ
fanɛ afitiri nɛ a kɔr ebuuso na.
7Ekama maa ku amo ere a gama
abar so a sulɔ fanɛ atembɔ.
8Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bɔla bumo
ase a choŋ e sa maŋ kaŋɛ le:
‘Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e nɛfa menyi!
Ŋko mee nɛfa menyi ashi
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be ketre to nna!’ ”

Title: NSHƐ 130
Content:
Keyirda Ebɔrɛ tɔrɔ be jemanɛ be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, tɔrɔ damta to
nɛ n wɔ shu a tre fo.
2Nu ma kekule,
nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr n chɛ ma to!
3Nɛ fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
daa sibɛ alubi a nase nna,
esa kikɛ daa maaŋ ji n lar
fo demuji to.
4Ama fee ta anyi be alubi
a paŋ anyi nna;
saŋɛ na so kɔnɔ beeŋ mɔ anyi
ashi fo anishito.
5Ma kagbene kikɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ
a jo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Ma tama kikɛ malɛ wɔ
mbe kamalga na to nna.
6Mee keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ekpa kenishipereso nna,
fanɛ kananɛ esa nɛ e chena a da
asɔ so bee keni karechɛ ekpa na.
Kashenteŋto, mee keni mo ekpa
a chɔ kananɛ esa nɛ e da asɔ so
bee keni karechɛ ekpa na.
7Israɛlebi, men yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe kasha nɛ k maa
chɛrga na maa loge kikɛ;
mo alɛ kɔ eleŋ nɛ e tiŋ m mɔlga menyi.
8Israɛlebi, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mɔlga
menyi ashi menyi be alubi kikɛ to.

Title: NSHƐ 131
Content:
Keyirda Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n yige ma
kamoowu kikɛ nseŋ lar ma
keŋkenshi kikɛ nyam to.
M maŋ naa ta ma kumu
a wɔtɔ asheŋgboŋ to,
ŋko emamachisheŋ nɛ
m maaŋ tiŋ m pin to to.
2Ama ŋ koya keshin nɛ kayurwushi
be kebaawɔtɔ e kukwe ma.
Kananɛ kebia popɔrbi bee dese
mo nio be enɔ to boeŋ na,
nɛ ma kagbene gba dese ma to.
3O Israɛlebi, men ta menyi
be tama n deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so
naniere hale mbaanaayɔ!

Title: NSHƐ 132
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka wɔ mbe basa to saŋkama be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa nyiŋi
Ewura Deevid nɛ awurfoŋ nɛ e ji
na kikɛ be asheŋ.
2Nyiŋi kɔnɔ nɛ e daŋ nase n sa fo,
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ an nananyɛn
Jeekɔb daŋ shuŋ dra dra na:
3E yɛ: “M maaŋ yɔ epe,
ŋko n ya dese ma gedo so;
4edi malɛ maaŋ la ma
hale nɛ mee di,
5n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ meeŋ nya
ekpa m pɔr bɔrɛlambu n sa
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la
Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na.”
6Jemanɛ nɛ an daa wɔ Bɛtlɛhɛm na,
nɛ an nu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be ŋkre be deka na daa wɔ
kakpa ko nɛ k mata kakpa
nɛ baa tre Jearim na.
7Ndoŋ nna nɛ an kaŋɛ le:
Men shin nɛ an yɔ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na pe
n ya gbir mbe aya ase
m bunyaŋ mo.
8O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
shin nɛ fo ŋkre be deka
nɛ k yili n sa fo eleŋgboŋ na,
e ba kaa wɔ fo bɔrɛlambu to
mbaanaayɔ.
9Shin nɛ fo bɔrɛmatapoana
e baa wora asheŋ niŋiso,
nseŋ shin nɛ fo basa nɛ baa
ji kashenteŋ a sa fo na e baa
boŋ nshɛ nsaa ji eyur kagbenefuliso.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, Ewura Deevid
la esa nɛ fo lara n sa fo kumu nna,
amoso sa maŋ kini mo n lɛ.
11Fo e daŋ bɔ ntaŋ n nase
kɔnɔ n sa mo; kumo alɛ la
kɔnɔ naseso nɛ feeŋ wora
m bɔlɔ so nna.
Fo yɛ: “Jemanɛ kikɛ meeŋ
shin nɛ fo kaman to ebi
e baa ji kuwura.
12Nɛ fo kaman to ebi beeŋ baa
bɛ ma nɛ fo be kɔnɔkoŋwule
be ŋkre na so nsaa wora ma
keŋini kasonu, kumo ere meeŋ
shin nɛ fo kaman to ebi e baa ji
Israɛl be kuwura mbaanaayɔ.”
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e lara Zayɔn be kebee
ashi Jerusalɛm to,
nɛ k baa la mbe echenakpa.
14E yɛ: “Kakpa nɛ meeŋ baa
wɔ mbaanaayɔ nde;
kakpa nɛ meeŋ chena a ji
kuwura nna na.
15Meeŋ nɛfa Jerusalɛm alegaiso,
Kumo to be betirpo gba beeŋ
baa nya a ji a moɛ.
16Meeŋ nɛfa kusɔ kama nɛ
bɔrɛmatapoana na beeŋ baa wora
nɛ basa na malɛ e baa
boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso.
17Meeŋ shin nɛ Deevid
be kuwurji e nya eleŋgboŋ.
Esa kama nɛ meeŋ lara m buu
mo kuwura beeŋ baa nyɛkpɛ
a fuli to fanɛ fitila na.
18E beeŋ baa buu kuwurwuro
nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ.
Ama meeŋ shin nɛ mo doŋana
bre a ji anishinyɔr.”

Title: NSHƐ 133
Content:
Kechena abar so kayurwushi so be asheŋ
1Kekurge koŋwule to be basa
be kechena abar so kashaso
nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso walɛ ga.
2K du fanɛ b ka daŋ duga
ɔlif be ŋku n wurge bɔrɛmatapo
Ɛɛrɔn be kumu so nɛ a gbelge to
m bɔla mbe katɔl so m ba
mbe piŋi be kubɔ to nna.
3Kumo alɛ naa du fanɛ bunyaŋ
ka shi Hɛɛmɔn be kebeegboŋ na so
a wurge Jerusalɛm be abee so nna.
Ndoŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ
fanɛ e beeŋ ta ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar
n nɛfa mbe basa na.

Title: NSHƐ 134
Content:
Kebaadi Ebɔrɛ epaŋ kanyɛso kikɛ be asheŋ
1Menyi nɛ men la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be nyɛrbi a shuŋ mo ashi mbe
bɔrɛlambu to kanyɛso na
e baa di mo epaŋ.
2Men maŋ menyi be enɔana so
kabɔrɛkule to ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be bɔrɛlambu to ŋ kpaŋ mo.
3Mee kule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule nna
fanɛ e yili Zayɔn n nɛfa menyi!

Title: NSHƐ 135
Content:
Kekpaŋ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal mbe alelasheŋ so be asheŋ
1Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Menyi nɛ men la mbe nyɛrbi na
e kpaŋ mbe ketre.
2Menyi nɛ menyee shuŋ Enyɛnpe
anyi be Ebɔrɛ na ashi mbe
bɔrɛlambu to na e kpaŋ mbe ketre.
3Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
ŋkpal e ka la esa lela so.
Men boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ mbe ketre,
ŋkpal k ka bee par mo so.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e lara an
nananyɛn Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi,
nɛ b la Israɛl be basa na,
fanɛ b baa la mo gbagba be basa.
5N nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
shi ga a chɔ agbirana kikɛ.
6Kusɔ nɛ k par mo nɛ e bee wora
ashi ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so nɛ teku
be kechimbi to kikɛ nyam.
7Mo e naa shin nɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa
bee yili durnya be ekar a ka
a dii a buu so; nsaa shin nɛ
bɔrɛ bee ba nsaa nyɛkpɛ nɛ afu
bee shi kakpa nɛ k wɔ a chela.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ mɔ
Ijipt be efuli so be ewurkoŋ
nɛ asɔbɔya be bibi juŋkparso kikɛ na.
9Mo e daŋ bɔla emamachisheŋ
nɛ alemaŋkarsheŋ so ŋ gberge
Ijipt be ewura, Fɛɛro,
nɛ mbe basa kikɛ kusoe na.
10E daŋ shin nɛ efuli damtaana
mur nɛ bewura lempo wu nna.
11Loŋ be bewura na be beko e daa la:
Amɔri be ewura nɛ baa tre Sihɔn na;
nɛ Bashan be ewura nɛ baa tre Ɔg na
nɛ Keenan be efuli so be bewuraana.
12E daŋ ta bewura na be nsawule nna
n sa mbe basa, Israɛlebi,
fanɛ bumo be kapetɛsawule.
13O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo ketre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ,
kekurgeto kikɛ to be basa
beeŋ baa nyiŋi kumo.
14Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
maaŋ ji m bri mbe basa;
e beeŋ wu bekama nɛ baa
shuŋ mo na kuwɔr.
15Shuwa nɛ gbiti e la
efuli pɔtɛana be agbirana;
edimɛdi e ta enɔ n lɔŋɛ amo.
16Agbirana na kɔ nnɔ nɛ anishi,
amo alɛ maaŋ tiŋ m malga
ŋko n wu shɛŋ.
17A kɔ asoe, amo alɛ maaŋ
tiŋ n nu asheŋ;
a maaŋ tiŋ n fute gba kuraa.
18Bekama nɛ b lɔŋɛ agbirana ere
ŋko n yirda amo beeŋ ki
basa fuloŋ fanɛ amo.
19Israɛl be basa nɛ bɔrɛmatapo
Ɛɛrɔn be kanaŋ to be basa kikɛ,
men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
20Livai be kanaŋ to be basa
nɛ bekama nɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na,
men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
21Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e chena Jerusalɛm to
ashi Zayɔn be kebee na so na.
Men kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 136
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be kasha ka maa wora asheŋ a gben be asheŋ
1Men baa di Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ epaŋ
ŋkpal e ka la esa lela so;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ maa wora shɛŋ a gben.
2Men baa di ebɔrɛana kikɛ to
be Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ;
ŋkpal mbe kasha ka maa
loge kikɛ so.
3Men baa di benyɛnpe to
be Enyɛnpe na epaŋ;
ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe kasha
nɛ k maa chɛrga na
wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
4Mo nawule e naa wora
emamachisheŋ gboŋgboŋi na;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
5Mo gbagba be kanyiasheŋ so
nɛ e to esoso;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e to kasawule
n deŋi nchuana so;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
7Mo e to epeŋi nɛ kufɔl;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
8Mo e shin nɛ epeŋi bee lar karechɛso;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ,
9Mo e naa shin nɛ kufɔl
malɛ bee lar kanyɛso;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
10Mo e daŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be efuli so
be kanaŋ kikɛ to be wurkoŋ wu na;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
11Mo e daŋ juŋkpar Israɛlebi
n lar Ijipt be efuli so na;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
12Mbe eleŋgboŋ nɛ enɔ lempo so
nɛ e bɔla so n lara bumo
ashi Ijipt be efuli so;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
13Mo e daŋ shin nɛ
Teku Peper na ku to;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e juŋkpar
mbe basa Israɛlebi m bɔla teku to
nɛ shɛŋ maŋ wora bumo na;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
15Mo e daŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be ewura
nɛ mbe benapo ji nchu m mur
ashi Teku Peper na to na;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ juŋkpar
mbe basa keshishɛrsawule so na;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
17Mo e daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ
bewurgboŋana so na;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
18Mo e daŋ shin nɛ
bewura lempoana wu na;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
19Bewuraana na be eko e daa la
Amɔ be ewura, Sihɔn;
Ebɔrɛ be kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ;
20eko malɛ e daa la
Bashan be ewura, Ɔg;
Ebɔrɛ be kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
21Ebɔrɛ e daŋ sɔ bewuraana ere
be nsawule n sa mbe basa na;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
22E daŋ sɔ nsawule na nna
n sa Israɛl be basa nɛ b la
mbe nyɛrbi na fanɛ kapetɛsawule;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
23Jemanɛ nɛ bedoŋ daŋ kɔ
m pɔɔ anyi so na
nɛ an daa wɔ etɔrɔ to na,
e daa maŋ teŋ anyi so;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
24E daŋ sɔ anyi nna n yige ashi
an doŋana be enɔ to;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
25Mo e naa sa kusɔ keniso kikɛ ajibi jiso;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
26Men baa di Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na epaŋ;
mbe kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
malɛ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 137
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ a fin kewora n tal to be asheŋ
1An daŋ chena Babilɔn
be elɔr na ase nna
n nyiŋi Jerusalɛm be asheŋ
nseŋ chena n shu ga.
2An daŋ ta anyi be ejaŋjilaŋ n shiga
ndibi nɛ a mata ndoŋ na so nna.
3Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ b pɛ
anyi anya m ba ndoŋ na
daŋ kaŋɛ anyi nna fanɛ
an boŋ nshɛ n deŋi bumo anishito.
B yɛ: “Men boŋ Jerusalɛm to
be nshɛ na be kuko!”
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ an kaŋɛ bumo:
“Nuso nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ
m boŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be kashɛ efuli pɔtɛ so?
5O Jerusalɛm, nɛ ŋ kaŋ teŋ fo so,
Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ n sa maŋ naŋ tiŋ
n laŋ alaŋsɔ kikɛ.
6Nɛ ŋ ka maŋ naŋ nyiŋi fo,
ŋko n ta Jerusalɛm fanɛ kakpa
nɛ ma kagbene bee fuli so ga,
Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ ma kudonduloŋ
e cha m mata ma kɔnɔ to
nɛ nsaa maŋ naŋ tiŋ m malga
ŋko m boŋ nshɛ.
7O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nyiŋi kusɔ
nɛ Edɔmebi na wora
kachɛ nɛ Jerusalɛmebi kɔ n tɔr na.
B yɛ: ‘Men bure kadegboŋ na!
Men mur kumo kikɛ kuraa!’
8Babilɔnebi, menyeeŋ mur cheche!
Ebɔrɛ e nɛfa basa nɛ baaŋ ka menyi
kusɔ nɛ men wora anyi ere be kukɔ.
9Mo e naŋ nɛfa bekama nɛ baaŋ pɛ menyi
be mbiwurbi ŋ ŋmɛa afalta so m mɔ!.”

Title: NSHƐ 138
Content:
Kapandi be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1Meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo;
O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ;
meeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo
ashi emalaika be anishito.
2Meeŋ bunyaŋ fo ashi
fo bɔrɛlambu cheembi to,
nseŋ kpaŋ fo ketre ŋkpal fo
kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
nɛ fo kashenteŋji so,
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo maŋ fo
ketre nɛ fo atande so
a chɔ asɔ kikɛ.
3Ŋ ka shu n tre fo,
fo nu ma kekule nna
nseŋ sa ma kenyɛn nɛ kagbene.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ durnya to
be bewuraana kikɛ nu
fo nnɔ naseso, baaŋ kpaŋ fo.
5Baaŋ baa boŋ nshɛ a laŋɛ asɔ
nɛ fo wora nɛ fo
kemaŋkuragboŋ na be kaplɛa so.
6Fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wɔ esoso ga,
ama kumubarasewuraana
be asheŋ tir fo;
kamoowuwuraana malɛ maaŋ
tiŋ ŋ ŋana fo so.
7Nɛ etɔrɔ baŋ kulti ma n wɔtɔ gba,
fo e naa kuŋ ma ashi bedoŋ
nɛ b nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma be enɔ to.
Fo gbagba be enɔ lempo na
e naa shin nɛ mee nya ma kumu a ji.
8Fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ wora
m bɔlɔ kusɔ kama nɛ fo nase
kumo be kɔnɔ so.
Fo kasha nɛ k maa chɛrga na
wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ;
amoso, jande sa maŋ kini anyi,
fo basa n lɛ.

Title: NSHƐ 139
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka taga to jemanɛ kikɛ be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e keni ma kagbene to,
nseŋ pin ma nɛnɛ.
2Fo nyi jemanɛ nɛ mee
wushi ŋko a shuŋ;
n wɔ kufɔ a maŋ taga
fo to gba fo nyi,
fo nyi kusɔ nɛ k wɔ ma
nfɛra to kikɛ.
3Fee wu kusɔ kama nɛ mee wora,
ŋko kaplɛkama nɛ mee yɔ nna.
4O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, pɔɛŋ nɛ kesheŋ
e lar ma kɔnɔ to, nɛ fo tia nyi kumo.
5Fo kulti ma kaba kama so nna n wɔtɔ,
nseŋ ta fo enɔgboŋ na a kuŋ ma.
6Kananɛ fo nyi ma na la mamachi nna;
m maaŋ tiŋ m pin kumo to.
7Nnɛ nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n shile
fo Kiyoyu n yɔ;
ŋko nnɛ nɛ meeŋ yɔ nɛ
fo maaŋ wu ma?
8M baŋ dii n yɔ ebɔrɛso chilili,
fo wɔ ndoŋ;
ma alɛ naŋ yɔ bubuni to
ashi kasawule to gba,
fo kraa wɔ ndoŋ gba.
9Nɛ m baŋ shile n yɔ
epeŋilarkpa be kakpa wɔfɔ;
ŋko n dii teku be kaba ndoŋ
n yɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kakpa wɔfɔ
n ya kaa wɔ ndoŋ gba,
10fo kraa beeŋ baa kɔ ma to,
nsaa juŋkpar ma ashi ma
kesheŋ wora kikɛ to.
11Nɛ m baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ
ŋana tentembiri to,
ŋko n shin nɛ kapa e ki kanyɛ
m buu ma so gba,
12tentembiri kraa maŋ biri to
n sa fo ere;
kanyɛso malɛ du fanɛ kapaso nna
n sa fo.
Tentembiri nɛ kefulto kikɛ la
kukoŋwule nna n sa fo ere.
13Fo e to ma eyur ere kikɛ,
nseŋ bela ma n chuge abar so
ashi n nio be kakurgesha to.
14Mee kpaŋ fo nna,
ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ
fo to ma na la mamachi nna
nsaa keta kufu.
Fo asheŋ woraso kɔ
mamachi pasaa.
M baa nyi kumo ma
kagbene to nna geeŋ.
15Shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ ŋana fo so
a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so!
Jemanɛ nɛ ma awibi
daa chuge abar so ashi n nio
be kakurgesha to ashiri to na,
16fo wu ma ndoŋ nna
pɔɛŋ nɛ b kurge ma.
Nchɛ nɛ meeŋ ji durnya to gba
kikɛ dese fo kawɔl na to nna
pɔɛŋ nɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ fara.
17O Ebɔrɛ, m maaŋ tiŋ m pin
kusɔ nɛ k wɔ fo nfɛra to kikɛ!
A shi m baŋ ma ketiŋ pin
amo be kananɛ a sa so.
18Nɛ fanɛ ŋ karga fo nfɛra gba,
e beeŋ baa chɔ teku ase be eshishɛr.
M baŋ di n tiŋi kelaŋ so gba,
ma nɛ fo e kraa la.
19O Ebɔrɛ, fo daa beeŋ shuli m mɔ
kumukpakpasowuraana nna
nseŋ kuŋ ma ashi bumo be kamɛaŋ to,
k daa beeŋ par ma ga.
20Baa kaa malga mmalga lubi
a gbiti fo nna nsaa jija fo ketre.
21O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, ma alɛ gba kishi
bekama nɛ b kishi fo nseŋ kini fo,
n lar fo kaman na nna.
22Yurkishi nawule nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa bumo;
n ta bumo nna fanɛ ma doŋana.
23O Ebɔrɛ, mige ma to ŋ keni,
m pin ma kagbene to;
wora ma ŋ keni
m pin ma nfɛra fɛso.
24Sa maŋ shin nɛ m baa bɔla
ekpa lubiana so a wora asheŋ,
ama baa juŋkpar ma ashi fo
ekpa nɛ k dese mbaanaayɔ na so.

Title: NSHƐ 140
Content:
Kekule Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kechɛto be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga ma ashi
kumukpakpasowuraana be enɔ to!
Nseŋ kuŋ ma ashi bedoŋ
nyaŋnyaŋso kutɔ.
2Ŋkre lubi e wɔ bumo be ŋgbene to,
nɛ baa bar kebagato karechɛ kikɛ.
3Bumo be nnɔ to be mmalga
du fanɛ awɔ lubi be kubɔr
ashi esa be eyur to nna.
4O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa kuŋ ma ashi
kumukpakpasowuraana nɛ bedoŋ
nyaŋnyaŋso nɛ baa fin ma
kemur na be enɔ to.
5Kamoowuwuraana ŋana nna
n sho ajigbelɛ nɛ ashewu ma
ekpa to a fin ma nɛ b pɛ.
6O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ.
Jande nu ma kekule nseŋ chɛ ma to!
7O Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
fo la ma emɔlgapo lempo,
fo e naa kuŋ ma ashi kekɔ
nɛ bedoŋ bee kɔ ma kikɛ to.
8O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ
kumukpakpasowuraana e nya
kusɔ nɛ baa sha.
Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ b maaŋ yige
kebaakre asheŋ lubi.
9Shin nɛ basa nɛ b kulti ma n wɔtɔ
be mmalga lubi e laŋɛ n ji bumo.
10Shin nɛ kedɛmurmur e tɔr
bumo be amu so.
Ta bumo n lɛ edepɔmaŋ to
nɛ b lar ŋ gben.
11Sa maŋ shin nɛ basa nɛ baa
ku asheŋ a deŋi beko e nya kusɔ
nɛ baa sha kasawule ere so kikɛ.
Shin nɛ asheŋ lubi e ba basa
nyaŋnyaŋso so m mur bumo cheche.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, n nyi fanɛ fo
e naa kɔ a sa betirpo,
nsaa shin nɛ betentaŋasepo
bee nya asɔ nɛ a daga bumo.
13Kashenteŋto, basa nɛ bumo
be asheŋ woraso niŋi beeŋ baa
wɔ fo kutɔ a kpaŋ fo ketre na.

Title: NSHƐ 141
Content:
Kaaseso be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
1O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo nɛ mee shu a tre;
nya manaŋ m ba chɛ ma to!
Jande nu ma kekule ere.
2Nu ma kekule fanɛ
duwu be efɛa belbelso,
nseŋ wu ma enɔana
nɛ m maŋ so ere fanɛ kaaseso
be sarga nɛ mee lara a sa fo.
3O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, chɛ ma to,
nɛ jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ meeŋ bugi
ma kɔnɔ, meeŋ baa de mmalga
nɛ a beeŋ lar kumo to so.
4Baa lara ma kagbene ashi
asheŋ lubi be kebaawora to
nɛ ma kebaatu basa lubi
a wora asheŋ gela gela to.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ m baa tu bumo
a ji bumo be kejigboŋana gba.
5Shin nɛ fo basa niŋiso
e baa ŋini ma ekpa;
ŋ kaŋ wora n foe
nɛ b gberge ma kusoe.
M maaŋ shin nɛ basa lubi
e maŋkura ma kikɛ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, mee kule
Ebɔrɛ nna a gbiti bumo.
6Jemanɛ nɛ bumo be bewuraana
beeŋ shi abee be awɔlto n tɔr to na,
nɛ basa beeŋ pin fanɛ asheŋ
nɛ m malga na la kashenteŋ nna.
7Kananɛ baa baŋɛ ndibi to
wurwurbi na nɛ bumo be awibi
beeŋ buri to n dese
nchaŋ be nnɔ ase.
8Ama ma ere be anishi yuu fo
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na so nna,
a fin fanɛ fo baa kuŋ ma
nsaa maŋ shin nɛ n wu!
9O Ebɔrɛ, baa kuŋ ma ashi ajigbelɛ
nɛ basa lubi bee sho ma to.
10Shin nɛ bumo gbagba e tɔr
bumo be ajigbelɛ to, nseŋ shin nɛ
ma ere e bɔla amo ase n choŋ
nɛ shɛŋ maŋ wora ma.

Title: NSHƐ 142
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ be kechɛto be asheŋ
1Mee shu a tre Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nna;
a kule mo fanɛ e wu ma kuwɔr.
2Mee ta ma nfubel kikɛ nna a bar mo;
nsaa kaŋɛ mo ma etɔrɔ kikɛ be asheŋ.
3M baa pɔ aba kiyoyu to,
mo e naa ŋini ma kusɔ nɛ
k daga fanɛ n wora.
Bedoŋ ŋana n sho ma kejigbelɛ
ashi ekpa nɛ mee nite so nna.
4M baŋ keni ŋ kulti, mee wu fanɛ
esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e chɛ ma to,
esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e kuŋ ma.
Ma asheŋ malɛ maŋ tir esa kikɛ.
5Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
nɛ mee kule nɛ fo chɛ ma to!
Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ma ekumpo.
Fo nawule nɛ mee fute a yigeso
ashi ma kebaawɔtɔ to.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nu ma kushu
nɛ mee shu a fin fo kechɛto ere.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, asheŋ gben ma nna na.
Mɔlga ma ashi ma doŋana be enɔ to;
b chɔ ma eleŋ ga nɛ m maaŋ tiŋ bumo.
7Lara ma ashi ebesa nɛ kafɔŋ to;
saŋɛ na so, meeŋ kpaŋ fo
ashi fo basa be nshɛr to,
ŋkpal kelela nɛ fo wora ma so.

Title: NSHƐ 143
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ be kechɛto be asheŋ
1Jande Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nu ma kekule!
Nu ma kushu nseŋ wu ma kuwɔr.
Bɔla fo kashenteŋji nɛ kebaawɔtɔ
niŋiso so n sɔ ma n yige.
2Sa maŋ ji ma, fo kayɛrbi demu;
ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kikɛ be kebaawɔtɔ
maŋ niŋi ashi fo anishito.
3Bedoŋ bee ju ma nna a kulti
nɛ mee tɔr a koso.
Tentembiri mina to nɛ n wɔ,
fanɛ esa nɛ e wu a dese nchaŋ to
dra dra kikɛ na.
4Ŋkpal loŋ so ma tama kikɛ loge nna,
nɛ ma kagbene jija ma m baŋ so.
5Mee nyiŋi asheŋ nɛ fo wora
nfɛ damta nɛ a choŋ na kikɛ nna
nsaa fɛ amo be asheŋ.
6M maŋ ma enɔana so
ashi kabɔrɛkule to a shoŋi fo nna,
Kananɛ kasawule wɔlso bee sha
nchu na nɛ ma kiyoyu gba
bee shu a fin fo.
7Jande Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
nu ma kabɔrɛkule manaŋ!
Ma tama kikɛ loge.
Sa maŋ pal kaman n sa ma.
Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ meeŋ ya ti
bumo nɛ b teŋ wu n yɔ
bubuni to na so.
8Ŋkpal ŋ ka ta ma yirda
n deŋi fo so so,
shin nɛ m baa nyiŋi fo kasha
nɛ k maa loge na be asheŋ
kachipurso kikɛ.
Mee kule fo nna nɛ fo ŋini ma
ekpa nɛ meeŋ baa bɔla so
a wora asheŋ.
9O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga ma
ashi bedoŋ be enɔ to,
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo kutɔ
nɛ mee ba nsaa nya kekuŋ.
10Fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ.
Ŋini ma kusɔ nɛ fee sha
fanɛ n wora, nseŋ shin nɛ fo
Kiyoyu nɛ e du boeŋ na e baa
juŋkpar ma ekpa kikɛ so.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa kɔ a kuŋ ma
fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na.
Bɔla fo kumɔlga be eleŋ na so
m mɔlga ma ashi etɔrɔ to.
12Ŋkpal fo kasha nɛ k maa loge
nɛ fo kɔ n sa ma so,
mɔ ma doŋana kikɛ nseŋ mur
bekama nɛ baa kɔrfɛ ma na;
ŋkpal manɛ so, n la fo kayɛrbi nna.

Title: NSHƐ 144
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n sa efuli be asheŋ
1Meeŋ kpaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ!
Fo e la ma kefalta gboŋ.
Fo alɛ e naa ŋini ma kananɛ
meeŋ baa kɔ kena.
2Fo e la n teri shaso
nɛ ma ekumpo lempo,
Fo nɛ mee shile a mata
nsaa nya ma kumu.
Fo e la ma kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋso,
fo alɛ e shin nɛ mee ji kuwura
anyi be basa so.
3O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wanɛ e la dimɛdi,
nɛ fee keni a wu mo;
nɛ mbe asheŋ tir fo le ere bre?
4Dimɛdi baa du fanɛ afu futeso nna;
mbe nchɛ bee choŋ nna fanɛ kiyoyul.
5O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, bugi esoso
be kuwɔlpa fanɛ patisa
ŋ gbelge m ba;
Beta abeeana na,
nɛ edishi e kaa amoso.
6Shin nɛ bɔrɛ e nyɛkpɛ
m pesaŋ fo doŋana to;
To fo atanyembi
m bar kebagato bumo to,
nɛ b lara aya n shile.
7Shi esoso ndoŋ n teŋi fo enɔ to
m pɛ ma n chule ashi nchu
be kechimbi to n sɔ ma n yige;
mɔlga ma ashi efuli pɔtɛ
be basa be enɔana to.
8Bumo e la befɔ nɛ b maa ji
kashenteŋ nsaa ku efɛ
a bɔ ntaŋ na.
9O Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ boŋ
kashɛ popɔr ŋ kpaŋ fo;
meeŋ laŋ jaŋjilaŋ
m boŋ kashɛ n sa fo.
10Fo e naa shin nɛ bewura
bee kɔ a pɔɔ so,
fo e naa kɔ a mɔlga fo kayɛrbi,
Ewura Deevid ashi kena to.
11Jande kɔ m mɔlga ma alɛ gba
ashi befɔ fɛpoana nɛ b maa
ji kashenteŋ na be enɔ to.
12An kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ anyi
be mbrantiɛbia e baa du fanɛ ndibi
nɛ a daŋ yili a kɔ eleŋ;
nɛ anyi be bibiche malɛ e baa
du fanɛ eshabɔrɛ nɛ b pɔr n ji
kuwurlambu kebita na.
13Shin nɛ anyi be mpuro
e bɔlɔ adɔjibi be yiri kikɛ
nɛ anyi be mbolpɔ e kurge ga
n salga n sɔ kaplɛkama,
14n shin nɛ anyi be ana gba
e kurge ga.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ amo be kekama
e gboŋi kedampo n lɛ kikɛ.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ bedoŋ e kɔ m pɔɔ
anyi be kadegboŋ na so,
ŋko m pɛ anyi be beko n yɔ
kenyaya to efuli wɔfɔ so.
Fo alɛ e sa maŋ shin nɛ an nu
kagbenejija be kushu ashi anyi
be abɔrbi so kikɛ.
15Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ le be asheŋ
bee wora bumo to na peya nna.
Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ bumo
be Ebɔrɛ la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.

Title: NSHƐ 145
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka la esa nsaa wu kuwɔr be asheŋ
1Meeŋ maŋ fo so nseŋ kpaŋ fo,
ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ ma Ewura;
Ma alɛ beeŋ maŋkura
fo ketre saŋkama.
2Meeŋ baa kpaŋ fo karechɛ kikɛ
nsaa maŋkura fo ketre
hale mbaanaayɔ.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shi ga,
nseŋ daga fanɛ b baa
kpaŋ mo saŋkama.
Ekama maaŋ tiŋ m pin
mbe kishi na to.
4Kekurgeto kama to ebi beeŋ ji
fo emamachisheŋ nɛ a bee
mɔ kɔnɔ na be asheŋ n sa
bumo be kaman to ebi.
5Baaŋ baa malga fo kemaŋkura
be kela be asheŋ.
Bumo alɛ beeŋ baa fɛ fo asheŋ
woraso nɛ a bee mɔ kɔnɔ na
be asheŋ jemanɛ kikɛ.
6Basa beeŋ baa malga fo
asheŋgboŋ be asheŋ
nsaa ber fo keshi be kubomboŋ
a sa beko.
7Baaŋ baa ji fo alelasheŋ
damta be asheŋ a sa beko
nsaa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso
a laŋɛ fo asheŋ niŋiso
be kaplɛa so.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la eshapo
nɛ e bee wu kuwɔr nna,
mo alɛ maa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ;
mbe kasha maa chɛrga kikɛ.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee wora
ekama kelela nsaa kɔ kashagboŋ
a sa mbe asɔ to so kikɛ nna.
10O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo asɔ to so kikɛ beeŋ kpaŋ fo,
nɛ fo basa kikɛ e di fo epaŋ.
11Baaŋ baa ji fo kuwurji
be kemaŋkura be asheŋ;
bumo alɛ beeŋ baa malga
fo eleŋgboŋ be asheŋ.
12Saŋɛ na so edimɛdi kikɛ
beeŋ pin fo ashuŋgboŋ
nɛ fo kuwurji be kemaŋkura
nɛ kela be asheŋ.
13Fo kuwurji wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ;
k maŋ kɔ ekar,
fo alɛ bee ji kuwura nna,
yili kenana ko n ya fo
kenana ko to ebi so nna.
An Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e naa wora
a bɔlɔ fo nnɔ naseso so nsaa wora
kusɔ kama nɛ fo kaŋɛ feeŋ wora.
14Fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa chɛ
bumo nɛ b wɔ tɔrɔ to to,
nsaa niŋi bumo nɛ b tɔr to.
15Asɔ futeso kikɛ bee keni
fo anishito nna nɛ fo sa
amo ajibi jemanɛ nɛ k daga.
16Fo e naa bugi enɔ to a sa
kusɔ futeso kikɛ kumo be
asheŋ tirso yila yila so.
17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be
kesheŋ wora kikɛ niŋi nna,
mo alɛ kɔ kasha nna
n sa mbe asɔ to so kikɛ.
18E wɔ bekama nɛ baa tre mo
kagbene koŋwule so na kutɔ nna.
19Mo alɛ bee sa bekama nɛ baa
bunyaŋ mo na asɔ nɛ a tir bumo nna
nsaa nu bumo be kekule a mɔlga
bumo ashi etɔrɔ to.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kuŋ bekama
nɛ baa sha mo na nna,
ama kumukpakpasowuraana bre,
e bee mur bumo nna.
21Jemanɛ kikɛ ma ere beeŋ
kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na;
ekama e sa mbe ketre cheembi na
bunyaŋ mbaanaayɔ.

Title: NSHƐ 146
Content:
Kekpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na awɔrso be asheŋ
1Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Meeŋ ta ma kagbene kikɛ
ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
2Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na saŋɛ nɛ
n wɔ ŋkpa to ere.
3Men sa maŋ ta menyi be yirda
n wɔtɔ edimɛdi be bejuŋkparpo to.
Dimɛdi bomin kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ
m mɔlga esa.
4B baŋ wu baa bɛta a
yɔ shishɛr to nna;
Loŋ be kachɛ na bumo be
ŋkre kikɛ bee ba ekar nna.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la an nananyɛn
Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na bee nɛfa ekama
nɛ e yirda mo nseŋ ta mbe kumu
n to mo so na nna.
6Ebɔrɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule;
mo e to teku nɛ kumo to
be asɔ kikɛ nyam.
Jemanɛ kikɛ e bee wora a bɔlɔ
mbe nnɔ naseso so nna.
7Mo e naa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
a sa betirpo nsaa sa bumo nɛ
akoŋ kɔ kusɔ jiso.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa lara basa
nɛ b ti ebu ashi kabuti to.
8Mo koŋwule na e naa bugi
etanpo be anishi.
Mo e naa pɛ bumo nɛ b tɔr to
a niŋi to a yili nsaa sha basa
nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ niŋi.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa keni befɔ so,
nsaa ji a chɛ amunibi nɛ bekulpoche to;
ama kumukpakpasowuraana bre,
e bee mur bumo nna.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ e la Jerusalɛm
be Ebɔrɛ na, bee ji kuwura nna
mbaanaayɔ!
Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 147
Content:
Keboŋ kashɛ ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
1Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Keboŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ an
Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na walɛ ga.
Kekpaŋ mo wɔ ebel ga
nseŋ daga loŋ.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee lɔŋɛ
Jerusalɛm nna a pɔr;
nsaa bɛta mbe basa nɛ b daŋ pɛ
n yɔ kenyaya to ashi efuli pɔtɛ
wɔfɔ so na a ba epe.
3Mo e naa ti kagbenejijawuraana
kagbene nsaa chɛ bumo be alɔana.
4Mo e yili kananɛ achɛkpabi
beeŋ ba sa awɔlpa so
nseŋ nase amo be kekama
ketre a tre kumo.
5An Nyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shi alegaiso
nsaa kɔ eleŋ ga.
Mo alɛ bee pin kusɔ kama to nna.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa chɛ bebɔlpo to,
nsaa bar kumukpakpasowuraana kaseto.
7Men boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na;
men laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ m boŋ
nshɛ n sa anyi be Ebɔrɛ na.
8Mo e naa shin nɛ abɔrɛwɔlpa
bee salga to a buu kaplɛkama so;
nɛ bɔrɛ bee ba kasawule so
a shin nɛ afitiri bee kɔr abee so.
9Mo e naa sa asɔbɔya kusɔ jiso
nsaa bela ejɔnɔkoso fɔlbi
jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ a shu n tre mo.
10Mannɛ egbaŋɛ be eleŋ nɛ
benapo lempoana be asheŋ e naa
par Ebɔrɛ nsaa fuli mbe kagbene.
11Basa nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo
nɛ bumo nɛ bumo be yirda
wɔ mbe kasha nɛ k maa
chɛrga na so be asheŋ e naa
par mo nsaa fuli mbe kagbene.
12O Jerusalɛmebi, men kikɛ e maŋ
Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na so
nseŋ kpaŋ mo!
13Mo e shin nɛ menyi be kadegboŋ
be mbunagboŋ na kɔ eleŋ;
mo alɛ e naa nɛfa menyi be basa.
14Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ men wɔ
kayurwushi to ashi
menyi be efuli so na.
Mo e naa sa menyi ajibi lela.
15Ebɔrɛ malɛ baŋ malga kenishipereso,
k bee sɔ durnya kikɛ to manaŋ nna.
16Mo e naa shin nɛ kunyɔlɔ
bee sɔ kaplɛkama,
nɛ bɔrɛfurbi malɛ bee ba
fanɛ kalabɛr na.
17Mo e naa shin nɛ abɔrɛjembubi
bee wurge to fanɛ awarabi na.
Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n chena awo
nɛ e bee shin nɛ k bee ba na to.
18Mo koŋwule na e naa malga
nɛ afu bee ber,
nɛ abɔrɛjembubi na bee ŋalga
a ki nchu a shile mbombi to na.
19Ebɔrɛ e ta mbe mbraana
nɛ keŋiniana n sa mbe basa
nɛ b la an nananyɛn Jeekɔb
nɛ e daa wɔtɔ dra dra na
be kaman to ebi;
bumo e ki Israɛl be efuli so
be basa na.
20E maŋ wora le n sa efuli pɔtɛ
kama so be basa;
b maŋ nyi mbe mbraana gba.
Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 148
Content:
Durnya kikɛ ka daga kekpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be shɛŋ
1Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Menyi nɛ men wɔ ebɔrɛso na,
men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
2Menyi Ebɔrɛ be emalaika kikɛ,
nɛ ebɔrɛso be beshumpo kikɛ,
men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
3Kufɔl nɛ epeŋi, e baa kpaŋ mo.
Achɛkpabi nɛ e bee nyɛkpɛ
gba e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
4Ebɔrɛso nɛ k wɔ awɔlto chilili,
nɛ awɔlto be nchuana kikɛ,
e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
5Men shin nɛ le be asɔ ere kikɛ
e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e malga eleŋso
n to amo kikɛ kuraa.
6Mo koŋwule na e malga eleŋso
nɛ amo be kekama ere nya kumo
be eyilikpa a yil mbaanaayɔ na.
Mbe atande maa chɛrga kikɛ.
7Kasawule so be asɔ keniso kikɛ,
e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
Teku to be asɔbɔya gboŋgboŋi kikɛ,
nɛ kumo to be asɔ keniso kikɛ
e baa kpaŋ mo.
8Bɔrɛ be kenyɛkpɛ nɛ abɔrɛjembubi
nɛ kunyɔlɔ nɛ awɔlpaana
nɛ bɔrɛfugboŋana nɛ amo kikɛ bee
nu a sa mo na e baa kpaŋ mo.
9Abeegboŋana nɛ abeebiana kikɛ,
nɛ ndibi sɔrsoana nɛ kupo to
be ndibi kikɛ e baa kpaŋ mo.
10Kowu nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya
be yiri kikɛ;
asɔbɔya wurbi be yiri kikɛ
nɛ mbuibi kikɛ e baa kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
11Durnya to be efuliana
kikɛ so be bewuraana,
bewurbi nɛ durnya to be
kenimujipoana kikɛ,
12mbrantiɛbia nɛ besuŋgurbi kikɛ,
basakpar nɛ mbiwurbi kikɛ
e baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
13Asɔ to so kikɛ e baa kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre.
Men baa kpaŋ mbe ketre na nawule.
Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura shi ga a chɔ
esoso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ peya.
14Mo e shin nɛ mbe efuli nya eleŋ,
saŋɛ na so, mbe basa, Israɛlebi kikɛ,
nɛ bumo be asheŋ wɔ mbe kagbene to na,
beeŋ baa kpaŋ mo.
Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 149
Content:
Kapandi be kasha be asheŋ
1Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Men boŋ kashɛ popɔr n sa
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na;
men baa kpaŋ mo ashi kakpa
nɛ mbe basa nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ
a sa mo shɛr abar so na.
2Israɛl be basa, men shin nɛ menyi
be ŋgbene e fuli menyi ŋkpal menyi
be etopo na so;
menyi Jerusalɛm to be basa malɛ e ji
eyur ŋkpal menyi be ewura so!
3Men ta echakachaka nɛ ejaŋjilaŋ
a boŋ nshɛ nsaa cha a dele
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ketre.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe basa be asheŋ
bee par mo nna.
Mo alɛ bee ta kemaŋkura nna
a buu bekama nɛ baa bar bumo
be amu kaseto so nsaa mɔlga bumo.
5Ebɔrɛ be basa kama nɛ b nya
le be kemaŋkura ere e shin nɛ
bumo be ŋgbene e baa fuli bumo
nɛ b baa boŋ nshɛ a ji eyur
kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ.
6B baa kpaŋ Ebɔrɛ awɔrso
jemanɛ nɛ b ta bumo be etokobi
jiso m bɔɔ enɔ a yɔ
7nɛ b ya kɔ m pɔɔ efuli pɔtɛana
be basa so ŋ gberge bumo kusoe;
8nseŋ naa kpaŋ mo jemanɛ nɛ baŋ pɛ
efuli pɔtɛana na be bewuraana
nɛ bumo be benimuana nseŋ wɔtɔ
bumo ŋgbɛlɛbiana na.
9Saŋɛ na so baaŋ gberge efuli
pɔtɛana na be basa kusoe
fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ yili kumo na.
Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso cheembi kikɛ
be kemaŋkura nna na.
Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: NSHƐ 150
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka walɛ n sa mbe basa be asheŋ
1Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Men baa kpaŋ Ebɔrɛ ashi
mbe bɔrɛlambu to!
Men baa kpaŋ mo ebɔrɛso ashi
mbe kakpa lempo na!
2Men baa kpaŋ mo ŋkpal asheŋ
gboŋgboŋi nɛ e wora so.
Men naa kpaŋ mo ŋkpal e ka
shi m baŋ so so.
3Men baa ta mbel nɛ alaŋsɔ
be yiri kikɛ
a kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
4Men baa laŋ ŋkure a cha
a kpaŋ mo,
nsaa ta ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ nlopi gba
a kpaŋ mo.
5Men baa ta echakachaka nɛ
abɛlso be alaŋsɔ be yiri kikɛ
a laŋ a kpaŋ Ebɔrɛ.
6Asɔ keniso kikɛ e baa kpaŋ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!
Men baa kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na!

Title: AŊASA 1
Content:
Aŋasa be tɔnɔ be asheŋ
1Israɛl be ewura Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ e la Deevid pibinyɛn na be aŋasa nde.
2Aŋasa ere beeŋ chɛ fo to nɛ fo nya kanyiasheŋ nɛ kasonu nsaa tiŋ a pin mmalga chiŋgeliŋ be afito.
3A beeŋ chɛ fo to nɛ fo nya
kebaawɔtɔ to be kanyiasheŋ
nsaa kɔ kashenteŋji a tiŋ
a wora asɔ nɛ a daga.
A beeŋ shin nɛ fo baa wɔ
kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso to
nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so.
4Aŋasa ere beeŋ tiŋ n sa
esa nɛ e maa pin asheŋ to
manaŋ manaŋ kanyiasheŋ;
nseŋ sa mbifɔlbi kenyi, n chɛ bumo to
nɛ b baa wora asheŋ nɛ a kɔ tɔnɔ.
5A bee sa benyiashempo
kenyi nna a ti so,
nsaa chɛ bekoyapo to
nɛ baa tiŋ a lara asɔ
nɛ a daga kewora;
6nsaa tiŋ a pin aŋasa
nɛ ablɔmbi nɛ mmalga chiŋgeliŋ
nɛ benyiashempo be mmalga be
atrɔmbi nɛ amo be afito.
Mbrantiɛbia be kasotoji be asheŋ
7Kabɔrɛŋana e la kenyi be sososo.
Ewulpo e naa kini
kanyiasheŋ be kekoya
nɛ kebela be kasogberge.
8M pibinyɛn, kaŋ kusoe n nu
fo tuto be kusɔ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fo,
nsaa maŋ kplaŋ
fo nio be ŋini gba so.
9Ŋkpal manɛ so
bumo be keŋini na
beeŋ sa fo da lela,
fanɛ kananɛ neemu
ŋko kubɔtoshembi
bee sa esa kela na.
10M pibinyɛn,
belubiworapo baa fule fo
a ŋin fo a wɔtɔ alubi to,
fo sa maa sa bumo kashuli.
11Nɛ b baŋ kaŋɛ fo le:
“Ba tu anyi nɛ an ya ŋana
n dese ekpakar n fin
esa ko m mɔ kenyanyaŋɛso,
12n shin nɛ bumo nɛ b kɔ eleŋ
nɛ alenfia
na e ki bubuni n luri nchaŋ to.
13An wora loŋ anyeeŋ nya
yawukpakpaso be asɔ lela
be yiri yiri,
nɛ an be ebuana e bɔlɔ asɔ
nɛ an suge
fanɛ b ka kɔ kena n suge asɔ na.
14Amoso ba ti anyi so,
saŋɛ na so anyi nɛ fo
beeŋ barga kusɔ kama
nɛ an nya na to.”
15M pibinyɛn,
sa maa tu loŋ be basa
a wora asheŋ.
Baa ji a gelge bumo.
16Ŋkpal manɛ so,
saŋkikɛ, baa jujo nna
nɛ b wora alubi.
Kemɔ esa maŋ la shɛŋ bumo kutɔ.
17Kebaa sho kabuibi kejigbelɛ
nɛ e jɔŋ a keni fo
la asheŋ fuloŋ nna!
18To, loŋ be basa lubi na
bee sho bumo gbagba be amu
ajigbelɛ nna.
B yɛ basa nɛ baa pugi a jo,
ama bumo gbagba be amu
nɛ baa kilgi a mɔ.
19Kayu to nɛ beyu bee paŋ
bumo be ŋkpa.
Loŋ nɛ basa kama
nɛ baa nyaŋɛ to a buu
basa kikɛ bee loge to.
Kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ;
20Men nu nfe,
kanyiasheŋ e wɔ agbembi so
nɛ kebɛ to a tre awɔrso na.
21K wɔ nde be mbunagboŋ
nɛ basa bee bɔla to a lar
nsaa luri na ase nna
a ponte a tre awɔrso a kaŋɛ le:
22“Ewulpo, fee sha fanɛ
fo baa la ewulpo saŋkikɛ nna
nsaa keni kenyi jiga a?
Fo kini kenyi be kekoya nna a?
Saŋɛ mo nɛ feeŋ fara a koya asheŋ?
23Fo daa nu ma kefiɛ so nna,
ndafanɛ meeŋ sa fo kasotoji lela
nseŋ bugi kagbene
n ŋini fo kusɔ nɛ n nyi.
24Saŋkama mee tre fo
a kaŋɛ fanɛ fo ba ma kutɔ
ama fo kplaŋ ma so
nseŋ kini kenu n sa ma.
25Fo kplaŋ ma kasotoji kikɛ so,
nseŋ kini fanɛ fo maaŋ shin nɛ
n niŋi fo ekpa.
26Amoso, fo baŋ luri tɔrɔ to,
meeŋ mushe fo.
Awurfoŋgboŋ baŋ tu fo,
meeŋ wora fo eyurto.
27Tɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ
beeŋ ba fo so
fanɛ afugboŋ ka ber
m bar etɔrɔ
nɛ ebesa nɛ kebaawɔtɔ kekra na.
28Loŋ be saŋɛ na,
feeŋ shu n tre ma, kanyiasheŋ,
ama m maaŋ tuge fo.
Feeŋ fin ma kenishipereso
ama fo maaŋ wu ma.
29Fo yɛ kenyi maŋ la shɛŋ
nseŋ kini kewora
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kasonu.
30Fo kini ma kasotoji
nsaa maŋ shin nɛ
n niŋi fo ekpa.
31Amoso feeŋ ji
kusɔ nɛ fo du na be asɔrso,
nɛ fo gbagba be aworbi
e kilgi a bishi fo.
32Ewulpo be kawuli
e naa bar mo luwu,
nɛ kekini kenyi be kekoya malɛ
bee yɛr esa kemur to.
33Ama esa kama nɛ e bee
wora ma kasonu beeŋ nya kekuŋ.
E maaŋ ba lɔ kufu
fanɛ kusɔ lubi ko beeŋ wora mo.”

Title: AŊASA 2
Content:
Kanyiasheŋ be tɔnɔ be asheŋ
1M pibinyɛn,
baa koya asɔ nɛ mee ŋini fo
nsaa nyiŋi asɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ
fo baa wora na saŋkikɛ.
2Baa bugi asoe
a koya kanyiasheŋ
nsaa pin asheŋ to.
3Baa kɔ a fin kenyi
nɛ asheŋ be kepinto.
4Baa fin kenyi kenishipereso
fanɛ kananɛ feeŋ fin gbiti
nɛ yawu kpakpaso
be asɔ nɛ a ŋana na.
5Fo wora loŋ,
kumo ere feeŋ pin
kusɔ nɛ k la kabɔrɛŋana
nsaa tiŋ a pin Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ to.
6Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa sa kanyiasheŋ.
Mo kutɔ nɛ kenyi
nɛ asheŋ be kepinto bee shi.
7Mo e naa chɛ basa nɛ
baa wora asheŋ niŋiso to
nsaa kuŋ bumo.
8Mo e naa kuŋ basa nɛ
baa wora asheŋ nɛ a daga,
nsaa ŋini bekama nɛ baa shuŋ mo
nɛ kagbene koŋwule na ekpa.
9Nɛ fee nu ma mmalga,
feeŋ pin kusɔ nɛ k walɛ
nɛ kusɔ nɛ k niŋi ekpa
nɛ kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ
fo baa wora.
10Kanyiasheŋ beeŋ luri
m bɔlɔ fo to,
nɛ fo kenyi e bɔlɔ fo kenishi.
11Fo lakal nɛ asheŋ be kepinto
beeŋ baa kuŋ fo.
12Kanyiasheŋ e naŋ kuŋ fo
ashi asheŋ lubi be kewora to;
nseŋ mɔlga fo ashi basa nɛ
bumo be mmalga bee bar asheŋ to.
13Loŋ be basa e kini
kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso
nsaa wɔ tentembiri be alubi
be kebaawɔtɔ to na.
14Bumo, nɛ alubi be kewora
bee wora ebel
nɛ bumo be ŋgbene
bee fuli alubi so na.
15Bumo be asheŋ woraso
e maa bɔla ekpa,
nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n yirda bumo na.
16Kanyiasheŋ beeŋ mɔlga fo
ashi beche nɛ baa lar
bumo kulana be mman
a ta kɔnɔ belbelso
a fule benyɛn a ji na kutɔ.
17Loŋ be beche
e naa yige
bumo be etumbanyɛn
nsaa kplaŋ kakil to be ŋkre be kɔnɔ
nɛ b nase Ebɔrɛ
be anishito na so na.
18Ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ
loŋ be beche pe na
bee yɛr basa luwu
nɛ kemur to nna.
19Esa kama nɛ e yɔ loŋ be eche pe
maŋ naa bɛta a yɔ epe,
ŋko a bɔla ekpa
nɛ k bee yɛr esa ŋkpa to na.
20Amoso a daga fanɛ fo baa kute
basa lela be aworbi to nna;
nsaa wɔ kebaawɔtɔ niŋi so to.
21Ŋkpal manɛ so basa
nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso
nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ mpulɔ
e naaŋ nya
anyi be kasawule ere so a wɔtɔ.
22Ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ lara basa lubi
nɛ basa nɛ b maa ji kashenteŋ
ashi kasawule ere so.

Title: AŊASA 3
Content:
Mbrantiɛbia be kasotoji be asheŋ
1M pibinyɛn, sa maŋ kaŋ teŋ
asɔ nɛ mee ŋini fo na so.
Baa nyiŋi asɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo fanɛ
fo baa wora na saŋkikɛ.
2Asɔ nɛ mee ŋini fo na
beeŋ sa fo ŋkpa tenteŋ,
nɛ nɛfa.
3Sa maŋ shin nɛ kebaayɛ a wora
e baa barga fo kikɛ.
Chɛ kumo n shɛga
fo kubɔ to fanɛ kubɔtoshembi,
n shin nɛ k bɔlɔ fo kagbene to
a dii efuli ashi fo kebaawɔtɔ to.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so
nɛ fo baa wora loŋ,
fo asheŋ beeŋ baa bɔlɔ Ebɔrɛ
nɛ dimɛdi kikɛ kenishi.
5Ta fo kagbene kikɛ nyam
n yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
Sa maa ta fo tama a deŋi
kusɔ nɛ fo nyi so.
6Baa nyiŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
ashi kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora to,
nɛ e baa lɔŋɛ ekpa nɛ fee bɔla so
kananɛ k daga a sa fo.
7Sa maa fɛ fanɛ
fo nyi asheŋ ga.
Baa nu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nsaa gelge alubi.
8Nɛ fo baa wora loŋ,
k beeŋ baa du fanɛ
kudur lela nna a chɛ fo,
nsaa wushi fo eyur to be ebesa.
9Baa ta fo kanya
nɛ fo sososo be adɔjibi
a bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
10Nɛ fee wora loŋ,
fo mpuro beeŋ baa bɔlɔ a wurge
nɛ fo nsapuya gba
e baa bɔlɔ
asɔ nuuso popɔr a wurge.
11M pibinyɛn, sa maa kini
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kebela
be kasogberge
ŋko mbe kefiɛso be keŋini.
12Ŋkpal manɛ so,
basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha
nɛ e bee niŋi ekpa,
fanɛ kananɛ etuto
bee wora mo pibi shaso na.
13Kagbenefuli la
ekama nɛ e ki enyiashempo,
ŋko ekama nɛ e nya
asheŋ be kepinto
be nfɛra na peya nna.
14Ŋkpal manɛ so
kanyiasheŋ kɔ tɔnɔ
a chɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti.
15Kanyiasheŋ kɔ tɔnɔ
a chɔ abitasɔ kikɛ.
Fo maaŋ tiŋ n ta shɛŋ shɛŋ
m ber kanyiasheŋ.
16Kanyiasheŋ e naa sa
esa ŋkpa tenteŋ,
nɛ kedamaya nɛ kemaŋkura.
17Kanyiasheŋ beeŋ sa fo
kebaawɔtɔ belbelso,
nseŋ ŋini fo ekpa lela
nɛ feeŋ baa bɔla so a wora asheŋ
ashi fo kebaawɔtɔ to.
18Bekama nɛ b kɔ kanyiasheŋ na,
be ŋgbene bee fuli bumo nna.
Bumo be kanyiasheŋ bee sa bumo
ŋkpa tenteŋ nna.
19Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kanyiasheŋ
nɛ e ta n to durnya,
nseŋ ta mbe kenyi
n wora awɔlpaana
n yili kakpa nɛ a wɔ.
20Mbe kanyiasheŋ
e shin nɛ eboŋana bee shile,
nɛ awɔlpa bee bar
bɔrɛchu kasawule so.
21M pibinyɛn,
baa kɔ fo kanyiasheŋ
nɛ fo lakal to kpakpa.
Sa maŋ shin nɛ a shile fo kikɛ.
22Ŋkpal manɛ so,
amo e naŋ sa fo
kagbenefuli be ŋkpa
nɛ k wɔ ebel.
23Kanyiasheŋ nɛ lakal
beeŋ kuŋ fo,
nɛ fo maaŋ foe ekpa.
24Kanyiasheŋ beeŋ shin nɛ
fo ya dese nɛ kufu e baa kɔ fo,
ŋko a di a yeŋi a tiŋi.
25Ŋko a fɔŋ etɔrɔ purgiso
nɛ a bee kaa ba basa lubi so
fanɛ afugboŋ na so.
26Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ baa kuŋ fo ashi etɔrɔ to.
E maaŋ shin nɛ fo tɔr
kejigbelɛ kama to.
27Saŋkama nɛ feeŋ tiŋ,
fo chɛ bekama
nɛ baa fin kechɛto to.
28Nɛ feeŋ tiŋ n chɛ fo kurgepo to,
fo chɛ mo to,
sa maŋ shin nɛ e jo
nɛ kare e chɛ pɔɛŋ.
29Sa maa kre fo kurgepo
nɛ e yirda fo ŋkre lubi.
30Ŋko ŋ ku asheŋ n deŋi
esa kama,
nɛ e maŋ wora fo kulubi kikɛ.
31Sa maa yɛlga
basa lubi be aworbi,
ŋko a wora
bumo be asheŋ woraso.
32Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kishi
basa nɛ baa wora alubi be asheŋ ga,
ama e yirda basa
nɛ bumo be aworbi niŋi na bre nna.
33Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be shoduu
wɔ basa lubi pe nna,
nɛ mbe nɛfa malɛ wɔ basa lela pe.
34Mo nɛ basa
nɛ baa maŋ bumo be amu so
maŋ kɔ shɛŋ,
ama e bee shu basa
nɛ baa bar bumo be amu ase
bre so nna.
35Benyiashempo bee nya
ketre lela nna,
ama bewulpo bre
bee ji nyɔmɔ nna
a ti bumo be anishinyɔr so.

Title: AŊASA 4
Content:
Tɔnɔ nɛ kanyiasheŋ kɔ be asheŋ;
1Ma mbinyɛnso,
men baa nu asɔ nɛ,
men tuto bee ŋini menyi na;
men baa bugi asoe a nu amo,
saŋɛ so menyeeŋ pin amo to nɛnɛ.
2Asɔ nɛ a walɛ
nɛ mee ŋini menyi;
amoso men baa nyiŋi amo.
3Ŋ kaa daa la kebibi
nsaa la n tuto
nɛ n nio be ebinyɛn koŋwule na,
4n tuto daa ŋini ma
asheŋ nna a kaŋɛ ma le:
“Baa nyiŋi asɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ na,
nsaa maa teŋ amo so.
Baa bɛ asɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ
fo na so nseŋ nya ŋkpa tenteŋ.
5Nya kanyiasheŋ nɛ lakal,
n sa maŋ teŋ ŋko ŋ kplaŋ
asɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo na so.
6Sa maŋ kplaŋ kanyiasheŋ so,
nɛ k kuŋ fo,
baa sha kumo, nɛ k baa keni fo so.
7Kanyiasheŋ e chɔ
kusɔ kama nyam,
amoso fin kanyiasheŋ nɛ lakal.
8Baa sha kanyiasheŋ
nɛ k ta fo ŋ ki esa gboŋ.
Pɛ kumo to kpakpa
nɛ k bar fo kemaŋkura.
9Kumo e naŋ ki fanɛ kemaŋkura,
be kuwurwuro m buu fo.
10M pibinyɛn,
kaŋ kusoe kenishipereso
n nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo ere,
nseŋ nya ŋkpa tenteŋ.
11Ŋ ŋini fo kanyiasheŋ,
nɛ kananɛ feeŋ baa kɔ
kebaawɔtɔ niŋi so.
12Nɛ fo kɔ kanyiasheŋ,
shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ kagle fo ekpa to.
Fee shile gba fo maaŋ fiti n tɔr.
13Baa nyiŋi asɔ nɛ fo
koya na saŋkikɛ,
nsaa kɔ amo to kpakpa,
ŋkpal manɛ so kusɔ nɛ fo koya
e la fo ŋkpa.
14Sa maa yɔ mboŋ nɛ
basa lubi bee yɔ,
ŋko a koya basa lubi
be aworbi.
15Baa gelge loŋ be ekpa,
nseŋ lar alubi to.
Kini alubi be kewora,
nseŋ m pɛ fo ekpa a yɔ.
16Basa lubi bre
baŋ maŋ wora kulubi,
b maaŋ tiŋ n di.
B maaŋ tiŋ n di nɛ b maŋ wora
kulubi ŋ gbiti esa ko.
17Asheŋ lubi nɛ kelantokɔ,
du nna fanɛ
ajibi nɛ nchu n sa bumo.
18Ama ekpa nɛ belelaworapo
bɔ so na bre
du nna fanɛ karechɛ so
be epeŋi na.
K bee fulto nna a ti so
hale nɛ kare e ya chɛ
nɛ kaboŋ e fulto parr.
19Ama belubiworapo bre
be ekpa
biri to nna fanɛ tentembiri plɔ.
Baa fiti a tɔr,
ama b maa wu asɔ nɛ baa fiti na.
20M pibinyɛn, bugi asoe
nɛnɛ n nu
kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo ere.
Kaŋ kusoe n nu
ma mmalga ere.
21Sa maŋ shin nɛ
ma mmalga na e barga fo.
Baa nyiŋi amo
nseŋ ta amo n wɔtɔ
fo kagbene to saŋkama.
22Ŋkpal manɛ so a beeŋ sa
esa kama nɛ e pin amo to
ŋkpa nɛ alenfia.
23Baa da fo nfɛra fɛso so,
ŋkpal manɛ so
amo e naa ŋini fo kebaawɔtɔ.
24Sa maŋ malga kusɔ kama nɛ
kashenteŋ maŋ wɔ kumo to.
Fo nɛ efɛsheŋ nɛ mmalga nɛ
a bee shin nɛ
basa bee wora a foe ekpa
e sa maa kɔ shɛŋ.
25Baa keni tenini
nseŋ ta kashenteŋji
nɛ kebaa teŋ a wora
be kebaawɔtɔ a yɔ anishito.
Sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ anishinyɔr e ji fo
nɛ fo kurgi fo kumu n yuu to kikɛ.
26Baa chena a fɛ asheŋ nɛnɛ,
nsaa kre kusɔ kama
nɛ fee sha kewora
be asheŋ nɛnɛ
pɔɛŋ nsaa wora kumo.
Aloŋ nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora
beeŋ nite nɛnɛ.
27Baa gelge kulubi
nsaa nite teteri,
Sa maa kpele ekpa
niŋiso na kikɛ.”

Title: AŊASA 5
Content:
Kesakalea be keji be kefiɛso be asheŋ
1M pibinyɛn,
bugi asoe nɛnɛ n nu
ma kanyiasheŋ
be mmalga
nɛ a bee sa lakal ere.
2Amo e naaŋ sa fo da lela,
nseŋ shin nɛ fo mmalga e baa
ŋini fanɛ fo kɔ kenyi.
3Eche nɛ lar mo kul be kaman
be kɔnɔpurbi
beeŋ tiŋ a du mɔlmɔlbi
fanɛ ŋku,
nɛ kumo be kepipe e baa wɔ ebel
fanɛ mushoŋchu na,
4ama fo baŋ di mo n loge,
ebesa nɛ n daa nyi nna
e naa bɛ kumo so.
5Fo bɛ mo so
e beeŋ yɛr fo bubuni to,
ŋkpal manɛ so ekpa nɛ e bɔ so na
bee yɔ luwu to nna.
6E maŋ bɔ ekpa nɛ
k bee yɔ ŋkpa to na,
ama mo alɛ maŋ nyi kumo be loŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so
e maŋ kɔ epe.
7Amoso m pibinyɛn,
bugi asoe nɛnɛ n nu.
Sa maŋ teŋ
kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere so.
8Baa gelge loŋ be beche na.
Sa maa ji a taga bumo to kuraa.
9Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, feeŋ paŋ
fo bunyaŋ nɛ kemaŋkura,
nɛ basa lubi
e nya ekpa m mɔ Juwebi;
10nɛ befɔ e ta asɔ lela
nɛ fo gben n nya na kikɛ.
11Fo ŋkpa be lalaloge,
feeŋ dese a shuto,
nɛ fo eleŋ nɛ eyur kikɛ
e fo amo be ekar.
12Loŋ be jemanɛ na so
nɛ fo kaŋɛ le:
“Manɛ e ba nɛ n daa maŋ koya?
Manɛ nna nɛ
m maŋ shuli n sɔ keŋini?
13N daa maŋ nu n sa
ma beŋinipoana;
n daŋ kplaŋ bumo so nna.
14Kabre ma e ŋaba
basa kikɛ be anishito na!
15Amoso shin nɛ fo laŋ to be ajibi
e baa kukwe fo.
16Mbia nɛ fo nɛ bejipoche
beeŋ kurge na,
maaŋ lar tɔnɔ n sa fo.
17Shin nɛ fo gbagba be mbia
e daŋ n chɛ fo to,
mannɛ basa pɔtɛ be mbia.
18Amoso shin nɛ fo kagbene
e baa fuli
fo kebiato be eche so.
Shin nɛ mbe asheŋ
e baa par fo.
19E walɛ kebita nna
a du shreembi fanɛ chibir na,
amoso shin nɛ mbe
kebita e baa sa fo kagbenefuli.
Shin nɛ mbe kasha
e baa bɔlɔ fo kenishi.
20M pibinyɛn, manɛ e ba
nɛ fee ta fo kasha
n ya kaa sa eche pɔtɛ?
Manɛ e ba nɛ enyɛn ko
be eche be kebita
bee par fo a chɔ fo eche peya?
21Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
bee wu kusɔ kama
nɛ fee wora.
Kaplɛkama nɛ fee yɔ
e bee wu fo.
22Esa lubi be alubi
du fanɛ kegba,
nɛ mo gbagba
bee kilgi a tɔr to
nɛ k bee pɛ mo nna.
23Loŋ be basa bee wu nna
ŋkpal b ka maŋ kɔ kamootiŋ so.
Bumo gbagba be kawulisheŋ
e naa yɛr bumo nchaŋ to.”

Title: AŊASA 6
Content:
Kawulisheŋ be asheŋ
1M pibinyɛn,
nɛ fo nase kɔnɔ
fanɛ feeŋ yili
esa ko be katelamu
ŋ ka mbe kukɔ bre,
2fo gbagba be kɔnɔ to
be mmalga kre fo nna na;
nɛ fo kɔnɔ naseso na
e kilgi m pɛ fo.
3M pibinyɛn, ŋkpal fo ka tɔr
amodoŋwura be enɔ to so,
kananɛ feeŋ wora n nya
fo kumu nde.
Nya manaŋ n ya kule
amodoŋwura fanɛ
e ta kukɔ na m paŋ fo.
4Sa maŋ ta loŋ be kesheŋ na
n wora ewɔji,
ŋko ŋ kplaŋ kumo so
a dese a di.
5Wora ania n lar
kesheŋ na to manaŋ,
fanɛ kananɛ kusɔbɔya
ŋko kabuibi nɛ e wɔ
kejigbelɛ to bee wu ekpampo
nsaa kɔ a fin
kumɔlga kumo be kumu na.
6Betɔlpo, men keni
kananɛ atutulombi
bee wora asheŋ so,
ŋ koya kebaawɔtɔ.
7B maŋ kɔ bejuŋkparpo
ŋko bewura
ŋko basa nɛ baa ji bumo
be edemu a sa bumo,
8ŋkeshin nɛ bumo alɛ bee fin
bumo be ajibi ketarso nna
a yili pɔɛŋ nɛ kechali e fo.
9Etɔlpo, nuso be ewushi
nɛ fee sha nɛ fo wushi?
Saŋɛ mo nɛ feeŋ tiŋi edi to
ŋ koso n shuŋ?
10Kusɔ nɛ etɔlpo bee kaa kaŋɛ
e la fanɛ;
shin nɛ n di gbrɛbi,
ŋko shin nɛ n chena
n wushi gbrɛbi.
11Ama saŋɛ nɛ e dese a di na
nɛ ketir bee nyaŋ mo
a wɔtɔ fanɛ
beyu ka ta adoŋsɔ ŋ kuŋ
esa ekpa n suge mbe asɔ na.
12Basa lubi nɛ basa fuloŋ
e naa nite a ku efɛ.
13Baa kaa wora basa
anishi nna
ŋko a ta bumo be eyur be mba
a malga basa kutɔ
a fule bumo.
14Baa wora loŋ nna
nsaa kɔ nfɛra lubi a kre asheŋ
a bar kebagato
basa to kaplɛkama.
15Ŋkpal loŋ so
tɔrɔ nɛ k bee yɛr basa
kemur to na,
beeŋ tɔr bumo so
m mur bumo
saŋɛ nɛ b maa tama kumo na.
16Asɔ ashunu nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
kishi ga na nde:
17Kamoowu
nɛ kudonduloŋ fɛpo
nɛ enɔ nɛ k bee mɔ
basa nɛ b maŋ wora n da so,
18nɛ nfɛra fɛso lubi
nɛ basa nɛ alubi be kewora
maa choŋ bumo so
19nɛ shɛdajipo nɛ e bee ku efɛ
a deŋi abar so
nɛ edebɔrpo nɛ
e bee ta beteri be amu
a ŋmɛa abar.
Kesakalea be asheŋ
20M pibinyɛn, baa bɛ
kusɔ nɛ fo tuto kaŋɛ fo so,
nsaa maa kplaŋ asɔ nɛ
fo nio ŋini fo so.
21Shin nɛ bumo be mmalga
e baa wɔ fo
nfɛra to saŋkama
fanɛ a ka la kubɔtoshembi
a di fo na.
22Shin nɛ a baa ŋini fo ekpa;
nsaa kuŋ fo kanyɛso.
Saŋkama nɛ fo di n tiŋi,
fo shin nɛ a baa ji fo asoeto.
23Ŋkpal manɛ so fo nio
nɛ fo tuto be keŋini
du fanɛ kefulto nna n sa fo;
nɛ bumo be kasogberge malɛ
bee sa fo kebaawɔtɔ lela.
24Bumo be keŋini na
e naaŋ kuŋ fo
ashi esa pɔtɛ be eche
be kayɛlga
be mmalga belbelso to.
25Sa maŋ kpal
loŋ be beche be kebita so
n yɛlga bumo;
ŋko n shin nɛ
bumo be kayɛlga so
be kekeni fo,
e shin nɛ fo sha bumo.
26Sakaleche be yawu maŋ fo
bodobodo be amansherbi so,
ama esa be eche be kasha
beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ fo luri
tɔrɔ gboŋgboŋi to.
27Esa beeŋ tiŋ n chɔɔ edɛ
n wɔtɔ mbe kusɔbuuso to,
nɛ kusɔbuuso na maaŋ chɔɔ a?
28Ŋko esa beeŋ tiŋ n ta aya fuloŋ
n nite ajanwulɛ so
nɛ a maaŋ chɔɔ mo a?
29To, loŋ koŋwule na
nɛ k du n sa
esa kama nɛ
e di mo barkasa be eche.
Esa kama nɛ e wora loŋ
maaŋ paŋ kasogberge kikɛ.
30Basa maa sha beyu be asheŋ;
hale eyu yuri ajibi n ji
ŋkpal akoŋ so gba,
nɛ b pɛ mo,
31baaŋ gberge mo kusoe
n shin nɛ e ka kusɔ nɛ
e yur na be kukɔ
ale ashunu.
Hale kumo be loŋ
beeŋ shin nɛ e paŋ
kusɔ nɛ e kɔ kikɛ gba,
baaŋ shin nɛ e wora loŋ.
32Enyɛn kama nɛ e bee sha
mo braana be beche
maŋ kɔ nfɛra nna na.
Mo alɛ gbagba be kumu nɛ
e baa jija na.
33Kebri nɛ ŋaba e
naa jo loŋ be esa.
Mo alɛ nɛ anishinyɔr
e naa baa la saŋkikɛ.
34Ŋkpal manɛ so
kedata be agbo lubi ga,
nɛ enyɛn bee bishi
kumo be kuwule
a maa wu kuwɔr kuraa.
35Sheŋ malɛ maa tiŋ a ka
kedata be agbo be kukɔ.
Kakɛ kama maŋ wɔtɔ
a wushi kedata be agbo.

Title: AŊASA 7
Content:
Sakaleche be kasokpele be asheŋ
1M pibinyɛn,
baa nyiŋi asɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo na.
Sa maŋ teŋ kusɔ nɛ
ŋ kaŋɛ fo na so kikɛ.
2Baa wora asɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ na
nseŋ ji efute tenteŋ;
Baa de so,
nsaa bɛ ma keŋini na so
fanɛ kananɛ esa bee kuŋ
kusɔ nɛ e bee sha ga na.
3Baa kɔ asɔ nɛ
ŋ ŋini fo na to saŋkikɛ,
n shin nɛ a baa wɔ
fo kagbene to.
4Ta kanyiasheŋ ŋ
ki fanɛ fo sipoche,
nseŋ ta lakal malɛ
ŋ ki fo teri kpakpaso.
5Amo e naŋ kuŋ fo
ashi fo braana be beche,
nɛ beche nɛ b kɔ
kesakalea so
be mmalga belbelso to.
Sakaleche be asheŋ
6Kachako nɛ n jule ŋ keni
ma ebu be tokuro to,
7n wu mbrantiɛbia damta
nɛ b maa pin asheŋ to
manaŋ manaŋ,
nseŋ keni bumo to
n wu ewulpo ko.
8E daa na kubɔrbi so nna
a mata kakpa
nɛ eche ko daa wɔ,
nseŋ bɔla eche na be kawu ase.
9Kaaseso e daa la,
nɛ kaboŋ birito.
10Nɛ kache na mɛato
kesakalea so
n lar n yɔ mo kutɔ.
Mbe nfɛra daa yil
kananɛ e beeŋ wora
n nya kabrantiɛbia na n yɔ
mbe laŋ to nna.
11Eche na daŋ paŋ
anishinyɔr nna,
nsaa nite kubɔrbi so saŋkikɛ
a malga awɔrso.
12Saŋko e bee yili
kebonfu ko to nna a jo,
saŋko malɛ kubɔrbi so,
saŋko malɛ kebɛ to.
13E ka ya tu kebinyɛnbi na
nɛ e pɛ mo to,
m pepe mbe kɔnɔpurbi
nseŋ keni mbe anishito diimbi
ŋ kaŋɛ le:
14“Kabre nɛ m mɔ
asɔbɔya n lara sarga;
eblaŋ wɔ ma laŋ to.
15Amoso nɛ n lar a fin fo
nseŋ keni n wu fo nfe!
16Ma alɛ ta ljipt be efuli so
be ago peper
be asɔ deseso nna
n deŋi ma gedo so.
17Nseŋ ta etulale nɛ baa tre
mir nɛ alowe
nɛ Sinamɔn na
ŋ ŋmenyaŋ kumo kikɛ so.
18Amoso, baa ba
nɛ an ya sha abar
nseŋ ji anyi be amu
hale nɛ kare e ya chɛ.
19Ma kul maŋ wɔ epe,
e yɔ kade wɔfɔ ko nna.
20E ta amansherbi damta
nna n yɔ.
Bɔkwe anyɔ pɔɛŋ e beeŋ ba.”
21Kache na ta
mmalga belbelso nna,
n fule mo, m pɛ mo
nɛ e shuli n sa mo.
22Nseŋ bɛ mo so epul na to
fanɛ kananɛ baa keta kusɔbɔya
a yɔ nɛ b ya mɔ,
ŋko kananɛ chibir bee shile a luri
kejigbelɛ to nɛ k bee pɛ kumo,
23nɛ b ya too ketanyembi
n wɔtɔ kumo be kagbene to
m mɔ na.
Kebinyɛnbi na daa du nna fanɛ
kabuibi nɛ e bee yɔ
kejigbelɛ to.
E daa maŋ nyi fanɛ
kenishipere to nɛ
e bee yɔ na.
24Amoso, naniere,
ma mbinyɛnsobi,
men nu nfe.
Men kaŋ kusoe n nu
kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere.
25Men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ
men be ekama
be kagbene e yɔ
loŋ be eche so.
Men sa maa sa
loŋ be beche kashuli.
26Eche na shin nɛ
benyɛn damta
paŋ bumo be eyilikpa.
Esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga basa
nɛ e shin nɛ b mur.
27Fo baa yɔ mo pe,
kumo ere luwu be ekpa
nɛ fo bɔ na.
Mo pe e la ekpa shimbi
nɛ k bee yɔ luwu to.

Title: AŊASA 8
Content:
Kanyiasheŋ ka walɛ be asheŋ
1Nu nfe,
kanyiasheŋ e naa tre na.
Lakal e naa kaŋɛ awɔrso
fanɛ fo nu n sa mo na.
2K wɔ abee so nna
nseŋ mata ekpakar
nɛ ŋkpancheri.
3Kade be kabunagboŋ
nɛ baa bɔla a luri kade to na
ase nɛ k wɔ a tre a kaŋɛ:
4“Dimɛdi kikɛ nɛ e wɔ
kasawule so nɛ mee kaŋɛ na.
5Menyee wora abibisheŋ nna a?
Men nya kenimufɛra.
Men wuli nna ŋko?
Men wora nfɛra.
6Men kaŋ kusoe n nu
ma mmalga lela ere.
Kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi na
niŋi ekpa nna.
7Kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji,
maa sha efɛ.
8Kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ
la kashenteŋ nna,
efɛ ŋko kafulesheŋ kikɛ
maŋ wɔ kumo to.
9K baŋ di efuli nna
n sa esa kama nɛ
e bee pin asheŋ to,
nseŋ bugi to n sa esa
nɛ e kɔ kenyi.
10Lara ma keŋini ere
nseŋ yige gbiti.
Baa fin kenyi
a chɔ shuwa lela.
11Kanyiasheŋ kɔ tɔnɔ
a chɔ abitasɔ kikɛ.
Dimɛdi be kusɔ shaso kikɛ
maaŋ tiŋ n ta kumo be kumu
m ber kanyiasheŋ.
12Ma, kanyiasheŋ,
e naa sa asheŋ be kepin to
nɛ kenyi nɛ demu be keji
nɛ kumo be ekpa so be nfɛra.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
be kesa bunyaŋ
e la alubi be kekishi.
Kamoowu nɛ ŋkpensheŋ,
nɛ asheŋ lubi nɛ efɛ be mmalga
maa par Ebɔrɛ kikɛ.
14Ma e naa kre ŋkre
nsaa wora a bɔlɔ so na.
Ma e naa pin asheŋ to,
nsaa kɔ eleŋ na.
15Ma e naa chɛ bewurjipo to
nɛ baa keni bumo be efuliana so,
nsaa chɛ bejuŋkparpo to
nɛ baa wora mbra lela.
16Ma e naa chɛ
ejuŋkparpo kikɛ to
nɛ e bee juŋkpar basa.
Ma e naa chɛ ekrachi
nɛ bewurjipo kikɛ to.
17Mee sha bumo nɛ
baa sha ma nna.
Esa kama nɛ e bee fin ma
kenishipereso beeŋ wu ma.
18Ŋ kɔ kedamaya,
nɛ kemaŋkura,
nɛ anishito be keyɔ,
nɛ kɔŋkɔŋ be keji
be kebaawɔtɔ nna a sa basa.
19Kusɔ nɛ feeŋ nya ma kutɔ
bɔ shuwa
nɛ gbiti lela.
20Ekpa niŋi so,
nɛ kebaaji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so
be ekpa nɛ m bɔ.
21Mee sa bumo nɛ baa sha
ma kedamaya nna
nsaa shin nɛ asɔ lela bee bɔlɔ
bumo be nwu.
22Ma nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
juŋkpar n to.
Dradra na kikɛ nɛ e to ma.
23Sososo kikɛ nɛ e to ma.
N wɔtɔ nna pɔɛŋ
nɛ durnya fara.
24B kurge ma nna pɔɛŋ
nɛ etekuana kikɛ fara.
Ŋ ka fara
nɛ nchu be abuye maŋ wɔtɔ.
25N wɔtɔ nna pɔɛŋ
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ to abeegboŋ,
n ta amo n yili
amo be eyilikpa.
26N wɔtɔ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ
Ebɔrɛ to kasawule,
nɛ sososo nɛ shishɛr
nɛ kasawule dɔso.
27N wɔtɔ nna pɔɛŋ,
nɛ e ta awɔlpa n yili
amo be kaboŋ,
nseŋ yili kakpa
nɛ esa be kenishi
beeŋ tiŋ n wu
n ya tar ashi teku so.
28N wɔtɔ nna pɔɛŋ
nɛ e ta abɔrɛwɔlpa
n wɔtɔ esoso,
nseŋ bugi nchu n wɔtɔ teku to,
29nseŋ ponte ŋ kaŋɛ nchu na
fanɛ a sa maŋ bɔlɔ n dii
a chɔ kananɛ e kaŋɛ amo
saŋɛ nɛ e tɔl
durnya be gbaltɔlase na.
30N daa wɔ mo kutɔ nna fanɛ
esa nɛ e nyi asɔ be kewora,
nsaa chɛ mo to a lɔŋɛ asɔ
nsaa du fanɛ kebibi.
Ma kagbene bee fuli ma nna
ashi mbe anishito,
nɛ ma alɛ bee sa mo
kagbenefuli kachɛ kama.
31Ma kagbene fuli durnya so,
nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kumo to be asheŋ
bee bɔlɔ ma kenishi ga.
32Naniere, mbifɔlbi,
men kaŋ kusoe n nu,
Men wora asɔ nɛ
ŋ kaŋɛ ere nɛ a shin nɛ
men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi.
33Men nu kusɔ nɛ mee
ŋini menyi ere,
nseŋ nya kanyiasheŋ.
Men sa maŋ kplaŋ kumo so.
34Bekama nɛ baa ba
ma laŋ to m ba kaa chena
ma kabuna to,
a jo a nu ma mmalga na
be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo.
35Bekama nɛ b nya ma,
nya ŋkpa;
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ
be kagbene fuli bumo so.
36Bekama nɛ b maŋ nya ma bre
bee tɔrɔ bumo be amu nna.
Ekama nɛ e kishi ma
bee sha luwu nna na.”

Title: AŊASA 9
Content:
Kanyiasheŋ nɛ kawuli be asheŋ
1Kanyiasheŋ pɔr kumo be ebu nna
n yili eshabɔrɛ ashunu so.
2Nseŋ shin nɛ b mɔ
kusɔbɔya n wora kejigboŋ;
nseŋ ta asɔ
nɛ amo be efɛa bee dufɛ viim
n wɔtɔ nsa to n yili.
3Nseŋ shuŋi mbe mbita fanɛ
b ya yili kade be mboŋ jeŋgreŋ
m ponte n tre basa ŋ kaŋɛ:
4“Menyi nɛ men maa pin asheŋ to
manaŋ manaŋ na e luri m ba.”
Nseŋ kaŋɛ bewulpo malɛ le:
5“Men ba ji ma ajibi
nseŋ nu nsa belbelso
nɛ n wora n yili na.
6Men lar basa nɛ
b maa pin asheŋ to
manaŋ manaŋ na be katuŋ to
nseŋ ji efute.
Men shin nɛ asheŋ be kepin to
e baa ŋini menyi ekpa.”
7Fo baa ŋini esa nɛ
e kɔ mpuchi ekpa,
katege nɛ fee fin a sa fo kumu na.
Nɛ fo fiɛ esa lubi so,
feeŋ luri tɔrɔ to.
8Sa maŋ kaŋ fiɛ
esa nɛ e bee puchi so,
fo baŋ wora loŋ,
e beeŋ kishi fo.
Ama fo baŋ ŋini enyiashempo bre
ekpa e beeŋ sa fo bunyaŋ.
9Kusɔ kama nɛ fo
kaŋɛ enyiashempo,
bee sa mo kanyiasheŋ nna a ti so.
Kusɔ kama malɛ
nɛ fo kaŋɛ basa nɛ
baa wora asheŋ niŋiso,
bee sa bumo kenyi nna a ti so.
10Nɛ fee sha kanyiasheŋ,
fo fara a ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.
Nɛ fo baa nyi Ebɔrɛ cheembi na,
feeŋ baa pin asheŋ to.
11Kanyiasheŋ beeŋ shin nɛ
fo ŋkpa e teŋi so.
12Fo nyiasheŋ,
feeŋ ji kumo be tɔnɔ;
Fo kpal kamoowuso
ŋ kini kanyiasheŋ
feeŋ ji awurfoŋ.
13Kawuli du fanɛ
eche nɛ e maa pin
asheŋ to manaŋ manaŋ
nsaa da asheŋ a wea abar to nna.
14E bee chena mbe kabuna to
ashi kaboŋ jeŋgreŋ nɛ
baaŋ wu mo nna,
15a tre a kaŋɛ basa nɛ baa choŋ le:
16“Basa nɛ b maa pin
asheŋ to manaŋ manaŋ,
e luri m ba.”
Nsaa kaŋɛ bewulpo malɛ le:
17“Keyuri nchu wɔ ebel,
ama ajibi nɛ fo ŋana n ji
e wɔ ebel a chɔ amo”
18Basa nɛ baa nu mbe kafulesheŋ
maŋ nyi fanɛ
bekama nɛ b luri mbe laŋ to kikɛ
bee yɔ bubuni to nna.

Title: AŊASA 10
Content:
Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be aŋasa
1Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be aŋasa nde:
Kebia nyiashempo
bee bar mo tuto nɛ mo nio
kumu saŋɛ nna,
ama kebia wulpo bre
bee wɔtɔ bumo ebesa to nna.
2Kapuni be kedamaya
maa lar tɔnɔ a sa esa
ama kashenteŋji bre
bee mɔlga esa be ŋkpa nna.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ maaŋ shin nɛ
basa lela e di akoŋ,
Mo alɛ maaŋ shin nɛ
alubiworapoana e nya
kusɔ nɛ baa sha.
4Ntɔl bee bar esa ketir nna,
ama kepere kenishi n shuŋ
bre bee shin nɛ esa bee
dii dama nna.
5Enyiashempo bee teŋi
asɔ saŋɛ nɛ a bel nna,
ama k la anishinyɔr nna fanɛ
esa e baa dese a di
kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ.
6Basa lela bee nya nɛfa nna;
ama nfɛra lubi e ŋana
a wɔ esa lubi
be mmalga be kaman.
7Basa lela be alela so
nɛ baa nyiŋi bumo,
ama b maa nyiŋi
belubiwurapo bre kikɛ.
8Basa nɛ b kɔ lakal
bee sɔ kasotoji nna,
ama basa nɛ baa malga
kawuliso bre
maa chɛr nsaa tɔr.
9Beshenteŋjipo bee nya kekuŋ nna,
nɛ shɛŋ maa gbuŋgbuŋ bumo;
ama kebirkɔnshiwura be asheŋ
beeŋ lar efuli.
10Esa nɛ e bee dɔ
a buu kashenteŋ so
bee wɔtɔ basa ebesa to nna,
ama esa nɛ e maa fɛ nfɛra
pɔɛŋ nsaa malga
maa chɛr nsaa tɔr.
11Esa lela be mmalga du fanɛ
kebuye nna a sa ŋkpa,
ama kamɔ be nfɛra lubi
e ŋana a wɔ esa lubi
be mmalga be kaman.
12Kekishi bee bar kamɔrɔji
nɛ kebagato nna,
ama kasha bre bee kplaŋ
aworandeso kikɛ so nna.
13Esa be mmalga e naa ŋini fanɛ
e la enyiashempo,
ama ewulpo bre
daga kasogberge nna.
14Enyiashempo bee fin kenyi nna
a ti so saŋkikɛ,
ama ewulpo be mmalga
e naa da mo a lɛ.
15Kedamaya bee kuŋ
damawuraana nna
fanɛ kananɛ baa pɔr egbal
a kuŋ kade na,
ama ketir bre maa kuŋ betirpo.
16Alela be kakɔka
e la ŋkpa tenteŋ,
ama alubi bre bee shin nɛ
esa bee wora alubi nna a ti so.
17Basa nɛ baa shuli a sɔ keŋini
be kasogberge beeŋ ji efute,
ama bumo nɛ b maa shuli
kewora n jija bre
be lalaloge maa kaa walɛ.
18Esa kama nɛ kekishi wɔ mo to
la efɛpo nna.
Ewulpo e naa ta
b yɛ b yɛ a shuŋ.
19Fo baa malga ga
fo maa kra malga a foe.
Nɛ fo nyi asheŋ
fo maaŋ baa malga ga.
20Esa lela be mmalga
du fanɛ gbiti nna,
ama esa lubi maa sa
esa nfɛra nɛ k kɔ tɔnɔ.
21Esa lela be mmalga
kɔ tɔnɔ nna n sa basa damta,
ama kawuli beeŋ tiŋ m mɔ fo.
22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa ta
esa e ki damawura.
Kepere kenishi n shuŋ
maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ fo dii dama.
23Ewulpo nɛ alubi be kewora
bee wora ebel.
Kanyiasheŋ e naa par benyipo bre.
24Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso
bee nya kusɔ nɛ baa sha nna,
ama kusɔ nɛ belubiworapo bre
maa sha nɛ baa nya ga.
25Afugboŋ bee ba nna
m ba kaa ber alubiworapoana a lɛ,
ama beshenteŋjipo bre
bee nya kumɔlga nna saŋkama.
26Sa maŋ shin nɛ etɔlpo
e wora shɛŋ n sa fo,
mbe asheŋ wora so kikɛ
du nna fanɛ fo ka ji dorobi
nɛ anyi bee nyiri fo;
ŋko edishi ka luri fo anishito nna.
27Wora Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kasonu
nseŋ ji efute n chɛr.
Kumu kpakpasowura
bee wu nna nɛ mbe saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo.
28Basa lela be kanya
bee bar kagbenefuli nna,
ama belubiworapo bre
maaŋ nya kusɔ nɛ baa tama kikɛ.
29Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
bee kuŋ beshenteŋjipo nna,
nsaa mur bumo nɛ
baa wora alubi.
30Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi
bee nya kekuŋ
saŋkikɛ nna,
ama belubiworapo bre
maaŋ ji efute n chɛr kasawule so.
31Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi
bee malga
kanyiasheŋ be mmalga nna,
ama baaŋ kuŋ
mmalga lubi wora bre ekpa.
32Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi
e nyi asheŋ lela
nɛ a daga kemalga,
ama asheŋ besaso nɛ belubiworapo
bre bee malga saŋkama.

Title: AŊASA 11
Content:
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi
kapuni be kasɔkarga ga.
Kasɔkarga nɛ k bɔla ekpa
e naa fuli mbe kagbene.
2Kamoowuwuraana maa chɛr
nsaa ji anishinyɔr.
Kamubrase bre
bee sa esa kanyiasheŋ nna.
3Basa lela be kashenteŋji
e naa kuŋ bumo.
Basa nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n yirda bre
gbagba be kebirkɔnshi
e naa mur bumo.
4Kedamaya maaŋ ba kɔ tɔnɔ
n sa fo gbagba fo kaluwuachɛ,
ama kashenteŋji bre
beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga fo ŋkpa.
5Kashenteŋji bee shin nɛ
kebaawɔtɔ bee ki pɔpɔtɔ nna
a sa esa lela,
ama belubiworapo bre
gbagba e naa da bumo amu a lɛ.
6Kecheembiya e naa
mɔlga beshenteŋjipo,
ama basa nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n yirda bre
gbagba be kejimuni
e naa ki kejigbelɛ a pɛ bumo.
7Belubiworapo nɛ tama e naa wu,
nɛ bumo be yirda
nɛ k deŋ bumo be kedamaya so
e ki fuloŋ.
8Basa cheembi bee nya kekuŋ
ashi tɔrɔ nɛ k bee ba
belubiworapo so na to nna.
9Basa nɛ b maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ be mmalga
beeŋ tiŋ n yɛr esa kemur to,
ama basa cheembi
be kanyiasheŋ be mmalga
bee sa esa kumɔlga nna.
10Beshenteŋjipo baŋ dii dama,
bumo be kade to ebi kikɛ be ŋgbene
bee fuli bumo nna.
Alubiworapo malɛ baŋ wu
mbe kade to ebi be ŋgbene
bee fuli bumo nna.
11Basa cheembi be nɛfa
bee maŋ bumo be kade so nna,
ama basa lubi bre be mmalga
bee mur bumo be kade nna.
12Ewulpo e naa ji beko be asheŋ,
enyiashempo bre bee loto nna.
13Esheŋjipo kikɛ maŋ kɔ ashiri,
ama feeŋ tiŋ n yirda
esa nɛ basa bee sa yirda bre.
14Efuli nɛ k maŋ kɔ
bejuŋkparpo nyiashempo
bee mur nna;
ama besoetojipo damta
bee kuŋ efuli nna.
15Nɛ fo yili kajinamu
n sa esa nɛ fo maŋ nyi,
feeŋ wora n daa nyi nna.
Amoso sa maŋ ta fo kumu m baga nfɔl.
16Eche nɛ e bee bugi enɔ a kɛ
bee nya kemaŋkura nna,
ama eche nɛ e maŋ kɔ da bre
bee bar anishinyɔr nna.
Etɔlpo maaŋ dii dama kikɛ,
ama basa nɛ baa pere kenishi a shuŋ bre
beeŋ dii dama.
17Nɛ fee wora kelela
fo kumu nɛ fee wora a sa.
Nɛ basa be awurfoŋ bee wora fo ebel,
fo alɛ gba beeŋ luri tɔrɔ to.
18Belubiworapo maa nya tɔnɔ kikɛ,
ama esa nɛ e bee wora kelela bre
maaŋ paŋ kumo be tɔnɔ kikɛ.
19Esa kama nɛ e yili
mbe kagbene to fanɛ
e beeŋ wora kelela beeŋ ji efute tenteŋ,
ama esa kama nɛ e yili
mbe kagbene to fanɛ
e beeŋ wora alubi bre
maaŋ ji efute n chɛr kikɛ.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi
nfɛra lubiwura ga,
ama e bee sha bekama
nɛ baa wora asheŋ lela bre ga.
21K baa dese nna geeŋ fanɛ
baaŋ gberge belubiworapo kusoe,
ama bekama nɛ baa wora
asheŋ niŋiso bre
beeŋ gelge kasogberge.
22Eche nɛ e walɛ kebita
nsaa maŋ kɔ da
du fanɛ shuwa be kepinibi nna
ashi preku be kamuna to.
23Asɔ kama nɛ basa lela bee fin
bee ki asɔ lela nna.
Ama belubiworapo bre baŋ nya asɔ
k bee pɛ basa agbo nna.
24Kakɛ maa loge asɔ.
Beko bee kɛ ga,
bumo alɛ nsaa dii dama saŋkikɛ,
nɛ beko malɛ kɔ miri ga
nsaa la betirpo saŋkikɛ.
25Fo baa bugi enɔ a kɛ
feeŋ dii dama.
Chɛ beko to
nɛ beko malɛ e chɛ fo to.
26Basa bee sho bumo
nɛ baa ti ajibi so a yili fanɛ
amo be yawu e di pɔɛŋ nɛ b fa na
kɔnɔ nna,
nsaa chɔrɔ bekama nɛ baa fa
amo saŋkikɛ na.
27Esa kama nɛ e bee fin asheŋ lela
bee nya asheŋ lela nna,
nɛ asheŋ lubi malɛ bee tu
ekama nɛ e bee fin asheŋ lubi.
28Bekama nɛ b ta
bumo be tama n deŋi
bumo be kanya so
beeŋ gbaŋgbaŋ n tɔr
fanɛ ketarso be afantaŋ,
ama basa cheembi bre
beeŋ baa purge afantaŋ popɔr
fanɛ kechaliso be ndibi nna saŋkama.
29Bekama nɛ baa fin asheŋ lubi
a ba bumo be laŋ to ebi so
maaŋ nya kapetɛ n ji kikɛ.
Bewulpo malɛ beeŋ baa la
benyiashempo be anya nna saŋkama.
30Kecheembiya bee sa ŋkpa nna,
ama kumu kpakpaso
be kebaawɔtɔ bre bee mɔ nna.
31Nɛ basa lela bee nya
kelela be kakɔka durnya ere to,
kumo ere kashenteŋto,
basa lubi gba beeŋ nya kasogberge.

Title: AŊASA 12
Content:
1Ekama nɛ e bee sha keniŋi
bee nya kenyi nna.
Ama ekama nɛ e kishi keniŋi
la ewulpo nna.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kagbene
bee fuli basa lela so nna,
ama e maa sa bekama
nɛ baa kre asheŋ lubi bre
kashuli kikɛ.
3Kumu kpakpaso be asheŋ woraso
maa kuŋ esa,
ama kecheembiya bre
bee shin nɛ esa
bee yili to kiŋkiŋ nna.
4Eche nɛ e kɔ da lela
bee bar mo kul kamusaŋɛ
nɛ kagbenefuli nna,
ama eche nɛ e bee wɔtɔ
mo kul anishinyɔr to bre
du fanɛ kɔrtɔ lubi nna.
5Beshenteŋjipo bee wora asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so nna,
ama belubiworapo bre
bee fule basa nna.
6Belubiworapo be mmalga
bee bar kamɔ nna,
ama basa cheembi bre be mmalga
bee lara esa eyilikpa lubi to nna.
7Belubiworapo baŋ tɔr,
bumo nɛ bumo kanaŋ kikɛ
bee mur nna,
ama basa cheembi bre
be kanaŋ wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
8Esa be kanyiasheŋ
e naa sa mo kechɔrɔ,
nɛ kawulisheŋ malɛ
bee shin nɛ baa keni esa jiga.
9Kebaa la ebɔlpo a shuŋ a ji
bɔ keta fo kumu n yili
eyilikpagboŋ nsaa di akoŋ.
10Basa lela bee keni
bumo be asɔbɔya gba so nɛnɛ nna,
ama basa lubi bre
be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ
bumo be asɔbɔya to.
11Bedɔpo nɛ b pere kenishi a shuŋ
maaŋ paŋ kusɔ jiso kikɛ,
ewulpo e naa jija saŋɛ
a bɛ asheŋ fuloŋ so.
12Belubiworapo bee kɔ nna a fin
alubi be kewora,
ama basa cheembi bre
mur achin nna
n yili fanɛ ndibi,
a maa gbuŋgbuŋ to kikɛ.
13Belubiworapo gbagba be mmalga
e naa kilgi a kre bumo,
ama beshenteŋjipo bre
bee lara bumo be amu asheŋ to nna.
14Feeŋ nya kusɔ kama
nɛ fo wora ŋko ŋ kaŋɛ be tɔnɔ.
15Ewulpo nawule
e naa fɛ fanɛ
e kɔ kashenteŋ nna saŋkama.
Enyiashempo bre
bee kaŋ kusoe nna a nu kasotoji.
16Ewulpo e naa nya agbo a puŋi kɔnɔ.
Enyiashempo bre
bee kplaŋ katege so nna.
17Fo baŋ ji kashenteŋ,
basa bee wora asheŋ a niŋi ekpa nna,
ama efɛ bre bee shin nɛ basa
bee wora asheŋ a gbɛto nna.
18Esa nɛ e maa fɛ nfɛra
pɔɛŋ nsaa malga
be mmalga bee besa nna fanɛ
b ka ŋe esa kasaŋɛ nna,
ama enyiashempo be mmalga bre
bee wushi ebesa nna.
19Efɛ maa chɛr nsaa fo ekar,
ama kashenteŋ bre
wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.
20Efɛ e wɔ basa nɛ baa kre
asheŋ lubi be nfɛra to,
ama bekama nɛ baa kre asheŋ lela bre
kɔ kagbenefuli nna.
21Asheŋ lubi maa tiŋ a tu
basa lela,
ama belubiworapo bre
maaŋ gelge tɔrɔ kikɛ.
22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi befɛpo
be asheŋ ga,
ama mbe kagbene bee fuli
bekama nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ so nna.
23Enyiashempo bee ta
mbe kenyi nna a ŋana,
ama ewulpo bre
bee shin nɛ mbe kawuli
bee di efuli nna.
24Basa nɛ baa pere kenishi a shuŋ
e naŋ ji kuwura;
ntɔl bre bee ta esa nna
a ki kenya.
25Kafɔŋ beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ
fo paŋ kagbenefuli,
ama kamalga lela
bee leŋ basa to nna.
26Basa cheembi bee ŋini
bumo teriana ekpa lela nna,
ama belubiworapo bre
be ekpa bee yɛr bumo
kefoe to nna.
27Etɔlpo maa nya
kusɔ nɛ e bee sha kikɛ,
ama esa nɛ e bee pere kenishi
a shuŋ bre beeŋ pɛ mbe anishi
be kabuibi.
28Kecheembiya be ekpa
e kɔ ŋkpa,
luwu maŋ wɔ kumo be
ekpa to kikɛ.

Title: AŊASA 13
Content:
1Kebia nyiashempo kikɛ
bee kaŋ kusoe nna a nu
mo tuto be keŋini,
ama kumukpakpasowura bre
maa shuli a sɔ keŋini.
2Basa lela be mmalga
e naa ka bumo kukɔ,
basa lubi bre be kusɔ nɛ baa sha e la
kebaa tintiŋ basa a wɔtɔ
alubi be kewora to.
3Esa nɛ e bee tiŋ a keta
mbe kudonduloŋ
beeŋ kuŋ mbe ŋkpa,
ama esa nɛ mbe kɔnɔ
maŋ kɔ kemɔrɛbi
bee mur mbe kumu nna.
4Etɔlpo bee yɛlga kusɔ gba,
jiga nna,
e maaŋ tiŋ n nya kumo,
ama esa kama nɛ e bee pere kenishi
a shuŋ bre
beeŋ tiŋ n nya kusɔ kama
nɛ e bee sha.
5Esa cheembi kikɛ
kishi kafulesheŋ nna,
ama basa lubi bre
be aworbi bee bar bumo
anishinyɔr nɛ nyɔmu nna.
6Kebaawora asheŋ niŋiso
bee kuŋ esa niŋiso nna,
ama alubi bre
bee da basa lubi nna a lɛ.
7Basa ko bee ta bumo be amu nna
fanɛ damawuraana,
ama bumo alɛ maŋ kɔ shɛŋ.
Beko malɛ bee ta bumo be amu
nna fanɛ betirpo,
bumo alɛ nsaa la damawuraana kashenteŋto.
8Saŋko, damawuraana bee kaa ta
bumo be kanya nna
a kuŋ bumo be amu,
ama betirpo bre
maa kaa luri loŋ be asheŋ to.
9Basa cheembi du fanɛ
kefulto nɛ k bee nyaŋɛ
nsaa nyɛkpɛ saŋkama nna,
ama basa lubi bre du fanɛ
fitila nɛ k bee mɔrɛ
a shin nɛ k duŋ nna.
10Kamoowu bee bar
esa tɔrɔ nna.
Enyiashempo bre
bee fin kasotoji nna.
11Ekpa lubi so be kanya
maa chɛr nsaa loge.
Ama esa kama nɛ e bee fin
gbrɛgbrɛbi be kanya bee ti so
saŋkama nna.
12Tama nɛ k bee chɛr
pɔɛŋ nsaa ba
bee shin nɛ esa
be aba bee pɔ mo nna,
ama esa baa nya
kusɔ nɛ e bee fin,
k bee bar mo kagbenefuli nna.
13Esa nɛ e bee kini kasotoji lela
bee wɔtɔ mbe kumu tɔrɔ to nna,
ama emo nɛ e bee shuli
a sɔ kasotoji bre
bee nya kumo be tɔnɔ nna.
14Benyiashempo be keŋini
du fanɛ ŋkpa be kebuye nna,
a chɛ esa to nɛ
e bee gelge luwu be kenishipere.
15Esa nɛ e bee nase asheŋ
amo be edesekpa
bee nya kemaŋkura nna,
ama esa nɛ e paŋ lakal bre
wɔ ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ
kemur to so nna.
16Enyiashempo bee fɛ nfɛra nna
pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ,
ama ewulpo bre bee ta
mbe kawulisheŋ
nna a deŋi kelafa so.
17Kabɔ wulpo e naa bar
kebagato,
ama kabɔ nɛ e bee ji
kashenteŋ bre
bee bar kayurwushi nna.
18Esa kama nɛ e bee kplaŋ
keŋini so mo
nɛ ketir nɛ anishinyɔr
e naa baa la,
ama ekama nɛ e bee shuli
a sɔ keŋini bre
bee nya kemaŋkura nna.
19Kenya kusɔ nɛ esa bee sha
wɔ ebel nna nsaa wushi kagbene.
Bewulpo nawule e naa kini
kechɛrga ashi alubi to.
20Esa kama nɛ
e bee tu benyiashempo a nite
bee ki enyiashempo nna,
ama esa nɛ mo nɛ
bewulpo bee wora asheŋ bre
bee luri tɔrɔ to nna.
21Kumu lubi e ju a buu
alubiworapoana so,
ama basa nɛ baa wora
asheŋ niŋiso bre
be kakɔka la kumulela nna.
22Basa lela bee yige kapetɛ nna
a yili bumo be kaman to ebi,
ama belubiworapo bre
bee fin asɔ nna a yili
basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso.
23Etirpo be kasawule
beeŋ tiŋ n wora adɔjibi nɛnɛ,
ama basa nɛ b maa ji kashenteŋ
beeŋ puni n suge kanya na
kikɛ ŋ ka mo.
24Esa kama nɛ e maa gberge
mbe mbia kusoe
a ŋini bumo asheŋ
maa sha bumo nna na.
Esa kama nɛ e bee sha mbe mbia
bee gberge bumo kusoe nna
a ŋini bumo asheŋ saŋɛ nɛ k daga.
25Basa niŋiso kɔ ajibi
saŋkikɛ nna a ji,
ama belubiworapo bre
nɛ akoŋ e wɔ aya.

Title: AŊASA 14
Content:
1Eche nyiashempo
bee koli kanaŋ nna,
ama eche wulpo bre
bee bure laŋ nna.
2Basa nɛ bumo be
asheŋ wora so niŋi
bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ nna,
ama esa kama nɛ
e maa wora asheŋ niŋiso
maa sa Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ.
3Ewulpo be kamoowu be mmalga
bee bar mo kasogberge nna,
ama enyiashempo bre be kɔnɔ
bee mɔlga mo nna.
4Nɛ ana dɔso maŋ wɔtɔ,
ajibi maŋ wɔtɔ.
Ana dɔso be eleŋ e naa shin nɛ
ajibi damta bee ba.
5Kashenteŋ be shɛdajipo maa fule,
ama efɛ be shɛdajipo bre
be kamalga kikɛ la efɛ nna.
6Shiaworapo maaŋ tiŋ n nya
kanyiasheŋ kikɛ
ama lakalwura bre bee
nya kenyi manaŋ manaŋ nna.
7Sa maa tu bewulpo a wora asheŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so
fo maaŋ tiŋ n nya
kanyiasheŋ bumo kutɔ.
8Enyiashempo be kanyiasheŋ
e naa ŋini mo ekpa,
ama ewulpo bre be kawuli
bee fule mo nna n ya kaa lɛ.
9Ewulpo nɛ asheŋ lubi maa fɔŋ,
ama esa lela bre bee fin
asheŋ be kelɔŋɛ nna.
10Esa pɔtɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin
kagbenefuli ŋko ebesa
nɛ k wɔ esa be kagbene to.
11Esa lubi be laŋ maa chɛr
nsaa bure,
ama esa lela bre
be laŋ to be asheŋ
bee yɔ anishito nna saŋkama.
12Kebaawɔtɔ ko bee kaa duli
kebaawɔtɔ lela nna,
ama kumo be lalaloge
bee yɛr esa luwu to nna.
13Esa beeŋ tiŋ m mushe
nɛ mbe kagbene maŋ fuli mo
n loge.
Kagbenefuli malɛ baŋ loge,
kagbenejija e naa bɛ so.
14Kusɔ kama nɛ esa duu,
kulubi ŋko kelela,
kumo nɛ e beeŋ teŋi.
15Ewulpo e maa shika kasheŋ to,
enyiashempo bre
bee fɛ nfɛra nna
pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ.
16Enyiashempo bee ŋana
Ebɔrɛ nna
nsaa gelge alubi,
ewulpo bre du brembreŋ nna,
e maa fɛ nfɛra pɔɛŋ
nsaa wora asheŋ.
17Esa nɛ e bee nya agbo
manaŋ manaŋ
maa kraa wora a foe.
Enyiashempo bre
bee wushi eyur nna
a wora asheŋ.
18Ewulpo bee ji mbe kawuli
be tɔnɔ nna,
ama enyiashempo bre
bee nya kenyi nna a ti so.
19Belubiworapo e naaŋ jɔŋɛ
belelaworapo ase
n fin kechɛto ashi bumo kutɔ.
20Etirpo maŋ kɔ elopo,
ama damawuraana bre
kɔ beteri damta nna.
21Kekishi fo kurgepo
la kulubi nna,
ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nɛfa bekama
nɛ baa chɛ betirpo to.
22Bumo nɛ baa kre asheŋ lubi
beeŋ foe,
ama bumo nɛ
baa kre alelasheŋ
beeŋ nya
basa be kasha nɛ yirda.
23Kepere kenishi n shuŋ
bee bar tɔnɔ nna,
ama k baa tase a malga
nawule bre
bee bar ketir nna.
24Benyiashempo beeŋ nya
kedamaya be tɔnɔ,
ama bewulpo bre be kawulisheŋ
e naa shin nɛ basa bee pin fanɛ
b la bewulpo.
25Kashenteŋ be shɛdajipo
bee mɔlga basa be ŋkpa nna,
ama efɛ be shɛdajipo bre
bee lar basa kaman nna.
26Esa kama nɛ
e bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ,
mo nɛ mbe mbia beeŋ nya
Ebɔrɛ be kekuŋ.
27Kabɔrɛŋana du fanɛ
ŋkpa be kebuye nna;
a kuŋ esa ashi
luwu be ajigbelɛ to.
28Basa e la kuwura.
Ewura nɛ e maŋ kɔ basa
be kuwura maa ji eleŋ.
29Enyitipo e la enyiashempo.
Esa nɛ e bee nya agbo
manaŋ manaŋ
bee shin nɛ mbe kawulisheŋ
bee dii efuli nna.
30Kagbenewushi bee sa esa
ŋkpa nna,
ama kayurbesa bre
du fanɛ kɔrtɔ lubi nna a ji esa.
31Esa nɛ e bee mɛaŋ betirpo
maa sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ
e to bumo na bunyaŋ nna na,
ama esa nɛ
e bee wu betirpo kuwɔr bre
bee bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nna.
32Belubiworapo gbagba
be asheŋ lubi
e naa mur bumo,
ama belelaworapo bre be alela
e naa kuŋ bumo.
33Kanyiasheŋ wɔ basa nɛ
baa pin asheŋ to be ŋgbene to nna,
ama bewulpo bre
maŋ kɔ kumo.
34Kebaawora asheŋ niŋiso
e naa sa efuli kemaŋkura,
ama alubi bre
bee shin nɛ efuli bee sipa nna.
35Nyɛrbi nyiashempo be asheŋ
bee bɔlɔ bewura kenishi nna,
ama nyɛrbi wulpo bre
bee nya bewura
be kasogberge nna.

Title: AŊASA 15
Content:
1Kɔnɔ belbelso bee ju agbo nna,
ama kɔnɔ nyaŋnyaŋso bre
bee kaa agbo nna.
2Enyiashempo be kamalga
bee koli basa nna a ba mo kutɔ,
ama kawulisheŋ e naa lar
ewulpo bre be kɔnɔ to.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishi
wɔ kaplɛkama nna,
a wu kusɔ nɛ basa lubi
nɛ belela kikɛ bee wora.
4Kamalga lela
bee sa basa ŋkpa nna,
ama efɛ be mmalga bre
bee mɔ esa be kiyoyu nna.
5Ewulpo e naa kplaŋ mo tuto
nɛ mo nio be keŋini so.
Enyiashempo kikɛ
bee shin nɛ mo tuto
nɛ mo nio bee niŋi mo ekpa nna.
6Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso
e naa ji bumo be kanya be tɔnɔ.
Ama tɔrɔ be saŋɛ belubiworapo bre
bee paŋ bumo be kanya nna.
7Benyiashempo be atuwebi
e naa sa basa kenyi,
mannɛ bewulpo peya.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi
belubiworapo be sarga ga,
ama basa lela bre be kabɔrɛkule
bee bɔlɔ mo kenishi nna ga.
9Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi
belubiworapo be asheŋ wora so ga,
ama e bee sha basa nɛ baa wora
asheŋ lela bre ga.
10Kasogberge gboŋgboŋi
bee jo ekama
nɛ e maa bɔla ekpa niŋiso so
a wora asheŋ na nna.
Ekama nɛ e kini keŋini
nsaa bɛ ekpa nɛ k maŋ niŋi na so
beeŋ wu.
11Luwu nɛ nchaŋ gba
maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so,
a bishi dimɛdi
be kagbene to be nfɛra.
12Esa nɛ e bee wora
basa eyurto kikɛ
maa sha keŋini,
amoso mo alɛ maaŋ yɔ
enyiashempo kutɔ
n ya fin kasotoji.
13Esa nɛ mbe kagbene fuli
maa gbir kenishito,
ama kagbenejija bre bee shin nɛ
esa be ŋkpa bee barga mo to nna.
14Enyiashempo kikɛ
bee koya nna a ti so,
ama kawulisheŋ e bɔlɔ
bewulpo bre to.
15Kebaawɔtɔ kpakpaso to
nɛ betirpo wɔ saŋkama,
ama esa nɛ
asheŋ bee bɔlɔ kenishi bre
be kebaawɔtɔ du fanɛ
esa nɛ e bee ji
kejigboŋ saŋkama nna.
16Kebaa la etirpo
nsaa ŋana Ebɔrɛ
bɔ kedamaya nɛ tɔrɔ.
17Kebaatu esa nɛ e bee sha fo
a ji nchu nɛ nfɔl bɔ kebaatu bedoŋ
n ji gbetɛgbetɛ.
18Esa nɛ e bee nya agbo
manaŋ manaŋ kikɛ
bee bar kolu nna,
ama enyitipo bre
bee kuŋ kolu nna.
19Etɔlpo be ekpa to e kɔ ewi,
ama esa nɛ e bee wora alela bre
be ekpa to du fanɛ
kegbembi nna.
20Kebia nyiashempo kikɛ
bee bar mo tuto kagbenefuli nna,
kebia wulpo e naa kplaŋ
mo nio be keŋini so.
21Kawulisheŋ bee fuli
ewulpo kagbene nna,
ama enyiashempo bre
bee wora asheŋ niŋiso nna.
22Ŋkre lela kikɛ bee shi
kasotoji lela to nna.
Kechena ŋ kre asheŋ nɛnɛ
pɔɛŋ nseŋ wora
e naa shin nɛ asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ.
23Keshuli n wora kesheŋ
saŋɛ nɛ k daga nɛ kananɛ k daga
e naa bar kagbenefuli.
24Ekpa nɛ benyiashempo bɔ
bee yɛr bumo ŋkpa to nna,
mannɛ luwu to.
25Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee shin nɛ kamoowuwuraana be nwu
bee ki alambure nna,
ama e bee kuŋ bekulpoche bre
be asɔ nna a sa bumo.
26Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kishi
nfɛra lubi ga,
kamalga lela
e naa fuli mo kagbene.
27Ekpa lubi so be kanya
bee bar tɔrɔ kanaŋ to nna.
Sa maa sɔ brɔbu
nseŋ kuŋ fo kumu.
28Basa lela bee fɛ
nfɛra nna pɔɛŋ
nsaa tuge asheŋ to,
ama basa lubi bre
bee jujo nna
a malga mmalga lubi pɔɛŋ
nsaa fɛ amo be nfɛra.
29Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa nu
basa lubi be kabɔrɛkule,
basa nɛ baa wora
asheŋ niŋiso peya
nɛ E bee nu.
30Kenishitosaŋɛ bee bar
kagbenefuli nna,
nɛ baru lela bee shin nɛ
esa be ŋkpa bee ba mo abar so.
31Enyiashempo e naa nu kasotoji.
32Esa kama nɛ e maa shuli
a sɔ kasogberge
maa sha mbe kumu nna na,
ama esa kama nɛ e bee sɔ keŋini
bee nya kanyiasheŋ nna a ti so.
33Kabɔrɛŋana e naa sa
esa kanyiasheŋ,
nɛ kamoobarase malɛ
bee sa esa kemaŋkura.

Title: AŊASA 16
Content:
1Dimɛdi e wɔ afɛso
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e wɔ aworbi.
2Dimɛdi beeŋ fɛ fanɛ
mbe asheŋ woraso walɛ,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule
e nyi kusɔ nɛ k walɛ.
3Ta kusɔ kama
nɛ fee sha kewora m bɔɔ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ enɔ
nɛ asheŋ e nite nɛnɛ n sa fo.
4Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e nyi
kusɔ so so nɛ e lɔŋɛ
kusɔ kama nɛ e lɔŋɛ;
E wora belubiworapo gba nna
a jo bumo be kemur be kachɛ.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi
esa nɛ e kɔ mpuchi ga.
Kumo alɛ maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ fanɛ
e beeŋ gberge loŋ be basa kusoe.
6Fo baa kɔ kasonu nɛ kashenteŋji,
Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta fo alubi m paŋ fo.
Kabɔrɛŋana e naa shin nɛ
esa bee ŋana kulubi.
7Esa be asheŋ woraso
baa bɔlɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kenishi,
E bee shin nna nɛ
amodoŋwura nɛ mo doŋana gba
bee chena kagbenewushi so.
8Kebɔla ekpa niŋiso so
n nya asɔ gbrɛ
bɔ kebirkɔshi so be kedamaya.
9Dimɛdi e wɔ afɛso,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e wɔ aworbi.
10Ewura be mmalga kɔ yuku nna,
nɛ mbe kɔnɔ to be atuwebi malɛ
bee bɛ kashenteŋ be ekpa so.
11Kashenteŋ be kasɔkarga
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee sha.
E maa sha kapuni be kayawuji.
12Kebaaji asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so
e naa sa kuwurji eleŋ,
amoso a daga fanɛ bewura
ka kishi durmu be keji.
13Kashenteŋji nɛ bewura bee sha,
amoso nɛ beshenteŋjipo be asheŋ
bee bɔlɔ bumo kenishi na.
14Ewura be agbo du fanɛ
luwu be kabɔ nna,
enyiashempo e naŋ tiŋ
n shin nɛ k wushi.
15Ewura be kagbenefuli
bee bar ŋkpa nna
nɛ mbe kasha malɛ du fanɛ
dɔchubɔrɛso be bɔrɛ.
16Kanyiasheŋ nɛ kenyi
bɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti.
17Basa lela bee gelge
alubi be ekpa nna.
Esa nɛ e da ekpa nɛ e bee bɔla so so
beeŋ kuŋ mbe ŋkpa.
18Kamoowu e naa yɛr
esa kemur to
nɛ ŋkpensheŋ malɛ
bee bar esa kaseto.
19Fo ki etirpo ŋkpal fo ka
bar fo kumu ase so
bɔ fo ka tu kamoowuwuraana
m barga asɔ nɛ b suge to.
20Asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ nna
a sa esa kama nɛ e bee
kaŋ kusoe a nu keŋini,
nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ
bee nɛfa esa kama nɛ
e ta mbe yirda n deŋi mo so.
21Enyiashempo e naa pin
asheŋ to manaŋ manaŋ,
nɛ kamalga lela malɛ
bee chɛ to a shin nɛ
esa be keŋini asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ.
22Kanyiasheŋ bee sa
benyiashempo ŋkpa nna,
ama kawulisheŋ bre
bee bar bewulpo kasogberge nna.
23Enyiashempo bee fɛ
nfɛra nna pɔɛŋ nsaa malga,
amoso mbe keŋini bee leŋ
basa to nna a wɔtɔ kasheŋwora to.
24Kamalga lela du fanɛ
mushoŋchu nna a wora basa ebel;
nsaa sa eyur be alenfia.
25Asheŋ ko bee kaa du fanɛ
asheŋ lela nna n sa dimɛdi,
ama amo be lalaloge
bee yɛr mo luwu to nna.
26Akoŋ e naa kaa shin nɛ
basa bee pere kenishi a shuŋ.
27Belubiworapo e naa kre alubisheŋ,
nɛ bumo be m malga
malɛ du fanɛ
ajanwulɛ a chɔɔ basa.
28Esa nɛ e bee ku asheŋ
bee bar kebagato nna
nɛ esa nɛ e bee sha ŋkuli
malɛ bee ku beteri kpakpaso to.
29Basa nɛ baa tintiŋ basa
nɛ baa wora asheŋ na
bee fule bumo braana nna
a wɔtɔ asheŋ lubi to.
30Esa nɛ e bee ŋe basa anishi
bee ku asheŋ nna,
nɛ esa nɛ e duŋ kɔnɔwuro malɛ
yil kulubi be kewora so.
31Kumu fuful la kemankura
be kuwurwuro nna,
basa nɛ baa wora
asheŋ niŋiso nawule
e naa buu kumo.
32Kanyiti be keji
bɔ kenyɛn be keji.
Enyitipo chɔ enapo
nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ nde damta so.
33Basa bee kaa bishiso nna
a fin kananɛ baaŋ wora asheŋ,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule
e naa yili kusɔ kikɛ.

Title: AŊASA 17
Content:
1Ŋ kaa bee ji nchu nɛ nfɔl nawule
nsaa kɔ kagbenewushi
bɔ ŋ kaa bee ji ebel nsaa wɔ
kagbenejija to saŋkama.
2Kenya nyiashempo
bee ji ebi wulpo so kuwura nna,
nɛ mo nɛ bibi e barga kapetɛ to.
3Edɛ nɛ baa ta a wora
shuwa nɛ gbiti a keni
a pin amo be kela;
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa wora
dimɛdi be kagbene a keni.
4Alubisheŋ bee wora
belubiworapo ebel nna
nɛ efɛ malɛ bee wora befɛpo ebel.
5Fo baa wora betirpo eyurto,
Ebɔrɛ nɛ E to bumo na
nɛ fee wora eyurto na.
Ebɔrɛ malɛ beeŋ gberge bekama
nɛ bumo braana be awurfoŋ
bee wora bumo ebel na kusoe.
6Benanabi du fanɛ
kuwurwuro nna n sa bumo nanaana;
nɛ mbia malɛ bee ji njɔŋ
ŋkpal bumo kurgepoana so so.
7Kananɛ kamalga nɛ k bee lar
anishi maaŋ tiŋ n shi
ewulpo be kɔnɔ to na;
aloŋ nɛ efɛ maŋ daga ewurjipo
be kɔnɔ to.
8Brɔbu bee shuŋ nna
fanɛ kananɛ baa shuŋ esa kushuŋ
nɛ e bee wora esa nɛ
e shuŋ mo kushuŋ na be aparsheŋ na.
K bee shin nna nɛ
asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ a sa
esa nɛ e sa kumo na.
9Esa nɛ e bee ta asheŋ a paŋ
bee nya beteri damta nna;
ama esa nɛ e maa ta asheŋ a paŋ bre
bee paŋ beteri nna.
10Enyiashempo be kegbɛlɛ gba
bee shin nɛ e bee koya
asheŋ manaŋ manaŋ
a chɔ ewulpo be kebri
alɛ damta n ŋini mo asheŋ.
11Kumu kpakpasowura kutɔ
nɛ baa shuŋi belubiworapo
nɛ b kɔ kusoe kpakpaso
a kini kenu n sa na.
12Fo ka purgi buluŋ cheso
nɛ k bee yɛla kenishi to
a fin kumo pibi
bɔ fo ka tu ewulpo
a wora kawulisheŋ.
13Fo baa ta kulubi
a ka kelela be kukɔ,
alubi maaŋ lar fo laŋ to kikɛ.
14Emɔrɔ be kefara
du fanɛ nchu be gbi
ka bee shin nɛ k futi nna.
Lar kamɔrɔji to manaŋ
pɔɛŋ nɛ k kurge asheŋ n sa fo.
15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi bumo
nɛ baa malga a kuŋ belubiworapo,
nɛ bumo nɛ baa ku asheŋ a deŋi
basa nɛ b maŋ wora kulubi na ga.
16Amansherbi be kejija
a laŋɛ ewulpo be kekoya so
maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ,
ŋkpal manɛ so ewulpo maaŋ tiŋ
ŋ koya shɛŋ.
17Beteri bee sha abar nna;
nɛ bekurgepo malɛ
bee cha abar to ashi tɔrɔ to.
18Esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ lakal
e naa sɔ mo barkasa
be kukɔ a sulɔ mbe kumu.
19Elushapo kikɛ
maa barga alubi be kewora.
Fo baa puchi ga fee fin
asheŋ nna a sa fo kumu.
20Esa kama nɛ e maa ji kashenteŋ
maaŋ yɔ anishito kikɛ.
Efɛ bee bar esa tɔrɔ nna.
