21Ebesa nɛ kagbenejija e
naa mɔ ewulpo mo tuto.
22Kebaa du wasawasa
bee teŋi esa be ŋkpa so nna;
ama saŋkama be kenishitogbir
bee ku esa be ŋkpa so
manaŋ manaŋ nna.
23Edemujipo lubiana nɛ baa ŋana a sɔ brɔbu na
maa tiŋ a ji demu nɛ kumo be ekpa so.
24Enyiashempo kikɛ bee pin kusɔ nɛ k daga kewora nna;
ama ewulpo bre maa tiŋ a yili mbe nfɛra kukoŋwule.
25Mbia wulpo bee wɔtɔ bumo tutoana ebesa to nna,
nsaa shin nɛ bumo nioana malɛ bee wora n daa nyi.
26Esa nɛ e maŋ wora n jija maŋ daga kasogberge;
nɛ esa nɛ e bee wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi ekpa maŋ daga tɔrɔ.
27Enyiashempo maa malga ga.
E bee wora asheŋ boeŋ boeŋ nna.
28Hale ewulpo gba baa maa tuge asheŋ to chilchil
baa ta mo nna a yili enyiashempo be eyilikpa.

Title: AŊASA 18
Content:
1Kebaafɛ fo nawule be kumu so be asheŋ,
nɛ kekini kesɔ esa pɔtɛ be nfɛra
la kejimuni nɛ kawulisheŋ nna.
2Ewulpo e naa kini asheŋ be kepin to,
nsaa kaŋɛ fanɛ mo nawule be nfɛra e walɛ.
3Kulubi nɛ anishinyɔr e wɔ aya.
Alubiworapo kikɛ nɛ nyɔmɔ nna.
4Enyiashempo be mmalga du fanɛ ketirbu chiŋgeliŋ to be nchu
nɛ a bee bul a teŋi a shile eleŋso fanɛ kabombi nna.
5Alubiworapo maŋ daga kesɔ n yige ashi kasogberge to,
esa nɛ e maŋ wora n jija malɛ maŋ daga kemɔn kashenteŋ.
6Ewulpo be kudonduloŋ bee wɔtɔ mo asheŋ to nna,
nɛ mbe kɔnɔ malɛ bee bar mo kebri.
7Ewulpo be mmalga e naa ki fanɛ efɔl a kre mo,
nɛ mbe atuwebi malɛ bee gberge mo a wɔtɔ asheŋ to.
8Ŋkuli wɔ ebel ga; nɛ basa bee sha kumo.
9Etɔlpo nɛ esa nɛ e bee jija asɔ kikɛ la kukoŋwule nna.
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ du fanɛ
ketempreŋ kuŋso nna nɛ basa
nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso bee shile a yɔ mo kutɔ n ya kaa nya kekuŋ.
11Damawuraana bee fɛ nna fanɛ
bumo be amansherbi e naa kuŋ bumo
fanɛ kananɛ baa pɔr egbal a kulti kade a kuŋ kumo na.
12Kamoowu bee yɛr esa kemur to nna;
ama kamoobarase bre bee sa esa kemaŋkura nna.
13Esa kama nɛ e maa kaŋ kusoe
a nu asheŋ nɛnɛ pɔɛŋ nsaa tuge amo to
la ewulpo nna nɛ anishinyɔr bee tiŋ a ji mo.
14Kagbenefuli bee chɛ to nna a sa esa alenfia ashi kulɔ to;
fo baŋ paŋ kumo, kumo ere fo tama loge.
15Enyiashempo kikɛ bela ase nna nɛ e koya asheŋ saŋkama.
16Kakɛ bee bugi ekpa nna a sa esa,
nɛ e bee tiŋ a yɔ basagboŋ kutɔ.
17Esa baŋ juŋkpar m malga ashi demujikpa,
fee fɛ nna fanɛ mo e kɔ kashenteŋ ama mo barkasa gba baŋ malga nna.
18Basa anyɔ baa gberge demu to nɛ k maa nya edesekpa,
kesulgeso e naŋ ku demu na to.
19Keyɔ eteri nɛ fo wora n da so kutɔ n ya fin kechɛto
du kpakpa a chɔ kebure n luri kade nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti to.
20Kɔnɔlelawura maa wora n daa nyi nna kikɛ.
21Atugebi beeŋ tiŋ m mɔ esa,
ŋko n sa mo ŋkpa;
Esa kama malɛ beeŋ nya mbe m malga be kakɔka.
22Fo baŋ nya eche fo nya kakɛ lela.
Eche lela la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nna.
23Etirpo bee kule nna pɔɛŋ nsaa nya kechɛto;
ama damawura bre bee malga kanaŋkama nna.
24Beteri damta beeŋ tiŋ n jija esa be kebaawɔtɔ;
ama eteri ko chɔ eniopibi.

Title: AŊASA 19
Content:
1Fo ka bee ji kashenteŋ nsaa la etirpo
bɔ fo ka la ewulpo nɛ efɛpo.
2Kebaa sha kusɔ be kewora nsaa maa kɔ kumo be kenyi maŋ walɛ;
kewora gerger n to kusɔ n da malɛ maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ.
3Kawuli e naa yɛr basa ko tɔrɔ to
nɛ baa pɔlɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ.
4Damawura bee nya beteri saŋkama nna;
ama etirpo bre mo teriana bee shile nna a ka mo.
5Efɛ be shɛdajipo ashi demujikpa maaŋ ta mbe kumu n ji
nɛ e maŋ nya kasogberge.
6Ekama beeŋ ba sha keji esagboŋ,
ŋko esa nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n chɛ mo to keteri.
7Etirpo maŋ kɔ eniopibi, a bishi eteri.
Kanaŋ kamaso nɛ e pere kenishi a sha bumo baa shile nna a ka mo.
8Esa kama nɛ e bee fin kanyiasheŋ
bee sha mbe kumu nna na.
Esa kama nɛ e pere kenishi ŋ koya, asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa mo.
9Efɛ be shɛdajipo ashi demujikpa maaŋ paŋ mbe kasogberge kikɛ.
Efɛpo malɛ kikɛ beeŋ mur.
10Ewulpo maŋ daga kedamaya;
Kenya malɛ maŋ daga keji ewurbi so kuwura.
11Kanyiti be keji la kanyiasheŋ nna.
Esa baŋ wora fo kulubi nɛ fo kplaŋ mo so,
k la kemaŋkura nna n sa fo.
12Ewura be agbo du fanɛ buluŋ ka bee ponte to nna
nɛ mbe kuwɔrwu malɛ du fanɛ bunyaŋ ka tɔr afitiri so.
13Kebia wulpo bee wɔtɔ mo tuto asheŋ to nna;
Eche nɛ asheŋ maa bɔlɔ kenishi
malɛ du nna fanɛ bɔrɛfurbi
nɛ k maa teŋ manaŋ.
14Esa beeŋ tiŋ n ji nwu nɛ amansherbi be kapetɛ;
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule e naa sa eche lela.
15Nɛ fo kɔ ntɔl nsaa dese a di,
akoŋ e naa mɔ fo.
16Bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra so nseŋ ji efute n chɛr.
Fo kplaŋ amo so feeŋ wu manaŋ.
17Kekɛ etirpo kusɔ
du fanɛ fo ka ta kumo m paŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nna;
Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ka fo kumo be kukɔ.
18Ŋini fo mbia kusɔ nɛ k daga pɔɛŋ nɛ b daŋ;
Fo baa maa gberge bumo kusoe a ŋini bumo asheŋ
fee mɔ bumo ŋgblaŋto nna na.
19Shin nɛ esa kama nɛ mbe agbo wɔ mo,
e ka mbe agbo na be kukɔ mo gbagba.
Nɛ fo baŋ ka kumo be kukɔ kelekoŋwule,
feeŋ baa ka mbe agbo be kukɔ saŋkikɛ.
20Esa nɛ e bee nu kasotoji nɛ keŋini,
bee ki enyiashempo nna.
21Dimɛdi beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kre ŋkre;
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ e naŋ wora.
22Kusɔ nɛ dimɛdi bee fin e la kashenteŋji;
K baa la etirpo bɔ k baa la efɛpo.
23Fo baa wora Ebɔrɛ kasonu feeŋ ji efute tenteŋ;
Esa nɛ e bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ be kagbene bee dese mo nna;
e maa lɔ kufu.
24Ajibi be keku n ji gba du betɔlpo ko so kpakpa nna.
25Gberge kumukpakpasowura kusoe, nɛ esa nɛ e maŋ nyi e koya kebaawɔtɔ;
Ama kefiɛ enyiashempo bre so bee sa mo lakal nna.
26Kebia nɛ e bee yuri mo tuto,
nsaa ju mo nio ashi laŋ to bee ŋaba mbe kumu nna na.
27Fo baŋ yige kebaa koya,
feeŋ teŋ kusɔ nɛ fo nyi gba so.
28Efɛ be shɛdajipo bee kuŋ kashenteŋji ekpa nna;
Asheŋ lubi bee wora alubiworapo ebel nna.
29Kasogberge wɔtɔ nna
ŋkpal basa kpeŋso so.
Ewulpo kikɛ bee nya kebri nna.

Title: AŊASA 20
Content:
1Nsa bee ta esa nna a ki elushapo,
a shin nɛ e bee nite a puchi.
Esa kama nɛ nsa wɔ mo la ewulpo nna.
2Ewura be kanya agbo du fanɛ buluŋ ka nya agbo nna.
Keshin nɛ ewura e nya agbo du fanɛ kapotɔ nna.
3Kebaa maa sha kolu bee sa esa kemaŋkura nna.
Ewulpo e naa sha kamɔrɔji.
4Edɔpo tɔlpo nɛ e maa dɔ saŋɛ nɛ k daga maa nya adɔjibi.
5Dimɛdi be nfɛra fɛso du chiŋgeliŋ nna
fanɛ ketirbu chiŋgeliŋ to be nchu na.
Enyiashempo nawule e naa tiŋ a saŋ amo.
6Basa damta bee tre bumo amu beshenteŋjipo nna,
ama kashenteŋ be beshenteŋjipo maa tiŋ a nya.
7Esa nɛ e niŋi kikɛ be kebaawɔtɔ niŋi nna.
Mbia nɛ baa koya mbe asheŋ woraso bee nya nɛfa nna.
8Ewura baa tase a ji demu mbe anishi yuu alubiworapoana so nna.
9Wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ m puchi ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ mbe nfɛra walɛ nɛ e maŋ wora kulubi?
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi kapuni be kasɔkarga
nɛ kapuni be asɔ karga asɔ ga.
11Mbia be aworbi e naa ŋini basa nɛ baaŋ ba ki echefoso.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e sa anyi asoe nɛ anyee ta a nu asheŋ,
nɛ anishi nɛ anyee ta a wu.
13Fo baa sha edi ga fee ki etirpo nna,
ama fo pere kenishi a shuŋ bre, fo maŋ paŋ fo kusɔ jiso.
14B baŋ ku yawujipo kikɛ asɔ be yawu e beeŋ fubel,
ama kumo be kaman nɛ e naa puchi
ŋkpal e ka nya asɔ na n tɔ pɔtɔ pɔtɔ so.
15Kanyiasheŋ be kamalga bɔ shuwa nɛ yawu kpakpaso be abitasɔ.
16Esa baŋ ta mbe kusɔbuuso
n nase tarma n ji kukɔ n sa efɔ,
nɛ efɔ na baŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ ka kukɔ na,
fo sɔ amodoŋwura be kusɔbuuso na n tal to.
17Ajibi be kepuni n ji wɔ ebel nna,
ama amo be lalaloge du fanɛ shishɛr nna kɔnɔ to.
18Fo baa bela ase nɛ fo kɔ kena,
kumo ere fin kasotoji lela nɛ k chɛ fo to.
19Esheŋjipo kikɛ maŋ tiŋ ŋ keta ashiri,
amoso baa gelge mo.
20Esa nɛ e bee sho mo tuto nɛ mo nio kɔnɔ be ŋkpa maa teŋiso,
k du nna fanɛ fitila ka duŋ tentembiri to epul to nna.
21Fo baa maŋ gben pɔɛŋ nseŋ dii dama,
fo asɔ na maa chɛr nsaa mur.
22Sa maa kɔ a fin kewora n tal esa nɛ e wora fo kulubi to.
Shin nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e bishi kuwule n sa fo.
23Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi basa nɛ baa ta kapuni be asɔ karga asɔ a ber asɔ ga.
24Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e nyi kananɛ dimɛdi be asheŋ bee nite.
Nuso nɛ esa gbagba beeŋ tiŋ m pin
kananɛ asheŋ beeŋ ba kaa du n sa mo.
25Fɛ nfɛra nɛnɛ pɔɛŋ nseŋ nase kɔnɔ n sa Ebɔrɛ.
Nɛ fo baŋ maŋ tiŋ n wora m bɔlɔ fo kɔnɔ naseso so, k maŋ walɛ.
26Ewura nyiashempo kikɛ bee gberge belubiworapo kusoe kenishipereso nna.
27Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be fitila bee wu dimɛdi be nfɛra,
nɛ mbe kebaawɔtɔ to kikɛ nna.
28Kashenteŋji nɛ kasha e naa shin nɛ bewura bee ji a chɛr.
29Mbifɔlbi be kemaŋkura e la bumo be eleŋ,
nɛ benimu malɛ be kemaŋkura la bumo be emin fuful.
30Kenishipereso be kebri beeŋ tiŋ n lara esa ashi asheŋ lubi to.

Title: AŊASA 21
Content:
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa ŋini Ewura be kagbene ekpa,
fanɛ nchu be kubɔr na.
2Dimɛdi be aworbi beeŋ tiŋ m par mo,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e nyi esa be kagbene to.
3Kewora kusɔ nɛ k niŋi nɛ kashenteŋji bee par Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ a chɔ sarga be kelara.
4Ŋkpensheŋ nɛ kamoowu la alubi be asɔrso nna,
nɛ belubiworapo bee sha amo ga.
5Kewushi eyur ŋ kre asheŋ pɔɛŋ nseŋ wora amo bee bar tɔnɔ nna,
ama brembreŋ be kasheŋwora bee bar ketir nna.
6Kebirkɔshi be kanya maa chɛr nsaa mur,
amo alɛ maa chɛr nsaa yɛr esa luwu to.
7Belubiworapo be kenyaŋɛto a fin basa be kemɔ
e naa yɛr bumo kemur to
ŋkpal b kaa maa sha kewora
kusɔ nɛ k niŋi so.
8Basa nɛ bumo be nfɛra bee ji a biri bumo kikɛ be asheŋ woraso maa niŋi,
ama basa nɛ b maa wora a foe bre be asheŋ kikɛ niŋi nna.
9Kechoŋi be awɔlto be kedese,
bɔ fo nɛ eche elushapo kaa wɔ ebu to.
10Asheŋ lubi bee wora belubiworapo ebel nna,
bumo alɛ maa wu bumo braana kuwɔr.
11Alubiworapo be kasogberge bee ŋini ewulpo asheŋ nna.
Enyiashempo kikɛ bee nya kenyi nna ashi kusɔ nɛ b ŋini mo to.
12Ebɔrɛ nɛ e niŋi na,
nyi kusɔ nɛ k bee wora belubiworapoana pe.
Mo alɛ e naŋ bar bumo kaseto.
13Fo baŋ kini kenu etirpo be kushu,
fo alɛ gba beeŋ shu nɛ basa maaŋ tuge fo.
14Ashiri to be kakɛ beeŋ tiŋ n lɔŋɛ fo nɛ esa nɛ e nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo be kefɛato.
15Asheŋ be keji nɛ amo be ekpa so bee sa belelaworapo kagbenefuli nna,
nsaa shin nɛ belubiworapo malɛ bee nyɔŋkɔŋ to.
16Esa nɛ e maa pin asheŋ to maa chɛr nsaa luri luwu to.
17Kɔnɔbel be kebaa sha ga
nɛ kamooji nɛ kasanuu
bee ta esa nna a ki etirpo.
18Belelaworapo be etɔrɔ bee kilgi nna
a ba belubiworapo so.
19Kiyi to chil be kechena bɔ ketu eche elushapo n chena.
20Enyiashempo bee ji nna a ka a yili echefoso,
ama ewulpo bre bee ji kusɔ nɛ e nya kikɛ nna a loge kachɛ koŋwule.
21Esa kama nɛ e bee wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi
nsaa sha basa
bee yɔ anishito nna,
nsaa nya kemaŋkura nɛ kebaawɔtɔ lela.
22Enyiashempo koŋwule beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ kade nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti so,
n jija asɔ nɛ a bee kuŋ basa nɛ b wɔ kumo to kikɛ.
23Esa kama nɛ e bee tiŋ a keta mbe kɔnɔ nɛ kudonduloŋ,
bee mɔlga mbe kumu ashi asheŋ lubi nɛ tɔrɔ to nna.
24Esa kama nɛ kamoowu nɛ ŋkpensheŋ bɔlɔ mo to,
bee wora basa eyur to nna.
25Etɔlpo nɛ e maa sha kushuŋ,
be asɔ shaso bee yɛr mo luwu to nna,
26ŋkpal manɛ so saŋkikɛ e bee fin kenya kusɔ ko nna.
Ama esa nɛ e bee wora asheŋ niŋiso bre
bee kaa kɔ asɔ nna a kɛ saŋkama.
27Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kishi belubiworapo be sarga ga.
Fɔŋfɔŋ saŋɛ nɛ b nya kumo ekpa lubi so na.
28Efɛ be shɛda maaŋ tiŋ n yili kikɛ,
kashenteŋ be shɛda nawule e naŋ yili.
29Kenyɛn nɛ belubiworapo kɔ a wora asheŋ,
ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso bre
bee fɛ nfɛra nna pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ.
30Dimɛdi be kanyiasheŋ kikɛ nɛ asheŋ be kepinto nɛ ŋkre kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so.
31Kanaŋkama so nɛ fo bela ase;
hale nɛ fo kena to be egbaŋɛ nɛ benapo wora shiriya gba,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ pɔɔ so.

Title: AŊASA 22
Content:
1Ketre lela bɔ kedamaya.
Ketre lela chɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e to etirpo nɛ damawura kikɛ.
3Enyiashempo baaŋ wu kenishipere ka bee ba e bee gelge kumo nna,
ama esa nɛ e maa pin asheŋ to manaŋ manaŋ bre bee suse kumo to nna;
kumo be kaman nɛ e wora n daa nyi nna.
4Kamoobarase nɛ kabɔrɛŋana e naa sa esa kanya
nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ ŋkpa tenteŋ.
5Ewi nɛ ajigbelɛ e wɔ belubiworapo be ekpa to,
ama esa nɛ e bee kuŋ mbe kumu bre
bee gelge amo nna.
6Ŋini kebia ekpa nɛ k daga fanɛ e bɔla so,
saŋɛ na so, e kaŋ daŋ
e maaŋ kpele ashi kumo so.
7Damawuraana e naa ji betirpo so kuwura,
nɛ basa nɛ baa paŋ asɔ bee ki
bumo nɛ b paŋ bumo kutɔ na be anya.
8Bekama nɛ baa duu alubi beeŋ nya amo be tɔnɔ.
Bumo be agbo lubi e naŋ yɛr bumo kemur to.
9Esa kama nɛ e bee bugi kagbene a kɛ beeŋ nya nɛfa,
ŋkpal mo nɛ betirpo ka bee barga mbe kusɔ jiso to so.
10Ju esa nɛ e bee wora basa eyurto n lar,
nɛ kolu, nɛ katege, nɛ asheŋ wurbi e loge.
11Fo baa sha asheŋ niŋiso nsaa kɔ kamalga belbelso,
kumo ere feeŋ tiŋ n ji ewura kenekpa.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be anishi yuu beshenteŋjipo kikɛ so nna,
ama e maa sa befɛpo bre be malga kashuli.
13Etɔlpo e naa kaŋɛ fanɛ buluŋ wɔ kowushina,
amoso e maaŋ lar kowu nɛ buluŋ na e pɛ mo.
14Eche nɛ e bee lar mo kul kaman be mmalga du fanɛ kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nna,
nɛ bumo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be agbo wɔ so na
bee tɔr kumo to.
15Kasogberge be kuchuchɔ
e naa ju kawulisheŋ nɛ k bɔlɔ kebia to.
16Basa nɛ baa puni betirpo a dii dama na,
nɛ bumo nɛ baa kɛ damawuraana asɔ na,
beeŋ ki betirpo.
Benyiashempo be keŋini
17Kaŋ kusoe n nu benyiashempo be mmalga ere,
nsaa ta bumo be keŋini a wɔtɔ kagbene to.
18Nɛ fee nyiŋi amo nsaa kute amo to,
fo kagbene beeŋ fuli fo.
19Mee ŋini fo kesheŋ ere kabre nna,
saŋɛ na so feeŋ ta fo yirda n wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to.
20M maŋ sibɛ mmalgamu adesa n sa fo,
nɛ a baa ŋini fo asheŋ nsaa sa fo lakal, 21a shin nɛ fo baa tiŋ a pin asheŋ to,
m ba kaa kute kusɔ nɛ b shuŋi fo fanɛ fo ya wora na be kashenteŋ a?
Sososo
22Sa maŋ puni esa ŋkpal e ka la etirpo so,
ŋko m mutir esa ashi demujikpa
ŋkpal e ka maŋ kɔ shɛŋ so.
23Ŋkpal manɛ so Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ chɛ bumo to,
nseŋ tɔrɔ bekama nɛ b tɔrɔ bumo na n tal to.
Kenyɔsopo
24Saa maa ji basa nɛ baa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ kenekpa,
25nɛ mannɛ aloŋ fo alɛ gba beeŋ ki kananɛ b du na
nsaa maŋ naŋ tiŋ n chɛrga.
Kesasopo
26Sa maa sɔ beko be akɔ a deŋi fo kumu,
27nɛ fo baŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ ka amo,
baaŋ sɔ fo asɔ kikɛ n ta fo gedo gba n ti so n tal to.
Kenasopo
28Sa maa lɔŋɛ fo nɛ basa be egbaŋ to
be kedulgijembu dra nɛ fo nananyɛnana yuu na a yuu.
Kenusopo
29Nɛ fo baa shuŋ fo kushuŋ nɛnɛ,
bewura nɛ feeŋ baa shuŋ a sa mannɛ bebɔlpo.

Title: AŊASA 23
Content:
Keshesopo
1Ewura baŋ tre fo fanɛ fo ba tu mo n ji,
fo koli fo kumu nɛnɛ.
2Nɛ fee ji ga fo ku fo epun so,
3nsaa maa fin fanɛ fo ji
kusɔ nɛ k wɔ ndoŋ kikɛ.
Mannɛ ajibi na kikɛ e deŋ fo.
Keshunusopo
4Sa maa mɔ fo kumu a fin kedii dama.
Ba nyi fo eleŋ be ekar.
5Ŋkpal manɛ so fo amansherbi beeŋ tiŋ n loge epul to,
fanɛ kananɛ kusore beeŋ yili epul to n firgi n choŋ na.
Keburwasopo
6Sa maa tu Miiriworaana a ji,
ŋko a yɛlga mbe ajibi lela.
7E beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo ji kananɛ fee sha,
ama kumo be loŋ maŋ shi mbe kagbene to.
8Feeŋ kwiɛ ajibi nɛ fo ji na kikɛ,
nɛ kechɔrɔ nɛ fo chɔrɔ mo na e ki jiga.
Kekpanusopo
9Sa maŋ jija saŋɛ a ŋini ewulpo asheŋ.
E maaŋ ta fo kanyiasheŋ be mmalga na n shuŋ.
Kudusopo
10Sa maa lɔŋɛ egbaŋ to be kedulgijembu dra a yili,
ŋko a dɔ a luri amunibi be kasawule to.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba e naa kɔ a mɔlga bumo.
Mo alɛ beeŋ yili bumo be katelamu
n ji bumo be demu n sa bumo.
Kudukakosopo
12Baa kaŋ kusoe a nu keŋini
nsaa wora ania a koya asheŋ.
Kuduanyɔsopo
13Sa maŋ yige kegberge fo kebia kusoe ŋ ŋini mo asheŋ.
Fo gberge mo kusoe e maaŋ wu.
14Kuya kebia so ŋ ŋini mo asheŋ,
nɛ kumo be loŋ e mɔlga mo
ashi luwu to kachako so.
Kuduasasopo
15Ma kebia, nɛ fo baa nyi asheŋ
k bee fuli ma kagbene nna.
16M ba nu fo ka bee ji kashenteŋ malɛ,
ma kumu bee tin nna.
Kuduanasopo
17Sa maŋ shin nɛ belubiworapo be asheŋ
e baa keta fo kayɛlga,
ama shin nɛ kabɔrɛŋana be kebaawɔtɔ e pere fo kenishi.
18Nɛ fo wora loŋ bre,
asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa fo echefoso.
Kuduanusopo
19M pibi, nu nfe,
ta kanyiasheŋ a bɛ ekpa niŋiso so.
20Sa maa tu basa nɛ baa wu nsa a choŋ a gben,
ŋko n wu ajibi a choŋ a gben a wora asheŋ.
21Ketir beeŋ pɛ besanuupo nɛ bejibishapo,
baaŋ baa dese a di nna,
nsaa buu asɔ farbi.
Kuduashesopo
22Baa nu fo tuto be mmalga,
mo e kurge fo.
Sa maŋ kplaŋ fo nio so ashi mbe mbel to.
23Jija amansherbi ŋ koya kashenteŋji
nɛ kanyiasheŋ nɛ kamootiŋ.
Sa maŋ yige amo n lɛ kikɛ.
24Esa nɛ e bee wora asheŋ niŋiso kikɛ,
mo tuto be kagbene bee fuli mo nna.
Kebia nyiashempo be asheŋ bee par mo kurgepo nna.
25Shin nɛ fo tuto nɛ fo nio be ŋgbene
e baa fuli bumo.
Shin nɛ eche nɛ e kurge fo be kumu e saŋɛ mo.
Kuduashunusopo
26M pibi baa kaŋ kusoe a nu ma mmalga,
nsaa wora ma asheŋ woraso.
27Sakaleche du fanɛ kejamaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nna,
nɛ eche nɛ e bee lar mo kul be kaman
malɛ du fanɛ ketirbu chiŋgeliŋ na.
28Baa jo fo nna fanɛ eyu na,
nɛ b da fo n lɛ alubiworapoana to.
Kuduaburwasopo
29Wanɛ e naa luri asheŋ to saŋkama?
Wanɛ e naa kɔ kolu saŋkama?
Wanɛ e naa tɔr a margaso?
Wanɛ be anishi e pere kpaw ŋkpal kasanuu so?
30Basa nɛ baa nuu nsa
n ya kaa fo kiidiso na.
31Sa maŋ keni kananɛ nsa pere nsaa walɛ,
ŋko a kpa edɛ glashi to,
ŋko a wushi ebɔl to so.
32Amo be lalaloge du fanɛ kuwɔ ka duŋ fo,
n ta kumo be kɔrtɔ lubi n wɔtɔ fo to nna.
33Nsa beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ fo anishi e baa kurge,
nɛ fo nfɛra e baa wul fo to.
34A bee wora fo fanɛ fo ka wɔ nchu so be kuloŋ to
ashi teku so nna, nɛ afu bee ber fo a yɔ a ba na.
35Feeŋ pira nɛ fo maŋ pin
kananɛ fo wora m pira.
Feeŋ baa dese a fin kananɛ feeŋ koso ŋ gben,
ama nsaa fin kananɛ kare beeŋ cha
nɛ fo naŋ nya nsa n nu.

Title: AŊASA 24
Content:
Kuduakpanusopo
1Sa maa besa belubiworapo eyur,
ŋko a yɛlga kebaa tu bumo a wora asheŋ.
2Asheŋ lubi nawule be asheŋ nɛ baa fɛ saŋkama.
Bumo be mmalga kikɛ la kananɛ baaŋ wora kulubi nna.
Adunyɔsopo
3Kanyiasheŋ e naa pɔr kowu,
nɛ kenu n sa abar malɛ bee shin nɛ k bee yili.
4Kenyi malɛ e naa shin nɛ asɔ lela
nɛ yawu kpakpaso be asɔ bee bɔlɔ laŋ.
Adunyɔ nɛ kako
5Enyiashempo e la elempo.
Kenyi bee shin nɛ esa be eleŋ nɛ yuku bee ti so nna.
6Ŋkpal manɛ so kasotoji lela
nɛ kebela ase nɛnɛ e naa shin nɛ baa kɔ kena a pɔɔ so.
Adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ
7Ewulpo maaŋ tiŋ m pin kanyiasheŋ be mmalga to.
B baa malga kenishipere be mmalga ewulpo maŋ kɔ shɛŋ a kaŋɛ.
Adunyɔ nɛ asa
8Esa nɛ e bee kre alubisheŋ
nɛ baa tre alubiworapo.
9Ewulpo be nfɛra fɛso kikɛ maŋ walɛ.
Basa kishi ewulpo nɛ e bee wora basa eyur to ga.
Adunyɔ nɛ ana
10Kesɔ kapɔshi be tɔrɔ be jemanɛ
bee shin nɛ esa be eleŋ bee kuso nna.
Adunyɔ nɛ anu
11Sɔ bumo nɛ b gberge a yɔ nɛ b ya mɔ
kenyanyaŋɛso na n yige.
12Nɛ fo kaŋɛ fanɛ k maŋ la fo asheŋ,
Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nyi nfɛra nɛ aworbi na bre nyi
kusɔ so so nɛ fee wora kusɔ kama.
Mo alɛ e naŋ ka fo kusɔ kama nɛ fo wora be kukɔ.
Adunyɔ nɛ ashe
13M pibi, baa ji mushoŋ ŋkpal manɛ so mushoŋ walɛ.
Kananɛ mushoŋ wɔ ebel kudonduloŋ so na,
14loŋ nɛ kanyiasheŋ gba walɛ n sa fo kiyoyu.
Fo baŋ nya kumo fo alɛ nya echefoso be tama
nɛ k maaŋ loge kikɛ.
Adunyɔ nɛ ashunu
15Sa maa kɔ kumu kpakpaso
fanɛ belubiworapo nɛ baa yuri basa lela be asɔ,
ŋko a suge bumo be nwu na.
16Basa niŋiso bee tɔr alɛ damta nsaa koso
ama tɔrɔ baŋ ba alubiworapo bre so
nɛ e tɔr kela koŋwule gba
e maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n niŋi to kikɛ.
Adunyɔ nɛ aburwa
17Sa maŋ shin nɛ fo doŋ be tɔrɔ e baa fuli fo kagbene.
Fo doŋ baŋ fiti n tɔr, sa maa mushe.
18Mannɛ a loŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wu kumo be loŋ,
nseŋ kilgi mbe tɔrɔ na m ba fo so.
Adunyɔ nɛ akpanu
19Sa maŋ shin nɛ belubiworapo be asheŋ e baa tir fo
ŋko a besa fo.
20Ŋkpal manɛ so alubiworapo maŋ kɔ echefoso be tama.
Mo alɛ beeŋ choŋ fanɛ kananɛ fitila beeŋ duŋ na.
Adesa
21M pibi, baa ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nsaa ŋana bewura gba,
sa maa tu amukpakpaso wuraana a wora asheŋ.
22Wanɛ e nyi tɔrɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ŋko ewura beeŋ sa bumo?
Aŋasa ko gba nde
23Kanyiasheŋ be mmalga ko gba nde:
A maŋ daga demujipo ka bee kpɛa to.
24Fo baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ esa nɛ e wora n jija e kɔ kashenteŋ,
basa beeŋ sho fo kɔnɔ,
nɛ efuli pɔtɛ so ebi gba e kishi fo.
25Ama demujipo nɛ e bee gberge belubiworapo kusoe bre
beeŋ nya nɛfa nna nɛ asheŋ e baa nite nɛnɛ a sa mo.
26Kashenteŋ be atuwebi e la kashenteŋ be keteri be tɔɔnɛ.
27Nase kudɔ n du fo adɔjibi
pɔɛŋ nsaa pɔr kowu.
28Sa maŋ kaŋ ji efɛ be shɛda ŋ gbiti fo barkasa
ŋko ŋ ku efɛ ŋ deŋi mo.
29Sa maŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Meeŋ wora mo n tal to.”
30Ŋ ka bɔla ewulpo tɔlpo be ndɔ
nɛ mbe ndibi sɔrso be dɔkar,
31nɛ afitiri nɛ ewi sɔ kudɔ na kikɛ,
nɛ ajembu be egbal nɛ e pɔr ŋ kulti kumo na kikɛ tɔr.
32Nɛ n yili ŋ keni kudɔ na,
nseŋ fɛ kumo be asheŋ ŋ koya kusɔ ko
ashi kusɔ nɛ n wu na to.
33Edi gbrɛbi, ewushi gbrɛbi
nɛ enɔ be kefar n chena gbrɛbi,
34nɛ ketir ba fo so fanɛ eyu na,
nɛ asheŋ kikɛ e ki fo so kpakpa.

Title: AŊASA 25
Content:
Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be aŋasa ko nde
1Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be aŋasa nɛ Ewura Hɛzekaya be ekrachi sibɛ na nde.
2Ebɔrɛ bee nya bunyaŋ nna
ŋkpal e ka kɔ ashiri so,
nɛ bewura malɛ bee nya kemaŋkura
ŋkpal bumo be kebaa bugi asheŋ to so.
3Wanɛ e naa tiŋ a pin ewura be nfɛra?
Ewura be nfɛra du chiŋgeliŋ nna
fanɛ kasawule be nchiŋ
ŋko awɔlpa be kufɔ na.
4Baa lara gbiti be eyurpi nna pɔɛŋ
nsaa ta kumo a lɔŋɛ asɔ lela.
5Lara besoetojipo lubi ashi ewura kutɔ
nɛ e ji kuwura ekpa niŋiso so.
6Sa maa maŋ fo kumu so
ashi ewura be anishito,
ŋko a ta fo kumu a yili basagboŋ be eyilikpa.
7Ewura gbagba ka ta fo n yili esagboŋ be eyilikpa
bɔ fo gbagba ka ta fo kumu n yili ndoŋ nɛ e ŋaba fo.
8Sa maa kuse a ta asheŋ a yɔ demujikpa.
Mannɛ aloŋ b baŋ ji m bri fo
anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ fo.
9Nɛ fo nɛ fo barkasa bee ji emɔrɔ,
fo sa maa lara mbe ashiri.
10Mannɛ aloŋ basa beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo maŋ kɔ ashiri
nsaa maŋ naa yirda fo.
11Kemalga kamalga nɛ k daga saŋɛ nɛ k daga
du nna fanɛ b ka ta shuwa m mata gbiti so na.
12Kenu enyiashempo be kasotoji
du fanɛ shuwa be akonde, ŋko abitasɔ nna.
13Kabɔ nɛ e bee ji kashenteŋ
du fanɛ kebleŋ to be nchu wushiso nna.
14Esa nɛ e bee nase kɔnɔ
nsaa maa tia kumo
du fanɛ kuwɔlpa nɛ k maa bar bɔrɛ nna.
15Kenyiti nɛ kɔnɔ lela
e naŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ ewura e chɛrga mbe nfɛra
nseŋ shuli n sɔ kusɔ nɛ fee kaŋɛ mo na.
16Sa maŋ kpal mushoŋ ka wɔ ebel so
n ji amo m baŋ fo kumu so,
mannɛ aloŋ feeŋ kwiɛ amo.
17Sa maa tir fo kurgepo to ga,
mannɛ aloŋ fo asheŋ beeŋ fi mo
nɛ e kishi fo.
18Keji efɛ be shɛda ŋ gbiti esa
du nna fanɛ fo ka da mo kasaŋɛ
ŋko ketanyembi ŋko ŋ ŋe mo kedibi nna.
19Keta yirda n deŋi efɛpo so ashi awurfoŋ be saŋɛ
du fanɛ fo ka na keya koŋwule so
ŋko fo kenyi ka bee besa fo nna.
20Keboŋ kashɛ n sa esa nɛ mbe kagbene jija
du nna fanɛ fo ka sɔ esa be wajɛ awo to
ŋko fo ka ta nfɔl be nchu n wurge kuchuu popɔr so na.
21Nɛ akoŋ kɔ fo doŋ fo sa mo ajibi nɛ e ji,
nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo
fo sa mo nchu nɛ e nuu.
22Nɛ fo wora loŋ,
kumo ere kedɛmurmur nɛ fo muu n deŋi mbe kumu so na.
Ebɔrɛ malɛ beeŋ nɛfa fo.
23Kananɛ kebɔrɛfito be afu bee bar bɔrɛ na,
aloŋ nɛ ŋkuli bee bar agbo.
24Kedese kuchoŋi be awɔlto bɔ
ketu eche elushapo a wɔ ebu to.
25Baru lela nɛ k shi kufɔ
bee wushi kagbene nna,
fanɛ kananɛ nchu wushiso bee wushi eyur na.
26Esa nɛ e bee wora asheŋ niŋiso baŋ yige mbe kumu to n sa esa lubi,
e bee ki fanɛ nchu nɛ a fɔnɔto ŋko eboŋ nɛ b bɔ kumo kesa nna.
27Kananɛ mushoŋ maŋ daga keji m baŋ so na,
aloŋ nɛ k maŋ daga esa ka bee fin fanɛ basa e baa fur mo saŋkama.
28Esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ kanyiti
du nna fanɛ kade nɛ kumo egbal bure
nɛ basa beeŋ tiŋ n luri kumo to ŋ kɔ kumo na.

Title: AŊASA 26
Content:
1Ketarso be bɔrɛ kɔ tɔnɔ
a chɔ kesa ewulpo bunyaŋ.
2Kɔnɔsho nɛ k maŋ bɛ ekpa so
maaŋ tiŋ m pɛ esa.
K du nna fanɛ mbuibi ka firgi a choŋ na.
3Kananɛ baa ta kebarga nɛ chembi
a keta gbaŋɛ nɛ kurma a shuŋ na,
aloŋ nɛ ewulpo daga kuchuchɔ.
4Fo baa tuge ewulpo to,
baaŋ tre fo alɛ gba ewulpo.
5Shin nɛ ewulpo e pin mbe kawulisheŋ,
nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e beeŋ baa fɛ fanɛ
e nyi asheŋ nna.
6Keta kubɔya ŋ shuŋi ewulpo
du nna fanɛ
fo ka ku fo gbagba be aya so
ŋko fo ka ji kɔrtɔ nna.
7Ewulpo be keŋasa,
du nna fanɛ bobi be aya na.
8Ewulpo be kesa bunyaŋ
du nna fanɛ fo ka kre kejembu n wɔtɔ katebabu to nɛ fo to na.
9Ewulpo be keŋasa
du nna fanɛ ewi
ashi nsanuupo be enɔ to.
10Ewulpo nɛ e na chamcham a choŋ
be kebir paa
du nna fanɛ ekpampo ka bee to
asɔbɔya a lɛ jijiga na.
11Kananɛ jɔnɔ bee gbu
nsaa bɛta a ji amo na,
aloŋ nɛ bewulpo bee lɔŋɛ a tal bumo be kawulisheŋ to.
12Ewulpo bɔ esa nɛ
e bee tre mbe kumu enyiashempo,
mo alɛ nseŋ wuli.
13Etɔlpo e naa kaŋɛ fanɛ
buluŋ wɔ ekpa to so
e maaŋ yɔ ndɔ to.
14Kananɛ kukuloŋ yil epul to
a yɔ a ba na,
aloŋ nɛ etɔlpo bee dese gedo so
a kilgi a laŋɛ a dese.
15Lɔma be keku m min gba
du betɔlpo ko so gba kpakpa nna.
16Etɔlpo kikɛ bee fɛ nna fanɛ
e nyi asheŋ a chɔ basa damta.
17Keta fo kɔnɔ n wɔtɔ
kolu nɛ k maŋ la feya to,
du nna fanɛ fo ka bee gberge jɔnɔ
nɛ e maŋ nyi fo be kusoe na.
18-19Kefule esa nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ
fee pel mo nna,
du nna fanɛ ebompo ka bee to
atanyembi kpalakpala na.
20Ndibi baa maŋ wɔ edɛ to
edɛ na bee duŋ nna,
aloŋ nɛ ŋkuli baa maŋ wɔtɔ kolu bee ku.
21Kananɛ ndibi nɛ ajanwulɛ
bee shin nɛ edɛ bee nyɛrga na,
aloŋ nɛ elushapo bee keta kolu to a chɛr.
22Ŋkuli wɔ ebel ga
nɛ basa bee sha kumo.
23Kamalga belbelso
nɛ nfɛra lubi wɔ kumo be kaman
du nna fanɛ b ka ta shuwa
n fɛfa ebɔ be kusɔ so nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ na.
24Esa lubi be kamalga belbelso so,
b maa pin fanɛ e kɔ nfɛra lubi.
25Kanaŋ kamaso nɛ
esa lubi be kamalga wɔ ebel,
sa maŋ kaŋ yirda mo.
26Kanaŋ kama nɛ e wora,
mbe nfɛra lubi na beeŋ lar efuli
nɛ ekama e pin kumo.
27Fo baa kur fo barkasa be kemaŋ,
fo gbagba e naŋ kilgi n tɔr kumo to.
Fo baa gbelti kejembu nɛ fo bɛa fo barkasa,
k beeŋ kilgi m bɛa fo gbagba.
28Esa nɛ fo kishi nɛ fee ku efɛ a deŋi.
Kefur esa kɔnɔ to
nɛ k maŋ shi kagbene to
du fanɛ fo ka mɔ mo ŋgblaŋ to nna.

Title: AŊASA 27
Content:
1Sa maa puchi echefoso,
ŋkpal manɛ so fo maŋ nyi
kananɛ asheŋ beeŋ ba du echefo.
2Shin nɛ basa pɔtɛ e baa kpaŋ fo,
fo gbagba e sa maa kpaŋ fo kumu.
3Ewulpo be kewɔtɔ esa agbo to
wɔgbɛ a chɔ e ka sulɔ ajembu nɛ leele.
4Esa nɛ e bee nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ
lubi a chɔ,
esa nɛ e bee kɔ kukɔrkɔ lubi.
5Keji esa kashenteŋ kpakpaso
bɔ kebaa sha mo ŋgblaŋto.
6Eteri lela be kefiɛso bɔ edoŋ ka lela fo so.
7Fo baŋ ji m moɛ,
mushoŋ gba maŋ naa wora fo keji,
ama nɛ akoŋ kɔ fo feeŋ ji ajibi kama.
8Esa baŋ lar laŋ to,
e du nna fanɛ kabuibi ka lar kesha to na.
9Tulale nɛ efɛa belbelso be duwu
bee sa kagbenefuli nna,
ama a maŋ fo eteri lela be kasotoji so.
10Sa maŋ kplaŋ fo teri
ŋko fo tuto mo teri so.
Fo alɛ e sa maŋ yɔ fo niopibi nɛ
e wɔ kufɔ kutɔ n ya kaa fin kechɛto
tɔrɔ be saŋɛ.
Eteri nɛ e taga fo to
beeŋ tiŋ n chɛ fo to a chɔ
fo niopibi nɛ e wɔ kufɔ.
11M pibi ba kɔ kanyiasheŋ,
nɛ kumo be loŋ e sa ma kagbenefuli
nɛ n nya kɔnɔ n tuge
esa kama nɛ e bee malga a gbiti ma to.
12Enyiashempo bee gelge asheŋ nna,
ama esa nɛ e maa pin asheŋ to
manaŋ manaŋ bre bee suse amo to nna.
13Esa baŋ ta mbe kusɔbuuso
n nase tarma n ji kukɔ n sa efɔ,
nɛ efɔ na baŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ ka kukɔ na
fo sɔ amodoŋwura be kusɔbuuso na
n tal to.
14Awɔr be kecha n chɔrɔ esa chipurdidi
beeŋ tiŋ a la tɔrɔ n sa
esa nɛ fee chɔrɔ na ekpa ko so.
15Eche elushapo du fanɛ
bɔrɛfurbi nɛ k maa teŋ manaŋ nna.
16Keshin nɛ e yige kolu
du fanɛ kekuŋ afu ekpa nna,
ŋko keta enɔ n jɔ ŋkuchu.
17Kananɛ baa ta kebɛlso a yee kebɛlso na,
aloŋ nɛ beteri bee chɛrga abar be nfɛra.
18Fo baŋ keni kedibisɔrso so nɛnɛ
feeŋ ji kumo be asɔrso.
Fo baŋ keta fo nyɛnpe nɛnɛ
feeŋ baa nya kechɔrɔ saŋkama.
19Kananɛ fee keni nchu kleŋklembi to
a wu fo kumu na,
aloŋ nɛ fo kagbene bee ŋini
esa nɛ e la fo kashenteŋto.
20Kananɛ luwu nɛ nchaŋ maa moɛ na,
aloŋ nɛ dimɛdi maa nya asɔ a moɛ.
21Kananɛ baa ta edɛ a keni a pin
shuwa nɛ gbiti be kela na,
aloŋ nɛ esa be kefur gba
beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ fo pin mbe da.
22Kebri maaŋ tiŋ n ju kawuli ashi esa to.
23Baa keni fo mbolpɔ nɛ mboe so nɛnɛ,
24ŋkpal manɛ so kanya
nɛ kemaŋkura maaŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
25Fo baa kuya afitiri a sa fo asɔbɔya
nɛ a bee laŋɛ a purge nɛnɛ,
26feeŋ nya mbɔlpo nɛ mboe
n fa n tɔ asɔbuuso nɛ kasawule.
27Fo alɛ nɛ fo mbia
nɛ fo nyɛrbi beeŋ naŋ nya kenyipochu damta n nuu.

Title: AŊASA 28
Content:
1Basa lubi bee shile nna nsaa gbɛ a keni
fanɛ esa ko ka bee ju bumo na,
ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso bre
bee nite kenyɛnso nna
fanɛ buluŋ na.
2Efuli be basa baa kɔ kumu kpakpaso,
baa chɛrga bejuŋkparpo manaŋ manaŋ nna.
Ama ejuŋkparpo nyiashempo bre
bee ji kuwura nna a chɛr.
3Ejuŋkparpo nɛ e bee mɛaŋ betirpo,
du nna fanɛ bɔrɛgboŋ
nɛ k bee jija adɔjibi na.
4Basa nɛ baa wora a da mbra so
e naa ji a chɛ belubiworapo to.
Basa nɛ baa bɛ mbra so bre
maa sha belubiworapo be asheŋ.
5Belubiworapo maŋ nyi
kananɛ baa wora asheŋ
nɛ amo be ekpa so,
mannɛ aloŋ nɛ bumo
nɛ baa ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bre du.
6Kebaa la etirpo nsaa ji kashenteŋ bɔ
kebaa la damawura fɛpo.
7Enyiashempo e naa bɛ mbra so.
Esa nɛ e bee ta basa nɛ b maa fɛ nfɛra
pɔɛŋ nsaa wora asheŋ keteri,
bee wɔtɔ mo tuto anishinyɔr to nna.
8Esa kama nɛ e bee wɔtɔ basa nɛ
b paŋ mo amansherbi nchu ga,
be kapetɛ beeŋ yɔ esa nɛ
e bee wu betirpo kuwɔr kutɔ.
9Ebɔrɛ maa nu esa nɛ e maa bɛ
mbra so be kabɔrɛkule.
10Esa kama nɛ e bee ŋin basa nɛ
baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi a wɔtɔ alubi to,
beeŋ tɔr kejigbelɛ nɛ mo gbagba sho to,
ama esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ alubi
beeŋ ji kapetɛ lela.
11Damawuraana bee fɛ nna fanɛ
b nyi asheŋ,
ama etirpo nɛ e bee pin asheŋ to
beeŋ tiŋ m pin fanɛ
mannɛ damawuraana kikɛ e nyi asheŋ.
12Esa lela baŋ ji kuwura
basa bee ji eyur nna,
ama esa lubi bre baŋ ji kuwura
basa bee shile nna a ŋana.
13Esa kama nɛ e bee ta mbe alubi a ŋana
maaŋ yɔ anishito kikɛ,
ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wu esa nɛ e bee bugi to
a kaŋɛ mbe alubi
nsaa tuba a lar amo to bre kuwɔr.
14Esa kama nɛ e bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ
bee nya nɛfa nna,
ama esa kama nɛ e kɔ kagbene kpakpaso
bre bee luri asheŋ to nna.
15Ewura lubi nɛ e bee tɔrɔ betirpo
du nna fanɛ buluŋ nɛ e bee ponte to na,
ŋko shishiri nɛ akoŋ kɔ.
16Ewura nɛ e bee mɛaŋ mbe basa
maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so,
ama emo nɛ e maa sha kapuni bre
beeŋ ji efute tenteŋ.
17Esa kama nɛ e mɔ esa,
be nfɛra beeŋ baa ji a bri mo
hale nɛ e ya wu.
Mo alɛ maaŋ nya kechɛto kikɛ.
18Kashenteŋji bee kuŋ esa nna,
ama esa nɛ e maŋ niŋi bre bee tɔr manaŋ manaŋ nna.
19Edɔpo nɛ e pre kenishi a shuŋ
beeŋ nya ajibi yɛlyɛla so,
ama basa nɛ baa jija bumo be saŋɛ bre
nɛ ketir e naa ba la saŋkama.
20Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nɛfa bekama
nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ,
ama E beeŋ gberge bekama
nɛ baa sha fanɛ b bɔla ekpa lubi so
n dii dama manaŋ na kusoe.
21Ŋkpɛato maŋ walɛ,
ama brɔbu fimbi beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ
basa ko e wora kusɔ nɛ k maŋ daga.
22Esa kama nɛ e bɔlɔ miri so n dii dama
beeŋ ki etirpo.
23Ji esa kashenteŋ nɛ
e chɔrɔ fo echefoso a chɔ
kemalga efɛ be mmalga nɛ a beeŋ wora mo ebel.
24Esa kama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ,
keyuri mo tuto ŋko mo nio maŋ la kulubi
maŋ kɔr eyu pɔtɛ to.
25Bejimunipo bee baga asheŋ to nna,
ama asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa esa kama nɛ
e ta mbe yirda n deŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ so.
26Esa kama nɛ e ta mbe yirda n deŋi
mo gbagba be kumu so la ewulpo nna,
ama ekama nɛ e bee sɔ benyiashempo
be mmalga, beeŋ nya kekuŋ.
27Esa kama nɛ e bee bugi enɔ a kɛ betirpo
maaŋ fin shɛŋ ŋ gben,
ama basa damta beeŋ sho ekama
nɛ e bee kplaŋ betirpo so kɔnɔ.
28Esa lubi baŋ ji kuwura
basa bee shile nna a ŋana,
ama b baaŋ gboŋi mo kuwura bre
basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi
bee nya bumo be amu nna.

Title: AŊASA 29
Content:
1Fo baŋ wora kumu kpakpaso ŋ kini kenu kasokpele damta,
k maaŋ chɛr nɛ fo mur.
2Asheŋ baa nyala a sa basa niŋiso
basa kikɛ be ŋgbene bee fuli nna,
ama basa lubi baa ji kuwura basa bee shuto nna.
3Esa nɛ e bee sha kanyiasheŋ
bee bar mo tuto kagbenefuli nna,
ama esa nɛ e ju a buu e sakaleche so bre
be kanya bee mur nna.
4Ewura nɛ e bee ji kashenteŋ
be efuli kɔ eleŋ nna,
ama emo nɛ e kɔ kejimuni
nsaa sɔ brɔbu bre be efuli bee bure nna.
5Esa nɛ e bee malga mmalga belbelso
nɛ a maŋ la kashenteŋ a sa mo braana
bee sho mbe kumu kejigbelɛ nna na.
6Belubiworapo be alubi
e naa kilgi a pɛ bumo,
ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi bre
bee boŋ kagbenefuli be nshɛ nna.
7Betirpo be kenya kashenteŋ be asheŋ tir ga
n sa basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso nna,
ama belubiworapo bre be shɛŋ
maŋ wɔ loŋ to.
8Basa nɛ baa wora basa eyurto
bee bar kebagato kade to nna,
ama benyiashempo bre bee shin nɛ agbo bee wushi nna.
9Enyiashempo baŋ yɛr ewulpo ewurkpa,
ewulpo na beeŋ ya kaa mushe chilchil n jija demu na.
10Emɔpo maa sha basa nɛ baa wora
asheŋ nɛ a niŋi be asheŋ.
Saŋkama e bee fin bumo nɛ e mɔ nna.
11Ewulpo e naa nya agbo
a puŋi kɔnɔ basa to,
enyiashempo bre nya agbo gba
fo maaŋ pin.
12Ewura nɛ e bee nu efɛ
be beyaasepo bee ki basa lubi nna.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naa sa etirpo
nɛ esa nɛ e bee mɛaŋ mbe basa kikɛ anishi nɛ baa wu.
14Ewura nɛ e bee ji betirpo be demu
nɛ kumo be ekpa so
beeŋ ji kuwura n chɛr.
15Keŋini be kasogberge
bee sa kebia kanyiasheŋ nna,
ama kebia nɛ b yige nɛ e bee wora mbe kepar
bee wɔtɔ mo nio anishinyɔr to nna.
16Belubiworapo baa ji kuwura,
alubi bee wora keshi nna,
ama basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ niŋiso
e naŋ wu bumo be ekar.
17Fo baa gberge fo mbia kusoe
a ŋini bumo asheŋ
baaŋ sa fo kasotowushi nɛ kagbenefuli.
18Efuli be basa baa maa bɛ
Ebɔrɛ be keŋini so,
mbra be kebɛso
nɛ kebaa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi maa wɔtɔ.
Ebɔrɛ bee nɛfa basa kama
nɛ baa bɛ mbe mbra so nna.
19Kamalga nawule maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini
kayɛrbi ekpa.
Hale e pin asheŋ to gba e maaŋ wora
kusɔ nɛ k daga.
20Ewulpo be asheŋ kɔ tama
a chɔ esa nɛ e bee kuse a malga.
21Fo baŋ yili kayɛrbi be kebia to n di mo kefɛ,
e beeŋ bar fo kebɔltofinfin kacha ko.
22Esa nɛ e bee nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ
bee bar kebagato nna,
nsaa wora a foe ekpa manaŋ manaŋ.
23Kamoowu bee bar esa kaseto nna,
ama kamoobarase bee sa esa kemaŋkura nna.
24Esa nɛ e bee tu eyu a yuri
la mo gbagba be kumu so be edoŋ nna.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ b bɔ ntaŋ n lɛ mo so gba
e maaŋ tiŋ n ji kashenteŋ.
25Sa maŋ shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ basa bee fɛ
a laŋɛ fo kaplɛa so e baa tir fo.
Yirda Ebɔrɛ nɛ e baa kuŋ fo.
26Esa kama bee sha fanɛ e ji ewura keteri nna,
ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nawule
e naa shin nɛ
ewura bee wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi.
27Basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi
kishi belubiworapo ga.
Nɛ belubiworapo malɛ gba kishi basa
nɛ ba wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi.

Title: AŊASA 30
Content:
Agɔr be aŋasa
1Jake pibi Agɔr be kubɔya nde.
Esa ko bee ponte a kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ le:
“Ma eleŋ loge, ma eleŋ loge.
2N duli kusɔbɔya a chɔ dimɛdi;
M maŋ naa kɔ dimɛdi be nfɛra
3M maŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ,
ma alɛ maŋ nyi shɛŋ a laŋɛ
Ebɔrɛ be kaplɛa so.
4Wanɛ e dii n yɔ Ebɔrɛ so m bɛta m ba?
Wanɛ e tiŋ m pɛ afu n wɔtɔ enɔ to?
Ŋko ŋ gbargbar nchu
n wɔtɔ mbe kusɔbuuso to?
Wanɛ e ta kasawule n yili kumo be eyilikpa?
Loŋ be esa be ketre
ŋko mo pibi be ketre e la nuso?
Nɛ fo nyi, fo kaŋɛ ma.
5Ebɔrɛ be kamalga kikɛ la kashenteŋ nna.
E la kusɔ kuŋso nna n sa bekama
nɛ baa shile a ba mo kutɔ
m baa ka fin kekuŋ na.
6Sa maŋ ta shɛŋ n ti mbe m mmalga so,
mannɛ aloŋ, e beeŋ fiɛ fo so n ta fo ŋ ki efɛpo.”
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, asɔ anyɔ nɛ mee kule
fanɛ fo wora n sa ma
pɔɛŋ nɛ n wu.
8Sa maŋ shin nɛ ŋ ki efɛpo
Fo alɛ e sa maŋ shin nɛ m baa la
etirpo ŋko damawura.
Baa sa ma kacha kama be kusɔ jiso.
9Saŋɛ na so maaŋ ki damawura
nseŋ teŋ fo so
ŋko nɛ ketir e shin nɛ n ya yuri n jija fo ketre.
10Sa maa debɔr kayɛrbi a ŋini mo nyɛnpe,
nɛ mannɛ aloŋ
e beeŋ sho fo kɔnɔ nɛ fo ji awurfoŋ.
11Basa ko bee sho bumo tutoana kɔnɔ nna
nsaa maa keni bumo nioana a bɔlɔ kenishi.
12Beko malɛ bee fɛ fanɛ
baa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi nna
ama alubi damta e bɔlɔ bumo to.
13Basa ko bee wu bumo be amu nna
a maa keni basa a bɔlɔ kenishi.
14Basa ko be kebaawɔtɔ e la
kebaa kɔ kumu kpakpaso
a mɛaŋ betirpo nɛ bebɔlpo.
15Kejimuni la mborobicheso anyɔ nna.
Bumo kikɛ be atre e la: ‘Ta n sa ma.’
Asɔ asa e wɔtɔ a maa moɛ.
Asɔ ana malɛ e maa kaŋɛ fanɛ a kukwe loŋ.
16Amo e la, nchaŋ, nɛ eche egbentepo,
nɛ kasawule wɔlso,
nɛ edɛ nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n duŋ.
17Ejita e naŋ ji
bekama nɛ baa fɛl bumo tutoana
nsaa keni bumo nioana jiga na
be eblaŋ kupuŋ to.
18Asɔ ana e naa wul ma nfɛra to
a shin nɛ maa pin asheŋ to.
19Amo e la, kananɛ kusore bee firgi,
nɛ kananɛ kuwɔ bee gbeye ajembu so,
nɛ kananɛ teku so be ekuloŋgboŋ
bee wu a yɔ kakpa nɛ k bee yɔ,
nɛ kananɛ enyɛn nɛ eche bee sha abar.
20Eche nɛ e bee lar mo kul kaman be da
e la keji nseŋ kpra kɔnɔ so
ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e maŋ wora kulubi.
21Asɔ ana nɛ kasawule maa tiŋ a nyiti
nsaa kpal amoso a gbuŋgbuŋ to.
22Amo e la, kenya ka ki ewura,
nɛ ewulpo ka ji m moɛ,
23nɛ eche nɛ basa maa sha ka nya ekul,
nɛ kebita nɛ e suge mo chepe mo kul.
24Asɔ fimfimbi ana e wɔ kasawule so
a kɔ kanyiasheŋ ga.
25Atutulombi maŋ kɔ eleŋ
ama amo alɛ bee fin amo be ajibi a yili dɔchubɔrɛ so nna.
26Kukukaka maŋ shi
kumo alɛ bee tiŋ a futi kedibi a luri to.
27Elotɔr maŋ kɔ ewura,
amo alɛ nsaa bɛ abar so
kenimu kenimu so fanɛ esoji na.
28Ketigbolu maŋ la shɛŋ
kumo alɛ bee nya ekpa a luri ewurkpa.
29Asɔ ana e naa wora asheŋ fanɛ bewura,
nsaa tia awurya.
30Buluŋ nɛ e la asɔbɔya to be enyɛn
nsaa maa tu shɛŋ a bɛta kaman na,
31nɛ kananɛ kaboelote bee nite,
nɛ kananɛ koshinyɛn bee nite,
nɛ ewura nɛ mbe benapo kulti mo.
32Nɛ fee puchi nsaa kɔ kumu kpakpaso
nɛ kawuli a kre asheŋ lubi
fo yige amo be kewora.
33Fo bri kenyipochu to a beeŋ lar ŋku
Fo ŋmɛa fo kamuna
k beeŋ gbege n lar ŋklaŋ.
Aloŋ nɛ fo wɔtɔ basa agbo to,
kolu beeŋ ba.

Title: AŊASA 31
Content:
Ewura Lamwɛl be aŋasa
1Kanyiasheŋ be mmalga
nɛ Masa be ewura Lamwɛl mo nio ŋini mo nde.
2M pibi Lamwɛl, kabɔrɛkule so nɛ
m bɔla n nya fo;
amoso kaŋ kusoe n nu kusɔ
nɛ mee shin nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo ere.
3Sa maa ta fo eleŋ a jija a bɛ beche so.
Beche ko bee da bewura nna a lɛ.
4A maŋ daga bewura nɛ bejuŋkparpo
ka bee nuu nsa a boo
ŋko a sha nsa ga.
5Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ baaŋ boo
nseŋ teŋ efuli be mbra
nɛ edaŋkaresheŋ so
nsaa maaŋ tiŋ n ji kashenteŋ
n sɔ bumo nɛ basa bee mɛaŋ na n yige.
6Yige nsa n sa bumo nɛ
b maŋ naa kɔ tama kikɛ
nsaa yɔ kemur to na.
7Shin nɛ loŋ be basa
e baa nuu nsa a boo
a teŋ bumo be ketir nɛ awurfoŋ so.
8Baa malga a sa bumo nɛ
b maa tiŋ a malga a kuŋ
bumo be amu na
nsaa kɔ a sa bepɔshipo.
9Baa ji demu nɛ kumo be ekpa so
a sa betirpo
nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ la shɛŋ na.
10Eche nɛ e kɔ da lela
a tiŋ a wora asheŋ nɛnɛ maa tiŋ a nya.
E bɔ shuwa nɛ gbiti.
11Mo kul bee yirda mo nna
a maa fɔŋ shɛŋ shɛŋ so.
12Eche na be kebaawɔtɔ to kikɛ
asheŋ lela nawule
nɛ e bee wora mo kul.
13E maa chena jiga.
Saŋkama e bee fɛa nna a lue ewajɛ.
14E du fanɛ yawujipo nna
a fin ajibi kaplɛkama a ba epe.
15E bee wule a koso nna a wora ajibi
a sa mbe laŋ to ebi pɔɛŋ nɛ kare bee cha,
nsaa ŋini mbe mbita ashuŋ nɛ
baaŋ baa shuŋ.
16Mo gbagba e naa nite a fin
kasawule lela a tɔ
nsaa ta mbe amansherbi a nase kudɔ.
17E bee pre kenishi nna a shuŋ
nsaa ta mbe eleŋ
a wɔtɔ kusɔ kama nɛ e bee wora to.
18E bee ji yawu nna a nya tɔnɔ
nsaa shuŋ a fo kiidiso.
19Mo gbagba e naa fɛa jese a lue ewajɛ.
20E bee bugi enɔ nna a chɛ betirpo
nɛ bumo nɛ asheŋ bee pɔɔ bumo so to.
21E maa fɔŋ awo so
ŋkpal manɛ so mbe laŋ to ebi kikɛ kɔ awo to be asɔbuuso.
22Mo gbagba e naa baa mbe asɔbuuso,
nsaa buu asɔ lela fanɛ ago be ewajɛ.
23Mo kul bee nya kemaŋkura nna
nsaa tiŋ a luri kade be benimu to.
24E bee lue ewajɛ nɛ eshata nna
a fa a sa eyawujipo.
25E kɔ eleŋ nna
nsaa sa mbe kumu bunyaŋ;
e maa fɔŋ echefoso be asheŋ so.
26E kɔ kanyiasheŋ nna
nsaa fɛ nfɛra pɔɛŋ a malga.
27E bee keni mbe laŋ to ebi so nɛnɛ nna,
mo alɛ maŋ kɔ ntɔl.
28Mbe mbia bee puchi mo so nna
nɛ mo kul bee kpaŋ mo a kaŋɛ le:
29“Beche damta bee wora asɔ
ama fo peya chɔ bumo kikɛ.”
30Kebita bee loge,
nɛ kela bee chɛrga,
ama eche nɛ e bee sha Ebɔrɛ bre
daga k baa fur nna.
31Shin nɛ loŋ be eche be asheŋ
e baa bɔlɔ fo kenishi
nɛ fo baa kpaŋ mo basa to.

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 1
Content:
Kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ ka la fuloŋ be asheŋ
1Ewura Deevid pibinyɛn nɛ e la eŋinipo nseŋ daa la ewura ashi Jerusalɛm to na be mmalga nde.
2Eŋinipo na yɛ, kusɔ kama na la fuloŋ nna kebaawɔtɔ ere to. Kebaawɔtɔ maŋ kɔ kifito kikɛ. 3Manɛ be tɔnɔ bre nɛ anyee nya kegben damta nɛ anyee gben ere to? 4Kenana ko beeŋ ba choŋ nɛ kenana ko malɛ e naŋ ba, ama durnya ere bre maaŋ chɛrga kikɛ. 5Epeŋi bee pete nna nsaa tɔr nseŋ naa chambɔ a yɔ kakpa nɛ k bee pete na. 6Afu bee ber a yɔ kelargato to be kaseto be kaba so nsaa ber a yɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so, a chambɔ loŋ a kulti. 7Elɔrana bee shile e luri teku to, ama teku malɛ maa bɔlɔ kikɛ. Nchu na kraŋ naa bɛta nna a luri lɔr na be kakpa nɛ a fara na to nsaa shile a luri to a chambɔ a ba. 8Kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ baa la kabapɔ nna nɛ k maŋ walɛ k malga. Anyi be anishi ere maa wu asheŋ a moɛ nɛ asoe malɛ gba maa nu asheŋ a moɛ. 9Kusɔ kama nɛ k bee wora naniere daŋ chɛr n wora dra dra kikɛ nna. Shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ la asheŋ popɔr ashi kasawule ere so. 10Men keni! Kusɔ ko wɔtɔ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kumo alɛ naa la asheŋ popɔr a? M-m. Asheŋ ere kikɛ wora dra dra kikɛ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ b kurge anyi. 11Esa kama maŋ wɔtɔ nseŋ naa nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ k wora n choŋ dra dra na. Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso gba.
Eŋinipo na be kusɔ nɛ e luri to nsaa nyi be asheŋ
12Ma eŋinipo ere ka malga le be asheŋ ere kikɛ nɛ n daa la Israɛl be efuli so be ewura nna nsaa wɔ Jerusalɛm to. 13N wora ania fanɛ meeŋ koya nseŋ pin kusɔ kama nɛ k bee wora durnya ere to.
Ama Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ k ki kpakpa n sa anyi edimɛdi. 14Ŋ ka wu asheŋ nɛ a bee wora durnya ere to na, nɛ n yɛ; kusɔ kama maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ. K du nna fanɛ fo ka bee ju a bɛ afu so na. 15Kusɔ kɔnto maa tiŋ a niŋi; b maa karga shɛŋ a ti asɔ nɛ e maŋ wɔtɔ so.
16Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ ma kumu le: “Naniere bre ŋ ki bunyaŋ be esagboŋ nna nsaa nyi asheŋ malɛ a chɔ esa kama nɛ e juŋkpar ma n ji kuwura ashi Jerusalɛm to. Amoso n nyi kusɔ nɛ baa tre kanyiasheŋ nɛ kenyi.” 17N daŋ pere kenishi nna a shin nɛ m pin kebaawora asheŋ kanyiasheŋ so, mannɛ kawuliso. Ama n wu fanɛ afu nɛ mee ju a buu so. 18Fo baa nya kanyiasheŋ ga, kumo be jemanɛ malɛ nɛ fo kagbene bee jija fo ga. Kenyi be ga la tɔrɔ nna.

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 2
Content:
1N daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ meeŋ ji ma kumu nseŋ fin kusɔ nɛ k la kagbenefuli, ama n wu fanɛ amo kikɛ maŋ la shɛŋ. 2N lege to n wu fanɛ emushe la kawulisheŋ nna, nɛ ebel be keji malɛ maa sa shɛŋ. 3Ŋ ka daa sha kanyiasheŋ ga so, n daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ meeŋ ta nsa be kenuu n ji ma kumu. N daa fɛ fanɛ ekpa nɛ basa beeŋ bɔla so n ji ŋkpa shiimbi nɛ b kɔ kasawule ere so nna na.
4N wora asɔgboŋ damta. M pɔr nwu, nseŋ dɔ ndibisɔrso be adɔana. 5N daŋ wora kambɔl nna n duu ndibi nɛ e bee sa kayul nɛ basa e baa chena to a wushi ashi ma kelɔnɛ so nseŋ duu ndibisɔrso be yiri yiri n wɔtɔ kumo to. 6N daŋ kur atirbu nɛ baaŋ baa jɔ nchu amo to a wurge ndibi na so nna. 7N daŋ tɔ anyache nɛ benyɛn kikɛ nna nɛ bumo alɛ gba bee kurge a ti so ashi ma laŋ to. Ma e daa kɔ asɔbɔya a chɔ esa kama nɛ e juŋkpar ma ashi Jerusalɛm be kade to. 8N daŋ chala shuwa nɛ gbiti ashi nsawule pɔtɛ nɛ mee ji amo so kuwura na be bewura be ekpanjawu to nna. Bumo be benyɛn nɛ beche kikɛ daŋ boŋ nshɛ nna n deŋi ma anishi to nɛ n nya beche nɛ mee sha ndoŋ.
9Jerusalɛm ka jɔŋɛ kikɛ m ba fo ma jemanɛ so, esa kama daa maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ mbe eyilikpa fo meya so, ma alɛ daa kɔ kanyiasheŋ malɛ gba. 10Shɛŋ shɛŋ be kenya daa maŋ du ma so kpakpa. Kusɔ kama malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ k beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ ma ekpa nɛ m maaŋ wora kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ fuli ma kagbene. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ n daŋ wora na, daŋ bɔlɔ ma kenishi nna. Ma alɛ bee wu amo kikɛ fanɛ asɔ nɛ e la tɔnɔ n sa ma nna. 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ n fɛ kusɔ nɛ n wora na be nfɛra nɛ kananɛ m pere kenishi n shuŋ ga be asheŋ, ama kumo be loŋ malɛ daŋ maŋ daga. Amo kikɛ daa du fanɛ k baa ju a bɛ afu so nna nɛ kumo alɛ be loŋ malɛ la fuloŋ. 12Kusɔ kama nɛ ewura kama nɛ e juŋkpar ma wora, ma alɛ gba tiŋ n wora kumo.
Amoso n daŋ fara nna a fɛ kusɔ nɛ k la kanyiasheŋ nɛ kebalto nɛ kawulisheŋ. 13Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ m pin fanɛ “Kanyiasheŋ walɛ a chɔ kawulisheŋ fanɛ kananɛ kefulto walɛ a chɔ tentembiri na. 14Enyiashempo bre nyi kakpa nɛ e bee yɔ, ama ewulpo bre maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e bee yɔ.” Kumo be lalaloge, enyiashempo nɛ ewulpo kikɛ sasa nna. 15Kede be kaman nɛ n fɛ fanɛ ketre jija nɛ bewulpo bee nya na, beeŋ ba ma alɛ gba so. Amoso ma kebaa la enyiashempo bre be kifito e la manɛ? Nɛ n yɛ “K maŋ la shɛŋ.” 16Esa kama maa nyiŋi benyiashempo nɛ bewulpo be asheŋ. K maaŋ chɛr nɛ b teŋ an kikɛ so. Bewulpo nɛ benyiashempo kikɛ beeŋ wu kachako. 17Ŋkpal loŋ so kebaawɔtɔ nɛ n wɔtɔ ere daa maŋ naa la shɛŋ ŋ kutɔ ŋkpal manɛ so k maŋ bar ma tɔnɔ kikɛ ama asheŋ nawule. Kebaadu fanɛ kebaa ju a buu afu so nna.
18Asɔ kama nɛ n daŋ pere kenishi n fin durnya ere to na kikɛ daa maŋ la shɛŋ ŋ kutɔ ŋkpal ŋ ka beeŋ yige amo n sa esa nɛ e beeŋ ba ma kaman na so. 19Feeŋ tiŋ m pin fanɛ enyiashempo ŋko ewulpo e naaŋ baa la loŋ be esa a? Ama loŋ be esa e naaŋ ba ji kusɔ kama nɛ fo gben n nya na be tɔnɔ. Kusɔ kama nɛ n ta ma kanyiasheŋ n fin n nya durnya ere to kikɛ baa la fuloŋ nna. 20Amoso ma kushuŋ damta nɛ n daŋ shuŋ na kikɛ daŋ ki kagbene jija nna n sa ma. 21Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo ka beeŋ ta fo nfɛra nɛ kanyiasheŋ nɛ fo enɔ to be ku shuŋ be kenyi kikɛ n shuŋ n sa esa nɛ e maŋ gben bee ŋini asheŋ fuloŋ nna nɛ kumo alɛ be loŋ maŋ walɛ. 22Mannɛ bre be tɔnɔ nɛ an baa nya kegben damta nɛ anyee gben ere to? 23Fo ka baa wɔ ŋkpa to ere bre kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora baa la fuloŋ nna. Kusɔ nɛ fee nya kumo to e baa la kagbene jija nɛ ebesa; hale kanyɛso gba fo maaŋ nya n di.
24Kusɔ nɛ ekama baa wora e la kebaa ta mbe kanya a ji a nuu nsaa ji mbe kumu. Ama ade kikɛ be nfɛra nɛ n fɛ nseŋ wu fanɛ amo kikɛ bee shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna. 25Nuso bre nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ a wɔtɔ a ji mbe kepar nsaa ji mbe kumu a ti so? 26Ebɔrɛ bee ta kanyiasheŋ nɛ kenyi nɛ kagbenefuli nna a sa bekama nɛ baa wora mbe aparsheŋ. Ama belubiworapo bre, e bee shin nna nɛ baa shuŋ a nya asɔ a yili, nɛ bekama nɛ baa wora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ na e ba ji amo be kapetɛ. Ade kikɛ la asheŋ fuloŋ nna. A du nna fanɛ kebaa ju a bɛ afu so.

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 3
Content:
Kusɔ kama kɔ kumo be saŋɛ nna
1Kusɔ kama nɛ k bee wora durnya to kikɛ kɔ kumo be saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili nna.
2Mo e yili kakurge nɛ luwu be saŋɛ.
Mo koŋwule na e yili kasɔdu nɛ kasɔteŋi be saŋɛ.
3Mo e yili luwu nɛ eyur be alenfia be saŋɛ,
nseŋ yili keda n lɛ nɛ kepɔr be saŋɛ.
4Mo e yili kagbenejija nɛ kagbenefuli be saŋɛ,
nseŋ yili kushu keli nɛ keji eyur be saŋɛ.
5Mo koŋwule na e yili ajembu be kechala ŋ deŋi abar so be saŋɛ nɛ amo be kegbeŋi to be saŋɛ,
mo e yili kebir abar to n chɔrɔ abar kasha so
be saŋɛ nɛ kebarga abar be saŋɛ.
6Mo e naa yili saŋɛ nɛ k daga dimɛdi ka fin nɛ saŋɛ nɛ k daga dimɛdi ka yige kafin,
Mo e naa yili saŋɛ nɛ k daga keta asɔ n yili
nɛ saŋɛ nɛ k daga keta asɔ n lɛ,
7mo e naa yili saŋɛ nɛ k daga kekpɛa to nɛ saŋɛ nɛ k daga kebaa m mata abar so,
mo e naa yili saŋɛ nɛ k daga kekaŋ kusoe n nu,
nɛ saŋɛ nɛ k daga kemalga.
8Mo e naa yili kasha nɛ kekishi be saŋɛ,
nsaa yili kena nɛ kayurwushi malɛ gba be saŋɛ.
9Manɛ be tɔnɔ bre nɛ anyee nya kegben damta nɛ anyee gben ere to? 10N nyi esulɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n deŋi dimɛdi so. 11Mo e yili jemanɛ nɛ k daga n sa kusɔ kikɛ. Mo e sa anyi nfɛra nɛ anyee pin kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso. Amo nɛ amo kikɛ an kra maa pin mbe nfɛra chiŋgeliŋ na to a loge. 12Kusɔ nɛ m pɛshɛ m pin fanɛ k walɛ n sa dimɛdi e la fanɛ esa ka kɔ kagbenefuli nsaa wora kelela. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so ajibi nɛ anyee nya a ji nɛ nchu nɛ anyee nuu nɛ tɔnɔ kama nɛ anyee nya ashi anyi be ashuŋ to ere kikɛ la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nna.
14M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Fo maaŋ tiŋ n ta shɛŋ n ti kumo so, fo alɛ maaŋ naaŋ tiŋ n lara shɛŋ ashi kumo to. Ebɔrɛ wora loŋ nna saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ baa bunyaŋ mo. 15Kusɔ kama nɛ k teŋ n wora kabre nɛ kumo nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso kikɛ teŋ wora nna ŋ ku so. Ebɔrɛ shin nna nɛ loŋ be asheŋ koŋwule na kra wora hale kabre.
Kebaa maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so be asheŋ
16Ŋ ka naŋ pɛshɛ asheŋ, nɛ n naŋ wu fanɛ, keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so maŋ naa shuŋ. Alubi nawule e naa ji eleŋ. 17Amoso kusɔ nɛ n fɛ ma kagbene to e la fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ji basa niŋiso nɛ basa lubi kikɛ demu ŋkpal manɛ so kusɔ kama kɔ kumo be saŋɛ nna. 18Asheŋ ere kikɛ be lalaloge nɛ n wu fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee wora anyi nna a keni nɛ e ŋini anyi fanɛ anyi maŋ bɔ asɔbɔya. 19Ŋkpal manɛ so asɔbɔya nɛ edimɛdi kikɛ la asɔ futeso nna. Bumo kikɛ la asɔ nɛ baa fute nna nseŋ naa la asɔ nɛ baa wu. Amoso dimɛdi maŋ bɔ kusɔbɔya ŋkpal manɛ so ŋkpa nɛ an kɔ ere maŋ kɔ kifito. 20Asɔ futeso kikɛ bee yɔ kakpa koŋwule nna. Shishɛr to nɛ an shi, shishɛr malɛ to nɛ anyeeŋ naaŋ bɛta n yɔ. 21Wanɛ e nyi fanɛ anyi be ayoyu bee yɔ esoso nna nɛ asɔbɔya malɛ peya bee shir kasawule to? 22Amoso kusɔ nɛ n naaŋ pɛshɛ m pin e la fanɛ a daga an ka bee ji anyi be kegben be tɔnɔ ŋkpal manɛ so anyi maaŋ tiŋ m pin echefoso be asheŋ.”

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 4
Content:
1Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ n naŋ keni n wu fanɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so maŋ naa wɔ durnya to. Basa nɛ b wɔ kamɛaŋ to na bee shu anishichubi nɛ esa kama maa chɛ bumo to, ŋkpal basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ bumo na ka kɔ eleŋ a chɔ bumo so. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ n fɛ basa nɛ b teŋ wu n choŋ na be asheŋ, nseŋ wu fanɛ b bɔ anyi bumo nɛ an kra wɔ ŋkpa to ere. 3Basa nɛ b maŋ naŋ kurge bumo na gba bɔ anyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be kenishi maŋ naŋ wu kananɛ kebaa maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so durnya ere to du.
4Kumo be kaman nɛ n naaŋ pɛshɛ m pin kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ basa bee pere kenishi a shuŋ ga nɛ b dii dama. Amo kikɛ to nɛ n wu fanɛ an ka bee besa abar eyur so nɛ k du loŋ. Ama amo kikɛ la fuloŋ nna. K du fanɛ fo ka ju a bɛ afu so nna. 5Ewulpo nawule e naa far mbe mbre a chena a maa sha kushuŋ nɛ akoŋ bee mɔ mo. 6Ama fo ka nya gbrɛ n ji kayurwushiso bɔ fo ka nya ga nsaa maa ji a moɛ. K du nna fanɛ fo ka bee ju a pɛ afu na.
7Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ n naŋ wu asheŋ ko nɛ a maŋ kɔ kifito ashi kasawule ere so. 8Kanyɛn ko e daa wɔtɔ; a maŋ kɔ ebi, mo alɛ daa maŋ kɔ ekurgepo kikɛ. E daŋ baa wɔ kushuŋ to nna saŋkama, ama mo alɛ be kenishi daa maa bɔlɔ kusɔ nɛ e bee nya so. Nɛ e yɛ: “Wanɛ bre so nɛ mee gben le saŋkama, nsaa maaŋ tiŋ n ta ma kegben n ji ma kumu gba ere?” Le be kesheŋ ere gba maŋ kɔ kifito, kumo alɛ nseŋ naa la kagbenejija ga be asheŋ! 9Fo baa kɔ eteri, bɔ fo nawule ka wɔtɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so basa anyɔ e naŋ tiŋ n shuŋ nɛnɛ. 10Ekoŋwule baŋ tɔr, eko beeŋ niŋi mo to, ama fo nawule bre baa la nseŋ tɔr, k maaŋ ba walɛ kikɛ ŋkpal manɛ so esa maaŋ niŋi fo to. 11Awo to, basa nyɔ beeŋ tiŋ n dese m mata abar nsaa bel edɛ a pɛ abar, ama nuso nɛ esa koŋwule beeŋ tiŋ n wora loŋ? 12Kolu nɛ esa koŋwule beeŋ kɔ n tɔr na, basa nyɔ bre beeŋ kɔ kumo m pɔɔ so. K beeŋ ba du kpakpa ga nɛ fo tiŋ n tuge kemamprɔŋ nɛ b ta efɔl asa m mɛa abar n wora to.
13-14Esa beeŋ tiŋ a la etirpo nseŋ ba ki mbe efuli so be ewura ŋko e beeŋ tiŋ n shi kabuti to gba m ba chena kuwura so, ama nɛ e ki enimu nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ ba ki ewura, mo alɛ nsaa maŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ ŋko a sɔ kasotoji, kumo ere kabrantiɛfɔlbi nɛ e la etirpo nsaa kɔ kanyiasheŋ bɔ mo. 15Ŋ ka fɛ basa nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to kikɛ be asheŋ, nɛ m pin fanɛ kabrantiɛfɔlbi beeŋ shi bumo to m ba ji kuwura jemanɛ nɛ ewura na maŋ naa wɔtɔ. 16Ashere basa nɛ ewura bee juŋkpar na shibi ga n baŋ so ama kachɛ nɛ e kaŋ wu, ekama maaŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ e lar ŋ kpaŋ mo. Ade kikɛ la asheŋ fuloŋ nna. A du nna fanɛ esa ka ju a bɛ afu so na.

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 5
Content:
Sa maa wule a nase kɔnɔ Ebɔrɛ be anishito
1Baa da asheŋ nɛ fee wora ashi Ebɔrɛ be lambu to so. Fee yɔ ndoŋ nna nɛ fo ya nu kusɔ nɛ beŋinipo bee ŋini, mannɛ keya lara kawuliso be sarga fanɛ bewulpo nɛ b maŋ nyi alubi nɛ alela be mbarga na. 2Baa fɛ nfɛra pɔɛŋ nsaa malga, sa maa nya manaŋ a nase nnɔ Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Ebɔrɛ wɔ ebɔrɛso nna nɛ fo alɛ wɔ kasawule ere so, amoso sa maa malga ga. 3Kananɛ kafɔŋ damta beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ esa e dese ŋ ku edare lubi na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ esa nɛ e bee malga ga beeŋ tiŋ m malga kawulisheŋ be mmalga. 4Amoso nɛ fo baŋ nase kɔnɔ Ebɔrɛ be anishito, a daga fanɛ fo tia kumo manaŋ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be shɛŋ maa ji bewulpo to. Amoso baa wora a bɔlɔ fo nnɔ naseso so. 5Fo ka maŋ nase kɔnɔ kraa bɔ fo ka nase kɔnɔ e maŋ tiŋ n tia kumo. 6Sa maŋ shin nɛ fo kɔnɔ to be mmalga e shin nɛ fo wora kulubi, saŋɛ na so fo maaŋ yɔ Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapo kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo fanɛ fo daa pɛl nna. Manɛ nna nɛ fee wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ agbo to? Manɛ nna nɛ fo shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ jija kusɔ nɛ fo gben n nya na ŋkpal fo kamalga so? 7Edare damta be kebaakuu nɛ mmalga damta be kebaa malga maŋ kɔ kifito. Amoso baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa sa mo bunyaŋ.
8Fo baŋ wu abane be ekrachi ka bee tɔrɔ mbe efuli so be betirpo nsaa ji bumo durmu, sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa chinchiŋ fo, ŋkpal manɛ so ekrachi wurbi na bee wora a bɛ bumo be benimu be nnɔ so nna.
9Ŋkpal ewura ka la enimu ekama so so, mo e naa nya kasawule na so be elampo nɛ baa sɔ na kikɛ be galeŋga.
10Esa kama nɛ e bee sha amansherbi nɛ kedamaya ga, maa nya amansherbi a moɛ kikɛ. Asheŋ fuloŋ e la amo kikɛ. 11Saŋɛ so nɛ fo dii dama na, loŋ be jemanɛ na so nɛ basa damta malɛ bee fin kechɛto fo kutɔ. Asheŋ nɛ damawura bee chena a fɛ saŋkama e la mbe kedamaya be asheŋ. 12Etirpo bre ji nɛ e maŋ ji gba, e bee dese kanyɛso a di nɛnɛ nna. Ama amansherbi wura bre, maa di a mata, ŋkpal mbe kedamaya so.
13Kusɔ lubi ko malɛ nɛ n naŋ wu k ka bee wora durnya ere to. Basa pere kenishi nna a fin amansherbi a deŋi abar so, nɛ kumo be loŋ bee bar bumo asheŋ. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so amansherbi na kikɛ beeŋ loge ŋkpal b ka maŋ ta amo n shuŋ kushuŋ lela so. Bumo be mbia malɛ maaŋ nya kapetɛ kikɛ. 15An ka ba durnya ere to anyi maŋ bar shɛŋ, anyi alɛ naa lar kumo to anyi maaŋ ta shɛŋ n yɔ. 16K daŋ maŋ daga fanɛ loŋ e wora kuraa! Kananɛ an ba loŋ nɛ anyeeŋ naŋ yɔ. Anyee shuŋ ga nna fanɛ an ka beeŋ tiŋ n ju afu m pɛ na, ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ manɛ b tɔnɔ nɛ anyee nya? 17Naniere bre tentembiri nɛ kebɔltofinfin nɛ kagbenejija nɛ agbo nɛ kulɔ be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ an wɔ.
18Kusɔ nɛ n wu e la fanɛ, kusɔ lela mo nɛ dimɛdi daga kewora an be ŋkpa shiimbi nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n sa anyi durnya ere to e la fanɛ an baa ta kusɔ kama nɛ an gben n nya a ji eyur. Kusɔ nɛ k baŋ daga dimɛdi kikɛ nna na. 19Nɛ Ebɔrɛ baŋ shin nɛ fo dii dama nseŋ nya asɔ nseŋ naŋ sa fo ekpa fanɛ fo ji amo be ebel, kumo ere a daga fanɛ fo baa ji a chɔrɔ mo ŋkpal tɔnɔ nɛ fo shuŋ n nya so. K la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nna. 20Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka sa fo kagbenefuliso, fo maŋ naa fɔŋ ŋkpa shiimbi nɛ anyee ji durnya ere to be asheŋ so.

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 6
Content:
1N dara m pin fanɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so maŋ wɔ durnya ere to kikɛ kuraa. 2Ebɔrɛ beeŋ tiŋ n sa esa ko kedamaya nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ asɔ nseŋ naŋ sa mo kusɔ kama gba nɛ e bee sha n ti so, ama mo alɛ maaŋ ji amo be ebel. Efɔ ko e naŋ ba ji amo be ebel. Kumo alɛ be loŋ la asheŋ fuloŋ nna a maŋ walɛ. 3Esa beeŋ tiŋ a kɔ mbia kalfa nseŋ chɛr kasawule ere so ga, ama k maŋ tir nfɛ afanɛ nɛ e ji durnya ere to, e baa maŋ nya kagbenefuli ŋko kupuli lela mbe kaluwuachɛ kumo ere kebia nɛ b kurge nɛ e laŋɛ gba bɔ mo. 4Kebia nɛ b kurge nɛ e laŋɛ maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ; e bee shir tentembiri to nna, nɛ b teŋ mo so epul to. 5E maŋ wu epeŋi be kefulto ŋko a nyi kusɔ nɛ baa tre ŋkpa gba, ama mo alɛ nya ewushi 6a chɔ esa nɛ e ji nfɛ ŋgboŋ anyɔ nsaa maŋ ji durnya ere to be ebel. Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ bumo kikɛ bee yɔ kakpa koŋwule bre nna.
7Kegben nɛ anyee gben ere kikɛ, kusɔ nɛ anyeeŋ ji so nɛ anyee wora. Amo nɛ amo kikɛ anyi alɛ kra maa ji a moɛ. 8Hale fo kɔ kanyiasheŋ gba, fo maŋ bɔ ewulpo. Nɛ an la betirpo gba, kumo be loŋ maa ŋini nna fanɛ anyi maaŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ nɛ k daga. 9Shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ fo kɔ e baa bɔlɔ fo kenishi a chɔ fo ka beeŋ baa kɔ a fin kananɛ feeŋ ba nya ga saŋkama. K la asheŋ fuloŋ nna nɛ kumo alɛ be loŋ du fanɛ fo ka bee ju a bɛ afu so na.
10Kusɔ kama nɛ k bee wora kabre ere daŋ chɛr wora dra dra kikɛ nna. Anyi edimɛdi nyi kusɔ nɛ k la anyi. Anyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ji Ebɔrɛ emɔrɔ ŋkpal manɛ so e kɔ eleŋ a chɔ anyi ga. 11Esa baa malga ga, mbe mmalga maŋ naa kɔ kifito, amo alɛ maŋ kɔ kechɛto n sa esa kikɛ. 12Nuso nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n wora m pin kusɔ nɛ k walɛ n sa anyi ashi ŋkpa shiimbi nɛ anyee ji durnya ere to, nɛ k bee choŋ fanɛ afu ere? Wanɛ e naŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora mo echefoso saŋɛ so nɛ e lar durnya ere to? An kaŋ wu, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora m pin kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora anyi durnya mo nɛ anyeeŋ naŋ yɔ na to?

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 7
Content:
Kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ
1Ketre lela bɔ tulale dufɛso; nɛ kaluwuachɛ malɛ bɔ kakurgeachɛ.
2Fo ka yɔ keelibuna bɔ fo ka yɔ kejigboŋ to; ŋkpal manɛ so, k yɔ keeli to bee nyiŋi anyi nna fanɛ ekama beeŋ wu kachako.
3Kagbenejija bɔ emushe, k bee jija anishiakpa ama kumo alɛ be loŋ bee shin nɛ esa bee fɛ nfɛra.
4Esa kama nɛ e bee chena a fɛ kagbenefuli nawule be asheŋ la ewulpo nna. Ama enyiashempo bre bee kaa chena nna a fɛ luwu be asheŋ.
5Eyiashempo baa kpele fo kusoe, k bɔ ewulpo ka bee boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ fo.
6Ewulpo be emushe du nna fanɛ ewi ka wɔ edɛ to a chɔɔ. K maŋ kɔ kifito kikɛ.
7Fo baa kɔ kanyiasheŋ nsaa puni basa, kumo ere fee wora nna fanɛ ewulpo na. Fo baa sɔ brɔbu malɛ, fo da nɛ fee jija na.
8Kusɔ kama be lalaloge bɔ kumo be sososo.
Kanyiti ka bɔ kamoowu be asheŋ
9Bewulpo e naa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ nsaa ta asheŋ a wɔtɔ kagbene to.
10K maŋ daga fanɛ fo baa kaŋɛ le: “Manɛ nna nɛ dra na bɔ kabre?” K maŋ la kanyiasheŋ be kamalga.
11Kanyiasheŋ du nna fanɛ kapetɛ, nsaa kɔ tɔnɔ n sa bekama nɛ b kɔ kumo. 12Kanyiasheŋ du fanɛ kusɔ kuŋso nna fanɛ kananɛ amansherbi gba du fanɛ kusɔ kuŋso na. Kanyiasheŋ be tɔnɔ kikɛ e la kananɛ k bee kuŋ esa nɛ e kɔ kumo na.
13Fɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora ere be asheŋ. Nɛ Ebɔrɛ baa maŋ niŋi kusɔ, wanɛ bre e naŋ tiŋ n niŋi kumo? 14Nɛ asheŋ baa nite nɛnɛ, shin nɛ fo kagbene e baa fuli fo, nɛ asheŋ maŋ naa nite nɛnɛ malɛ, ba nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e naa sa ekpa nɛ asheŋ lela nɛ asheŋ lubi bee tu esa. Amoso ekama maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso.
15Kebaawɔtɔ jiga nɛ n wɔtɔ ere to, nɛ n wu fanɛ basa lela ko bee wu bumo be alelasheŋ to nna nɛ basa lubi malɛ kɔ ŋkpa nsaa wɔ bumo be asheŋ lubi to. 16Amoso sa maŋ shin nɛ kanyiasheŋ nɛ kenishibugi nɛ fo kɔ na e mur fo. 17Sa maa kɔ kumu kpakpaso ŋko e la ewulpo saŋɛ na so fo maaŋ wu nɛ fo kachɛ maŋ naŋ fo. 18Baa nite teteri a yɔ. Fo baa kɔ bunyaŋ a sa Ebɔrɛ asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa fo.
19Kusɔ nɛ esa nɛ e kɔ kanyiasheŋ beeŋ tiŋ n wora, bejuŋkparpo kudu maaŋ tiŋ n wora kumo n sa bumo be kade.
20Esa kama maŋ wɔ durnya ere to nɛ e niŋi n ya loge nsaa maa wora a foe.
21Sa maa kaŋ kusoe a nu kusɔ kama nɛ basa bee malga, nɛ manɛ aloŋ, feeŋ nu fo kayɛrbi ka bee tege fo, 22ŋkpal manɛ so fo alɛ gba bee kaa tege beko.
23Ŋ gbagba be kanyiasheŋ nɛ n ta m pin ade kikɛ ama amo alɛ kra chɔ ma so. 24Nuso nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ m pin kebaawɔtɔ ere be asheŋ to? Kumo be kepinto du kpakpa ga nsaa du chiŋgeliŋ. 25Amoso n daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ meeŋ ta ma kanyiasheŋ n fin asheŋ kpakpaso ere kikɛ be edesekpa, saŋɛ na so meeŋ koya kananɛ kulubi nɛ kawulisheŋ du.
26Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ n naŋ wu fanɛ eche dalubiwura, lubi a chɔ luwu. E du nna fanɛ b ka so kejigbelɛ na. Mbe kasha nɛ e beeŋ sha fo na bee pɛ nna fanɛ kashewu; Nɛ mbe enɔ nɛ e beeŋ ta n deŋi fo so na malɛ du fanɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi. E maaŋ tiŋ n nya esa nɛ e bee wora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ ama alubiworapo bre e bee pɛ mo nna manaŋ. 27Eŋinipo na yɛ: “Mee lege asheŋ ere to nna gbrɛgbrɛ a fin amo be edesekpa.” 28N daŋ naa keni nna a fin atuwebi ko nɛ n sa ama ma alɛ maŋ nya. Meeŋ tiŋ n nya esa lela koŋwule benyɛn kagboŋ to, ama beche bre to maaŋ nya loŋ be esa. 29Asheŋ nɛ ŋ koya kikɛ nna na. Ebɔrɛ to anyi nɛnɛ nna nɛ anyi alɛ jija anyi be amu.

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 8
Content:
1Enyiashempo nawule e kɔ nfɛra a pin asheŋ be afito to. Kanyiasheŋ e naa sa mo kagbenefuli nsaa shin nɛ e bee mushe.
Kebaanu a sa ewura be asheŋ
2Fo baŋ nase kɔnɔ Ebɔrɛ be anishito fanɛ feeŋ baa nu a sa ewura, kumo ere a daga fanɛ fo baa wora loŋ. 3Sa maa kuse a lar ewura be anishito ŋko a ji mo emɔrɔ ŋkpal manɛ so e beeŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ kama nɛ e bee sha. 4Ewura be kamalga du fanɛ b ka nase mbra nna, amoso esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n ji mbe kamalga emɔrɔ. 5Fo baa nu a sa ewura, asheŋ maa pɔɔ fo so. Enyiashempo malɛ kikɛ nyi kananɛ daga fanɛ e nu n sa ewura nɛ saŋɛ nɛ k daga e ka wora loŋ. 6Kebaawɔtɔ du kpakpa, ama kusɔ kama kɔ kumo be saŋɛ nɛ kakpa nɛ k daga k ka wora. 7Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso. Esa kama malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ mo. 8Esa kama maŋ kɔ eleŋ luwu so ŋko nɛ e tiŋ n chɛrga mbe kaluwuachɛ. Luwu la kena nɛ esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n shile kumo nna, loŋ koŋwule na e la esa nɛ e bee wora alubi. Mbe alubi beeŋ ba dii efuli kachɛ ko.
Kumukpakpasowura nɛ esa nɛ e niŋi be asheŋ
9N wu kananɛ asheŋ bee nite durnya ere to kikɛ, beko bee tɔrɔ bumo braana nna ŋkpal b ka kɔ eleŋ a chɔ bumo so. 10N wu amukpakpaso wuraana ka wu nɛ b puli bumo bunyaŋ so, ama Ebɔrɛ bre be basa ka lar kade cheembi na to, epul to nɛ b teŋ bumo so. Kanyiasheŋ maŋ wɔ ade be kekama to. 11Kulubi be kasogberge baa maa ba manaŋ manaŋ, k bee shin nɛ basa be ŋgbene bee laŋɛ kulubi be kewora so nna. 12Kumukpakpasowura beeŋ tiŋ n wora alubi kalfa nseŋ kraŋ ji efute n chɛr, ama n nyi fanɛ asheŋ beeŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa esa nɛ e bee ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa wora mo kasonu na. 13Ama ŋkpal kumukpakpasowuraana ka maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa maa wora mo kasonu so, asheŋ maaŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa bumo; bumo alɛ be nchɛ maaŋ teŋi so fanɛ kiyoyul nɛ k maa yili kakpa koŋwule a chɛr na.
14Kusɔ ko nɛ kumo be kepin to du kpakpa kraa wora kasawule so. Kumo e la fanɛ basa niŋiso ka bee nya kasogberge nɛ k daga kumukpakpasowuraana, nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana bee nya kemaŋkura nɛ k daga basa niŋiso. Ma ere kutɔ kede gba maŋ kɔ kifito. 15Ma ere so an baa ji anyi be amu, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be kebaawɔtɔ to be kagbenefuli kikɛ baa wɔ kebaaji a nuu nsaa ji eyur to nna. Kusɔ nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n wora kikɛ ashi kegben kama nɛ anyee gben kebaawɔtɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa anyi durnya ere to e baa la na.
16Kapa nɛ kanyɛ mee gal edi nna a wora ania nɛ m pin kusɔ nɛ k bee wora durnya ere to. 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora nseŋ pin to fanɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin asheŋ nɛ a bee wora ere to. Dimɛdi wora ania kanaŋkama, e maaŋ tiŋ m pin amo be afito. Hale enyiashempo kaŋɛ fanɛ e nyi asheŋ kanaŋkama gba, e maaŋ tiŋ m pin amo to.

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 9
Content:
Kelamba koŋwule ka dese n sa ekama be asheŋ
1Kede be kaman nɛ n fɛ asheŋ ere kikɛ be asheŋ nseŋ wu fanɛ basa niŋiso nɛ benyiashempo kikɛ be asheŋ nɛ baa wora kasha so nɛ amo nɛ baa wora yurkishi so kikɛ bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nna. Ekama maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k dese a jo mo. 2Kelamba koŋwule e dese n sa basa niŋiso nɛ kumukpakpasowuraana; basa lela nɛ basa lubi kikɛ. Kusɔ koŋwule e naaŋ wora basa nɛ baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa sa mo bunyaŋ nɛ bumo nɛ b maa ŋana mo kikɛ. Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora basa nɛ baa lara esarga a sa Ebɔrɛ na, kumo e naŋ wora bumo nɛ b maa bɛ bumo be nnɔ naseso so na gba.
3Kulubi nɛ k wɔ asheŋ kama nɛ e bee wora durnya to na e la fanɛ, kelamba koŋwule e dese n sa ekama. Asheŋ lubi nɛ ebonsheŋ e baŋ bɔlɔ edimɛdi be ŋgbene nɛ nfɛra to; amo alɛ kikɛ be kaman baa wu a yɔ bubuni to nna. 4Ekama nɛ e kraa wɔ ŋkpa to kraa kɔ tama, fanɛ kananɛ jɔnɔ keniso kɔ tɔnɔ a chɔ buluŋ wuso na. 5Kashenteŋto, basa nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to nyi b ka beeŋ wu, ama basa nɛ b wu bre maŋ naa nyi shɛŋ. Kusɔ lela kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n sa bumo; bumo ere choŋ nna na, nɛ b teŋ bumo so. 6Kasha nɛ yurkishi nɛ kukɔrkɔ kama nɛ b daa kɔ kikɛ choŋ nna na. B maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n ti basa so n wora asheŋ kasawule ere so kikɛ.
7Baa ji a nuu kagbenefuliso! Kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili dra kikɛ fanɛ fo baa wora nna na. 8Baa buu asɔ fuful jemanɛ kikɛ nsaa saŋɛ kenishito a wora asheŋ kagbenefuliso 9Durnya to be kebaawɔtɔ maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ, amoso jemanɛ nɛ men wɔ ŋkpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa menyi to ere, fo nɛ fo eche nɛ fee sha na e baa ji menyi be amu nɛnɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ n sa menyi ashi menyi be kegben kikɛ to nna na. 10Kushuŋ kama nɛ fo nya, baa shuŋ kumo nɛ fo eleŋ kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, k maaŋ chɛr feeŋ yɔ bubuni to, kakpa nɛ kushuŋ nɛ kefɛ nfɛra nɛ kekre asheŋ nɛ kanyiasheŋ maŋ wɔ.
11N daŋ naŋ wu kusɔ ko malɛ gba durnya to n ti so. Kumo e la fanɛ, mannɛ basa nɛ baa shile ga e naa tiŋ a ji kɔŋkɔŋ ŋko belempo e naa tiŋ a kɔ a pɔɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ. Mannɛ kanyiasheŋ ŋko kenyi be ga e naa bar ajibi ŋko kedamaya ŋko ketregboŋ. Kumu lubi malɛ wɔtɔ nna n sa ekama.
12Fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin jemanɛ nɛ fo peya bee ba. Kananɛ abulbi bee pɛ mbuibi ŋko ewule bee pɛ ekɔrɔtɔ epul to na, aloŋ nɛ asheŋ lubi bee ba edimɛdi gba so.
Kanyiasheŋ ka bɔ kawulisheŋ be asheŋ
13N daŋ naŋ wu kananɛ basa bee fɛ kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ nɛ k bɔlɔ ma kenishi ga. 14Kadebi ko nɛ kumo to be basa daa maŋ shibi e daa wɔtɔ. Nɛ ewura lempo ko nɛ mbe benapo daŋ ba kulti kumo n wɔtɔ a shin nɛ b bure kumo be egbal n luri to ŋ kɔ kumo kena. 15Etirpo ko daa wɔ kadebi na to a nyi asheŋ ga, nseŋ daŋ bɔla mbe kanyiasheŋ so m mɔlga kumo. Ama ekama daa maŋ naa nyiŋi mbe asheŋ. 16Amoso nɛ ma ere kaŋɛ fanɛ kanyiasheŋ bɔ eleŋ na. Ama esa kikɛ maa fɛ fanɛ etirpo nyi asheŋ ŋko a ta mbe kamalga a shuŋ. 17Kewora enyiashempo be kamalga nɛ e beeŋ malga boeŋ na kasonu bɔ awɔr nɛ bewulpo be ewura bee chɛ na. 18Kanyiasheŋ kɔ kechɛto a chɔ kena to be akɔsɔ, ama kulubi koŋwule bee jija alela damta nna.

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 10
Content:
1Kananɛ ashushombi bee wu a wɔtɔ tulale to nɛ amo be efɛa bee chɛrga na, aloŋ nɛ kawuli fimbi kikɛ bee jija esa be kanyiasheŋ nɛ kemaŋkura.
2Enyiashempo be kagbene bee laŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k daga be kewora so nna, ama ewulpo bre be kagbene bee laŋɛ asheŋ nɛ a gbɛto so nna. 3Ewulpo baa bɔ ekpa a nite gba, ekama bee pin fanɛ e maŋ kɔ nfɛra nɛ kanyiasheŋ kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to.
4Hale ewurjipo nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo gba, sa maŋ kaŋ kini kushuŋ nɛ fee shuŋ a sa mo na. Fo kewushi kagbene m bar fo kumu kaseto beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ e ta fo kewora n jija na m paŋ fo.
5N wu kulubi ko ashi durnya to, kumo e la bewurjipo ka maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. 6Baa ta bewulpo nna a yili eyilikpagboŋ a sa bumo bunyaŋ nsaa keni damawuraana jiga. 7Ma ere wu anya ka chena egbaŋɛ so nɛ bewurbi bee nite aya so fanɛ anya.
8Esa kama nɛ e kur kemaŋ n nase nsaa maŋ de so mo gbagba e naŋ tɔr kumo to. Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bure egbal dra n lɛ nsaa maa de so kana e naaŋ duŋ mo. 9Esa kama nɛ e bee bure afalta ŋko a baŋɛ ndishaŋ to beeŋ tiŋ n doro mbe kumu. 10Nɛ fo kekpanfu baa maa ji nɛ fo alɛ maŋ yee kumo, kumo ere eleŋ fuful nɛ feeŋ baa kɔ a ku kusɔ. Kenyi bre bee shin nɛ asheŋ bee nite nɛnɛ nsaa loge to nɛnɛ nna. 11Kuwɔ be keduŋ esa m mɔ pɔɛŋ nɛ edurpo e ba wora kudur m mɔ kuwɔ na maŋ kɔ kechɛto kikɛ. 12Enyiashempo be mmalga bee bar mo kemaŋkura nna, ama ewulpo bre be kɔnɔ to be mmalga e naa mur mo. 13Ewulpo bee fara kawulisheŋ be mmalga nna, kumo be lalaloge nɛ a ya bar kebagato. 14Mbe mmalga malɛ maa loge kikɛ, e baa bela amo a biti abar so nna.
Esa kikɛ maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ naŋ wora. Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ anyi kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora luwu be kaman.
15Ewulpo e naa shuŋ a gben a chul to nsaa maŋ naa nyi kananɛ e beeŋ naaŋ wora n yɔ epe.
16Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa efuli kama nɛ kumo be ewura la kebia nɛ kumo be bejuŋkparpoana malɛ wɔtɔ a ji kejigboŋ karechɛ kikɛ. 17Ama efuli kama nɛ kumo be ewura bee ta mo gbagba be nfɛra a wora asheŋ nɛ kumo be bejuŋkparpo malɛ bee ji jemanɛ k daga nsaa tiŋ a keta bumo be amu a maa boo nsa bre wora kumulela.
18Etɔlpo be ebu be larbeŋ e naa bu a tɔr to nɛ ebu na bee dul mo so, kumo be lalaloge nɛ kowu na e tɔr kuraa.
19Kebaa ji nsaa nuu bee shin nɛ esa be kagbene bee fuli mo nna, ama amansherbi nɛ e beeŋ nya pɔɛŋ tiŋ n wora amo kikɛ.
20Sa maŋ kaŋ malga ŋ gbiti ewura ŋko n shoduu damawura, hale fo nfɛra to ŋko ashi fo ebu deseso to gba. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kabuibi ko beeŋ tiŋ n nu nseŋ ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ fo malga na kikɛ.

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 11
Content:
Kusɔ nɛ Enyiashempo bee wora be asheŋ
1Baa ta fo asɔ a kɛ yilayilaso, kachako so feeŋ ji amo be tɔnɔ. 2Baa chige fo asɔ to a sa basa be yiri yiri damta, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin jemanɛ nɛ kumu lubi beeŋ tu fo. 3Bɔrɛwɔlpa baŋ moɛ nchu, k bee bar bɔrɛchu nna; kaplɛkama nɛ kedibi malɛ baŋ tɔr n shoŋi, ndoŋ nɛ k dese, k maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n chɛrga kumo be edesekpa. 4Esa kama nɛ e bee sha fanɛ afu e baa nite nɛnɛ nɛ kakpa e kpeta to nɛnɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ e dɔ, maaŋ tiŋ n dɔ n duu n teŋi shɛŋ.
5Kananɛ fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin ekpa nɛ afu bee bɔla so a ba, ŋko kananɛ kebia bee wora a daŋ mo nio be epun to na, a loŋ nɛ fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to kusɔ kikɛ na be kasheŋwora to.
6Baa wule a koso kachipurdidi n ya kaa duu fo asɔduu nsaa pere kenishi a shuŋ a tɔr epeŋi. Ŋkpal manɛ so fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin fanɛ kachipurso peya na ŋko kaaseso peya na e naaŋ wora n lar tɔnɔ n sa fo.
Kenyiŋi fo etopo fo kebifɔlbi to be asheŋ
7Shɛŋ maŋ walɛ kenishiso a chɔ kachipurso be epeŋi. 8Nfɛ kama nɛ esa beeŋ ji durnya ere to, e shin nɛ mbe kagbene e fuli amo be kekama so. Ama e baa nyiŋi fanɛ nfɛ nɛ e beeŋ ji luwu be kaman chɔ amo nɛ e beeŋ ji durnya to. Shɛŋ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n ta mbe yirda n to kumo so.
9Kebifɔlbi, baa ji fo kumu kagbenefuliso, ŋkpal fo kebifɔlbi so. Baa wora fo kagbene be aparsheŋ kanaŋkama nɛ fee sha. Ama baa nyiŋi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ yili kusɔ kama nɛ fo wora so n ji fo demu.
10Sa maŋ shin kusɔ kama e baa fɔŋ fo ŋko a tɔrɔ fo ashi fo kagbene to, ŋkpal manɛ so, kebifɔlbiya nɛ kumo be asheŋ woraso maa chɛr nsaa choŋ.

Title: KAŊINICHIŊGELIŊ 12
Content:
1Amoso baa nyiŋi fo etopo jemanɛ nɛ fo kraa la kebifɔlbi ere, pɔɛŋ nɛ asheŋ e baa wora fo so keshi ashi nfɛ nɛ a wɔ fo anishito ere to nɛ fo kaŋɛ le: “Kebaawɔtɔ maŋ naa wora ma ebel.” 2Loŋ be jemanɛ na, epeŋi nɛ kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabi maaŋ naa fuli to nɛnɛ a sa fo, ŋkpal fo anishi ka maa naa wu nɛnɛ so. Nɛ kewora fanɛ bɔrɛwɔlpa ka buu fo so jemanɛ kikɛ na. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ fo mbre nɛ e bee kuŋ fo na e fara a chicha nɛ fo aya nɛ e kɔ eleŋ kabre ere e paŋ amo be eleŋ. Fo anyii damta na beeŋ gbaŋ n tɔr nseŋ ka gbrɛbi nɛ fo maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ we ajibi to nɛnɛ nɛ fo anishi malɛ maaŋ naa wu nɛnɛ. 4Loŋ be jemanɛ na fo asoe maa naa nu awɔr nɛ a bee chɛ kelɔnɛ so ŋko nshɛ nɛ beche beeŋ baa kɔr asɔ abo so nsaa boŋ na nɛnɛ. Mbuibi be kushu gba beeŋ gal fo edi. 5Feeŋ baa ŋana kedii kakpa jeŋgreŋ ŋko a nite ekpaana to be mboŋ nɛ e bee keta kufu. Fo emin beeŋ kilgi n fuli nɛ enite gba e baa nu fo; shɛŋ malɛ maaŋ naa yɛlga fo.
Loŋ be jemanɛ na bee ŋini fanɛ anyi be ekama bee yɔ epe nɛ k wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na nna, nɛ basa e sɔ abɔrbi so a shu nli. 6Amoso baa nyiŋi fo etopo na pɔɛŋ nɛ fo efute nɛ k du fanɛ kajesebi na e tuge to ŋko a du fanɛ kapuya na e bure kuraa. 7Anyi be eyurana ere beeŋ bɛta n yɔ shishɛr nɛ a shi to na to, nɛ Kiyoyu nɛ e bee sa anyi ŋkpa nɛ efute na malɛ e bɛta n yɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e ta mo n wɔtɔ anyi to na kutɔ.
8Eŋinipo na yɛ: “Shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ kɔ kifi to! Shɛŋ maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ! Amo kikɛ la fuloŋ nna.”
Kesa Ebɔrɛ bunyaŋ nseŋ wora mo kasonu be asheŋ
9Ama ŋkpal eŋinipo na ka la enyiashempo so, e kraa ŋini basa asɔ nɛ mo ere nyi nna. E koya aŋasa nna nseŋ mige amo to nɛnɛ m pin amo be kashenteŋ kikɛ. 10E wora ania fanɛ e beeŋ keni to n fin mmalgabi nɛ e bee wushi kagbene. Kusɔ nɛ e sibɛ na malɛ niŋi nna nsaa la kashenteŋ.
11Enyiashempo na be mmalga na du fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo be kekpabi nɛ e kɔ a kpa mbe mbolpɔ nna nɛ aŋasa na malɛ du fanɛ ayir nɛ e gbir nɛnɛ nna. Mmalga na shi Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la anyi kikɛ be ekpapo na kutɔ nna. 12M pibi, baa da so nɛ fo maaŋ naŋ ta shɛŋ n ti mmalga ere so.
Nwɔl be kasibɛ maaŋ kɔ ekar kikɛ, nɛ kekoya be alegai malɛ bee shin nɛ esa bee gben a bɛlɛ.
13Ade kikɛ be kaman, kusɔ koŋwule e ka nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ. Baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa bɛ mbe mbraana so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ to dimɛdi bomin. 14Ebɔrɛ beeŋ yili kusɔ kama nɛ an wora so n ji anyi demu, hale asheŋ lubi ŋko asheŋ lela nɛ an wora ashiri to gba.

Title: SƆLƆMƆN 1
Content:
1Sɔlɔmɔn be nshɛ to be kebelbelso.
Sososo be kashɛ
Eche shaso be kashɛ
2Pipe ma kɔnɔ kasha so;
fo kasha bɔ nsa;
3nɛ fo efɛa wɔ ebel ga.
Fo ketre du viim nna fanɛ b ka chulgi tulale n wurge nna.
Nɛ besuŋgurbi bee wu fo so.
4Keta ma nɛ an nya manaŋ n yɔ;
Ma ewura, keta ma n yɔ fo ebu to manaŋ.
Ndoŋ nɛ anyi be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli anyi,
nɛ an nuu nsa nseŋ ji anyi be amu.
Nɛ beche bee sha fo, kumo be ekpa so nna.
5Jerusalɛm be beche,
ma kayurwule biri nna, ama ma alɛ walɛ kebita.
N nyɔ gbitigbiti nna fanɛ Keeda be ewajɛbu
nɛ a wɔ keshishɛrsawule so na,
ama ma kebita du nna fanɛ Sɔlɔmɔn be lambu to be epatisa
6Men sa maŋ mɛrge anishi n cha ma ŋkpal epeŋi ka chɔ ma nɛ m biri gbitigbiti so.
N siponyɛnana e daŋ nya agbo n wora ma
nseŋ shin nɛ n ya ka keni asɔrso
nɛ baa tre greep na be ndɔ so.
Nɛ m maŋ naa nya saŋɛ a sa ma eyur nɛ k ki loŋ na.
7N jipo, ŋini ma kakpa nɛ fee yɛr fo mbolpɔ nɛ baa ya kaa ji,
nɛ kakpa nɛ baa dese a wushi kapaso.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
k maŋ daga fanɛ n ya kaa na fo braana be mbolpɔ to a fin fo.
Enyɛn na be kashɛ
8Beche to be kebita,
nɛ fo maŋ nyi ndoŋ gba fo bɛ mbolpɔ na be aya so.
Keta fo mboebi n yɔ kejito
a mata mbolpɔkpapoana na be ewajɛbu na ase.
9N jipo, fee shin nɛ mee wora yireŋ yireŋ nna fanɛ
egbaŋɛnyɛn nɛ a bee gberge
ewura Fɛɛro be gbaŋɛturko na ka wu gbaŋɛche na.
10Akonde bee shin nɛ fo kebita bee lar alegaiso nna,
nɛ fo kubɔtoshembi malɛ bee nyɛkpɛ fanɛ shuwa na. 11Anyeeŋ ta shuwa nɛ gbiti n lɔŋɛ akonde n sa fo.
Eche na be kashɛ
12Ma kowurnyɛn ka tase mbe ejikpa nɛ ma tulale be efɛa ya ber mo.
13N jipo, fo du fanɛ tulale nna ashi ma anyipo be nfɛato.
14N jipo, fo du nna fanɛ kedibi nɛ baa tre hena na be atoto ashi kudɔ nɛ k wɔ kade nɛ baa tre Engedi na to.
Enyɛn na be kashɛ
15N jipo, fo kebita maŋ kɔ ebarkasa,
fo anishi du fanɛ lepɔ be anishi nna.
Eche na be kashɛ
16N jipo fo walɛ keyɛrbi,
m baŋ maŋ wu fo maaŋ teŋ n chena.
Anyeeŋ dese afitiri bumbuŋ so kasha so
fanɛ gedo nɛ an wora kejafɔ n dese so na;
17nɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre sida nɛ seprɛs na be kiyoyul e buu anyi so.

Title: SƆLƆMƆN 2
Content:
1N du fanɛ ketoto nɛ baa tre rosi na nna ashi kakpa nɛ baa tre Sharɔn na
ŋko ketoto nɛ baa tre lili nɛ k wɔ ketaŋɛ to na.
Enyɛn na be kashɛ
2Kananɛ ketotodibi lela bee kaa wea ewidibiana to na, loŋ gbagba chap nɛ n jipo du ashi besuŋgurbi to.
Eche na be kashɛ
3Kananɛ mangodibi bee wea ndibi pɔtɛ to ashi kupo to na nɛ n jipo du ashi mbrantiɛbia to.
Kumo be kiyoyul to be kechena wɔ ebel nna
nɛ kumo kusɔrso bee wora ma kɔnɔ to ebel ga
4Fo yɛr ma fo kejigboŋ be ebu to
n ya ŋini ma fo kasha alegaiso.
5Sa ma asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be awɔlso nɛ amo nɛ baa tre apɔl na nɛ n ji n nya eleŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so fo kasha shin nɛ mee lɔ nna.
6N jipo be enɔ bena sɔ ma kumu to nna
nɛ mbe enɔjiso malɛ bee lala ma so kasha so.
7Jerusalɛm be beche,
men nase kɔnɔ n sa ma
nseŋ bɔ chibir nɛ shantaŋ be ntaŋ
fanɛ men maaŋ chuchɔl kasha
nɛ kumo be saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo.
Kashɛ nyɔsopo
Eche na be kashɛ
8N nu n jipo be ebɔl!
Mo e shi abee nɛ apreŋ so n shile a tɛto n gbelge to a ba ma kutɔ na.
9N jipo du nna fanɛ chibir na.
Mo e yil egbal be kaman a jule a keni tokuro to a dara ebu to na.
Enyɛn na be kashɛ
10Le nɛ n jipo kaŋɛ ma: “Ma eshapo, niŋi to;
ma kebita lela, ba nɛ an yɔ!
11Kechali loge nna na, nɛ bɔrɛ ku.
12Ndibi fara a wora atoto
nɛ basa fara a lɔŋɛ asɔ to nsaa boŋ nshɛ kaplɛkama,
nɛ elepɔ be kushu sɔ kiyi to.
13Ndibi nɛ baa tre figi na fara a sɔr,
nɛ asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na fara a futi
nɛ amo be atoto be efɛa sɔ kaplɛkama.
Amoso n jipo koso nɛ an yɔ;
ma kebita lela, ba nɛ an yɔ!
14Fo du nna fanɛ lepɔ nɛ e ŋana kefalta to ashi kebeegboŋ so na.
Shin nɛ n wu fo anishito;
nseŋ nu fo ebɔl belbelso na.
15Shin nɛ an pɛ ejiŋkaamu wurbi nɛ baa jija anyi be asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na be kudɔ na,
ŋkpal manɛ so greep be asɔrso na bee futi nna.
Eche na be kashɛ
16Ma eshapo la meya nna, nɛ ma alɛ gba la mo peya;
Atoto nɛ baa tre lili na be kakpa nɛ e bee yɛr mbe asɔbɔya kejito.
17N jipo du fanɛ chibir nna a wɔ kebee so hale nɛ kare e ya cha
nɛ tentembiri e foe.”

Title: SƆLƆMƆN 3
Content:
1Ŋ ka dese ma gedo so kanyɛso nɛ n jipo be asheŋ ba ma kagbene to;
nɛ ŋ keni bena nɛ jiso m maŋ wu mo.
2Nɛ ŋ koso n nite n kilgi to kade na kikɛ to;
n nite kumo be abɔrbi kikɛ nɛ kumo be alɔnɛ kikɛ so n fin ma jipo,
ama m maŋ wu mo.
3Nɛ basa nɛ baa keni kade na so kanyɛso na shɛr ma to
nɛ m bishi bumo: “Men wu n jipo a?” 4Ma nɛ bumo ka baŋ barga abar gbrɛ nɛ n wu ŋ jipo.
Nɛ n far n chɛ mo kiŋkiŋ;
M maŋ naŋ yige mo to.
Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ keta mo n yɔ n nio be ebu to;
ebu nɛ b kurge ma kumo to na gbagba to.
5Jerusalɛm be beche, men nase kɔnɔ n sa ma
nseŋ bɔ chibir nɛ shantaŋ be ntaŋ fanɛ
men maaŋ chuchɔl kasha
nɛ kumo be saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo.
Kashɛ Sasopo
Eche na be kashɛ
6Wanɛ e shi keshishɛrsawule so
a ba fanɛ edishi ka bee kaa kululu loŋ,
nɛ etulale kpakpaso fanɛ mɛr nɛ fraŋkinsensi
nɛ eyawujipoana bee fa na be efɛa bɛ mo so loŋ?
7Sɔlɔmɔn nɛ b sulɔ mbe kekpata so a ba
nɛ Israɛl be benapo kpakpaso adeshe bee kuŋ mo.
8Benapo na kikɛ la benapo lempo nɛ b nyi kena to nɛnɛ nna.
B nyi tokobi be keta ŋ kɔ nɛnɛ.
Bumo be ekama malɛ di tokobi nna nseŋ wora shiriya
a jo kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora kanyɛso nna.
9Lebanɔn be ndibi lela nɛ ewura Sɔlɔmɔn ta n lɔŋɛ mbe kekpata na.
10Gbiti nɛ e daŋ ta n wora kumo be ndibi tenteŋ na,
nseŋ ta shuwa malɛ n wora kumo be kaseto be ndibi na.
Wajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ e daŋ ta n ta kumo be kaseto.
Jerusalɛm be mbichebi e daŋ lue kumo be epunto be asɔ kikɛ.
11Zayɔn be beche, men lar m ba keni ewura Sɔlɔmɔn
ka buu kuwurwuro;
kuwurwuro nɛ mo nio
daŋ ta m buu mo mbe kejafɔ achɛ
nɛ k shin nɛ mbe kagbene fuli mo ga na.

Title: SƆLƆMƆN 4
Content:
Enyɛn na be kashɛ
1N jipo fo lar kebita nɛnɛ bre.
Fo kebita maŋ kɔ ebarkasa.
Keni kananɛ fo anishi walɛ nɛnɛ
a wɔ shata to fanɛ lepɔ ka wɔ kesha to na.
Nɛ fo emin bee gbungbuŋto fanɛ mboe
ka shi Giliad be kebee so a gbelge to a ba na.
2Fo anyii fuli nna parr
fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ b baŋ bɛr n ji kebita na.
Amo kikɛ bɛ abar so nna yɛɛr.
K kama maŋ gbaŋ.
3Fo kɔnɔpurbi nyɔ nna m pere kpeŋ fanɛ kechɛbi peper na;
fo kɔnɔ be kapɔr walɛ.
Fo ŋgbuŋ du kulkulbi nna a walɛ nsaa nyɛkpɛ fo shata to.
4Fo kubɔ du nna shirembi fanɛ ketempreŋ jeŋgreŋ nɛ ewura Deevid pɔr na.
Kumo so nɛ b daa ta benapo be abɛlso be asɔkuŋso ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto a shiga na.
5Fo anyipo yil nna jɔŋjurɔmbi
fanɛ echibir anyɔ ka lar kepla so a ji na.
6Meeŋ nya manaŋ n yɔ
abee nɛ apreŋ nɛ a kɔ etulale nɛ asɔ dufɛso be efɛa na so
pɔɛŋ nɛ kaboŋ e bugi to nɛ kare e chɛ.
7Fo baa walɛ kebita nna nɛnɛ;
Ŋ jipo, fo kebita maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ kikɛ.
8Ma kejafɔ, shin nɛ an lar Lebanɔn.
An lar Lebanɔn be abeegboŋ
nɛ baa tre Amana,
nɛ Senir nɛ Hɛɛmɔn na to,
Amo be alaŋ to nɛ ebuluŋ nɛ ebuful bee di na.
9Esipoche, ma kagbene pɛ fo ga;
ma kagbene pɛ fo kashenteŋto nna.
Ma nɛ fo be anishi ka baŋ wora abar anyɔ
nɛ n wu kananɛ fo kubɔtoshembi bee nyɛkpɛ na
nɛ ma kagbene laŋɛ fo so.
10N jipo nɛ ma kejafɔ, fo kasha bee bɔlɔ ma kenishi ga.
Fo kasha bɔ nsa,
nɛ fo etulale be efɛa chɔ asɔ dufɛso kama.
11Ma kejafɔ, fo kɔnɔ be kepipe wɔ ebel nna fanɛ mushoŋ.
Nɛ fo kudonduloŋ bee wora ma ebel,
fanɛ mushoŋ nɛ kenyipochu na.
Fo asɔbuuso to be efɛa wɔ ebel nna
fanɛ Lebanɔn be ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na be efɛa.
12N sipoche nɛ ŋ jipo,
fo du fanɛ kudɔbi nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti nna
ŋko kebuye nɛ b ti so n yili n na.
13Ndoŋ nɛ asɔduuso bee wora nɛnɛ
nsaa sɔr asɔrso jiso lela nɛ baa tre pomegranates na,
nɛ asɔrso dufɛso lela nɛ baa tre naad nɛ hena na;
14nɛ amo nɛ baa tre safrɔn nɛ kalamus nɛ sinamɔn na,
nɛ ndibi nɛ baa ta a wora duwu be yiri yiri
fanɛ mir nɛ alowe nɛ asɔ nɛ a kɔ efɛa belbelso
be yiri kikɛ na.
15Fo du fanɛ kebuye nna ashi kudɔbi to,
kakpa nɛ nchu lela bee bul na;
ŋko kabombi nɛ k shi Lebanɔn be kebeegboŋ na so
m ba shin nɛ kakpa wushi na nna.
Eche na be kashɛ
16Shin nɛ afu e ta ma kudɔbi na to be efɛa
n ya ber ŋ jipo,
nɛ n jipo e ba luri kumo to
n daŋ kumo be asɔrso lela na ŋ keni.

Title: SƆLƆMƆN 5
Content:
Kashɛ Nasopo
Enyɛn na be kashɛ
1M ba ma kudɔbi to,
ŋ jipo, nɛ ma kejafɔ.
N chala ma etulale nɛ asɔ dufɛso
Ŋ ji ma mushoŋkɔrfɔ nɛ mushoŋchu;
nseŋ nuu ma nsa belbelso nɛ kenyipochu.
Eche na be kashɛ
Ji nseŋ nu kanaŋkama so nɛ fee sha;
shin nɛ kasha e boo fo.
Eche na be kashɛ
2Mee di nɛ ma kagbene maa di.
Ŋ ku edare fanɛ n jipo ka ba ŋmɛa ma kukuloŋ.
Enyɛn na be kashɛ
N jipo nɛ ma eshapo, nɛ fo du fanɛ lepɔ,
bugi ma nɛ n luri;
ŋkpal manɛ so bunyaŋ tɔr ma so nna;
nɛ ma kumu nɛ ma emin kikɛ pɔ.
Eche na be kashɛ
3Ma ere teŋ wora shiriya nɛ n dese nna,
manɛ nna nɛ n naa ta ma asɔ a buu?
N tiŋ n fɔr ma aya nna,
n naaŋ shin nɛ a wora eyurpi a?
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ n jipo ba pɛ kukuloŋ na to nɛ e bugi,
nɛ ma kagbene fara a ku.
5Nɛ ŋ koso nɛ n bugi kukuloŋ na n sa mo,
nɛ etulale bee chise ma enɔ nɛ ashilbi so
a do kukuloŋ na be kelagatobi so.
6Ŋ ka bugi kukuloŋ na nɛ n jipo maŋ naa wɔtɔ;
e tiŋ n yɔ,
nɛ k tɔrɔ ma ga.
Nɛ ŋ keni a fin mo, ama m maŋ wu mo.
Nɛ n tre mo ama m maŋ nu mbe ebɔl.
7Nɛ basa nɛ baa keni kade na so na
bee kulti m ba tu ma
m bri ma,
n doro ma nseŋ suge ma kusɔbuuso.
8Jerusalɛm be beche,
meeŋ kaŋ wu n jipo,
manɛ nɛ menyeeŋ kaŋɛ mo?
Men kaŋɛ mo fanɛ kasha shin nɛ mee lɔ.
Eche na be kashɛ
9Beche to be kebita, nuso bre nɛ fo jipo na baa du ga?
E walɛ nna a chɔ ekama a;
Nɛ fo kpal mo so a bishi anyi ade kikɛ a?
Eche na be kashɛ
10N jipo walɛ keyɛrbi nna, nsaa kɔ eleŋ nɛnɛ.
E wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kudu gba to feeŋ wu mo.
11Mbe kumu du nna fanɛ shuwa,
nɛ mbe emin du mɔlɔ mɔlɔ
nseŋ biri gbiti gbiti fanɛ mɔmɔ na.
12Mbe anishi du nna fanɛ elepɔ
ka ya biri kepa nɛ kumo be nchu ki fanɛ kenyipochu
nɛ b lar m ba kaa jɔŋ na.
13Mbe ŋgbuŋ walɛ nna fanɛ kudɔbi
nɛ k kɔ afantaŋ nɛ asɔrso nɛ amo be efɛa wɔ ebel.
Nɛ mbe kɔnɔpurbi du fanɛ atoto nɛ baa tre lili
nɛ a bee dufɛ viim na.
14Mbe mbre pɔl nɛnɛ nna fanɛ eshuwadibi na,
nɛ e wɔtɔ enɔ to be mpinibi lela.
Mbe eyur walɛ nna fanɛ
b ka lɔŋɛ jebote be kinyi so
nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ
nɛ b ta abitasɔ nɛ baa tre safai na
n ji kumo kebita na.
15Mbe aya kɔ eleŋ nna fanɛ
b ka ta ajembu kpakpaso m pɔr n yili shuwa so na;
e yil jirembi nna
fanɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na
ka yil Lebanɔn be abee so na.
16Mbe kɔnɔ be kepipe wɔ ebel nna,
nɛ mbe kusɔ kama malɛ bee par ma.
To, Jerusalɛm be beche, kananɛ n jipo nɛ ma eshapo na du nna na.

Title: SƆLƆMƆN 6
Content:
Eche na be kashɛ
