6Menyi nɛ men wɔ efuli nɛ baa tre Fenisha na e boŋ to awɔrso n shu ga nseŋ wora ania n shile n yɔ efuli nɛ baa tre Speen na! 7Kadegboŋ ere beeŋ tiŋ a la Tayɛ be kadegboŋ nɛ kagbenefuli daŋ bɔlɔ kumo to nɛ k jɔŋɛ dra dra na kikɛ a? Kadegboŋ nɛ k daa shuŋi kumo to be basa nɛ baa dii teku a yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so n ya ka ji kuwura bumo so na nde a? 8Wanɛ e kre le n deŋi Tayɛ so? Kumo be basa daŋ ji eleŋ ga nɛ kumo be eyawujipo malɛ daa la bewurbi nɛ basa daa maŋkura bumo ashi durnya to kikɛ. 9Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ kre kumo fanɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ bumo be mpuchi nɛ baa puchi ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b tiŋ n wora so na e ba ekar nɛ e ŋaba bumo be bunyaŋwuraana.
10Tayɛebi, men ya kaa dɔ menyi be kasawule na so fanɛ kananɛ Ijiptebi bee dɔ Nail be lɔrgboŋ na be ekarso na, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi maŋ naa kɔ kakpa nɛ men baa yili menyi be ekuloŋgboŋana. 11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋi mbe enɔ to m baŋ teku so n ya shin nɛ kufugboŋ tɔr efuliana na so. Mo alɛ yili kumo nna fanɛ Fenisha be efuli so be ndegboŋ nɛ b pɔr egbal lempoana ŋ kulti na kikɛ beeŋ mur. 12Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Sidɔn be basa na le: “Menyi be kayurji na fo ekar. Menyi alɛ mur nna na. Hale nɛ men ŋana n shile n yɔ Saipres be kepla so gba, men kraa maaŋ nya kayurwushi ndoŋ.”
13Keni kusɔ nɛ Asiriyaebi wora Babilɔn be efuli so be basa! B kre kena m ba gbare shishɛr n deŋi abar so nseŋ dii amo so n luri kadegboŋ na to ŋ kɔ kumo nseŋ mur kasawule na so be ewurkpa kikɛ. Naniere kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi e wɔ kumo be alambure na to. 14Kakpa lempo nɛ k bee kuŋ efuli na kikɛ maŋ naŋ ka a yil, amoso kaŋɛ basa nɛ b wɔ ekuloŋgboŋ nɛ e wɔ teku so na kikɛ fanɛ b baa shu awɔrso kagbenejijaso. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kadegboŋ nɛ baa fute a yige so na kikɛ mur.
15Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ b teŋ Tayɛ be kadegboŋ so n ya fo nfɛ adushunu. Nfɛ nɛ ewura bee ji durnya to nna. Nfɛ adushunu ere be kaman, Tayɛ beeŋ ki fanɛ sakaleche nɛ kashɛ ere bee ji mbe asheŋ ere:
16Ta jaŋjilaŋ n nite ŋ kulti kade na kikɛ to,
fo sakaleche nɛ b teŋ fo so ere!
Baa laŋ kumo nsaa boŋ fo nshɛ nɛ fee sha ga na
nɛ fo basa e naŋ nyiŋi fo asheŋ nseŋ bɛta m ba.
17Nfɛ adushunu na be kaman, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ Tayɛ e bɛta n yɔ mbe kayawuji dra na to. Kadegboŋ na beeŋ baa du fanɛ eche nɛ e bee fa mbe kumu a sa enyɛn kikɛ ashi durnya to be efuli kama so nna, 18ama asɔ kama nɛ e beeŋ nya na be kekama maaŋ nya n yili kadegboŋ na to. Amansherbi na beeŋ baa la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya nɛ bekama nɛ baa shuŋ mo na e ta amo n tɔ ajibi damta nɛ asɔbuuso lela nɛ baa sha.

Title: AIZAAYA 24
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge durnya kusoe be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha kejija durnya kikɛ nna nɛ k dese fuloŋ fanɛ kiyitokpaŋ na. E beeŋ melgi durnya na m buu nseŋ pesaŋ kumo be basa to. 2Kesheŋ koŋwule na e naaŋ tu bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ bumo be basa, nɛ anya nɛ bumo nyɛnpeana, nɛ basa nɛ baa tɔ nɛ bumo nɛ baa fa asɔ, nɛ basa nɛ baa paŋ asɔ nɛ bumo nɛ baa ta asɔ a paŋ basa, nɛ damawuraana nɛ betirpo kikɛ. 3Durnya na beeŋ jija nseŋ mur kuraa. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ; kumo alɛ beeŋ wora loŋ. 4Kasawule wɔl a baŋɛ to, nɛ durnya kikɛ ki kakpa nɛ basa nɛ b kɔ eyilikpa nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eyilikpa kikɛ wu m bɛ. 5Edimɛdi jija durnya nna ŋkpal b ka kini kewora Ebɔrɛ be mbraana kasonu so. Bumo alɛ maŋ naa sa bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ k daga fanɛ k baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na bunyaŋ. 6Amoso Ebɔrɛ sho durnya na kɔnɔ nna nɛ kumo to be basa bee wu ŋkpal bumo be alubi so. 7Ewaindibi bee wu nna nɛ yabra be asheŋ bee ki kpakpa. Esa kama nɛ mbe kagbene daa fuli mo wɔ kagbenejija to naniere nna. 8Kagbenefuliso be nshɛ nɛ b daa laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ nɛ ŋkure a boŋ na kikɛ kuu. 9Basa maŋ naa nuu yabra nsaa boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso. Yabra gba maŋ naa wora basa ebel 10Kebagato e sɔ ndeana na kikɛ to nɛ basa ber bumo be amu so n wɔtɔ ebuana to ŋkpal kufu so. 11Kagbenefuli foe durnya to nɛ basa bee ponte to agbembi so a kaŋɛ le: “Anyi maŋ naa kɔ yabra! Anyi maŋ naa kɔ yabra!” 12Ndegboŋana na kikɛ mur nɛ amo be mbunagboŋana buri to n tɔr. 13Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora efuliana nɛ a wɔ durnya kikɛ to nna na. K beeŋ baa du fanɛ kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ nɛ b ŋeri ndibi kikɛ be asɔrso n lɛ nseŋ chuge waindibi be asɔrso koko na malɛ kikɛ na nna.
14Basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute bre beeŋ boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa na e malga kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be keshi nɛ kemaŋkura du, 15nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ epeŋilarkpa na malɛ e kpaŋ mo. Basa nɛ b wɔ teku be ekarso na malɛ gba beeŋ fur Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na. 16Anyeeŋ nu b kaa bee boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ Israɛl nɛ k la efuli niŋiso na ashi durnya be mboŋ wɔfɔ wɔfɔ kikɛ.
Ama tama maŋ wɔtɔ n sa ma ere! Ma ere be asheŋ jija n loge nna na! Bedebɔrpo kraa wɔtɔ nna a debɔr basa, nɛ bumo be kedebɔre na malɛ bee daŋɛ so. 17Ekama e nu nfe! Kufugboŋ nɛ amaŋ chiŋgeliŋ nɛ ajigbelɛ dese a jo menyi. 18Ekama nɛ e wora ania n shile kufugboŋ na beeŋ ya tɔr kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ to, nɛ emo nɛ e gelge kemaŋ chiŋgeliŋ malɛ e ya tɔr kejigbelɛ to. Bɔrɛchu damta beeŋ shi awɔlpa so m ba kasawule so nɛ durnya be gbaltɔlase e gbuŋgbuŋ to. 19Kasawule beeŋ pante m baŋɛ to kaplɛkama. 20Kumo be kaman nɛ durnya na e baa lente fanɛ esa nɛ e boo nsa na, ŋko afugboŋ kaa bee ber kubuu so na. Durnya be alubi pɔɔ kumo so. Amoso k beeŋ mur nsaa maaŋ naaŋ tiŋ ŋ koso kikɛ.
21Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge esoso be eleŋana nɛ durnya to be bewuraana kusoe. 22Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gbargbar bewuraana n wɔtɔ kemaŋ gboŋ koŋwule to fanɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kabuti to na. E beeŋ ti bumo so loŋ hale nɛ bumo be kasogberge be saŋɛ e ya fo ekar. 23Kufɔl beeŋ biri to nɛ epeŋi e nyaŋɛ ŋ gben, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura. Zayɔn be kebee na so nɛ e beeŋ baa wɔ nsaa ji Jerusalɛm so kuwura nɛ basa na be benimuana e wu mbe kemaŋkura.

Title: AIZAAYA 25
Content:
Kekpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e la ma Ebɔrɛ;
Meeŋ maŋkura fo
nseŋ kpaŋ fo ketre.
Fo e wora emamachisheŋ
nɛ a bee mɔ kɔnɔ;
fo alɛ e ta kashenteŋji
n shin nɛ fo ŋkre nɛ fo wora
dra na kikɛ bɔlɔ so.
2Fo e shin nɛ ndegboŋana bure ŋ ki alambure
nɛ amo be ekuŋkpa lempoana mur.
Ewurkpaana nɛ an doŋana pɔr na
mur hale mbaanaayɔ.
3Basa nɛ b wɔ efuli lempoana so beeŋ kpaŋ fo;
nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ ndegboŋana nɛ a wɔ efuliana
nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr na to
e ŋana fo.
4Betirpo nɛ basa nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ
n chɛ bumo be amu to
shile m ba buu fo
etɔrɔ be jemanɛ
nseŋ nya bumo be amu.
Fo e kuŋ bumo ashi bɔrɛfugboŋ to
nseŋ sa bumo kayul epeŋi
nyaŋnyaŋso so.
Bedoŋ nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr
kre m ba fanɛ gbaŋgbaŋ to
be afugboŋ,
5ŋko ewule ashi kasawule wɔlso so nna.
Ama fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
shin nɛ an doŋana
lo bumo be nnɔ;
nseŋ shin nɛ basa
nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr
be awɔr kuu,
fanɛ kananɛ awɔlpa to be epeŋi
be ebeldɛ bee dugaso na.
Ebɔrɛ ka bela kejigboŋ ase be asheŋ
6Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ bela ajibi lela nɛ asɔ nuuso belbelso be kejigboŋ ase n sa durnya to be efuliana kikɛ so ebi ashi kebee nɛ baa tre Zayɔn na so ashi Jerusalɛm. 7Kebee ere so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ lara kagbenejija nɛ k du fanɛ awɔlpa a buu efuliana na kikɛ so na. 8Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mur luwu mbaanaayɔ! E beeŋ kpra anishichubi ashi ekama be anishito nseŋ lara ŋaba nɛ mbe basa ji ashi durnya kikɛ to na ashi bumo so. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e kaŋɛ.
9Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, ekama beeŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mo e la anyi be Ebɔrɛ! An ta anyi be yirda n deŋi mo so, nɛ e mɔlga anyi. Mo e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na! An ta anyi be yirda n deŋi mo so, nɛ anyi be ŋgbene fuli nɛ an nya kagbenewushi ŋkpal e ka mɔlga anyi so.”
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge Mowab kusoe be asheŋ
10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ kuŋ Zayɔn be kebee ere, ama e beeŋ chichi efuli nɛ baa tre Mowab na be basa so fanɛ ana ka chichi atuweklaŋ so n wɔtɔ depɔ to na. 11Baaŋ wora ania fanɛ baaŋ lar depɔ na to, ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wora bumo eyurto n shin nɛ b lar ŋ gben. 12E beeŋ shin nɛ Mowabebi na be kumɔlga be kakpa lempoana be egbal jeŋgreŋana e bure n tɔr ŋ ki fanɛ eshishɛr.

Title: AIZAAYA 26
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ shin nɛ mbe basa e kɔ m pɔɔ so be asheŋ
1Kachako bee ba nɛ basa e boŋ kashɛ ere ashi Juda be kasawule so:
Anyi be kadegboŋ na kɔ eleŋ!
Ebɔrɛ gbagba e naa kɔ
a kuŋ kumo be egbalana!
2Men bugi kadegboŋ na
be mbunagboŋana na
n shin nɛ efuli nɛ k bee ji kashenteŋ
nɛ kumo be basa bee wora kusɔ nɛ k niŋi na e luri to.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa basa
nɛ bumo be yirda yil to kpakpa na
kayurwushi gbagba.
4Amoso an baa yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na saŋkama,
nɛ e baa la fanɛ kefalta
a kuŋ anyi saŋkikɛ.
5Ebɔrɛ bar an doŋana
nɛ baa maŋ bumo be amu so na kaseto;
nseŋ mur kadegboŋ lempo
nɛ b daa wɔtɔ na,
nseŋ shin nɛ kumo
be egbalana bure
n tɔr kasawule.
6Naniere betirpo nɛ basa
nɛ bedoŋ na daa kɔrfɛ na
e naa chichi a chichi
kakpa nɛ kadegboŋ na
daa wɔ na so.
7Kusɔ nɛ k daga nɛ fo Enyɛnpe
Ebɔrɛ bee wora jemanɛ kikɛ,
nsaa shin nɛ ekpabi
bee ki fanɛ kegbembi
a sa basa nɛ baa wora
fo kasonu.
8Anyee bɛ fo aparsheŋ so nna
nsaa ta anyi be tama
a to fo so.
Fo nawule be ketre
nɛ anyee sha fanɛ
k baa nya kemaŋkura
ashi anyi be ŋgbene to.
9Kanyɛso kikɛ ma kagbene
bee kɔ a fin fo nna.
Fo baŋ ji durnya
nɛ kumo be basa demu,
bumo kikɛ beeŋ koya
kebaawɔtɔ ŋini so.
10Kuwɔr nɛ fo wu
kumu kpakpasowuraana ere
kikɛ be kaman,
b kraa maŋ naŋ koya
kewora kusɔ nɛ k daga.
Basa nɛ b niŋi gba
be kasawule so nfe
b kraa wora asheŋ lubi nna
nseŋ kini kewu fo,
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo doŋana
maŋ nyi fanɛ feeŋ gberge
bumo kusoe.
Shin nɛ b wu fanɛ
fee sha kebaachɛ fo basa to saŋkama nna,
nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ bumo.
Shin nɛ edɛ nɛ fo bela ase a jo fo doŋana na
e chɔɔ bumo m mur.
12Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo e naaŋ sa anyi
kedamaya nɛ kayurwushi,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
kusɔ kama nɛ anyee wora,
fo eleŋ to nɛ anyee tiŋ
a wora kumo.
13Beko gba daŋ ji kuwura anyi so
n ti fo, Enyɛnpe
anyi be Ebɔrɛ na so,
ama fo nawule
nɛ anyee wora kasonu.
14Bumo kikɛ wu naniere
nsaa maaŋ naa wɔ ŋkpa to.
Bumo be abuniyoyu
maaŋ naŋ koso kikɛ,
ŋkpal fo ka gberge bumo kusoe nseŋ mur bumo so.
Esa maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo kikɛ.
15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e shin
nɛ anyi be basa wora keshi,
fo e kpalga anyi be efuli
be egbaŋ kaba kama so;
nɛ kumo be loŋ bar fo kemaŋkura.
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo gberge
fo basa kusoe,
nɛ b ta kagbenejija nɛ kushu ŋ kule fo.
17Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fo wora
anyi na so,
an daŋ ji awurfoŋ fanɛ eche
nɛ kakurge ta mo nna.
18An daa wɔ ebesa damta to
nna fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta na,
ama anyi alɛ daa maŋ kurge.
An daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so kikɛ
ashi anyi be kasawule so;
anyi alɛ maŋ tiŋ n wora
ŋko n nya shɛŋ
n sa basa durnya to.
19Anyi be basa nɛ b wu na
beeŋ naŋ ba ŋkpa to!
Bumo be eyurana
beeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba ŋkpa to.
Bekama nɛ baa di
bumo be nchaŋana to na
beeŋ naŋ koso m boŋ nshɛ kagbenefuliso
Kananɛ kachipurso be bunyaŋ
bee shin nɛ nsawule
bee wushi na,
loŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ naŋ tiŋi basa
nɛ b wu dra dra na.
20Ma basa, men luri
menyi be ebuana to
nseŋ ti menyi be amu so n wɔtɔ.
Men ŋana ndoŋ gbrɛbi,
n ya fo fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be agbo ka beeŋ wushi.
21Keni, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ shi ebɔrɛso
m ba gberge durnya to
be basa kusoe
ŋkpal bumo alubi so.
Basa kama nɛ b mɔ
ashiri to na
be asheŋ beeŋ lar efuli
nɛ b nya kumo be kasogberge.

Title: AIZAAYA 27
Content:
Israɛl be kumɔlga be asheŋ
1Kamɔnchɛ kaŋ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta mbe tokobi nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga na ŋ gberge kusɔbɔya gbeyeso gboŋgboŋi nɛ k wɔ teku to nɛ baa tre kumo Liviatan na kusoe m mɔ kumo. 2Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, le nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kaŋɛ a laŋɛ mbe ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ lela na be kaplɛa so: 3“Mee keni kudɔ na so nna nsaa wurge kumo so nchu jemanɛ kikɛ. Ma alɛ naa kuŋ kumo kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ tiŋ n tɔrɔ kumo. 4Kumo be kaman, m maŋ naŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ ndibi sɔrso be kudɔ na. Nɛ fanɛ ewi be yiri yiri kɔr kumo to gba, meeŋ tia amo kikɛ n chɔɔ m mur cheche. 5Ama nɛ ma basa bumo doŋana bee sha fanɛ m baa kuŋ bumo bre, b shin nɛ ma nɛ bumo e nya kayurwushi anyi be kefɛato.”
6Kachako bee ba nɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b la Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi na e mur achin fanɛ kedibi nɛ k purge nseŋ wora atoto na. Saŋɛ na so bumo be asɔrso beeŋ chase durnya be kaplɛkama.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maŋ naŋ gberge Israɛl be basa kusoe kenishipereso nseŋ mɔ bumo be basa fanɛ kananɛ e gberge bumo doŋana kusoe nseŋ mɔ bumo be basa na. 8Kasogberge nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na sa mbe basa e la fanɛ e shin nna nɛ bumo doŋana kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so nseŋ pɛ bumo n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so n ya ki anya. Bumo bedoŋana na daa du fanɛ epeŋilarkpa be afu tushiso nna m ba ber bumo n yɔ kufɔ kufɔ. 9Ekpa koŋwule so nɛ Israɛlebi beeŋ tiŋ m bɔla so n nya bumo be alubi nɛ kewora n jija be ketampaŋ. A daga fanɛ b bure nnyamase be agbirsure nɛ b pɔr a chɔɔ eduwu amo so na nseŋ tia kegbirche nɛ baa tre Ashira na be ndibi tenteŋ nɛ b yuu na kikɛ n lɛ.
10Kadegboŋ nɛ k kɔ egbal kuŋso lempoana na e ki alambure fanɛ keshishɛrsawule nɛ ekama maŋ wɔ kumo to, a dese na. K ki ana be ejikpa nɛ kakpa nɛ baa dese a wushi nna. 11Kumo to be ndibi be ayabi bee wɔl nna a buri a tɔr nɛ beche bee kil amo a puga edɛ. Ŋkpal basa na ka maŋ pin asheŋ to na so, Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to bumo na maaŋ wu bumo kuwɔr ŋko n shu bumo so.
12Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e yili Lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na n ya fo Ijipt be egbaŋ to na ŋ gama mbe basa abar so fanɛ kananɛ baa beri ayu a chela to a deŋi abar so na. 13Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, kabel beeŋ shu awɔrso n tre Israɛlebi nɛ b pɛ n yɔ kenyaya to ashi Asiriya nɛ Ijipt be efuliana so na. Baaŋ bɛta m ba kaa shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na mbe kebee cheembi na so ashi Jerusalɛm to.

Title: AIZAAYA 28
Content:
Samɛria be kasogberge be asheŋ
1Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa Israɛl be kuwurji na. Kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Samɛria nɛ k dese ketaŋɛ nɛ k bee wora adɔjibi ga na be ekarso na wɔ asheŋ to pasaa. Kumo be bejuŋkparpoana la basa booso nsaa maŋ bumo be amu so, a sha kebaaji nsaa nuu nsa a boo ga. Baaŋ ki fanɛ atoto a wɔl m bolo nna. 2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na teŋ nya esa ko nɛ e kɔ eleŋ nɛ yuku nseŋ wora shiriya nɛ e kɔ bumo. E la esa nɛ e beeŋ ba fanɛ bɔrɛfugboŋ nɛ kumo nɛ bɔrɛchu wea abar to a ba nɛ k ba buu kasawule so na nna. 3Bejuŋkparpo booso na be kusɔ nɛ baa puchi so beeŋ mur nɛ basa e baa chichi kumo a choŋ. 4Bumo be kemaŋkura nɛ k bee terge na beeŋ foe fanɛ asɔrso nɛ a juŋkpar m bel kafɛ to, nɛ basa bee fuu amo a ji na.
5Loŋ be kacha na, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ baa du fanɛ atoto be kuwurwuro lela n sa mbe basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute a wɔtɔ na; mannɛ fanɛ Samɛria nɛ k du fanɛ atoto nɛ a wɔl m bolo n chuge n tɔr na. 6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sa demujipoana kashenteŋji be nfɛra nseŋ sa kadegboŋ na be mbuna kenipoana kenyɛn be kagbene nɛ b baa tiŋ a kuŋ kadegboŋ na.
Aizaaya nɛ Juda be anebi boosoana na be asheŋ
7Anebiana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana gba boo nna a jante. B nuu yabra nɛ nsa booso ga nna hale nɛ bumo be nfɛra mel to. Anebiana na kaa bee boo ga so, b maŋ naa pin ebɔrɛdare nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa bumo na to. Bɔrɛmatapoana na malɛ gba kaa bee boo ga so, b maŋ naa tiŋ a ji asheŋ nɛ basa bee ta a ba bumo kutɔ nɛnɛ. 8B kwiɛ n sɔ mbɛ nɛ b chena so na kikɛ nna nɛ ndoŋ kikɛ bee dufɛ ekwiɛ.
9A le nɛ b daa bile asheŋ a kaŋɛ a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so: “Wanɛ nɛ kanyɛn ere bee fɛ fanɛ e bee ŋini asheŋ? Wanɛ e naa sha mbe kubɔya? K walɛ n sa mbibi nɛ b baŋ ku kenyipo nawule nna! 10E bee wora ania nna nɛ e baa ŋini anyi nsibɛbi nɛ mmalgabi nɛ a maŋ kɔ afito.”
11Nɛ menyi maaŋ nu n sa ma, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ befɔ nɛ baa gbar ŋgbar pɔtɛ e ŋini menyi asheŋ. 12E bee sha kesa menyi kikɛ ewushi nɛ kayurwushi nna, ama men kini kenu n sa mo. 13Amoso nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee sha keŋini menyi nsibɛbi nɛ mmalgabi nɛ menyi maaŋ pin to na. Kumo be kaman keya kama nɛ menyeeŋ tia, menyeeŋ fiti n tɔr n doro nɛ b naŋ pɛ menyi fanɛ anya.
Zayɔn be kebonfu to be kejembu na be asheŋ
14To, menyi basa kpeŋso nɛ menyee ji kuwura basa ere so ashi Jerusalɛm to na e kaŋ asoe n nu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ. 15Menyee ka kaŋɛ fanɛ menyi ere nɛ luwu wora kɔnɔ nna, nɛ menyi nɛ basa nɛ b wu n yɔ bubuni to be nnɔ wora kukoŋwule. Men yirda fanɛ jɛrbi kama nɛ k beeŋ ba maaŋ wora menyi shɛŋ ŋkpal efɛ nɛ kafule be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ men wɔtɔ na so. 16To, kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nde: “Mee tɔl gbaltɔlase nɛ k kɔ eleŋ a yil a maa gbuŋgbuŋ nna ashi Zayɔn to. Ma alɛ beeŋ ta kejembu nɛ bepɔrpo keni to n lara fanɛ kebonfu to be kejembu nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga na nna n nase gbaltɔlase na, nɛ b sibɛ le n deŋi kumo so, ‘Yirda nɛ k yil to kpakpa kɔ kanyiti nna.’ 17Kewora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nɛ asheŋ niŋiso e naaŋ baa la efɔl nɛ meeŋ baa ta a kargaso a pɔr nɛ k baa niŋi.
Bɔrɛjembubi nɛ bɔrɛchu beeŋ bɔlɔ m mur efɛsheŋ nɛ men ta a kuŋ menyi be amu na nseŋ sulɔ amo kikɛ n ya lɛ.” 18Menyi nɛ luwu be kɔnɔ nɛ men wora na nɛ kananɛ menyi nɛ basa nɛ b wu n yɔ bubuni to be nnɔ wora kukoŋwule na beeŋ ba ekar. Kumo be kaman nɛ jɛrbi e ba menyi so fanɛ nchu ka bɔlɔ n sulɔ menyi n yɔ na. 19Jɛrbi beeŋ gbelge menyi so kachipurso nɛ kapaso nɛ kanyɛso kikɛ nna fanɛ nchu ka bee bɔlɔ a ba na. Kubɔya popɔr kama malɛ nɛ k beeŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba menyi kutɔ beeŋ ta kufugboŋ m pɛ menyi! 20Menyeeŋ baa du fanɛ esa nɛ b bɔ keŋasa ere a laŋɛ mbe kaplɛa so na nna. B yɛ, e wora ania nɛ e dese gedo shiimbi nɛ e maaŋ tiŋ n teŋi mbe aya to so nseŋ naŋ ta keta nɛ k maŋ wɔ mpar nɛ k tiŋ m buu mo kikɛ so m buu nna. 21Kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na baŋ kɔ kenishipereso ashi kebee nɛ baa tre Perazim na so nɛ ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Gibiɔn na to na nɛ e beeŋ naŋ kɔ le be jemanɛ ere gba. Saŋɛ na so e beeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ e kre kewora na, nɛ k chinchiŋ menyi ŋkpal men ka maa tama kumo so.
22Men sa maŋ kaa mushe kasokpele nɛ mee sa menyi ere! Nɛ men kaŋ wora loŋ, k beeŋ baa du kpakpa n sa menyi nɛ men nya n lar asheŋ to. N nu fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na yili kumo nna fanɛ e beeŋ mur efuli na kikɛ.
Ebɔrɛ be kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ
23Men nu kusɔ mee malga ere nseŋ wɔtɔ lakal kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi ere to. 24Edɔpo kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ a lɔŋɛ mbe kudɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ mbaanaayɔ. 25E baŋ lɔŋɛ so n dɔ n loge e bee ŋmenyaŋ epofantaŋ be aduuso nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ e duu aboyu nɛ ayu mbure so nseŋ duu aduuso pɔtɛ n wɔtɔ egbaŋ to. 26Edɔpo na nyi mbe kushuŋ nna ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e ŋini mo kumo. 27E maa ta ndibi gbɛgbɛso a beri ayu a bɛa amo to. Ndibi nɛ a kukwe nseŋ daga nɛ e bee ta a beri amo. 28Mo alɛ maa beri ayu na nna hale nɛ a nia n luri eshishɛr to ŋko nɛ a bɛa to ŋ ki nyifu. E bee beri amo nna a lara bibi na ashi amimi na to. 29Kanyiasheŋ ere kikɛ shi Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nna. Ebɔrɛ bee kre ŋkre kanyiasheŋ so nna, nɛ amo alɛ bee wora a bɔlɔ so jemanɛ kikɛ!

Title: AIZAAYA 29
Content:
Jerusalɛm nɛ k la ewura Deevid be kadegboŋ na be asheŋ
1Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa Jerusalɛm, kakpa nɛ ma bɔrɛsure na wɔ nɛ k la kadegboŋ nɛ Deevid daŋ chena kumo to na! Kumo to be basa beeŋ tiŋ a ji bumo be nchɛgboŋ kafɛ kafɛ kikɛ. 2Ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ jɛrbi e ba kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre “Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛsure” na so. Kagbenejija nɛ kushu beeŋ baa wɔ kadegboŋ na to nɛ k ki fanɛ bɔrɛsure nɛ ŋklaŋ gbiti kumo kikɛ na. 3Ebɔrɛ beeŋ kre kena m ba kulti kadegboŋ na kikɛ n wɔtɔ ŋ kɔ kumo. 4Jerusalɛm beeŋ ki fanɛ kebuniyoyu ka wɔ nchaŋ to a wora ania nɛ e malga fanɛ ebɔl ka fɛa nseŋ shi kasawule to a malga nɛ k maa nu to na.
5Afu beeŋ ber befɔ kama nɛ baa kɔ fo, Jerusalɛm, na n yɔ fanɛ kalabɛr na, nɛ bumo be benapo nɛ bumo be asheŋ kɔ kufu na e firgi n choŋ fanɛ amimi na. Jemanɛ nɛ ekama maa tama fanɛ kusɔ ko beeŋ wora na 6nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ bɔla bɔrɛfugboŋ nɛ kebembeŋ so ŋ kɔ n suge menyi n yige. E beeŋ shin nɛ afugboŋ nɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ e ba. 7Kumo be kaman nɛ efuliana nɛ a bee kɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ k la Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛsure be kadegboŋ na be benapo nɛ bumo be akɔsɔ kikɛ e foe basa be anishi so fanɛ esa ka ku edare kanyɛso nseŋ teŋ kumo so kachipurso na. 8Efuliana nɛ a beeŋ gama abar so a kɔ Jerusalɛm na beeŋ baa du fanɛ esa nɛ akoŋ bee mɔ nɛ e ku edare fanɛ e kaa bee ji nseŋ yeŋi n tiŋi na nna. Ŋko achukoŋ ka bee mɔ esa nɛ e ku edare fanɛ e kaa bee nuu nchu nseŋ yeŋi n tiŋi nɛ mbe ebɔlto kraŋ wɔlto na nna.
Kegal kasokpele n lɛ be asheŋ
9Asheŋ beeŋ chinchiŋ menyi anebiana na nseŋ mɔ menyi kɔnɔ! Menyeeŋ buu anishi so fanɛ etanpo a wɔtɔ! Menyeeŋ boo a jante nɛ menyi maŋ nuu nsa! 10Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ menyi be anishi bee biri menyi nɛ edi bee la menyi na. Menyi anebiana na e daga fanɛ b baa wu asheŋ a kaŋɛ basa na, ama Ebɔrɛ buu menyi be anishi so nna nɛ men maŋ naa wu asheŋ a pin to. 11Kewuŋkaŋɛ be bɔrɛdare kikɛ be kifito beeŋ ŋana menyi so. K beeŋ baa du fanɛ kawɔl nɛ b ber so nna n ta n sa menyi. Men ta kumo n yɔ esa nɛ e nyi kakraŋ kutɔ fanɛ e kraŋ kumo n sa menyi gba, e beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e maaŋ tiŋ ŋkpal k kaa ber so so. 12Menyi alɛ ta kumo n sa esa nɛ e maŋ nyi kakraŋ fanɛ e kraŋ kumo n sa menyi, e beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e maŋ nyi kakraŋ.
13Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Nnɔ fuloŋ nɛ basa ere kɔ a shuŋ ma nɛ bumo be ŋgbene malɛ maŋ wɔ ma so. Edimɛdi be mbra nɛ edaŋkare nɛ b bii n wɔtɔ amu to nawule nɛ baa bɛ so a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ. 14Amoso meeŋ wora asheŋ nɛ a beeŋ chinchiŋ bumo nseŋ chɔɔ bumo be ŋgbene to nɛ bumo be nnɔ e mɔ bumo. Bumo to be benyiashempo beeŋ ki bewulpo nɛ bumo be kashennyi e ki jiga.”
Echefoso be tama be asheŋ
15Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bekama nɛ baa ta bumo be ŋkre a ŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so na! Baa wora asheŋ ŋgbalanto nna a fɛ fanɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ wu bumo ŋko m pin kusɔ nɛ baa wora na. 16Baa melgi kusɔ kama na nna a buu. Epɔrpo nɛ ebɔ nɛ e kɔ a pɔr na, emo e bɔ? Kusɔ nɛ esa lɔŋɛ beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ esa na fanɛ: “Manɛ fo e lɔŋɛ ma a?” Ŋko ŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ “Fo maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ fee wora ere a?”
17Aloŋ nɛ baa kaa kaŋɛ fanɛ k maaŋ chɛr, kupuŋ beeŋ ki kudɔsawule nɛ kudɔsawule malɛ e ki kupuŋ.
18Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, ekpawu beeŋ nu b kaa bee kraŋ kawɔl awɔrso nɛ etanpo, nɛ b wɔ tentembiri to, e bugi anishi a wu. 19Nɛ betirpo nɛ basa nɛ b du boeŋ e nya kagbenefuli nɛ Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na bee sa na. 20Basa nɛ baa mɛaŋ beko nsaa keni Ebɔrɛ jiga na be ekar nna na. Alubiworapo kikɛ beeŋ mur loŋ be kachɛ na. 21Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mur bekama nɛ baa ku efɛ a jija beko be atre, nɛ bumo nɛ baa kuŋ belubiworapo ashi kasogberge to na. E beeŋ mur bekama nɛ baa ku efɛ demujikpa a shin nɛ basa nɛ baa ji kashenteŋ maa nya kashenteŋ na gba.
22Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e mɔlga bumo nananyɛn Eebraham dra dra na ashi etɔrɔ to na kaŋɛ nde: “Menyi ma basa maaŋ naŋ ji anishinyɔr kikɛ, nyɔmɔ malɛ maaŋ naŋ mɔ menyi. 23Men kaŋ wu mbia nɛ meeŋ sa menyi na pɔɛŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na. Saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ maŋkura ma nseŋ bunyaŋ ma. 24Kumo be kaman nɛ basa nɛ b maa pin asheŋ to na e fara a pin asheŋ to, nɛ bumo nɛ baa munto a bile asheŋ malɛ e sɔ ma keŋini kagbenefuliso.”

Title: AIZAAYA 30
Content:
Asheŋ ka maaŋ nyalɛ n sa efuli kpeŋso na be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa nɛ baa ji kuwura Juda be efuli so na ŋkpal b ka lar ma kaman a maa nu a sa ma so. Baa bɛ ŋkre nɛ m maŋ wora so nna nseŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ efuli ko so ebi bee wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ m maa sha kumo be loŋ. B wɔtɔ nna a wora alubi a deŋi abar so. 2Ade be kaman, baa yɔ Ijipt be efuli so nna n ya kaa fin kechɛto a maa bishi ma shɛŋ. Baa sha fanɛ Ijipt e baa kuŋ bumo nna, amoso b ta bumo be yirda nna n wɔtɔ Ijipt be ewura to. 3Ama Ijipt be ewura na maaŋ baa kɔ eleŋ nɛ e tiŋ n chɛ bumo to. Ijipt be kekuŋ na beeŋ bar bumo ŋaba nna. 4Juda be basa be mbɔ teŋ yɔ Ijipt be efuli so be ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Zowan nɛ Hanes na, 5ama Ijiptebi na maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ bumo. Keyirda loŋ be efuli na la jiga nna nsaa la kawulisheŋ n ti so.”
6Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya nɛ e sa asɔbɔya nɛ a wɔ kiyi nɛ k wɔ Juda be efuli so be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na nde: “Menyi basa ere bee ta ekurma nɛ enyɔma a sulɔ asɔ lela nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa a bɔla efuli lubiana nɛ ebuluŋ nɛ awɔ lubi wɔ amoso to a yɔ efuli nɛ k maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ menyi to so. 7Ijipt be kechɛto maŋ la shɛŋ. Amoso nɛ mee tre kumo ‘Kusɔ gbeyeso nɛ k du fanɛ laŋchaŋ a maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ na.’ ”
Basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ kasonu be asheŋ
8Ade be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ n sibɛ kusɔ nɛ basa bee sha kebaanu be asheŋ n wɔtɔ kawɔl ko to, saŋɛ na so kusɔ ko beeŋ baa dese a laŋɛ bumo be kananɛ b lubi be kaplɛa so mbaanaayɔ. 9B wɔtɔ nna a lar Ebɔrɛ kaman nsaa ku efɛ nsaa kini kebaanu a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be keŋini. 10Bumo alɛ bee kaŋɛ anebiana na nna fanɛ b baa lo bumo be nnɔ to. Kusɔ nɛ baa kaŋɛ bumo e la: “Men sa maa kaŋɛ anyi kusɔ nɛ k daga be asheŋ. Men baa kaŋɛ anyi asheŋ nɛ anyee sha kebaanu na, hale nɛ a maŋ la kashenteŋ gba. 11Men yige kebaakaŋɛ anyi kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ be asheŋ! Anyi maŋ naa sha kenu shɛŋ a laŋɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na be kaplɛa so.”
12Ama kusɔ nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na kaŋɛ nde: “Men kplaŋ kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi so nseŋ ta menyi be yirda n deŋi kanyaŋ nɛ efɛsheŋ so. 13Men wora n jija. Men ki fanɛ egbal jeŋgreŋ nɛ k yili esoso m baŋɛ m ba fo kaseto nna. Menyi alɛ beeŋ tiŋ n tɔr epul to. 14Men ki fanɛ kapuya nɛ k bure to kpachɛrkpachɛrbi nna nɛ kumo be kapɛlanfu kama maaŋ tiŋ n chɔ edɛ ŋko m jɔ nchu.”
15Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na kaŋɛ basa na le: “Men bɛta m ba kaa yirda ma nsaa du boeŋ. Aloŋ nɛ menyeeŋ nya eleŋ nɛ kekuŋgboŋ.” Ama men kini kewora loŋ! 16Kusɔ nɛ menyee fɛ e la fanɛ menyeeŋ dii egbaŋɛ shileso n shile m mɔlga menyi be amu ŋkpal men doŋana so. Menyee fɛ fanɛ menyi be egbaŋɛ beeŋ tiŋ n shile ga ama bumo nɛ baa ju a buu menyi so na peya beeŋ shile a chɔ bumo nɛ b pɛ menyi. 17Menyi to be basa kagboŋ beeŋ wu bedoŋ be enapo koŋwule nseŋ shile nɛ bumo be benapo anu e shin nɛ menyi kikɛ e shile. Kumo be lalaloge menyi to be basa gbrɛbi e naaŋ ka nsaa du fanɛ kedibi nɛ b ta tuta n chɛ m mata n yuu kebee be awɔlto na. 18Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kraa jo nɛ e wu menyi kuwɔr nna. E wora shiriya nɛ e shu menyi so ŋkpal e kaa bee wora asheŋ nɛ a daga jemanɛ kikɛ na so. Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ bumo be yirda wɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na to na peya nna.
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ nɛfa mbe basa be asheŋ
19Men basa nɛ men wɔ Jerusalɛm to maaŋ naŋ shu kikɛ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la ewɔrwupo nna nɛ men shu n tre mo fanɛ e chɛ menyi to, e beeŋ nu n sa menyi. 20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ men luri jemanɛ kpakpaso to, ama mo gbagba e naaŋ ŋini menyi ekpa nɛ men bɔla so n lar kpakpa na to; nɛ men maaŋ naa kulti a fin mo gba. 21Nɛ fanɛ men foe ekpa a yɔ jisoso ŋko bena so gba, menyeeŋ nu mbe ebɔl menyi be kamanto ka bee kaŋɛ le: “Ekpa na nde. Men bɔla kumo so.” 22Saŋɛ na so nɛ men ta menyi be agbirana nɛ men ŋalga shuwa nɛ gbiti n wurge amo so na n ya lɛ fanɛ epi na nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Men baa yɔ, anyi maŋ naa sha menyi.”
23Ade be kaman, jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ men duu asɔ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛchu e ba nɛ a kɔr n daŋ nseŋ wora nɛnɛ nɛ men teŋi. Men be asɔbɔya malɛ gba beeŋ nya ejikpa damta a ji. 24Egbolu nɛ ekurma nɛ men kɔ a dɔ menyi be adɔ na gba beeŋ baa nya afitiri bumbuŋ nɛ awɔlso lela ga a ji. 25Kachɛ nɛ menyeeŋ kɔ n suge men doŋana be ebu lempoana nseŋ mɔ bumo be basa na, nɛ mbombi beeŋ shile abee nɛ apreŋ kikɛ so ŋ gbelge to. 26Kufɔl beeŋ fuli to parr fanɛ epeŋi nɛ epeŋi malɛ e fuli to ale ashunu so n ti so, a du fanɛ nchɛnshunu be kefulto na. Kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ fɔr nseŋ kre mbe basa be achuu nseŋ chɛ bumo be alɔana na nɛ le beeŋ wora.
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge Asiriya kusoe be asheŋ
27Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ nɛ kemaŋkura shi kufɔ kufɔ a ba. Edɛ nɛ edishi e naa ŋini mbe agbo. E malga nɛ mbe kɔnɔ to be mmalga bee chɔ fanɛ edɛ na. 28E shin nɛ afu juŋkpar mo fanɛ nchugboŋ ka bu n sulɔ kusɔ kama a yɔ nna. Nchugboŋ na sulɔ efuliana na n yɔ kemur to nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be ŋkre lubiana kikɛ ba ekar. 29Ama menyi, Ebɔrɛ be basa bre be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi nɛ men baa boŋ nshɛ fanɛ kananɛ menyee wora nchɛgboŋ cheembiana be kanyɛso na. Menyi be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi fanɛ basa nɛ b ta nlopi a boŋ nshɛ a yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee kuŋ Israɛl na be bɔrɛlambu to na.
30Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ ekama e nu mbe ebɔlgboŋ nɛ k kɔ kufu na nɛ mbe agbogboŋ nɛ k du fanɛ edɛ wuloŋ wuloŋ nɛ bɔrɛfugboŋ nɛ abɔrɛjembubi nɛ bɔrɛchu damta na be asheŋ. 31Jemanɛ nɛ Asiriya be basa beeŋ nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ebɔl nseŋ wu mbe kasogberge be eleŋ na, kufu gboŋgboŋi beeŋ tɔr bumo so. 32Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa beeŋ baa laŋ ŋkure nɛ ejaŋjilaŋ a wɔtɔ mo jemanɛ nɛ e bee kɔ nsaa laŋɛ a kɔ Asiriya be basa na. 33Dra dra na kikɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bela kakpa nɛ edɛgboŋ beeŋ chɔ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ m mɔ na ase n yili. Ndoŋ la kakpa chiŋgeliŋ nsaa wɔ mpar nna nɛ ndibi biti abar so kumo to. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ fute edɛ be adondulombi n wɔtɔ ndibi na to nɛ a suseso.

Title: AIZAAYA 31
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ kuŋ Jerusalɛm be asheŋ
1Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bekama nɛ baa yɔ Ijipt be efuli so n ya kaa fin kechɛto na! Baa ta bumo be amu nna a deŋi Ijipt be benapo be egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko be keshi nɛ benapo lempo so. Ama b maa ta bumo be amu a deŋi Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na so ŋko a fin mbe kechɛto. 2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malɛ nyi kusɔ nɛ e bee wora! Mo e naa sa ekpa nɛ jɛrbi bee ba. Kusɔ kama nɛ e kaŋɛ, kumo nɛ e bee wora. Mo e naa gberge basa lubi nɛ bumo be bekumpo kikɛ kusoe. 3Ijiptebi na maŋ la Ebɔrɛ, edimɛdi e la bumo. Bumo be egbaŋɛ gba maŋ la kiyoyu to be asɔ nɛ a beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baaŋ ŋini mbe eleŋgboŋ, efuli lempo bee mur nna nɛ efuli pɔso nɛ k bee chɛ to na e tɔr. Saŋɛ na so nɛ efuli anyɔ na kikɛ e mur.
4Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Awɔr kama nɛ mbolpɔkpapo beeŋ wora maaŋ tiŋ n funti buluŋ nɛ e yige kusɔbɔya nɛ e pɛ na. Aloŋ koŋwule na nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na, e yige kebaakuŋ Zayɔn be kebee na. 5Kananɛ kabuibi bee firgi a kulti kumo be kesha a kuŋ kumo be bibi na nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ ŋ kuŋ Jerusalɛm.”
6Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Menyi Israɛl be basa wora kulubi n da ma so nseŋ kini ma. Ama naniere, men bɛta m ba ma kutɔ! 7Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ menyi kikɛ e ta agbir nɛ men ta shuwa nɛ gbiti n lɔŋɛ nseŋ bɔla amo so n wora alubi n da ma so na n lɛ. 8Saŋɛ na so Asiriya be basa beeŋ mur kena to nɛ mannɛ dimɛdi be eleŋ e mur bumo. Baaŋ shile kena nɛ bumo doŋana e pɛ bumo be mbrantiɛfɔlbi ŋ ki anya. 9Bumo be ewurgboŋ beeŋ lara keya n shile ŋkpal kufu so nɛ kufugboŋ e tɔr bumo be benapo be benimuana na so nɛ b shile ŋ ka bumo be kena to be etuuta n lɛ kaman.” Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ baa shuŋ mo Jerusalɛm to nɛ mbe edɛ bee chɔɔ esarga ndoŋ na kaŋɛ nna na.

Title: AIZAAYA 32
Content:
Ewura nɛ e kɔ ketre lela be asheŋ
1Kachako bee ba nɛ ewura ko e ba ta kashenteŋji a ji kuwura nɛ efuli na be benimu malɛ e baa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be akpa so. 2Ewura na nɛ benimuana na beeŋ baa du fanɛ kusɔ kuŋ afu nɛ kakpa nɛ esa beeŋ shile n ya ŋana bɔrɛfu so nna. Bumo alɛ beeŋ baa du fanɛ mbombi ashi kiyi to nɛ kefaltagboŋ nɛ k bee kuŋ epeŋi a sa kayul. 3Baaŋ bugi anishi a wu nseŋ bugi asoe a nu basa be asheŋ tirso. 4Bumo alɛ beeŋ baa kɔ kanyiti, nsaa pin asheŋ to nseŋ naa wora asheŋ nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ baaŋ baa wora na. 5Ewura nɛ mbe benimuana maaŋ naŋ sa bewulpo bunyaŋ ŋko n sa basa jiga fanɛ beyu kemaŋkura be eyilikpa. 6Bewulpo bee malga kawuli be mmalga nna nsaa kre asheŋ lubi be kewora be nia. Kusɔ kama nɛ baa wora ŋko a kaŋɛ la katege nna n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Bumo alɛ maa sa basa nɛ akoŋ kɔ ajibi ŋko basa nɛ achukoŋ kɔ nchu. 7Esa nɛ e maa ji kashenteŋ la esa lubi nna nsaa wora asheŋ lubi nawule. E bee kre kebɔla efɛ so nna m mur betirpo nseŋ kuŋ bumo ekpa nɛ b sa maŋ nya kusɔ nɛ k daga bumo. 8Ama esa nɛ ekama bee sa bunyaŋ bre bee ji kashenteŋ nna nsaa yil kusɔ nɛ k niŋi so a wora asheŋ.
Jerusalɛm to be beche be kasogberge be asheŋ
9Menyi beche nɛ men wɔtɔ a maa wora shɛŋ nsaa ji kananɛ menyee sha fanɛ kusɔ ko ka maŋ tir menyi na, e kaŋ asoe n nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere. 10Ashere shɛŋ maŋ tir menyi naniere, ama ta a ba kafɛ a ba saŋɛ ere so kagbenejija damta beeŋ tɔr menyi so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ndibi be asɔrso maaŋ sɔr nɛ b nya n wora yabra n sa menyi nɛ men baa nuu. 11Men daa wɔtɔ nna fanɛ shɛŋ ka maŋ tir menyi, ama naniere men shin kufu e baa kɔ menyi nɛ men baa chicha! Men gbaŋ menyi be asɔbuuso n lɛ nseŋ ta keeli be asɔbuuso m buu. 12Men ta kagbenejija a ber ŋgbene so ŋkpal nsawule lela nɛ a bee wora adɔjibi nɛ ndibi sɔrso kikɛ nɛnɛ na ka mur, 13nɛ ewi be yiri yiri kɔr ma basa be nsawule so so. Men baa shu anishichubi ŋkpal kagbenefuli nɛ k maŋ naa wɔ basa be elaŋ to ashi kadegboŋ nɛ kebaawɔtɔ daa nite nɛnɛ kumo to na so. 14Basa beeŋ shile n lar ewurkpa ŋ ka kumo fuloŋ nɛ basa be elaŋ nɛ ebu lempoana nɛ a daa kuŋ basa na kikɛ e ki alambure a dese hale mbaanaayɔ. Kumo be kaman nɛ ndoŋ e ki ekurma be epelkpa nɛ mbolpɔ be ejikpa.
15Ama Ebɔrɛ kraa beeŋ naŋ sa anyi mbe kiyoyu. Nsawule pɔso na beeŋ naŋ ki nsawule lela nɛ a kɔ eleŋ nɛ adɔsawule e wora adɔjibi nɛnɛ ga. 16Saŋɛ na basa beeŋ baa kɔ kashenteŋji nsaa wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi nsaa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so ashi kasawule na be kaplɛkama. 17Ŋkpal ekama ka beeŋ baa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga so, kayurwushi beeŋ ba nɛ kufu maaŋ naa kɔ esa kama mbaanaayɔ. 18-19Hale nɛ bɔrɛ ba nɛ abɔrɛjembubi tɔr kupo to be ndibi so nɛ basa be kananɛ baa puchi bumo be ndegboŋana so duga so gba, Ebɔrɛ be basa bre maaŋ baa wɔ kafɔŋ to. Kayurwushi beeŋ baa wɔ bumo be elaŋana to nɛ b maaŋ naa ŋana kufu. 20Ekama be kagbene beeŋ fuli mo ŋkpal bɔrɛchu damta nɛ adɔjibi beeŋ nya n wora nɛnɛ, nɛ ekurma nɛ ana malɛ gba e nya afitiri lela a ji nsaa nite yila yila so na so.

Title: AIZAAYA 33
Content:
Kekule n fin kechɛto be asheŋ
1Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa an doŋana! B suge anyi be asɔ nseŋ naŋ debɔr anyi, ama esa kama maŋ naŋ suge bumo ere be asɔ ŋko debɔr bumo. Bumo be kasuge nɛ kedebɔr be jemanɛ beeŋ fo ekar nɛ beko malɛ e suge bumo be asɔ nseŋ debɔr bumo.
2Jande, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, wu anyi kuwɔr. Fo nɛ an ta anyi be tama n deŋi so. Baa kuŋ anyi karechɛ kama nsaa mɔlga anyi ashi etɔrɔ to. 3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nɛ fo baa kɔ a sa anyi, efuli pɔtɛana be basa beeŋ nu kena be asheŋ nseŋ shile. 4Saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ mel abar so fanɛ elotɔr n fuu bumo be asɔ n shile.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e chɔ esa kikɛ nsaa ji kuwura kusɔ kama so. E beeŋ shin nɛ kashenteŋji nɛ asheŋ niŋiso be kebaawora e bɔlɔ Jerusalɛm to. 6Mo nɛ anyee fute a yige so, ŋkpal e kaa bee mɔlga mbe basa jemanɛ kikɛ nsaa sa bumo kanyiasheŋ nɛ kashennyi damta so. Kebaaŋana Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nsaa nu a sa mo nɛ baaŋ baa sha kewora ga a chɔ kusɔ kikɛ.
7Benapo nɛ b kɔ kenyɛn bee kɔ a fin kechɛto ashi kadegboŋ na be agbembi so nna. Anyi be mbɔ daa tama kayurwushi nna, ama kushu nɛ b ta m ba epe. 8Esa kikɛ daa maŋ naa yɔ enite to nɛ ekpaana na kikɛ dese fuloŋ. Basa maŋ naa wora a bɔlɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre so. Bumo alɛ maaŋ naa sa esa kama nɛ e bee bɛ mbe nnɔ naseso so bunyaŋ. 9Nsawule kikɛ wɔl a dese jiga. Lebanɔn be kupo na wɔl ŋ gbaŋgbaŋ afantaŋ nɛ Sharɔn be ketaŋɛ lela na ki fanɛ keshishɛrsawule. Ndibi nɛ a wɔ Bashan nɛ kebee nɛ baa tre Kamɛl na so gbaŋgbaŋ amo be afantaŋ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka fiɛ mo doŋana so be asheŋ
10Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ efuli pɔtɛana na le: “Naniere meeŋ wora kusɔ ko ŋ ŋini ma eleŋgboŋ. 11Menyee kaa kre ŋkre fuloŋ nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora bee to jiga. Ma kɔnɔ to be afu du fanɛ edɛ nɛ k beeŋ mur menyi nna. 12Menyeeŋ chɔɔ ŋ ki nsunɔ fanɛ afitiri wɔlso ka ji edɛ na. 13Bekama nɛ b wɔ kufɔ ŋko n taga to, beeŋ nu kusɔ nɛ n wora nseŋ shuli so fanɛ ma eleŋgboŋ bee shuŋ kashenteŋto.”
14Kufugboŋ beeŋ tɔr Jerusalɛm be basa lubi nɛ b maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ na so nɛ b baa chicha. B yɛ: “Ebɔrɛ be demuji du fanɛ edɛ nɛ k bee chɔ a maa duŋ nna. Anyi to be beko beeŋ tiŋ n luri edɛ ere to n lar nɛ anyi maaŋ wu a?” 15Nɛ menyee kaŋɛ nsaa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga bre, menyeeŋ ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be demuji to. Amoso men sa maŋ ta eleŋ nɛ men kɔ na a puni betirpo. Menyi alɛ e sa maa sɔ brɔbu. Men sa maa tu basa nɛ baa kre basa be kamɔ ŋko a wora asheŋ alubi na a wora asheŋ. 16Aloŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men nya menyi be amu, nsaa du fanɛ basa nɛ b wɔ ebu lempo jeŋgreŋ nɛ k bee kuŋ basa na to. Menyi alɛ beeŋ naa nya a ji nsaa nuu yila yila so jemanɛ kikɛ.
Echefoso be kemaŋkura be asheŋ
17Ade kikɛ be kaman, menyeeŋ naŋ wu ewura ko ka bee ji kuwura kemaŋkuraso ashi kasawule nɛ k dese n sɔ kaplɛkama a yɔ na so. 18Saŋɛ na so nɛ men bishi menyi be amu le: “Nnɛ nɛ ekrachi nɛ b daa ta kufu a da anyi nsaa tintiŋ anyi nɛ anyee ka elampo damta na wɔ?” 19Menyi alɛ maaŋ naaŋ wu befɔ nɛ baa wu bumo be amu a fɛ fanɛ b shi ga nsaa gbar ŋgbar nɛ menyi maa nu na kenishiso kikɛ. 20Men to anishi ŋ keni Zayɔn be kebee nɛ anyee ji anyi be nchɛgboŋ kumo so na. Menyeeŋ wu fanɛ Jerusalɛm la kakpa nɛ anyi beeŋ tiŋ n nya anyi be amu a wɔtɔ nna. K du fanɛ wajɛbu nɛ k yil a maa gbuŋgbuŋ nna. Kumo be ayir maa tia nɛ kumo be efɔlana malɛ gba maa tuge to kikɛ. 21Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ lara mbe kemaŋkura ŋ ŋini anyi nɛ an chena m mata elɔr nɛ a wɔ nchiŋ nɛ mbombi nɛ e wɔ mpar na. Ama an doŋana be nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ maaŋ nite nchuana na so. 22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la anyi be demujipo nɛ esa nɛ e bee ji kuwura anyi so. Mo e la anyi be ewura nɛ e bee kuŋ anyi nɛ an nya anyi be amu a wɔtɔ. 23Ama asɔ nɛ efuli pɔtɛana ta n chɛ bumo be nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ so na maŋ chɛ nɛnɛ a kɔ eleŋ; Ewajɛ nɛ b ta n chɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na so nɛ afu e baa ber amo a nite nchu so na maŋ parga to. Anyeeŋ suge bedoŋ be benapo be asɔ damta, hale nɛ ebobi gba e nya asɔ n sɔ bumo kutɔ. 24Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta menyi be alubi m paŋ menyi, nɛ esa kama nɛ e wɔ anyi be kasawule so maaŋ naŋ fubel ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mee lɔ nna!”

Title: AIZAAYA 34
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge mo doŋana kusoe be asheŋ
1Menyi efuli kama so be basa e ba abar so nseŋ nu nfe! Durnya kikɛ nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ kumo to e ba nfe m ba nu. 2Eyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nya agbo n wɔtɔ efuli pɔtɛana na nɛ amo be benapo kikɛ. Mo alɛ yili kumo fanɛ bumo kikɛ beeŋ mur. 3Baaŋ wu n dese m bɛa a dufɛ nɛ bumo be ŋklaŋ malɛ e shile abee so ŋ gbelge to fanɛ nchu na. 4Epeŋi nɛ kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabi kikɛ beeŋ foe basa be anishi so nɛ b bɔɔ awɔlpa fanɛ kelaŋ na. Kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ awɔlpa so beeŋ tɔr to fanɛ afantaŋ ŋko asɔrso ka bolo kedibi so n chuge n tɔr to na.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋ ta mbe tokobi n wora awɔlpa so be asɔ kusɔ nɛ e bee sha n loge, k beeŋ gbelge efuli nɛ baa tre Edɔm na be basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yili kumo fanɛ baaŋ mur na so. 6Bumo be ŋklaŋ beeŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be tokobi na fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔ fɔlbi nɛ mboe nɛ b ta n lara esarga be ŋklaŋ bee gbiti nsaŋɛbi na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ mɔ basa damta n ta bumo n lara sarga ashi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Bozra na nɛ Edɔm be efuli so be kaplɛkama. 7Basa na beeŋ wu n tɔr fanɛ egbolufɛlso nɛ egbolufɔlbi, nɛ bumo be ŋklaŋ e pere kasawule so nɛ nfɔ e sɔ kaplɛkama. 8Le be jemanɛ ere nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ n suge Zayɔn nseŋ sɔ kumo be basa be kɔnɔ ŋ kɔ bumo doŋana.
9Mbombi nɛ a wɔ Edɔm be efuli so beeŋ kilgi ŋ ki fanɛ kootal nɛ eshishɛr na malɛ e ki fanɛ jɛrbi. Efuli na kikɛ beeŋ suse so fanɛ kootal ka bee chɔɔ edɛ to na. 10K beeŋ baa chɔɔ kapa nɛ kanyɛ nna, nɛ edishi malɛ e baa lar kumo to hale mbaanaayɔ. Edɔm beeŋ ki keshishɛrsawule a dese nfɛ damta nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ bɔla kumo to n choŋ kikɛ. 11Egbuŋgbula nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya be yiri yiri e naaŋ sɔ kasawule na kikɛ so a wɔtɔ. Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ k naaŋ ki kasawule fuloŋ n dese fanɛ kananɛ k daa du kasɔto be jemanɛ so na. 12Ewura maaŋ naa wɔtɔ a keni Edɔm be efuli na so. Bejuŋkparpoana gba maaŋ naa wɔtɔ a juŋkpar kumo be basa. 13Ewi nɛ egɔnnyaŋɛ e naaŋ kɔr bumo be ewurkpaana nɛ nde nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti amo na kikɛ to. Saŋɛ na so ejiŋkaamu nɛ egbuŋgbula be yiri yiri beeŋ ba kaa wɔ amo to. 14Kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi fanɛ ekarmɛ nɛ ekuntuŋ beeŋ ba kaa nite a kulti kumo nɛ ayoyu lubiana e baa shu a tre abar ndoŋ. Kanyɛso be asɔ lubi beeŋ ta ndoŋ ŋ ki bumo be ewushikpa. 15Egbuŋgbula beeŋ tɔ asha nseŋ to afule m bure, hale m bela bumo be bibi nɛ a daŋ ashi ndoŋ. Loŋ be jemanɛ na nɛ ejita e gama abar so a firgi a kulti ndoŋ.
16To, keni Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asɔ keniso be kawɔl na to ŋ kraŋ kusɔ nɛ k bee kaŋɛ. K yɛ: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e bɔla mbe Kiyoyu be eleŋgboŋ so m bar mbe asɔ toso abar so. Amo be kukoŋwule kama maŋ foe.” 17Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ barga kasawule na to n sa bumo nseŋ sa ekama mbe kachige nɛ b baa wɔ ndoŋ nfɛ damta. Saŋɛ na so kasawule na beeŋ baa la bumo peya mbaanaayɔ.

Title: AIZAAYA 35
Content:
Kecheembiya be ekpa be asheŋ
1Kiyi be kagbene beeŋ fuli kumo,
nɛ ndibi be atoto e purge ashi kasawule nɛ k dese jiga so.
2Kiyi beeŋ purge kaplɛkama
nseŋ boŋ kagbenefuli be nshɛ.
K beeŋ baa walɛ fanɛ Lebanɔn be abee
nsaa kɔ eleŋ fanɛ kebee nɛ baa tre Kamɛl na,
ŋko ketaŋɛ nɛ baa tre Sharɔn na be adɔsawule.
Kumo be kaman nɛ ekama e wu
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura,
nɛ mbe keshi nɛ eleŋgboŋ.
3-4Kubɔya nɛ k wɔtɔ n sa bekama
nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ nsaa chicha na nde;
bumo e la basa nɛ baa fɔŋ na:
“Men nya kenyɛn nsaa maa ŋana kufu.
Menyi be Ebɔrɛ bee ba
nɛ e ba gberge men doŋana kusoe.
Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sɔ menyi be kɔnɔ
ŋ kɔ n m mɔlga menyi.”
5Etanpo beeŋ naŋ nya anishi a wu,
nɛ ekpawu e nya asoe a nu.
6Ebobi beeŋ nya aya a tɛ to a cha,
nɛ eneemu a nya nnɔ a boŋ to kagbenefuliso
Mbombi beeŋ fara a shile kiyi to;
7nɛ shishɛrpumpuŋ tushiso e ki apa,
nɛ nsawule nɛ a wɔl a dese kikɛ
e nya abuye amo so.
Kakpa nɛ ejiŋkaamu daa wɔ na,
beeŋ ki kakpa nɛ agasa
nɛ achufitiri bee kɔr.
8Kegbembi lela beeŋ ba dese ndoŋ,
nɛ b baa tre kumo
“Kecheembiya be ekpa.”
K beeŋ baa la Ebɔrɛ be basa be ekpa.
Esa nɛ e maa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ
maaŋ nite kumo so.
Bewulpo gba maaŋ nite
loŋ be kegbembi na so.
9Ebuluŋ maaŋ baa wɔ ekpa na so,
asɔbɔya nɛ a bee keta kufu
maaŋ mata ekpa na gba.
Basa nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
kɔ n suge na
e naaŋ bɔla ekpa na so n yɔ epe.
10Baaŋ ta kagbenefuli nɛ nshɛ
n wora awɔr
n ya luri Jerusalɛm to.
Bumo alɛ be ŋgbene
beeŋ fuli bumo mbaanaayɔ;
ŋkpal manɛ so,
kagbenejija nɛ kafɔŋ
maaŋ naa wɔtɔ.

Title: AIZAAYA 36
Content:
Asiriyaebi ka bee funti Jerusalɛmebi be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 18:13-27; 2 Kronikɛls 32:1-19)
1Ewura Hɛzekaya ka bee ji Juda be efuli so be kuwura be kafɛ kuduanasopo to nɛ Sennakerɛb nɛ e la Asiriya be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na ba kɔ Juda be ndegboŋ nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti na n suge amo be galeŋga. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Asiriya be ewura na kaŋɛ mbe benapo be ejuŋkparpo fanɛ e lar kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Lackish na nseŋ keta benapo damta n yɔ Jerusalɛm to.
Benapo be ejuŋkparpo na daŋ ya yili ekpa nɛ k mata ewajɛluepoana be eshuŋkpa nɛ k dese ŋ kra nchu be kubɔr nɛ b kur nɛ nchu bee shi Esoso be Kepa na to a bɔla kumo to na nna. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juda be benimu asa ko lar n ya shɛr mo to. Bumo e daa la Eliakim nɛ e la Hilkiya pibinyɛn nseŋ daa la esa nɛ e bɛ ewura so na, nɛ Shɛbna nɛ e la ewura be esibɛpo na, nɛ Jowa nɛ e la Asaf pibinyɛn nseŋ daa la esa nɛ e bee keni ewurkpa be asheŋ nɛ b sibɛ n nase so na. 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo na kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ bee sha nna nɛ e pin kusɔ nɛ k shin nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya kɔ kenyɛn nseŋ yirda mbe kumu loŋ. 5E bee fɛ fanɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n yili kɔnɔ to be mmalga nawule so ŋ kre kena nseŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so a? Naniere e ka lar Asiriya be ewura kaman ere, wanɛ e naaŋ chɛ mo to? 6E bee ta mbe kumu a to Ijipt be efuli nɛ kumo be ewura so nna, ŋko? Nɛ loŋ bre nna, k du fanɛ e ka bee yirgi kedibi buso nɛ k beeŋ tiŋ n da mbe enɔ be epun to m bɔl so nna. Kananɛ Ijipt be ewura, Fɛɛro, du n sa esa kama nɛ e ta mbe kumu n lɛ mo so nna na.
7Kumo be kaman nɛ Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Menyee sha kekaŋɛ ma fanɛ Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na nawule nɛ men ta menyi be amu a to so a? Mannɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be ebɔrɛsure nɛ mboŋ nɛ baa shuŋ mo na nɛ Hɛzekaya kaŋɛ fanɛ b mur nseŋ ka kakpa koŋwule n sa basa nɛ b wɔ Juda be efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm to nɛ b baa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ ndoŋ nawule na a? 8To, meeŋ yili Asiriya be ewura be aya to nna nɛ ma nɛ menyi e ji n yili. Nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n nya egbaŋɛ be bediipo, ma alɛ beeŋ sa menyi egbaŋɛ ŋgboŋ anyɔ. 9Menyi maaŋ tiŋ n tu Asiriya be efuli so be enapo nɛ e maŋ kɔ eyilikpagboŋ gba ŋ kɔ, ama menyee tama fanɛ Ijiptebi beeŋ sa menyi egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛ diipoana nɛ b ba chɛ menyi to ŋ kɔ a? 10Men baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ ma fanɛ m ba kɔ m mur menyi be efuli na. Mo alɛ e chɛ ma to.”
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ Eliakim nɛ Shɛbna nɛ Jowa kaŋɛ benapo be ejuŋkparpo na le: “Jande, ta Aramaik be ŋgbar to a malga anyi kutɔ. Amo nɛ anyee nu. Sa maa gbar Hibruw be ŋgbar to, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ b wɔ egbalana ere so kikɛ bee nu kusɔ nɛ anyee malga nna na.”
12Nɛ Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo na malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Menyee tama fanɛ menyi nɛ ewura na nawule nɛ anyi be ewurgboŋ shuŋi ma fanɛ m ba malga n sa a? Mannɛ loŋ nna, basa nɛ b chena egbalana na so na gba nɛ mee malga a sa. K maaŋ chɛr bumo alɛ gba beeŋ ji bumo gbagba be ejɔŋɛ nseŋ nuu bumo be ebɔnfɔl, fanɛ kananɛ menyi benimuana beeŋ wora na.”
13Kumo be kaman nɛ e ponte awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ le Hibruw be gbar to, saŋɛ na so, ekama nɛ e wɔ ndoŋ beeŋ nu: “Men nu kusɔ nɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ bee kaŋɛ menyi. 14E yɛ, men sa maŋ shin nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya e fule menyi. E maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga menyi ashi anyi be enɔ to. 15E kaŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ m mɔlga menyi ashi Asiriya be ewurgboŋ be enɔ to, men sa maŋ yirda kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ na. 16Men sa maŋ nu n sa ewura Hɛzekaya! Men nu n sa ma ewurgboŋ na. Menyi alɛ e ta menyi be amu n sa mo. E beeŋ shin nɛ men baa kraa kɔ menyi be waindibi be adɔana nɛ efigi be ndibi be asɔrso a ji nsaa nu menyi be atirbu to be nchu 17n ya fo fanɛ ewurgboŋ na ka beeŋ lɔŋɛ menyi n chena efuli nɛ k du fanɛ men gbagba be efuli ere so. Ndoŋ la kakpa nɛ ewaindibi wɔtɔ nna nɛ men baa ta a wora eyabra a nuu, nɛ ayu malɛ gba wɔtɔ nɛ men baa ta a wora ebodobodo a we. 18Men sa maŋ shin nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya e fule menyi nɛ men baa fɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ kɔ n suge menyi. Efuli ko be agbirana daŋ tiŋ m mɔlga amo be basa ashi Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na be enɔ to a? 19Nnɛ nɛ basa nɛ b daa wɔ ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hamaf nɛ Appad nɛ Sefavaim na be agbirana naa wɔ naniere? Samɛria be efuli so be agbirana daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ kasawule na ashi Asiriya be benapo be enɔ to. 20Agbirana na be kekama daŋ maŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ kumo be basa ashi Asiriya be ewura be enɔ to. Nɛ manɛ so nɛ menyi ere bee fɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga Jerusalɛm bre ashi mbe enɔ to?”
21Ŋkpal Ewura Hɛzekaya ka daŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ na so, basa na daŋ maŋ tuge shɛŋ. 22Kumo be kaman nɛ Eliakim nɛ Shɛbna nɛ Jowa ta kagbenejija ŋ kpɛa bumo be asɔbuuso to nseŋ ya bɔ kusɔ nɛ Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo kaŋɛ na be kubɔya n sa ewura Hɛzekaya.

Title: AIZAAYA 37
Content:
Ewura Hɛzekaya ka fin Aizaaya be kasotoji be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 19:1-7)
1Ewura Hɛzekaya ka nu kubɔya nɛ Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo kaŋɛ na, nɛ mbe kagbene jija mo ga nɛ e kpɛa mbe asɔbuuso to nseŋ ta keeli be asɔbuuso m buu n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu to. 2Kumo be kaman nɛ e shuŋi Eliakim nɛ e bee keni ewura be laŋ so na nɛ Shɛbna nɛ e la ewura be esibɛpo nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimusoana na ma, anebi Aizaaya kutɔ. Bumo alɛ gba daŋ buu keeli be asɔbuuso nna m ba. 3Kubɔya nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya ta n shuŋi bumo nɛ b ba sa ma nde: “Kabre la awurfoŋ be kachɛ nna n sa anyi, ŋkpal loŋ so an wɔ kasogberge nɛ ŋaba to nna. An du fanɛ eche nɛ e bee kurge a gben nsaa maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nɛ e kaŋto ŋ kurge nna. 4Asiriya be ewurgboŋ shuŋi mbe benapo be ejuŋkparpo nna nɛ e ba tege Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa na. Enyɛnpe fo Ebɔrɛ na e naaŋ nu katege ere kikɛ nseŋ gberge basa nɛ baa tege mo na kusoe. Amoso kule Ebɔrɛ n sa anyi be basa nɛ b kraa wɔ ŋkpa to na.”
5Ewura Hɛzekaya be benimu nɛ e shuŋi na ka kaŋɛ ma kubɔya na, 6nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ fanɛ men sa maa lɔ kufu ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ Asiriyaebi na kaŋɛ na so, fanɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga menyi na. 7Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na beeŋ nu b yɛ b yɛ be kubɔya ko, nɛ k shin nɛ e bɛta n yɔ mo gbagba be efuli so nɛ b ya mɔ mo ndoŋ.”
Asiriyaebi ka naŋ ta kafunti be kubɔya n shuŋi n ya sa Judaebi na be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 19:8-19)
8Asiriya be benapo be ejuŋkparpo na ka nu fanɛ bumo be ewurgboŋ lar Lakish be kadegboŋ to n ya kaa kɔ Libna be kadegboŋ nɛ k mata ndoŋ na kena, nɛ e yɔ ndoŋ nɛ e ya bishi mo kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora.
9Loŋ be jemanɛ na gbagba nɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ, Sennakerɛb, nu fanɛ Itiopia be ewura, Tɛhaka wɔ ekpa to a ba nɛ e ba kɔ mo kena. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ewurgboŋ Sennakerɛb shuŋi mbɔ fanɛ b ta kawɔlbi ko n ya sa Juda be ewura, Hɛzekaya. 10Kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ kawɔlbi na to nde: “Sa maŋ ta fo yirda n wɔtɔ fo Ebɔrɛ na to ŋko n shin nɛ mbe kekaŋɛ fanɛ Asiriya be ewura maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ n sɔ Jerusalɛm na e fule fo. 11Fo nu kananɛ anyi Asiriya be bewura mur efuli pɔtɛana ko cheche be asheŋ. Nɛ manɛ so nɛ fee fɛ fanɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n wora fo ere? 12N nananyɛnana e daŋ mur ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Gozan nɛ Haran nɛ Rezef, nseŋ mɔ Bɛtaden be basa nɛ b daa wɔ Tɛlassa na gba. Bumo be agbirana daŋ maŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo. 13Bewura nɛ b daa wɔ ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hamaf nɛ Apad nɛ Sefavaim nɛ Hena nɛ Iwa na kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ. Bumo kikɛ mur!”
14Ewura Hɛzekaya ka sɔ kawɔlbi na ashi mbɔ na kutɔ nɛ e kraŋ kumo nseŋ ta kumo n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya bugi kumo to n nase Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito. 15Kumo be kaman nɛ e kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: 16“Enyɛnpetale Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ, fo e chena fo kuwurputi so awɔlto nɛ emalaika nɛ baa tre chɛrubim na wɔ fo aya ase. Fo nawule e la Ebɔrɛ. Fo e to esoso nɛ kasawule nsaa ji kuwura durnya be kuwurjiana kikɛ so. 17Keni kananɛ Asiriya be ewura, Sennakerɛb bee tege fo Ebɔrɛ nɛ fee sa ŋkpa na loŋ. 18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, kashenteŋ nna fanɛ Asiriya be bewuraana mur efuli damtaana nseŋ shin nɛ amo be nsawule dese fuloŋ. 19Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ chɔɔ efuliana na be agbirana nɛ b ta ndibi nɛ ajembu n lɔŋɛ a shuŋ nna. 20Ama fo ere la Enyɛnpe, anyi be Ebɔrɛ nna! Anyee kule fo nna nɛ fo mɔlga anyi ashi Asiriya be ewura be enɔ to, saŋɛ na so, ekama nɛ e wɔ durnya to be efuli kama so, beeŋ pin fanɛ fo nawule e la Ebɔrɛ.”
Kubɔya nɛ Aizaaya ta n shoŋi Ewura Hɛzekaya na be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 19:20-37)
21Ndoŋ nna nɛ ma anebi Aizaaya ta kubɔya ere n shuŋi n ya sa ewura Hɛzekaya a kaŋɛ mo kusɔ 22nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na malga a laŋɛ mbe kabɔrɛkule na be kaplɛa so. E yɛ: “Sennakerɛb, Jerusalɛm be basa bee mushe fo nna nsaa fɛl fo a keni fo jiga. 23Wanɛ nɛ fo daa fɛ fanɛ fee tege nsaa wora eyurto na? Ma, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na nɛ fo daa maa sa bunyaŋ na. 24Fo daŋ shuŋi fo mbɔ nna nɛ b ba kaa puchi menyi ka daŋ ta menyi be egbaŋɛturko n dii n yɔ Lebanɔn be kebee be awɔlto n ya kɔ m pɔɔ so ashi ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito. Men daa puchi fanɛ men daŋ tiŋ ŋ ku sida be ndibi tenteŋ nɛ seprɛs be ndibi lelaana n lɛ nna ashi kebee na so hale n ya fo kupo na be nferinto. 25Fo daŋ puchi fanɛ men daŋ kur atirbu ashi efuli pɔtɛana so nseŋ nuu amo to be nchu. Kumo be kaman menyi be benapo be aya gba chichi Lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Nail na gba so nɛ k wɔlto.
26Menyi maŋ pin to fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kre kumo loŋ dra na kikɛ nɛ naniere k wora m bɔlɔ so na. Ma e sa menyi eleŋ nɛ men tiŋ n shin nɛ ndegboŋ lempoana ki alambure na. 27Basa nɛ b daa wɔ ndegboŋ na to daŋ maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nna, ŋkpal kufu ka daŋ pɛ bumo nɛ eburma tɔr bumo so so. B daa du fanɛ kudɔ to be afitiri nna ŋko afitiri popɔrbi nɛ e kɔr ebu be esoso nɛ epeŋilarkpa be afu tushi so ber amo so nɛ e wu nna.
28Ama ma ere nyi kusɔ kama a laŋɛ fo kaplɛa so. N nyi kusɔ nɛ fee wora nɛ kakpa nɛ fee yɔ kikɛ. Ma alɛ naa nyi kananɛ fee nya agbo ga a wora ma. 29N wu fo kamoowu nɛ agbogboŋ na kikɛ. Naniere meeŋ ta dariwa n wɔtɔ fo kamuna to nseŋ ta kebarga n wɔtɔ fo kɔnɔ to. Kumo be kaman nɛ n ta fo m bɔla ekpa nɛ fo bɔla so m ba na m bɛta n yɔ kakpa nɛ fo shi m ba.”
30Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ anebi Aizaaya kaŋɛ ewura Hɛzekaya le: “Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora be tɔɔnɛ nde. Kafɛ ere nɛ kafɛ a ba kikɛ menyi maaŋ dɔ n duu shɛŋ ama menyi alɛ beeŋ nya akɔrbua n teŋi n ji. Ama kafɛ nɛ k bɛ so kesasopo na bre, menyeeŋ dɔ n duu ayu n teŋi nseŋ duu ndibi sɔrso n nya amo be asɔrso n chuge n ji. 31Basa nɛ baaŋ ji efute ashi Juda be efuli so na beeŋ purge fanɛ aduuso nɛ amo be achin yɔ kasawule to nɛ e wora nɛnɛ na. 32Basa ko beeŋ ji efute ashi Jerusalɛm to nɛ Zayɔn be kebee so, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e naŋ shin nɛ loŋ e wora.
33Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ na be kaplɛa so nde. E yɛ: ‘Asiriya be ewurgboŋ maaŋ nya n luri kadegboŋ na to ŋko n to ketanyembi koŋwule gba ashi kumo to. Mbe benapo nɛ b keta abɛlso be asɔ kuŋamuso a kuŋ bumo be amu maaŋ taga kadegboŋ na to. Bumo alɛ maaŋ nya n dɔ ashigboŋ ŋ kulti kumo kikɛ n wɔtɔ m bɔla amo so n dii n luri kumo to. 34Ekpa nɛ e bɔla so m ba na nɛ e beeŋ naŋ bɔla so n yɔ nɛ e maŋ nya n luri kadegboŋ na to. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na. 35Meeŋ kuŋ kadegboŋ na ŋkpal ŋ gbagba be kemaŋkura nɛ kɔnɔ nɛ n nase n sa ma kayɛrbi Deevid nɛ e daa la ewura ashi Jerusalɛm to jemanɛ ko na so.’ ”
Ewurgboŋ Sennakerɛb be luwu be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 19:35-37)
36Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ mbe malaika yɔ Asiriya be basa be keeyi to n ya mɔ benapo ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ aduburwa nɛ anu. Kare ka chɛ kachipurdidi, nɛ bumo kikɛ wu a dese! 37Ndoŋ nna nɛ Asiriya be ewurgboŋ, Sennakerɛb bɛta n yɔ mbe ewurkpa ashi Asiriya be efuli so be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Ninɛve na. 38Kachako e ka yɔ mbe kegbir be lambu to n ya kaa shuŋ mbe kegbir nɛ baa tre Nishrɔk na, nɛ mbe mbinyɛnsobi anyɔ nɛ baa tre bumo Adremalɛk nɛ Shareza na ta bumo be etokobi m mɔ mo ndoŋ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b shile n yɔ Ararat be kasawule so nɛ mo pibinyɛn nɛ baa tre Essahaddɔn na sɔ mo so ŋ ki ewura.

Title: AIZAAYA 38
Content:
Ewura Hɛzekaya ka lɔ nseŋ naŋ nya alenfia be asheŋ
(2 Bewura 20:1-11; 2 Kronikɛls 32:24-26)
1Le be jemanɛ ere nɛ kulɔ ko pɛ ewura Hɛzekaya nɛ a daŋ ka gbrɛ nɛ e wu. Ndoŋ nna nɛ anebi Aizaaya nɛ e la Amɔz pibinyɛn na yɔ nɛ e ya bɔ mo so nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ yɛ fo bela ase n lɔŋɛ fo kusɔ kama n yili nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo maaŋ naŋ nya alenfia. Bela ase a jo luwu.” 2Ewura Hɛzekaya ka nu loŋ nɛ e kilgi anishi n shoŋi egbal nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ le: 3“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, baa nyiŋi kananɛ n daŋ shuŋ fo kashenteŋ nɛ kagbene koŋwule so. Ma alɛ wora ania fanɛ meeŋ baa wora kusɔ kama nɛ fee sha.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e shu ga.
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ anebi Aizaaya 5fanɛ e naŋ bɛta n yɔ ewura Hɛzekaya kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Ma, Enyɛnpe, fo nananyɛn ewura Deevid be Ebɔrɛ na, nu fo kabɔrɛkule nseŋ wu fo anishichubi na. Meeŋ naŋ shin nɛ fo naŋ ji nfɛ kuduanu n ti so. 6Ma alɛ beeŋ kuŋ fo nɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ ere ashi Asiriya be ewurgboŋ kutɔ.”
7Nɛ anebi Aizaaya kaŋɛ Ewura Hɛzekaya: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sa fo tɔɔnɛ ko a ŋini fanɛ e beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ mbe kɔnɔ naseso so. 8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ kiyoyul nɛ k deŋ atemprembi nɛ ewura Ahaz pɔr na so na e bɛta kaman ateŋgreŋ kudu so.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ kiyoyul na bɛta kaman ateŋgreŋ kudu so, fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na.
9Ewura Hɛzekaya ka koso mbe kulɔ na to nɛ e sibɛ kapandi be kashɛ ere:
10Le nɛ n daa fɛ ashi ma kagbene to;
jemanɛ nɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ daa yil to nɛnɛ na,
nɛ n daa shin nɛ n wu n yɔ bubuni to;
saŋɛ na so m maaŋ naa wɔ ŋkpa to.
11N daa maa tama fanɛ
meeŋ naŋ wu fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
ŋko basa nɛ b kraa wɔ ŋkpa to
ashi durnya to kikɛ.
12Ma ŋkpa daŋ ku so nna nseŋ fo ekar,
fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo be wajɛbu nɛ e bɔɔ na,
ŋko fanɛ wajɛ nɛ b kraa lue
nseŋ ku kumo so ashi kɔrɛ to na.
N daa fɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ ma ŋkpa loge nna.
13Amoso n daa shu nna a klade ŋkpal ebesa so!
K daa du fanɛ buluŋ ka bee buri ma awibi to nna.
N daa fɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ ma ŋkpa loge nna.
14N daa shu nna fanɛ kabɔrɛpɔpɔbi,
nseŋ daa naa shu kuwɔr so fanɛ lepɔ na.
N daŋ dese nna a keni fo Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na anishito,
hale nɛ ma anishi gben, a maŋ naa wu nɛnɛ.
Jande, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, mɔlga ma ashi etɔrɔ ere kikɛ to.
15Manɛ nɛ meeŋ naŋ kaŋɛ?
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e wora ma loŋ.
Kagbenejija nɛ ebesa damta e bɔlɔ ma kagbene to,
hale m maaŋ tiŋ n di gba kuraa.
16Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nawule nɛ meeŋ baa wɔtɔ n sa.
Chɛ ma kulɔ ere n shin nɛ n naŋ nya ŋkpa.
17Ma nɛnɛ so nɛ fo shin nɛ
asheŋ kpakpaso ere tu ma.
Ama fo kasha kuŋ ma,
nɛ m maŋ wu n yɔ bubuni to.
Fo alɛ kpele fo anishi n lɛ
ashi ma alubi so.
18Esa kama nɛ e wɔ bubuni to maaŋ naŋ tiŋ ŋ kpaŋ fo;
bubuni maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n yirda fo kashenteŋji.
19Basa nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to e naa kpaŋ fo,
fanɛ kananɛ mee kpaŋ fo naniere na.
Bekurgepo bee kaŋɛ bumo be mbia
fo kashenteŋji be asheŋ.
20Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo e chɛ ma kulɔ.
Amoso, anyeeŋ laŋ ejaŋjilaŋ m boŋ nshɛ ŋ kpaŋ fo.
Anyi be kebaawɔtɔ to kikɛ, anyeeŋ boŋ nshɛ
ŋ kpaŋ fo ashi fo bɔrɛlambu to.
21Pɔɛŋ nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya nya alenfia nseŋ boŋ kashɛ na, anebi Aizaaya daŋ kaŋɛ mo nna fanɛ e shin nɛ b kɔr kedibi nɛ baa tre figi na be afantaŋ m mata mbe kechuu bɔbɔ na so.
22Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya bishi le: “Manɛ e naaŋ ŋini fanɛ meeŋ naaŋ tiŋ n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu to n ya shuŋ mo?”

Title: AIZAAYA 39
Content:
Mbɔ nɛ b shi Babilɔn na be asheŋ
1Merodak Baladan nɛ e la Baladan pibinyɛn nseŋ daa la efuli nɛ baa tre Babilɔn be ewura na ka nu fanɛ ewura Hɛzekaya daŋ lɔ nseŋ nya alenfia, nɛ e shuŋi mbɔ nɛ b ta kawɔl nɛ kakɛ n ya sa mo. 2Nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya keta mbɔ na kefɔ nseŋ ŋini bumo mbe shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ eposɔ nɛ e kɔ efɛa belbelso a shin nɛ ajibi bee wora bel na nɛ ɔlif be ŋku lela nɛ etulale nɛ mbe benapo be akɔsɔ kikɛ. Shɛŋ shɛŋ daa maŋ naŋ ka ashi mbe ewurkpa ŋko mbe efuli na kikɛ so nɛ e maŋ ta ŋ ŋini mbɔ na. 3Kumo be kaman nɛ anebi Aizaaya yɔ ewura Hɛzekaya kutɔ n ya bishi mo le: “Nnɛ nɛ basa ere shi m ba nfe; nɛ manɛ nɛ b kaŋɛ fo?”
Nɛ ewura Hɛzekaya kaŋɛ: “B shi efuli wɔfɔ ko nɛ baa tre kumo Babilɔn na nna.”
4Nɛ anebi Aizaaya naŋ bishi mo le: “Nɛ manɛ nɛ b wu ewurkpa nfe?”
Nɛ ewura na kaŋɛ: “B wu kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ nfe. Shɛŋ maŋ naŋ ka e wɔ nfe nɛ m maŋ ta ŋ ŋini bumo.”
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Aizaaya kaŋɛ ewura na le: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba kaŋɛ fanɛ, 6jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ b ba sulɔ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ ewurkpa nfe nɛ asɔ kama nɛ fo nananyɛnana fin n yili hale m ba fo kabre na kikɛ n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so. Shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ naŋ ka a wɔ nfe! 7Baaŋ keta fo mbinyɛnsobi gbagba be beko n ya fɛl bumo nɛ b baa shuŋ Babilɔn be ewura be lambu to.”
8Ewura Hɛzekaya bre daa fɛ nna fanɛ mo ere be jemanɛ to kayurwushi beeŋ baa wɔ efuli na so, amoso le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ: “Kubɔya nɛ fo ta n shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba sa ma ere walɛ.”

Title: AIZAAYA 40
Content:
Tama be mmalga be asheŋ
1Anyi be Ebɔrɛ na yɛ:
“Meeŋ lolo ma basa, n shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e wushi!
2Meeŋ leŋ Jerusalɛm be basa to.
Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b ji awurfoŋ n chɛr ga.
Naniere b nya bumo be alubi be ketampaŋ.
N tiŋ ŋ gberge bumo kusoe ga ŋkpal bumo be alubi so.”
3Esa ko bee ponte a kaŋɛ le:
“Men lɔŋɛ ekpa kiyi to n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bɔla so!
Men tise n tise asɔ kama nɛ e dese ekpa na to na,
nseŋ sulɔ ajaŋ n deŋi kumo so nɛ k baa walɛ nɛnɛ!
4Men ti ataŋɛ nɛ amaŋ kikɛ,
nseŋ dɛdɛ abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi kikɛ so.
Men lɔŋɛ mboŋ nyaŋgraŋ,
n shin nɛ amo kikɛ e dɛdɛ so.
5Saŋɛ na so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be keshi nɛ kemaŋkura
beeŋ lar efuli nɛ basa kikɛ e wu kumo.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e nase kumo be kɔnɔ!”
6Esa ko daŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ m ponte awɔrso,
nɛ m bishi mo le:
“N ponte ŋ kaŋɛ manɛ?”
Nɛ e yɛ: “Ponte ŋ kaŋɛ awɔrso fanɛ
edimɛdi kikɛ du fanɛ afitiri nna;
b maa chɛr kebaawɔtɔ to fanɛ kananɛ atoto maa chɛr
nsaa chɔɔ a mur ashi kupuŋ to na.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ baŋ shin nɛ afu ber m ba,
afitiri bee bolo nna nɛ atoto malɛ bee chuge a tɔr.
Edimɛdi maa chɛr fanɛ kananɛ afitiri maa chɛr nsaa wu na.
8Kashenteŋto, afitiri bee bolo nna nɛ atoto malɛ bee chuge a tɔr,
ama Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na bre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.”
9Fo nɛ fo kɔ baru lela a ba Zayɔn na,
e dii n yɔ kebee jeŋgreŋ na so.
Fo nɛ fo kɔ baru lela a ba Jerusalɛm to na,
bugi kɔnɔ m ponte awɔrso;
maŋ kumo so nsaa maa lɔ kufu.
Kaŋɛ nde nɛ a wɔ Juda be efuli so na le:
“Menyi be Ebɔrɛ bee ba!”
10Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kɔ eleŋgboŋ a ba
nɛ e ba ji kuwura basa so eleŋso.
E keta basa nɛ e kɔ m mɔlga bumo na nna a ba,
nɛ kumo be loŋ fuli mbe kagbene.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee keni mbe efuli so nna,
fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapo
bee keni mbe mbolpɔ so na.
E bee ta mbolpɔbi na nna a di ŋkɔŋ,
nsaa juŋkpar mbolpɔ nioana na malɛ boeŋ boeŋ.
Shɛŋ ka maŋ du fanɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
12Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ta mbe enɔ be epun to ŋ karga teku;
ŋko n ta mbe enɔ ŋ karga awɔlpa.
Esa maaŋ tiŋ n ta durnya to kikɛ be eshishɛr n wɔtɔ kurwa to;
ŋko n ta abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi
n deŋi kusɔ so ŋ karga amo be egbɛ.
13Esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kusɔ
nɛ k daga fanɛ e wora,
ŋko ŋ ŋini mo kesheŋwora ŋko n ji mo asoe to.
14Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa yɔ esa kikɛ kutɔ
n ya kaa fin kanyiasheŋ ŋko kepinto
ŋko kewora asheŋ nɛ e niŋi amodoŋwura kutɔ.
15Efuliana na maŋ la shɛŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bre kutɔ,
a du fanɛ nchu ka do bokiti nɛ nchu to nna;
ŋko kalabɛr nɛ a deŋ kusɔ nɛ b kɔ a karga asɔ be egbɛ so nna.
Aplasawule nɛ e wɔ kufɔ kufɔ na kikɛ
du fanɛ enɔ be bɔlɔ be eshishɛr nna.
16Nɛ esa ta Lebanɔn be kupo to be asɔbɔya kikɛ
n lara sarga n sa anyi be Ebɔrɛ na, a kraŋ maaŋ fo mo;
kumo to be ndibi kikɛ gba maaŋ fo
m puga sarga be edɛ.
17Efuliana na kikɛ maŋ la shɛŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ,
mo ere bee ta amo nna fanɛ asɔ fuloŋ.
18Esa kikɛ maŋ du fanɛ Ebɔrɛ.
Amoso esa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini kananɛ e du.
19E maŋ du fanɛ kegbir nɛ dimɛdi lɔŋɛ na nna,
ŋko kegbir nɛ bɔyɛpo ŋalga shuwa ŋ gbiti
nseŋ ta gbiti be kubɔtoshembi n ji kumo kebita na nna.
20Esa nɛ e maaŋ tiŋ n nya shuwa ŋko gbiti n lɔŋɛ kegbir
bee ku kedibi nɛ k maa tiŋ a bɛ manaŋ nna a lɔŋɛ kumo.
E bee fin esa nɛ e nyi kashɛl nɛnɛ nna
nɛ e shɛl kegbir nɛ k maaŋ melgi n tɔr nna.
21Fo maŋ nyi a?
B maŋ kaŋɛ fo dra dra na kikɛ a?
Fo maŋ nu kananɛ durnya fara a?
22Esa nɛ e chena mbe kuwurputi so
ashi durnya be esoso nɛ k baŋ awɔlpa so na
e to durnya.
Basa nɛ b wɔ kumo to na du fanɛ atutulombi mo kutɔ nna.
Mo e parga kuwɔlpa to fanɛ patisa,
ŋko fanɛ wajɛbu nɛ esa e chena to na.
23Ebɔrɛ e naa bar bumo nɛ baa ji kuwura kenyɛnso kaseto,
nsaa shin nɛ baa ki basa fuloŋ ashi durnya to na.
24B du fanɛ asɔduuso popɔrbi nna
nɛ b baŋ kraŋ duu amo nɛ a maŋ naŋ mur achin na nna.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na baŋ shin nɛ afu ber m ba,
baa wɔl nna nɛ afu na e ber bumo n ya lɛ fanɛ amimi na.
25Wanɛ bre nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n ta m ber Ebɔrɛ cheembi na?
Esa mo e wɔtɔ a du fanɛ mo?
26Maŋ anishi so ŋ keni awɔlpa so!
Wanɛ e to achɛkpabi nɛ fee wu ere?
Mo ere Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee juŋkpar amo
fanɛ benapo be ejuŋkparpo na,
e nyi kananɛ amo kikɛ sa
nɛ amo be kekama be ketre!
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be yuku shi ga,
nɛ achɛkpabi na be kekama maa foe mo so.
27Israɛl be basa, manɛ nna nɛ menyee fubel a kaŋɛ
fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maŋ nyi menyi be etɔrɔ be asheŋ,
ŋko mbe shɛŋ maŋ wɔ kapuni nɛ men wɔtɔ ere to?
28Menyi maŋ nyi a? Menyi alɛ maŋ naŋ nu a?
Fanɛ Enyɛnpe na e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ;
mo e to durnya kikɛ.
E maa shuŋ a gben ŋko a gben a chul to kikɛ.
Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin mbe nfɛra to.
29Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa sa bekama nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ
nseŋ gben a chul to na eleŋ.
30Basa fɔlbi gba bee kaa shuŋ a gben,
nsaa fiti a tɔr.
31Ama bekama nɛ b yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
beeŋ nya eleŋ popɔr.
Baaŋ ber atɛ to ŋ koso n firgi n yɔ awɔlto fanɛ ejɔnɔkoso;
bumo alɛ beeŋ shile ga, ama b maaŋ gben a chul to;
baaŋ nite ekpa tenteŋ, ama b maaŋ gben m bɛlɛ.

Title: AIZAAYA 41
Content:
Israɛl be echɛtopo be asheŋ
1Ebɔrɛ yɛ:
“Menyi basa nɛ men wɔ mplasawule so kikɛ e wora shruum n nu nfe!
Men wora shiriya m ba kute menyi be asheŋ
nɛ men wora be asheŋ ashi demujikpa.
Meeŋ sa menyi ekpa nɛ men malga.
Men shin nɛ ma nɛ menyi e ba abar so,
n fin emo nɛ e kɔ kashenteŋ.
2Wanɛ e daŋ shi epeŋilarkpa m bar esa nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so na,
nseŋ shin nɛ e daŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so kaplɛkama nɛ e yɔ na?
Wanɛ e shin nɛ e tiŋ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ bewura nɛ efuliana na so na?
Mbe tokobi daa ŋele bumo nna a lɛ
nɛ baa wu a ki shishɛrpumpuŋ.
Nɛ mbe atanyembi malɛ daa pesaŋ bumo to
fanɛ kananɛ afu bee kaa ber amimi a lɛ na.
3E daa ju a buu bumo so manaŋ manaŋ nna
hale mbe aya daa maa beta kasawule gba!
Mo alɛ daa maŋ nya doro kikɛ.
4Wanɛ e daŋ shin nɛ le wora?
Wanɛ e yili edimɛdi be adrasheŋ n sa bumo?
Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ n wɔtɔ sososo na kikɛ na e wora loŋ!
Ma, alɛ e naaŋ baa wɔtɔ hale mbaanaayɔ.
5Basa nɛ b wɔ nsawule nɛ a wɔ kufɔ kufɔ so na wu kusɔ nɛ n wora;
nɛ kufu pɛ bumo nɛ baa chicha.
Amoso b gama abar so nna m ba ma kutɔ.
6Basa nɛ baa shuŋ agbirana
bee lɔlɔ abar nna
a kaŋɛ le: ‘Men sa maa fɔŋ so’ 7Eshɛlpo na bee kaŋɛ bɔyɛpo le nna: ‘Fo wora asɔ!’
Nɛ esa nɛ mo alɛ bee fifɛa kegbir na so nɛ k bee ki bɔlbɔlbi na
malɛ bee leŋ emo nɛ e bee ber kegbir na a mata abar so na to.
B yɛ: ‘Kumo be keŋalga m mata abar so walɛ paa!’
Anyembi nɛ b ta ŋ gbir kegbir na n yili kumo be eyilikpa.
8Israɛlebi, men la ma nyɛrbi nna.
Ma e lara menyi.
Menyi nɛ men la nteri Eebraham be kaman to ebi na nɛ n lara.
9Durnya be mboŋ wɔfɔ kikɛ nɛ n shi ŋ keta menyi m ba,
nseŋ kaŋɛ menyi le: ‘Men la ma nyɛrbi nna.’
M maŋ kini menyi n lɛ.
10Amoso men sa maa lɔ kufu. Ma nɛ menyi e wɔtɔ!
Ma e la menyi be Ebɔrɛ.
Men sa maŋ shin nɛ kufu e pɛ menyi
nɛ men baa chicha!
Meeŋ sa menyi eleŋ nseŋ chɛ menyi to.
Ma alɛ beeŋ kuŋ menyi nseŋ mɔlga menyi.
11Bekama nɛ b kishi menyi
beeŋ ji anishinyɔr lubi.
Bumo nɛ baaŋ kɔ menyi kena beeŋ wu
12nsaa maaŋ naa wɔ durnya to kikɛ.
13Ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.
Ma e wɔtɔ menyi eleŋ nsaa kaŋɛ,
‘Men sa maa lɔ kufu; meeŋ chɛ menyi to.’ ”
14Ade be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ:
“Israɛl be basa, men ka maŋ shi nsaa maa kɔ eleŋ ga ere gba,
men sa maa lɔ kufu; meeŋ chɛ menyi to.
Ma, nɛ n la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na e naa mɔlga menyi.
15Meeŋ shin nɛ men ki fanɛ kedishiŋ
nɛ k kɔ ewi nsaa du pɛlpɛlbi.
Menyeeŋ bure abee to nɛ e ki shishɛrpumpuŋ.
16Kumo be kaman nɛ men ta amo n lɛ afu to
nɛ afu na e sulɔ amo n ya lɛ.
Afugboŋ beeŋ pesaŋ amo to n sɔ kaplɛkama.
Saŋɛ na so menyi be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi
ŋkpal ŋ ka la men be Ebɔrɛ so.
Kede be kaman nɛ men kpaŋ ma nɛ n la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na.
17Nɛ ma basa be ebɔl to wɔlto ŋkpal achukoŋ so,
nɛ baa fin nchu nɛ b nuu nseŋ kule ma,
ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nu bumo be kekule.
Ma, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na, maaŋ kplaŋ bumo so kikɛ.
18Meeŋ shin nɛ elɔr e baa shile abee be awɔlto
nɛ abuye e pete a shile ataŋɛ to.
Meeŋ shin nɛ keshishɛrsawule e ki fanɛ apa
nɛ kasawule wɔlso e ki fanɛ kubuye e shile.
19Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ ndibi nɛ baa tre
sida nɛ akasia nɛ ɔlif na e kɔr keshishɛrsawule so.
Ejaŋkilɛa nɛ ŋkɔbidibi nɛ echɛchɛdibi beeŋ kɔr
nsawule jiga so ŋ ki apo.
20Saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ wu loŋ nseŋ pin
fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ k wora.
Kumo be kaman nɛ b pin to
fanɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na e shin nɛ loŋ wora.”
Agbirana ka maŋ la shɛŋ be asheŋ
21Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, Israɛl be ewura na kaŋɛ nde:
“Menyi efuli pɔtɛana be agbirana na
e kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ men kɔ nɛ men kaŋɛ ma!
Men ta kamɔrɔji kama nɛ men kɔ m ba!
22Men ba kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso,
saŋɛ na so nɛ k kaŋ wora, anyeeŋ pin kumo.
Men bugi asheŋ nɛ a wora dra na to ŋ kaŋɛ ashi demujikpa,
nseŋ kaŋɛ anyi amo be afito.
23Men naŋ kaŋɛ anyi asheŋ nɛ a beeŋ wora echefoso,
aloŋ nɛ anyeeŋ pin fanɛ men la agbirana kashenteŋto!
Men wora kesheŋ lela ko ŋko alemaŋkarsheŋ ko,
n shin nɛ kufu e pɛ anyi nɛ kɔnɔ e mɔ anyi.
24Menyi gbagba nɛ asɔ nɛ menyee wora kikɛ maŋ la shɛŋ.
Basa nɛ baa shuŋ menyi na la basa nɛ mbushu pɛ bumo nna!
25Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara esa ko nɛ e wɔ epeŋilarkpa.
Men shin nɛ e shi kelargato be esoso m ba kɔ kena.
E bee chichi bewura so nna fanɛ b ka la eshii,
ŋko fanɛ kananɛ mpuliya be epɔrpo bee chichi ebɔ so na nna.
26Menyi, agbirana to be emo e daŋ wu
kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso ŋ kaŋɛ?
Saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ tiŋ n wu k kaa wora m bɔlɔ so
nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ k la kashenteŋ?
Men to be ekama maŋ naŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ
a laŋɛ echefoso be kaplɛa so.
Esa kikɛ malɛ maŋ naŋ nu men ka kaŋɛ kusɔ ko!
27Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e juŋkpar m bɔ baru na n sa Zayɔn.
N daŋ shuŋi kabɔ Jerusalɛm to fanɛ e ya kaŋɛ le nna:
‘Menyi be basa bee ba! Baa ba epe nna!’
28Ŋ ka keni agbirana na kikɛ to,
bumo be ekama maŋ kɔ shɛŋ a kaŋɛ;
bumo to be ekoŋwule gba
maŋ tiŋ n sa ma asheŋ bishiso na be atugebi.
29Agbirana ere kikɛ du jiga pasaa!
B maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ,
Bumo alɛ kikɛ maŋ kɔ eleŋ.”

Title: AIZAAYA 42
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kayɛrbi be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ:
“Ma kenya nde, ma e naa sa mo eleŋ.
Mo e la esa nɛ n lara, nɛ ma kagbene bee fuli mo so.
N ta ma Kiyoyu nna n sa mo,
nɛ e bar keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so ashi efuliana so.
2E maaŋ ponte awɔrso
ŋko m malga awɔrso ashi agbembi so.
3E maaŋ bu kejolobi nɛ k dɛlɛ to a yil
ŋko n duŋ fitila nɛ k maa wu nɛnɛ.
Ama e beeŋ shin nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so
e baa la ekama peya.
4E maaŋ gben n yige to ŋko m pɔ aba;
e beeŋ shin nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so e ba durnya to.
Efuli pɔtɛ so be basa pere kenishi nna a jo mbe keŋini.”
5Ebɔrɛ e to esoso nseŋ parga kumo to n sɔ kaplɛkama;
mo e to kasawule nɛ asɔ kama nɛ e wɔ kumo so na kikɛ;
mo e sa durnya to be basa kikɛ ŋkpa nɛ efute.
Naniere kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ mbe kayɛrbi nde:
6“Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e tre fo nseŋ sa fo eleŋ,
nɛ fo shin nɛ keji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so e ba durnya to.
Fo so nɛ ma nɛ basa kikɛ beeŋ bɔla so
n wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre.
Fo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kebaanyi be kefulto beeŋ bɔla so
m ba efuliana na to.
7Fo e naaŋ shin nɛ etanpo be anishi e bugi;
Feeŋ sɔ basa nɛ b wɔ tentembiri be kabuti to n yige.
8N nawule kpeŋ e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
M maaŋ shuli nɛ agbir ŋko edimɛdi e sɔ
kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ e daga ma na.
9Asheŋ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ a beeŋ wora na wora kashenteŋto.
Naniere meeŋ naaŋ kaŋɛ fo asheŋ popɔr
pɔɛŋ nɛ a fara a wora.”
Keboŋ kashɛ ŋ kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be asheŋ
10Men boŋ kashɛ popɔr n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na;
nɛ durnya to be basa kikɛ e boŋ kashɛ ŋ kpaŋ mo!
Menyi nɛ menyee nite teku so, e kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na;
nɛ asɔ keniso kikɛ nɛ a wɔ teku to e, kpaŋ mo!
Menyi nɛ men wɔ mplasawule nɛ a wɔ kufɔ kufɔ na so,
e kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
11Menyi basa nɛ men wɔ keshishɛrsawule so
nɛ nde nɛ a wɔ kumo so na kikɛ e kpaŋ Ebɔrɛ;
nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kakpa nɛ baa tre Kɛda na gba e kpaŋ mo!
Men shin nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sela na
e yili abee be awɔlto n wora awɔr kagbene fuli so!
12Menyi basa nɛ men wɔ mboŋ wɔfɔ
e kpaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ n ta kemaŋkura n sa mo!
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee lar nna n ya kaa kɔ fanɛ enapo na;
e bela ase nna nseŋ wora shiriya a jo kena.
E beeŋ boŋ to awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ kena be asheŋ,
e beeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ mo doŋana so.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka beeŋ chɛ mbe basa to be asheŋ
14Ebɔrɛ yɛ:
“Ŋ lo ma kɔnɔ n chɛr ga.
M maŋ tuge ma basa shɛŋ.
Ama naniere jemanɛ fo nɛ n wora kusɔ ko,
nɛ mee shu to fanɛ eche nɛ kakurge ta mo na.
15Meeŋ mur abeebi nɛ abeegboŋ
nseŋ shin nɛ ndibi nɛ afitiri e wɔl.
Meeŋ shin nɛ elɔr nɛ mbombi e wɔl to
nɛ apa e feeto.
16Meeŋ juŋkpar etanpo m bɔla
ekpaana nɛ b maŋ naŋ bɔla so ŋ ku so so.
Meeŋ shin nɛ bumo be tentembiri e ki kefulto
nseŋ shin nɛ ekpa lubi nɛ baa nite so e nyalɛ n sa bumo.
Ma nnɔ naseso nna na,
ma alɛ beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ amo kikɛ so nyam.
17Bekama nɛ b yirda agbirana,
nɛ bumo nɛ baa ta apɔrso fanɛ bumo be ebɔrɛana na,
beeŋ ji anishinyɔr nseŋ ŋaba.”
Ebɔrɛ be basa ka maa wora kasonu be asheŋ
18Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Ekpawu, men nu nfe!
Menyi, etanpo malɛ e keni n wu nɛnɛ!
19Esa maŋ tan a chɔ ma kayɛrbi
ŋko a la kpawu a chɔ ma kabɔ nɛ n shuŋi na.
20Fo, Israɛl, wu asɔ damta ga,
ama fo alɛ be lakal maŋ wɔ amo to.
Fo kɔ asoe nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ n nu asheŋ,
ama fo alɛ maŋ kaŋ asoe n nu shɛŋ.”
21Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaa bee sha kumɔlga basa so,
e bee keni mbe mbraana nɛ keŋini a bɔlɔ kenishi nna,
mo alɛ nsaa sha mbe basa e baa bunyaŋ amo.
22Ama naniere mbe basa ki basa nɛ beko
suge bumo be asɔ eleŋso nna,
nseŋ ta bumo kikɛ n wɔtɔ emaŋ chiŋgeliŋ to
ŋko n ti ebu nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n lara bumo.
Beko daŋ suge asɔ kama b daa kɔ nna
nɛ esa kama malɛ daa maŋ wɔtɔ
nɛ e kɔ n sɔ amo n sa bumo.
23Menyi to be emo e naaŋ kaŋ kusoe n nu kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ?
Yili kabre a yɔ, menyeeŋ kaŋ asoe n nu nɛnɛ a?
24Wanɛ e sa ekpa nɛ beko ba suge Israɛl be asɔ?
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ an wora n da so na
gbagba e sa bumo ekpa nɛ b wora loŋ!
Ŋkpal manɛ so, an daa maa wɔ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ e daa sha na to
ŋko n daa wora mbe keŋini nɛ e sa anyi na kasonu.
25Amoso nɛ e shin nɛ mbe agbogboŋ ba anyi so
nseŋ shin nɛ kena lubi koso anyi so na.
Mbe agbo daŋ suse fanɛ edɛ nna ashi Israɛl kikɛ to,
ama an daa maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k daa wora na.
Anyi alɛ daa maŋ koya shɛŋ kumo to.

Title: AIZAAYA 43
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ mɔlga mbe basa be asheŋ
1Israɛl be basa, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to menyi na yɛ:
“Men sa maa lɔ kufu, meeŋ mɔlga menyi.
Ma e ti menyi be atre n tre menyi.
Men la ma basa nna.
2Nɛ men bɔla lɔr chiŋgeliŋ to gba,
ma nɛ menyi e naaŋ baa la.
Etɔrɔ nɛ e beeŋ ba menyi so maaŋ pɔɔ menyi so.
Nɛ men bɔla edɛ to gba, a maaŋ chɔɔ menyi.
Kechɔŋkeni kpakpaso kama nɛ k beeŋ ba menyi so
maaŋ pɔɔ menyi so.
3Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.
Ma, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na, e la menyi be emɔlgapo.
Meeŋ kplaŋ Ijipt nɛ Itiopia nɛ kebonfu nɛ baa tre Seba na
be asheŋ so nseŋ sɔ menyi n yige.
4Meeŋ kplaŋ efuli pɔtɛana na so nseŋ mɔlga menyi,
ŋkpal menyi be asheŋ ka bee par ma ga so.
Ma alɛ bee sha menyi nna nsaa maŋkura menyi.
5Men sa maa lɔ kufu! Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma nɛ menyi nna.
Meeŋ yili epeŋilarkpa m ba choŋ epeŋitɔrkpa
n ya bar menyi abar so.
6Meeŋ kaŋɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kelargato be esoso
nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ kelargato be kaseto na kikɛ fanɛ,
b sa menyi, nɛ men la ma basa, ekpa nɛ men baa yɔ!
Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b shin nɛ men shi
efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a wɔ kufɔ kufɔ,
nɛ durnya be kaplɛkama m bɛta m ba
menyi gbagba be efuli so.
7Men la ŋ gbagba be basa nna,
nɛ n to menyi nɛ men baa kemaŋkura ma.”
Israɛlebi ka la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be eshɛdajipoana be asheŋ
8Nɛ Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Shin nɛ ma basa e gama abar so.
B kɔ anishi, ama bumo alɛ maa wu;
b kɔ asoe, bumo alɛ maa nu!
9Kaŋɛ efuliana na be basa fanɛ b gama abar so.
Bumo be agbirana na be kumo e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ
kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefoso?
Agbirana na be emo e naŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ
kusɔ nɛ k bee wora naniere ere?
Men shin nɛ agbirana na e bar bumo be eshɛdajipoana,
nɛ b ba ŋini fanɛ kusɔ nɛ b kaŋɛ na la kashenteŋ nna.
10Menyi Israɛl be basa e la ma eshɛdajipoana;
ma e lara menyi nɛ men baa la ma nyɛrbi,
saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ pin ma nseŋ yirda ma
nseŋ naŋ pin to fanɛ n nawule e la Ebɔrɛ.
Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti ma so.
Ekama malɛ maaŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti ma so.
11N nawule kpeŋ e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
Ma alɛ nawule e naaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga menyi.
12Ma e daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ mɔlga menyi,
ma alɛ wora m bɔlɔ ma kɔnɔ naseso na so.
Menyi e la ma eshɛdajipoana nsaa nyi fanɛ
mannɛ efuli pɔtɛ ko be kegbir e mɔlga menyi.
Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.
13Ma e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na.
Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gberge menyi n suge ma enɔ to;
ŋko ŋ kuŋ ma ekpa nɛ m maaŋ tiŋ n wora
kusɔ nɛ mee sha.”
Israɛl be kelar Babilɔn be efuli so be asheŋ
14Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi
nɛ e mɔlga bumo na kaŋɛ nde:
“Meeŋ shuŋi benapo ko nɛ b ba kɔ Babilɔn be efuli so
be basa kena nseŋ mɔlga menyi.
Ma alɛ beeŋ buri kadegboŋ na be mbunagboŋ to,
nseŋ shin nɛ benapo na e ta Babilɔn be basa
n wɔtɔ bumo gbagba be ekuloŋgboŋ to n sulɔ bumo a yɔ
nɛ b baa boŋ to a shu.
15Ma e la Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na.
Israɛl, mee to fo nsaa la fo ewura.”
16Dra dra na kikɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nase ekpa teku peper na to n sa menyi
ashi Ijipt be efuli so.
17Mo e daŋ juŋkpar benapo lempoana n yɔ kemur to;
b daa la benapo nɛ b kɔ egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko nna.
B daŋ kɔ n tɔr nsaa maŋ naŋ tiŋ nɛ b koso kikɛ.
B daŋ ki fanɛ fitila nɛ b foŋ kumo be edɛ n duŋ nna!
18Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naaŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Men teŋ asheŋ nɛ a wora dra na so!
Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ ta menyi be nfɛra n wɔtɔ
asheŋ nɛ e wora n choŋ na to.
19Men baa keni kusɔ popɔr nɛ meeŋ wora na ekpa.
K tea wora gba! Menyeeŋ tiŋ n wu kumo naniere!
Meeŋ wora ekpa keshishɛrsawule so
nseŋ shin nɛ men nya mbombi ashi kasawule wɔlso so.
20Jemanɛ ko bee ba nɛ n shin nɛ elɔr
e baa shile keshishɛrsawule so,
nɛ ma basa laraso e nya nchu a nuu.
Saŋɛ na so asɔbɔya lubi beeŋ baa maŋkura ma,
nɛ ejiŋkaamu nɛ egbuŋgbula kikɛ e baa di ma epaŋ.
21B la basa nɛ n to bumo n sa ma kumu nna,
nɛ b baa boŋ nshɛ a kpaŋ ma!”
Israɛl be kulubi be asheŋ
22Ade be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Ama ma asheŋ gba menyi, Israɛl be basa, nna
nɛ menyi maŋ naa shuŋ ma.
23Menyi maŋ ta mbolpɔ n lara esarga chɔɔso n sa ma,
ŋko n ta menyi be esarga m bunyaŋ ma.
Ma alɛ maŋ yili menyi so a fin ayu be esarga
ŋko efɛa belbelso be eduwu be esarga
n shin nɛ ebɔl e lar menyi.
24Menyi maŋ tɔ efɛa belbelso be eduwu n sa ma
ŋko n sa ma menyi be asɔbɔya be nfɔ gba.
Ama menyi be alubi nɛ men bela n deŋi ma so;
nseŋ shin nɛ menyi be aworandeso lar ma ebɔl.
25Ma, e naa ta menyi be alubi a paŋ menyi,
ŋkpal esa nɛ e la ma so.
Ma alɛ maŋ naa nyiŋi alubi nɛ men wora ŋ gbiti ma na.
26To, men shin nɛ ma nɛ menyi e yɔ demujikpa!
Nɛ men ta menyi be asheŋ n nase ma anishi to
a ŋini fanɛ men wora n nyalɛ nna!
27Men nananyɛn sososo daŋ wora kulubi nna,
nɛ menyi be bejuŋkparpoana malɛ lar ma kaman.
28Amoso nɛ n daa maŋ shin nɛ
menyi be bɔrɛmatapoana shuŋ ma
ashi ma bɔrɛlambu to na.
Ma alɛ e daŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be efuli mur
nɛ menyi be basa ji anishinyɔr na.”

Title: AIZAAYA 44
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nawule ka la Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le:
“Israɛl be basa, ma e lara menyi fanɛ ma nyɛrbi.
2Ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to menyi.
Jemanɛ nɛ b kurge menyi kikɛ nɛ n chɛ menyi to.
Men sa maa lɔ kufu, ŋkpal manɛ so, men la ma nyɛrbi
nɛ ma basa laraso nɛ mee sha nna.
3Meeŋ shin nɛ kasawule nɛ k wɔl a baŋɛ
ŋ ki mbombi e shile kumo so.
Meeŋ shin nɛ ma kiyoyu e gbelge menyi be mbia so
nɛ ma nɛfa e ba menyi be kaman to ebi so.
4Baaŋ purge fanɛ afitiri nɛ a bee nya nchu nɛnɛ,
ŋko ndibi nɛ a kɔ afantaŋ ga nsaa yil mbombi nɛ a bee shile ase.
5Basa pɔtɛ beeŋ kaŋɛ le kukoko to: ‘N la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ peya nna.’
Baaŋ ta bumo be amu n ti Israɛl be basa so.
Bumo be ekama beeŋ sibɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
be ketre n deŋi mbe be kabre so
nsaa tre mo kumu Ebɔrɛ be esa.”
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee ji kuwura Israɛl so
nsaa kuŋ kumo na e kaŋɛ le:
“Ma e la sososo nɛ lalaloge;
n nawule e la Ebɔrɛ.
Ma kaman, Ebɔrɛ kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ.
7Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wora asɔ nɛ n wora ere.
Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora
yili saŋɛ be sososo n ya fo kumo be lalaloge.
8Men sa maa lɔ kufu, ma basa!
Men nyi yili dra dra na kikɛ m ba fo mbre,
ma e naa kaŋɛ asɔ nɛ e beeŋ baa wora kikɛ;
menyi alɛ e la ma eshɛdajipoana.
N nawule e la Ebɔrɛ,
shɛŋ maŋ naa kɔ eleŋgboŋ fanɛ ma.”
Agbirana ka maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ be asheŋ
9Bekama nɛ b lɔŋɛ agbirana maŋ la shɛŋ. Agbirana nɛ baa lɔŋɛ a fa yawu kpakpaso na maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ. Basa nɛ baa shuŋ agbirana ere du fanɛ etanpo nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ nna. Bumo alɛ beeŋ ji anishinyɔr ŋkpal loŋ so. 10Keta kebɛlso n lɔŋɛ kegbir a shuŋ kumo fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ! 11Esa kama nɛ e bee shuŋ kegbir nɛ basa nɛ baa lɔŋɛ agbirana na kikɛ la edimɛdi nna. Bumo alɛ kikɛ be lalaloge la ŋaba nna. Shin nɛ b ba yili ma anishi to nɛ n ji bumo demu nɛ fo keni. Baaŋ baa chicha nseŋ ji anishinyɔr.
12Bɔyɛpo e naa ta kebɛlso a wɔtɔ edɛ to nsaa bɛa kumo a lɔŋɛ asɔ. Enɔ to nɛ e bee keta hama na a bɛa kebɛlso a lɔŋɛ kapɔrduli nɛ e bee sha na. Jemanɛ nɛ e bee shuŋ na, akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ kikɛ bee pɛ mo nna nɛ mo alɛ naa gben a ti so, a ŋini fanɛ dimɛdi e la mo.
13Ndibi be eshɛlpo e naaŋ ku kedibi nseŋ chaŋ kusɔ nɛ e bee sha na be kapɔrduli n deŋi kumo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ e shɛl kedibi na nɛ k ki fanɛ dimɛdi be kapɔrduli gbagba n yili mbe laŋ to. 14Eshɛlpo na beeŋ tiŋ n yɔ kupuŋ to n ya ku kakale ŋko kelera ŋko jaŋkelia be kedibi n shɛl. Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n duu kedibi nseŋ jo nɛ bɔrɛ e ba n wurge kumo so nɛ k daŋ nɛ e ku kumo n shɛl. 15Ndibi nɛ edimɛdi kɔ a puga edɛ na be ako nɛ baa ku a lɔŋɛ agbirana. E beeŋ kpele kedibi na be ayabi m puga edɛ n wɔl gbaŋgbaŋ to nseŋ ta ako m puga edɛ n daŋɛ n ji. Kumo be kaman nɛ e ku kedibi na be kaba n lɔŋɛ kegbir a shuŋ kumo. 16Ndibi koŋwule na be ako nɛ e beeŋ ta m puga edɛ n tɔ eblaŋ n we m moɛ. Awo to nɛ e ta ako m puga edɛ n wɔl mbe kumu nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Keni kananɛ kaboŋ bel edɛ a wɔ ebel loŋ! Edɛ walɛ bre!” 17Ade be kaman nɛ e ta ndibi nɛ a ka na n lɔŋɛ agbir nseŋ ya gbir m bunyaŋ kumo ŋ kaŋɛ: “Fo e la ma ebɔrɛ, mɔlga ma!”
18Basa nɛ baa shuŋ agbirana maŋ nyi asheŋ, bumo alɛ nsaa du fanɛ etanpo. B ti bumo be nfɛra nɛ anishi so nna a laŋɛ kashenteŋ na be kaplɛa so. 19Esa nɛ e bee lɔŋɛ agbir maŋ kɔ mbe kumu so be eleŋ ŋko nfɛra nɛ e tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ndibi na be ako nɛ n ta m puga edɛ n daŋɛ ajibi n ji nseŋ tɔ eblaŋ edɛ koŋwule na to n we na. Ndibi nɛ a ka na nɛ n ta n lɔŋɛ kegbir na. Amoso kedishiŋ fuloŋ nɛ mee gbir a bunyaŋ na!”
20Esa nɛ e bee shuŋ agbir baa du fanɛ esa nɛ e bee muu nsunɔ a ji nna. Mbe kawulisheŋ na fule mo nna nɛ e ta mbe kumu n wɔtɔ kebaawɔtɔ ko to nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n chɛ mo to na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e maaŋ shuli fanɛ kegbir nɛ e bee shuŋ na maŋ la Ebɔrɛ kikɛ.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka la etopo nɛ emɔlgapo be asheŋ
21Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Israɛl be basa, men baa nyiŋi fanɛ men la ma nyɛrbi nna.
Mee to menyi nɛ men baa la ma nyɛrbi.
Ma alɛ maaŋ teŋ menyi so kikɛ.
22Ma e fuge menyi be alubi fanɛ afu ka ber kuwɔlpa n ya lɛ na nna.
