B ka ta Juda be basa n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so be asheŋ
24Ade be kaman nɛ Nebuzaradan naŋ pɛ Seraiya nɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nɛ Zefanaiya nɛ e bɛ Seraiya so nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be benimu asa ko gba n ti so. 25Kumo be kaman nɛ e pɛ Juda be benapo be benimuana na be eko nɛ ewura Zɛdikaya be besoetojipo ashunu nɛ b kraa wɔ kadegboŋ na to na, nɛ enimu nɛ e bee nite efuli na so a tintiŋ basa a wɔtɔ kebɔŋwura to na, n ta benapo adeshe nɛ e daŋ pɛ kadegboŋ na to na ti so. 26-27Kumo be kaman nɛ Nebuzaradan keta bumo kikɛ n yɔ Ribla ashi Hamaf be kasawule so nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza shin nɛ b mɔ bumo.
Juda be basa maŋ naa wɔ bumo gbagba be efuli so ŋkpal b ka keta bumo n yɔ kenyaya to ashi efuli wɔfɔ so so. 28Juda be basa nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza pɛ anya n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so be kananɛ b sa nɛ b sibɛ n nase kebɛso kebɛso nde.
Mbe kuwurji be kafɛ shunusopo to basa ŋgboŋ asa nɛ adunyɔ nɛ asa nɛ e pɛ ashi Jerusalɛm n yɔ Babilɔn.
29Mbe kafɛ kuduaburwasopo to malɛ basa alfa aburwa nɛ adesa nɛ anyɔ nɛ e pɛ n yɔ Babilɔn.
30Mbe kafɛ adunyɔ nɛ asa to malɛ benapo nɛ baa kuŋ mo na be enimu, Nebuzaradan daŋ pɛ basa alfa ashunu nɛ adena nɛ anu nna n yɔ Babilɔn.
Amoso basa nɛ Ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ pɛ Juda be efuli so n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so kikɛ koso basa ŋgboŋ ana nɛ alfa ashe nna.
31Babilɔn be Ewura Nebukadneeza daŋ pɛ Juda be ewura Jehowachin nna n ya ti ebu nfɛ adesa nɛ ashunu ashi Babilɔn be efuli so. Kafɛ nɛ ewura Nebukadneeza wu nɛ mo pibinyɛn, Ivɔl Mɛrodak, nɛ e sɔ mo so n ji Babilɔn be kuwura na wu ewura Jehowachin kuwɔr n shin nɛ b lara mo kabuti to. 32E daŋ shu Juda be ewura Jehowachin so nna nseŋ sa mo kemaŋkura a chɔ bewura kama nɛ b pɛ m ba Babilɔn be efuli so na kikɛ. 33E daŋ sa ewura Jehowachin ekpa nna nɛ e maŋ naa buu kabuti to be asɔbuuso nsaa buu amo nɛ e bee sha. Mo alɛ nɛ Babilɔn be ewura daa chena mbe ejikpa nna a ji karechɛ kikɛ. 34Ewura Jehowachin ka daa wɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na, Babilɔn be ewura daa sa mo amansherbi jiso karechɛ kikɛ nna, hale n ya fo kachɛ nɛ e wu.

Title: NFABEL 1
Content:
Kebɔltofinfin ka tɔr Jerusalɛm be basa so be asheŋ
1Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ nɛ basa daŋ bɔlɔ kumo to na
e dese fuloŋ naniere na!
Kadegboŋ nɛ durnya kikɛ daa nyi kumo be asheŋ
nsaa sa kumo bunyaŋ ga na
e ki fanɛ ekulpoche na!
Kadegboŋ nɛ efuliana kikɛ daa shuŋ a sa na,
e ki somaŋji na!
2Kanyɛso kikɛ, kumo to be basa bee shu nna
nɛ anishichubi bee pɔ bumo be ŋgbuŋ.
Kumo beshapo kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ
nɛ b lolo kumo n wushi kumo kagbene.
Kumo teriana kikɛ lar kumo kaman nseŋ debɔr kumo,
naniere b ki kumo be bedoŋ nna.
3Juda be efuli so be basa ki anya nna,
a ji awurfoŋ ashi efuli pɔtɛana so.
Efuli pɔtɛana so nɛ b wɔ a maa kɔ kakpa
nɛ baaŋ tre bumo gbagba pe.
Bedoŋ e kulti bumo n wɔtɔ,
nɛ ekpa maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ b bɔla so m mɔlga bumo be amu.
4Naniere esa kikɛ maŋ naa ba bɔrɛlambu
nɛ k yil Zayɔn be kebeegboŋ so na to
m ba kaa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nchɛgboŋachɛ.
Beche fɔlbi nɛ baa boŋ nshɛ ndoŋ na bee ji awurfoŋ nna,
nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na malɛ bee munto a shu.
Kadegboŋ na be mbunagboŋana na ase wora shruum
nɛ k wora fanɛ kebɔltofinfin ka pɛ Jerusalɛm na.
5Bedoŋ e naa ji kadegboŋ na so kuwura
nsaa wɔ kumo to a wora bumo be kepar.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e gberge Jerusalɛm be basa kusoe
ŋkpal asheŋ lubi damta nɛ b wora na so.
E shin nɛ bedoŋ pɛ bumo ŋ ki anya nna n yɔ efuli wɔfɔ so.
6Jerusalɛm be kemaŋkura kikɛ loge.
Kumo be bejuŋkparpoana ki fanɛ echibir nɛ akoŋ kɔ
nɛ b maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nɛ b shile ŋ ŋana bekpampo so nna.
7Jerusalɛm be basa bee nyiŋi dra na
be kebaawɔtɔ lela nɛ b daa kɔ be asheŋ.
Jemanɛ nɛ bumo doŋana ba kɔ m pɔɔ bumo so na,
esa kikɛ daa maŋ chɛ bumo to.
Ŋkpal b ka kɔ n tɔr so, bumo doŋana
daŋ mushe nseŋ wora bumo eyur to nna.
8Jerusalɛm to be asheŋ lubi so,
k ki kadegboŋ nɛ ekama bee keni jiga nna.
Basa kama nɛ b daa sha kumo nsaa keni kumo a bɔlɔ kenishi,
kikɛ kishi kumo be asheŋ naniere nna.
Jerusalɛm be basa gbagba be asheŋ woraso
shin nɛ k wora eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so nna.
9Kumo to be asheŋ lubi na daŋ dii efuli nna,
ama amo be asheŋ maŋ tir kumo be basa na.
Jerusalɛm be kebure n tɔr na daŋ lubi ga.
Esa kikɛ daa maŋ lolo kumo be basa na n ti bumo kagbene.
Bedoŋ daŋ pɔɔ basa na so nna nɛ baa shu a kaŋɛ
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na fanɛ e wu bumo kuwɔr.
10Bedoŋ na daŋ suge bumo be yawu kpakpaso be asɔ kikɛ nna.
Jerusalɛm be basa na daŋ wu befɔ na
ka luri bumo be bɔrɛlambu nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daa
maŋ sa nnyamase ekpa fanɛ b luri kumo to na nna.
11Jerusalɛm be basa na kikɛ daa fubel nna,
jemanɛ nɛ b daa fin kusɔ jiso nɛ b ji na.
B daa ta bumo be asɔ lela a chɛr ajibi
nɛ baaŋ ji nseŋ nya ŋkpa nna.
Le nɛ b daa kaŋɛ:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni awurfoŋ nɛ anyee ji.”
12Esa kama nɛ e bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ baaŋ kaŋɛ mo le:
“Keni, chɛ anyi to! Esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ ji awurfoŋ
nɛ k fo awurfoŋ nɛ anyee ji ere so.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e nya agbo
n shin k ba anyi so.
13Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ ebesa shi esoso
m ba luri anyi be eyurana to a chɔɔ fanɛ edɛ na.
K du fanɛ e ka sho kejigbelɛ m pɛ anyi nɛ an tɔr kasawule nna.
Kumo be kaman nɛ e yige anyi n wɔtɔ ebesa nɛ k maa yige to.
14Kewora fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gama anyi be alubi kikɛ
n chɛ n shiga anyi be abɔ so nna nɛ amo be egbɛ
shin nɛ anyi be eleŋ kikɛ lar anyi to.
E ta anyi m bɔɔ an doŋana nɛ b chɔ anyi eleŋ ga enɔ nna,
nɛ anyi maŋ kɔ shɛŋ nɛ an wora bumo be anishito.
15Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na wora anyi eyur to nna m mushe
anyi be benapo lempoana.
E shin nɛ benapo ba nna m ba mur anyi be mbrantiɛfɔlbi,
nseŋ chichi anyi be basa so fanɛ
kananɛ baa chichi greep be asɔrso so a wora yabra na.
16Amoso nɛ anyee shu anishichubi ga na.
Esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n lolo anyi n ti anyi kagbene,
esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n leŋ anyi to nɛ an naŋ nya kenyɛn.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, an doŋana pɔɔ anyi so
nɛ anyi maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ kebaawɔtɔ to.
17An teŋi anyi be enɔana to nna a fin kechɛto,
ama esa kikɛ maŋ chɛ anyi to.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na tre efuliana nɛ a kulti anyi na nna
nɛ b ba kɔ anyi kena kaba kama so.
Baa keni anyi nna fanɛ basa jiga.
18Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ ekpa nɛ e wora loŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi maŋ wora mo kasonu nna.
Kaplɛkama be basa, men nu nfe.
Men keni ebesa nɛ anyee ji.
An doŋana pɛ anyi be mbifɔlbi nna
n yɔ kenyaya to ashi efuli wɔfɔ so.
19An kela n tre basa nɛ anyi nɛ bumo kre
fanɛ anyeeŋ baa chɛ abar to kena be jemanɛ,
ama b kini keba chɛ anyi to.
Bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na daŋ fin ajibi nɛ
b ji kadegboŋ na to ŋ gben nseŋ wu n dese agbembi so.
20O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni awurfoŋ nɛ ebesa damta
nɛ anyee ji ere!
Anyi be ŋgbene jija anyi nna ga ŋkpal anyi be alubi so.
Basa be kamɔ e sɔ agbembi so, nɛ anyi be elaŋana gba to.
21Ekama nu anyi ka bee munto a shu,
ama esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e lolo anyi.
An doŋana nyi etɔrɔ nɛ fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, bar anyi so,
nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo ŋkpal loŋ so.
Jande, nya manaŋ ŋ gberge bumo kusoe,
fanɛ kananɛ fo nase kɔnɔ na.
22Sa maŋ kplaŋ bumo be asheŋ lubi so
n shin nɛ b nya bumo be amu n ji.
Kananɛ fo baŋ gberge anyi kusoe ŋkpal anyi be alubi so na,
gberge bumo alɛ gba kusoe ŋkpal bumo be alubi so.
Anyee munto a shu kagbenejijaso nna.
Anyi be tama kikɛ loge.”

Title: NFABEL 2
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka gberge Jerusalɛmebi kusoe be asheŋ
1Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nya agbo nna n shin nɛ
Zayɔn be kebee nɛ k wɔ Jerusalɛm to na
paŋ kumo be kemaŋkuragboŋ kikɛ.
Kumo e daa la kakpa nɛ Israɛlebi daa puchi so
nseŋ naa la kakpa nɛ mo gbagba be bɔrɛlambu wɔ.
Ama kachɛ nɛ e nya agbo na,
e daŋ bure kumo nna n lɛ kasawule.
2Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ maŋ wu ndekarso nɛ a wɔ
Juda be efuli so na kikɛ kuwɔr nseŋ shin nɛ a mur.
E daŋ shin nɛ mboŋ lempoana nɛ a daa
kuŋ kasawule na kikɛ bure n tɔr nna,
nseŋ shin nɛ efuli na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ ji anishinyɔr.
3Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nya agbo nna ga,
nseŋ daŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be basa paŋ bumo be eleŋ kikɛ.
An doŋana ka ba anyi so, e daŋ kini kechɛ anyi to nna.
Mbe agbo daŋ koso anyi so fanɛ edɛ nna a mur kusɔ kikɛ.
4E daa to anyi mbe atanyembi nna fanɛ edoŋ na.
Nseŋ daŋ mɔ basa kama nɛ b daa bar anyi
kagbenewushi nɛ kagbenefuli na.
E daŋ shin nɛ mbe agbo ba fanɛ edɛ nna m ba chɔɔ
anyi be nwu nɛ a wɔ Jerusalɛm to na n lɛ kasawule.
5Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ mur Israɛl nna fanɛ edoŋ na,
nseŋ daŋ shin nɛ kumo be mboŋ lempoana nɛ
ewurkpaana ki alambure a dese.
N naŋ shin nɛ kebɔltofinfin nɛ kushu
naŋ wora keshi n ti so n sa Juda be efuli so be basa.
6E daŋ shin nɛ mbe bɔrɛlambu nɛ anyee shuŋ mo kumo to na
daŋ bure n tɔr nna fanɛ kudɔtobuu na.
Nseŋ shin nɛ nchɛgboŋ nɛ kewushiachɛ na be keji ba ekar.
Mbe agbogboŋ na so, e daŋ kini ewura na
nɛ bɔrɛmatapo na gba nna n lɛ.
7Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ kini mbe bɔrɛsure nna n lɛ
nseŋ daŋ lar mbe bɔrɛlambu cheembi to ŋ ka kumo.
E daŋ sa bedoŋ ekpa nna nɛ b da Jerusalɛm be egbalana n lɛ,
nseŋ daa wora awɔr a ŋini fanɛ b kɔ m pɔɔ kakpa nɛ
an daa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ kagbenefuliso na so.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na gbagba daŋ yili kumo mbe kagbene to fanɛ
a daga egbalana nɛ a kulti Jerusalɛm na ka bure n tɔr.
E ka fara kumo be kebure e maŋ naŋ yige kikɛ,
a ŋini fanɛ e bee sha kumo be kemur cheche nna.
Naniere kumo be mboŋ lempoana
nɛ egbalana kikɛ bure a dese.
9Jerusalɛm be mbunagboŋana tɔr a pul eshishɛr to
nɛ ndibi nɛ baa ta a ber amo so na kikɛ buri to burburbi a dese.
Ewura nɛ bewurbi nɛ b daa wɔ ndoŋ na
kikɛ ki anya efuli wɔfɔ so nna.
Bɔrɛmatapoana na maŋ naa ŋini mbraana na,
anebiana na malɛ maŋ naa nu kubɔya kikɛ
ashi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kutɔ.
10Jerusalɛm be benimuana na daŋ buu nli be asɔbuuso a tase
kasawule a maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ nɛ b kaŋɛ abar,
nseŋ wora eshishɛr ŋ gbiti bumo be amu to
a ŋini bumo be kagbenejija nna.
Nɛ bechefɔlbi na malɛ chena
ŋ kurgi amu n yuu to a keni kasawule.
11M baŋ shu nna m pere anishi hale nɛ ma epun to bee besa.
Ma basa ka mur na shin nɛ ma kagbene jija ma hale nɛ m bɛlɛ.
Mbi wurbi nɛ mbi popɔrbi kikɛ kreŋ a dese agbembi so
ŋkpal esa kikɛ ka maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e keni bumo so
ashi kadegboŋ na to so.
12Akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ so, mbia bee shu nna
a fin ajibi nɛ nchu bumo nioana kutɔ, bumo alɛ maa nya.
Amoso baa kreŋ a tɔr nna fanɛ enapo ka doro kena to n tɔr na;
nseŋ wu bumo nioana be enɔana to.
13O Jerusalɛmebi, manɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ?
Nuso bre nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n lɔlɔ menyi? Ŋkpal manɛ so,
esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ ji awurfoŋ fanɛ kananɛ men ji ere.
Jɛrbi nɛ men ji ere maŋ kɔ ekar fanɛ teku;
tama be yiri kikɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ n sa menyi.
14Menyi be anebiana maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ nɛ b kaŋɛ menyi
nɛ mannɛ efɛ be kebaakuu a sa menyi.
Abɔrɛsheŋ nɛ b malga n sa menyi na
maŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ men wu menyi be alubi.
B shin nna nɛ menyee fɛ fanɛ
a maŋ daga men tuba n lar alubi to.
15Basa nɛ b bɔla kadegboŋ na ase a choŋ bee fɛl menyi nna.
Baa keni Jerusalɛm be alambure na nna
nsaa fifi amu a mushe.
Kumo be kaman nɛ b bishi le: “Kadegboŋ lela na nde a?
Kadegboŋ nɛ durnya kikɛ daa puchi so na nde a?”
16Menyi doŋana kikɛ bee mushe nna a wora menyi eyurto,
nsaa gbɛlɛ menyi yurkishi so.
Baa mɛr nnɔ nna nsaa kaŋɛ le: “An mur kumo!
Kachɛ nɛ an baa jo na nna na!”
17Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kre
nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ wora na nɛ e wora na.
Dra na kikɛ nɛ e kpele anyi kusoe fanɛ e maaŋ wu anyi kuwɔr;
e yɛ e beeŋ mur anyi, mo alɛ mur anyi kashenteŋto.
E shin nɛ an doŋana pɔɔ anyi so nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli,
ŋkpal an ka kɔ n tɔr so so.
18Jerusalɛmebi, men shu ŋgbene to ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
Kapa nɛ kanyɛ, men shin nɛ men be anishichubi
e baa shile fanɛ lɔr na.
Men shu hale nɛ men be ebɔl e ya fɛa!
19Men koso n shu kanyɛ lelemu kikɛ ŋ ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
nseŋ bugi ŋgbene ŋ kule mo nɛ e wu menyi be mbia
nɛ akoŋ bee mɔ agbembi so be akɔlɔbi to kikɛ na kuwɔr!
20O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, keni anyi a!
Manɛ nna nɛ fee gberge anyi kusoe loŋ?
A maŋ daga fanɛ bibinioana e baa daŋɛ
bumo be mbi shaso a we!
Ŋko nɛ basa e baa mɔ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ anebiana na
fo bɔrɛlambu gbagba to loŋ!
21Mbifɔlbi nɛ basakpar kikɛ e wu a dese agbembi so na,
bedoŋ malɛ ta etokobi m mɔ mbrantiɛ nɛ besuŋgurbi.
Kachɛ nɛ fo nya agbo na nɛ fo shin nɛ bedoŋ mɔ bumo
nsaa maŋ wu bumo kuwɔr kikɛ.
22Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo kanya agbo so,
fo kela n tre n doŋana nna fanɛ basa nɛ fo tre kejigboŋ to na.
Esa kikɛ daa maŋ ji efute loŋ be kachɛ na.
Bedoŋ na daŋ mɔ ma mbia nɛ m bela a sha bumo ga na nna.

Title: NFABEL 3
Content:
Kasogberge nɛ tuba nɛ tama be asheŋ
1N la esa nɛ n ji awurfoŋ ga nna
ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ ma so.
2E daŋ ju ma n lɛ tentembiri plɔ to,
kakpa nɛ kefulto kikɛ maŋ wɔ nna.
3Kashenteŋto, n nawule nɛ e gberge kusoe ale damta
nsaa maŋ wu ma kuwɔr kikɛ.
4Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ ma eyur so kikɛ wora achuu
nɛ ma eyur be eblaŋ kikɛ bɛlge,
nɛ ma awibi buri to nna.
5E daŋ shin nɛ kagbenejija damta nɛ kushu nɛ etɔrɔbi
ki fanɛ ebu nna ŋ kulti ma n wɔtɔ.
6E daŋ tintiŋ ma n chena tentembiri to
fanɛ esa nɛ e wu dra dra kikɛ nna.
7Ebɔrɛ daŋ yuu kunji nɛ m maaŋ tiŋ n dii nna
ŋ kulti ma n wɔtɔ,
nseŋ naŋ chɛ ma ŋgbɛlɛbi n nase.
8Ŋ ka shu awɔrso ŋ kule mo fanɛ e chɛ ma to,
e kini kenu ma kekule nna.
9Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta afalta gboŋgboŋi
n nase ma ekpa to nna,
nɛ n daa nite a lente.
10E daa du fanɛ kutuŋ ŋko buluŋ
nɛ e daŋ ŋana m pugi a jo ma
nɛ m ba nɛ e tɛ n yuu ma so nna.
11Ŋ ka fo mo nɛ e tɛ n yuu ma so,
ŋ gberge ma n lar ekpa so
n ya kpɛa ma to wurwurbi n lɛ nseŋ choŋ.
12Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta mbe keta
n yuu ma so nɛ e to ma nna.
13E ka to ketanyembi na nɛ k ba
da ma kagbene to n ya pɛ ma kukuumu.
14Ŋ ki fanɛ kemɔmɔshia be kusɔ nna n sa ekama,
saŋkikɛ basa bee mushe ma nsaa wora ma eyurto nna.
15Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ kebaawɔtɔ ki kekera n sa ma.
16E ta ma anishi to ŋ gbiti kasawule,
nɛ ajembu buri ma anyii.
17M maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n nyiŋi asɔ nɛ e la
alenfia nɛ kayurwushi nɛ kagbenefuli gba.
18Amoso kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ e la: “Asheŋ loge n sa ma!
M maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta ma tama n to Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na so
nɛ e wora kusɔ ko n sa ma kikɛ.”
19M baa fɛ etɔrɔ damta nɛ e bee tu ma
nɛ ma kenawule be kebaanite cham cham a choŋ na be asheŋ,
k bee sa ma kagbenejija damta ga nna.
20Amo be asheŋ be kebaafɛ jemanɛ kikɛ na
bee mɔ ma kiyoyu nna nsaa pɔ ma aba.
21Ama nɛ m baŋ nyiŋi kusɔ koŋwule ko bre,
k naa sa ma tama nna.
22Kumo e la fanɛ, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be alelasheŋ maa loge!
E daa maa wu kuwɔr nna, n dafanɛ anyi kikɛ mur.
23Esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na jemanɛ kikɛ
nɛ e baa wu mo kuwɔr kachipurso kikɛ.
24Kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ma kagbene to e la:
“Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e baa la ma;
mo nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n ta ma tama n to so!”
25Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la esa nna n sa
ekama nɛ e ta mbe yirda n wɔtɔ mo to
nsaa wora mo kasonu.
26Amoso, a daga fanɛ anyi e baa wora kanyiti a jo
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nɛ e mɔlga anyi.
27Jemanɛ nɛ an la mbifɔlbi na
e daga fanɛ an koya le be kanyiti ere.
28Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na tea sha fanɛ an ji awurfoŋ,
kumo ere an nya kanyiti n chena shruum a jo mo.
29Kebar anyi be amu kaseto awurfoŋ be jemanɛ
beeŋ shin nɛ an koya kusɔ ko;
ŋkpal manɛ so, tama kraa wɔtɔ n sa anyi.
30Hale nɛ b bri anyi nseŋ tege anyi gba, an sɔ kumo loŋ.
31Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na la ewɔrwupo nna,
e maaŋ kini anyi n lɛ hale mbaanaayɔ.
32Hale nɛ e shin nɛ awurfoŋ ba anyi so gba,
e kraa kɔ kushuso n sa anyi
ŋkpal mbe kasha ka shi ga so.
33Anyi be kagbenejija nɛ keji ebesa
maa par Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
34Kekeni basa nɛ b wɔ kabuti to jiga,
nseŋ ta bumo fanɛ achɛbi a chichi so,
35ŋko kepuni esa be kusɔ maa par mo.
Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee wu kusɔ kama,
36mo alɛ nsaa nyi jemanɛ nɛ baa ji esa
durmu ashi demuji to.
37Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maŋ sa kusɔ akpa
k maaŋ tiŋ n wora kikɛ.
38Kulubi nɛ kelela be ketiŋ wora kikɛ
yil kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na yili so nna.
39Manɛ nna nɛ esa nɛ e kraa kɔ ŋkpa
bee fubel a bele asheŋ
jemanɛ nɛ e wɔ mbe alubi be kasogberge to?
40Men shin nɛ an keni anyi be asheŋ woraso to nɛnɛ
nseŋ naŋ bɛta m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ.
41Men shin nɛ an bugi anyi be ŋgbene n sa
Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le:
42An lar fo kaman n wora alubi!
43Fo ka nya agbo so, fo maŋ wu anyi kuwɔr
nseŋ ju m buu anyi so n ya mɔ anyi.
44K du fanɛ fo ka wɔ awɔlpa be egbal be kaman nna
nɛ kabɔrɛkule maaŋ tiŋ m bɔl kumo to n fo fo kutɔ.
45Fo shin nɛ an ki fanɛ epi nɛ basa jiga n sa
durnya to be efuliana nna.
46An doŋana bee tege anyi nsaa wora anyi eyur to.
47An luri jɛrbi nɛ kemur damta to n lar,
naniere kufugboŋgboŋi be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ an wɔ.
48Mee shu anishichubi damta nna,
ŋkpal ma basa ka mur so.
49M maa ba nɛ n yige kebaa shu anishichubi
50n ya fo fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka beeŋ shi ebɔrɛso
n to kenishi ŋ keni n wu anyi nseŋ chɛ anyi to.
51Nɛ m baŋ wu kusɔ nɛ bedoŋ wora anyi be kadegboŋ to
be beche kikɛ na, ma kagbene bee jija ma ga nna.
52N doŋana nɛ b kishi ma nɛ m maŋ wora shɛŋ na
daŋ fe abulbi nna m pɛ ma fanɛ kabuibi na.
53Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta ma n wɔtɔ ketirbu to,
nseŋ bela ajembu a kpa ma ketirbu na to a fin kemɔ ma.
54Ndoŋ nna nɛ nchu dii m muni ma kumu so,
nɛ n fɛ fanɛ naniere n wu nna na.
55Ketirbu na be kaseto ndoŋ nɛ n wɔ
nseŋ shu n tre fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
56Ŋ ka kule fo nɛ fo nu ma kabɔrɛkule.
57Nseŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n sa maa lɔ kufu.
58Kumo be keman nɛ fo ba sɔ ma n yige
nseŋ mɔlga ma efute nɛ n ji ŋkpa.
59Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nyi kulubi nɛ b wora ma;
amoso ji asheŋ na n chɛ ma to.
60Fo nyi kananɛ n doŋana kishi ma,
nseŋ naa nyi kananɛ b kre kulubi a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so.
61“O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, fo nu katege nɛ baa tege ma;
fo alɛ naa nyi bumo be ŋkre lubi kikɛ.
62Karechɛ kikɛ baa kuli ma nna a ji ma asheŋ
nsaa kre ma nia lubi.
63Kusɔ kama nɛ baa wora,
baa boŋ nshɛ nna a wora ma eyurto.
64O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, gberge bumo kusoe
ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora so.
65Shoduu bumo nseŋ shin nɛ b ji awurfoŋ!
66Nyagbo n ju m buu bumo so m mur bumo kuraa
nɛ b sa maŋ naa wɔ durnya to!”

Title: NFABEL 4
Content:
Jerusalɛm ka bure n tɔr be kaman be asheŋ
1Anyi be shuwa nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ ga na kreŋ so
nɛ ajembu nɛ b ta m pɔr bɔrɛlambu na
pesaŋ to a dese agbembi so.
2Jerusalɛm be mbrantiɛfɔlbi daa du fanɛ shuwa
n sa anyi nna;
ama naniere bumo e ki fanɛ ebɔ be mpuliya
nɛ ekama bee keni jiga na.
3Ejiŋkamu gba bee nyipo bumo be bibi wurbi,
ama ma basa bre ki fanɛ keshishɛrsawule so
be mbuibi nɛ baa shile a ka bumo be bibi
a wora bumo be mbiwurbi na kumu kpakpaso nna.
4Baa shin nɛ akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ
bee mɔ bumo be mbi popɔrbi nna;
mbia na bee ta enɔ to a kule ajibi nna,
esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ sa bumo ajibi nɛ b ji.
5Basa nɛ b daa ji ajibi lela nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa ga na
nɛ akoŋ bee mɔ a lɛ agbembi so na.
Bumo nɛ b daa ji kedamaya na,
e naa amuni so a fin ajibi jiso na.
6Ma basa be kasogberge chɔ basa
nɛ b daa wɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sodɔm,
nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ mur kumo epul to dra dra na peya.
7Anyi be benimuana be ŋgbene daŋ fuli nna parr fanɛ ateebi;
b daŋ maŋ kɔ saŋgre kikɛ bumo to.
Bumo alɛ daa kɔ eyur be alenfia, a walɛ eyurto nɛnɛ
nsaa kɔ kuwibi to be eleŋ ga, a walɛ eyur so nna.
8Ama naniere bumo e chɔɔ m biri fanɛ
adundumbi a dese agbembi so,
nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m pin bumo na.
B daŋ nyɔr nna ŋ ki awibi nawule fanɛ ndibi wɔlso na.
9Bumo nɛ b daŋ wu kena to na bɔ bumo nɛ akoŋ mɔ na.
Ŋkpal b ka maŋ nya ajibi nɛ b ji so,
akoŋ shin nɛ b ji awurfoŋ nna hale n ya wu.
10Kemurgboŋ nɛ k daŋ ba ma basa so na
daŋ shin nɛ beche nɛ baa sha bumo be mbia ga gbagba
daŋɛ bumo be mbia nɛ b wu nna n we ŋkpal akoŋ so.
11Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ nya agbo ga so,
e daŋ shin nɛ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na
ji edɛ nna m mur cheche.
12Ekama nɛ e wɔ kaplɛkama;
hale efuli pɔtɛana so be bewuraana gba
daa maŋ yirda fanɛ bedoŋ beeŋ tiŋ m bure
Jerusalɛm be mbunagboŋana n luri kumo to ŋ kɔ.
13Ama loŋ daŋ wora nna ŋkpal Jerusalɛm to be anebiana
nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na ka daŋ wora alubi
nseŋ shin nɛ b mɔ basa nɛ b maŋ wora shɛŋ na so.
14Kashenteŋto, anebiana na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na
daa nite kadegboŋ na be agbembi so
cham cham fanɛ etanpo nna.
Ŋkpal basa nɛ b wu na be luwu be turju ka bɛ bumo so so,
esa kikɛ daa maa sha kefirgi n tege bumo to gba kuraa.
15Kusɔ nɛ basa bee kaŋɛ bumo nde: “Men shile anyi so!
Men wora eyurpi nna. Men sa maŋ beta anyi ere!”
Ŋkpal loŋ so efuli kama so nɛ b yɔ,
ndoŋebi gba bee kini bumo nna.
16Bumo be asheŋ daa maŋ naŋ tir Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na,
amoso mo gbagba e daŋ shin nɛ b pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama.
E daa maŋ naa sa anyi be anebiana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na
bunyaŋ ŋko a wu bumo kuwɔr gba.
17Ade kikɛ be kaman, an daa keni a fin kechɛto
ashi efuli pɔtɛ ko kutɔ, ama anyi be tama ki fuloŋ;
ŋkpal manɛ so, efuli na maŋ tiŋ n chɛ to m mɔlga anyi.
18Bedoŋ daa fin anyi nɛ b mɔ ashi kegbembi kama so nna.
Amoso an daa maŋ naa tiŋ a nite agbembi so.
Anyi be kemur be jemanɛ fo,
anyi be nchɛ fo ekar nna na.
19An doŋana na daa du fanɛ kusore
ka bee fuu kusɔ na nna.
B daa ju a buu anyi so kaplɛkama nna
a fin anyi nɛ b pɛ.
Abee so nɛ b daa kuŋ anyi a pɛ,
ŋko pugi keshishɛrsawule so
a jo anyi nɛ an ba purgi bumo nɛ b pɛ.
20B daŋ pɛ ewura nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
gbagba lara n sa anyi nɛ an daa fute a yige mo so na nna.
Mo e la ewura nɛ an daŋ yirda fanɛ e beeŋ baa kuŋ anyi
ashi edoŋ kama nɛ e beeŋ ba kɔ anyi kena kutɔ.
21Menyi Edɔm be efuli so, nɛ Uz be kasawule so be basa,
menyi be ŋgbene fuli menyi nna nɛ menyee mushe.
Menyeeŋ ji jɛrbi nseŋ ji awurfoŋ ga.
Menyeeŋ nite kesaria a jante fanɛ men ka boo nsa na.
22Zayɔn be kadegboŋ na to be basa bre
teŋ ka bumo be alubi be kukɔ nna na.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ naŋ shin nɛ an baa wɔ
kenyaya to ashi efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ so.
E beeŋ shin nɛ an bɛta m ba epe.
Ama menyi Edɔm be efuli so be basa bre,
e beeŋ gberge menyi kusoe nseŋ shin nɛ menyi
be asheŋ lubi e dii efuli nɛ ekama e pin amo.

Title: NFABEL 5
Content:
Kekule Ebɔrɛ n fin mbe kuwɔrwu be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jerusalɛm to be basa kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ:
“O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ k wora anyi ere.
To kenishi ŋ keni ŋaba nɛ an wɔ kumo to.
2Anyi be kasawule laŋɛ basa pɔtɛ be enɔ to;
nɛ befɔ sɔ anyi be nwu n chena to.
3An doŋana shin nɛ an ki amunibi,
nɛ an nioana malɛ ki bekulpoche.
4Naniere anyee ka nchu nɛ anyee nuu be kukɔ nna;
nsaa tɔ ndibi puga edɛ yawu kpakpaso.
5Basa nɛ baa ju anyi na baa ji anyi ayabi nna,
an gben ama anyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n yili n wushi.
6Ijipt nɛ Asiriya be efuliana so nɛ an ya kaa kule
ajibi nɛ anyeeŋ ji nseŋ nya ŋkpa a wɔtɔ.
7An nananyɛnana e daŋ wora alubi,
bumo alɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ naniere.
Anyi e wɔtɔ a ji bumo be alubi na be awurfoŋ.
8Basa nɛ anya bɔ bumo e naa ji anyi so kuwura.
Esa kikɛ malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e mɔlga anyi bumo be enɔ to.
9Anyee ta anyi be ŋkpa a kpa kelera nna pɔɛŋ nsaa nya ajibi jiso;
ŋkpal basa nɛ baa mɔ basa ka sɔ efuli na be kaplɛkama so.
10Akoŋ shin nɛ anyee lɔ hale a chicha,
nɛ anyi be eyurana bel edɛ fanɛ asure to.
11B pur anyi be beche nɛ anyi be mbichesobi
Zayɔn be kebee so ashi Jerusalɛm
nɛ Juda be efuli so be ndeana to.
12B pɛ anyi be bewuraana n ya chɛ efɔl;
esa malɛ maa sa anyi be benimuana bunyaŋ.
13B nyaŋ anyi be mbrantiɛfɔlbi
nɛ baa kɔr ayu abo so fanɛ anya,
nɛ anyi be mbinyɛnsobi malɛ bee sulɔ
ndibi gbɛgbɛso a jante.
14Basakpar maŋ naa chena kadegboŋ na
be mbunagboŋana na ase a ji asheŋ.
Mbifɔlbi malɛ gba maŋ naa boŋ nshɛ.
15Kagbenefuli maŋ naa wɔ anyi to kikɛ;
anyi be epelana ki fanɛ nli nna nɛ anyee shu.
16Asɔ nɛ an daa puchi so na be kekama maŋ naa wɔtɔ.
Ŋkpal anyi ka wora alubi so, asheŋ maa nyalɛ a sa anyi.
17Anyi be eyur be kaplɛkama bee besa nna;
anyi maŋ naa wu nɛnɛ ŋkpal anishichubi so.
18Ekama shile Zayɔn be kebee na so nɛ k dese fuloŋ,
nɛ ejiŋkaamu sɔ kumo so a wora bumo be kepar.
19Ama fo, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la ewura mbaanaayɔ.
Fo e naa ji kuwura hale n ya fo jemanɛ be lalaloge.
20Nɛ manɛ nna nɛ fo teŋ anyi so n chɛr loŋ?
Manɛ nna nɛ fo kplaŋ anyi so loŋ?
21O Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ, naŋ bɛta anyi m ba fo kutɔ!
Nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ an nya anyi be kebaawɔtɔ lela dra na!
22Ŋko fo kini anyi nna n lɛ mbaanaayɔ?
Ama fo agbo maŋ kɔ ekar a?”

Title: EZIKƐL 1
Content:
Ezikɛl ka wu Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura be asheŋ
1-3Ma ketre e la Ezikɛl nɛ n la bɔrɛmatapo nsaa la kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Buzi na pibinyɛn. B ka pɛ Juda be ewura nɛ baa tre Jehowachin nseŋ tintiŋ mo n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ nusopo to nɛ ma nɛ bumo nɛ b pɛ n ti mo so n yɔ na daa wɔ lɔr nɛ baa tre Kɛba na ase. Ma nfɛ adesa to be kufɔl nasopo to be kachɛ nusopo na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kubɔya ba ma kutɔ nɛ esoso bugi n shin nɛ ŋ ku bɔrɛdare ere. 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni esoso n wu bɔrɛ be afugboŋ ko ka shi kelargato be esoso be kaba so a ba. Bɔrɛ daa nyɛkpɛ kuwɔlpagboŋ ko to nna nɛ esoso kikɛ fulto. Edɛ daa lar kuwɔlpagboŋ na be nferinto a nyɛkpɛ fanɛ danyaŋ nɛ k la kachɔnɔnyifu nɛ b fifɛa kumo so na nna. 5Nɛ n wu asɔbɔya keniso ana ko nɛ b du fanɛ edimɛdi ashi edɛ na be nferinto. 6Bumo be ekama daa kɔ anishito ana nɛ mbuibi be aba ana ana nna. 7Bumo be aya daa maŋ kɔ echɛkpa amo alɛ nsaa kɔ alotobi fanɛ kenabi na. Alotobi na daa kpa edɛ nna fanɛ danyaŋ nɛ b fifɛa so nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ so na. 8Asɔbɔya keniso na be ekama daa kɔ dimɛdi be enɔ nna ashi mbe aba ana na be kekama be kaseto. 9B daŋ pal kaman nna n sa abar nseŋ parga bumo be aba na be anyɔ anyɔ to nɛ amo be nnɔso pɛ abar. Kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ baa yɔ, b pɛ abar to loŋ nna a yɔ, b maa kilgi bumo be eyurana. 10Anishito ana nɛ ekama kɔ na malɛ daa kɔr abar to nna. Bumo be anishito be kaba so daa la dimɛdi be anishito nna, nɛ jisoso be kaba so la buluŋ be anishito, nɛ bena so la gbolu be anishito nɛ kaman malɛ peya na la kusore be anishito. 11Asɔbɔya keniso na daŋ parga bumo be aba na be anyɔ anyɔ to nna nɛ a beta bumo braana nɛ b wɔ bumo be jisoso nɛ bena so na peya, nseŋ parga anyɔ anyɔ nɛ a ka malɛ to m buu bumo be eyurana so. 12Bumo be ekama be anishito daa keni mba ana na kikɛ nna, amoso bumo kikɛ beeŋ tiŋ m pɛ abar to n yɔ kaba kama so nɛ b maŋ kilgi. 13Asɔbɔya keniso na daa du fanɛ mbulpi nɛ a bee suse nna a nite saŋkikɛ, nsaa nyɛrga a kpa edɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee nyɛkpɛ na. 14Bumo alɛ daa yɔ anishito nsaa bɛta kaman manaŋ manaŋ nna fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee nyɛkpɛ na. 15Ŋ ka bee keni asɔbɔya keniso ana na nɛ n wu fanɛ bumo be ekama kɔ kusɔ kulkulso fanɛ cheche be keya nɛ k yil kasawule nna m mata mo. 16Aya kulkulso ana na kikɛ daŋ duli abar nna nsaa kpa edɛ fanɛ yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso na, nɛ amo be kekama malɛ kɔ keya kulkulso nyɔsopo nɛ k kilgi n larga to ashi kumo be nferinto, 17saŋɛ na so aya kulkulso na gba beeŋ tiŋ a yɔ anishito ŋko a bɛta kaman, ŋko a yɔ bena so ŋko jisoso nɛ a maŋ kilgi. 18Abɛlso kulkulso nɛ a wɔ asɔbɔya keniso na be aya kulkulso fanɛ cheche be aya na to na daa kɔ anishi ŋ kulti amo be kaplɛkama.
19Asɔbɔya keniso ana na baa yɔ kaplɛkama, aya kulkulso nɛ a mata bumo na gba bee yɔ ndoŋ nna, nɛ b baa firgi, aya na gba bee firgi nna. 20Kaplɛkama nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na daa sha keyɔ baa yɔ nna nɛ bumo be aya kulkulso na e tu bumo a yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔbɔya keniso na e naa keta aya na a ashuŋ. 21Ŋkpal loŋ so, jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na bee nite ŋko n yili ŋko a firgi gba nna, aya kulkulso na gba bee wora loŋ gbagba nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔbɔya keniso na e naa keta amo a shuŋ.
22Kede be kaman nɛ n wu kusɔ ko nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛ fanɛ jɛrbi nsaa du le joŋgroŋ ka salga n sɔ awɔlto ashi asɔbɔya keniso ana na be amu so fanɛ kuwɔlpa na. 23Asɔbɔya keniso ana na daa yil kuwɔlpa na be kaseto nna nseŋ parga bumo be mbuibi be aba ana na to be anyɔ nyɔ to n ya pɛ bumo braana peya to; nseŋ ta anyɔ anyɔ nɛ a ka malɛ m parga to m buu bumo be eyurana so. 24Asɔbɔya keniso na ka koso m bri aba to a firgi, nɛ n nu egbri fanɛ teku so be kewawa na, ŋko benapo damta ka na aya so na ŋko Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl na. B ka ya yili nɛ b bra bumo be mbuibi be aba na m buu bumo be eyurana so.
25Jemanɛ nɛ b maŋ naa firgi nseŋ bela bumo be aba m buu eyurana so a yil na, nɛ n nu egbri ko ka shi kuwɔlpa nɛ k wɔ asɔbɔya keniso ana na be amu so na be awɔlto m ba. 26Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ wu kusɔ ko fanɛ kuwurputi nɛ b ta yawu kpakpaso be kejembu lela nɛ baa tre ‘Saffai’ na n lɔŋɛ, nseŋ naŋ wu esa ko ka duli dimɛdi nɛ e tase kuwurputi na so. 27Nɛ yili mbe kashɛr ase a yɔ mbe kumu ase du fanɛ danyaŋ nɛ k wɔ edɛ be nferinto na nɛ mbe kashɛr ase a yɔ mbe aya ase malɛ du fanɛ edɛ be adondulombi. Kakpa kikɛ daŋ fulto parr nna ŋ kulti mo 28fanɛ kananɛ bɔrɛ bee mɔl nɛ kabɔrɛnyaŋgelambi bee lar kuwɔlpa so a fulto na.
Ndoŋ nna nɛ m pin fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura nɛ n wu na nseŋ ta enɔ m buu anishi so epul na to ŋ tɔr epun so. Kumo be kaman nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka bee malga ma kutɔ.

Title: EZIKƐL 2
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka tre Ezikɛl be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɔl na kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, koso n yili. Mee sha kemalga fo kutɔ nna.” 2Ebɔl na ka bee malga na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu ba ma so n shin nɛ ŋ koso n yili nɛ k kaŋɛ le: 3“Dimɛdi pibi, mee shuŋi fo Israɛl be basa kutɔ nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ bumo tutoana kikɛ daŋ pal kaman n sa ma nseŋ kini kenu n sa ma na nɛ bumo alɛ gba bee wora hale nɛ mbre na. 4Basa nɛ mee shuŋi fo bumo kutɔ ere la ŋgbene kpakpaso nɛ kusoe kpakpa be basa nɛ b maa sa ma bunyaŋ nna. Ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ. 5B kaŋ nu n sa fo ŋko ŋ kini kenu n sa fo ŋkpal b ka la ŋgbene kpakpaso be basa so gba baaŋ pin fanɛ anebi ko ba bumo kutɔ m ba malga bre. 6Ama fo ere, dimɛdi pibi, sa maa ŋana bumo ŋko bumo be mmalga. Sa maa lɔ kufu ŋkpal b ka beeŋ kplaŋ fo so nseŋ wora fo yɛryɛrbi so. K beeŋ baa du fanɛ fo ka wɔ ewi to ŋko nna to nna. Ama sa maa ŋana basa nɛ b kini ma nseŋ pal kaman n sa ma na ŋko n shin nɛ b baa ta kufu a da fo. 7Ma mmalga a daga fanɛ fo malga n sa bumo. Baaŋ nu ŋko b maaŋ nu, fo ere e malga n sa bumo. Baa nyiŋi fanɛ b la basa nɛ b kini ma nseŋ pal kaman n sa ma nna. 8Ama fo ere, dimɛdi pibi, nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo ere, nsaa maŋ kini ma m pal kaman n sa ma fanɛ bumo. Amoso bugi kɔnɔ n sɔ kusɔ nɛ mee sa fo ere n ji fanɛ ajibi.”
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni nseŋ wu enɔ nɛ kawɔl sibɛso ko bɔɔ to a wɔ enɔ na to nɛ k teŋi n shoŋi ma. 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ enɔ na bugi kawɔl sibɛso na to nɛ n wu fanɛ kushu nɛ kagbene jija be yiri kikɛ be asheŋ nɛ b sibɛ n deŋi kumo be mba anyɔ na kikɛ so.

Title: EZIKƐL 3
Content:
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, ta kawɔl sibɛso ere n ji fanɛ ajibi nseŋ yɔ n ya malga Israɛl be basa na kutɔ.” 2Nɛ m bugi kɔnɔ nɛ e ta kawɔl sibɛso na n sa ma fanɛ n ji.
3Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi, ta kawɔl sibɛso nɛ n sa fo ere n ji fanɛ ajibi m moɛ.” Nɛ n ta kumo n ji. K daa du belbel ma kɔnɔ to nna fanɛ mushoŋ.
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi, naniere yɔ Israɛl be basa na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ kama nɛ meeŋ kaŋɛ fo. 5Mannɛ efuli pɔtɛ so be basa nɛ bumo ŋgbar kɔr nsaa du kpakpa n sa fo kutɔ nɛ mee shuŋi fo, ama Israɛl be basa kutɔ. 6N daŋ shuŋi fo efuligboŋ pɔtɛ be basa nɛ baa gbar ŋgbar nɛ a du kpakpa nɛ fo tiŋ m pin amo to gba, baaŋ nu n sa fo. 7Ama Israɛl be basa ere maŋ wora shiriya nɛ b nu n sa fo, ŋkpal manɛ so b maŋ wora shiriya nɛ b nu n sa ma so. Bumo kikɛ la kusoe kpakpaso nɛ kumu kpakpaso be basa nna. 8Ŋkpal loŋ so, meeŋ shin nɛ fo kusoe nɛ kagbene e baa du kpakpa fanɛ bumo peya. 9Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ fo kumu e ki kpakpa fanɛ kejembu kpakpaso nɛ k du kpakpa a chɔ kewarbi. Amoso, sa maa ŋana bumo ŋko n shin nɛ bumo be asheŋ e baa da fo kufu, ŋkpal b ka la basa nɛ b kini ma nseŋ pal kaman n sa ma so.”
10Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Dimɛdi pibi, kaŋ kusoe n nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo ere nɛnɛ nseŋ fɛ kumo be nfɛra. 11To, yɔ fo kurgepoana nɛ b pɛ menyi kikɛ n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ. Baaŋ nu ŋko b maaŋ nu, fo ere e ya kaŋɛ bumo.”
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu maŋ ma so n yɔ esoso, nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka bee ponte awɔrso fanɛ bɔrɛ ka ponte na ma kaman to a kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura e baa nya bunyaŋ ashi ebɔrɛso!” 13Kumo be kaman nɛ n nu asɔbɔya keniso na be mbuibi be aba na ka bee fe abar nɛ asɔ kulkulso fanɛ cheche be aya nɛ a mata bumo na ka bee gbri fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee ponte na. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na naŋ ta ma, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋ gbelge ma so ga nɛ ma kagbene kaa nɛ n nya agbo. 15Kumo be kaman nɛ m ba kakpa nɛ basa nɛ b pɛ anya n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so na wɔ na ashi kebeebi nɛ baa tre ‘Tɛl Abib’ nɛ k dese m mata Lɔr nɛ baa tre Kɛba na ase na n ya tu bumo n chena nchɛ ashunu. Kusɔ nɛ n wu nseŋ nu ndoŋ na daŋ chinchiŋ ma nna.
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka ta Ezikɛl ŋ ki ekenipo be asheŋ
16Nchɛ ashunu na be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 17“Dimɛdi pibi, n lara fo nna nɛ fo baa keni Israɛl be basa so. Amoso nu kamalga nɛ ŋ kɔ nɛ n sa bumo ere nseŋ fɛa bumo so. 18Nɛ m baŋ kaŋɛ kumu kpakpasowura fanɛ e beeŋ wu ŋkpal mbe be alubi so, nɛ fo maaŋ fɛa mo so ŋko ji mo asoe to nɛ e lar asheŋ lubi na to m mɔlga mbe kumu, e beeŋ wu ŋkpal mbe alubi so, ama mbe luwu na be turju beeŋ baa bɛ fo. 19Ama nɛ fo fɛa mo so nɛ e kini kelar mbe asheŋ lubi na to, e beeŋ wu ŋkpal mbe alubi so, ama fo ere beeŋ nya fo kumu.
20Kede be kaman, nɛ esa nɛ e bee wora alelasheŋ yige alelasheŋ be kewora nsaa wora alubi, nɛ n shin nɛ e luri kebaawɔtɔ kpakpaso ko to, nɛ fo maŋ fɛa mo so, e beeŋ wu ŋkpal mbe alubi so. M maaŋ nyiŋi mbe alelasheŋ nɛ e wora na be kukoŋwule gba. Ma alɛ beeŋ ta mbe luwu na m bɛ fo. 21Ama nɛ fo fɛa mo so nɛ e yige alubi be kewora bre, e beeŋ ji efute ŋkpal e ka nu n sa fo so, nɛ fo alɛ e nya fo kumu.”
Ezikɛl ka maŋ tiŋ m malga be asheŋ
22Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ na ba ma so, nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Koso n yɔ ketaŋɛ to nɛ n ya kaŋɛ fo kusɔ ko ndoŋ.”
23Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ koso n yɔ ketaŋɛ na to nseŋ ya wu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura sɔ kaplɛkama, fanɛ kumo nɛ n daŋ wu ashi Lɔr nɛ baa tre Kɛba ase na, nɛ n ta enɔ m buu anishi so nseŋ tɔr epun so. 24Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be Kiyoyu ba pɛ ma to ŋ niŋi to n yili nseŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Yɔ epe n ya ti fo kumu so n wɔtɔ fo ebu to. 25Basa beeŋ ta efɔl ŋ kre fo n nase nɛ fo maaŋ nya n lar kowu n yɔ basa to. 26Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ fo ki neemu a maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m malga n fɛa basa nɛ b kini ma nseŋ pal kaman n sa ma ere so. 27Ama kachɛ nɛ meeŋ malga fo kutɔ na kaŋ fo, meeŋ bugi fo kɔnɔ nɛ fo malga bumo kutɔ saŋɛ na so feeŋ kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ. Beko beeŋ nu nɛ beko malɛ e kini kenu, ŋkpal manɛ so, b la basa nɛ b kini ma nseŋ pal kaman n sa ma nna.”

Title: EZIKƐL 4
Content:
Ezikɛl ka wora epel n ŋini kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora Jerusalɛm be asheŋ
1Nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le: “Dimɛdi pibi Ezikɛl, ta ebɔ be kuboo paŋgelambi n nase fo anishito nseŋ wora kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jerusalɛm na be foto n deŋi kumo so. 2Kumo be kaman nɛ fo wora asɔ ŋ kulti kumo fanɛ b ka kre kena ŋ kulti kumo n wɔtɔ na. Gbare shishɛr n deŋi abar so m mata kumo be egbal nɛ k kulti kumo na fanɛ kananɛ benapo beeŋ wora n dii so n luri kade to na, nseŋ wora ndibi gbɛgbɛso nɛ baaŋ ta n da egbal na n futi na nseŋ wora benapo be keeyi to be efoto m mata ebɔ be kuboo paŋgelambi na. 3Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ fo ta kebɛlso paŋgelambi ŋ kuŋ fo nɛ foto nɛ fo wora n deŋi kuboo na so na be nferinto fanɛ kebɛlso be egbal na, nseŋ kilgi fo anishito n shoŋi kebɛlso paŋgelambi na, nɛ k duli fanɛ fo kre kena nna ŋ kulti kade na n wɔtɔ. Kede beeŋ ba la tɔɔnɛ n sa Israɛl be basa na. 4-5Ade be kaman nɛ fo dese fo bena so nchɛ alfa asa nɛ adekpanu a ŋini fanɛ Israɛl be basa beeŋ luri kasogberge to nfɛ alfa asa nɛ adekpanu. Kachɛ koŋwule kama yili nna n sa bumo be kafɛ koŋwule be awurfoŋ nɛ baaŋ ji na. 6Kumo be kaman nɛ fo naŋ kilgi n dese fo jisoso malɛ nchɛ adena, a ŋini Juda be basa malɛ be kasogberge nɛ baaŋ nya. Kachɛ koŋwule kama yili n sa kafɛ koŋwule be awurfoŋ nɛ baaŋ ji nna.
7Ade be kaman nɛ fo kilgi fo anishi n shoŋi Jerusalɛm be foto nɛ fo wora na, nseŋ bɔɔ fo enɔ to a malga a teŋi a ŋini kumo a kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ k beeŋ wora kumo na. 8Ama meeŋ ta efɔl ŋ kre fo nɛ fo maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kilgi kikɛ hale n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ kena nɛ fo kre ŋ kulti kade na ka beeŋ ba ekar. 9Kumo be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Ta aboyu nɛ shiŋkafa nɛ chɛbɛ fuful nɛ a peper nɛ adurbi nɛ atuwe peper n wea abar to n wɔtɔ kusɔ koŋwule to, nsaa jɔ amo a wora fo ajibi. Amo e naaŋ baa la fo kusɔ jiso nchɛ alfa asa nɛ adekpanu nɛ feeŋ baa dese kekilso na. 10Feeŋ baa jɔ amo gbrɛgbrɛbi nna a wora ajibi kachɛ kama a ji, 11nsaa nuu nchu malɛ kawiebi nuunchu be ebɔlɔ anyɔ anyɔ kachɛ kama. 12Feeŋ baa ta dimɛdi be ebin wɔlso nna a puga edɛ a daŋɛ ajibi na kelɔnɛ so, kakpa nɛ esa kama beeŋ wu fo.’ ” 13Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kede bee ŋini kananɛ Israɛl be basa beeŋ ji ajibi nɛ baa kishi jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ pesaŋ bumo to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so na nna.” 14Nɛ ma alɛ kaŋɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ le: “Loŋ maaŋ wora, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ naŋ ji ma ekishi n jija ma kumu kikɛ. Yili ma kebia to kikɛ, m maŋ naŋ ji kusɔ wuso ŋko kusɔ nɛ kusɔbɔya pɛ n ji ŋ ka kikɛ. Ajibi nɛ a maŋ walɛ so maŋ naŋ luri ma kɔnɔ kikɛ.”
15Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma: “K nyalɛ, meeŋ shin nɛ fo ta anabin wɔlso mannɛ dimɛdi be ebin m puga edɛ nna ŋ daŋɛ fo ajibi na.”
16Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi, meeŋ shin nɛ akoŋ a tɔr Jerusalɛm be basa so nɛ ajibi be asheŋ a ki kpakpa ga n sa bumo nɛ b ta kafɔŋ nɛ kagbene jija a karga ajibi nɛ nchu nuuso a sa abar, 17ŋkpal manɛ so, ajibi nɛ nchu be asheŋ beeŋ ki kpakpa. Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora na beeŋ chinchiŋ bumo hale nɛ b baa chicha. Ekama beeŋ foe eyur to hale n ya wu ŋkpal bumo be alubi so.”

Title: EZIKƐL 5
Content:
Jerusalɛm ka beeŋ Mur be asheŋ
1Asheŋ ere be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, ta bɔrfɔ nɛ k bee ji n she fo kumu nɛ fo katɔl. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo ta kusɔ nɛ b kɔ a karga asɔ be egbɛ na m barga emin na to ntuŋ asa. 2Jemanɛ nɛ fo kre kena ŋ kulti Jerusalɛm be foto nɛ fo wora n deŋi kejembu paŋgelambi na so na kaŋ fo ekar, nɛ fo chɔɔ emin na be katuŋ koŋwule kade nɛ fo wora kumo be foto na to, nseŋ ta bɔrfɔ na ŋ kuya emin na be katuŋ nyɔsopo to ŋ kulti kade na. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo ta katuŋ sasopo na n lɛ esoso nɛ ŋ gbagba e ta ma tokobi ŋ kuya amo to. 3Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ fo wora loŋ fo lara emin na be gbrɛbi n da fo piŋi be kɔnɔ. 4Nseŋ lara amo be gbrɛbi n chɔɔ edɛ to a ŋini fanɛ edɛ beeŋ shi ndoŋ n suse m mur ekama Israɛl be efuli so.”
5Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Jerusalɛm nɛ n ta n yili durnya kikɛ be nferinto nɛ efuliana kulti kumo ŋ wɔtɔ a keni kumo a yɛlga nna na. 6Ama Jerusalɛm to be basa lar ma kaman nseŋ kini kewora m bɛ ma mbraana nɛ ma atande so. B kplaŋ ma mbraana so nsaa wora alubi a chɔ efuliana nɛ a kulti bumo na gba.
7Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ Jerusalɛm be basa e la fanɛ, men kini kenu m bɛ ma mbraana nɛ ma atande so nseŋ ya ka bɛ efuliana nɛ e kulti menyi na be mbraana so. Men be ŋgbene ki kpakpa a chɔ bumo gba! 8Amoso, ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ ŋ ki menyi, Jerusalɛm to be basa, be edoŋ nna na. Meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe nɛ efuliana na kikɛ e wu kumo. 9Ŋkpal menyi be agbirana nɛ ŋ kishi ga ere kikɛ so, meeŋ wora menyi kusɔ nɛ m maŋ naŋ wora kikɛ, ma alɛ m maaŋ naŋ wora kumo kikɛ. 10Bekurgepo beeŋ kpal akoŋ so a mɔ bumo be mbia a we nɛ mbia e baa mɔ bumo bekurgepoana a we. Meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe hale nɛ bekama nɛ baaŋ ji efute gba na e pesaŋ to n yɔ mboŋ wɔfɔ. 11Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na, e naa bɔ ntaŋ a kaŋɛ fanɛ, ŋkpal men ka ta menyi be agbirana nɛ aworbi lubiana n shin nɛ ma bɔrɛlambu ki kakpa nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n shuŋ ma ndoŋ so, m maaŋ wu menyi kuwɔr ŋko n shu menyi so ŋko n shin nɛ men nya menyi be amu n ya ji kikɛ. 12Menyi to be ntuŋ asa to be katuŋ koŋwule beeŋ wu ŋkpal alɔ nɛ akoŋ so ashi Jerusalɛm to, nɛ katuŋ nyɔsopo e wu kena to. Katuŋ sasopo malɛ beeŋ pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama a shile nɛ n ta tokobi m bɛ bumo so a mɔ.
13Menyeeŋ ji awurfoŋ ga pɔɛŋ nɛ ma agbo e wushi. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ kenishipereso nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, daa malga menyi be asheŋ lubi be asheŋ na.
14Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Jerusalɛm e ki kelambure nɛ kemɔmɔshia be kade n sa efuliana nɛ a kulti kumo na nɛ bekama nɛ baaŋ bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ kikɛ. 15Menyeeŋ ki kemɔmɔshia nɛ katege be kusɔ nsaa la kefiɛso n sa efuliana nɛ a kulti menyi na nɛ menyi be asheŋ a chinchiŋ bumo. 16Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ akoŋ e mɔ menyi fanɛ b ka to menyi atanyembi m mɔ na. Kashenteŋto, meeŋ mur menyi be adɔjibi nɛ akoŋgboŋ a tɔr menyi so. 17Akoŋ nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya beeŋ ba mur menyi be mbia nɛ men ki begbentepo. Meeŋ bɔla alɔ mɔso so nɛ men doŋana be kemɔ menyi so ŋ gberge menyi kusoe. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 6
Content:
Kemalga ŋ gbiti Israɛl be abee be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kilgi fo anishito n shoŋi Israɛl be abee nseŋ malga n sa amo 3ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Israɛl be abee, men nu Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be kubɔya.’ ” E yɛ: “Ŋ kɔ tokobi nna a ba abee nɛ agoŋgulombi nɛ amantaŋ nɛ ataŋɛ kikɛ so nɛ m ba mur mboŋ nɛ basa bee shuŋ agbirana na. 4Meeŋ bure agbirsure nɛ eduwusure na kikɛ nyam nseŋ mɔ basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ n nase bumo be agbirana be anishito. 5Meeŋ pesaŋ Israɛl be basa be bubuni to ashi bumo be agbirana be anishito nseŋ pesaŋ bumo be awibi to ŋ kulti agbirsure na. 6Israɛl be efuli so be nde kikɛ beeŋ mur nɛ bumo be agbirshuŋkpaana kikɛ e bure m bure. Kumo be kaman, nɛ bumo be kusɔ kama e ki fuloŋ. 7Menyi be basa beeŋ wu n dese kaplɛkama, nɛ menyi to be bumo nɛ baaŋ ji efute na e pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ shuŋ ma.
8Ama meeŋ shin nɛ beko e ji efute nseŋ pesaŋ to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so. 9Saŋɛ na so, bumo nɛ baaŋ ji efute na beeŋ fɛ ma asheŋ nseŋ nyiŋi kananɛ b lar ma kaman nsaa shuŋ agbirana nseŋ ta nyɔmɔ m pɛ ma na ashi efuliana nɛ baaŋ tintiŋ bumo n yɔ na so. Ndoŋ nɛ bumo gbagba be asheŋ beeŋ baa nu bumo gbagba agbo ŋkpal bumo asheŋ lubi lubi nɛ b wora so 10nɛ b pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na, ma alɛ maa funti jiga nna a kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ mur bumo be asɔ.”
11Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Ezikɛl, ta fo enɔana n deŋi kumu nsaa shu a bri aya ase a boŋ to kagbenejijaso. Ŋkpal Israɛl be basa be aworbi lubi nɛ ŋ kishi ga na so, kena nɛ akoŋ nɛ alɔ mɔso e naŋ mur bumo. 12Alɔ beeŋ mɔ bumo nɛ b wɔ kufɔ kufɔ nɛ bumo nɛ b taga to malɛ e wu kena to nɛ bumo nɛ baaŋ nya bumo be amu n ji efute malɛ e wu ŋkpal akoŋ so. Kananɛ ma agbogboŋ beeŋ gbelge bumo so nna na. 13Jemanɛ nɛ bumo be basa beeŋ wu n dese abeebi nɛ abeegboŋ be awɔlto nɛ ndibi gboŋ be yiri nɛ a la bumo be agbirana be eshuŋkpaana nɛ baa chɔɔ duwu a sa bumo be agbirana kikɛ be afito na nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na. 14Kashenteŋto, meeŋ yili Keshishɛrsawule nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto na m ba choŋ kade nɛ baa tre Dibla nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na m mur efuli na kikɛ,. Meeŋ mur kaplɛkama nɛ Israɛl be basa tase. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 7
Content:
Lalaloge be saŋɛ na ka taga to be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ Israɛl be efuli so be basa e la fanɛ, lalaloge be jemanɛ na bee fo nɛ efuli na kikɛ nyam e mur. 3Israɛl be basa, lalaloge be kachɛ na fo menyi nna na. Meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbo e ba menyi so. Kanaŋkama, lalaloge be kachɛ na beeŋ ba nɛ n ji menyi demu nseŋ gberge menyi kusoe ŋkpal menyi be aworbi lubi nɛ ŋ kishi na so. 4M maaŋ wu menyi kuwɔr ŋko n yige menyi nɛ men ta men be amu n ya ji. Abaanaaworasheŋ meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe ŋkpal men be eda lubi nɛ aworbi lubi nɛ ŋ kishi so. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.” 5Le nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “Aleblawu nɛ ekama maŋ naŋ nu kumo be asheŋ bee ba! 6Kemur be saŋɛ na fo! K fo n loge. K beeŋ shin nɛ men mur. 7Menyi nɛ men wɔ Israɛl be kasawule so na beeŋ mur. Saŋɛ na fo, demujiachɛ na taga to. Keyeŋiyeŋi beeŋ tɔr menyi so nɛ men maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n ji eyur kagbenefuliso ashi abee so be kakpa nɛ menyee shuŋ agbirana na. 8Meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbogboŋ e ba menyi so nɛ n ji menyi demu ŋkpal menyi be eda lubi so nseŋ gberge menyi kusoe ŋkpal menyi be aworbi lubi nɛ ŋ kishi na so. 9M maaŋ wu menyi kuwɔr, ma alɛ maaŋ yige menyi nɛ men ta menyi be amu n ya ji. Meeŋ gberge menyi kusoe ŋkpal menyi be eda nɛ aworbi lubi so. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa gberge menyi kusoe na.”
10To, kemur be kachɛ na taga to! K teŋ fo gba! Kebaa maa ji kashenteŋ nɛ mpuchi be kebaawɔtɔ sɔ kaplɛkama. 11Basa nɛ b ta akɔsɔ a kɔ a fin bumo be kepar tintinso na nya ekpa a wora bumo be kepar nseŋ shin nɛ kumu kpakpaso wora keshi n ti so. Ama bumo be ekama maaŋ ji efute; bumo be kedamaya nɛ b kɔ nsaa keni amo a bɔlɔ kenishi malɛ gba beeŋ mur. 12Saŋɛ na bee ba. Kachɛ na taga to. Amoso esa nɛ e bee tɔ asɔ e sa maŋ shin nɛ mbe kagbene e baa fuli mo, esa nɛ e bee fa malɛ gba be kagbene e sa maa jija mo, ŋkpal manɛ so ma agbo bee ba ekama so nna. 13Esa nɛ e fa mbe kasawule maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n sɔ kumo esa nɛ e tɔ kumo na kutɔ kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so kewuŋkaŋɛ nɛ k bee laŋɛ ekama b kaplɛa so na maaŋ naŋ chɛrga. Bumo be ekama maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga mbe kumu ŋkpal bumo be alubi so. 14Hale nɛ b foŋ kabel fanɛ ekama e bela ase n yɔ kena to gba esa koŋwule gba maŋ lar n yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma kagbene kaa ekama so nna.
15Kena nɛ alɔ nɛ akoŋ beeŋ sɔ kaplɛkama! Kena e naŋ mɔ ndekarso be basa nɛ akoŋ nɛ alɔ mɔso malɛ e mɔ ndegboŋ to be basa. 16Bekama nɛ baaŋ ji efute na malɛ beeŋ shile n yɔ abee so fanɛ kufu ka pɛ elepɔ nɛ a firgi n shi ketaŋɛ to n yɔ kebee so na. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ ya shu ŋkpal bumo be alubi so. 17Ebruma beeŋ tɔr basa kikɛ so nɛ bumo be mbre maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nɛ bumo be amuli malɛ e baa chicha. 18Baaŋ ta ebɔtɛ ŋ ki asɔbuuso m buu a ŋini fanɛ bumo be ŋgbene jija bumo nna, nɛ kufugboŋ e tɔr bumo so. Anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ bumo nseŋ shin nɛ ekama e she mbe kumu nɛ k baa la ŋaba n sa mo. 19Baaŋ ta bumo be shuwa nɛ gbiti n lɛ agbembi so fanɛ asɔ jiga na, ŋkpal manɛ so, shuwa nɛ gbiti na maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo jemanɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be agbo beeŋ ba bumo so na. B maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta amo n tɔ ajibi gba n ji. Ŋkpal manɛ so, shuwa nɛ gbiti na e shin nɛ b tɔr kulubi to. 20B daa puchi ŋkpal abitasɔ lela nɛ b kɔ so nna nseŋ ta amo ŋ wora agbirana nɛ amo be asheŋ bee nu agbo. Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ abitasɔ na e ki fuloŋ, nsaa maŋ naa kɔ tɔnɔ n sa bumo. 21Meeŋ shin nɛ befɔ e kɔ n suge bumo be asɔ tintiŋ so nɛ basa nɛ b kɔ kumu kpakpaso malɛ e ba jija bumo be asɔ nɛ a ka kikɛ. 22Jemanɛ nɛ basa lubi beeŋ ba bure n luri ma bɔrɛlambu nɛ mee sha ga na to a jija kumo na, meeŋ kpele ma anishi fanɛ ŋ ka maŋ wu bumo na. Beyu ba luri n ya kaa yuri kumo to be asɔ gba, m maaŋ tuge bumo.
23“Basa be kamɔ nɛ keta akɔsɔ a kɔ a fin kusɔ nɛ esa bee sha tintiŋ so sɔ efuli na be kaplɛkama nna. 24Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ efuliana nɛ b lubi a chɔ bekama na e ba sɔ bumo be nwu kikɛ. Kumo be kaman, nɛ n shin nɛ benapo lempo nɛ baa puchi so na e pɔ aba, ŋkpal efuliana ka beeŋ jija bumo be kabɔrɛshuŋ be mboŋ so. 25Kufugboŋ kaŋ ba bumo so na nɛ baaŋ pere kenishi n fin kayurwushi, ama bumo alɛ maaŋ nya kumo. 26Aleblawu bee ba nɛ ebaru lubi be abɔya a sɔ kaplɛkama. Basa beeŋ baa kule anebiana fanɛ b nu Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl ŋ kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ ko, nɛ b maaŋ nya. B maaŋ naŋ nya mbraana nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana daa ŋini na nɛ kasotoji nɛ benimuana na daa sa bumo na kikɛ. 27Ewura beeŋ shu nɛ benimuana na e paŋ tama nɛ kufu e tɔr basa na kikɛ so nɛ b baa chicha. Bumo be aworbi so nɛ meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe nseŋ wora bumo kusɔ nɛ b ta n wora beko na. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 8
Content:
Kagbirshuŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu to be asheŋ
1B ka pɛ anyi n tintiŋ anyi n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ shesopo na to be kufɔl shesopo be kachɛ nusopo na, nɛ ma nɛ Juda be benimuana chena ma nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ gbelge ma so ndoŋ epul to. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni nseŋ wu kusɔ ko ka du fanɛ dimɛdi be kaduli ka yil a kpa edɛ. Yili kumo be kashɛr ase m ba aya ase daa du fanɛ edɛ na, nɛ yili kumo be kashɛr ase n dii a yɔ kumo be kumu ase malɛ daa nyɛkpɛ fanɛ danyaŋ nɛ b fɛfa so na. 3Nɛ k teŋi kusɔ ko to fanɛ enɔ na m pɛ ma emin to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu maŋ ma so awɔlto ashi bɔrɛdare to n ta ma n yɔ Jerusalɛm to n ya yili bɔrɛlambu na be epunto be kelɔnɛ na be kabuna nɛ k bee laŋɛ kelargato be esoso be kaba so be kakpa nɛ basa na ta kegbir nɛ k bee shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kagbene bee kaa ga na n yili na. 4Ndoŋ nɛ ŋ wu Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura fanɛ kumo nɛ n daŋ wu jemanɛ nɛ n daa wɔ Lɔr nɛ baa tre Kɛba na ase na.
5Kumo be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, to kenishi ŋ keni kelargato be esoso be kaba so na.” Nɛ n to kenishi ŋ keni nseŋ wu kegbir nɛ basa na ta n yili nɛ kumo be asheŋ bee nu Ebɔrɛ agbo ga na bɔrɛsure nɛ k wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be epunto be kelɔnɛ na be kabuna nɛ k wɔ a laŋɛ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na ase.
6Nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, fo wu kusɔ nɛ k bee wora nna na. Keni ekishisheŋ nɛ Israɛl be basa ere bee wora nfe, baa ju ma a lar ma bɔrɛlambu to a yɔ kufɔ kufɔ nna na. Ama fo kraa beeŋ wu ekishisheŋ nɛ a chɔ ade gba.”
7Ndoŋ nna nɛ e bar ma bɔrɛlambu na be kowushina be kelɔnɛ na be kabuna to m ba ŋini ma kemaŋ ko egbal na to, 8nseŋ kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi kpalga kemaŋ na to.” Nɛ ŋ kpalga kumo nseŋ wu fanɛ ndoŋ la kabuna nna.
9Nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Luri to n ya keni ekishisheŋ nɛ baa wora ndoŋ.” 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ n luri to n ya keni, nseŋ wu b ka wora awɔ nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ a maŋ walɛ keji be efoto n deŋi egbalana na so nɛ agbirana nɛ Israɛl be basa bee shuŋ ndoŋ. 11Israɛl be basa na be benimuana na to be basa adushunu e daa yil ndoŋ. Shafan pibinyɛn, Jazaania gba daŋ ti bumo so. Bumo be ekama malɛ daa kɔ kusɔ nɛ b kɔ a chɔɔ duwu mbe enɔ nna nɛ edishi bee kaa kumo to.
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, fo wu kusɔ nɛ Israɛl be benimuana ere bee wora ashiri to nna na, ŋko? Bumo be ekama yil mbe kegbir ase nna na. B yɛ: ‘Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa wu anyi. Mo alɛ naŋ lar efuli na kaman nna.’ ” 13Nɛ e naŋ lɔŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Feeŋ naaŋ wu bumo nɛ baa wora ekishisheŋ nɛ a chɔ ade.”
14Ndoŋ nna nɛ e bar ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna nɛ k bee laŋɛ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na, nɛ n wu beche ko nɛ b chena ndoŋ a shu kegbir nɛ baa tre Tammuz na be keli. 15Nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi, fo wu kusɔ nɛ beche ere bee wora ere a? Fo kraa beeŋ wu ekishisheŋ nɛ a chɔ ade.”
16Ndoŋ nna nɛ e naŋ bar ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na be epunto be kelɔnɛ na so, ashi bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna nɛ k wɔ bɔrɛsure na nɛ kedɛdɛ na be nferinto na ase, nɛ ŋ wu benyɛn beeŋ wora fanɛ basa adunyɔ nɛ anu. B daŋ pal bumo be mman nna n shoŋi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛlambu na nseŋ kilgi bumo be anishito n shoŋi epeŋilarkpa m murgi a bunyaŋ epeŋi nɛ k bee pete na.
17Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi, fo wu kede a? Fo tama fanɛ k la kusɔ fɔmbi nna fanɛ Juda be basa ere kaa beeŋ baa wora asheŋ lubi lubi ere ashi nfe a? A daga fanɛ b baa ta akɔsɔ a kɔ a fin bumo be kepar tintiŋ so kaplɛkama a wora asheŋ nɛ a bee wɔtɔ ma agbo to jemanɛ kikɛ a? Keni kananɛ b ŋaba ma nsaa tege ma ekpa nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ ŋaba ŋko n tege ma loŋ. 18Ŋkpal loŋ so, meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe agbo so. M maaŋ wu bumo kuwɔr ŋko n yige bumo nɛ b ta bumo be amu n ya ji. Hale nɛ b shu n tre ma gba m maaŋ nu nseŋ chɛ bumo to.”

Title: EZIKƐL 9
Content:
B ka mɔ agbirshumpoana be asheŋ
1Ade be kaman nɛ n nu Ebɔrɛ ka ponte ŋ kaŋɛ: “Menyi nɛ b lara fanɛ men gberge kadegboŋ na to be basa kusoe na e ta menyi be akɔsɔ m bɔɔ enɔ m ba Jerusalɛm to.” 2Epul to nɛ benyɛn ashe ko shi bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na m ba. Bumo be ekama daa bɔ kekɔsɔ enɔ to nna. Kanyɛn ko nɛ e daŋ buu piŋi lela nsaa kɔ kasibɛ be asɔ enɔ to gba daŋ ti bumo so nna. Bumo kikɛ ba luri bɔrɛlambu na to nna n ya yili danyaŋ be bɔrɛsure na ase.
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura na lar asɔbɔya keniso nɛ a kɔ mbuibi be aba nɛ baa tre ‘chɛrubim’ na be kumu ase n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna to. Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na tre kanyɛn nɛ e buu piŋi lela na nsaa kɔ kasibɛ be asɔ enɔ to na 4ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Yɔ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na to n ya dulgi bekama nɛ asheŋ bee besa nɛ bumo be ŋgbene jija bumo ŋkpal ekishisheŋ nɛ a bee wora kade na to so na be nsɔto.” Nɛ kanyɛn na lar n yɔ nɛ e ya dulgi bumo.
5Kumo be kaman nɛ n naŋ nu Ebɔrɛ ka kaŋɛ benyɛn nɛ b ka yil na le: “Men bɛ mo so n ya kaa mɔ basa, men sa maŋ kaŋ wu ekama kuwɔr ŋko n shu ekama so. 6Men ya mɔ benyɛnnimu nɛ mbrantiɛ nɛ besuŋgurbi nɛ bechekpar nɛ mbi wurbi kikɛ ama men sa maŋ beta ekama nɛ e kɔ ndulgi mbe kasɔto na. Men fara ma bɔrɛlambu to a mɔ a yɔ.” Nɛ b ta benimuana nɛ b daa wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be anishito na n fara.
7Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Men mɔ basa n lɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ na so kikɛ n shin nɛ k jija. Men fara a mɔ!” Nɛ b lar n ya fara basa be kemɔ Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na kikɛ to. 8B ka fara kamɔ na a yɔ nɛ n nawule ka a yil, nseŋ kurgi kumu n yuu to m boŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal fo ka nya agbo ga n wora Jerusalɛm to be basa so, fee sha nna nɛ fo mɔ Israɛl be basa nɛ b ka ere kikɛ a?”
9Nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma le: “Israɛl nɛ Juda be basa be kulubi na shi m baŋ so. Basa be kemɔ e sɔ kasawule na kikɛ so nɛ ekishisheŋ malɛ sɔ Jerusalɛm be kade to kikɛ. Baa kaŋɛ nna fanɛ, ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kplaŋ efuli na so nna; ma alɛ maa wu asheŋ nɛ baa wora na. 10Amoso m maaŋ wu bumo kuwɔr ŋko n shu bumo so kikɛ. Kananɛ b wora beko na nɛ ma alɛ gba beeŋ wora bumo.”
11Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ kanyɛn nɛ e daŋ buu piŋi lela na bɛta m ba kaŋɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na le: “N wora kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ na n loge.”

Title: EZIKƐL 10
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura ka lar bɔrɛlambu na to be asheŋ
1Asheŋ na be kaman nɛ ŋ keni kuwɔlpa nɛ k sha asɔbɔya keniso na be amu so, nseŋ wu kusɔ ko fanɛ kuwurputi nɛ b ta yawu kpakpaso be kejembu lela nɛ baa tre saffai na n lɔŋɛ. 2Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ kanyɛn nɛ e buu piŋi lela na le: “Ya lara ajanwulɛ nɛ a kɔ edɛ ashi asɔ kulkulso nɛ a du fanɛ cheche be aya a wɔ asɔbɔya keniso na be akel to na n ya fari Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na kikɛ to.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ mee keni mo nɛ e bee yɔ.
3Jemanɛ nɛ kanyɛn na bee yɔ na nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na yil a laŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kelargato be kaseto na nna, nɛ kuwɔlpa buu bɔrɛlambu na be epunto be kelɔnɛ na kikɛ so. 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura shi asɔbɔya keniso na be amu so n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna to nɛ kuwɔlpa na sɔ bɔrɛlambu na to kikɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura shin nɛ kelɔnɛ na kikɛ to fulto parr. 5Esa nɛ e daa wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kowushina be kelɔnɛ na gba so daa nu asɔbɔya keniso na be mbuibi be aba be egbri, ŋkpal manɛ so, a daa gbri nna fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl na.
6Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka kaŋɛ kanyɛn nɛ e daŋ buu piŋi lela na fanɛ e ya lara ajanwulɛ ashi asɔ kulkulso nɛ a du fanɛ cheche be aya m mata asɔbɔya keniso na ase nɛ kanyɛn na ya yili m mata aya kulkulso na be kuko. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na be ekoŋwule teŋi enɔ n shoŋi edɛ nɛ a dese bumo be nferinto na nseŋ lara ako n wɔtɔ kanyɛn na be enɔ to nɛ mo alɛ ta n lar n choŋ.
8Kumo be kaman nɛ n naŋ wu fanɛ asɔbɔya keniso na be kekama daa kɔ kusɔ ko fanɛ dimɛdi be enɔ bumo be mbuibi be aba na be kekama be kaseto. 9Nɛ n naŋ keni n wu fanɛ aya kulkulso ana mata asɔbɔya keniso na nsaa nyɛkpɛ fanɛ yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nyɛkpɛso na. 10Aya kulkulso ana na kikɛ duli abar nna nɛ kekama malɛ kɔ keya nyɔsopo nɛ k larga kumo to, 11saŋɛ na so asɔbɔya keniso na baa yɔ kaplɛkama aya kulkulso na maŋ naa kilgi. Bumo be aya na kikɛ beeŋ tiŋ n yɔ kaplɛkama nɛ a maŋ kilgi. 12Anishi daa wɔ asɔbɔya keniso na be eyur so kikɛ nna. Bumo be mman nɛ mbre nɛ mbuibi be aba so nɛ aya kulkulso ana na gba kikɛ so daa kɔ anishi nna. 13Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ko kaa bee kaŋɛ le: “Aya kulkulso nɛ a bee yili kapa koŋwule a kilgi to nde.” 14Asɔbɔya keniso na be ekama daa kɔ anishiakpa ana nna. Bumo be anishito daa la dimɛdi be anishiakpa nna nɛ bumo be jisoso daa la buluŋ be anishiakpa nɛ bumo be bena so la gbolu be anishiakpa nɛ bumo be kaman to daa la kusore be anishiakpa.
15Asɔbɔya keniso nɛ n daŋ wu Lɔr nɛ baa tre Kɛba ase na gbagba e daa la bumo. B ka koso n firgi n yɔ awɔlto, 16nɛ aya kulkulso na gba bɛ so. Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na baaŋ parga aba to a firgi, aya kulkulso na wɔ bumo be akel to nna. 17Nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na baaŋ yili aya na gba bee yili epul na to nna. Nɛ b baŋ naŋ koso malɛ amo alɛ gba bee koso nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔbɔya keniso na e naa keta amo a wora asheŋ.
18Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura lar bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna ase n ya buu asɔbɔya keniso na be amu so. 19Ŋ ka keni nɛ n wu asɔbɔya keniso na ka parga bumo be aba to ŋ koso kasawule a firgi nɛ aya kulkulso na tu bumo a yɔ. B ka ya fo bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na nɛ b shir n yili gbrɛ, nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura kraa buu bumo so.
20Ndoŋ nna nɛ m pin geeŋ fanɛ asɔbɔya keniso ere nɛ n daŋ wu Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kaseto na ashi Kɛba be lɔr ase na. 21Bumo be ekama daa kɔ anishiakpa ana ana nɛ mbuibi be aba ana ana nna, nɛ bumo be aba na be kekama malɛ be kaseto daa kɔ kusɔ ko fanɛ dimɛdi be enɔ. 22Bumo alɛ be anishiakpa daa du fanɛ amo nɛ n wu Kɛba be lɔr ase na gbagba nna. Ekama malɛ baaŋ niŋi nna a yɔ a maŋ naa kilgi.

Title: EZIKƐL 11
Content:
Demuji ka ba Israɛlebi be benimu so be asheŋ
1Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu ta ma m ba Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna nɛ k shoŋi epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na ase nɛ n wu benyɛn adunyɔ nɛ anu ko nɛ efuli na be bejuŋkparpo anyɔ ti bumo so. Bumo e la kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Jaazania nɛ e la Azzu pibinyɛn na nɛ emo nɛ baa tre Pɛlatiya nɛ mo alɛ la Bɛnaya pibinyɛn na. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, basa ere bee kre kulubi nsaa sa Jerusalɛm to be basa kasotoji lubi nna na. 3Le nɛ kaa kaŋɛ: ‘K maaŋ chɛr nɛ an naa pɔr nwu. Kadegboŋ ere du fanɛ kapuliya nna a bɛ edɛ so nɛ anyi alɛ du fanɛ eblaŋ a wɔ kumo to, ama kanaŋkama nɛ asheŋ du k bee kuŋ anyi nɛ anyi maŋ wɔ edɛ to gbagba.’ 4Amoso, dimɛdi pibi, malga ŋ gbiti bumo.”
5Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be Kiyoyu kaŋɛ ma fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Israɛl be basa, n nyi kusɔ nɛ menyee kaŋɛ nɛ asheŋ nɛ menyee kre menyi be nfɛra to kikɛ. 6Men mɔ basa damta Jerusalɛm to hale nɛ bubuni sɔ kumo be agbembi kikɛ so.”
7“Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ e la fanɛ basa nɛ men mɔ n lɛ kaplɛkama na e ki eblaŋ nɛ kadegboŋ na malɛ ki kapuliya ama e beeŋ tintiŋ menyi n lar Jerusalɛm to. 8Ŋkpal menyi kaa bee ŋana tokobi so, kumo nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ basa e ta m ba menyi so. 9Meeŋ lara menyi kadegboŋ na to n ta menyi m bɔɔ befɔ enɔ nɛ b gberge menyi kusoe. 10Baaŋ kɔ menyi kena m mɔ menyi ashi menyi gbagba be efuli so. Ndoŋ nɛ ekama beeŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 11Kadegboŋ ere maaŋ kuŋ menyi bejuŋkparpo na fanɛ kananɛ kapuliya bee kuŋ eblaŋ nɛ a wɔ kumo to na. Meeŋ ji menyi demu kaplɛkama nɛ men wɔ ashi Israɛl be efuli so nɛ men ji n tɔr. 12Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ men kini k bɛ ma mbraana so nseŋ ya kaa bɛ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a kulti menyi na be mbraana so na.”
13Ŋ kraa malga nna nɛ Pɛlatiya tɔr n wu epul na to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ n ta enɔ m buu ma anishi so nseŋ kurgi kumu n yuu to m boŋ to n shu ŋ kaŋɛ: “O, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ! Fee sha kemɔ Israɛl be basa gbrɛbi nɛ b ka ere kikɛ nna a?”
14Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 15“Dimɛdi pibi, le nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to ere bee kaŋɛ a laŋɛ fo nɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b yɛr Babilɔn be efuli so na be kaplɛa so. B yɛ, menyi ere maŋ naŋ taga Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ to a bishi nɛ men tiŋ n shuŋ mo. Amoso, Israɛl be kasawule na ki bumo nawule peya nna.
16Ama kusɔ nɛ mee sha fanɛ fo, Ezikɛl, e kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b wɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na e la fanɛ, ma e shin nɛ b yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so kufɔ kufɔ n ya pesaŋ to a wɔtɔ na. Ama naniere, ma nɛ menyi e naŋ baa la ashi efuliana nɛ men wɔ amo so na.
17Kumo be kaman nɛ fo kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ e la fanɛ meeŋ naŋ gama bumo abar so ashi efuli pɔtɛana na so nseŋ bɛta Israɛl be efuli na n naŋ sa bumo nɛ b chena so.
18B kaŋ bɛta m ba malɛ, baaŋ lara agbirana nɛ a la ekishisheŋ n sa ma na ashi mboŋ nɛ a wɔ na kikɛ. 19Meeŋ lara bumo be ŋgbene nɛ a du kpakpa fanɛ ajembu na bumo to nseŋ sa bumo ŋgbene nɛ nfɛra popɔr, nɛ b maaŋ naa sha keshuŋ agbirana. 20Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ bɛ ma mbraana so nsaa wora asɔ nɛ mee ŋini bumo na. Baaŋ baa la ma basa nɛ ma alɛ e baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ. 21Ama meeŋ gberge bekama nɛ bumo be ŋgbene kraa wɔ bumo be agbirana nɛ ŋ kishi nɛ a la ekishisheŋ n sa ma na kusoe ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ lubi so. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura ka lar Jerusalɛm to be asheŋ
22Kumo be kaman nɛ asɔbɔya keniso na fara a firgi, nɛ aya kulkulso na wɔ bumo be akel to, nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura buu bumo so. 23Ndoŋ nna nɛ kefulto nɛ k bee ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura na lar Jerusalɛm to n ya buu kebee nɛ k wɔ kadegboŋ na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na so. 24Nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu ta ma m bɛta m ba basa nɛ ma nɛ bumo daa wɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na kutɔ ashi bɔrɛdare na to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛdare nɛ n daa ku na loge, 25nɛ ŋ kute kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na lara ŋ ŋini ma na kikɛ n sa bumo.

Title: EZIKƐL 12
Content:
B ka beeŋ pɛ Israɛlebi n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ so be tɔɔnɛ be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naaŋ kaŋɛ ma: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, fo nɛ basa nɛ b pal kaman n sa ma e wɔtɔ. B kɔ anishi, bumo alɛ kini kewu asɔ nɛ mee ŋini bumo. B kɔ asoe, bumo alɛ kini kenu ma mmalga. Ŋkpal manɛ so b pal kaman nna n sa ma. 3Amoso, dimɛdi pibi, bela fo adiiku nseŋ wora fanɛ b ka nyaŋ fo a yɔ efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ so. Wora le pɔɛŋ nɛ epeŋi e tɔr. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo yɔ kakpa nɛ ekama beeŋ wu fo n ya kaa nite a yɔ a ba. B kaŋ wu fo kaa bee wora loŋ, ashere baaŋ pin fanɛ b la basa nɛ b pal kaman n sa ma nna. 4Fo kaŋ wora ade kikɛ n loge nɛ fo bɛta n yɔ fo laŋ to. Kaaseso kaŋ fo nɛ fo wora shiriya fanɛ feeŋ yɔ efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ. 5Futi fo kowu be egbal jemanɛ nɛ baa keni fo n ta fo adiiku m bɔla kumo to m bɔl. 6Shin nɛ b baa keni fo nɛ fo ta fo adiiku na n di keba nseŋ ta kusɔ m buu fo anishi so n lar n luri tentembiri to a yɔ, saŋɛ na so fo maaŋ wu m pin kakpa nɛ fee yɔ na. Kusɔ nɛ feeŋ wora na beeŋ baa la kusoe kpele n sa Israɛl be basa na.”
7Nɛ n wora kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma na. Epeŋi ka ya ka tɔr nɛ m bela ma adiiku nseŋ wora keyɔ efuli pɔtɛ so be shiriya. Kaase ka fo nɛ n ta enɔ ŋ kur n futi ma laŋ to be egbal nseŋ ta ma adiiku n di keba m bɔla ndoŋ n lar jemanɛ nɛ ekama bee keni ma na n choŋ.
8Kaarɛ ka chɛ kachipurso nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma: 9“Dimɛdi pibi, Israɛl be basa nɛ b pal kaman n sa ma na maŋ bishi fo kusɔ nɛ fo daa wora a? 10To, ya kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde: ‘Kubɔya ere bee yɔ ejuŋkparpo nɛ e wɔ Jerusalɛm to na nɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ na kikɛ nna. 11Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kusɔ nɛ fo wora n ŋini bumo na la tɔɔnɛ nna a ŋini kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora bumo echefoso.
Kusɔ nɛ n wora ere e naaŋ tu menyi echefoso. Baaŋ pɛ menyi n tintiŋ menyi n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so.
12Jerusalɛm be ejuŋkparpo na gbagba beeŋ shin nɛ b futi egbal n sa mo kaaseso belebela nɛ e bɔla kumo to n m bɔl n ta mbe adiiku n di keba a yɔ. E beeŋ ta kusɔ m buu mbe anishi so saŋɛ na so e maaŋ wu kasawule nɛ e bee yige a shile na. 13Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ to kashewu m pɛ mo jemanɛ nɛ e bee lar Jerusalɛm to a shile na nseŋ yɛr mo kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Babilɔn na to, ama e maaŋ wu kadegboŋ na kenishiso hale nɛ e ya wu ndoŋ. 14Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ mbe benimuana nɛ mbe benapo nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to na e pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama nɛ basa e bɛ so n fin bumo mɔ.
15Ŋ kaŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na pesaŋ to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛ wɔfɔ so na nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 16Ama meeŋ shin nɛ bumo be gbrɛbi ko e ji efute ashi kena nɛ akoŋ nɛ alɔ na to, saŋɛ na so baaŋ pin kananɛ bumo be ekishisheŋ nɛ b wora na be asheŋ daŋ nu ma agbo ga, nseŋ naŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ shuŋ ma ashi efuli pɔtɛana na so.’ ”
17Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 18“Dimɛdi pibi, baa chicha jemanɛ nɛ fee ji ajibi nseŋ shin nɛ kufu e baa kɔ fo jemanɛ nɛ fee nuu nchu. 19Kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ a sa Jerusalɛm to be basa nɛ b kra wɔ Israɛl be efuli so na e la fanɛ, baaŋ baa ji bumo be ajibi nɛ kafɔŋ nna nsaa nuu bumo nchu malɛ kufuso, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be efuli na nɛ kumo so be asɔ kikɛ beeŋ mur n dese fuloŋ ŋkpal bumo be amu kpakpaso nɛ asheŋ lubi so. 20Ndegboŋ nɛ basa bɔlɔ amo to naniere kikɛ beeŋ mur nɛ efuli na kikɛ e ki kasawule a dese loŋ nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ wɔ kumo so. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
21Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 22“Dimɛdi pibi, manɛ so nɛ Israɛl be basa bee kaa kaŋɛ keŋasa ere: ‘Nchɛ na bee choŋ, nɛ kewuŋkaŋɛ malɛ maa wora a bɔlɔ so!’ 23To, kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kɔ a kaŋɛ a laŋɛ kumo be kaplɛa so. Meeŋ shin nɛ keŋasa na e ba ekar nɛ b maaŋ naa bɔ kumo ashi Israɛl be efuli so. K maŋ chɛr nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ kikɛ e wora m bɔlɔ so. 24Ŋkpal manɛ so, efɛ be ebɔrɛdare ŋko kafule be kewuŋkaŋɛ maaŋ naa wɔ Israɛl be basa to kikɛ. 25Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naŋ malga n sa bumo nɛ kusɔ nɛ meeŋ kaŋɛ na a wora. Menyi basa nɛ men pal kaman n sa ma ere bre be jemanɛ to, meeŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kpele menyi kumo be kusoe fanɛ meeŋ wora na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”
26Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 27“Dimɛdi pibi, Israɛl be basa na bee fɛ nna fanɛ, fo ebɔrɛdare na nɛ kewuŋkaŋɛ na la echefoso be asheŋ nna. 28Amoso kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ. Ma mmalga ere be kekama maaŋ chɛr nseŋ wora m bɔlɔ so. Kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ so. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 13
Content:
B ka malga ŋ gbiti anebi fɛpoana be atre be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, malga ŋ gbiti Israɛl to be anebiana nɛ baa ta bumo gbagba be mmalga fanɛ kewuŋkaŋɛ na nɛ ekama e pin. Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa kaŋ kusoe a nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kubɔya.” 3Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nde: “Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa anebi fɛpoana na. B maa ku ebɔrɛdare. Bumo gbagba be abɔya nɛ baa malga! 4Israɛl to be anebiana du fanɛ ejiŋkaamu nɛ e wɔ kadegboŋ nɛ k bure a dese to a fin kusɔ nɛ baaŋ ji nna. 5B maa kpele basa na kusoe a laŋɛ tɔrɔ nɛ k bee ba ŋko a kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ kewora n da ma so beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ b wu be asheŋ. 6Bumo be ebɔrɛdare nɛ baa ku na kikɛ maŋ la kashenteŋ. Bumo be asheŋ nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ a beeŋ wora na kikɛ la efɛ nna. Baa kaŋɛ nna fanɛ ma kubɔya nɛ baa malga, ama ma alɛ maaŋ shuŋi bumo. Amo nɛ amo kikɛ, baa sha fanɛ bumo be mmalga e baa la kashenteŋ nna. 7Amoso nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo na fanɛ, ebɔrɛdare nɛ baa ku na maaŋ la kashenteŋ na. Asheŋ nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ a beeŋ wora na malɛ la efɛ nna. Baa kaŋɛ fanɛ ma mmalga nna, ama ma alɛ maaŋ malga bumo kutɔ.”
8To, kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ bumo nde: “Menyi be mmalga la kafule nna nɛ menyi be ebɔrɛdare malɛ la efɛ. Amoso m maaŋ yige menyi kikɛ. 9Meeŋ gberge menyi anebiana nɛ menyee ku efɛ be ebɔrɛdare nseŋ naa fule a kpal a malga asheŋ na kusoe. Menyi maŋ naŋ ti ma basa so, menyi alɛ be atre maŋ ti Israɛl be basa be atre so. Menyi maaŋ naŋ bɛta n yɔ menyi be kasawule so. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.
10Anebiana na bee fule a kaŋɛ ma basa nna fanɛ kayurwushi bee ba, jemanɛ nɛ kayurwushi maŋ wɔtɔ. Ma basa pɔr egbal pɔso, nɛ anebiana na ta asɔ nyɔɔso fuful n nyɔɔ egbalana na. 11Kaŋɛ anebiana na fanɛ bumo be egbal na beeŋ tɔr. Abɔrɛjembubi beeŋ tɔr kumo so nɛ afugboŋ e ber kumo so 12nɛ k tɔr nɛ ekama e bishi menyi fanɛ asɔ fuful nɛ men ta n nyɔɔ egbal na be tɔnɔ e la manɛ?”
13To, egbal na e la Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ na. Kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde: “Meeŋ kaa agbo ga n shin nɛ afugboŋ nɛ bɔrɛgboŋ nɛ abɔrɛjembubi a bure egbal na. 14Mee kre kebure egbal nɛ men nyɔɔ n fuli na nɛ k bure cheche n tɔr nɛ kumo be gbaltɔlase nawule e ka a dese. Egbal na beeŋ tɔr menyi so m mɔ menyi kikɛ. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
15Meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbogboŋ e gbelge egbal na nɛ basa nɛ b nyɔ kumo nɛ k fuli na kikɛ so. Saŋɛ na so nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ egbal na tɔr nɛ bumo nɛ b nyɔ kumo nɛ k fuli na kikɛ wu. 16Israɛl be anebiana nɛ b ku ebɔrɛdare nseŋ wu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kayurwushi wɔ Jerusalɛm to jemanɛ nɛ kayurwushi maaŋ wɔ kumo to na nɛ n de na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
17Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma: “Naniere, dimɛdi pibi, kilgi fo anishi n yuu Israɛl be beche nɛ baa bɔla bumo gbagba be aparsheŋ so a wu asheŋ a kaŋɛ na so. Malga ŋ gbiti bumo 18nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ bumo.
Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi beche. Menyee bɔla ŋkilgi be ekpa so nna a wora adur a wɔtɔ ebaŋɛ nɛ echimu to a sa ekama nɛ baa ta a chɛ amu so ŋko a wɔtɔ enɔ to, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ nya eleŋ basa be ŋkpa so. Menyee sha fanɛ menyi e baa kɔ ŋkpa nɛ luwu be eleŋ ma basa so nseŋ ta eleŋ na a wora asɔ nɛ menyee sha. 19Men keni ma jiga ma basa be anishito, ŋkpal shiŋkafa nɛ ajibi gbrɛbi nɛ menyeeŋ nya so. Ma basa kaa bee nu efɛ so, men bɔla efɛ so m mɔ basa nɛ b daŋ maŋ daga luwu nseŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ b daga luwu bre ji efute.”
20Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde: “Ŋ kishi menyi be ŋkilgi be adur be ebaŋɛ nɛ menyee bɔla so a fule ma basa nɛ baa yirda menyi be efɛsheŋ na ga. Ma alɛ beeŋ gberge amo n tuge ashi menyi be mbre so nseŋ shin nɛ basa nɛ men fule m pɛ fanɛ mbuibi na e nya bumo be amu. 21Meeŋ kpɛa menyi be echimu na to nɛ ma basa e nya bumo be amu ashi menyi be eleŋ to. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 22Men bɔla efɛ so n shin nɛ basa lela nɛ m maŋ kre ketɔrɔ bumo pɔ aba nseŋ kuŋ basa lubi ekpa nɛ b maŋ lar bumo be asheŋ lubi to m mɔlga bumo be amu. 23Amoso menyi be efɛ be ebɔrɛdare nɛ kafule be ŋkpal na kikɛ fo ekar. Meeŋ mɔlga ma basa ashi men be eleŋ to nɛ men pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 14
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka malga ŋ gbiti kagbirshuŋ be asheŋ
1Kachako nɛ Israɛl be benimuana na be beko ba chena ma anishi to a fin kubɔya nɛ k shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 3“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, basa ere ta bumo be ŋgbene nna n wɔtɔ kagbirshuŋ to n shin nɛ k bee yɛr bumo kulubi to. A daga ŋ ka tuge bumo a? 4Amoso kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ. Kumo e la fanɛ Israɛl be esa kikɛ nɛ e ta mbe kagbene n wɔtɔ kagbirshuŋ to nseŋ shin nɛ k yɛr mo kulubi to, kumo be kaman nɛ e yɔ anebi kutɔ n ya kaa fin e nu ma kɔnɔ to be kamalga, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ sa mo kubɔya nɛ k daga mo. 5Loŋ e naŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b kini ma nseŋ ta bumo be ŋgbene n wɔtɔ kagbirshuŋ to na e kini agbirana na nseŋ bɛta m ba ma kutɔ.
6Amoso, Ezikɛl, kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na kikɛ kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ. Kumo e la fanɛ b tuba nseŋ yige bumo be agbirana nɛ amo be asheŋ bee nu agbo nɛ menyi be ekishisheŋ na!
7Nɛ fanɛ Israɛl be esa ko ŋko efɔ ko nɛ e wɔ Israɛl be efuli so kini ma nseŋ ya kaa shuŋ agbir, kumo be kaman nɛ e yɔ anebi kutɔ n ya kaa fin ma kɔnɔ to be kamalga be kenu, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ gbagba e naŋ tuge mo. 8M maaŋ sa mo kashuli. Ma alɛ beeŋ gberge mo kusoe nɛ k baa la kefiɛso n sa ekama nɛ e daa fɛ kewora kusɔ nɛ e wora na. Kumo be kaman nɛ n lara mo ashi ma basa to saŋɛ na so nɛ men pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
Demuji nɛ k maŋ kɔ ŋgelge na be asheŋ
9“Nɛ fanɛ anebi ko sa efɛ be kubɔya, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e sa anebi na ekpa nɛ e ku efɛ. Ama ma alɛ kraa beeŋ kini anebi na nseŋ lara mo ashi ma basa Israɛlebi to. 10Anebi na nɛ esa nɛ e yɔ mo kutɔ n ya bishi so na kikɛ beeŋ nya kasogberge koŋwule. 11Meeŋ wora loŋ, saŋɛ na so, Israɛl be basa na maaŋ kini ma nseŋ ta bumo be amu n ya wɔtɔ asheŋ lubiana to. Baaŋ baa la ma basa, nɛ ma alɛ e baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ.” Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.
Efuli lubi be demuji be asheŋ
12Ade be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 13“Dimɛdi pibi, nɛ efuli ko so be basa wora alubi n da ma so nsaa maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa ma, nɛ n shin nɛ bumo be adɔjibi jija nɛ akoŋ tɔr m mɔ basa na nɛ bumo be asɔbɔya kikɛ, 14hale nɛ Nowa nɛ Danɛl nɛ Job, gba daŋ ti bumo so, bumo be alelasheŋ daa beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo gbagba nawule nna ama mannɛ basa na kikɛ.” Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.
15“Ŋko nɛ n shin nɛ asɔbɔya lubi yɔ efuli na so n ya mɔ kumo so be basa nna nɛ kasawule na ki kakpa ŋana so n sa bekama nɛ baa bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ ŋkpal asɔbɔya lubi na so, 16kashenteŋ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ nɛ basa asa ere, Nowa nɛ Danɛl nɛ Job, gba daa wɔ efuli na so, b daa maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo be mbia gba. Bumo gbagba nawule e daa beeŋ nya kumɔlga nɛ kasawule na e ki kakpa fuloŋ a dese.
17Ŋko nɛ fanɛ n shin nɛ bedoŋ kre kena n ya kɔ efuli nɛ kumo so be basa wora alubi nseŋ mɔ basa na nɛ bumo be asɔbɔya kikɛ gba, 18kashenteŋ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ nɛ basa asa na daa wɔ efuli na so gba, b daa maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo be mbia gba, ama bumo gbagba nawule e daa beeŋ nya kumɔlga.
19Ŋko nɛ fanɛ n nya agbo nna nseŋ shin nɛ kulɔ mɔso tɔr efuli na so a mɔ basa nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ, 20ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ kashenteŋto na fanɛ, nɛ Nowa nɛ Danɛl nɛ Job gba daa wɔ efuli na so, b daa maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga bumo be mbia. Bumo gbagba nawule e daa beeŋ nya kumɔlga ŋkpal bumo be alelasheŋ so.”
21Ŋkpal ade kikɛ so, kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ ekpa nɛ meeŋ bɔla kumo so ŋ gberge Jerusalɛm to be basa kusoe kenishipere so nde: “Meeŋ shin nɛ kena nɛ akoŋgboŋ nɛ asɔbɔya lubi nɛ kulɔ mɔso e ba mɔ basa nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ. 22Nɛ esa ko kaŋ ji efute nseŋ mɔlga mbe mbia gba, baaŋ bar bumo Babilɔn be efuli so. Ezikɛl, nɛ fo wu kebaawɔtɔ lubi nɛ fo be basa kɔ na nɛ feeŋ pin kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ m mur Jerusalɛm to be basa. 23Ndoŋ nɛ feeŋ pin geeŋ fanɛ ŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ n wora kusɔ nɛ n wora na.” Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.

Title: EZIKƐL 15
Content:
B ka ta Jerusalɛm m ber kefeelebi jiga be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, nuso nɛ baa ta kefeelebi a ber kedibi? Kefeelebi be keyabi nɛ kupuŋ to be kedibi be keyabi be kumo e kɔ tɔnɔ? 3Esa beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ku kefeelebi be keyabi n wora kusɔ ko a? Esa beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ku kumo n shɛl keyir ŋ gbir a ta asɔ a shiga so a? 4K baa walɛ nna n sa kebaa puga edɛ. Nɛ kumo be mba anyɔ nɛ nferinto kikɛ ji edɛ, esa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta kumo n wora shɛŋ. 5K ka daa maŋ chɔɔ gba k daa maa kɔ tɔnɔ. K ka chɔɔ bre nɛ k beeŋ baa kɔ tɔnɔ a?”
6“To, kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ, kananɛ m baa ta kefeelebi be keyabi kupuŋ to a wɔtɔ edɛ to nɛ k bee chɔɔ na aloŋ nɛ meeŋ ta edɛ 7ŋ gberge basa nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to kusoe. B tiŋ n luri edɛ ko to n lar, ama edɛ malɛ kraa beeŋ chɔɔ bumo m mur. Ŋ kaŋ gberge bumo kusoe na nɛ fo, Ezikɛl, beeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 8B ka maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa ma so, meeŋ shin nɛ efuli na a ki kasawule fuloŋ a dese jiga. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 16
Content:
Jerusalɛm ka maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, shin nɛ Jerusalɛm be basa e pin ekishisheŋ nɛ baa wora na be asheŋ, 3nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Jerusalɛm be kaplɛa so na fanɛ Keenan be kasawule so nɛ b kurge fo nɛ fo tuto la Amɔri be esa nɛ fo nio malɛ la Hiti be esa. 4Kachɛ nɛ b kurge fo, esa kikɛ maŋ ku fo enyaŋ, ŋko m bɛr fo nchu ŋko n wora nfɔl ŋ gbiti fo eyur so ŋko n ta wajɛ m buu fo so. 5Esa kikɛ daa maŋ wu fo kuwɔr gba a bishi nɛ e bee wora fo asheŋ ere be kekama. Kachɛ nɛ b kurge fo gbagba na esa kikɛ maŋ nya kasha n sa fo. B ta fo nna n lɛ kupuŋ to.
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ m bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ nseŋ wu fo nɛ fo dese fo gbagba be ŋklaŋ to a to aya to nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ m maaŋ shin nɛ fo wu. 7Kumo be kaman nɛ n ta fo n ya bela fo fanɛ kusɔ duuso popɔrbi na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ fo daŋ nɛnɛ ŋ ki suŋguru n nyalɛ kebita. Nɛ fo anyipo koso n yili fo kagbene to nɛ fo emin daŋ m ba buu fo abatimu so, ama nɛ fo kraa maa dela shɛŋ.
8Ŋ ka naŋ ba wu fo nɛ m pin fanɛ naniere fo ki eche nna n loge na, nɛ n ta ŋ gbagba be kusɔbuuso m buu fo kayurkpaŋ so. Kumo be kaman nɛ n nase kɔnɔ n sa fo nseŋ bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ feeŋ baa la meya nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e baa keni fo so.
9Kumo be kaman nɛ m bɛr fo nchu n fɔr fo ŋklaŋ na kikɛ nseŋ gbiti fo ɔlif be ŋku. 10Kumo be kaman nɛ n ta kale nɛ b jɔɔ m buu fo nseŋ wɔtɔ fo asɔbɔya be kawɔl lela be asɛbta. Nseŋ naŋ sa fo chimu nɛ k bee nyɛkpɛso pɛlpɛl nɛ fo chɛ nɛ yawu kpakpaso be epiŋi. 11Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ n sa fo enɔ to be mpinibi nɛ kubɔtoshembi 12nɛ kamuna to be kepinibi nɛ akonde nɛ kuwurwuro lela ga nɛ fo ta m buu fo kumu so. 13Shuwa nɛ gbiti be abitasɔ nɛ fo daa wɔtɔ nsaa buu epiŋi nɛ b jɔɔ nɛ yawu kpakpaso be asɔbuuso. Nyifu lela nɛ fo daa ta a wora bodobodo nseŋ daa ji mushoŋ nɛ ɔlif be ŋku. Ŋkpal loŋ so, nɛ fo kebita lar nɛnɛ nɛ fo ki ewurche. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ fo asheŋ sɔ kaplɛkama nɛ ekama bee ji fo kebita be asheŋ ashi efuliana na kikɛ so, ŋkpal kananɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na shin nɛ fo kela lar nɛ ekama bee wu kumo so.
15Ama fo shin nɛ fo kela na luri fo kumu to nɛ fo ki sakaleche nsaa ta fo kumu a sa enyɛn kama nɛ e kra fo a choŋ. 16Fo alɛ lɔŋɛ agbirshuŋkpa nseŋ ta fo asɔbuuso na be ako n lɔŋɛ ndoŋ nsaa keta fo benyɛn a yɔ ndoŋ n ya kaa ji kesakalea. Le be asheŋ daa maŋ daga fanɛ a wora kikɛ. 17Fo ta shuwa nɛ gbiti be abitasɔ nɛ n sa fo na n lɔŋɛ agbir nyɛnsoana nsaa yɔ amo ase n ya kaa ji kesakalea. 18Fo alɛ ta epiŋi nɛ b jɔɔ nɛ n sa fo na a buu agbirana na nsaa ta ɔlif be ŋku nɛ duwu nɛ n sa fo na a lara sarga a sa amo. 19Fo ta nyifu lela nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ mushoŋ nɛ n sa fo fanɛ fo baa ji na n lara sarga n sa agbirana na a fin fanɛ fo asheŋ e par amo. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na gbagba e wu k ka bee wora.
20Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ fo ta fo mbia nɛ fo kurge n sa ma na n lara sarga n sa agbirana na. Fo kubojua na nawule maŋ kukwe a? 21Fo mɔ ma mbia n lara sarga n sa agbirana. 22Fo ka pere kenishi a wora ekishisheŋ ere nsaa ji fo kubojua ere kikɛ na, fo teŋ fo kebia to so; jemanɛ nɛ fo daŋ delge so a dese ŋklaŋ to a to aya to na.
23To, ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ fanɛ kumu lubi gboŋgboŋi bee ba fo so! Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa fo kikɛ. Fo ekar fo nna na! Asheŋ lubi nɛ fee wora ere kikɛ be kaman, 24fo kraa pɔr agbirshuŋkpaana a yili alɔnɛ so nna. 25Kubɔrbi kikɛ ase fo pɔr kegbirshuŋkpa n yili ndoŋ n ya kaa jija fo kela nsaa tu enyɛn kikɛ nɛ e bɔla ndoŋ a choŋ a ŋaba fo kumu. 26Fo tu Ijipt be efuli so be basa nɛ b pere kenishi a fin kananɛ baaŋ nya n di fo na n ji kubojua nɛ ma kagbene kaa ŋkpal loŋ so. 27Amoso nɛ ŋ gberge fo kusoe nseŋ shin nɛ ma nɛfa lar fo so nɛ Filisti be basa nɛ b la fo doŋana nɛ fo asheŋ bee nu bumo agbo na ba ku fo kasawule so. 28Ŋkpal benyɛn nɛ fo kɔ na ka maa kukwe fo so fo kra naŋ ya tu Asiriya be basa malɛ gba nna n ji kesakalea. Bumo alɛ gba maŋ kukwe fo. 29Kumo be kaman nɛ fo naŋ yɔ Babilɔn, nɛ k la eyawujipo be efuli na, malɛ gba nɛ fo kubojuaji na wora keshi n ti so. Ama amo kikɛ be kaman, fo kraa maŋ nya fo kepar.
30Amoso nɛ ma nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo to fo kumu pasaa! Fo wora asheŋ ere kikɛ fanɛ sakaleche nɛ e paŋ anishinyɔr pasaa! 31Fo daŋ pɔr mboŋ nɛ feeŋ baa shuŋ agbirana nsaa ji kubojua n yili kubɔrbi kikɛ ase nna. Ama mannɛ amansherbi so nɛ fo daa wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so fo daa maa sɔ amansherbi. 32Fo du fanɛ eche nɛ e bee sha kebaatu befɔ nna a ji kubojua a chɔ kebaa sha mo kul nawule. 33Sakaleche kikɛ bee sɔ amansherbi nna, ama fo ere e naa sa fo jipoana asɔ, a lɔlɔ bumo nɛ b baa shi kaplɛkama a ba m ba kaa di fo. 34Fo ere be kubojuaji na baa kɔr bekama peya to nna. Benyɛn maa kɔ a fin fo, ama fo ere e naa fin bumo nsaa ka bumo kukɔ gba kuraa.”
Ebɔrɛ ka ji Jerusalɛm demu be asheŋ
35Amoso Jerusalɛm, nu kusɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ fo, sakaleche ere! 36Fo ka delge fo kumu so fanɛ sakaleche nseŋ ta fo kumu n sa fo jipoana nseŋ mɔ fo mbia n lara esarga n sa agbirana nɛ ŋ kishi amo be asheŋ ga na so, 37meeŋ gama fo jipoana nɛ fee sha nɛ bumo nɛ fo kishi kikɛ abar so. Nseŋ shin nɛ b yili ŋ kulti fo nɛ n delge fo so bumo kikɛ be anishito nɛ b wu fo kayurkpaŋ. 38Kejimbri be kasogberge beeŋ ba fo so ŋkpal kubojuaji nɛ basa be kemɔ so. Meeŋ nya agbo ga nseŋ ta luwu ŋ gberge fo kusoe. 39Kumo be kaman, meeŋ shin nɛ fo jipoana e bure m bure mboŋ nɛ fee ji kesakalea na nsaa shuŋ agbirana na kikɛ. Baaŋ suge fo asɔbuuso nɛ abitasɔ na kikɛ ŋ ka fo kayurkpaŋ nɛ enɔfuloŋ.
40“Bumo alɛ beeŋ naŋ we n wɔtɔ jimaŋ nɛ b kpa fo ajembu m mɔ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta etokobi ŋ ŋele fo to fanɛ mblaŋkul nseŋ chɔɔ fo nwu. 41Meeŋ wora loŋ ashi beche damta be anishito nɛ fo kubojuaji e fo ekar nɛ fo jipoana maaŋ naaŋ nya ŋkɛ ashi fo kutɔ. 42Aloŋ nɛ ma agbo beeŋ wushi nɛ ma kagbene e dese ma nɛ m maaŋ naŋ nya agbo ŋko ŋ kɔ kukɔrkɔ. 43Fo teŋ so kananɛ ŋ keta fo jemanɛ nɛ fo daa la kebia fɔlbi na nna nseŋ wora ekishisheŋ nɛ agbo pɛ ma ga. Fo daŋ wora amo nɛ a chɔ loŋ gba nseŋ ki sakaleche gba kuraa. Fo daga kasogberge!” Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.
Ebiche ka du fanɛ kananɛ mo nio du be asheŋ
44Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Basa beeŋ baa bɔ keŋasa ere a laŋɛ fo, Jerusalɛm be kaplɛa fanɛ kananɛ enio be da baa du, aloŋ nɛ mo pibiche gba be da du. 45Fo baa du fanɛ fo nio gbagba nna. Mo e kishi mo kul nɛ mbe mbia na. Fo alɛ baa naa du fanɛ fo kurgepo chesoana nna. Bumo alɛ gba kishi bumo kulana nɛ mbia na. Fo nio daa la Hiti be esa nna nɛ fo tuto malɛ daa la Amɔri be esa. 46Fo dacheso e la kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Samɛria na, nɛ kumo nɛ kumo be ndekarso wɔ a laŋɛ fo kelargato be esoso na.
