Nɛ fo sipocheso malɛ la kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sodɔm na, nɛ kumo alɛ nɛ kumo be ndekarso wɔ a laŋɛ fo kelargato be kaseto na. 47Fo baa maŋ kute bumo be kebaawɔtɔ to nna n wora ekishisheŋ nɛ b wora na nawule, ama fo wora amo nɛ a chɔ bumo peya na gba kuraa.”
48Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo, Jerusalɛm na, fanɛ fo sipocheso Sodɔm nɛ kumo be nde kreso to be basa kikɛ maŋ wora asheŋ lubi n fo amo nɛ fo nɛ fo ndekarso to be basa wora so. 49Sodɔm nɛ kumo be ndekarso to be basa daa wu bumo be amu nna ŋkpal b kaa kɔ ajibi damta a ji nseŋ naa wɔ kayurwushi to so. B daa maa keni betirpo nɛ basa nɛ asheŋ maa nyalɛ a sa na so. 50B daŋ kpeŋ nna nsaa wu bumo be amu nseŋ daŋ naa wora ma ekishisheŋ. Amoso nɛ n daŋ mur bumo fanɛ kananɛ fo nyi geeŋ na.
51Samɛria to be basa bre daŋ maŋ wora asheŋ lubi nɛ fo basa wora ere be barga to gba. Fo basa wora asheŋ keshiso a chɔ bumo be basa, n shin nɛ k wora fanɛ fo kurgepoana na be basa la basa lela a chɔ fo basa. 52To, naniere e daga fanɛ fo nya fo ŋaba. Ŋkpal fo basa be asheŋ lubi ka shi a chɔ fo kurgepoana be basa peya so, kewora fanɛ b la basa lela a chɔ fo basa.”
53Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ Jerusalɛm to be basa le: “Meeŋ naŋ nɛfa Sodɔm nɛ Samɛria nɛ amo be nde kresoana kikɛ to be basa. Ma alɛ beeŋ nɛfa fo alɛ gba be basa ashi Jerusalɛm to, 54saŋɛ na so nyɔmɔ beeŋ pɛ fo basa ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ wora so ka shin nɛ Sodɔm nɛ Samɛria kikɛ to be basa duli basa lela a chɔ bumo so. 55Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, asheŋ beeŋ naŋ nyalɛ n sa fo basa nɛ Sodɔm nɛ Samɛria kikɛ be basa nɛ ndekarsoana na kikɛ to be basa nɛ ekama e bɛta n yɔ kakpa nɛ e daa wɔ dra na. 56Fo, Jerusalɛm, daa wora Sodɔm eyur to nna jemanɛ nɛ fo daa wu fo kumu na, 57kumo be pɔɛŋ nɛ ekama wu fo da lubi na. Naniere fo ki kemɔmɔshia be kusɔ nna n sa Edɔmebi nɛ Filistiebi nɛ efuliana nɛ a kulti fo na kikɛ nɛ baa keni fo jiga. 58Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na, fanɛ, feeŋ ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal asheŋ jiga nɛ asheŋ lubi nɛ fo wora na kikɛ so.”
59Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ: “Meeŋ gberge fo, Jerusalɛm, kusoe ŋkpal fo ka kplaŋ ntaŋ nɛ fo bɔ na so nseŋ jija ma nɛ fo kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na so. 60Ama ma ere beeŋ wora m bɔlɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ fo kre fo kebia to kikɛ na so nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ ma nɛ fo e wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ k beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. 61Aloŋ nɛ feeŋ nyiŋi asheŋ lubi nɛ fo wora na nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ fo jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ fo kurgepoana, Sodɔm nɛ Samɛria, e naŋ bɛta m ba ki fo mbia na, ama mannɛ a loŋ e daa la ma nɛ fo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na. 62To, ma nɛ fo beeŋ naŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ fo pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe na. 63Meeŋ ta fo alubi m paŋ fo, ama feeŋ baa nyiŋi amo nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ fo nɛ fo maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m bugi kɔnɔ. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 17
Content:
Ŋjɔnɔkoso anyɔ be keŋasa be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, bɔ Israɛl be basa na keŋasa 3n shin nɛ b pin fanɛ kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, bee kaŋɛ bumo e la fanɛ kajɔnɔkoso gboŋ ko nɛ e daa kɔ aba lempo nɛ atɛ lela ga e daŋ firgi n yɔ Lebanɔn be abee so n ya bu kedibi nɛ baa tre sida na be awɔlto be keyabi. 4Nseŋ ta keyabi na n yɔ eyawujipo be kasawule so n ya fɛa bumo kadegboŋ to.
5Kumo be kaman nɛ kajɔnɔkoso na ta Israɛl be efuli so be keduuso n ya duu kasawule lela nɛ k mata kabombi so, kakpa nɛ k beeŋ baa nya nchu jemanɛ kikɛ nseŋ tiŋ n daŋ nɛnɛ na. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ keduuso na kɔr n daŋ ŋ ki kefeelebi a sɔr asɔrso nɛ baa tre greep na. Nɛ kumo be ayabi daŋ esoso a shoŋi kajɔnɔkoso na, nɛ kumo be nliŋi yɔ nchiŋ kasawule to. Nɛ kefeelebi na wora ayabi damta nseŋ purge afantaŋ.
7Kajɔnɔkoso nyɔsopo ko malɛ gba daa wɔtɔ a kɔ aba lempo nɛ atɛ damta. Nɛ kefeelebi na be ayabi nɛ nliŋi salga to a yɔ kajɔnɔkoso nyɔsopo na kutɔ, a tama fanɛ k beeŋ nya nchu kumo kutɔ a chɔ kudɔbi nɛ k daa wɔ kumo to na. 8Ama kasawule lela nɛ k kɔ nchu nɛnɛ so nɛ b daŋ duu kumo nɛ k tiŋ n daŋ nɛnɛ ŋ ki kefeelebi lela nseŋ tiŋ n sɔr nɛnɛ.
9Naniere, Ezikɛl, kaŋɛ ma, fo tama fanɛ kefeelebi ere beeŋ pete a? Kajɔnɔkoso juŋkparso na maaŋ nya agbo n tia kumo nseŋ kuya kumo be ayabi to n lɛ nɛ a wɔl a? Kajɔnɔkoso na beeŋ tiŋ n tia kefeelebi na nɛ k maŋ fin benapo lempo damta be kechɛto gba. 10Kefeelebi na kɔ eleŋ nɛ alenfia nɛnɛ, ama nɛ fanɛ epeŋilarkpa be afu ber kumo so, k maaŋ chɛr nɛ k bolo.”
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka bugi keŋasa na to be asheŋ
11Kumo be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma le: 12“Bishi Israɛl be basa nɛ b pal kaman n sa ma ere fanɛ b pin keŋasa ere be kefito a? Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ Babilɔn be efuli so be ewurgboŋ e ba Jerusalɛm to m ba pɛ Juda be ewura nɛ mbe benimuana m bɛta n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so. 13Babilɔn be ewurgboŋ na daŋ ta Juda be ewura be kanaŋ to be esa ko nna n shin nɛ e bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ e beeŋ baa nu a sa mo, nseŋ shin nɛ mo nɛ mo wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre. Kumo be kaman nɛ e pɛ kade na be basa gboŋ n ti so n yɔ, 14saŋɛ na so Juda be efuli so be basa nɛ b ka na beeŋ baa wɔ mbe kaseto a nu a sa mo nawule nsaa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n nya eleŋ bumo gbagba be efuli na so kikɛ. 15Ama ewura popɔr nɛ Babilɔn be ewurgboŋ lara na pal kaman n sa mo nseŋ shuŋi mbɔ Ijipt be efuli so a fin egbaŋɛ nɛ benapo damta. Fo tama fanɛ ewura ere beeŋ ji n lar kusɔ nɛ e bee wora ere to a? E maaŋ tiŋ n lar kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na kaman nsaa maŋ nya kumo be kasogberge!”
16Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le: “Ŋ ka baa la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa ere bre, Juda be ewura ere beeŋ wu ashi Babilɔn be efuli so, ŋkpal e ka lar kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ mo nɛ Babilɔn be ewurgboŋ kre na kaman so nseŋ wora n da mo gbagba be ntaŋ nɛ e bɔ na so so. 17Fɛɛro nɛ e la Ijipt be ewurgboŋ na nɛ mbe benapo lempo kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ Juda be basa to ŋ kɔ jemanɛ nɛ Babilɔn be basa beeŋ ba gbare eshishɛr n deŋi abar so m mata Jerusalɛm be egbal na a fin keluri kade na to ŋ kɔ m mɔ basa na. 18Juda be ewura gbagba e wora n da mbe ntaŋ so nseŋ lar kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ mo nɛ Babilɔn be ewurgboŋ kre na kaman, ŋkpal loŋ so, e beeŋ nya kasogberge.
19Amoso kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ mee sa ŋkpa na kaŋɛ e la fanɛ meeŋ gberge Juda be ewura kusoe ŋkpal e ka wora n da mo gbagba be ntaŋ nɛ e bɔ so nseŋ lar kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na kaman so so. 20Kewora fanɛ kashewu nɛ n ta m pɛ mo nseŋ yɛr mo Babilɔn be efuli so n ya ji mo demu ndoŋ ŋkpal e ka maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa ma so. 21Mbe benapo kpakpaso kama nɛ baaŋ shile na beeŋ wu kena to nɛ bumo nɛ baaŋ ji efute na malɛ e pesaŋ to n sɔ kaplɛkama. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
Ebɔrɛ ka nase tama be kɔnɔ n sa Israɛl be asheŋ
22Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde:
“Ŋ gbagba beeŋ ku kedibi nɛ baa tre sida na
be keyabi n fɛa;
keyabi popɔrbi nɛ meeŋ ku ashi kumo be awɔlto
n ya fɛa kebee jeŋgreŋ so.
23Israɛl be kebee nɛ k du jeŋgreŋ ga na be awɔlto nɛ meeŋ fɛa kumo.
Nɛ k daŋ n wora ayabi nseŋ sɔr asɔrso
nseŋ ki sida be kedibi lela.
Nɛ mbuibi be yiri kikɛ e ba tɔ asha kumo so;
nseŋ nya edikpa kumo be ayabi so.
24Ndoŋ nɛ ndibi nɛ a wɔ kasawule na so beeŋ pin
fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na
e naa ku ndibi tenteŋ a lɛ
nsaa shin nɛ ndibi shiimbi bee daŋ nteŋ.
Mee naa shin nɛ ndibi bumbuŋ bee wɔl
nsaa shin nɛ ndibi wɔlso bee purge.
Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e malga na; ma alɛ beeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ na kikɛ.”

Title: EZIKƐL 18
Content:
Esa nɛ e wora kulubi e naaŋ wu
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma: 2“Ezikɛl, mee kaa nu Israɛl be basa ka bee bɔ keŋasa ere e kaŋɛ fanɛ;
bekurgepo e ji anyinyembi
nɛ a bee nyiri bumo be mbia be anyi.
3Naniere kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa na e kaŋɛ na fanɛ b maaŋ naa bɔ loŋ be keŋasa na Israɛl be efuli so. 4Dimɛdi kikɛ be ŋkpa bɔɔ ma enɔ nna, bekurgepo nɛ bumo be mbia kikɛ. Amoso, esa nɛ e wora kulubi e naaŋ wu kumo be luwu.
5Nɛ fanɛ esa lela koso a ji kashenteŋ nsaa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga jemanɛ kikɛ. 6E maa ji agbirjibi ŋko a shuŋ Israɛl be basa be agbirana na. Mo alɛ maa sha mo barkasa be eche ŋko a di eche jemanɛ nɛ e bee lar ntamaŋ. 7Amodoŋwura malɛ maa puni ŋko a suge esa, mo alɛ maa sɔ tarma pɔɛŋ nseŋ sa esa mpaŋ. Ade be kaman mo alɛ naa chɛ betirpo to a sa bumo ajibi nɛ asɔbuuso. 8Loŋ be esa na maa wɔtɔ amansherbi nɛ e ta m paŋ esa nchu, mo alɛ maa wora kulubi nseŋ naa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so a sa ekama. 9Ade kikɛ be kaman, mo alɛ de so nna nɛ e maaŋ wora n da ma mbra nɛ ma keŋini so. Le be esa la esa lela nna nsaa beeŋ ji efute n chɛr.” Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.
10Ama nɛ fanɛ esa lela ere kurge ebi nɛ e bee suge nsaa mɔ basa, nsaa wora 11asheŋ nɛ mo tuto bre maaŋ wora na. Ebi na bee ji agbirjibi nsaa di mo braana be beche. 12E bee puni betirpo nsaa suge basa. Nɛ esa ta kusɔ ko m ba yili tarma gba e maaŋ naŋ laŋɛ kumo n sa kumo wura. Mo alɛ bee shuŋ agbirana nsaa wora ekishisheŋ. 13Ade kikɛ be kaman, e bee wɔtɔ mpaŋ kama nɛ e sa esa nchu ga nna. Esa kikɛ nɛ e la esa lubi fanɛ mo maa ba nɛ e ji efute n chɛr. Mo gbagba e wora le be ekishisheŋ ere, amoso mo e daga amo be luwu. Mo luwu na be turju beeŋ baa bɛ mo gbagba nna.
14Ama nɛ fanɛ esa lubi ere pibi wu asheŋ nɛ mo tuto bee wora na nseŋ kini kewora asheŋ fanɛ mo tuto, 15nsaa maa ji agbirjibi ŋko a shuŋ Israɛl be agbirana, mo alɛ maaŋ di mo barkasa be eche. 16E maaŋ suge ŋko m puni esa kikɛ, mo alɛ maaŋ sɔ tarma pɔɛŋ nseŋ sa esa mpaŋ. Mo alɛ bee sa betirpo ajibi nɛ asɔbuuso nna 17nsaa kini asheŋ lubi be kewora. Kusɔ nɛ e bee wora e la fanɛ e bee nu nna nsaa bɛ ma mbraana nɛ ma keŋini so. Le be esa beeŋ ji efute n chɛr. Mo tuto e wora alubi, nɛ le be esa lela ere maaŋ wu ŋkpal mo tuto be asheŋ lubi so. 18Mo tuto gbagba e naŋ wu ŋkpal mbe kapuni nɛ kasuge nɛ asheŋ lubi so.
19Ashere menyeeŋ bishi fanɛ nɛ mannɛ e baa nɛ ebi maaŋ nya mo tuto be asheŋ lubi be kakɔka? Kusɔ nɛ k ba e la fanɛ ebi na wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nseŋ wora ma mbraana kasonu nna. 20Basa nɛ b wora alubi e naa wu alubi be luwu. Mbia maaŋ ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal bumo tutoana be alubi so nɛ bekurgepo gba maaŋ ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal bumo be mbia be alubi so. Basa lela beeŋ nya bumo be alelasheŋ be kakɔka nɛ basa lubi malɛ e nya kasogberge ŋkpal bumo be alubi so.
21Nɛ fanɛ basa lubi yige asheŋ lubi be kewora nseŋ fara a wora ma mbraana kasonu nseŋ naa wora asheŋ nɛ a daga, b maaŋ wu manaŋ. 22Baaŋ nya bumo be alubi kikɛ be ketampaŋ, ŋkpal b ka wora asheŋ nɛ a daga so. 23Basa lubi be luwu maa par ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ. Kusɔ nɛ mee sha e la fanɛ b ka beeŋ tuba n lar bumo be alubi to nseŋ ji efute n chɛr.
24Ama nɛ fanɛ basa lela yige alela be kewora nseŋ fara a wora ekishisheŋ nɛ basa lubi bee wora na, a daga fanɛ b ji efute n chɛr a? Ayai! B maaŋ nyiŋi bumo alelasheŋ dra na. Baaŋ wu ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ lubi na so.
25Menyi Israɛl be basa bee kaa kaŋɛ fanɛ, kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe bee wora na maŋ walɛ. Ama men nu nfe, mannɛ ma e naa wora asɔ nɛ a maŋ walɛ. Menyi e naa wora asɔ nɛ a maŋ walɛ! 26Nɛ fanɛ basa lela fara asheŋ lubi be kewora, a daga fanɛ b wu ŋkpal bumo be alubi so. 27Nɛ fanɛ basa lubi malɛ yige asheŋ lubi be kewora nsaa wora asheŋ lela, baaŋ mɔlga bumo be amu ashi kasogberge to. 28Ŋkpal b ka fɛ bumo be asheŋ wora so na be asheŋ nseŋ yige asheŋ lubi na be kewora so nɛ baaŋ ji efute. 29Ama men kraa kaŋɛ fanɛ asɔ nɛ mee wora na maŋ walɛ. Menyi e wora n jija nsaa wora asɔ nɛ a maŋ walɛ.
30“Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa kaŋɛ menyi Israɛl be basa fanɛ meeŋ ji menyi be ekama demu ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora so. Amoso, men tuba ashi menyi be asheŋ woraso lubi to. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, a beeŋ yɛr menyi kemur to. 31Men lar men be asheŋ lubi na to nseŋ fara a fɛ asheŋ lela be kewora be asheŋ menyi be ŋgbene to. Menyi alɛ e baa ji kashenteŋ a sa ma. Men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be alubi e mɔ menyi. 32Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maa sha fanɛ men be ekama e wu. Amoso men tuba nseŋ ji efute n chɛr!”

Title: EZIKƐL 19
Content:
Kagbenejija be kashɛ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ m boŋ kagbenejija be kashɛ n sa Israɛl be benimu anyɔ ko ŋ kaŋɛ le:
2“Men nio daa la fanɛ buluŋ cheso nɛ e daa kɔ kenyɛn nna
nseŋ bela mbe bibi ashi ebuluŋ nyɛnso lempo to!
3E bela mbe ebi ko nseŋ ŋini kumo kepɛ n ji,
nɛ k koya edimɛdi be kepɛ n ji.
4Efuliana na ka nu mbe asheŋ,
nɛ b fe mo kekpaala m pɛ mo,
nseŋ ta edariwa
ŋ gberge mo n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so.
5Kumo nio ka jo nseŋ wu fanɛ tama loge na,
nɛ k naŋ ta kumo be bibi na be eko
m bela kumo nɛ k ki buluŋ lempo.
6K ka daŋ n yili
nɛ k tu kumo braana ebuluŋ e ji kekpaŋ.
Nseŋ koya edimɛdi be kepɛ n ji.
7K daa bure basa be ebu lempoana nna,
nsaa jija bumo be ndeana.
K baaŋ ponte jemanɛ kikɛ, kufugboŋ bee tɔr
ekama so efuli na so nna nɛ b baa chicha.
8Ndoŋ nna nɛ efuliana na kre kumo be kemɔ be nia,
nɛ basa shi kaplɛkama m ba.
Nɛ b sho kashewu
m pɛ kumo
9Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta kumo n wɔtɔ katurgegboŋ to
nseŋ ta kumo n yɔ Babilɔn be ewura kutɔ.
N ya ta mo n ti ebu
nɛ ekama maŋ naŋ nu mbe kaponte
ashi Israɛl be abee so kikɛ.
10Fo nio daa du fanɛ kedibi sɔrso nna
nɛ k yil m mata kabombi;
K daa sɔr nɛnɛ nna nsaa kɔ ayabi damta
ŋkpal k ka daa nya nchu nɛnɛ so.
11Kumo be ayabi daa kɔ eleŋ nna,
nseŋ daa walɛ keku n wora kuwurkpabi.
K daŋ daŋ n yɔ awɔlto
a chɔ ndibi nɛ a ka na kikɛ nna.
Ekama daŋ wu kumo be nteŋ nɛ ayabi damta.
12Ama agbo so nɛ n tia kumo
n lɛ kasawule.
Afu nɛ a shi epeŋilarkpa daŋ shin nɛ k bolo
nɛ kumo be asɔrso gbaŋgbaŋ n tɔr;
nɛ kumo be ayabi lempo na wɔl
nɛ edɛ ji amo.
13Naniere keshishɛrsawule so nɛ n duu kumo,
kasawule wɔlso nɛ nchu maŋ wɔ kumo so.
14Ndoŋ nna nɛ kumo be keyabi gboŋgboŋi ko pɛ edɛ;
nɛ edɛ na bɛ kumo so n chɔɔ kumo be ayabi nɛ asɔrso kikɛ.
Keyabi lempo kikɛ daŋ maŋ naŋ ka kumo so
nɛ b ku n wora kuwurkpabi.
Kashɛ ere la kagbenejija be kashɛ nna n daga kebaaboŋ kagbenejijaso.”

Title: EZIKƐL 20
Content:
Israɛl ka wora kagbene kpakpaso be asheŋ
1B ka pɛ ewura Jehowachin nɛ anyi be beko n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ shunusopo to be kufɔl nusopo to be kachɛ kudusopo na nɛ Israɛl be benimuana ko ba chena ma anishi to a fin kenu kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo.
2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma 3fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Israɛl be benimuana na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde: “Men ba nna nɛ men ba pin kusɔ nɛ mee sha fanɛ men wora a? Ŋ ka baa la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa ere, m maaŋ shin nɛ men pin kusɔ nɛ mee sha fanɛ men wora.
4Dimɛdi pibi, fo wora shiriya nɛ fo kpele bumo kusoe a? Kumo ere nyiŋi bumo ekishisheŋ nɛ bumo tutoana daŋ wora na be asheŋ, 5nseŋ naŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ kachɛ nɛ e lara menyi nɛ men baa la mbe basa na, e daŋ bɔ ntaŋ nna n nase kɔnɔ n sa Jeekɔb nɛ men tutoana nseŋ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini bumo ashi Ijipt be efuli so ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ baa la menyi nɛ men be kaman to ebi be Ebɔrɛ. 6Loŋ be kachɛ na nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ lara bumo Ijipt be efuli so n yɔ kasawule nɛ k kɔ kanya alegaiso nsaa wora adɔjibi ga nseŋ naa la kasawule nɛ k walɛ a chɔ nsawule kikɛ nɛ mo gbagba fin n yili bumo na so. 7Kumo be kaman, nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ bumo be ekama e yige agbirana nɛ men ta menyi be anishi n yuu so, nɛ amo be asheŋ bee nu ma agbo nɛ ŋ kishi amo ga na be kebaashuŋ; saŋɛ na so, menyi maaŋ ta Ijipt be efuli so be agbirana n jija menyi be kebaawɔtɔ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.”
8Ama b pal kaman n sa ma nseŋ kini kenu n sa ma. B daŋ maŋ lara asɔ nɛ b ta ŋ ki agbirana ashuŋ nseŋ ta bumo be anishi n yuu amo so na ashi bumo to. Bumo alɛ daa maŋ naŋ kini Ijipt be efuli so be agbirana na gba. Amoso nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbo a ba bumo so nɛ ŋ gberge bumo kusoe ashi Ijipt ndoŋ na. 9Ama n daa maŋ wora loŋ, ŋkpal ŋ ka daa maa sha fanɛ ma ketre e jija efuliana nɛ baaŋ wu kananɛ meeŋ lara ma kumu ŋ ŋini Israɛl be basa nseŋ juŋkpar bumo n lar Ijipt be efuli so na be anishito so. 10Amoso nɛ n daŋ juŋkpar bumo n lar Ijipt be efuli so n yɔ keshishɛrsawule so na. 11Ndoŋ nɛ n sa bumo ma mbraana nɛ ma keŋini, nɛ b wora amo kasonu nseŋ pin kananɛ baŋ baa keta bumo be amu. 12Kumo be kaman, nɛ n yili ma Kewushiachɛ n sa bumo nɛ k baa la ashi tɔɔnɛ ma nɛ bumo be kefɛato, saŋɛ na so baaŋ pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ b ki basa cheembi.
13Ama Israɛl be basa na lar ma kaman keshishɛrsawule na so ndoŋ, nseŋ kini kebɛ ma mbraana nɛ keŋini nɛ a bee shin nɛ esa bee bii kebaawɔtɔ lela na so. Bumo alɛ nseŋ keni ma Kewushiachɛ na jiga. Amoso nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbo e ba bumo so nɛ m mur bumo ashi keshishɛrsawule na so na. 14Ama n daa maŋ wora loŋ, ŋkpal ŋ ka daa maa sha fanɛ ma ketre e jija ashi efuliana nɛ b wu kananɛ n lara bumo ashi Ijipt be efuli so na be anishito so. 15Amoso nɛ ma alɛ daŋ bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo keshishɛrsawule na so fanɛ m maaŋ naŋ yɛr bumo kasawule lela nɛ k bee wora adɔjibi ga nɛ n daŋ sa bumo na so. 16Ŋkpal manɛ so, b kini kebɛ ma mbraana nɛ ma keŋini so nseŋ keni ma Kewushiachɛ na jiga, nɛ bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ malɛ daa wɔ bumo be agbirana na so a chɔ ma. 17Ade kikɛ be kaman, n daŋ wu bumo kuwɔr nna a maŋ mur bumo ŋko n shin nɛ b shir keshishɛrsawule na so ndoŋ. 18Kusɔ nɛ n daŋ wora e la fanɛ, n daŋ fɛa bumo be mbifɔlbi nɛ b daa wɔ bumo to na so nna, fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ kute bumo tutoana to m bɔla agbirana so n jija bumo be amu. 19Ma e la Enyɛnpe, menyi be Ebɔrɛ na; men be ma mbraana nɛ ma keŋini so. 20Men ta ma Kewushiachɛ naŋ ki kachɛ cheembi, saŋɛ na so k beeŋ baa la tɔɔnɛ a ŋini fanɛ men la ma basa nna nɛ ma alɛ la Enyɛnpe menyi be Ebɔrɛ na.
21Ama ashi keshishɛrsawule na so ndoŋ, mbia na gba lar ma kaman nseŋ kini kebɛ ma mbraana nɛ ma keŋini so. Bumo alɛ gba naŋ keni ma Kewushiachɛ na jiga nna. Amoso nɛn daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbo e ba bumo so ashi kiyi na to ndoŋ. 22Ama n daa maŋ wora loŋ, ŋkpal ŋ ka daa maa sha fanɛ ma ketre e jija ashi efuliana nɛ b wu kananɛ n juŋkpar bumo n lar Ijipt be efuli so na be anishito so. 23Amoso nɛ n daŋ naŋ bɔ ntaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo kiyi na to fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ b pesaŋ to n sɔ efuliana pɔtɛana so na. 24Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ kini kebɛ ma mbraana nɛ atande so nsaa maŋ ta ma Kewushiachɛ na n tre sheŋ nna. Bumo tutoana be agbirana e daŋ bɔlɔ bumo kenishi ga nɛ b daa shuŋ amo. 25Nɛ n daŋ kpal loŋ so n sa bumo mbraana nɛ ŋ gbagba nyi fanɛ b daa maaŋ tiŋ m bɛ amo so n nya ŋkpa. 26B daŋ naŋ bɔla bumo gbagba be esarga so n jija bumo be kebaawɔtɔ nna. B daa ta bumo be ewurkoŋ nna a lara esarga. N daŋ shin nɛ loŋ wora nna nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo nɛ b pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe na.
27Amoso, dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na fanɛ, kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ e la fanɛ kananɛ bumo tutoana daŋ kini ma nseŋ tege ma nna na. 28Jemanɛ nɛ m bar men tutoana kasawule nɛ n nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ sa bumo na so n loge na, nɛ b baa wu agoŋgulombi nɛ ndibigboŋ nɛ a kɔ afantaŋ nseŋ ta amo ŋ ki bumo be agbirshuŋkpaana nsaa wɔtɔ a lara esarga amo ase a sa bumo be agbirana. B daa chɔɔ eduwu nna nsaa duga nsa a wurge agbirana na nɛ kumo be loŋ daa nu ma agbo nsaa kaa ma kagbene. 29Ndoŋ nna nɛ m bishi bumo fanɛ nuso be mboŋ nɛ menyee kaa yɔ na? Nɛ b kaŋɛ, ‘Agbir ase’ nɛ anyee yɔ. Hale nɛ mbre agbirshuŋkpa nɛ baa tre agbir ase.
30Amoso kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ bee bishi e la fanɛ, manɛ e baa nɛ menyeeŋ jija menyi be amu nɛ kebaawɔtɔ fanɛ kananɛ men tutoana daŋ wora na nsaa shuŋ bumo be agbirana nɛ amo be asheŋ bee nu agbo na? 31Jemanɛ nɛ menyee ta menyi be mbia a lara esarga a sa agbirana na hale nɛ mbre na, menyee jija menyi be amu nɛ menyi be kebaawɔtɔ nna na. O Israɛlebi, a daga ŋ ka naŋ sa menyi ekpa nɛ men bishi ma kusɔ ko a? Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e naa kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ m maaŋ sa menyi ekpa nɛ men bishi ma shɛŋ.
32Menyee kaa kaŋɛ le nna: “Anyee sha fanɛ an baa du fanɛ efuliana nɛ amo be basa bee shuŋ ndibi nɛ ajembu na nna.” Ama kusɔ nɛ menyee fɛ na maaŋ tiŋ n wora kikɛ. 33Ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ meeŋ ta eleŋ n ji kuwura menyi so nɛ men pin kananɛ ma agbogboŋ du. 34Eleŋ nɛ tintiŋ nɛ agbogboŋ nɛ meeŋ ta n lara menyi ashi efuliana nɛ men pesaŋ to n yɔ na, m ba gama abar so. 35Nseŋ bar menyi keshishɛrsawule nɛ efuliana na kulti kumo na so, nɛ ma nɛ menyi e tu abar ndoŋ nɛ n ji menyi demu nɛ men ji n tɔr. 36Kananɛ n ji men tutoana demu Ijipt be efuli so be kiyi to nɛ b ji n tɔr nɛ ŋ gberge bumo kusoe na nɛ meeŋ ji menyi alɛ gba demu. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na. 37“Meeŋ ta tintiŋ n shin nɛ men be ekama e wora kusɔ nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na bee ŋini. 38Meeŋ lara ŋgbene kpakpaso wuraana nɛ baa lar ma kaman na ashi menyi to. Hale nɛ n lara bumo ashi efuliana nɛ b pesaŋ to n yɔ na gba m ba, b maaŋ nya m bɛta n yɔ Israɛl be kasawule so. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
39Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ menyi nde: Menyi Israɛlebi, be ekama nɛ e bee sha e ya kaa shuŋ mbe agbirana, ŋkpal manɛ so, ade kikɛ be kaman menyeeŋ ba nu n sa ma nseŋ yige kebaa lara esarga a sa menyi be agbirana a jija ma ketre. 40Ŋkpal manɛ so, kachɛ na kaŋ fo ekama ashi Israɛl be efuli so beeŋ shuŋ ma ashi kebee cheembi nɛ baa tre Zayɔn ashi Jerusalɛm to na so, nɛ ma alɛ e sɔ bumo esarga nɛ baaŋ lara n sa ma ndoŋ na. Menyi be asheŋ beeŋ baa par ma nɛ ma alɛ e baa keni menyi be esarga lela nɛ ŋkɛ cheembi na akpa. 41Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ naŋ lara menyi efuliana nɛ men pesaŋ to n yɔ to m bɛta m ba gama abar so na, ma kagbene beeŋ naŋ fuli menyi so nɛ n sɔ menyi be esarga fanɛ duwu nɛ a bee dufɛ viim na. Ndoŋ nɛ efuliana na kikɛ beeŋ wu fanɛ n du cheembi nna. 42Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ bɛta menyi m ba Israɛl be efuli so, kasawule nɛ n nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ ta n sa men tutoana na, nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe na. 43Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ nyiŋi menyi be asheŋ wora so nɛ a shin nɛ men jija menyi be kebaawɔtɔ na, nɛ a shin nɛ menyi be asheŋ e baa nu menyi gbagba agbo ŋkpal asheŋ lubi nɛ men wora so. 44Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ wora menyi, Israɛlebi, asheŋ nɛ a beeŋ bar ma ketre kemaŋkura nɛ mannɛ men be asheŋ lubi nɛ aworbi jiga so na nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.”
45Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kubɔya naŋ ba ma kutɔ. 46E yɛ: “Dimɛdi pibi, kilgi a keni kelargato be kaseto nseŋ malga ŋ gbiti kupo nɛ k wɔ ndoŋ na. 47Kaŋɛ kupo na fanɛ k kaŋ kusoe n nu Enyɛnpe na be kubɔya. E yɛ: ‘Mee sha kenya edɛ n wɔtɔ fo to nɛ a chɔɔ fo ndibi bumbuŋ nɛ awɔlso kikɛ m mur nna na. Sheŋ maaŋ tiŋ n duŋ edɛ na saŋɛ nɛ a beeŋ yili kelargato be kaseto n chɔɔ a yɔ kelargato be esoso na. Kusɔkama malɛ nɛ edɛ na beeŋ tu amo be kebɔr so beeŋ ji edɛ m mur. 48Ekama beeŋ pin fanɛ ma Enyɛnpe na e nya edɛ na n wɔtɔ kupo na to nɛ ekama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n duŋ amo.’ ”
49Ndoŋ nna nɛ n fubel ŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, sa maŋ shin nɛ n wora loŋ! Ekama bee malga a kaŋɛ fanɛ aŋasa nɛ mee bɔ nɛ a bee wul bumo to.”

Title: EZIKƐL 21
Content:
Babilɔn ka la Ebɔrɛ be tokobi be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kilgi fo anishi n shoŋi Jerusalɛm m malga ŋ gbiti kakpa nɛ basa na bee shuŋ be Ebɔrɛ na. Kpele Israɛl be basa kikɛ kusoe 3nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ b ki ndoŋana nna. Amoso meeŋ pee ma tokobi kumo be efar to m mɔ bumo to be basa lela nɛ belubi kikɛ. 4Ma tokobi na beeŋ yili kelargato be kaseto be kaba so m ba choŋ kelargato be esoso na kikɛ m mɔ basa kama nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ 5Nɛ ekama e pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maaŋ naŋ bɛta ma tokobi nɛ n pee na n wɔtɔ kumo be efar to kikɛ.
6Amoso, dimɛdi pibi, shin nɛ fo kagbene e jija fo nɛ fo baa shu ashi kakpa nɛ ekama beeŋ wu fo. 7B kaŋ bishi fo kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ fee shu fo kaŋɛ bumo le: ‘Baru nɛ k bee ba na so nɛ mee shu.’ Kumo jemanɛ kaŋ fo ekama be kagbene beeŋ jija mo nɛ kufu e tɔr ekama so nɛ bumo be aba e pɔ bumo nɛ b baa chicha a maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ. Kachɛ na bee ba! K maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
8Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 9“Dimɛdi pibi, kaŋɛ Jerusalɛm be basa na fanɛ;
N wora ma tokobi shiriya n loge,
n yee kumo nɛ k bee kpa edɛ.
10N yee kumo nɛ n mɔ;
n fifɛa kumo so nɛ k bee kpa edɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ ka nyɛkpɛ na!
Kayurji maŋ naa wɔtɔ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, ma basa
kplaŋ ma kasokpele nɛ kasogberge kikɛ so nna.
11Mee yee ma tokobi nna,
a wora kumo shiriya a jo,
esa nɛ e beeŋ ta kumo m mɔ na.
12Dimɛdi pibi, boŋ to awɔrso,
ŋkpal manɛ so tokobi na bee ba ma basa
nɛ Israɛl be benimuana so nna.
Bumo kikɛ beeŋ wu,
bumo nɛ basa nɛ b ka na kikɛ.
Amoso, ta enɔ n deŋi kumu a shu!”
13Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mee wora ma basa a keni nna na,
nɛ b kaŋ kini ketuba,
kumo ere asheŋ ere kikɛ beeŋ ba bumo so.”
14“Amoso, dimɛdi pibi,
kpele bumo kusoe,
nseŋ ber enɔbelaŋ ŋkpal ŋ ka kɔ m pɔɔ so so.
Tokobi na beeŋ baa mɔ bena nɛ jiso kikɛ,
nseŋ ta kufu m pɛ basa na.
Kamɔ be tokobi e la kumo
k la kamɔ damta be tokobi nna,
bena nɛ jiso nɛ k bee mɔ.
15Saŋɛ na so kufu beeŋ pɛ basa;
nɛ galeŋga e chicha n fiti n tɔr.
N wora ma tokobi shiriya nɛ k mɔ
ashi bumo be mbunaana kikɛ ase.
N tiŋ n yee kumo nna nɛ k bee kpa edɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee nyɛkpɛ na,
nseŋ pɛ kumo to nɛ m mɔ.
16K beeŋ baa ŋe bena nɛ jiso;
kaplɛkama nɛ kumo be jisoso
kilgi n shoŋi nɛ k beeŋ ŋe.
17Ma alɛ gba beeŋ ber enɔbelaŋ,
nɛ ma agbo e yɔɔso.
Ma, Enyɛnpe e kaŋɛ na.”
18Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe na be kubɔya ba ma kutɔ: 19E yɛ: “Dimɛdi pibi, ŋini ekpa anyɔ nɛ Babilɔn be efuli so be ewura beeŋ ta mbe tokobi na m bɔla so m ba. Ekpa anyɔ na daga fanɛ a fara efuli koŋwule so nna. Dulgi kakpa nɛ ekpa na barga to anyɔ na, 20a ŋini ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ Ammɔnebi be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Raba na, nɛ kumo nɛ kumo alɛ bee yɔ Juda be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jerusalɛm nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kulti kumo na; nɛ Babilɔn be ewura na e bɔla so n yɛr mbe tokobi na. 21Babilɔn be ewura kaŋ baa fo ekpa anyɔ na be ŋkpancheri na, e beeŋ bɔla mbe atanyembi so nɛ mbe agbirana so nɛ kusɔbɔya nɛ b mɔ n lara sarga be kegbirche so m bishi so m pin kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora. 22Nɛ e baaŋ ta enɔjiso m pee ketanyembi nɛ b sibɛ ‘Jerusalɛm’ n deŋi kumo so a ŋini fanɛ b kɔ kumo kena, e beeŋ shin nɛ b foŋ kabel n sa benapo ekpa nɛ b ya kulti kadegboŋ na n wɔtɔ, nseŋ koli eshishɛr n deŋi abar so ŋ gbuŋ egbal nɛ k kulti kade na, saŋɛ na so baaŋ bɔla amo so n dii n luri kade na to ŋ kɔ basa na kena. Bumo alɛ beeŋ naaŋ ta ndibi gbɛgbɛso n da kade na be mbunagboŋ na m bugi n n luri to. 23Ekama nɛ e wɔ Jerusalɛm beeŋ baa fɛ fanɛ efɛ be kubɔya e la kumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo nɛ Babilɔn be ewura nase nnɔ nna n sa abar. Ama e beeŋ nyiŋi bumo asheŋ lubi nɛ b wora na nseŋ yili amo so pɛ bumo ŋ ki anya.
24Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ e la fanɛ, ŋkpal menyi, Jerusalɛm be basa, nɛ menyi be ewura be alubi ka dii efuli ashi kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora to so, meeŋ shin nɛ b pɛ menyi ŋ ki anya.
25Fo, Israɛl be ewura lubi nɛ kumu kpakpaso wura ere, fo kasogberge be kachɛ maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ fo. 26Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa kaŋɛ fo na fanɛ fo shɛŋi fo kumu so be neemu na nseŋ lara kuwurwuro na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, asheŋ maaŋ naa du kananɛ a daa du na. Esa nɛ e daa maŋ kɔ eyilikpa beeŋ nya eyilikpa nɛ emo nɛ e daa kɔ eyilikpa e paŋ mbe eyilikpa. 27Meeŋ shin nɛ kadegboŋ na e mur! Kumo alɛ maaŋ naŋ ki kade kikɛ n ya fo fanɛ esa nɛ k la mo peya na ka beeŋ ba, nɛ n ta kumo n sa mo.
28Ama fo, dimɛdi pibi, kaŋɛ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Ammɔn be basa nɛ baa tege Israɛl na be kaplɛa so e la fanɛ
b gberge tokobi m pe,
n wora shiriya nɛ b mɔ;
b fifɛa kumo so nna m bela ase nɛ b ta kumo m mɔ.
K bee kpa edɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ ka nyɛkpɛ nna!
29Ebɔrɛdare nɛ menyee ku na la efɛ nna,
nɛ asheŋ nɛ men kpal n wu na kikɛ la kafulesheŋ.
Menyi amu kpakpasowuraana nɛ basa lubi ere,
menyi be kasogberge be kachɛ bee ba;
tokobi na beeŋ gbelge menyi be abɔ so.
30Amoso men bɛta menyi be tokobi
n wɔtɔ kumo be efar to.
Ŋkpal manɛ so jemanɛ nɛ menyee gberge basa kusoe fo ekar.
Meeŋ ji menyi demu
kakpa nɛ b kurge menyi,
ashi men nanaana be kasawule so na.
31Meeŋ shin nɛ ma agbo e ba menyi so
fanɛ edɛ na n chɔɔ menyi.
Meeŋ ta menyi m bɔɔ basa nyaŋnyaŋso enɔ,
basa nɛ b nyi kamɔ to.
32Menyeeŋ ki fanɛ ndibi puga edɛ,
menyi be ŋklaŋ beeŋ wurge menyi be kasawule so
nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi menyi kikɛ;
ŋkpal manɛ so, ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 22
Content:
Jerusalɛm be alubi be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, fo wora shiriya nɛ fo kaŋɛ Jerusalɛm nɛ k la kadegboŋ nɛ basa nɛ baa mɔ basa bɔlɔ kumo to na fanɛ k maŋ wora n nyalɛ a? Kumo ere shin nɛ basa na e pin bumo be ekishisheŋ nɛ b wora na be asheŋ. 3Kumo be kaman nɛ fo kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ, ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ ŋkpal fo basa ka mɔ fo gbagba to be basa damta nseŋ naŋ ta kagbirshuŋ n jija fo so, fo kasogberge be saŋɛ bee ba. 4Basa be kemɔ na shin nɛ fo basa wora n jija nɛ agbirana nɛ b lɔŋɛ a shuŋ na malɛ shin nɛ b jija bumo be amu. Basa be kasogberge be kachɛ taga to nna na. Amoso nɛ n shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛana be basa bee wora fo basa eyurto nsaa malga mmalga jiga a gbiti bumo na. 5Efuli nɛ a taga to nɛ amo nɛ a wɔ kufɔ kikɛ to be basa beeŋ wora fo basa eyurto, ŋkpal b ka maa bɛ mbraana so so.
6Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana na be ekama ta eleŋ nɛ e kɔ nna a mɔ basa. 7Menyi basa nɛ men wɔ kadegboŋ na to na maa sa men tutoana nɛ men nioana bunyaŋ. Menyee puni befɔ nna nsaa kɔrfɛ amunibi nɛ bekulpoche. 8Menyi maa sa mboŋ cheembi na bunyaŋ. Menyi alɛ maa bɛ ma kewushiachɛ na so. 9Fo basa na be beko bee ku efɛ nna a deŋi beko a fin bumo be kamɔ. Beko malɛ bee ji agbirjibi nna nɛ beko malɛ wɔtɔ a wora kusɔjiya be asheŋ. 10Basa na be beko wɔtɔ nna a di bumo tutoana be beche nɛ beko malɛ bee tintiŋ a di beche nɛ baa lar ntamaŋ. 11Basa ko wɔtɔ nna a ji kubojua nɛ beko bee di bumo be bibinyɛn be beche. Bede malɛ wɔtɔ a di bumo sipocheana nɛ bumo nɛ bumo la kututo ŋko kenio koŋwule. 12Ade kikɛ be kaman, basa na be beko wɔtɔ nna a sɔ amansherbi nsaa mɔ basa, nɛ beko malɛ bee wɔtɔ amansherbi nɛ b ta m paŋ bumo braana Israɛl be basa nchu ga a dii kedama nɛ kumo be loŋ maŋ daga. B teŋ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na so nna.
13Ŋkpal ade kikɛ ere so ma agbo beeŋ basa nɛ baa suge nɛ bumo nɛ baa mɔ ere kikɛ so. 14Ma agbo kaŋ ba fo basa ere so, b maŋ naa kɔ kenyɛn nseŋ nya eleŋ m maŋ enɔ so gba. Ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ, ma alɛ beeŋ wora kumo. 15Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ b pesaŋ to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so nɛ bumo be asheŋ lubi na kikɛ e ba ekar. 16Efuli pɔtɛana so be basa beeŋ keni bumo jiga, nɛ fo basa e pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
17Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 18“Dimɛdi pibi, Israɛl be basa na maŋ naa kɔ tɔnɔ n sa ma. B ki fanɛ danyaŋ ŋko kebɛlso ŋko epal ŋko gbiti nɛ b ŋalga n lɔŋɛ so be ebin nna. 19Amoso meeŋ gama bumo kikɛ abar so ashi Jerusalɛm to 20-21fanɛ kananɛ baa chala gbiti ŋko danyaŋ ŋko abɛlso ŋko epal a wɔtɔ edɛ to a lɔŋɛ amo so nna. Ma agbo gboŋ beeŋ ba bumo so ashi Jerusalɛm to, fanɛ edɛ nɛ k bee ŋalga abɛlso be yiri yiri na. 22Kananɛ gbiti bee ŋalga edɛ to na nɛ bumo alɛ gba beeŋ ji awurfoŋ Jerusalɛm to. Aloŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e nya agbo a gberge bumo kusoe na.”
Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana be alubi be asheŋ
23Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 24“Dimɛdi pibi, kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na fanɛ bumo be kasawule na maŋ du cheembi. Alubi e bɔlɔ kumo to, amoso nɛ n nya agbo a gberge kumo be basa kusoe na. 25Bumo be bejuŋkparpoana ŋko anebiana du fanɛ ebuluŋ nɛ a pɛ kusɔbɔya a kpɛa to a we nsaa munto nna. Baa mɔ basa na nna nseŋ suge amansherbi nɛ mpetɛsɔ kikɛ nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n nya n sɔ. Bumo alɛ bee mɔ bekulana nna nɛ beche damta e ki bekulpoche. 26Israɛl be bɔrɛmatapoana bee gal ma mbraana nna a nase nsaa keni ma asɔ cheembi jiga. B maa barga asɔ nɛ a du cheembi nɛ amo nɛ a maŋ du cheembi to. Bumo alɛ maa ŋini basa kananɛ asɔ nɛ a walɛ so nɛ amo nɛ a maŋ walɛ so kɔr abar to. Ade kikɛ be kaman, b maa bɛ ma kewushiachɛ na so. Israɛl be basa maa sa ma bunyaŋ. 27Israɛl be benimuana na gba du fanɛ ekuntuŋ nɛ baa pɛ asɔbɔya a kpɛa to a we nna. Baa mɔ basa nna nsaa bɔla ekpa nɛ k maŋ daga so a dii dama. 28Nɛ bumo be anebiana malɛ bee bɔla efɛ be ebɔrɛdare nɛ kafule be kewuŋkaŋɛ so a da a buu le be asheŋ lubi ere so fanɛ b ka ta asɔ fuful n nyɔɔ egbal na. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na maŋ malga bumo kutɔ, ama baa ku efɛ a kaŋɛ fanɛ b nya kubɔya ashi ŋ kutɔ nna. 29Basa na baa wɔ kapuni nɛ kasuge be kebaawɔtɔ to nna. B wɔtɔ nna a kɔrfɛ betirpo nsaa puni befɔ, a mɔn bumo kashenteŋ ashi demuji to. 30Ade kikɛ so nɛ n fin esa nɛ e beeŋ kɔ n sa kadegboŋ na nseŋ kuŋ kumo, nɛ ma agbo maaŋ ba kumo so nɛ k mur. Ama m maŋ nya esa kikɛ. 31Amoso ma agbogboŋ beeŋ mur Israɛl be basa ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b wora so. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 23
Content:
Ebojuache anyɔ be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, beche anyɔ ko nɛ b daa la eche koŋwule be mbia e daa wɔtɔ. 3Bumo be kebia to kikɛ nɛ b ki esakaleche ashi Ijipt be efuli so. Ndoŋ nɛ benyɛn daŋ ta bumo ŋ ki beche. 4Enimu so na e daa la Ohola nɛ e yili n sa kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Samɛria na nɛ ekekarso na malɛ daa la Oholiba, nɛ mo alɛ yili n sa Jerusalɛm. B daa la ma beche nna nseŋ daŋ kurge mbia n sa ma.
5Ohola daŋ kra la ma eche nna nsaa ji kesakalea nsaa kɔ kayɛlga lubi n sa mo jipoana nɛ b shi Asiriya be efuli so na. 6Mo jipoana na daa la benapo nɛ baa buu epiŋi nɛ a nyɔ buru nɛ gomena be benimuana nɛ benapo nimuso nɛ benapo nɛ baa dii egbaŋɛ nɛ bumo kikɛ daa la mbrantiɛ nɛ b walɛ ayɛrbi nna. 7Asiriya be efuli so be benimu nɛ e daa tu a ji kesakalea nɛ mbe kayɛlga lubi na shin nɛ e tu bumo a shuŋ bumo be agbirana nseŋ jija mbe kumu. 8Jemanɛ nɛ benyɛn jija mo nseŋ ta mo ŋ ki eche ashi Ijipt be efuli so mbe kebia to kikɛ hale nɛ mbre e maŋ naŋ yige mbe kesakalea na.
9Amoso nɛ n kini mo n sa mo jipoana nɛ e daa sha ga ashi Asiriya be efuli so na. 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo alɛ delge mo so kesaria nseŋ pɛ mbe mbia n yɔ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b mɔ mo gbagba nɛ kaplɛkama be beche bee kuli Ohola ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ k nya mo so.
11Mo sipo Oholiba gba daŋ wu kusɔ nɛ k wora, ama mbe kesakalea daa chɔɔ mo da, Ohola peya. 12Mo alɛ gba daa kɔ kayɛlga lubi nna n sa Asiriya be efuli so be benimuana nɛ b walɛ ayɛrbi nɛ benapo nɛ baa kre to nɛnɛ nɛ benapo nɛ baa dii egbaŋɛ nsaa la mbrantiɛ nɛ b walɛ ayɛrbi na. 13Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu fanɛ kusɔ jigaya be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ mo da daa kɔ na nɛ mo alɛ gba kɔ.
14Ama Oholiba bre be kebaawɔtɔ daŋ naŋ lubi a chɔ mo da Ohola peya. E daŋ wu b ka wora Babilɔn be efuli so be benyɛn be efoto n deŋi egbal so nseŋ nyɔɔ amo apeper. 15Benyɛn nɛ b daŋ wora n deŋi egbalana na so na daŋ mɛa to nna ŋ kre ekreso kashɛr to nseŋ mɛa eneemugboŋ malɛ bumo be amu so, nɛ kumo be loŋ shin nɛ mbe nfɛra laŋɛ Babilɔn be efuli so be benapo nimuso nɛ baa dii egbaŋɛturko na so. 16E ka baŋ wu efoto na nɛ kayɛlga lubi luri mo to nɛ e shuŋi mbɔ Babilɔn be efuli so be benapo be benimuana na kutɔ. 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ba tu mo n di n jija mo. B daŋ di mo hale nɛ bumo be asheŋ ya kilgi a nu mo agbo. 18Oholiba shin nɛ ekama wu mbe kesaria nseŋ pin fanɛ sakaleche e daa la mo. Mbe asheŋ daŋ ba kaa nu ma agbo nna ga nɛ m pal kaman n sa mo fanɛ kananɛ n daŋ wora mo da, Ohola na. 19Ama amo nɛ amo kikɛ, e kraa ji kesakalea na nna a ti so, nseŋ daa wora asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ e daa wora amo jemanɛ nɛ e daa la kasuŋgurbia ashi Ijipt be efuli so na gbagba. 20E daa kɔ kayɛlga lubi be kasha nna n sa Ijipt be efuli so be benyɛn nɛ b daa di beche fanɛ ekurma nɛ egbaŋɛ na nna.” 21Amoso e kraa yɛlga mbe kebia to be kusɔ jigaya be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ e daa kɔ ashi Ijipt be efuli so na nna. Ndoŋ nɛ benyɛn daŋ fɔnɔ mbe anyipo nseŋ jija mbe tumba na.
22Amoso kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ Oholiba nɛ fo yili n sa Jerusalɛm na e la fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ fo jipoana nɛ bumo be asheŋ fi fo ere e nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo nseŋ ba kulti fo n wɔtɔ fanɛ bedoŋ na. 23Meeŋ gama benapo nimuso nɛ benapo nɛ baa far egbaŋɛturko be benimuana nɛ basa gboŋ nɛ baa dii egbaŋɛ na kikɛ nɛ b shi Babilɔn be efuli so nɛ Asiriya be efuli so nɛ Chaldian be yiri to be basa nɛ b shi nde nɛ baa tre Pɛkɔd nɛ Showa nɛ Kowa na m ba abar so. 24Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta egbaŋɛturko wurbi nɛ agboŋi kikɛ n sulɔ akɔsɔ nɛ benapo damta n shi kelargato be esoso m ba kulti fo n wɔtɔ ŋ kɔ fo kena. Baaŋ keta abɛlso be asɔ kuŋamuso wurbi nɛ agboŋi kikɛ nseŋ buu abɛlso be akpaŋwuro bumo be amu so nna m ba. Ma alɛ beeŋ ta fo m bɔɔ bumo enɔ nɛ b gberge fo kusoe kananɛ bumo be mbraana bee ŋini. 25Ŋkpal ŋ ka nya agbo n wɔtɔ fo so, meeŋ shin nɛ benapo na e kaa kagbene n tɔrɔ fo ga. Benapo na beeŋ ku fo kamuna nɛ asoe nseŋ mɔ fo mbia. Kashenteŋto, baaŋ suge fo mbia n yɔ n ya chɔɔ bumo m mɔ. 26Kumo be kaman, benapo na beeŋ suge fo asɔbuuso nɛ yawu kpakpaso be abitasɔ kikɛ. 27Saŋɛ na so nɛ n shin nɛ fo yige fo kayɛlga lubi nɛ kusɔ jigaya be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ kesakalea nɛ fo fara a ji ashi Ijipt be efuli so na. Fo maaŋ naa nyiŋi asheŋ ere nsaa yɛlga amo ŋko a nyiŋi Ijipt be efuli so gba kuraa.
28Ade be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ ta fo m bɔɔ basa nɛ fo kishi nsaa maa sha kewu bumo kikɛ na enɔ. 29Ŋkpal b ka kishi fo so, baaŋ suge asɔ kama nɛ fo gben n nya kikɛ n yɔ ŋ ka fo kesaria. Saŋɛ na so nɛ ekama e wu fanɛ sakaleche e la fo kashenteŋto. Fo gbagba be kayɛlga lubi nɛ kesakalea 30e bar le be asheŋ ere fo so na. Fo daa la sakaleche nna n sa efuli pɔtɛ so be basa nseŋ daa shuŋ bumo be agbirana n jija fo kumu. 31Fo daŋ bɔla ekpa nɛ fo da, Ohola nɛ e yili n sa kade nɛ baa tre Samɛria na, bɔla so na nna, amoso kasogberge nɛ e nya na nɛ fo alɛ gba beeŋ nya.
32Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ fanɛ
“Kurwa nɛ fo da nuu to na nɛ fo alɛ gba beeŋ nuu to,
k la kurwa nɛ k shi nsaa du chuŋguluŋ nna.
Ekama beeŋ keni fo jiga nseŋ wora fo eyur to,
ŋkpal manɛ so, ma agbogboŋ e bɔlɔ kurwa na to.
33Feeŋ nuu kurwa na to m boo nɛ kagbenejija e tɔr fo so,
ŋkpal kemur nɛ kufusheŋ ka bɔlɔ kurwa na to so.
K la fo da Samɛria be kurwa nna.
34Feeŋ nuu kumo to be asɔ nseŋ dente kumo kikɛ to;
kumo be kaman nɛ fo bure kumo
nseŋ ta kumo be abureso na ŋ ku ŋ ku fo anyipo.
Ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.
35Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ, Ŋkpal fo ka teŋ ma so nseŋ pal kaman n sa ma so, feeŋ ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal fo kayɛlga lubi be kusɔ jigaya nɛ kesakalea be kebaawɔtɔ na so.”
Ebɔrɛ ka ji eche nɛ mo sipocheso demu be asheŋ
36Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, fo wora shiriya nɛ fo kaŋɛ Ohola nɛ Oholiba fanɛ b wora n jija a? Kumo ere shin nɛ b pin bumo be ekishisheŋ nɛ b wora na be asheŋ. 37B bɔla kagbirshuŋ so n ji kubojua, kumo e la fanɛ b maŋ ji kashenteŋ n sa ma nseŋ ta ma mbia n m mɔ n lara esarga n sa agbirana. 38B daŋ naŋ keni ma bɔrɛlambu na nɛ ma kewushiachɛ nɛ n yili na jiga nna a maŋ sa amo bunyaŋ. 39Kachɛ nɛ b mɔ ma mbia n lara esarga n sa agbirana na nɛ b ba ma bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ kumo be loŋ shin nɛ k ki kakpa nɛ k maŋ naŋ daga fanɛ b shuŋ ma ndoŋ.
40Ade malɛ kikɛ be kaman nɛ b shuŋi mbɔ n tre benyɛn nɛ b shi kufɔ kufɔ m ba. Nɛ benyɛn na ka ba, nɛ beche anyɔ ere bɛr nchu nseŋ ŋ ŋe ekele nseŋ ta abitasɔ m mɛa to. 41Kumo be kaman nɛ b chena mbɛ lela so nseŋ bela asɔ lela fanɛ eduwu nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ n sa bumo na m bɛ teebɔl so ashi bumo be anishito.
42Kaaseso kikɛ bumo be ebu daŋ baa bɔlɔ keshishɛrsawule so be benyɛn damta nɛ baa cha awɔr nsaa ji bumo be amu nna. Benyɛn na daa sa beche na enɔ to be mpini nɛ awurwuro lela nna. 43Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu fanɛ benyɛn na kraŋ pere kenishi nna a sha kedi beche na, ama beche na malɛ teŋ ji kesakalea ga. 44Kananɛ benyɛn baa di esakaleche ale anyɔ nyɔ na nɛ b daa di Ohola nɛ Oholiba, nɛ b la beche jiga na. 45Ama kachako benyɛn lela na beeŋ ji beche anyɔ ere demu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b wora n jija nseŋ daga kubojuaji nɛ basa be kemɔ be kasogberge, ŋkpal manɛ so, b ji kubojua nɛ ŋklaŋ malɛ gbiti bumo be enɔana.”
46“Amoso kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ, meeŋ shin nɛ jimaŋ nɛ b nya agbo e ba tɔrɔ bumo nɛ kufugboŋ e pɛ bumo nɛ b suge bumo be asɔ n ti so. 47Kumo be kaman nɛ jimaŋ na e kpa bumo ajembu nseŋ ta etokobi ŋ kɔ bumo, m mɔ bumo be mbia nseŋ chɔɔ bumo be nwu n lɛ. 48Meeŋ lara kusɔjigaya be kebaawɔtɔ kasawule na kikɛ so nɛ k baa la kusoe kpele n sa eche kikɛ nɛ b sa maaŋ naŋ ji kubojua nɛ kesakalea fanɛ kananɛ Ohola nɛ Oholiba wora na. 49Ama meeŋ gberge menyi beche anyɔ nɛ men la kenio pibi ere kusoe kenishipereso, ŋkpal menyi be kusɔ jigaya be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ kagbirshuŋ be kulubi so. Aloŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 24
Content:
Kapuliya daŋɛso na be asheŋ
1B ka daŋ pɛ anyi be galeŋga nɛ ewura Jehowachin kenya n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ kpanusopo na to be kufɔl kudusopo na be kachɛ kudusopo na, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, sibɛ kabre be kachɛ ere n nase, ŋkpal manɛ so, k la kachɛ nɛ Babilɔn be ewura kre kena m ba kulti Jerusalɛm n wɔtɔ a kɔ nna. 3Amoso bɔ keŋasa ere ŋ kaŋɛ ma basa nɛ b pal kaman n sa ma na. Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ
Wɔtɔ nchu kadaŋɛ na to,
n ta kumo m bɛ edɛ so.
4Nseŋ ta eblaŋ na be alela fanɛ ebɛaŋ nɛ aba n wɔtɔ to.
Bela awibi lela na gba n wɔtɔ nɛ k bɔlɔ.
5Kubɔlpo lela ga be eblaŋ nɛ awibi e daga fanɛ fo ta n wɔtɔ kadaŋɛ na to.
Nseŋ gbar ndibi n wɔtɔ edɛ na to,
saŋɛ na so a beeŋ falte
nɛ eblaŋ na nɛ awibi na e bel.
6Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa Jerusalɛm be kadegboŋ nɛ kumo to be basa bee mɔ basa ere! K du fanɛ kadaŋɛ kreŋ so nɛ b maŋ naŋ fɔr kumo na nna. Baa lara eblaŋ na kukoko to nna nɛ esa kikɛ be shɛŋ maŋ wɔ kusɔ nɛ k bee wora na to. 7Jerusalɛm to be basa mɔ basa nɛ b maŋ wora shɛŋ ashi kadegboŋ na to, ama b maŋ wora ania nɛ b wora eshishɛr m buu bumo be ŋklaŋ nɛ a wurge kefalta so gba. 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ ma alɛ gba yige ŋklaŋ na kefalta na so, kakpa nɛ a maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋana. Nɛ amo alɛ bee fin fanɛ ŋ kɔ n sa amo.”
9Ade be kaman kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ; “Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa kadegboŋ nɛ baa mɔ basa kumo to na. Ŋ gbagba e naŋ ber ndibi damta n wɔtɔ edɛ na to. 10Amoso kil ndibi damta m ba nseŋ foŋ edɛ na to n wɔtɔ! Daŋɛ eblaŋ na nɛnɛ nseŋ shin nɛ amo be epochu na a feeto nɛ awibi na a chɔɔ! 11Kumo be kaman nɛ fo ta danyaŋ be kadaŋɛ fuloŋ na m bɛ ajanwulɛ so hale nɛ k ya bel m pere, saŋɛ na so kumo be kananɛ k kreŋ so na beeŋ chɔɔ m mur nɛ k naŋ nyalɛ so. 12Ama edɛ wuloŋ wuloŋ na gba kra maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ kumo be kekreŋso na kikɛ e lar kumo so. 13Naniere fo, Jerusalɛm, be kusɔ jigaya be kebaawɔtɔ e shin nɛ fo wora eyurpi. Ŋkpal ŋ ka wora ania nɛ n fɔr fo so nɛ fo nyalɛ so nɛ fo kraa kini nsaa wɔ fo eyurpi to so, fo maaŋ naŋ nyalɛ so kikɛ n ya fo fanɛ ma agbo gboŋ ka beeŋ ba fo so. 14Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na fanɛ saŋɛ fo nɛ n wora kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ wora na. M maaŋ kplaŋ fo lubi so ŋko n wu fo kuwɔr ŋko n chɛrga ma nfɛra. Meeŋ gberge fo kusoe ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fo wora so.”
Ezikɛl be eche be luwu be asheŋ
15Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 16“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kachɛ koŋwule meeŋ sɔ esa nɛ fee sha ga na be ŋkpa. Ama fo alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ fubel m bile asheŋ ŋko n shu ŋko n shin nɛ anishichubi a lar fo anishito gba kuraa. 17Fo alɛ e sa maŋ shin nɛ esa e nu fo ka bee shuto gba. Sa maŋ kaŋ shɛŋi fo neemu fo kumu so ŋko n lara fo asɛbta nsaa na aya fuloŋ a ŋini fanɛ fee shu keeli nna. Fo alɛ e sa maŋ buu fo anishiakpa so ŋko n ji daŋkare be ajibi nɛ basa nɛ baa shu nli bee ji na.”
18Kachipurso be jemanɛ nɛ n yaŋ ya ka malga basa na kutɔ fanɛ kananɛ n chɛr a wora na. Kumo be kaaseso nɛ ma eche wu. Kumo be ŋklade nɛ n wora kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ma na. 19Basa na ka wu ma nɛ b bishi ma le: “Manɛ nna nɛ fo maa shu fo eche be keeli?”
20Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ ma fanɛ 21ŋ kaŋɛ menyi, Israɛl be basa kubɔya ere fanɛ menyee puchi bɔrɛlambu na be eleŋ so na nna. Menyi alɛ nseŋ naa sha kebaa wu kumo nsaa yɔ kumo to, ama Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee shin nɛ e jija kumo nna nɛ k maaŋ naaŋ daga keshuŋ Ebɔrɛ kumo to. Menyi be mbia nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm to naniere na malɛ beeŋ wu kena to. 22Saŋɛ na so nɛ menyi alɛ gba e wora kananɛ n wora ere. Menyi maaŋ ta asɔ m buu menyi be anishiakpaana so ŋko n ji daŋkare jibi nɛ basa nɛ baa shu nli bee ji na. 23Menyi alɛ maaŋ shɛŋi menyi be eneemu ashi menyi be amu so ŋko n lara asɛbta menyi be aya to nsaa nite aya fuloŋ. Ade kikɛ be kaman, menyi maaŋ wora kuwɔrsheŋ ŋko n shu nɛ anishichubi e lar, ama menyi be asheŋ lubi so menyeeŋ foe eyur to nsaa nite a kulti a shu epun to. 24Saŋɛ na so nɛ ma, Ezikɛl e baa la tɔɔnɛ n sa menyi. Nɛ menyi alɛ gba e wora asheŋ nɛ n wora na kikɛ. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ asheŋ ere kikɛ wora.”
25Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, meeŋ mur bɔrɛlambu nɛ basa na be ŋgbene bee fuli so nɛ baa puchi kumo so nsaa sha kumo to be kebaayɔ ga na. Ma alɛ beeŋ lara bumo be mbia ashi bumo to. 26Kachɛ nɛ loŋ beeŋ wora na kaŋ fo, esa nɛ e beeŋ nya n shile kadegboŋ na to e naŋ ba kaŋɛ fo kusɔ nɛ k wora. 27Loŋ be kachɛ na gbagba nɛ fo kɔnɔ beeŋ bugi nɛ fo nɛ esa nɛ e bar kubɔya na e malga abar kutɔ. Amoso feeŋ baa la tɔɔnɛ n sa basa na, nɛ b pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 25
Content:
Kewuŋkaŋɛ a laŋɛ Ammɔn be kaplɛa so be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kilgi a keni Ammɔn be efuli so be basa ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b maŋ wora n nyalɛ. 3Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b kaŋ asoe n nu kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ: E yɛ menyi be ŋgbene daŋ fuli menyi nna jemanɛ nɛ men daŋ wu ma bɔrɛlambu ka jija kuraa nɛ Israɛl be efuli mur nɛ b pɛ Juda be basa n yɔ efuli wɔfɔ so na nna. 4Meeŋ shin nɛ eyiriana nɛ b wɔ keshishɛrsawule nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na e ba kɔ m pɔɔ menyi so. Baaŋ ba yuu bumo be ewajɛbu n chena menyi be efuli so n ji kumo be asɔrso nseŋ nuu kumo be kenyipo nɛ a daga menyi na. 5Ade be kaman, meeŋ naŋ shin nɛ menyi be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Rabba na a ki enyɔma be ejikpa nɛ Ammɔn be efuli so kikɛ malɛ a ki kakpa nɛ baŋ baa bela mbolpɔ. Loŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
6Kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ men daŋ kpla enɔ nseŋ daŋ tɛto kagbenefuliso a ŋini kekishi nɛ men kɔ n sa Israɛl be basa nna. 7Amoso meeŋ ta menyi m bɔɔ efuli pɔtɛana be basa enɔ nɛ b suge menyi be asɔ nseŋ sesaŋ menyi to. Ma alɛ beeŋ mur menyi kuraa nɛ men maaŋ naa la efuli a kɔ menyi gbagba be kasawule a wɔtɔ. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
Mowab be kaplɛa so be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
8Kesheŋ ere be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mowab be efuli so be basa nɛ Edɔm be efuli so be basa daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Juda be efuli so gba baa du fanɛ efuli kama nna. 9Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ kena e ba ndegboŋ nɛ a bee kuŋ Mowab be efuli be egbaŋ na nɛ ndegboŋ lela fanɛ Bɛf Jeshimɔf nɛ Baal Mɛɔn nɛ Kiriyateem gba na so. 10Kumo be kaman nɛ n shin nɛ eyiriana nɛ b shi epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be keshishɛrsawule so na e ba kɔ m pɔɔ Mowab be efuli so be basa nɛ Ammɔn be efuli so be basa kikɛ so. Kananɛ ŋ gberge Ammɔn be basa kusoe ashi efuliana na so nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo be asheŋ na 11aloŋ nɛ meeŋ gberge Mowab be basa gba kusoe, nɛ b pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
Edɔm be Kaplɛa so be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
12Ade be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Edɔm be efuli so be basa wora n jija ŋkpal b ka daŋ wora n tal Juda be basa to so. 13Amoso meeŋ gberge Edɔm be basa kusoe nseŋ mɔ bumo be basa nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ kena to nɛ kasawule nɛ k yili kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Tɛman n dese n ya fo kumo nɛ baa tre Dedan na e dese jiga. 14Kumo be kaman nɛ n shin nɛ ma basa Israɛlebi na e wora n tal Edɔm be basa to, nɛ b pin kananɛ kanya agbo gboŋ du. Ŋ kaŋ gberge Edɔm be basa kusoe na, nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
Filistiebi be Kaplɛa so be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
15Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Filisti be efuli so be basa nyaŋnyaŋso na daŋ wora n tal bumo be dra dra be bedoŋana to nna a fin kemur bumo yurkishi so. 16Amoso meeŋ gberge Filisti be basa na kusoe m mɔ bumo. Ma alɛ beeŋ mur bumo be bekama nɛ b ka a wɔ teku ase be nde to na. 17Meeŋ gberge bumo kusoe kenishipereso nseŋ wora n tal bumo to nɛ b pin kananɛ ma agbo gboŋ du nɛ b pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 26
Content:
Tayɛ be kaplɛa so be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
1B ka pɛ ewura Jehowachin nɛ anyi be galeŋga kenya n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ kudukakosopo na to be kufɔl na be kachɛ juŋkparso na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Tayɛ na be basa daŋ ji eyur nna nseŋ boŋ kashɛ ere ŋkpal Jerusalɛm ka daŋ kɔ n tɔr so:
‘Jerusalɛm bure n tɔr!
Nɛ kumo be yawu be keji be eleŋ loge!
Amoso k maaŋ naa kɔ anyi kukɔrkɔ
ŋkpal yawu be keji so!’
3Kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ menyi Tayɛ be basa ki n doŋana nna na, nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ efuli damtaana e kre kena m ba kɔ menyi fanɛ kananɛ teku so bee ku atili a ba kaa gbuŋ teku be kɔnɔ na. 4Baaŋ bure egbalana nɛ men pɔr ŋ kulti menyi be kadegboŋ na nɛ menyi be ebu jeŋgreŋana nɛ menyee yili so a wu kufɔ na. Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ gbare kumo be shishɛr na n lɛ nseŋ ka kefalta fuloŋ n nase. 5Ekɔrɔtɔ pɛpo beeŋ ta ndoŋ a fata bumo be ashewu ashi teku ase. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e nase kɔnɔ na fanɛ efuliana na beeŋ ba kɔ n suge Tayɛ be basa be asɔ, 6nseŋ mɔ basa kama nɛ chena nde nɛ a wɔ teku ase na kikɛ. Ndoŋ nɛ Tayɛ be basa beeŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
7Kumo be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ: “Meeŋ shin nɛ Babilɔn be ewura Nebukadneeza, nɛ e la bewura to be ewura na, e shi kelargato be esoso be kaba so m ba kɔ Tayɛ be basa. E beeŋ keta benapo damta nɛ b kɔ egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko nɛ egbaŋɛ diipoana nna m ba. 8E beeŋ juŋkpar ŋ kɔ basa nɛ b chena teku ase na m mɔ bumo. Kumo be kaman nɛ e gbare eshishɛr n deŋi abar so nɛ a fo menyi be ndeana na be egbalana be esoso nɛ mbe benapo e keta bumo be abɛlso be asɔ kuŋamuso m bɛ abar so ŋ kulti menyi n wɔtɔ fanɛ egbal lempo na. 9Ade be kaman nɛ mbe benapo na e ta ndibi gbɛgbɛso n da egbalana na n lɛ nseŋ ta akɔsɔ m bure m bure menyi be ebu jeŋgreŋana nɛ menyee yili so a keni a wu kufɔ na. 10Mbe egbaŋɛ be keshi ga so amo be kalabɛr beeŋ buu menyi so fanɛ kunyɔlɔ na. Benapo na kaa luri menyi be ndeana to, bumo be egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturko wurbi nɛ agboŋi kikɛ be egbri beeŋ shin nɛ menyi be ebuana be egbalana a gbuŋgbuŋ fɔŋfɔŋ saŋɛ nɛ b wɔ men be nde nɛ b bure na to na. 11Mbe benapo beeŋ dii bumo be egbaŋɛ n sɔ menyi be agbembi kikɛ so n ta etokobi a mɔ menyi be basa bena nɛ jiso, nɛ menyi be eshabɔrɛ lempo kikɛ a bure n tɔr kasawule. 12Ade kikɛ be kaman, baaŋ suge menyi be kedama nɛ menyi be asɔ faso. Bumo alɛ beeŋ bure menyi be egbalana nɛ menyi be nwu lela kikɛ nseŋ gbare ajembu na nɛ ndibi na nɛ eshishɛr na n ya lɛ teku to. 13Nɛ n shin nɛ nshɛ nɛ menyee boŋ a cha awɔr na e ku nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ nu menyi be ejaŋjilaŋ be kushu kikɛ. 14Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ menyi be kasawule na a dese fanɛ kefalta fuloŋ nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ pɛpo e baa fata bumo be ashewu kumo so. Menyi maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n lɔŋɛ m pɔr menyi be kadegboŋ na kikɛ. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
15Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ Tayɛ be basa e la fanɛ basa nɛ b chena teku ase na kaŋ nu menyi be basa nɛ baa mɔ na be kushu kufu beeŋ pɛ bumo nɛ b baa chicha. 16Saŋɛ na so nɛ bekama nɛ baa ji kuwura efuliana nɛ a chena m mata teku ase na e gbelge bumo be nwurputi so. Kumo be kaman nɛ b gbaŋ bumo be bewura be epiŋiana nɛ bumo be asɔbuuso nɛ b jɔɔ amo na kikɛ nseŋ chena kasawule a chicha. Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ tu menyi na so, kufu beeŋ pɛ bumo ga hale nɛ b maŋ tiŋ n yige kebaachicha. 17Saŋɛ na so nɛ b boŋ keeli be kashɛ ere n laŋɛ menyi kaplɛa so.
Kadegboŋ nɛ k nya ketre ga na mur!
Kumo be nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ kikɛ mur teku so.
Kumo to be basa e daa ji eteku so kuwura
nseŋ daa ta kufu a wɔtɔ basa nɛ b chena teku ase na. 18Kachɛ nɛ k tɔr na ka fo,
basa nɛ b chena teku ase na bee chicha nna.
Nɛ kumo be kemur na chinchiŋ bumo ga.
19Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ shin nɛ menyi be ndegboŋ e bure a dese nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ naa wɔ amo to. Meeŋ shin nɛ teku be nchugboŋ e buu menyi so. 20Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ n shin nɛ men wu n yɔ bubuni to n ya tu bumo nɛ b juŋkpar n yɔ ndoŋ na nɛ nde nɛ a daŋ mur dra dra na kikɛ na. Menyeeŋ ya kaa wɔ bubuni to nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ sɔ menyi so n chena menyi be ndegboŋana to. 21Meeŋ shin nɛ men be kebaa maaŋ naa wɔtɔ na e baa la tɔɔnɛ nɛ k bee ta kufu a pɛ basa. Basa beeŋ fin menyi, ama b maŋ naŋ wu menyi.” Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.

Title: EZIKƐL 27
Content:
Keli be kashɛ a laŋɛ Tayɛ be kaplɛa so be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, boŋ keeli be kashɛ ere a laŋɛ Tayɛ nɛ k la 3kadegboŋ nɛ k chena m mata teku ase nsaa tu basa nɛ b chena teku ase nɛ mboŋ damta a ji yawu na be kaplɛa so. Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ a laŋɛ Tayɛ be kaplɛa so e la fanɛ
Tayɛ, fee puchi ŋkpal kananɛ fo walɛ kebita ga so nna.
4Teku kulti fo echenakpa nna n wɔtɔ.
B pɔr fo, fanɛ nchu so be kuloŋ lela nna;
5Ndibi nɛ baa tre fir nɛ a shi kebee nɛ baa tre Hɛɛmɔn so na nɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ fo;
Nseŋ ta ndibi nɛ baa tre sida
nɛ a shi Lebanɔn be efuli so na
n wora ndibi tenteŋ nɛ baa chɛ ewajɛ a kre amo
nɛ a bee pɛ afu a keta kuloŋ a nite na n sa fo.
6Kedibi gboŋgboŋi nɛ b ku ashi Bashan be efuli so n shɛl ebaŋɛ;
Ndibi kpakpaso fanɛ chɛchɛdibi
nɛ b ku ashi Saiprus be efuli so n wora fo kaseto
Nseŋ baŋɛ ejebotenyi n fɛga n fɛga amo to nɛ a baa walɛ.
7Wajɛchɛbi lela nɛ b lue
nɛ k shi Ijipt be efuli so
nɛ b ta n chɛ nɛ afu bee ber kumo a keta fo a nite.
Esa wɔ kufɔ nseŋ wu kumo gba e beeŋ pin fanɛ k la feya nna.
Kechɛbi gbɛgbɛso nɛ k walɛ ga
nɛ b ta n chɛ m buu fo so a kuŋ epeŋi,
Kechɛbi buru nɛ kepeper kunɔkunɔ
nɛ k shi Saiprus be keplasawule so e la kumo.
8Basa nɛ baa far fo na shi Sidɔn nɛ Aavad be ndegboŋ to nna.
Fo basa nɛ b nyi nchu to e la bumo be benimu.
9Basa nɛ b lɔŋɛ nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ na
la basa nɛ b koya kushuŋ na nɛnɛ nna
nseŋ shi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Biblɔs na.
Basa nɛ baa shuŋ nchu so kikɛ
bee ba kaa tu fo ashi Tayɛ nna a ji yawu.
10Pɛshiya nɛ Lidiya nɛ Libiya be efuliana so be benapo gba ti fo benapo so.
Kakpa nɛ fo benapo daŋ chena na
nɛ b daa ta bumo be abɛlso be asɔ kuŋamuso
nɛ abɛlso be akpaŋwuro a shiga.
Benapo na e daa kɔ a sa fo nɛ fo bɔla bumo so n nya ketre.
11Benapo nɛ b shi Aavad e daa kuŋ fo egbalana
nɛ bumo nɛ b shi Gamad malɛ daa kuŋ fo ebu jeŋgreŋana na
nsaa ta bumo be abɛlso be asɔ kuŋamuso a shiga egbalana so
nɛ k shin nɛ fo nyalɛ kebita.
12Fo nɛ Speen be efuli so be basa daŋ ji yawu nna nɛ b ta gbiti nɛ abɛlso nɛ anyembi nɛ epal kikɛ ŋ ka fo asɔ damtaana be kukɔ.
13Fo daŋ naŋ tu Griis nɛ Tubal nɛ Mɛshɛk be efuliana so ebi n ji yawu
nɛ bumo alɛ ta anya nɛ danyaŋ be asɔ ko ŋ ka fo kukɔ.
14Fo alɛ daŋ fa fo asɔ n sa Bɛf Togaama be efuli so ebi n sɔ egbaŋɛshuŋso nɛ egbaŋɛ nɛ baa ta a yɔ kena to nɛ ekurma.
15Roodis be efuli so be basa gba daŋ tu fo n ji yawu nɛ basa nɛ b chena teku be ekarso be efuli damtaana ta ejebotenyi nɛ ndibi lembir lela ga n chɛr fo asɔ. 16Siriya be basa daŋ tɔ fo asɔ faso damta nseŋ ta yawu kpakpaso be kejembu nɛ k la kefitiribumbuŋ nɛ baa tre ‘ɛmeraldi’ na nɛ ewajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ewajɛ nɛ jɔɔ nɛ ewajɛchɛbi lela nɛ nchu to be kefalta jembu nɛ baa tre ‘koral’ na nɛ yawu kpakpaso be ajembu peper nɛ baa tre ‘rubi’ na ŋ ka amo be kukɔ. 17Juda nɛ Israɛl be basa gba daŋ ta ayu nɛ mushoŋ nɛ ɔlif be ŋku nɛ eposɔ ŋ ka fo asɔ faso be kukɔ. 18Damaskɔs be basa daŋ wu asɔ damta be yiri yiri nɛ fee fa na, nɛ b shi Hɛlbɔn m bar yabra belbelso nseŋ naŋ shi Zaha m bar mbolpɔ be afuibi m ba tɔ amo. 19Nɛ Griik be basa nɛ b shi Uzal be efuli so na malɛ gba ta asɔ nɛ b ta abɛlso n wora nɛ eposɔ m ba tɔ fo asɔ faso. 20Dedan be basa gba daŋ ta ata nɛ baa ta a wora egaare na n tɔ fo asɔ. 21Nɛ Areebia be efuli so be basa nɛ Kɛda be efuli so be bewura gba ta mbolpɔfɔlbi nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ mboe m ba tɔ fo asɔ faso. 22Nɛ Shiba nɛ Raama be eyawujipo gba ta yawu kpakpaso be ajembu nɛ baa ta a wora abitasɔ nɛ shuwa nɛ asɔ dufɛso lela ga m ba tu fo n ji yawu. 23Ndegboŋ fanɛ Haran nɛ Kanne nɛ Iden nɛ Asshɔ nɛ Chilmad nɛ Shiba be efuli so be eyawujipo kikɛ daŋ ba tu fo n ji yawu. 24Yawu kpakpaso be ewajɛ nɛ ewajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ewajɛ nɛ b ta jese lela ŋ jɔɔ amo be ekarso nɛ achɛbi nɛ b nyɔɔ amo kenyɔɔ be yiri yiri nɛ ejese nɛ a kɔ eleŋ nɛ b daa bar m ba ka fa fo kebɛ to. 25Nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ gboŋi e daa sulɔ fo asɔ faso a bɛ abar so a yɔ mboŋ nɛ b daa sha a ka yɔ.
Fo daa du fanɛ nchu so be ekuloŋ nɛ k deŋ teku so,
nɛ asɔ gbɛgbɛso bɔlɔ kumo to nna.
26Jemanɛ nɛ fo befarpo far fo n lar teku so na,
nɛ afugboŋ shi epeŋilarkpa m ba mur fo.
27Ndoŋ nna nɛ fo asɔ faso lela na kikɛ,
nɛ basa nɛ baa shuŋ ekuloŋ na to na,
ekapɛnta nɛ eyawujipoana na kikɛ,
nɛ benapo nɛ b wɔ ekuloŋ na to na
kikɛ nyam mur teku na so.
Jemanɛ nɛ fo nchu so be ekuloŋ na mur na;
28nɛ basa nɛ baa ji nchu na boŋ to
nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kedeŋi so nu kumo.
29Naniere bekama beeŋ shile ŋ ka ekuloŋ nawule,
Nɛ efarpo kama e dii kedeŋi so.
30Bumo kikɛ beeŋ shu kagbenejijaso ŋkpal fo so,
Baaŋ wora eshishɛr n wurge bumo be amu so
nseŋ dese nsunɔ to a melti.
31Bumo alɛ beeŋ she bumo be amu ŋkpal fo so,
nseŋ buu kagbenejijaso be asɔbuuso
a ŋini bumo be kagbenejija.
Baaŋ ta kagbenejija damta n shu ga ŋkpal fo so
32Baaŋ boŋ awɔba n shu ŋ kaŋɛ le:
‘Wanɛ nɛ anyeeŋ ta ŋ keshɛr Tayɛ so,
Tayɛ nɛ e dese teku to shruum le ere?
33Jemanɛ kama nɛ fo yɛr fo asɔ faso efuli pɔtɛ so,
Efuli kama so ebi bee nya bumo be kepar nna.
Bewura bɔla fo asɔ lela so
N dii kedama.
34Ama naniere fo e mur a dese teku to na;
Fo ji nchu n ya dese nchugboŋ be kechimbi to.
Fo asɔ faso nɛ bekama nɛ baa shuŋ a sa fo na kikɛ;
e tu fo n ji nchu teku to n chul na.’
35Kusɔ nɛ k wora fo na be asheŋ mɔ ekama nɛ e chena teku ase na kɔnɔ.
Hale kufu pɛ bumo be bewura gba nɛ baa chicha
36Durnya to be eyawujipo maŋ tiŋ nɛ b yirda kusɔ nɛ k wora fo ere. Fo luwu na bee keta kufu gboŋgboŋi nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo baŋ choŋ nna na nɛ esa maaŋ naŋ wu fo kikɛ.”

Title: EZIKƐL 28
Content:
Tayɛ be ewura be kaplɛa so be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kaŋɛ Tayɛ be ewura kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ mo. Kamoowu shin nɛ fee fɛ fanɛ fo la kegbir nna nsaa kaŋɛ fanɛ fo ka la kegbir so nɛ fo chena kuwurputi so nɛ eteku kulti fo n wɔtɔ. Feeŋ tiŋ n ta fo kumu fanɛ kegbir e la fo, ama dimɛdi e la fo, mannɛ kegbir. 3Fo alɛ naa fɛ fanɛ fo nyi asheŋ nna a chɔ Danɛl nɛ Babilɔn be ewura daŋ ta n wɔtɔ ebuluŋ to na, ŋko ashiri kikɛ maŋ ŋana fo so. 4Fo yɛ fo kanyiasheŋ nɛ kashennyi e shin nɛ fo dii kedama nseŋ nya shuwa nɛ gbiti m bɔlɔ ebu na. 5Fo yɛ fo yawu be keji be kenyigboŋ na so nɛ fo ji yawu n nya tɔnɔ na. Fo kedama na shin nɛ kamoowu luri m bɔlɔ fo to nɛ fee puchi.
6“To, naniere kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nde. Ŋkpal fo ka bee fɛ fanɛ fo nyi asheŋ fanɛ kegbir so, 7meeŋ shin nɛ bedoŋ nɛ b maŋ kɔ kushuso e ba kɔ fo. Baaŋ mur asɔ lela nɛ fo bɔla kanyiasheŋ nɛ kashennyi so n nya na kikɛ kuraa. 8Bumo alɛ beeŋ mɔ fo nseŋ ta fo n lɛ teku to nɛ k ki fo nchaŋ. 9Jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ ba mɔ fo na, fo kraa beeŋ baa fɛ fanɛ kegbir e la fo a? Jemanɛ nɛ feeŋ yili fo bemɔpo be anishito na, dimɛdi e naaŋ baa la fo mannɛ kegbir. 10Befɔ beeŋ mɔ fo, nɛ fo wu fanɛ bumo nɛ b maa shuŋ ma na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
Kananɛ Tayɛ be ewura loge to be asheŋ
11Kumo be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 12“Dimɛdi pibi, boŋ awɔba n sa Tayɛ be ewura, nseŋ kaŋɛ mo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ,
jemanɛ ko fo kusɔ kama daa bɛ abar so dede nna nsaa la tɔɔnɛ.
Fo alɛ daa nyi asheŋ ga nseŋ daa walɛ keyɛrbi nna.
13K daa du fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kudɔbi
nɛ baa tre Iden na to nɛ fo daa wɔ.
Yawu kpakpaso be asɔ lela nyɛkpɛso be yiri yiri
fanɛ shuwa be abitasɔ nɛ fo daa ta a mɛa to.
Kachɛ nɛ b kurge fo na nɛ b bela amo kikɛ ase n sa fo.
14Ndoŋ nna nɛ n shin nɛ malaika bee kuŋ fo kowu
jemanɛ nɛ fo daa na ajembu nyɛkpɛso to
ashi ma kebee cheembi na so na.
15Yili kachɛ nɛ b kurge fo kikɛ,
fo kasheŋwora daa walɛ nna ga
n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ fo fara a asheŋ lubi be kewora.
16Fo daŋ pere kenishi nna n wɔtɔ yawu be keji to
nɛ k shin nɛ fo luri keŋkenshi nɛ alubi be kebaawɔtɔ to.
Amoso nɛ n tintiŋ fo nɛ fo lar ma kebee cheembi na so
nɛ malaika nɛ e daa kuŋ fo na
ju fo ashi ajembu nyɛkpɛso na so na.
17Fo ka daa walɛ keyɛrbi so, fo daa wu fo kumu nna.
Fo ketre ka dii so fo daa wora asheŋ nna fanɛ ewulpo.
Amoso nɛ n lara fo n lɛ kasawule so
nɛ bewura pɔtɛ e wu kusɔ nɛ n wora fo na
nɛ k baa la kusoe kpele n sa bumo.
18Fo alɛ daŋ wora alubi nna ga ashi fo yawu be keji to
hale nɛ fo kabɔrɛshuŋakpa ki asheŋ lubi be mboŋ.
Amoso nɛ n shin nɛ edɛ chɔɔ fo kadegboŋ na m mur na.
Naniere nsunɔ nawule nɛ ekama bee wu
kakpa nɛ fo kadegboŋ na daa wɔ na.
19Fo ere choŋ nna na,
nɛ kusɔ nɛ k wora fo ere
shin nɛ kufugboŋ tɔr efuliana
nɛ b nyi fo na so.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, baa fɛ nna fanɛ
kusɔ nɛ k nya fo na beeŋ tiŋ n nya bumo alɛ gba.”
Sidɔn be kaplɛa so be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
20Kumo be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 21“Dimɛdi pibi, kaŋɛ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Sidɔn na fanɛ k maŋ wora n nyalɛ. 22Kaŋɛ basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ a laŋɛ bumo be kaplɛa so e la fanɛ, Sidɔn be basa, ŋ ki menyi doŋ nna na. Basa malɛ beeŋ maŋkura ma ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ meeŋ wora menyi so. Ŋ kaŋ gberge menyi kusoe ŋ ŋini ma kecheembiya na nɛ basa beeŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 23Meeŋ shin nɛ alɔ mɔso e ba menyi so nseŋ shin nɛ bedoŋ e ba kɔ menyi kaba kama so m mɔ menyi be basa. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
Israɛl ka beeŋ nya nɛfa be asheŋ
24Kumo be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Efuliana nɛ a kulti Israɛl be basa n wɔtɔ a keni bumo jiga nsaa tege bumo na be kekama maaŋ naa la fanɛ ewi ŋko gɔŋnyaŋɛ a tɔrɔ Israɛl be basa. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma, e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.”
25Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ bɛta Israɛl be basa na n shi efuliana nɛ n daŋ pesaŋ bumo to n yɔ na m ba nɛ efuliana na kikɛ e pin fanɛ n du cheembi nna. Israɛl be basa na beeŋ naŋ ba chena bumo gbagba be kasawule so, kumo nɛ n ta n sa ma kayɛrbi Jeekɔb dra dra na. 26Baaŋ chena ndoŋ kayurwushi so m pɔr nwu nseŋ naŋ nase ndibisɔrso be adɔ. Ma alɛ beeŋ gberge bumo be bechenashapoana nɛ b keni bumo jiga na kusoe nɛ Israɛl be basa na e nya bumo be amu a wɔtɔ. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe bumo be Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 29
Content:
Ijipt be kaplɛa so be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
1B ka pɛ anyi be beko nɛ ewura Jehowachin n yɔ kenyaya to ashi Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ kudusopo na to be kufɔl kudusopo na be kachɛ kudu anyɔsopo na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le. 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, malga ŋ gbiti Ijipt be ewura, Fɛɛro, ŋ kaŋɛ mo kananɛ mo nɛ Ijipt be kasawule so be basa kikɛ beeŋ nya kasogberge be asheŋ. 3Kaŋɛ Ijipt be ewura fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ, fo ki n doŋ nna ŋkpal fo ka ta fo kumu fanɛ laŋchaŋ nɛ e kɔ eleŋ a wɔ lɔr to na so. Fo alɛ naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ feeto lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Nail na a ki feya. 4Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ dariwa e kɔl fo ŋgbuŋ to nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ nɛ a wɔ lɔr na to e mata fo so nɛ ŋ gberge fo n lar Nail be lɔr na to. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ n ta fo nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ nɛ a mata fo so na kikɛ n lɛ keshishɛrsawule so nɛ fo ya dese ndoŋ a maaŋ nya kepuli. Meeŋ shin nɛ mbuibi nɛ asɔbɔya e ji fo. 6Saŋɛ na so nɛ Ijipt be efuli so be basa kikɛ e pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Israɛlebi na daŋ ta bumo be amu n to menyi Ijiptebi so nna fanɛ men chɛ bumo to, ama men daa du fanɛ kedibi wuso nɛ k maŋ kɔ eleŋ nna n sa bumo. 7B ka yirgi menyi so nɛ men bu n da bumo be aba to m bɔl n shin nɛ bumo be ketetowibi shege ŋko ŋ kpekpel. 8Amoso, ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa kaŋɛ menyi naniere na fanɛ meeŋ shin nɛ benapo e ba kɔ menyi kena nseŋ mɔ menyi be basa nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ. 9Nɛ Ijipt be efuli na a ki kasawule jiga nɛ shɛŋ maŋ naa wɔ kumo so a dese. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
Ŋkpal fo ka kaŋɛ fanɛ feeto Nail be lɔr na a ki feya so, 10fo nɛ Nail kikɛ ki n doŋ nna na. Amoso meeŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be efuli na a ki kasawule jiga nɛ shɛŋ maaŋ naa wɔ kumo so, yili kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Migdɔl nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso na n ya fo kumo nɛ baa tre Aswan ashi kelargato be kaseto na, hale ŋ keta m ba choŋ menyi nɛ Kush be efuli so be egbaŋ to. 11Dimɛdi ŋko kusɔbɔya kikɛ maaŋ naŋ bɔla kasawule na so n choŋ kikɛ. Nfɛ adena nɛ shɛŋ maŋ naa wɔ kumo so. 12Meeŋ shin nɛ Ijipt e ki efuli nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ naa wɔ kumo so ashi durnya ere kikɛ to. Nfɛ adena nɛ Ijipt be efuli so be ndegboŋ dese alambure. A beeŋ dese n chɛr a chɔ nde nɛ a bure a dese kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ n shin nɛ Ijiptebi na e pesaŋ to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so; ŋkpal manɛ so baaŋ shile n yɔ efuli kama so n ya kaa wɔ ndoŋ be basa to.”
13Ade be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Nfɛ adena be kaman, meeŋ naŋ shin nɛ Ijiptebi na e naŋ bɛta n shi efuliana nɛ m pesaŋ bumo to n yɔ na so m ba 14chena Ijipt be kasawule so be kelargato be kaseto, nɛ k la bumo be echenakpa gbagba na. Ama bumo alɛ beeŋ baa la basa pɔso ndoŋ nna. 15Kumo e la fanɛ baaŋ baa la basa nɛ b maaŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n ji efuliana ko so kuwura. Meeŋ shin nɛ b ki efuli jiga nɛ k maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n tintiŋ efuli ko nɛ efuli na e wora kumo be aparsheŋ. 16Israɛl be basa malɛ maaŋ naŋ ta bumo be amu n to Ijiptebi so a fin kechɛto. Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ tu Ijipt be basa na beeŋ shin nɛ Israɛlebi na e nyiŋi fanɛ kedaa maŋ daga fanɛ b ta bumo be amu n to Ijipt so nseŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.”
Ewurgboŋ Nebukadneeza ka beeŋ pɔɔ Ijipt so be asheŋ
17B ka pɛ ewura Jehowachin nɛ anyi be beko n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so kenyaya to na be kafɛ adunyɔ nɛ ashunusopo na to be kufɔl sososo na be kachɛ sososo na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 18“Dimɛdi pibi, Babilɔn be ewurgboŋ Nebukadneeza daŋ kre n ya kɔ Tayɛ be basa kena. Mo alɛ daŋ sulɔ mbe benapo esulɔ gbɛgbɛso nna hale nɛ bumo be amu kpra nɛ bumo be abatimu pɛge, ama ewura na nɛ mbe benapo kikɛ maŋ nya bumo be kegben be tɔnɔ ashi kena na to. 19Amoso kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ nde e la fanɛ: Meeŋ ta Ijipt be kasawule n sa ewurgboŋ Nebukadneeza nɛ e kɔ n suge bumo be asɔ nseŋ sulɔ Ijipt be efuli so be mpetɛsɔ lela n yɔ nɛ a ki mbe benapo be kakɔka. 20Ŋkpal manɛ so, ewura na nɛ mbe benapo kikɛ daa shuŋ nna a sa ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na.
21Nɛ kumo be loŋ kaŋ wora, meeŋ shin nɛ Israɛl be basa e nya eleŋ, nɛ fo, Ezikɛl, e yili kakpa nɛ ekama beeŋ nu fo ebɔl nseŋ malga, saŋɛ na so baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 30
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ gberge Ijipt kusoe be asheŋ
1Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee malga ere. A daga fanɛ fo kaŋɛ amo awɔrso fanɛ
Kachɛ lubi lubi bee ba!
3Kachɛ na taga to, kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ gberge fo kusoe na fo nna na,
K la kemur nɛ etɔrɔ be kachɛ nna n sa efuliana na.
4Kena beeŋ ku Ijipt be efuli so;
Nɛ kagbenejija damta e tɔr Itiopia be basa so.
Basa damta beeŋ wu ashi Ijipt to;
Nɛ b suge efuli na so be asɔ kikɛ
Nseŋ ka kumo kelambure n nase.
5Benapo nɛ b ya haya ashi Itiopia nɛ Libiya nɛ Lidiya n Areebia nɛ Kub be efuliana so na nɛ ma basa gbagba to be basa damta beeŋ wu kena na to.”
6Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Bekama nɛ baa kɔ a sa Ijipt na beeŋ yili kade nɛ baa tre Migdɔl nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso na m ba choŋ kumo nɛ baa tre Aswan nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto na n wu kena to nɛ benapo nɛ baa puchi so na kikɛ e mur. Ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ. 7Ijipt be efuli na beeŋ ki kakpa fuloŋ nɛ ekama kini ashi durnya kikɛ to nɛ kumo be ndegboŋ a ki nde bureso a dese. 8Ŋ kaŋ shin nɛ edɛ ji Ijipt be efuli nɛ kumo be basa nɛ baa kɔ a kuŋ kumo na nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
9Kachɛ nɛ Ijipt beeŋ mur na, meeŋ shuŋi mbɔ nɛ b ta nchu so be ekuloŋgboŋ m ba bɔ Itiopia be basa nɛ b maa fɛ shɛŋ be asheŋ na kubɔya a laŋɛ kemur nɛ k bee ba bumo alɛ gba so be kaplɛa so nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo. Loŋ be kachɛ na malɛ bee ba!”
10Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ bɔla Babilɔn be ewurgboŋ, Nebukadneeza so m mur Ijipt be efuli so be benapo damta kikɛ. 11Ewurgboŋ Nebukadneeza nɛ mbe benapo nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr beeŋ ba kɔ Ijipt be basa kena m mɔ basa m biti abar so kasawule na so be kaplɛkama. 12Kumo be kaman nɛ n shin nɛ lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Nail na e wɔlto nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ basa lubi e ba ji Ijipt be efuli so eleŋ. Befɔ beeŋ ba jija kasawule na nɛ k maaŋ naa kɔ tɔnɔ. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ.”
13Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ mur agbirana nɛ mpɔrduliana nɛ Ijiptebi bee shuŋ ashi kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Mɛmfis na. Esa kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ e ji Ijipt be efuli so kuwura, nɛ kufu a pɛ basa kikɛ efuli na so. 14Meeŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be efuli na be kelargato be kaseto na be kasawule e dese fuloŋ. Meeŋ nya edɛ n wɔtɔ kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Zowan nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso na n chɔɔ kumo m mur. Ma alɛ beeŋ gberge basa nɛ b wɔ Ijipt be efuli so be kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Tɛɛbis na kusoe. 15Kumo be kaman nɛ n shin nɛ Ijipt be kade nɛ b pɔr egbal ŋ kuŋ kumo nɛ baa tre kumo Pɛlusium na to be basa e pin kananɛ ma agbo du. Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ mur Tɛɛbis be benapo damta. 16Meeŋ shin nɛ edɛ e ji Ijipt nɛ kagbenejija e tɔr basa nɛ b wɔ Pɛlusium na so. Egbal nɛ b pɔr ŋ kulti Tɛɛbis n wɔtɔ na beeŋ bure n tɔr nɛ nchu e ji kadegboŋ na; nɛ kufu a tɔr basa nɛ b wɔ Mɛmfis na so. 17Mbrantiɛfɔlbi nɛ b wɔ ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hiliopolis nɛ Bubastis na kikɛ beeŋ wu kena to nɛ b pɛ basa nɛ b ka na ŋ ki anya. 18Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ jija Ijipt be eleŋ nɛ baa puchi so nseŋ shin nɛ k ba ekar na, tentembiri beeŋ tɔr kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Taapanes na so. Kuwɔlpa beeŋ buu Ijipt be efuli na so nɛ b pɛ kumo be ndegboŋ to be basa ŋ ki anya. 19Ŋ kaŋ gberge Ijiptebi le be kusoe ere n loge nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
Ijipt be ewura be eleŋ ka yɔɔ be asheŋ
20B ka pɛ ewura Jehowachin nɛ anyi be beko n yɔ kenyaya to ashi Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ kudukakosopo na to be sososo be kufɔl na to be kachɛ shunusopo na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 21“Dimɛdi pibi, m pɔɔ Ijipt be ewura so nna nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ tiŋ m ba chɛ mo to. 22Amoso, kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde e la fanɛ: Ijipt be ewura la n doŋ nna nɛ mee sha kemur mo kuraa, saŋɛ na so, e maaŋ naŋ nya eleŋ ŋ koso n wora shɛŋ. 23Kumo be kaman, meeŋ shin nɛ Ijiptebi na e pesaŋ to n yɔ durnya kikɛ to. 24Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ n wɔtɔ Babilɔn be ewura eleŋ to nseŋ ta tokobi m bɔɔ mo enɔ. Meeŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be ewura e kɔ n tɔr n wu mo doŋ be anishito. 25Kashenteŋto, meeŋ shin nɛ Ijipt be ewura, Fɛɛro, e ki esa pɔso nseŋ shin nɛ Babilɔn be ewura e nya eleŋ. Saŋɛ na so nɛ ŋ kaŋ ta ma tokobi m bɔɔ mo enɔ nɛ e ta kumo n shoŋi Ijipt, ekama beeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 26Meeŋ shin nɛ Ijiptebi na e pesaŋ to n yɔ durnya kikɛ to. Saŋɛ na so nɛ b pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 31
Content:
B ka ta Ijipt m ber kedibi nɛ baa tre Sida na be asheŋ
1B ka daŋ pɛ ewura Jehowachin nɛ anyi be galeŋga anya n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ kudukakosopo to be kufɔl sasopo na to be kachɛ sososo na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, kaŋɛ Ijipt be ewura, Fɛɛro nɛ mbe basa fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ;
Fo kɔ eleŋ ga a chɔ ekama durnya to!
Wanɛ nɛ meeŋ ta ŋ keshɛr fo?
3Fo du fanɛ Lebanɔn be efuli so be kedibi nɛ baa tre sida;
Nɛ k kɔ ayabi lela nɛ kiyoyul ga,
nsaa wɔ nteŋ a sha kechute awɔlpa na nna.
4Nchu e sa kumo kayul.
Achubu nɛ a wɔ nchiŋ e shin nɛ k daŋ nteŋ;
Nɛ eboŋana daa shile a kulti kumo be kaseto
n shin nɛ kakpa nɛ k yil na bee wushi
a sa kupuŋ to be ndibi kikɛ.
5Ŋkpal k ka daa nya kayul nɛnɛ so,
nɛ k daŋ nteŋ a chɔ ndibi nɛ a ka na.
Kumo be ayabi daŋ nɛnɛ nsaa wɔ nteŋ nna.
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbuibi be yiri kikɛ tɔl asha kumo be ayabi so;
Nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya bee kurge amo be bibi kumo be kifito;
Nɛ efuliana nɛ a wɔ durnya to
be basa bee chena kumo be kiyoyul to a wushi.
7Kedibi na daa walɛ ga.
Kumo be ayabi daa wɔ nteŋ ga.
Kumo be nliŋi daa fo kasawule to be nchu nna.
8Ebɔrɛ be kudɔbi na to be ndibi nɛ baa tre sida na be kekama maŋ walɛ n fo kumo so.
Ndibi kpakpaso nɛ baa tre fir na
be kekama be ayabi maŋ fo kumo be ayabi so.
Kedibi kikɛ be ayabi be nteŋ maŋ fo kumo peya so.
Ebɔrɛ be kudɔbi na to malɛ be kedibi kikɛ
be kela maŋ fo kumo peya so.
9Mee to kumo nɛ k walɛ nsaa kɔ ayabi damta.
Kedibi kama nɛ k wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kudɔbi
nɛ baa tre Iden na to na
daa sha kebaadu fanɛ kumo nna,
ŋkpal loŋ so nsaa besa kumo eyur.
10Amoso, naniere, kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ k beeŋ wora kedibi nɛ k daŋ nteŋ hale n ya fo awɔlpa to na nde. K kaa daŋ nteŋ ga so nɛ k fara a wu kumo be kumu; 11ŋkpal loŋ so, ŋ kini kumo nna nsaa beeŋ shin nɛ efuli pɔtɛ ko be ewura e sɔ kumo nseŋ gberge kumo kusoe ŋkpal kumo be kumu kpakpaso so. 12Befɔ nɛ b maa wu kuwɔr beeŋ ku kumo nseŋ yige kumo n nase kakpa nɛ k beeŋ tɔr na. Kumo gbagba nɛ kumo be ayabi beeŋ tɔr kebee kama nɛ ketaŋɛ kama nɛ a wɔ efuli na so so. Saŋɛ na so efuliana nɛ a daa chena kumo be kiyoyul to na beeŋ yɔ mboŋ ko. 13Kumo be kaman nɛ mbuibi e ba kaa jɔŋɛ kedibi nɛ k tɔr a dese na so nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya malɛ e baa chichi kumo be ayabi so. 14Amoso yili le be jemanɛ a yɔ, kanaŋkamaso nɛ kedibi kikɛ nya nchu, k maaŋ tiŋ n daŋ nteŋ fanɛ kumo. Amo be kekama beeŋ wu fanɛ kananɛ edimɛdi bee wu a gbelge kasawule to a yɔ bubuni to na.”
15To, kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nde: “Kachɛ nɛ kedibi na beeŋ wu n yɔ bubuni to na, meeŋ shin nɛ elɔr nɛ mbombiana e bɔlɔ m buu kumo so a ŋini fanɛ a bee shu kumo be keeli nna. Meeŋ shin nɛ elɔr nɛ mbombiana kikɛ e sa maŋ naŋ shile. Kumo be kaman nɛ tentembiri e buu Lebanɔn be efuli so be abee so nɛ kiyi to be ndibi kikɛ e gbaŋgbaŋ amo be afantaŋ. 16Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ kedibi na e wu n yɔ bubuni to na, kumo be asheŋ beeŋ shin nɛ kufu e pɛ efuliana nɛ b baa chicha. Iden to be ndibi nɛ Lebanɔn be efuli so be ndibi nɛ a bee nya nchu nɛnɛ nɛ amo be nliŋi luri kasawule to kikɛ be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli amo ŋkpal k ka wu n tɔr so. 17Bekama nɛ b daa chena kumo be kiyoyul to na gba beeŋ tu kumo ŋ gbelge to n yɔ bubuni to kakpa nɛ bumo nɛ b daŋ kewu na yɔ na.
18Kedibi na e la fo Ijipt be ewura nɛ mbe basa. Iden be kudɔbi na to be ndibi gba be kela daa maŋ fo feya so. Ama naniere, kananɛ Iden be ndibi wu ŋ gbelge to n yɔ bubuni to na nɛ fo alɛ gba beeŋ wu n ya tu basa nɛ b maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nɛ bumo nɛ b wu kena to na. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e malga na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 32
Content:
B ka ta Ijipt be ewura m ber laŋchaŋ be asheŋ
1B ka pɛ ewura Jehowachin nɛ anyi be galeŋga anya n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ kudu anyɔsopo na be kufɔl kudu anyɔsopo na to be kachɛ sososo na, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kaŋɛ Ijipt be ewura, Fɛɛro, kenishipere be kasokpele be kubɔya ere fanɛ n yɛ: ‘Fee wora fanɛ buluŋ nna ashi efuliana na to, ama fo alɛ baa la fanɛ lɔr to be laŋchaŋ nɛ fee bri nchu to nna a jija amo. 3Efuli damtaana be basa kaŋ shɛr abar so, meeŋ to fo kashewu nseŋ shin nɛ b gberge fo nɛ kashewu na n dii kedeŋi so.’ 4Kumo be kaman, nɛ n lara fo n lɛ kasawule nseŋ bar durnya to be mbuibi nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ nɛ a baa ji fo. 5Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ fo eblaŋ bɛso e dese abee so nɛ ataŋɛ to kikɛ, 6nɛ n chulgi fo ŋklaŋ m pɔ abee kikɛ hale nɛ a bɔlɔ eboŋana. 7Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ mur fo na kaŋ fo, meeŋ shin nɛ kakpa e buu so nɛ epeŋi nɛ kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabi kikɛ e fulto ŋ gben. 8Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ esoso be kefulto kikɛ e ki tentembiri m buu fo efuli na kikɛ so. Ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.
9Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ fo kemur be asheŋ be baru e sɔ efuliana na so na, efuli damta so be basa nɛ fo maŋ naŋ nu bumo be asheŋ be ŋgbene beeŋ jija bumo ga. 10Kusɔ nɛ meeŋ wora fo na beeŋ chinchiŋ basa damta. Kachɛ nɛ meeŋ pee ma tokobi m mɔ fo na, kufu beeŋ tɔr bewura so nɛ b baa chicha ŋkpal bumo gbagba be ŋkpa so.”
11Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ Ijipt be ewura le: “Babilɔn be ewura beeŋ ba kɔ fo kena. 12Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ efuliana nɛ amo be basa maa wu kuwɔr e ba mɔ fo basa kikɛ nseŋ mur asɔ kama nɛ fee puchi so na kikɛ. 13Kumo be kaman nɛ m mɔ menyi be ana nɛ b wɔ nchu ase kikɛ, saŋɛ na so edimɛdi ŋko ana maaŋ naa wɔtɔ a jija nchu na. 14Saŋɛ na so nɛ n shin nɛ menyi be nchuana e tɔr so a du keleŋkelembi nɛ menyi be eboŋana e baa shile boeŋ boeŋ. Ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.
15Ŋ kaŋ mur bekama nɛ b wɔ Ijipt be efuli so kikɛ nseŋ shin nɛ kasawule na dese fuloŋ na nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 16Kasokpele ere beeŋ baa la awɔba nɛ efuli pɔtɛana so be beche e boŋ kumo n shu Ijipt nɛ kumo be basa kikɛ be keeli. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”
17B ka pɛ anyi be beko nɛ ewura Jehowachin n yɔ kenyaya to na be kafɛ kudu anyɔsopo na to be kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ kuduanusopo na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le. 18E yɛ: “Dimɛdi pibi, baa shu ŋkpal Ijipt be basa damta so nseŋ shin nɛ b pin fanɛ bubuni to e daga bumo. Ndoŋ e la kakpa nɛ baaŋ ta bumo nɛ efuli pɔtɛana nɛ a kɔ eleŋ ga na be basa n ya puli.” 19Kaŋɛ bumo le:
“Menyee tama fanɛ men walɛ nna ga a chɔ ekama a?
Menyeeŋ yɔ bubuni to n ya tu basa
nɛ b maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ na n dese ndoŋ.
20Menyi, Ijipt be basa, nɛ bumo nɛ b mɔ kena to na kikɛ e naŋ wu luwu koŋwule. Ŋkpal manɛ so, tokobi na teŋ wora shiriya nɛ k mɔ menyi kikɛ. 21Saŋɛ na so nɛ benapo lempoana nɛ b daŋ kɔ n sa Ijiptebi nɛ b mɔ bumo na e wora menyi Ijiptebi na maraba ashi bubuni to. Baaŋ boŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ le: ‘Basa nɛ b maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nseŋ wu kena to na e ba bubuni to nfe m ba ka dese na!’
22Asiriya nɛ kumo be benapo be nchaŋana kulti kumo na gba wɔ ndoŋ. Kena to nɛ b daŋ mɔ bumo kikɛ. 23Bumo be nchaŋana dese efuli na kikɛ so nna. Ama bumo alɛ e daa funti basa jemanɛ ko na.
24Elam nɛ kumo be benapo be nchaŋana kulti kumo na gba wɔ ndoŋ. Kena to nɛ b daŋ mɔ basa nɛ b maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ nɛ b yɔ bubuni to. Bumo e daa funti basa nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to na, ama naniere bumo e ji anishinyɔr a dese bubuni to na. 25Elam e dese kakpa nɛ basa nɛ b mɔ kena to dese na nɛ kumo be benapo be nchaŋana kulti efuli na kikɛ so na. Bumo koŋwule na e daa funti basa na, ama naniere bumo e ji anishinyɔr n wu n tu basa nɛ b mɔ kena to a dese na.
26Meshɛk nɛ Tubal nɛ amo be benapo be nchaŋana kulti amo na gba wɔ ndoŋ. B la basa nɛ b maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nna nɛ b mɔ bumo kikɛ kena to. Bumo e daa funti basa nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to na. 27B daa maŋ puli bumo bunyaŋ so fanɛ kananɛ b daa puli dra na be basa nɛ b ji eleŋ ga nɛ b daa ta bumo nɛ bumo be akɔsɔ kikɛ a puli na. Jemanɛ ko le be benapo nɛ b ji eleŋ ga ere daa funti basa nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to nna.
28Kananɛ Ijiptebi gba beeŋ wu m mur nseŋ dese basa nɛ b maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nseŋ wu kena to na nna na.
29Edɔm nɛ mbe bewura nɛ bejuŋkparpo kikɛ gba wɔ ndoŋ. B daa la benapo lempo nna, ama naniere bumo nɛ basa nɛ b maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nseŋ wu kena to na kikɛ e dese bubuni to na.
30Benimuana nɛ b shi kelargato be esoso na nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ shi Sidɔn be kadegboŋ to m ba na kikɛ gba wɔ ndoŋ. Bumo be eleŋ gboŋ daa funti basa nna, ama naniere bumo alɛ gba ta anishinyɔr nna n tu basa nɛ b wu kena to n yɔ bubuni to. Bumo kikɛ ji nyɔmɔ ashi bubuni to nna na.”
31Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Ijipt be ewura nɛ mbe benapo kaŋ wu, bekama nɛ baa wu kena to na bumo be ŋgbene beeŋ wushi. 32Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e shin nɛ Ijipt be ewura daa funti basa nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to, ama baaŋ mɔ mo nɛ mbe benapo kikɛ nseŋ puli bumo kakpa nɛ b puli basa nɛ b maa ŋana ma nseŋ wu kena to na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 33
Content:
Ebɔrɛ ka lara Ezikɛl fanɛ kade be ekenipo be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le. 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kaŋɛ fo basa fanɛ jemanɛ kama nɛ mee bar kena efuli so, loŋ be efuli na so be basa bee lara bumo to be eko nna nɛ e chena a keni ekpa to. 3Nɛ e baŋ wu edoŋ ka bee ba nɛ e foŋ kabel nɛ ekama e pin. 4Ekama nɛ e beeŋ nu kabel na nseŋ kplaŋ so nɛ edoŋ na ba mɔ mo be luwu be turju bɛ mo gbagba nna. 5Amodoŋwura gbagba e bar mbe luwu, ŋkpal manɛ so, e kplaŋ kefiɛso be kabel na be kushu so nna. Ashere nɛ e daŋ maŋ kplaŋ kumo so nna, e daŋ beeŋ gelge luwu na. 6Ama nɛ fanɛ esa nɛ e chena a keni na wu edoŋ ka bee ba nsaa maŋ foŋ kabel na, edoŋ na beeŋ ba mɔ belubiworapoana na, ama meeŋ ta bumo be luwu na be turju m bɛ esa nɛ e chena a keni ekpa to na.
7Dimɛdi pibi, naniere mee lara fo nna nɛ fo baa la esa nɛ e beeŋ baa wu asheŋ nsaa kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa. A daga fanɛ fo shin nɛ b nu kefiɛso be kubɔya kama nɛ meeŋ sa fo fanɛ fo ta n sa bumo na. 8Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ esa lubi ko beeŋ wu, nɛ fo maŋ fɛa mo so nɛ e chɛrga ashi mbe asheŋ na lubi to nseŋ mɔlga mbe kumu, kumo ere e beeŋ wu ashi mbe alubi na to ama mbe luwu be turju beeŋ baa bɛ fo. 9Ama nɛ fanɛ fo fɛa esa lubi na so nɛ e maŋ yige alubi be kewora, nseŋ wu mbe alubi to, mannɛ fo e bar kumo.”
10Kumo be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Israɛl be basa na bee bile asheŋ a fubel a kaŋɛ fanɛ bumo be alubi be kasogberge na chɔ bumo so.
