B maŋ naa kɔ tama kikɛ fanɛ baaŋ ji efute nseŋ kpal loŋ so a malga a gbiti ma. 11Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ, ŋ ka la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa so, ma kagbene maa fuli alubiworapoana be luwu so. B ka yige bumo be alubi be kewora nseŋ ji efute e naa fuli ma kagbene. Amoso nɛ Israɛl be basa na bee sha keji efute, kumo ere b yige bumo be asheŋ lubi na nseŋ bɛta m ba ma kutɔ.
12Dimɛdi pibi, kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na fanɛ nɛ esa lela wora kulubi, kelela dra nɛ e wora na maaŋ tiŋ m mɔlga mo alubi na be kasogberge to. Nɛ fanɛ esa lubi yige alubi be kewora, e maaŋ naŋ nya kasogberge. Esa lela malɛ nɛ e yige alela be kewora nsaa wora asheŋ lubi maaŋ ji efute a wɔtɔ. 13Nɛ fanɛ n nase kɔnɔ n sa esa lela fanɛ e beeŋ ji efute, ama kumo be kaman nɛ e fara a fɛ fanɛ alelasheŋ nɛ e daŋ wora na so e beeŋ nya kumɔlga nseŋ fara a wora asheŋ lubi, m maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi alelasheŋ nɛ e daŋ wora na. E beeŋ wu ŋkpal mbe alubi na so. 14Ama nɛ fanɛ ŋ fɛa esa lubi so fanɛ e beeŋ wu ŋkpal mbe alubi so, nɛ e yige asheŋ lubi be kewora nsaa wora asheŋ lela nɛ a daga 15fanɛ, e ka bɛta kusɔ nɛ e daŋ sɔ n yili tarma pɔɛŋ nseŋ sa esa ko mpaŋ na ŋko m bɛta kusɔ nɛ e yuri n ya sa kusɔwura na, kumo ere e maaŋ wu ama e beeŋ ji efute. 16Meeŋ ta mbe alubi na m paŋ mo nɛ e ji efute, ŋkpal e ka wora asheŋ lela nɛ a daga na so.
17Ade kikɛ be kaman, fo basa bee kaŋɛ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ mee wora na maŋ walɛ. Ama bumo ere be asheŋ nɛ baa wora na e maŋ niŋi. 18Nɛ esa lela yige asheŋ lela be kewora nseŋ fara a wora asheŋ lubi, e beeŋ wu ŋkpal mbe alubi so. 19Ama nɛ esa lubi yige asheŋ lubi be kewora nsaa wora asheŋ lela nɛ a daga, e mɔlga mbe kumu nna na. 20Ama menyi Israɛl be basa bee kaŋɛ fanɛ m maa wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. Kusɔ nɛ menyee wora nɛ meeŋ yili so n ji menyi demu.
Jerusalɛm ka bure n tɔr be baru be asheŋ
21Kafɛ nɛ b pɛ ewura Jehowachin nɛ anyi be galeŋga anya n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ kudu anyɔsopo na to be kufɔl kudusopo na be kachɛ nusopo na nɛ esa ko nya ekpa n shile Jerusalɛm to m ba kaŋɛ ma fanɛ Jerusalɛm bure n tɔr. 22Pɔɛŋ nɛ esa na ba ma kutɔ na be kaaseso, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ daŋ gbelge ma so nna nɛ e shin nɛ ma kɔnɔ bugi nɛ n tiŋ m malga pɔɛŋ nɛ kanyɛn na ba ma kutɔ kumo be ŋklade kachipurso na.
Basa nɛ b ka Israɛl na be alubi be asheŋ
23Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le. 24Dimɛdi pibi, basa nɛ b kra wɔ Israɛl be efuli so be nde nɛ a bure na to na bee kaŋɛ nna fanɛ: ‘Eebraham daa la esa koŋwule nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ta kasawule na kikɛ n sa mo. Naniere an ka la basa damta ere, kasawule na ki anyeya nna a.’
25To, kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ. Menyee we eblaŋ nɛ ŋklaŋ kra wɔ amo to. Menyee shuŋ agbirana nsaa mɔ basa. Nɛ mannɛ so nɛ menyee fɛ fanɛ kasawule na ki menyeya nna? 26Ade be kaman, men wɔtɔ nna a kɔ etokobi a mɔ abar nsaa wora ekishisheŋ. Ekama wɔtɔ nna a ji kubojua. Nɛ mannɛ so nɛ menyee fɛ fanɛ kasawule na ki menyeya nna?
27Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ ŋ ka la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa so, mee fɛa basa nɛ b kraa wɔ nde bureso na to na so nna nsaa kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ baaŋ wu kena to. Kumo be kaman nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi e pɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ ndekarso na n we, nɛ kulɔ e mɔ bumo nɛ bumo alɛ ŋana a wɔ abee so nɛ abeelaŋ to na. 28Meeŋ shin nɛ kasawule na e ki kasawule fuloŋ a dese, nɛ basa nɛ b daa kɔ eleŋgboŋ nsaa wu bumo amu kumo so na e ba ekar. Israɛl be abee beeŋ ki mboŋ lubi nɛ esa kama maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m bɔla amo ase n choŋ. 29Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ gberge basa na kusoe ŋkpal bumo be alubi so nseŋ shin nɛ kasawule na e dese fuloŋ na, nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
Kusɔ nɛ k wora Anebi Ezikɛl be kubɔya na be kaman be asheŋ
30Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Dimɛdi pibi, basa nɛ fo nɛ bumo wɔ Babilɔn be efuli so nfe na baŋ shɛr kadegboŋ na be egbalana ase ŋko n chena bumo be ebuana be mbuna, fo asheŋ nɛ baa malga. Le nɛ baa kaŋɛ abar, ‘Men shin nɛ an ya bishi Ezikɛl n nu kubɔya nɛ k yaŋ shi Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ m ba kabre.’ 31Amoso ma basa bee chala nna m ba nu kusɔ nɛ fo kɔ a kaŋɛ, ama bumo alɛ maaŋ wora kusɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ fanɛ b wora na. Kashaso nɛ baa malga a sa abar, ama kejimuni nɛ kapuni e bɔlɔ bumo be ŋgbene to. 32Kashenteŋto, bumo ere kutɔ fo la esa nɛ e kɔ ebɔl belbel so nna a laŋ jaŋjilaŋ nsaa boŋ kasha be nshɛ a deŋi bumo anishito. Baa nu asheŋ nɛ fee malga na kikɛ ama bumo alɛ maaŋ wora amo to be kukoŋwule gba. 33K maaŋ chɛr baaŋ nya kasogberge, fanɛ kananɛ fo kpele bumo kusoe na. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ anebi ko ba bumo to.”

Title: EZIKƐL 34
Content:
Israɛl be benimu nɛ b la mbolpɔkpapo na be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, Israɛl be bejuŋkparpoana na du fanɛ mbolpɔkpapo nɛ baa keni ma basa nɛ b du fanɛ mbolpɔ so nna. Ama mee sha fanɛ fo kaŋɛ Israɛl be bejuŋkparpo na fanɛ b maŋ wora n nyalɛ nɛ ekama e nu. Kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ fanɛ: Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi, Israɛl be mbolpɔkpapo ere! Menyi be amu nɛ menyee keni so nseŋ kplaŋ ma mbolpɔ so. 3Menyee nuu bumo be kenyipochu nna nsaa ta bumo be afuibi a lue asɔbuuso nseŋ naa mɔ bumo be belelabi a we, ama menyi alɛ maa keni bumo so nɛnɛ. 4Menyee maa keni bumo be bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ na so, ŋko a chɛ bumo nɛ baa lɔ na ŋko a wɔtɔ bumo nɛ b doro na be achuu to adur a kre amo ŋko a kuŋ bumo nɛ baa lar a yɔ mboŋ ko na a ba ŋko a fin bumo nɛ foe na. Men du nyaŋnyaŋ nna a tɔrɔ bumo. 5Ŋkpal mbolpɔ na ka maŋ kɔ ekpapo so, b pesaŋ to nna nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi bee pɛ bumo a ji. 6Ma mbolpɔ ya kaa na abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi so nna. B daŋ pesaŋ to nna a wɔ durnya be kaplɛkama nɛ esa kikɛ malɛ daa maŋ keni n fin bumo.
7Amoso, menyi mbolpɔkpapoana na e nu kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ menyi. 8Nɛ men nu n sa ma, asheŋ beeŋ baa bɔ menyi so ŋkpal manɛ so ma e la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa na. Kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi pɛ ma mbolpɔ m mɔ n we ŋkpal esa kikɛ ka maa keni bumo so so. Ma mbolpɔkpapoana maŋ wora ania fanɛ baŋ fin mbolpɔ na. Bumo gbagba be amu so nɛ baa keni so, mannɛ ma mbolpɔ. 9Amoso, menyi mbolpɔkpapoana na e nu nfe. 10Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na yɛ ma nɛ menyi maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ. Ma alɛ beeŋ suge ma mbolpɔ menyi be enɔ to nɛ menyi maaŋ naa la bumo be ekpapo a nya bumo a mɔ a we.
Mbolpɔkpapo lela na be asheŋ
11Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ ŋ gbagba e naŋ fin ma mbolpɔ nsaa keni bumo so 12fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔkpapoana bee keni bumo be mbolpɔ nɛ b daŋ pesaŋ to nɛ b naŋ ya bar bumo abar so na. Ma alɛ beeŋ bɛta bumo n shi mboŋ nɛ b pesaŋ to n yɔ kachɛ nɛ asheŋ daŋ maŋ nite nɛnɛ n sa bumo na kikɛ m ba. 13Meeŋ lara bumo efuli pɔtɛana so m ba gama bumo abar so nseŋ shin nɛ b bɛta m ba bumo gbagba be kasawule so. Ma alɛ beeŋ baa la bumo be ekpapo nseŋ shin nɛ b nya n ji nɛnɛ ashi Israɛl be abee nɛ eboŋana ase. 14Ade be kaman, meeŋ shin nɛ b nya n ji kayurwushi so ashi abeemase nɛ ataŋɛ to nɛ mboŋ kama nɛ ajibi lela wɔ ashi Israɛl be kasawule so kikɛ. 15Ŋ gbagba e naaŋ baa keni ma mbolpɔ so nseŋ fin ewushi be kakpa n sa bumo. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.
16Ma alɛ beeŋ fin bumo be bumo nɛ foe na nseŋ bɛta bumo nɛ yeŋ na m ba. Kumo be kaman nɛ ŋ kre bumo nɛ b doro na be achuu nseŋ chɛ bumo nɛ baa lɔ na. Ama bekama nɛ b ji n daŋ nsaa kɔ eleŋ na bre, meeŋ mur bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, n la mbolpɔkpapo nɛ e bee wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nna.
17Naniere ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ menyi nɛ men la ma mbolpɔ na nna fanɛ meeŋ keni menyi to m barga belela na ashi belubi na to nɛ mbolpɔ ashi mboe to. 18Menyi be beko ji ajibi lela nna ŋkukwe; nsaa chichi amo nɛ menyi maŋ ji so a wea shishɛr to! Menyeeŋ nuu nchu lela nna nseŋ gbar nchu nɛ menyi maaŋ nuu na to! 19Saŋɛ na so nɛ ma mbolpɔ nɛ b ka na e ji ajibi nɛ men chichi so na nseŋ nuu nchu nɛ men gbar to na.
20Amoso, naniere ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ menyi nna fanɛ, meeŋ keni so m barga mbolpɔ nɛ b kɔ eleŋ na ashi bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ na to. 21Ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi bumo nɛ men kɔ eleŋ na bee ŋin bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ na nna a lar ekarso nsaa ta menyi be alambɛ a pur bumo a lar ma mbolpɔ to. 22Ama ma alɛ beeŋ mɔlga ma mbolpɔ nɛ menyi maaŋ naa kɔrfɛ bumo. Meeŋ keni bumo so nseŋ barga belela na ashi belubi na to. 23Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ n sa bumo ewura nɛ e beeŋ baa du fanɛ ma kayɛrbi ewura Deevid nɛ e baa kpa bumo nsaa keni bumo so nɛnɛ. 24Saŋɛ na so nɛ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ, nɛ ewura nɛ e du fanɛ ma kayɛrbi ewura Deevid na e baa la bumo be ejuŋkparpo. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na 25Ma nɛ bumo beeŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ k beeŋ bar bumo kayurwushi. Ma alɛ beeŋ ju kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya lubi na kikɛ kasawule na so, saŋɛ na so ma mbolpɔ maaŋ naa ŋana kufu.
26Ade be kaman, meeŋ nɛfa bumo nseŋ shin nɛ b baa wɔ ma kebee cheembi na ase nɛ n sa bumo bɔrɛchu lela jemanɛ nɛ k daga nsaa la nɛfa na. 27Saŋɛ na so nɛ ndibi na e sɔr nɛnɛ nɛ nsawule na kikɛ malɛ e wora adɔjibi. Kumo be kaman nɛ ekama e chena mo gbagba be kasawule so nɛ kayurwushi. Ŋ kaŋ tuge ŋgbɛlɛbi nɛ a kre ma basa na, nseŋ shin nɛ b nya bumo be amu ashi basa nɛ b pɛ bumo anya na be enɔ na nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 28Loŋ be jemanɛ so, efuli pɔtɛana maaŋ naŋ tiŋ m ba kɔ n suge bumo be asɔbɔya, nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔ lubi gba maaŋ naŋ pɛ bumo n ji. Baaŋ chena kayurwushi so nna nɛ esa kama maa naa funti bumo. 29Ade kikɛ be kaman, meeŋ sa bumo kasawule lela nɛ akoŋ maaŋ naa wɔ kumo so. Efuli pɔtɛana be basa maaŋ naaŋ mushe bumo kikɛ. 30Aloŋ nɛ ekama beeŋ pin fanɛ ma e naa kuŋ Israɛl be basa nɛ b la ma basa na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ na.”
31Kumo be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Menyi, ma mbolpɔ, nɛ mee bela na, la ma basa nna nɛ ma alɛ la menyi be Ebɔrɛ.”

Title: EZIKƐL 35
Content:
Edɔm be kaplɛa so be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, malga ŋ gbiti Edɔm be kebee nɛ k yili n sa kumo be basa na. 3Kaŋɛ Edɔmebi kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ.
N yɛ ma nɛ menyi Edɔm be basa, maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ!
Meeŋ shin nɛ menyi be efuli e ki kasawule fuloŋ a dese,
nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔ kumo so.
4Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ menyi be ndegboŋ e ki alambure a dese.
Nɛ menyi be kasawule e ki kakpa nɛ ekama kini n lɛ.
Aloŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
5Ŋkpal manɛ so, dra dra kikɛ nɛ menyi Edɔm be basa ta Israɛl be basa ŋ ki men doŋana nseŋ kpal loŋ so n shin nɛ b wu ga jemanɛ nɛ b nya bumo be alubi be kasogberge na. 6Ŋ ka la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa so luwu nɛ men maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gbelge e naaŋ ba menyi so. Men wora n jija ŋkpal basa be kamɔ so, amoso menyi alɛ gba beeŋ wu. 7Meeŋ shin nɛ Edɔm be kepreŋsawule e dese fuloŋ a maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ nseŋ shin nɛ esa kama nɛ e beeŋ bɔla kumo so n choŋ e wu. 8Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ basa nɛ b wu kena to na e dese n sɔ kaplɛkama ashi abee so nɛ ataŋɛ to kikɛ. 9Saŋɛ na so nɛ menyi be efuli na e dese fuloŋ mbaanaayɔ, nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ naa wɔ menyi be ndegboŋana to. Aloŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
10Hale ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na ka daa la Juda nɛ Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na gba, men daŋ kaŋɛ nna fanɛ bumo be efuliana be nsawule kikɛ la menyeya nna nseŋ daa sha keta amo ŋ ki menyeya. 11Amoso ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ ka baa wɔ ŋkpa to ere bre, meeŋ ka menyi kukɔ ŋkpal agbo nɛ kukɔrkɔ nɛ yurkishi nɛ men kɔ a laŋɛ ma basa be kaplɛa so so, saŋɛ na so baŋ pin fanɛ kusɔ nɛ men wora bumo na so nɛ mee gberge menyi kusoe na. 12Kumo be kaman, nɛ men pin fanɛ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na daŋ nu men ka daa malga mmalga jiga a gbiti Israɛl be basa nsaa kaŋɛ fanɛ kasawule na dese jiga nna n sa menyi nɛ men ta ŋ ki menyeya. 13Ma alɛ naŋ nu mpuchi be mmalga nɛ men malga ŋ gbiti ma na gba.”
14Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: “Meeŋ shin nɛ men mur cheche a maaŋ naa la shɛŋ nɛ durnya kikɛ e ji eyur ŋkpal loŋ so, 15fanɛ kananɛ men ji eyur jemanɛ nɛ ma basa Israɛlebi na daŋ mur na. Edɔm be efuli nɛ kumo be nsawule kikɛ beeŋ mur cheche, a maaŋ naa la shɛŋ. Kumo be kaman nɛ ekama e pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 36
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa ka ba Israɛl so be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, kaŋɛ abee nɛ a wɔ Israɛl be efuli so na fanɛ a nu kubɔya nɛ ma, 2Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kɔ n sa amo. Israɛl mo doŋana daŋ malga mmalga jiga ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ, Naniere abee dra na ki bumo peya nna!
3Amoso bɔ kubɔya nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ ere. Jemanɛ nɛ efuli nɛ a chena ŋ kulti Israɛl na kɔ n suge Israɛl be abee na, ekama na daŋ wora Israɛl eyurto nna. 4Amoso naniere kusɔ nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ menyi abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi nɛ eboŋana nɛ ataŋɛ nɛ mboŋ nɛ a bure a dese nɛ ndegboŋ nɛ basa shile amo to nɛ efuliana nɛ a kulti menyi na ba muu amo to be asɔ n yɔ nseŋ wora menyi eyurto na kikɛ nde. 5Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na malga agbogboŋ so nna ŋ gbiti efuliana nɛ a kulti fo Israɛl be efuli na kikɛ, fɔŋfɔŋ Edɔm be efuli na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo e daŋ ji eyur ga nseŋ daŋ sɔ ma kasawule nɛ kumo be asɔbɔya be ejikpa ŋ ki bumo peya.
6Amoso malga ŋ kaŋɛ Israɛl be efuli so be abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi nɛ eboŋana nɛ ataŋɛ kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ kukɔrkɔ nɛ agbo so ŋkpal kananɛ efuliana na tege nseŋ wora bumo yeryerbi so. 7Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bɔ ntaŋ fanɛ efuliana na beeŋ ji anishinyɔr. 8Ama ndibi nɛ a yil abee so ashi ma basa, Israɛlebi, be efuli so na beeŋ naŋ purge nseŋ sɔr asɔrso n sa bumo. K maaŋ chɛr baaŋ bɛta m ba epe. 9N nyi menyi Israɛlebi be asheŋ nɛ men be asheŋ tir n sa ma. Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ men naaŋ dɔ menyi be adɔsawule so n duu adɔjibi. 10Kumo be kaman nɛ n shin nɛ Israɛl be basa e naŋ wora keshi n chena menyi be nsawule so nɛ basa e naŋ chena ndeana to nseŋ lɔŋɛ alambure na m pɔr. 11Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin menyi be asɔbɔya kikɛ e salga n wora keshi nɛ men naaŋ chena kasawule na so fanɛ kananɛ men daŋ chena kumo so dra na. Menyeeŋ dii kedama ga a chɔ kananɛ men daa du na, saŋɛ na so nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 12Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ n shin nɛ ma basa Israɛlebi na e naŋ bɛta m ba chena bumo be nsawule so. Nsawule na beeŋ baa la bumo gbagba peya nɛ akoŋ malɛ maaŋ naŋ mɔ bumo be mbia.
13Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: Kashenteŋ nɛ basa bee kaŋɛ fanɛ kasawule na maa wora ajibi nɛnɛ nsaa shin nɛ akoŋ bee mɔ kumo be basa. 14Ama yili jemanɛ ere a yɔ, k beeŋ baa wora ajibi nɛnɛ nɛ menyi maaŋ naŋ paŋ menyi be mbia. Ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na. 15Kumo be kaman, menyi maaŋ naŋ bugi asoe a nu mmalga jiga nɛ efuliana na bee malga a gbiti menyi. Meni alɛ maaŋ naŋ keni n wu basa ka bee wora menyi eyurto. Kasawule na maaŋ naŋ shin nɛ men paŋ menyi be mbia. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na, e kaŋɛ na.”
Israɛl be basa be ŋkpa popɔr be asheŋ
16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 17“Dimɛdi pibi, Israɛlebi na ka daa wɔ bumo be kasawule so na, b daŋ bɔla bumo be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ asheŋ woraso so nna n jija kumo. Kananɛ eche nɛ e bee lar ntamaŋ maŋ walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so na, nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ na daa du n sa ma. 18Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo ŋkpal kabasamɔ nɛ kagbirshuŋ nɛ b ta n jija kasawule na so, 19nseŋ pesaŋ bumo to n yɔ efuli pɔtɛana so. Bumo be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ asheŋ woraso so nɛ n daŋ ji bumo demu. 20Kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ b yɔ, b daa ŋaba ma ketre cheembi na nna; ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ efuli pɔtɛana be basa daa kaŋɛ: ‘Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be basa nna na. E tintiŋ bumo nna n lar bumo gbagba be kasawule so.’ 21Ndoŋ nna nɛ kusɔ nɛ efuli pɔtɛana be basa bee fɛ a laŋɛ ma kaplɛa so na tɔrɔ ma ga.
22Amoso kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na kubɔya nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kɔ nɛ sa bumo: Mannɛ menyi Israɛlebi so nɛ meeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ mee sha kewora ere, ama ma ketre cheembi nɛ men ŋaba efuli pɔtɛ kama nɛ men yɔ kumo so na so. 23Ŋ kaŋ lara kecheembiya nɛ k wɔ ma ketregboŋ nɛ men ŋaba ashi efuliana na so na ŋ ŋini bumo na nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ, fanɛ men bɔla menyi so ŋ ŋini efuli pɔtɛana na fanɛ n du cheembi nna. 24Meeŋ lara menyi ashi efuli pɔtɛana kama to m ba epe menyi gbagba be kasawule so. 25Nɛ kebaadu fanɛ ŋ ka wora nchu lela ŋ ŋmenyaŋ menyi so nɛ men nyalɛ so ashi kagbirshuŋ nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k shin nɛ men wora eyurpi na to. 26Ade be kaman, nɛ n lara menyi be ŋgbene kpakpaso fanɛ kejembu na nseŋ sa menyi ŋgbene popɔr nɛ a beeŋ shin nɛ men baa wora ma kasonu. 27Ma alɛ beeŋ ta ma kiyoyu n wɔtɔ menyi to nseŋ shin nɛ men bɛ ma mbraana nɛ keŋini kikɛ so kenishipereso. 28Saŋɛ na so nɛ men chena kasawule nɛ n ta n sa men nananyɛnana na so nsaa la ma basa nɛ ma alɛ e baa la menyi be Ebɔrɛ. 29Meeŋ kuŋ menyi ashi kusɔ kama nɛ k bee shin nɛ menyee wora eyurpi na to nseŋ shin nɛ menyi be ayu e wora nɛnɛ, saŋɛ na so akoŋ maaŋ naa wɔtɔ. 30Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ menyi be ndibi sɔrso nɛ adɔjibi e foo, saŋɛ na so menyi maaŋ naŋ ji anishinyɔr ashi efuliana na so ŋkpal akoŋ so. 31Ade kikɛ be kaman, menyeeŋ nyiŋi menyi be asheŋ woraso lubi nɛ a shin nɛ men gbagba e kishi menyi be amu ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ men wora so. 32Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: Israɛlebi, mee sha nɛ men pin fanɛ mannɛ menyi so nɛ mee wora asheŋ ere, ama mee sha nna nɛ anishinyɔr nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ menyi ŋkpal asheŋ nɛ men wora na so.”
33Nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kachɛ nɛ meeŋ kpra menyi be alubi ashi menyi so na nɛ meeŋ naŋ shin nɛ men chena menyi be ndegboŋana to nseŋ lɔŋɛ alambure na m pɔr. 34Ekama nɛ e daŋ bɔla menyi be adɔana ase a choŋ daa wu fanɛ e ki kupuŋ nna a dese, ama meeŋ naŋ shin nɛ men lɔŋɛ amo so n dɔ. 35Nɛ ekama na e naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kasawule nɛ k daa la kudɔpuŋ a dese jiga na a kilgi a walɛ fanɛ Iden be Kudɔbi na. Kumo be kaman nɛ wu kananɛ ndeana nɛ a daŋ ki alambure a dese nɛ shɛŋ daa maŋ naa wɔ amo to na naŋ nya basa nɛ b pɔr egbalana ŋ kulti amo nsaa wɔ amo to na. 36Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ efuliana nɛ a mata menyi nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ na e pin fanɛ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e naa lɔŋɛ menyi be nde bureso a pɔr nsaa dɔ menyi be adɔpuŋ a du. Ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e nase kumo be kɔnɔ, ma alɛ beeŋ wora loŋ gbagba chap.”
37Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ naŋ shin nɛ Israɛlebi na e kule ma kechɛto nɛ n shin nɛ b wora keshi n ti so fanɛ mbolpɔ na. 38Nɛ nde nɛ a bure a dese ere e naŋ bɔlɔ basa fanɛ kananɛ mbolpɔ daŋ bɔlɔ Jerusalɛm to nɛ b daa ta amo a lara esarga nchɛgboŋachɛ na. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 37
Content:
Ketaŋɛ nɛ awibi wɔlso dese to na be asheŋ
1Saŋko ka fo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ na gbelge ma so nɛ mbe Kiyoyu ta ma ŋ gbelge to n yɔ ketaŋɛ ko to nɛ awibi sɔ kaplɛkama a dese. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na keta ma n nite ketaŋɛ na to nɛ n wu fanɛ awibi na daa shi nseŋ daŋ wɔl n fuli a dese. 3Nɛ e bishi ma: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, awibi ere beeŋ naŋ tiŋ m ba ŋkpa to a?”
Nɛ ma alɛ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ, fo nawule e naŋ tiŋ m pin kumo be loŋ!”
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Malga n sa awibi nɛ a wɔl n fuli na nseŋ kaŋɛ amo nɛ e nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kamalga. 5Kaŋɛ amo fanɛ le nɛ ma Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ: Meeŋ shin nɛ efute e ba menyi to nɛ men naŋ nya ŋkpa. 6Ma alɛ beeŋ sa menyi achin nɛ eblaŋ, nseŋ shin nɛ kawɔl e ba buu menyi so. Kumo be kaman nɛ n sa menyi efute nɛ men nya ŋkpa. Ndoŋ nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”
7Ndoŋ nna nɛ m malga n sa awibi na fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na. Ŋ kraa malga nna nseŋ nu egbri ko fanɛ basa ka bee kpla enɔ na nɛ awibi kɔŋkɔŋ na fara a chɛ abar so. 8Ŋ kraa yil a keni amo nna nɛ achin nɛ eblaŋ nɛ kawɔl ba buu amo so. Ama ŋkpa daa maŋ wɔ amo to.
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ naŋ kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi, malga n sa afu. Kaŋɛ afu na fanɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na yɛ k shi kaba kama so m ba luri eyurana nɛ a la bubuni a dese ere to nɛ e nya ŋkpa.”
10Ŋ ka baŋ kaŋɛ loŋ, nɛ afu ber m ba luri eyurana na to nɛ a nya ŋkpa ŋ koso n yili. B daa la benapo be katuŋ gboŋgboŋi ko nna.
11Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma: “Dimɛdi pibi, Israɛl be basa du fanɛ awibi kɔŋkɔŋ ere nna. Baa fubel nna a kaŋɛ fanɛ b wɔlso nna nsaa maa kɔ echefoso be tama kikɛ kebaawɔtɔ to. 12Amoso kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee sha kebugi bumo be nchaŋana nna nɛ b lar m bɛta m ba Israɛl be kasawule so. 13Ŋ kaŋ wora loŋ, baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 14Ma kiyoyu beeŋ sa bumo efute nɛ b nya ŋkpa m ba kaa wɔ bumo gbagba be kasawule so. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ n nase kɔnɔ fanɛ meeŋ wora loŋ na. Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”
Juda nɛ Israɛl ka naŋ ki kuwurji koŋwule be asheŋ
15Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma. 16E yɛ: “Dimɛdi pibi, fin kedibi nseŋ sibɛ le kumo so, ‘Juda be kuwurji be asheŋ.’ Kumo be kaman nɛ fo fin kedibi nyɔsopo nseŋ sibɛ le kumo alɛ gba so, ‘Israɛl be kuwurji be asheŋ.’ 17Kede be kaman, nɛ fo ta ndibi anyɔ na be nnɔso n chɔga abar so ŋ keta enɔ to nɛ k wora fanɛ a ka la kedibi koŋwule na. 18Fo basa kaŋ bishi fo kusɔ nɛ k bee ŋini, 19feeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee sha keta kedibi nɛ k yili n sa Israɛl nna n chuge kumo nɛ k yili n sa Juda na so nna, saŋɛ na so amo anyɔ na beeŋ ki kedibi koŋwule a wɔ ma enɔ to.
20To, feeŋ keta ndibi anyɔ na fo enɔ to nɛ basa na e wu amo. 21Ndoŋ nna nɛ fo kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee sha kelara ma basa kikɛ ashi efuliana nɛ b pesaŋ to n yɔ to na n shin nɛ b ba abar so ashi bumo gbagba be kasawule so. 22Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ b baa la basa koŋwule ashi Israɛl be efuli so. Baaŋ baa kɔ ewura koŋwule nɛ e beeŋ baa ji bumo so kuwura a maaŋ naŋ barga to a wɔtɔ. 23Bumo alɛ maaŋ naŋ bɔla kagbirshuŋ so n jija bumo be amu ŋko n wora alubi ŋ gbiti bumo be amu. Ma alɛ beeŋ sɔ bumo n yige ashi ekpa kama so nɛ baa bɔla so a wora alubi a debɔr ma na, nseŋ fɔr bumo so, nɛ b baa la ma basa, nɛ ma alɛ e baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ. 24Ewura nɛ e du fanɛ ma kayɛrbi Deevid e naaŋ baa la bumo be ewura nɛ bumo kikɛ e wora kɔnɔkoŋwule a wɔ mbe kaseto nseŋ ta kashenteŋji a bɛ ma mbraana so. 25Kasawule nɛ n ta n sa ma kayɛrbi Jeekɔb na so nɛ baaŋ chena, kakpa nɛ bumo nanaana daŋ chena na. Bumo nɛ bumo be mbia nɛ kaman to ebi kikɛ beeŋ chena kumo so hale mbaanaayɔ, nɛ ewura nɛ e du fanɛ ma kayɛrbi Deevid na e baa ji bumo so kuwura. 26Ade kikɛ be kaman, ma nɛ bumo beeŋ luri kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre to a ŋini kayurwushi nɛ baaŋ baa wɔtɔ to hale mbaanaayɔ. Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ b baa wɔtɔ nseŋ wora keshi n ti so nɛ ma bɔrɛlambu na e baa wɔ bumo to mbaanaayɔ. 27Ma nɛ bumo e naa baa wɔ ndoŋ, nɛ m baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ bumo alɛ e baa la ma basa. 28Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ yili ma bɔrɛlambu bumo to mbaanaayɔ na, nɛ efuliana na beeŋ pin fanɛ ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e lara Israɛlebi na ŋ ki ma basa.”

Title: EZIKƐL 38
Content:
Gɔg be kaplɛa so be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
1Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 2“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, malga ŋ gbiti Gɔg nɛ e la Meshɛk nɛ Tubal be efuliana so be ewurgboŋ ashi Magɔg be kasawule so na. Malga ŋ gbiti mo 3nseŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mo maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ. 4Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ e maaŋ naa kɔ eleŋ, nseŋ ta edariwa ŋ kɔl mbe ŋgbuŋ to ŋ gberge mo nɛ mbe benapo damta nɛ baa dii egbaŋɛ nsaa kɔ akɔsɔ damta, nɛ bumo be ekama malɛ kɔ kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋkumuso nɛ tokobi enɔana to na kikɛ n yɔ. 5Pɛshiya nɛ Kush nɛ Libiya be efuliana so be benapo ti fo benapo na so nɛ bumo kikɛ malɛ kɔ abɛlso be asɔ kuŋamuso nɛ abɛlso be akpaŋwuro. 6Gɔma nɛ Bɛf Togaama be nsawule so ebi ashi kelargato be esoso na nɛ bumo be benapo kikɛ gba ti bumo so. Efuli damtaana be basa gba ti bumo so. 7To, kaŋɛ mo fanɛ mo nɛ mbe benapo e bela ase n wora shiriya n ya kɔ kena, 8ŋkpal manɛ so, nfɛ damta be kaman meeŋ kaŋɛ mo nɛ e ya kɔ m pɔɔ efuli ko nɛ kumo be basa daŋ gama abar n shi efuli pɔtɛ damtaana so m ba chena a maa ŋana kena na. E beeŋ pɔ Israɛl be basa nɛ b chena kayurwushi so ashi abee nɛ b daŋ shile ŋ ka amo n chɛr na so. 9Gɔg nɛ mbe benapo nɛ efuli damtaana nɛ b ti so na beeŋ kre m ba Israɛlebi na so fanɛ bɔrɛfu m ba buu bumo so fanɛ kuwɔlpa.”
10Kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee kaŋɛ Gɔg nde: “Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, feeŋ fara a fɛ ŋkre lubi. 11Fo alɛ beeŋ baa sha kekɔ m pɔɔ efuli nɛ kumo be basa chena kayurwushi so ashi nde nɛ b maŋ pɔr egbalana a kuŋ amo na so. 12Kumo be kaman, nɛ fo kɔ n suge basa nɛ b wɔ ndegboŋana nɛ a daŋ bure a dese na be asɔ. B la basa nɛ b shi efuli pɔtɛana so nna m ba abar nsaa kɔ asɔbɔya nɛ asɔ nsaa wɔ durnya be kakpa k bee bɔlɔ kenishi ga na naniere. 13Saŋɛ na so nɛ Sheba nɛ Dedan be efuliana so be basa nɛ Speen be efuli so be ndeana to be eyawujipo e bishi fo fanɛ fo gama fo benapo abar so nna nɛ fo kɔ n suge asɔ fanɛ shuwa nɛ gbiti nɛ asɔbɔya kikɛ n yɔ a?
14Amoso nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na shuŋi ma fanɛ n ya kaŋɛ Gɔg fanɛ nɛ e wu mbe basa Israɛlebi ka wɔ kayurwushi to, e beeŋ koso 15kakpa nɛ e wɔ ashi kelargato be esoso wɔfɔ wɔfɔ na n juŋkpar benapo lempo damta nɛ bumo kikɛ dii egbaŋɛ 16ŋ kre m ba buu bumo so fanɛ bɔrɛfugboŋ ka ba kasawule na so na. Jemanɛ na kaŋ fo, meeŋ shin nɛ men kɔ m pɔɔ ma kasawule so nɛ efuliana na e pin esa nɛ e la ma ashi kusɔ nɛ meeŋ bɔla menyi so n wora a ŋini ma kecheembiya na.”
17Nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Fo asheŋ nɛ n daa malga dra dra jemanɛ nɛ n daŋ bɔla ma nyɛrbi, Israɛl be anebiana na so na, fanɛ kachako bee ba nɛ n shin nɛ esa ko e ba kɔ Israɛlebi kena na. 18Kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora kachɛ nɛ Gɔg beeŋ ba kɔ Israɛlebi kena na beeŋ shin nɛ ma kagbene e kaa ga, 19nɛ n nya agbo n shin nɛ kasawule e gbuŋgbuŋ eleŋ so ashi Israɛl be efuli so. 20Saŋɛ na so nɛ kufu e pɛ ekɔrɔtɔ nɛ mbuibi, nɛ asɔbɔya wurbi nɛ agboŋi kikɛ nɛ dimɛdi kama nɛ a wɔ durnya to so nɛ b baa chicha. Abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi kikɛ beeŋ bu n tɔr nɛ egbal kama e bure n tɔr kasawule. 21Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ etɔrɔ be yiri yiri e ta kufu n lɛ Gɔg nɛ mbe benapo so nɛ b kilgi a mɔ abar. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na. 22Kumo be kaman nɛ n ta alɔ nɛ luwu ŋ gberge mo kusoe, nseŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛfu nɛ abɔrɛjembubi nɛ edɛ nɛ a bee suse fanɛ kejembu nɛ baa tre jɛrbi na e chulgi n wurge mo nɛ mbe benapo nɛ efuli damtaana nɛ b ti mo so na so. 23Kananɛ meeŋ ŋini efuliana na kikɛ ma keshi nɛ kecheembiya nna na. Aloŋ nɛ baaŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 39
Content:
Gɔg ka kɔ n tɔr be asheŋ
1Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, malga ŋ gbiti Gɔg nɛ e la Meshɛk nɛ Tubal be efuliana be ewurgboŋ na nseŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ ma nɛ mo maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ. 2Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ e kilgi anishito n shoŋi kakpa pɔtɛ nɛ n juŋkpar mo n shi kelargato be esoso wɔfɔ wɔfɔ hale nɛ e ba fo Israɛl be abee so. 3Saŋɛ na so nɛ ŋ ŋmɛa mbe keta nɛ atanyembi ashi mbe enɔjiso nɛ bena to n lɛ. 4Kumo be kaman nɛ Gɔg nɛ mbe benapo nɛ mbe bechɛtopo kikɛ e tɔr n wu ashi Israɛl be abee so nɛ n shin nɛ b ki kusɔ jiso n sa mbuibi nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya. 5Bumo be beko malɛ gba beeŋ wu n dese kupuŋ to. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na. 6Ade be kaman, nɛ n shin nɛ edɛ e chɔɔ Magɔg be kasawule nɛ teku ase be nsawule nɛ basa chena amo so kayurwushi so na, nɛ ekama e pin fanɛ ma e la Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 7Ma alɛ beeŋ shin nɛ ma basa Israɛlebi e pin ma ketre cheembi na, a maaŋ naa keni kumo jiga kikɛ. Ndoŋ nɛ efuliana na beeŋ pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ cheembi na.”
8Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kachɛ nɛ m malga kumo be asheŋ ere beeŋ ba, fanɛ kananɛ n nase kumo be kɔnɔ na; 9Nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ Israɛl be ndegboŋ to na e lar n ya tise n tise bumo doŋana be akɔsɔ nɛ baaŋ yige n lɛ na m ba wɔtɔ edɛ. Baaŋ ta abɛlso be asɔ kuŋamuso nɛ ata nɛ atanyembi nɛ akpa nɛ mprɛ m wɔtɔ edɛ to. Nfɛ ashunu nɛ baa chɔɔ amo. 10B maaŋ naŋ yɔ kupuŋ to n ya fin ndibi puga edɛ ŋko ŋ ku ndibi kiyi to kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so akɔsɔ nɛ b shile ŋ ka na ba ako beeŋ ndibi puga edɛ n sa bumo. Bumo alɛ beeŋ suge basa nɛ b daŋ suge bumo be asɔ na be asɔ.” Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.
Gɔg be kepuli be asheŋ
11Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Jemanɛ nɛ asheŋ ere kikɛ beeŋ wora na, meeŋ shin nɛ b puli Gɔg ashi Israɛl be kakpa nɛ baa tre Benitepo be Ketaŋɛ to nɛ k dese Teku Wuso na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na. Ndoŋ nɛ baaŋ puli Gɔg nɛ mbe benapo kikɛ, saŋɛ na so baaŋ baa tre ketaŋɛ na Gɔg be benapo be Ketaŋɛ. 12Afɔl ashunu nɛ Israɛlebi na beeŋ ta m puli bubuni na kikɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ kasawule na e naŋ nyalɛ so. 13Ekama nɛ e wɔ kasawule na so beeŋ chɛ to m puli bumo, nɛ kumo be loŋ e shin nɛ b nya kemaŋkura kachɛ nɛ meeŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so na. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na. 14Afɔl ashunu na be kaman nɛ, b lara benyɛn ko nɛ b nite efuli na kikɛ so n ya keni n fin bubuni kama nɛ baaŋ ka a dese mboŋ ko na m puli, saŋɛ na so kasawule na beeŋ naŋ nyalɛ so. 15Kaplɛkama nɛ benyɛn na beeŋ wu dimɛdi be kuwibi ka dese baaŋ dulgi ndoŋ, saŋɛ na so bechaŋkurpoana na beeŋ ba ta kumo n ya puli ashi Gɔg be benapo be Ketaŋɛ na to 16m mata kade nɛ baa tre Gɔg be Benapo na. Kumo be kaman, nɛ kasawule na e naŋ nyalɛ so.”
17Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, tre mbuibi nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya kikɛ nɛ b shi kaplɛkama m ba ji sarga nɛ mee wora a sa bumo na. K beeŋ baa la kejigboŋ nna ashi Israɛl be abee so, nɛ b we eblaŋ nseŋ nuu ŋklaŋ ndoŋ. 18Benapo be eblaŋ nɛ baaŋ we nseŋ nuu durnya to be bewurjipo be ŋklaŋ. Kananɛ baa mɔ ekpakpa ŋko mbolpɔ fɔlbi ŋko mboe ŋko egbolu danso na nɛ baaŋ mɔ benapo na nɛ bewurjipo na. 19Jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ mɔ basa ere fanɛ sarga be asɔbɔya na, mbuibi nɛ asɔbɔya beeŋ ji nfɔ kanaŋkama nɛ baaŋ tiŋ nseŋ nuu ŋklaŋ hale nɛ a boo bumo. 20Ndoŋ beeŋ ki fanɛ ma ejikpa nɛ b we egbaŋɛ nɛ bumo be bediipo nɛ basa gboŋ nɛ benapo be yiri yiri be eblaŋ m mɔɛ m baŋ bumo be amu so.”
Israɛl be efuli ka naaŋ laŋɛ n yili be asheŋ
21Amo kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Meeŋ shin nɛ efuliana na e wu ma kemaŋkura nɛ ŋ ŋini bumo kananɛ mee wora asheŋ nɛ ŋ ŋkre ma eleŋ to na. 22Yili loŋ be kachɛ na a yɔ Israɛlebi na beeŋ pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la bumo be Ebɔrɛ. 23Kumo be kaman, nɛ efuliana na e pin fanɛ Israɛlebi na daŋ yɔ kenyaya to nna ŋkpal bumo be alubi nɛ b wora n da ma so na so. N daŋ lar bumo kaman nseŋ shin nɛ bumo doŋana kɔ bumo kena m mɔ bumo. 24Kusɔ nɛ k daga bumo nɛ n shin nɛ b nya na. Bumo be asheŋ lubi nɛ amu kpakpaso so nɛ n daŋ pal kaman n sa bumo na.”
25Ade ere malɛ kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ama naniere bre meeŋ wu Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi nɛ b la Israɛl be basa na kuwɔr nseŋ shin nɛ b naŋ dii dama. Ma alɛ beeŋ kuŋ ma ketre cheembi na. 26B kaŋ ba chena bumo gbagba be kasawule so kayurwushi so nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ naa funti bumo na, baaŋ teŋ bumo be anishinyɔr nɛ b daŋ ji ŋkpal b ka daŋ debɔr ma na so. 27Efuli damtaana beeŋ wu kananɛ meeŋ lara ma basa, Israɛlebi na ashi mboŋ nɛ bumo doŋana yɛr bumo na m ba nseŋ wu fanɛ n du cheembi nna. 28Saŋɛ na so nɛ ma basa e pin fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e la bumo be Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, n daŋ yɛr bumo kenyaya to nna nseŋ naŋ gama bumo abar so m ba bumo gbagba be kasawule so, hale bumo be ekoŋwule gba maŋ shir ndoŋ. 29Ma alɛ maaŋ naaŋ lar Israɛl be basa na kaman kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, meeŋ ta ma kiyoyu n wɔtɔ bumo to. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 40
Content:
B ka ta Ezikɛl n yɔ Jerusalɛm be asheŋ
1B ka pɛ anyi be beko nɛ ewura Jehowachin kenya n tintiŋ anyi n yɔ Babilɔn be efuli so na be kafɛ adunyɔ nɛ anu nɛ Babilɔnebi ka kɔ n suge Jerusalɛm na be kafɛ kuduanasopo to be kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ kudusopo na nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be eleŋgboŋ gbelge ma so nɛ e keta ma n yɔ Jerusalɛm. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ ku bɔrɛdare n wu fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ka keta ma n yɔ Israɛl be kasawule so n ya yili kebee jeŋgreŋ ko so nɛ ŋ keni kelargato be kaseto be kaba so n wu nwu damta ko nɛ a duli fanɛ kadegboŋ na. 3Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na firgi ma n taga amo to nɛ wu esa ko nɛ e bee nyɛkpɛ fanɛ b ka fifɛa danyaŋ so na, nɛ e kɔ wajɛchɛbi be kusɔ nɛ baa ta a karga asɔ be nteŋ nɛ kekpabi nɛ b kɔ a karga asɔ na mbe enɔ to nsaa yil kabunagboŋ ase ashi bɔrɛdare na to.
4Kumo be kaman nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, bugi anishi nɛ asoe ŋ keni nseŋ nu kusɔ nɛ mee sha keŋini fo ere nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ so nɛ m bar fo nfe. Feeŋ kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na kusɔ kama nɛ fo wu.”
Epeŋilarkpa be kabunagboŋ na be asheŋ
5Kusɔ nɛ n daŋ wu e la bɔrɛlambu na, nɛ egbal kulti kumo n wɔtɔ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na ta mbe kekpabi nɛ b kɔ a karga asɔ nɛ kumo be nteŋ sa fanɛ ayadra kudu na ŋ karga egbal na. Egbal na be jeŋgreŋ nɛ ndanto kikɛ daa sa fanɛ ayadra kudu nna. 6Kumo be kaman, nɛ e yɔ kabunagboŋ nɛ k bee shoŋi epeŋilarkpa na nseŋ ya dii ketemprembi na n yɔ kumo be awɔlto n ya karga kabuna na, nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ sa fanɛ ayadra kudu. 7Kedɛdɛ ko daa wɔ kabunagboŋ na be anishito nɛ kumo be kaba kama so daa kɔ ebu asa nɛ baa tre amo bekumpo be ebuana. Ebuana na be mba ana na be kekama daa sa fanɛ ayadra kudu nna nɛ kedɛdɛ na malɛ daŋ dese n ya fo kabuna to be ebu ko nɛ k kilgi n shoŋi bɔrɛlambu na. 8-9Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na karga ebu nɛ k kilgi n shoŋi bɔrɛlambu ere nseŋ wu fanɛ yili kumo be kabuna to n ya fo epunto be egbal na sa fanɛ ayadra kuduana nna. Naŋ yili kabuna na to n ya fo kumo be akel to be egbalana na malɛ be kekama sa fanɛ ayadra ana nna. 10Bekumpo be ebuana nɛ a wɔ kedɛdɛ na be mba anyɔ na kikɛ daa sasa nna, nɛ egbalana nɛ a daa barga amo to na malɛ gba be ndanto daa sasa.
11Kumo be kaman, nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ karga kedɛdɛ na be mparto nɛ kumo kikɛ koso ayadra adunyɔ nɛ anyɔ, ama yili kabuna ko n ya fo kenyɔsopo daa sa fanɛ ayadra kuduashe nna. 12Egbal shiimbi nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ nɛ pentren kikɛ ka gbrɛ nɛ e fo ayadra anyɔ daa wɔ bekumpo be ebuana na be kekama be anishito nna. Bekumpo be ebuana na be kekama be nteŋ to nɛ mparto kikɛ daa la ayadra kudu nna. 13Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na yili ebu ko be kaman to be egbal ŋ karga m bɔla kedɛdɛ na to m ba choŋ ebu nyɔsopo be kaman to be egbal nɛ k koso fanɛ ayadra adena nɛ anyɔ. 14Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ karga ebu nɛ k wɔ kedɛdɛ na be lalaloge to, nɛ baa bɔla kumo to a lar kelɔnɛ so na nseŋ wu fanɛ kumo be mparto daa sa fanɛ ayadra adesa nɛ ana nna. 15To, yili kedɛdɛ na be kabuna to be egbal be kaman to n ya fo ebu nɛ k wɔ kedɛdɛ na be lalaloge to na be nteŋ to kikɛ daa sa fanɛ ayadra aduburwa nɛ ana nna. 16Etokuro wurbi daa wɔ egbal asa nɛ a wɔ bekumpo be ebuana to na nna. Amo alɛ baa du fanɛ amo nɛ a wɔ kabuna to be ebu na to na nna. B daŋ wora abii be ndibi be nduli nna n deŋi kedɛdɛ na be epunto be egbalana so.
Kowushina be kelɔnɛ na be asheŋ
17Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ keta ma m bɔla kedɛdɛ na to n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kowushina be kelɔnɛ na so. Ebu adesa e wɔ kowushina be egbal na to nɛ b ta ajembu n yuu n dulgi kakpa nɛ baa nite na 18n chambɔ kelɔnɛ na kikɛ. Kowushina be kelɔnɛ ere daa wɔ kaseto a chɔ epunto be kelɔnɛ na nna.
19Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na yili kowushina be kelɔnɛ na be kabuna to ŋ karga n ya fo epunto be kelɔnɛ na be kabuna to nɛ k koso fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa.
Kelargato be esoso be kabunagboŋ na be asheŋ
20Kumo be kaman nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ karga kelargato be esoso be kabunagboŋ nɛ k bee bugi a lar kowushina be kelɔnɛ so na. 21Kabunagboŋ ere gba be kedɛdɛ daa kɔ bekumpo be ebu asa kumo be kaba kama so nna. Kanyɛn na ka karga ebuana ere nɛ egbalana nɛ a barga amo to na nɛ kabuna to be ebu na, amo nɛ amo nɛ a wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kabunagboŋ ase na kikɛ daa sasa nna. 22Kelargato be esoso be kabuna to be ebu na nɛ etokuro na nɛ abii be ndibi be nduli nɛ b wora n deŋi egbalana so na kikɛ daa du fanɛ amo nɛ a wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kabunagboŋ ase na nna. Kabuna to be ebu na bee shoŋi bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ na nna nɛ baa dii atemprembi ashunu a yɔ kumo to. 23Kabuna ko daa wɔ kelɔnɛ na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so nɛ baa bɔla kumo to a yɔ epunto be kelɔnɛ na so, fanɛ kananɛ kuko daa wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na. Nɛ kanyɛn na yili kowushina be kabuna na ŋ karga n ya fo epunto be kabuna na ase nɛ kekoso fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa.
Kelargato be kaseto be kabunagboŋ na be asheŋ
24Ade be kaman, nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ ta ma n yɔ kelargato be kaseto na, nɛ n ya wu kabunagboŋ ko gba ndoŋ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e karga kumo be epunto be egbalana na, nɛ kabuna to be ebu na, nɛ amo nɛ amo nɛ a wɔ mbunagboŋ anyɔ na ase na kikɛ sasa. 25Kananɛ ebuana nɛ a wɔ mbunagboŋ anyɔ na ase na kɔ etokuro na nɛ ade gba kɔ. Kabunagboŋ ere be nteŋ to daa sa fanɛ ayadra aduburwa nɛ ana nna nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ daa sa fanɛ ayadra adena nɛ anyɔ. 26Atemprembi ashunu nɛ baa dii a yɔ kabunagboŋ ere ase. Ebu nɛ k wɔ kumo be kabuna to ashi kumo be lalaloge to na malɛ kilgi anishito n shoŋi bɔrɛlambu na be kelɔnɛ so nna. B daŋ wora abii be ndibi be nduli n deŋi kedɛdɛ na be epunto be egbalana na so nna. 27Nfe gba daa kɔ kabuna a laŋɛ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nna nɛ k bee bugi a yɔ epunto be kelɔnɛ na so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na yili kowushina be kabuna na ŋ karga n ya fo epunto be kabuna na ase, nɛ k sa fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa.
Epun to be kelɔnɛ na be mbunagboŋ na be asheŋ
28Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ keta ma m bɔla kelargato be kaseto be kabunagboŋ na to n luri epunto be kelɔnɛ na to nseŋ ya karga kabunagboŋ na. Kumo nɛ kowushina be kabunagboŋ na kikɛ sasa nna. 29-30Kumo be bekumpo be ebuana nɛ kabuna to be ebu na nɛ egbalana nɛ a bee barga ebuana na to na kikɛ daa du fanɛ amo nɛ a wɔ mbunagboŋ nɛ a ka ase na nna. Ebuana na gba daa kɔ etokuro nna. Kabunagboŋ ere gba be nteŋ daa la fanɛ ayadra aduburwa nɛ ana nna nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ daa la fanɛ ayadra adena nɛ anyɔ. 31Ebu nɛ k wɔ kumo be kabuna to na daŋ kilgi anishito n shoŋi kowushina be kelɔnɛ na nna. Atemprembi aburwa nɛ baa dii a yɔ kabunagboŋ ere ase.
Epeŋilarkpa be Kabunagboŋ na be asheŋ
32Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ ta ma m bɔla epeŋilarkpa be kabunagboŋ na to n yɔ epunto be kelɔnɛ na so nseŋ ya karga kabuna to na. Kumo nɛ amo nɛ a ka na kikɛ sasa nna. 33Kumo alɛ be bekumpo be ebuana, nɛ kabuna to be ebu na, nɛ egbalana nɛ a barga ebuana na to na, nɛ amo braana nɛ a wɔ mbunagboŋ nɛ a ka na ase na kikɛ la kukoŋwule nna. Kumo alɛ gba be bekumpo be ebuana na nɛ kabuna to be ebu na daa kɔ etokuro nna n chambɔ. Kumo be nteŋ to kikɛ koso ayadra aduburwa nɛ ana nɛ mparto kikɛ koso ayadra adena nɛ anyɔ nna. 34Ebu nɛ k wɔ kumo be kabuna to na daŋ kilgi n shoŋi kowushina be kelɔnɛ na nna nɛ b wora abii be ndibi be nduli n deŋi kedɛdɛ na be egbalana so. Atempreŋ aburwa nɛ baa dii so a yɔ kabunagboŋ ere ase.
Kelargato be esoso be kabunagboŋ na be asheŋ
35Kede be kaman, nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ keta ma n yɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so be kabunagboŋ na ase nseŋ ya karga kumo. Kumo nɛ amo nɛ a ka na kikɛ daa sasa nna. 36Kumo alɛ gba daa kɔ bekumpo be ebuana nɛ egbalana nɛ b wora abii be ndibi be nduli n deŋi amo so nɛ kabuna to be ebu nɛ etokuro n chambɔ kumo fanɛ kelargato be kaseto be kabunagboŋ na gbagba nna chap. Kumo be nteŋ to daa la fanɛ ayadra aduburwa nɛ ana nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ daa la fanɛ ayadra adena nɛ anyɔ. 37Ebu nɛ k wɔ kumo be kabuna to na daŋ kilgi n shoŋi kowushina be kelɔnɛ na nna, nɛ b wora abii be ndibi be nduli n deŋi kedɛdɛ na be egbalana na so. Atemprembi aburwa nɛ baa dii so a yɔ kabunagboŋ ere ase.
Sarga be asɔbɔya be ebuana be asheŋ
38Ebubiana ko daŋ mata kedɛdɛ nɛ k wɔ epunto be mbunagboŋ na be kekama na ase nna nɛ baa fɔr sarga chɔɔso be asɔbɔya so amo to. 39Eteebɔl ana e daa wɔ ebubi ere to. Amo be anyɔ daa yil kaba ko so nna nɛ anyɔ nɛ a ka malɛ daa yil kaba nyɔsopo so nɛ b daa mɔ esarga chɔɔso ŋko kulubi be sarga ŋko kewora n jija be sarga be asɔbɔya amo so. 40Eteebɔl ana ko gba daa wɔ kowushina be kelɔnɛ na to. Amo be anyɔ daa yil atemprembi nɛ a dese a yɔ kabunagboŋ nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso na be kaba ko so nna nɛ anyɔ malɛ yil kaba nyɔsopo so. 41Eteebɔl aburwa e daa wɔtɔ nɛ b daa mɔ asɔbɔya nɛ baa ta a lara esarga na amo so. Amo be ana daa yil ebubi na to nna nɛ ana nɛ a ka malɛ daa yil kowu ashi kelɔnɛ na so. 42Ajembu nɛ b daŋ shɛl n lɔŋɛ eteebɔl ana nɛ a daa yil ebubi na to, nsaa ta asɔbɔya nɛ baa ta a lara esarga chɔɔso na a deŋi amo so a bɛ. Amo be jeŋgreŋ daŋ fo fanɛ keyadra koŋwule nɛ bargato nɛ amo be esoso be mparto malɛ be mba ana na be kekama daa la ayadra anyɔ nɛ bargato. Nsaŋɛ nɛ asɔ kama nɛ b kɔ a mɔ nsaa bɛ esarga be asɔbɔya na kikɛ daa deŋ eteebɔl ere so nna. 43B daŋ gbir ayir nɛ amo be nteŋ fo fanɛ enɔ be mparto egbalana na so nna ŋ kulti ebuana na to. Eteebɔl na malɛ so nɛ b daa ta esargablaŋ na a deŋi so.
Bɔrɛmatapoana na be ebuana be asheŋ
44Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ keta ma n luri epunto be kelɔnɛ na to nɛ n ya wu ebu anyɔ ko nɛ amo be mbuna daa bugi a yɔ epunto be kelɔnɛ na so. Kuko daa wɔ kabunagboŋ nɛ k wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so na ase nseŋ kilgi n shoŋi kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nna, nɛ kenyɔsopo malɛ wɔ kabunagboŋ nɛ k wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na ase nseŋ kilgi n shoŋi kelargato be esoso be kaba so. 45Nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ ma fanɛ ebu nɛ kumo be anishito bee shoŋi kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to na peya nna, 46nɛ kumo nɛ kumo alɛ be anishito be shoŋi kelargato be esoso be kaba so na malɛ la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ baa shuŋ bɔrɛsure na ase na peya. Zadɔk be kabuna ebi nɛ b shi Livai be yiri to na nawule e kɔ ekpa nɛ b shuŋ bɔrɛmatapoana be kushuŋ n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na.
Epunto be kelɔnɛ na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be asheŋ
47Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ karga epunto be kelɔnɛ na. Kumo be mba ana na be kekama daa la ayadra kalfa nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa nna. Bɔrɛsure na daa wɔ bɔrɛlambu nɛ k daa wɔ kelɔnɛ na be epeŋitɔrkpa na be anishito nna. 48Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ keta ma n luri bɔrɛlambu na be kedɛdɛ na to nseŋ ya karga kumo be kabuna to na. Kumo be jeŋgreŋ daa sa fanɛ ayadra akpanu nna nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ daa sa fanɛ ayadra adunyɔ nɛ ana. 49Atemprembi nɛ b daa bɔla so a dii a yɔ kedɛdɛ na so. Kedɛdɛ na be mparto daa sa fanɛ ayadra adesa nɛ ana nna nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ daa sa fanɛ ayadra adunyɔ nna. Eshabɔrɛ malɛ daŋ bɛ abar so kedɛdɛ na be mba anyɔ na kikɛ so nna n ya fo kumo be ekar.

Title: EZIKƐL 41
Content:
1Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ keta ma n luri bɔrɛlambu na be ebu nɛ baa tre kakpa cheembi to. Nseŋ karga kumo be kedɛdɛ na, nɛ kumo be mparto daa sa fanɛ ayadra kudu, 2nɛ kumo be nteŋ to malɛ daa sa fanɛ ayadra kuduaburwa. Yili kumo be kabuna to n yɔ egbalana nɛ a wɔ kumo be mba anyɔ na be kekama ase daa sa fanɛ ayadra kudu anyɔ nna. Kumo be kaman, nɛ e karga ebu na gbagba, nɛ kumo be nteŋ daa sa fanɛ ayadra adushunu, nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ daa sa fanɛ ayadra adesa nɛ aburwa. 3Kanyɛn na ka karga ndoŋ n loge, nɛ mo nawule yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be ŋkpar to be ebu na to. E daŋ juŋkpar nna ŋ karga kedɛdɛ nɛ baa bɔla to a yɔ kumo to na, nɛ kumo be mparto daa sa fanɛ ayadra asa nɛ egbalana nɛ a wɔ kumo be akel to na be kekama be nteŋ to daa sa fanɛ ayadra kudu anyɔ. 4E ka loge, nɛ e karga ŋkpar to be ebu na gbagba; nɛ kumo be kaba kama so daa sa fanɛ ayadra adesa nɛ ana. Ebu ere daa wɔ nferinto be ebu na be anishito nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi nna na.”
Ebuana nɛ baa ta asɔ a yili to na be asheŋ
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ karga bɔrɛlambu na be egbal na be pentren nɛ k daa sa fanɛ ayadra kudu. B daŋ pɔr asɔ be ebuana nna nɛ amo be kekama be mparto daa sa fanɛ ayadra ashunu, m mata bɔrɛlambu na be egbal na ŋ kulti. 6Ebuana ere daa wɔ ntuŋ asa nna nseŋ bɛ abar so asa asa n yɔ awɔlto, nɛ katuŋ kama daa kɔ ebu adesa nsaa yil egbal nɛ k kulti bɔrɛlambu na so. Bɔrɛlambu na be esoso be ebuana na be egbalana daa maŋ danto n fo kaseto be ebuana peya so, saŋɛ na so ebuana na beeŋ tiŋ n yili egbalana na so nɛ shɛŋ maŋ suse amo to. 7Egbalana nɛ a kulti bɔrɛlambu na daa du pentren kaseto a chɔ esoso nna, a ŋini fanɛ esoso be ebuana na be epunto daŋ kpalga to a chɔ kaseto peya na. B daŋ pɔr atemprembi nna a dii so a yɔ nferinto nɛ awɔlto be asɔ be ebuana na to. 8Bɔrɛlambu na daa yil kejembu nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ daa sa fanɛ ayadra kudu nna. Kumo koŋwule na so nɛ ebuana na gba daa yil. 9Ebuana na be kaman to be egbalana na be pentren daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra aburwa. Efuli nɛ k daŋ dese egbalana ere 10nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na be ebuana be kefɛato be mparto daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra adesa nɛ ana. 11Kabuna koŋwule daa bugi nna a yɔ asɔ be ebuana nɛ a wɔ a laŋɛ kelargato be esoso be kaba so nna nɛ kuko malɛ daa bugi a yɔ amo nɛ a wɔ a laŋɛ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na. Kejembu nɛ bɔrɛlambu na daa yil so na daŋ dese nna m baŋ ebuana na be kaman to be egbalana na so n fo fanɛ ayadra aburwa be mparto ŋ kulti bɔrɛlambu na.
Epeŋitɔrkpa be kowu na be asheŋ
12Kede be kaman, nɛ n naŋ wu kowu ko. K daŋ kilgi nna n shoŋi bɔrɛlambu na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nɛ kumo be nteŋ to daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ adunu nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ kuduashe. Kumo be egbal malɛ be pentren daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra akpanu.
Kananɛ bɔrɛlambu na kikɛ sa be asheŋ
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na karga bɔrɛlambu na be nteŋ to nɛ k fo fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa. Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ yili kumo be kaman to be egbal na ase ŋ karga m bɔla kumo be kaman to be kelɔnɛ na so m ba choŋ ebu nɛ k wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa na be kaman to be egbal na, nɛ kumo alɛ gba fo fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa. 14E ka karga bɔrɛlambu na be anishito nɛ alɔnɛ nɛ a dese kumo be mba anyɔ na ase kikɛ nɛ kumo alɛ gba fo fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa. 15Kumo be lalaloge nɛ e karga kowu nɛ k wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na nɛ adɛdɛ nɛ a wɔ kumo be mba anyɔ na kikɛ be nteŋ to nɛ a fo fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa.
Kananɛ bɔrɛlambu na be epunto du be asheŋ
B daŋ yili kasawule nna ŋ gbir ndibi m mata abar ashi kedɛdɛ nɛ k wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna to na nɛ Kakpa cheembi na nɛ acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na 16kikɛ be epunto be egbalana na so hale n ya fo etokuro na. Ndibi na daa beeŋ tiŋ m buu etokuro na so gba kuraa. 17Bumo alɛ daŋ naŋ shɛl asɔ be nduli nna m mata m mata bɔrɛlambu na be epunto kikɛ, hale kumo be akuloŋ be awɔlto kikɛ. 18Abii be ndibi nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ a kɔ aba fanɛ mbuibi be nduli nɛ b daŋ shɛl n deŋi egbalana na so. B baŋ shɛl abii be kedibi be nduli koŋwule n deŋi egbal so, b naa shɛl kusɔbɔya nɛ k kɔ aba fanɛ kabuibi na be nduli nna m bɛ so. Asɔbɔya be nduli na malɛ be kekama kɔ anishito anyɔ nna. 19-20B daa kɔ dimɛdi be anishito nna nɛ k bee keni abii be kedibi be nduli ko kaba ko so nseŋ naa kɔ buluŋ be anishito nɛ kumo alɛ bee keni abii be kedibi be nduli ko kaba pɔtɛ so. Aloŋ nɛ b daŋ yili kasawule n wora amo n ya fo akuloŋ na be awɔlto n deŋi egbalana na so ŋ kulti. 21Kakpa cheembi be kukuloŋ na be jeŋgreŋ nɛ mparto kikɛ daa sasa nna.
Ndibi be bɔrɛsure be asheŋ
Kusɔ ko daa yil acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na be kabuna to n duli 22bɔrɛsure nɛ b ta ndibi wora nna. Kumo be jeŋgreŋ daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra anu nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra ana. Ndibi nɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ kumo be kaplɛkama. Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ ma le “Kede la kanyiŋi nna fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na bee keni mbe bɔrɛlambu so jemanɛ kikɛ nna.”
Bɔrɛlambu na be mbuna be asheŋ
23Kabuna ko daa wɔ kakpa nɛ baa bɔla a yɔ kakpa cheembi to nna nɛ kuko malɛ gba daa wɔ kakpa nɛ baa bɔla a yɔ acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to. 24Kabuna kama malɛ daa kɔ akuloŋ anyɔ nna. 25B daŋ shɛl abii be ndibi nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ a kɔ aba fanɛ mbuibi na be nduli nna n deŋi kakpa cheembi be mbunaana na so fanɛ kananɛ b wora n deŋi egbalana na so na. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta ndibi n ti kedɛdɛ na be kabuna ashi kowushina. 26Kedɛdɛ na be akel to be egbalana na daa kɔ etokuro wurbi nna, nɛ b naŋ shɛl abii be ndibi be nduli n deŋi kumo alɛ gba be egbalana na so.

Title: EZIKƐL 42
Content:
Bɔrɛmatapoana be ebuana be asheŋ
1Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ kanyɛn na ta ma n luri kowushina be kelɔnɛ na to nseŋ juŋkpar nɛ m bɛ mo so nɛ an yɔ kowu ko nɛ k wɔ a laŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kelargato be esoso be kaba so ase. Kumo nɛ kowu nɛ k wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be epeŋitɔrkpa na daa maŋ barga abar ga. 2Kowu ere be nteŋ to daa sa fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa nna nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ daa sa fanɛ ayadra aduburwa nɛ ana. 3Kowu na be kaba ko daŋ kilgi n shoŋi efuli ko nɛ k dese bɔrɛlambu na ase nɛ kumo be mparto daa sa fanɛ ayadra adesa nɛ ana, nɛ kaba ko malɛ bee shoŋi ekpabi nɛ k chambɔ kowushina be kelɔnɛ na. B daŋ pɔr ebuana na nna m bɛ abar so esoso, nɛ kekama nɛ k bɛ kumo barkasa so na laŋɛ kaman a chɔ kumo nɛ k wɔ kaseto na. 4Kedɛdɛ daa wɔ a laŋɛ kowu ere be kelargato be esoso be kaba so nna nɛ kumo be mparto daa sa fanɛ ayadra kuduashe, nɛ kumo be nteŋ to malɛ daa sa fanɛ ayadra kalfa nɛ adeshe nɛ aburwa. Kumo be mbuna daa bugi a yɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so nna. 5Ebuana nɛ a wɔ kowu ere be awɔlto gbagba na daa maŋ wɔ mpar n fo nferinto peya na so. Nferinto peya na malɛ daa maŋ naa wɔ mpar n fo kaseto peya na so. 6Kowu na be ebuana nɛ a wɔ kaseto na e daa kɔ amo nɛ a wɔ esoso na to a yil, amoso esoso peya na daa maa kɔ eshabɔrɛ fanɛ nwu nɛ a ka a wɔ kelɔnɛ na so na. 7-8Kowu na be kaseto na be bargato daa la egbal nawule nna nɛ egbal na be nteŋ to daa sa fanɛ ayadra aduburwa nɛ ana, nɛ kumo be bargato nɛ k ka na malɛ daa la ebuana. Kumo be awɔlto na bre kikɛ daa la ebuana nna n ya fo kumo be ekar. 9-10Ebu anyɔ nɛ a wɔ kowu na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na be kaseto daa kɔ kabuna nɛ k bee bugi a lar kowushina be kelɔnɛ na so nna.
Kowu ko nɛ k duli kowu ere daa yil bɔrɛlambu na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nna nɛ kumo nɛ kowu nɛ k yil bɔrɛlambu na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na maŋ barga abar ga. 11Nwuana ere be ebuana nɛ amo nɛ a yil kelargato be esoso be kaba so na maŋ kɔr abar to. Amo be nteŋ to nɛ mparto nɛ kananɛ b pɔr amo nɛ amo be mbuna kikɛ daŋ duli abar nna. Kedɛdɛ ko malɛ daa wɔ amo alɛ gba be anishito nna. 12Amo be akuloŋ daa shoŋi egbal nɛ k yil amo be anishito na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nna.
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ ma le: “Nwu anyɔ ere kikɛ la mboŋ cheembi nna. Amo to nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ baa luri a yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito na beeŋ baa chena a ji esargajibi cheembi na. Ebuana na ka du cheembi so, ndoŋ nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na beeŋ baa ta ayu be esarga nɛ alubi be esarga nɛ kewora n jija be esarga cheembiana na a wɔtɔ. 14Bɔrɛmatapoana na baa sha kelar bɔrɛlambu na to n yɔ kowushina be kelɔnɛ na so, a daga fanɛ b bɔla ebuana na ere to n lara bumo be asɔbuuso nɛ b buu n yɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be anishito na n nase ndoŋ pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta asɔbuuso pɔtɛ m buu n lar.”
B ka karga bɔrɛlambu na be kowushina be asheŋ
15Kanyɛn na ka karga bɔrɛlambu na be epunto kikɛ n loge, nɛ e keta ma m bɔla kabunagboŋ nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na to n lar nseŋ ya karga kumo be kowushina na kikɛ ŋ kulti. 16E daŋ ta kekpabi karga asɔ na nna ŋ karga bɔrɛlambu na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na. Kumo be nteŋ to daa sa fanɛ ayadra alfa aburwa nɛ adena nna. 17-19Ndoŋ nna nɛ e naŋ karga kumo be kelargato be esoso nɛ kaseto nɛ epeŋitɔrkpa be mbaana na kebɛso kebɛso. Kekama be nteŋ to daa sa fanɛ ayadra alfa aburwa nɛ ana nna, 20a ŋini fanɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kakpa nɛ egbal na kulti na be kaba kama so daa sa fanɛ ayadra alfa aburwa nɛ adena nna. Egbal na daa barga mboŋ cheembi na nɛ amo nɛ a maŋ du cheembi na to nna.

Title: EZIKƐL 43
Content:
Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura ka bɛta m ba bɔrɛlambu na to be asheŋ
1Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ kanyɛn na keta ma n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kabunagboŋ nɛ k shoŋi epeŋilarkpa na ase. 2Ndoŋ nɛ n wu Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura ka bee nyɛkpɛ pɛlpɛl n shi epeŋilarkpa a ba, nɛ Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl gbir fanɛ teku ka bee baga to na. Kusɔ kama nɛ k daa wɔ ndoŋ gba daŋ fulto nna a nyɛkpɛ. 3Bɔrɛdare nɛ n wu ere daa du fanɛ amo nɛ n daŋ wu jemanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ba nɛ e ba mur kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Jerusalɛm na nna nɛ jemanɛ nɛ n daa wɔ lɔr nɛ baa tre Kɛba na ase na nna. Ndoŋ nna nɛ n ta enɔ m buu anishi so nseŋ kurgi kumu n yuu to epul na to. 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ kefulto nɛ k bee ŋini Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura na bɔla kabunagboŋ nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na to n luri bɔrɛlambu na to.
5Kumo be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be Kiyoyu keta ma n luri bɔrɛlambu na be laŋ be epunto be kelɔnɛ so nɛ n ya wu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kemaŋkura sɔ bɔrɛlambu na to kikɛ. 6Ma nɛ kanyɛn na yil nna nɛ n nu Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ka shi bɔrɛlambu na to ŋ kaŋɛ ma le: 7“Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, ma kuwurputi be kakpa nna na. Meeŋ baa wɔ Israɛl be basa nɛ b la ma basa ere to a ji kuwura bumo so hale mbaanaayɔ. Israɛl be basa ŋko bumo be bewuraana maaŋ naŋ shuŋ agbirana ŋko n wora kanyiŋi be asɔ nɛ a bee ŋaba ma ketre cheembi na n yili nfe n sa bumo be bewura nɛ b wu na. 8Israɛl be bewura daŋ pɔr bumo be ewurkpaana nna m mata ma bɔrɛlambu cheembi na ga. Egbal e daa wɔ ma nɛ bumo be nferinto. B daa wora asheŋ jiga nna a ŋaba ma ketre cheembi na, amoso nɛ n daŋ nya agbo m mur bumo na. 9Naniere a daga fanɛ b yige kagbirshuŋ nseŋ lara bumo be bewuraana nɛ b wu na be kanyiŋi be asɔ nɛ b pɔr n yili na. Nɛ b wora loŋ, meeŋ ba ka wɔ bumo to mbaanaayɔ.”
10Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Dimɛdi pibi, kute bɔrɛlambu na be asheŋ n sa Israɛl be basa na nɛ nyɔmɔ e pɛ bumo ŋkpal bumo be asheŋ lubi so. Kumo be kaman nɛ fo shin nɛ b fɛ kumo be kananɛ k du be asheŋ. 11Nɛ fanɛ bumo be asheŋ woraso kaŋ pɛ bumo nyɔmɔ nɛ bumo be ŋgbene jija bumo, fo bugi kananɛ bɔrɛlambu na du na be asheŋ to n sa bumo. Kute kumo be mbuna nɛ kananɛ k dese nɛ kumo to be asɔ be asheŋ nɛ mbraana nɛ a wɔtɔ a laŋɛ kumo be kaplɛa so be asheŋ n sa bumo. Fo alɛ e sibɛ ade kikɛ n nase n sa bumo saŋɛ na so baaŋ wu kananɛ kusɔ kama dese nseŋ tiŋ n wora m bɛ mbraana na so. 12Mbra nɛ k dese a laŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na be kaplɛa so e la fanɛ, kaboŋ nɛ k kulti kumo ashi kebee na be awɔlto na kikɛ la kakpa cheembi gbagba nna.”
Bɔrɛsure na be asheŋ
13Kananɛ ekama nyi b kaa bee karga asɔ ashi bɔrɛlambu to na nɛ b yili so ŋ karga bɔrɛsure na. Le nɛ k daa sa. Kemaŋ ko nɛ kumo be nchiŋ daa sa fanɛ keyadra koŋwule nɛ bargato nɛ kumo be mparto gba daa sa fanɛ keyadra koŋwule nɛ bargato e daŋ kulti kumo. Kumo be ekarso be kananɛ k du kulkulbi na malɛ daŋ ka gbrɛ nɛ k fo keyadra koŋwule nna. 14Bɔrɛsure na be gbaltɔlase na be jeŋgreŋ daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra ana nna. Nɛ kumo be kaba nɛ k bɛ gbaltɔlase na so na be jeŋgreŋ malɛ daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra ashunu. B daŋ yili gbaltɔlase na be ekarso nna n firgi n yɔ anishito fanɛ keyadra koŋwule nɛ barga pɔɛŋ nseŋ pɔr bɔrɛsure m bɛ kumo so. Kumo be kaman, nɛ b naŋ firgi n yɔ anishito fanɛ keyadra koŋwule nɛ bargato ashi kumo alɛ gba so ŋ kulti pɔɛŋ nseŋ pɔr bɔrɛsure be kaba nyɔsopo m bɛ so. 15Bɔrɛsure nɛ k bɛ so esoso na so nɛ b daa ta esarga na a deŋi so a chɔɔ. Kumo alɛ daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra ashunu. Kumo be akel to be nnɔso ana na daŋ dii a chɔ kumo be esoso na kikɛ nseŋ daŋ duli gbolu be alambɛ. 16Bɔrɛsure na be esoso na be mba ana na kikɛ daa sasa nna. Kaba kama so be nteŋ to daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra adunyɔ nna. 17Kumo be nferinto na gba be mba ana na kikɛ daa sasa nna. Kaba kama daŋ fo fanɛ ayadra adunyɔ nɛ ana nna, nɛ kumo be ekarso ŋ kulti malɛ be jeŋgreŋ daŋ ka gbrɛ nɛ k fo keyadra koŋwule. Atemprembi nɛ baa dii so a yɔ bɔrɛsure na be esoso na daa wɔ a laŋɛ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nna.
B ka ta bɔrɛsure na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ be asheŋ
18Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, nu kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo ere. B kaŋ pɔr bɔrɛsure na n loge, menyeeŋ mɔ asɔbɔya n lara esarga kumo so, nseŋ ta ŋklaŋ na ŋ ŋmenyaŋ kumo so a ŋini fanɛ men ta kumo m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nna na. 19Bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi Livai be yiri to nsaa la kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Zadɔk na be kanaŋ to be basa nawule e naŋ tiŋ m ba ma anishi to m ba shuŋ ma. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na be mbra nna na. Menyeeŋ sa bumo gbolu fɔlbi nɛ b ta n lara kulubi be sarga. 20Kumo be kaman, nɛ b suse kusɔbɔya na be ŋklaŋ ŋ gbiti bɔrɛsure na be akel to be nnɔso ana na so nɛ kumo be nferinto gba peya so nɛ kumo be ekarso kikɛ ŋ kulti. Kananɛ menyeeŋ wora nɛ k nyalɛ so nsaa la kusɔ nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ a lara esarga kumo so a sa ma nna na. 21Kede be kaman, nɛ men ta gbolu nɛ b ta n lara kulubi be sarga na n lar ekarso n ya chɔɔ ashi kakpa nɛ k maŋ mata bɔrɛlambu na ase, nɛ b lara ndoŋ n yili a chɔɔ kulubi be esarga. 22Kumo be ŋklade nɛ men ta kaboenyɛnso nɛ doro kikɛ maŋ wɔ kumo so n lara kulubi be sarga. Menyeeŋ ta kumo be ŋklaŋ n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure na so fanɛ kananɛ men ta gbolu na be ŋklaŋ n wora na. 23Men kaŋ wora loŋ n loge, nɛ men ta gbolu fɔlbi nɛ kpakpafɔlbi nɛ amo be kekama maŋ kɔ doro kikɛ kumo so 24m ba sa ma. Bɔrɛmatapoana na beeŋ mɔ amo nseŋ wora nfɔl n fur amo so n chɔɔ amo n lara sarga n sa ma. 25Karechɛ kama menyeeŋ baa ta kaboe nɛ gbolu nɛ kpakpa nɛ amo be kekama maŋ kɔ doro kikɛ amo so na a lara kulubi be sarga hale nɛ nchɛ ashunu e ya fo. 26Nchɛ ashunu nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na beeŋ ta n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛsure na so nɛ k nyalɛ so n sa ma. 27Nchɛ ashunu na kaŋ choŋ, bɔrɛmatapoana na beeŋ fara a lara esarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be esarga bɔrɛsure na so. Saŋɛ na so nɛ ma kagbene e fuli Israɛl be basa so. Kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ nna na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 44
Content:
Epeŋilarkpa be kabunagboŋ na be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ keta ma n yɔ kowushina be kelɔnɛ na so a mata bɔrɛlambu na be kabunagboŋ nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na. Nɛ n wu fanɛ kumo be akuloŋ na daŋ ti nna. 2Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Kabuna ere nɛ ma Enyɛnpe, Israɛl be Ebɔrɛ na bɔla to n luri bɔrɛlambu na to, amoso, a daga fanɛ k baŋ ti loŋ mbaanaayɔ! Esa kama e sa maŋ naŋ bɔla kumo to n luri kikɛ. 3Israɛl be ewura beeŋ tiŋ m ba nfe m ba ji ajibi nɛ b ta n lara sarga n sa ma, ama a daga fanɛ e bɔla kabunagboŋ ere be kedɛdɛ na to nna n luri ŋko n lar.”
Basa nɛ b maŋ daga keluri bɔrɛlambu na to be asheŋ
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na keta ma m bɔla kelargato be esoso be kabuna na to n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be anishito nɛ n to kenishi ŋ keni nseŋ wu fanɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura bɔlɔ bɔrɛlambu na to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ n ta ma enɔana m buu ma anishi so nseŋ kurgi kumu n yuu to.
5Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, shin nɛ fo lakal e baa wɔ kusɔ kama nɛ feeŋ wu nsaa nu ashi nfe so. Mbraana nɛ a wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ mee sha kekaŋɛ fo na. Baa de so nɛnɛ a nyi basa nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n luri nɛ bumo nɛ b maaŋ tiŋ n luri bɔrɛlambu na to. 6Kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b kini ma nseŋ lar ma kaman na fanɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na maŋ naa ba nɛ n sɔ ekishisheŋ nɛ baa wora na kikɛ. 7B wora eyurpisheŋ n jija ma bɔrɛlambu ŋkpal b ka shin nɛ befɔ nɛ b maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ luri kumo to jemanɛ nɛ baa lara esarga a sa ma na so. Amoso, ma basa wora kulubi nseŋ da ma nɛ bumo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na so. 8Bumo gbagba ka beeŋ baa wora asɔ nɛ a daga a laŋɛ esarga cheembi na kaplɛa so ashi bɔrɛlambu na to so na, befɔ nɛ b ta loŋ be kushuŋ nna n sa.
9Amoso kusɔ nɛ ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na, bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ efɔ kama nɛ e maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa maa nu a sa ma maŋ daga keluri ma bɔrɛlambu to, hale efɔ nɛ e chena Israɛl be basa na to gba maŋ daga keluri kumo to.”
Livaiebi ko kaa nya kasogberge be asheŋ
10Kede be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Mee sha kegberge Livaiebi nɛ b tu Israɛl be basa na ŋ kini ma nseŋ ya shuŋ agbirana na kusoe nna na. 11B kraa beeŋ tiŋ a shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to fanɛ basa nɛ baa keni mbunaana na so nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n chɛ basa na to m mɔ asɔbɔya nɛ b ta a lara esarga na. 12Ama ŋkpal Livaiebi ere ka chɛ Israɛl be basa na to jemanɛ nɛ b daa shuŋ agbirana na so, ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na bee nase kɔnɔ nna fanɛ Livaiebi na beeŋ nya kasogberge. 13B maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n shuŋ ma fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana ŋko n yɔ ma kusɔ cheembi kama ase ŋko n luri bɔrɛlambu na to be acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to. Ekishisheŋ nɛ b wora na be kasogberge nna na. 14Ashuŋ kpakpaso nawule nɛ mee sa bumo ekpa fanɛ b baa shuŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to.”
Mbraana nɛ a wɔtɔ n sa bɔrɛmatapoana be asheŋ
15Kumo be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Livai be yiri to be bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Zadɔk na be kabuna na bre daŋ maŋ kini ma kushuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to nseŋ ya shuŋ agbirana jemanɛ nɛ Israɛl be basa na daŋ kini ma na. Amoso bumo e naŋ tiŋ m ba ma anishi to m ba shuŋ ma fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nseŋ ta asɔbɔya be nfɔ nɛ ŋklaŋ n lara esarga. 16Zadɔk be kabuna ebi na nawule e naŋ tiŋ n luri bɔrɛlambu na to n shuŋ bɔrɛsure na ase nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n juŋkpar basa nɛ baa shuŋ ma na. 17A daga fanɛ b buu bɔrɛmatapoana be epiŋi lela na nna n luri bɔrɛlambu na be epun to be kelɔnɛ na so. A maŋ daga fanɛ b baa buu asɔbuuso nɛ b ta ateebi n lue jemanɛ nɛ b wɔ kushuŋ to ashi epun to be kelɔnɛ na so ŋko bɔrɛlambu na gbagba to. 18A daga fanɛ b baa buu ago be kechɛbi be asɔbuuso nna nsaa chɛ ago be achɛbi be eneemu, saŋɛ na so b maaŋ baa pa kebleŋ jemanɛ nɛ baa shuŋ bumo be kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ na. 19Pɔɛŋ nɛ b lar n yɔ kowushina be kelɔnɛ na so ashi kakpa nɛ basa wɔ na, a daga fanɛ b lara epiŋi nɛ b buu a shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to na n nase ebu cheembiana na to nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta asɔbuuso pɔtɛ m buu n lar, saŋɛ na so bumo be asɔbuuso cheembi na maaŋ bar tɔrɔ basa so.
20Bɔrɛmatapoana maŋ daga fanɛ b she bumo be emin ŋko n shin nɛ e daŋ tenteŋ. A daga fanɛ b baa digi amo so nna. 21Bɔrɛmatapoana maŋ daga fanɛ b nuu yabra pɔɛŋ nseŋ luri bɔrɛlambu na be epunto be kelɔnɛ na to. 22Bɔrɛmatapowura kikɛ maŋ daga fanɛ e ta eche nɛ mo kul kini mo. A daga fanɛ e ta Israɛl to be eche nɛ e maŋ nyi enyɛn ŋko eche nɛ mo kul daa la bɔrɛmatapo nseŋ wu ŋ ka nawule nna.
23Bɔrɛmatapoana na e daga fanɛ b baa ŋini ma basa kusɔ nɛ k du cheembi nɛ kusɔ nɛ k maŋ du cheembi nseŋ naŋ ŋini bumo kusɔ nɛ k walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so nɛ kusɔ nɛ k maŋ walɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so nɛ b pin amo be mbarga. 24Nɛ kesheŋ ko koso nɛ a daga fanɛ b ji kumo mbra be ekpa so, bɔrɛmatapoana na beeŋ keni ma mbraana so nna n ji kumo. Kananɛ ma mbraana nɛ atande bee ŋini na nɛ baaŋ baa yili so a ji bumo be kabɔrɛshuŋ be nchɛgboŋana, nseŋ shin nɛ Kewushiachɛ na e baa la kachɛ cheembi n sa bumo.
25Bɔrɛmatapowura maŋ daga fanɛ e beta kebuni kikɛ nseŋ wora eyurpi daŋkare be ekpa so, ama k baa la mo tuto ŋko mo nio ŋko mo pibi ŋko mo niopibi nyɛnso ŋko mo niopibi cheso nɛ e maa kil be kebuni nna. 26Kumo be kaman nɛ e ka naŋ nyalɛ so daŋkare be ekpa so, a daga fanɛ e jo nchɛ ashunu pɔɛŋ 27nseŋ yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be epunto be kelɔnɛ na to n ya lara sarga nɛ k beeŋ shin nɛ e nyalɛ so, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ naŋ tiŋ a shuŋ bɔrɛlambu na to. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na, e kaŋɛ na.
28Kebɔrɛmata be kushuŋ na e la bɔrɛmatapoana be kapetɛ nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n yige n sa bumo be kenana. B maŋ daga fanɛ b baa kɔ kapetɛsɔ kikɛ Israɛl to. Ma e la bumo be kapetɛ. 29Ayu be esarga nɛ kulubi be esarga nɛ kewora n jija be esarga kikɛ beeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapoana be asɔ jiso nna. Kumo be kaman, kusɔ kama nɛ b kɛ ma ashi Israɛl to kikɛ gba la bumo peya nna. 30Adɔjibi kama nɛ b juŋkpar n teŋi nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ b ta n sa ma beeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapoana na peya nna. Jemanɛ kikɛ nɛ basa na wora ebodobodo, a daga fanɛ b ta bodobodo nɛ b juŋkpar n wora na n sa bɔrɛmatapoana fanɛ kakɛ nɛ k bee yɔ Ebɔrɛ kutɔ, saŋɛ na so ma nɛfa beeŋ baa wɔ bumo be elaŋana so. 31Bɔrɛmatapoana maŋ daga fanɛ b ji kusɔbɔya ŋko kabuibi nɛ k wu kpi ŋko kumo nɛ kusɔbɔya pɔtɛ mɔ n ji ŋ ka be eblaŋ.”

Title: EZIKƐL 45
Content:
Israɛl be kasawule na be kebarga to be asheŋ
1Nɛ menyi bee barga Israɛl be kasawule na to a sa eyiriana na, men ku kaba n nase n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. Kumo be nteŋ to e baa la emayɛl ashunu nɛ mparto malɛ e baa la emayɛl ashe. Loŋ be kakpa na kikɛ beeŋ baa la kakpa cheembi nna. 2Men ku kaboŋ nɛ kumo be nteŋ to nɛ mparto kikɛ sa fanɛ ayadra alfa aburwa nɛ adena nɛ m pɔr bɔrɛlambu na n yili kumo so. A daga fanɛ kasawule nɛ kumo be mparto sa fanɛ ayadra aduburwa nɛ ana ka dese ŋ kulti kaboŋ na kikɛ. 3Men ku kakpa cheembi na be bargato, nɛ kumo be nteŋ to fo emayɛl ashunu nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ fo emayɛl asa m pɔr bɔrɛlambu na n yili so. Ndoŋ beeŋ baa la kakpa cheembi na kikɛ be acheembiakpa. 4Ndoŋ beeŋ baa la efuli na kikɛ be kakpa cheembi nɛ k dese n sa bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ baa shuŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to na. Bumo be nwu beeŋ baa wɔ kumo be kaba nɛ bɔrɛlambu na malɛ e baa wɔ kumo be kaba. 5Saŋɛ na so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kasawule na be kaba nɛ k ka na e baa dese n sa Livaiebi nɛ baa shuŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to na nɛ b pɔr bumo be ndeana n chena so.
6Kede be kaman nɛ men naŋ ku kasawule nɛ kumo be nteŋ to fo emayɛl ashunu nɛ kumo be mparto malɛ fo mayɛl koŋwule nɛ bargato m bɛ kakpa cheembi na so nɛ b pɔr kadegboŋ nɛ Israɛl be esa kama beeŋ tiŋ n chena kumo to ashi kasawule na so.
Ewura be kasawule be asheŋ
7A daga fanɛ men ku kasawule n nase n sa Israɛl be ewura nɛ k yili kakpa cheembi na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so m ba choŋ Teku nɛ baa tre Mɛditerenia na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na; nseŋ naŋ yili kakpa cheembi na be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so m ba choŋ efuli na be gbaŋ nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na, nɛ kumo be nteŋ to e fo fanɛ mboŋ nɛ menyeeŋ ku n sa Israɛl be eyiriana na be kekama na. 8Kakpa nɛ esa nɛ e bee ji kuwura na beeŋ baa kɔ ashi Israɛl be kasawule so nna na, saŋɛ na so e maaŋ baa nyaŋ basa na, nseŋ shin nɛ efuli na be kasawule nɛ k ka na e baa la Israɛl be eyiriana na peya.
Mbraana nɛ a wɔtɔ n sa ewura na be asheŋ
9Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Fo nɛ fee ji Israɛl so kuwura na wora alubi n chɛr pasaa! Yige fo kebagato nɛ kanyaŋ be asheŋ na nsaa wora kusɔ nɛ k daga nseŋ bɔla ekpa. A maŋ daga fanɛ fo naŋ ju ma basa n lar bumo be kasawule so kikɛ. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e naa kaŋɛ fo le na.
10A maŋ daga fanɛ men baa ta kapuni be asɔ karga asɔ fanɛ ekurwa nɛ b wuse amo be afito nɛ ebɔtɛ wurbi a karga asɔ wɔlso nɛ ekɔlba wurbi nɛ egalɔn wurbi a karga asɔ nɛ a la fanɛ ŋku nɛ nchu a sa basa.
11Ekurwa nɛ ebɔtɛ nɛ ekɔlba nɛ egalɔn nɛ men kɔ a karga asɔ a fa na kikɛ maŋ daga fanɛ a baa la kapuni b kasɔkarga be asɔ. Amo kikɛ daga fanɛ a baa la asɔ nɛ ekama yirda fanɛ amo e la kashenteŋ be asɔ nɛ b kɔ a karga asɔ a fa nna.
12Kusɔ nɛ menyeeŋ baa ta asɔ be egbɛ a ber e la kadɛrbi. Kadɛrbi koŋwule malɛ la fanɛ kilo be bargato malɛ be bargato malɛ be bargato nna.
13A daga fanɛ men barga men be ayu nɛ menyeeŋ teŋi to ntunshe nna nseŋ ta katuŋ koŋwule m ba sa ma fanɛ kakɛ lela. 14Menyeeŋ barga men be ɔlifs be ŋku to ntuŋ kalfa, nseŋ ta katuŋ koŋwule m ba sa ma. Menyeeŋ baa karga amo ekɔlba nɛ egalɔn to nna. Galɔn koŋwule malɛ la ekɔlba ashunu nna. 15Ade be kaman, a daga fanɛ men keni men be mbolpɔ alfa anyɔ kikɛ to n lara ekoŋwule n sa ma.
Menyeeŋ ta ŋkɛana ere n lara ayu be esarga nɛ esarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be esarga n sa ma saŋɛ na so ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be kagbene beeŋ fuli amo so nɛ n ta ma basa be alubi m paŋ bumo.
16Basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule na so na kikɛ beeŋ lara esarga ere m ba sa Israɛl be ewura na. 17Mo e daga fanɛ e yili Israɛl be efuli na kikɛ be katelamu n lara asɔbɔya nɛ baaŋ ta n lara esarga chɔɔso nɛ baaŋ ta n lara ayu be esarga nɛ yabra belbelso be esarga na kikɛ jemanɛ nɛ baa ji Kufɔl Popɔr be Kachɛgboŋ nɛ Kewushiachɛ na nɛ nchɛgboŋ nɛ a ka na kikɛ na. Mo koŋwule na e daga fanɛ e lara asɔbɔya nɛ b ta n lara alubi nɛ ayu nɛ sarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be esarga nɛ e kpra Israɛl be basa be alubi.”
Nchɛgboŋana na be asheŋ
18Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Menyeeŋ ta gbolu nɛ doro kikɛ maŋ wɔ kumo so n lara sarga n lɔŋɛ bɔrɛlambu na so kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ sososo na. 19Bɔrɛmatapowura na beeŋ suse kulubi be sarga be kusɔbɔya na be ŋklaŋ na be ako ŋ gbiti bɔrɛlambu na be akuloŋ be ndibi na nɛ bɔrɛsure na be mba ana na nɛ epunto be kelɔnɛ be akuloŋ be ndibi na. 20Kumo be kaman nɛ men naŋ wora loŋ gbagba kufɔl na be kachɛ shunusopo na, saŋɛ na so nɛ esa ko nɛ e maŋ kute ŋko e maŋ nyi nseŋ wora kulubi beeŋ nya mbe alubi be ketampaŋ. Kananɛ menyeeŋ wora nɛ ma bɔrɛlambu e baa du cheembi nna na.
21Kufɔl juŋkparso na be kachɛ kuduanasopo na nɛ menyeeŋ fara Kebansonchoŋ be Kejigboŋ na be kesheŋ wora. Nchɛnshunu nɛ ekama beeŋ ta n ji bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yisi. 22Ewura na beeŋ mɔ gbolu n lara mo gbagba nɛ basa na kikɛ be alubi be sarga kejigboŋ na be kachɛ sososo na. 23Karechɛ kama, ewura na beeŋ baa mɔ egbolu ashunu nɛ ekpakpa ashunu nɛ e maŋ kɔ doro kikɛ a lara sarga chɔɔso n ya fo nchɛ kachɛ shunusopo nɛ baaŋ ji kejigboŋ na n loge na. Mo alɛ beeŋ naa mɔ kaboenyɛn a lara alubi be sarga karechɛ kikɛ. 24E beeŋ ta ayu cheenshigboŋ be bargato nɛ ɔlifs be ŋku galɔn koŋwule n ti gbolu kama nɛ kpakpa kama nɛ e beeŋ mɔ n lara sarga na so n lara sarga.
25Abuu to be kebaawɔ be Kejigboŋ na bee fara kufɔl shunusopo na be kachɛ kuduanusopo na nseŋ keta loŋ n ya fo nchɛnshunu. Kananɛ ewura na baaŋ lara asɔbɔya nɛ ayu nɛ ɔlifs be ŋku karechɛ kikɛ jemanɛ nɛ b daa ji Kebansonchoŋ be Kejigboŋ na, aloŋ nɛ e beeŋ naŋ lara amo kede gba to.”

Title: EZIKƐL 46
Content:
Ewura na nɛ nchɛgboŋ be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na kaŋɛ le: “A daga fanɛ bɔrɛlambu na be epunto be kelɔnɛ na be kabuna nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na ka ti so nna a yil nchɛnshe nɛ menyee shuŋ na kikɛ, ama men bugi kumo n yili Kewushiachɛ na nɛ Kufɔl popɔr be kachɛ juŋkparso na bre. 2Jemanɛ nɛ bɔrɛmatapo na malɛ bee lara ewura be sarga chɔɔso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be esarga na Israɛl be ewura na beeŋ shi kowushina be kelɔnɛ na so m bɔla kabuna to be ebu na to n luri m ba yili m mata kabunagboŋ na be ndibi na; ŋ gbir m bunyaŋ ma nseŋ bɛta m bɔla kabunagboŋ na to n lar. Kabuna na beeŋ bugi n yili loŋ hale n ya fo kaaseso. 3Kewushiachɛ nɛ Kufɔl popɔr be kachɛ juŋkparso kikɛ, basa na kikɛ daga fanɛ b ba gbir m bunyaŋ ma ashi kabunagboŋ na ase. 4Ewura na beeŋ bar mbolpɔ fɔlbi ashe nɛ kpakpa nɛ e maŋ kɔ doro kikɛ m ba lara sarga chɔɔso kewushiachɛ na. 5E beeŋ ta ayu cheenshigboŋ be bargato n ti kpakpa kama so nseŋ ta kusɔ kama nɛ e bee sha n ti mbolpɔ fɔlbi na be kekama so nna m ba. Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ ta ɔlifs be ŋku galɔn koŋwule n ti ayu cheenshigboŋ be bargato na so nna m ba. 6Kufɔl popɔr be kachɛgboŋachɛ na bre, ewura na beeŋ lara gbolu fɔlbi nɛ mbolpɔ fɔlbi ashe nɛ kpakpa nɛ e maŋ kɔ doro kikɛ nna. 7Ewura na beeŋ ta ayu cheenshigboŋ be bargato n ti gbolu nɛ kpakpa kama nɛ e lara na so nseŋ ta kusɔ kama nɛ e bee sha n ti mbolpɔ fɔlbi na be kekama malɛ so m ba. A daga fanɛ e ta ɔlifs be ŋku galɔn koŋwule n ti ayu cheenshigboŋ be bargato kama nɛ e beeŋ bar na so nna m ba. 8Ekpa nɛ ewura na beeŋ bɔla n luri kabuna to be ebu nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kabunagboŋ ase na to na so nɛ e beeŋ bɔla so n lar kumo to.
9Ama jemanɛ kama nɛ basa na ba nɛ b ba bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na nchɛgboŋana na be kekama to, bekama nɛ baaŋ bɔla kelargato be esoso be kaba so be kabunagboŋ na to n luri na daga fanɛ b bɔla kelargato be kaseto be kaba so be kabunagboŋ na to nna n lar. Ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ naŋ bɔla kabuna nɛ e bɔla to n luri na to n lar, ama kabuna nɛ k wɔ kumo nɛ e bɔla to n luri na be kaba ndoŋ na. 10Jemanɛ nɛ basa na bee luri na a daga fanɛ ewura na gba e luri nseŋ na ŋ lar jemanɛ nɛ basa na naa lar na. 11Kejigboŋachɛ nɛ nchɛgboŋachɛ kikɛ, ayu cheenshigboŋ be bargato nɛ esa bee ta a ti gbolu ŋko kpakpa kikɛ so a lara sarga, nsaa ta kusɔ kama nɛ e bee sha a ti mbolpɔ fɔlbi na be kekama malɛ so a lara sarga. Amo be kaman nɛ e ta ɔlifs be ŋku galɔn koŋwule n ti ayu cheenshigboŋ be bargato na so m ba.
12Kede be kaman nɛ ewura na bee sha kelara mo gbagba be keparso be sarga chɔɔso ŋko kɔnɔkoŋwule be sarga n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na baŋ bugi bɔrɛlambu na be epunto be kelɔnɛ na be kabunagboŋ nɛ k wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so na n sa mo nɛ e luri. Kananɛ e baa lara Kewushiachɛ be esarga na nɛ e beeŋ lara kede gba. E kaŋ wora n loge nseŋ lar na nɛ b ti kabunagboŋ na.”
Karechɛ kikɛ be esarga be asheŋ
13Ade be kaman nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kachipurso kikɛ a daga fanɛ men bar kubɔlpo fɔlbi nɛ k ji kafɛ koŋwule nɛ doro kikɛ maŋ wɔ kumo so m ba lara sarga chɔɔso n sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na. 14Menyi alɛ kraa beeŋ bar nyifu lela fanɛ kurwa anu nɛ ɔlifs be ŋku kɔlba nɛ barga kachipurso kikɛ m ba lara ajibi be sarga. Kebaa lara le be esarga ere a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be mbraana ere baa wɔtɔ nna a yɔ, a maa chɛrga kikɛ. 15A daga fanɛ men baa ta mbolpɔ fɔlbi nɛ nyifu lela nɛ ɔlifs be ŋku a lara esarga a sa Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na kachipurso kikɛ nna hale mbaanaayɔ.”
Ewura na nɛ kasawule na be asheŋ
16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ le kenishipereso: “Nɛ fanɛ ewura na ku kasawule nɛ e kɔ na be kaba ŋ kɛ mbe mbia to be eko, k beeŋ baa la kebia na peya fanɛ mbe kanaŋ to be kapetɛsɔ. 17Ama nɛ fanɛ ewura na ku mbe kasawule ŋ kɛ esa kama nɛ e bee shuŋ mo, kumo ere k beeŋ naŋ bɛta ŋ ki ewura na peya kafɛ nɛ baa bɛta basa be mpetɛsɔ a sa bumo na to. Kasawule na la mbe kapetɛ nna. Mo nɛ mbe mbia nawule e naaŋ tiŋ a wɔ kumo mbaanaayɔ. 18Ewura na maŋ daga fanɛ e sɔ basa na to be ekama be kapetɛsɔ ashi mo kutɔ. Kasawule kama nɛ e beeŋ ta n sa mbe kebia daga fanɛ k baa la mo gbagba peya nna, saŋɛ na so e maaŋ baa nyaŋ ma basa a sɔ bumo be nsawule a mbe mbia.”
Bɔrɛlambu na to be edaŋɛkpaana be asheŋ
19Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ kanyɛn nɛ e daŋ keta ma a ŋini bɔrɛlambu na, naŋ keta ma n yɔ ebuana nɛ a bee shoŋi kelargato be esoso be kaba so a mata kabunagboŋ nɛ k wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be epunto be kelɔnɛ na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na. Ebuana na daa la ebu cheembiana n sa bɔrɛmatapoana na nna. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e teŋi enɔ n ŋini kaboŋ ko ashi ebuana na be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so 20nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kakpa nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na beeŋ baa daŋɛ eblaŋ nɛ b ta n lara kulubi ŋko kewora n jija be esarga nseŋ naa ta nyifu nɛ b ta n lara esarga naa wora ebodobodo gba nna na. Saŋɛ na so b maaŋ sulɔ asɔ cheembi na be kekama n lar n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kowushina be kelɔnɛ so be kakpa nɛ esa ko beeŋ tiŋ n foe m bɛta amo nɛ k baa la tɔrɔ n sa mo.”
21-22Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ juŋkpar ŋ keta ma m bɔla kowushina be kelɔnɛ na be akɔlɔbi ana na kikɛ to n choŋ nɛ n wu fanɛ amo be kekama kɔ kelɔnɛbi nɛ kumo be nteŋ to fo fanɛ ayadra adeshe nɛ aburwa nɛ mparto malɛ fo fanɛ ayadra adena nɛ aburwa nna. 23B daŋ ta ajembu m pɔr egbal ŋ kulti amo be kekama nna nseŋ yuu asure m mata egbal na. 24Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Edaŋɛkpaana nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be beshumpo bee daŋɛ esarga nɛ basa na bee lara na nna na.”

Title: EZIKƐL 47
Content:
Kabombi nɛ k shi bɔrɛlambu na to a shile na be asheŋ
1Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ kanyɛn na bɛta ma n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to, ndoŋ nɛ n wu kabombi ko ka bee shile kabuna na be kaseto a yɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so. K fara bɔrɛlambu na be kelargato be esoso na nna a shile m ba bɔla bɔrɛsure na ase m baŋɛ kelɔnɛ na to a yɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na naŋ keta ma m bɔla kelargato be esoso be kabunagboŋ na to n lar bɔrɛlambu na to nseŋ juŋkpar ma ŋ kulti n ya fo kabunagboŋ nɛ k bee shoŋi epeŋilarkpa na. Ndoŋ nɛ n wu kabombi ko ka bee shile kabunagboŋ na be kelargato be kaseto be kaba so na. 3Nɛ kanyɛn na ta mbe efɔl karga asɔ ŋ karga ateŋgreŋ alfa anu nɛ adeshe m bɛ kabombi na so ŋ gbelge to a yɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nseŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n luri nchu na to a nite to ndoŋ. Nchu na daa fo ma anaŋgbeltobi to nna. 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ e naŋ yili ndoŋ ŋ karga ateŋgreŋ alfa anu nɛ adeshe m bɛ kabombi na so a gbelge to nɛ nchu na dii m ba ma amuli to. Nɛ e naŋ yili ndoŋ ŋ karga ateŋgreŋ alfa anu nɛ adeshe n chuge so, nɛ nchu na naŋ dii n fo ma kashɛr to. 5Kumo be kaman, nɛ e naŋ yili ndoŋ ŋ karga ateŋgreŋ alfa anu nɛ adeshe n yɔ anishito. Ndoŋ bre be nchu na daa wɔ nchiŋ nna amoso, n daa maŋ tiŋ n nite amo to. Ŋkpal ndoŋ ka daa wɔ nchiŋ so esa daa maaŋ tiŋ n nite amo n dii ama e la nna. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ ma le: “Dimɛdi pibi, Ezikɛl, baa de asheŋ ere kikɛ so nɛnɛ.”
Kumo be kaman nɛ e keta ma n laŋɛ n yɔ kabombi na be ekarso, 7nɛ n ya wu fanɛ ndibi damta daa yil kabombi na be mba anyɔ na kikɛ so nna. 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: “Nchu ere bɔla kasawule ere so nna n sɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so ŋ gbelge to m bɔla Jɔɔdan be ketaŋɛ to a yɔ Teku Wuso na to nna na. Kumo be nchu na baŋ luri Teku Wuso na to, Teku Wuso na be nchu nɛ a kɔ nfɔl na beeŋ kilgi nchu nɛ e walɛ kenuu. 9Kaplɛkama nɛ nchu na beeŋ shile m bɔla, asɔbɔya nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ be yiri yiri beeŋ ba ndoŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so kabombi na beeŋ bar ŋkpa nɛ nchu nɛ e walɛ kenuu m ba wɔtɔ Teku Wuso na to. 10Yili achubu nɛ baa tre Ɛngɛdi na hale n ya fo achubu nɛ baa tre Ɛneglem na, basa beeŋ baa pɛ ekɔrɔtɔ teku na to nsaa fata bumo be ashewu kumo be ekarso. Teku Wuso na beeŋ nya ekɔrɔtɔ be yiri yiri fanɛ kananɛ Mɛditerenia be Teku kɔ amo na. 11Ama apa nɛ a dese m mata teku na bre be nchu nɛ a kɔ nfɔl na bre be nfɔl maaŋ lar amo to, saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ baa nya nfɔl amo to a wora asheŋ. 12Ndibi be yiri yiri beeŋ kɔr a yil kabombi na be kaba kama so a sa kusɔ jiso. Amo be afantaŋ maa ba nɛ aba bolo, amo alɛ maaŋ yige kebaasɔr kikɛ. Kufɔl kikɛ a beeŋ baa kɔ asɔrso popɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so a bee nya nchu nɛ a bee shi bɔrɛlambu na to nna. Ndibi na be asɔrso beeŋ baa la ajibi nɛ amo be afantaŋ malɛ e baa chɛ basa alɔ.”
Kasawule na be Egbaŋ ana be asheŋ
13Ade kikɛ be kaman, nɛ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na naŋ kaŋɛ Israɛl be basa na le: “Kananɛ kasawule nɛ menyeeŋ chige to n sa Israɛl be eyiri kudu anyɔ na be egbaŋ daga fanɛ a baa du nde. Josɛf be eyiri anyɔ nɛ baa tre Manase nɛ Efrayim na beeŋ nya mboŋ anyɔ. 14N daŋ bɔ ntaŋ n nase kɔnɔ n sa menyi nananyɛnana fanɛ meeŋ sa bumo kasawule ere nɛ k baa la bumo peya; amoso men barga kumo to dede n sa abar.
15Kumo be kelargato be esoso be ekar beeŋ fara Mɛditerenia be Teku na ase ŋ keta n ya bɔla epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Hiflɔn nɛ Lɛbo Hamaf na n ya fo kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Zedad na. 16Kumo alɛ beeŋ naŋ keta loŋ n ya fo ndegboŋ nɛ baa tre Bɛrota nɛ Sibreem nɛ a dese nwursawule anyɔ nɛ baa tre Damaskɔs nɛ Hamaf be nferinto na, hale n ya fo kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Tikɔn nɛ k dese kebonfu nɛ baa tre Hawuran na be gbaŋ ase na. 17Amoso kasawule na be kelargato be esoso be ekar yili Mɛditerenia be Teku na ase ŋ keta n sɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so n ya fo kadegboŋ nɛ baa tre Enɔn na nna, nɛ kumo nɛ Damaskɔs nɛ Hamaf be abonfu wora gbaŋ a laŋɛ kelargato be esoso be kaba so.
18Epeŋilarkpa be gbaŋ na malɛ fara Damaskɔs nɛ Hawuran be abonfu anyɔ be nferinto nna ŋ keta n sɔ kelargato be kaseto, nɛ Jɔɔdan be Lɔr ki Israɛl be basa be kasawule ashi epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so nɛ Giliad be kasawule ashi epeŋilarkpa be egbaŋ to, nseŋ keta loŋ n ya lar kade nɛ baa tre Tama nɛ k mata Teku Wuso na.
19Kasawule na be kelargato be kaseto be ekar beeŋ fara Tama be kade na nna ŋ keta n ya fo Kadɛsh Mɛriba be achubu na ashi kelargato be kaseto be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nseŋ naŋ ta n sɔ kelargato be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so a shi Ijipt be gbaŋ to n ta ya fo Mɛditerenia be Teku ase.
20Kumo be epeŋilarkpa be ekar malɛ beeŋ fara Mɛditerenia be Teku ase ŋ keta n sɔ kelargato be esoso n ya fo Lɛbo Hamaf be epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so.
21Kasawule nɛ menyeeŋ barga to n sa Israɛl be eyiriana na nna na. 22K beeŋ baa la menyi be kapetɛ hale mbaanaayɔ. Nɛ menyi bee chige kasawule na to, befɔ kama nɛ menyi nɛ bumo wɔtɔ nɛ b kurge mbia nfe na gba daga fanɛ b nya bumo be kachige. A daga fanɛ men baa wora bumo fanɛ Israɛl be ndetobia nseŋ shin nɛ bumo alɛ gba e baa tu Israɛl be eyiriana na a to beri a nya kasawule na be kachige. 23Yiri kama to nɛ efɔ chena, daga fanɛ b chige bumo kasawule na nɛ efɔ na gba e nya mbe kachige. Ma, Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ na e kaŋɛ.”

Title: EZIKƐL 48
Content:
Kasawule na be kebarga to n sa eyiriana na be asheŋ
1-7Eyiriana na be kekama beeŋ nya kasawule na be kaba nɛ k beeŋ yili Israɛl be epeŋilarkpa be kaba so be gbaŋ nɛ k dese epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so na n ya fo Mɛditerenia be Teku ase nna na. Israɛl be kelargato be esoso be kaba so be gbaŋ na beeŋ bɔla Hiflɔn nɛ Lɛbo Hamaf be ndeana to n ya fo kakpa nɛ baa tre Haza Ɛnɔn nɛ k dese m mata Damaskɔs nɛ Hamaf be egbaŋ to na. Kananɛ eyiriana na beeŋ nya bumo be nsawule be kachige nde. Dan be yiri e naŋ juŋkpar n nya nɛ Asha be yiri e bɛ so nɛ Naftali be yiri e bɛ so nɛ Manase be yiri e bɛ so nɛ Efrayim be yiri e bɛ so nɛ Ruben be yiri e bɛ so nseŋ ta Juda be yiri m bɛ so lalaloge.
Kasawule na be nferinto be asheŋ
8Kakpa nɛ menyeeŋ ku m bɛ Juda be yiri so a laŋɛ kelargato be kaseto na beeŋ baa la kasawule nɛ k beeŋ baa kɔr to nna. Kumo be mparto beeŋ yili kelargato be esoso m ba choŋ kelargato be kaseto nsaa la emayɛl ashunu nɛ kumo be nteŋ to malɛ nɛ kananɛ menyeeŋ ku n sa Israɛl be eyiriana na be nteŋ to e baa sasa. Kasawule ere so nɛ ma bɔrɛlambu beeŋ yili.
9Kakpa ere be nferinto be kasawule na beeŋ baa la ma Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na peya. Kumo be nteŋ to beeŋ baa la emayɛl ashunu nɛ mparto malɛ e baa la emayɛl ashe. 10Ma, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ku ma kasawule cheembi na n sa bɔrɛmatapoana na. Kakpa nɛ meeŋ ku n sa bumo na be nteŋ beeŋ yili epeŋilarkpa n ya fo epeŋitɔrkpa nsaa la emayɛl ashunu, nɛ kumo be mpar malɛ e yili kelargato be esoso n ya fo kelargato be kaseto, nsaa la emayɛl asa. Saŋɛ na so baaŋ pɔr Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na be bɔrɛlambu n yili kumo be nferinto. 11Kakpa cheembi ere beeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi Zadɔk be kabuna na peya nna. Ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo e ta kashenteŋji a shuŋ ma nsaa maŋ tu Livaiebi nɛ Israɛl be basa nɛ b ka na a wora alubi. 12Amoso bumo e naŋ nya kakpa nɛ k daga m bɛ kasawule nɛ k la Livaiebi peya na so.
