Ama naniere bre menyi be saŋɛ nna nɛ tentembiri e ŋini kumo be eleŋ.”
Pita ka chɛ fanɛ e maŋ nyi Yesu be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:57-58, 69-75; Maak 14:53-54, 66-72; Jɔn 18:12-18, 25-27)
54Ndoŋ nna nɛ b nyaŋ Yesu m pɛ mo n yɔ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na pe. Saŋɛ na so nɛ Pita bɛ kufɔ a wɔ kaman. 55B ka ya puga edɛ laŋ na to a wɔl nɛ Pita tu bumo a tase ndoŋ. 56E ka tase ndoŋ na nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na be kebita ko wu mo kefulto na to m pɛshɛ mo loŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mo nɛ kanyɛn ere gba e daa la.” 57Nɛ Pita chɛ kumo ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kache manɛ, m maŋ nyi mo.” 58K maŋ chɛr ko nɛ esa ko malɛ naŋ wu mo nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Fo alɛ gba la bumo to be eko nna.” Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ: “Kanyɛn manɛ, ma alɛ maŋ la bumo to be eko.” 59Kumo be awa koŋwule be kaman nɛ basa na be eko naŋ kaŋɛ: “K baŋ fuli nna fanɛ kanyɛn ere gba nɛ Yesu e daa la, ŋkpal manɛ so, Galili be esa e la mo.” 60Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ le: “Kanyɛn manɛ, ma ere maŋ pin kusɔ nɛ fee malga ere gba to.” E kraa malga nna nɛ koshinyɛn boŋ epul na to. 61Ndoŋ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe kilgi ŋ keni Pita nɛ e nyiŋi Enyɛnpe be kamalga mo nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ: “Pɔɛŋ nɛ koshinyɛn e boŋ kabre, feeŋ chɛ ale asa ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo maŋ nyi ma na.” 62Ndoŋ nna nɛ e lar kowu n ya shu ga.
B ka wora Yesu eyurto m bri mo be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:67-68; Maak 14:65)
63Basa nɛ b daa kɔ Yesu to na wora mo eyurto nseŋ bri mo 64nseŋ naŋ wora mo kebuumbuuanishi nseŋ ŋmɛa mo nsaa kaŋɛ mo: “Pin esa nɛ e ŋmɛa fo ere.” 65Amo be kaman nɛ b malga mmalga damta ŋ gbiti mo a tege mo.
B ka bar Yesu demujikpa be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:59-66; Maak 14:55-64; Jɔn 18:19-24)
66Kare ka chɛ nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ mbraŋinipoana nɛ baa tre Juwebi be benimuana be nshɛrwuraana na kikɛ shɛr. Amo be kaman nɛ b keta mo n yɔ bumo be demujikpa n ya kaŋɛ mo le: 67“Nɛ fo e la Kristo na, fo kaŋɛ anyi.” Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi gba, men maaŋ yirda. 68Nɛ ma alɛ naŋ bishi menyi kamalga ko, men maaŋ sa ma kumo be kifito. 69Ama yili kabre a yɔ ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn beeŋ ya chena Elempo Ebɔrɛ be jiso so.” 70Nɛ basa na kikɛ bishi mo le: “Ama fo e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na ŋko?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Loŋ gbagba nɛ men yɛ na.” 71Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ abar: “To, manɛ be shɛda nɛ an naa sha? Mo gbagba be kɔnɔ to nɛ an nu kumo na.”

Title: LUUK 23
Content:
B ka yɛr Yesu Gomena Pailat kutɔ be asheŋ
(Matiu 27:1-2, 11-14; Maak 15:1-5; Jɔn 18:28-38)
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ nshɛrwuraana na kikɛ koso n yɛr Yesu Gomena Pailat kutɔ 2n ya kaŋɛ mo fanɛ le be alubi nɛ Yesu wora. B yɛ: “An wu fanɛ kanyɛn ere wɔtɔ nna a wul anyi be efuli ere so ebi to nsaa kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ an sa maa ka lampo a sa Romebi be ewurgboŋ Siza nseŋ naa wɔtɔ a tre mo gbagba be kumu Kristo nɛ e la ewura na.” 3Nɛ Gomena Pailat bishi mo le: “Fo e la Juwebi be Ewura na a?” Nɛ Yesu shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Loŋ gbagba nɛ fo kaŋɛ na.” 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat kaŋɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ jimaŋ na le: “Ma ere maŋ wu kulubi kikɛ kanyɛn ere so.” 5Nɛ b kini nseŋ kaŋɛ: “E ta mbe asheŋ ŋiniso nna a wɔ Judiya be efuli so kikɛ a ŋini basa nsaa fur bumo a wɔtɔ kumuleŋ to. Hale Galili kikɛ nɛ e yili n wora loŋ m ba fo nfe.” 6Pailat ka nu loŋ nɛ e bishi bumo le: “Galili be esa e la mo a?” Nɛ b shuli so. 7E ka pin fanɛ Yesu shi Galili, Ewura Hɛrɔd be kasawule so na nɛ e shin nɛ b yɛr mo n ya sa Ewura Hɛrɔd, saŋɛ na so nɛ mo alɛ gba ba Jerusalɛm be kade na to. 8Ewura Hɛrɔd ka wu Yesu nɛ mbe kagbene fuli mo ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ nu mbe asheŋ ga nseŋ daa fin kewu mo nɛ e wora mbe emamachisheŋ na be kuko nɛ e keni. 9Amoso, e daŋ bishi mo asheŋ damta, ama mo alɛ daa maŋ kaŋɛ mo shɛŋ. 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ mbraŋinipoana na yili nshɛr na to m malga kenishipereso ŋ gbiti Yesu. 11Nɛ Hɛrɔd nɛ mbe benapo wora mo nfɛlsheŋ nseŋ wora mo eyurto ga. Ade be kaman nɛ Hɛrɔd shin nɛ b ta asɔbuuso lela m buu Yesu shiaso nseŋ shin nɛ b naŋ bɛta mo n ya sa Pailat. 12Kumo be kamɔnchɛ kikɛ nɛ Hɛrɔd nɛ Pailat ki beteri, ŋkpal manɛ so, pɔɛŋ nɛ Yesu be demu na ba, b daa maŋ wɔ ebel abar so.
B ka yɛ Yesu daga luwu be asheŋ
(Matiu 27:15-26; Maak 15:6-15; Jɔn 18:39—19:16)
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat tre bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ benimuana na nɛ jimaŋ na kikɛ m ba shɛr 14ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men yɛ kanyɛn nɛ men bar ma na la esa lubi nna a wɔtɔ a fur basa a wɔtɔ kumuleŋ to. Ma alɛ ka yili menyi kikɛ be anishito nfe ŋ keni mbe demu na to m maŋ wu alubi nɛ men kaŋɛ fanɛ e wora na be kekama mo so. 15Ewura Hɛrɔd gba daa maŋ wu kulubi kikɛ mo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, e laŋɛ mo nna n naŋ ba sa anyi. Men keni, mo alɛ maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ nɛ k daga mbe luwu. 16Amoso, meeŋ shin nɛ b kuya mo so nseŋ yige mo.” 17[Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ be jemanɛ kikɛ k daa la daŋkare be kusɔ nna fanɛ Pailat e lara basa na be keparso be esa ashi kabuti to.]
18Nɛ bumo kikɛ ponte kɔnɔkoŋwuleso ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Lara mo basa to nseŋ lara Barabas kabuti to n sa anyi.” 19Barabas daŋ yɔ kabuti to nna ŋkpal e ka daŋ fur basa nɛ b ta kumuleŋ ŋ kɔ ewura be eleŋ kelantokɔ to nɛ esa ko daŋ wu so. 20Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat naŋ malga basa na kutɔ eleŋso a sha keshin nɛ Yesu e yɔ. 21Nɛ jimaŋ na ponte eleŋso ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so, gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so.” 22Nɛ e naŋ bishi bumo kela sasopo: “Manɛ nna, manɛ be kulubi nɛ e wora? M maŋ wu kulubi kikɛ mo so nɛ k daga mbe luwu. Amoso, meeŋ shin nɛ b kuya mo so nseŋ yige mo nɛ e yɔ.” 23Nɛ b kini nseŋ ponte eleŋso a kaŋɛ fanɛ Pailat e shin nɛ b gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so. Bumo be kaponte na shin nɛ b pɔɔ Pailat so. 24Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat shuli n sa bumo 25n shin nɛ b lara kanyɛn nɛ b daŋ ti ebu ŋkpal e ka daŋ fur basa n wɔtɔ kumuleŋ to nɛ b kɔ ewura be eleŋ ashi kelantokɔ to m mɔ esa na so ashi kabuti na to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo nɛ b daŋ kule Pailat fanɛ e lara n sa bumo. Amo be kaman nɛ e yige Yesu bre n sa bumo fanɛ b wora mo kusɔ nɛ baa sha.
B ka gbir Yesu m mata kedibi largato so be asheŋ
(Matiu 27:32-44; Maak 15:21-32; Jɔn 19:17-27)
26B ka kɔ mo a yɔ nɛ b ya nyaŋ Sairini be kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Saimɔn nɛ e shi adɔ to a luri kade to n tintiŋ mo nɛ e sulɔ Yesu be kedibi largato na m bɛ Yesu so. 27Nɛ jimaŋ na be basa damta bɛ Yesu so nɛ beche damta ko ta enɔana n deŋi amu so a shu ŋkpal mo so. 28Nɛ Yesu kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Jerusalɛm to be beche, men sa maŋ kpal ma so a shu. Men baa shu ŋkpal menyi nɛ menyi be mbia so. 29Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋko bee ba nɛ b kaŋɛ le: ‘Begbentepoana nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ naŋ kurge ŋ ku so nɛ beche nɛ mbia maŋ naŋ nyipo ŋ ku so nu ebel kashenteŋto bre.’ 30Saŋɛ na so baaŋ fara a kule abeegboŋ nɛ abeebi fanɛ a ka la enyiŋgbasa na ŋ kaŋɛ abeegboŋ le: ‘Men tɔr anyi so’, nseŋ kaŋɛ abeebi malɛ: ‘Men buu anyi so.’ 31Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma ere ka du fanɛ kedibi wushiso nɛ b wora ma le ere, nuso nɛ baaŋ wora menyi nɛ men du fanɛ ndibi wɔlso ere?”
32B daŋ ta beyu anyɔ ko nna n ti mo so a yɔ nɛ b ya gberge bumo kusoe m mɔ bumo. 33B ka ba fo kakpa nɛ baa tre Kumuwibi be Kakpa na nɛ b ta mo nɛ beyu anyɔ na ŋ gbir m mata ndibi largato so. Beyu anyɔ na be ekoŋwule daa wɔ mbe jisoso nna nɛ ekoŋwule malɛ daa wɔ mbe bena so. 34Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ le: “Etuto, ta m paŋ bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ baa wora.” Nɛ b to beri a fin bumo nɛ baaŋ nya mbe asɔbuuso. 35Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa ba yili ndoŋ a keni mo nɛ benimuana na bee wora mo eyurto a kaŋɛ mo le: “Men keni, e mɔlga basa pɔtɛ, men shin nɛ e mɔlga mo gbagba be kumu nɛ an keni ŋko kashenteŋ nɛ e la Kristo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be esa laraso na a.” 36Nɛ benapo malɛ gba wora mo eyurto nseŋ firgi n taga mo to n ta yabra nyannyanso ko a sa mo fanɛ e sɔ n nuu 37a kaŋɛ mo le: “Nɛ fo kaŋɛ fo la Juwebi be Ewura na gbagba nna, fo mɔlga fo kumu.” 38Kasibɛ nɛ basa na daŋ sibɛ ŋ gbir m mata Yesu be kumu ase e daa la:
“JUWEBI BE EWURA NA NDE.”
39Beyu anyɔ nɛ b daŋ gbir m mata ndibi largatoana so n ti mo so na be eko daŋ tege mo nna ŋ kaŋɛ: “Fo e la Kristo na, amoso, mɔlga fo kumu nseŋ mɔlga anyi alɛ gba.”
40Nɛ eyu nyɔsopo na fiɛ mo barkasa na so m bishi mo le: “Keni, fo maa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nna a? Ŋko fo maŋ wu kananɛ fo nɛ mo kikɛ wɔ luwu be kasogberge koŋwule to a? 41Anyi ere be alubi be tɔnɔ nɛ anyee ji na, ama kanyɛn ere bre maŋ wora shɛŋ.” 42E ka kaŋɛ loŋ nɛ e kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ Yesu le: “Yesu, fo kaŋ luri fo kuwura na to, fo nyiŋi ma.” 43Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo na fanɛ kabre ma nɛ fo beeŋ ya kaa wɔ paradisi.”
Yesu be luwu be asheŋ
(Matiu 27:45-56; Maak 15:33-41; Jɔn 19:28-30)
44Ta a ba kapaso, kerfi kuduanyɔ be jemanɛ nɛ tentembiri ba buu efuli na kikɛ so m biri to loŋ hale n ya fo kaaseso kerfi asa. 45Ŋkpal manɛ so, epeŋi daa maŋ naa nyaŋɛ nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be patisa na yili kumo be esoso n chaŋɛ to m ba kaseto. 46Nɛ Yesu boŋ to awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Etuto, n ta ma kiyoyu m bɔɔ fo enɔ.” E ka baŋ kaŋɛ loŋ n loge nɛ e fute mbe lalaloge be efute. 47Benapo be enimu ko ka daŋ wu asɔ nɛ a wora na kikɛ nɛ e di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kashenteŋto, kanyɛn ere daa maŋ wora shɛŋ.” 48Basa damta nɛ b daŋ ba shɛr ndoŋ a keni na, ka wu asheŋ na kikɛ nɛ b bɛta n ta enɔana a bri bumo be ŋgbene so a yɔ epe. 49Nɛ Yesu be benyipoana na nɛ beche nɛ b daŋ shi Galili m bɛ mo so m ba na kikɛ ya kaa yil ekarso gbrɛ a keni asheŋ nɛ a daa wora na kikɛ.
Yesu be kepuli be asheŋ
(Matiu 27:57-61; Maak 15:42-47; Jɔn 19:38-42)
50Kanyɛn ko e daa wɔtɔ nɛ baa tre mo Josɛf. E daŋ shi Juwebi be kade nɛ baa tre Arimatiya na nna nseŋ daa la Juwebi be nshɛrwuraana na to be esa lela nɛ kashenteŋshapo. 51E daa la nshɛrwuraana na be eko nna, ama e daa maŋ sa bumo kashuli ashi kesheŋ nɛ b daŋ wora na to. E daa wɔtɔ nna a jo Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na be keba. 52Mo e daŋ yɔ Pailat kutɔ n ya kule mo Yesu be kebuni. 53Pailat ka sa mo ekpa, nɛ e ya lara ebuni na kedibi largato na so nseŋ ta kesaŋɛ lela ko m mea mo nseŋ ta mo n nase kejembulaŋ kurso ko be nchaŋ to nɛ b daa maŋ naŋ ta esa kikɛ n nase kumo to kikɛ na. 54Kebelaseachɛ e daa la nɛ Kewushiachɛ na daa fara.
55Beche nɛ b daŋ shi Galili m bɛ Yesu so m ba na daŋ bɛ Josɛf so n ya wu nchaŋ na nɛ kananɛ b daŋ nase mo kumo to. 56Kumo be kaman nɛ b bɛta n yɔ epe n ya wora ŋku dufɛso nɛ etulale n yili.
Kewushiachɛ ka fo nɛ b wushi m bɛ kusɔ nɛ mbra na bee kaŋɛ na so.

Title: LUUK 24
Content:
Yesu be ketiŋi luwu to be asheŋ
(Matiu 28:1-10; Maak 16:1-8; Jɔn 20:1-10)
1Kewushiachɛ na ka ji ŋ klade be bɔkwe na be kachɛ juŋkparso be chipurdidi nɛ beche na ta ŋku dufɛsoana nɛ etulale nɛ b daŋ wora na n yɔ nchaŋ na akpa. 2B ka yɔ nɛ b wu fanɛ b gbelti kejembu nɛ b daŋ ta n ti nchaŋ na be kɔnɔ so na ashi to. 3Ama b ka luri nchaŋ na to, b keni kumo to n fin Yesu be kebuni na ŋ gben. 4B kraa yil ndoŋ nna nɛ kesheŋ na bee chinchiŋ bumo nɛ benyɛn anyɔ ko buu epiŋi fuful parrbiana ko m ba yili m mata bumo epul na to. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ kufu pɛ beche na nɛ b kur amu n yuu kasawule nɛ benyɛn na bishi bumo le: “Manɛ e ba nɛ menyee fin esa keniso bubuni to? 6Men baa nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ menyi saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ kraa wɔ Galili na 7fanɛ a daga b ka ta mo, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn m bɔɔ alubiworapoana enɔ nɛ b gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so nɛ e tiŋi kumo be kachɛ sasopo to na.” 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ b nyiŋi Yesu be mmalga na 9nseŋ shi nchaŋ na akpa m bɛta n yɔ epe n ya ta asheŋ na kikɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bebɛsopo kudukako na nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na kikɛ. 10Mɛɛri Magdalin nɛ Joana nɛ Jeems mo nio Mɛɛri nɛ beche nɛ b daŋ ti bumo so na e daŋ ya kaŋɛ beshuŋipo na. 11Ama b daa maŋ yirda bumo nseŋ daa tama fanɛ bumo be mmalga na daa la mmalga fuloŋ nna. 12[Nɛ Pita koso n shile n yɔ nchaŋ na akpa n ya murgi n jule ŋ keni kumo to nɛ kesaŋɛ nɛ b daŋ ta m mea Yesu na nawule e dese to. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e bɛta a yɔ epe nɛ kesheŋ na bee chinchiŋ mo.]
Yesu ka lar bebɛsopo anyɔ ko so be asheŋ
(Maak 16:12-13)
13Kumo be kamɔnchɛ na kikɛ nɛ Yesu be bebɛsopo anyɔ ko yili Jerusalɛm n nite a malga asheŋ nɛ a wora na kikɛ be asheŋ a yɔ kadebi ko nɛ baa tre Ɛmeeyes na. 14Kumo nɛ Jerusalɛm daa la fanɛ emayɛl ashunu nna. 15B kaa bee malga a ber asheŋ nɛ a wora na be bare a yɔ nɛ Yesu gbagba ya tu bumo ekpa na to a yɔ. 16Ama bumo be anishi daŋ ki nna gbrum nɛ b maŋ tiŋ m pin mo. 17Nɛ e bishi bumo le: “Nuso be bare nɛ men kɔ a na a ber le ere?” Nɛ b kilgi a yil a keni asheŋ kagbenejijaso. 18Nɛ bumo be eko nɛ baa tre Kliopas na bishi mo le: “N tama fanɛ fo nawule e la Jerusalɛm ere to be efɔ nɛ e maŋ nyi asheŋ nɛ a wora ndoŋ nchɛnnyɔ ere to ŋko?” 19Nɛ e bishi bumo: “Manɛ be asheŋ?” Nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Nazarɛt be Yesu na be asheŋ. E daa la anebi nna nɛ mbe mmalga nɛ asheŋ woraso daa la asheŋgboŋ ashi Ebɔrɛ nɛ basa kikɛ be anishito. 20Ama anyi be bɔrɛmatapowuraana nɛ benimuana ta mo m bɔɔ Romebi be benimu enɔ nɛ b ji mo demu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e daga luwu n ta mo ŋ gbir m mata kedibi largato so m mɔ. 21Anyi alɛ daa tama fanɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ lara fanɛ e sɔ Israɛlebi n yige. Kumo be buushi kesheŋ na ka wora kumo be nchɛ asa nde kabre. 22Ade malɛ kikɛ be kaman anyi to be beche ko shin nɛ mamachi pɛ anyi nna. B wule nna n yɔ mbe nchaŋ akpa chipur ere 23n ya fin mbe kebuni ŋ gben nseŋ bɛta m ba kaŋɛ fanɛ emalaika lara bumo be amu nna ŋ ŋini bumo nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ Yesu na tiŋi luwu to a wɔ ŋkpa to. 24Anyi to be beko ka yɔ nchaŋ na akpa nɛ b ya wu asheŋ nɛ beche na kaŋɛ na gbagba chap, ama Yesu bre gbagba, b maŋ wu mo.” 25Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men maa wora nfɛra kuraa, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔ nɛ anebiana na sibɛ n nase na kikɛ be keta n wɔtɔ menyi be ŋgbene to du menyi so kpakpa kashenteŋto geeŋ. 26Men maŋ nyi fanɛ asheŋ nɛ a wora ere kikɛ daga kewora Kristo na nna pɔɛŋ nɛ e luri mbe kemaŋkura na to a?” 27Ndoŋ nna nɛ e fara Mosis be abɔrɛsibɛ to m bugi asɔ nɛ a bee malga mo gbagba be asheŋ kikɛ to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo loŋ hale n ya bɔla anebiana na kikɛ be abɔrɛsibɛana to nyam.
28B ka ba fo kadebi na nɛ Yesu wora fanɛ e ka daa sha kekpar so n yɔ anishito na. 29Nɛ basa anyɔ na kule mo ŋ kaŋɛ: “Sa maŋ yɔ, ba luri anyi be laŋ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, epeŋi teŋ tɔr nɛ kaboŋ bee jija to.” 30Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu shuli n tu bumo n yɔ. Mo nɛ bumo ka ya kaa tase ejikpa nɛ e ta bodobodo na n nɛfa kumo nseŋ bu kumo to n ta n sa bumo. 31Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo be anishi bugi nɛ b pin mo nɛ e foe bumo to epul na to. 32Nɛ b kaŋɛ abar le: “Amoso nɛ e daŋ bugi abɔrɛsibɛ na to a malga a sa anyi ekpa to nɛ anyi be ŋgbene daŋ fuli anyi ga loŋ na.”
33Epul na gbagba to nɛ b bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya tu bebɛsopo kudukako na nɛ bebɛsopo ko malɛ ti bumo so n shɛr a tase. 34Nɛ bebɛsopoana na kaŋɛ bumo benyɔ na le: “Enyɛnpe tiŋi kashenteŋto hale n lar Saimɔn so.” 35Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo benyɔ na malɛ kaŋɛ bumo asheŋ nɛ a wora Ɛmeeyes be ekpa na to kikɛ nɛ kananɛ b pin mo ashi bodobodo na be kebuto to.
Yesu ka lar mbe bebɛsopo so be asheŋ
(Matiu 28:16-20; Maak 16:14-18; Jɔn 20:19-23; Ashuŋ Shunso 1:6-8)
36B kraa kute asheŋ ere nna nɛ Yesu gbagba ba yili bumo kikɛ to. 37Ama kananɛ e daŋ lar bumo so na daŋ chinchiŋ bumo n ta kufu m pɛ bumo ga nɛ b daa tama fanɛ kebuniyoyu nna. 38Nɛ e bishi bumo le: “Manɛ be kufu e kɔ menyi loŋ? Nɛ manɛ malɛ be nfɛra nɛ menyee fɛ menyi be ŋgbene to ere? 39Men keni ma enɔana nɛ ma aya m pin fanɛ ma nna. Men beta ma ŋ keni, ŋkpal manɛ so, kebuniyoyu maŋ kɔ eyur nɛ awibi fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kɔ ere.” 40E ka kaŋɛ loŋ na nɛ e ta mbe enɔana nɛ aya ŋ ŋini bumo. 41Bumo be ŋgbene ka fuli bumo ga nɛ kesheŋ na kraa chinchiŋ bumo nɛ baa yirda kumo a gben nɛ e bishi bumo le: “Men maŋ kɔ kusɔ jiso ko nfe a?” 42Ndoŋ nna nɛ b sa mo kɔrɔtɔ ŋaseso 43nɛ e ta kumo n we bumo be anishito ndoŋ.
44Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “Asheŋ ere kikɛ nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ menyi saŋɛ nɛ ma nɛ menyi daŋ kraa wɔtɔ na fanɛ ma asheŋ nɛ a wɔ Mosis be abɔrɛsibɛ to nɛ anebiana na kikɛ peyaana to nɛ Nshɛ to na kikɛ daga kebɔla ekpa na.” 45Ndoŋ nna nɛ e shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene bugi nɛ b tiŋ m pin abɔrɛsibɛ na be afito 46nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ a daga fanɛ Kristo na ka ji awurfoŋ n wu, 47ama kumo be nchɛ asa to e beeŋ tiŋi luwu na to. Mbe ketre so nɛ baaŋ bɔla n yili Jerusalɛm m bɔ kelar alubi to nɛ Ebɔrɛ be keyige alubi m paŋ na be baru na n sa efuli kama so ebi. 48Menyi e la asheŋ ere be eshɛdajipoana. 49Meeŋ shin nɛ n Tuto be kɔnɔ naseso be kakɛ e ba menyi so. Amoso, men baa wɔ kade ere to hale nɛ eleŋ e ya shi esoso m ba buu menyi.”
Yesu ka yɔ ebɔrɛso be asheŋ
(Maak 16:19-20; Ashuŋ Shunso 1:9-11)
50Ndoŋ nna nɛ e juŋkpar bumo n lar n yɔ hale Bɛtani n ya maŋ mbe enɔana so n nɛfa bumo. 51E ka bee nɛfa bumo nɛ e fara a yige bumo a yɔ ebɔrɛso. 52Nɛ b bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ kagbenefuli damta 53n ya kaa wɔtɔ a ba a ba bɔrɛlambu na to saŋkama m ba kaa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.

Title: JƆN 1
Content:
Ŋkpa be kamalga na be asheŋ
1Pɔɛŋ nɛ durnya fara na nɛ esa nɛ baa tre Ebɔrɛ be Kamalga na wɔtɔ. Mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ e daa wɔtɔ nɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ daa la kukoŋwule. 2Pɔɛŋ nɛ durnya fara na nɛ esa nɛ baa tre Kamalga ere nɛ Ebɔrɛ e wɔtɔ. 3Mo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla n to kusɔ kikɛ. Kusɔ toso kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ bɔla Kamalga na so n to. 4Kamalga na to nɛ ŋkpa kikɛ shi nɛ le be ŋkpa ere malɛ bar kefulto basa to. 5Kefulto na malɛ wɔtɔ nna a nyaŋɛ a fuli tentembiri to, ama tentembiri na malɛ maŋ naŋ pɔɔ kumo so. 6Kanyɛn ko malɛ daa wɔtɔ nɛ baa tre mo Jɔn, nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ shuŋi mo durnya to. 7E daŋ ba nna fanɛ shɛdajipo, kumo e la fanɛ e ba ji kefulto na be asheŋ be shɛda, saŋɛ na so, basa beeŋ bɔla mo so n yirda kumo. 8Mannɛ mo gbagba e daa la kefulto na, e daŋ ba nna nɛ e ba ji kefulto na be shɛda. 9Kashenteŋ be kefulto nɛ k bee nyaŋɛ a sa esa kama na e daa ba durnya ere to na. 10Durnya ere to nɛ e daa wɔ a la esa nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla mo so n to durnya, ama kumo alɛ daa maŋ pin mo. 11E daŋ ba mo gbagba be efuli so nna, ama mbe basa gbagba daa maŋ sɔ mo. 12Ama bekama nɛ b sɔ mo nseŋ yirda mbe ketre na, e sa bumo ekpa nna nɛ b ki Ebɔrɛ be mbia. 13Mannɛ durnya ere to be ekpa so ŋko dimɛdi be eyur be kayɛlga be ekpa so ŋko kusɔ nɛ esa yili na so nɛ b bɔla ŋ ki Ebɔrɛ be mbia. Ebɔrɛ gbagba be katinto be kesheŋ nna.
14Esa nɛ baa tre Kamalga na daŋ ki dimɛdi nna m ba kaa wɔ anyi to. An wu mbe kemaŋkura nɛ kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kashenteŋ bɔlɔ kemaŋkura na to. Le be kemaŋkura ere la mo peya nna ŋkpal e ka la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn koŋwule na so. 15Mbe asheŋ nɛ Jɔn daŋ ji, saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ le awɔrso na, e yɛ: “Ede be asheŋ nɛ n daa malga, saŋɛ nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Esa ko wɔ ma kaman a ba, ama mo e chɔ ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e daŋ ma kebaawɔtɔ ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito.’ ” 16Mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ k bɔlɔ mo to felɛlɛ na to nɛ e nɛfa anyi nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ a nɛfa a nɛfa anyi. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, anebi Mosis so nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla m bar mbra na, ama kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kashenteŋ bre shi Yesu Kristo so nna.
18Esa kama maŋ naŋ wu Ebɔrɛ kenishiso. Ebinyɛn koŋwule, nɛ e tase m mata Ebɔrɛ na, nawule e ŋini basa kananɛ Ebɔrɛ du.
Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo be kubɔya be asheŋ
(Matiu 3:1-12; Maak 1:1-8; Luuk 3:1-18)
19Kachako Jerusalɛm to be Juwebi be benimuana shuŋi bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ Livaiebi ko Jɔn kutɔ fanɛ b ba bishi mo le: “Nuso be esa e la fo?” 20Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jɔn bugi to nɛnɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo, e yɛ: “Mannɛ ma e la Mesaya na.” 21Ndoŋ nna nɛ b naŋ bishi mo: “To, nɛ nuso be esa e la fo? Anebi Elaija e la fo a?” Nɛ Jɔn kaŋɛ: “Ayai, mannɛ anebi Elaija e la ma.” Nɛ b naŋ bishi mo le: “Anebi nɛ e bee ba na e la fo a?” Nɛ Jɔn yɛ: “Ayai.” 22Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Jande, kaŋɛ anyi esa nɛ e la fo, ŋkpal manɛ so, a daga fanɛ an nya kusɔ ko n ya kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b shuŋi anyi na. Manɛ nɛ fo kɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ anyi fo asheŋ?” 23Nɛ Jɔn ta anebi Aizaaya be mmalga ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma e la esa nɛ mbe ebɔl bee ponte ashi kiyi to a kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Men lɔŋɛ Enyɛnpe be ekpa niŋiso n sa mo nɛ e bɔla so na.’ ”
24Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbɔ nɛ Efarisiana na daŋ shuŋi na malɛ bishi Jɔn: 25“Fo yɛ fo maŋ la Mesaya na ŋko anebi Elaija ŋko anebi nɛ e bee ba na. To, nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ fee bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr?” 26Nɛ Jɔn kaŋɛ bumo: “Nchu nɛ ŋ kɔ a bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr, ama esa ko yil menyi to nfe nɛ men maŋ nyi mo. 27Mo e la esa nɛ e wɔ ma kaman a ba na, esa nɛ m maŋ fo mbe aya to be shishɛr gba so na.”
28Bɛtani nɛ asheŋ ere kikɛ wora ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr be kaba ndoŋ, kakpa nɛ Jɔn daa bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr na.
Ebɔrɛ be Kpakpafɔlbi be asheŋ
29Asheŋ ere ka wora ŋ klade nɛ Jɔn wu Yesu ka bee ba mo kutɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ basa le: “Men keni, Ebɔrɛ be Kpakpafɔlbi nɛ k bee lara durnyaebi be alubi ashi bumo to a lɛ na. 30Mo nɛ n daa de saŋɛ nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ le na fanɛ: ‘Kanyɛn ko wɔ ma kaman a ba na, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ ma kebaawɔtɔ ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito.’ 31Ma ere gbagba daa maŋ nyi mo, ama kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ m ba kaa ta nchu a bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr na e la fanɛ Israɛlebi e wu mo nseŋ pin mo.”
32Kede be kaman nɛ Jɔn ji le be shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ: “N wu Kiyoyu na ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ gbelge m ba fanɛ lepɔ m ba shir a wɔ mo so. 33Nɛ fanɛ esa nɛ e shuŋi ma fanɛ m ba ta nchu m bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr na daa maŋ ŋini ma mo, ma alɛ gba daa maaŋ pin mo. Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ ma: ‘Esa nɛ feeŋ wu Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na ka beeŋ ba gbelge mo so n shir a wɔ mo to na e la esa nɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e gbelge basa so.’ 34Ma alɛ wu nsaa ji shɛda fanɛ mo e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na.”
Yesu be beshuŋipo juŋkparsoana be asheŋ
35Kumo be ŋklade Jɔn nɛ mbe bebɛsopo anyɔ ko naa yil kakpa koŋwule na. 36Nɛ e wu Yesu ka bee choŋ nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Men keni Ebɔrɛ be Kpakpafɔlbi na.” 37Bebɛsopo anyɔ na ka nu kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ na nɛ b ta m bɛ Yesu so. 38Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu gbɛ ŋ keni nɛ b bɛ mo so nɛ e bishi bumo: “Manɛ nɛ menyee fin?” Nɛ b bishi mo: “Rabai, nnɛ nɛ fo wɔ?” Rabai be kifito e la eŋinipo. 39Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men ba keni.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ya wu kakpa nɛ e wɔ nseŋ shir mo kutɔ ndoŋ hale nɛ epeŋi ya tɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, k daa la fanɛ kaaseso kerfi ana be saŋɛ nna. 40Basa anyɔ nɛ b daŋ nu kusɔ nɛ Jɔn daŋ kaŋɛ nseŋ bɛ Yesu so na be eko e daa la Andru, Saimɔn Pita mo sipo na. 41Kusɔ nɛ Andru daŋ baŋ fara n wora e la fanɛ e daŋ fin mo da Saimɔn nna ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “An wu Mesaya na.” Kumo e la fanɛ Kristo na. 42Kumo be kaman nɛ e bar Saimɔn Yesu kutɔ nɛ mo alɛ keni Saimɔn nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Fo e la Saimɔn nɛ fo tuto bee ji Jɔn na ŋko? Naniere baaŋ baa tre fo Sifas.” Kumo be kifito e la kefalta nɛ kumo koŋwule na la Pita.
Yesu ka tre Filip nɛ Nataniɛl be asheŋ
43Kesheŋ ere ka wora ŋklade nɛ Yesu yili kumo fanɛ e bee yɔ Galili be kasawule so. Kumo be kamɔnchɛ na nɛ e tu Filip nseŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Bɛ ma so.” 44Filip daŋ shi Bɛtsaida be kade to nna, kakpa koŋwule nɛ Andru nɛ Pita gba shi na. 45Kumo be kaman nɛ Filip malɛ wu Nataniɛl nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “An wu esa nɛ anebi Mosis sibɛ mbe asheŋ ashi mbra be kawɔl na to na. Mo koŋwule na be asheŋ nɛ anebiana na kikɛ sibɛ na. Mo e la Nazarɛt be Yesu, Josɛf pibi na.” 46Ndoŋ nna nɛ Nataniɛl bishi mo: “Fo kaŋɛ Nazarɛt? Kusɔ lela mo malɛ e naaŋ shi Nazarɛt be kade to?” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip kaŋɛ: “Ba keni.” 47Yesu ka wu Nataniɛl ka bee ba mo kutɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ mo le: “Kashenteŋto, Israɛl be esa gbagba nde nɛ efɛsheŋ kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to.” 48Nɛ Nataniɛl bishi mo: “Nnɛ nɛ fo nyi ma?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Fo ka daa wɔ figi be kedibi na be kifi to pɔɛŋ nɛ Filip tre fo na kikɛ nɛ n wu fo.” 49Nɛ Nataniɛl kaŋɛ mo le: “Rabai, kashenteŋto, fo e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na. Fo e la Israɛl be efuli so be Ewura na.” 50Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Ŋ ka kaŋɛ fo fanɛ n wu fo figi be kedibi na be kifi to na so so nɛ fo yirda ere a? Fo kraa beeŋ wu asheŋ nɛ a chɔ kede ere gba.” 51Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo kikɛ: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ menyeeŋ wu ebɔrɛso ka bugi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be emalaika bee dii a gbelge a ba ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn so.”

Title: JƆN 2
Content:
Yesu ka ta nchu ŋ ki yabra belbelso be asheŋ
1Filip nɛ Nataniɛl ka ba Yesu kutɔ be nchɛnnyɔ be kaman nɛ esa ko bee kre kejafɔ ashi Keena be kade to ashi Galili, nɛ Yesu mo nio gba yɔ ndoŋ. 2B daŋ tre Yesu nɛ mbe bebɛsopo gba kejafɔ na to nna nɛ b yɔ. 3B wɔ ndoŋ nna nɛ kejafɔ na to be yabra belbelso ya loge nɛ Yesu mo nio kaŋɛ mo: “Keni, bumo be yabra belbelso na maŋ naa wɔtɔ.” 4Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Kache manɛ, fee sha keŋini ma asheŋ be kewora nna a? Ma saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo.” 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu mo nio kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ laŋ na to be nyɛrbi le: “Kusɔ kama nɛ e yɛ men wora, men wora.” 6Juwebi daa kɔ eyur be kefɔrso be daŋkare be kabɔrɛbɛso ko nna, amoso, mpuya ashe e daa yil ndoŋ. Mpuya na be kekama daa beeŋ tiŋ n sɔ nchu fanɛ egalɔn adunyɔ ŋko adesa. 7Loŋ be mpuya na be asheŋ nɛ Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ nyɛrbi na le: “Men jɔ nchu m bɔlɔ amo felɛlɛ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ b jɔ nchu na m bɔlɔ amo. 8B ka loge nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “To, naniere men jɔ amo be ako n ya sa kejafɔ be kejigboŋ ere to be enimu na.” Nchu na daŋ kilgi yabra belbelso nna. 9B ka jɔ amo n yɔ nɛ enimu na nuu ŋ keni. Nyɛrbi nɛ b daŋ jɔ nchu na daa nyi kakpa nɛ le be yabra belbelso na daŋ shi, ama enimu na bre daa maŋ nyi. Amoso, e daŋ tre kejafɔ mo kul na nna n lar ekarso n ya kaŋɛ mo le: 10“Keni, yabra belbelso lela nɛ ekama yaa fara a bar nɛ basa bee nuu bumo be keparso pɔɛŋ nɛ baa bar amo nɛ a maŋ wɔ ebel fanɛ ade na kaman. Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ fo ere yaŋ ta alela na n yili loŋ m ba kaa chige amo naniere?”
11Le be mamachi be kesheŋ ere e daa la emamachisheŋ ana nɛ Yesu daŋ wora n wora ana na to be kejuŋkparso ashi Keena, Galili be efuli so. E daŋ wora loŋ nna ŋ ŋini kananɛ mbe kemaŋkura du nɛ mbe bebɛsopo wora mo yirda.
12Ade be kaman nɛ Yesu nɛ mo nio nɛ mo sipoana nɛ mbe bebɛsopoana kikɛ yɔ Kapɛɛniam n ya ji nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ.
Yesu ka ju yawujipoana ashi bɔrɛlambu na to be asheŋ
(Matiu 21:12-13; Maak 11:15-18; Luuk 19:45-46)
13A ka ba ka gbrɛbi nɛ Juwebi be Kebansonchoŋ be daŋkare be kejigboŋ be saŋɛ e fo nɛ Yesu yɔ Jerusalɛm. 14E ka fo ndoŋ nɛ e yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ basa ko wɔ kumo to be kelɔnɛ so a fa ana nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ ali nɛ beko malɛ tase bumo be eteebɔl ase a chɛr amansherbi. 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ e ta amamprɔŋ n wora kuchuchɔ n ju basa na kikɛ nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ ana na kikɛ nseŋ melgi eteebɔl na kikɛ m buu nɛ bumo be amansherbiana na tɔr m pesaŋ to. 16Kumo be kaman nɛ e kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ alifapoana na le: “Men ta amo n lar nfe. Men sa maŋ ta n Tuto pe a ki kebɛ.” 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe bebɛsopoana nyiŋi abɔrɛsibɛ na ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Kasha nɛ fo kɔ a sha fo pe ere shi ma to ga hale a chɔɔ ma to fanɛ edɛ na.” 18Asheŋ ere be kaman nɛ Juwebi be benimuana na ba bishi mo le be kesheŋ bishiso ere, b yɛ: “Manɛ be mamachi be kesheŋ nɛ fo kɔ nɛ fo wora ŋ ŋini anyi nɛ an pin ekpa nɛ fo kɔ a tiŋ a wora le be asheŋ ere kikɛ?” 19Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men jija bɔrɛlambu ere ŋ keni nɛ n naŋ pɔr kumo nchɛ nsa to.” 20Nɛ Juwebi na bishi mo: “B ta nfɛ adena nɛ ashe m pɔr kusɔ nɛ fo ere e tiŋ n ta nchɛ nsa m pɔr kumo a?” 21Ama mannɛ bɔrɛlambu be ebu na gbagba nɛ Yesu daa de. Mbe eyur nɛ e daa de. 22Ebɔrɛ daŋ tiŋi Yesu ashi luwu to nna pɔɛŋ nɛ bebɛsopo na nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b wora abɔrɛsibɛ na nɛ mmalga nɛ Yesu daŋ malga na yirda.
23Yesu ka daa wɔ Jerusalɛm, Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ be saŋɛ na, basa damta daŋ yirda mo nna ŋkpal emamachi be ashuŋ nɛ b daŋ wu e ka wora so. 24Ama Yesu daa maŋ ta mbe kumu m bɔɔ esa kama enɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e nyi dimɛdi kikɛ to nɛnɛ nyam. 25E daa maŋ naa sha dimɛdi kikɛ ka chɛ mo to ŋ ŋini mo kananɛ basa du, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa nyi kusɔ nɛ k wɔ dimɛdi to.

Title: JƆN 3
Content:
Yesu nɛ Nikodimɔs be asheŋ
1Kanyɛn ko e daa wɔtɔ nɛ baa tre mo Nikodimɔs. E daa la Farisi nna nseŋ daa la Juwebi be bejuŋkparpoana na be eko. 2Kachako kiidiso nɛ e yɔ Yesu kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Rabai, mamachi be asheŋ nɛ fee wora ere e shin nɛ an pin fanɛ fo ka la eŋinipo nɛ e shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ wɔ esa to, e maaŋ tiŋ n wora asɔ nɛ fee wora ere.” 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo na fanɛ, nɛ esa baa maŋ nya kakurge nyɔsopo na, e maaŋ wu Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na kikɛ.” 4Nɛ Nikodimɔs bishi mo le: “Nuso nɛ b naa lɔŋɛ a kurge esa kpar? E beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n luri mo nio be epun to kela nyɔsopo pɔɛŋ nɛ b kurge mo a?” 5Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo na fanɛ nɛ b baa maŋ bɔla nchu nɛ Kiyoyu na so ŋ kurge esa, e maaŋ tiŋ n luri Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to. 6Dimɛdi e naa kurge dimɛdi nɛ Kiyoyu na malɛ bee bar kiyoyu na be kakurge. 7Sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa chinchiŋ fo ŋkpal ŋ ka kaŋɛ fo fanɛ: A daga fanɛ b ka naŋ kurge menyi kela nyɔsopo so. 8An ta fanɛ afu le. Kaplɛkama nɛ afu bee sha, ndoŋ nɛ a bee ber a yɔ. Feeŋ tiŋ n nu amo be egbri, ama fo maaŋ tiŋ m pin kakpa nɛ a shi ŋko kakpa nɛ a bee yɔ. To, loŋ gbagba malɛ nɛ k du n sa esa kama nɛ e nya kakurge ashi Kiyoyu na kutɔ.” 9Nɛ Nikodimɔs naŋ bishi Yesu le: “Nɛ nuso nɛ le be kesheŋ beeŋ tiŋ n wora?” 10Nɛ Yesu bishi mo le: “Fo baa la Israɛlebi be eŋinipo ŋkaa maa pin le be asheŋ ere to a? 11Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ an nyi be asheŋ nɛ anyee malga nsaa ji kusɔ nɛ an wu na malɛ be shɛda, ama men kraa maŋ yirda shɛda nɛ anyee ji a sa menyi. 12Keni, durnya ere to be asheŋ nɛ m malga n sa menyi nɛ menyi maŋ yirda amo na. To, nɛ ŋ kaŋ malga ebɔrɛso be asheŋ n sa menyi, nuso nɛ menyeeŋ wora n yirda amo? 13Esa kama maŋ naŋ yɔ ebɔrɛso she emo nɛ e shi ndoŋ m ba na nawule, mo e la ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na.
14Kananɛ anebi Mosis daŋ kre danyaŋ be kabulpi nɛ k du fanɛ kuwɔ ashi kiyi to m mata kedibi nseŋ maŋ kumo so n yili na, loŋ gbagba na nɛ a daga fanɛ b maŋ Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na gba so. 15Saŋɛ na so ekama nɛ e yirda mo beeŋ nya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. 16Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ daŋ sha durnya ere ga so nna nɛ e ta mo Pibinyɛn koŋwule n sa durnya fanɛ nɛ esa kama nɛ e yirda mo, e maaŋ shir, ama e beeŋ nya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maŋ shin nɛ mo Pibinyɛn na ba durnya to nna fanɛ e ba ji kumo demu. Ebɔrɛ shin nna nɛ e ba ki durnya be emɔlgapo. 18Esa kama malɛ nɛ e yirda mo, Ebɔrɛ maaŋ ji mo demu, ama emo nɛ e maŋ yirda mo bre, Ebɔrɛ teŋ ji mo demu, ŋkpal e ka maŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn koŋwule na so. 19Ekpa nɛ demu be keji na beeŋ bɔla so nde fanɛ: Kefulto na ba durnya ere to, ama ŋkpal basa be ashuŋ shunso ka lubi so, baa sha tentembiri a chɔ kefulto na. 20Alubiworapo kikɛ maa sha kefulto. E maaŋ shuli n luri kefulto to, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maa sha mbe asheŋ lubi na ka lar efuli. 21Ama esa kama nɛ e bee wora asheŋ a bɔla ekpa, bee luri kefulto to nna nɛ ekama e wu fanɛ kesheŋ nɛ e wora na, Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nu n sa nseŋ wora kumo.”
Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo ka ji Yesu be shɛda be asheŋ
22Asheŋ ere be kaman nɛ Yesu nɛ mbe bebɛsopo yɔ Judiya be kasawule so nɛ mo nɛ bumo ya ji nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ nseŋ bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr. 23Jɔn gba daa wɔtɔ nna a bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr ashi Eenɔn be kade to nɛ k mata Seelɛm be kade to na, ŋkpal manɛ so, nchu damta ko e daa wɔ ndoŋ nɛ basa daŋ baa ba nɛ e daa bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr. 24Kumo be jemanɛ na so nɛ b maŋ naŋ ti Jɔn ebu.
25Kachako Juwnyɛn ko nɛ Jɔn be bebɛsopo ko nya emɔrɔ ŋkpal eyur so be kefɔr be daŋkare be kabɔrɛbɛso so. 26Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jɔn be bebɛsopo yɔ mo kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Eŋinipo, fo nyiŋi kanyɛn nɛ fo nɛ mo daa la ashi Jɔɔdan be lɔr be kaba ndoŋ na ŋko? Kanyɛn nɛ fo daŋ ji mbe shɛda na. Keni, e wɔtɔ a bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ basa kikɛ shile a yɔ mo kutɔ.” 27Nɛ Jɔn kaŋɛ bumo: “Nyiŋgbasa maaŋ tiŋ n nya shɛŋ mo gbagba be kumu so ama Ebɔrɛ e baŋ sa mo kumo. 28Menyi alɛ gba beeŋ tiŋ n ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ŋ ka daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Mannɛ ma e la Mesaya na, ama b shuŋi ma nna fanɛ n juŋkpar mo m ba.’ 29Kejafɔ mo kul e wɔ eche nɛ baa kre kejafɔ na. Kejafɔ mo teri na bre bee kaa yil nna nseŋ kaŋ kusoe a jo saŋɛ nɛ e beeŋ nu mo teri kejafɔ mo kul na be ebɔl nɛ mbe kagbene e fuli mo ga. Le e naa shin nɛ kagbenefuli bee bɔlɔ ma alɛ gba to. 30A daga fanɛ Yesu na be ketre e baa dii nɛ ma ere peya e baa yɔ kaseto.”
Esa nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso na be asheŋ
31Esa nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso na e chɔ ekama. Emo nɛ e shi kasawule so nfe la kasawule ere so be esa nna nɛ e bee malga kasawule ere so be asheŋ. Ama emo nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso na bre e chɔ ekama nyam. 32Kusɔ nɛ e wu nɛ kusɔ nɛ e nu be asheŋ be shɛda nɛ e bee ji, ama basa maa sha kesɔ loŋ be shɛda na. 33Esa kama malɛ nɛ e sɔ loŋ be shɛda na gbagba bee ji shɛda nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ka la kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ. 34Emo nɛ Ebɔrɛ shuŋi na bee malga Ebɔrɛ be mmalga nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mbe Kiyoyu na bɔlɔ mo to felɛlɛ. 35Amodoŋwura e la Ebinyɛn na nɛ Etuto na malɛ bee sha mo, amoso, e ta kusɔ kama nna m bɔɔ mo enɔ. 36Esa kama nɛ e yirda Ebinyɛn na kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na, ama esa kama nɛ e kini Ebinyɛn na, maaŋ wu ŋkpa na, ama Ebɔrɛ be agbo e naaŋ baa wɔ mo so.

Title: JƆN 4
Content:
Yesu nɛ Samɛria be kache ko be asheŋ
1Jemanɛ ko Efarisiana na nu fanɛ Yesu daa nya nseŋ daa bɛr bebɛsopo a chɔ Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo. 2Ama kashenteŋto, Yesu gbagba daa maŋ bɛr esa kikɛ kabɔrɛbɛr. Mbe bebɛsopo e daa bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr. 3Enyɛnpe ka nu fanɛ Efarisiana na nu kesheŋ na nɛ e lar Judiya be efuli na so nɛ e naŋ bɛta n yɔ Galili be kasawule so.
4Ndoŋ nna nɛ k ba fanɛ e bɔla Samɛria be kasawule so n choŋ. 5E ta loŋ m ba fo kade ko nɛ baa tre Sikaa ashi Samɛria. Sikaa nɛ kasawule nɛ Jeekɔb daŋ ta n sa mo pibi Josɛf na daa maŋ wɔ kufɔ. 6Jeekɔb be ketirbu daa wɔ ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu nite ŋ gben m ba fo ndoŋ kapaso chɛŋchɛŋ nseŋ kilgi n chena ketirbu na ase. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ Samɛria be kache ko ba nɛ e ba jɔ nchu nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Jande, sa ma nchu nɛ n nuu.” 8Saŋɛ na so nɛ mbe bebɛsopo yɔ kade to nɛ b ya tɔ ajibi. 9Nɛ Samɛriache na bishi mo: “To, fo la Juw nna nɛ ma alɛ la Samɛriache, nɛ nuso nɛ fee wora a kule ma nchu nuuso?” [Kache na daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Juwebi nɛ Samɛriaebi maŋ kɔ shɛŋ bumo be nferinto.] 10Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Keni alako fo daa nyi Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nna nseŋ daa nyi esa nɛ e bee kule fo nchu nuuso ere, fo daa beeŋ kule mo nɛ e sa fo nchu nɛ a bee sa ŋkpa.” 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ kache na bishi mo: “To, Ebunyampo, fo maŋ kɔ shɛŋ nfe nɛ fo jɔ nchu ketirbu ere to, ketirbu ere malɛ wɔ nchiŋ nna nɛ nnɛ nɛ feeŋ nya nchu nɛ a bee sa ŋkpa na? 12An nananyɛn Jeekɔb e ta ketirbu ere n sa anyi, mo alɛ nɛ mbe mbia nɛ mbe asɔbɔya kikɛ nuu kumo to be nchu, amoso, fo yɛ fo ŋini fanɛ fo chɔ mo nna ŋko nuso?” 13Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Esa kama nɛ e nuu nchu ere, achukoŋ beeŋ naŋ pɛ amodoŋwura, 14ama esa kama nɛ e nuu nchu nɛ meeŋ sa mo na maaŋ naŋ shu achukoŋ kikɛ. Kashenteŋto, nchu nɛ meeŋ sa amodoŋwura na beeŋ baa wɔ mo to a bul fanɛ ketirbu na a sa mo ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.” 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ kache na kaŋɛ mo: “Ebunyampo, kumo ere fo sa ma loŋ be nchu na nɛ achukoŋ e sa maŋ naŋ pɛ ma kikɛ nɛ n sa maŋ naa ba m ba kaa jɔ nchu.” 16Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Ya tre fo kul m ba nfe.” 17Nɛ kache na kaŋɛ mo: “M maŋ kɔ ekul.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Kashenteŋ nɛ fo ji ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo maŋ kɔ ekul na. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, bekul anu nɛ fo kil ŋ ku so, nɛ enyɛn mo nɛ fo nɛ mo kraa wɔtɔ ere malɛ gba maŋ la fo kul. Amoso, kusɔ nɛ fo baŋ kaŋɛ ere la kashenteŋ nna.” 19Nɛ kache na kaŋɛ: “Ebunyampo, n wu fanɛ fo la anebi nna. 20Kebee ere so nɛ an nanaana daa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ, ama menyi ere Juwebi kaŋɛ fanɛ kakpa nɛ k daga an ka bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ e la Jerusalɛm.” 21Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Kache manɛ, yirda ma kamalga ere fanɛ saŋko beeŋ ba fo nɛ basa maaŋ naa bunyaŋ Etuto na kebee ere so, bumo alɛ maaŋ naa bunyaŋ Etuto na Jerusalɛm to gba. 22Esa nɛ men maŋ nyi nɛ menyi Samɛriaebi bee bunyaŋ, ama anyi ere nyi esa nɛ anyee bunyaŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Juwebi so nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla m mɔlga basa. 23Ama saŋko beeŋ ba fo, k teŋ fo gba nɛ basa e bɔla Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu be eleŋ so a bunyaŋ Etuto na kashenteŋto. Bumo nɛ b kɔ le be bunyaŋ ere nɛ Etuto na bee fin. 24Ebɔrɛ la Kiyoyu nna nɛ a daga fanɛ bumo nɛ baa bunyaŋ mo e baa bɔla mbe Kiyoyu be eleŋ so a bunyaŋ mo kashenteŋto.” 25Nɛ kache na kaŋɛ Yesu le: “Ma alɛ gba nyi fanɛ kachako Mesaya nɛ baa tre Kristo na beeŋ ba, mo alɛ kaŋ ba, e beeŋ bugi kusɔ kama to n sa anyi.” 26Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Ma nɛ mee malga fo kutɔ ere e la mo na.”
27Kumo be saŋɛ na so nɛ Yesu be bebɛsopo shi kade to m bɛta m ba nɛ e bee malga kache na kutɔ nɛ k chinchiŋ bumo ga. Ama bumo alɛ be ekama maŋ tiŋ m bishi kache na: “Manɛ nɛ fee sha?” Ŋko m bishi Yesu: “Manɛ e ba nɛ fee malga kache na kutɔ?” 28Ndoŋ nna nɛ kache na yige mbe kusɔjɔnchu ndoŋ nseŋ kilgi n yɔ kade to n ya kaŋɛ basa le: 29“Kadeebi, men ba keni kanyɛn nɛ e tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ ŋ koso n wora kikɛ, shere Kristo na nna.” 30Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lar kade na to m pɛ Yesu kutɔ be keyɔ be ekpa.
31Kesheŋ ere ka bee wora kade to le ere nɛ Yesu be bebɛsopo malɛ bee kule mo fanɛ e ji ajibi a kaŋɛ mo: “Eŋinipo, wora ania n ji kusɔ ko.” 32Ama le nɛ Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Ŋ kɔ kejibi ko nɛ n ji nɛ men maŋ nyi kumo be asheŋ.” 33Nɛ bebɛsopo na bishi abar: “Ŋko esa ko e bar mo ajibi ŋko nuso?” 34Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma ajibi e la kewora esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na be aparsheŋ nɛ keloge mbe kushuŋ. 35Mannɛ menyi basa e naa kaa kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘A ka afɔl ana nɛ kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ e fo’ na a? Ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ men bugi menyi be anishi ŋ keni kananɛ adɔana du. Asɔ kikɛ daŋ bel nna m pere a jo keteŋi. 36Men keni asɔteŋipo na tea nya mbe kakɔka, mo alɛ bee teŋi asɔ nna a yili ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na be jemanɛ, saŋɛ na so, eduupo na nɛ eteŋipo na kikɛ be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo. 37Basa ka bee kaa malga loŋ be kesheŋ na malɛ fanɛ: ‘Esa ko e naa duu nɛ eko malɛ bee teŋi na’, la kashenteŋ nna. 38N daŋ shuŋi menyi nna nɛ men ya teŋi asɔ nɛ men gbagba maŋ dɔ. Beko e dɔ nɛ menyi ere bee ji amo be tɔnɔ na.”
39Kade na to be Samɛriaebi damta daŋ yirda Yesu nna ŋkpal kache na be shɛda nɛ e daŋ ji ŋ kaŋɛ le na so, e yɛ: “E kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ n wora kikɛ.” 40Amoso, Samɛriaebi na ka ba mo kutɔ, nɛ b ba kule mo fanɛ e ya chena bumo kutɔ nɛ e ya ji nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ. 41Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa damta ko malɛ gba naŋ yirda mo n ti so ŋkpal mbe mmalga na so. 42Nɛ bumo gbagba kaŋɛ kache na: “Naniere bre, mannɛ fo ka kaŋɛ anyi so nɛ an yirda, an gbagba nu mmalga na nseŋ pin fanɛ kashenteŋto kanyɛn ere e la durnya ere be Emɔlgapo.”
Yesu ka bɛta n yɔ Galili be asheŋ
43Yesu ka ji nchɛnnyɔ na ndoŋ n loge nɛ e yɔ Galili be kasawule so. 44Mo ere Yesu gbagba e daŋ chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Anebi kama maŋ kɔ bunyaŋ mo gbagba be basa to.” 45E ka ba fo Galili nɛ ndoŋebi sɔ mo nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ wu asheŋ nɛ e daŋ wora ashi Jerusalɛm to Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ be daŋkare be jemanɛ na. Bumo alɛ gba daa wɔ ndoŋ nna nɛ loŋ be asheŋ na kikɛ daŋ wora.
Yesu ka chɛ enimu ko pibi be asheŋ
(Matiu 8:5-10; Luuk 7:2-10)
46Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu yaŋ yɔ Keena ashi Galili, kakpa nɛ e daŋ keta nchu ŋ ki yabra belbelso na. E ka yɔ nɛ abane be krachi nimuso ko pibinyɛnsobi ko dese Kapɛɛniam a lɔ. 47Kanyɛn na ka nu fanɛ Yesu shi Judiya m ba Galili nɛ e yɔ mo kutɔ n ya kule mo fanɛ e yɔ Kapɛɛniam n ya chɛ mo pibinyɛn nɛ e daa sha nɛ e wu na n sa mo. 48Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Nɛ men be ekama baa maŋ wu mamachi be etɔɔnɛsheŋ, men maa yirda kikɛ.” 49Ndoŋ nna nɛ krachi na kaŋɛ Yesu le: “Ebunyampo, jande, ba nɛ an yɔ nɛ ma kebia na e sa maŋ wu pɔɛŋ nɛ an fo ndoŋ.” 50Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Baa yɔ, fo pibi na maaŋ wu.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na yirda Yesu be kamalga na nseŋ choŋ. 51E kraa wɔ epe be ekpa to nna a yɔ nɛ mbe anya shɛr mo ekpa to ŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ mbe kebia na nya alenfia. 52E ka bishi bumo saŋɛ mo nɛ mbe kebia na fara a nya alenfia nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Ndre kapaso kerfi koŋwule nɛ mbe kayurbeldɛ na yige mo.” 53Ndoŋ nna nɛ etuto na nyiŋi fanɛ kumo be saŋɛ na so gbagba nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ le na: “Fo pibi na maaŋ wu.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ mo nɛ mbe kowu to ebi kikɛ yirda Yesu.
54Kesheŋ ere e daa la mamachi be tɔɔnɛsheŋ nyɔsopo nɛ Yesu daŋ shi Judiya m ba Galili m ba wora.

Title: JƆN 5
Content:
Yesu ka chɛ esa ko nchu ko ase be asheŋ
1Yesu ka wora nchɛnnyɔ nɛ e yɔ Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso be daŋkare ko be Kejigboŋ to ashi Jerusalɛm. 2Kepa ko malɛ kɔ adɛdɛ anu a wɔ Jerusalɛm a mata kakpa nɛ baa tre Mbolpɔ be Kabuna na. Hibruwebi be ŋgbar to kepa na nɛ baa tre Betɛsda. 3Belɔpo nnaŋ to damta ko fanɛ betanpo nɛ ebobi nɛ eyurwusowuraana daa ba ndoŋ nna m ba kaa dese a jo nchu na be kebagato. 4[Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe be malaika daa ba saŋko saŋko nna m ba kaa baga nchu na to. Kebagato na malɛ be kaman elɔpo kama daŋ baŋ juŋkpar n luri nchu na to, amodoŋwura be kulɔ kama nɛ k daa kɔ mo beeŋ lar mo to.] 5Kanyɛn ko malɛ daŋ dese nfɛ adesa nɛ aburwa a lɔ nsaa wɔ ndoŋ. 6Yesu ka wu mo nɛ e dese ndoŋ nseŋ pin e ka dese ndoŋ n chɛr nɛ e bishi mo le: “Fee sha kenya alenfia a?” 7Nɛ elɔpo na kaŋɛ mo le: “Ebunyampo, m maŋ kɔ esa kikɛ nɛ e chɛ ma to nɛ n luri nchu ere to, saŋkama nɛ b baga amo to. Ma alɛ baŋ wora ania a sha keluri amo to nɛ esa ko teŋ daŋ ma keluri to.” 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Niŋi to ŋ koso m bɔɔ fo kelaŋ to a nite.” 9Epul na to nɛ kanyɛn na nya alenfia nseŋ bɔɔ mbe kelaŋ to n fara a nite.
10Amo be kamɔnchɛ malɛ daa la kewushiachɛ nna, amoso, Juwebi be benimu na ka wu kanyɛn na nɛ b kaŋɛ mo le: “Kabre la kewushiachɛ nna. Anyi be mbra na malɛ maa sa ekpa fanɛ fo di fo kelaŋ a na.” 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “Kanyɛn nɛ e chɛ ma na e kaŋɛ ma fanɛ: ‘Bɔɔ fo kelaŋ to a nite.’ ” 12Nɛ b bishi mo: “Esa mo malɛ e kaŋɛ fo fanɛ fo bɔɔ fo kelaŋ to a na?” 13Kanyɛn nɛ e daŋ nya alenfia na daa maŋ nyi amodoŋwura, ŋkpal manɛ so, jimaŋ damta ko e daa wɔ ndoŋ nɛ Yesu daŋ lar bumo to n choŋ. 14Saŋko ba choŋ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Yesu ya wu mo bɔrɛlambu na to be kelɔnɛ so nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Keni, fo naŋ nya alenfia nna na, yige alubi be kebaawora. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, kusɔ nɛ k lubi a chɔ fo kulɔ na beeŋ nya fo.” 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na ya kaŋɛ Juwebi be benimuana na fanɛ Yesu e daŋ chɛ mo na. 16Amoso, Juwebi na daŋ fara nna a tɔrɔ Yesu, ŋkpal e ka daŋ wora le be asheŋ kewushiachɛ na so. 17Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Saŋkikɛ n Tuto bee shuŋ nna, amoso, a daga fanɛ ma alɛ gba e baa shuŋ loŋ.” 18Le be kamalga ere malɛ e daŋ naŋ shin nɛ Juwebi na nyaŋɛ to n ti so a sha kemɔ Yesu na, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ fanɛ e daa jija kewushiachɛ na nawule nna, ama e daa tre Ebɔrɛ mo Tuto gbagba nna a ti so a ŋini fanɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ka la kukoŋwule.
Ebinyɛn na be eleŋ be asheŋ
19Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji menyi na fanɛ ma, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na maa tiŋ a wora shɛŋ ŋ gbagba be kumu so kikɛ. Kusɔ nɛ mee wu n Tuto na ka bee wora nawule nɛ ma alɛ gba bee wora. Kusɔ nɛ Etuto na bee wora, kumo nɛ ma, Ebinyɛn na gba bee wora. 20Ŋkpal manɛ so, Etuto na bee sha ma, Ebinyɛn na ga. Amoso, kusɔ kama nɛ e bee wora, e bee ŋini ma kumo nna. Mo alɛ kraa beeŋ ŋini ma asɔ nɛ a chɔ ade ere nɛ men be nnɔ e mɔ menyi. 21Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ Etuto na bee tiŋi basa luwu to a sa bumo ŋkpa na, loŋ gbagba nna nɛ ma, Ebinyɛn na bee sa basa nɛ mee sha ŋkpa. 22Kumo be kaman, Etuto na maa ji esa kama demu, e ta demu be keji kikɛ nna m bɔɔ ma, Ebinyɛn na enɔ, 23saŋɛ na so, ekama beeŋ bunyaŋ ma, Ebinyɛn na fanɛ kananɛ baa bunyaŋ Etuto na. Ekama malɛ nɛ e maa bunyaŋ ma, Ebinyɛn na maa bunyaŋ Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na gba nna na.
24Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ esa kama nɛ e nu ma mmalga ere nseŋ yirda esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na, mo alɛ maaŋ ji n tɔr, ama e teŋ lar luwu to m ba luri ŋkpa to. 25Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ saŋko beeŋ ba fo, saŋɛ na teŋ fo gba fanɛ bubuni beeŋ nu ma, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na be ebɔl, ekama malɛ nɛ e nu kumo beeŋ nya ŋkpa a wɔtɔ. 26Kananɛ ŋkpa shi Etuto na to na, loŋ gbagba na nɛ e shin nɛ ŋkpa bee shi Ebinyɛn na gba to. 27Mo alɛ sa Ebinyɛn na ekpa nna nɛ e ji basa demu ŋkpal ebi na ka la Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na so. 28Men sa maŋ shin nɛ kesheŋ ere e baa chinchiŋ menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋko beeŋ ba fo nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ bumo be nchaŋana to na kikɛ e nu Ebinyɛn na be ebɔl 29nseŋ lar bumo be nchaŋana na to nɛ bumo nɛ b wora alelasheŋ na e tiŋi a wɔ ŋkpa to nɛ bumo nɛ b wora alubisheŋ na malɛ e tiŋi n luri kasogberge to.
30Ma alɛ gbagba maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ ma kumu so. Kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ ma be demu nɛ mee ji, amoso, ma demu be keji kɔ kashenteŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ ŋ gbagba be aparsheŋ nɛ mee wora, esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na be aparsheŋ nɛ mee wora. 31Nɛ m baŋ ji ŋ gbagba be kumu so be shɛda, kumo ere ma shɛda na maŋ la shɛda kpakpaso. 32Ama esa pɔtɛ ko wɔtɔ a ji ma shɛda a sa basa nɛ ma alɛ nyi amodoŋwura be loŋ be shɛda na ka bɔla ekpa. 33Men gbagba e shuŋi mbɔ Jɔn kutɔ, mo alɛ ji kashenteŋ na be shɛda n sa menyi. 34Mannɛ fanɛ dimɛdi be shɛda nɛ mee sha, ama m malga kesheŋ ere nna nɛ men tiŋ n nya kumɔlga. 35Jɔn daa du fanɛ fitila nɛ k chɔɔ so nna a sa basa kefulto nɛ men daŋ shuli n wu kefulto na be ebel gbrɛbi. 36Ama ŋ kɔ shɛda kpakpaso a chɔ Jɔn be shɛda na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, ashuŋ nɛ mee shuŋ ere, amo nɛ Etuto na sa fanɛ n shuŋ na e naa ji ma shɛda a ŋini fanɛ Etuto na e shuŋi ma. 37Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na malɛ gba bee ji ma shɛda nna a sa basa. Menyi maŋ naŋ nu mbe ebɔl ŋko n wu mbe anishito. 38Mbe kamalga na malɛ gba maa chena menyi to, ŋkpal manɛ so, men maŋ yirda esa nɛ e shuŋi mo na. 39Menyi e naa kaa keni abɔrɛsibɛ na to nɛnɛ ŋkpal men ka bee fɛ fanɛ amo to nɛ menyeeŋ bɔla n nya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na so, ama ma alɛ be asheŋ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ bee ji shɛda a kaŋɛ na. 40Ama menyi alɛ maa sha keba ŋ kutɔ m ba nya ŋkpa na.
41M maa fin kechɔrɔ ashi basa kutɔ. 42Ama n nyi menyi, men maŋ kɔ kasha a sha Ebɔrɛ menyi be ŋgbeneana to. 43N Tuto be ketre nɛ n ta m ba nɛ men kini ma na, ama nɛ esa pɔtɛ ko baŋ ta mo gbagba be eleŋ m ba, menyeeŋ sɔ amodoŋwura na. 44Menyee sha kebaanya mbo abar kutɔ, ama men maa wora ania a fin mbo ashi Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na kutɔ nɛ nuso nɛ menyeeŋ wora n yirda? 45Ama men sa maa fɛ bre fanɛ ma e naaŋ yili Ebɔrɛ be anishito ŋ ŋini mo menyi be alubi. Ayai, esa nɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ menyi be alubi e dii efuli e la anebi Mosis nɛ men ta menyi be tama kikɛ n deŋi so na. 46Nɛ men daŋ yirda Mosis be mmalga kenishipereso nna, men daa beeŋ yirda ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma asheŋ nɛ e daŋ sibɛ n sa menyi na. 47Ama men ka maŋ yirda kusɔ nɛ e sibɛ na bre, nuso nɛ menyeeŋ wora n yirda asheŋ nɛ mee malga?”

Title: JƆN 6
Content:
Yesu ka sa basa ŋgboŋ anu ajibi be asheŋ
(Matiu 14:13-21; Maak 6:30-44; Luuk 9:10-17)
1Asheŋ ere be kaman nɛ Yesu yɔ Galili be kepagboŋ na be kaba so ndoŋ. Teku koŋwule na nɛ baa tre Taibɛrias be kepagboŋ na. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ jimaŋ damta ko muu m bɛ mo so ŋkpal kechɛ basa be alɔ be emamachisheŋ damta nɛ b daŋ wu e ka daa wora na so so. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu dii kebee ko n yɔ nɛ mo nɛ mbe bebɛsopo ya chena. 4Kumo be kamɔnchɛ nɛ Juwebi be Kebansonchoŋ be daŋkare be kejigboŋ bee taga to. 5Yesu ka chena kebee na so nseŋ wu jimaŋ ko ka bee ba mo kutɔ nɛ e bishi Filip: “Filip, nnɛ nɛ anyeeŋ nya bodobodo n tɔ n sa basa ere nɛ b ji?” 6Yesu daŋ kute nna m bishi Filip loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa nyi kusɔ nɛ e daa sha nɛ e wora gba nseŋ bishi mo loŋ na. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip kaŋɛ mo le: “Cha, pɔŋ alfa anyɔ gba be bodobodo maaŋ fo basa ere kikɛ nɛnɛ.” 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na be emo nɛ baa tre Andru, Saimɔn Pita mo sipo na kaŋɛ: 9“Kebia ko wɔ nfe a kɔ ayunyifu be ebodobodo anu nɛ ekɔrɔtɔ anyɔ, ama manɛ nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ n wora n sa basa damta ere?” 10Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mbe bebɛsopo na le: “Men shin nɛ basa na e chena kasawule.” Afitiri damta ko malɛ daa wɔ ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na kikɛ chena amo so. B daa sa fanɛ benyɛn ŋgboŋ anu. 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu ta ebodobodo na nseŋ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nseŋ fara a sa basa nɛ b daŋ chena ndoŋ na. Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ e daŋ ta kɔrɔtɔ na gba n wora. Kanaŋkamaso nɛ ekama daa beeŋ tiŋ n we nɛ e we m moɛ. 12Basa na kikɛ ka baŋ we m moɛ nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mbe bebɛsopo na: “Men tise n tise ejiŋka na nsaa maŋ shin nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ e to jiga.” 13Ndoŋ nna nɛ b tise n tise ayunyifu be bodobodo nɛ basa na daŋ we ŋ ka na m bɔlɔ nlantaŋɛ kuduanyɔ. 14Basa na ka wu mamachi be kesheŋ nɛ e daŋ wora na nɛ b fara a kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋto, Anebi mo nɛ e beeŋ ba durnya ere to na nna na.”
15Yesu ka pin fanɛ b daa sha kebaata mo katinso nna m buu mo kuwura nɛ e bɔl bumo to n naŋ lar mo nawule n yɔ kebeebi ko so.
Yesu ka nite nchu so be asheŋ
(Matiu 14:22-33; Maak 6:45-52)
16Kaase ka fo nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na malɛ yɔ kepagboŋ na ase 17n ya luri ekuloŋ ko to n dii kepagboŋ na a yɔ Kapɛɛniam, kepagboŋ na be kaba ndoŋ. B ta loŋ hale nɛ kaboŋ ya kaa pɛ anishi nɛ Yesu maŋ naŋ ba bumo kutɔ. 18B wɔ nchu na so nna nɛ afugboŋ ko fara a ber a baga nchu na to. 19B ka far ekuloŋ na loŋ fanɛ emayɛl asa ŋko ana n yɔ anishito nɛ b wu Yesu nɛ e na nchu na so a ba ekuloŋ na akpa nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ga. 20Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma nna, men sa maa lɔ kufu.” 21Ndoŋ nna nɛ b daa sha keta mo ekuloŋ na to, epul na malɛ to nɛ ekuloŋ na teŋ fo kedeŋiso.
Basa na ka fin Yesu be asheŋ
22Kumo be ŋklade nɛ jimaŋ nɛ b daŋ shir a wɔ kepagboŋ na be kaba ndoŋ na wu fanɛ ekuloŋ koŋwule e ka ndoŋ nseŋ naŋ pin fanɛ mannɛ Yesu nɛ mbe bebɛsopo e yɔ, bumo nawule e daŋ yɔ. 23Taibɛrias be ekuloŋ ko malɛ daŋ ba kaa yil kepagboŋ na be ekarso a mata kakpa nɛ Yesu daŋ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nseŋ sa basa na ajibi na. 24Amoso, jimaŋ na ka maŋ wu Yesu ŋko mbe bebɛsopo ndoŋ na nɛ b luri ekuloŋana na to a yɔ Kapɛɛniam nɛ b ya fin Yesu.
Yesu ka la ŋkpa be bodobodo be asheŋ
25B ka ya wu mo kepagboŋ na be kaba ere so ndoŋ nɛ b bishi mo: “Eŋinipo, saŋɛ mo nɛ fo fo nfe?” 26Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ, mannɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ men wu na so nɛ menyee fin ma, ama men ka we ebodobodo na ŋ kukwe kananɛ menyee sha na so e shin nɛ menyee fin ma na. 27Men sa maa kɔ a fin ajibi nɛ a bee jija ere, men baa kɔ a fin ajibi nɛ a bee sa ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. Ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn e naa sa loŋ be ajibi na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ Etuto na e ŋini fanɛ mbe kenyi wɔ ma so.” 28Nɛ b bishi mo: “To, nɛ manɛ nɛ anyeeŋ wora n tiŋ n shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be ashuŋ?” 29Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ebɔrɛ be kushuŋ e la keyirda esa nɛ e shuŋi na.” 30Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bishi mo: “To, nɛ nuso be mamachi be kesheŋ nɛ feeŋ wora n sa anyi nɛ an wu nseŋ yirda fo? Manɛ nɛ feeŋ wora? 31An nanaana daŋ ji ajibi nɛ baa tre manna na nna ashi kiyi to, loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ bodobodo shi ebɔrɛso nna m ba sa bumo nɛ b we.’ ”
32Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men keni, kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ mannɛ Mosis e daŋ sa menyi ebɔrɛso be bodobodo na. N Tuto e naa sa menyi kashenteŋ be bodobodo nɛ k bee shi ebɔrɛso na. 33Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be bodobodo na e la bodobodo nɛ k shi ebɔrɛso m ba kaa sa durnya ŋkpa na.” 34Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ Yesu le: “Ebunyampo, kumo ere, yili kabre a yɔ, baa sa anyi loŋ be bodobodo na.” 35Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma e la loŋ be bodobodo nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa na. Ekama nɛ e ba ŋ kutɔ, akoŋ maaŋ pɛ mo kikɛ nɛ ekama nɛ e yirda ma, achukoŋ malɛ maaŋ pɛ mo. 36Ama n teŋ kaŋɛ menyi kumo fanɛ men wu ma, ama menyi alɛ kraa maŋ yirda. 37Esa kama nɛ n Tuto na ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ beeŋ ba ŋ kutɔ nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e ba ŋ kutɔ, m maaŋ ju mo n lɛ kikɛ. 38Ŋkpal manɛ so, n shi ebɔrɛso nna m ba nɛ m ba wora esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na be aparsheŋ, mannɛ ŋ gbagba be aparsheŋ so e shin nɛ m ba. 39Esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na malɛ be aparsheŋ nde fanɛ n sa maŋ kaŋ paŋ basa nɛ e ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na kikɛ be ekama, ama e yili kumo nna fanɛ n tiŋi bumo ashi luwu to lalaloge be kachɛ na. 40Ŋkpal manɛ so, n Tuto be aparsheŋ e la fanɛ esa kama nɛ e wu ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na nseŋ yirda, amodoŋwura beeŋ nya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na nɛ n tiŋi mo ashi luwu to lalaloge be kachɛ na.”
41Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na fara a malga a gbiti mo ŋkpal e ka kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ma e la bodobodo nɛ k shi ebɔrɛso m ba na” so. 42B yɛ: “Mannɛ mo e la Yesu, Josɛf pibi na a? To, an nyi mo tuto nɛ mo nio nɛ a ji nuso nna nɛ e bee kaŋɛ mbe kumu fanɛ: ‘Ebɔrɛso nɛ n shi m ba?’ ” 43Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men yige kebaamalga le be asheŋ a sa abar.
44Esa kama maaŋ tiŋ m ba ma kutɔ ama Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na baŋ bar mo ŋ kutɔ nna, ma alɛ beeŋ tiŋi amodoŋwura ashi luwu to lalaloge be kachɛ na. 45Anebiana na be nsibɛ na to bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ŋini basa kikɛ asheŋ.’ Ekama nɛ e bee nu kusɔ nɛ Etuto na bee kaŋɛ nseŋ naa koya asheŋ ashi mo kutɔ bee ba ŋ kutɔ nna. 46Ama mannɛ fanɛ esa daŋ wu Etuto na kenishiso nna. Emo nɛ e shi Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ na nawule e wu Etuto na. 47Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ ekama nɛ e yirda ma kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.
48Ma e la bodobodo nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa na. 49Men nananyɛnana daŋ we manna kiyi to ŋkeshin nɛ bumo alɛ daŋ wu. 50Ama bodobodo nɛ k shi ebɔrɛso m ba nɛ esa e we a maaŋ wu na nde. 51Ma e la bodobodo nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa n shi ebɔrɛso na. Esa kama nɛ e we le be bodobodo ere beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ. Bodobodo mo nɛ meeŋ ta n sa basa na e la ma eyur ere nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa durnya nɛ k nya ŋkpa na.”
52Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na fara a bile asheŋ agboso a kaŋɛ: “Nuso nɛ le be esa bee wora a sa anyi mbe eyur nɛ an we?” 53Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ nɛ men baa maŋ we Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na be eyur na nseŋ nuu mbe ŋklaŋ na, men maaŋ nya ŋkpa. 54Esa kama nɛ e bee we ma eyur na nsaa nuu ma ŋklaŋ na kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. Ma alɛ beeŋ tiŋi mo ashi luwu to lalaloge be kachɛ na, 55ŋkpal manɛ so, ma eyur ere la ajibi gbagba nna nɛ ma ŋklaŋ malɛ la asɔnuuso gbagba. 56Esa kama malɛ nɛ e we ma eyur ere nseŋ nuu ma ŋklaŋ wɔ ma to nna nɛ ma alɛ gba wɔ mo to. 57Kananɛ Etuto nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa na baŋ shuŋi ma nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to ŋkpal Etuto na so na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ esa kama nɛ e we ma eyur na malɛ gba beeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to ŋkpal ma so. 58Bodobodo nɛ k shi ebɔrɛso m ba na nde. An nananyɛnana daŋ we manna nna, ama b wu. Ama esa kama nɛ e we le be bodobodo beeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to hale mbaanaayɔ.”
59Yesu daa wɔ Kapɛɛniam be nshɛrbu to nna a ŋini basa abɔrɛsheŋ nseŋ malga kesheŋ ere.
Bebɛsopo damta ka shile Yesu be asheŋ
60Mbe bebɛsopo damta ko ka nu kesheŋ nɛ e malga na nɛ b kaŋɛ abar le: “Cha, keŋini ere bre la kesheŋ kpakpaso nna, wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n sɔ kumo?” 61Yesu ka pin fanɛ mbe bebɛsopo daa bile asheŋ nna ŋkpal kesheŋ na so nɛ e bishi bumo: “Kesheŋ nɛ m malga na bee pɔ menyi aba nna ŋko? 62To, nɛ men daŋ wu ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn ka bɛta a yɔ ebɔrɛso, kakpa nɛ n daa wɔ na ai? 63Kiyoyu na bee sa ŋkpa nna, ama eyur ere bre maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ. Mmalga nɛ m malga n sa menyi ere e naa shin nɛ menyee nya Kiyoyu nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa na. 64Ama menyi to be beko maŋ yirda.” Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, sososo na kikɛ e daa nyi bumo nɛ b maŋ yirda nɛ emo nɛ e beeŋ debɔr mo. 65Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Amoso nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ esa kama maaŋ tiŋ m ba ŋ kutɔ ama Etuto na e naaŋ shin nɛ amodoŋwura na e ba na.”
66Baŋ yili kumo be jemanɛ na so a yɔ nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na be bedamta lar mo kaman m bɛ mo so ŋ gben.
Pita ka kaŋɛ Yesu e la Ebɔrɛ be Esa cheembi na be asheŋ
67Nɛ Yesu kilgi m bishi bebɛsopo kuduanyɔ na le: “Menyi alɛ gba bee sha keyɔ nna ŋko?” 68Ndoŋ nna nɛ Saimɔn Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Enyɛnpe, fo e kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na be mmalga. 69To, nɛ wanɛ malɛ kutɔ nɛ anyeeŋ naŋ yɔ? Anyi ere yirda nsaa nyi fanɛ fo e la Ebɔrɛ be Esa cheembi na.” 70Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋto, ma e lara menyi basa kuduanyɔ ere, ama menyi to be eko la alubipo nna.” 71Judas, Saimɔn Iskareɔt pibi nɛ e daa de na, ŋkpal manɛ so, bebɛsopo kuduanyɔ na to be eko e daa la mo, ama mo e daa shin nɛ e ba debɔr Yesu kacha ko.

Title: JƆN 7
Content:
Yesu nɛ mo siponyɛnsoana be asheŋ
1Ade be kaman nɛ Yesu shir a wɔ Galili be efuli so be nde nawule to a nite a maa sha kenite Judiya bre to, ŋkpal manɛ so, ndoŋ be Juwebi be benimuana na daa fin mo nna nɛ b mɔ. 2Ama Juwebi be daŋkare so be nshɛr nɛ baa tre Abuu to be Kebaawɔ be kejigboŋ na be jemanɛ na ka ba kaa fo 3nɛ Yesu mo siponyɛnsoana kaŋɛ mo le: “A daŋ daga fo ka lar nfe nna n yɔ Judiya nɛ fo bebɛsopo e ya wu fo asheŋ woraso. 4B yɛ: ‘Esa kama nɛ e bee sha nɛ basa e baa nyi mbe asheŋ maa ŋana a wora asheŋ.’ Amoso, fo ka baa wora asheŋ ere, shin nɛ durnya e wu fo.” 5Kede e naa ŋini fanɛ hale mo siponyɛnsoana gba daa maŋ yirda mo. 6Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo, ama menyi ere, saŋɛ kikɛ walɛ nna n sa menyi. 7Durnya maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kishi menyi ere, ama ma ere, k kishi ma nna ŋkpal ŋ ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ kumo be asheŋ woraso maŋ walɛ so. 8Men baa yɔ Kejigboŋ be nshɛr na to. Ma ere maa yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma saŋɛ maŋ naŋ fo.” 9E ka kaŋɛ loŋ n loge nɛ e shir a wɔ Galili.
Yesu ka yɔ Abuu to be Kebaawɔ be daŋkare be kejigboŋ to be asheŋ
10Ama mo siponyɛnsoana na ka choŋ Kejigboŋ na to n loge nɛ Yesu malɛ gba yɔ, ama wulo to nɛ e daŋ ŋana n yɔ. 11Ama saŋɛ na so nɛ Juwebi na malɛ wɔ Kejigboŋ na to a fin mo a bishi le: “To, nnɛ nɛ kanyɛn na wɔ?” 12Jimaŋ na to be bedamta daŋ baa wɔtɔ nna a kuli a malga mbe asheŋ. Beko yɛ: “Esa lela nna.” Nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ: “Ayai, e bee fule basa nna.” 13Ama ekama daa maŋ nya kagbene m bugi to m malga mbe asheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa ŋana Juwebi be benimuana na nna.
14Kejigboŋ na to be asheŋ woraso na daŋ kraa wɔ nferinto nna a yɔ nɛ Yesu koso n yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya fara a ŋini basa abɔrɛsheŋ. 15Mbe keŋini na daŋ chinchiŋ Juwebi na ga nɛ b bishi abar: “Nnɛ nɛ kanyɛn ere nya le be keŋini ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maŋ koya ko?” 16Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma keŋini maŋ la meya nna. K shi esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na kutɔ nna. 17Esa kama nɛ e bee sha kewora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ beeŋ pin fanɛ asɔ nɛ mee ŋini ere shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna ŋko ŋ gbagba be eleŋ nɛ ŋ kɔ a ŋini amo. 18Esa kama nɛ e kɔ mo gbagba be eleŋ a malga asheŋ, bee fin mo gbagba be kemaŋkura nna na. Ama esa kama nɛ e bee fin kemaŋkura a sa esa nɛ e shuŋi mo la kashenteŋwura nna nɛ efɛsheŋ kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo so. 19Mannɛ anebi Mosis e daŋ sa menyi mbra na ŋko? Ama men be ekama maa bɛ mbra na so. Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ menyee sha kemɔ ma?” 20Ndoŋ nna nɛ jimaŋ na kaŋɛ mo le: “Fo kɔ kiyoyu lubi fo to. Wanɛ e naa sha kemɔ fo?” 21Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men keni, n wora mamachi be kesheŋ koŋwule nɛ k chinchiŋ menyi ga. 22Ama ŋkpal Mosis ka sa menyi mbra fanɛ men baa ku atutu so, menyee ku menyi be mbiana nna kewushiachɛ. Ama kashenteŋto, mannɛ Mosis e daŋ sa menyi mbra na, men nananyɛnana e nase kumo. 23To, nɛ menyee tiŋ a ku menyi be mbia atutu kewushiachɛ na, saŋɛ na so men maaŋ tɔr Mosis be mbra na, manɛ e ba nɛ menyee nya agbo a wora ma ŋkpal ŋ ka chɛ esa lelemu na kewushiachɛ so? 24Men sa maa yili basa be asheŋ nɛ menyee wu kenishiso so a ji bumo demu, men baa ji kashenteŋ be demu.”
Basa ka bee sha kepin esa nɛ Yesu la be asheŋ
25Saŋɛ ere so nɛ Jerusalɛm to be basa ko fara a bishi abar le: “Mannɛ kanyɛn ere nɛ baa fin nɛ b mɔ na a? 26To, mo e yil a malga basa kikɛ to na nɛ esa kama malɛ maa tuge shɛŋ. Ŋko Juwebi be benimuana na wu kumo naniere nna fanɛ mo e la Kristo na a? 27Kusɔ koŋwule nde fanɛ nɛ Mesaya na kaŋ ba, esa kama maaŋ pin kakpa nɛ e shi m ba, ama kanyɛn ere bre, an nyi kakpa nɛ e shi.” 28Saŋɛ na nɛ Yesu kraa ŋini abɔrɛsheŋ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nseŋ ba kaŋɛ awɔrso le: “Kashenteŋ nna nɛ men nyi ma nsaa nyi kakpa nɛ n shi. Ama mannɛ ŋ gbagba be kumu so so nɛ n wɔ nfe, esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na la Kashenteŋwura nna. Men maŋ nyi mo. 29Ama ma ere nyi mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo kutɔ nɛ n shi. Mo alɛ e shuŋi ma.”
30E ka malga le ere nɛ b yɛlga kepɛ mo ndoŋ, ama esa kama maŋ tiŋ n ta enɔ m beta mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe saŋɛ daa maŋ naŋ fo.
31Le be nfɛra e daa wɔ basa na to, ama jimaŋ na to be bedamta malɛ daŋ yirda mo nseŋ bishi abar le: “Menyee tama fanɛ Mesaya na kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ba wora emamachisheŋ damta mo nɛ a chɔ amo nɛ kanyɛn ere bee wora ere a?”
B ka shuŋi basa nɛ b ya pɛ Yesu be asheŋ
32Ndoŋ nna nɛ asheŋ nɛ basa na bee kuli a kaŋɛ Yesu be asheŋ na tɔr Efarisiana na be asoe to. Nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana nɛ Efarisiana na shuŋi bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo fanɛ b ya pɛ Yesu m ba. 33Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ le: “Ma nɛ menyi maaŋ naa wɔtɔ n chɛr. Meeŋ yɔ esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na kutɔ. 34Menyeeŋ fin ma, ama men maaŋ naŋ wu ma. Kakpa nɛ ma alɛ beeŋ baa wɔ na, menyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ ndoŋ.” 35Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi be benimuana na fara a bishi abar le: “To, nnɛ nɛ kanyɛn ere bee sha keyɔ nɛ anyi ere maaŋ tiŋ n wu mo ere? Ŋko e bee yɔ an peebi nɛ b wɔ Griikebi to na nna nɛ e ya kaa ŋini bumo abɔrɛsheŋ? 36E yɛ: ‘Menyeeŋ fin ma, ama men maaŋ wu ma’, nseŋ naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Menyi maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ kakpa nɛ meeŋ ya kaa wɔ na.’ ”
Nchu nɛ a bee sa ŋkpa na be asheŋ
37Kejigboŋ na be nshɛr na be lalaloge be kachɛ, kumo be kachɛgboŋ na ka fo nɛ Yesu niŋi to n yili ŋ kaŋɛ awɔrso: “Esa kama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo, e ba ŋ kutɔ m ba nuu. 38Esa kama nɛ e yirda ma, nchu nɛ a bee sa ŋkpa na e naaŋ ba lar mo to fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na.” 39Yesu daŋ malga le nna a ŋini Kiyoyu nɛ bumo nɛ baaŋ yirda mo na beeŋ ba nya kachako na be asheŋ. Amo be saŋɛ na so malɛ kikɛ nɛ b maŋ naŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu na ba, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ na so b maŋ naŋ maŋ Yesu so n sa mo kemaŋkura.
40Basa na ka nu mbe mmalga na nɛ bumo be beko kaŋɛ le: “Kashenteŋto, kanyɛn ere e la Anebi na.” 41Nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ: “Mesaya na nna.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ beko malɛ bishi: “Nuso nɛ Mesaya na bee wora ashi Galili? 42Abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to nɛ Mesaya na beeŋ shi nɛ b kurge mo ashi Bɛtlɛhɛm, kade nɛ Ewura Deevid daŋ shi na.” 43Amoso, basa na daŋ barga to nna ŋkpal Yesu so. 44Beko daa sha kepɛ mo m mɔ, ama esa kikɛ daa maŋ ta enɔ m beta mo.
Kananɛ Juwebi be bejuŋkparpo maŋ kɔ yirda be asheŋ
45Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo na bɛta n yɔ bɔrɛmatapowuraana nɛ Efarisiana na kutɔ nɛ b bishi bekumpo na: “Manɛ e ba nɛ men maŋ bar mo?” 46Nɛ bekumpo na kaŋɛ bumo le: “Kananɛ kanyɛn na bee malga na, esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ malga loŋ.” 47Nɛ Efarisiana na bishi bekumpo na: “E fule menyi alɛ gba nna a? 48Kumo be kaman, men daŋ wu Juwebi be ejuŋkparpo kama ŋko Farisi kama ka yirda mo a? 49To, jimaŋ na to ebi ka maŋ nyi Mosis be mbra na so so nɛ baa yirda mo na, bumo alɛ wɔ kɔnɔso to nna so.” 50Nikodimɔs nɛ e daŋ yɔ n ya wu Yesu kachako na daa la bumo be eko nna nɛ e bishi mo braana le: 51“Anyi be mbra na wɔtɔ fanɛ an kaŋɛ fanɛ esa daga kasogberge nɛ anyi alɛ maŋ nu kusɔ nɛ amodoŋwura kɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ nseŋ naŋ bishi m pin to pɔɛŋ nsaa ji mo demu a?” 52Ndoŋ nna nɛ mo braana na bishi mo le: “Fo alɛ gba shi Galili nna a? Kraŋ abɔrɛsibɛ na, feeŋ wu fanɛ anebi kikɛ maa lar Galili.”
Kache nɛ b pɛ kesakalea to na be asheŋ
53Ade be kaman nɛ ekama yɔ mo pe.

Title: JƆN 8
Content:
[ 1Nɛ Yesu malɛ yɔ Ɔlifs be kebee so. 2Kare ka bee chɛ nɛ e naŋ ba bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ basa na kikɛ shɛr ŋ kulti mo nɛ e kilgi n chena a ŋini bumo abɔrɛsheŋ. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbraŋinipoana na nɛ Efarisiana na bar kache ko b ka pɛ kesakalea to m ba shin nɛ e yili jimaŋ na be anishito nɛ b kaŋɛ Yesu le: 4“Eŋinipo, b pɛ kache ere kesakalea to nna geeŋ. 5Mbra na malɛ to Mosis kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ an kpa loŋ be beche na ajembu m mɔ. To, nɛ nuso nɛ fo alɛ kaŋɛ?” 6B daŋ bar le be kesheŋ bishiso ere nna nɛ b ba lute mo kɔnɔ n nya kusɔ ko n yili so n wu mo kulubi. Ama Yesu daŋ kilgi nna m murgi n ta mbe keshilbi n fara a sibɛ kasawule so. 7B ka kraa wɔtɔ a bishi mo na nɛ e niŋi to n yili ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Menyi be ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi e fara ŋ kpa kache ere kejembu.” 8Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ murgi a sibɛ kasawule so. 9Yesu ka kaŋɛ loŋ na nɛ bumo nɛ b nu na fara a yɔ kukoko to. Benimu e daŋ fara loŋ hale nɛ Yesu nawule ya ka nɛ kache na malɛ kraa yil ndoŋ. 10Nɛ Yesu niŋi to m bishi mo: “Kache manɛ, b wɔ nnɛ? Esa kama maŋ ka nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ fo daga kasogberge a?” 11Nɛ kache na kaŋɛ Yesu: “Ebunyampo, esa kama maŋ ka.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “To, ma alɛ gba maaŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo daga kasogberge. Baa yɔ, ama sa maŋ naa wora alubi.”]
Yesu ka la durnya be kefulto be asheŋ
12Yesu ka naŋ ya malga basa na kutɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma e la durnya be kefulto. Esa kama nɛ e bɛ ma so maaŋ nite tentembiri to kikɛ, ama e beeŋ baa kɔ kefulto nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa.” 13Ndoŋ nna nɛ Efarisiana kaŋɛ mo: “Too, fo kumu so be shɛda nɛ fee ji na, amoso, asheŋ nɛ fee malga ere maŋ la kashenteŋ.” 14Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Hale nɛ n ji ma kumu so be shɛda gba, asɔ nɛ mee malga ere kɔ kashenteŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, n nyi kakpa nɛ n shi m ba nseŋ naa nyi kakpa nɛ mee yɔ, ama menyi ere maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ n shi m ba nɛ kakpa nɛ mee yɔ. 15Dimɛdi be ekpa so nɛ menyee bɔla a ji esa demu, ma ere maa ji esa kama demu. 16Hale nɛ n ji esa demu gba, ma demuji daa beeŋ baa kɔ ekpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ n nawule nna, ma nɛ Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na nna. 17Menyi alɛ gbagba be mbra to nɛ b sibɛ fanɛ basa anyɔ baŋ ji kesheŋ koŋwule be shɛda, kesheŋ na la kashenteŋ nna. 18Ŋ gbagba bee ji ma kumu so be shɛda nɛ Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na malɛ gba bee ji ma shɛda.” 19Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na bishi mo: “Nnɛ nɛ fo tuto wɔ?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men maŋ nyi ma, menyi alɛ maŋ nyi n Tuto gba. Men daa nyi ma nna, men daa beeŋ baa nyi n Tuto gba.”
20Bɔrɛlambu na to be kakpa nɛ k mata kaboŋ nɛ baa yili amansherbi be edekana na nɛ Yesu daŋ yili ŋ ŋini asheŋ ere kikɛ, ama esa kikɛ daa maŋ pɛ mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe saŋɛ daa maŋ naŋ fo.
Basa ka maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ kakpa nɛ Yesu bee yɔ na be asheŋ
21Kede be kaman nɛ Yesu naŋ lɔŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Meeŋ yɔ nɛ menyi e fin ma ŋ gben nseŋ wu menyi be alubi to. Kakpa nɛ ma ere bee yɔ na, menyi maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ ndoŋ.” 22Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na bishi abar: “E bee sha kemɔ mbe kumu nna so nɛ e yɛ: ‘Kakpa nɛ mee yɔ na, menyi maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ na’, ŋko nuso?” 23Nɛ Yesu naŋ ta mbe kamalga n chuge so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kasawule ere nfe nɛ menyi ere shi, ama esoso nɛ ma ere shi, durnya ere to nɛ men shi, ama mannɛ durnya ere to nɛ ma ere shi. 24Amoso nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ menyeeŋ wu menyi be alubi to na. Menyi alɛ baa maŋ yirda fanɛ ma e la esa nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n la ere, menyeeŋ wu menyi be alubi to.” 25Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bishi mo: “Nɛ wanɛ e la fo bre?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Kumo nɛ m baa wɔtɔ a kaŋɛ menyi sososo na kikɛ na. 26Asɔ damta wɔtɔ nɛ n yili amo so m malga menyi be asheŋ nseŋ ji menyi demu, ama esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na la Kashenteŋjipo nna. Ma alɛ, kusɔ nɛ mee nu ashi mo kutɔ nɛ mee ta a kaŋɛ durnya.” 27B daa maŋ pin fanɛ mo Tuto be asheŋ nɛ e daa kaŋɛ bumo na. 28Amoso, le nɛ Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Men kaŋ maŋ ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn so m mata kedibi so na, menyeeŋ pin esa nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n la ere, kumo alɛ be saŋɛ na so nɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ m maa wora shɛŋ ma kumu so, asɔ nɛ Etuto na bee ŋini ma nawule nɛ mee malga. 29Esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na malɛ maŋ yige ma n to, e wɔ ŋ kutɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋkikɛ kusɔ nɛ k bee par mo nɛ mee wora.”
Basa nɛ b la Eebraham be mbia gbagba be asheŋ
30Basa damta ka daŋ nu Yesu be mmalga na nɛ b yirda mo. 31Juwebi nɛ b daŋ yirda mo na, le nɛ Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Nɛ men baa bɛ ma keŋini ere so, menyeeŋ baa la ma bebɛsopo kashenteŋto. 32Saŋɛ na so, menyeeŋ pin kashenteŋ na nɛ kashenteŋ na e shin nɛ men lar kenyaya to.” 33Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ mo le: “Eebraham mo nanabiana e la anyi, anyi ere maŋ naŋ ki esa kikɛ be anya, nɛ a ji nuso nna nɛ fee kaŋɛ fanɛ anyeeŋ lar kenyaya to?” 34Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na, esa kama nɛ e bee wora alubi la alubi be kenya nna. 35Kenya maŋ la laŋ to be esa saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ, ama ebi bre, laŋ to be esa nna saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ. 36Nɛ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn baŋ lara fo kenyaya to, fo nya fo kumu kashenteŋto pasaa.
37N nyi men ka la Eebraham mo nanabiana, ama menyi alɛ bee sha kemɔ ma nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, men maa sha kesɔ ma keŋini. 38Asɔ nɛ n wu n Tuto na kutɔ be asheŋ nɛ mee malga nɛ menyi alɛ bee wora asɔ nɛ men nu ashi men tuto kutɔ.” 39Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ Yesu: “Eebraham e la an tuto.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Nɛ men daa la Eebraham be mbia nna, men daa beeŋ baa wora asɔ nɛ Eebraham daŋ wora. 40Ama kumo nɛ menyee sha kemɔ ma na ŋkpal ŋ ka kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋ nɛ n nu ashi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ so. Le be asheŋ nɛ Eebraham daŋ wora a? 41Asɔ nɛ men tuto bee wora nɛ menyee wora na.” Nɛ b kaŋɛ Yesu le: “Mannɛ ayurbi e la anyi. Etuto koŋwule nɛ an kɔ, mo alɛ e la Ebɔrɛ na.” 42Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa la men tuto nna, men daa beeŋ baa sha ma asheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nɛ n shi m ba kaa wɔ nfe naniere na, m maŋ ba ŋ gbagba be kumu so. Mo e shuŋi ma. 43Men nyi kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ men maa pin ma mmalga to ere a? Kusɔ nɛ k ba e la fanɛ men maaŋ tiŋ n nu amo. 44Men tuto e la alubipo na nɛ menyee sha kebaawora mbe aparsheŋ. Emɔpo e la mo sososo kikɛ, mo alɛ be shɛŋ maa ji kashenteŋ to, ŋkpal kashenteŋ ka maŋ wɔ mo to so. E baa ku efɛ, kananɛ mbe kapɔr du nɛ e bee ŋini, ŋkpal manɛ so, e la efɛpo nna nseŋ naa la efɛ kikɛ amo tuto. 45Ŋ ka bee ji kashenteŋ na so so nɛ men maa yirda ma na. 46Men be emo e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini kulubi kama nɛ n daŋ wora? To, nɛ kashenteŋ nɛ m baa ji, manɛ e ba nɛ men maa yirda ma? 47Esa kama nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ peya bee nu asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ nna. Men ka maŋ la Ebɔrɛ peya so e shin nɛ men maa nu asɔ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ na.”
48Nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ mo: “Kashenteŋ nɛ an ji ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ fo la Samɛrianyɛn nsaa kɔ kiyoyu lubi fo to na.” 49Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Kiyoyu lubi kama maŋ wɔ ma to. N Tuto nɛ mee bunyaŋ nɛ menyi alɛ maa bunyaŋ ma. 50Ma ere gbagba maa fin kemaŋkura nna a sa ma kumu, esa ko e naa fin kumo, mo alɛ e naa ji ma asheŋ amo be ekpa so na. 51Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ nɛ esa baa ta ma kamalga na a wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to, e maaŋ wu kikɛ.” 52Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ: “To, naniere nɛ an pin fanɛ kiyoyu lubi e wɔ fo to kashenteŋto, ŋkpal manɛ so, Eebraham nɛ anebiana na kikɛ wu n wu, ama kumo nɛ fee kaŋɛ fanɛ nɛ esa baŋ ta fo kamalga na n wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to, e maaŋ wu na. 53Fo chɔ an tuto Eebraham nna a? Mo nɛ anebiana na kikɛ wu. To, nɛ wanɛ nɛ fee tama fanɛ fo ere la?” 54Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Nɛ m baa maŋkura ma kumu, kumo ere ma kemaŋkura na maŋ kɔ kifi, ama n Tuto nɛ menyee tre menyi be Ebɔrɛ na e la esa nɛ e bee maŋkura ma. 55Men maŋ nyi mo, ama ma ere nyi mo. Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ m maŋ nyi mo, meeŋ baa la efɛpo fanɛ menyi, ma ere nyi mo nsaa ta mbe mmalga a wɔtɔ ma kagbene to. 56Men tuto Eebraham be kagbene daŋ fuli mo ga ŋkpal e ka daa shin nɛ e nya ma saŋɛ n wu so. Kashenteŋto malɛ, e wu kumo nɛ mbe kagbene fuli mo.” 57Nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ mo: “To, fo maŋ naŋ fo nfɛ adunu gba nɛ fo wu Eebraham a?” 58Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ b kurge Eebraham nɛ n wɔtɔ.” 59E ka malga le ere nɛ b ta ajembu nɛ b kpa mo nɛ e ŋana mbe kumu nseŋ bɔl basa na to n lar bɔrɛlambu na to.

Title: JƆN 9
Content:
Yesu ka chɛ tanpo ko be asheŋ
1Yesu ka na a choŋ nɛ e wu kanyɛn ko b ka kurge mo tanpo. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe bebɛsopo bishi mo le: “Eŋinipo, kanyɛn ere gbagba be alubi so nɛ e tan ere ŋko mo nio nɛ mo tuto bre e wora alubi?” 3Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Mannɛ kanyɛn ere gbagba be alubi so ŋko mo nio nɛ mo tuto be alubi so so nɛ e tan. E tan nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ e bɔla mo so ŋ ŋini basa mbe eleŋ be ashuŋ. 4Kefulto ka kraa wɔtɔ ere bre, a daga fanɛ an baa shuŋ esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na be ashuŋ. Kanyɛ bee biri a ba, kumo alɛ baŋ ba, esa maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n shuŋ shɛŋ. 5Ŋ ka kraa wɔ durnya to ere bre, ma e la durnya ere be kefulto.” 6E ka malga le n loge nɛ e tuu echɔl n lɛ kasawule m pɔ shishɛr nseŋ ta amo m mata kanyɛn na be anishi so, nseŋ kaŋɛ kanyɛn na: 7“Yɔ Sailowam be kepa to n ya fɔr amo n lɛ ndoŋ.” Sailowam be kifito e la Shuŋi. Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na yɔ ndoŋ n ya fɔr nseŋ fara a wu a ba.
8Mo braana nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ wu mo nɛ e daa tase a kule na ka naŋ wu mo nɛ b bishi abar: “Mannɛ kanyɛn ere e daa tase a kule na a?” 9Nɛ beko kaŋɛ fanɛ mo nna nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ le: “Ayai, mannɛ mo nna, b duli abar nna.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ mo gbagba kaŋɛ: “Ma nna.” 10Nɛ b bishi mo: “To, nɛ nuso nɛ fo wora nɛ fo anishi bugi?” 11Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Yesu na e pɔ shishɛr m mata ma anishi so nseŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n ya fɔr ashi Sailowam. Ma alɛ ka baŋ ya fɔr nɛ n fara a wu epul na to.” 12Nɛ b bishi mo: “Nɛ kanyɛn na wɔ nnɛ?” Nɛ e yɛ: “M maŋ nyi.”
Efarisiana na ka bishi kechɛ na to be asheŋ
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ b keta kanyɛn nɛ e daŋ tan na n yɔ Efarisiana na be anishito. 14Kachɛ nɛ Yesu daŋ pɔ shishɛr na m bugi kanyɛn na be anishi na malɛ daa la kewushiachɛ nna. 15Nɛ Efarisiana na malɛ gba bishi mo kananɛ e wora n nya mbe anishi a wu. Nɛ e yɛ: “Depɔ nɛ e ta m mata ma anishi so nɛ n ya fɔr amo n lɛ nseŋ fara a wu na.” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Efarisiana na be beko kaŋɛ: “Kanyɛn na maŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ kashenteŋto, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maa bɛ kewushiachɛ be mbra na so.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ: “Nuso nɛ alubipo bee wora a wora le be emamachi be asheŋ ere?” Ŋkpal le so kebarga to daŋ ba bumo to nna. 17Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ b naŋ bishi kanyɛn na: “Manɛ nɛ fo alɛ kɔ nɛ fo kaŋɛ mbe asheŋ?” Nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ: “Ma ere kutɔ e la anebi nna.” 18Ade kikɛ daŋ wora, ama Juwebi na kraa maa sha keyirda gba kuraa fanɛ kanyɛn na daŋ tan gba, ama b shuŋi nna n tre mo nio nɛ mo tuto pɔɛŋ. 19B ka ba nɛ b bishi bumo: “Men pibi nde a? Men kaŋɛ e daŋ tan nna, nuso nɛ a ji nɛ naniere nɛ e bee wu ere?” 20Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na mo nio nɛ mo tuto na kaŋɛ Efarisiana na: “An nyi e ka la an pibi nseŋ naa nyi an ka kurge mo nɛ e tan na, 21ama kananɛ e wora a wu naniere ŋko esa nɛ e chɛ mo bre, an maŋ nyi. Men bishi mo gbagba nɛ e kaŋɛ menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ kebia e la mo.” 22Kanyɛn na mo nio nɛ mo tuto daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ nna ŋkpal b ka daa ŋana Juwebi be benimuana na so so, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ kaŋɛ nna fanɛ ekama nɛ e bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu e la Mesaya na, baaŋ ju mo nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to. 23Amoso nɛ mo nio nɛ mo tuto daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Mannɛ kebia nna, men bishi mo gbagba na.”
24Ndoŋ nna nɛ b naŋ tre kanyɛn nɛ e daŋ tan na kela nyɔsopo m ba kaŋɛ mo le: “Ji kashenteŋ n sa Ebɔrɛ kemaŋkura, ŋkpal manɛ so an nyi kanyɛn na ka la alubipo.” 25Nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ bumo le: “To, ma ere maŋ nyi ŋko e la alubipo nna ŋko e maŋ la. Ama kusɔ nɛ m baa nyi e la fanɛ n daŋ tan nna, ama naniere mee wu.” 26Nɛ b bishi mo: “Nuso nɛ e wora fo? Nuso nɛ e wora m bugi fo anishi na?” 27Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ bumo: “Kumo nɛ n daŋ kekaŋɛ menyi na, menyi alɛ maa nu. Manɛ e ba nɛ menyi naa sha fanɛ n naŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ŋko menyi alɛ gba naa sha keki mbe bebɛsopo nna?” 28Ndoŋ nna nɛ b tege n tege mo nseŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Fo e baa la mbe ebɛsopo, anyi ere, Mosis be bebɛsopo e la anyi. 29An nyi Ebɔrɛ ka malga n sa Mosis, ama kanyɛn ere bre, anyi maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e shi gba.” 30Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ nde walɛ! Men maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e shi, ama mo alɛ tiŋ m bugi ma anishi. 31Anyi alɛ nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maa nu a sa alubiworapoana, basa nɛ b kɔ kabɔrɛŋana nsaa wora mbe aparsheŋ na nawule nɛ e bee nu a sa. 32Durnya ka fara kikɛ anyi maŋ naŋ nu esa ka bugi esa nɛ b kurge mo tanpo be anishi kikɛ. 33Nɛ kanyɛn nɛ e bugi ma anishi ere daa maŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna, e daa maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ.” 34Nɛ basa na kaŋɛ: “Keni, baŋ yili fo kakurgeachɛ kikɛ nɛ fo wɔ alubi to m ba fo mbre nɛ fo ba kaa sha nɛ fo ŋini anyi asheŋ a?” B ka kaŋɛ mo loŋ n loge nɛ b ju mo nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to.
Kiyoyu to be ntaŋ be asheŋ
35Yesu nu b ka ju kanyɛn na nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to nseŋ ya tu mo kakpa ko m bishi mo: “Fo yirda Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na a?” 36Nɛ kanyɛn na bishi Yesu: “Ebunyampo, wanɛ e la mo? Kaŋɛ ma nɛ n yirda mo.” 37Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Fo teŋ wu mo gba, mo alɛ e naa malga fo kutɔ naniere na.” 38Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn na kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe, n yirda.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e gbir kumuli. 39Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “M ba durnya ere to nna nɛ m ba ji basa demu nɛ betanpo e nya a wu nɛ bumo nɛ baa wu malɛ e tan.” 40Efarisiana ko daa yil ndoŋ nseŋ nu kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ na nseŋ bishi mo le: “Fee ŋini fanɛ anyi alɛ gba tan nna ŋko?” 41Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men daŋ tan nna, kulubi daa maaŋ baa wɔ menyi so, ama ŋkpal men ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ menyee wu ere bre, menyi be alubi beeŋ baa kraa wɔ menyi so.”

Title: JƆN 10
Content:
Mbolpɔkpapo nɛ mbe mbolpɔ be keŋasa be asheŋ
1Yesu e daŋ bɔ keŋasa ere ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ esa kama nɛ e maa bɔla mbolpɔ be kuluu be kabuna to a luri kuluu na to nsaa bɔla kaboŋ pɔtɛ a tɛ a luri kumo to la eyu nɛ esugepo nna. 2Esa nɛ e bee bɔla kuluu na to be kabuna to a luri mbolpɔ na to e la mbolpɔkpapo na. 3E baa ba, kabunakenipo na bee bugi kabuna na nna a sa mo nɛ e bee luri to a tre a tre mo gbagba be mbolpɔ na be atreana nɛ bumo alɛ bee pin mbe ebɔl nsaa bɛ mo so nɛ e bee keta bumo a lar kuluu na to. 4E baŋ lara bumo kikɛ kuluu na to n loge, e bee choŋ nna n juŋkpar mbolpɔ na nɛ b bɛ mo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, b nyi mbe ebɔl. 5Ama efɔ bre, b maaŋ bɛ mo so kikɛ. Baaŋ shile gba nseŋ ka mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maŋ nyi mbe ebɔl.”
6Yesu daŋ bɔ le be keŋasa ere nna n sa bumo, ama b daa maŋ pin kusɔ nɛ e daa kaŋɛ bumo na be kifito.
7Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu naŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ ma e du fanɛ kabuna a sa mbolpɔ na. 8Bekama nɛ b daŋ juŋkpar ma m ba na kikɛ la beyu nɛ besugepo nna nɛ mbolpɔ na malɛ maŋ nu n sa bumo. 9Ma e la kabuna na, esa kama nɛ e bɔla ma to n luri, beeŋ nya kumɔlga. Mo alɛ beeŋ baa luri a lar a nya ajibi. 10Eyu bre bee kaa ba nna m ba kaa yuri ŋko a mɔ ŋko a jija nawule, ama ma ere ba nna nɛ basa e nya ŋkpa nseŋ nya kumo nɛnɛ ga.
11Ma e la mbolpɔkpapo lela na, mbolpɔkpapo lela na bee shin nɛ baa lara mbe ŋkpa ashi mo to nna a sa mbolpɔ na. 12Esa kama nɛ b ber paa nɛ e bee keni mbolpɔ so, mo alɛ ŋkaa maŋ la mbolpɔkpapo gbagba na, mo alɛ ŋkaa maŋ naa la mbolpɔ na wura na baŋ wu kuntuŋ ka bee ba, e bee shile nna a ka mbolpɔ na. Saŋɛ na so nɛ kuntuŋ na e pɛ mbolpɔ na be ako nɛ amo nɛ a ka e pesaŋ to. 13Amodoŋwura bee shile nna a yɔ a ka mbolpɔ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, b ber mo paa nna nɛ e bee keni amo so nɛ mbe shɛŋ maŋ wɔ amo to. 14Ma e la mbolpɔkpapo lela na, n nyi ma mbolpɔ nɛ ma mbolpɔ malɛ gba nyi ma, 15fanɛ kananɛ Etuto na nyi ma nɛ ma alɛ gba nyi Etuto na. Ma alɛ bee ta ma kumu nna a mɔ a sa bumo. 16Ŋ kraa kɔ mbolpɔ ko nɛ a maŋ wɔ mbolpɔ ere to. A daga fanɛ m bar loŋ be mbolpɔ na gba nɛ amo alɛ gba e ba kaa nu ma ebɔl nɛ amo kikɛ e baa la kukoŋwule nsaa kɔ ekpapo koŋwule. 17Kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ n Tuto na bee sha ma na e la fanɛ ŋ ka shuli n ta ma ŋkpa a sa basa nɛ n naŋ bɛta n nya kumo so. 18Esa kikɛ maa sɔ kumo ŋ kutɔ. Ŋ gbagba e naa ta kumo a sa basa. Meeŋ tiŋ n ta kumo n sa basa nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta kumo a wɔtɔ. Loŋ nɛ n Tuto na yili fanɛ n wora.”
19Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na yaŋ barga to ŋkpal mmalga na so. 20Le nɛ bumo be bedamta daŋ kaŋɛ: “Kiyoyu lubi e wɔ mo to. E bee lɔ eboŋ nna. Manɛ so nɛ esa bee nu ede be mmalga!” 21Ama le nɛ beko malɛ daŋ kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ nɛ kanyɛn ere bee malga ere maŋ la mbuibilubiwura be mmalga. Nɛ nuso nɛ kiyoyu lubi bee wora a bugi betanpo be anishi?”
Juwebi na ka paŋ yirda be asheŋ
22B wɔtɔ loŋ nɛ bɔrɛlambu na be daŋkare be nshɛr ashi Jerusalɛm ya fo. Kumo be jemanɛ daa la awo to nna. 23Nɛ Yesu wɔ bɔrɛlambu na akpa a na kakpa nɛ baa tre Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn be kedɛdɛ na. 24Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na chala m ba mo kutɔ m ba bishi mo: “Manɛ e ba nɛ fo ta asheŋ ŋ ŋana anyi so n chɛr loŋ? Kaŋɛ anyi kashenteŋto preen: Fo e la Mesaya na a?” 25Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “N teŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ama menyi alɛ maŋ yirda ma. Emamachi be asheŋ nɛ ŋ kɔ n Tuto be ketre a wora ere e naa ji shɛda a kaŋɛ ma asheŋ. 26Ama menyi alɛ maŋ yirda ma ŋkpal men ka maŋ la ma mbolpɔ so so. 27Ma mbolpɔ bee nu ma ebɔl nɛ n nyi bumo nɛ baa bɛ ma so. 28Mee sa bumo ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na nɛ b sa maŋ wu kikɛ. Esa kama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n suge bumo ashi ma enɔ to. 29N Tuto e ta bumo m bɔɔ ma enɔ, mo alɛ e chɔ kusɔ kikɛ, amoso, esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n suge bumo ashi n Tuto na be enɔ to kikɛ. 30Ma nɛ n Tuto na la kukoŋwule nna.”
31Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na yaŋ ta ajembu nɛ b kpa mo. 32Nɛ Yesu bishi bumo le: “Asheŋ lela damta nɛ a shi Etuto na kutɔ nɛ n wora ŋ ŋini menyi. To, nɛ amo be kumo so nɛ menyee kpal a sha nɛ men kpa ma ajembu ere?” 33Nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ mo: “Mannɛ kusɔ lela ko fo ka wora so nɛ anyee sha kekpa fo ajembu, ama ŋkpal fo ka baa la nyiŋgbasa nsaa tre fo kumu Ebɔrɛ nsaa malga a gbiti Ebɔrɛ na so.” 34Nɛ Yesu bishi bumo le: “Mannɛ menyi be mbra to nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Men la ebɔrɛana nna na’ a? 35To, an nyi abɔrɛsibɛ na ka maa chɛrga kikɛ. Amoso, a ka kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ tre basa mo nɛ mbe kamalga ba bumo to ebɔrɛana ere, 36manɛ e ba nɛ menyee kaŋɛ ma, esa nɛ Etuto na gbagba lara n yili a sa mbe kumu nseŋ shuŋi durnya ere to na, fanɛ mee malga nna a gbiti Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal ŋ ka kaŋɛ fanɛ ma e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na so? 37Nɛ m maa shuŋ n Tuto na be ashuŋ nna, kumo ere men sa maŋ yirda ma. 38Ama nɛ mee shuŋ mbe ashuŋ na nna nɛ men maŋ yirda ma gba, a daga fanɛ men yirda ashuŋ na bre, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ pin fanɛ Etuto na wɔ ma to nɛ ma alɛ wɔ Etuto na to.”
39Ndoŋ nna nɛ b naŋ wora ania a sha kepɛ mo nɛ e gelge n lar bumo to n choŋ.
40Yesu ka lar ndoŋ nɛ e naŋ bɛta n yɔ Jɔɔdan be lɔr be kaba ndoŋ, kakpa nɛ Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo daa bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr na. Ndoŋ nɛ e daŋ ya kaa wɔ. 41Nɛ basa damta daa ba mo kutɔ m ba kaa kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo daa maŋ wora mamachi be kesheŋ kama, ama asheŋ nɛ e ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ kanyɛn ere be asheŋ na kikɛ la kashenteŋ nna chap.” 42Basa damta daŋ yirda mo ndoŋ.

Title: JƆN 11
Content:
Lazɔrɔs be luwu be asheŋ
1Kanyɛn ko e daa wɔtɔ nɛ baa tre mo Lazɔrɔs nɛ e daa lɔ. Mo nɛ Mɛɛri nɛ mo da Maata kikɛ daŋ shi Bɛtani nna. 2Mɛɛri ere e la emo nɛ e daŋ chulgi tulale dufɛso ko n wurge Enyɛnpe be aya so nseŋ ta mbe emin m melti amo na, mo alɛ mo siponyɛn e daa la Lazɔrɔs mo nɛ e daa lɔ na. 3Lazɔrɔs ka bee lɔ na nɛ mo sipocheana na shuŋi fanɛ b ya kaŋɛ Yesu. B yɛ: “Enyɛnpe, fo teri kpakpaso na bee lɔ.” 4Yesu ka nu kubɔya na nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Lazɔrɔs be kulɔ ere be lalaloge maŋ la luwu. K la kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ ba bar Ebɔrɛ kemaŋkura nna, saŋɛ na so nɛ ma, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na e nya kemaŋkura ashi kumo to.” 5Yesu daa sha Maata nɛ mo sipo Mɛɛri nɛ Lazɔrɔs be asheŋ ga. 6Ŋkeshin nɛ e ka nu fanɛ Lazɔrɔs bee lɔ na nɛ e shir a wɔ kakpa nɛ e daa wɔ na nchɛnnyɔ pɔɛŋ nseŋ ba kaŋɛ mbe bebɛsopo na le: 7“Men shin nɛ an naŋ yɔ Judiya.” 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Eŋinipo, nchɛnnyɔ ere to nɛ Juwebi na daa sha kekpa fo ajembu ndoŋ nɛ fo naa kaŋɛ fanɛ an yɔ ndoŋ a?” 9Nɛ Yesu bishi bumo le: “Mannɛ awa kuduanyɔ e wɔ yili epeŋi be kepete n ya fo kumo be ketɔr to a?
