Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee nite kapaso, maa fiti, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere be kefulto nɛ e bee wu a nite. 10E baa nite kanyɛso nɛ e beeŋ baa fiti, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maŋ kɔ kefulto.” 11Yesu ka malga le n loge nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “An teri Lazɔrɔs bee di, ama mee yɔ nɛ n ya tiŋi mo.” 12Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na kaŋɛ mo: “Enyɛnpe, nɛ e bee di bre, kumo ere e beeŋ nya alenfia.” 13Lazɔrɔs be luwu be asheŋ nɛ Yesu daa malga, ama mbe bebɛsopo na bre daŋ fɛ fanɛ edi gbagba nɛ e daa de. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Lazɔrɔs wu. 15Ama ŋkpal menyi so, k par ma ga fanɛ ŋ ka maŋ wɔ ndoŋ nɛ e wu, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men yirda ma asheŋ. Ama naniere, men shin nɛ an yɔ mo kutɔ.” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Tɔmas nɛ baa tre kaborobi na kaŋɛ mo braana bebɛsopo na le: “Men shin nɛ an kikɛ e yɔ nɛ anyi nɛ mo kikɛ e ya wu ndoŋ.”
Yesu ka wushi Lazɔrɔs mo sipocheana kagbene be asheŋ
17Yesu ka ba fo Bɛtani nɛ e nu fanɛ b teŋ puli Lazɔrɔs kejembulaŋ to kumo be nchɛ nna. 18Bɛtani nɛ Jerusalɛm daa maŋ fo emayɛl anyɔ, 19amoso, Juwebi damta daŋ shi ndoŋ nna m ba nɛ b ba wushi Maata nɛ Mɛɛri kagbene ŋkpal bumo siponyɛn ka wu so. 20Maata ka nu fanɛ Yesu bee ba nɛ e lar n yɔ nɛ e ya shɛr mo to, ama Mɛɛri bre daŋ shir a wɔ laŋ to nna. 21Maata ka ya tu Yesu nɛ e kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe, fo daa wɔ nfe nna n siponyɛn ere daa maaŋ wu. 22Ama naniere gba n nyi fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ fo kule Ebɔrɛ, e beeŋ sa fo kumo.” 23Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Fo siponyɛn ere beeŋ naŋ tiŋi.” 24Nɛ Maata kaŋɛ mo: “N nyi e ka beeŋ tiŋi ashi luwu to lalaloge be kachɛ na.” 25Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Ma e la esa nɛ e bee tiŋi basa ashi luwu to a sa bumo ŋkpa na, nɛ esa kama nɛ e yirda ma beeŋ nya ŋkpa hale nɛ e wu gba. 26Esa kama malɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to nseŋ yirda ma, maaŋ naŋ wu kikɛ. Fo yirda kesheŋ ere a?” 27Nɛ Maata shuli ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mm, Enyɛnpe, n yirda kumo. N yirda fanɛ fo e la Mesaya, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ ba durnya to na.” 28Maata ka malga loŋ n loge nɛ e bɛta n yɔ epe n ya tre mo sipo Mɛɛri n lar ekarso ŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Eŋinipo na ba nsaa fin fo.” 29Mɛɛri ka nu loŋ nɛ e koso manaŋ n yɔ Yesu kutɔ. 30Jemanɛ na so malɛ nɛ Yesu maŋ naŋ luri kade to nɛ e kraa wɔ kakpa nɛ Maata ya tu mo na. 31Juwebi nɛ bumo nɛ Mɛɛri daa tase ebu to nɛ baa wushi mo kagbene na ka wu kananɛ e kpa ŋ koso manaŋ n lar kowu na nɛ b koso m bɛ mo so a fɛ fanɛ e daa yɔ nchaŋ na akpa nna nɛ e ya shu. 32Mɛɛri ka fo kakpa nɛ Yesu daa wɔ na nseŋ wu mo nɛ e gbir Yesu be anishito nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe, fo daa wɔ nfe nna, n siponyɛn ere daa maaŋ wu.” 33Yesu ka wu kananɛ e daa shu na nɛ kananɛ Juwebi nɛ b daŋ bɛ mo so m ba na kikɛ daa shu na nɛ mbe kagbene kaa nseŋ jija mo. 34Ndoŋ nna nɛ e bishi bumo: “Nnɛ nɛ men ta mo n nase?” Nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Ba keni ndoŋ Enyɛnpe.” 35Yesu shu. 36Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ le: “Men keni e bee sha mo pasaa.” 37Ndoŋ nna nɛ beko kaŋɛ le: “Esa nɛ e bee tiŋ a bugi tanpo be anishi, ama e daa maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ kanyɛn ere e sa maŋ wu a?”
Yesu ka tiŋi Lazɔrɔs luwu to be asheŋ
38Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu be kagbene naŋ kaa nɛ e ta m ba nchaŋ na akpa. Kumo alɛ daa la kejembulaŋ nna nɛ b ta kejembu kpaŋgalaŋ ko m buu kumo be kɔnɔ so. 39Yesu ka ba ndoŋ nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Men ta kejembu na ashi nchaŋ na be kɔnɔ so.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Maata, kanyɛn na mo sipoche na kaŋɛ Yesu le: “Enyɛnpe, mbe nchɛ nna nna na nchaŋ ere to, amoso, naniere e beeŋ baa dufɛ.” 40Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “M maŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ nɛ fo yirda feeŋ wu Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura a?” 41Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lara kejembu na nɛ Yesu keni esoso nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Etuto, mee chɔrɔ fo ga fanɛ fo nu ma kekule. 42N nyi fo ka bee nu ma kekule saŋkikɛ, ama ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ nna ŋkpal basa nɛ b yil nfe ere so nɛ b yirda fanɛ fo e shuŋi ma.” 43Yesu ka malga le n loge nɛ e tre awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Lazɔrɔs, lar m ba!” 44Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebuni na lar nchaŋ na to m ba nɛ mbe kebuni be ameato kraa mea mo to nɛ kechɛbi ko gba mea mbe anishiakpa. Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ basa na: “Men saŋɛ n saŋɛ bubuni be ameato na nseŋ shin nɛ e yɔ.”
B ka kre Yesu be kemɔ be nia be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:1-5; Maak 14:1-2; Luuk 22:1-2)
45Ŋkpal kesheŋ ere so Juwebi nɛ b daŋ ba nɛ b ba chɔrɔ Mɛɛri nseŋ wu kusɔ nɛ Yesu daŋ wora na be bedamta daŋ yirda Yesu nna. 46Nɛ beko malɛ yɔ Efarisiana na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ Yesu daŋ wora na. 47Ndoŋ nna nɛ Efarisiana na nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na shɛr kɔɔtiebi nɛ b daa tre Sanhedrinebi na ŋ kaŋɛ: “Men keni emamachisheŋ damta nɛ kanyɛn ere bee wora ere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora? 48An baŋ yige mo nɛ e wɔtɔ a wora le be asheŋ ere, ekama beeŋ yirda mo nɛ Romebi na e ba m ba jija anyi be bɔrɛlambu ere nseŋ ta anyi be efuli ere kikɛ n ti so.” 49Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo be eko nɛ baa tre Kayafas nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso amo be kafɛ na kaŋɛ le: “Men maŋ nyi shɛŋ. 50Men maŋ nyi fanɛ nɛ esa koŋwule wu n sa basa, loŋ bɔ n sa menyi a chɔ efuli ere kikɛ ka mur a?” 51Kesheŋ ere e ka malga ere daa maŋ shi mo gbagba to, ama ŋkpal e ka daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso amo be kamoafɛ na so so nɛ e daa wu a kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu e daa shin nɛ e wu n sa efuli na so ebi na. 52Mannɛ bumo nɛ b daa wɔ efuli na so na nawule gba, ama e daa shin nɛ e wu n sa Ebɔrɛ be mbia nɛ b daŋ pesaŋ to a wɔ mboŋ pɔtɛana na kikɛ gba, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ bar bumo abar so n shin nɛ b ba ki kukoŋwule. 53Amoso, baŋ yili kumo be kachɛ na a yɔ nɛ basa na kre Yesu be kemɔ be nia.
54Amoso, Yesu daa maŋ naa bugi to a nite Juwebi na to. E daŋ lar bumo to nna n yɔ kadebi mo nɛ baa tre Efrayim na nna ashi kasawule nɛ k mata keshishɛrsawule so na nɛ mo nɛ mbe bebɛsopo ya kaa wɔ ndoŋ.
55Saŋɛ na so nɛ Juwebi be Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ be saŋɛ bee fo nɛ basa damta shi ndewurbiana na to n juŋkpar n yɔ nɛ b ya fɔr bumo be amu so pɔɛŋ nɛ Kebansonchoŋ be kachɛ na gbagba e fo. 56Basa na daa wɔ ndoŋ nna a fin Yesu nseŋ ya yili bɔrɛlambu na akpa a bishi abar le: “Nuso nɛ fee fɛ, fo tama fanɛ e maaŋ ba Kejigboŋ ere to nna kuraa ŋko nuso?” 57Saŋɛ na malɛ so bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ Efarisiana na sa ebɔl fanɛ esa kama nɛ e nyi kakpa nɛ Yesu daa wɔ, amodoŋwura e ba kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b nya mo m pɛ.

Title: JƆN 12
Content:
B ka chulgi tulale n wurge Yesu so be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:6-13; Maak 14:3-9)
1A ka ba ka fanɛ nchɛ nshe nɛ Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na e fo nɛ Yesu yɔ Bɛtani, kade nɛ Lazɔrɔs nɛ e daŋ tiŋi luwu to na daa wɔ na. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Lazɔrɔs nɛ mo sipocheana na wora ajibi nɛ b keta Yesu kufɔ. Maata e daa chige ajibi na nɛ Lazɔrɔs malɛ nɛ basa nɛ b daa wɔ ndoŋ na tu Yesu a tase ejikpa. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mɛɛri ta amansherbi damta be tulale dufɛso be kɔlbagboŋ ko m ba ta amo n wurge Yesu be aya so nseŋ gbir n ta mbe emin m melti tulale na ŋ gbiti amo n wɔtɔ Yesu be aya so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ tulale na be efɛa sɔ ebu na kikɛ to verr. 4Ama mbe bebɛsopo na to be emo nɛ b daa tre Judas Iskareɔt nɛ e daa beeŋ debɔr Yesu na bishi le: 5“To, manɛ e ba nɛ b daa maŋ ta tulale ere n fa n nya pɔŋ alfa asa n ta amansherbi na n sa betirpo?” 6Mannɛ fanɛ betirpo be asheŋ ka tir mo so so nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ, ama e daa la eyu nna. Mo e daa la katuŋ na be amansherbikenipo, amoso, e daa wɔtɔ nna a lara amansherbi na be ako a wɔtɔ mbe jifa to. 7Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men yige mo. Kusɔ nɛ e daa beeŋ wora ma ma kepuliachɛ nna na. 8Saŋkama menyi nɛ betirpo e naaŋ baa la, ama ma ere nɛ menyi maaŋ baa la saŋkama.”
9Asheŋ ere ka bee wora ere nɛ Juwebi na be bedamta nu fanɛ Yesu ba Bɛtani nseŋ ba nɛ b ba keni mo. Mannɛ Yesu malɛ gba nawule so nɛ b daŋ ba, b daŋ ba nna nɛ b ba keni Lazɔrɔs nɛ Yesu tiŋi luwu to na. 10Amoso, bɔrɛmatapowuraana na daa kre Lazɔrɔs gba be kemɔ nna. 11Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo so nɛ Juwebi na be bedamta daa yɔ Yesu kutɔ n ya kaa yirda mo.
Yesu ka luri Jerusalɛm bunyanso be asheŋ
(Matiu 21:1-11; Maak 11:1-11; Luuk 19:28-40)
12Kumo be ŋklade nɛ jimaŋ damta nɛ k ba Kejigboŋ na to na nu fanɛ Yesu lar m pɛ Jerusalɛm be ekpa nɛ e yɔ ndoŋ. 13Ndoŋ nna nɛ b fɛta n fɛta abii be ayabi n lar n yɔ nɛ b ya tu mo nsaa ponte a kaŋɛ:
“Hosana,
nɛfa la esa nɛ e shi Enyɛnpe be ketre to a ba na peya nna.
Nɛfa la mo, Israɛl be Ewura na peya nna.”
14Saŋɛ ere so nɛ Yesu fin kurmafɔlbi ko n chena kumo so nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na e bɔla ekpa. A yɛ:
15“O Zayɔn, sa maa lɔ kufu,
keni fo Ewura e dii kurmafɔlbi a ba na.”
16Saŋɛ nɛ asheŋ ere wora na mbe bebɛsopo na daa maŋ pin amo to she saŋɛ nɛ Yesu ba nya mbe kemaŋkura na pɔɛŋ nɛ k ba bumo be nfɛra to fanɛ asheŋ nɛ a daŋ wora na kikɛ daa dese abɔrɛsibɛ na to a kute mbe asheŋ nseŋ naŋ nyiŋi fanɛ b wora mo asheŋ na kikɛ nyam. 17Saŋɛ ere so malɛ kikɛ nɛ basa nɛ b daa wɔ mo kutɔ kachɛ nɛ e tiŋi Lazɔrɔs ashi luwu to nseŋ tre mo ashi nchaŋ to na, wɔtɔ a kɔ loŋ be kubɔya na a kela kaplɛkama. 18Basa damta na daŋ lar n yɔ mo kutɔ nna ŋkpal mamachi be kesheŋ nɛ b daŋ nu e ka daŋ wora na so. 19Ndoŋ nna nɛ Efarisiana na kaŋɛ abar le: “Men keni, an maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya kikɛ e muu a bɛ mo so na.”
Griikebi ko ka ba kaa fin Yesu be asheŋ
20Griikebi ko malɛ gba daŋ ti basa nɛ b daŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm to be Kejigboŋ be nshɛr na to nɛ b ya bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na so. 21Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ba Filip nɛ e daŋ shi Bɛtsaida nɛ k wɔ Galili na kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ mo le: “Kowurnyɛn, jande, anyee sha kewu Yesu nna.” 22Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip ya kaŋɛ Andru nɛ bumo benyɔ ya kaŋɛ Yesu. 23Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Naniere bre jemanɛ nɛ ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn beeŋ nya kemaŋkura na fo. 24Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ kuyubi baa maŋ tɔr shishɛr to n wu, k beeŋ baa la keduusobi koŋwule nna saŋkikɛ. Ama nɛ fanɛ k baŋ tɔr shishɛr to ŋ kɔr pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu, k bee bar asɔrso damta nna. 25Esa kama nɛ e bee sha mbe ŋkpa ga beeŋ paŋ kumo, ama ekama nɛ e maa ta mbe ŋkpa ere a tre shɛŋ durnya ere to, beeŋ nya mbe ŋkpa nɛ kebaawɔ ŋkpa ere to mbaanaayɔ. 26Esa kama nɛ e bee shuŋ ma, e baa bɛ ma so nɛ kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ n wɔ, ndoŋ nɛ ma kenya gba beeŋ baa wɔ. N Tuto malɛ beeŋ bunyaŋ esa kama nɛ e bee shuŋ ma.”
Yesu ka malga mbe luwu be asheŋ
27Naniere ma kagbene maŋ dese ma, ama nuso nɛ meeŋ wora? Ŋ kaŋɛ n Tuto fanɛ: ‘Etuto, mɔlga ma ashi le be kenishipere ere to,’ ŋko nuso? Ayai, m maaŋ wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ so nɛ m ba nɛ m ba ji saŋɛ ere so be awurfoŋ. 28N Tuto, maŋkura fo ketre. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɔl shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ: “N teŋ maŋkura kumo, ama meeŋ naŋ maŋkura kumo.” 29Jimaŋ nɛ k daa wɔ ndoŋ na ka nu ebɔl na be egbri na nɛ beko kaŋɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ e ponte to nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ malaika e malga mo kutɔ. 30Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo le: “Menyi so nɛ ebɔl na lar na, mannɛ ma so. 31Naniere bre keji durnya ere demu be saŋɛ fo, naniere nɛ kegboŋi durnya ere to be ejuŋkparpo na ashi mbe kejuŋkpar na to na fo. 32Ama nɛ b kaŋ maŋ ma so ashi kasawule ere so bre, meeŋ bar basa kikɛ ŋ kutɔ.” 33E daŋ malga le nna a ŋini luwu mo nɛ e daa beeŋ wu be asheŋ. 34Ndoŋ nna nɛ jimaŋ na kaŋɛ mo le: “Anyee nu ashi anyi be mbra na to fanɛ Mesaya na beeŋ ba kaa wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ nɛ a ji nuso nna nɛ fee kaŋɛ: ‘Baaŋ maŋ Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na so’? Wanɛ nɛ fee tre Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn na?” 35Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Kefulto na maaŋ naŋ chɛr menyi kutɔ. Amoso, men ka kraa kɔ kumo menyi to ere bre, men baa na kumo to, saŋɛ na so, tentembiri maaŋ luri menyi to. Esa kama nɛ e na tentembiri to maa pin kakpa nɛ e bee yɔ. 36Men ka kraa kɔ kefulto ere bre, men ta menyi be yirda n wɔtɔ kumo to, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ baa la kefulto be basa.”
E ka malga n loge nɛ e lar basa na to n ya ŋana.
Juwebi ka maŋ kɔ yirda be asheŋ
37Yesu daŋ wora emamachisheŋ damta ere kikɛ bumo be anishito, ama bumo alɛ daa maŋ yirda mo. 38Loŋ be kesheŋ na malɛ daŋ wora nna nɛ anebi Aizaaya be kamalga nɛ e daŋ malga na e bɔla ekpa. Le nɛ e daŋ bishi Ebɔrɛ: “Enyɛnpe, wanɛ e yirda kubɔya nɛ an bɔ na? Nɛ basa mo nɛ Enyɛnpe ŋini mbe eleŋ na?” 39Ŋkpal loŋ so, b daa maŋ tiŋ n yirda, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ malɛ nɛ Aizaaya kaŋɛ kakpa ko na fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: 40“N tan bumo be anishiana nseŋ ti bumo be ŋgbeneana, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, bumo be anishiana beeŋ bugi asheŋ be kewuto nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e bugi asheŋ be kepinto nɛ b ba ma kutɔ nɛ n lara bumo ashi bumo be kebaawɔtɔ na to n sa bumo kebaawɔtɔ popɔr.” 41Anebi Aizaaya daŋ kaŋɛ le nna ŋkpal e ka daŋ wu Yesu be kemaŋkura nseŋ malga mbe asheŋ na so. 42Ŋkeshin nɛ benimu na to gba be bedamta daŋ yirda Yesu, ama ŋkpal Efarisiana so, b daa maa sha kebugi to ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b yirda mo ŋkpal b ka daa maa sha fanɛ b ju bumo ashi nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to so. 43Bumo alɛ ka daa sha mbo ashi basa kutɔ a chɔ Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na so e shin nɛ b daa wora loŋ.
Kusɔ nɛ k bar Yesu be asheŋ
44Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu malga awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Esa baŋ yirda ma, mannɛ ma nawule nɛ e yirda, ama emo nɛ e shuŋi ma na gba nɛ e yirda. 45E baŋ keni ma, e bee wu esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na nna. 46M ba durnya to nna fanɛ kefulto na, saŋɛ na so, ekama nɛ e yirda ma, maaŋ shir a wɔ tentembiri to. 47Ama ekama nɛ e nu ma mmalga ŋkaa maa ta amo a wɔtɔ mo to, m maa kaŋɛ fanɛ e daga kasogberge, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ ba na nɛ m ba ji durnya demu. M ba na nɛ m ba mɔlga durnya. 48Esa kama nɛ e bee kini ma a maa sɔ ma mmalga na kɔ esa nɛ e beeŋ ji mo demu. Mmalga nɛ m malga na gbagba e naaŋ ki amodoŋwura be demujipo lalaloge be kachɛ na. 49Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ ŋ gbagba be eleŋ to so nɛ m malga, Etuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na e nase kusɔ nɛ meeŋ kaŋɛ nɛ kananɛ meeŋ kaŋɛ kumo n sa ma. 50N nyi mbe kamalga naseso ka bee bar ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na, amoso, kusɔ kama nɛ m malga baa la kusɔ nɛ Etuto na kaŋɛ fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ nna.”

Title: JƆN 13
Content:
Yesu ka fɔr mbe bebɛsopo be aya be asheŋ
1K ka ba ka kachɛ koŋwule nɛ Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na e fo nɛ Yesu pin fanɛ mbe kelar durnya ere to n yɔ Etuto na kutɔ na be jemanɛ fo, e daŋ sha mbe basa ashi durnya to, n sha bumo loŋ n ya fo ekar. 2B ka tase ejikpa a shin nɛ b ji kanyɛso be ajibi nɛ alubipo na malɛ teŋ yili kumo Judas Iskareɔt, Saimɔn pibi be kagbene to fanɛ e debɔr Yesu. 3Yesu daa nyi Etuto na ka daŋ ta eleŋ kikɛ m bɔɔ mo ere Yesu na enɔ nseŋ naa nyi e ka shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba nseŋ naa bɛta a yɔ mo kutɔ. 4Amoso, Yesu daŋ koso ajibi na akpa nna n yili nseŋ gbaŋ mbe piŋi n nase nseŋ ta bɔrdeba n chɛ kashɛr. 5Kumo be kaman nɛ e chulgi nchu n wɔtɔ katishaŋ to nseŋ fara a fɔr mbe bebɛsopoana na be aya so nsaa ta bɔrdeba nɛ e ta n chɛ kashɛr na a melti bumo be ayaana. 6E wora loŋ m ba fo Saimɔn Pita nɛ e bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, fo yɛ fo fɔr ma aya so a?” 7Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Naniere bre fo maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ mee wora ere, ama k maaŋ chɛr nɛ fo pin to.” 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita kaŋɛ: “Ayai, fo maa ba nɛ fo ba fɔr ma aya so kuraa.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Nɛ m baŋ maŋ fɔr fo so, ma nɛ fo maaŋ baa kɔ shɛŋ.” 9Nɛ Saimɔn Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Kumo ere, Enyɛnpe, sa maŋ fɔr ma aya so nawule, fɔr ma enɔana nɛ ma kumu so gba n ti so.” 10Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Esa nɛ e teŋ bɛr nchu maŋ naa bɛr ai, she mbe aya nawule nɛ e beeŋ fɔr so. Menyi alɛ nyalɛ so nna, ama mannɛ menyi kikɛ nyam bre e nyalɛ so.” 11E daa nyi esa nɛ e daa shin nɛ e debɔr mo, amoso nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ mannɛ bumo kikɛ nyam e daŋ nyalɛ so na.
12E ka fɔr n fɔr bumo be ayaana na so n loge nɛ e ta mbe asɔ m buu nseŋ bɛta n yɔ mbe echenakpa n ya chena m bishi bumo le: “Men pin kusɔ nɛ n wora menyi ere to a? 13Menyee kaa tre ma Eŋinipo nɛ Enyɛnpe, kashenteŋ nɛ menyi alɛ bee ji, ŋkpal manɛ so, n la Eŋinipo nɛ Enyɛnpe nna. 14Nɛ kananɛ ma alɛ baa la men Nyɛnpe nɛ menyi be Eŋinipo nseŋ fɔr menyi be aya so ere, a daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e baa fɔr abar be aya so. 15N wora loŋ nna ŋ ŋini menyi nna na fanɛ men baa wora kananɛ n wora menyi ere. 16Kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji menyi na fanɛ kenya maŋ chɔ mo nyɛnpe, kabɔ kama malɛ maŋ chɔ esa nɛ e shuŋi mo na. 17Men baŋ pin asheŋ ere nsaa wora amo, nɛfa beeŋ baa la menyeya.”
18E yɛ: “Mannɛ menyi kikɛ nɛ n de. N nyi bumo nɛ n lara. Ama ade kikɛ wora nna nɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na kaŋɛ le na e bɔla ekpa, a kaŋɛ: ‘Esa nɛ e ji ma ajibi gbagba kilgi nna n tu ma.’ 19Mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na a yili pɔɛŋ nɛ k ba wora, saŋɛ na so, nɛ k ba wora, menyeeŋ pin fanɛ ma e la Esa nɛ e bee ba na. 20Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ ekama nɛ e sɔ esa kama nɛ n shuŋi, sɔ ma nna na. Ekama malɛ nɛ e sɔ ma sɔ esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na nna na.”
Yesu ka wu b ka beeŋ debɔr mo be asheŋ m malga be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:20-25; Maak 14:17-21; Luuk 22:21-23)
21Yesu ka malga kesheŋ ere n loge nɛ mbe kagbene jija mo ga nɛ e bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ menyi be eko beeŋ debɔr ma.” 22Ndoŋ nna nɛ kesheŋ na wul bebɛsopo na to nɛ b kilgi ŋ keni ŋ keni abar a fɛ bumo to be emo nɛ e daa de. 23Bebɛsopo na be emo nɛ Yesu daa sha na daŋ chena nna m mata mo. 24Nɛ Saimɔn Pita wora ebɛsopo na enɔ fanɛ e bishi Yesu bumo to be emo nɛ e de. 25Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɛsopo na firgi n taga to Yesu nseŋ bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, wanɛ nna?” 26Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Mo e la emo nɛ meeŋ ku bodobodo n wɔtɔ epo to n sa na.” E ka loge nɛ e ku bodobodo na n shoŋi epo to n ta n sa Judas, Saimɔn Iskareɔt pibi. 27Judas ka baŋ sɔ bodobodo na nɛ Setani luri mo to. Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Kusɔ nɛ fee sha kewora ere, fo wora kumo manaŋ manaŋ.” 28Ama bumo nɛ b daa tase ejikpa na be ekama daa maŋ pin kusɔ nɛ k daŋ ba nɛ e kaŋɛ Judas Iskareɔt loŋ. 29Ŋkpal Judas ka daa keni katuŋ na be amansherbi so so, bumo be beko daa fɛ fanɛ Yesu daa kaŋɛ mo nna fanɛ e ya tɔ Kejigboŋ na to be asɔ nɛ baaŋ baa sha m ba ŋko fanɛ e ta kusɔ ko n ya sa betirpo. 30Judas ka baŋ sɔ bodobodo na nɛ e lar epul na to. Kanyɛ daŋ biri nna nɛ e lar.
Kamalga naseso popɔr be asheŋ
31Judas ka lar nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ le: “Naniere bre ma, Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn nya kemaŋkura nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba nya kemaŋkura ashi ma to. 32Nɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ baŋ bɔla ma so n nya kemaŋkura, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ beeŋ maŋkura ma, Ebinyɛn na ashi mo to. Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ maŋkura ma epul ere to. 33Ma mbia, m maaŋ baa wɔ menyi kutɔ n chɛr. Menyeeŋ fin ma, ama fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Juwebi na nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi alɛ gba na fanɛ kakpa nɛ mee yɔ na, men maaŋ tiŋ m ba ndoŋ.
34Ama kamalga naseso popɔr nɛ mee sa menyi e la fanɛ men baa sha abar. Kananɛ mee sha menyi na e daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e baa sha abar loŋ. 35Nɛ menyee sha abar, basa kikɛ beeŋ pin men ka la ma bebɛsopo.”
Yesu ka yɛ Pita beeŋ chɛ fanɛ e maŋ nyi mo be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:31-35; Maak 14:27-31; Luuk 22:31-34)
36Ndoŋ nna nɛ Saimɔn Pita bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, nnɛ nɛ fee yɔ?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Fo maaŋ tiŋ m bɛ ma so naniere n yɔ kakpa nɛ mee yɔ ere, ama kachako feeŋ bɛ ma so n yɔ.” 37Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita naŋ bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, manɛ e ba nɛ m maaŋ tiŋ m bɛ fo so naniere n yɔ? Meeŋ tiŋ ŋkpal fo so gba n wu.” 38Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Fo yɛ feeŋ tiŋ ŋkpal ma so n wu ŋko? Keni, ma e kaŋɛ fo kashenteŋto na fanɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ koshinyɛn e boŋ kanyɛ ere, feeŋ chɛ ale asa fanɛ fo maŋ nyi ma.”

Title: JƆN 14
Content:
Yesu ka la ekpa nɛ k bee yɔ Etuto na kutɔ be asheŋ
1Yesu yɛ: “Men sa maŋ shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa jija menyi. Men yirda n Tuto Ebɔrɛ, men baa yirda ma alɛ gba. 2Ebu damtaana wɔ n Tuto na pe, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ e daa la, n daŋ kaŋɛ menyi. Ma alɛ bee yɔ ndoŋ nna na nɛ n ya kaa lɔŋɛ kaboŋ a yili menyi. 3Ma alɛ kaŋ yɔ n ya lɔŋɛ kaboŋ na n yili menyi n loge, meeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba keta menyi n yɔ ŋ kutɔ, saŋɛ na so kakpa nɛ n wɔ, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ ya kaa wɔ ndoŋ. 4Men nyi kakpa nɛ mee yɔ na be ekpa.” 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ Tɔmas bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, anyi maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ fee yɔ na nɛ nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora m pin ekpa na?” 6Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Ma e la ekpa na nɛ kashenteŋ nɛ ŋkpa na, esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n yɔ Etuto na kutɔ ama e bɔla ma so nna.” 7Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Nɛ men daa nyi ma nna, menyi daa beeŋ baa nyi n Tuto na gba. Baŋ yili kabre a yɔ menyi alɛ tea nyi mo hale n teŋ wu mo gba.”
8Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip kaŋɛ mo le: “Enyɛnpe, ŋini anyi Etuto na nɛ kusɔ kama e kukwe anyi.” 9Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Filip, fo maŋ nyi ma a? Ma nɛ menyi kikɛ e baa wɔtɔ n chɛr le nɛ fo maŋ nyi ma a? Esa kama nɛ e wu ma, wu Etuto na nna na nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ fo kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Ŋini anyi Etuto na’? 10Fo maŋ nyi fanɛ n wɔ Etuto na to nna nɛ Etuto na malɛ gba wɔ ma to a? Men baa nyi fanɛ mmalga nɛ mee malga ere maŋ la ŋ gbagba peya, Etuto nɛ e wɔ ma to na e naa shuŋ mbe kushuŋ. 11Ŋ ka kaŋɛ fanɛ n wɔ Etuto na to nɛ Etuto na malɛ gba wɔ ma to ere, men yirda ma, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ gba nna, men keni emamachisheŋ nɛ mee wora so n yirda fanɛ kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji na. 12Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ esa kama nɛ e ta mbe yirda n deŋi ma so, beeŋ wora asɔ nɛ mee kaa wora ere. E beeŋ wora asɔ nɛ a chɔ ade gba, ŋkpal ŋ ka bee yɔ Etuto na kutɔ so. 13Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ men ta ma ketre na ŋ kule, meeŋ wora kumo, saŋɛ na so ma, Ebinyɛn na beeŋ bar Etuto na kemaŋkura. 14Kusɔ kama nɛ men ta ma ketre na ŋ kule, meeŋ wora kumo n sa menyi.”
Yesu ka nase kɔnɔ fanɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na beeŋ ba be asheŋ
15Nɛ men baa sha ma, menyeeŋ baa bɛ ma mmalga naseso so. 16Meeŋ kule Etuto na nɛ e naaŋ sa menyi Echɛtopo ko, 17mo e la kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu na, nɛ e ba kaa wɔ menyi kutɔ mbaanaayɔ. Durnya ere to ebi maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ loŋ be Echɛtopo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maaŋ tiŋ n wu mo, bumo alɛ maŋ naa nyi mo. Ama menyi ere nyi mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, e beeŋ ba kaa wɔ menyi kutɔ nseŋ naa wɔ menyi be ŋgbeneana to.
18M maaŋ yige menyi n to fanɛ amunibi. Meeŋ naŋ ba menyi kutɔ. 19A ka gbrɛbi nɛ durnya ere to ebi maaŋ naŋ wu ma, ama menyi ere beeŋ wu ma, ma alɛ ka wɔ ŋkpa to ere, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to. 20Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, menyeeŋ pin ŋ ka wɔ n Tuto na to nɛ menyi alɛ wɔ ma to nɛ ma alɛ gba wɔ menyi to.
21“Esa kama nɛ e kɔ ma mmalga naseso nsaa wora asɔ nɛ a bee kaŋɛ na e la esa nɛ e bee sha ma. Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee sha ma, n Tuto gba beeŋ sha mo nɛ ma alɛ gba e sha mo nseŋ lara ma kumu ŋ ŋini mo.” 22Nɛ Judas, mannɛ Judas Iskareɔt, bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, nuso nɛ feeŋ lara fo kumu ŋ ŋini anyi ŋkaa maaŋ lara fo kumu ŋ ŋini durnya ere to ebi bre?” 23Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Esa kama nɛ e bee sha ma beeŋ ta ma mmalga n wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to. N Tuto malɛ gba beeŋ baa sha mo nɛ ma nɛ n Tuto na kikɛ e ba mo kutɔ m ba ta mo ŋ ki anyi be kowu. 24Esa kama nɛ e maa sha ma, maa ta ma mmalga a wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to. Mmalga nɛ menyee nu ere malɛ maŋ la meya nna, n Tuto nɛ e shuŋi ma na peya nna.
25Ŋ kraa wɔ menyi kutɔ nna nsaa malga asheŋ ere kikɛ na. 26Ama Echɛtopo na, mo e la Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ n Tuto beeŋ shuŋi ma ketre to na kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ŋini menyi kusɔ kama nseŋ nyiŋi menyi asɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kikɛ.
27Kagbenewushi nɛ mee yige a sa menyi na, kagbenewushi nɛ k shi ŋ gbagba kutɔ. Kumo alɛ mannɛ fanɛ kananɛ durnya bee sa kumo na nɛ ŋ kɔ kumo a sa menyi. Amoso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e baa jija menyi ŋko nɛ kufu e baa kɔ menyi. 28Men teŋ nu ŋ ka kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ: ‘Mee yɔ nna nɛ n naŋ bɛta m ba menyi kutɔ’. Nɛ men daa sha ma nna, k daa beeŋ wora menyi ebel ŋkpal ŋ ka bee yɔ n Tuto na kutɔ so, ŋkpal manɛ so, Etuto na e chɔ ma. 29Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere naniere nna na pɔɛŋ nɛ loŋ e ba wora, saŋɛ na so, nɛ k ba wora, menyeeŋ yirda. 30M maaŋ naŋ malga menyi kutɔ n chɛr, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere to be ejuŋkparpo na bee ba. 31E maŋ kɔ eleŋ ma so, ama a daga durnya ere ka pin fanɛ mee sha Etuto na, amoso nɛ mee wora kusɔ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ ma kikɛ na.
Men niŋi to nɛ an koso nfe n choŋ.”

Title: JƆN 15
Content:
Yesu ka du fanɛ kedibi sɔrso gbagba na be asheŋ
1Yesu yɛ: “N du fanɛ kedibi sɔrso gbagba nna nɛ n Tuto malɛ la ndibi sɔrso na be ekenipo. 2Keyabi kama nɛ k chɔɔ ma so ŋkaa maa sɔr shɛŋ, e bee ku kumo nna a lɛ nɛ keyabi kama malɛ nɛ k bee sɔr e bee lɔŋɛ kumo so nna nɛ k tiŋ n sɔr ga n ti so. 3Men teŋ nyalɛ so ŋkpal kamalga nɛ m malga n sa menyi na so. 4Men baa wɔ ma to nɛ ma alɛ gba e baa wɔ menyi to. Kedibi be keyabi kama nawule maaŋ tiŋ n sɔr asɔrso ama k baa chɔɔ kedibi na gbagba so nna. Menyi alɛ gba maaŋ tiŋ n nya asɔrso kama ama men baa wɔ ma to nna. 5Ma e la kedibi sɔrso na nɛ menyi alɛ la kumo be ayabi. Nɛ esa baa wɔ ma to nɛ ma alɛ gba baa wɔ mo to, amodoŋwura beeŋ nya asɔrso damta, ama nɛ m baa maa wɔ men be asheŋ to, men maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ. 6Esa kama nɛ e maŋ wɔ ma to du fanɛ kedibi be keyabi nɛ b ku ashi kedibi gbagba so nna n lɛ nɛ k bee wɔl na nna. Ayabi mo nɛ a du loŋ malɛ, baa muu amo nna n wɔtɔ edɛ to nɛ a chɔɔ. 7Nɛ men baa wɔ ma to nɛ ma mmalga gba wɔ menyi to, men kule kusɔ kama nɛ menyee sha nɛ men nya kumo. 8Kusɔ nɛ k bee bar n Tuto na kemaŋkura e la men ka bee nya asɔrso damta, loŋ e naa ŋini men ka la ma bebɛsopo.
9Kananɛ Etuto na sha ma na gbagba nɛ ma alɛ gba sha menyi. Men baa wɔ ma kasha na to. 10Nɛ men baa bɛ ma mmalga naseso so, menyeeŋ baa wɔ ma kasha to fanɛ kananɛ mee bɛ Etuto na be mmalga naseso so nsaa wɔ mbe kasha to na.
11Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere nna nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ mee sa na e baa wɔ menyi to, saŋɛ na so, menyi be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi m baŋ so. 12Ma kamalga naseso nde: ‘Men baa sha abar fanɛ kananɛ mee sha menyi na.’ 13Kasha kama maŋ naa chɔ le be kasha ere fanɛ esa ka beeŋ ta mbe ŋkpa n sa mo teriana. 14Nɛ men baa wora asɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi, kumo ere n teriana e la menyi. 15M maŋ naa tre menyi ma anya, ŋkpal manɛ so, kenya maa pin mo nyɛnpe be asheŋ woraso to. Naniere bre mee tre menyi n teriana nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ koya ashi n Tuto na kutɔ, m maŋ ta amo ŋ ŋana menyi so. 16Mannɛ menyi e lara ma, ma e lara menyi nseŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men ya nya asɔrso nɛ a beeŋ baa wɔtɔ a yɔ. Saŋɛ na so, Etuto na beeŋ sa menyi kusɔ kama nɛ men ta ma ketre ŋ kule mo. 17Ma kamalga naseso nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa menyi nde fanɛ: ‘Men baa sha abar.’ ”
Kananɛ durnya beeŋ kishi bebɛsopo na be asheŋ
18“Nɛ durnya ere baŋ kishi menyi, men baa nyi fanɛ ma nɛ k fara ŋ kishi pɔɛŋ nseŋ ba kaa kishi menyi na. 19Nɛ men daa la durnya ere peya nna, k daa beeŋ baa sha menyi fanɛ kumo be basa gbagba. Ama n lara menyi ashi durnya ere to nna nɛ men maŋ naa la kumo be basa, amoso nɛ k kishi menyi na. 20Men baa nyiŋi kananɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ: ‘Kenya maŋ chɔ mo nyɛnpe’. Nɛ durnya ere to ebi baŋ tɔrɔ ma, kumo ere baaŋ tɔrɔ menyi alɛ gba. Nɛ b baŋ ta ma mmalga n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to, baaŋ ta menyi alɛ gba peya n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to. 21Asheŋ ere kikɛ nɛ baaŋ wora menyi ŋkpal men ka la meya so, ŋkpal manɛ so, b maŋ nyi esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na. 22Kumo alɛ nɛ n daa maŋ ba nna m ba malga n sa bumo, b daa maaŋ tɔr alubi be ntaŋ, ama naniere b maaŋ tiŋ n ji n lar. 23Esa kama nɛ e kishi ma, kishi n Tuto gba nna. 24Nɛ fanɛ n daa maŋ wora emamachisheŋ nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ wora ere bumo to nna, b daa maaŋ tɔr alubi be ntaŋ, ama naniere b wu emamachisheŋ ere kikɛ, bumo alɛ kraa kishi ma nɛ n Tuto na kikɛ. 25Ama kumo alɛ du loŋ nna nɛ kusɔ nɛ k wɔ bumo be mbra na to na e bɔla. K yɛ: ‘B kishi ma nna kenyanyaŋɛso’.
26Ama Echɛtopo nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ e shi Etuto na kutɔ m ba menyi kutɔ na, mo e la kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu nseŋ shi Etuto na kutɔ na kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ji ma shɛda. 27Ama a daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba ka ji shɛda na, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma nɛ menyi e baa la sososo na kikɛ.”

Title: JƆN 16
Content:
1Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mbe bebɛsopo na le: “Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi asheŋ ere nna nɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ foe ekpa. 2Basa beeŋ ba kaa ju menyi ashi nshɛrbuana na to be keluri to. Saŋko beeŋ ba fo nɛ esa kama nɛ e mɔ menyi beeŋ baa fɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee shuŋ. 3Bumo alɛ beeŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal b ka maŋ nyi Etuto ŋko ma so. 4Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere nna, saŋɛ na so, jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ wora asheŋ na kaŋ fo, menyeeŋ nyiŋi fanɛ n chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ menyi. Ŋ ka wɔ menyi kutɔ na so so nɛ n daa maŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere sososo na.”
Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be kushuŋ be asheŋ
5Ama naniere bre mee bɛta a yɔ esa nɛ e shuŋi ma na kutɔ nna ŋkeshin nɛ menyi alɛ be ekama maŋ bishi ma fanɛ: ‘Nnɛ nɛ fee yɔ?’ 6Ama ŋkpal ŋ ka kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere so so, kagbenejija luri nna m bɔlɔ menyi to. 7Kashenteŋ malɛ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ menyi be kechɛto so nɛ mee yɔ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ m baa maŋ yɔ, Echɛtopo na maaŋ ba menyi kutɔ. Ama nɛ m baŋ yɔ bre, meeŋ shuŋi mo nɛ e ba menyi kutɔ. 8Mo alɛ kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ŋini durnyaebi kananɛ baa fɛ alubi be asheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ be asheŋ nɛ mbe kasogberge be asheŋ. E beeŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ b foe amo be kenyi be ekpa. 9E beeŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ b foe alubi be kenyi be ekpa, ŋkpal b ka maŋ yirda ma, Yesu Kristo so, 10nseŋ naŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ b foe alelasheŋ be kenyi be ekpa, ŋkpal ŋ ka bee yɔ Etuto na kutɔ nɛ men maaŋ naŋ wu ma so. 11Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ b foe kasogberge be kenyi be ekpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ teŋ gboŋi durnya ere to be ejuŋkparpo na ashi mbe kejuŋkpar na to.
12Ŋ kraa kɔ asɔ damta nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ama nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ amo naniere, a beeŋ wora keshi n sa menyi. 13Ama nɛ mo ere, kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu na kaŋ ba, e beeŋ ŋini menyi kashenteŋ be ekpa kikɛ. E maaŋ ta mo gbagba be kumu so be eleŋ m malga, asɔ nɛ e beeŋ nu nawule be asheŋ nɛ e beeŋ malga nseŋ kaŋɛ basa asɔ nɛ a beeŋ ba be asheŋ. 14E beeŋ bar ma kemaŋkura, ŋkpal manɛ so, e beeŋ ta asɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi na m malga n sa menyi. 15Asɔ nɛ n Tuto na kɔ na kikɛ la meya nna. Amoso nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Kiyoyu na beeŋ ta asɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi na m malga n sa menyi na.
Kagbenewushi nɛ kagbenejija be asheŋ
16“A ka gbrɛbi nɛ men maaŋ naŋ wu ma nɛ a naŋ wora gbrɛbi nɛ men wu ma.” 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na be beko fara a bishi abar: “Manɛ bre nɛ e de nsaa malga le be asheŋ ere fanɛ: ‘A ka gbrɛbi nɛ men maaŋ naŋ wu ma nɛ a naŋ wora gbrɛ nɛ men naŋ wu ma’ ere ŋko nɛ manɛ malɛ nɛ e naa de fanɛ: ‘Ŋkpal ŋ ka bee yɔ n Tuto na kutɔ na so’ ere?” 18B yɛ: “To, a ka gbrɛbi, a ka gbrɛbi ere be kifito bre e baa la nuso? Anyi maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ e bee malga ere be kifito.” 19Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu pin b ka bee sha kebishi kesheŋ na be kifito nseŋ fara m bishi bumo: “Menyee bishi abar nuso nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘A ka gbrɛbi nɛ men maaŋ naŋ wu ma nɛ a naŋ wora gbrɛbi nɛ men naŋ wu ma’ na be kifito nna ŋko? 20Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ menyi ere beeŋ boŋ to nseŋ shu anishichubi, ama durnya ere to ebi bre be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo. Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ menyi be ŋgbene bee jija menyi, ama menyi be kagbenejija na beeŋ ba ki kagbenefuli. 21K du fanɛ eche ka bee sha kekurge nna. Mbe saŋɛ baŋ fo nɛ e luri kakurge be ebesa to, mbe kagbene bee jija mo nna, ama nɛ e baŋ kurge ebi na e bee teŋ mbe ebesa na so nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe kagbene bee fuli mo nna ŋkpal e ka kurge ebi n wɔtɔ durnya ere to so. 22To, loŋ nɛ k du n sa menyi alɛ gba. Naniere bre, men be ŋgbene jija menyi nna, ama a wora gbrɛ, meeŋ naŋ wu menyi nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli menyi nɛ esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n lara loŋ be kagbenefuli na ashi menyi to. 23Loŋ be saŋɛ na ba fo, men maaŋ naŋ kule ma shɛŋ. Ma e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ n Tuto na beeŋ sa menyi kusɔ kama nɛ men ta ma ketre ŋ kule mo. 24Hale m ba fo mbre, men maŋ naŋ ta ma ketre ŋ kule shɛŋ. Men kule nseŋ nya nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli menyi m baŋ so.
25Kashenteŋto, aŋasa to nɛ m bɔla m malga asheŋ na, ama saŋko bee ba nɛ m maaŋ naŋ ta aŋasa m malga asheŋ n sa menyi, meeŋ bugi asheŋ to filifili ŋ kaŋɛ menyi n Tuto na be asheŋ. 26Amo be saŋɛ na ba fo, menyeeŋ ta ma ketre ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ. M maa kaŋɛ nna fanɛ ma e naaŋ yili menyi be katelamu to ŋ kule mo n sa menyi. 27Ŋkpal manɛ so, Etuto na gbagba bee sha menyi ŋkpal men ka bee sha ma nseŋ yirda fanɛ n shi Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ na so. 28N Tuto na kutɔ nɛ n shi m ba durnya ere to, ma alɛ nseŋ naa lar durnya ere to a yɔ Etuto na kutɔ.”
29E ka malga le ere n loge nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na kaŋɛ le: “Too, naniere bre fo maŋ naa malga aŋasa to, fee bugi asheŋ to nna filifili a kaŋɛ. 30Naniere nɛ an pin fanɛ fo nyi kusɔ kikɛ. Amoso, nɛ esa maŋ bishi fo asheŋ nɛ a wɔ mbe kagbene to gba, fo nyi amo. Loŋ malɛ e shin nɛ an yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nɛ fo shi.” 31Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu bishi bumo: “Naniere bre men yirda nna na ŋko? 32Ama men baa nyiŋi fanɛ saŋko beeŋ ba fo, k teŋ fo gba nɛ menyi kikɛ e pesaŋ to nɛ ekama e yɔ mo gbagba pe. Menyeeŋ yige n nawule n to, ama mannɛ n nawule e wɔtɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, n Tuto wɔ ŋ kutɔ nna. 33Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi asheŋ ere nna, saŋɛ na so, menyeeŋ bɔla ma so n nya kagbenewushi. Menyeeŋ nya tɔrɔ durnya ere to, ama men baa kɔ kagbene, ma e pɔɔ durnya ere so.”

Title: JƆN 17
Content:
Yesu ka kule Ebɔrɛ n sa mbe bebɛsopo be asheŋ
1Yesu ka malga asheŋ ere n loge nɛ e maŋ kumu so ŋ keni ebɔrɛso nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Etuto, saŋɛ na fo. Maŋkura ma, fo Pibinyɛn na nɛ ma, fo Pibinyɛn na malɛ e maŋkura fo. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e daŋ sa ma eleŋ dimɛdi kikɛ so fanɛ n sa bekama nɛ fo ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na kikɛ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. 3Nɛ basa malɛ baa nyi fo, Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo nawule la kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na nseŋ naa nyi ma, Yesu Kristo nɛ fo shuŋi na, kumo ere baaŋ baa kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. 4M maŋkura fo kasawule ere to, ŋkpal manɛ so, n wora kushuŋ nɛ fo ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ fanɛ n wora na kikɛ. 5To, naniere, n Tuto, ta kemaŋkura nɛ n daa kɔ fo kutɔ pɔɛŋ nɛ durnya jɔŋɛ na m maŋkura ma fo anishito naniere.”
6N ta fo asheŋ ŋ ŋini basa nɛ fo lara durnya ere to m bɔɔ ma enɔ na. B daa la feya nna nɛ fo ta bumo m bɔɔ ma enɔ nɛ b ta fo kamalga na n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to. 7Naniere b pin fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ fo sa ma bee shi fo kutɔ nna. 8Ŋkpal manɛ so, n ta mmalga nɛ fo ta n sa ma na n sa bumo nɛ b sɔ. B pin geeŋ fanɛ fo kutɔ nɛ n shi, bumo alɛ nseŋ naŋ yirda fanɛ fo e shuŋi ma. 9Bumo nɛ mee kule a sa na, m maa kule a sa durnya ere to ebi, bumo nɛ fo ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na nɛ mee kule a sa, ŋkpal manɛ so, b la feya nna. 10Basa kama nɛ ŋ kɔ la feya nna, nɛ ekama nɛ fo alɛ kɔ la meya nna. Bumo alɛ to nɛ mee bɔla a nya kemaŋkura. 11To, naniere mee ba fo kutɔ nna na, a ka gbrɛbi nɛ n lar durnya to, ama bumo ere kraa wɔ durnya to nna. Etuto cheembi, ta fo ketre be eleŋ na a keni bumo so, ketre mo nɛ fo sa ma na nɛ n de na, saŋɛ na so baaŋ baa la kukoŋwule fanɛ kananɛ ma nɛ fo la kukoŋwule na. 12Ŋ ka daa wɔ bumo kutɔ na fo ketre nɛ fo sa ma na be eleŋ na nɛ n daa ta a keni bumo so nsaa kuŋ bumo ashi kulubi to. Bumo be ekama maŋ foe ekpa she emo nɛ e chɛr a beeŋ foe na, saŋɛ na so abɔrɛsibɛ na be kamalga na beeŋ bɔlɔ. 13Naniere mee ba fo kutɔ nna na, ama ma alɛ kraa wɔ durnya ere to nna nsaa kaŋɛ asheŋ ere kikɛ na, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya kagbenefuli nɛ mee sa na m baŋ so. 14N ta fo kamalga nna n sa bumo nɛ durnya ere e kishi bumo ŋkpal b ka maŋ wɔ durnya ere be basa to na so fanɛ kananɛ m maŋ wɔ durnya ere be basa to na. 15M maa kule fo nna fanɛ fo lara bumo ashi durnya ere to, kusɔ nɛ mee kule fo e la fanɛ fo baa kuŋ bumo ashi alubipo na kutɔ. 16Mannɛ durnya ere to be basa to nɛ b wɔ fanɛ kananɛ m maŋ wɔ durnya ere to be basa to na. 17Bɔla fo kashenteŋ be mmalga na so n lara bumo durnya be basa to nɛ b baa la fo basa. Fo kamalga na e la kashenteŋ na. 18Kananɛ fo shuŋi ma durnya ere to na nɛ ma alɛ gba bee shuŋi a shuŋi bumo kumo to. 19Bumo alɛ so mee lara ma kumu nna a yili a sa fo, saŋɛ na so bumo alɛ gba beeŋ lara bumo be amu n yili n sa fo kashenteŋto.
20Mannɛ bede nawule nɛ mee kule fo a sa. Mee kule fo nna a sa bumo nɛ baaŋ ba nu bede ere be kamalga nseŋ yirda ma na gba nna fanɛ 21fo shin nɛ bumo kikɛ e baa la kukoŋwule. Etuto, fanɛ kananɛ n wɔ fo to nɛ fo alɛ wɔ ma to na, loŋ nɛ mee kule fo fanɛ fo shin nɛ b baa wɔ anyi to nɛ durnya e yirda fanɛ fo e shuŋi ma durnya ere to. 22N sa bumo kemaŋkura nna fanɛ kananɛ fo sa ma kemaŋkura na nɛ b baa la kukoŋwule fanɛ kananɛ ma nɛ fo la kukoŋwule na. 23Nɛ m baa wɔ bumo to nɛ fo alɛ baa wɔ ma to, saŋɛ na so, baaŋ baa la kukoŋwule chap, nɛ durnya ere e pin fanɛ fo e shuŋi ma nseŋ naŋ pin fanɛ kananɛ fee sha ma na nɛ fee sha loŋ be basa na gba.
24“Etuto, mee sha fanɛ bumo nɛ fo ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na e ba kaa wɔ kakpa nɛ meeŋ ya kaa wɔ na n tiŋ n wu ma kemaŋkura nɛ fo sa ma ŋkpal fo ka fara a sha ma pɔɛŋ nɛ durnya jɔŋɛ na so. 25Etuto nɛ e la Elelapo, kashenteŋ nna fanɛ durnya ere to ebi maŋ nyi fo, ama ma ere nyi fo nɛ bede malɛ gba nyi fanɛ fo e shuŋi ma. 26N ta fo ŋ ŋini bumo, ma alɛ kraa beeŋ baa wora loŋ, saŋɛ na so, kasha nɛ fo kɔ a sa ma na beeŋ baa wɔ bumo to nɛ ma alɛ gba e baa wɔ bumo to.”

Title: JƆN 18
Content:
Kananɛ b pɛ Yesu be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:47-56; Maak 14:43-50; Luuk 22:47-53)
1Yesu ka kule mbe kabɔrɛkule na n loge nɛ mo nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na lar ndoŋ n yɔ Kidrɔn be ketaŋɛ be kaba ndoŋ. Ketaŋɛ na be kaba ndoŋ malɛ daa kɔ kupo ko nɛ Yesu nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na ya luri kupo na to. 2Judas edebɔrpo na daa nyi kakpa nɛ b yɔ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, ndoŋ daa la kakpa nɛ Yesu nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na daa tiŋ a yɔ nna. 3Amoso, ndoŋ nɛ Judas daŋ keta esoji be katuŋ ko nɛ bɔrɛlambu to be bekumpo ko mo nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ Efarisiana na daŋ shuŋi na n yɔ. B daa kɔ akɔsɔ nɛ mbulpi nɛ efitila to nna. 4Yesu daa nyi asɔ nɛ a daa beeŋ nya mo kikɛ, amoso, e daŋ lar m ba anishito nna m ba bishi bumo le: “Wanɛ nɛ menyee fin?” 5Nɛ b yɛ: “Nazarɛt be Yesu na.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ: “Ma nna na.” Saŋɛ na so nɛ Judas edebɔrpo na yil bumo to ndoŋ. 6Yesu ka daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ma nna na” na, b daŋ lar kamanto nna gbrɛ n tɔr kasawule. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ e naŋ laŋɛ m bishi bumo: “Wanɛ nɛ menyee fin?” Nɛ b yɛ: “Nazarɛt be Yesu na.” 8Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “N teŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ ma nna na, ama nɛ ma nɛ men baa fin bre, men shin nɛ bede bre e baa yɔ.” 9E daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ nna nɛ mmalga nɛ e daŋ malga saŋko fanɛ: “Etuto, bumo nɛ fo ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na be ekama maŋ foe ma enɔ to” na e bɔla. 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ Saimɔn Pita nɛ e daa yil ndoŋ a kɔ tokobi to na pe kumo ŋ ŋe bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be kenya ko be jisoso be kusoe n chuge. Kenya na be ketre e daa la Malkes. 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ Pita: “Bɛta fo tokobi na n wɔtɔ kumo be efar to. Fee tama fanɛ m maa sha keji tɔrɔ nɛ n Tuto yili fanɛ n ji na ŋko nuso?”
B ka yɛr Yesu Anas be anishito be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:57; Maak 14:53; Luuk 22:54)
12Kede be kaman nɛ esoji na nɛ bumo be enimu nɛ Juwebi be bekumpo na pɛ Yesu ŋ kre mo nseŋ ta mo n yɔ Anas kutɔ pɔɛŋ. 13Anas daa la Kayafas nɛ e daa la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso amoafɛ na mo sha nna. 14Kayafas koŋwule na malɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ Juwebi na fanɛ nɛ esa koŋwule wu n sa basa bɔ efuli ere kikɛ ka mur na.
Pita be kelar Yesu kaman be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:69-70; Maak 14:66-68; Luuk 22:55-57)
15B ka daŋ pɛ Yesu a yɔ na nɛ Saimɔn Pita nɛ ebɛsopo ko bɛ mo so. Ebɛsopo na nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na daa nyi abar nna nɛnɛ, amoso, mo ere daŋ bɛ Yesu so nna n luri bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na be laŋ na to. 16Ama Pita bre daŋ shir a yil kabuna to nna ashi kowu. Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɛsopo nɛ mo nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nyi abar na naŋ lar kowu n ya malga kebichebi nɛ e daa yil kabuna to a de so na kutɔ nseŋ keta Pita n luri laŋ na to. 17Pita ka daa yil ndoŋ na nɛ kebichebi na bishi mo le: “Kanyɛn na be bebɛsopo na be eko e la fo alɛ gba ŋko?” Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo le: “M-m, m maŋ la mbe ebɛsopo.” 18Awo daa wɔtɔ nna, amoso, anya na nɛ bekumpo na daŋ ta adundumbi nna m puga edɛ a yil ŋ kulti amo a wɔl. Saŋɛ na so nɛ Pita malɛ gba yil ndoŋ a wɔl edɛ na.
Bɔrɛmatapowura nimuso na ka bee bishi Yesu asheŋ be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:59-66; Maak 14:55-64; Luuk 22:66-71)
19Saŋɛ ere malɛ so nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na wɔtɔ a bishi Yesu mbe bebɛsopo nɛ mbe keŋini be asheŋ. 20Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “N daa bugi to a malga nna a sa ekama. Nshɛrbuana na to ŋko bɔrɛlambu na to, kakpa nɛ Juwebi kikɛ bee kaa shɛr na nɛ n daa malga saŋkikɛ, n daa maa malga shɛŋ wulo to kikɛ. 21Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ fo naa bishi ma le be asheŋ ere? Bishi bumo nɛ b daŋ nu ma mmalga na nɛ b kaŋɛ fo, ŋkpal manɛ so, m baa nyi fanɛ b nyi asheŋ nɛ n daa malga na.” 22Yesu ka malga le ere n loge nɛ bekumpo nɛ b daa yil ndoŋ na be eko kpa mo etaŋ nseŋ bishi mo le: “Le nɛ baa malga bɔrɛmatapo nimuso kutɔ a?” 23Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Nɛ m malga nna n da so, feeŋ tiŋ m bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ ekpa mo so nɛ m malga n foe, ama nɛ m maŋ malga nna n foe, manɛ e ba nɛ fee ŋmɛa ma?” 24B daŋ kraŋ kre Yesu loŋ nna nɛ Anas shin nɛ b yɛr mo bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Kayafas kutɔ.
Pita ka naŋ lar Yesu kaman be asheŋ
(Matiu 26:71-75; Maak 14:69-72; Luuk 22:58-62)
25Jemanɛ ere kikɛ so nɛ Saimɔn Pita yil a wɔl edɛ na nɛ basa bishi mo le: “Kanyɛn na be ebɛsopo na be eko e la fo alɛ gba ŋko?” Ndoŋ nna nɛ e chɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “M-m, m maŋ la mbe ebɛsopo.” 26Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na be anya na be eko nɛ e daa la kenya mo nɛ Pita daŋ ŋe mbe kusoe n chuge na be esa na bishi Pita le: “Mannɛ fo nɛ kanyɛn na nɛ n wu kupo na to nna a?” 27Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita naŋ laŋɛ n chɛ fanɛ mannɛ mo e daa la. Epul na malɛ to nɛ koshinyɛn boŋ.
B ka yɛr Yesu Gomena Pailat be anishito be asheŋ
(Matiu 27:1-2, 11-14; Maak 15:1-5; Luuk 23:1-5)
28Juwebi na ka bar Yesu Kayafas pe nɛ b naŋ keta mo n lar ndoŋ n yɔ Romebi be gomena be lambu to. Saŋɛ na so nɛ kare bee chɛ, amoso, ŋkpal daŋkare be eyurpi be kenya so, Juwebi na daa maŋ luri gomena na be lambu na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa sha ketiŋ n ji Kebansonchoŋ be kejibi na nna. 29Amoso, Gomena Pailat daŋ lar nna m ba bumo kutɔ m ba bishi bumo le: “Nuso be kulubi nɛ men wu kanyɛn ere so?” 30Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ Pailat: “E daa maŋ la alubiworapo nna, an daa maaŋ ta mo m ba bɔɔ fo enɔ.” 31Nɛ Pailat kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men gbagba e ta mo a yɔ n ya bɔla men gbagba be mbra so n ji mo demu n wɔtɔ luwu be kasogberge to.” Nɛ Juwebi na kaŋɛ mo: “An gbagba maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ an tiŋ m mɔ esa ai.” 32Le be asheŋ ere daŋ wora nna nɛ asheŋ nɛ Yesu daŋ malga a laŋɛ luwu nɛ e daa beeŋ wu na be kaplɛa so na e bɔlɔ so.
33Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat naŋ bɛta n luri mbe lambu to nseŋ tre Yesu n ya bishi mo le: “Fo e la Juwebi be Ewura na a?” 34Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Fo gbagba be nfɛra to nɛ kesheŋ ere shi ŋko basa ko e malga ma asheŋ ŋ ŋini fo?” 35Nɛ Pailat bishi mo: “N la Juw nna a? Fo gbagba be basa nɛ fo bɔrɛmatapowuraana e ta fo m bɔɔ ma enɔ. Manɛ nɛ fo wora?” 36Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Ma kuwurji maŋ la durnya ere to peya. Nɛ k daa la durnya ere to peya nna, ma anya daa beeŋ kɔ n sɔ ma ashi Juwebi ere be enɔ to, ama ma kuwura na malɛ shi kaboŋ pɔtɛ nna.” 37Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat bishi mo: “Kumo ere, ewura e la fo nna ŋko?” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Kumo nɛ fo baa kaŋɛ na. Kesheŋ nɛ mee sha kekaŋɛ ere so nɛ b kurge ma. Kumo koŋwule na malɛ so nɛ m ba durnya ere to fanɛ m ba malga kashenteŋ na be asheŋ. Esa kama malɛ nɛ e wɔ kashenteŋ na to bee nu nna a sa ma.” 38Nɛ Pailat bishi mo: “Manɛ e la kashenteŋ?”
B ka yɛ Yesu daga luwu be asheŋ
(Matiu 27:15-31; Maak 15:6-20; Luuk 23:13-25)
Pailat ka bishi Yesu loŋ nɛ e naŋ lar n yɔ Juwebi na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma ere maŋ wu shɛŋ mo so nɛ k daga b ka gberge mo kusoe.
39Ama menyi be daŋkare ko bee ŋini fanɛ a daga fanɛ Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ be jemanɛ kikɛ to n lara menyi be keparso be esa ashi kabuti to n sa menyi. Amoso, menyee sha fanɛ n yige Juwebi be ewura na n sa menyi a?” 40Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ponte awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ayai, mannɛ mo nɛ anyee sha. Barabas nɛ anyee sha.” Barabas ere daa kɔ ewura be eleŋ nna kelantokɔ to.

Title: JƆN 19
Content:
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat ta Yesu n shin nɛ b kuya mo so. 2Nɛ esoji na ta ewidibi be ayabi n wora kuwurwuro m buu mbe kumu so. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta kusɔbuuso peper kunɔkunɔ ko m buu mo 3nsaa yɔ a yɔ mo kutɔ n ya kaa kaŋɛ mo le: “Ebɔrɛ e sa Juwebi be Ewura na ŋkpa tenteŋ,” nseŋ kpa ŋ kpa mo etaŋ.
4Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Pailat naŋ lar ŋ kaŋɛ Juwebi na le: “Men keni, meeŋ ta mo m bar menyi nɛ men pin fanɛ ma ere maŋ wu kusɔ lubi kikɛ mo so nɛ k daga mbe kasogberge.” 5Yesu ka buu kuwurwuro na nɛ kusɔbuuso peper kunɔkunɔ na m ba lar nɛ Pailat kaŋɛ basa na le: “To, mo nde!” 6Bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ bumo be bekumpo na ka baŋ wu mo nɛ b ponte ŋ kaŋɛ: “Gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so, gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so!” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat kaŋɛ bumo: “Men gbagba e keta mo n ya gbir m mata kedibi largato so, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma ere maŋ wu kulubi mo so nɛ esa beeŋ kpal kumo so ŋ gberge mo kusoe.” 7Nɛ Juwebi na naŋ kaŋɛ mo: “An kɔ mbra ko nɛ k bee ŋini fanɛ a daga kanyɛn ere ka wu ŋkpal e ka bee tre mbe kumu Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn so.”
8Pailat ka nu loŋ na nɛ kufu naŋ pɛ mo n ti so. 9Nɛ e naŋ bɛta n luri mbe lambu to n ya bishi Yesu: “Nnɛ nɛ fo shi?” Ama Yesu daa maŋ tuge mo. 10Nɛ Pailat bishi mo: “Fo la ma to nna a? Fo maŋ nyi fanɛ ŋ kɔ eleŋ nɛ n tiŋ n shin nɛ b gbir fo m mata kedibi largato so ŋko?” 11Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo le: “Nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ sa fo eleŋ ma so nna, fo daa maaŋ baa kɔ eleŋ ma so. Esa nɛ e ta ma m bɔɔ fo enɔ ere malɛ be kulubi e shi a chɔ feya.” 12Pailat ka nu kesheŋ na nɛ e wora ania nɛ e shin nɛ Yesu e nya mbe kumu a yɔ, ama Juwebi na daa maŋ shuli nsaa ponte a kaŋɛ le: “Fo baŋ shin nɛ kanyɛn ere nya mbe kumu n yɔ jiga, kumo ere mannɛ fo teri e la Ewurgboŋ Siza, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e bee tre mbe kumu ewura bee kɔ Ewurgboŋ Siza be eleŋ nna na.”
13Pailat ka nu loŋ na nɛ e keta Yesu n lar lambu na to m ba kelɔnɛ so m ba chena demujipowura be echenakpa nɛ baa tre Demuji be Guŋgɔni na. Juwebi be ŋgbar to baa tre kumo Gabata. 14Kebansonchoŋ be Kebelaseachɛ e daa la nɛ kumo be saŋɛ malɛ daa la kapiidi. Amo be saŋɛ na nɛ Pailat kaŋɛ Juwebi na: “Menyi be ewura nde.” 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ponte ŋ kaŋɛ: “Men mɔ mo, men mɔ mo. Men gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so!” Nɛ Pailat bishi bumo: “Ŋ gbir menyi be ewura m mata kedibi largato so a?” Nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na kaŋɛ mo le: “Anyi maŋ kɔ ewura kama n naŋ ti Siza so.” 16Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ Pailat ta mo m bɔɔ bumo enɔ fanɛ b ya gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so.
B ka gbir Yesu m mata kedibi largato so be asheŋ
(Matiu 27:32-44; Maak 15:21-32; Luuk 23:26-43)
17Ndoŋ nna nɛ esoji na keta Yesu n lar n choŋ. B daŋ shin nɛ e lar ndoŋ nna n sulɔ mbe kedibi largato m ba fo kakpa nɛ baa tre Kumuwibi be Kakpa na. Juwebi bee tre ndoŋ Gɔlgata. 18Ndoŋ nɛ b daŋ gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so na. B daŋ gbir basa anyɔ ko gba ndibi largatoana so nna n ti mo so. Yesu e daa wɔ nferinto nɛ ede wɔ mbe kaba ere so nɛ ede malɛ wɔ kaba ere so. 19Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat shin nɛ b sibɛ kasibɛ ŋ gbir m mata mbe kedibi largato na so a kaŋɛ le:
“NAZARƐT BE YESU NƐ E LA JUWEBI BE EWURA NA NDE.”
20Juwebi na be bedamta daŋ kraŋ kasibɛ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, kakpa nɛ b daŋ gbir Yesu m mata kedibi largato so na daŋ mata kade to nna, kumo be kaman b daŋ sibɛ kesheŋ na Juwebi be ŋgbar to nɛ Romebi be ŋgbar to nɛ Griikebi be ŋgbar to nna. 21Bɔrɛmatapowuraana na ka wu kasibɛ na loŋ na nɛ b ya kaŋɛ Pailat: “Sa maŋ shin nɛ b sibɛ fanɛ Juwebi be Ewura, shin nɛ b sibɛ fanɛ kanyɛn ere kaŋɛ fanɛ mo e la Juwebi be Ewura na.” 22Nɛ Pailat kaŋɛ bumo: “Kusɔ nɛ n shin nɛ b sibɛ nɛ b sibɛ na.”
23Esoja na ka gbir Yesu m mata kedibi largato na so n loge nɛ b ta mbe asɔbuuso na m barga amo to ntuŋ nna so nɛ soja kama e nya kukoŋwule nseŋ ka asɔbuuso na be kumo nɛ k daa maa kɔ bamurgi nseŋ daa la kukoŋwule peŋgeleŋ na. 24Esoja na ka ta kumo nɛ b kaŋɛ abar le: “Men sa maŋ shin nɛ an kpɛa kumo to. Men shin nɛ an to beri ŋ keni emo nɛ e beeŋ nya kumo.” B daŋ wora loŋ nna nɛ kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “B daŋ barga ma asɔbuuso to nna n sa abar nseŋ to beri a fin ma piŋi” na e bɔla. Amoso, kusɔ nɛ esoji na daŋ wora nna na. 25Yesu mo nio nɛ mo niokar nɛ Mɛɛri nɛ e daa la Kliopas be eche na nɛ Mɛɛri Magdalin daŋ ba yili nna n taga kedibi largato na to. 26Yesu ka wu mo nio ndoŋ nseŋ naŋ wu ebɛsopo nɛ e daa sha ga na gba ka yil n taga to ndoŋ nɛ e kaŋɛ mo nio le: “Kache manɛ, keni fo pibi nde.” 27Kede be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ ebɛsopo na malɛ: “Fo nio nde.” Baŋ yili kumo be kamɔnchɛ na kikɛ nɛ ebɛsopo na keta Yesu mo nio n yɔ mo pe nɛ e ya kaa wɔtɔ.
Yesu be luwu be asheŋ
(Matiu 27:45-56; Maak 15:33-41; Luuk 23:44-49)
28Asheŋ ere kikɛ ka wora n choŋ nɛ Yesu pin loŋ nsaa sha fanɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na e bɔlɔ so nɛ e kaŋɛ le: “Achukoŋ kɔ ma.” 29Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ta kiche m pɔlɔ nsa nyannyanso ko ka daa wɔ kusɔ to a yil ndoŋ to nseŋ ta hisɔp be kedibi m maŋ kiche na so n yɔ Yesu be kɔnɔ ase. 30Yesu ka pipe nsa nyannyanso na nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ loge.” E ka kaŋɛ le ere n loge nɛ e kur mbe kumu n yuu nseŋ wu.
31Kumo be kachɛ na daa la Kebelaseachɛ nna nɛ kumo be ŋklade malɛ daa la Kewushiachɛgboŋ ko. Ŋkpal Juwebi na malɛ ka daa maa sha basa nɛ b daŋ gbir m mata ndibi na so be eyurana na ka shir a wɔ ndibi largatoana na so ŋkpal kewushiachɛ na so, b daŋ ya kaŋɛ Pailat nna fanɛ e shin nɛ b buri m buri basa na be aya nseŋ lara n lara bumo be eyurana na ndibi largatoana na so. 32Nɛ Pailat sa bumo ekpa nɛ esoji na yɔ n ya buri basa nɛ b daŋ gbir m mata Yesu na be ejuŋkparso be aya nseŋ buri enyɔsopo na malɛ gba peya. 33Ama b ka ba Yesu kutɔ nɛ e teŋ wu, amoso, b daa maŋ buri mo ere be aya. 34Esoja na be ekoŋwule nawule e daŋ baŋ ta kekpa n da Yesu be kekel so n futi, nɛ ŋklaŋ nɛ nchu kleŋklembi ko lar epul na to. 35Esa nɛ e daŋ wu kesheŋ na e malga kumo be asheŋ, saŋɛ na so menyi alɛ gba beeŋ yirda. Kusɔ nɛ e malga na la kashenteŋ nna. Nɛ mo alɛ gba nyi e ka bee ji kashenteŋ. 36B ka daa maŋ buri Yesu be aya na daŋ wora loŋ nna nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ nɛ a bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Mbe kuwibi kama maaŋ bu to” na e bɔlɔ so. 37Abɔrɛsibɛ na to be kaboŋ ko gba bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Baaŋ keni emo nɛ b ta kusɔ n da na.”
Yesu be kepuli be asheŋ
(Matiu 27:57-61; Maak 15:42-47; Luuk 23:50-56)
38Ade be kaman nɛ Josɛf nɛ e daŋ shi Arimatiya na ba kule Pailat fanɛ e shin nɛ e lara Yesu be kebuni na. Josɛf ere daa la Yesu be ebɛsopo na, ama wulo to nɛ e daa bɛ mo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa ŋana Juwebi be benimuana na nna. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pailat sa ekpa fanɛ e ya ta Yesu be eyur na nɛ e yɔ n ya ta kumo. 39Nikodimɔs nɛ e daŋ keyɔ Yesu kutɔ kiidiso kachako na nɛ Josɛf na e daŋ yɔ. Nikodimɔs daŋ ta etulale mo nɛ baa tre mir nɛ alowe nɛ b kɔ a gbiti bubuni so nɛ baa dese a chɛr na be weato nna m ba. Amo be egbɛ daa wɔ fanɛ kekargato be pɔŋ kalfa. 40Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo, basa anyɔ na ta etulale na n wɔtɔ kesaŋɛ lela ko to nseŋ ta kumo m mea Yesu be eyur na, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ Juwebi bee wora bubuni a puli. 41Kudɔbi ko daa wɔ kakpa nɛ b daŋ gbir Yesu m mata kedibi largato so na nɛ kebeelaŋ be nchaŋ popɔr ko nɛ b daa maŋ naŋ ta ebuni kama n nase to malɛ daa wɔ kudɔbi na to. 42Amoso, ŋkpal kumo be kachɛ na ka daa la Juwebi be Kebelaseachɛ nɛ ŋkpal nchaŋ na ka taga to na so, b daŋ ta Yesu nna n nase kumo to.

Title: JƆN 20
Content:
Yesu be ketiŋi luwu to be asheŋ
(Matiu 28:1-8; Maak 16:1-8; Luuk 24:1-12)
1Kewushiachɛ na ka ji ŋ klade Alediachɛ kare ka maŋ naŋ chɛ n loge nɛnɛ nɛ Mɛɛri Magdalin yɔ nchaŋ na akpa n ya wu fanɛ kejembu nɛ b daŋ ta ŋ kuŋ nchaŋ na be kɔnɔ so na maŋ naŋ kuŋ kɔnɔ na so. 2E ka wu loŋ na nɛ e kilgi n shile m ba Saimɔn Pita nɛ ebɛsopo nɛ Yesu daa sha na kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ bumo le: “B ta Enyɛnpe ashi nchaŋ na to, anyi alɛ maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ b ta mo n wɔtɔ.”
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita nɛ ebɛsopo mo na pɛ nchaŋ na akpa be ekpa. 4Bumo benyɔ na kikɛ daa shile nna, ama ebɛsopo mo na daŋ shile nna n sɔ kejuŋkpar n ya fo ndoŋ pɔɛŋ nɛ Pita fo. 5Ama e daa maŋ luri nchaŋ na to, e daŋ murgi nawule nna ŋ keni to n wu kesaŋɛ na ka dese. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ Saimɔn Pita nɛ e daa wɔ kaman na ba m ba luri nchaŋ na to. 7Mo alɛ gba daŋ wu kesaŋɛ na ka dese ndoŋ nseŋ naŋ wu kumo nɛ b daŋ ta m mea Yesu be kumu na gba ka dese. K daa maŋ dese m mata kesaŋɛ mo na nseŋ daŋ bɔɔ to a dese kumo nawule. 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɛsopo mo nɛ e daŋ juŋkpar n fo nchaŋ na akpa na malɛ gba luri to n ya wu asɔ na nseŋ yirda. 9B daa maŋ pin ashi abɔrɛsibɛ na to fanɛ Yesu beeŋ tiŋi luwu to. 10Bebɛsopo na ka wu asheŋ ere n loge nɛ b bɛta n yɔ epe.
Yesu ka lar Mɛɛri so be asheŋ
(Matiu 28:9-10; Maak 16:9-11)
11Bumo kikɛ ka choŋ n loge nɛ Mɛɛri yil nchaŋ na ase a shu. E daa yil ndoŋ a shu nna nseŋ naŋ bɛta n ya jule ŋ keni nchaŋ na to 12n wu emalaika anyɔ ka buu asɔ fuful a tase kakpa nɛ Yesu be kebuni na daa dese na. Eko daa tase kakpa nɛ Yesu be kumu ase daa wɔ na nɛ eko malɛ tase aya ase. 13Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bishi Mɛɛri le: “Kache manɛ, manɛ e ba nɛ fee shu?” Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “B ta n Nyɛnpe nna, ma alɛ maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ b ta mo n wɔtɔ.” 14E ka malga le n loge nseŋ gbɛ ŋ keni kaman nɛ e wu Yesu ka yil, ama e daa maŋ pin fanɛ Yesu nna. 15Nɛ Yesu bishi mo: “Kache manɛ, manɛ e ba nɛ fee shu, wanɛ nɛ fee fin?” Mɛɛri daa nyi fanɛ kudɔbi na be ekenipo nna nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Ebunyampo, jande, nɛ fo ta mo nna, fo ŋini ma kakpa nɛ fo ta mo n nase.” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Yesu tre mo: “Mɛɛri.” Nɛ Mɛɛri kilgi a yɔ Yesu be kaba so nseŋ boŋ to Juwebi be ŋgbar to ŋ kaŋɛ: “Rabonai!” Kumo be kifito e la eŋinipo. 17Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Sa maŋ pɛ ma to, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ naŋ bɛta n yɔ esoso Etuto na kutɔ. Ama yɔ n niopibiana na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ mee bɛta nna a yɔ esoso n Tuto nɛ men Tuto nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ nɛ menyi be Ebɔrɛ kutɔ.” 18Ndoŋ nna nɛ Mɛɛri Magdalin ta le be baru ere n yɔ bebɛsopoana na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ e wu Enyɛnpe na nɛ e kaŋɛ mo kananɛ e kaŋɛ na.
Yesu ka lar mbe bebɛsopo so be asheŋ
(Matiu 28:16-20; Maak 16:14-18; Luuk 24:36-49)
19Alediachɛ na be kaaseso nɛ bebɛsopo na kikɛ shɛr kaboŋ koŋwule nseŋ ti mbuna ŋkpal b ka daa ŋana Juwebi be benimuana na so so, nɛ Yesu ba yili bumo to nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Kagbenewushi e baa wɔ menyi to.” 20E ka malga loŋ n loge nɛ e ta mbe enɔana nɛ mbe kekel ŋ ŋini bumo amo be amaŋana na. Bebɛsopo na ka wu Enyɛnpe na nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo ga. 21Nɛ Yesu naŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Kagbenewushi e baa wɔ menyi to. Kananɛ Etuto na shuŋi ma na nɛ ma alɛ gba bee shuŋi menyi na.” 22Kede be kaman nɛ e gberge afu n wɔtɔ bumo so nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Men sɔ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na.” 23Kede be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Bekama nɛ men ta bumo be alubi m paŋ beeŋ nya amo be ketampaŋ nɛ bekama malɛ nɛ men maŋ ta m paŋ, maaŋ nya ketampaŋ.”
Yesu nɛ Tɔmas be asheŋ
24Yesu ka daŋ ba bebɛsopo na kutɔ na nɛ Tɔmas, bumo kuduanyɔ na to be emo nɛ baa tre Kaborobi na bre maŋ wɔtɔ. 25Kumo be kaman nɛ bebɛsopo na kaŋɛ mo fanɛ b wu Enyɛnpe na nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo le: “M ba maŋ wu anyembi na be amaŋ na mbe enɔana to nseŋ ta ma keshilbi n wɔtɔ kakpa nɛ anyembi na daŋ luri na nseŋ naŋ ta ma enɔ n wɔtɔ mbe kekel na to ŋ keni, m maaŋ yirda kesheŋ ere.”
26Kumo be bɔkwe be kaman nɛ mbe bebɛsopo na naŋ shɛr a wɔ ebu to nɛ Tɔmas gba wɔ bumo to kamɔnchɛ. B daŋ ber mbuna na kikɛ so nna, ama Yesu daŋ ba yili bumo to nna nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Kagbenewushi e baa wɔ menyi to.” 27Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ Tɔmas le: “Tɔmas, ta fo keshilbi n wɔtɔ ma nfe, keni ma enɔana so. Teŋi fo enɔ to n ta n wɔtɔ ma kekel to ŋ keni. Yirda nsaa maa wora shikashika.” 28Ndoŋ nna nɛ Tɔmas kaŋɛ Yesu le: “N Nyɛnpe nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ!” 29Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Fo ka wu ma so nɛ fo yirda na, ama nɛfa la bekama nɛ b maŋ wu nseŋ yirda na peya nna.”
30Yesu daŋ wora emamachisheŋ damta mbe bebɛsopoana na be anishito nɛ b maŋ sibɛ amo n wɔtɔ kawɔl ere to. 31Ama b sibɛ ade ere nna nɛ men yirda fanɛ Yesu e la Mesaya na, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na, nɛ menyi alɛ yirda loŋ, men beeŋ nya ŋkpa ashi mbe ketre na to.

Title: JƆN 21
Content:
Yesu ka lar bebɛsopo ashunu ko so be asheŋ
1Ade be kaman nɛ Yesu naŋ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini mbe bebɛsopo na ashi Taibɛrias be teku ase. Le nɛ e daŋ wora kumo. 2Kachako Saimɔn Pita nɛ Tɔmas, emo nɛ baa tre Kaborobi na, nɛ Nataniɛl nɛ e shi Keena nɛ k wɔ Galili na nɛ Zɛbedi be mbia anyɔ na nɛ bebɛsopo anyɔ ko daa la. 3Nɛ Saimɔn Pita kaŋɛ bumo le: “Ma ere bee yɔ ekɔrɔtɔ be kepɛ to nna.” Nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na malɛ kaŋɛ mo: “Anyeeŋ tu fo n yɔ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo kikɛ lar n ya luri ekuloŋ to, ama kumo be kamɔnchɛ be kanyɛso na b daa maŋ nya shɛŋ m pɛ. 4Kare ka chɛ nɛ Yesu ba kaa yil eboŋ na be ekarso, ama bebɛsopo na daa maŋ pin fanɛ Yesu e daa la. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ e tre bumo m bishi bumo: “Mbrantiɛ, men maŋ pɛ kɔrɔtɔ kama a?” Nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Ayai, anyi maŋ pɛ shɛŋ.” 6Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Men lɛ menyi be keshewu na n wɔtɔ ekuloŋ na be jisoso, menyeeŋ nya ako m pɛ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lɛ keshewu na n wɔtɔ ndoŋ a maŋ tiŋ nɛ b gberge keshewu na n wɔtɔ ekuloŋ na to ŋkpal ekɔrɔtɔ damta nɛ b daŋ pɛ na so. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɛsopo nɛ Yesu daa sha na kaŋɛ Pita: “Enyɛnpe nna.” Saimɔn Pita ka baŋ nu fanɛ Enyɛnpe nna nɛ e ta mbe kusɔbuuso m mea to, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ lara kumo nna n nase nseŋ tɛ n luri nchu na to. 8Nɛ bebɛsopo mo nɛ b daŋ ka na malɛ ta m bɛ so ekuloŋ to a gberge keshewu na nɛ kɔrɔtɔ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, kakpa nɛ b daa wɔ na nɛ kedeŋi so daa maŋ wɔ kufɔ. K daa la fanɛ ayadra alfa asa be nteŋ nna. 9B ka ya fo kedeŋi so nɛ b wu ajanwulɛ ndoŋ nɛ kɔrɔtɔ deŋ amo so nɛ bodobodo malɛ dese. 10Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men ta ekɔrɔtɔ nɛ men pɛ naniere na be ako m ba.” 11Nɛ Saimɔn Pita luri ekuloŋ na to ŋ gberge keshewu na n dii kedeŋi na so. Ekɔrɔtɔ gboŋgboŋiana ko e daa la n fo kalfa nɛ adunu nɛ asa, ama keshewu na malɛ daa maŋ kpɛa to. 12Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “Men ba ber kɔnɔ.” Saŋɛ ere so kikɛ nɛ bebɛsopo na be ekama maŋ tiŋ n nya kagbene m bishi mo: “Wanɛ e la fo?” Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa nyi Enyɛnpe ka la. 13Nɛ Yesu ya ta bodobodo na n sa bumo nseŋ ta kɔrɔtɔ na malɛ gba n wora loŋ gbagba. 14Yesu ka daŋ tiŋi ashi luwu to nseŋ ta mbe kumu ŋ ŋini mbe bebɛsopo na, kede e daa la mbe kela sasopo.
Yesu nɛ Pita be asheŋ
15B ka ji n loge nɛ Yesu bishi Saimɔn Pita le: “Saimɔn, Jɔn pibinyɛn, fee sha ma kashenteŋto a chɔ bede ere a?” Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Mm Enyɛnpe, fo nyi ŋ ka bee sha fo.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Baa keni ma mbolpɔbi so.” 16Nɛ Yesu naŋ bishi mo kela nyɔsopo: “Saimɔn, Jɔn pibinyɛn, fee sha ma kashenteŋto a?” Nɛ Pita naŋ shuli ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mm Enyɛnpe, fo nyi ŋ ka bee sha fo.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Baa keni ma mbolpɔ so.” 17Kela sasopo nɛ Yesu naŋ bishi Pita: “Saimɔn, Jɔn pibinyɛn fee sha ma a?” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita be kagbene jija mo, ŋkpal Yesu ka bishi kela sasopo fanɛ: “Fee sha ma?” Amoso, le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ Yesu: “Enyɛnpe, fo nyi kusɔ kama, fo nyi ŋ ka bee sha fo.” Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ mo: “Baa keni ma mbolpɔ so.” 18Kede be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo na fanɛ fo ka daa la kabrantiɛbia na, fo gbagba e daa kre so a yɔ kaplɛkama nɛ fo daa sha, ama nɛ fo ba bel, feeŋ teŋi fo enɔana to nɛ esa pɔtɛ e kre fo to n yɛr fo kakpa nɛ fo maa sha keyɔ.” 19Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ le nna a ŋini luwu mo nɛ Pita daa beeŋ wu m maŋkura Ebɔrɛ na. Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ Pita: “Bɛ ma so.” 20Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita gbɛ ŋ keni kaman nɛ ebɛsopo mo nɛ Yesu bee sha na e bɛ bumo so. Ebɛsopo ere e la emo nɛ e daŋ dese m mata Yesu ejikpa nseŋ daŋ bishi Yesu fanɛ: “Enyɛnpe, wanɛ e naa shin nɛ e debɔr fo?” 21Pita ka wu mo na nɛ e bishi Yesu le: “Enyɛnpe nɛ ede malɛ?” 22Nɛ Yesu bishi Pita: “Nɛ mee sha fanɛ e baa wɔ ŋkpa to hale nɛ n ya ba bre, k nya fo nnɛ nna? Fo ere e bɛ ma so de!” 23Ŋkpal le so, k daŋ sɔ Yesu be bebɛsopo na kikɛ to nna fanɛ ebɛsopo mo na bre maaŋ wu. Ama mannɛ aloŋ malɛ nɛ Yesu daŋ kaŋɛ. E daŋ kaŋɛ nna fanɛ: “Nɛ mee sha fanɛ e baa wɔ ŋkpa to hale nɛ n ya ba bre, k nya fo nnɛ nna?”
24Amo be ebɛsopo na e malga asheŋ ere, mo alɛ nseŋ naŋ sibɛ amo n nase na. Anyi alɛ nyi mbe shɛda na ka la kashenteŋ.
25Yesu daŋ wora asheŋ damta ko gba n ti so, nɛ b daŋ sibɛ amo be kekama nna n nase, mee tama fanɛ durnya kikɛ gba daa maaŋ tiŋ n nya kakpa n sɔ loŋ be nwɔl na.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 1
Content:
1N teri lela Tiɔfiles, asɔ nɛ Yesu daŋ wora nseŋ ŋini saŋɛ nɛ e fara mbe kushuŋ n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ e naŋ bɛta n yɔ ebɔrɛso na kikɛ be asheŋ nɛ n daŋ sibɛ ma kawɔl juŋkparso na to. 2Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e yɔ ebɔrɛso na, Yesu daŋ bɔla Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na so nna ŋ ŋini basa nɛ e daŋ lara nɛ b baa la mbe beshuŋipo na ŋ kaŋɛ bumo asɔ nɛ a daga fanɛ b baa wora. 3Mbe luwu na be kaman, nchɛ adena be kefɛato nɛ e wɔtɔ a bɔla ekpa damtaana so a lara mbe kumu a ŋini mbe beshuŋipoana na hale nɛ b ya pin kashenteŋto geeŋ fanɛ e tiŋi luwu to. B daŋ wu mo hale nɛ mo nɛ bumo malga Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to be asheŋ. 4Kachako bumo kikɛ ba shɛr nɛ e sa bumo le be ebɔl: “Men sa maŋ kaŋ lar Jerusalɛm to. Men baa jo kakɛ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n Tuto yɛ e beeŋ sa na. 5Nchu nɛ Jɔn kabɔrɛbɛrpo daŋ ta m bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr, ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e gbelge menyi so nchɛnnyɔ ere to be kefɛato.”
Yesu ka yɔ ebɔrɛso be asheŋ
6Kachako beshuŋipo na nɛ Yesu ka shɛr nɛ b bishi mo: “Enyɛnpe, naniere bre, feeŋ ta kuwurji na m bɛta n sa Israɛlebi a?” 7Nɛ Yesu kaŋɛ bumo: “N Tuto nawule be enɔ to nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ kumo be jemanɛ wɔ. Amo be asheŋ maŋ la asɔ nɛ a daga men ka pin. 8Ama men baa nyi fanɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋ gbelge menyi so, menyeeŋ baa kɔ eleŋ menyi to a malga ma asheŋ a sa basa ashi Jerusalɛm to nɛ Judiya kikɛ to nɛ Samɛria to nɛ durnya ere kikɛ nyam to.” 9Yesu ka malga kesheŋ ere n loge nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e fara a yɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ baa keni mo hale nɛ kuwɔlpa ko ya buu mo so nɛ b maŋ naŋ wu mo. 10Bumo be anishi kraa yuu awɔlpa na so nna nɛ benyɛn anyɔ ko nɛ b daa la emalaika buu epiŋi fuful m ba yili bumo kutɔ epul na to 11nseŋ bishi bumo: “Galiliebi, manɛ e ba nɛ men yil a keni esoso loŋ? Yesu koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e lar menyi kutɔ a yɔ ebɔrɛso ere beeŋ naŋ bɛta loŋ gbagba chap m ba kananɛ men wu mo nɛ e bee yɔ ebɔrɛso ere.”
Esa nɛ e sɔ Judas so be asheŋ
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ beshuŋipoana na lar Ɔlifs be kebee so m bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm to. K daa la fanɛ mayɛl be bargato nna. 13B ka fo Jerusalɛm nɛ b dii n yɔ esoso be ebu be ebu ko to nɛ b daa sha keji nchɛnnyɔ kumo to na. Bumo e daa la: Pita nɛ Jɔn nɛ Jeems nɛ Andru nɛ Filip nɛ Tɔmas nɛ Baatɔlomiu nɛ Matiu nɛ Jeems, Alfias pibi nɛ Saimɔn Zɛlɔt nɛ Judas, Jeems pibi. 14Bumo kikɛ nɛ beche na nɛ Mɛɛri, Yesu mo nio nɛ Yesu koŋwule na mo sipoana daa wɔtɔ nna a shɛr kɔnɔkoŋwuleso a kule Ebɔrɛ.
15Kumo be kaman nɛ beyirdapoana na kikɛ, b daŋ fo fanɛ basa kalfa nɛ adunyɔ, shɛr nɛ Pita niŋi to n yili m malga ŋ kaŋɛ: 16“Ŋ kurgepoana, a daga fanɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na ka bɔla ekpa fanɛ kananɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na shin nɛ Deevid wu ŋ kaŋɛ Judas nɛ e juŋkpar basa nɛ b pɛ Yesu na be asheŋ. 17Anyi to be eko e daa la Judas, ŋkpal manɛ so, Yesu daŋ lara mo nna nɛ mo alɛ gba e baa wɔ anyi be kushuŋ na to. 18Kasawule ko nɛ Judas daŋ ta mbe nia be amansherbi nɛ e nya na n tɔ. Ndoŋ malɛ nɛ e daŋ ta kapo n tɔr epun so m pante epun nɛ apumbi lar nɛ e wu. 19Basa nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm to na kikɛ daŋ nu kumo be asheŋ nseŋ sa kasawule na ketre: Akɛldama. Bumo be ŋgbar to, kumo be kifito e la: Kakpa nɛ ŋklaŋ lar n wurge.” 20Nɛ Pita naŋ kaŋɛ: “Le be esa ere be asheŋ nɛ b sibɛ Ebɔrɛ be Nshɛ be Kawɔl na to fanɛ:
‘A daga mbe kowu ka ki lambure
nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ kaa wɔ kumo to.’
Abɔrɛsibɛ na kraa kaŋɛ fanɛ:
‘A daga fanɛ esa pɔtɛ ko
e sɔ mo so a shuŋ mbe kushuŋ.’
21Amoso, a daga fanɛ esa ko e ba ti anyi so a la Enyɛnpe be ketiŋi luwu to be baru na be emalgapo. 22A daga fanɛ e baa la basa nɛ anyi nɛ bumo daa la saŋkama, saŋɛ nɛ anyi nɛ Yesu daa wɔtɔ, yili saŋɛ nɛ Jɔn daa malga mbe kabɔrɛbɛr be asheŋ na n ya fo kachɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ Yesu lar anyi kutɔ n yɔ ebɔrɛso na be eko.” 23Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ kanyɛn ko nɛ b daa tre Josɛf na nseŋ naa tre mo Baasabas nseŋ naa tre mo koŋwule na Jɛstes na nɛ kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Matayas na be eko e daga kelara. 24Nɛ b kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe, fo nyi basa kikɛ be ŋgbene to, amoso, ŋini anyi basa anyɔ ere be emo nɛ feeŋ lara 25nɛ e baa la fo eshuŋipo a shuŋ kushuŋ nɛ Judas daa shuŋ nseŋ yige kumo n yɔ kakpa nɛ k daga mo na.” 26Kumo be kaman nɛ b to beri nɛ Matayas ji. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b shin nɛ e ti beshuŋipo kudukako na so.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 2
Content:
Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be asheŋ
1Kachɛgboŋ nɛ baa tre Pɛntekɔst na ka fo nɛ beyirdapoana na kikɛ shɛr kakpa koŋwule. 2Epul to nɛ awɔr shi ebɔrɛso ŋ gbri m ba bɔla ebu nɛ b daa tase to na kikɛ to fanɛ afugboŋ ko na. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ b wu adonduloŋ fanɛ edɛ be adondulombi nɛ a ba barga to nɛ amo be kekama yɔ beyirdapoana na be ekama so. 4Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na ba bɔlɔ bumo kikɛ to nɛ b fara a gbar ŋgbar nɛ bumo gbagba maa nu kanaŋkamaso nɛ Kiyoyu na daŋ shin nɛ b malga.
5Saŋɛ na so nɛ Juwebi nɛ b daa bɔla bumo be daŋkare so a bɛ Ebɔrɛ so na be bedamta shi durnya to kikɛ be efuliana so m ba Jerusalɛm be kade na to. 6B ka nu awɔr na nɛ jimaŋ damta ko shɛr ndoŋ. K daŋ chinchiŋ bumo kikɛ ga ŋkpal bumo be ekama ka nu beyirdapoana na ka bee gbar bumo be ŋgbar so. 7K daŋ wul bumo to nseŋ chinchiŋ bumo ga nɛ b bishi abar: “Mannɛ Galili nɛ basa nɛ baa malga le ere kikɛ shi a? 8Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ anyi be ekama bee nu basa ere ka bee gbar anyi be efuli so be ŋgbar? 9To, Paatia nɛ Midia nɛ Ilam nɛ Mɛsopoteemia nɛ Judiya nɛ Kapadosia nɛ Pɔntes nɛ Eeshia, 10Frijia nɛ Pamfilia nɛ Ijipt nɛ Libiya be mba nɛ a mata Sairini be efuli so na nɛ an shi. 11Anyi be beko malɛ shi Rom nna a la Juwebi nɛ nnyamase nɛ b tuba a bɛ Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso na so na. Anyi be beko malɛ shi Kriit nɛ Areebia nna ŋkeshin nɛ anyi alɛ kikɛ bee nu b ka bee malga anyi be ŋgbarana to a kaŋɛ asheŋgboŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora.” 12K daŋ wul bumo kikɛ to ga nɛ b wɔtɔ a bishi abar: “Kede be kifito e la nuso?” 13Nɛ basa na be beko wora beyirdapoana na eyurto ŋ kaŋɛ: “Basa ere boo nna na.”
Pita be kamalga be asheŋ
14Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita nɛ beshuŋipo kudukako na niŋi to n yili nɛ Pita fara a kaŋɛ jimaŋ na awɔrso: “M peebi Juwebi nɛ menyi nɛ men wɔ Jerusalɛm to ere kikɛ, men kaŋ kusoe n nu asɔ nɛ a wora na kikɛ be kifito. 15Men sa maa fɛ fanɛ basa ere boo nna. B maŋ boo, ŋkpal manɛ so, chipurso, kerfi akpanu e kraa la nna. 16Ama men baa nyi fanɛ asheŋ nɛ a wora ere be asheŋ nɛ anebi Jowɛl daŋ sibɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ:
17‘Le nɛ meeŋ wora lalaloge be nchɛ na to:
Meeŋ shin nɛ ma Kiyoyu e ba basa kikɛ to.
Menyi be mbrantiɛbi beeŋ ku bɔrɛdareana
nɛ menyi be benyɛnnimu
e ku abɔrɛsheŋ be edareana
nɛ menyi be mbinyɛnbi nɛ mbichebi
e wu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ.
18Kashenteŋto, saŋɛ na so meeŋ shin nɛ ma Kiyoyu na
e ba ma nyɛrbi nɛ ma mbita gba kikɛ to
nɛ b wu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ.
19Meeŋ wora emamachisheŋ ebɔrɛso
nɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ ŋiniso kasawule so.
Baaŋ wu ŋklaŋ nɛ edɛ nɛ edishi damta.
20Nɛ epeŋi e biri to gbrum,
nɛ kufɔl malɛ e pere to kpaiŋ
fanɛ ŋklaŋ. Amo kikɛ beeŋ wora nna pɔɛŋ
nɛ Enyɛnpe be kachɛgboŋ na e fo.
21Saŋɛ na so ekama nɛ e tre Enyɛnpe na beeŋ nya kumɔlga.’
22Israɛlebi, men nu nfe, Ebɔrɛ ŋini menyi fanɛ Nazarɛt be Yesu na shi mo kutɔ nna, ŋkpal e ka bɔla Yesu na so n wora emamachisheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ nɛ asheŋ ŋiniso damta menyi be anishito nfe so. Menyi gbagba baa nyi amo be asheŋ. 23Ebɔrɛ gbagba be kasha nɛ kashennyi so nɛ e daŋ yili kumo saŋɛ na kikɛ fanɛ baaŋ ta Yesu m bɔɔ menyi enɔ. Menyi shin nɛ basa lubi gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so m mɔ. 24Ama Ebɔrɛ naŋ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu na to n sɔ mo luwu be ebesa to n yige, ŋkpal manɛ so, luwu daa maŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ e ka kumo be enɔ to kikɛ.
25Ŋkpal manɛ so le nɛ Deevid daŋ malga mbe asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ:
‘Mee wu Enyɛnpe saŋkama ma anishito,
ŋkpal manɛ so, e wɔ ma kutɔ nna a chɛ ma to
nɛ basa e sa maŋ tiŋ n tɔrɔ ma.
26Amoso, ma kagbene kikɛ fuli ma nna
nɛ ma mmalga gba la kagbenefuli be mmalga.
Nɛ ma alɛ bomin e tiŋ a kɔ kusɔ
nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wora n sa ma be tama.
27Ŋkpal manɛ so, fo Ebɔrɛ maaŋ shin
nɛ n wu nɛ ma kiyoyu e yɔ luwu to.
Fo maaŋ shin nɛ fo kenya nɛ e bee bɛ fo so
nɛ kagbene koŋwule e wu m bɛ.
28Fo ŋini ma ekpaana nɛ meeŋ bɔla so n nya Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa.
Fo alɛ ka wɔ ma kutɔ so, ma kagbene fuli ma ga.’
29Ŋ kurgepoana, men shin nɛ m bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ menyi an nana Deevid be asheŋ. E daŋ wu nna nɛ b puli mo, hale mbre an kraa wu mbe nchaŋ kade ere to. 30E daa la anebi nna a nyi Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ nɛ e nase n sa mo fanɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ mo ere Deevid be kanaŋ to ebi be eko e ki ewura fanɛ Deevid gbagba. 31Deevid malɛ ka daa nyi kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa sha kewora na so nɛ e daŋ malga Kristo na be ketiŋi luwu to be asheŋ saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ shin nɛ e ka luwu to, e daa maŋ shin nɛ e wu m bɛ.’ 32Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ Yesu koŋwule ere tiŋi luwu to nɛ anyi wu kumo be loŋ be kashenteŋ. 33Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu to n ya chena mbe jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa nseŋ shin nɛ e nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ Etuto na nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na. Asɔ nɛ menyee wu nsaa nu naniere malɛ kikɛ la mbe kakɛ nna. 34Deevid gbagba daa maŋ yɔ ebɔrɛso fanɛ Yesu, ama le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ:
‘Enyɛnpe na kaŋɛ n Nyɛnpe le:
Chena ma jisoso nfe
35hale nɛ n ya ta fo doŋana m bɔɔ fo enɔ.’
36To, menyi, Israɛlebi kikɛ men baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ Yesu koŋwule nɛ men gbir m mata kedibi largato so na nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e ki Enyɛnpe nɛ Kristo na.”
37Basa na ka nu asɔ nɛ Pita malga na kikɛ nɛ bumo be ŋgbene kaa nɛ b bishi Pita nɛ mo braana beshuŋipoana na: “An kurgepoana, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora?” 38Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ bumo: “Men be ekama e lar mbe alubi to, kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ b bɛr mo kabɔrɛbɛr Yesu Kristo be ketre to nɛ Ebɔrɛ e ta mbe alubi m paŋ mo nseŋ sa mo Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na. 39Ŋkpal manɛ so, kumo be loŋ be kɔnɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase n sa menyi nɛ menyi be mmantoebi nɛ basa pɔtɛ nɛ b maŋ taga to nfe ere na kikɛ, bumo e la bumo nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ bee tre a ba mo kutɔ na.” 40Kesheŋ ere nɛ Pita daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nseŋ ta le be mmalga ŋ kaŋɛ bumo kenishipereso: “Men mɔlga menyi be amu ashi kasogberge nɛ k bee ba le be basa lubi ere so na to.”
41Basa na be bedamta daŋ yirda Pita be kamalga na nɛ b bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr. Kumo be kachɛ na basa fanɛ ŋgboŋ asa e ba ti beyirdapoana na so. 42Bumo nɛ beshuŋipo na e daa la saŋkama nɛ baa koya asɔ ashi beshuŋipo na kutɔ nsaa ba bumo be nshɛrbuana to nɛ bumo kikɛ ba kaa bɔ enɔ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso a wɔtɔ kawie koŋwule to nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso.
Beyirdapoana be kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ
43Beshuŋipoana na daŋ wora emamachisheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ ŋiniso damta n shin nɛ ekama kooba kufuso ga. 44Beyirdapoana na kikɛ daŋ baa wɔ abar so nna kɔnɔkoŋwuleso nsaa bar bumo be asɔ kakpa koŋwule m ba kaa chɛ abar to. 45Saŋko baa fa bumo be ekpanjawu to be asɔ nna a ta amo be amansherbi a chige a sa bumo to be ekama kanaŋkamaso nɛ a daga ekama ka nya. 46Karechɛ kama malɛ b daa shɛr bɔrɛlambu na to nna kɔnɔkoŋwuleso nseŋ naa shɛr abarana pe nchɛ nchɛ a ji ajibi kagbenewushiso nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso nsaa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ. 47Bumo be asheŋ daŋ bɔlɔ kade na to ebi kikɛ kenishi ga. Karechɛ kama malɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu daa mɔlga basa pɔtɛ nna a ti bumo so.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 3
Content:
B ka chɛ bobinyɛn ko be asheŋ
1Kachako Pita nɛ Jɔn ka bee yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to kapaso kerfi asa, jemanɛ nɛ basa daa yɔ n ya kaa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ bumo be kabɔrɛkule to na 2nɛ kanyɛn ko nɛ e daa la bobi mbe kakurgeachɛ kikɛ na wɔ bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna nɛ b daa tre Kabuna Lela na akpa. Kachɛ kama b daa sulɔ mo nna a ba kabuna na akpa nɛ e ba kaa kule basa nɛ b daa luri bɔrɛlambu na to na amansherbi. 3E ka wu Pita nɛ Jɔn ka bee luri bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ e kule bumo fanɛ b sa mo kusɔ ko. 4Nɛ b keni mbe anishito nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Keni anyi so.” 5Nɛ e keni bumo boeŋ a tama kenya kusɔ ko. 6Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “M maŋ kɔ kubo, ama meeŋ sa fo kusɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ. Nazarɛt be Yesu Kristo be eleŋ to so, niŋi to n nite!” 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita pɛ mbe enɔ to n chɛ mo to nɛ e niŋi to epul na to nɛ mbe aya nya eleŋ. 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ e tɛ to n yuu mbe aya so nseŋ fara a nite a kilgi to. Kumo be kaman nɛ mo nɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn luri bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ e bee nite nsaa tɛ to a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ. 9Jimaŋ na kikɛ daŋ wu e ka na nsaa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ. 10B ka pin fanɛ mo e daa tase bɔrɛlambu na be kabuna nɛ baa tre Kabuna Lela na akpa na nɛ bumo be nnɔ mɔ bumo ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ k wora mo na so.
Pita be kamalga ashi bɔrɛlambu to be asheŋ
11Basa na ka wu kananɛ kanyɛn na far n chɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn na nɛ k chinchiŋ bumo kikɛ ga nɛ b shile n yɔ bumo kutɔ ashi kakpa nɛ b daa tre Sɔlɔmɔn be kedɛdɛ na. 12Pita ka wu bumo nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Israɛlebi, manɛ e ba nɛ kesheŋ ere bee chinchiŋ menyi nɛ menyee keni anyi loŋ? Menyee tama fanɛ anyi gbagba be eleŋ ŋko anyi be kelela so so nɛ an tiŋ n chɛ kanyɛn ere nɛ e bee nite le ere a? 13An nananyɛnana Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ anyi be kanaŋ to ebi kikɛ be Ebɔrɛ na e sa mbe Kenya Yesu kemaŋkura. Mo nɛ men daŋ ta m bɔɔ belempo enɔ nseŋ kini mo Pailat be anishito, saŋɛ nɛ Pailat gbagba daa sha keyige mo na. 14Esa cheembi nɛ Esa Lela e daa la mo ama men kini mo nseŋ kule Pailat fanɛ e sɔ emɔpo n yige n sa menyi. 15Amoso, men mɔ esa nɛ e bee sa basa Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa. Ama Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu na to nɛ anyi gbagba ji kumo be loŋ be shɛda. 16Mo, Yesu koŋwule na be eleŋ e chɛ bobinyɛn ere na. Kusɔ nɛ men wu nseŋ nu ere tiŋ n wora nna ŋkpal keyirda mbe ketre na so so. Keyirda Yesu na e tiŋ n chɛ mo menyi kikɛ be anishito le ere na.
17To, ŋ kurgepoana, n nyi fanɛ kusɔ nɛ menyi nɛ menyi be benimuana wora Yesu na daa la kamaanyi be kusɔ nna. 18Dra na kikɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ anebiana kikɛ wu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ mbe Kristo na beeŋ ba ji awurfoŋ, kumo nɛ e shin nɛ k bɔla ekpa le ere na. 19Amoso, men lar menyi be alubi to nseŋ bɛta m ba Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nɛ e kpra menyi be alubi kikɛ n lɛ. 20Nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ ewushi e shi mo kutɔ m ba menyi be ayoyu to nɛ e shin nɛ Yesu nɛ e la Kristo nɛ Ebɔrɛ teŋ lara n sa menyi na e ba menyi kutɔ. 21Ama e beeŋ baa wɔ ebɔrɛso hale nɛ saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ asɔ kikɛ e ki apopɔr fanɛ kananɛ e shin nɛ mbe dra na be anebi cheembiana na kikɛ wu mbe asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ loŋ beeŋ wora na be jemanɛ e fo. 22Anebi Mosis le daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Menyi be Ebɔrɛ Enyɛnpe beeŋ shin nɛ anebi e ba menyi kutɔ fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ shin nɛ m ba na. E beeŋ ba kaa la menyi be efuli ere so be esa nna. E kaŋ ba, men baa nu a sa mo kusɔ kama to. 23Ekama nɛ e kini kenu kusɔ nɛ anebi na beeŋ kaŋɛ menyi, baaŋ lara mo Ebɔrɛ be basa to n shin nɛ e mur.’ 24Baŋ fara Samuɛl n ta anebiana nɛ b daŋ bɛ mo so na nɛ anebiana nɛ b ka na kikɛ nyam nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ b bɔ mbe kubɔya na daŋ wu naniere be asheŋ ere ŋ kaŋɛ. 25Nnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ mbe anebiana nase na la menyi alɛ gba peya nna. Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ Eebraham: ‘Fo kanaŋ to nɛ meeŋ bɔla n nɛfa durnya ere to be basa kikɛ.’ 26Amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara mbe kenya Yesu n shin nɛ e ba menyi kutɔ pɔɛŋ m ba nɛfa menyi a shin nɛ menyi kikɛ bee lar menyi be alubi to na.”

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 4
Content:
B ka shɛr Pita nɛ Jɔn kɔɔti to be asheŋ
1Pita nɛ Jɔn daa maŋ naŋ malga n sa basa na n loge nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na be beko nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpoana be enimu nɛ Esadusiana na be beko ba bumo kutɔ. 2B daŋ nya agbo nna ŋkpal beshuŋipo anyɔ na ka daa ŋini basa na fanɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ Yesu tiŋi luwu to so. Yesu be ketiŋi na malɛ e naa ŋini fanɛ basa nɛ b wu na kikɛ beeŋ ba tiŋi luwu to. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ bumo n ya ti ebu nɛ b klade ŋkpal kaboŋ ka daŋ jija to na so. 4Ama jimaŋ na to be bedamta nɛ b nu kubɔya na yirda kumo, nɛ beyirdapoana na kikɛ fo fanɛ basa ŋgboŋ anu.
5Kumo be ŋklade nɛ Juwebi be bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ benimuana na nɛ mbraŋinipoana na shɛr Jerusalɛm to be kakpa ko. 6Bumo nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Anas nɛ Kayafas nɛ Jɔn nɛ Alɛkzaanda nɛ beko nɛ bumo alɛ gba daŋ shi bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na be kanaŋ to na kikɛ e daa la. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ b bar beshuŋipo na m ba shin nɛ b yili bumo be anishito nɛ b bishi bumo: “Nuso nɛ men wora n chɛ bobinyɛn na? Eleŋ mo nɛ men kɔ ŋko wanɛ be ketre nɛ men ta n wora kumo?” 8Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na luri m bɔlɔ Pita to nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Israɛlebi be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ benimuana, 9menyee bishi anyi kabre be kachɛ ere kelela nɛ an wora bobinyɛn ere nɛ kananɛ a ji nɛ e nya alenfia. 10To, menyi kikɛ nɛ Israɛlebi kikɛ baa nyi fanɛ Nazarɛt be Yesu Kristo nɛ men gbir m mata kedibi largato so m mɔ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu na to na be ketre be eleŋ to so nɛ kanyɛn ere nya alenfia mo kikɛ nyam a yil menyi be anishito le ere na. 11Abɔrɛsibɛ na ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Kejembu mo nɛ menyi bepɔrpo keni jiga na e ba ki ajembu kikɛ be kelela’ na bee malga Yesu be asheŋ nna na. 12Yesu na nawule so nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n nya kumɔlga. Ebɔrɛ maŋ ta esa kikɛ be ketre durnya ere to n sa basa nɛ b bɔla kumo so n nya kumɔlga she Yesu Kristo nawule peya.”
13Nshɛrwuraana na ka wu kananɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn daŋ malga kenyɛnso nsaa la basa fuloŋ a maŋ nyi kawɔl nseŋ tiŋ n wora loŋ na, k daŋ chinchiŋ bumo ga. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b nyiŋi bumo nɛ Yesu ka daa la. 14Bumo alɛ ka wu kanyɛn nɛ e nya alenfia na ka yil Pita nɛ Jɔn kutɔ na so, b paŋ kenaŋ malga ŋ gbiti bumo. 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ b shin nɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn nɛ kanyɛn na lar kɔɔti na to nseŋ fara a malga demu na be asheŋ 16a bishi abar: “Nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora basa anyɔ ere? Jerusalɛm ere to be esa kama nyi fanɛ bumo e wora kemamachisheŋ gboŋ na, anyi maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ kumo be loŋ. 17Ama kananɛ anyeeŋ wora nɛ kesheŋ ere e sa maŋ naŋ sɔ kakpa n ti so e la, an ka beeŋ fiɛ bumo so fanɛ b sa maŋ naŋ ta Yesu be ketre m malga asheŋ n sa esa kikɛ.” 18Ndoŋ nna nɛ b naŋ tre Pita nɛ Jɔn m ba ndoŋ m ba kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ naŋ malga ŋko ŋ ŋini basa Yesu be asheŋ kikɛ. 19Nɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn bishi bumo: “Menyi ere kutɔ, kenu n sa menyi nɛ kenu n sa Ebɔrɛ, kumo e bɔla ekpa? 20Anyi ere maaŋ tiŋ n yige kemalga kusɔ nɛ anyi gbagba wu nseŋ nu be asheŋ.” 21Nɛ nshɛr na to ebi naŋ fiɛ bumo so ga n ti so nseŋ yige bumo nɛ b yɔ. B daa maŋ wu ekpa nɛ b daa beeŋ bɔla so n tiŋ ŋ gberge bumo kusoe, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa kikɛ daa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nna ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ k wora na so. 22Kanyɛn nɛ le be mamachisheŋ daŋ chɛ na daa chɔ nfɛ adena.
Beyirdapoana na ka kule Ebɔrɛ kenyɛn be asheŋ
23Basa na ka baŋ yige Pita nɛ Jɔn nɛ b bɛta n yɔ bumo braana beyirdapoana na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na nɛ benimuana na kaŋɛ bumo. 24B ka nu kesheŋ na nɛ bumo kikɛ kule Ebɔrɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe nɛ Etopo nɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule nɛ nchuana nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ amo to na kikɛ, 25fo e daŋ malga saŋɛ nɛ fo daŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na shin nɛ an nananyɛn Deevid, fo kenya wu m bishi:
‘Manɛ e ba nɛ nnyamase na daŋ diewu loŋ?
Manɛ e ba nɛ b daŋ kre bumo nia fuloŋ loŋ?
26Durnya ere to ebi be bewura bela ase
nɛ kadewuraana shɛr nɛ b kɔ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe Kristo na kena.’
27Kumo alɛ kashenteŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Hɛrɔd nɛ Pɔnshes Pailat nɛ nnyamase nɛ Israɛlebi daŋ shɛr kadegboŋ ere to ŋ kre Yesu nɛ e la fo Ebɔrɛ be Kenya cheembi nseŋ naa la emo nɛ fo lara fanɛ e baa la Kristo na be nia. 28Kusɔ nɛ fo daŋ nase fanɛ k wora na gbagba chap nɛ b daŋ shɛr n wora. Ŋkpal fo eleŋ nɛ fo kebaasha kumo be loŋ na so e shin nɛ fo daŋ yili kumo loŋ. 29Naniere Enyɛnpe, fo nu kananɛ b fiɛ anyi so nna na, amoso, sa anyi, fo anya kenyɛn nɛ an tiŋ m bɔ fo kubɔya na n sa basa. 30Ŋini fo eleŋ n chɛ belɔpo nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ an tiŋ m bɔla Yesu Kristo, fo Kenya na be ketre so n wora kashenteŋ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ nɛ emamachisheŋ.” 31B ka loge bumo be kabɔrɛkule na nɛ bumo be nshɛrkpa na kikɛ fara a gbuŋgbuŋ to nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na luri m bɔlɔ bumo kikɛ to nɛ b fara a bɔ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na kenyɛnso a sa basa.
Beyirdapoana na ka barga bumo be asɔ to be asheŋ
32Nfɛra koŋwule nɛ beyirdapoana na kikɛ daa kɔ. Bumo be ekama daa maa kaŋɛ fanɛ mbe asɔ la mo nawule peya nna. Kusɔ kama nɛ ekama daa kɔ b daa ta nna a barga to a sa abar. 33Nɛ beshuŋipoana na malga kenyɛnso n ji Enyɛnpe Yesu be ketiŋi luwu to na be shɛda n sa basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛfa bumo kikɛ ga. 34Shɛŋ shɛŋ daa maŋ tir bumo be ekama. Bumo to be nsawulewuraana ŋko nwuwuraana daa fa amo nna 35a ta amo be amansherbi na m ba kaa bɔɔ beshuŋipoana na enɔ nɛ b ta amansherbi na m barga to n sa ekama kanaŋkamaso nɛ a daga ekama ka nya. 36Kanyɛn ko malɛ gba daa wɔ bumo to nɛ baa tre mo Josɛf. E daa la Livai be kanaŋ to be esa nna nɛ b kurge mo Saipres be efuli so. Ketre nɛ beshuŋipo na daŋ sa mo e la Baanabas, kumo be kifito e la fanɛ esa nɛ e bee kpaŋ beko. 37Mo e daŋ fa mbe kasawule nseŋ ta kumo be amansherbi m ba bɔɔ beshuŋipoana na enɔ.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 5
Content:
Ananiyas nɛ Safaira be asheŋ
1Kanyɛn ko malɛ nɛ b daa tre Ananiyas daŋ fa mo nɛ mbe eche Safaira be kusɔ ko ŋ kaŋɛ mbe eche 2nseŋ lara amansherbi na be ako n yili nseŋ ta amo nɛ a ka n ya bɔɔ beshuŋipo na enɔ. 3Nɛ Pita bishi mo: “Ananiyas, manɛ e ba nɛ fo shin nɛ Setani ba fo kagbene to m ba shin nɛ fo lara fo kudɔ na be amansherbi nɛ fo nya na so nseŋ ta ade m ba nɛ fo ba fule Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na? 4Kusɔ nɛ fo fa na daa maa la feya nna nɛ fo fa kumo n nya amansherbi na a? Nɛ a ji nuso nɛ kusɔ nɛ fo wora ere be nfɛra ba fo kagbene to? Mannɛ enyiŋgbasa nɛ fo fule, Ebɔrɛ nɛ fo fule!” 5Ananiyas ka baŋ nu kesheŋ ere nɛ e tɔr n wu epul na to nɛ kufu pɛ bekama nɛ b nu kumo be asheŋ na ga. 6Nɛ mbrantiɛbi ba ta asɔ m mea mo nseŋ ta mo n ya puli.
7Ta a ba fanɛ awa asa to nɛ mbe eche ba, ama e daa maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k wora. 8Nɛ Pita bishi mo: “Kaŋɛ ma, amansherbi nɛ fo nɛ fo kul fa menyi be kusɔ na n nya na kikɛ nde a?” Nɛ e shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mm, amo kikɛ nyam nna na.” 9Nɛ Pita bishi mo: “Manɛ e ba nɛ fo nɛ fo kul wora kɔnɔkoŋwule a sha kewora Enyɛnpe be Kiyoyu na ŋ keni? Basa nɛ b puli fo kul e wɔ kabuna to na, bumo alɛ beeŋ ta fo alɛ gba loŋ.” 10Epul na to nɛ e tɔr Pita be anishito ndoŋ n wu. Nɛ mbrantiɛbi na ba wu mo nɛ e wu a dese nɛ b sulɔ mo n lar n ya puli m mata mo kul. 11Kufu daŋ pɛ asɔriebi na kikɛ nɛ bekama nyam nɛ b daŋ nu kesheŋ ere na ga.
Emamachisheŋ damta be kewora be asheŋ
12Beshuŋipo na daŋ wora emamachisheŋ nɛ kashenteŋ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ damta basa na to. Beyirdapoana na kikɛ daa shɛr Sɔlɔmɔn be Kedɛdɛ na to nna kɔnɔkoŋwuleso. 13Basa pɔtɛana nɛ b daa maŋ yirda na be ekama daa ŋana keyaa tu beyirdapoana na nna n shɛr, ama bumo alɛ kikɛ nyam daa sa beyirdapoana na bunyaŋ ga. 14Saŋkama malɛ basa damta, beche nɛ benyɛn nɛ b daŋ yirda Enyɛnpe na daa ti beyirdapo na so nna. 15Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ beshuŋipo na daa wora na so, basa daa sulɔ belɔpo nna a lar abɔrbiana so n ya kaa nase egedo nɛ ekelaŋ so nɛ Pita e ba kaa choŋ nɛ mbe kiyoyul nawule gba e baŋ tɔr bumo be beko so. 16Nɛ jimaŋ damtaana shi ndewurbi nɛ a taga to Jerusalɛm na m bar bumo be belɔpo nɛ bekama nyam nɛ b kɔ mbuibi lubi bumo to na, nɛ bumo kikɛ nya alenfia.
B ka tɔrɔ beshuŋipo na be asheŋ
