17Nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nɛ mo braana Esadusiana na be ŋgbene kaa kekishiso ŋkpal asɔ nɛ beshuŋipo na daa wora na so nɛ b yili kumo fanɛ beshuŋipo na beeŋ pin. 18Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ beshuŋipo na n ti ebu. 19Ama kumo be kanyɛso nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika ba bugi kabuti na be mbuna nseŋ bar bumo kowu m ba kaŋɛ bumo: 20“Men yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya yili m bɔ kebaawɔtɔ popɔr ere be asheŋ kikɛ n sa basa.” 21Beshuŋipo na ka nu loŋ nɛ b yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to karechɛso n ya fara a ŋini basa abɔrɛsheŋ na.
Nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nɛ mo braana tre Juwebi be benimuana na kikɛ fanɛ bumo, nshɛrwuraana na kikɛ nyam e ba shɛr. Kumo be kaman nɛ b shuŋi fanɛ b ya lara beshuŋipo na kabuti to m ba. 22Ama mbɔ na ka yɔ kabuti na to, b maŋ ya wu beshuŋipo na nseŋ bɛta n ya kaŋɛ nshɛrwuraana na: 23“An ka yɔ kabuti na akpa nɛ kumo be akuloŋ kikɛ ti nna m ber so kpakpa nɛ bekumpoana na kikɛ yil mbunaana na to a de so, ama an ka bugi ebu na nɛ esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ.” 24Bɔrɛlambu na to be bekumpo be enimu na nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na ka nu kesheŋ nɛ k wora na nɛ k chinchiŋ bumo ga nɛ b fara a fɛ kusɔ nɛ kesheŋ na beeŋ ba ki. 25Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn ko ba kaŋɛ bumo: “Men nu nfe, basa nɛ men ti ebu na yil bɔrɛlambu na to a ŋini basa.” 26Nɛ enimu na shin nɛ mo nɛ mbe beshumpo na naŋ ya bar beshuŋipo na. B daa maŋ ta katiŋ m pɛ bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa lɔ kufu nna fanɛ basa na beeŋ kpa bumo ajembu m mɔ.
27Nɛ b bar beshuŋipo na m ba yili nshɛrwuraana na be anishito nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na kaŋɛ bumo: 28“An fiɛ menyi so fanɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ ta kanyɛn na be ketre ŋ ŋini esa kusɔ kama, ama men keni kusɔ nɛ men wora. Menyi shin nɛ menyi be keŋini ere sɔ Jerusalɛm ere to kikɛ a sha keta kanyɛn na be luwu na be turju n deŋi anyi.” 29Nɛ Pita nɛ mo braana beshuŋipo na kaŋɛ: “Ebɔrɛ e daga an ka nu n sa, mannɛ enyiŋgbasa. 30An nanaana be Ebɔrɛ e daŋ shin nɛ Yesu nɛ men daŋ gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so m mɔ na tiŋi luwu na to. 31Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu to n yɔ mbe jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa fanɛ Ejuŋkparpo nɛ Emɔlgapo nɛ Israɛlebi e tiŋ n nya ekpa n lar bumo be alubi to nɛ Ebɔrɛ e ta m paŋ bumo. 32Amo be eshɛdajipo e la anyi nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nɛ e kɔ a sa bekama nɛ baa nu a sa mo na.”
33Nshɛrwuraana na ka nu loŋ nɛ b nya agbo ga nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ baaŋ shin nɛ b mɔ beshuŋipo na. 34Ama Gameelial, basa na to be Farisinyɛn ko nɛ e daa la mbraŋinipo nsaa la esa nɛ basa kikɛ daa sa bunyaŋ na koso n yili nseŋ shin nɛ b keta beshuŋipo na n lar ekarso gbrɛ 35nseŋ kaŋɛ nshɛrwuraana na: “Israɛlebi, men baa de kusɔ nɛ menyee sha kewora basa ere na so. 36Saŋɛ nɛ Tyudas daŋ koso a tre mbe kumu esagboŋ ko nɛ basa damta fanɛ basa alfa ana daŋ shile m buu mo na, maŋ naŋ chɛr ko. Ama b ka mɔ mo, mbe bebɛsopoana na kikɛ pesaŋ to nna nɛ mbe kushuŋ na kikɛ mur. 37Kede be kaman nɛ Judas Galili be esa na ba lar, jemanɛ nɛ efuli ere so ebi daa karga bumo be basa na n shin nɛ basa damta daŋ ba kaa bɛ mo alɛ gba so. Ama b ka mɔ mo alɛ gba nɛ mbe bebɛsopoana na kikɛ pesaŋ to. 38Amoso, mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na fanɛ men sa maŋ wora basa ere shɛŋ. Men yige bumo boeŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ nyiŋgbasa gbagba e ta mbe nfɛra ŋ jɔŋɛ bumo be kushuŋ ere, k maaŋ chɛr nseŋ mur. 39Ama nɛ kashenteŋ nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ, men maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ bumo so kikɛ. Nɛ menyi alɛ gbagba maŋ de so, menyeeŋ baa wora a da Ebɔrɛ so.”
40Ndoŋ nna nɛ nshɛrwuraana na nu Gameelial be kamalga na. Nɛ b tre beshuŋipo na m ba shin nɛ b kuya bumo so nseŋ fiɛ bumo so fanɛ b sa maŋ kaŋ naŋ ta Yesu be ketre m malga kikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ b sa bumo ekpa nɛ b yɔ. 41Nɛ beshuŋipo na lar nshɛrwuraana na kutɔ nɛ kagbenefuli ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka shin nɛ bumo alɛ tiŋ n ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal Yesu be ketre na so so. 42Kachɛ kama malɛ b daa luri bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ basa peana nna ŋ kraa ŋini nsaa bɔ baru lela na a sa basa a kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu e la Kristo na.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 6
Content:
Bechɛtopo ashunu na be asheŋ
1Saŋko kananɛ bebɛsopoana na daŋ baa wora keshi a ti so na nɛ kɔnɔgberge tɔr Juwebi nɛ b daa malga Griik to na nɛ bumo nɛ b daa la ndetobia gbagba na so. Juwebi nɛ b daa malga Griik to na e daa kaŋɛ fanɛ bumo na daa gal bumo be bekulpocheana nna a lɛ a maa sa bumo karechɛ kama be kasɔchige be kechɛto na. 2Nɛ beshuŋipo kuduanyɔ na tre bebɛsopoana na kikɛ nyam m ba kaŋɛ bumo: “A maŋ daga an ka yige kebaabɔ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na nsaa wɔtɔ a wora keji be kasɔchige be asheŋ. 3Amoso, bekurgepoana, men lara menyi to be basa ashunu nɛ ekama nyi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nɛ kanyiasheŋ ka bɔlɔ bumo to nɛ an shin nɛ b baa keni le be kushuŋ na so 4nɛ anyi alɛ e baa wɔ kabɔrɛkule kpakpaso to nseŋ naa bɔ kubɔya na.” 5Kusɔ nɛ beshuŋipo na daŋ kaŋɛ na daŋ par beyirdapoana na kikɛ ga nɛ b lara Stiven. E daa la esa nɛ yirda nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na daŋ bɔlɔ mo to nna. B daŋ lara Filip nɛ Prɔkɔres nɛ Nikeenɔɔ nɛ Taimɔn nɛ Paamɛnas nɛ Nikolaws nɛ e daŋ shi Antiɔk n daa la kanyamase nseŋ daŋ ba tuba a bɛ Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso so pɔɛŋ m ba ki eyirdapo na. 6Bumo nɛ beyirdapoana na daŋ lara m bɔɔ beshuŋipo na enɔ nɛ b ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi n deŋi bumo nɛ b lara na so ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa bumo.
7Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya daŋ baa sɔ kakpa kikɛ nna nɛ Jerusalɛm be bebɛsopoana baa wora keshi a ti so nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na be bedamta ba yirda.
8Stiven daa la esa nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nɛfa nna ga nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na luri m bɔlɔ mo kikɛ to nɛ e wora emamachisheŋ nɛ kashenteŋ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ damta basa na to. 9Ama nshɛrbu nɛ b daa tre “Basa nɛ b sɔ bumo be amu n yige be Nshɛrbu na” to ebi be beko daŋ ba ji Stiven emɔrɔ. Bumo be beko daŋ shi Sairini nɛ Alɛkzaandria nna. Bumo nɛ Silisia nɛ Eeshia be Juwebi ko e daŋ ba fara a ji Stiven emɔrɔ. 10Ama b daa maŋ tiŋ n ji m bri mo ŋkpal eleŋgboŋ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na daŋ sa mo nɛ e malga so. 11Nɛ b kpal loŋ so n sa basa ko amansherbi nseŋ we n wɔtɔ bumo fanɛ b kaŋɛ le: “An nu e ka bee malga a da Mosis nɛ Ebɔrɛ so.” 12Le nɛ b daŋ wora n nyaŋɛ basa na nɛ benimuana na nɛ mbraŋinipoana na to nɛ b ba nyaŋ Stiven n yɔ nshɛrwuraana na kutɔ 13nseŋ shin nɛ basa ko ba ku efɛ n deŋi mo ŋ kaŋɛ: “Saŋkama kanyɛn ere bee malga a gbiti anyi be bɔrɛlambu cheembi na nɛ Mosis be mbra nna. 14An nu e ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Nazarɛt be Yesu na beeŋ bure bɔrɛlambu na nseŋ chɛrga edaŋkaresheŋ nɛ Mosis sa anyi na kikɛ.” 15Nshɛrwuraana nɛ b daa tase nshɛr na to na kikɛ daŋ ta bumo be anishi nna n yuu Stiven so n wu mbe anishiakpa ka du fanɛ malaika peya.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 7
Content:
Stiven be kamalga be asheŋ
1Nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na bishi Stiven: “Kashenteŋ nɛ baa ji ere a?” 2Nɛ Stiven kaŋɛ: “N daana nɛ n tutoana, men nu nfe. Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daga kemaŋkura na e daŋ ba an nananyɛn Eebraham kutɔ, saŋɛ nɛ e daa wɔ Mɛsopoteemia pɔɛŋ m ba kaa n yɔ Haran be kade to na 3m ba kaŋɛ mo: ‘Lar fo basa kutɔ nɛ fo efuli ere so n yɔ efuli nɛ meeŋ ŋini fo ere so.’ 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ e lar Kaldiya be efuli na so n ya kaa wɔ Haran. Eebraham mo tuto ka ba wu nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e kaa m ba efuli nɛ men wɔ ere so. 5Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ sa Eebraham kasawule na be gbrɛ nyitiibi kikɛ gba fanɛ k baa la mo peya. Ama Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ n sa Eebraham fanɛ e beeŋ ta kasawule na n sa mo nɛ mbe kaman to ebi kikɛ. Saŋɛ na so nɛ Eebraham daa maa kɔ mbia. 6Le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ mo: ‘Fo kaman to ebi beeŋ ba kaa wɔ efuli pɔtɛ ko so, kakpa nɛ baaŋ baa la anya nɛ b tɔrɔ bumo ga nfɛ alfa ana. 7Ama meeŋ gberge basa nɛ fo kaman to ebi beeŋ shuŋ na kusoe pɔɛŋ n shin nɛ fo basa na e lar efuli na so m ba nfe m ba kaa bunyaŋ ma.’ 8Kumo be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mo nɛ Eebraham nase kɔnɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ Eebraham fanɛ mbe kaman to ebi e baa ku atutu a ŋini fanɛ b sɔ kɔnɔ naseso na. Amoso, b ka kurge Aizek mbe kachɛ burwasopo nɛ Eebraham ku mo kututu nɛ Aizek malɛ ba ku Jeekɔb peya nɛ Jeekɔb malɛ ku mbe mbia, basa kuduanyɔ nɛ b juŋkpar Israɛlebi be kanaŋ kuduanyɔ na be atutu.
9Bejuŋkparpo ere daŋ kurge bumo sipo Josɛf yurkishi nna n ta mo n fa n shin nɛ e ki kenya ashi Ijipt be efuli so. Ama Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ yige mo n to. 10E daŋ lara mo ashi mbe etɔrɔ kikɛ to nseŋ sa mo kanyiasheŋ nɛ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ a par Ijipt be ewura Fɛɛro ga nɛ Fɛɛro shin nɛ Josɛf ki efuli na so be gomena nɛ mbe kowu to ebi kikɛ so be enimu. 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ akoŋgboŋ ko tɔr Ijipt nɛ Keenan be efuliana kikɛ so m bar awurfoŋ damta ga nɛ an nanaana fin ajibi kanaŋkama ŋ gben. 12Nɛ Jeekɔb ba nu fanɛ ajibi wɔ Ijipt be efuli so nseŋ shuŋi mbe mbia, an nananyɛnana ndoŋ. Kede to e daa la bumo be sososo be keyɔ ndoŋ. 13B ka naŋ bɛta n yɔ kela nyɔsopo to nɛ Josɛf shin nɛ mo daana na pin mo, kumo be kaman nɛ Fɛɛro ba pin Josɛf be basa. 14Nɛ Josɛf kela fanɛ b ya kaŋɛ mo tuto Jeekɔb nɛ mbe basa kikɛ fanɛ b bela m ba Ijipt be efuli so, basa na kikɛ daa wɔ basa adushunu nɛ anu. 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ Jeekɔb kaa n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so, ndoŋ nɛ mo nɛ an nanaana kikɛ ya wu n wu n loge 16nɛ b ta bumo n yɔ Shɛkɛm n ya puli kebeelaŋ ko nɛ Eebraham daŋ tɔ ashi Hamɔ be kanaŋ to ebi kutɔ na to.
17Ama kɔnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase n sa Eebraham na be jemanɛ ka ba taga to, k bɔla ekpa nɛ anyi be basa nɛ b daa wɔ Ijipt na malɛ wora keshi n ti so. 18Jemanɛ na nɛ ewura popɔr ko nɛ e daa maŋ nyi Josɛf, ji Ijipt be efuli na so be kuwura. 19Mo e daŋ fule anyi be basa nseŋ tɔrɔ an nanaana ga n tintiŋ bumo n shin nɛ b ta bumo be mbi popɔrbi n ya nase nde na be ntamaŋ to nɛ b wu. 20Amo be jemanɛ nɛ b kurge kayɛrbi Mosis ŋ keni mo so epe afɔl asa pɔɛŋ 21nseŋ ta mo n ya nase kaboŋ ko nɛ e wu nɛ Fɛɛro pibiche ya ta mo n ya ki mo peya ŋ keni mo so nɛ e daŋ. 22Ndoŋ nɛ b ŋini mo Ijipt be kanyiasheŋ kikɛ nɛ e ba ki esagboŋ ashi mbe kamalga nɛ mbe asheŋ woraso kikɛ to.
23Mosis ka ba fo nfɛ adena nɛ k ba mo to fanɛ e ya chɔrɔ mo peebi Israɛlebi. 24E ka yɔ nɛ e ya wu Ijipt be esa ko ka bee tɔrɔ Israɛl be esa ko nɛ e ya chɛ Israɛl be esa na to n sɔ mbe kɔnɔ m mɔ Ijipt be esa na. 25E daa nyi fanɛ mo peebi na daa beeŋ pin fanɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa sha keshin nɛ e sɔ bumo n yige, ama b daa maŋ pin kumo be loŋ. 26Kumo be ŋklade nɛ e wu Israɛlebi be benyɔ ka bee bile nɛ e yɔ nɛ e ya wora ania m barga bumo to ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Men nu nfe, men la basa koŋwule nna nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ menyee wora a da abar so le?’ 27Nɛ emo nɛ e daŋ wora n jija na ŋin Mosis n yili ekarso nseŋ bishi mo: ‘Wanɛ e ta fo ŋ ki anyi be enimu nɛ anyi be demujipo? 28Fo yɛ fo mɔ ma alɛ gba nna fanɛ kananɛ ndre fo mɔ Ijipt be kanyɛn na nna a?’ 29Mosis ka nu loŋ nɛ e shile Ijipt be efuli na so n ya kaa wɔ Midian be efuli so. Ndoŋ nɛ e kurge mbinyɛnbi anyɔ.
30Mosis ka wɔ Midian be efuli na so kumo be nfɛ adena be kaman nɛ malaika lar mo so kiyi to ashi kupumbi chɔɔso ko to. Ndoŋ daŋ mata Sainai be kebee na so nna. 31Kusɔ nɛ Mosis daŋ wu na daŋ chinchiŋ mo ga nɛ e firgi n taga to nɛ e keni nseŋ nu Enyɛnpe be ebɔl ka bee kaŋɛ: 32‘Ma e la fo nanaana be Ebɔrɛ na, Eebraham nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ.’ Nɛ kufu pɛ Mosis ga nɛ e chicha a maŋ naŋ tiŋ nɛ e keni kakpa na. 33Nɛ Enyɛnpe kaŋɛ mo: ‘Lara fo asɛbta na, ŋkpal manɛ so, kakpa nɛ fo yil ere la kasawule cheeŋ nna. 34N wu kekɔrfɛ nɛ tɔrɔ damta nɛ ma basa wɔ Ijipt be efuli so a nya. N nu bumo be kushu m ba nɛ m ba mɔlga bumo. Nu nfe, meeŋ shuŋi fo Ijipt.’
35Mosis koŋwule ere nɛ Israɛlebi daŋ kini nseŋ bishi mo: ‘Wanɛ e ta fo ŋ ki anyi be enimu nɛ anyi be demujipo?’ Mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla malaika nɛ e daŋ wu kupumbi chɔɔso na to na so n shuŋi fanɛ Israɛl be enimu nɛ emɔlgapo na. 36Mo e daŋ juŋkpar bumo n wora emamachisheŋ nɛ kashenteŋ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ damta ashi Ijipt nɛ Teku Peper na to nɛ jemanɛ nɛ b daa wɔ kiyi to nfɛ adena na kikɛ. 37Mo, Mosis koŋwule na e daŋ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi: ‘Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa menyi anebi fanɛ kananɛ e shuŋi ma na, e beeŋ ba kaa la menyi to be eko nna.’ 38Mosis koŋwule na nɛ Israɛlebi nɛ b daŋ shɛr kiyi to na e daa la ndoŋ. Mo nɛ an nanaana nɛ malaika nɛ e daŋ malga mo kutɔ ashi Sainai be kebee na so e daa la. Mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta mbe kubɔya nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na n sa nɛ e ba sa anyi. 39Ama an nanaana daŋ kini kenu n sa Mosis nseŋ kplaŋ mo so nseŋ naa yɛlga kenaŋ bɛta n yɔ Ijipt be efuli so. 40Ŋkpal loŋ so ŋ kaŋɛ Ɛɛrɔn: ‘Lɔŋɛ agbir ko n sa anyi nɛ a baa juŋkpar anyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi maŋ naa nyi kusɔ nɛ k wora Mosis nɛ e bar anyi ashi Ijipt na.’ 41Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɔr kegbir ko fanɛ kenabi nseŋ mɔ asɔ n wora kejigboŋ n lɔŋɛ kumo a bunyaŋ kusɔ nɛ bumo gbagba pɔr na. 42Nɛ Ebɔrɛ pal kaman n sa bumo n shin nɛ baa bunyaŋ achɛkpabi fanɛ kananɛ anebiana na daŋ sibɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ:
‘Israɛlebi, mannɛ ma
nɛ men daŋ mɔ asɔbɔya kiyi na to
nfɛ adena n sa na.
43Kegbir Molɛk be wajɛbu nɛ men daŋ keta
n ti menyi be kegbir pɔrso Rɛfam
nɛ k duli kechɛkpabi na so.
Amo agbir anyɔ na
nɛ men daŋ lɔŋɛ a bunyaŋ.
Amoso, meeŋ shin nɛ b lara menyi
ashi menyi be efuli ere so
n yɔ kufɔ kufɔ, Babilɔn be kaman.’
44Ebɔrɛ be wajɛbu nɛ k daa ŋini fanɛ Ebɔrɛ wɔ an nanaana kutɔ na nɛ bumo e daa la kiyi to. Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ŋini Mosis fanɛ e wora kumo na gbagba chap nɛ e daŋ wora kumo. 45Kumo be kaman, an nanaana nɛ bumo tutoana daŋ ta wajɛbu na n sa na, daŋ keta kumo, saŋɛ nɛ bumo nɛ Joshuwa daa la na nna n yɔ efuliana nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ju amo to be basa n lɛ nɛ an nanaana sɔ bumo be nsawule na kikɛ so. Ndoŋ nɛ wajɛbu na daŋ ba kaa shir a wɔ hale n ya fo Ewura Deevid be jemanɛ. 46Mbe asheŋ daŋ bɔlɔ Ebɔrɛ kenishi ga nɛ e kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ e pɔr ebu n sa mo ere, Jeekɔb be Ebɔrɛ na. 47Ama Ewura Sɔlɔmɔn e daŋ ba pɔr kumo. 48Ama Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ pe maŋ la nyiŋgbasa be nwu pɔrso fanɛ kananɛ anebiana kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na:
49‘Ebɔrɛso e la ma kuwurjiakpa
nɛ kasawule so la ma aya be kusɔ yiliso so.
Nɛ nuso be ebu nɛ menyeeŋ pɔr n sa ma?
Nnɛ nɛ meeŋ baa wɔ a wushi?
50Mannɛ ŋ gbagba e to loŋ be asɔ na kikɛ a?’
51Men kɔ amu kpakpaso ga. Menyi be ŋgbene du fanɛ nnyamase peya nna, men maŋ kɔ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na be asoe. Menyi nɛ men nanaana baa la kukoŋwule nna. Menyi alɛ gba maa nu a sa Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na. 52Anebi mo nɛ men nanaana maŋ tɔrɔ! B mɔ Ebɔrɛ be mbɔ nɛ b daŋ wu ŋ kaŋɛ dra na kikɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kenya cheembi beeŋ ba na. Kabre menyi alɛ debɔr mo nseŋ mɔ mo. 53Menyi nɛ emalaika daŋ bar Ebɔrɛ be mbra na, ama men kini kebɛ mbra na so.”
B ka kpa Stiven ajembu m mɔ be asheŋ
54Nshɛrwuraana na ka nu kusɔ nɛ Stiven bee kaŋɛ na nɛ b nya agbo ga n we anyi to agboso. 55Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na luri m bɔlɔ Stiven to nɛ e maŋ kumu so ŋ keni ebɔrɛso n wu Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura nɛ Yesu yil Ebɔrɛ be jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa. 56Nɛ e kaŋɛ basa na: “Men keni, n wu ebɔrɛso ka bugi nɛ Nyiŋgbasa Pibinyɛn yil Ebɔrɛ be jisoso.” 57Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ponte eleŋso ga nseŋ ti bumo be asoe nseŋ yarase epul na to kɔnɔkoŋwuleso 58n ya gberge mo n lar kadegboŋ na to ŋ kpa mo ajembu m mɔ. Kabrantiɛbia ko nɛ b daa tre Sɔɔl kutɔ nɛ eshɛdajipoana na daŋ yige bumo be asɔbuuso nɛ e bee keni so. 59B daŋ kraa wɔ kekpa Stiven ajembu to nna nɛ e kule Enyɛnpe le: “Enyɛnpe Yesu, shin nɛ ma kiyoyu e ba fo kutɔ.” 60Ndoŋ nna nɛ e gbir nseŋ kaŋɛ awɔrso: “Enyɛnpe, ta bumo be kulubi ere m paŋ bumo.” Kede be kaman nɛ e wu.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 8
Content:
1Sɔɔl gba daŋ shuli fanɛ Stiven be luwu na bɔla ekpa.
Sɔɔl ka tɔrɔ beyirdapoana na be asheŋ
Kumo be kamɔnchɛ na kikɛ nɛ b fara a tɔrɔ Jerusalɛm to ebi be beyirdapoana na ga. Nɛ beyirdapoana na kikɛ pesaŋ to n sɔ Judiya nɛ Samɛria be efuliana na kikɛ so ŋ ka beshuŋipo na. 2Ebɔrɛ be bebɛsopo ko e daŋ puli Stiven nseŋ boŋ to n shu mbe keeli ga. 3Ama Sɔɔl malɛ daa kɔ a fin kemur beyirdapoana na kikɛ nna nyam. E daa nite basa peana nna a nyaŋ beyirdapoana na, benyɛn nɛ beche kikɛ a lar n ya kaa ti ebu.
B ka bɔ baru lela na n sa Samɛriaebi be asheŋ
4Beyirdapo na nɛ b daŋ pesaŋ to na daŋ yɔ kaplɛkama nna n ya kaa bɔ kubɔya na. 5Filip daŋ yɔ Samɛria nna n ya bɔ Yesu Kristo na be asheŋ n sa ndoŋebi. 6Jimaŋana na ka nu Filip be kamalga nseŋ wu emamachisheŋ nɛ e wora na nɛ b bugi asoe n nu mbe kamalga kɔnɔkoŋwuleso. 7B daŋ wu mbuibi lubiana ka boŋ to awɔrso n lar basa damta to nseŋ naŋ wu eyurwusowuraana nɛ ebobi damta gba ka nya alenfia. 8Amoso, kagbenefuli daŋ bɔlɔ Samɛria be kade na to kikɛ nna.
9Jemanɛ na so malɛ kikɛ nɛ kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Saimɔn daa kɔ ŋkilgi be kudur a wɔ Samɛria be kade na to a wora emamachisheŋ a shin nɛ Samɛriaebi na be nnɔ daa mɔ bumo ga. E daa tre mbe kumu esagboŋ ko nna. 10Nɛ kade na to be basa kikɛ, benimu nɛ mbia daa bugi asoe a nu asɔ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ. Le nɛ b daa kaŋɛ: “Kanyɛn ere e la Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ nɛ baa tre Eleŋgboŋ na.” 11Saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ fara a wora emamachisheŋ ŋana so damta na daa maŋ taga to, amoso, b daŋ bugi bumo be asoe kikɛ nna n nu kusɔ kikɛ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ bumo. 12Ama b ka yirda Filip be baru lela nɛ e bee bɔ a kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na nɛ Yesu Kristo be ketre be asheŋ na, nɛ b bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr, beche nɛ benyɛn kikɛ. 13Saimɔn gba daŋ yirda Filip be kubɔya na nɛ b bɛr mo kabɔrɛbɛr. Kumo be kaman nɛ e ta mbe kumu m mata Filip nseŋ wu Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ be emamachisheŋ ŋiniso nɛ Filip daŋ wora na nɛ mbe kɔnɔ mɔ mo ga.
14Beshuŋipo nɛ b daa wɔ Jerusalɛm to nseŋ nu fanɛ Samɛriaebi yirda Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na nɛ b shuŋi Pita nɛ Jɔn bumo kutɔ. 15B ka yɔ nɛ b ya kule Ebɔrɛ n sa ndoŋ be beyirdapoana na fanɛ b nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na, 16ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ na nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na maŋ naŋ gbelge bumo be ekama so. Enyɛnpe Yesu be ketre to nawule nɛ b daŋ bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr. 17Nɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi n deŋi bumo so nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na gbelge bumo so. 18Saimɔn ka wu beshuŋipo na ka ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi n deŋi basa na so nɛ b nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nɛ e ta amansherbi m ba kaŋɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn: 19“Men sɔ nseŋ sa ma eleŋ na nɛ esa kama nɛ ma alɛ ta ma enɔ n deŋi mo so e nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na.” 20Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Fo nɛ fo amansherbi ere beeŋ mur, ŋkpal fo ka bee fɛ ketɔ Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ so. 21Fo maŋ kɔ shɛŋ anyi be kushuŋ ere to, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo kagbene maŋ bɔla ekpa ashi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ. 22Amoso, lar le be nfɛra lubi ere to nseŋ kule Enyɛnpe na nɛ e ta fo nfɛra fɛso lubi ere m paŋ fo. 23Ŋkpal manɛ so, n wu yurkishi lubi ka bɔlɔ fo to nɛ alubi nyaŋ fo kpakpa a wɔtɔ.” 24Nɛ Saimɔn kaŋɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn: “Jande, men kule Ebɔrɛ n sa ma nɛ asheŋ nɛ men malga ere be kekama e sa maŋ wora ma.”
25Pita nɛ Jɔn ka ji bumo be shɛda nseŋ bɔ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na n loge nɛ b bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm. B ka daa wɔ ekpa to a yɔ b daŋ bɔ baru lela na nna n sa Samɛria be ndewurbiebi damta.
Filip nɛ Itiopia be krachigboŋ be asheŋ
26Nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika ko kaŋɛ Filip: “Ta a ba kapaso, bela ase ŋ koso n yɔ ekpa nɛ k shi Jerusalɛm a yɔ Gaaza na.” Basa maŋ naa nite ekpa na so ga. 27Nɛ Filip bela ase n yɔ. Saŋɛ na so nɛ Itiopia be krachigboŋ ko wɔ ekpa na to a yɔ epe. 28Amo be kanyɛn na daa la krachigboŋ ko nna a keni Itiopia be ewurche Kandasi be amansherbi so. E daŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm nna n ya bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nseŋ luri mbe gbaŋɛturko to m bɛta a kraŋ anebi Aizaaya be kawɔl a yɔ epe. 29Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ Filip: “Nite n yɔ gbaŋɛturko ere akpa n ya tu kumo.” 30Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip shile n yɔ n ya nu e ka bee kraŋ anebi Aizaaya be kawɔl nɛ e bishi mo: “Fee pin kusɔ nɛ fee kraŋ ere to a?” 31Nɛ krachigboŋ na bishi mo: “Esa baa maŋ ŋini ma, nuso nɛ ma alɛ beeŋ tiŋ m pin amo to?” Kumo be kaman nɛ e kule Filip fanɛ e dii gbaŋɛturko na n tu mo n chena. 32Abɔrɛsibɛ na to be kakpa nɛ e daa kraŋ na nde:
“E daa du fanɛ kubolpɔ
nɛ b kɔ a yɔ nɛ b ya teŋ nna.
E daa du fanɛ kpakpafɔlbi
nɛ baa ku kumo be afuibi
nɛ k la to boeŋ nna.
E daa maŋ kaŋɛ shɛŋ.
33B daŋ fɛl mo ga nseŋ kini keji mo demu
nɛ kumo be ekpa so.
Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ m pin
mbe jemanɛ na to ebi be alubi to?
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
b bar mbe durnya ere to be ŋkpa ekar.”
34Nɛ krachigboŋ na bishi Filip: “Kaŋɛ ma esa nɛ anebi ere bee malga mbe asheŋ ere, mo gbagba be asheŋ ŋko esa pɔtɛ?” 35Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filip fara abɔrɛsibɛ be kakpa nɛ kanyɛn na daa kraŋ na gbagba m bɔ Yesu be baru lela na n sa mo. 36B ka wɔ ekpa na to a yɔ na nɛ b ya wu kabombi ko nɛ krachigboŋ na kaŋɛ: “Keni, nchu nde nɛ manɛ e naa wɔtɔ a kuŋ fo kebɛr ma kabɔrɛbɛr?” 37[Nɛ Filip kaŋɛ mo: “Fo baŋ yirda nɛ fo kagbene kikɛ, meeŋ bɛr fo kabɔrɛbɛr na.” Nɛ e shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ: “N yirda fanɛ Yesu Kristo e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na.”] 38Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ gbaŋɛturko na yili nɛ bumo benyɔ na, Filip nɛ krachigboŋ na luri nchu na to nɛ Filip bɛr mo kabɔrɛbɛr na. 39B ka bee lar nchu na to nɛ Enyɛnpe be Kiyoyu na ba ta Filip ndoŋ nɛ krachigboŋ na maŋ naŋ wu mo nseŋ la to m pɛ ekpa a yɔ nɛ kagbenefuli. 40Azotas nɛ Filip daŋ wu fanɛ Kiyoyu na yɛr mo nɛ e yɔ nde na kikɛ to n ya kaa bɔ baru lela na n ya fo Sizariya.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 9
Content:
Sɔɔl ka ki Yesu be ebɛsopo be asheŋ
1Saŋɛ ere so kikɛ nɛ Sɔɔl wɔtɔ a kɔ a fin kemur Enyɛnpe be bebɛsopoana na. 2E daŋ yɔ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso kutɔ nna n ya kule mo nwɔl nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini Damaskɔs be nshɛrbu to be Juwebi na esa nɛ e la mo. Loŋ na e beeŋ tiŋ m pɛ ndoŋebi be ekama, benyɛn nɛ beche nɛ baa bɛ Enyɛnpe be ekpa na so, n yɔ Jerusalɛm. 3E ka wɔ ekpa na to a yɔ m ba kaa taga to Damaskɔs be kade to nɛ kefulto ko shi awɔlpa so epul na to m ba yuu mo kikɛ so. 4Nɛ e tɔr kasawule nseŋ nu ebɔl ka bee bishi mo: “Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl, manɛ e ba nɛ fee tɔrɔ ma?” 5Nɛ Sɔɔl bishi mo: “Fo wanɛ Enyɛnpe?” Nɛ ebɔl na kaŋɛ: “Ma Yesu nɛ fee tɔrɔ na. 6Niŋi to n yɔ kade to nɛ b ŋini fo kusɔ nɛ k daga nɛ fo wora.” 7Basa nɛ bumo nɛ Sɔɔl daa yɔ na be nnɔ daŋ mɔ bumo ga nɛ b kilgi a yil cham. B daŋ nu ebɔl na, ama bumo alɛ daa maŋ wu esa kama. 8Sɔɔl ka niŋi to m bugi mbe anishi e daa maŋ tiŋ n wu shɛŋ. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b pɛ mbe enɔ to ŋ keta mo n luri Damaskɔs to. 9Nchɛ nsa nɛ e maa tiŋ a wu, jemanɛ na malɛ kikɛ so nɛ e maa ji ŋko a nuu shɛŋ.
10Ebɛsopo ko daa wɔ Damaskɔs to nɛ baa tre mo Ananiyas. Mo nɛ Enyɛnpe daŋ bɔla mbe bɔrɛdare to ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ananiyas.” Nɛ Ananiyas shuli ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma nde Enyɛnpe.” 11Nɛ Enyɛnpe kaŋɛ mo: “Bela ase n yɔ kubɔrbi niŋiso to n ya luri Judas pe m bishi kanyɛn nɛ e shi Taases nɛ baa tre mo Sɔɔl na be asheŋ. 12E bee kule Ebɔrɛ nseŋ wu kanyɛn ko ashi mbe bɔrɛdare to nɛ baa tre Ananiyas ka ba luri n ta mbe enɔana n deŋi mbe kumu so nɛ e naŋ bɛta a wu.” 13Nɛ Ananiyas kaŋɛ: “Enyɛnpe, basa damta kaŋɛ ma kanyɛn ere be asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ e tɔrɔ fo basa ashi Jerusalɛm. 14Mo alɛ kule ekpa ashi bɔrɛmatapowuraana na kutɔ nna m ba Damaskɔs nfe nɛ e ba pɛ bekama nɛ baa bɛ fo so na nna.” 15Nɛ Enyɛnpe kaŋɛ: “Fo ere e yɔ de, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e lara mo nɛ e baa shuŋ ma n shin nɛ nnyamase nɛ bewura nɛ Israɛlebi e pin ma. 16Ma alɛ gbagba beeŋ ŋini mo tɔrɔ nɛ a daga e ka ji n sa ma.” 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ananiyas yɔ kowu na to n ya ta mbe enɔana n deŋi Sɔɔl so nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Ekurgepo Sɔɔl, Enyɛnpe Yesu gbagba, emo nɛ fo wu ekpa to na e shuŋi ma. Mo e shuŋi ma nɛ fo naa tiŋ a wu nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e tiŋ n luri fo to.” 18Epul na to nɛ kusɔ ko fanɛ kɔrɔtɔ be afɔfɔ lar Sɔɔl be anishito n tɔr nɛ e naŋ fara a wu ŋ koso nɛ b bɛr mo kabɔrɛbɛr. 19Kede be kaman nɛ e ji n naŋ nya mbe eleŋ.
Sɔɔl ka bɔ kubɔya na ashi Damaskɔs be asheŋ
Ndoŋ nna nɛ Sɔɔl wora nchɛnnyɔ ashi Damaskɔs be bebɛsopo na kutɔ 20nseŋ yɔ nshɛrbuana to epul na to n ya fara a bɔ kubɔya na a kaŋɛ Yesu be asheŋ a kaŋɛ: “Mo e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na.” 21K daŋ chinchiŋ bekama nɛ b nu kumo na ga nɛ b bishi abar: “Mannɛ kanyɛn ere e daa wɔ Jerusalɛm a mɔ bekama nɛ baa ti ketre ere yirdaso na a? Kumo be kaman, mannɛ kepɛ loŋ be basa n ya bɔɔ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na enɔ so so nɛ e ba nfe a?” 22Ama Sɔɔl be kebɔ kubɔya na daŋ baa wora eleŋ nna a ti so nɛ mbe keŋini fanɛ Yesu e la Kristo na gba daŋ bɛ ekpa so a kɔ eleŋ amo to ga nɛ Juwebi nɛ b wɔ Damaskɔs to na be ŋgbene wul bumo to ga nɛ b paŋ keji mo emɔrɔ.
23K ka ba wora nchɛnnyɔ nɛ Juwebi na ba abar so m ba kre nia nɛ b mɔ Sɔɔl. 24Nɛ Sɔɔl nu kesheŋ nɛ b daa sha kewora na. Kapa nɛ kanyɛ malɛ kikɛ b daa wɔ kade na to be mbunaana na to nna a fin kenya mo m mɔ. 25Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛso ko, Sɔɔl be bebɛsopo ta mo n wɔtɔ kelantaŋɛ gboŋ ko to m bɔla kade na be egbal so n ta mo ŋ gbelge to.
Sɔɔl ka ba Jerusalɛm be asheŋ
26Sɔɔl ka yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya kaa sha keba bebɛsopo na to, b daa maŋ yirda fanɛ e la ebɛsopo nseŋ daa ŋana mo. 27Nɛ Baanabas ba mbe kechɛto to m ba keta mo n yɔ beshuŋipo na kutɔ n ya bugi asheŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ Sɔɔl daŋ wu Enyɛnpe na ekpa to nɛ Enyɛnpe na malga mo kutɔ. Kede be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ Sɔɔl daŋ bɔ kubɔya na Yesu be ketre to kenyɛnso ashi Damaskɔs. 28Ndoŋ nna nɛ Sɔɔl tu bumo a wɔtɔ nsaa nite Jerusalɛm kikɛ to a bɔ kubɔya na Enyɛnpe be ketre to kenyɛnso. 29Mo nɛ Juwebi nɛ b daa malga Griik to na gba daŋ malga n ji emɔrɔ nɛ b kre bumo be nia a kɔ a fin kemɔ mo. 30Bekurgepoana na ka nu kumo be asheŋ nɛ b keta Sɔɔl n yɔ Sizariya n ya shin nɛ e yɔ Taases. 31Kumo be kaman nɛ asɔriebi nɛ b daa wɔ Judiya na nɛ Galili nɛ Samɛria na lar bumo be etɔrɔ na to n nya kagbenewushi gbrɛ. Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e daŋ shin nɛ b daŋ yɔ anishito nseŋ wora keshi n ti so a wɔ Enyɛnpe be kebunyaŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to.
Pita ka yɔ Lida nɛ Jɔpa be asheŋ
32Pita gba daŋ yɔ mboŋ damta. Kachako e yɔ nɛ e ya chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be bebɛsopo ashi Lida 33n ya tu kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Eeneeyas ndoŋ. E daa la eyurwusowura nna a dese kakpa koŋwule nfɛ burwa. 34Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Eeneeyas, Yesu Kristo e naa chɛ fo na. Niŋi to m bɔɔ fo kusɔ deseso na to.” Epul na to nɛ Eeneeyas niŋi to. 35Lida nɛ Shɛrɔn be basa kikɛ daŋ wu mo nseŋ ki Enyɛnpe be bebɛsopo.
36Kache ko daa la eyirdapo a wɔ Jɔpa nɛ baa tre mo Tabita. Mbe Griik tre e la Dɔɔkas. Kumo be kifito e la Chibir. Kelela nɛ e daa wɔtɔ a wora saŋkama nsaa chɛ betirpo to. 37Ndoŋ nna nɛ kulɔ ko ba pɛ mo nɛ e wu nɛ b ber mo nseŋ ta mo n nase esoso be ebu ko to. 38Jɔpa nɛ Lida daa maŋ wɔ kufɔ, amoso, beyirdapo nɛ b daa wɔ Jɔpa na ka nu fanɛ Pita wɔ Lida nɛ b shuŋi basa anyɔ ko mo kutɔ fanɛ b ya kaŋɛ mo le: “Jande, wora ania n yeŋi so m ba anyi kutɔ.” 39Nɛ Pita bela ase n tu bumo n yɔ. E ka fo ndoŋ nɛ b keta mo n yɔ esoso be ebu na to nɛ bekulpocheana na kikɛ ba kulti mo a shu nsaa ta nle nɛ asɔbuuso nɛ Dɔɔkas daŋ lue saŋɛ nɛ e daa maŋ naŋ wu na a ŋini Pita. 40Nɛ Pita shin nɛ bumo kikɛ lar ebu na to nɛ e gbir ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ nseŋ kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ ebuni na: “Tabita, koso!” E ka bugi mbe anishi n wu Pita nɛ e niŋi to n chena. 41Nɛ Pita pɛ mbe enɔ to n chɛ mo to nɛ e niŋi to nseŋ tre beyirdapo na nɛ bekulpocheana na m ba ta mo ŋkpa to m bɔɔ bumo enɔ. 42Kumo be baru daŋ sɔ Jɔpa to kikɛ nɛ basa damta yirda Enyɛnpe na. 43Kumo be kaman nɛ Pita chena nwɔlgbitipo ko nɛ b daa tre Saimɔn pe ashi Jɔpa be kade na to n wora nchɛnnyɔ.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 10
Content:
Pita ka yɔ Kɔɔnilias kutɔ be asheŋ
1Kanyɛn ko daa wɔ Sizariya nɛ baa tre mo Kɔɔnilias. E daa la Romebi be benapo kalfa be enimu nna ashi benapo be katuŋgboŋ nɛ baa tre Itali be Katuŋ na to. E daa la abɔrɛshenshapo nna, mo nɛ mbe kowu to ebi kikɛ daa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nna. 2E daŋ chɛ Juwebi be betirpo to ga nseŋ daa kule Ebɔrɛ saŋkama. 3Kachako kapaso, fanɛ kerfi asa be jemanɛ nɛ e ku bɔrɛdare ko n wu Ebɔrɛ be malaika geeŋ ka ba kaŋɛ mo: “Kɔɔnilias.” 4Nɛ e ta mbe anishi n yuu malaika na so kufuso nseŋ bishi mo: “Manɛ nna, n nyɛnpe?” Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ: “Ebɔrɛ nu fo kabɔrɛkuleana nseŋ naŋ wu fo kelela be kewora na nsaa shin nɛ e wora asɔ nɛ fee kule na. 5Shuŋi basa Jɔpa nɛ b ya tre kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Saimɔn Pita na. 6E wɔ Saimɔn nwɔlgbitipo nɛ e wɔ a mata teku na pe.” 7Kede be kaman nɛ malaika nɛ e daa malga mo kutɔ na yige mo nseŋ yɔ nɛ Kɔɔnilias tre mbe laŋ to be nyɛrbi anyɔ ko nɛ enapo ko nɛ e daa la abɔrɛshenshapo nsaa la bumo nɛ b daa shuŋ a sa Kɔɔnilias gbagba na be eko 8m ba kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ k wora na kikɛ nseŋ shuŋi bumo Jɔpa.
9Kumo be ŋklade b ka ya taga to Jɔpa nɛ Pita malɛ dii kuchoŋi kapaso be jemanɛ nɛ e ya kule Ebɔrɛ. 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ akoŋ pɛ mo ga nɛ e yɛlga keji. 11B daŋ kraa wɔ ajibi na be kewora to nna nɛ e ku bɔrɛdare ko n wu ebɔrɛso ka bugi nɛ kusɔ peŋgeleŋ ko fanɛ wajɛ nɛ kumo be ekarso ana kɔ kumo to a ba kasawule so. 12Nɛ asɔbɔya be yiri kikɛ nɛ asɔ gbeyeso nɛ kupuŋ to be mbuibi wɔ kumo to. 13Nɛ e nu ebɔl ko ka bee kaŋɛ: “Pita, koso m mɔ n we!” 14Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ: “Akai, Enyɛnpe, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ naŋ ji kusɔ kama nɛ k maŋ walɛ so nɛ anyi Juwebi bee kishi kikɛ.” 15Nɛ ebɔl na naŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Sa maa tre kusɔ nɛ k la kusɔ lela Ebɔrɛ kutɔ kusɔ nɛ k maŋ walɛ so.” 16Ela asa nɛ e daŋ ku le be bɔrɛdare koŋwule ere pɔɛŋ nɛ b gberge kusɔ na n naŋ yɔ ebɔrɛso.
17Loŋ be bɔrɛdare nɛ Pita daŋ ku na be kifito be kepin daŋ chinchiŋ mo ga. Jemanɛ ere so nɛ basa nɛ Kɔɔnilias daŋ shuŋi na wu kowu nɛ Saimɔn daa wɔ to na m ba kaa yil kumo be kabuna to 18m bishi awɔrso: “Nfe nɛ kafɔnyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Saimɔn Pita wɔ na a?” 19Pita daŋ kraa pin bɔrɛdare nɛ e ku na be kifito nna a gben nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ mo: “Nu nfe, benyɛn asa ko bee fin fo. 20Amoso, koso m bela ase ŋ gbelge n ya shuli n tu bumo n yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e shuŋi bumo.” 21Nɛ Pita gbelge n ya kaŋɛ basa na: “Ma nɛ menyee fin na. Manɛ e bar menyi?” 22Nɛ b kaŋɛ: “Kɔɔnilias, benapo be enimu na e shuŋi anyi. E la esa lela nna a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nsaa la Juwebi kikɛ be ebunyampo. Ebɔrɛ be malaika ko e ba kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e shin nɛ fo ba mo pe m ba shin nɛ e nu kusɔ nɛ feeŋ kaŋɛ mo.” 23Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita shin nɛ b luri m ba di ŋ klade.
Nɛ e bela ase nɛ mo nɛ bumo nɛ Jɔpa be bekurgepoana ko yɔ. 24Kumo be ŋklade nɛ e fo Sizariya kakpa nɛ Kɔɔnilias nɛ mbe basa nɛ mo teriana gbagba nɛ e daŋ tre na daa wɔ a jo mo na. 25Pita ka daŋ baa sha nɛ e luri nɛ Kɔɔnilias shɛr mo to ŋ gbir mbe anishito. 26Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ mo: “Niŋi to n yili, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma alɛ gba la nyiŋgbasa nna.” 27E ka koso nɛ mo nɛ Pita malga abar kutɔ loŋ hale n ya luri ebu na to nɛ Pita ya wu basa damta nɛ b shɛr na. 28Nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Menyi alɛ gba baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ Juwebi be mbraana na ka bee ŋini fanɛ Juw be esa e sa maŋ kaŋ ya chɔrɔ ŋko n shin nɛ mo nɛ kanyamase e ba abar so kikɛ. Ama Ebɔrɛ ŋini ma fanɛ n sa maa ta dimɛdi pɔtɛ kama fanɛ eyurpiwura fanɛ kananɛ anyi Juwebi bee tre nnyamase na. 29Amoso nɛ n nu menyi be ketre a maŋ ji emɔrɔ nseŋ ba na. Ama men kaŋɛ ma kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ men shuŋi n tre ma.”
30Nɛ Kɔɔnilias kaŋɛ: “Kachɛnawase be kapaso, kerfi asa, saŋɛ ere so nɛ mee kule Ebɔrɛ ashi ma pe nɛ kanyɛn ko buu asɔ fuful m ba yili ma anishito nseŋ kaŋɛ ma: 31‘Kɔɔnilias, Ebɔrɛ nu fo kabɔrɛkule na nseŋ naŋ wu fo alelasheŋ na. 32Shuŋi esa Jɔpa nɛ e ya tre kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Saimɔn Pita na. E wɔ Saimɔn nwɔlgbitipo nɛ e wɔ a mata teku na pe.’ 33Kumo so nɛ n shuŋi epul na to fanɛ b ya tre fo nɛ fo alɛ shuli m ba na. Ebɔrɛ malɛ be anishito nɛ anyi kikɛ tase nfe a jo kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe na kɔ a sha nɛ fo kaŋɛ anyi na.”
Pita be kamalga be asheŋ
34Nɛ Pita fara mbe kamalga ŋ kaŋɛ: “Naniere nɛ m pin kashenteŋto fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maa kpɛa to. 35Esa kama nɛ e bee ŋana mo nsaa wora asɔ nɛ a bee bɔla ekpa nɛ e bee sɔ. 36E maa keni yiri nɛ k la mo. Men nyi kubɔya nɛ e sa Israɛlebi a kaŋɛ baru lela na be asheŋ fanɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n nya kagbenewushi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ashi Yesu Kristo nɛ e la basa kikɛ be Enyɛnpe na to be asheŋ. 37Kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ Jɔn daŋ bɔ kumo be kubɔya na be kaman men nyi kusɔgboŋ nɛ k daŋ fara Galili to n wora n yɔ Judiya kikɛ to na be asheŋ. 38Men nyi Nazarɛt be Yesu na be asheŋ nɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ lara mo nseŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nɛ eleŋ ba mo so. E daŋ yɔ kaplɛkama n ya wora kelela nseŋ chɛ basa damta nɛ b daa wɔ Setani be enɔ to na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ daa wɔ mo to. 39An la asheŋ nɛ a wora ashi Jerusalɛm to nɛ Juwebi be efuli so nɛ k ka na kikɛ be eshɛdajipoana nna. B daŋ gbir mo m mata kedibi largato so nna m mɔ mo. 40Ama kumo be nchɛ asa to nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu na to n ta mbe kumu ŋ ŋini anyi. 41Mannɛ basa kikɛ e daŋ wu mo she anyi, bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ an baa la mbe eshɛdajipoana na. Ebɔrɛ ka shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu to na be kaman anyi nɛ mo daŋ ji nseŋ nuu. 42Mo e kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ an baa bɔ baru lela na a sa basa a bugi to a kaŋɛ fanɛ mo e la emo nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ e baa la basa keniso nɛ bumo nɛ b wu be demujipo na. 43Anebiana kikɛ daŋ malga mbe asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ekama nɛ e yirda mo, e beeŋ nya mbe alubi be ketampaŋ ashi mbe ketre na be eleŋ to.”
Nnyamase ka nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be asheŋ
44Pita daŋ kraa malga nna nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na gbelge m ba bumo nɛ b daa nu kubɔya na so. 45Juwebi be beyirdapoana nɛ b daŋ tu Pita n shi Jɔpa m ba na ka wu Ebɔrɛ ka ta mbe Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na ŋ kɛ nnyamase na malɛ n shin nɛ e gbelge bumo so na, nɛ k chinchiŋ bumo ga. 46Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ nu kananɛ b daŋ gbar ŋgbar nɛ bumo gbagba maa nu nseŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e la durnya be Enyɛnpetale. 47Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ: “Basa ere gba nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na fanɛ anyi. Amoso, esa mo e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ kuŋ bumo ekpa fanɛ b sa maŋ ta nchu m bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr na?” 48Ndoŋ nna nɛ e shin nɛ b bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr ashi Yesu Kristo be ketre to. Kumo be kaman nɛ b shin nɛ mo nɛ bumo chena kade na to n wora nchɛnnyɔ.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 11
Content:
1Beshuŋipo na nɛ Judiya be efuli na so kikɛ be bekurgepo na daŋ nu nnyamase na malɛ gba ka sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na. 2Ama Pita ka bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm nɛ bumo nɛ b yirda katutuku be keŋini na ba fara a ji mo emɔrɔ 3a bishi mo kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ e yɔ asoliwuraana pe hale n ya kaa tu bumo a ji. 4Nɛ Pita kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ asheŋ na kikɛ nyam fara nɛ kananɛ a ji. E yɛ: 5“Kachako n wɔ Jɔpa a kule Ebɔrɛ nseŋ ku bɔrɛdare n wu kusɔ peŋgeleŋ ko fanɛ wajɛ nɛ kumo be ekarso be nnɔ ana kɔ kumo to ashi ebɔrɛso a ba m ba yili m mata ma. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni kumo to nɛnɛ n wu kowu nɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya nɛ asɔ gbeyeso nɛ kupuŋ to be mbuibi. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka bee kaŋɛ: ‘Pita, niŋi to ŋ koso m mɔ n we.’ 8Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Akai, Enyɛnpe, kejibi nɛ k maŋ walɛ so nɛ anyi Juwebi bee kishi maŋ naŋ luri ma kɔnɔ to kikɛ.’ 9Nɛ ebɔl na naŋ shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Sa maa tre kusɔ nɛ k la kusɔ lela Ebɔrɛ kutɔ kusɔ nɛ k maŋ walɛ so.’ 10Kusɔ na wora loŋ ale asa pɔɛŋ nɛ b gberge kumo kikɛ n naŋ bɛta n yɔ ebɔrɛso. 11Epul na malɛ to nɛ mbɔ asa shi Sizariya m ba kowu nɛ n daa wɔ na to. 12Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ ma fanɛ n yeŋi so n shuli n tu bumo n yɔ. Ma nɛ bekurgepo ashe nɛ b shi Jɔpa ere e daŋ yɔ Sizariya n ya yɔ Kɔɔnilias pe. 13Nɛ e kaŋɛ anyi kananɛ e wu malaika mo pe nɛ e kaŋɛ: ‘Shuŋi esa ko Jɔpa nɛ e ya tre kanyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Saimɔn Pita 14nɛ e ba kaŋɛ fo asheŋ, nɛ fo nɛ fo kowu to ebi kikɛ e nya kumɔlga.’ 15Ŋ ka fara a malga nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na gbelge bumo so fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ gbelge anyi so sososo na. 16Saŋɛ na so nɛ n nyiŋi kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Nchu nɛ Jɔn daŋ ta m bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr, ama Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e gbelge menyi so.’ 17K baŋ fuli nna fanɛ Kiyoyu koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa anyi jemanɛ nɛ an fara n yirda Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na nɛ e sa nnyamase ere na, nɛ manɛ be eleŋ nɛ ma alɛ kɔ nɛ n tiŋ n ju Ebɔrɛ ashi kusɔ nɛ e bee sha kewora to?” 18B ka nu kamalga na nɛ b yige bumo be kebaraso na nseŋ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kumo ere, Ebɔrɛ sa nnyamase gba ekpa nɛ b tiŋ n lar bumo be alubi to n nya ŋkpa na.”
Antiɔk be asɔriebi be asheŋ
19Tɔrɔ nɛ k daŋ ba jemanɛ nɛ b mɔ Stiven na daŋ shin nɛ beyirdapoana na pesaŋ to nna n yɔ mboŋ damta. Beko daŋ yɔ hale Fenisha nɛ Saipres nɛ Antiɔk n ya kaa bɔ Kristo be kubɔya na a sa Juwebi nawule. 20Beyirdapoana nɛ b daŋ shi Saipres nɛ Sairini na be beko malɛ daŋ yɔ Antiɔk nna n ya bɔ Enyɛnpe Yesu be baru lela na be kubɔya na n sa nnyamase malɛ. 21Enyɛnpe be eleŋ ka daa wɔ bumo to na so, basa damta daŋ yirda bumo be kubɔya na nseŋ fara a bɛ Enyɛnpe na so. 22Jerusalɛm be asɔriebi na ka nu kumo be baru nɛ b shuŋi Baanabas Antiɔk. 23E ka ba ndoŋ m ba wu kananɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛfa basa na nɛ mbe kagbene fuli mo ga nɛ e leŋ bumo kikɛ to fanɛ b bugi bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ kashenteŋto a nu a sa Enyɛnpe na. 24Baanabas daa la esa ga a kɔ yirda nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bɔlɔ mo to. Ŋkpal loŋ so, basa damta daŋ ba pin Ebɔrɛ bumo be ŋgbene to. 25Kede be kaman nɛ Baanabas yɔ Taases nɛ e ya fin Sɔɔl. 26E ka wu mo nɛ e bar mo Antiɔk nɛ bumo benyɔ na ba ji kafɛ lelemu asɔriebi na kutɔ nsaa ŋini basa damta ko abɔrɛsheŋ na. Antiɔk nɛ b daŋ fara n tre bebɛsopoana na Kristoebi.
27Jemanɛ na so nɛ anebiana ko shi Jerusalɛm n yɔ Antiɔk. 28Bumo to be eko e daa la Agabes, mo e daŋ bɔla Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be eleŋ to n wu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ akoŋgboŋ beeŋ tɔr durnya kikɛ to. Ewurgboŋ Klawdias be jemanɛ na nɛ akoŋgboŋ na daŋ tɔr. 29Ndoŋ nna nɛ bebɛsopoana na kikɛ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule fanɛ bumo be ekama e bar amansherbi kanaŋkamaso nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ nɛ b ta n ya sa bekurgepoana nɛ b daa wɔ Judiya na. 30B ka wora toto na n loge nɛ b ta amansherbi na n shuŋi Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl nɛ b ya sa ndoŋ be asɔriebi be benimuana na.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 12
Content:
B ka naŋ lɔŋɛ n tɔrɔ bebɛsopo na ga be asheŋ
1Jemanɛ ere so nɛ Ewura Hɛrɔd daŋ fara a tɔrɔ asɔriebi na be beko. 2Mo e daŋ shin nɛ b ta tokobi ŋ ŋe Jɔn mo sipo Jeems m mɔ na. 3E ka pin fanɛ k par Juwebi na nɛ e naŋ shin nɛ b pɛ Pita malɛ. Kejigboŋ nɛ baa tre Bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi be Kejigboŋ na be jemanɛ nɛ e daŋ wora kumo. 4B ka pɛ Pita nɛ b ta mo n ya ti ebu n shin nɛ benapo ana be ntuŋ ana so bee keni mo so. Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na be kaman nɛ Hɛrɔd daa sha keji mo demu basa kikɛ be anishito. 5Amoso nɛ b daŋ shin nɛ Pita daŋ kraa wɔ kabuti to na. Ama jemanɛ na so nɛ asɔriebi na malɛ wɔ kabɔrɛkule kpakpaso to a sa Pita.
Malaika ka shin nɛ Pita lar kabuti to be asheŋ
6Kachɛ nɛ Hɛrɔd daa sha kelara Pita kabuti to m ba ji mo demu basa kikɛ be anishito na be kanyɛso b ta ŋgbɛlɛbi anyɔ ŋ kre Pita n nase bekumpo anyɔ ko be nferinto nɛ e dese a di nɛ bekumpo ko malɛ yil ebu na be kabuna a de so. 7Epul na to nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika ko ba yili ndoŋ nɛ kefulto ko nyaŋɛ n fuli ebu na to nɛ malaika na beta Pita be kekel so n tiŋi mo nseŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Yeŋi so ŋ koso.” Epul na to nɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi na lar mbe enɔana to n tɔr. 8Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ mo: “Lɔŋɛ fo kreso n chɛ nseŋ lɔŋɛ fo asɛbta n wɔtɔ.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita wora loŋ nɛ malaika na naŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Ta fo piŋi m buu nseŋ bɛ ma so.” 9Nɛ Pita bɛ mo so n lar ebu na to. Ama e daa maŋ nyi ŋko kusɔ nɛ malaika na daa wora na daa la kashenteŋ nna. E daa tama fanɛ bɔrɛdare nɛ e daa ku. 10B daŋ ya baŋ sososo be bekumpo be eyilikpa na so n ya baŋ kenyɔsopo so pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta n yɔ abɛlso be kabuna nɛ k bee bugi a yɔ kade na to na nɛ kabuna na gbagba bugi nɛ b lar m bɔla kubɔrbi ko so nɛ malaika na yige Pita epul na to nseŋ yɔ. 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pita pin kusɔ nɛ k wora mo na nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Naniere nɛ m pin kashenteŋto fanɛ Enyɛnpe e shuŋi mbe malaika nɛ e ba lara ma ashi Hɛrɔd be eleŋ nɛ asɔ nɛ Juwebi na daa fɛ na kikɛ to.”
12E ka pin kumo be loŋ nɛ e yɔ Jɔn Maak mo nio Mɛɛri pe. Kumo be jemanɛ na nɛ basa damta ko shɛr ndoŋ a kule Ebɔrɛ. 13Nɛ Pita ya ŋmɛa ebu na be kabuna nɛ kebichebi ko nɛ baa tre Roda ba nɛ e ba keni esa nɛ e la. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ e pin Pita be ebɔl nɛ mbe kagbene fuli mo ga nɛ e yige kabuna na be kebugi nseŋ nya manaŋ m bɛta n ya kaŋɛ ekama fanɛ Pita e yil kabuna to na. 15Nɛ b bishi mo: “Fee lɔ nna a?” Nɛ e kraa kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kashenteŋ nna. 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kaŋɛ: “Mbe malaika nna.” Jemanɛ ere so malɛ kikɛ nɛ Pita kraa yil a ŋmɛa. Kumo be kaman nɛ b ba bugi kabuna na n wu mo nɛ k chinchiŋ bumo ga. 17Nɛ e wora bumo enɔ fanɛ b lo to nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo kananɛ Enyɛnpe lara mo ashi kabuti na to. Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Men kaŋɛ Jeems nɛ bekurgepo nɛ b ka na.” E ka kaŋɛ bumo loŋ n loge nɛ e yige bumo nseŋ yɔ kakpa ko.
18Kare ka chɛ nɛ kebagato gboŋ ko tɔr bekumpo na to nɛ b fara a bishi abar: “Manɛ e wora Pita na?” 19Nɛ Hɛrɔd sa kɔnɔ fanɛ basa e fin mo, nɛ b fin mo ŋ gben. Nɛ e shin nɛ b bishi bekumpo na mbe asheŋ nɛnɛ nseŋ shin nɛ b mɔ bumo. Kumo be kaman nɛ Hɛrɔd shi Jerusalɛm n yɔ Sizariya n ya wora nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ.
Hɛrɔd be luwu be asheŋ
20Hɛrɔd ka nya agbo ga n wora Tayɛ nɛ Saidɔn ebi so, b daŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nna n shuŋi bumo to be basa ko Hɛrɔd kutɔ. Ama kumo ere be pɔɛŋ, b daŋ wule nna nɛ bumo nɛ Blastes nɛ e daa la ewura na be kowu to be enimu na wora kɔnɔkoŋwule n yili, ŋkpal manɛ so, ewura na be efuli na so ebi kutɔ nɛ bumo be efuli so ebi daa nya bumo be ajibi. 21Hɛrɔd be kachɛgboŋ ko nɛ e lara mbe kuwurpiŋi m buu nseŋ chena mbe kuwurputi so nseŋ malga n sa basa na. 22Nɛ basa na malga eleŋso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mannɛ nyiŋgbasa e naa malga ere. Ebɔrɛ ko nna.” 23Epul na to nɛ Enyɛnpe be malaika ba ta kulɔ n lɛ Hɛrɔd so ŋkpal e ka maŋ ta kemaŋkura na n sa Ebɔrɛ so. Ashushombi e daŋ ji mbe eyur nɛ e wu.
24Jemanɛ na so malɛ kikɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na bee yɔ anishito nɛ bebɛsopoana na bee wora keshi a ti so.
25Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl ka loge bumo be kushuŋ nɛ b keta Jɔn Maak nɛ mo nɛ bumo lar Jerusalɛm to m bɛta n yɔ.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 13
Content:
B ka lara Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl n shuŋi be asheŋ
1Anebiana nɛ beŋinipo ko daa wɔ Antiɔk be asɔriebi na to. Bumo be atreana e daa la Baanabas nɛ Saimɔn, emo nɛ baa tre esa lembir na nɛ Sairini be Lisias nɛ Maneeyen, emo nɛ b daŋ bela mo nɛ Gomena Hɛrɔd na nɛ Sɔɔl. 2Saŋko b ka bee bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe nsaa kishi nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ bumo: “Men lara Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl n sa ma nɛ b shuŋ kushuŋ nɛ n lara bumo fanɛ b ba shuŋ ere.” 3Nɛ b kishi nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n ta bumo be enɔana n deŋi basa anyɔ na so nseŋ shin nɛ b yɔ.
Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl ka ba Saipres be asheŋ
4Kiyoyu na ka shuŋi Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl na nɛ b yɔ Sɛlyusia n ya yili ndoŋ n luri ekuloŋgboŋ to m bɔla nchu so n yɔ Saipres be kepla so. 5B ka ba kepla na to be kade ko nɛ baa tre Salamis na nɛ b ya bɔ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na ashi Juwebi be nshɛrbuana na to. Bumo nɛ Jɔn Maak e daa la nɛ e bee chɛ bumo to kushuŋ na to. 6B nite kepla na so loŋ hale n ya fo Pafɔs. Ndoŋ nɛ b ya tu ŋkilgiwura ko nɛ baa tre Baa Jizes. E daa la Juw nna a tre mbe kumu anebi. 7Kepla na so be Gomena Sɛjes Pɔɔles mo teri e daa la mo. Sɛjes Pɔɔles ere daa la enyiashempo nna ga. Ndoŋ nna nɛ gomena na tre Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl ŋkpal kenu abɔrɛsheŋ na so. 8Nɛ Elimas, ŋkilgiwura ere, Baa Jizes na be Griik tre be kifito e daa la loŋ na, ba kaa kuŋ bumo ekpa a fin kekuŋ gomena na ekpa nɛ e sa maŋ yirda Yesu. 9Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na luri m bɔlɔ Sɔɔl, mo koŋwule e la Pɔɔl na to nɛ e keni ŋkilgiwura na be anishito nseŋ kaŋɛ: 10“Setani pibi ere. Fo la kelela be yiri kikɛ be edompo nna. Kafule be kulubi be yiri kikɛ e baŋ bɔlɔ fo to nɛ saŋkama fee kɔ a fin keta Enyɛnpe be nshenteŋ ŋ ki efɛ. 11Enyɛnpe malɛ beeŋ gberge fo kusoe naniere nɛ fo tan a maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n wu efuli hale n ya fo saŋko.” Epul na to nɛ k wora Elimas na fanɛ kumɔɔ lembir ko ka ba buu mbe anishi kikɛ so nɛ e fara a nite a kulti a laa a fin esa nɛ e beeŋ pɛ mbe enɔ to. 12Gomena na ka daŋ wu kusɔ nɛ k wora na nɛ e yirda. Enyɛnpe be asheŋ nɛ b daa ŋini na daŋ chinchiŋ mo ga.
Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas ka yɔ Pisidia be Antiɔk be asheŋ
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pɔɔl nɛ mo braana luri ekuloŋgboŋ to ashi Pafɔs n ta n ya fo Pɛga nɛ k wɔ Pamfilia na. Nɛ Jɔn Maak ba yige bumo ndoŋ nseŋ bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm. 14Nɛ bumo alɛ lar Pɛga n ta n yɔ Pisidia be Antiɔk. Kewushiachɛ ka fo nɛ b yɔ ndoŋ be nshɛrbu to n ya chena. 15Esa ko ka kraŋ Mosis be mbraana na nɛ anebiana be nwɔl na be mboŋ ko n loge nɛ nshɛrbu na to be benimuana na shuŋi kabɔ bumo kutɔ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Bekurgepoana, nɛ men kɔ kamalga nɛ menyeeŋ ta ŋ leŋ basa ere to, men baa malga.” 16Nɛ Pɔɔl niŋi to n yili n wora bumo enɔ fanɛ b lo to nseŋ fara mbe kamalga.
“M braana Israɛlebi nɛ menyi kikɛ nɛ men la nnyamase a wɔ nfe a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ ere, men nu nfe. 17Israɛlebi be Ebɔrɛ e daŋ lara an nanaana Juwebi n shin nɛ b wora keshi ga saŋɛ nɛ b daa la befɔ a wɔ Ijipt be kasawule so na. 18Ebɔrɛ na e daŋ ta mbe eleŋgboŋ n lara bumo ashi Ijipt ŋ keni bumo so kiyi to kanyitiso loŋ nfɛ adena. 19Keenan be kasawule so be efuli ashunu nɛ e shin nɛ a mur nseŋ ta kasawule na kikɛ n sa mbe basa na. 20Asheŋ ere kikɛ daŋ fo fanɛ nfɛ alfa ana nɛ adunu. Kumo be kaman benimu ko nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa sa a sa bumo pɔɛŋ nɛ anebi Samuɛl ya ba. 21Jemanɛ na so nɛ b kule Samuɛl fanɛ e lara ewura n sa bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta Sɔɔl, Kish nɛ e shi Bɛnjamin be kanaŋ to na pibi n sa bumo fanɛ e ji bumo so kuwura nfɛ adena. 22Ebɔrɛ ka gboŋi mo kuwura na to nɛ e shin nɛ Deevid ki bumo be ewura. Le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ malga Deevid be asheŋ: ‘N wu fanɛ Jɛsi pibi Deevid be kaduli gbagba nɛ mee sha na. Mo e la emo nɛ e beeŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ mee sha fanɛ e wora na.’ 23Yesu nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e ki Israɛlebi be emɔlgapo a bɔla mbe kɔnɔ nɛ e daŋ nase na daŋ shi Deevid be kanaŋ to nna. 24Pɔɛŋ nɛ Yesu fara mbe kushuŋ na, Jɔn daŋ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi na kikɛ nna fanɛ b lar bumo be alubi to nɛ b bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr. 25Jɔn ka daa sha keloge mbe kushuŋ nɛ e bishi basa na: ‘Wanɛ nɛ menyee tama fanɛ n la? Mannɛ ma e la emo nɛ menyee jo na. Ama ma kaman esa ko beeŋ ba a chɔ ma ga, m maŋ fo mbe aya to be shishɛr gba so.’
26Ŋ kurgepoana, Eebraham mo nanabiana nɛ menyi nɛ men la nnyamase a wɔ nfe a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ ere kikɛ, anyi kikɛ nɛ b ta le be kumɔlga be kubɔya ere n sa. 27Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ bumo nɛ bumo be benimu wɔ Jerusalɛm to ere daa maŋ nyi fanɛ mo e la emɔlgapo na, bumo alɛ daa maŋ pin anebiana be mmalga nɛ b sibɛ n nase nɛ b baa kraŋ amo kewushiachɛ kama na gba to. Ama bumo alɛ daŋ shin nɛ b mɔ Yesu n shin nɛ anebiana be mmalga na bɔla ekpa. 28B daa maŋ wu kulubi kikɛ mo so nɛ k daga mbe luwu, ama b daŋ shin nɛ Pailat shin nɛ b mɔ mo. 29B ka wora asɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na kaŋɛ fanɛ baaŋ wora mo na n loge, nɛ b lara mo kedibi largato na so n ta mo n wɔtɔ kejembulaŋ kurso ko to. 30Nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu na to. 31Kumo be kaman nchɛ damta ko nɛ e bee lar bumo nɛ mo nɛ bumo daŋ shi Galili m ba Jerusalɛm na so nɛ baa wu mo. Bumo e la mbe eshɛdajipoana a sa Israɛlebi kabre na. 32Baru lela na nɛ anyi alɛ bee bar menyi nfe na, kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ an nanaana fanɛ e beeŋ wora na nɛ e tiŋi Yesu luwu to n wora n sa anyi nɛ an la bumo nanabiana kabre na. 33Nshɛ be Kawɔl be kashɛ nyɔsopo malɛ to nɛ baa kaŋɛ loŋ:
‘Fo e la m Pibinyɛn.
Kabre ŋ ki fo Tuto.’
34Le malɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ malga ketiŋi mo luwu to nɛ e maaŋ naŋ bɛta n wu kikɛ na be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ:
‘Meeŋ ta nɛfa cheembi
nɛ n nase kɔnɔ kashenteŋto fanɛ
meeŋ sa Deevid na n sa fo.’
35Abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ kraa kaŋɛ kakpa ko fanɛ:
‘Fo maaŋ shin nɛ fo kenya nɛ e bee bɛ fo so
nɛ kagbene koŋwule e wu m bɛ.’
36Ŋkpal manɛ so, Deevid be jemanɛ na, e daŋ wora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ nna nseŋ wu nɛ b ta mo m puli m mata mo nanaana nɛ e bɛ. 37Ama emo nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu to na maŋ bɛ. 38Ŋ kurgepoana, men kikɛ e baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ Yesu nawule so nɛ b bɔ alubi be ketampaŋ be kubɔya na a sa menyi. 39Men baa nyi fanɛ ekama nɛ e yirda mo, b sɔ mo ashi kulubi be yiri kikɛ to n yige. 40Loŋ nɛ Mosis be mbraana daa maŋ tiŋ n wora n sa menyi na. Amoso, men baa da so nɛ kusɔ nɛ anebiana be eko kaŋɛ na e sa maŋ wora menyi. E yɛ:
41‘Menyi nɛ menyee fɛl
kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na,
men nu nfe. Menyeeŋ kooba nseŋ wu.
Meeŋ wora kusɔ ko menyi be ŋkpa ere to,
ama esa bugi kumo to n sa menyi gba,
men maaŋ yirda kumo.’ ”
42Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas ka bee lar nshɛrbu na to nɛ basa na kule bumo fanɛ b naŋ bɛta m ba kewushiachɛ nɛ k naa ba m ba kaŋɛ bumo asheŋ na be ako n ti so. 43Basa na ka lar nshɛr na to n yɔ nɛ Juwebi damta nɛ nnyamase nɛ b tuba a bɛ Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso so na be bedamta ba buu Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas so nɛ b malga n leŋ bumo to fanɛ b baa kraa yirda a kɔ Ebɔrɛ be kelela na to kpakpa.
44Kewushiachɛ nɛ k naŋ bɛ so ka fo kade na to ebi be galeŋga e ba nɛ b ba nu Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na. 45Juwebi na ka wu jimaŋ na nɛ yurkishi luri m bɔlɔ bumo to nɛ b malga ŋ gbiti kusɔ nɛ Pɔɔl daa malga na nseŋ tege mo. 46Ama Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas daŋ kplaŋ bumo so nna nsaa malga kenyɛnso a kaŋɛ: “Menyi nɛ b daŋ yili kumo fanɛ b fara m malga Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na n sa, ama men ka kini kumo nsaa ta menyi be amu fanɛ men maŋ daga Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na bre so, anyeeŋ yige menyi nseŋ yɔ nnyamase kutɔ. 47Ŋkpal manɛ so, le be mbra nɛ Enyɛnpe sa anyi:
‘Fo nɛ n lara nɛ fo baa la kefulto
a sa nnyamase.
Fo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla
m mɔlga durnya kikɛ.’ ”
48Nnyamase na ka nu loŋ nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo ga nɛ b yɛ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na wɔ ebel. Nɛ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ b nya Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na ki beyirdapo. 49Nɛ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na sɔ nde na be kaplɛkama nyam.
50Nɛ Juwebi na we n wɔtɔ kadegboŋ na to be benimu nɛ bebunyampocheana nɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na nɛ b fara a tɔrɔ Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas n ju bumo bumo be kasawule so. 51Ndoŋ nna nɛ beshuŋipoana na gbaŋgbaŋ bumo be aya to be shishɛr n lɛ bumo a ŋini fanɛ b wora bumo kusha nseŋ yɔ Ikoniam. 52Nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bɔlɔ Antiɔk be bebɛsopo na to ga.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 14
Content:
Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas ka ba Ikoniam be asheŋ
1Kusɔ nɛ k daŋ wora Antiɔk na koŋwule na e daŋ wora Ikoniam gba. Pɔɔl daŋ yɔ ndoŋ be Juwebi be nshɛrbu to nna n ya bɔ kubɔya na kenyɛnso nɛnɛ ga nɛ Juwebi damta ko nɛ nnyamase damta ko ba ki beyirdapo. 2Nɛ Juwebi nɛ b kini Yesu na we n wɔtɔ nnyamase na nɛ b fara a kishi bekurgepoana na. 3Beshuŋipo na daŋ chɛr ndoŋ ga a malga Enyɛnpe na be asheŋ kenyɛnso, nɛ e sa bumo eleŋ nɛ b wora emamachisheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ damta ŋ ŋini fanɛ bumo be kubɔya nɛ k bee kute mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na be asheŋ na la kashenteŋ nna. 4Nɛ kadegboŋ na to ebi barga to nɛ beko bɛ Juwebi na so nɛ beko malɛ bɛ beshuŋipo na so. 5Nɛ nnyamase na nɛ Juwebi nɛ bumo be benimuana gba kre ketɔrɔ nɛ kekpa beshuŋipo na ajembu m mɔ be nia. 6Beshuŋipo na ka nu loŋ nɛ b shile n yɔ Listra nɛ Dɛbi, Laikonia be ndeana to nɛ efuli na so be nde kikɛ nyam to 7n ya kaa bɔ baru lela na a sa ndoŋebiana.
B ka kpa Pɔɔl ajembu nɛ e bɛlɛ ashi Listra be asheŋ
8Kanyɛn ko daa wɔ Listra nɛ mbe aya daŋ wu hale mbe kebiato kikɛ. E daa maŋ naŋ nite ŋ ku so. 9Pɔɔl ka bee bɔ kubɔya na nɛ e wu kananɛ kanyɛn na kaŋ kusoe a nu kamalga na nɛ kananɛ e kɔ yirda a beeŋ tiŋ n nya kechɛ. Nɛ Pɔɔl keni mo diimbi nseŋ malga awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Niŋi to n teŋ to n yili fo aya so.” 10Nɛ kanyɛn na tɛ to ŋ koso a nite a kilgi to. 11Jimaŋ na ka wu kusɔ nɛ Pɔɔl wora na nɛ b fara a wora awɔr bumo be ŋgbar Laikonia to a kaŋɛ: “Anyi be ebɔrɛana e ki enyiŋgbasa n shi ebɔrɛso ŋ gbelge m ba anyi kutɔ na.” 12Ketre nɛ b daŋ nase Baanabas e daa la Zius, bumo be kegbir ko be ketre nseŋ nase Pɔɔl malɛ Hɛmes, bumo be kegbir ko malɛ be ketre, ŋkpal manɛ so mo e daa malga. 13Ndoŋ nna nɛ kegbirwura nɛ e daa keni kegbir Zius be kelɔŋɛ be ebu nɛ k daa wɔ kade na be ekarso na so na ta egbolu nɛ atoto m ba kabuna na to. Mo nɛ jimaŋ na daa sha kemɔ amo nna n lara sarga n sa beshuŋipo na. 14Baanabas nɛ Sɔɔl ka nu kusɔ nɛ b daa shin nɛ b wora na nɛ b kpɛa bumo be asɔbuuso to a ŋini kananɛ kesheŋ na jija bumo be ŋgbene nseŋ shile n luri jimaŋ na be nferinto a boŋ to a bishi bumo a kaŋɛ: 15“Manɛ e ba nɛ menyee wora loŋ? Anyi alɛ gba la enyiŋgbasa nna fanɛ menyi. An ba nfe nna nɛ an ba kaŋɛ menyi baru lela na be asheŋ n shin nɛ men lar le be asheŋ jiga ere to m ba Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to nsaa la esa nɛ e to ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule nɛ teku nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ amo to na kikɛ kutɔ. 16Saŋɛ na e daŋ yige basa kikɛ nna fanɛ b baa bɛ bumo gbagba be aparsheŋ be ekpaana so. 17Ama jemanɛ kikɛ, mo alɛ bee wora asɔ lela damta nna a ŋini menyi esa nɛ e la mo. Mo e naa sa menyi bɔrɛchu nɛ adɔjibi jemanɛ nɛ a daga. Mo e naa sa menyi ajibi jiso nsaa shin nɛ kagbenefuli bee bɔlɔ menyi to.” 18Kamalga ere be kaman gba, keju basa na ashi sarga na be kelara n sa bumo to daa du kpakpa.
19Juwebi ko daŋ shi Pisidia be Antiɔk nɛ Ikoniam m ba kilgi jimaŋ na be ŋgbene nseŋ kpa Pɔɔl ajembu ŋ gbɛ mo n lar kade na to n ya lɛ a tama fanɛ e wu na. 20Ama beyirdapoana na ka ba chala ŋ kulti mo nɛ e koso n niŋi to m bɛta n luri kade na to. Kumo be ŋklade nɛ mo nɛ Baanabas yɔ Dɛbi.
Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas ka naŋ bɛta n yɔ Siriya be Antiɔk be asheŋ
21Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas daŋ bɔ baru lela na n sa Dɛbiebi n shin nɛ basa damta ki bebɛsopo ndoŋ. 22Kumo be kaman nɛ b bɛta n yɔ Listra nɛ Ikoniam nɛ Pisidia be Antiɔk a wushi beyirdapoana na be ŋgbene nseŋ naa leŋ bumo to fanɛ b baa kɔ yirda nɛ kashenteŋto kpakpa. Le nɛ b daŋ naa kaŋɛ bumo: “An kikɛ beeŋ luri etɔrɔ damta to pɔɛŋ nseŋ luri Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to.” 23Asɔri kama to, b daa lara benimu nna a sa kumo to be basa nseŋ daa ta kabɔrɛkule nɛ ekishi a ta basa na kikɛ a bɔɔ Enyɛnpe nɛ bumo be yirda daa wɔ so na enɔ.
24B ka bɔla Pisidia be kasawule so m ba lar nɛ b ba Pamfilia 25m ba bɔ kubɔya na ashi Pɛga nseŋ yɔ Atalia 26n ya yili ndoŋ n luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɛta n yɔ Antiɔk kakpa nɛ b daŋ yili n ta bumo m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nɛ e baa keni bumo so ashi kushuŋ nɛ b daa loge na to. 27B ka ba Antiɔk nɛ b shɛr asɔriebi na kikɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo asɔ nɛ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora kikɛ nɛ kananɛ e bugi ekpa n sa nnyamase gba nɛ b yirda. 28Kumo be kaman nɛ b chena bebɛsopo na kutɔ kade na to n chɛr ga.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 15
Content:
Beshuŋipo na nɛ benimuana na ka shɛr Jerusalɛm to be asheŋ
1Basa ko daŋ shi Judiya m ba Antiɔk m ba fara a ŋini bekurgepoana le be asheŋ a kaŋɛ: “B baa maŋ ku fo kututu fanɛ kananɛ Mosis be mbra na bee ŋini na, Ebɔrɛ maaŋ mɔlga fo kikɛ.” 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ b kpal loŋ so n ji Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas emɔrɔ kpakpaso ga nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas nɛ Antiɔk be basa na be beko e yɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ bumo nɛ beshuŋipo na nɛ benimuana na e ya malga demu na be asheŋ. 3Asɔriebi na ka keta bumo n lar ekpa m bɛta nɛ b bɔla Fenisha nɛ Samɛria ŋ kaŋɛ ndoŋ be asɔriebiana kananɛ nnyamase gba fara a bɛ Ebɔrɛ so nɛ kumo be loŋ be baru na fuli bekurgepoana na kikɛ be ŋgbene ga. 4B ka ba Jerusalɛm nɛ asɔriebi na nɛ beshuŋipo na nɛ benimuana na sɔ bumo nɛnɛ nɛ b kaŋɛ bumo asɔ nɛ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora kikɛ nyam. 5Nɛ beyirdapoana na be beko nɛ b shi Efarisiana na be katuŋ to na niŋi to n yili ŋ kaŋɛ: “A daga fanɛ b ku bumo atutu ŋkeŋ shin nɛ b baa nu a sa Mosis be mbraana na.”
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ beshuŋipo na nɛ benimuana na shɛr nɛ b keni demu na to. 7B daŋ keni kumo to loŋ nɛ Pita ya niŋi to n yili ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ŋ kurgepoana, men nyi fanɛ ma nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ lara menyi to dra na kikɛ fanɛ n ya bɔ baru lela na be kubɔya na n sa nnyamase nɛ b nu nseŋ yirda. 8Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nyi basa kikɛ be ŋgbene kikɛ na malɛ e sa bumo Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ wora n sa anyi na, a ŋini fanɛ nnyamase gba beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ki beyirdapo. 9E maŋ ŋini fanɛ an kɔr bumo to. Bumo be yirda so nɛ e ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo. 10Nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ menyee ta le be kesheŋ kpakpaso nɛ an nanaana maŋ tiŋ ŋko an gbagba maaŋ tiŋ n wora a deŋi beyirdapo ere so nɛ men wora Ebɔrɛ ŋ keni? 11Akai, loŋ maŋ nyalɛ. An yirda fanɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu be kuwɔr be kakɛ na so nɛ an nya kumɔlga. Loŋ malɛ e la bumo alɛ gba.”
12Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas ka bee kute Ebɔrɛ be etɔɔnɛsheŋ nɛ emamachisheŋ damta nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ b wora nnyamase na to be asheŋ ere nɛ basa na kikɛ la to boeŋ a nu. 13B ka malga n loge nɛ Jeems malɛ ta ŋ kaŋɛ: “Bekurgepoana, men nu ma kutɔ nfe. 14Naniere nɛ Saimɔn kute kananɛ Ebɔrɛ fara n sha nnyamase na n lara bumo to be basa nɛ baaŋ baa la mo peya. 15Loŋ gbagba malɛ nɛ anebiana na be mmalga na bee kaŋɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na to fanɛ:
16‘Kede be kaman meeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba
m ba bar Deevid be kanaŋ ŋkpa to
n naŋ pɔr kanaŋ na be alambure na
m bɛ abar so.
17Nɛ basa pɔtɛ nɛ b ka na kikɛ
nɛ nnyamase nɛ n lara
ŋ ki meya na kikɛ e ba fin ma.
18Enyɛnpe nɛ e bugi kesheŋ ere to
ŋ kaŋɛ dra na kikɛ na e naa kaŋɛ loŋ na.’ ”
19Nɛ Jeems naŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma ere kutɔ an sa maŋ tɔrɔ nnyamase nɛ b fara nɛ b bɛ Ebɔrɛ so ere. 20Ama a daga fanɛ an sibɛ kawɔl ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b sa maa ji ajibi nɛ a maŋ walɛ so ŋkpal a ka la kalɔŋɛ be ajibi so. An kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa gelge kubojuaji nsaa maa ji ŋklaŋ ŋko kusɔbɔya kama nɛ b maŋ teŋ. 21Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa ka fara a kraŋ Mosis be mbra na ashi nshɛrbuana to kewushiachɛ kama na nɛ kananɛ b malga amo be asheŋ kade kama to na chɛr ga kabre.”
B ka sibɛ kawɔl n sa nnyamase na be asheŋ
22Ndoŋ nna nɛ beshuŋipo na nɛ benimuana na nɛ asɔriebi na kikɛ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule fanɛ b lara katuŋ na to be basa ko n shuŋi bumo nɛ Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas Antiɔk. Judas nɛ baa tre Baasabas na nɛ Sailas nɛ b daŋ lara. Bumo benyɔ na daa la basa nɛ bekurgepoana na kikɛ daa sa bunyaŋ nna. 23Le be kawɔl nɛ b daŋ ta n shuŋi mbɔ na: “Beshuŋipo na nɛ benimuana na bee chɔrɔ menyi nnyamase nɛ men la bekurgepoana a wɔ Antiɔk nɛ Siriya nɛ Silisia to na.
24An nu kananɛ anyi to be beko ya malga asheŋ ko a tɔrɔ menyi n shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene jija menyi ga, ama men baa nyi fanɛ mannɛ anyi e shuŋi bumo fanɛ b ya kaŋɛ menyi loŋ. 25Amoso nɛ an shɛr n wora kɔnɔkoŋwule n lara anyi to be beko n shuŋi bumo menyi kutɔ na. 26Bumo nɛ Baanabas nɛ Pɔɔl, an teri lelaana nɛ b kpal Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so n ji kenyɛn m mɔ bumo be amu n shuŋ na e naa yɔ. 27Menyeeŋ nu asheŋ koŋwule nɛ anyee sibɛ ere gbagba ashi Judas nɛ Sailas nɛ anyee shuŋi ere be kɔnɔ to. 28Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na wora kɔnɔkoŋwule nna fanɛ an sa maŋ naŋ sa menyi tɔrɔ kama n ti le be mbraana nɛ an tama fanɛ a daga ere so fanɛ: 29Men sa maa ji nlɔŋɛjibi, men sa maa ji ŋklaŋ, men sa maa we kusɔbɔya kama nɛ b maŋ teŋ. Kumo nɛ k ka na e la fanɛ men baa gelge kubojuaji. Men baa gelge asheŋ ere, asheŋ beeŋ nyalɛ n sa menyi. Ebɔrɛ e chɛ menyi to.”
30Kede be kaman nɛ b sa mbɔ na ekpa nɛ b yɔ Antiɔk n ya shɛr beyirdapoana na kikɛ n ta kawɔl na n sa bumo. 31Basa na ka kraŋ kawɔl na nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo ga ŋkpal kananɛ kubɔya na leŋ bumo to na so. 32Judas nɛ Sailas nɛ bumo alɛ gba daa la anebiana na daŋ malga n chɛr ga a ŋini bekurgepoana na asheŋ n leŋ bumo to. 33B ka wora nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ nɛ bekurgepoana na sa bumo ekpa nɛ b bɛta n yɔ nɛ kagbenewushi bumo nɛ b shuŋi bumo na kutɔ. 34Ama Sailas bre daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ ka ndoŋ. 35Nɛ Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas wora nchɛnnyɔ ashi Antiɔk nɛ bumo nɛ bebɛsopoana na be bedamta ŋini basa abɔrɛsheŋ m bɔ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na n sa bumo.
Pɔɔl nɛ Baanabas ka barga to be asheŋ
36B wɔtɔ loŋ nɛ kachako Pɔɔl ba kaŋɛ Baanabas: “Shin nɛ an naŋ ya bɔɔ nde nɛ an daŋ ya bɔ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya n sa na to ebi be bekurgepoana na so ŋ keni kananɛ baa bɛ so.” 37Nɛ Baanabas yɛ b keta Jɔn Maak n ti bumo be amu so a yɔ. 38Nɛ Pɔɔl yɛ loŋ maŋ daga, ŋkpal manɛ so, Jɔn Maak daa maŋ tu bumo n loge bumo be sososo be kushuŋ nɛ b daŋ ba to na nseŋ yili Pamfilia n yige bumo nseŋ bɛta n yɔ epe. 39Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ji kumo be emɔrɔ ga m barga to. Nɛ Baanabas keta Maak n luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɔla nchu so n yɔ Saipres. 40Nɛ Pɔɔl malɛ ta Sailas, nɛ bekurgepoana na ta bumo m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nɛ e baa keni bumo so. Kumo be kaman nɛ b yɔ. 41Nɛ b bɔla Siriya nɛ Silisia n ya kaa leŋ asɔriebiana na to ashi bumo be kebɛso to fanɛ b baa kɔ yirda na to kpakpa.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 16
Content:
Timoti ka tu Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas n yɔ be asheŋ
1Pɔɔl ta loŋ n ya fo Dɛbi n lar ndoŋ n yɔ Listra n ya tu ebɛsopo ko nɛ baa tre Timoti ndoŋ. Mo nio gba daa la eyirdapo nna a la Juw nɛ mo tuto malɛ daa la Griik. 2Timoti daa kɔ ketre ga ashi bekurgepoana nɛ b daa wɔ Listra nɛ Ikoniam na kikɛ nyam kutɔ. 3Pɔɔl ka daa sha keketa Timoti n yɔ so e ku mo kututu nna. E daŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal ndoŋ be basa na kikɛ ka daa nyi Timoti mo tuto ka la Griik so. 4Kade kama to nɛ b daŋ yɔ b daa kaŋɛ beyirdapoana na asɔ nɛ beshuŋipo nɛ benimuana nɛ b wɔ Jerusalɛm na wora kɔnɔkoŋwule n yili na nna nsaa kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa bɛ loŋ be mbraana na so. 5Amoso, asɔriebi na daa naŋ nya keyirda be eleŋ nna nseŋ naa wora keshi kachɛ kama malɛ gba a ti so.
Pɔɔl ka ku bɔrɛdare ashi Trowas be asheŋ
6B ka naŋ lar Listra nɛ b bɔla Frijia nɛ Galeesha be efuliana so be egbaŋ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na daa maŋ shin nɛ b bɔ kubɔya na ashi Eeshia be efuli so. 7B ka fo Maisiya be efuli be ekar to a sha keyɔ Bitinia be efuli so nɛ Yesu be Kiyoyu na maŋ sa bumo ekpa. 8Nɛ b bɔla Maisiya to n yɔ Trowas. 9Kumo be kamɔnchɛ be kanyɛso nɛ Pɔɔl ku bɔrɛdare ko n wu Masɛdonia be kanyɛn ko ka yil a kule mo: “Dii a ba Masɛdonia nfe m ba chɛ anyi to!” 10Pɔɔl ka ku le be bɔrɛdare na nɛ an bela ase manaŋ manaŋ m pɛ Masɛdonia be ekpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, an daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e tre anyi fanɛ an ya bɔ baru lela na n sa ndoŋebi.
Libiya ka ki ebɛsopo ashi Filipai be asheŋ
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ an yili Trowas n luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɔla nchu so n ta n yɔ Samɔtrees ŋ klade n yili ndoŋ n yɔ Niyapɔlis. 12Ndoŋ nɛ an ya yili n nite n yɔ Filipai, Masɛdonia be efuli so be kadegboŋ juŋkparso ko. Romebi e daŋ jɔŋɛ kumo ere gba a wɔ ndoŋ. An daŋ wora nchɛnnyɔ kade na to. 13Kewushiachɛ ka fo nɛ an lar kade na to n yɔ lɔr ko ase kakpa nɛ an daa tama Juwebi be kabɔrɛkulekpa beeŋ baa wɔ. 14Ndoŋ nɛ an ya chena m malga n sa beche ko ka ba shɛr. Beche nɛ b daŋ nu anyi be kamalga na be eko e daa la Libiya, e daa la ewajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ amo be yawu daa du kpakpa na be efapo nna n shi Tayataira. E daa la eche nɛ e daŋ bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nna nɛ Enyɛnpe bugi mbe kagbene nɛ e bugi asoe n nu kusɔ nɛ Pɔɔl daa kaŋɛ na. 15B daŋ bɛr mo nɛ mbe laŋ to ebi kikɛ kabɔrɛbɛr nna. Le nɛ e daŋ ba kaŋɛ anyi: “Nɛ men baa nyi fanɛ n la Enyɛnpe na be eyirdapo kashenteŋto nna, men ba kaa wɔ ma pe.” Le nɛ e daŋ ta n shin nɛ an yɔ.
B ka ti Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas ebu be asheŋ
16Kachako an ka bee yɔ kabɔrɛkulekpa nɛ kebichebi ko nɛ kiyoyu lubi ko daa wɔ mo to a shin nɛ e daa wu asheŋ a kaŋɛ na tu anyi. Mbe kewu asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ na daa shin nɛ e daa nya amansherbi damta ga nna a sa mo nyɛnpeana. 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ e bɛ anyi nɛ Pɔɔl so a ponte a kaŋɛ: “Basa ere la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be anya nna. Baa kaŋɛ menyi kananɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n nya kumɔlga nna.” 18E daŋ malga loŋ nchɛ damta nɛ kachako Pɔɔl be kagbene jija mo ga nɛ e gben ŋ kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ kiyoyu lubi na: “Yesu Kristo be ketre to nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo na: Lar kebichebi ere to!” Epul na gbagba to nɛ kiyoyu lubi na lar kebichebi na to.
19Kebichebi na mo nyɛnpeana ka pin fanɛ e maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n nya amansherbi n sa bumo nɛ b nyaŋ Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas ŋ gberge bumo n yɔ kelɔnɛ so, demujikpa n ya sa benimuana na. 20Romebi be ekrachigboŋana na kutɔ nɛ b daŋ bar bumo m ba kaŋɛ: “Basa ere la Juwebi nna a wɔ kade ere to a tɔrɔ basa. 21Edaŋkaresheŋ ko nɛ a maa bɛ anyi be mbra na so nɛ b wɔtɔ a ŋini. Anyi alɛ la Romebi nna, an maaŋ tiŋ m bɛ loŋ be edaŋkare so.” 22Nɛ jimaŋ na malɛ ta bumo be nnɔ n wɔtɔ a bri bumo, nɛ benimuana na kpɛa Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas be asɔbuuso to nseŋ shin nɛ b kuya bumo so. 23B ka shin nɛ b bri bumo ga n loge nɛ b shin nɛ b ti bumo ebu nseŋ kaŋɛ kabutikenipo na fanɛ e ti bumo kpakpa n wɔtɔ. 24Kabutikenipo na ka nu loŋ nɛ e ta bumo n wɔtɔ lalaloge be ebu na to nseŋ kre bumo be ayaana m mata ŋgbuliŋ gbɛgbɛso ko.
25Kumo be kamɔnchɛ be kiidiso Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas ka bee kule Ebɔrɛ nsaa boŋ nshɛ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nɛ bumo braana nɛ b wɔ kabuti na to na bee nu. 26Nɛ kebembeŋgboŋ ko ba epul na to m ba gbuŋgbuŋ kasawule nɛ ebu na daa yil so na gba to nɛ mbuna na kikɛ bugi epul na to nɛ kabutipoana na be ŋgbɛlɛbiana lar bumo so n tɔr. 27Kabutikenipo na ka tiŋi n wu kananɛ mbuna na kikɛ bugi a yil na nɛ e pe tokobi nɛ e mɔ mbe kumu, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa tama fanɛ basa na kikɛ lar nna. 28Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pɔɔl boŋ to awɔrso ga ŋ kaŋɛ: “Sa maŋ doro fo kumu. Anyi kikɛ wɔtɔ.” 29Nɛ kabutikenipo na shin nɛ b sa mo fitila nɛ e jɔ to n luri ŋ gbir Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas be anishito a chicha. 30Ndoŋ nna nɛ e keta bumo n lar n ya bishi bumo: “N nyɛnpeana, nuso nɛ meeŋ wora n tiŋ n nya kumɔlga?” 31Nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Yirda Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo nɛ fo nɛ fo laŋ to ebi e nya kumɔlga.” 32Kumo be kaman nɛ b bɔ Enyɛnpe na be kubɔya na n sa mo nɛ mbe kowu to ebi kikɛ. 33Jemanɛ na malɛ kikɛ so nɛ kabutikenipo na fɔr bumo be achuuana na nɛ b bɛr mo nɛ mbe laŋ to ebi kabɔrɛbɛr epul na to. 34E daŋ yɛr Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas mo pe nna n ya sa bumo ajibi. Mo nɛ mbe eche nɛ bibi be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo ga ŋkpal b ka yirda Ebɔrɛ naniere so.
35Kumo be ŋklade nɛ Romebi be ekrachigboŋana na ta le be kubɔya n shuŋi bepurshi ŋ kaŋɛ: “Men shin nɛ basa na e baa yɔ.” 36Nɛ kabutikenipo na ta kumo ŋ kaŋɛ Pɔɔl: “Ekrachigboŋana na shuŋi n sa ekpa fanɛ b lara menyi kabuti to. Amoso, men koso kagbenewushiso a yɔ.” 37Nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ bepurshi na: “B maŋ ji anyi demu ŋ keni nseŋ shin nɛ b bri anyi basa to. Anyi alɛ la Rom be efuli so ebi nna. B ka bri anyi n loge nɛ b ta anyi n ti ebu nseŋ naa sha keŋana boeŋ n lara anyi a? Akai, loŋ maaŋ nya. A daga fanɛ bumo, Romebi be ekrachigboŋana na gbagba ka ba nfe m ba lara anyi.” 38Ndoŋ nna nɛ bepurshi na ya kute kesheŋ na n sa Romebi be benimuana na nɛ kufu pɛ bumo ŋkpal b ka nu basa nɛ b ti ebu na ka la Rom be efuli so ebi so. 39Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ya kule bumo fanɛ b ta m paŋ bumo. Kumo be kaman nɛ b lara bumo kabuti na to nseŋ kule bumo fanɛ b lar kade na to. 40Nɛ Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas lar kabuti na to n yɔ Libiya pe n ya tu bekurgepoana na ndoŋ n leŋ bumo to nseŋ lar kade na to.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 17
Content:
B ka tɔrɔ Pɔɔl nɛ mo braana ashi Tɛsalɔnika be asheŋ
1B ta loŋ m ba bɔla Amfipɔlis nɛ Apɔlonia m ba fo Tɛsalɔnika, kakpa nɛ Juwebi be nshɛrbu ko daa wɔ na. 2Nɛ Pɔɔl yaŋ yɔ nshɛrbu na to fanɛ kananɛ e chɛr a wora kade kama to na. Mbe kewushiachɛ asa nɛ e wɔ ndoŋ a kɔ abɔrɛsibɛ na a ji basa na emɔrɔ 3a ta amo a bugi asheŋ to a ŋini bumo kananɛ a daga Kristo na ka beeŋ luri etɔrɔ to nɛ Ebɔrɛ e naŋ tiŋi mo luwu to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Yesu nɛ mee malga mbe asheŋ ere e la Kristo na.” 4Nɛ bumo be beko yirda Pɔɔl be kamalga na nɛ bumo nɛ Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas ba ki basa koŋwule a bɛ Yesu so. Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ Griikebi be bedamta ko nɛ b daa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na nɛ bebunyampocheana na be bedamta malɛ gba daŋ wora. 5Ama kayurbesa daŋ pɛ Juwebi na ga nɛ b chala basa fuloŋ tɔlpo ko ashi kubɔrbi so nseŋ nya jimaŋ ko n ta kade na kikɛ to n wɔtɔ awɔrgboŋ ko to nseŋ ya mel Jeesɔn pe a fin kepɛ Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas m ba sa basa na. 6B ka fin Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas ŋ gben nɛ b gberge Jeesɔn nɛ bekurgepo ko n ya sa kade na to be benimuana m ponte ŋ kaŋɛ: “Basa ere na nde kama to nna a baga amo to nseŋ ba anyi alɛ be kade ere to. 7Nɛ Jeesɔn ta bumo n wɔtɔ mo pe. Bumo kikɛ wɔtɔ nna a wora a da Romebi be ewurgboŋ na be mbraana na so a kaŋɛ basa fanɛ ewura ko malɛ gba naa wɔtɔ nɛ baa tre Yesu.” 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ jimaŋ na nɛ kade na to be benimuana na be kebagato sɔ kakpa kikɛ. 9Nɛ benimu na shin nɛ Jeesɔn nɛ mo braana na yili Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas be katelamu to ŋ ka kumo be loŋ be amansherbi pɔɛŋ nɛ b yige bumo.
Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas ka ba Beriya be asheŋ
10Kanyɛ ka baŋ biri nɛ bekurgepoana na shin nɛ Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas yɔ Beriya. B ka fo ndoŋ nɛ b yɔ ndoŋ be nshɛrbu to. 11Ndoŋebi bre daŋ bugi bumo be asoe a sha kenu kubɔya na ga nsaa koya abɔrɛsibɛ na kachɛ kama a keni ŋko Pɔɔl be mmalga na bɔla ekpa a. 12Bumo be bedamta daŋ yirda nɛ Griikebi be bebunyampocheana be bedamta nɛ Egriiknyɛn be bedamta gba ba yirda. 13Tɛsalɔnika be Juwebi na ka nu fanɛ Pɔɔl bɔ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na ashi Beriya gba nɛ b ba ndoŋ m ba fara a we a wɔtɔ basa na a yeŋ bumo to a wɔtɔ kebagato to. 14Epul na to nɛ bekurgepoana na nya manaŋ n shin nɛ Pɔɔl yɔ teku ase be nde to nseŋ ka Sailas nɛ Timoti Beriya to. 15Atens kikɛ nɛ bumo nɛ b daŋ shuŋi Pɔɔl a yɔ na daŋ ya yige mo nseŋ bɛta n ta Pɔɔl be ŋkela n yɔ Beriya fanɛ Sailas nɛ Timoti e ba manaŋ m ba tu mo.
Pɔɔl ka malga ashi Atens be asheŋ
16Pɔɔl ka wɔ Atens a jo Sailas nɛ Timoti nseŋ wu kananɛ agbir bɔlɔ kade na to nɛ mbe kagbene jija mo ga. 17Amoso, saŋkama e daa ji Juwebi nɛ nnyamase nɛ b daa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na emɔrɔ nna ashi nshɛrbu na to nseŋ naa yɔ kelɔnɛ so gba kachɛ kama n ya kaa ji basa nɛ e daa tu ndoŋ emɔrɔ. 18Kanyiashenfinpoana be ntuŋ nɛ baa tre Epikyurisebi nɛ Stowikebi na malɛ gba be beko daŋ ba ji mo emɔrɔ nɛ beko bishi abar: “Manɛ nɛ kanyiashenfuloŋwura ere bee sha keŋini ere?” Nɛ beko kaŋɛ: “K du fanɛ e bee malga ebɔrɛ pɔtɛana ko be asheŋ nna.” Pɔɔl ka daa malga Yesu be ketiŋi luwu to na be asheŋ so nɛ b daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ na. 19Ndoŋ nna nɛ b keta Pɔɔl n yɔ nshɛrwuraana ko nɛ b daa shɛr Ariɔpages be kebee so na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo: 20“Kaŋɛ anyi keŋini popɔr nɛ fee malga ere be asheŋ. Asheŋ popɔr nɛ fee malga na, anyi maŋ naŋ nu amo be asheŋ kikɛ, amoso nɛ anyee sha fanɛ fo kaŋɛ anyi amo be afito.” 21Atens be ndetoebi kikɛ nɛ befɔana na daa maa kɔ wale she kebaatase a nu ŋko a kaŋɛ abar ebaru popɔr nɛ b nu be asheŋ so so nɛ b daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ na.
22Nɛ Pɔɔl niŋi to n yili Ariɔpages be nshɛr na to nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Atensebi, n wu kananɛ men ta menyi be yirda n wɔtɔ ebɔrɛ damtaana to. 23Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ ka nite menyi be kade ere to nseŋ wu asɔ nɛ menyee bunyaŋ, n wu bɔrɛsure ko nɛ b sibɛ kumo so: ‘Ebɔrɛ nɛ b maŋ nyi peya.’ Kusɔ nɛ menyee bunyaŋ nsaa maa nyi na be asheŋ nɛ m baa kaŋɛ menyi naniere na. 24Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to durnya ere nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ kumo to kikɛ ere e la ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule kikɛ be Enyɛnpe, mo alɛ maa chena nshɛrbu nɛ enyiŋgbasa pɔr nɛ b baa bunyaŋ mo to. 25Mo alɛ maŋ naa sha kusɔ kama nɛ nyiŋgbasa ta enɔ a shuŋ a sa mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa sa nyiŋgbasa ŋkpa nɛ efute nɛ kusɔ kama nyam. 26Esa koŋwule nɛ e daŋ fara n to nseŋ bɔla mo to n to yiri kikɛ n shin nɛ b sɔ kasawule so kikɛ nyam a wɔtɔ na. Mo gbagba malɛ e daŋ yili saŋɛ nɛ kakpa nɛ baaŋ ba kaa wɔ pɔɛŋ nseŋ to bumo. 27E daŋ wora loŋ nna nɛ b laa n fin mo kukoko to n ya nya mo ashi bumo be kafin na to. Ama anyi be ekama ere nyam nɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ wɔ kufɔ, 28ŋkpal manɛ so:
‘Mo e naa shin nɛ an wɔtɔ
a nite a kilgi to
a du kananɛ an du ere na.’
Menyi be besibɛpo malɛ e naa kaŋɛ loŋ:
‘Anyi alɛ gba la mbe mbia nna.’
29Ŋkpal anyi alɛ ka la mbe mbia so, an sa maa fɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ du fanɛ shuwa be kusɔ pɔrso ŋko gbiti be kusɔ pɔrso ŋko kejembu be kusɔ pɔrso ko nɛ nyiŋgbasa ta mo gbagba be kenyi be nfɛra n wora nna. 30Ebɔrɛ kplaŋ saŋɛ nɛ basa daa maŋ nyi na so, ama naniere e bee kaŋɛ ekama kaplɛkama fanɛ e lar mbe alubi to. 31Ŋkpal manɛ so, e lara kachako n yili a sha keshin nɛ esa ko nɛ e lara n yili na e ji durnya ere demu kumo be ekpa so. Mo alɛ ŋini ekama nyam kumo be loŋ n shin nɛ amodoŋwura tiŋi luwu to.”
32B ka nu Pɔɔl ka malga ketiŋi luwu to be asheŋ na nɛ bumo be beko wora mo eyurto nɛ beko malɛ kaŋɛ: “Anyi ere kraa sha kenamba n nu fo kamalga na.” 33Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pɔɔl lar nshɛr na to n yɔ. 34Nɛ basa ko yɔ mo kutɔ n ya ki bebɛsopo. Bumo to be beko e daa la Dayɔnaisias, Ariɔpages be katuŋ na to be esa, nɛ kache ko nɛ baa tre Damaris na n ta beko malɛ gba n ti so.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 18
Content:
Pɔɔl ka ba Kɔrint be asheŋ
1Kede be kaman nɛ Pɔɔl lar Atens n ta n yɔ Kɔrint. 2Ndoŋ nɛ e ya tu Juwnyɛn ko nɛ b daŋ kurge mo ashi Pɔntes a tre mo Akwila na. Mo nɛ mbe eche Prisila ka daŋ shi Itali m ba ndoŋ ŋkpal Ewurgboŋ Klawdias ka daŋ ju Juwebi kikɛ ashi Rom na so, k daa maŋ chɛr. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pɔɔl ya chɔrɔ bumo nseŋ shir bumo pe a wɔtɔ a baa ewajɛbu a fa a nya amansherbi a tɔ mbe asɔ jiso fanɛ kananɛ bumo gbagba daa wora na. 4Kewushiachɛ kama e daa yɔ nshɛrbu na to nna n ya kaa bugi asheŋ to a kaŋɛ Juwebi nɛ Griikebi kikɛ a sha keshin nɛ b wu fanɛ mbe kamalga na e bɔla ekpa.
5Sailas nɛ Timoti ka shi Masɛdonia m ba nɛ Pɔɔl yige kusɔ kama nsaa wɔtɔ a bɔ kubɔya na a bugi kumo to nɛnɛ a kaŋɛ Juwebi na fanɛ Yesu e la Kristo na. 6Nɛ b ji mo emɔrɔ kpakpaso nseŋ tege mo. Nɛ mo alɛ gbaŋgbaŋ mbe asɔbuuso to be shishɛr n lɛ bumo n wora bumo kusha ŋ kaŋɛ: “Menyi be ŋklaŋ e baa wɔ menyi gbagba be amu so, mannɛ ma e bar kumo. Yili kabre a yɔ nnyamase kutɔ nɛ meeŋ baa yɔ n ya kaa bɔ kubɔya na a sa bumo.” 7Kumo be kaman nɛ e yige bumo nseŋ yɔ n ya kaa wɔ kanyɛn ko nɛ e daa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na pe. Mbe ketre e daa la Titias Jɛstes. Mbe kowu daŋ mata ndoŋ be nshɛrbu nna. 8Nshɛrbu na be enimu nɛ b daa tre Krispes na nɛ mbe laŋ to ebi daŋ yirda Enyɛnpe na nɛ Kɔrintebi be basa damta gba nu kubɔya na n yirda nɛ b bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr. 9Kanyɛso ko Pɔɔl ku bɔrɛdare n nu Enyɛnpe ka bee kaŋɛ mo: “Sa maa lɔ kufu n yige, baa kraa malga, ŋkpal manɛ so, n wɔ fo kaman. 10Esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n wora fo shɛŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, kade ere to be basa damta la meya nna.” 11Kafɛ nɛ afɔl ashe nɛ Pɔɔl daŋ ji ndoŋ a ŋini kade na to ebi Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na.
12Galio ka ba ki Romebi be gomena ashi Griis nɛ Juwebi na wora kɔnɔkoŋwule n nyaŋ Pɔɔl n ta mo n yɔ demujikpa n ya kaŋɛ gomena na: 13“Kanyɛn ere bee wora ania nna a sha fanɛ basa e nu n sa mo nseŋ bɔla ekpa nɛ anyi be mbra na maa ŋini so m bɛ Ebɔrɛ so.” 14Pɔɔl ka bugi kɔnɔ nɛ e malga nɛ Galio ku mbe kɔnɔ so ŋ kaŋɛ Juwebi na: “Demu ere daa la kulubi ko ŋko dalubisheŋ ko be demu nna, a daŋ daga ŋ ka ji menyi Juwebi ere kanyiti. 15Ama k ka la mmalga nɛ atre nɛ menyi be mbraana be asheŋ ere bre, menyi gbagba e ji kumo kumo be ekpa so. M maaŋ ji loŋ be asheŋ be demu.” 16Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ b ju bumo n lar demujikpa na. 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo kikɛ nyaŋ Sɔstenis nɛ e daa la nshɛrbu na to be enimu na m bri mo demujikpa na be kabuna to. Ama kumo alɛ daa maŋ tir Galio gbrɛbi gba kikɛ.
Pɔɔl ka bɛta n yɔ Antiɔk be asheŋ
18Pɔɔl ka chena bekurgepoana na kutɔ ashi Kɔrint n wora nchɛnnyɔ nɛ e kela bumo nɛ mo nɛ Prisila nɛ Akwila luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɔla nchu so n yɔ Siriya. E daŋ nase kɔnɔ ashi Kɛŋkriya nna n sa Ebɔrɛ n shin nɛ b she mbe kumu pɔɛŋ nɛ e luri ekuloŋgboŋ to n yɔ. 19B ka ba fo Ɛfeses nɛ Pɔɔl yige Prisila nɛ Akwila nseŋ yɔ ndoŋ be nshɛrbu to nɛ mo nɛ Juwebi na ya ji abɔrɛsheŋ na be emɔrɔ. 20Nɛ b kule mo fanɛ e chena bumo kutɔ kade na to n wora nchɛnnyɔ nɛ e kini. 21Ama le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nseŋ pɛ ekpa: “Nɛ Ebɔrɛ shuli, meeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba menyi kutɔ.” Kede be kaman nɛ e yili Ɛfeses n luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɔla nchu so n yɔ.
22E ka ta m ba fo Sizariya nɛ e yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya chɔrɔ ndoŋ be asɔriebi na nseŋ yɔ Antiɔk. 23E ka ya wora nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ nɛ e lar ndoŋ m bɔla Galeesha nɛ Frijia be efuliana so be egbaŋ to a leŋ beyirdapoana na kikɛ to.
Apɔlɔs ka ba Ɛfeses nɛ Kɔrint be asheŋ
24Juwnyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Apɔlɔs nɛ b daŋ kurge mo Alɛkzaandria na daŋ ba Ɛfeses. E daa nyi kamalga to ga nsaa nyi abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ ga. 25B daŋ ŋini mo Enyɛnpe be ekpa na be asheŋ nna nɛ e daa wɔtɔ a yeŋi so a malga nsaa ŋini basa Yesu be asheŋ na kashenteŋto nɛ amo be ekpa so. Ama Jɔn be kabɔrɛbɛr na nawule be asheŋ nɛ e daa nyi. 26Prisila nɛ Akwila ka nu e ka malga nshɛrbu na to kenyɛnso n loge nɛ b keta mo n yɔ epe n ya bugi Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ na to ŋ ŋini mo nɛnɛ. 27Kumo be kaman nɛ Apɔlɔs yili kumo fanɛ e beeŋ yɔ Griis. Nɛ Ɛfeses be beyirdapoana na leŋ mo to nseŋ chɛ mo to n sibɛ nwɔl n sa bumo kurgepoana ashi Griis a kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b sɔ mo nɛnɛ. E ka fo ndoŋ nɛ e chɛ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ n shin nɛ b ki beyirdapo na to ga, 28ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ ta kamalganyi nna n ji m bri Juwebi na basa to a ta abɔrɛsibɛ na a bugi asheŋ a ŋini bumo nɛnɛ fanɛ Yesu e la Kristo na.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 19
Content:
Pɔɔl ka ba Ɛfeses be asheŋ
1Jemanɛ nɛ Apɔlɔs daa wɔ Kɔrint na nɛ Pɔɔl malɛ na kasawule na kikɛ so loŋ n ya fo Ɛfeses. 2Ndoŋ nɛ e ya tu beyirdapo ko m bishi bumo: “Men ka ki beyirdapo, Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na gbelge menyi so a?” Nɛ b kaŋɛ: “Anyi ere maŋ nu fanɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ ko malɛ wɔtɔ gba.” 3Nɛ Pɔɔl bishi bumo: “Nɛ nuso be kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ b bɛr menyi?” Nɛ b kaŋɛ: “Kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ Jɔn daŋ bɔ kumo be asheŋ na.” 4Nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ: “Kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ Jɔn daa bɛr basa na daa ŋini fanɛ basa na yɛ b lar bumo be alubi to, ama e daa kaŋɛ ekama nna fanɛ a daga fanɛ e yirda esa nɛ e wɔ mo ere Jɔn be kaman a ba na, mo e la Yesu na.” 5Ɛfeses be beyirdapoana na ka nu loŋ nɛ b shin nɛ b bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr Enyɛnpe Yesu be ketre to. 6Nɛ Pɔɔl ta mbe enɔana n deŋi bumo so nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na gbelge bumo so nɛ b gbar ŋgbar nɛ bumo gbagba maa nu nseŋ naŋ wu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ. 7Bumo kikɛ daŋ fo fanɛ benyɛn kuduanyɔ.
8Pɔɔl be afɔl asa nɛ e wɔtɔ a yɔ ndoŋ be nshɛrbu to n ya kaa malga basa na kutɔ kenyɛnso a ji bumo emɔrɔ a sha b ka yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to be asheŋ nɛ e daa malga na la kashenteŋ nna. 9Ama bumo be beko daŋ ta amu kpakpaso ŋ kini kenu nseŋ malga mmalga lubi basa na kikɛ to ŋ gbiti ekpa nɛ Enyɛnpe bee ŋini na. Nɛ Pɔɔl yige bumo nseŋ keta beyirdapoana na nɛ b wɔtɔ a shɛr kachɛ kama a ber abɔrɛsheŋ na be bare ashi lambu nɛ Tiranes daa shɛr basa a malga a sa bumo na to. 10Pɔɔl be nfɛ anyɔ nɛ e wɔtɔ a wora loŋ hale nɛ basa nɛ b daa wɔ Eeshia be efuli so na kikɛ, Juwebi nɛ nnyamase gba ya nu Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na.
Skiva be mbinyɛnbi nɛ ayoyu lubi ko be asheŋ
11Ebɔrɛ daa bɔla Pɔɔl so nna a wora emamachisheŋ popɔr damta ga. 12B daa ta Pɔɔl be antikiana nɛ mbe kushuŋ to be asɔbuuso gba nna n ya kaa sa belɔpo nɛ a bee shin nɛ basa na be alɔ nɛ ayoyu lubiana malɛ gba bee lar bumo to. 13Juwebi ko gba daa na a kilgi to a ju ayoyu lubi nseŋ wora ania nɛ b ta Enyɛnpe Yesu be ketre gba n wora loŋ ŋ kaŋɛ ayoyu lubi na: “Yesu nɛ Pɔɔl bee bɔ mbe kubɔya na be ketre to nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi na, men lar esa ere to.” 14Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nɛ baa tre Skiva na be mbinyɛnbi ashunu e daa wora loŋ na. 15Nɛ kiyoyu lubi na kaŋɛ bumo: “N nyi Yesu nsaa nyi Pɔɔl be asheŋ nɛ basa mo malɛ e la menyi alɛ?” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ kanyɛn nɛ kiyoyu lubi na wɔ mo to na nyaŋɛ to m buu bumo n doro bumo nseŋ kpɛa bumo be asɔbuuso to n lɛ nɛ b lar mbe kowu na to n delge so n shile n choŋ. 17Juwebi nɛ nnyamase nɛ b daa wɔ Ɛfeses na kikɛ ka nu kumo nɛ kufu pɛ bumo kikɛ ga nɛ b sa Enyɛnpe Yesu be ketre kemaŋkura ga. 18Nɛ beyirdapoana na be bedamta ba basa to m ba kaa bugi bumo gbagba be afito a kaŋɛ alubi nɛ b wora. 19Bumo be bedamta nɛ b daŋ ta ŋkilgi be nwɔl ŋ koya ŋkilgi na daŋ bar amo kikɛ abar so m ba chɔɔ amo basa kikɛ be anishito. B ka daŋ ber nwɔl na be amansherbi a daa wɔ pɔŋ ŋgboŋ adesa. 20Ŋkpal le be asheŋgboŋ ere so Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na daŋ sɔ kakpa kikɛ nna nɛ basa damta bee yirda a ti so.
Kolu ka ku Ɛfeses be asheŋ
21Asheŋ nɛ a wora na be kaman nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na shin nɛ Pɔɔl yili kumo mbe kagbene to fanɛ e beeŋ bɔla Masɛdonia nɛ Griis to n ta n yɔ Jerusalɛm. Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ: “A daga fanɛ, ŋ kaŋ yɔ ndoŋ, n fo Rom gba.” 22Ndoŋ nna nɛ e shuŋi mbe bechɛtopo anyɔ ko Masɛdonia nseŋ kraa wɔ Eeshia be kasawule so. Mbe bechɛtopo na e daa la Timoti nɛ Irastes.
23Jemanɛ na so nɛ kenishipere be kayurnyaŋ koso Ɛfeses ŋkpal Enyɛnpe be ekpa na so. 24Gbitibɔyɛponyɛn ko e daa wɔ Ɛfeses nɛ baa tre mo Demitrias. E daa ta egbiti nna a lɔŋɛ asɔ nɛ a du fanɛ kegbirche Aatemis be ebu. Mbe beshumpo daa nya tɔnɔ ga ashi kushuŋ na to. 25Ndoŋ nna nɛ e tre mbe beshumpoana na nɛ bekama nɛ bumo alɛ gba daa shuŋ loŋ be kushuŋ na m ba shɛr ŋ kaŋɛ: “Men nyi fanɛ kushuŋ ere e naa nyalɛ anyi. 26Menyi alɛ gba bee wu nseŋ naa nu kusɔ nɛ kanyɛn nɛ baa tre Pɔɔl na wɔtɔ a wora. E wɔtɔ nna a kaŋɛ basa fanɛ agbirana nɛ baa lɔŋɛ na maŋ la ebɔrɛana kikɛ. Mo alɛ tiŋ n shin nɛ basa damta ashi Ɛfeses nfe nɛ Eeshia be kasawule ere so be basa damta shuli fanɛ mbe kamalga na la kashenteŋ nna. 27Nɛ an maŋ de so, basa beeŋ jija anyi be kushuŋ ere be ketre. Kumo alɛ be kaman, nɛ an maŋ de so, basa beeŋ ba kaa fɛl kegbirche Aatemis be ebu na nɛ mbe ketre maaŋ naŋ dii kikɛ. Men keni, kegbirche nɛ basa kikɛ bee bunyaŋ ashi Eeshia be efuli ere so na nɛ baa sha kewora loŋ na.”
28Jimaŋ na ka nu asheŋ nɛ Demitrias malga na nɛ agbo pɛ bumo nɛ b fara a ponte a kaŋɛ: “Ɛfesesebi be kegbirche Aatemis e la elempo.” 29Ndoŋ nna nɛ kebagato na sɔ kade na to kikɛ nɛ jimaŋ yenso na nyaŋ Gayes nɛ Aristaakes, Masɛdonia be basa anyɔ ko nɛ bumo nɛ Pɔɔl daa na na ŋ gberge bumo n yɔ kade na be nshɛrkpa. 30Pɔɔl gbagba daa sha keyɔ jimaŋ na be anishito nna ashi nshɛr na to nɛ beyirdapoana na ju mo. 31Nɛ efuli na so be benimuana nɛ b daa la Pɔɔl mo teriana na gba shuŋi ŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ ba nshɛrkpa na to. 32Jemanɛ ere so kikɛ nɛ nshɛr na kikɛ bee baga to, nɛ ekama bee gbar a juge to, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be bedamta gba daa maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ b shɛr ndoŋ nɛ b wora. 33Basa na be beko daa tama fanɛ Alɛkzaanda be asheŋ nna, ŋkpal Juwebi na ka daŋ shin nɛ e ya yili anishito na so. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Alɛkzaanda wora jimaŋ na enɔ a sha kemalga m mɔlga mbe kumu ashi jimaŋ na kutɔ. 34B ka pin fanɛ e la Juw nna nɛ bumo kikɛ ponte awa anyɔ a kaŋɛ kusɔ koŋwule nɛ b daŋ fara ŋ kaŋɛ na: “Ɛfesesebi be kegbirche Aatemis e la elempo.” 35Jimaŋ na wora awɔr na loŋ nɛ kade na to be krachigboŋ na ya tiŋ n lɔlɔ bumo nɛ b lo to nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Ɛfesesebi, ekama nyi fanɛ Ɛfeses e naa keni kegbirche Aatemis be ebu na nɛ kejembu cheembi nɛ k shi ebɔrɛso n tɔr na so. 36Esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n chɛ kumo be loŋ, amoso, men wushi eyur boeŋ n sa maŋ kuse n wora asheŋ brembreŋ. 37Basa nɛ men bar nfe ere maŋ yuri kegbirlambu na to be kusɔ kama, bumo alɛ maŋ malga kulubi ŋ gbiti anyi be kegbirche na. 38Nɛ Demitrias nɛ mbe beshumpo nɛ esa ko kɔ abar gba nna, baaŋ tiŋ n yɛr amodoŋwura benimuana na kutɔ nchɛ nɛ baa kaa lar a chena demujikpa na to na nɛ bumo nɛ amodoŋwura ya kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ b wora abar. 39Ama nɛ fanɛ men kraa sha kusɔ ko n ti so, kakpa nɛ baaŋ ji loŋ be demu e la ndetobia be nshɛr nɛ mbra na bee ŋini na to. 40Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ anyi maŋ de so, Romebi na beeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ k wora ere la kelantokɔ nna. Le be kebagato ere maŋ kɔ kifi. Anyi alɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ k bar le be kebagato ere.” 41Krachi na ka malga n loge nɛ e shin nɛ basa na pesaŋ to n yɔ epe.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 20
Content:
Pɔɔl ka naŋ bɛta n yɔ Masɛdonia nɛ Griis be asheŋ
1Basa na be kebagato na ka baŋ loge nɛ Pɔɔl tre beyirdapoana na n ta mmalga damta n leŋ bumo to ga nseŋ kela bumo nseŋ ta n yɔ Masɛdonia n ya yɔ ndoŋ be ndeana na to 2n ya kaa ta mmalga damta a leŋ beyirdapoana na to. 3Ade be kaman nɛ e yili ndoŋ n yɔ Griis n ya ji afɔl asa ndoŋ.
