E daŋ naa bela ase nna nɛ e luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɔla nchu so n yɔ Siriya nseŋ nu Juwebi na ka bee sha kemɔ mo nɛ e naŋ bɛta m bɔla Masɛdonia. 4Mo nɛ Pires nɛ e shi Beriya na pibi Sopata nɛ Aristaakes nɛ Sɛkundes nɛ b shi Tɛsalɔnika na nɛ Gayes nɛ e shi Dɛbi na nɛ Timoti nɛ Eeshia be efuli so ebi Tikikes nɛ Trɔfimes na e daŋ yɔ. 5Bumo e daŋ juŋkpar n ya kaa jo anyi ashi Trowas. 6Bodobodo nɛ a maŋ kɔ yiisi be Kejigboŋ na be jemanɛ ka choŋ nɛ an yili Filipai n luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɔla nchu so n ji nchɛ anu nseŋ ya tu bumo Trowas nɛ an kikɛ ji bɔkwe ndoŋ.
Pɔɔl be lalaloge be kechɔrɔ Trowas be bebɛsopo be asheŋ
7Bɔkwe be kachɛ juŋkparso be kanyɛso ko an shɛr m bɔ enɔ n wɔtɔ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be kawiejibi na to nɛ Pɔɔl kpal e ka beeŋ lar kade na to kumo be ŋklade na so m bɔ kubɔya na loŋ nɛ kiidiso ya fo. 8Ndia damta ko malɛ e daa wɔ esoso be ebu nɛ an daŋ shɛr na to. 9Kabrantiɛbia ko daa tase tokuro so nɛ baa tre mo Yutikes. Ŋkpal Pɔɔl ka malga n chɛr na so nɛ edi laa mo nɛ e fara a di hale n ya di n choŋ so n shi esoso be ebu sasopo na to m ba tɔr kasawule nɛ b ba nɛ b ba ta mo nɛ e wu. 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pɔɔl gbelge n ya teŋi mbe kumu to n dese mo so nseŋ ta mbe enɔana m mea mo nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Men sa maa fɔŋ so, e kɔ ŋkpa.” 11Kumo be kaman nɛ Pɔɔl naŋ bɛta n dii n yɔ esoso be ebu na to n ya buri bodobodo to n we. Pɔɔl ka malga bumo kutɔ loŋ hale nɛ epeŋi ya pete nɛ e yige bumo nseŋ yɔ. 12Ndoŋ nna nɛ b keta kabrantiɛbia na ŋkpa to n yɔ epe. Bumo be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo ga ŋkpal loŋ so.
Pɔɔl ka shi Trowas n yɔ Mailites be asheŋ
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ an juŋkpar n yɔ ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɔla nchu so n ta n yɔ Asɔs, kakpa nɛ an daa yɔ nɛ an ya ta Pɔɔl na. E ka daŋ bɔla aya so n yɔ ndoŋ na so nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ an wora loŋ. 14E ka tu anyi Asɔs nɛ an ta mo n wɔtɔ ekuloŋ na to n ta n yɔ Mitilini 15n ya yili ndoŋ n luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to n di ŋ klade m ba baŋ Kiyɔs so n choŋ. Kumo be ŋklade nɛ an ta n yɔ Samɔs n naŋ klade n yɔ Mailites. 16Pɔɔl daa sha kekpar Ɛfeses so nna n yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa maŋ naa sha kenaŋ n chɛr Eeshia be efuli so. E daa kuse nna nɛ e ya fo Jerusalɛm ta a ba Pɛntekɔst be kachɛgboŋ na, nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ nna na.
Pɔɔl ka kela Ɛfeses be asɔri to be benimuana be asheŋ
17Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pɔɔl yili Mailites n shuŋi kabɔ fanɛ e ya kaŋɛ ndoŋ be asɔriebi be benimuana fanɛ b shɛr mo to. 18B ka ba nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo: “Men nyi kebaawɔtɔ nɛ n daa kɔ a wɔ menyi kutɔ na yili kachɛ nɛ n fara m ba Eeshia be efuli ere so na m ba fo kabre. 19N daa shuŋ ma kushuŋ nna fanɛ kebɔrɛnya nsaa yɔɔ ma kumu saŋkama a wɔtɔ a nya kagbenejija a shu nchɛ nchɛ to ŋkpal Juwebi be nia nɛ b daa kre ma na so. 20Men nyi fanɛ saŋɛ nɛ n daŋ bɔ kubɔya na n sa menyi nseŋ ŋini menyi asheŋ basa to nɛ menyi peana na, n daa maŋ ta kusɔ kama nɛ k beeŋ chɛ menyi to ŋ ŋana menyi so kikɛ. 21Juwebi nɛ nnyamase kikɛ nɛ n daŋ fiɛ so kpakpa fanɛ b lar bumo be alubi to a bɛ Ebɔrɛ so nseŋ yirda an Nyɛnpe Yesu. 22Naniere malɛ, kenu n sa Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na so nɛ mee yɔ Jerusalɛm a maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ ya wora ma ndoŋ na. 23Kusɔ nɛ m baa nyi e la fanɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bee fiɛ ma so kade kama to fanɛ kabuti nɛ etɔrɔ bee jo ma saŋko. Ama amo alɛ maŋ tir ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maa ta ŋ gbagba be ŋkpa ere fanɛ k la kusɔ ko ma kutɔ. 24Kusɔ nɛ k tir ma e la kananɛ meeŋ tiŋ n loge Enyɛnpe Yesu be kushuŋ nɛ e sa ma na. Kumo alɛ e la kebɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na be baru lela na. 25N yɔ menyi be ekama ere nyam kutɔ n ya bɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to be asheŋ n sa menyi, ama naniere n nyi fanɛ menyi be ekama maaŋ naŋ wu ma kikɛ. 26Amoso, m baa bugi asheŋ to nna a kaŋɛ menyi kabre nna fanɛ: Nɛ menyi be ekama baŋ foe ekpa, mannɛ ma e bar kumo, 27ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ ta kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili fanɛ e beeŋ wora na ŋ ŋana menyi so. 28Men baa de men gbagba be amuana so nsaa de basa nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na ta m bɔɔ menyi enɔ na so. Men baa keni Ebɔrɛ be asɔriebi nɛ e ta ŋ ki mo peya ashi mo gbagba Pibinyɛn be luwu na so fanɛ kananɛ asɔbɔyakpapo bee keni mbe asɔbɔya so na. 29Ŋkpal manɛ so, n nyi fanɛ ŋ kaŋ yɔ, befɛpo damta beeŋ ba menyi to m ba fin kemur asɔriebi na fanɛ kananɛ kuntuŋ bee luri mbolpɔ to a mur amo na. 30Menyi to be beko malɛ gba beeŋ koso kachako ŋ ku efɛ n shin nɛ beyirdapoana na e bɛ bumo so. 31Amoso, men baa da so a nyiŋi kananɛ n daŋ shu n fiɛ menyi so kenishipereso kapa nɛ kanyɛ nfɛ asa a ŋini menyi be ekama asheŋ na. 32Naniere, Ebɔrɛ be enɔ to nɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ be kubɔya na be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ mee ta menyi a wɔtɔ to na. Kubɔya na e naaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ menyi be kenyi e wora keshi n ti so n naŋ shin nɛ men nya nɛfa nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ a jo nɛ e sa mbe basa cheembi na. 33M maŋ yɛlga esa kama be gbiti ŋko shuwa ŋko asɔbuuso. 34Menyi gbagba nyi fanɛ ma enɔana ere nɛ n daŋ ta n shuŋ n nya asɔ nɛ a daga fanɛ ma nɛ m braana na e nya. 35M bɔla kusɔ kama to ŋ ŋini menyi fanɛ kebaashuŋ le ere nɛ anyee chɛ bepɔshipo to nsaa nyiŋi Enyɛnpe Yesu gbagba be mmalga nɛ e kaŋɛ na: ‘Kakɛ kɔ kagbenefuli a chɔ kesɔ.’ ”
36Pɔɔl ka malga n loge nɛ mo nɛ bumo kikɛ gbir ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ. 37Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo kikɛ ba kaa nyaŋ mo a mata bumo be amu kashaso a kela mo nsaa shu. 38Kusɔ nɛ k daŋ baa jija bumo be ŋgbene ga e daa la kananɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ b maaŋ naŋ wu mo kikɛ na. Ade be kaman nɛ b shuŋi mo n lar ekpa n yɔ ekuloŋgboŋ nɛ e beeŋ luri na akpa.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 21
Content:
1An ka kela bumo n loge nɛ an luri ekuloŋgboŋ na to m bɔla nchu so n ta tinini loŋ n ya fo Kɔs ŋ klade n yɔ Rodes n ya shi ndoŋ n yɔ Patara. 2Ndoŋ nɛ an ya nya ekuloŋgboŋ ko nɛ k bee shin nɛ k yɔ Fenisha nɛ an luri kumo to n yɔ. 3An ta loŋ m ba kaa wu Saipres nseŋ yige kumo anyi be bena so n lɛ nseŋ ta n yɔ Siriya n naŋ ta n ya yili Tayɛ, kakpa nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na daa sha keyaa lara kumo be esulɔ. 4Ndoŋ nɛ an ya wu beyirdapoana ko n ji bɔkwe bumo kutɔ nɛ b bɔla Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be eleŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ Pɔɔl fanɛ e sa maŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm. 5Ama anyi be keyige bumo n yɔ be saŋɛ ka ba fo nɛ an lar bumo kutɔ ndoŋ. Bumo kikɛ nɛ bumo be beche nɛ mbia e daŋ shuŋi anyi n lar kadegboŋ na to nɛ an kikɛ ya gbir shishɛr so ashi teku na ase ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ. 6Kumo be kaman nɛ an kela abar ŋkeŋ shin nɛ an luri ekuloŋgboŋ na to nɛ bumo alɛ bɛta n yɔ epe.
7An ka naŋ fara anyi be enite na nɛ an lar Tayɛ n yɔ Petɔlemeeyis n ya ji kachɛ koŋwule ndoŋ n chɔrɔ bekurgepoana na. 8Kumo be ŋklade nɛ an lar ndoŋ n yɔ Sizariya n ya luri baru lela malgapo Filip pe. E daa la basa ashunu nɛ bebɛsopoana na daŋ lara Jerusalɛm na be eko nna. 9E daa kɔ mo gbagba be mbichebi kurgeso bena. B daa la anebicheana nna a wɔtɔ a maŋ kil. 10An daŋ wora nchɛnnyɔ nɛ anebi ko nɛ baa tre Agabes na ya shi Judiya m ba. 11E ka ba anyi kutɔ nɛ e ba ta Pɔɔl be kreso ŋ kre mo gbagba be aya nɛ enɔana nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Le nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ: ‘Le nɛ Jerusalɛm to be Juwebi na beeŋ kre kreso ere wura nseŋ ta mo m bɔɔ nnyamase enɔ.’ ” 12An ka nu loŋ nɛ anyi nɛ basa na kule Pɔɔl fanɛ e sa maŋ naŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm. 13Nɛ e bishi bumo: “Manɛ so nɛ menyee wora le ere nsaa shu le a jija ma kagbene? Ŋkpal Enyɛnpe Yesu so meeŋ shuli fanɛ b mɔ ma ashi Jerusalɛm to gba, a bishi kekre ma ndoŋ.” 14An daa maŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ e chɛrga mbe nfɛra, amoso, an daŋ yige mo nna nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Kusɔ kama nɛ Enyɛnpe yili e wora loŋ.”
15An ka wora nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ nɛ an bela ase n yɔ Jerusalɛm. 16Anyi nɛ Sizariya be bebɛsopo na be beko e daŋ yɔ nɛ b keta anyi n yɔ anyi be kowurnyɛn Meneesɔn pe. E daŋ shi Saipres nna a la ebɛsopo ashi mbe kebiato kikɛ.
Pɔɔl ka ya chɔrɔ Jeems be asheŋ
17An ka ba Jerusalɛm nɛ bekurgepoana na bugi kagbene n sɔ anyi kagbenefuliso 18Kumo be ŋklade nɛ anyi nɛ Pɔɔl yɔ nɛ an ya chɔrɔ Jeems. Saŋɛ na so nɛ asɔriebi be benimuana na kikɛ wɔ ndoŋ. 19Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pɔɔl chɔrɔ bumo nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla mo so n wora nnyamase to kikɛ nyam. 20B ka nu mbe kamalga na nɛ bumo kikɛ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ Pɔɔl: “Fo wu ai, ekurgepo, Jerusalɛm ere to be Juwebi damta gba ki beyirdapo naniere, ama bumo alɛ kraa mɔ bumo be amu nna a bɛ Mosis be mbra na so. 21Basa kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ fo wɔtɔ nna a ŋini Juwebi nɛ b wɔ nnyamase be efuliana so nna fanɛ b yige kebaabɛ Mosis be mbra na so. B yɛ fo yɛ, b sa maa ku bumo be mbia atutu, bumo alɛ e sa maa bɛ Juwebi be edaŋkare na so. 22Bumo be kenu fanɛ fo ba malɛ baŋ fuli nna, amoso, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora? 23Wora kusɔ nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ fo ere. Benyɛn ana ko nase kɔnɔ n sa Ebɔrɛ a wɔ nfe. 24Ya ti bumo so nɛ b fɔr fo nɛ bumo be eyurpi n lɛ nseŋ shin nɛ fo ka bumo be eyurpi be kefɔr n lɛ be kukɔ n sa bumo nɛ b tiŋ n shin nɛ b she bumo be amu. Loŋ nɛ ekama beeŋ pin fanɛ asɔ nɛ b nu na kikɛ la efɛ nna, ŋkpal fo gbagba ka bee bɛ Mosis be mbra na so so. 25To, nnyamase nɛ b ki bebɛsopo na malɛ, an sibɛ kawɔl n shuŋi bumo fanɛ b sa maŋ naa ji nlɔŋɛjibi ŋko ŋklaŋ ŋko a we kusɔbɔya kama nɛ b maŋ teŋ, nseŋ naŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa gelge kubojuaji gba.” 26Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pɔɔl shin nɛ mo nɛ basa na yɔ ŋ klade n ya wora bumo be kefɔr n lɛ be daŋkaresheŋ na nseŋ shin nɛ e yɔ bɔrɛlambu na to n ya kaŋɛ kachɛ nɛ baa loge eyurpi be kefɔr n lɛ be daŋkare na nseŋ lara basa na be ekama be sarga.
B ka pɛ Pɔɔl ashi bɔrɛlambu na to be asheŋ
27Nchɛnshunu na ka taga to nɛ Eeshia be kasawule so be Juwebi ko wu Pɔɔl bɔrɛlambu na to nseŋ we n wɔtɔ jimaŋ na kikɛ nseŋ nyaŋ Pɔɔl 28m ponte ŋ kaŋɛ: “Israɛlebi, men ba chɛ to. Kanyɛn nɛ e na kaplɛkama a ŋini basa kikɛ asheŋ nɛ a bee da Israɛlebi nɛ Mosis be mbra na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na so e ba nfe hale m bar nnyamase bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ b ba jija kumo kananɛ k du cheembi na.” 29B ka daŋ wu Trɔfimes nɛ e shi Ɛfeses nɛ Pɔɔl kade na to so nɛ b daŋ tama fanɛ Pɔɔl daŋ keta mo nna n luri bɔrɛlambu na to. 30Ndoŋ nna nɛ kadegboŋ na to ebi kikɛ luri kebagato to nɛ basa na kikɛ shile m ba abar so m ba nyaŋ Pɔɔl ŋ gberge mo n lar bɔrɛlambu na to nseŋ ti bɔrɛlambu na be mbuna epul na to. 31Jimaŋ yenso na daa sha kemɔ Pɔɔl nna nɛ esa ko ya kaŋɛ Romebi be benapo be enimu na fanɛ Jerusalɛmebi nyaŋɛ to. 32Epul na to nɛ enimu na lara ekrachi ko nɛ benapo ko nɛ b bɛ mo so n nya manaŋ n yɔ jimaŋ na to. B ka baŋ wu mo nɛ benapo na nɛ b yige Pɔɔl be kebri. 33Nɛ enimu na yɔ Pɔɔl kutɔ n ya shin nɛ b pɛ mo nseŋ shin nɛ b ta ŋgbɛlɛbi anyɔ ŋ kre mo. Kumo be kaman nɛ e bishi: “Nuso be esa e la kanyɛn ere, nɛ manɛ nɛ e wora?” 34Ndoŋ nna nɛ jimaŋ na gbar n juge to. Kebagato na be keshi na so benapo be enimu na daa maŋ tiŋ m pin kusɔ nɛ k baŋ wora, amoso, e daŋ shin nɛ mbe benapo keta Pɔɔl nna n yɔ kesɔnyige be ebu lempo na to. 35Ebu na be kabondiikpa nawule nɛ b daŋ fo nɛ benapo na maŋ mo so ŋkpal kananɛ jimaŋ yenso na nyaŋɛ to na so. 36Bumo kikɛ daa shil nna a buu mo a ponte a kaŋɛ: “Men mɔ mo.”
Kananɛ Pɔɔl malga ŋ kuŋ mbe kumu be asheŋ
37B ka daa shin nɛ b ta Pɔɔl n luri kesɔnyige be ebu lempo na to nɛ e malga benapo be enimu na kutɔ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Jande, shin nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo kusɔ ko.” Nɛ benapo be enimu na bishi mo: “Fee nu Griik to a? 38Kumo ere, mannɛ fo e la Ijipt be kanyɛn nɛ e daŋ koso jemanɛ ko so a kɔ mbe abane kena nseŋ keta benapo yenso ŋgboŋ ana n luri kiyi to nna ŋko?” 39Nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ: “N la Juw nna ashi Silisia be Taases nɛ k maŋ la kade fɔmbi na. Jande shin nɛ m malga n sa basa ere.” 40Ndoŋ nna nɛ benapo be enimu na sa Pɔɔl ekpa nɛ e yili ebu na be kabondiikpa nseŋ wora basa na enɔ nɛ b la to nɛ e malga Hibruw to ŋ kaŋɛ:

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 22
Content:
1“M braana nɛ n tutoana, men lo to n nu ma kamalga nɛ mee sha kemalga ŋ kuŋ ma kumu ashi menyi kutɔ ere.” 2B ka nu e ka bee malga Hibruw to nɛ bumo kikɛ wora shruum a chɔ sososo b ka fara n lo to na nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ: 3“N la Juw nna ashi Silisia be Taases, ama Jerusalɛm to nfe nɛ b bela ma nɛ Gameelial daa la ma eŋinipo. Kananɛ k daga fanɛ esa e bɛ an nanaana be mbra na so na nɛ b daŋ ŋini ma nɛ n ta ma kumu m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nɛ n shuŋ mbe kushuŋ fanɛ kananɛ menyi kikɛ nfe ere bee wora na. 4N daŋ tɔrɔ basa nɛ b bɛ le be ekpa ere na so hale a sha kemɔ bumo kikɛ. Beche nɛ benyɛn kikɛ nɛ n daŋ pɛ n shin nɛ b ti ebu. 5Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nɛ nshɛrwuraana na kikɛ e la ma shɛdajipoana. Bumo kutɔ nɛ n daa sɔ nwɔl a yɔ bekurgepo Juwebi nɛ b wɔ Damaskɔs na kutɔ nɛ b sa ma ekpa nɛ m pɛ loŋ be basa na ŋ kre bumo ŋgbɛlɛbi m ba Jerusalɛm to nfe m ba kaa shin nɛ baa gberge bumo kusoe.
Pɔɔl ka malga kananɛ e ba ki ebɛsopo be asheŋ
6Kachako ŋ ka wɔ loŋ be enite na to m ba kaa taga to Damaskɔs kapaso ko nɛ kefultogboŋ ko nyaŋɛ n shi ebɔrɛso m ba yuu ma so. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ n tɔr kasawule nseŋ nu ebɔl ka bee bishi ma: ‘Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl, manɛ e ba nɛ fee tɔrɔ ma?’ 8Nɛ m bishi: ‘Fo wanɛ, Enyɛnpe?’ Nɛ e kaŋɛ: ‘Ma Nazarɛt be Yesu nɛ fee tɔrɔ na.’ 9Ma nɛ basa nɛ b daa la na daŋ wu kefulto na, ama b daa maŋ nu esa nɛ e daŋ malga n sa ma na be ebɔl na. 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ m bishi: ‘Nɛ nuso nɛ meeŋ wora Enyɛnpe?’ Nɛ Enyɛnpe na kaŋɛ ma: ‘Niŋi to ŋ koso n luri Damaskɔs nɛ b kaŋɛ fo kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha fanɛ fo wora.’ 11Ŋkpal kefultogboŋ na so n daŋ tan nna, amoso, m braana na e daŋ pɛ ma enɔ to n luri Damaskɔs to. 12Kanyɛn ko daa wɔtɔ a la abɔrɛshenshapo a bɛ anyi be mbra na so nɛ baa tre mo Ananiyas. Damaskɔs to be Juwebi na kikɛ daa sa mo bunyaŋ nna. 13Mo e daŋ ba yili ma kutɔ ŋ kaŋɛ ma: ‘Ekurgepo Sɔɔl, naŋ bɛta a wu.’ Epul na malɛ to nɛ n naŋ nya ma anishi n wu mo. 14Nɛ e kaŋɛ: ‘An nanaana be Ebɔrɛ na e lara fo fanɛ fo pin kusɔ nɛ e bee sha kewora nseŋ shin nɛ fo wu mbe Kenya cheembi na n naŋ shin nɛ fo nu mbe ebɔl na. 15Ŋkpal manɛ so, feeŋ ki mbe shɛdajipo ŋ kaŋɛ basa kikɛ mbe kusɔ nɛ fo wu nɛ kusɔ nɛ fo nu be asheŋ. 16Amoso, sa maŋ naŋ jo, koso n shin nɛ b bɛr fo kabɔrɛbɛr a ti Yesu be ketre na nɛ Ebɔrɛ e fɔr fo alubi n lɛ.’
B ka tre Pɔɔl nnyamase to be asheŋ
17Kumo be kaman nɛ m bɛta m ba Jerusalɛm m ba kaa kule Ebɔrɛ bɔrɛlambu na to nseŋ ku bɔrɛdare n wu Enyɛnpe Yesu nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: 18‘Nya manaŋ n lar Jerusalɛm, ŋkpal manɛ so, nfe be basa ere maaŋ yirda ma shɛda nɛ fee sha keji n sa bumo ere.’ 19Nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ: ‘Enyɛnpe, b baa nyi geeŋ ŋ ka daŋ yɔ nshɛrbuana to n ya pɛ basa nɛ b yirda fo na nseŋ bri bumo. 20Saŋɛ nɛ baa mɔ fo shɛdajipo Stiven na nɛ ma alɛ gba yil a keni mbe bemɔpo na be asɔbuuso so nsaa kaŋɛ fanɛ kashenteŋto e daga luwu.’ 21Nɛ Enyɛnpe kaŋɛ ma: ‘Lar nɛ n shuŋi fo kufɔ kufɔ nnyamase kutɔ.’ ”
22Pɔɔl ka bee malga asheŋ na kikɛ nɛ basa na bee nu. Ama e ka ba malga keyɔ nnyamase na kutɔ be asheŋ nɛ b fara a ponte ga a kaŋɛ: “Men lara mo durnya ere to. Men mɔ mo!” 23B daŋ baa ponte to nna a kpa bumo be nle a lɛ nsaa jɔ shishɛr a lɛ esoso. 24Nɛ Romebi be benapo be enimu na shin nɛ mbe benapo ba keta Pɔɔl n yɔ kesɔnyige be ebu lempo na to nseŋ shin nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b kuya Pɔɔl so nɛ e kaŋɛ bumo kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ Juwebi na bee boŋ to a malga a gbiti mo loŋ na. 25B ka kre mo nɛ b kuya mo so nɛ Pɔɔl bishi enapo nimusobi ko nɛ e daa yil ndoŋ na le: “Ekpa wɔtɔ fanɛ b kuya Rom be efuli so be esa so nɛ b maŋ ji mo demu ŋ keni a?” 26Enapo nimusobi na ka nu loŋ na nɛ e yɔ benapo be enimu na kutɔ n ya bishi mo: “Manɛ nɛ fo yɛ fo wora ere? Kanyɛn na la Rom be esa nna.” 27Ndoŋ nna nɛ benapo be enimu na yɔ Pɔɔl kutɔ n ya bishi mo: “Kaŋɛ ma, Rom be esa e la fo a?” Nɛ Pɔɔl shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Mm.” 28Nɛ benapo be enimu na kaŋɛ: “Amansherbi damta nɛ ŋ ka n sa abane pɔɛŋ nseŋ ki Rom be esa.” Nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ: “Ma ere, b kurge ma Rom be esa nna.” 29Epul na to nɛ basa nɛ b daa sha nɛ b bishi Pɔɔl asheŋ na bɛta kaman nɛ kufu pɛ benapo be enimu na gba ŋkpal e ka pin Pɔɔl ka la Rom be esa nɛ ŋkpal e ka shin nɛ b ta ŋgbɛlɛbi ŋ kre mo so so.
30Benapo be enimu na daa sha kepin kusɔ nɛ k baŋ ba nɛ Juwebi na nɛ Pɔɔl daŋ baa kɔ abar loŋ nna. Amoso, kare ka chɛ nɛ e shin nɛ b saŋɛ Pɔɔl be ŋgbɛlɛbi na nseŋ shin nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ nshɛrwuraana na kikɛ shɛr nɛ e shin nɛ Pɔɔl ba yili bumo be anishito.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 23
Content:
1Nɛ Pɔɔl keni nshɛrwuraana na diimbi nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Ŋ kurgepoana, hale kabre ma kagbene to maa wora ma shikashika Ebɔrɛ be anishito fanɛ m maŋ kɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi.” 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Ananiyas shin nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ yili n taga to Pɔɔl na ŋmɛa Pɔɔl be kɔnɔ. 3Nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ mo: “Kebirkɔnshiwura ere! Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ŋmɛa fo kɔnɔ loŋ. Fo yɛ fo chena nfe nna nɛ fo bɔla ekpa nɛ mbra na bee ŋini na so n ji demu, ama ma nɛ fee shin nɛ baa ŋmɛa n naa wora a da mbra na so na.” 4Nɛ basa nɛ b yili n taga to Pɔɔl na kaŋɛ mo: “Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nɛ fee tege ere a?” 5Nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ: “Ŋ kurgepoana, n daa maŋ nyi fanɛ e la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: ‘Sa maŋ kaŋ malga kamalga lubi ŋ gbiti fo basa be enimu.’ ” 6Pɔɔl ka wu fanɛ basa na be beko la Esadusiana nna nɛ beko malɛ la Efarisiana nɛ e malga awɔrso n sa nshɛrwuraana na ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ŋ kurgepoana, Farisinyɛn e kurge ma nɛ ma alɛ naa la Farisi. Baa ji ma demu nfe ere nna, ŋkpal ŋ ka kɔ tama kpakpaso fanɛ bumo nɛ b wu na ka beeŋ tiŋi luwu to so.” 7E ka malga loŋ epul na to nɛ Efarisiana na nɛ Esadusiana na fara a bile nɛ basa na kikɛ barga to ntuŋ anyɔ so. 8Ŋkpal manɛ so, Esadusiana bee kaŋɛ fanɛ basa maaŋ tiŋi luwu to nseŋ naa kaŋɛ fanɛ emalaika ŋko ayoyu maŋ wɔtɔ, ama Efarisiana daŋ yirda amo asa na kikɛ. 9Ndoŋ nna nɛ bumo be kaponte na naŋ dii ga nɛ mbraŋinipoana nɛ b la Efarisiana na be beko niŋi to n yili m ponte eleŋso ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b maŋ shuli ŋ kaŋɛ: “Anyi ere maŋ wu kulubi kikɛ kanyɛn ere so. Ashere kiyoyu ko ŋko malaika e malga mo kutɔ kashenteŋto na.” 10Bumo be kolu na daŋ nyaŋɛ to ga hale basa na be kegberge Pɔɔl n tuge to be asheŋ pɛ benapo be enimu na kufu ga. Nɛ e shin nɛ mbe benapo luri basa na to ŋ keta Pɔɔl n lar bumo to n yɔ kesɔnyige be ebu lempo na to.
11Kumo be kamɔnchɛ be kanyɛso nɛ Enyɛnpe ba yili Pɔɔl kutɔ nseŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Baa kɔ kenyɛn. Kananɛ fo ji ma shɛda ashi Jerusalɛm to ere nɛ fee naŋ yɔ Rom malɛ n ya wora.”
Juwebi ka kre Pɔɔl be kemɔ be nia be asheŋ
12Kumo be ŋklade nɛ Juwebi na shɛr ŋ kre bumo be nia nseŋ sa Ebɔrɛ kɔnɔ fanɛ b baa maŋ mɔ Pɔɔl b maaŋ ji ajibi, bumo alɛ maaŋ nuu shɛŋ. 13Basa nɛ b daŋ yili kusɔ ere le na kikɛ daa chɔ basa adena. 14B ka sa kɔnɔ na n loge nɛ b yɔ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ benimuana na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ bumo: “An ba abar so nna m ba sa kɔnɔ kpakpaso fanɛ an baa maŋ mɔ Pɔɔl, an maaŋ ji shɛŋ. 15Amoso, menyi nɛ nshɛrwuraana na e kute n shuŋi kabɔ nɛ e ya kaŋɛ Romebi be benapo be enimu na fanɛ e shin nɛ b bar Pɔɔl menyi kutɔ nɛ e ba malga nɛ men pin mbe demu na to nɛnɛ. Saŋɛ na so nɛ anyee jo mo ekpa to n nya mo m mɔ nɛ e maŋ fo nfe.”
16Ndoŋ nna nɛ Pɔɔl mo sipoche pibi nu bumo be nia na nseŋ ya luri kesɔnyige be ebu lempo na to n ya kaŋɛ Pɔɔl kesheŋ na. 17Nɛ Pɔɔl tre benapo be benimuwurbiana na be eko ŋ kaŋɛ mo: “Keta kabrantiɛbia ere n yɔ benapo be enimu na kutɔ. E bee sha kekaŋɛ mo kusɔ ko nna.” 18Nɛ benapo be enimubi na juŋkpar ŋ keta mo n yɔ benapo be enimu na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo: “Pɔɔl kabutipo na e tre ma ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ŋ keta kabrantiɛbia ere m ba fo kutɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e kɔ kusɔ ko nna nɛ e kaŋɛ fo.” 19Ndoŋ nna nɛ benapo be enimu na gbagba pɛ kabrantiɛbia na be enɔ to nseŋ keta mo n lar ekarso m bishi mo: “Manɛ nɛ fee sha kekaŋɛ ma?” 20Nɛ e yɛ: “Juwebi na yili kumo fanɛ baaŋ kute ŋ kule fo echefo fanɛ fo keta Pɔɔl m ba nshɛrwuraana na kutɔ nɛ e malga nɛ b pin mbe demu na to nɛnɛ. 21Ama kplaŋ bumo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa ko chɔ basa adena ŋ ŋana a jo mo. Amo be basa na kikɛ bɔ ntaŋ nna fanɛ b maŋ mɔ Pɔɔl, b maaŋ ji ajibi, bumo alɛ maaŋ nuu shɛŋ. B bela ase nɛ b wora loŋ nsaa jo nɛ b nu kusɔ nɛ feeŋ kaŋɛ.” 22Nɛ benapo be enimu na kaŋɛ mo: “Sa maŋ kaŋɛ esa kikɛ fanɛ fo e kute le be kesheŋ ere n sa ma kikɛ.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ kabrantiɛbia na yɔ.
B ka keta Pɔɔl n yɔ Gomena Filiks kutɔ be asheŋ
23Kumo be kaman nɛ benapo be enimu na tre mbe benapowurbi benyɔ ko ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Men shin nɛ benapo alfa anyɔ nɛ egbaŋɛdiipoana be benapo adushunu nɛ akpawuraana be benapo alfa anyɔ e bela ase nɛ men yɔ Sizariya. Menyeeŋ koso nfe kerfi akpanu kanyɛ ere. 24Men fin egbaŋɛ n sa Pɔɔl nɛ e dii nɛ men keni mo so nɛnɛ n yɛr mo nɛ alenfia n ya sa Gomena Filiks.” 25Kumo be kaman nɛ benapo be enimu na sibɛ kawɔl ŋ kaŋɛ:
26“Ma, Klawdias Lisias e naa sibɛ kawɔl ere a sa fo, ebunyampogboŋ Gomena Filiks na. Mee chɔrɔ fo. 27Juwebi e daŋ nyaŋ kanyɛn ere a sha kemɔ mo nɛ n nu fanɛ e la Rom be esa nna nseŋ keta ma benapo n ya mɔlga mo bumo kutɔ. 28N daa sha kenu kusɔ nɛ e wora bumo nna, 29ŋkpal loŋ so ŋ keta mo n yɔ nshɛrwuraana na kutɔ n ya wu fanɛ e maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ nɛ k daga mbe luwu ŋko kabuti. Bumo gbagba be mbraana be emɔrɔsheŋ nɛ b kɔ a wu mo kulubi. 30Ma alɛ nu fanɛ Juwebi na bee kre mbe kemɔ be nia nna, amoso nɛ n shin nɛ b kɔ mo a ba fo kutɔ na. Ŋ kaŋɛ basa nɛ bumo nɛ mo kɔ abar na fanɛ b ba kaŋɛ fo alubi nɛ e wora.”
31Ndoŋ nna nɛ benapo na wora asɔ nɛ benapo be enimu na kaŋɛ bumo na kikɛ ŋ keta Pɔɔl kanyɛso na kikɛ hale n ya fo Antipatris. 32Kumo be ŋklade nɛ aya so be benapo na yili Antipatris m bɛta n yɔ kesɔnyige be ebu lempo na to ŋ ka egbaŋɛdiipoana nɛ bumo nɛ Pɔɔl e baa yɔ. 33B ka fo Sizariya nɛ b ta kawɔl na n sa gomena na nseŋ ta Pɔɔl m bɔɔ mo enɔ. 34Gomena na ka kraŋ kawɔl na nɛ e bishi Pɔɔl efuli na so be kaba mo nɛ e shi. E ka pin fanɛ Silisia nɛ e shi 35nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Basa nɛ baa wu fo kulubi na kaŋ ba, meeŋ keni fo demu na to.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ benapo na ta Pɔɔl n yɔ kowu nɛ Hɛrɔd daŋ pɔr na to n ya kaa keni mo so.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 24
Content:
Juwebi na ka kaŋɛ fanɛ Pɔɔl wora kulubi be asheŋ
1Kumo be nchɛ anu be kefɛato nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Ananiyas nɛ benimu ko nɛ mbraŋinipo nɛ baa tre Tetales yɔ Sizariya n ya kaŋɛ Gomena Filiks ashi demujikpa na kulubi nɛ Pɔɔl wora. 2B ka tre Tetales, nɛ e ba fara le a kaŋɛ alubi nɛ Pɔɔl wora: “Ebunyampogboŋ, ŋkpal fo kanyiasheŋ so nɛ fo tiŋ n juŋkpar anyi n shin nɛ an nya kagbenewushi saŋɛ kikɛ m ba fo mbre nɛ asheŋ lela damta tiŋ n wora anyi be efuli ere so nɛ kumo be ketre dii na. 3Saŋkama kumo be loŋ bee par anyi ga kaplɛkama. Anyee chɔrɔ fo ga ŋkpal loŋ so. 4M maa sha fanɛ m baa kɔ kechɛchɛrase nfe a wora fo, amoso, mee kule fo nna fanɛ fo wora ania n nu anyi be kamalga shiimbi ere. 5An wu fanɛ kanyɛn ere la esa lubi nɛ kabɔlarwura nna. E wɔtɔ nna a yɔ kaplɛkama n ya kaa ta Juwebi a wɔtɔ kebagato to nseŋ naa la basa nɛ baa tre bumo be amu Nazarinebi be katuŋ na to be enimu. 6Ade be kaman nɛ e daa naa sha kejija bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ an pɛ mo. [An daa sha nɛ an bɔla anyi be mbra na so nna n ji mo demu 7nɛ benapo be enimu Lisias ba suge mo eleŋso anyi kutɔ, 8nseŋ yili demu na fanɛ basa nɛ bumo nɛ kanyɛn na kɔ abar e ba fo kutɔ.] Fo gbagba baŋ bishi kanyɛn na, feeŋ pin alubi nɛ e wora na kikɛ nyam.”
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ Juwebi na kikɛ shuli n chɛ Tetales to ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ alubi nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ Pɔɔl wora na kikɛ la kashenteŋ nna.
Pɔɔl ka malga ŋ kuŋ mbe kumu be asheŋ
10Ade be kaman nɛ gomena na wora Pɔɔl enɔ fanɛ e malga nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ: “Fo ka fara a ji efuli ere so ebi demu k chɛr ga kabre. Amoso, k par ma ga ŋ ka bee sha kemalga ŋ kuŋ ma kumu fo anishito ere. 11Yili kachɛ nɛ n yɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ n ya bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na m ba fo kabre maŋ naŋ fo nchɛ kuduanyɔ. Nɛ fee sha, fo bishi n nu. 12Juwebi na maŋ wu ŋ ka bee ji esa kikɛ emɔrɔ ashi bɔrɛlambu na to, bumo alɛ maŋ wu ŋ ka bee we a wɔtɔ basa ashi bumo be nshɛrbuana to ŋko kadegboŋ na to be kaplɛkama. 13Bumo alɛ maŋ kɔ shɛŋ nɛ b ta ŋ ŋini fo fanɛ asheŋ nɛ baa malga ere la kashenteŋ nna. 14Kashenteŋto, an nanaana be Ebɔrɛ na nɛ mee bɔla ekpa nɛ b yɛ k la efɛ na so a bunyaŋ. N yirda asɔ nɛ a wɔ Mosis be mbra na to nɛ anebiana na be nwɔl na to kikɛ nyam. 15Tama koŋwule nɛ basa ere kɔ Ebɔrɛ so na nɛ ma alɛ gba kɔ, kumo e la fanɛ basa lela nɛ belubi kikɛ nyam beeŋ ba tiŋi luwu to. 16Amoso, saŋkama mee wora ania nna nɛ m baa kɔ kagbene koŋwule nɛ k maa wora ma shikashika ashi ma nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ nyiŋgbasa be kebaawɔtɔ to. 17Ŋ ka lar Jerusalɛm kumo be nfɛ damta nde kabre, nɛ n naŋ bɛta n ta amansherbi nɛ n ya kɛ ma basa nseŋ lara sarga. 18Le be kesheŋ ere nɛ n daa wɔ bɔrɛlambu na to a wora nɛ b wu ma. Saŋɛ na so nɛ n wora kefɔr eyurpi n lɛ be daŋkare na be asheŋ n loge. Jimaŋ kikɛ daa maŋ wɔ ma kutɔ, kebagato malɛ kikɛ daa maŋ wɔtɔ. 19Ama Eeshia be efuli so be Juwebi ko malɛ daa wɔtɔ, amoso, a daga fanɛ bumo alɛ gba ka ba nfe m ba kaŋɛ fo alubi nɛ b wu ma so nɛ fanɛ b wu alubi ma so nna na. 20Ŋko fo shin nɛ basa ere e kaŋɛ fo kulubi nɛ b wu ma so, saŋɛ nɛ n daŋ yili nshɛrwuraana na kutɔ na. 21Kusɔ koŋwule nɛ n daŋ ba n yili bumo to ndoŋ ŋ kaŋɛ e la: ‘Menyee ji ma demu kabre nna ŋkpal ŋ ka yirda fanɛ bumo nɛ b wu na kikɛ ka beeŋ tiŋi luwu to so.’ ”
22Ndoŋ nna nɛ Filiks nɛ e daŋ nu Enyɛnpe be ekpa na be asheŋ ga ŋ ku so na shin nɛ b yige demu na be kenu nseŋ shin nɛ e kaŋɛ basa na: “Benapo be enimu Lisias kaŋ ba, meeŋ keni menyi be demu na to.” 23Kumo be kaman nɛ e shin nɛ benapo be enimubi nɛ e daa de Pɔɔl so na keta Pɔɔl n ya kaa de mo so. Ama e daŋ sa mo ekpa n shin nɛ mo teriana daa tiŋ a chɛ mo to kanaŋkamaso nɛ b daa sha.
Pɔɔl ka malga n sa Filiks nɛ Drusila be asheŋ
24Kachako malɛ nɛ Filiks keta mbe eche Drusila nɛ e daa la Juw na m ba shin nɛ b ya bar Pɔɔl nɛ e ba malga keyirda Yesu Kristo be asheŋ nɛ e nu. 25Ama Pɔɔl ka ba kaa malga alela be kebaawora nɛ kamootiŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be demujiachɛ be asheŋ nɛ kufu pɛ Filiks nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Feeŋ tiŋ a yɔ naniere. N naŋ nya kachena meeŋ naŋ tre fo.” 26Saŋkama e daa tama fanɛ Pɔɔl beeŋ sa mo amansherbi nna. Amoso, e daa sha kebaatre mo a malga mo kutɔ ga. 27B wɔtɔ loŋ nɛ nfɛ anyɔ ba choŋ nɛ Pɔkias Fɛstes ba sɔ mo so a la gomena. Ŋkpal kenya ketre Juwebi na kutɔ so, Filiks daŋ yige Pɔɔl kabuti na to nna nseŋ yɔ.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 25
Content:
Pɔɔl ka bee sha keyɔ Romebi be ewurgboŋ na kutɔ be asheŋ
1Fɛstes ka ba kasawule na so mbe kachɛ sasopo nɛ e yili Sizariya n yɔ Jerusalɛm. 2Nɛ bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ Juwebi be benimuana na ba kaa kaŋɛ mo alubi nɛ Pɔɔl wora. 3Kumo be kaman nɛ b kule Fɛstes fanɛ e wora ania n chɛ bumo to n shin nɛ Pɔɔl e ba Jerusalɛm. B ka daŋ kre Pɔɔl be kemɔ ekpa to be nia so nɛ b daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ na. 4Nɛ Fɛstes kaŋɛ: “Pɔɔl wɔ kabuti to ashi Sizariya, ma alɛ gbagba maaŋ chɛr nseŋ bɛta n yɔ Sizariya. 5Amoso, men shin nɛ menyi be benimu e tu ma n yɔ Sizariya n ya kaŋɛ alubi nɛ e wora nɛ fanɛ e wora amo nna na.” 6Kumo be kaman nɛ Fɛstes naŋ ji fanɛ nchɛ burwa ŋko nchɛ kudu basa na be kade na to pɔɛŋ nseŋ naŋ bɛta n yɔ Sizariya. Kumo be ŋklade nɛ e ya chena mbe kakpa nɛ e ji demu n shin nɛ b ya bar Pɔɔl. 7Pɔɔl ka ba nɛ Juwebi nɛ b shi Jerusalɛm m ba na yili ŋ kulti mo nseŋ malga kenishipereso be asheŋ lubi damta mo nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ e wora, ama bumo alɛ daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini fanɛ asheŋ nɛ b daa malga na la kashenteŋ. 8Nɛ Pɔɔl malga le ŋ kuŋ mbe kumu: “M maŋ wora shɛŋ n da Juwebi be mbra na ŋko bɔrɛlambu na ŋko Romebi be ewurgboŋ na so.” 9Ŋkpal kenya ketre Juwebi na kutɔ so, Fɛstes daŋ bishi Pɔɔl nna: “Fee sha keyɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ n ya ji fo asheŋ nɛ b yɛ fo wora ere be demu ndoŋ a?” 10Nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ: “Romebi be ewurgboŋ na be demujikpa gbagba ere to nɛ m baa yil nɛ b ji ma demu na. Fo gbagba baa nyi fanɛ m maŋ wora Juwebi na shɛŋ. 11Nɛ n daŋ wora kusɔ ko nna n da mbra na so nɛ k daga ma luwu, n daa maaŋ gelge kumo be loŋ. Ama nɛ kashenteŋ maŋ wɔ asheŋ nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ n wora ere to, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ta ma m bɔɔ bumo enɔ. Romebi be ewurgboŋ na nɛ mee kule fanɛ e keni ma demu na to.” 12Ndoŋ nna nɛ Fɛstes bishi mbe beyaasepo kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora Pɔɔl pɔɛŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ Pɔɔl: “Fo yɛ Romebi be ewurgboŋ na e keni fo demu na to, amoso, mo kutɔ nɛ feeŋ yɔ!”
Fɛstes ka kaŋɛ Ewura Agripa Pɔɔl be asheŋ
13Kede be kaman saŋko nɛ Ewura Agripa nɛ Benis ba Sizariya nɛ b ba chɔrɔ Fɛstes n wora mo ansaŋ nɛ keba. 14B wora nchɛnnyɔ ndoŋ nɛ kachako nɛ Fɛstes kaŋɛ ewura na Pɔɔl be asheŋ fanɛ: “Filiks yige kabutipo ko nfe. 15Ŋ ka yɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ Juwebi be bɔrɛmatapowuraana na nɛ benimuana na ba kaŋɛ ma asheŋ lubi nɛ b wu mo so nseŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e wora n da so. 16Ama ŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ Romebi maa shin nɛ baa gberge esa kusoe ŋkpal kulubi kama so she mo nɛ basa nɛ b kɔ abar na ba yili nna geeŋ nɛ e malga n sɔ mbe kumu ashi kulubi nɛ b yɛ e wora na to. 17Bumo kikɛ ka kpal loŋ so m ba nfe nɛ n nya manaŋ kumo be ŋklade n ya chena demujikpa n shin nɛ b bar amo be kanyɛn. 18Ama basa nɛ bumo nɛ mo daa kɔ abar na daa maŋ tiŋ n wu mo kenishipereso be alubi nɛ n daa tama fanɛ baaŋ wu mo na be kekama. 19Bumo gbagba be kabɔrɛshuŋ nɛ ebuninyɛn ko nɛ baa tre Yesu na be emɔrɔana nawule be asheŋ nɛ b daa kɔ. Pɔɔl bee kaŋɛ nna fanɛ amo be kanyɛn na wɔ ŋkpa to. 20N daa maŋ nyi ekpa nɛ meeŋ bɔla so n naŋ nu kusɔ ko n ti so m pin bumo be demu na to nseŋ bishi Pɔɔl fanɛ e bee sha keyɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ b ya keni demu na to a. 21Nɛ Pɔɔl kini nseŋ kule fanɛ benapo e baa keni mo so nfe nseŋ shin nɛ Romebi be ewurgboŋ na e keni mbe demu na to kacha ko. Ndoŋ nna nɛ n shin nɛ benapo bee de mo so nɛ kachako nɛ e yɔ Romebi be ewurgboŋ na kutɔ.” 22Nɛ Agripa kaŋɛ Fɛstes: “Ma alɛ gba bee sha fanɛ e malga mbe demu na nɛ n nu.” Nɛ Fɛstes shuli so ŋ kaŋɛ: “To, echefo feeŋ nu kumo ashi mbe kɔnɔ to.” 23Kumo be ŋklade nɛ Agripa nɛ Benis ba luri nshɛrkpa na bunyanso nɛ basa sa bumo kemaŋkura ga. Bumo nɛ benapo be benimuana na nɛ kade na to be benimuana na e daŋ luri nshɛrkpa na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ Fɛstes shin nɛ b ya bar Pɔɔl. 24Nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Ewura Agripa nɛ menyi nɛ men wɔ nfe ere, men keni kanyɛn ere nɛ nfe be Juwebiana na nɛ Jerusalɛm to peyaana na kikɛ bee kaŋɛ ma fanɛ e wora alubi nsaa ponte a kaŋɛ fanɛ e maŋ naŋ daga kebaawɔtɔ na. 25Ama ma alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wu kusɔ nɛ e wora n daga luwu be kasogberge. Mo alɛ naŋ kule fanɛ n shin nɛ Romebi be ewurgboŋ na gbagba e keni mbe demu na to, amoso, meeŋ shin nɛ b yɛr mo ndoŋ. 26Ama m maŋ kɔ shɛŋ nɛ n sibɛ ŋ kaŋɛ n nyɛnpe na mbe asheŋ. Amoso nɛ m bar mo menyi kutɔ nfe na, fɔnfɔŋ fo, Ewura Agripa kutɔ nɛ n tiŋ n nya kusɔ ko demu na be kaman n sibɛ. 27Ŋkpal manɛ so, a maŋ daga fo ka shin nɛ kabutipo yɔ loŋ, a maŋ sibɛ shɛŋ a ŋini ekama kulubi nɛ e wora.”

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 26
Content:
Pɔɔl ka ba malga ŋ kuŋ mbe kumu Agripa be anishito be asheŋ
1Nɛ Agripa kaŋɛ Pɔɔl: “N sa fo ekpa nɛ fo malga ŋ kuŋ fo kumu.” Nɛ Pɔɔl teŋi mbe enɔ to nseŋ fara a malga le a kuŋ mbe kumu:
2“Ewura Agripa, k la kumulela nna ga ŋ ka tiŋ n yili fo anishito nfe kabre nɛ m malga ŋ kuŋ ma kumu ashi asheŋ nɛ Juwebi na ku n deŋi ma kikɛ to. 3Kumo alɛ baŋ kukwe nna ŋkpal kananɛ fo nyi Juwebi be edaŋkareana na nɛ asheŋ nɛ b kɔ a ji abar emɔrɔana na kikɛ nɛnɛ na so. Amoso, mee kule fo fanɛ fo ji kanyiti n nu ma demu ere.
4Juwebi na kikɛ nyi ma kebaawɔtɔ nɛ n daa wɔ to saŋɛ nɛ n daa la kebibi na kikɛ. B nyi fanɛ sososo na ma efuli so nɛ Jerusalɛm to nɛ ŋ ki esa. 5Nɛ baa sha keji kashenteŋ, baaŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ dra dra na kikɛ nɛ b pin ŋ ka wɔ katuŋ nɛ k bee bɛ anyi be mbraana na so nɛnɛ a chɔ ntuŋ nɛ a ka na kikɛ na, katuŋ nɛ baa tre Efarisiana be katuŋ na. 6Ama ma e yil nfe kabre nɛ baa ji ma demu ŋkpal ŋ ka kɔ kɔnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase n sa an nanaana na be tama so. 7Kɔnɔ naseso koŋwule nɛ anyi be basa be nnaŋ kuduanyɔ ebi na bee bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ kapa nɛ kanyɛ nsaa tama kenya na gbagba chap na. Yiramu, le be tama ere malɛ so nɛ Juwebi na bee ku asheŋ a deŋi ma na. 8Manɛ e ba nɛ menyi Juwebi maaŋ tiŋ n yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee tiŋi basa luwu to?
9Ma alɛ gba daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ meeŋ wora kusɔ kama n tiŋ n jija Nazarɛt be Yesu be ketre na. 10Loŋ malɛ nɛ n daŋ wora ashi Jerusalɛm. N daa sɔ a chɛ to nna a kaŋɛ fanɛ bumo be luwu na daga bumo. 11N daa wɔtɔ nna a shin nɛ baa gberge bumo kusoe ashi nshɛrbuana na to nseŋ daa kɔ a fin kananɛ meeŋ wora nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ b maaŋ naŋ yirda Yesu na. Agbo daŋ pɛ ma ga ŋkpal bumo so nɛ n yɔ hale nde pɔtɛana to gba nɛ n ya tɔrɔ bumo.”
Pɔɔl ka malga kananɛ e ki ebɛsopo be asheŋ
12Le be kesheŋ nɛ n daŋ kule ekpa ashi bɔrɛmatapowuraana na kutɔ a yɔ Damaskɔs nɛ n ya wora. 13Yiramu, kapaso ko e daa la nɛ n wu kefulto ko ka fuli to a chɔ epeŋi n nyaŋɛ ashi ebɔrɛso m ba yuu ma nɛ basa nɛ an daa na na so. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ anyi kikɛ tɔr kasawule nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka bee bishi ma Hibruw to: ‘Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl, manɛ e ba nɛ fee tɔrɔ ma? Fo gbagba be kumu nɛ fee doro fanɛ kananɛ kena bee to keya a sela mo nyɛnpe be kekpabi a doro mo gbagba be kumu na.’ 15Nɛ m bishi: ‘Fo wanɛ Enyɛnpe?’ Nɛ Enyɛnpe na kaŋɛ: ‘Ma Yesu nɛ fee tɔrɔ na. 16Ama niŋi to ŋ koso n yili. N lar fo so nna nɛ n shin nɛ fo ki ma eshumpo. A daga fanɛ fo ya kaŋɛ basa ma asheŋ nɛ fo wu kabre ere nɛ amo nɛ meeŋ ŋini fo kachako so ere be asheŋ. 17Meeŋ mɔlga fo ashi Israɛl be basa nɛ nnyamase nɛ meeŋ shin nɛ fo yɔ bumo kutɔ ere kutɔ. 18Ya bugi bumo be anishi n shin nɛ b lar bumo be tentembiri na to m ba kefulto to. Shin nɛ b lar Setani be eleŋ to m ba Ebɔrɛ peya to n shin nɛ b yirda ma nɛ n ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo nɛ b nya bumo be kakpa ashi Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso na to.’
Pɔɔl ka malga a bɔ Yesu be kubɔya na be asheŋ
19“Amoso, Ewura Agripa, m maŋ kini kenu n sa bɔrɛdare nɛ k shi ebɔrɛso m ba ma kutɔ na. 20Damaskɔs nɛ n fara m bɔ kubɔya na nseŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ Juwebi be efuli so kikɛ nɛ nnyamase to n ya kaa bɔ kubɔya na fanɛ b lar bumo be alubi to m ba Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba kaa wora asheŋ nɛ a beeŋ ŋini fanɛ b lar bumo be alubi to kashenteŋto. 21Ŋ ka wora le ere so nɛ Juwebi na nyaŋ ma ashi bɔrɛlambu na to n fin kemɔ ma na. 22Ama Ebɔrɛ chɛ ma to hale m ba fo kabre nɛ n yili nfe a ji ma shɛda a sa ekama nyam, begboŋi nɛ bewurbi kikɛ na. Kusɔ nɛ mee malga e la kusɔ koŋwule chap nɛ anebiana nɛ Mosis gba kaŋɛ fanɛ k beeŋ wora na. 23Kumo e la fanɛ, a daga fanɛ Kristo na e ji awurfoŋ nseŋ wu n juŋkpar ekama n tiŋi luwu to ŋ ŋini Juwebi nɛ nnyamase fanɛ baaŋ tiŋ n nya kumɔlga, kumo alɛ e la kefulto bumo kutɔ.”
24Pɔɔl ka yili a malga le a kuŋ mbe kumu na nɛ Fɛstes ponte mo so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Pɔɔl, keyeŋiyeŋi e kɔ fo na. Fo kawɔl be kenyi damta ere e naa shin nɛ keyeŋiyeŋi tɔr fo so na.” 25Nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ: “Yiramu, m maa lɔ nna. Ma nɛ ma nfɛra lela nɛ kashenteŋ be mmalga nɛ mee malga na. 26Ewura Agripa, n tiŋ n ta kenyɛn m malga fo kutɔ nna ŋkpal fo ka nyi asheŋ ere kikɛ so. Ma alɛ bee tama fanɛ fo ta asheŋ na be kekama n wɔtɔ fo kagbene to, ŋkpal manɛ so, asheŋ na daa maŋ wora ŋ ŋana. 27Ewura Agripa, fo yirda anebiana na a? N nyi fo ka yirda bumo.” 28Nɛ Agripa bishi Pɔɔl: “Fo tama fanɛ feeŋ tiŋ n yili epul ere to n shin nɛ ŋ ki Kristo be ebɛsopo a?” 29Nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ: “Nɛ fo ki Kristo be ebɛsopo epul ere to ŋko kachako so gba, kusɔ nɛ mee kule Ebɔrɛ e la fanɛ e shin nɛ fo nɛ bumo nɛ b yil nfe kabre a nu kamalga ere e ba ki kananɛ n du ere. Kusɔ nɛ m maa kule nɛ men nya e la kananɛ n wɔ ŋgbɛlɛbi to ere.”
30Kumo be kaman nɛ ewura na nɛ gomena na nɛ Benis nɛ basa nɛ b ka na kikɛ koso a yɔ nsaa kaŋɛ abar: 31“Kanyɛn ere maŋ wora kusɔ kama nɛ k daga mbe luwu ŋko kabuti.” 32Nɛ Agripa kaŋɛ Fɛstes: “Nɛ kanyɛn ere daa maŋ kule fanɛ Romebi be ewurgboŋ na e keni mbe demu ere to nna, an daa beeŋ shin nɛ e lar kabuti ere to.”

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 27
Content:
Pɔɔl ka luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to n yɔ Rom be asheŋ
1B ka ba yili kumo fanɛ an luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko to m bɔla nchu so n yɔ Itali nɛ b ta Pɔɔl nɛ kabutipoana ko m bɔɔ Julias enɔ. E daa la Romebi be ewurgboŋ be benapo be katuŋ to be enimubi nna. 2Adramitiam nɛ an daŋ yili n luri ekuloŋgboŋ ko nɛ k daŋ bela ase a yil nɛ k yɔ Eeshia be efuli so be teku be nnɔ ase na to n yɔ. Anyi nɛ Masɛdonia be esa nɛ e shi Tɛsalɔnika nɛ baa tre mo Aristaakes na e daa la. 3Kumo be ŋklade nɛ an fo Saidɔn. Ndoŋ nɛ Julias wora Pɔɔl kelela n shin nɛ e lar n ya chɔrɔ mo teriana nɛ b sa mo asɔ nɛ a daga fanɛ e nya. 4An ka naŋ lar ndoŋ nɛ an kpal afu ko ka daa ber a shɛr anyi to so m bɔla Saipres so be kakpa nɛ afu na daa maa ber eleŋso na. 5An ta loŋ m ba bɔla teku na be mboŋ nɛ a taga to Silisia nɛ Pamfilia be efuliana so na, n naŋ ta ndoŋ m ba fo Maira nɛ k wɔ Lisia na. 6Ndoŋ nɛ benapo be enimubi na ba nya Alɛkzaandria be ekuloŋgboŋ ko nɛ k daa sha keyɔ Itali nɛ e shin nɛ an luri kumo to. 7Ŋkpal afu na so ekuloŋgboŋ na daŋ nite nchu na so nna boeŋ boeŋ loŋ nchɛ damta ko pɔɛŋ nɛ an ba kpar Kenaidas so n yɔ. Ŋkpal kananɛ afu na daa ber a shɛr anyi to na so an daa maŋ tiŋ m bɔla kakpa nɛ an daŋ bɔla so na n yɔ anishito, amoso, Kriit be kepla na so be kakpa nɛ k daŋ kuŋ anyi ashi afu na to nɛ an daŋ bɔla n ya mata Salmoni ŋ kpar so n yɔ. 8An daŋ baŋ kra teku na be kɔnɔ ase nna n ji awurfoŋ loŋ n ya fo kakpa ko nɛ baa tre Ekulonyilikpa Lela Nɛ Kafɔŋ Maŋ Wɔtɔ na. Ndoŋ nɛ Lasiya be kade to daa maŋ wɔ kufɔ.
9An daŋ chɛr ndoŋ ga hale nɛ anyi be kenaŋ pɛ ekpa ya ki kpakpa, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ na so nɛ kachɛ nɛ baa nyiŋi alubi be keyigempaŋ be asheŋ be daŋkare na gba baŋ so. 10Nɛ Pɔɔl fiɛ bumo so ŋ kaŋɛ: “M braana, n wu fanɛ yili nfe a yɔ, anyi be enite ere be ekpa ere to lubi ga. Ekuloŋgboŋ ere nɛ kumo be esulɔ ere be adamta beeŋ jija nɛ basa gba e mur.” 11Ama benapo be enimubi na daŋ kplaŋ Pɔɔl be kamalga na so nna nseŋ yirda kusɔ nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na be befarpoana na be enimu nɛ ekuloŋ na wura na kaŋɛ nna. 12Ndoŋ be ekulonyilikpa na ka daa maa la kakpa lela awo to so, basa na be bedamta daa sha keyige eyilikpa na nna nsaa wɔ ekuloŋgboŋ na to a bɛ teku na so a sha kewora ania n fo Finiks nɛ baaŋ tiŋ nna na. Ndoŋ daa la Kriit be ekulonyilikpa nna a kɔ nnɔ anyɔ, kukoŋwule daa wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be jisoso be kaba so nna nɛ kukoŋwule malɛ daa wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be bena so be kaba so. Ndoŋ nɛ b daa beeŋ tiŋ n shir a wɔ hale nɛ awo na be jemanɛ e ya choŋ.
Afugboŋ ko ka ber teku na so be asheŋ
13Afubi ko ka chela n shi kelargato be kaseto be kaba so m ba nɛ basa na fara a tama fanɛ asheŋ nɛ b daŋ kre fanɛ baaŋ wora na beeŋ nyalɛ n sa bumo. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b gberge ekuloŋgboŋ na be kebɛlso gbɛgbɛso nɛ baa ta a lɛ nchu to nɛ k bee pɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na to a yili na ashi to nseŋ luri ekuloŋgboŋ na to n ta m mata Kriit be teku na be ekarso loŋ a yɔ. 14Ama k maŋ chɛr ko nɛ afugboŋ ko nɛ baa tre epeŋilarkpa be bena so be kaba so be afu na shi kepla na so m ba ber ekuloŋ na 15nɛ k shɛr afu na to kanaŋkamaso ŋ gben nseŋ shin nɛ afu na kɔ anyi be ekuloŋgboŋ na a yɔ. 16An ka bɔla Kawda be kepla na be epeŋitɔrkpa nɛ an luri kakpa ko nɛ k kuŋ anyi gbrɛ ashi afu na to. Ndoŋ nɛ an wora ania ga m ba tiŋ m mɔlga ekulombi nɛ kegboŋi na daa gberge na ashi kebure to. 17B daŋ gberge kumo nna n wɔtɔ kegboŋi na be epunto nseŋ ta efɔlana m bɔla kegboŋi koŋwule na be kaseto ŋ kre kumo kpakpa. Ŋkpal b ka daa lɔ kufu fanɛ baaŋ ya ber Libiya be teku be ekarso be keplagboŋ na to n nia so, b daŋ yɔɔ ekuloŋ na be wajɛ gbɛgbɛso nɛ afu bee ber a yɛr ekuloŋgboŋ na nna nseŋ shin nɛ afu na e baa kɔ ekuloŋ to na a yɔ loŋ. 18Kare ka chɛ nɛ afugboŋ na kraa ber eleŋso nɛ b fara a lara kumo to be esulɔ na a lɛ nchu na to. 19Kare ka naŋ chɛ nɛ bumo gbagba bela ekuloŋ na to be asɔ damta ko nɛ a daŋ daga fanɛ b baa kɔ a shuŋ kumo to na be ako n lɛ nchu na to. 20An daŋ ji nchɛ damta ekuloŋgboŋ na to a maa wu epeŋi nɛ achɛkpabi nɛ afu na malɛ kraŋ baa ber eleŋso, nɛ an ba gben n yige kebaatama anyi be kenaŋ pete be asheŋ.
21Basa na ka ta nchɛ damta loŋ a maa ji shɛŋ nɛ kachako nɛ Pɔɔl koso n yili bumo to ŋ kaŋɛ: “M braana, a daga men ka daŋ bɛ ma kɔnɔ so n daŋ shir Kriit to nɛ an daŋ tiŋ ŋ gelge le be awurfoŋ nɛ jɛrbi nɛ anyee ji ere. 22Ama mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa kɔ kenyɛn, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi be ekama maaŋ paŋ mbe ŋkpa, ekuloŋgboŋ ere nawule e naaŋ mur. 23Ŋkpal manɛ so, ndre kanyɛso Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ma nɛ mee bunyaŋ mo na be malaika kaŋ ba ma kutɔ nna m ba kaŋɛ ma: 24‘Pɔɔl, sa maa lɔ kufu. A daga fanɛ fo ya yili Romebi be ewurgboŋ na be anishito. Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ malɛ nɛ mbe kelela so, basa nɛ fo nɛ bumo wɔ nchu so be enite ere to ere be ekama maaŋ mur.’ 25Amoso, men baa kɔ kenyɛn, ŋkpal manɛ so, n yirda Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ e kaŋɛ ma na maaŋ chɛrga kikɛ. 26Ama afu ere beeŋ ber anyi n ya lɛ kechɛɛ ko so bre.”
27Anyi be kachɛ kuduanasopo be kanyɛso nɛ afu na wɔtɔ a kpata anyi ashi Eedria be teku so. Kiidiso be jemanɛ ko nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na be befarpo na kaŋɛ fanɛ baa tama fanɛ anyee taga to kedeŋi so. 28Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lɛ efɔl gbɛgbɛso nɛ b kɔ a karga nchu be nchiŋ na n wɔtɔ nchu na to n wu fanɛ kakpa nɛ b daa yil na be nchiŋ wɔ ayadra kalfa nɛ adunyɔ. B ka yɔ anishito gbrɛ nɛ b naŋ wora loŋ n wu fanɛ ndoŋ malɛ wɔ ayadra adekpanu. 29B daa lɔ kufu nna fanɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na beeŋ ya dii kefaltagboŋ ko so nseŋ kpal loŋ so n ta abɛlso gbɛgbɛso ana ko n lɛ ekuloŋ na be kamanto n wɔtɔ nchu na to nɛ a ya pɛ ekuloŋ na to n yili nɛ b baa kule Ebɔrɛ a jo nɛ kare ya chɛ. 30Ndoŋ nna nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na be befarpo na wora ania nɛ b lar n shile nseŋ yɔɔ ekulombi na to n wɔtɔ nchu na to nsaa kute a wora fanɛ b ka bee sha keta abɛlso gbɛgbɛso na be ako n lɛ n wɔtɔ ekuloŋ na be anishito malɛ na. 31Nɛ Pɔɔl kaŋɛ benapo na nɛ bumo be enimubi na: “Befarpo ere baŋ lar ekuloŋgboŋ ere to, men maaŋ lar kikɛ.” 32Ndoŋ nna nɛ benapo na ku efɔlana nɛ a kre ekulombi na m mata kegboŋi na n shin nɛ k yɔ.
33Kare ka bee taga to kechɛ nɛ Pɔɔl kule basa na kikɛ fanɛ b ji ajibi nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Menyi be nchɛ kuduana nde kabre men ka bee jo a maa ji shɛŋ. 34Jande men ji ajibi n nya eleŋ m mɔlga menyi gbagba be amu. Menyi be ekama maaŋ paŋ mbe kemin koŋwule gba.” 35Pɔɔl ka malga le n loge nɛ e ta bodobodo n di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ bumo kikɛ be anishito nseŋ bu kumo to n fara a we. 36Nɛ basa na ji kenyɛn nɛ bumo be ekama malɛ ji ajibi. 37Anyi kikɛ nyam daa wɔ basa alfa anyɔ nɛ adushunu nɛ ashe ekuloŋgboŋ na to. 38Ekama ka ji n kukwe nɛ b ta ayu nɛ a wɔ ekuloŋgboŋ na to na n lɛ teku na to nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na e fuga so.
Ekuloŋgboŋ na ka bure be asheŋ
39Kare ka chɛ befarpo na maŋ tiŋ m pin teku na be kedeŋi nɛ b fo na. Ama b wu teku na ka ku kasawule n wɔtɔ nchu na be kakpa ko nseŋ naŋ wora kewawa nɛ b yili kumo bumo be ŋgbene to fanɛ b shin nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na e ya fo kasawule na n yili nɛ baaŋ tiŋ nna na. 40Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ku abɛlso gbɛgbɛso ana na be efɔlana na to n shin nɛ abɛlsoana na ka nchu na to nseŋ saŋɛ ekuloŋ na be kamanto be ndibi paŋgelambi nɛ b kɔ a niŋi kumo na malɛ epul na to. Ade be kaman nɛ b maŋ ekuloŋgboŋ na be wajɛ gbɛgbɛso nɛ afu bee ber a yɛr kumo na so ashi ekuloŋgboŋ na be anishito nɛ afu na e ber ekuloŋgboŋ na n yɔ anishito kedeŋi so. 41Ndoŋ nna nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na ya ber kechɛɛsawule ko to nchu na to nɛ kumo be anishito nia nɛ k tia ŋ gben nsaa yil nɛ atiligboŋ ko bee kpata ekuloŋgboŋ na be kamanto eleŋso a bure kumo. 42Nɛ benapo na kre kemɔ kabutipoana na kikɛ nɛ bumo be ekama e sa maŋ laa n dii n shile n yɔ. 43Ama benapo be enimubi na ka daa maa sha nɛ Pɔɔl e wu so, e daŋ ju benapo na ashi loŋ be kesheŋ na to nna nseŋ kaŋɛ basa na be bumo nɛ b daa nyi kalaa na kikɛ fanɛ b fara n tɛ n luri nchu na to a laa a dii. 44Nɛ bumo nɛ b ka na malɛ pɛ ekuloŋgboŋ na be ndibi fɛtaso na to m bɛ kaman a ba. Loŋ nɛ ekama daŋ wora n dii nɛ alenfia.

Title: ASHUŊ SHUNSO 28
Content:
Kusɔ nɛ k wora Pɔɔl ashi Malta be asheŋ
1An ka dii kedeŋi so nɛ alenfia nɛ an nu fanɛ kepla na nɛ baa tre Malta. 2Ndoŋebi daŋ chɛ anyi to ga. Bɔrɛ daŋ fara nna a ba nɛ awo ko ba nɛ b puga edɛ n sa anyi nɛ an wɔl. 3Pɔɔl ka chala ndibi a wɔtɔ edɛ na to nɛ kuwɔ ko lar ndibi na to ŋkpal kuwuloŋ na so m mea mbe enɔ kpakpa. 4Kepla na so be basa na ka wu kuwɔ na ka chul Pɔɔl be enɔ so nɛ b kaŋɛ abar: “Kanyɛn ere la emɔpo nna, k maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ. E tiŋ n lar nchu na to nɛ alenfia, ama kashenteŋ be ekpa so be ebɔrɛ na maaŋ yige mo nɛ e baa kraa wɔtɔ.” 5Ama Pɔɔl tiŋ ŋ ŋmenyaŋ kuwɔ na n wɔtɔ edɛ na to nɛ k maŋ tiŋ n doro mo kikɛ. 6B daa dara mo nna a keni kananɛ e beeŋ tiŋ to n tɔr epul na to n wu. Ama b ka jo loŋ n ya gben a maa wu kulubi kikɛ ka bee nya Pɔɔl nɛ b chɛrga bumo be nfɛra nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Ebɔrɛ ko e la mo.”
7Kakpa nɛ kesheŋ ere daŋ wora Pɔɔl na nɛ kepla na so wura be adɔsawuleana so daa maŋ wɔ kufɔ. Ewura na be ketre e daa la Pablias. E daŋ sɔ anyi kasawule na so nseŋ keta anyi kufɔ nɛnɛ ga nchɛ nsa. 8Pablias mo tuto be eyur daŋ bel edɛ nna nɛ e dese ebu to a lɔ epun to nɛ Pɔɔl luri mbe ebu na to n ta mbe enɔana n deŋi mo so nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa mo nɛ e nya alenfia. 9Kede be kaman nɛ kechɛɛsawule na so be belɔpo kikɛ ba nɛ e chɛ bumo. 10B daŋ kɛ anyi asɔ damta ga ndoŋ. Kachɛ nɛ an ba kaa lar ndoŋ nɛ b naŋ ta asɔ nɛ anyeeŋ ya kaa sha ekpa to n wɔtɔ anyi be ekuloŋgboŋ na to.
Pɔɔl nɛ mo braana na ka lar Malta n yɔ Rom be asheŋ
11Afɔl asa be kaman nɛ an luri Alɛkzaandria be ekuloŋgboŋ ko nɛ baa tre kumo Mborobi na to n yɔ. Kepla na so nɛ k daŋ ba kaa wɔ loŋ nɛ awo be jemanɛ ba choŋ. 12Ndoŋ nna nɛ an ta n ya fo Sirakyus be kade to n ji nchɛ asa ndoŋ pɔɛŋ 13nseŋ ta loŋ m ba fo kadegboŋ ko nɛ baa tre Rɛjiam. Kumo be ŋklade nɛ afu ko shi epeŋitɔrkpa be bena so m ber m ba. Kumo be kachɛ nyɔsopo nɛ an fo Putioli be ekulonyilikpa. 14An ka ba wu bebɛsopo ko ndoŋ nɛ b shin nɛ an ji bɔkwe bumo kutɔ. Asheŋ nɛ a daŋ wora anyi anyi be enite na to pɔɛŋ nɛ an ya fo Rom nna na. 15Bekurgepo nɛ b wɔ Rom na ka nu anyi be asheŋ nɛ b lege anyi m ba hale Apias be Kebɛ nɛ kakpa nɛ baa tre Befɔ be Ewushikpa be Nwu Asa na. Pɔɔl ka wu bumo nɛ e nya kenyɛn chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga.
Kusɔ nɛ k wora Pɔɔl ashi Rom be asheŋ
16An ka ba Rom nɛ Romebi be abane be benimuana na shin nɛ Pɔɔl gbagba wɔtɔ a keni mbe kumu so nseŋ shin nɛ b lara enapo nɛ e baa de Pɔɔl so.
17Pɔɔl be kachɛ sasopo ashi Rom nɛ e tre ndoŋ be Juwebi be benimuana na m ba shɛr ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Ŋ kurgepoana, m maŋ wora shɛŋ n da anyi be basa ŋko edaŋkare nɛ an nanaana sa anyi na so nɛ m peebi ti ma ebu ashi Jerusalɛm nseŋ naŋ ta ma m bɔɔ Romebi enɔ. 18Romebi na ka bishi ma asheŋ a maŋ wu kulubi kikɛ nɛ n wora nɛ k daga luwu nɛ b daa shin nɛ b yige ma. 19Nɛ Juwebi na maŋ shuli kumo be loŋ nɛ ŋ gben ŋ kule fanɛ b shin nɛ Romebi be ewurgboŋ na gbagba e keni ma demu na to, mannɛ fanɛ ŋ kɔ kusɔ ko nna a sha keta n wu m peebi na kulubi. 20Amoso nɛ n tre menyi nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi amo na. Esa nɛ Israɛlebi na bee tama fanɛ e beeŋ ba na malɛ so nɛ ŋgbɛlɛbi ere wɔ ma enɔana to na.” 21Nɛ b kaŋɛ mo: “Esa kama maŋ sibɛ anyi nwɔl ashi Judiya ŋ kaŋɛ anyi fo asheŋ, an kurgepo kama malɛ maŋ shi ndoŋ m bar anyi fo baru lubi ŋko kulubi kama nɛ fo wora be asheŋ. 22Ama kaŋɛ anyi kusɔ nɛ k wɔ fo kumu to, kusɔ nɛ fee fɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi basa ka bee malga kaplɛkama a gbiti katuŋ nɛ fo wɔ na to be basa.” 23Kede be kaman nɛ b sa Pɔɔl kachɛ nɛ baaŋ ba. Kachɛ na ka fo nɛ bumo be bedamta ba kakpa nɛ Pɔɔl daa wɔ na nɛ e baŋ yili chipurso m bɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to be asheŋ na ŋ ŋini bumo loŋ n ya fo kanyɛso. E daŋ bɛ Mosis be mbra na nɛ anebiana na be nsibɛ na so nna ŋ kɔ ga n fin keshin nɛ basa na yirda Yesu. 24Beko daŋ yirda mbe kamalga na nɛ beko malɛ kini keyirda kumo. 25Pɔɔl ka malga kesheŋ koŋwule ere n loge nɛ b fara a ji abar emɔrɔ a yɔ. Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na daŋ shin nɛ anebi Aizaaya daŋ wu ŋ kaŋɛ men nanaana fanɛ e ya kaŋɛ basa na le:
26‘Menyeeŋ nu hale n ya gben, ama men maaŋ pin to.
Menyeeŋ keni hale n ya gben, ama men maaŋ wu shɛŋ.’
27‘Ŋkpal basa ere be ŋgbene ka du kpakpa so
b ti bumo be asoe
nseŋ buu bumo be anishi so.
Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, bumo be anishi beeŋ bugi asheŋ be kewuto
nɛ bumo be asoe e bugi asheŋ be kenuto
nɛ bumo be ŋgbene e bugi asheŋ be kepinto.
Ebɔrɛ yɛ: Loŋ na baaŋ ba ma kutɔ
nɛ n lara bumo ashi bumo be kebaawɔtɔ dra to
n sa bumo kebaawɔtɔ popɔr.’ ”
28Nɛ Pɔɔl naŋ kaŋɛ: “Amoso, men baa nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ shuŋi basa nɛ baa bɔ mbe kumɔlga be kubɔya na nnyamase gba kutɔ. Bumo ere beeŋ bugi asoe n nu.” 29Pɔɔl ka malga asheŋ ere n loge nɛ Juwebi na pesaŋ to a ji abar emɔrɔ kpakpaso a yɔ.
30Pɔɔl be nfɛ anyɔ nɛ e sɔ esa ko be ebu a wɔtɔ a ka ebu na wura. Ndoŋ nɛ e daa wɔ a sɔ basa kama nɛ b daa ba m ba kaa chɔrɔ mo. 31Ndoŋ koŋwule na malɛ nɛ e daa wɔ a bɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to be kubɔya na a sa basa kenyɛnso a malga kayurwushiso a ŋini Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be asheŋ.

Title: ROMEBI 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ n la Kristo Yesu be kenya na kutɔ nna. Ebɔrɛ e tre ma nseŋ lara ma ashi ma basa to n shin nɛ ŋ ki mbe eshuŋipo nɛ m ba kaa bɔ mbe baru lela na. 2Dradra na kikɛ nɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ na bɔla mbe anebiana so nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ cheembi na to n nase kɔnɔ 3fanɛ baru lela na beeŋ ba kaa kute mo Pibinyɛn, an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo nɛ nyiŋgbasa be kaplɛa so nɛ e shi Ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to na be asheŋ. 4Kebaawɔtɔ cheembi be Kiyoyu malɛ be kaplɛa so, Ebɔrɛ ta eleŋgboŋ ŋ ŋini e ka la mo Pibinyɛn saŋɛ nɛ e tiŋi mo luwu to na. 5Mo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla n wu ma kuwɔr n sa ma ekpa fanɛ m baa la eshuŋipo ŋkpal Yesu koŋwule na be ketre so nɛ efuli kama so ebi e ba yirda mo nseŋ fara a nu a sa mo. 6Menyi, bumo nɛ men wɔ Rom be kade to ere gba ti efuliana nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre fanɛ men ba kaa la Yesu Kristo peya na so. 7Amoso nɛ mee sibɛ kawɔl ere a sa menyi kikɛ nɛ men wɔ Rom be kade to nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha menyi nseŋ tre menyi fanɛ men ba kaa la mo gbagba be basa na. An Tuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo e sa menyi kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi.
Pɔɔl ka bee di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nsaa chɔrɔ mo be asheŋ
8Men shin nɛ n fara m bɔla Yesu Kristo so n chɔrɔ ma Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal menyi kikɛ so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere to ebi kikɛ baa ji kananɛ menyi be yirda du be asheŋ nna. 9Ebɔrɛ nɛ n ta ma kagbene kikɛ nyam a bɔ mo Pibinyɛn be baru lela na gbagba e la ma shɛdajipo a nyi menyi be asheŋ ka baa wɔ ma kagbene to ashi ma kabɔrɛkule to saŋkikɛ. 10Ma alɛ bee kule Ebɔrɛ nna fanɛ naniere nɛ k par mo, e sa ma ekpa nɛ m ba bɔɔ menyi so. 11M baa sha kewu menyi gbrɛ nna n shin nɛ men nya abɔrɛsheŋ be nɛfa nɛ a bee bɔla Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na so a ba anyi so na. Loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men nya eleŋ kebɛso na to n ti so. 12Kumo e la fanɛ nɛ n tiŋ m ba, menyi be yirda beeŋ leŋ ma to nɛ ma alɛ peya e leŋ menyi alɛ gba to. 13Bekurgepoana, mee sha fanɛ men baa nyi fanɛ saŋɛ damta nɛ ŋ kre keba menyi kutɔ be nia nɛ m ba shin nɛ basa e yirda Yesu kananɛ n shin nɛ nnyamase ko gba wora ashi mboŋ ko na, ama m maŋ nya kumo be ekpa. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so, k du fanɛ ŋ ka ji Griikebi nɛ basa bubɔrɔ nɛ benyiashempo nɛ bewulpo kikɛ abɔrɛsheŋ be keŋini be kukɔ nna. 15Amoso nɛ m baa sha kebɔ baru lela na n sa menyi nɛ men wɔ Rom be kade to gba na.
Baru lela na be eleŋ be asheŋ
16M maa wora baru lela na be anishinyɔr kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, kumo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee bɔla a ŋini mbe eleŋ a mɔlga basa kama nɛ baa yirda na. Juwebi e nya kumo be loŋ be ekpa pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta nnyamase, bumo nɛ b maŋ la Juwebi na m bɛ so. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, baru lela na e naa ŋini kananɛ Ebɔrɛ bee nase kumo fanɛ basa e baa la belelapo mbe anishito. Kumo alɛ be sososo kikɛ la yirda nna hale n ya fo ekar. Loŋ gbagba malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Esa kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e la elelapo na beeŋ nya ŋkpa ŋkpal mbe yirda so.”
Ebɔrɛ be agbo nɛ k bee ba basa so be asheŋ
18Ama Ebɔrɛ bugi to ŋ ŋini basa kananɛ mbe agbo beeŋ shi ebɔrɛso m ba basa so ŋkpal alubi nɛ a wɔ bumo be ŋgbene to nɛ amo nɛ a dii efuli na kikɛ so. Bumo e la basa nɛ bumo be alubi na bee buu kashenteŋ na so basa be anishito na. 19Ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔ nɛ basa beeŋ ta m pin Ebɔrɛ na baŋ dii efuli nna geeŋ a sa bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ gbagba e bugi amo to n sa bumo. 20Kashenteŋ malɛ nna fanɛ yili jemanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ baŋ to durnya kikɛ na m ba fo mbre, basa beeŋ tiŋ m pin kananɛ mbe edasheŋ nɛ basa maaŋ tiŋ n wu kenishiso na du, kumo e la fanɛ mbe eleŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na nɛ kananɛ e la Ebɔrɛ kashenteŋto na. Bumo alɛ beeŋ tiŋ m pin amo to, ŋkpal mbe asɔtoso so. Loŋ so, b maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kini mo nseŋ ta bumo be amu n ya ji. 21B nyi Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ, ama bumo alɛ maa ta mo fanɛ Ebɔrɛ a bunyaŋ mo ŋko a chɔrɔ mo. Ama b shin nɛ bumo be nfɛra ki nfɛra fuloŋ nna nɛ bumo be kawuliso be ŋgbene malɛ ki m biri to. 22B yɛ b nyi asheŋ, ama bumo alɛ ki bewulpo nna. 23B ka beeŋ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to saŋkama na, b wɔtɔ nna a bunyaŋ asɔ nɛ enyiŋgbasa wora nna nɛ amo be ako duli basa nɛ ako duli mbuibi, ako malɛ duli asɔbɔya nɛ ade malɛ duli asɔ gbeyeso.
24Amoso, Ebɔrɛ malɛ yige bumo be asheŋ nna n sa bumo nɛ b luri kesakalea be ayɛlgasɔ to a wɔtɔ a kɔ abar be eyurana a wora amɔmɔshiasheŋ. 25Kashenteŋ be mmalga nɛ a bee kute Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ na nɛ b kɔ a chɛr efɛ be mmalga a wɔtɔ a bunyaŋ nsaa shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be asɔtoso nsaa yige amo be Etopo na bre, emo nɛ e daga epaŋ be kedi hale mbaanaayɔ na. Amɛn. 26Ŋkpal le be asheŋ ere so Ebɔrɛ yige bumo nna n sa kesakalea be ayɛlgasɔ hale nɛ bumo be beche yige kedi benyɛn n lɛ nsaa kɔ bumo braana beche a di keche nɛ kenyɛn. 27Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ benyɛn na gba bee yige kebaadi beche a lɛ nsaa shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene bee kaa kesakalea so a wɔ bumo braana benyɛn be kasha to. Benyɛn wɔtɔ nna a kɔ abar kesakalea so a wora amɔmɔshiasheŋ nsaa nya amo be loŋ be tɔnɔ ashi bumo be eyurana to.
28Ade malɛ kikɛ be kaman Ebɔrɛ yige bumo be asheŋ nna n sa bumo ŋkpal b ka kini kenyiŋi kashenteŋ be abɔrɛsheŋ na so nɛ b baa wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ nɛ a maŋ daga kikɛ. 29Ŋkpal b ka kini Ebɔrɛ na so, eda lubi be yiri kikɛ nɛ alubisheŋ nɛ kejimuni nɛ abar be kebaawora alubi e bɔlɔ bumo to. Amo nɛ a bɔlɔ bumo to gba n ti so e la, kayurbesa nɛ kamɔ nɛ nlu nɛ efɛ nɛ kebaafɛ abar asheŋ lubi. Ade malɛ gba be buushi baa kuli bumo braana, 30nsaa malga alubi a gbiti abar a kishi Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ a tege abar nsaa wu bumo be amu. B kɔ mpuchi a fin alubi be ekpa popɔrana a wora alubi nsaa kini kebaanu a sa bumo nioana nɛ bumo tutoana. 31B maŋ nyi asheŋ, bumo alɛ maŋ naa bɛ bumo be nnɔ so ŋko a wu kuwɔr nsaa maa la basa. 32B nyi Ebɔrɛ be mbra na ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ le be kebaawɔtɔ ere to daga luwu, ama b kraŋ pere kenishi nna a wora amo nsaa leŋ basa pɔtɛ gba to a wɔtɔ loŋ be asheŋ na be kewora to.

Title: ROMEBI 2
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be demu be keji be asheŋ
1Amoso, manɛ be ekpa nɛ fo dimɛdi kɔ nsaa tiŋ a wu fo barkasa kulubi? Ŋkpal manɛ so, kanaŋkama nɛ fo du nseŋ wu fo barkasa kulubi, fee ji nna a bri fo gbagba be kumu nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔ koŋwule na nɛ fee wora. 2Nɛ Ebɔrɛ bre bee ji basa nɛ baa wora asheŋ ere demu, an nyi e ka bee ji asheŋ kashenteŋ be ekpa so. 3Ama fo ere dimɛdi, asheŋ nɛ fo kɔ a wu basa kulubi ere gbagba nɛ fee wora, amoso, fee tama fanɛ feeŋ nya ŋ gelge Ebɔrɛ be demuji to a? 4Ŋko fo kpal Ebɔrɛ be kelela ka shi mo to ga na so nna nɛ e ka maa nya manaŋ a gberge basa kusoe na nɛ mbe kanyiti na so so nna a fɛl mo a? Fo maŋ nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kelela wɔtɔ nna nɛ fo nya n lar fo alubi to a? 5Ama ŋkpal fo kagbene ka du kpakpa a maa sha kechɛrga na so, fo wɔ fo alubi na to nna a shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo bee kaa a ti so a jo kachɛ nɛ mbe agbo nɛ mbe demuji kashenteŋ be ekpa so na bee lar efuli na. 6Kusɔ kama nɛ esa wora, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ka mo kumo be kukɔ. 7Bumo nɛ alelasheŋ be kewora maa gben bumo nɛ baa fin kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k maŋ kɔ luwu na, e beeŋ sa bumo ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. 8Ama bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo gbagba be aparsheŋ to a kini kashenteŋ na be kebɛso nsaa bɛ alubi so na, Ebɔrɛ be kagbene beeŋ kaa nɛ mbe agbo e ba bumo so. 9Tɔrɔ nɛ kayurnyaŋ beeŋ ba dimɛdi kama nɛ e bee wora alubi so, Juwebi e naaŋ juŋkpar n nya amo pɔɛŋ nɛ nnyamase e bɛ so. 10Ama ekama nɛ e bee wora alelasheŋ, kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ kagbenewushi beeŋ baa wɔ amodoŋwura so. Juwebi e naaŋ juŋkpar n nya amo pɔɛŋ nseŋ ta nnyamase m bɛ so. 11Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maa kpɛa basa to.
12Bekama nɛ b maŋ kɔ mbra na nseŋ wora alubi beeŋ lar mbra na be kaman n wu. Bekama malɛ nɛ b wɔ mbra na to nseŋ wora alubi, mbra na to nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla n ji bumo demu. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ basa nɛ baa nu mbra na nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee nase kumo fanɛ b la belelapo mbe anishito, bumo nɛ baa wora kusɔ nɛ mbra na bee kaŋɛ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ba nase kumo fanɛ b la belelapo. 14Kashenteŋto, nnyamase maŋ kɔ anebi Mosis be mbra na, ama saŋkama nɛ bumo gbagba ta nfɛra nɛ a wɔ bumo to na n wora kusɔ nɛ mbra na bee ŋini, kumo ere bumo be nfɛra na ki mbra na nna n sa bumo na, ama bumo alɛ maŋ kɔ mbra na. 15Bumo be asheŋ woraso na e naa ŋini fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ta asɔ nɛ mbra na bee ŋini na n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to. Nɛ bumo be elakal gba bee ŋini fanɛ kashenteŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋko bumo be nfɛra maa dese bumo ŋkpal alubi so, saŋko malɛ nɛ a bee yili bumo be kaman. 16To, loŋ malɛ nɛ baru lela nɛ mee bɔ na bee ŋini fanɛ asheŋ beeŋ ba kaa du kachɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla Yesu Kristo so n yili edimɛdi be wulo be nfɛraana so n ji bumo demu.
Juwebi nɛ mbra na be asheŋ
17To, mannɛ fo e naa tre fo kumu Juw nsaa ta fo yirda a deŋi Mosis be mbra na so a wɔtɔ a ji njɔŋ a kaŋɛ fanɛ fo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nferinto wɔ ebel na a? 18Mannɛ fo e naa kaŋɛ fanɛ fo nyi kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha fanɛ esa e wora, fo alɛ naŋ koya ashi mbra na to a nyi kusɔ nɛ k daga esa ka lara na a? 19Mannɛ fo koŋwule na e naa kaŋɛ fanɛ fo e baa la esa nɛ e bee keta betanpo kekpabi nsaa du fanɛ kefulto a sa bumo nɛ b wɔ tentembiri to na a? 20Mannɛ fo koŋwule na e kraa kaŋɛ fanɛ fo e la basa balto be eŋinipo nɛ mbibi be eŋinipo, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo ere be kanyiasheŋ na nɛ kashenteŋ na bee shi mbra na to nna a? 21To, fo nɛ fee ŋini basa pɔtɛ asheŋ, fo maa ŋini fo kumu loŋ be asheŋ na a? Fo e naa malga abɔrɛsheŋ a sa basa fanɛ b sa maa yuri, fo alɛ nsaa yuri a? 22Fo koŋwule na e naa kaŋɛ basa fanɛ b sa maa di bumo braana be beche ŋko a shin nɛ bumo braana be bekul e baa di bumo, fo alɛ nsaa wora loŋ a? Fo kishi agbir, fo alɛ nsaa yuri asɔ ashi amo be ebuana to. 23Fo e wɔtɔ a kɔ mbra na a ji njɔŋ, fo alɛ nseŋ naa shin nɛ fo kemaa bɛ amo so bee bar Ebɔrɛ anishinyɔr. 24Loŋ koŋwule na malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Menyi, Juwebi so nɛ nnyamase bee malga a ji Ebɔrɛ emɔrɔ.”
25Nɛ fee bɛ mbra na be kɔnɔ so nseŋ ku kututu, kumo ere fo keku na kɔ kifi, ama nɛ fo maa bɛ mbra na be kɔnɔ so nseŋ ku kututu, kenyanyaŋɛso nɛ fo ku na. 26Fo maŋ nyi fanɛ basa nɛ b maŋ ku atutu na baa wora asɔ nɛ mbra na bee ŋini, Ebɔrɛ bee sɔ bumo nna fanɛ bumo nɛ b ku atutu a? 27To, men baa nyi fanɛ basa nɛ b maŋ ku durnya ere to, bumo alɛ nsaa bɛ mbra na be kɔnɔ so na be kebaawɔtɔ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ yili n ji menyi nɛ men ku nseŋ naa kɔ mbra na n ti so na demu. 28Mannɛ kenishiso nɛ baa ta a pin Juw, mannɛ kuku kututu be nwɔl na n lɛ na malɛ e la kashenteŋ be katutuku na. 29Kashenteŋto, dimɛdi be kebaawɔtɔ to e naa ŋini e ka la Juw nɛ kashenteŋ malɛ be keku na la kagbene to be kesheŋ, Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ nna, mannɛ kenishiso be asheŋ nna. Nɛ esa nɛ e ku loŋ na malɛ be kechɔrɔ bee shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna, mannɛ nyiŋgbasa kutɔ.

Title: ROMEBI 3
Content:
1To, nɛ nuso be kechɔ nɛ Juwebi chɔ basa pɔtɛ? Ŋko manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ katutuku kɔ? 2Cha, Juwebi baa chɔ basa pɔtɛ ekpa kama so nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k juŋkpar e la fanɛ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mbe mmalga m bɔɔ enɔ. 3Ama nɛ bumo be beko malɛ kini kebugi epunto n sa Ebɔrɛ ai? Loŋ beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ e ki kɔnɔleŋiwura a? 4Kaarɛ fanɛ loŋ e tiŋ n wora. Nɛ nyiŋgbasa bre la efɛpo, Ebɔrɛ bre la kashenteŋjipo nna saŋkama fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na. A yɛ:
“Fo mmalga to e naa ŋini fo ka kɔ kashenteŋ,
fo alɛ beeŋ baa ji a lar fo edemu to.”
5Kesheŋ bishiso ko malɛ nde fanɛ: “Nɛ fanɛ anyi be asheŋ lubi bee shin nɛ basa bee wu Ebɔrɛ be alelasheŋ, nuso nɛ an naa kaŋɛ ere? An kaŋɛ fanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bar mbe agbo anyi so, e maŋ wora n nyalɛ ŋko?” Nyiŋgbasa be kamɔrɔji be kamalga nɛ mee malga na. 6Kaarɛ, loŋ maŋ kɔ ekpa kuraa, ŋkpal manɛ so, nuso nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa tiŋ a ji durnya ere to ebi demu? 7Ama esa ko malɛ kraa beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n ji emɔrɔ m bishi le: “Nɛ fanɛ ŋkpal ma efɛsheŋ so Ebɔrɛ be kashenteŋ na bee lar efuli nɛnɛ a nya kemaŋkura a ti so, manɛ e naaŋ ba nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ n wora n da so?” 8Le be kamalga koŋwule ere malɛ so nɛ basa ko bee yili so a ku anyi kɔnɔ a kaŋɛ fanɛ loŋ nɛ anyee kaŋɛ na. B yɛ: “Men shin nɛ an baa wora alubi nɛ a baa ki alela.” Loŋ be basa be kasogberge baŋ daga bumo nna.
Dimɛdi ka maŋ du cheembi be asheŋ
9To, naniere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ anyi chɔ basa pɔtɛ ŋko? Cha, anyi maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, an teŋ wu fanɛ dimɛdi kikɛ, Juwebi nɛ basa pɔtɛ kikɛ wɔ alubi to nna. 10Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“Elelapo kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be anishito,
hale ekoŋwule gba maŋ wɔtɔ.
11Esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ a pin asheŋ to,
ekama malɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ a kɔ a fin Ebɔrɛ.
12Ekama nyam kilgi m pal kaman n sa Ebɔrɛ n choŋ,
ekama nyam ki jiga.
Esa kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ a wora kelela,
hale esa koŋwule gba maŋ wɔtɔ.
13Ekama be kɔnɔ du fanɛ b ka kur nchaŋ nna n nase.
Efɛ nɛ bumo be nnɔana na bee ku
mmalga nɛ a bee lar bumo be nnɔana to
du fanɛ wasa ka duŋ esa n lara kɔrtɔ n wɔtɔ mo to na.
14Abar be kebaamelgi kpakpaso e bɔlɔ bumo be nnɔ to a wɔtɔ.
15Bumo be aya malɛ maa chɛr a yɛr bumo basa be kemɔ to.
16Kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ b yɔ, kasɔjija be tɔrɔ nɛ baa yige a lɛ basa so.
17B maŋ nyi kagbenewushi be ekpa.
18Bumo alɛ maŋ naa kɔ kabɔrɛŋana.”
19Ama an nyi fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ mbra na bee kaŋɛ, basa nɛ b wɔ kumo to na to nɛ k de, saŋɛ na so esa kikɛ maaŋ nya kɔnɔ m bugi. Loŋ malɛ e naaŋ shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ e ji durnya kikɛ demu. 20Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ esa nɛ e bee wora mbra be ashuŋ shunso e la esa nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kumo fanɛ e la elelapo. Kusɔ nɛ mbra na baa ŋini e la kebaashin nɛ basa e baa pin kulubi be asheŋ.
Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ bee shin nɛ mo nɛ basa bee nya kɔnɔkoŋwule be asheŋ
21Ama naniere bre Ebɔrɛ ŋini kananɛ e nase kumo fanɛ basa e baa la belelapo mbe anishito, loŋ be ekpa na malɛ nɛ mbra na maŋ kɔ shɛŋ. 22Loŋ be shɛda nɛ mbra na gba nɛ anebiana na bee ji. Ebɔrɛ malɛ bee bɔla basa be yirda nɛ k deŋ Yesu Kristo so so nna a shin nɛ mo nɛ basa na kikɛ bee nya kɔnɔkoŋwule. Mo alɛ maa kpɛa basa to. 23Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nyam wora kulubi a maŋ taga to Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura na. 24Ama ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ esa maa wora shɛŋ nsaa nya na so, asheŋ naŋ nyalɛ n sa basa, ŋkpal kesɔnyige be ekpa nɛ b bɔla Yesu Kristo so m bugi na so. 25Ebɔrɛ ta mo nna n sa basa nɛ e wu m mata be luwu nɛ k bee shin nɛ dimɛdi bee bɔla yirda so a nya alubi be ketampaŋ na. Ebɔrɛ wora loŋ nna nɛ e ŋini kananɛ e bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ na e daa nyi basa be alubi nna nsaa nyiti bumo. 26Ama naniere bre e maa kplaŋ dimɛdi be alubi so, a ŋini e ka bee ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. Loŋ malɛ e naa ŋini mo gbagba ka la asheŋ be keji nɛ amo be ekpa so be Ebɔrɛ, mo alɛ nseŋ naa ta esa nɛ e yirda Yesu a ki elelapo mbe anishito.
27To, nɛ manɛ so nɛ esa bee wu mbe kumu? E beeŋ tiŋ ŋkpal e ka bee bɛ mbra na so so a wu mbe kumu a? Ayai, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ e ka bee bɛ mbra na so e shin nɛ e ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito, ama ŋkpal e ka yirda so. 28Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ an baa kɔ to e la fanɛ yirda e naa shin nɛ esa bee ji a lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito, mannɛ kebaabɛ mbra na be asheŋ woraso so. 29Ŋko Ebɔrɛ la Juwebi nawule be Ebɔrɛ nna a? Mannɛ basa pɔtɛ gba be Ebɔrɛ e la mo a? Bumo alɛ gba be Ebɔrɛ nna walɛ. 30Ebɔrɛ koŋwule e wɔtɔ, mo alɛ Juwebi nɛ basa pɔtɛ kikɛ, ekpa koŋwule so nɛ e bee bɔla a shin nɛ baa ji a lar. Bumo kikɛ be yirda so nɛ e bee yili a wora loŋ. 31Ama an ta le be yirda ere n ti mbra na ekpa ŋko? Ayai, an baa kraa kɔ kumo to a ti kumo so eleŋ.

Title: ROMEBI 4
Content:
Kananɛ Eebraham ŋini yirda be asheŋ
1To, nɛ an keni an nananyɛn Eebraham malɛ be kebaawɔtɔ to, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ? Manɛ nɛ e daŋ wu mbe kebaawɔtɔ to? 2Nɛ fanɛ ashuŋ ko nɛ e daŋ wora nseŋ ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito, kumo ere e daa beeŋ tiŋ ŋkpal amo so m puchi, ama e maaŋ tiŋ m puchi Ebɔrɛ bre be anishito. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “Eebraham daŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ nna so nɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ nase kumo fanɛ e la elelapo na.” 4Nɛ esa baŋ shuŋ kushuŋ, baa ka mo loŋ be kushuŋ na be kukɔ nna. Fo maaŋ tiŋ n tre loŋ be kakɔka na kakɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e shuŋ nna n nya kushuŋ na be kakɔka. 5Ama esa nɛ e lara mbe yirda ashi mbe ashuŋ shunso to n lɛ nseŋ ta yirda na n deŋi Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee shin nɛ alubiworapoana bee ji a lar mbe anishito na so, loŋ be yirda na beeŋ ki alelasheŋ Ebɔrɛ be anishito n sa mo. 6Loŋ gbagba nɛ Ewura Deevid daa de saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ malga nɛfa nɛ k wɔ esa kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee lar amodoŋwura be ashuŋ shunso be kaman a ta mo a ki elelapo na be asheŋ na. 7E yɛ:
“Nɛfa la bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta bumo be alubi m paŋ bumo na peya nna, bumo nɛ e kpra bumo be alubi bumo so na.
8Nɛfa la esa nɛ Enyɛnpe na maa nyiŋi mbe alubi be asheŋ na peya nna.”
9To, nɛfa nɛ Ewura Deevid daŋ malga kumo be asheŋ ere la basa nɛ b ku atutu na nawule peya nna ŋko bumo nɛ b maŋ ku atutu gba peya nna? Bumo nɛ b maŋ ku atutu gba ti so. Kumo be asheŋ nɛ an teŋ nyiŋi anyi be amu ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na kaŋɛ le na: “Ŋkpal Eebraham ka daŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ so, Ebɔrɛ nase kumo fanɛ e la elelapo nna.” 10Saŋɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ wora loŋ Eebraham daŋ ku kututu nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora loŋ ŋko e daŋ wora loŋ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Eebraham ku? E daŋ wora loŋ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Eebraham ku. 11Mbe yirda na be kaman nɛ e daŋ ku kututu a ŋini fanɛ ŋkpal mbe yirda na so nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kumo fanɛ e la elelapo pɔɛŋ nɛ e ku. Amoso, abɔrɛsheŋ be kaplɛa so, mo e la bumo nɛ b maŋ ku nseŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ bumo tuto, saŋɛ na so Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nase kumo fanɛ b la belelapo. 12Mo ere Eebraham koŋwule na e la bumo nɛ b ku atutu na gba bumo tuto, ama mannɛ b ka baŋ ku na so, b ka wɔ yirda be kebaawɔtɔ koŋwule nɛ mo ere Eebraham daa wɔ to pɔɛŋ nseŋ ku kututu na gba so.
Kananɛ yirda la Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso be kumu be asheŋ
13Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ nna n sa Eebraham nɛ mbe kaman to ebi fanɛ baaŋ nya durnya ere. Mannɛ Eebraham ka daa bɛ mbra na so so nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ na, e ka daŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nase kumo fanɛ e la elelapo na so nɛ e daŋ wora loŋ. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso na la bumo nɛ baa bɛ mbra na so na peya nna, kumo ere esa be yirda maŋ kɔ kifi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso na malɛ gba maŋ la shɛŋ. 15Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbra e naa shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo bee lar efuli. Kaplɛkama nɛ mbra maŋ wɔtɔ, kewora n da so malɛ gba maŋ wɔtɔ.
16Amoso, yirda e la kɔnɔ naseso be kumu, saŋɛ na so, loŋ be kɔnɔ naseso na beeŋ baa la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ be tɔɔnɛ a sa Eebraham be kaman to ebi kikɛ, mannɛ bumo nɛ baa bɛ mbra na so nawule na, ama bumo nɛ b yirda Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kananɛ Eebraham daŋ yirda na gba ti so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Eebraham e la anyi kikɛ be etuto ashi abɔrɛsheŋ be kaplɛa so. 17Loŋ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Eebraham le na. E yɛ: “N ta fo ŋ ki efuli damtaana so ebi bumo tuto.” Amoso, Ebɔrɛ be anishito Eebraham nɛ e daŋ yirda mo ere Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa basa wuso ŋkpa nsaa shin nɛ asɔ nɛ a maŋ wɔ durnya to bee fara kebaawɔtɔ na e la an tuto. 18Saŋɛ nɛ Eebraham daŋ yirda nseŋ tama na, e daa maŋ wu shɛŋ pɔɛŋ nna nseŋ tama. Amoso nɛ e ki efuli damta so ebi bumo tuto fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na kaŋɛ mo le na: “Loŋ nɛ fo kaman to ebi beeŋ ba wora keshi a sa.” 19Mo ere Eebraham na daŋ fo fanɛ nfɛ kalfa, ama e ka daŋ keni mo gbagba be eyur ka daa maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ so, mbe yirda be eleŋ daa maŋ yɔɔ. Mo alɛ ka daŋ naŋ wu fanɛ mbe eche Sɛɛra be kakurge be saŋɛ baŋ so, mbe yirda na be eleŋ maŋ yɔɔ. 20Mbe yirda daa maŋ gbuŋgbuŋ to n shin nɛ e fara a lar Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso be kaman. E daŋ nya yirda be eleŋ nna n ti so nseŋ ta kemaŋkura n sa Ebɔrɛ. 21E daa nyi geeŋ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ nɛ e daŋ nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ wora na. 22Amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kumo fanɛ e la elelapo na.
23Kekaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ nase kumo fanɛ e la elelapo na,” maŋ de mo nawule nna ashi abɔrɛsibɛ na to. 24Anyi nɛ an yirda mo Ebɔrɛ nɛ e tiŋi Yesu an Nyɛnpe ashi luwu to ŋkaa beeŋ nase kumo fanɛ an la belelapo na gba ti so. 25Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ b daŋ ta mo nna n sa nɛ e wu ŋkpal anyi be alubi so nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu na to nɛ an baa la belelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

Title: ROMEBI 5
Content:
Ebɔrɛ nɛ nyiŋgbasa be kenya kɔnɔkoŋwule be asheŋ
1Naniere Ebɔrɛ ka kpal anyi be yirda so n shin nɛ an ji n lar mbe anishito ere bre, an bɔla an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so a kɔ kagbenewushi ashi Ebɔrɛ na be anishito. 2Yesu kpal anyi be yirda so n shin nɛ an nya le be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ an wɔ ere to. Amoso, anyi be ŋgbene fuli anyi ŋkpal an ka kɔ tama fanɛ anyi alɛ gba beeŋ nya Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura nɛ e kɔ a jo anyi na so. 3Mannɛ aloŋ gba nawule so, ama an ka wɔ tɔrɔ to so nɛ anyi be ŋgbene kraa naŋ fuli anyi n ti so, ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi tɔrɔ ka bee bar kenya kagbene a kɔ to be kebaawɔtɔ 4nɛ kumo alɛ bee sa esa da lela, nɛ da lela malɛ bee sa esa tama. 5Ebɔrɛ bɔla Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nɛ e kɔ a sa anyi na so nna n ta mbe kasha m bɔlɔ anyi be ŋgbene to. 6Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ nɛ an daa maŋ kɔ eleŋ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be jemanɛ fo nɛ Kristo wu n sa bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ kabɔrɛŋana na. 7Pɔɛŋ nɛ esa e wu n sa elelapo, k du kpakpa. Shere esa ko beeŋ shuli n wu n sa esa nɛ e la esa bre. 8Ama kananɛ Ebɔrɛ ŋini anyi mbe kasha nde fanɛ saŋɛ nɛ an daa la alubiworapoana na nɛ Yesu wu n sa anyi. 9Ŋkpal manɛ so, naniere Kristo wu n shin nɛ an ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito, amoso, mbe kumɔlga anyi kachako ashi Ebɔrɛ be agbo na bre to nɛ e maaŋ wora a? 10An daa la Ebɔrɛ mo doŋana nna, ama e bɔla mo Pibinyɛn Kristo be luwu na so n shin nɛ anyi nɛ mo naŋ nyalɛ. To, nɛ naniere anyi nɛ mo ka nyalɛ ere bre nɛ e maaŋ bɔla Kristo be ŋkpa na so m mɔlga anyi kachako a? 11Mannɛ aloŋ gba nawule so nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, an bɔla an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo nɛ e shin nɛ anyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ naŋ nyalɛ na so n nya kagbenefuli ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ so n ti so.
Adam nɛ Kristo be asheŋ
12To, naniere, men baa nyi fanɛ esa koŋwule so nɛ alubi bɔla m ba durnya to nɛ luwu malɛ ba ŋkpal alubi na so m ba sɔ durnya kikɛ to nyam, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa kikɛ wora alubi. 13Alubi malɛ daa wɔ durnya to nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa mbra. Ama kakpa nɛ mbra maŋ wɔtɔ, Ebɔrɛ maa karga alubi. 14Ama baŋ yili Adam be jemanɛ na m ba fo Mosis be jemanɛ to be basa kikɛ, luwu pɔɔ ekama so, hale bumo nɛ b maŋ wora n da Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ so geeŋ fanɛ kananɛ Adam daŋ wora na gba. Adam e daa la esa nɛ e daa ba na be kaduli.
15Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ ŋkpal esa koŋwule na be kulubi na so, basa damta wu. Ama le be basa anyɔ ere kɔr abar to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kagbene koŋwuleso be kakɛ na nɛ Adam be kulubi na kɔr abar to. Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na chɔ Adam be kulubi na ga. Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ mbe kagbene koŋwuleso be kakɛ nɛ e bee bɔla esa koŋwule Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr na so a sa basa damta na gba chɔ kumo. 16Kusɔ nɛ k lar kakɛ na malɛ gba be kaman naa chɔ kusɔ nɛ k lar esa koŋwule be kulubi na be kaman, ŋkpal manɛ so, Adam ka baŋ wora kulubi koŋwule na n loge nɛ kewora n da so be nfɛra ba. Ama alubi damta malɛ be kewora ka ba nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ shin nɛ kejinlar Ebɔrɛ be anishito malɛ ba. 17Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ esa koŋwule be kulubi so nɛ luwu ba kaa ji kuwura basa so, ama kusɔ nɛ esa koŋwule, Yesu Kristo wora na chɔ kumo ga. Ekama malɛ nɛ e sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ damta na nɛ mbe alelasheŋ be kakɛ na, beeŋ bɔla Kristo so a wɔ ŋkpa to a ji kuwura.
18Amoso, kananɛ esa koŋwule be kulubi na baŋ shin nɛ basa kikɛ tɔr Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋ n nya kasogberge na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ esa koŋwule be kelela koŋwule nɛ e wora na bee sɔ basa kikɛ a yige a sa bumo ŋkpa. 19Nɛ kananɛ esa koŋwule be kasomaanu shin nɛ basa kikɛ ki alubiworapoana na koŋwule na nɛ esa koŋwule mo na be kasonu beeŋ shin nɛ basa damta e ki belelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 20Ebɔrɛ bar mbra na nna nɛ basa be alubi e wora keshi n ti so, ama kanaŋkamaso malɛ nɛ alubi bee wora keshi a ti so, saŋɛ na so nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ bee shin nɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ bee wora keshi a ti so a chɔ loŋ. 21Amoso, kananɛ alubi baŋ bɔla luwu so ŋ ŋini amo be eleŋ na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na bee bɔla alelasheŋ so a ŋini kumo be eleŋ m bɔla an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so a kɔ anyi a yɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar to.

Title: ROMEBI 6
Content:
Kenya ŋkpa ŋkpal Yesu Kristo so be asheŋ
1To, naniere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ? Fanɛ an baa wɔtɔ a wora alubi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na malɛ e baa wora keshi a ti so ŋko? 2Kaarɛ, loŋ maŋ daga, ŋkpal manɛ so, alubi be kewora be kaplɛa so, an wu nna, amoso, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora ŋ kraa wɔ amo be kewora be kebaawɔtɔ to? 3Ŋko men maŋ nyi fanɛ anyi kikɛ nɛ b bɛr kabɔrɛbɛr ŋkpal Yesu Kristo so ere, b bɛr anyi nna n wɔtɔ mbe luwu na to a? 4Anyi nɛ mo alɛ nɛ b puli saŋɛ nɛ b bɛr anyi kabɔrɛbɛr a ŋini fanɛ anyi nɛ mo koŋwule na e luri mbe luwu na to na, saŋɛ na so, kananɛ Etuto na baŋ ta mbe eleŋgboŋ n shin nɛ Kristo na tiŋi luwu to na, anyi alɛ gba beeŋ nya kebaawɔtɔ popɔr a wɔtɔ. 5Nɛ anyi nɛ mo e baŋ ki kukoŋwule ashi mbe luwu na to, kumo ere k baa dese geeŋ nna fanɛ anyi nɛ mo beeŋ naŋ bɔla mbe ketiŋi luwu to na so m ba abar so. 6Anyi alɛ nyi fanɛ anyi be kebaawɔtɔ dra na nɛ Yesu nɛ b daŋ mɔ kedibi largato na so na, saŋɛ na so alubi be eleŋ nɛ k bee ji da dra na so eleŋ na beeŋ mur nɛ an sa maŋ naa la alubi be anya. 7Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa baŋ wu, kumo ere e nya mbe kumu ashi alubi be eleŋ to. 8Nɛ anyi nɛ Kristo na e wu, kumo ere an yirda fanɛ anyi nɛ mo e naaŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to. 9Ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi fanɛ Kristo ka baŋ tiŋi luwu to ere bre, e maaŋ naŋ wu kikɛ. Luwu maŋ naa kɔ mbe eleŋ. 10Mbe luwu be kaplɛa so, kela koŋwule pati nɛ e wu m pɔɔ alubi be eleŋ so, mbe ŋkpa malɛ be kaplɛa so, e wɔ kumo to nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ so. 11Loŋ koŋwule na e daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e baa ta menyi be amu fanɛ men wu nna nɛ alubi maŋ naa ji menyi so eleŋ, ama men bɔla Kristo Yesu so nna a kɔ ŋkpa a wɔtɔ ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ so. 12Amoso, men sa maŋ naa shin nɛ alubi e baa pɔɔ menyi be eyurana nɛ a beeŋ wu ere so nɛ men baa nu a sa amo be ayɛlgasɔ lubiana. 13Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ naa shin nɛ menyi be eyurana be mba kama malɛ gba e naa wora kulubi nɛ men baa kɔ loŋ be kaba na a wora edalubisheŋ. Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men wora e la fanɛ men ta menyi be amu m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ fanɛ basa nɛ b shi luwu to m ba luri ŋkpa to. Men ta menyi be eyurana kikɛ m bɔɔ mo enɔ nɛ e ta n shuŋ ashuŋ lela. 14A maŋ daga alubi ka ji menyi so kuwura, ŋkpal manɛ so, men maŋ naa wɔ mbra na to. Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ na be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ men wɔ.
Alelasheŋ be anya be asheŋ
15To, naniere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ? Fanɛ ŋkpal an ka maŋ naa wɔ mbra na to nsaa wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ be kebaawɔtɔ to so an baa wora alubi a? Kaarɛ, loŋ maŋ daga. 16Men maŋ nyi fanɛ men baŋ ta menyi be amu m bɔɔ esa enɔ fanɛ amodoŋwura be anya, men ki mbe anya kashenteŋto a? Menyeeŋ tiŋ a la alubi nɛ a beeŋ shin nɛ men wu na be anya, menyi alɛ beeŋ naŋ tiŋ a la kasonu nɛ kumo be lalaloge beeŋ shin nɛ men ki belelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito na be anya. 17Ama anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋko men daa la alubi be anya nna, ama naniere, men ta menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ m bɛ kashenteŋ be keŋiniana nɛ men nya na kikɛ so. 18Ebɔrɛ shin nna nɛ men nya menyi be amu ashi alubi be eleŋ to nseŋ ba ki alelasheŋ be anya. 19Enyiŋgbasa be nfɛra be kaplɛa so nɛ mee ber kesheŋ ere a sa menyi nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men pin amo to. Saŋko men daŋ ta menyi be amu kikɛ nna nyam ŋ ki kusɔjigaya nɛ dalubisheŋ be anya a wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ nɛ a maŋ daga. Naniere loŋ koŋwule na e daga fanɛ men naŋ ta menyi be amu kikɛ nyam ŋ ki alelasheŋ be anya a wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ nɛ a daga a du cheembi. 20Men ka daa la alubi be anya na, menyi nɛ alelasheŋ daa maŋ kɔ shɛŋ. 21Men ka daa wora asheŋ nɛ amo be asheŋ bee pɛ menyi anishinyɔr ere, manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ men daŋ nya amo to? Loŋ be asheŋ na be tɔnɔ e la luwu. 22Ama naniere men ka nya menyi be amu ashi alubi to m ba ki Ebɔrɛ be anya ere bre, tɔnɔ mo nɛ menyee nya e la kebaawɔtɔ cheembi, kumo alɛ be lalaloge e la ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. 23Ŋkpal manɛ so, asheŋ lubi be kakɔka e la luwu, ama Ebɔrɛ be kagbene koŋwuleso be kakɛ e la ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na ashi an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo to.

Title: ROMEBI 7
Content:
Kakil be mbra nɛ anyi nɛ Yesu be kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ
1Ŋ kurgepoana, m baa nyi men ka beeŋ pin kusɔ nɛ mee sha kekaŋɛ menyi ere to, ŋkpal manɛ so, men la basa nɛ b nyi mbra na nna. Kumo e la fanɛ nɛ esa kraŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to bre, mbra na e naa ji mo so kuwura ŋko? 2An ta fanɛ eche kilpo nɛ kakil be mbra na ŋ keni. Eche baŋ kil nɛ mo kul kraa wɔ ŋkpa to, mbra na bee kre mo nna a mata mo kul na loŋ hale n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ mo kul na beeŋ wu. Ama nɛ ekul na ba wu bre, kumo ere kakil be mbra maŋ naa kɔ mbe eleŋ. 3Amoso, nɛ mo kul na kraa wɔ ŋkpa to nɛ e ya kil enyɛn pɔtɛ, e ki bojua. Ama nɛ mo kul na baŋ wu bre, kumo ere mbra sa ekpa fanɛ e naŋ kil, e maŋ ki bojua. 4Ŋ kurgepoana, loŋ nɛ k du n sa menyi alɛ gba, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbra na be kaplɛa so, menyi alɛ gba wu nna ŋkpal men ka la Kristo be eyur na be kaba ko so. Naniere malɛ, men la mo koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ tiŋi mo ashi luwu to nɛ an tiŋ a la basa nɛ b kɔ tɔnɔ ashi Ebɔrɛ be kushuŋ to na peya nna. 5Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ nɛ anyi be kebaawɔtɔ dra nɛ k daa wɔ anyi nɛ mbra na daa shin nɛ eyur to be ayɛlgasɔ daa kɔ anyi to a shuŋ na, luwu nɛ an daa kɔ tɔnɔ a sa. 6Ama naniere bre mbra na maŋ naa ji kuwura anyi so, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k daŋ nyaŋ anyi a wɔtɔ na be kaplɛa so, an wu nna naniere. Anyi maŋ naa shuŋ ekpa dra nɛ k la mbra nɛ b sibɛ n nase na, ekpa popɔr nɛ k la Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na peya na nɛ an naa shuŋ.
Mbra nɛ kulubi be asheŋ
7To, naniere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ? An kaŋɛ fanɛ mbra na gbagba lubi nna ŋko? Kaarɛ, anyi maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ kuraa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbra na e shin nɛ m pin kusɔ nɛ k la kulubi. Nɛ mbra na daa maŋ kaŋɛ le nna: “Sa maŋ yɛlga fo barkasa be kusɔ,” n daa maaŋ pin loŋ be kayɛlga be asheŋ to. 8Ntaŋ malɛ so nɛ alubi nya ekpa n shin nɛ ayɛlgasɔ be yiri kikɛ nyam kaa, ŋkpal manɛ so, kakpa nɛ mbra maŋ wɔtɔ alubi malɛ gba wu nna a dese. 9Ŋ gbagba daa wɔ ŋkpa to nna a maŋ nyi mbra saŋko, ama ŋ ka ba pin ntaŋ na nɛ alubi malɛ nya ŋkpa ma to 10nɛ n wu, nɛ ntaŋ nɛ k daŋ daga fanɛ k bar ŋkpa na bar luwu m ba sa ma. 11Ŋkpal manɛ so, ntaŋ na so nɛ alubi nya ekpa n fule ma. Amoso, ntaŋ na so nɛ alubi bɔla m mɔ ma. 12Ade e naa ŋini fanɛ mbra na bre gbagba maŋ kɔ kulubi kumo to. Loŋ koŋwule na gba nɛ ntaŋ na gba la kusɔ lela a kɔ ekpa nsaa maŋ kɔ kulubi kumo to.
Kebagato nɛ k wɔ esa to be asheŋ
13To, kede bee ŋini fanɛ kusɔ lela e bar luwu ŋko? Cha, mannɛ aloŋ nna kuraa. Kulubi e bɔla kusɔ lela so m bar ma luwu nɛ kumo be da lubi gbagba e lar efuli. Amoso, ntaŋ na so nɛ esa bee wu kananɛ kulubi baŋ lubi kashenteŋto. 14An nyi mbra na ka la abɔrɛsheŋ, ama ma ere la nyiŋgbasa nna nɛ alubi kɔ ma fanɛ kenya. 15Amoso, ma ere gbagba maa pin ma asheŋ woraso to, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔ nɛ mee sha kewora, amo nɛ m maa wora nsaa wora asɔ nɛ ŋ kishi. 16Nɛ ma alɛ baa wɔtɔ a wora asɔ nɛ m maa sha kebaawora, kumo ere mee ŋini fanɛ mbra na kɔ kashenteŋ nna na. 17Amoso, mannɛ ma gbagba e naa wora kesheŋ na, kulubi nɛ k wɔ ma to na e naa wora kumo. 18M baa nyi kelela kikɛ ka maŋ wɔ ma to, ma kagbene lubi ere to nɛ n de na. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kelela be kewora be kasha wɔ ma to, ama ma alɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wora kumo. 19Kelela nɛ mee sha fanɛ m baa wora na, m maa wora. Ama kulubi nɛ m maa sha fanɛ n wora na nɛ mee wora. 20To, naniere k ka baa la fanɛ kusɔ nɛ m maa sha nɛ mee wora ere, kumo ere mannɛ ma e naa wora kumo na, kulubi nɛ k wɔ ma to na e naa wora kumo. 21Amoso, k du fanɛ le be kebaawɔtɔ e baa wɔtɔ fanɛ nɛ m baa sha kewora kelela nɛ kulubi teŋ ba sɔ kejuŋkpar. 22Ma kagbene bre gbagba bee sha Ebɔrɛ be mbra na. 23Ama ma alɛ bee wu mbra pɔtɛ ko ka wɔ ma eyur to a shuŋ. Mbra ko nna nɛ k bee kɔ mbra nɛ ma nfɛra bee sha na nsaa ta ma a ki alubi be mbra nɛ k wɔ ma eyur to a shuŋ na be kabutipo. 24Yee, nuso bre be asheŋ e nya ma le? Nɛ wanɛ malɛ e naaŋ mɔlga ma ashi le be eyur nɛ k kɔ ma a yɔ luwu to ere? 25Mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga fanɛ mo e naaŋ bɔla an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so m mɔlga ma.
Kusɔ nɛ k baa wɔtɔ kikɛ nde fanɛ ma ere gbagba be nfɛra to n la Ebɔrɛ be mbra na be kenya nna, ama ma kagbene lubi ere bre to n la kulubi be mbra be kenya nna.

Title: ROMEBI 8
Content:
Kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k la Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na peya be asheŋ
1Bumo nɛ b wɔ Kristo Yesu to naniere bre, kejimbri be kasogberge maŋ naa wɔ bumo so. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋkpa be Kiyoyu na be mbra bɔla Yesu Kristo so n shin nɛ n nya ma kumu ashi kulubi nɛ luwu be mbra to. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ mbra na daa maaŋ tiŋ n wora ŋkpal dimɛdi be kapɔr lubi ere ka maŋ kɔ eleŋ na so, Ebɔrɛ bre wora kumo. E shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn gbagba nna n ji m bri kulubi nɛ k wɔ dimɛdi be eyur to na. Mo Pibinyɛn na ta eyur fanɛ dimɛdi be alubi be eyur ere nna m ba lara kulubi ashi to. 4Ebɔrɛ wora loŋ nna nɛ alelasheŋ nɛ mbra na bee sha na e nya n wora anyi to nɛnɛ ashi anyi nɛ an maŋ naa wɔ alubi be eyur be kebaawɔtɔ to nsaa wɔ Kiyoyu na be kebaawɔtɔ to na to. 5Bumo nɛ b wɔtɔ a bɛ bumo be kapɔr lubiana be keŋini so, asɔ nɛ bumo be eyurana na bee sha na e wɔ bumo be nfɛra na. Bumo nɛ bumo alɛ wɔtɔ a bɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be keŋini na so, asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bee sha na e wɔ bumo be nfɛra. 6Keshin nɛ kapɔr lubi ere e baa wɔ fo nfɛra bee yɛr fo luwu to nna nɛ keshin nɛ Kiyoyu na e baa wɔ fo nfɛra malɛ bee yɛr fo ŋkpa nɛ kagbenewushi to. 7Amoso, nyiŋgbasa baŋ shin nɛ kapɔr lubi ere wɔ mbe nfɛra, kumo ere e ki Ebɔrɛ mo doŋ nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ be mbra na.
