Kashenteŋto, e baŋ maaŋ tiŋ n nu n sa kumo nna gba kuraa. 8Bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo be kapɔr lubi na be keŋini to maaŋ tiŋ m par Ebɔrɛ kikɛ. 9Ama naniere bre, mannɛ asɔ nɛ menyi be kapɔr lubiana bee ŋini menyi na to nɛ men wɔ, asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bee ŋini menyi na to nɛ men wɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na baa wɔ menyi to nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e maŋ kɔ Kristo be Kiyoyu na maŋ la Kristo na peya. 10Amoso, nɛ Kristo baa wɔ menyi to, hale nɛ menyi be eyurana ere beeŋ wu ŋkpal alubi so gba, menyi be ayoyu bre kɔ ŋkpa nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ nase kumo fanɛ menyi la belelapo nna mbe anishito. 11Nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e tiŋi Yesu ashi luwu to na be Kiyoyu baa wɔ menyi to bre, kumo ere mo koŋwule nɛ e tiŋi Kristo ashi luwu to na gbagba beeŋ naŋ bɔla mbe Kiyoyu nɛ e wɔ menyi to na so n sa menyi be eyurana nɛ a beeŋ kaŋ wu kachako ere ŋkpa.
12Kusɔ ko malɛ nde: Ŋ kurgepoana, an ji kebaawɔtɔ ko be kukɔ nna, ama kumo alɛ maŋ la kapɔr lubi nɛ an wɔ to ere peya nna nɛ an baa wɔ kumo to a wora kumo be aparsheŋ. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ men baa bɛ menyi be kapɔr lubiana ere be keŋini so, menyeeŋ wu, ama nɛ men baŋ bɔla Kiyoyu na so n jija kapɔr lubi ere be ashuŋ lubi na, menyeeŋ nya ŋkpa. 14Bekama nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na bee juŋkpar bumo na kikɛ la Ebɔrɛ be mbia nna. 15Kiyoyu nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa menyi na malɛ maa ta menyi nna a ki anya n shin nɛ men naa lɔ kufu. Men nya Kiyoyu nɛ e bee ta menyi a ki mbia nna. Kiyoyu na malɛ so nɛ anyee tiŋ a tre Ebɔrɛ ‘Aba’, kumo e la fanɛ an Tuto. 16Kiyoyu na malɛ gbagba e naa chɛ anyi be ayoyu to a ŋini fanɛ an la Ebɔrɛ be mbia nna kashenteŋto. 17To, nɛ anyi alɛ baa la mbia bre, kumo ere anyeeŋ nya enɛfa nɛ e kɔ a jo mbe basa na. Kumo be kaman nɛ anyi nɛ Kristo e naaŋ nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ a sa mo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baa tu Yesu a ji mbe awurfoŋ na fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ ji na, anyi alɛ beeŋ naŋ tu mo n nya mbe kemaŋkura na.
Kachako so be kemaŋkura na be asheŋ
18M baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ tɔrɔ mo nɛ anyee nya naniere maaŋ tiŋ n fo kemaŋkura nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bugi to n sa anyi na kikɛ so kuraa. 19Ebɔrɛ be kepɔrso kikɛ nyam malɛ baa jɔŋ kumo be aya so nna a jo saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ lara mbe mbia efuli na. 20Ŋkpal manɛ so, b yili kumo nna fanɛ kepɔrso kikɛ e sa maa kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ, mannɛ ŋkpal kepɔrso na gbagba be keparso, ama ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ nɛ e yili kumo loŋ na be katiŋ so. 21Ama le be tama ere e chɛr a wɔtɔ fanɛ kepɔrso kikɛ gbagba beeŋ nya kumo be kumu a maaŋ naŋ wu m bɛ kachako nɛ Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ k nya kumo be kemaŋkura nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ a sa mbe mbia na. 22Ŋkpal manɛ so an baa nyi fanɛ yili kulubi be sososo na m ba fo mbre, kepɔrso kikɛ bee shu ebesa nɛ k du fanɛ kakurge to be ebesa na to nna. 23Mannɛ asɔtoso na gba nawule, anyi nɛ an nya Kiyoyu nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ juŋkparso na gba bee shu to nna nsaa jo saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ ta anyi ŋ ki mbe mbia n shin nɛ an nya anyi be amu kikɛ nyam na. 24Tama so nɛ Ebɔrɛ mɔlga anyi, ama nɛ esa tea wu kusɔ nɛ e bee tama bre, kumo ere mannɛ tama e naa la na, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa mo e naa wu kusɔ nsaa kaŋɛ fanɛ e bee tama kumo be kenya a wora fanɛ e ka maŋ naŋ wu kumo na? 25Ama nɛ an baa tama kusɔ nɛ anyi maŋ naŋ wu bre, kumo ere, kanyiti nɛ an kɔ a jo kumo. 26Loŋ koŋwule na malɛ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee ba m ba kaa chɛ anyi mo nɛ an maŋ kɔ eleŋ ashi yirda na to na to. Anyi maŋ nyi kananɛ k daga fanɛ an kule Ebɔrɛ gba, ama Kiyoyu na gbagba e naa bugi kagbene a kule kabɔrɛkule nɛ k bee mɔ kɔnɔ a sa anyi. 27Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee wu basa be ŋgbene to na e nyi Kiyoyu na be nfɛra. Kiyoyu na malɛ e naa bɔla ekpa nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ so a kule mo a sa mbe basa. 28Anyi alɛ nyi fanɛ asɔ kikɛ to, Ebɔrɛ bee wora asheŋ nna nɛ a bee ba abar so m ba kaa ki asɔ lela a sa mbe beshapo nɛ e tre m ba mo kutɔ fanɛ b ba kaa wora mbe aparsheŋ na. 29Bumo nɛ e chɛr a nyi koŋwule na nɛ e lara n yili fanɛ b baa du fanɛ mo Pibinyɛn na, saŋɛ na so, Ebinyɛn na beeŋ baa la bekurgepo damtaana na to be ejuŋkparso. 30Amoso, Ebɔrɛ tre bumo nɛ e lara n yili na nna. Bumo nɛ e tre na malɛ kikɛ nɛ e shin nɛ b ji n lar. Bumo nɛ e shin nɛ b ji n lar malɛ kikɛ nɛ e shin nɛ mo nɛ bumo nya mbe kemaŋkura na.
Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla Kristo Yesu so ŋ ŋini mbe kasha be asheŋ
31To, asheŋ nɛ an nu ere kikɛ be kaman, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ? Nɛ Ebɔrɛ baa wɔ anyi be kaman, wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ anyi so? 32Esa nɛ e maŋ mɔn anyi mo gbagba Pibinyɛn nseŋ ta mo m bɔɔ basa enɔ ŋkpal anyi kikɛ so na, manɛ nna nɛ e maaŋ bugi kagbene n sa anyi kusɔ kikɛ n ti mo Pibi so? 33Nɛ wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n wu Ebɔrɛ be basa kulubi, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ gbagba e kaŋɛ fanɛ b ji n lar. 34Esa ko malɛ naa wɔtɔ nna nɛ e tiŋ n ji m bri bumo a? Kristo Yesu e la emo nɛ e wu, mo alɛ nseŋ naa la emo nɛ Ebɔrɛ tiŋi ashi luwu to nɛ e ya kaa tase Ebɔrɛ be jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa a kule Ebɔrɛ a sa anyi na. 35To, manɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n lara kasha nɛ Kristo kɔ a sa anyi ashi anyi so? Tɔrɔ ŋko awurfoŋ ŋko basa be kekɔrfɛ anyi ŋkpal anyi be yirda so ŋko akoŋ ŋko ketir ŋko kenishipere ŋko luwu bre e naaŋ tiŋ n lara mbe kasha ashi anyi so? 36Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“Ŋkpal fo so nɛ an wɔ kenishipere
nɛ k kɔ anyi a yɔ luwu to kachɛ kama na.
An ki fanɛ mbolpɔ nɛ b kɔ a yɔ nɛ b ya teŋ nna.”
37Kashenteŋto, shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n lara mbe kasha ashi anyi so. Kusɔ kama malɛ kikɛ to an bɔla emo nɛ e daŋ sha anyi na so nna a kɔ eleŋ kusɔ kikɛ so. 38Ŋkpal manɛ so, m baa nyi geeŋ nna fanɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n lara kasha nɛ e kɔ a sa anyi na anyi so. Nɛ an wu ŋko an wɔ ŋkpa to gba, anyi maaŋ tiŋ n lar mbe kasha na to. Emalaika ŋko mbuibi lubiana ŋko asheŋ nɛ a bee wora naniere ŋko amo nɛ a beeŋ wora kachako gba ŋko eleŋana maaŋ tiŋ n lara kasha na anyi so. 39Shɛŋ maŋ wɔ durnya ere be esoso ŋko kumo be kaseto nɛ k tiŋ n lara mbe kasha na ashi anyi so. Shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ wɔ durnya ere kikɛ to nɛ k tiŋ n lara anyi ashi Ebɔrɛ be kasha nɛ k bɔla an Nyɛnpe Kristo Yesu so a la anyeya na to.

Title: ROMEBI 9
Content:
Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe basa laraso be asheŋ
1Asɔ nɛ n wɔ Kristo to a kaŋɛ ere la kashenteŋ nna, m maa fule nna nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na malɛ bee ŋini ma ashi ma kagbene to fanɛ m maa fule nna. 2Asɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ na nde: Kagbenejija damta nɛ ebesa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar e bɔlɔ ma to ŋkpal ma basa so. 3Nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kpal bumo so, ma yiri to ebi gbagba nɛ n de na, n so ma gbagba kɔnɔ nseŋ lara ma ashi Kristo be kebaawɔtɔ to gba, n daa beeŋ baa sha loŋ. 4Ma basa Israɛlebi nɛ n de na. Bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta ŋ ki mbe mbia n shin nɛ b nya mbe kemaŋkura na n ti so. E nase kebaawɔtɔ koŋwuleso be kɔnɔ n sa bumo nseŋ sa bumo mbra na nɛ bɔrɛlambu na to be kabɔrɛshuŋ na nɛ b nya Ebɔrɛ be nnɔ naseso n ti so. 5B shi benananyɛngboŋana na be kanaŋ to nna. Dimɛdi malɛ be kaplɛa so Kristo na shi bumo to nna. Epaŋ be kedi e baa la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e chɔ kusɔ kama kuwura na peya. Amɛn.
6Kede maa ŋini fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso na maŋ tiŋ m bɔla ekpa nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ Israɛl be efuli so ebi kikɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso. 7Kumo alɛ maŋ naa ŋini fanɛ ŋkpal b ka la Eebraham mo nanabiana so bumo kikɛ la Ebɔrɛ be mbia nna. Ayai, kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Eebraham e la: “Aizek be kaman to ebi nawule e naaŋ ba ki feya.” 8To, kede e naa ŋini fanɛ mannɛ eyur ere to be kakurge e naa ta basa a ki Ebɔrɛ be mbia she bumo nɛ b bɔla Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso na to n nya kakurge na nawule e la Eebraham be kaman to ebi kashenteŋto. 9Ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ n sa Eebraham ŋ kaŋɛ: “Jemanɛ na gbagba kaŋ fo, meeŋ bɛta m ba nɛ Sɛɛra e nya ebinyɛn.” 10Kede malɛ be kaman Rebɛka gba be mbinyɛnbi anyɔ na gba daa kɔ etuto koŋwule nna, mo e la an nananyɛn Aizek na. 11Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ b kurge mbia na nɛ b wora kelela ŋko kulubi Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Rebɛka nna le: 12“Enimuso beeŋ ba shuŋ ebibiso na.” Loŋ e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili na fanɛ mbe kelara bumo be eko na daŋ shi mbe keparso be ketre to nna, mannɛ ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ b daŋ wora so. 13Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “N lara Jeekɔb nna nseŋ kini Isɔɔ.”
14To, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ naniere? Fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maa ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so ŋko? Kaarɛ gba! 15Ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ anebi Mosis: “Esa nɛ mee sha kewu kuwɔr, nɛ mee wu kuwɔr nsaa shu a sa esa nɛ mee shu a sa.” 16Amoso, k maŋ la kusɔ nɛ k bee wora ŋkpal nyiŋgbasa be kusɔ nɛ e bee sha so ŋko mbe ashuŋ shunso so, k la Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr nna. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ ewura Fɛɛro: “M maŋ fo so nna ŋkpal le so nɛ m bɔla fo so ŋ ŋini ma eleŋ nseŋ shin nɛ durnya kikɛ e pin ma asheŋ.” 18Amoso, nɛ Ebɔrɛ baa sha kewu esa kuwɔr, e beeŋ wu mo kuwɔr nɛ e naa sha keshin nɛ esa be kumu e baa du kpakpa, e beeŋ shin nɛ k baa du loŋ.
Ebɔrɛ be agbo nɛ mbe kuwɔr be asheŋ
19Nɛ kenya la loŋ nna, menyi be eko beeŋ tiŋ m bishi ma le: “To, nɛ Ebɔrɛ e la esa nɛ e bee wora loŋ, manɛ e ba nɛ e naa wu anyi kulubi, ŋkpal manɛ so, wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n ji kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha emɔrɔ?” 20Ama fo alɛ dimɛdi e la wanɛ nɛ fo tiŋ m malga n ji Ebɔrɛ emɔrɔ le? Kusɔ pɔrso beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ kumo be epɔrpo le: “Manɛ e ba nɛ fo pɔr ma le” a? 21Mannɛ epɔrpo e kɔ mbe ebɔ be eleŋ nɛ e tiŋ ŋ ku ebɔ na be ako m pɔr nchɛgboŋ be kusɔ jiso to be kusɔ nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta ebɔ na be ako malɛ m pɔr kachɛ kama malɛ be kusɔ jiso to be kusɔ a? 22To, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ Ebɔrɛ wora. Mbe demuso be agbo nɛ mbe eleŋ nɛ e daa sha kelara ŋ ŋini basa. Ama e daŋ ji basa nɛ mbe demuso be agbo daa wɔ bumo so nɛ b daga kasogberge na kanyiti. 23Mo alɛ daa sha nna nɛ basa e wu mbe kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ e shin nɛ k ba anyi nɛ mbe kuwɔr na chɛr a ba anyi so so nna. Anyi nɛ e bela ase n yili nɛ an nya mbe kemaŋkura na. 24Anyi nɛ e tre na, ama mannɛ ashi Juwebi nawule to, e tre basa ko ashi nnyamase gba to. 25Le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla anebi Hoziya so ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Basa nɛ b daa maŋ la meya na, naniere meeŋ tre bumo ma basa.
Efuli nɛ n daa maa sha na, naniere meeŋ tre kumo ma eshapo.”
26“Kakpa nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: ‘Mannɛ ma basa e la menyi’ na koŋwule na
nɛ meeŋ naŋ tre bumo ma, Ebɔrɛ nɛ n wɔ ŋkpa to na be mbia.”
27Le nɛ anebi Aizaaya bee kaŋɛ Israɛlebi be asheŋ awɔrso:
“Nɛ Israɛlebi baa shi fanɛ teku ase be ajembubi gba,
bumo to be gbrɛbi e naaŋ nya kumɔlga.
28Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maaŋ chɛr nseŋ ji durnya ere demu nɛ asheŋ e loge.”
29Kumo alɛ baa du fanɛ kananɛ Aizaaya daŋ chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ le nna:
“Nɛ Enyɛnpetale daa maŋ yige kaman to ebi ko nna n sa anyi,
anyi daa beeŋ ki fanɛ kananɛ Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra be nde daŋ ki na.”
Israɛl be baru lela be asheŋ
30To, naniere, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ kaŋɛ? Kumo kikɛ nde fanɛ saŋɛ na nnyamase daa maa fin bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nferinto be kelela, ama naniere bre b bɔla yirda so n nya loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ. 31Ama Israɛlebi nɛ b daŋ fara a bɛ mbra nɛ k bee bar le be kelela so na a fin kumo na bre maŋ nya kumo. 32To, nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ bumo alɛ maŋ nya loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na? Kusɔ nɛ k ba e la fanɛ b daa maŋ ta yirda n fin bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nferinto be kelela na, b daŋ ta ashuŋ shunso nna a fin kumo. Amoso, b daŋ fiti kejembu nɛ basa bee fiti kumo so na nna. 33Kumo be asheŋ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le na:
“Men keni, kejembu nɛ n ta n nase Zayɔn
nɛ k bee shin nɛ basa bee fiti kumo na,
kumo e la fanɛ kefalta nɛ baaŋ fiti n tɔr na.
Ama ekama nɛ e yirda mo Yesu na bre maaŋ ji anishinyɔr kikɛ.”

Title: ROMEBI 10
Content:
Kananɛ Israɛlebi wora n foe ekpa na be asheŋ
1Ŋ kurgepoana, kusɔ nɛ m baa sha ga nsaa kule kumo be Ebɔrɛ e la fanɛ ma basa Israɛlebi e nya kumɔlga. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so, meeŋ tiŋ n ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ pere bumo kenishi ga, ama loŋ be kenishipere na malɛ maŋ bɛ kepin asheŋ to so. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, b maa pin ekpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha fanɛ b bɔla so na to nɛ bumo nɛ mo e nyalɛ nsaa wɔtɔ a bɔla bumo gbagba be aworbi be ekpaana so. Loŋ malɛ e naa ŋini fanɛ b maŋ ta bumo be amu m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nɛ e shin nɛ mo nɛ bumo e nyalɛ.
Kananɛ kumɔlga la ekama peya be asheŋ
4Kristo malɛ e bar mbra na ekar, saŋɛ na so, ekama nɛ e yirda, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ mo nɛ amodoŋwura e nyalɛ. 5Le malɛ be asheŋ nɛ anebi Mosis daŋ kaŋɛ saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ malga kebaabɛ mbra na so a sha keki elelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito na be asheŋ na fanɛ: “Ekama nɛ e bee wora kusɔ nɛ mbra na bee ŋini malɛ gba beeŋ baa wɔ mbra na be kebaawɔtɔ to nna na.” 6Ama le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ kebɔla yirda so a ki elelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito be asheŋ: “Sa maŋ bishi fo kumu fanɛ: ‘Wanɛ e naaŋ dii n yɔ ebɔrɛso?’ Kumo e la fanɛ n ya bar Kristo. 7Fo alɛ e sa maŋ bishi le gba: ‘Wanɛ e naaŋ gbelge n yɔ durnya be kaseto?’ Kumo e la fanɛ n ya bar Kristo ashi bubuni to.” 8Kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na naa kaŋɛ e la: “Ebɔrɛ be kamalga baŋ taga menyi to nna. K baa wɔ menyi be nnɔ to nɛ menyi be ŋgbene to nna.” Yirda na be baru nɛ anyee bɔ a sa basa na. 9Nɛ fo baŋ bugi kɔnɔ n ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu e la Enyɛnpe na nseŋ yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ tiŋi mo ashi luwu to, feeŋ nya kumɔlga. 10Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa be yirda ashi kagbene to e naa shin nɛ e bee ki elelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito nɛ mbe kebaabugi kɔnɔ a ji eshɛda malɛ bee shin nɛ e bee nya kumɔlga. 11Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Esa kama nɛ e yirda mo maa ji anishinyɔr kikɛ.” 12Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be anishito Juw nɛ kanyamase maŋ kɔr abar to, Enyɛnpe na e la ekama nyam be Enyɛnpe, nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e shu n tre mo, e beeŋ bugi kagbene n nɛfa amodoŋwura. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Esa kama nɛ e shu n tre Enyɛnpe na beeŋ nya kumɔlga.” 14Ama nuso nɛ baaŋ wora n shu n tre esa nɛ b maŋ yirda? Nɛ nuso malɛ nɛ baaŋ wora n yirda emo nɛ baaŋ shu n tre na nɛ esa pɔtɛ baa maŋ kaŋɛ bumo mbe asheŋ? Ŋko nɛ esa pɔtɛ baa maŋ bɔ kubɔya na n sa bumo, nuso nɛ baaŋ wora n nu? 15Nɛ nuso malɛ nɛ baaŋ wora m bɔ kubɔya na nɛ Ebɔrɛ baa maŋ shuŋi bumo? Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “K la mamachi be kesheŋ nna n sa basa nɛ b kɔ kubɔya na nna a ba.” 16Ama mannɛ Israɛlebi kikɛ e sɔ baru lela na, ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ anebi Aizaaya daŋ bishi Enyɛnpe na: “Enyɛnpe, wanɛ e yirda anyi be kubɔya na?” 17Amoso, yirda bee shi kubɔya na be kenu to nna nɛ kubɔya na be kenu malɛ bee shi kemalga Kristo na be asheŋ to. 18Ama kesheŋ bishiso nɛ ŋ kɔ nde: “Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ b maŋ nu kubɔya na a?” Cha, b nu. Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“Bumo be ebɔl fo kasawule ere so be kaplɛkama
nɛ bumo be mmalga yɔ durnya ere be ekar kikɛ.”
19Mee sha fanɛ n naŋ bishi fanɛ: “Israɛlebi daa maŋ pin to a?” Anebi Mosis gbagba e juŋkpar n sa kebishi ere be kifito ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ le nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ:
“Meeŋ shin nɛ kayurbesa e luri menyi to
ŋkpal basa nɛ bumo be efuli so maŋ la shɛŋ na so,
meeŋ shin nɛ men nya agbo n wɔtɔ efuli ko
nɛ kumo be basa wuli.”
20Ama anebi Aizaaya ji kenyɛn a chɔ loŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ le nɛ Ebɔrɛ yɛ:
“Basa nɛ b daa maa fin ma e bante ma
nɛ n lara ma kumu ŋ ŋini basa
nɛ b daa maa bishi ma asheŋ.”
21Le nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Israɛlebi malɛ be asheŋ:
“M bugi enɔ to nna saŋkikɛ nɛ n sɔ menyi,
nɛ menyi be asoe maa nu asheŋ
nɛ men wɔtɔ a ji ma eleŋ emɔrɔ na.”

Title: ROMEBI 11
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr nɛ e kɔ a sa Israɛlebi be asheŋ
1To, kusɔ nɛ mee sha nɛ m bishi e la fanɛ, Ebɔrɛ kini mbe basa nna ŋko? Kaarɛ, ma alɛ gba la Israɛl be efuli so be esa nna n shi Eebraham be kanaŋ to a la Bɛnjamin be yiri to be esa. 2Ebɔrɛ maŋ kini mbe basa nɛ e lara dra dra na kikɛ kuraa. Men nyi kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ ashi kakpa nɛ a bee malga anebi Elaija be asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ e ta kenishipere ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ ŋ gbiti Israɛlebi na ŋko? E yɛ: 3“Enyɛnpe, b mɔ fo anebiana nseŋ da fo bɔrɛsureana n lɛ. Naniere n nawule e ka nɛ baa sha kemɔ ma alɛ gba.” 4Elaija ka daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ, nuso nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ mo? Ebɔrɛ yɛ: “Basa ŋgboŋ ashunu nɛ b maŋ gbir m bunyaŋ kegbir nɛ baa tre Baal na nɛ n yige n sa ma kumu.” 5Naniere be jemanɛ ere gba, loŋ koŋwule nna fanɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ lara basa gbrɛbi ko nna n sa mbe kumu ŋkpal mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ so. 6K ka baa la kuwɔr be kakɛ be asheŋ ere bre, k maŋ naa la ashuŋ shunso be asheŋ, nɛ k daa la ashuŋ shunso be asheŋ nna, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na daa maaŋ naa la kuwɔr be kakɛ. 7To, naniere manɛ e naa wɔtɔ? Kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ e la fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Israɛlebi daŋ pere kenishi a fin na, b fin kumo ŋ gben, ama Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso na bre nya kumo nɛ basa nɛ b ka malɛ nya amu kpakpaso. 8Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“Ebɔrɛ sa bumo kebalto
nɛ anishi nɛ a maa wu nɛ asoe nɛ a maa nu nna
hale m ba fo mbre.”
9Ewura Deevid malɛ yɛ:
“Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ b gelge ŋ gben
nɛ b so m pɛ bumo ashi bumo be ejikpa.
Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ b tɔr
nseŋ shin nɛ b gberge bumo kusoe.
10Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ bumo be anishi buu so nɛ b sa maŋ nya n wu nseŋ shin nɛ bumo be nshɛr e kɔnto hale mbaanaayɔ.”
11Men shin nɛ n naŋ bishi kesheŋ ere fanɛ Israɛlebi daŋ fiti nna n tɔr ŋ koso ŋ gben ŋko? Ayai, mannɛ aloŋ nna kuraa. Ama ŋkpal bumo be alubi so nɛ nnyamase nya kumɔlga nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ na yɛlga Israɛlebi. 12Juwebi be alubi so nɛ durnyaebi nya nɛfa gboŋgboŋi nɛ bumo be kabɔrɛŋana wuso malɛ gba bar nnyamase nɛfa gboŋgboŋi. Nɛ kananɛ k la loŋ ere, nɛ Juwebi kikɛ na ba ti so, kumo ere nɛfa nɛ k beeŋ ba na beeŋ ba kaa shi pasaa.
Nnyamase be kumɔlga be asheŋ
13To, naniere, menyi nnyamase nɛ mee malga a sa na. Ŋ ka baa la nnyamase be eshuŋipo ere bre, meeŋ baa puchi ma kushuŋ na so. 14Shere mee wora loŋ, meeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ kayɛlga e pɛ ma basa nɛ loŋ e tiŋ n shin nɛ bumo be beko e nya kumɔlga. 15Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ kini bumo na so, durnyaebi nɛ b ka na nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ba abar so nna. To, nɛ naniere Ebɔrɛ naŋ sɔ bumo, nuso nɛ asheŋ beeŋ baa du? Kumo ere bubuni beeŋ nya ŋkpa nna na. 16Nɛ esa baŋ ta bodobodo be kaba n lara kanya popɔr be sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ, kumo ere bodobodo na gba kikɛ la Ebɔrɛ peya nna na. Nɛ esa malɛ naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e wɔ kedibi be nliŋi, kumo ere mo koŋwule na e kraa wɔ kedibi na kikɛ gba. 17B ka fɛta ɔlifs be kedibi fɛaso be keyabi nɛ k bee nya kekeni nseŋ ta menyi nɛ men du fanɛ ɔlifs be kukɔrbua n yuu n chɔga ɔlifs be kedibi na so nɛ menyee nu kedibi na be ebel ere, 18men sa maa puchi ŋkpal men ka la ayabi na so, ŋkpal manɛ so, men baa nyiŋi fanɛ mannɛ menyi e kɔ nliŋi na to, amo e kɔ menyi to. 19Menyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi be amu le: “B fɛta ayabi ashi kedibi nɛ k nya kebela na so nna n lɛ nseŋ ta anyi nɛ anyi maŋ nya kebela na n yuu to nɛ an kule n chena.” 20To, kashenteŋ nna fanɛ b daŋ fɛta bumo nɛ b daa la kedibi na be ayabi gbagba na nna n lɛ ŋkpal b ka maŋ kɔ yirda so, ama yirda so nɛ menyi ere yil kpakpa na. Amoso, men sa maa wu menyi be amu, men baa kɔ kabɔrɛŋana a wɔtɔ. 21Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ ka baa maŋ yige m paŋ Juwebi nɛ b du fanɛ ayabi gbagba na, e maaŋ yige m paŋ menyi alɛ gba. 22To, loŋ e daga men ka keni m pin kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kelela nɛ mbe nyaŋnyaŋ du. E ŋini basa nɛ b foe kashenteŋ be ekpa na so na kananɛ e du nyaŋnyaŋ nseŋ ŋini menyi alɛ mbe kelela nɛ men kraŋ baa wɔ mbe kelela na to nna na. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, e beeŋ ku menyi n lɛ fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ ku ayabi gbagba na n lɛ na. 23Ama nɛ Juwebi na chɛrga bumo be nfɛra nseŋ fara a yirda, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ beeŋ naŋ bɛta bumo n wɔtɔ kakpa nɛ b daa yil na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n wora loŋ. 24Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ Ebɔrɛ baŋ tiŋ ŋ ku fo ashi ɔlifs be kekɔrbuadibi be kapɔr to nseŋ ta fo n yuu n wɔtɔ ɔlifs be kedibi nɛ k nya kebela a maŋ daga fo nɛ kumo ka luri abar to na, kumo ere ayabi dra nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ku n lɛ na maaŋ baa du mo so kpakpa hale gbrɛbi kama kuraa fanɛ ayabi na ka beeŋ naŋ tiŋ m ba chuge amo be kedibi gbagba so ŋko?
Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr nɛ e kɔ a sa basa kikɛ be asheŋ
25Ŋ kurgepoana, kashenteŋ be wulo ko wɔtɔ nɛ mee sha fanɛ men pin kumo, saŋɛ na so men maaŋ ta menyi be amu fanɛ basa nyiashempo. Kumo nde fanɛ kumu kpakpaso be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k ba Israɛlebi so na maŋ ba nna nɛ k ba kaa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ, kumo be ekar e la saŋɛ nɛ nnyamase nɛ baaŋ nya kumɔlga na kikɛ ya loge nyam. 26Amoso, Israɛlebi kikɛ beeŋ nya kumɔlga fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le na:
“Emɔlgapo na beeŋ shi Zayɔn
m ba lara edalubisheŋ kikɛ ashi Jeekɔb be kaman to ebi to.”
27“Ŋ kaŋ lara bumo be alubi ashi bumo to,
meeŋ nase kɔnɔ ashi ma nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ be kaplɛa so.”
28Baru lela na be kaplɛa so, bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ki bedoŋ nna ŋkpal menyi nnyamase so, ama Ebɔrɛ be kelara bumo so na be kaplɛa so, b la mo teriana nna ŋkpal benananyɛngboŋana na so. 29Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nɛ mbe ketre esa a sa mbe kumu maa chɛrga. 30An ta fanɛ menyi nnyamase le, saŋɛ na men daa maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ, ama naniere e bee wu menyi kuwɔr nna ŋkpal Juwebi ka maa nu a sa mo so. 31Naniere bumo alɛ gba kpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr nɛ e wu menyi na so nna a maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ, saŋɛ na so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wu bumo alɛ gba kuwɔr. 32Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ yige basa kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ kasomaanu be kebaawɔtɔ to, saŋɛ na so nɛ e wu bumo kikɛ kuwɔr.
Kananɛ Pɔɔl bee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
33Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ be alelasheŋ shi pasaa. Mbe nfɛra nɛ mbe kashennyi shi kashenteŋto. Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ m pin asheŋ nɛ e bee yili to ŋ kute ŋko m pin mbe asheŋ woraso to?
34Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na:
“Wanɛ e nyi Enyɛnpe be kagbene to
wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n sa mo nfɛra
ashi mbe asheŋ woraso to?
35Nɛ wanɛ malɛ e daŋ paŋ mo kusɔ ko nɛ e fin ŋ ka amodoŋwura?”
36Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e pɔr kusɔ kikɛ, mo alɛ to nɛ kusɔ kikɛ bɔla a wɔ ŋkpa to a sa mo. Kemaŋkura e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ so mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

Title: ROMEBI 12
Content:
Kebaawɔtɔ ashi Ebɔrɛ be ekpa so be asheŋ
1To, ŋ kurgepoana, ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ damta nɛ e wu anyi na so, mee kule menyi nna nɛ men ta menyi be amu n sa Ebɔrɛ fanɛ sarga nɛ k wɔ ŋkpa to a du cheembi a par Ebɔrɛ. Menyi be kabɔrɛshuŋ nɛ men kɔ a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nna na. 2Men sa maa ta menyi be ŋgbene a wɔtɔ durnya ere to ebi be asheŋ to, men shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ e chɛrga menyi be ŋgbene n sa menyi nɛ men nya nfɛra popɔr. Saŋɛ na so nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ m pin kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha, kumo e la fanɛ alelasheŋ, mbe aparsheŋ nɛ asɔ nɛ a daga.
3Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ e sa ma so, mee kaŋɛ menyi be ekama nna fanɛ e sa maa maŋ mbe kumu so a chɔ kananɛ e baa du. Ama men baa fɛ bebɔlpo be nfɛra a sa menyi be amu a kɔ loŋ be nfɛra na a yuu kananɛ yirda nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa ekama na sa so. 4Mba damta e chɔɔ esa be eyur so, ama amo alɛ be kekama nɛ kumo be kushuŋ. 5To, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ anyi nɛ Yesu be kefɛato du. An shi, ama an la eyur koŋwule nna ashi mo to nɛ ekama malɛ wɔ mo barkasa to. 6Amoso, an baa kɔ anyi be nnaŋ to be ŋkɛana na to a shuŋ. Amo nɛ an nya ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ e sa ekama kananɛ e beeŋ tiŋ na so. Fo kama nɛ fo kakɛ baa la abɔrɛsheŋ be kebaawu a kaŋɛ, fo ta loŋ be kakɛ na ŋ kesar fo yirda so n shuŋ. 7Fo kama nɛ fo kakɛ la fo braana be kebaashuŋ, fo baa shuŋ bumo. Nɛ k naa la keŋini, fo baa ŋini. 8Nɛ kumo alɛ naa la basa be keleŋto, fo baa wora loŋ. Ekama malɛ nɛ e bee barga mbe kanya to a sa beko e baa bugi kagbene a wora loŋ. Ekama nɛ e la ejuŋkparpo e baa shuŋ ga nɛ emo nɛ mo alɛ naa wu basa kuwɔr e baa bugi kagbene a wora loŋ.
9Men shin nɛ menyi be kasha e baa la kashenteŋ be kasha. Men baa kishi alubisheŋ nsaa far a chɛ alelasheŋ. 10Men baa kɔ bekurgepo be kasha a sha abar nsaa juŋkpar a bunyaŋ abar. 11Men baa shuŋ ga nsaa maa wora ntɔl. Men baa bugi menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ to a shuŋ Enyɛnpe kashenteŋto. 12Men shin nɛ menyi be tama e baa sa menyi kagbenefuli nɛ men baa ji kanyiti ashi menyi be etɔrɔ to nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ saŋkama. 13Men baa barga menyi be asɔ to a sa bekurgepoana nɛ b maŋ kɔ nsaa bugi menyi be nwu a sa bekurgepo nɛ b la befɔ.
14Men baa nɛfa basa nɛ baa kpal menyi be kebɛso so a tɔrɔ menyi na, men baa nɛfa bumo nsaa maa so bumo kɔnɔ. 15Men baa tu bumo nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli a shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e baa fuli nsaa tu bumo nɛ baa shu malɛ a shu. 16Men baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ a sa abar. Men sa maa maŋ menyi be amu so, ama men baa bar menyi be amu kaseto a shuli a shuŋ bebɔlpo be ashuŋ a maa fɛ fanɛ men la benyiashempo. 17Men sa maa bɛta kulubi a ka kulubi be kukɔ. Men baa wora ania a sha basa kikɛ nsaa wora bumo kelela. 18Men baa wora ania kanaŋkamaso nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ nɛ menyi nɛ basa kikɛ e baa wɔ kagbenewushi be kebaawɔtɔ to. 19Beshapo, men sa maa wora a tal basa nɛ baa wora menyi to, men shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo e baa shuŋ loŋ be kushuŋ a sa menyi fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe bee kaŋɛ le na: “Keka esa be kulubi kukɔ la ma asheŋ nna. Ma, Enyɛnpe na e naaŋ ka esa be kulubi kukɔ nɛ kumo be ekpa so.” 20Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men baa wora nde, nɛ akoŋ baa kɔ fo doŋ, fo sa mo ajibi, nɛ achukoŋ malɛ naa kɔ mo, fo sa mo kusɔnuuso nɛ e nuu. Nɛ fo baŋ wora loŋ, feeŋ ta anishinyɔr m pɛ edoŋ na. 21Men sa maŋ shin nɛ kulubi e baa pɔɔ menyi so, ama men baa shin nɛ menyi be kelela e baa pɔɔ kulubi so.

Title: ROMEBI 13
Content:
Keshuŋ n sa abane be asheŋ
1A daga fanɛ ekama e baa nu a sa mbe efuli so be abane be bejuŋkparpo, ŋkpal manɛ so, abane kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ ta eleŋ m bɔɔ kumo enɔ. Mo Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na malɛ e jɔŋɛ abane kama. 2Amoso, ekama nɛ e maa nu a sa abane be bejuŋkparpo bee ji kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ jɔŋɛ emɔrɔ nna na. Bekama malɛ nɛ baa wora loŋ bee ta kasogberge nna a bar bumo be amu na. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ baa wora kelela maa ŋana abane be bejuŋkparpo. Bumo nɛ baa wora alubi e naa ŋana bumo. Men maa sha fanɛ men baa ŋana abane be ejuŋkparpo kama ŋko? To, kumo ere, men baa wora asɔ nɛ a daga nɛ enimu na e baa sa menyi mbo. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, e la Ebɔrɛ be kenya nna ŋkpal fo kelela so. Ama nɛ fo baa wora alubi bre, baa lɔ kufu, ŋkpal manɛ so, enimu na maa keta mbe tokobi na jiga nna. E la Ebɔrɛ be kenya nna nɛ e baa keni asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so a sa basa a gberge alubiworapoana kusoe. 5Amoso, a daga fanɛ men baa bar menyi be amu kaseto a sa bejuŋkparpoana, mannɛ ŋkpal kasogberge nawule so, ama ŋkpal kananɛ menyi be ŋgbene to be nfɛra bee yili menyi so so. 6To, loŋ koŋwule na malɛ gba so e shin nɛ a daga fanɛ men baa ka elampo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, benimuana na la Ebɔrɛ be anya nna a kɔ bumo be saŋɛ kikɛ a keni abane be asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so. 7Amoso, men baa ka akɔ kama nɛ men ji bumo. Nɛ k la fanɛ menyi be amu so be lampo nna, men ka, nɛ kumo alɛ naa la fanɛ menyi be asɔ be lampo nna, men ka amo alɛ gba be kukɔ. Nɛ k naa la fanɛ bunyaŋ nna, men jɔŋɛ bumo ase m bunyaŋ bumo.
Asheŋ nɛ a daga fanɛ an wora n sa abar be asheŋ
8Men sa maŋ ji esa kikɛ be kukɔ she abar be kasha nawule be kukɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e bee sha mo barkasa dimɛdi bɛ mbra na so n loge. 9Ebɔrɛ be mbraana nɛ a bee kaŋɛ le na: “Men sa maa ji kubojua nɛ men sa maa mɔ nɛ men sa maa yuri nɛ men sa maa yɛlga abar be asɔ,” nɛ mbraana nɛ a ka na kikɛ wɔ le be mbra ere to nna: “Baa sha fo barkasa dimɛdi fanɛ fo gbagba be kumu.” 10Fo kama nɛ fee sha fo barkasa dimɛdi, fo maaŋ wora mo kulubi. Amoso, kesha fo barkasa bee ŋini kebɛ mbra na kikɛ so nna na.
11Men baa wora loŋ a nyi jemanɛ mo nɛ an wɔ ere to be asheŋ. Jemanɛ mo nɛ k daga fanɛ men tiŋi ashi menyi be edi to na fo, ŋkpal manɛ so, naniere anyi be kumɔlga be kachɛ na taga to a chɔ saŋɛ nɛ an daŋ fara n yirda Yesu Kristo na. 12Kanyɛ na biri n chɛr ga, naniere a ka gbrɛ nɛ kare e chɛ. Amoso, men shin nɛ an yige tentembiri to be ashuŋ shunso n lɛ nseŋ ta akɔsɔ na a wɔ kefulto to a kɔ. 13Men shin nɛ an baa bii kebaawɔtɔ lela nɛ k daga basa nɛ b wɔ kapaso be kefulto be kebaawɔtɔ na to. An sa maŋ naa wɔ kasanuu be nshɛr jijigaana to nɛ kusɔjigaya ŋko amɔmɔshiasheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ nlu ŋko kayurbesa be kebaawɔtɔ to. 14Ama men ta Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be akɔsɔ na a kuŋ menyi be amu fanɛ asɔbuuso na nseŋ yige kebaade menyi be kapɔr lubiana ere be aparsheŋ so nɛ a sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ menyi be ayɛlgasɔ e ka menyi to.

Title: ROMEBI 14
Content:
Kananɛ k maŋ daga fo ka bee wu fo barkasa kulubi be asheŋ
1Men baa sɔ ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ eleŋ ashi yirda na to na a wɔtɔ menyi to, ama menyi nɛ mo e sa maa ji emɔrɔ a yɔ mbe asheŋ fɛso be kaplɛa so. 2Esa ko bee kaa yirda fanɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n ji kusɔ kikɛ be epo, ama emo nɛ mbe yirda maŋ kɔ eleŋ bre bee ji afantaŋ nawule be epo nna. 3Nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee ji kusɔ kikɛ e sa maa fɛl emo nɛ e maa wora loŋ. Emo nɛ mo alɛ maa ji kusɔ kikɛ na malɛ e sa maa kaŋɛ fanɛ emo nɛ e bee ji kusɔ kikɛ na bee foe ekpa nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e sɔ amodoŋwura na. 4Manɛ be ekpa nɛ fo alɛ kɔ nɛ fo tiŋ n ji esa pɔtɛ be kayɛrbi demu? Mo nyɛnpe gbagba be anishito nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n ji n lar ŋko n ji n tɔr, mo alɛ beeŋ ji n lar malɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ e ji n lar.
5An ta fanɛ nchɛ le. Esa ko kutɔ nchɛ ko la nchɛgboŋ nna, ama esa ko malɛ kutɔ nchɛ kikɛ sasa nna. A daga fanɛ ekama e baa pin mbe kagbene to geeŋ fanɛ le be kesheŋ ere e daga ŋ ka wora ŋko n sa maŋ wora. 6Esa kama nɛ e bee ta kachɛ ko fanɛ kachɛgboŋ, bee wora loŋ nna a sha kebunyaŋ Enyɛnpe. Nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee ji kejibi ko, bee ji kumo nna a bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe na, ŋkpal manɛ so, amodoŋwura gba bee kaa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nna pɔɛŋ nsaa ji. Nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee kini kejibi ko be keji, bee wora loŋ nna a bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe na nsaa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nna na. 7Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be ekama maŋ wɔtɔ nna ŋkpal mo gbagba be kumu so so. Anyi be ekama malɛ maa wu a sa mo gbagba be kumu so. An baa wɔ ŋkpa to, Enyɛnpe nɛ an wɔ ŋkpa to a sa nɛ anyi alɛ naŋ wu gba, Enyɛnpe na nɛ anyee wu a sa. 8Amoso, nɛ an baa wɔ ŋkpa to ŋko an wu gba, an wɔ Enyɛnpe na be enɔ to nna. 9Loŋ so nɛ Kristo na wu nseŋ naŋ lar luwu to m ba na, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ baa la basa nɛ b wu nɛ bumo nɛ b kraa wɔ ŋkpa to be Enyɛnpe.
10To, nɛ a ji nuso nna nɛ fee wu fo barkasa kulubi? Nɛ fo alɛ, manɛ e ba nɛ fee keni fo barkasa a bɔl? Ŋkpal manɛ so, kachako an kikɛ beeŋ yili Ebɔrɛ be demuji be echenakpa nɛ e ji anyi demu. 11Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ gbagba nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ le na:
“Ma, Enyɛnpe ka baa wɔ ŋkpa to ere bre,
ekama beeŋ ba gbir ma kumuli kacha ko,
ekama malɛ beeŋ ba bugi kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ
ma e la Ebɔrɛ.”
12Amoso, kachako anyi be ekama beeŋ kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ asheŋ nɛ an wora kikɛ nyam nɛ kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ an wora amo.
Kesa maŋ shin nɛ fo barkasa e tɔr be asheŋ
13Amoso, men shin nɛ an yige kebaawu abar alubi be asheŋ n lɛ. Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men baa wora e la fanɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ ta shɛŋ shɛŋ ŋ kagle men niopibi kama ekpa nɛ e fiti n tɔr kulubi to. 14Ŋ ka wɔ Enyɛnpe Yesu to so m baa nyi nna geeŋ fanɛ kejibi kikɛ gbagba maŋ lubi so, ama nɛ esa kama baa ta kejibi kama fanɛ kejibi lubi, kumo ere k beeŋ baa la kejibi lubi n sa amodoŋwura kashenteŋto. 15Nɛ kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ fee ji nɛ k bee tɔrɔ fo niopibi be nfɛra, kumo ere mannɛ kasha be kesheŋ nɛ fee wora na. Sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ fo niopibi nɛ Kristo wu n sa na e foe ekpa ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ fee ji so. 16Sa maŋ shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ fee tre kusɔ lela e nya ketre lubi fanɛ k maŋ walɛ so. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to be asheŋ maŋ la kebaaji nɛ kebaanuu be asheŋ nna. K la alelasheŋ nɛ kagbenewushi nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ a bee shi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kutɔ na be kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ nna. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e bee shuŋ Kristo le be ekpa so be kebaawɔtɔ bee par Ebɔrɛ nna nɛ basa pɔtɛ gba e ji mbe kebaawɔtɔ lela na be shɛda n sa abar. 19Amoso, men shin nɛ an baa wora ania saŋkikɛ a wora asheŋ nɛ a bee bar kagbenewushi nɛ asheŋ nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ n chɛ to n shin nɛ an baa leŋ abar to. 20Sa maŋ kpal ajibi so n jija Ebɔrɛ be kushuŋ. Kejibi kama walɛ so nna, ama a maŋ daga fanɛ esa kikɛ ka ji kejibi kama nɛ k bee shin nɛ esa pɔtɛ bee foe ekpa na. 21Nɛ fo nyi fanɛ fo we eblaŋ ko ŋko n nuu nsa ŋko n wora kusɔ kama nɛ k beeŋ shin nɛ fo niopibi e foe ekpa bre, fo ka maŋ wora amo be kekama bɔ. 22Amoso, kusɔ kama nɛ fo yirda a yɔ le be asheŋ ere be kaplɛa so, fo shin nɛ k baa wɔ fo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nferinto. Kagbenefuli malɛ la esa kama nɛ e maa wu mo gbagba be kumu kedoŋ ashi kusɔ nɛ e bee yirda be ekpa so na peya nna. 23Nɛ esa baa shin nɛ e ji kejibi kama nsaa wora shikashika nseŋ ji kumo, amodoŋwura wora n da so ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maŋ kɔ yirda kesheŋ nɛ e bee wora na to nna na. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ fo maŋ ta yirda n wora kumo la kulubi nna.

Title: ROMEBI 15
Content:
Kebaawora asheŋ a par basa pɔtɛ be asheŋ
1A daga fanɛ anyi, bumo nɛ an kɔ eleŋ yirda na to na e baa chɛ bepɔshipo na to a keni bumo be asheŋ nɛ a bee pɔɔ bumo so to. An sa maa wɔtɔ a de anyi gbagba be aparsheŋ so. 2Anyi be ekama e baa wora mo braana bebɛsopo asheŋ lela nɛ a bee par bumo nɛ loŋ e tiŋ n sa bumo eleŋ nɛ k beeŋ yɛr bumo anishito ashi yirda na to. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo gba daa maŋ de mo gbagba be aparsheŋ so, ama loŋ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ e bee kaŋɛ le na: “Katege nɛ basa tege menyi na kikɛ laŋɛ ma kumu so.” 4Abɔrɛsibɛ kama malɛ nɛ b daŋ sibɛ dra dra kikɛ n nase na, b daŋ sibɛ amo nna nɛ a baa ŋini anyi asheŋ, saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ bɔla kanyiti nɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee leŋ anyi to na to a kɔ tama. 5Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa anyi kanyiti nsaa leŋ anyi to na e shin nɛ men nya kagbene koŋwuleso be kebaawɔtɔ a wɔ abar so a bɛ Kristo Yesu so. 6Saŋɛ na so menyi kikɛ beeŋ ta ebɔl koŋwule n di Ebɔrɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo mo Tuto na epaŋ.
Nnyamase ka bee maŋkura Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
7To, men baa sɔ abar fanɛ kananɛ Kristo sɔ menyi na nɛ Ebɔrɛ e nya kemaŋkura. 8Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ Kristo ki Juwebi be kenya nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kashenteŋ na so, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ shin nɛ nnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase n sa benananyɛngboŋana na e bɔla ekpa. 9Loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ nnyamase e maŋkura Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal mbe kuwɔr so fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ le na:
“Ŋkpal le so meeŋ baa wɔ nnyamase to a di fo Ebɔrɛ epaŋ.
Meeŋ boŋ nshɛ n dele fo ketre.”
10Le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na kraŋ naa kaŋɛ:
“Nnyamase, men tu Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso
n shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e fuli menyi.”
11Amo koŋwule na kraŋ naa kaŋɛ le:
“Menyi nnyamase kikɛ, men di Enyɛnpe na epaŋ,
nɛ menyi basa yiri kikɛ men boŋ nshɛ n di mo epaŋ.”
12Ade malɛ gba kikɛ be kaman le nɛ anebi Aizaaya yɛ:
“Jɛsi be kenanabi beeŋ ba kachako
m ba lar n ji nnyamase so kuwura
nɛ b ta bumo be tama kikɛ n deŋi mo so.”
13Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa anyi tama na e shin nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ kagbenewushi e bɔlɔ menyi to ashi menyi be keyirda mo ere to, saŋɛ na so menyi be tama beeŋ bɔla Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be eleŋ to m bɔlɔ menyi to felɛlɛ n ya kaa wurge.
Ekpa nɛ Pɔɔl kɔ n tiŋ n sibɛ le be asheŋ ere be asheŋ
14Ŋ kurgepoana, ma alɛ gba baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ alelasheŋ e baŋ bɔlɔ menyi alɛ gbagba to nseŋ naa nyi fanɛ men kɔ kanyiasheŋ kikɛ nɛ men gbagba e tiŋ ŋ ŋini abar asheŋ. 15Ama kawɔl ere to m malga asheŋ ko nɛ amo be ekpa so n sa menyi fanɛ ŋ ka bee nyiŋi menyi amo be asheŋ na. N nya kenyɛn nna m malga amo kikɛ ŋkpal kuwɔr nɛ Ebɔrɛ wu ma n shin nɛ ŋ ki Yesu Kristo be kenya a shuŋ a sa nnyamase na so. 16Mee shuŋ nna fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo a wɔtɔ a bɔ baru lela nɛ a shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na nna a sa nnyamase, saŋɛ na so, baaŋ baa du fanɛ kakɛ nɛ k bee par mo ere Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na lara m bɔɔ mo enɔ na. 17Ŋkpal kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ k wɔ ma nɛ Kristo Yesu be kefɛato so mee puchi nna ŋkpal ŋ ka bee shuŋ Ebɔrɛ so. 18Meeŋ baa kɔ kenyɛn nawule a malga asheŋ nɛ Kristo na wora ashi ma to nɛ loŋ e tiŋ n shin nɛ m bɔla mmalga nɛ ashuŋ shunso to n shin nɛ nnyamase e ba kaa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ. 19Kiyoyu na be eleŋ to nɛ m bɔla n shin nɛ b wu etɔɔnɛ nɛ emamachisheŋ. Amoso, baŋ yili Jerusalɛm be kade to n ta ŋ kulti n ya fo Ilirikem kikɛ m bɔ Kristo be baru lela na nɛnɛ n sa basa. 20Kusɔ nɛ m baŋ yili ma kagbene to fanɛ meeŋ baa wora e la fanɛ saŋkikɛ m baa bɔ baru lela na a sa basa nɛ b wɔ mboŋ nɛ ndoŋebi maŋ naŋ nu Kristo na be asheŋ kikɛ na, saŋɛ na so, m maaŋ baa du fanɛ esa nɛ e bee pɔr egbal a yuu esa pɔtɛ ko be gbaltɔlase so. 21Kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ le na nɛ m baa sha:
“Basa nɛ b daa maŋ kaŋɛ mbe asheŋ n sa na beeŋ wu mo kenishiso
nɛ bumo nɛ b daa maŋ nu mbe asheŋ na e pin to.”
22Ade so nɛ m maŋ nya ekpa ale damta nɛ m ba menyi kutɔ na.
Pɔɔl ka bee fɛ keyɔ Rom be asheŋ
23Ama naniere ŋ ka maŋ naa kɔ kakpa ashi nsawule ere so nfe nɛ n shuŋ ere nɛ ŋkpal kananɛ ŋ kɔ nfɛ damta nɛ a choŋ ere kikɛ nɛ n wu menyi ere so, 24n yili kumo nna fanɛ ŋ kaa yɔ Speen be efuli so, meeŋ wu menyi. Ŋ kaŋ wu menyi m moɛ gbrɛ nɛ n shin nɛ men chɛ ma to ashi ma enite na to. 25Naniere bre, ma aya kraa wɔ Jerusalɛm be ekpa to nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ so. 26Masɛdonia nɛ Akaya be efuliana so be asɔriana e yili kumo bumo gbagba be keparso n to amansherbi be toto nɛ n ta n ya sa Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b la betirpo a wɔ Jerusalɛm be asɔri to na. 27Bumo gbagba e yili kumo loŋ n wora. Kumo alɛ kashenteŋto bre, a daga b ka chɛ loŋ be betirpo na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ nnyamase baŋ bɔla Juwebi so n nya abɔrɛsheŋ be nɛfa na koŋwule na a daga fanɛ nnyamase gba ka ta bumo be durnya ere to be asɔ be ako a chɛ Juwebi to. 28Amoso, m baŋ ta le be toto ere n sa bumo nseŋ shuŋ ma kushuŋ na n loge, meeŋ pɛ Speen be efuli so be ekpa nseŋ gbɛ n chɔrɔ menyi. 29M baa nyi fanɛ ŋ kaŋ ba menyi kutɔ ma nɛ Kristo be nɛfa kikɛ nyam e naaŋ ba menyi to.
30Amoso, ŋ kurgepoana, mee kpal Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so nɛ kasha nɛ Kiyoyu na bee sa na so a kule menyi fanɛ men tu ma a kule Ebɔrɛ kpakpa a sa ma. 31Men baa kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ Judiya be efuli so be basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ yirda na maaŋ ya wora ma shɛŋ nseŋ naŋ kule mo fanɛ kushuŋ nɛ mee yɔ nɛ n ya shuŋ Jerusalɛm ere beeŋ par Ebɔrɛ be basa ndoŋ. 32Saŋɛ na so nɛ k la Ebɔrɛ be kepar nɛ m ba menyi kutɔ nɛ kagbenefuli, nɛ ma nɛ menyi kikɛ be keba abar so e leŋ anyi to. 33Ebɔrɛ nɛ kagbenewushi kikɛ bee shi mo kutɔ na e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ to. Amɛn.

Title: ROMEBI 16
Content:
Pɔɔl gbagba be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
1An sipoche Fibi nna na nɛ mee ta mo a ŋini menyi. E bee chɛ Kɛŋkriya be asɔriebi to nna. 2Men sɔ mo menyi to fanɛ esa nɛ e la Enyɛnpe na peya, nɛ kechɛto kama nɛ e bee sha menyi kutɔ, men chɛ mo to kananɛ k daga bebɛsopo ka wora, ŋkpal manɛ so, e la esa nɛ e chɛ basa damta to nna n ta ma alɛ gba n ti so.
3Mee chɔrɔ Prisila nɛ Akwila nɛ b la m braana Kristo be beshumpo na. 4B daŋ kpal ma so nna n ta bumo be amu ŋ kpa kelara. Mee chɔrɔ bumo ga ŋkpal loŋ so, mannɛ n nawule gba malɛ e naa chɔrɔ bumo. Nnyamase be asɔriebiana na kikɛ gba bee chɔrɔ bumo ga. 5Mee chɔrɔ asɔriebi nɛ baa shɛr le be basa koŋwule ere pe na gba. Mee chɔrɔ n teri lela Epainites nɛ e baŋ juŋkpar m ba ta mbe yirda n deŋi Kristo so ashi Eeshia be kasawule so na gba. 6Mee chɔrɔ Mɛɛri nɛ e shuŋ ga n sa menyi na. 7Mee chɔrɔ Andrɔnikes nɛ Junias nɛ b la n niopibi Juwebiana nɛ ma nɛ bumo daa wɔ kabuti to na. B la basa nɛ b kɔ ketre nna ashi beshuŋipoana na to, bumo alɛ pin Kristo nna pɔɛŋ nɛ m ba pin mo. 8Mee chɔrɔ Ampliyates nɛ mee sha ga ashi Enyɛnpe to nna. 9Mee chɔrɔ Ebaanes nɛ e la m barkasa Kristo be eshumpo na nsaa chɔrɔ n teri lela Staakis gba. 10Mee chɔrɔ Apɛles nɛ e kpal Kristo so n luri kechɔŋkeni to nseŋ tiŋ n lar a yil na. Mee chɔrɔ Aristɔbules be kowu to ebi gba. 11Mee chɔrɔ n niopibi Juwnyɛn nɛ baa tre Hɛrodiɔn na nseŋ naa chɔrɔ Naasises be kowu to ebi nɛ b la Enyɛnpe peya na. 12Mee chɔrɔ Traifina nɛ Traifosa nɛ b la beche nɛ baa shuŋ ga ashi Enyɛnpe be kushuŋ na to na. Mee chɔrɔ n teri lela Pɛɛsis nɛ mo alɛ gba la eche n shuŋ ga Enyɛnpe be kushuŋ na to na. 13Mee chɔrɔ Rufes nɛ Enyɛnpe lara n sa mbe kumu na nseŋ naa chɔrɔ mo nio nɛ e ta ma alɛ gba ŋ ki mo pibi na gba. 14Mee chɔrɔ Asiŋkrites nɛ Flɛgɔn nɛ Hɛmes nɛ Patrɔbas nɛ Hɛmas nɛ bekurgepoana nɛ b wɔ bumo kutɔ na kikɛ. 15Mee chɔrɔ Filɔlɔges nɛ Julia nɛ Neria nɛ mo sipoche nɛ Ɔlimpas nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ bumo nɛ bumo wɔtɔ na kikɛ. 16Men ta kasha cheembi m pipe abar be ŋgbuŋ kechɔrɔso. Kristo be asɔriebiana na kikɛ bee chɔrɔ menyi.
Pɔɔl be kamalga be ekar be asheŋ ŋiniso be asheŋ
17Ŋ kurgepoana, mee fiɛ menyi so nna fanɛ men baa de basa nɛ baa shin nɛ kebarga to bee ba basa to nseŋ naa lar keŋini nɛ men daŋ nya na be kaman a wɔtɔ a bar asheŋ ko m ba kaa kagle basa yirda be ekpa na so. Amoso, men baa gelge bumo. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na nɛ loŋ be basa na bee shuŋ na, bumo gbagba be epunana nɛ baa shuŋ a sa. Kɔnɔ belbelso nɛ ŋkpaŋ fuloŋ nɛ b kɔ a fule basa nɛ b maŋ nyi asheŋ to. 19Naniere esa kama nu menyi be kasonu be asheŋ, amoso, ma kagbene fuli ma ga ŋkpal menyi so. Ama mee sha fanɛ men baa kɔ kanyiasheŋ a yɔ kelela be kaplɛa so nna nsaa maa nyi shɛŋ a yɔ alubi be kaplɛa so. 20K maaŋ chɛr ko nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ kagbenewushi kikɛ bee shi mo kutɔ na e jija Setani be eleŋ kikɛ n shin nɛ e gbir menyi kumuli. An Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi to.
21Timoti nɛ e la m barkasa eshumpo na nɛ Lusias nɛ Jeesɔn nɛ Sosipata nɛ b la n niopibi Juwebi na bee chɔrɔ menyi.
22Ma Tɛɛshes nɛ Pɔɔl malga asheŋ ere n shin nɛ n sibɛ amo kawɔl ere to ere bee chɔrɔ menyi ashi Enyɛnpe na to. 23Gayes nɛ e la ma kowurnyɛn nɛ nfe be asɔriebi kikɛ bee shɛr mo pe na bee chɔrɔ menyi. Irastes nɛ e la kadegboŋ ere to be amansherbikenipo na nɛ an kurgepo Kwaates bee chɔrɔ menyi. 24[An Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ to. Amɛn.]
Pɔɔl be lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
25Kemaŋkura e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ men baa kɔ menyi be yirda na to a yil kpakpa ŋkpal baru lela nɛ m bɔ n sa menyi m malga Kristo be kubɔya na be asheŋ na so nɛ ŋkpal kashenteŋ be wulo nɛ k daŋ ŋana dra dra na kikɛ so. 26Naniere bre, ŋkpal asɔ nɛ anebiana na sibɛ n nase na so so, kashenteŋ na dii efuli nna. Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na saŋkikɛ be kusɔ nɛ e yili na so, kusɔ kama bugi to nna n dese a sa efuli kama so ebi, saŋɛ na so, baaŋ yirda nseŋ nu n sa Ebɔrɛ. 27Kemaŋkura e baa la Ebɔrɛ nɛ kanyiasheŋ kikɛ la mo nawule peya ashi Yesu Kristo to na mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ Ebɔrɛ kpal mo gbagba be keparso n tre ma fanɛ m ba ki Kristo Yesu be eshumpo na nɛ an kurgepo Sɔstenis kutɔ nna a yɔ Ebɔrɛ be asɔriebi nɛ b wɔ Kɔrint be kade to na kutɔ. 2Bumo e la basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ b ba kaa la mbe basa a wɔ Kristo Yesu to na. Bumo koŋwule na nɛ basa kama nɛ b wɔ kaplɛkama a ti an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre na, mo e la bumo Nyɛnpe nɛ an Nyɛnpe na nɛ b tre nɛ b ba kaa la basa cheembi a wɔtɔ. 3Kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi mo nɛ a shi an Tuto kutɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo kutɔ na e baa wɔ menyi kutɔ.
Pɔɔl ka bee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal basa be yirda so be asheŋ
4Saŋkikɛ mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ nna ŋkpal mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ e bɔla Kristo Yesu so n wu menyi na so. 5Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo so nɛ men bɔla n nya nɛfa ashi ekpa kama so a tiŋ a malga mbe mmalga nsaa nya kanyiasheŋ damta. 6Kristo be asheŋ nɛ an daŋ ji amo be shɛda na bɔlɔ menyi to naniere, 7ŋkpal manɛ so, naniere men ka bee jo saŋɛ nɛ baaŋ lara an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo ŋ ŋini ere, Kiyoyu to be kakɛ maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ menyee paŋ kumo menyi to. 8E beeŋ baa wɔtɔ menyi eleŋ to loŋ n ya fo lalaloge na, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ ji n lar ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito saŋɛ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo beeŋ naŋ ba na. 9Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e tre menyi fanɛ menyi nɛ mo Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo an Nyɛnpe e baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ koŋwule na la esa nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda nna.
Asɔri na to be kebargato be asheŋ
10Ŋ kurgepoana, mee ta an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre nna a kule menyi fanɛ men kikɛ e baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule a wɔ abar so, saŋɛ na so kebarga to kikɛ maaŋ baa wɔ menyi to. Men baa kɔ nfɛra koŋwule nsaa wora asheŋ ekpa koŋwuleso. 11Ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ kurgepoana, basa ko ashi Klowe pe bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ ma fanɛ menyi to be beko wɔtɔ nna a kɔ abar nlu. 12Kusɔ nɛ mee ber e la fanɛ men wɔtɔ nna a kaŋɛ abar le: “Pɔɔl nɛ ma ere bɛ so,” nɛ ede kaŋɛ: “Apɔlɔs nɛ ma ere bɛ so,” nɛ ede malɛ e kaŋɛ: “Sifas nɛ ma ere bɛ so,” nɛ eko malɛ e kaŋɛ: “Kristo nɛ ma ere bɛ so.” 13B barga Kristo to nna a mɔ Pɔɔl kedibi largato so nna n sa menyi a? Ŋko b bɛr menyi kabɔrɛbɛr nna ashi Pɔɔl be ketre to a? Ayai, loŋ be asheŋ ere kikɛ maŋ wora. 14K par ma ga fanɛ ŋ ka maŋ bɛr men be ekama kabɔrɛbɛr she Krispes nɛ Gayes nawule, 15saŋɛ na so, men be ekama maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ ma ketre to nɛ b bɛr mo kabɔrɛbɛr. 16N nyiŋi fanɛ ŋ ka bɛr Stɛfanas nɛ mbe kowu to ebi gba, ama bede be buushi m maŋ naŋ nyiŋi ŋ ka bɛr esa kama kabɔrɛbɛr n naŋ ti so. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo maŋ shuŋi ma nna fanɛ m ba kaa bɛr basa kabɔrɛbɛr, e shuŋi ma nna fanɛ m ba kaa bɔ baru lela na a sa basa. Kumo alɛ maŋ la fanɛ m ba ta dimɛdi be kamalganyi be mmalga nna n wora loŋ, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, Kristo be luwu nɛ e wu kedibi largato so na beeŋ paŋ kumo be eleŋ na.
Kristo ka la Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ nɛ mbe kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ
18Ŋkpal manɛ so, luwu mo nɛ Kristo wu kedibi largato so be kubɔya na la kawulisheŋ nna n sa basa nɛ b wɔ kemur be ekpa to na. Ama anyi nɛ an wɔ kumɔlga be ekpa to ere bre, loŋ be kubɔya na la Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ nna. 19Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ:
“Meeŋ jija benyiashempo be kanyiasheŋ
nseŋ ta benyiashempo be kenyi ŋ ki jiga.”
20To, nɛ kenya la loŋ, nnɛ nɛ benyiashempo ŋko nwɔlnyipoana ŋko durnya ere to be kanyiashenfinpowuraana naa yil? Ebɔrɛ maŋ ŋini fanɛ durnya ere to be kanyiasheŋ la kawulisheŋ nna a? 21Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla mbe kanyiasheŋ so nna n yili kumo fanɛ edimɛdi e sa maŋ ta bumo gbagba be kanyiasheŋ so m ba pin mo. Ama mo ere gbagba be keparso nɛ e yili kumo fanɛ e beeŋ bɔla kubɔya mo nɛ anyeeŋ bɔ n sa basa nɛ baa tre kawulisheŋ be mmalga ere so m mɔlga bekama nɛ b yirda na. 22Juwebi bee kaa sha kewu mamachi be etɔɔnɛsheŋ nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ yirda kubɔya na nɛ Griikebi malɛ bee keni a fin kanyiasheŋ kumo to pɔɛŋ nseŋ yirda. 23Ama anyi ere, Kristo mo nɛ b daŋ gbir m mata kedibi largato so na be asheŋ be kubɔya nɛ anyee bɔ a sa basa. Loŋ be kubɔya na malɛ la kusɔ nɛ k bee kagle Juwebi ekpa nna nsaa la kawulisheŋ a sa Nnyamase malɛ. 24Ama bumo, Juwebi nɛ Griikebi nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre na bre kikɛ, kubɔya na la Kristo mo nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ nɛ mbe kanyiasheŋ na nna. 25Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k bee ŋini Ebɔrɛ be kawulisheŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ a chɔ edimɛdi be kanyiasheŋ. Kusɔ nɛ kumo alɛ bee ŋini Ebɔrɛ be kapɔshi basa be anishito kɔ eleŋ a chɔ edimɛdi be eleŋ.
26Ŋ kurgepoana, men baa nyiŋi basa nɛ men daa la pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre menyi na. Edimɛdi be anishito menyi be bedamta daa maŋ la benyiashempo. Men be bedamta daa maŋ la bejuŋkparpo basa be anishito, bedamta malɛ daa maŋ shi kuwurji be kanaŋ kama to. 27Ama Ebɔrɛ lara durnya ere to be asɔ wuliso nna nɛ e ta anishinyɔr m pɛ benyiashempo. E lara durnya ere to be asɔ pɔso nna nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ belempo. 28E lara durnya ere to be asɔ bɔlpo nna nɛ asɔ nɛ basa bee keni jiga na nna nɛ asɔ nɛ a maŋ la shɛŋ na, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ ta durnya ere to be asɔ lela na ŋ ki asɔ fuloŋ 29nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ tiŋ m puchi ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 30Mo nawule e shin nɛ menyi nɛ Kristo Yesu ba ki kukoŋwule, mo alɛ e shin nɛ Kristo shin nɛ an pin kanyiasheŋ gbagba. Kristo na malɛ gba so e shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee ta anyi fanɛ basa niŋiso nɛ basa cheembi, basa nɛ b fɔr so n nyalɛ so nɛ b nya kumɔlga. 31Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“Esa kama nɛ e bee sha kepuchi, e baa puchi Enyɛnpe na so.”

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 2
Content:
Yesu Kristo be kewu kedibi largato so be asheŋ
1Ŋ kurgepoana, ŋ ka daŋ ba menyi kutɔ nɛ m ba kaŋɛ menyi wulo be asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bugi to na, n daa maŋ ta kɔnɔ belbelso nɛ kenyisha be kanyiasheŋ be mmalga n tu menyi. 2N daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ ŋ ka daa wɔ menyi kutɔ na, n daa maŋ nyi shɛŋ she Yesu Kristo nawule nɛ luwu mo nɛ e wu kedibi largato so na be asheŋ. 3Ma alɛ ka daŋ ba menyi kutɔ na, ma nɛ kapɔshi nɛ kufu nɛ kechicha damta e daŋ ba. 4Ma alɛ daa maŋ ta kanyiasheŋ nɛ mmalga belbelso nna nɛ n nya menyi. Ama ŋ ka daŋ malga m bɔ kubɔya na, Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu be eleŋ daŋ dii efuli nna. 5Saŋɛ na so men be yirda maaŋ baa yil dimɛdi be kanyiasheŋ so. Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ so nɛ k beeŋ baa yil.
Ebɔrɛ be kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ
6Ama anyee kaa malga kanyiashenso be mmalga nna ashi bumo nɛ b kɔ kenimufɛra to bre, ama mannɛ kanyiasheŋ mo nɛ k shi durnya ere to nna. Kumo alɛ maŋ naa shi bumo nɛ b kɔ eleŋ durnya ere to nɛ a bee mur na kutɔ. 7Kanyiasheŋ mo nɛ anyee malga kumo be asheŋ ere la Ebɔrɛ be wulo be kanyiasheŋ nna nɛ k daŋ ŋana basa so. Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ to durnya ere, e yili asheŋ ere nna, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ tu mo n luri mbe kemaŋkura to. 8Basa nɛ b kɔ eleŋ durnya ere to daa maŋ nyi le be kanyiasheŋ ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ b daa nyi kumo nna, b daa maaŋ gbir an Nyɛnpe mo nɛ e kɔ kemaŋkura na m mata kedibi largato so.
9Ama abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ:
“Esa kikɛ maŋ naŋ wu
ŋko n nu ŋko n fɛ m pin
kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bela ase
n yili basa nɛ baa sha mo na.”
10Ebɔrɛ bɔla mbe Kiyoyu so nna n lara asheŋ ere ŋ ŋini anyi. Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na malɛ e naa wu asheŋ to nɛnɛ hale Ebɔrɛ be wulo to be asheŋ. 11Esa kikɛ maa pin esa kama be nfɛra to she esa na wura gbagba be kiyoyu e nyi mo to. Loŋ koŋwule na malɛ nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin Ebɔrɛ be nfɛra to she Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na nawule. 12Kiyoyu mo nɛ anyi ere nya na maŋ la durnya ere to peya nna. E shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna, saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ pin asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta ŋ kɛ anyi na kikɛ nyam. 13Amoso, anyi maa malga mmalga mo nɛ edimɛdi ta bumo be kanyiasheŋ ŋ ŋini. Mmalga mo nɛ Kiyoyu na ŋini nɛ an kɔ a bugi Kiyoyu na to be nshenteŋ a sa basa nɛ b kɔ Kiyoyu na. 14Durnya ere to be esa bre maaŋ tiŋ n nya asɔ nɛ a bee shi Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na kutɔ. Kashenteŋto, a la kawulisheŋ nna n sa mo nɛ e maaŋ tiŋ m pin amo to kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Kiyoyu na nawule e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini mo amo be asheŋ. 15Ama Kiyoyu to be esa bre bee tiŋ a pin asheŋ kama to nna, ama esa kama maaŋ tiŋ m pin loŋ be esa na be asheŋ to. 16Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Wanɛ e nyi Enyɛnpe na be nfɛra to? Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini mo asheŋ?” Ama anyi ere, Kristo be nfɛra wɔ anyi be ŋgbene to nna.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 3
Content:
Kebarga to ashi asɔri to be asheŋ
1Ŋ kurgepoana, n daa maŋ tiŋ m malga menyi kutɔ fanɛ basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu bee juŋkpar na. N daa malga menyi kutɔ nna fanɛ durnya ere to be basa nɛ baa bɛ bumo gbagba be aparsheŋ so. N daa malga menyi kutɔ nna fanɛ bumo nɛ b la mbia ashi Kristo be asheŋ to. 2Kusɔ nɛ n daŋ sa menyi na daa du fanɛ kenyipo nna, mannɛ ajibi nyiŋgriŋ e daa la, ŋkpal manɛ so, men daa maŋ naŋ fo loŋ be ajibi na, hale mbre gba men maŋ naŋ fo amo. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, men kraa wɔtɔ nna fanɛ eyur to be basa a wora abar kayurbesa be asheŋ nsaa bile. To, men maŋ nyi fanɛ nɛ men baa wɔtɔ a wora loŋ men kraa du fanɛ eyur ere to be basa nna nsaa wɔtɔ a wora asheŋ fanɛ basa fuloŋ a? 4Nɛ men wɔtɔ a kaŋɛ abar fanɛ: “Pɔɔl nɛ ma ere bee bɛ so,” nɛ ede malɛ e kaŋɛ: “Apɔlɔs nɛ ma ere bee bɛ so,” loŋ maa ŋini fanɛ basa fuloŋ e baa la menyi ere a? 5Manɛ e la Apɔlɔs ŋko manɛ e la ma Pɔɔl? Anyi maŋ la shɛŋ, an baa la beshumpo mo nɛ men bɔla anyi so nna m ba yirda. An be ekama daŋ baa wora kushuŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ mo enɔ na nna. 6An baa du fanɛ basa nɛ b wɔ ndɔ to a shuŋ nna. Ma e duu asɔ duuso nɛ Apɔlɔs wora nchu n wurge amo so, ama Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ a daŋ. 7Amoso, esa nɛ e bee duu asɔ nɛ emo nɛ e bee wurge so nchu kikɛ maŋ la shɛŋ, Ebɔrɛ nawule e la kusɔ ko, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa tiŋ a shin nɛ asɔ bee daŋ. 8Esa nɛ e bee duu nɛ emo nɛ e bee wurge so nchu na kikɛ sasa nna. Kananɛ ekama malɛ bee shuŋ mbe kushuŋ so nɛ baaŋ yili ŋ ka mo kukɔ. 9Ebɔrɛ mo braana beshumpo e la anyi nɛ menyi alɛ du fanɛ mbe kasawule nseŋ naa du fanɛ mbe ebu nɛ e bee pɔr.
10Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ e sa ma na e shin nɛ n tiŋ n nase ebu na be gbaltɔlase na fanɛ epɔrpo nyipo na n sa basa nɛ baa pɔr a yili so. Ama a daga fanɛ ekama e baa de kananɛ e bee pɔr kumo so. 11Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama maaŋ naŋ tiŋ n nase gbaltɔlase kama n naŋ ti kumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ teŋ ta Yesu Kristo n nase na so. 12Beko bee ta shuwa ŋko gbiti ŋko ajembu mo nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa nna a pɔr a yili gbaltɔlase na so nɛ beko malɛ bee ta ndibi ŋko afitiri ŋko atuweklaŋ a pɔr a yili gbaltɔlase na so. 13Kachako kanaŋkamaso nɛ ekama be kushuŋ du, k beeŋ lar efuli. Kumo be kamɔnchɛ na e naaŋ ŋini kusɔ kama, ŋkpal manɛ so, edɛ e naaŋ wora kusɔ kama ŋ keni nɛ ekama e pin ekama be kushuŋ to. 14Nɛ edɛ na maŋ tiŋ n ji kusɔ nɛ amodoŋwura pɔr n yili egbaltɔlase na so na, kumo ere e beeŋ nya mbe tɔnɔ. 15Ama nɛ fanɛ kusɔ na baŋ chɔɔ bre, e beeŋ tɔr. Mo ere gbagba beeŋ nya kumɔlga, ama kumo alɛ beeŋ baa du fanɛ esa nɛ e bɔla edɛ to nna n shile n lar n nya mbe kumu.
16Men maŋ nyi fanɛ men la Ebɔrɛ be lambu nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu wɔ menyi to a? 17Ekama nɛ e jija Ebɔrɛ be lambu, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ jija amodoŋwura gba, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be lambu la lambu cheembi nna, menyi alɛ e la loŋ be lambu na.
18Ekama e sa maŋ kaa fule mbe kumu, menyi to be ekama nɛ e bee fɛ mbe kumu to fanɛ e la enyiashempo nna durnya ere be kaplɛa so, e ki ewulpo, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ ki enyiashempo. 19Ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere to be kanyiasheŋ la kawulisheŋ nna ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Loŋ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“Ebɔrɛ bee kaa ta benyiashempo gbagba
be kanyiasheŋ be aworbiana nna a pɛ bumo.”
20Abɔrɛsibɛ na kraŋ naa kaŋɛ kaboŋ ko fanɛ:
“Enyɛnpe na nyi benyiashempo be nfɛra ka la nfɛra fuloŋ.”
21Amoso, ekama e sa maa puchi edimɛdi so, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ kikɛ nyam la menyeya nna. 22Pɔɔl ŋko Apɔlɔs ŋko Sifas ŋko durnya ŋko ŋkpa ŋko luwu ŋko asheŋ nɛ a bee wora naniere ŋko amo nɛ a beeŋ wora echefoso kikɛ nyam la menyeya nna. 23Nɛ menyi alɛ la Kristo peya nɛ Kristo malɛ la Ebɔrɛ peya.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 4
Content:
Kristo be beshuŋipo be asheŋ
1Kananɛ k daga fanɛ men baa ta anyi e la fanɛ an la Kristo be anya nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mbe ewulosheŋ m bɔɔ anyi enɔ. 2Kusɔ nɛ k baŋ daga esa nɛ b ta nɛ e baa keni asɔ so e la fanɛ e sa maa lar mo nyɛnpe kaman. 3Ma ere kutɔ nɛ menyi ŋko durnya to be kɔɔti kama to ebi bee ji ma demu, k maŋ tir ma. Ma ere gbagba maa ji ma kumu demu. 4Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ m maŋ wu kulubi kikɛ ma so, ama kumo be loŋ maa shin nɛ mee ji a lar. Enyɛnpe e naa ji ma demu. 5Amoso, a maŋ daga fanɛ men baa wu abar kulubi a ji abar demu pɔɛŋ nɛ demuji be kachɛ e fo. Kumo e la saŋɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe beeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba na. Mo e naaŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kikɛ nɛ k daŋ ŋana tentembiri to e lar efuli nseŋ lara nfɛra fɛso nɛ a ŋana a wɔ basa be ŋgbene to kikɛ efuli. Kumo be saŋɛ na malɛ nɛ ekama beeŋ nya mbe kechɔrɔ ashi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ.
6Ŋ kurgepoana, m malga asheŋ ere nna n ta ma nɛ Apɔlɔs be asheŋ m ber ŋkpal men be kechɛto so. N wora loŋ nna nɛ men pin kusɔ nɛ basa bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Sa maŋ kaŋ wora asheŋ m baŋ kusɔ nɛ b sibɛ n nase na so.” Men be ekama e sa maŋ kaa puchi esa ko so nsaa kishi eko. 7Ŋkpal manɛ so, wanɛ e la fo nɛ fee fɛ fanɛ fo bɔ fo niopibiana? Mannɛ Ebɔrɛ e kɛ fo asɔ nɛ fo kɔ ere kikɛ a? To, nɛ manɛ e ba nɛ fee puchi fanɛ asɔ nɛ fo kɔ ere maŋ la kakɛ nna? 8Menyee fɛ fanɛ naniere men tea kɔ kusɔ kikɛ nɛ menyee sha ŋko? Men teŋ dii dama ŋko? Men ki bewura ŋ ka anyi. Nɛ men daa la bewura kashenteŋto k daa beeŋ par ma paa! Saŋɛ na so anyi alɛ gba daa beeŋ tu menyi a la bewura. 9K bee wora ma nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ta anyi beshuŋipo nna m bɛ ekama be kaman nɛ an baa du fanɛ basa nɛ b ji n tɔr n daga kewu kelɔnɛ so na. B yili anyi kefulto so nna geeŋ, emalaika nɛ basa kikɛ be anishito, kumo e la fanɛ durnya kikɛ be anishito. 10Ŋkpal Kristo so, an la bewulpo nna, ama menyi ere la benyiashempo nna ashi Kristo to. Anyi ere maŋ kɔ eleŋ, ama menyi ere kɔ! B kishi anyi nna, ama baa bunyaŋ menyi ere nna! 11Hale m ba fo kabre, anyi nɛ akoŋ nɛ achukoŋ e na, anyi nɛ asɔ farbi e na, baa bri anyi nɛ anyi maŋ kɔ epeana a wɔtɔ. 12Anyi gbagba be enɔana nɛ an kɔ a shuŋ ga. Basa baŋ so anyi kɔnɔ, anyee nɛfa bumo nna, b baŋ tɔrɔ anyi, anyee ji kumo be loŋ be kanyiti nna. 13B baŋ tege anyi, anyee malga bumo kutɔ kashaso nna. Hale m ba fo kabre an du fanɛ durnya ere to be eyurpi nna, kumo be kumuni.
14M maa sibɛ asɔ ere nna a sa menyi nɛ n ta anishinyɔr m pɛ menyi, ama mee sibɛ amo nna nɛ n niŋi menyi ekpa ŋkpal men ka la ma mbia shaso so. 15Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ hale nɛ men kɔ basa nɛ baa ŋini menyi Kristo be asheŋ damta fanɛ kagboŋ gba, menyi maŋ kɔ betuto damta bre, ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo Yesu to, ma e daŋ bɔla baru lela na so ŋ ki menyi tuto. 16Amoso, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa kute ma to.
17Ŋkpal loŋ so, mee shuŋi Timoti men kutɔ nna. E la m pibi shaso nna nɛ esa nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n yirda ashi Enyɛnpe be kaplɛa so. E beeŋ nyiŋi menyi kananɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ du ashi Kristo Yesu to fanɛ kananɛ mee ŋini amo kaplɛkama ashi asɔri kama to na. 18Menyi be beko bee wu menyi be amu nna a fɛ fanɛ shere m maaŋ naŋ ba menyi kutɔ, 19ama nɛ Enyɛnpe na shuli, m maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba menyi kutɔ. Ma alɛ kaŋ ba, meeŋ pin eleŋ nɛ basa nɛ baa wu bumo be amu ere kɔ, mannɛ bumo be mmalga nawule. 20Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na be asheŋ baa maa la kamalga nna, k la eleŋ nna. 21Kumo nɛ menyeeŋ baa sha, ŋ ka beeŋ ta kasogberge m ba tu menyi ŋko ŋ ka beeŋ ta kasha nɛ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k du boeŋ m ba tu menyi?

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 5
Content:
Kesakalea nɛ k wɔ asɔri na to be asheŋ
1Basa wɔtɔ nna a kaŋɛ fanɛ kesakalea be keji wɔ menyi to nna, kesakalea mo nɛ b maa ji bumo nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ gba to, kumo e la fanɛ menyi to be eko kɔ mo tuto be eche nna a sha. 2Le be asheŋ ere e baa wora menyi to nɛ menyee wu menyi be amu ere a? Cha, a daŋ daga fanɛ men be ŋgbene ka jija menyi ga nna nɛ men daŋ lara esa nɛ e bee wora loŋ na menyi to. 3Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ m maŋ wɔ menyi kutɔ ndoŋ, ama menyi to be asheŋ wɔ ma kagbene to paa. Ma alɛ teŋ ji esa nɛ e wora loŋ na demu fanɛ ŋ ka wɔ ndoŋ na ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e daga kasogberge. 4Men kaŋ ba shɛr an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre to nɛ ma alɛ wɔ menyi to ashi kiyoyu na to nɛ Yesu Kristo be eleŋ wɔ menyi to na, 5men ta loŋ be esa na m bɔɔ Setani enɔ, saŋɛ na so, mbe eyur beeŋ jija nɛ mbe kiyoyu bre e nya kumɔlga kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe beeŋ ba na.
6Kananɛ menyee puchi ere maŋ walɛ kuraa. Men maŋ nyi keŋasa mo nɛ k bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: Yiisi gbrɛbi baŋ luri nyifu to a bee shin nɛ nyifu na kikɛ bee tiŋ fɔŋgrɔŋ nna a? 7To, loŋ nɛ kulubi gba du. Amoso, men lara kulubi kikɛ menyi to nɛ k maaŋ tiŋ n sɔ kaplɛkama. Loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men ki basa popɔr. Kashenteŋ malɛ nna fanɛ men la basa cheembi nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Yesu Kristo wu n sa anyi. Mo e la emo nɛ baa tre Kebansonchoŋ be Kpakpafɔlbi nɛ b ta n lara sarga na. 8Amoso, men shin nɛ an ji Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ na kumo be ekpa so, nɛ kekishi nɛ kulubi kama e sa maa wɔ anyi to, ama kelela nɛ kashenteŋ beeŋ baa wɔ anyi to.
9Kawɔl mo nɛ n daŋ juŋkpar n sibɛ menyi na to, ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ menyi nɛ basa kama nɛ b kɔ kesakalea be kebaawɔtɔ e sa maa to jina kikɛ. 10Mannɛ basa nɛ b maŋ nyi Kristo nsaa kɔ kesakalea ŋko a la kejimuniwuraana na ŋko beyu ŋko agbirshumpoana nɛ n daa de. Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ nna menyeeŋ lar durnya ere to nna kuraa ai. 11Kusɔ nɛ n daa de e la fanɛ men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi nɛ esa kama nɛ e bee tre mbe kumu ekurgepo, mo alɛ nsaa wɔ kesakalea be kebaawɔtɔ to ŋko ŋkaa kɔ kejimuni ŋko emo nɛ e wɔtɔ a shuŋ agbir ŋko a na a tege basa ŋko emo nɛ e bee nuu nsa a boo ŋko emo nɛ e la eyu e baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ. Menyi nɛ loŋ be esa e sa maŋ bɔ enɔ n wɔtɔ kawie koŋwule to gba n ji. 12Kashenteŋto, m maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ n ji bumo nɛ b maŋ wɔ asɔri na to demu. Bumo nɛ b wɔ asɔri na to e la bumo nɛ k daga an ka bee keni bumo be asheŋ to. 13Ebɔrɛ e naaŋ ji basa nɛ b maŋ wɔ asɔri na to demu. Kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ e la fanɛ: “Men ju alubiworapo kama ashi menyi to.”

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 6
Content:
Beyirdapo be keyɛr abar kɔɔti to be asheŋ
1Nɛ menyi to be ekama nɛ ekurgepo ko nya kamalga, nuso nɛ amodoŋwura beeŋ wora n nya kagbene n yɛr ekurgepo na demujipowuraana mo nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ be anishito nseŋ kini keyɛr kesheŋ na Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso be anishito? 2Men maŋ nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa e naaŋ ba ji durnya to ebi kikɛ demu kachako a? To, nɛ menyi ka beeŋ ba ji durnya ere to ebi kikɛ demu, men maaŋ tiŋ n ji le be asheŋ wurbi ere bre a? 3Men maŋ nyi fanɛ anyi e naaŋ ba ji emalaika demu a? Nɛ an ka beeŋ tiŋ n ji emalaika demu, kebaawɔtɔ ere to be asheŋ bre maŋ bɛ n sulge a? 4To, nɛ fanɛ loŋ be asheŋ ba menyi to nna, menyee ta amo nna a yɔ basa mo nɛ b maŋ la shɛŋ ashi asɔri to ebi be anishito fanɛ b ji amo a? 5Ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere nna nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ menyi. Ama esa kikɛ maŋ wɔ menyi to a nyi asheŋ nɛ e tiŋ n shin nɛ kesheŋ nɛ k wɔ bekurgepo anyɔ be nferinto e nya edesekpa a? 6Ama ekurgepo ko bee ta mo barkasa nna a yɔ demujikpa nɛ b ya yili basa nɛ b maa bɛ Yesu so na be anishito a? 7Men ka baa kɔ asheŋ menyi to ere e naa ŋini fanɛ men tɔr kashenteŋto pasaa. Men daa maaŋ tiŋ n shuli kejija nna n sa abar ŋkaa maaŋ yɛr abar demujikpa a? Keshuli n shin nɛ b puni menyi maŋ bɔ keyɛr abar demujikpa a? 8Ama kumo nɛ men gbagba wɔtɔ a da abar so nsaa puni abar na hale men niopibiana gbagba kuraa. 9Men maŋ nyi fanɛ mannɛ basa lubi e naaŋ ba nya Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to n luri ŋko? Men sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e fule menyi. Kesakaleawuraana kikɛ ŋko bumo nɛ baa shuŋ agbirana ŋko bumo nɛ baa kil nsaa ji kesakalea ŋko benyɛn mo nɛ baa di abar keche nɛ kenyɛn kikɛ maaŋ nya Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to n luri kikɛ. 10Beyu ŋko kejimuniwuraana ŋko nsanuupoana ŋko bumo nɛ baa tege bumo braana ŋko besugepoana maaŋ nya Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to n luri kikɛ. 11Loŋ nɛ menyi be beko daa du, ama naniere bre Ebɔrɛ fɔr menyi so ashi kulubi to nseŋ lara menyi nɛ men ki mbe basa. Men bɔla Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre so nɛ an be Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na so n ji n lar.
Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ ebɛsopo e baa kɔ mbe eyur a wora be asheŋ
12Menyi be beko bee kaa kaŋɛ le kukoko to: “Ŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ n wora kusɔ kama nɛ mee sha.” Kashenteŋ nna, ama mannɛ kusɔ kama malɛ e walɛ n sa ma. Menyee yɛ kukoko to: “Ŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ n wora kusɔ kama nɛ mee sha.” Kashenteŋ nna, ama ma alɛ maaŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kama e ta ma ŋ ki kumo be kenya. 13Esa ko malɛ beeŋ naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ajibi e wɔ epun nɛ epun malɛ gba wɔ ajibi.” Kashenteŋ nna, ama baa nyiŋi fanɛ kachako Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mur amo kikɛ. A maŋ daga fanɛ dimɛdi e baa ta mbe eyur a wora kesakaleasheŋ, k daga fanɛ e baa ta kumo nna a shuŋ Enyɛnpe na nɛ Enyɛnpe na malɛ e baa shuŋ eyur na. 14Ebɔrɛ e tiŋi Enyɛnpe ashi luwu to, mo alɛ beeŋ ta mbe eleŋ n tiŋi anyi alɛ gba ashi luwu to. 15Men maŋ nyi fanɛ men be eyurana ere la Kristo gbagba be mba ko nna ŋko? To, k daga fanɛ n ta Kristo to be mba ko n ya chɔga sakaleche be eyur so a? Kuraa, loŋ maaŋ nya kikɛ. 16Men maŋ nyi fanɛ esa kama nɛ e ta mbe eyur a wɔtɔ sakaleche to, bumo benyɔ na bee ki eyur koŋwule nna a? Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Enyɛn kama nɛ e ta mbe kaba n wɔtɔ eche to, mo nɛ eche na bee ki kukoŋwule nna.” 17Ekama malɛ nɛ e ta mbe kumu n wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe na to, mbe kiyoyu nɛ Enyɛnpe na peya bee ki kukoŋwule nna. 18Amoso, men baa gelge kesakalea be keji. Kulubi kama nɛ esa wora, e maa wora kumo a gbiti mbe eyur, ama ekama nɛ e bee ji kesakalea bee ji kumo nna a gbiti mo gbagba be eyur nna na. 19Men maŋ nyi fanɛ men be eyur ere la Kiyoyu Cheeŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mo n sa menyi nɛ e wɔ menyi to na be lambu nna a? Men maŋ wɔ men gbagba be amu nna. 20Ŋkpal manɛ so, kukɔ damta nɛ Ebɔrɛ ka n tɔ menyi. Amoso, men ta men be eyurana ere a maŋkura Ebɔrɛ.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 7
Content:
Kakil be asheŋ
1To, naniere men shin nɛ n sa menyi asheŋ nɛ men sibɛ ma na be afito. Nɛ esa baa maŋ ta eche, loŋ walɛ. 2Ama ŋkpal kesakalea ka shi ga so, a daga fanɛ enyɛn kama ka ta mo gbagba be eche nɛ eche kama malɛ gba e baa kɔ mo gbagba mo kul. 3A daga fanɛ ekul na e baa wora kakil to be asɔ nɛ a daga fanɛ ekul e baa wora a sa mbe eche nɛ eche na malɛ gba e baa wora asɔ nɛ a daga fanɛ eche e baa wora a sa mo kul na. 4Eche na be eyur maŋ la mo gbagba peya nna, ekul na e wɔ kumo. Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ enyɛn na gba be eyur maŋ la mo gbagba peya, eche na e wɔ kumo. 5Amoso, men sa maŋ kaa mɔn abar keche nɛ kenyɛn be kedi ashi men be kebaawɔtɔ to ama men baŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ men maaŋ ba abar so yili saŋko n ya fo saŋko ŋkpal men ka bee sha keta men be nfɛra n wɔtɔ kabɔrɛkule to so. Ama kumo be loŋ be kaman men naŋ ba abar so nɛ Setani e sa maŋ kaŋ nya ekpa n fule menyi nɛ men tɔr mbe kechɔŋkeni to ŋkpal men ka maaŋ tiŋ n nyiti so. 6Asheŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ ere maa ŋini fanɛ mee sa menyi mbra nna fanɛ men luri kakil to, ama m baa kaŋɛ nna fanɛ nɛ men wora loŋ, k maŋ lubi. 7Nɛ esa kama daa du fanɛ ma nna, k daa beeŋ par ma paa, ama ekama malɛ nɛ mbe kakɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa mo, eko beeŋ baa kɔ kakɛ ere nɛ ede malɛ e baa kɔ kakɛ ere.
8Kusɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ egbawu nɛ bekulponyɛnana nɛ bekulpocheana nde fanɛ nɛ b maŋ luri kakil to nsaa wɔtɔ le fanɛ ma gbagba e bɔ. 9Ama nɛ fanɛ b maaŋ tiŋ bumo be amu, b luri kakil to, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa ka luri kakil to bɔ keche nɛ kenyɛn be kedi be kasha ka wɔ mo to a chɔɔ mo to.
10Le be mbra ere malɛ nɛ mee ta a sa kakilwuraana, mannɛ ma e naa sa bumo, Enyɛnpe e naa sa bumo, a maŋ daga fanɛ eche ka yige mo kul. 11Ama nɛ k ba fanɛ e wora loŋ nna, a maŋ daga fanɛ eche na e naŋ kil enyɛn pɔtɛ. Ama nɛ e naa sha kakil, e shin nɛ mo nɛ mo kul e naŋ nyalɛ m ba abar so. Enyɛn kama malɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ kini mbe eche.
12Basa nɛ b ka malɛ kikɛ, le nɛ ŋ kɔ a kaŋɛ bumo, ma e naa kaŋɛ, mannɛ Enyɛnpe, fanɛ ekurgepo kama nɛ e kɔ eche mo nɛ e maŋ la eyirdapo, nɛ eche na bee sha mo nɛ mbe kebaawɔtɔ, ekurgepo na e sa maŋ kaŋ kini mo. 13Eche kama malɛ nɛ e kɔ ekul mo nɛ e maŋ la eyirdapo, nɛ ekul na bee sha mo nɛ mbe kebaawɔtɔ, eche na e sa maŋ kaŋ kini mo. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ kpal eche na so nna n ta mo kul na ŋ ki esa laraso. Nɛ enyɛn na e la eyirdapo, Ebɔrɛ bee ta eche na gba nna a ki esa laraso ŋkpal mo kul na so. Nɛ mannɛ fanɛ loŋ nna, bumo be mbia daa maaŋ baa la Ebɔrɛ be mbia laraso, ama kananɛ k du le ere bre b la nna. 15Ama nɛ fanɛ emo nɛ e maŋ yirda na gbagba lar bre, fo shin nɛ e baa yɔ. Loŋ be asheŋ na bre be mbra maa pɛ enyɛn mo nɛ e la eyirdapo ŋko eche mo nɛ e la eyirdapo. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ tre anyi nna nɛ an ba kaa wɔ kagbenewushi to. 16Eche kilpo mo nɛ e la eyirdapo, nuso nɛ feeŋ wora m pin fanɛ mannɛ fo so nɛ fo kul beeŋ bɔla n nya kumɔlga? Ŋko fo, ekul mo nɛ fo la eyirdapo ere, nuso nɛ feeŋ wora m pin fanɛ mannɛ fo so nɛ fo eche beeŋ bɔla n nya kumɔlga?
Kaplɛkama nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta ekama n wɔtɔ e baa wɔ ndoŋ be asheŋ
17Kusɔ nɛ k baa wɔtɔ e la fanɛ ekama e baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ mo nɛ Enyɛnpe na ta n sa mo pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre mo na a yil to kpakpa. Kusɔ nɛ n sibɛ n nase a sa asɔriana na kikɛ nna na. 18Esa kama nɛ b daŋ ku mo kututu pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre mo, e sa maŋ naŋ fin kekpara keku na. Ekama malɛ nɛ e daa maŋ ku pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre mo, e sa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ b ku mo. 19Nɛ b ku esa ŋko b maŋ ku mo, k maŋ la shɛŋ. Kusɔ nɛ k tir e la fanɛ men baa bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso so. 20Kanaŋkama nɛ ekama daa du pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ tre mo, e baa kraa du loŋ. 21Fo daa la kenya nna pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ tre fo ŋko? Sa maŋ shin nɛ k tir fo. Ama nɛ fo nya fo kumu be kesɔnyige be ekpa bre, fo lar kenyaya na to. 22Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e daa la kenya pɔɛŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe tre mo la Enyɛnpe be esa sɔnyigeso nna. Nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e daa wɔ mbe kumu pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre mo e ki Kristo be kenya nna na. 23Men baa nyi fanɛ kukɔ damta nɛ Ebɔrɛ ka n tɔ menyi. Amoso, men sa maŋ ki edimɛdi be anya. 24Ŋ kurgepoana, kanaŋkamaso nɛ ekama daa du pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ tre mo na, e baa kraa du loŋ nɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ e baa wɔtɔ.
Bumo nɛ b maŋ naŋ luri kakil to nɛ bekulpoche nɛ bekulponyɛnana be asheŋ
25To, naniere men shin nɛ an keni bumo nɛ b maŋ naŋ luri kakil to na be asheŋ to. Enyɛnpe maŋ ta kamalga naseso nɛ k bee yɔ bumo be kaplɛa so n sa ma, ama meeŋ kaŋɛ menyi kusɔ nɛ ma nɛ n la esa nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n yirda ŋkpal Enyɛnpe na be kuwɔr so na gbagba be nfɛra bee kaŋɛ ma.
26Ma nfɛra bee wora ma nna fanɛ ŋkpal naniere be kebaawɔtɔ nyaŋgraŋ ere so, esa maŋ luri kakil to, k bɔ. 27Ekama nɛ e kɔ eche e sa maŋ kaŋ fin kakilgboŋi. Enyɛn kama malɛ nɛ e maŋ kɔ eche, e sa maŋ kaŋ fin eche n ta. 28Ama nɛ fo ta eche, mannɛ kulubi nɛ fo wora. Kasuŋgurbia kama malɛ nɛ e kil maŋ wora kulubi nna. Ama basa kama nɛ b luri kakil to beeŋ nya etɔrɔ ashi kebaawɔtɔ ere to, kumo alɛ be loŋ to nɛ mee sha kumɔlga menyi ashi to na.
29Ŋ kurgepoana, kusɔ nɛ n de e la fanɛ, saŋɛ maŋ naa shi. Amoso, bekama nɛ b kɔ beche e baa wɔtɔ fanɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ beche. 30Bumo nɛ baa shu e baa wɔtɔ fanɛ b maa shu, nɛ basa nɛ bumo be ŋgbene fuli bumo na e baa wɔtɔ fanɛ bumo be ŋgbene maŋ fuli bumo. Bumo nɛ baa tɔ asɔ malɛ gba e baa wora fanɛ mannɛ bumo e wɔ asɔ nɛ b tɔ na. 31Bekama malɛ nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to be asɔ be asheŋ woraso to, b baa wora amo ŋkaa maa shin nɛ amo be asheŋ e bɔlɔ bumo to, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere be kananɛ k du ere bee choŋ nna na.
32Mee sha fanɛ men be ŋgbene e baa dese menyi nna. Enyɛn mo nɛ e maŋ kɔ eche be nfɛra wɔ Enyɛnpe be aparsheŋ to so nna nɛ e bee fɛ kananɛ e beeŋ wora n wora Enyɛnpe na be aparsheŋ. 33Ama enyɛn mo nɛ e kɔ eche bre be nfɛra wɔ durnya ere to be asheŋ to so nna nɛ e bee fɛ kananɛ e beeŋ wora n wora mbe eche be aparsheŋ 34nɛ mbe nfɛra bee wora mo anyɔnyɔ. Eche nɛ e maŋ kɔ ekul ŋko eche mo nɛ e maŋ nyi enyɛn be nfɛra wɔ Enyɛnpe be asheŋ to so nna nɛ e bee fɛ kananɛ e beeŋ wora n wora a du cheembi ashi mbe eyur nɛ mbe kiyoyu to be asheŋ. Ama eche kilpo be nfɛra wɔ durnya ere to be asheŋ to so nna a fɛ kananɛ e beeŋ wora n wora mo kul be aparsheŋ. 35Men be kechɛto so so nɛ mee kaŋɛ asheŋ ere na, m maa sha fanɛ n nyaŋ menyi nna. M baa sha fanɛ men baa wora asɔ nɛ a niŋi nsaa bɔla ekpa nna a kɔ kagbene koŋwule be kasha a shuŋ Enyɛnpe ŋkaa maŋ naŋ ka mba ko.
36Enyɛn kama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ e maa wora asheŋ nɛ a daga mo nɛ mo jipo be nferinto nɛ eche na malɛ gba bee bel nɛ enyɛn na wu fanɛ a daga fanɛ e ta eche na, men shin nɛ e wora kusɔ nɛ e bee sha, mannɛ kulubi nna, men shin nɛ b ta abar. 37Ama enyɛn kama nɛ e baa yil to nɛnɛ mbe kagbene to a maŋ wɔ katiŋ kama to, mo alɛ nsaa tiŋ mbe kumu a sha mo nɛ kebichebi na e baa wɔ kejipo to, kusɔ lela nɛ amodoŋwura wora na. 38Amoso, esa kama nɛ e ta mo jipo wora kusɔ lela nna, ama emo nɛ e maŋ ta mo jipo, wora nɛnɛ a chɔ loŋ.
39Eche kilpo mo kul baa wɔ ŋkpa to, e maŋ wɔ mbe kumu enyɛn na be kaman, ama nɛ enyɛn na baŋ wu bre e kɔ ekpa nɛ e kil enyɛn kama nɛ e bee sha, ama a daga fanɛ amo be kanyɛn na e baa la Enyɛnpe na peya. 40Ma ere kutɔ, nɛ e chena loŋ e beeŋ baa kɔ kagbenefuli a chɔ e ka naŋ kil, ma alɛ bee tama fanɛ ŋ kɔ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 8
Content:
Nlɔŋɛjibiana be asheŋ
1To, naniere men shin nɛ an keni nlɔŋɛjibiana be asheŋ to. An nyi fanɛ an kikɛ kɔ kanyiasheŋ fanɛ kananɛ menyee kaŋɛ na. Kanyiasheŋ malɛ e naa shin nɛ esa bee maŋ mbe kumu so nɛ kasha malɛ bee shin nɛ esa bee yɔ anishito. 2Esa baa fɛ fanɛ e nyi kusɔ ko, kumo ere e maŋ naŋ pin kusɔ na to fanɛ kananɛ k daga fanɛ e baa nyi kumo. 3Ama ekama nɛ e bee sha Ebɔrɛ, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ nyi amodoŋwura.
4To, naniere an keni nlɔŋɛjibiana be asheŋ to. An baa nyi fanɛ kegbir la kusɔ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ŋkpa kumo to nna a wɔtɔ, anyi alɛ nseŋ naa nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule e wɔtɔ, ekama maŋ naŋ ti mo so. 5Hale nɛ asɔ damta wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule nɛ basa bee ta amo fanɛ bumo be ebɔrɛana gba, kumo alɛ la kashenteŋ nna fanɛ le be ebɔrɛ damtaana nɛ benyɛnpe damtaana wɔtɔ, 6ama anyi ere kutɔ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule e baa wɔtɔ, mo e la Etuto mo nɛ kusɔ kikɛ shi mo kutɔ, mo alɛ so nɛ an wɔtɔ na. Enyɛnpe koŋwule, Yesu Kristo na malɛ e wɔtɔ, mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla mo so n to kusɔ kikɛ mo alɛ nsaa sa anyi ŋkpa na.
7Anyi alɛ nyi le be asheŋ ere, ama mannɛ ekama e kɔ le be kanyiasheŋ ere bre. Hale mbre, agbirshuŋ baŋ luri basa be nfɛra to nna ga nɛ baa fɛ fanɛ nɛ baa ji nlɔŋɛjibi, kegbir gbagba be ajibi nɛ baa ji. Bumo alɛ be nfɛra ka maŋ kɔ eleŋ so a maa dese bumo nsaa wora bumo fanɛ b luri eyurpi to nna na. 8Ama ajibi maaŋ tiŋ n yɛr anyi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Nɛ an baa maŋ ji, anyi maa paŋ shɛŋ Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nɛ anyi alɛ naŋ ji, anyi maa nya shɛŋ. 9Ama men baa da so nɛ le be kamooji mo nɛ men kɔ ere e sa maŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ yirda na to na e tɔr alubi to. 10Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ eleŋ baŋ wu fo nɛ fo kɔ le be kanyiasheŋ ere ka tase kegbir ko be lambu to a ji nɛ amodoŋwura na be nfɛra maŋ kɔ eleŋ, kusɔ nɛ e wu na maaŋ leŋ mo to nɛ e baa ji nlɔŋɛjibi a? 11Saŋɛ na so, fo kanyiasheŋ na beeŋ shin nɛ epɔsopo na, fo niopibi mo nɛ Kristo wu n sa na e mur mbe alubi to nna na. 12Nɛ fo alɛ baa wora kulubi a da fo niopibiana so le a doro bumo be ŋgbene pɔsoana, fee wora kulubi nna a da Kristo so nna na. 13Amoso, nɛ ajibi baa la asɔ nɛ a bee shin nɛ n niopibi bee tɔr, kumo ere m maaŋ naŋ we eblaŋ kikɛ, saŋɛ na so m maaŋ shin nɛ n niopibi na e tɔr.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 9
Content:
Ekpaana nɛ eshuŋipo kɔ be asheŋ
1Men shin nɛ an bishi menyi kusɔ ko. M maŋ wɔ ma kumu nna a? Mannɛ eshuŋipo e la ma a? M maŋ naŋ wu an Nyɛnpe Yesu nna a? Mannɛ menyi e la kushuŋ nɛ mee shuŋ a sa Enyɛnpe na be tɔɔnɛ a? 2Nɛ m maŋ la beko be eshuŋipo gba, emɔrɔ maŋ wɔtɔ fanɛ n la menyi alɛ be eshuŋipo. Ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi e la ma kebaa la eshuŋipo be tɔɔnɛ ashi Enyɛnpe na to.
3Kusɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ a kaŋɛ basa nɛ baa keni ma asheŋ to a wu ma kulubi nna na. 4Anyi maŋ kɔ ekpa fanɛ basa e sa anyi ajibi nɛ asɔnuuso nna ŋkpal anyi be kushuŋ ere so a? 5Ma alɛ maŋ kɔ ekpa nna nɛ ŋ kil ebɛsopoche ko n ta mo m bɛ anyi so fanɛ kananɛ Enyɛnpe mo sipoana nɛ Sifas nɛ beshuŋipo mo nɛ b ka na bee wora na a? 6Ŋko ma nɛ Baanabas nawule e daga fanɛ an baa shuŋ a ji? 7Soja mo gbagba e naa ka mo gbagba be kumu ashi kushuŋ na to? Esa mo e naa duu ndibi sɔrso nɛ a baa wora nɛ e maaŋ ji amo be asɔrso na? Esa mo e naaŋ baa keni ana so ŋkaa maaŋ baa nyaŋ amo kenyipo? 8Dimɛdi be eleŋso nɛ n yil so a kaŋɛ le ere a? Mannɛ aloŋ koŋwule na be asheŋ nɛ mbra na bee kaŋɛ na a? 9B sibɛ anebi Mosis be mbra na to fanɛ: “Sa maŋ kaŋ kre kena mo nɛ k bee shuŋ ajibi to be kɔnɔ.” To, ana be asheŋ e tir Ebɔrɛ a? 10Mannɛ anyi nawule so e shin nɛ e daŋ malga loŋ a? Kashenteŋto, anyi so nɛ e daŋ shin nɛ b sibɛ loŋ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, edɔpo nɛ eteŋipo kikɛ daga fanɛ b baa tama kenya adɔjibi na be ako. 11Nɛ an bar abɔrɛsheŋ m baa wɔtɔ menyi to fanɛ kananɛ eduupo bee duu asɔ duuso na, k la tɔrɔ gboŋgboŋi nna ga fanɛ an nya asɔ ashi menyi kutɔ a? 12Nɛ beko baa kɔ ekpa fanɛ b baa nya le be kechɛto ashi menyi kutɔ, a maŋ daga fanɛ an baa kɔ loŋ be ekpa a chɔ bumo a?
Ama anyi alɛ daa maŋ ŋini loŋ be ekpa nɛ an kɔ na. An daŋ ji kanyiti ashi kusɔ kama to nna, saŋɛ na so anyi maaŋ shin nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ e kagle Kristo be baru lela na ekpa. 13Men maŋ nyi fanɛ basa nɛ baa shuŋ bɔrɛlambu to bee nya bumo be keji nna ashi bɔrɛlambu na to nɛ bumo nɛ baa shuŋ bɔrɛsure akpa na malɛ gba bee nya bumo be kachige ashi asɔ nɛ baa ta a lara esarga na to a? 14To, loŋ koŋwule na nna nɛ Enyɛnpe nase kumo fanɛ a daga fanɛ bumo nɛ baa bɔ Baru Lela na e baa nya bumo be kusɔ jiso ashi baru lela na be kebɔ to.
15Ama ma alɛ daa maŋ ŋini ekpa nɛ ŋ kɔ ana ere be kekama, ma alɛ maŋ naa sibɛ naniere nna a sa menyi nɛ n nya loŋ be kechɛto na. Cha, nɛ n wu gba k bɔ ŋ ka shin nɛ esa e nya ekpa m mɔn ma ashi kepuchi to. 16Ama m maŋ kɔ ekpa bre nɛ ŋ kpal ŋ ka bee bɔ Baru Lela na so m puchi, ŋkpal manɛ so, k la katiŋ nna fanɛ m bɔ Baru Lela na. Nɛ ma alɛ maŋ bɔ Baru Lela na, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa ma kikɛ. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ fanɛ mee wora loŋ nna ŋkpal ma alɛ gbagba be keparso, n daa beeŋ baa kɔ kakɔka, ama nɛ k maŋ la fanɛ ŋ gbagba be kepar be asheŋ so nɛ mee wora kumo, kumo ere kusɔ nɛ b ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ nɛ mee wora. 18To, nɛ manɛ e la ma tɔɔnɛ? Kumo nde jia: Mee bɔ kubɔya na nna nɛ n tiŋ n ta kumo n sa basa ŋkaa maaŋ sɔ bumo shɛŋ, saŋɛ na so m maaŋ ta ekpa mo nɛ ŋ kɔ ana ere a ji ashi kushuŋ na to.
19N wɔ ma kumu nna a maŋ la esa kikɛ be kenya, ama n ta ma kumu nna ŋ ki kenya a sa ekama, saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya basa damta n ti so nɛ b ba pin Ebɔrɛ. 20Nɛ ma nɛ Juwebi baa la n wɔtɔ nna fanɛ Juw be esa, saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya bumo n wɔtɔ Yesu be kebɛso to. Kumo e la fanɛ ma alɛ gbagba maŋ wɔ anebi Mosis be mbra na to, ama ma nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ kumo to na baa la, mee ta ma kumu nna fanɛ n wɔ mbra na to nna, saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya bumo nɛ b wɔ mbra na to gba n wɔtɔ Yesu be kebɛso to. 21Nɛ ma nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ wɔ anebi Mosis be mbra na to baa la n wɔtɔ nna fanɛ esa nɛ e maŋ wɔ mbra na to, mannɛ fanɛ m maa bɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ so nna, n wɔ Kristo be mbra to nna, saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya bumo nɛ b maŋ wɔ mbra na to gba n wɔtɔ Yesu be kebɛso to n ti so. 22Nɛ m baa wɔ yirda na to be bepɔshipo to, mee ta ma kumu nna a ki epɔsopo, saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya bumo bepɔshipo na n wɔtɔ Yesu be kebɛso to. N ta ma kumu nna ŋ ki kusɔ kikɛ n sa basa be nnaŋ to kikɛ, saŋɛ na so meeŋ bɔla ekpa kama so n shin nɛ basa na be beko e nya kumɔlga. 23Mee wora asheŋ ere kikɛ nna ŋkpal baru lela na so so, saŋɛ na so, ma alɛ gba beeŋ nya kumo be enɛfa na be ako.
24Men maŋ nyi fanɛ eshile kikɛ to beshilepo na kikɛ bee shile nna, ama esa koŋwule e naa kaa ji kɔŋkɔŋ a? Men baa shile nɛnɛ, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ nya kɔŋkɔŋ n ji. 25Ekama nɛ e beeŋ ki eshilepo bee keta mbe kumu nna nɛnɛ kenishipereso. Baa kaa wora loŋ nna, saŋɛ na so, baaŋ ji kɔŋkɔŋ n nya kusɔ nɛ k maaŋ chɛr nseŋ jija, ama anyi ere, kusɔ nɛ k maa jija so nɛ anyee wora loŋ. 26Amoso, m maa shile chamcham nna fanɛ esa nɛ e maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e bee yɔ. M maa bile kolu nna fanɛ esa nɛ e bee too enɔ to a wɔtɔ afu to na nna. 27Ama mee kaa kɔrfɛ ma eyur nna a shin nɛ k bee nu a sa ma, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, meeŋ bɔ kubɔya na n sa basa nɛ ma alɛ gbagba e paŋ kɔŋkɔŋ na be keji.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 10
Content:
Kefiɛ basa so ŋkpal agbir be asheŋ so be asheŋ
1Bekurgepoana, mee sha fanɛ men pin fanɛ kuwɔlpa daŋ juŋkpar an tutoana kikɛ nna nɛ bumo kikɛ daŋ bɔla teku na so n choŋ. 2Saŋɛ nɛ kuwɔlpa na daŋ juŋkpar bumo nɛ b daŋ bɔla teku na to n lar na, b daŋ bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr nna n wɔtɔ anebi Mosis be kebɛso to. 3Bumo kikɛ daŋ ji kejibi koŋwule mo nɛ k daŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na, 4nseŋ daŋ nuu asɔnuuso koŋwule mo nɛ a daŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na. Kefalta mo nɛ kumo nɛ bumo daa na na kutɔ nɛ b daŋ nuu amo. Kefalta na e la Kristo na. 5Ama bumo be galeŋga be asheŋ daa maŋ par Ebɔrɛ, amoso, e daŋ shin nɛ bumo be eyurana pesaŋ m pesaŋ to nna n dese kiyi na to.
6To, le be asheŋ ere kikɛ la asɔ nɛ a bee ŋini anyi asɔ ko nna a fiɛ anyi so nɛ an sa maŋ kaa ta anyi be ŋgbene a deŋi alubi so fanɛ kananɛ b daŋ wora na. 7Men sa maŋ kaa la agbirshumpoana fanɛ kananɛ bumo be beko daa la na. Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Basa na daŋ chena nna n ji nseŋ nuu nseŋ koso n cha.” 8A maŋ daga fanɛ an luri kesakalea gba to fanɛ kananɛ bumo be beko daŋ wora nɛ bumo basa ŋgboŋ adunyɔ nɛ asa daŋ wu kachɛ koŋwule na. 9A maŋ daga fanɛ an wora Enyɛnpe na ŋ keni fanɛ kananɛ bumo be beko daŋ wora nɛ awɔ daŋ duŋ n duŋ bumo m mɔ na. 10Men sa maa bile asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ bumo be beko daŋ wora nɛ malaika mɔpo na daŋ mur bumo na. 11Asheŋ ere kikɛ daŋ wora bumo nna nɛ an pin kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ. B sibɛ amo n nase malɛ nna nɛ a baa fiɛ anyi so, ŋkpal manɛ so, jemanɛ mo nɛ an wɔtɔ ere bee fo durnya be ekar nna na.
12Amoso, ekama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ e yil kpakpa na e baa da so nsaa maŋ kaŋ tɔr. 13Kechɔŋkeni kama nɛ k ba menyi so la kusɔ nɛ k bee kaa ba esa kama so nna. Ama Ebɔrɛ la esa nɛ e maaŋ yige anyi n to nna, e maaŋ shin nɛ men luri kechɔŋkeni mo nɛ k chɔ menyi be eleŋ so to. Nɛ men baŋ luri kechɔŋkeni to, mo alɛ beeŋ bugi ekpa n sa menyi nɛ men tiŋ n nya n yili to kpakpa.
Agbirjibi be nshɛrgboŋana nɛ Enyɛnpe be kejibi na be asheŋ
14Amoso ma beshapo, men baa gelge kagbirshuŋ. 15Mee malga menyi kutɔ nna fanɛ benyiashempo, amoso, men gbagba e fɛ asheŋ nɛ mee malga ere be nfɛra ŋ keni.
16An ka bee kaa ji Enyɛnpe be kejibi na nsaa kule mbe nɛfa a wɔtɔ asɔrso be asɔnuuso be kawiebi nɛfaso to a nuu amo na, anyi kikɛ nɛ Kristo maŋ wɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ to nna ŋkpal mbe ŋklaŋ so a? An ka bee kaa buri bodobodo na to nsaa we kumo na, anyi kikɛ nɛ Kristo maŋ wɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ to nna ŋkpal mbe eyur so a? 17Bodobodo na bee kaa la kukoŋwule nna nɛ anyi basa damta bee tu abar a we kumo, amoso, an la eyur koŋwule to ebi nna. 18Men fɛ Israɛlebi be asheŋ ŋ keni. Men maŋ nyi fanɛ bekama nɛ b ji esarga mo nɛ b lara n sa Ebɔrɛ ashi bɔrɛsure na so wɔ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be kebaawɔtɔ to nna ŋkpal bɔrɛsure na so a? 19To, nuso nɛ mee ber ere, fanɛ kalɔŋɛjibi e la kusɔ ko ŋko kegbir bre e la kusɔ ko? 20Ayai, kusɔ nɛ mee ŋini e la fanɛ esarga mo nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ bee kaa lara na, la asɔ nɛ baa ta a sa alizinaana nna, mannɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ baa ta a sa. Ma alɛ maa sha fanɛ menyi nɛ alizinaana e baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule a wora asheŋ. 21Men maaŋ tiŋ n nuu asɔnuuso ashi Enyɛnpe be kawiebi na to nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n nuu alizinaana peya to. Men maaŋ tiŋ n nya kakpa n chena Enyɛnpe be ejikpa n ji nseŋ naŋ nya kakpa n chena alizinaana be ejikpa n ji. 22Ŋko anyee sha fanɛ an wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe kayurbesa to nna ŋ keni? Anyi e chɔ mo eleŋ a?
Kananɛ eyirdapo wɔ mbe kumu be asheŋ
23Le nɛ menyi be beko bee kaa kaŋɛ: “An kɔ ekpa nɛ an wora kusɔ kama nɛ anyee sha.” Kashenteŋ nna, ama mannɛ kusɔ kama malɛ e walɛ. Menyee kaŋɛ: “An kɔ ekpa nɛ an wora kusɔ kama nɛ anyee sha.” Kashenteŋ nna, ama mannɛ kusɔ kama e naa yɛr esa anishito. 24Esa kama e sa maa fin mo gbagba nawule be kelela, a daga fanɛ e baa fin basa pɔtɛ peya.
