25Kusɔ kama nɛ baa fa eblaŋ be kebɛ to, men ji nsaa maa bishi asheŋ ŋkpal shika be nfɛra nɛ men kɔ so. 26Ŋkpal manɛ so: “Kasawule ere nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ kumo so ere kikɛ la Enyɛnpe na peya nna.” 27Nɛ esa nɛ e maŋ la eyirdapo tre fo fanɛ fo ba ji nɛ fo shuli n yɔ, ya ji kusɔ kama nɛ b ta n yili fo anishito nsaa maŋ bishi asheŋ ŋkpal shika be nfɛra mo nɛ fo kɔ so. 28Ama nɛ esa ko baŋ kaŋɛ fo le: “B ta kumo nna n lɔŋɛ kegbir,” kumo ere fo sa maŋ ji kumo ŋkpal esa nɛ e kaŋɛ fo na so, nɛ shika be nfɛra so. 29Esa nɛ e kaŋɛ fo na be shika nɛ n de na, mannɛ fo alɛ gbagba peya, ŋkpal manɛ so, manɛ so nɛ mee shin nɛ esa pɔtɛ be shika be nfɛra bee keni ma kamooji be asheŋ to? 30Nɛ m baŋ chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal ma ajibi so, manɛ so nɛ esa naa malga a gbiti ma ŋkpal ajibi mo nɛ n chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ nsaa ji so so?
31Amoso, nɛ fee ji ŋko fee nuu nna ŋko kusɔ kama nɛ fee wora, wora amo kikɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ e nya kemaŋkura. 32Sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ fo kebaawɔtɔ e shin nɛ Juw be esa kama ŋko Griik be esa kama ŋko Ebɔrɛ be asɔri na to be ekama e tɔr. 33Kusɔ nɛ ma ere bee wora nde: Kusɔ kama nɛ mee wora, mee wora ania nna nɛ k par ekama ŋkaa maa fɛ ŋ gbagba be kumu so so, ekama be kumu so nɛ mee wora loŋ, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya kumɔlga.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 11
Content:
1Amoso, men baa kute ma to fanɛ kananɛ mee kute Kristo to na.
Kebaabuu kumu so ashi asɔri to be asheŋ
2Saŋkikɛ mee chɔrɔ menyi nna ŋkpal men ka bee nyiŋi ma kusɔ kama to nɛ kananɛ men baa kɔ keŋini mo nɛ n ta n sa menyi na to so.
3Ama mee sha nna nɛ men pin fanɛ enyɛn kama be kumu e la Kristo, nɛ eche malɛ be kumu la enyɛn nɛ Kristo malɛ be kumu la Ebɔrɛ. 4Amoso, enyɛn kama nɛ e bee ta kusɔ a buu mbe kumu so nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ ŋko nsaa wu abɔrɛsheŋ to a malga basa to bee ŋaba mbe kumu nna na. 5Ama eche kama malɛ nɛ e bee kule Ebɔrɛ ŋko a wu abɔrɛsheŋ to a malga basa to nsaa maa ta shɛŋ a chɛ kumu bee ŋaba mbe kumu nna na. K baa du fanɛ b ka kpasa mbe kumu nna. 6Nɛ eche baa maa ta shɛŋ a chɛ kumu, kumo ere a daga fanɛ e shin nɛ b she mo. Ama nɛ fanɛ keshɛ eche na ŋko kekpesa mo so bee keta mo anishinyɔr bre, kumo ere amo be kache na e baa ta kusɔ a chɛ mbe kumu. 7A maŋ daga enyɛn bre ka ta kusɔ ko m buu mbe kumu so, ŋkpal manɛ so, e la Ebɔrɛ be kaduli nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura nna. Ama eche bre la enyɛn be kemaŋkura nna. 8Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ enyɛn e shi eche to, eche e shi enyɛn to. 9Ebɔrɛ malɛ maŋ pɔr enyɛn nna n sa eche, e pɔr eche nna n sa enyɛn. 10Amoso, a daga fanɛ eche e baa ta kusɔ a chɛ mbe kumu a ŋini fanɛ e wɔ mo kul be kaseto nna ŋkpal emalaika so. 11Ama men baa nyiŋi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na to, nɛ enyɛn maŋ wɔtɔ, eche maŋ la shɛŋ, nɛ eche malɛ maŋ wɔtɔ, enyɛn maŋ la shɛŋ. 12Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ eche baŋ shi enyɛn to na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ eche bee kurge enyɛn. Ama kusɔ kama malɛ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna. 13Menyi alɛ gbagba e keni kesheŋ ere to, a daga fanɛ eche e baa kule Ebɔrɛ basa to ŋkaa maŋ ta shɛŋ n chɛ kumu a? 14Nɛ men keni Ebɔrɛ be kapɔr kikɛ to, men maŋ wu fanɛ nɛ enyɛn baa kɔ emin tenteŋ, k la ŋaba nna n sa mo ere gbagba a? 15Ama men maŋ nyi fanɛ nɛ eche bre kɔ emin tenteŋ, k la mbe kemaŋkura nna a? Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ sa mo emin tenteŋ na nna nɛ a baa buu mo so.
16To, kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ ere, nɛ esa kama nɛ e bee sha keji kumo emɔrɔ, kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ amodoŋwura e la fanɛ kusɔ nɛ anyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be asɔriana na to ebi kikɛ bee bɛ so nna na.
Enyɛnpe be daŋkarejibi be asheŋ
17Le be kesheŋ ŋini ere bre to, m maŋ kɔ kechɔrɔ kama a sa menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, men be nshɛrana to kejija e wɔtɔ, kelɔŋɛ maŋ wɔtɔ. 18Kusɔ nɛ k juŋkpar nde: N nu fanɛ men baŋ shɛr fanɛ asɔri, men kɔ kebargatoana nna menyi to, ma alɛ yirda kumo ashi ekpa ko so. 19Kumo alɛ la kashenteŋ nna fanɛ menyeeŋ baa kɔr abar to, saŋɛ na so, loŋ beeŋ shin nɛ basa e pin bumo nɛ b yil to nɛnɛ.
20Men ka bee kaa shɛr a sha keji Enyɛnpe be kejibi na, mannɛ Enyɛnpe be kejibi na nɛ menyee ji, 21ŋkpal manɛ so, men ka bee kaa ji na, ekama baa ji mo peya nna a maŋ naa jo esa kama. Amoso, beko wɔ akoŋ to nna nɛ beko malɛ nuu nsa m boo. 22Men maŋ kɔ epeana nna nɛ men baa ji nsaa nuu ndoŋana a? Ŋko menyee fɛl Ebɔrɛ be asɔri nna nsaa ŋaba bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ shɛŋ na nna a? To, nɛ le ere, nuso nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi? N chɔrɔ menyi ŋkpal le ere so a? Loŋ maaŋ wora kikɛ kuraa. 23Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ n nya ashi Enyɛnpe kutɔ nɛ ma alɛ gba bee ta a sa menyi na fanɛ: Kanyɛ mo nɛ b daŋ debɔr Enyɛnpe Yesu na, e daŋ ta bodobodo nna 24n chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ n loge nseŋ bu kumo to nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Ma eyur nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa menyi nde, men baa wora kesheŋ ere a nyiŋi ma.” 25B ka ji n loge nɛ e ta kawiebi na malɛ n wora kananɛ e daŋ wora na ŋ kaŋɛ: “Kawiebi ere e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ dimɛdi be ŋkre popɔr ŋkpal ma ŋklaŋ so na. Men baa wora loŋ saŋkikɛ nɛ menyee nuu asɔrso be asɔnuuso ashi kumo to na a nyiŋi ma.” 26Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋkama nɛ menyee we bodobodo ere nsaa nuu kawiebi ere to be asɔ, menyee kute Enyɛnpe na be luwu be asheŋ to nna na hale n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ e beeŋ ya ba na. 27Amoso, ekama nɛ e we Enyɛnpe be bodobodo na nseŋ nuu asɔrso be asɔnuuso na ekpa nɛ k maŋ daga so, wora alubi nna ŋ gbiti Enyɛnpe be eyur nɛ mbe ŋklaŋ na nna na. 28Amoso, a daga fanɛ esa e keni mbe kumu so nɛnɛ pɔɛŋ nseŋ we Enyɛnpe be bodobodo na nseŋ nuu asɔnuuso na ashi kawiebi na to. 29Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e ji kejibi na nseŋ nuu asɔnuuso na ashi kawiebi na to nsaa maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ eyur na bee ŋini, bee ji nna nsaa nuu kasogberge a sa mbe kumu nna na. 30Amoso nɛ menyi to be bedamta maŋ kɔ eleŋ nsaa lɔ nɛ menyi be beko malɛ gba wu na. 31Ama nɛ an baŋ keni anyi gbagba be ŋgbene to nɛnɛ bre, anyi maaŋ luri demuji kama to. 32Ama nɛ Enyɛnpe na baŋ sa anyi kasogberge n niŋi anyi ekpa, e bee wora loŋ nna, saŋɛ na so, e maaŋ ta anyi n ti durnyaebi so m mur. 33Amoso, ŋ kurgepoana, men baŋ ba nɛ men ba tu abar n ji, men baa jo abar. 34Ekama nɛ akoŋ kɔ, amodoŋwura e ji epe, saŋɛ na so, men baŋ ba shɛr abar so, kumo be lalaloge maaŋ bar kasogberge.
To, asheŋ nɛ a ka na bre, ŋ kaŋ ba, meeŋ ŋini menyi amo alɛ be afito.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 12
Content:
Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be ŋkɛ be asheŋ
1To, naniere ŋ kurgepoana, men shin nɛ an keni ŋkɛ mo nɛ a bee shi Kiyoyu na to na be asheŋ to. Mee sha fanɛ men baa nyi amo be asheŋ nna. 2Men nyi fanɛ saŋɛ nɛ men daa maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ na, Setani e daŋ fuli menyi ekpa kama nɛ men daŋ bɔla so nɛ men bɛ agbir nɛ a la asɔ wuso na so. 3Amoso, mee sha fanɛ men pin fanɛ esa kikɛ nɛ e kɔ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kɔnɔso e baa wɔ Yesu so!” Esa kikɛ malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Yesu e la Enyɛnpe” ama Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e shin nɛ e kaŋɛ loŋ.
4Kiyoyu to be ŋkɛ be nnaŋ to e wɔtɔ, ama Kiyoyu koŋwule na e naa sa amo kikɛ. 5Ashuŋ be nnaŋ to damta nɛ Enyɛnpe ta m bɔɔ mbe basa enɔ, ama Enyɛnpe koŋwule e wɔtɔ. 6Ekpa be nnaŋ to damtaana so nɛ basa bee bɔla a shuŋ, ama Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na e kɔ amo a wɔ basa to a shuŋ. 7Kiyoyu na bee bɔla ekpa pɔtɛana so nna a lara mbe kumu a ŋini ekama nɛ mbe basa kikɛ e nya kechɛto, 8Kiyoyu na bee kaa sa esa ko kanyiasheŋ be kamalga be kakɛ nna ŋkaa sa eko malɛ nfɛra mo nɛ a shi mo gbagba kutɔ nɛ e malga be kakɛ. 9Kiyoyu koŋwule na malɛ gbagba e naa sa eko malɛ yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wora kusɔ ko be kakɛ nseŋ sa esa ko malɛ kakɛ nɛ e baa chɛ basa. 10Eko malɛ e bee sa mo kakɛ nna nɛ e baa wora emamachisheŋ, eko malɛ nɛ e sa mo kewuŋkaŋɛ be kakɛ, n sa eko malɛ kanyiasheŋ mo nɛ k bee shin nɛ esa bee pin ayoyu to be kakɛ, eko malɛ nɛ e sa mo ŋgbar mo nɛ e maa nu be nnaŋ to be ketiŋ ŋ gbar be kakɛ, nseŋ sa eko malɛ ŋgbar mo nɛ e maa nu be afito be kekute be kakɛ. 11Ade malɛ kikɛ Kiyoyu koŋwule na gbagba e naa sa amo, mo e naa sa basa ŋkɛ na be kekama kanaŋkamaso nɛ e bee sha.
Eyur koŋwule nɛ kumo be mba damta be asheŋ
12Fanɛ kananɛ eyur baa la kukoŋwule kumo alɛ nsaa kɔ mba damta nɛ kumo be mba na kikɛ wɔ eyur koŋwule so na gbagba na nɛ Kristo gba du. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kiyoyu koŋwule na e shin nɛ anyi kikɛ, Juwebi ŋko Griikebi, anya ŋko bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo be amu kikɛ nyam bɔla kabɔrɛbɛr so ŋ ki eyur koŋwule to ebi nyam nɛ anyi kikɛ ba nya Kiyoyu koŋwule na. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so, eyur na maŋ la kaba koŋwule nna, mba damta nna. 15Nɛ eyur be keya baŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ŋkpal ŋ ka maŋ la enɔ so so, m maŋ la eyur na be kaba,” loŋ maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ k sa maŋ naa la eyur na be kaba. 16Nɛ kusoe baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ŋkpal ŋ ka maŋ la kenishi so, m maŋ la eyur na be kaba,” loŋ maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ k sa maŋ naa la eyur na be kaba. 17To, nɛ eyur ere kikɛ daa la kenishi nna, nnɛ nɛ kenu daa beeŋ baa wɔ? Ŋko nɛ eyur ere kikɛ daa la kusoe nna, nnɛ nɛ efɛa be kenu daa beeŋ baa wɔ? 18Ama kananɛ k du ere Ebɔrɛ ta eyur be kaba kama nna n wɔtɔ eyur na to kananɛ e bee sha fanɛ a baa du. 19Nɛ amo kikɛ daa la kaba koŋwule nna, nuso nɛ eyur na daa beeŋ baa du? 20Ama kananɛ k du ere, mba damta e wɔtɔ, ama eyur koŋwule malɛ nna. 21Kenishi maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ enɔ le: “M maa sha fo kechɛto.” Kumu malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ ayadra le: “M maa sha men be kechɛto.” 22Ama nɛ fo keni to, feeŋ wu fanɛ eyur ere be mba nɛ a pɔ ga a chɔ mba nɛ a ka na e daga anyi. 23Mba mo nɛ anyee kaa fɛ fanɛ a maŋ la shɛŋ na malɛ nɛ anyee kaa ta bunyaŋ damta a sa. Mba mo nɛ a maŋ walɛ kenishiso na malɛ nɛ anyee kaa keni so nɛnɛ. 24An be mba mo nɛ a walɛ kenishiso na bre maŋ daga le be kekeniso ere. Ebɔrɛ gbagba e ta eyur be mba kikɛ n chɔga abar so nɛ e ta bunyaŋ n sa mba mo nɛ a maŋ kɔ bunyaŋ amo gbagba be amu so na. 25Saŋɛ na so kebarga to kama maaŋ baa wɔ eyur na to, ama mbaana na kikɛ beeŋ baa kɔ kagbene koŋwule a keni abar so. 26Eyur na be kaba koŋwule baa wu ebesa, eyur na kikɛ bee wu ebesa nna, kaba koŋwule malɛ baa nya bunyaŋ, mba na kikɛ bee nya kagbenefuli nna. 27To, menyi e la Kristo be eyur na nsaa la kumo be mba kukoko to.
28Asɔri na to, basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ juŋkpar n lara e la beshuŋipo, bumo nɛ b bɛ so e la abɔrɛsheŋ be bewuŋkaŋɛpo, besasopo e la beŋinipo, n ta emamachishumpoana m bɛ so, n ta bechɛpo nɛ bechɛtopo nɛ bumo nɛ baa keni ashuŋ be asheŋ to so m bɛ so nseŋ ta bumo nɛ baa gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ bumo gbagba maa nu m bɛ so. 29Bumo kikɛ e la beshuŋipo a? Bumo kikɛ e la abɔrɛsheŋ be bewuŋkaŋɛpo a? Bumo kikɛ e la beŋinipo a? Bumo kikɛ e naa shuŋ emamachishuŋ a? 30Bumo kikɛ e kɔ kechɛ be kakɛ a? Bekama e naa gbar ŋgbar nɛ bumo gbagba maa nu a? Bekama e naa kute ŋgbar nɛ bumo gbagba maa nu be afito a? Ayai, mannɛ bumo kikɛ e naa wora loŋ. 31Amoso, men baa ta men be ŋgbene kikɛ a fin ŋkɛ mo nɛ a walɛ ga na.
Ma alɛ beeŋ ŋini menyi ekpa mo nɛ k beeŋ yɛr menyi anishito n ti so.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 13
Content:
Kasha be asheŋ
1Nɛ m baa tiŋ a gbar basa nɛ emalaika gba be ŋgbar ŋkaa maa kɔ kasha, kumo ere m baa du fanɛ kakure bureso nna ŋko awɔr fuloŋ.
2Hale nɛ m baa kɔ abɔrɛsheŋ be kewuŋkaŋɛ be kakɛ nsaa tiŋ a pin ewulosheŋ kikɛ nɛ kanyiasheŋ kikɛ to nsaa kɔ yirda kikɛ ma to a tiŋ a tia abee
ŋkaa maa kɔ kasha bre,
m maŋ la shɛŋ.
3Nɛ m baa tiŋ a ta kusɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ a kɛ basa ŋkaa beeŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta ma eyur n sa fanɛ b chɔɔ edɛ ŋkpal ma yirda so,
ma alɛ ŋkaa maa kɔ kasha bre,
kumo ere m maŋ nya tɔnɔ kikɛ.
4Kasha la kanyiti nna nɛ
kebaala esa.
Kasha maa besa eyur,
kumo alɛ maa maŋ kumu so.
K maŋ la kumu be ketinto
ŋko nfɛlso be kebaawɔtɔ.
5Esa nɛ e kɔ kasha maa fin mo gbagba nawule be kelela.
Kasha wɔ esa to e maa nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ,
mo alɛ maa ta alubi nɛ esa wora mo a wɔtɔ kagbene to.
6Kasha wɔ esa to, mbe kagbene maa fuli mo ŋkpal kulubi so, kashenteŋ e naa fuli mbe kagbene. 7Kasha wɔ esa to e maa gben a yige kusɔ kama to, e bee yirda kusɔ kama nna a tama kusɔ kama nsaa yil to kanyitiso malɛ saŋkama.
8Kasha maa loge kikɛ.
Ama kewuŋkaŋɛana bre
nɛ ŋgbar pɔtɛana be kegbar
nɛ kanyiasheŋ bre kikɛ beeŋ ba choŋ.
9Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be kanyiasheŋ ere nɛ anyi be kewuŋkaŋɛ ere maŋ naŋ bɔlɔ so n loge.
10Ama kusɔ nɛ k bɔlɔ so kaŋ ba, kusɔ nɛ k maŋ bɔlɔ so beeŋ choŋ.
11Ŋ ka daa la kebia, n daa malga fanɛ kebia nna
a fɛ nfɛra fanɛ kebia
a pin asheŋ to fanɛ kebia.
Ama ŋ ka ba ki enimu nɛ n yige mbibisheŋ ma asheŋ to.
12Naniere bre anyee wu asɔ nna lii fanɛ an ka bee keni digi to na. Ama saŋko anyeeŋ wu kusɔ kama kenishiso nɛnɛ.
Naniere n nyi asheŋ to gbrɛbi nna, ama saŋko meeŋ pin kusɔ kama to nɛnɛ n loge fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ nyi ma to na.
13Ama asheŋ ere kikɛ to asɔ nɛ a beeŋ baa wɔtɔ e la, yirda nɛ tama nɛ kasha, ama amo alɛ kikɛ be kejuŋkparso e la kasha.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 14
Content:
Kewuŋkaŋɛ nɛ ŋgbar pɔtɛana be ŋkɛ be asheŋ
1Amoso, men baa kɔ a fin kasha nseŋ ta menyi be ŋgbene kikɛ n fin ŋkɛ mo nɛ a shi Kiyoyu na kutɔ na, fɔnfɔŋ kewu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ be kakɛ na. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e bee gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ e maa nu na, maa gbar amo nna a sa basa, Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee gbar amo a sa, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama maa nu amo. E bee bɔla Kiyoyu na to nna a malga wuloso be mmalga. 3Ama esa kama nɛ e bee wu abɔrɛsheŋ na to a kaŋɛ bre bee malga nna a sa basa a chɛ bumo to nɛ b baa yɔ anishito nsaa leŋ bumo to a wushi bumo kagbene. 4Esa kama nɛ e bee gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ e maa nu, bee chɛ mo nawule be kumu to nna nɛ e yɔ anishito, ama ekama nɛ e bee wu abɔrɛsheŋ to a kaŋɛ bre, bee chɛ asɔri to ebi na kikɛ to nna nɛ b yɔ anishito. 5Nɛ men kikɛ daa gbar ŋgbar pɔtɛana nna, k daa beeŋ par ma, ama kusɔ nɛ k chɔ loŋ e la men kikɛ ka daa beeŋ baa tiŋ a wu abɔrɛsheŋ to a kaŋɛ. Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e bee wu abɔrɛsheŋ to a kaŋɛ, chɔ esa nɛ e bee gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ e maa nu, ama esa ko baa wɔ ndoŋ a beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kute ŋgbar na be afito nɛ asɔri na to ebi kikɛ e nya kechɛto n yɔ anishito. 6Ŋ kurgepoana, nɛ m baŋ ba menyi kutɔ m ba kaa gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ m maa nu ŋkaa maŋ bar menyi kelaraŋŋini ko ŋko kanyiasheŋ ko ŋko kewu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ ŋko keŋini ko, mannɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ menyeeŋ nya? 7Hale alaŋsɔ fanɛ kalopi nɛ jaŋjilaŋ nɛ a maŋ kɔ ŋkpa ere gba, nɛ b maŋ foŋ ŋko n laŋ amo amo be ekpa so, nuso nɛ feeŋ wora m pin amo be kushu ka wɔ ebel? 8Ŋko nɛ fanɛ akarma maŋ laŋ ntempeni kananɛ k daga, nuso nɛ basa bee wora a bela ase a yɔ kena to? 9To, loŋ nɛ k du n sa menyi. Nɛ men baa maŋ gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ basa bee nu, nuso nɛ esa beeŋ wora m pin kusɔ nɛ menyee kaŋɛ? Nɛ b baa maa pin amo to, kumo ere fee malga a sa afu nna na. 10Ŋgbar nnaŋ to damta e wɔ durnya ere to, amo alɛ kikɛ be kekama kɔ kifito nna. 11Ama nɛ fanɛ m baa maa nu ŋgbar mo nɛ esa bee malga, kumo ere esa nɛ e bee malga amo la efɔ nna ma kutɔ nɛ ma alɛ la efɔ mo kutɔ. 12Loŋ nɛ k du n sa menyi alɛ gba. Amoso, ŋkpal men ka bee kɔ a fin kenya ŋkɛ mo nɛ Kiyoyu na bee sa so, men baa pere kenishi a nya ŋkɛ mo nɛ a bee shin nɛ asɔri na bee yɔ anishito ga na.
13Amoso, ekama nɛ e bee gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ e maa nu, e baa kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ e baa tiŋ a kute amo be afito. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ m baa kule Ebɔrɛ ŋgbar mo nɛ m maa nu to, ma kiyoyu e naa kule, ama ma nfɛra bre maa wora shɛŋ shɛŋ. 15To, naniere, nuso nɛ meeŋ baa wora? Meeŋ baa ta ma kiyoyu a kule Ebɔrɛ nseŋ naa ta ma nfɛra gba a kule Ebɔrɛ. Meeŋ baa ta ma kiyoyu a boŋ nshɛ nseŋ naa ta ma nfɛra gba a boŋ amo. 16Nɛ fee ta fo kiyoyu a chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ, nuso nɛ esa pɔtɛ mo nɛ e ba asɔri na to ŋkaa maa nu ŋgbar na bee wora a shuli ‘Amɛn’ a wɔtɔ fo kechɔrɔ na to? Ŋkpal manɛ so, e maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ fee kaŋɛ. 17Shere fo kabɔrɛchɔrɔ na beeŋ baa kɔ kifito ga, ama esa pɔtɛ na maaŋ nya kechɛto kama n yɔ anishito. 18Mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga fanɛ mee gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ m maa nu a chɔ menyi be ekama. 19Ama nɛ m baa wɔ asɔri to mee kaa sha kemalga mmalga anu mo nɛ basa beeŋ tiŋ n nu to nna nɛ n ta amo ŋ ŋini basa na asɔ, a chɔ ŋ ka gbar mmalga ŋgboŋ kudu mo nɛ a wɔ ŋgbar mo nɛ b maa nu to.
20Ŋ kurgepoana, men sa maa fɛ nfɛra fanɛ mbia. Alubi bre be kewora be kaplɛa so men baa la mbia, ama men be nfɛra bre to, men baa la basa kpar. 21Abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ e naa kaŋɛ loŋ fanɛ Enyɛnpe na yɛ: “Meeŋ bɔla basa nɛ b kɔ ŋgbar pɔtɛana nɛ befɔ be nnɔana to m malga n sa basa ere, ama nɛ n wora loŋ gba, b maaŋ nu n sa ma.” 22Amoso, ŋgbar mo nɛ amo be begbarpo maa nu be kegbar bee ŋini basa nɛ b maŋ la beyirdapo kusɔ ko nna, mannɛ beyirdapo na, ama kewu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ bre la kusɔ nɛ k bee ŋini beyirdapo kusɔ ko nna, k maŋ kɔ shɛŋ a ŋini bumo nɛ b maŋ la beyirdapo.
23Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ asɔri na to ebi kikɛ ba shɛr nɛ ekama nyam bee gbar ŋgbar nɛ b maa nu ana nɛ esa pɔtɛ ŋko bumo nɛ b maŋ la beyirdapo ba luri nshɛr na to, b maaŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ menyee lɔ eboŋ nna a? 24Ama nɛ fanɛ asɔri na to ebi kikɛ bee wu abɔrɛsheŋ na to a kaŋɛ nɛ emo nɛ e maŋ la eyirdapo ŋko esa pɔtɛ ba luri nshɛr na to, asheŋ nɛ e bee nu na kikɛ beeŋ shin nɛ e keni mbe asheŋ to n shin nɛ e wu mbe alubi. 25Mbe wulo to be nfɛra beeŋ lar n dii efuli nɛ e gbir n dese kasawule m maŋ Ebɔrɛ so ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kashenteŋto, Ebɔrɛ wɔ menyi kutɔ nfe.”
Asɔri to be asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so be asheŋ
26To, ŋ kurgepoana, naniere manɛ e naŋ ka nɛ an kaŋɛ? Men baŋ ba shɛr asɔri to, eko beeŋ baa kɔ kapandi be kashɛ ŋko keŋini ko ŋko kelaraŋŋini be kesheŋ ko ŋko ŋgbar nɛ e maa nu be kegbar ŋko amo be kifito be kekute. A daga fanɛ men baa wora ade kikɛ nɛ asɔriebi na e nya kechɛto n yɔ anishito. 27Nɛ basa baa shin nɛ b gbar ŋgbar mo nɛ b maa nu, men shin nɛ k baa la fanɛ basa anyɔ ŋko b baa shi ga, b baa la basa asa ŋ gbar amo kukoko to nɛ esa ko malɛ e kute amo be afito. 28Nɛ esa nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kute ŋgbar na be afito maŋ wɔtɔ, egbarpo na e lo mbe kɔnɔ asɔri na to nseŋ malga mo gbagba be kumu to nɛ Ebɔrɛ kutɔ. 29Kekama malɛ to a daga fanɛ abɔrɛsheŋ be bewuŋkaŋɛpo anyɔ ŋko besa e malga abɔrɛsheŋ nɛ bumo nɛ bumo alɛ ka na e belsi asheŋ nɛ bumo na kute na. 30Ama nɛ abɔrɛsheŋ be ewuŋkaŋɛpo kama nɛ e bee malga nɛ kelaraŋŋini be kubɔya ko shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba esa ko nɛ e tase nshɛr na to na kutɔ, ewuŋkaŋɛpo na e lo to. 31Ŋkpal manɛ so, men kikɛ beeŋ tiŋ n wu abɔrɛsheŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ kukoko to, saŋɛ na so ekama beeŋ koya kusɔ ko nseŋ nya keleŋto. 32Abɔrɛsheŋ be bewuŋkaŋɛpoana gbagba e wɔ bumo be kewuŋkaŋɛ be ayoyu. 33Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maŋ la kebagato be Ebɔrɛ nna, kagbenewushi be Ebɔrɛ e la mo.
34A daga fanɛ beche e baa lo bumo be nnɔ to ashi asɔriana to fanɛ kananɛ k du ashi Ebɔrɛ be basa larasoana na kikɛ be asɔriana na to na. B maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ b malga, a daga fanɛ b baa bar bumo be amu kaseto fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na. 35Kusɔ kama nɛ baa sha kepinto, b bishi bumo kulana epe, ŋkpal manɛ so, k la anishinyɔr be kesheŋ nna fanɛ eche e baa malga asɔri to. 36Cha, menyi kutɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na fara ŋko menyi nawule kutɔ nɛ k yɔ?
37Ekama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ abɔrɛsheŋ be ewuŋkaŋɛpo e la mo ŋko fanɛ e la kiyoyu to be esa nna e baa nyi fanɛ kusɔ nɛ mee sibɛ a sa menyi ere la kamalga naseso mo nɛ k shi Enyɛnpe kutɔ nna. 38Nɛ e baŋ kplaŋ le be kesheŋ ere so, baaŋ kplaŋ mo alɛ gba so.
39Amoso, ŋ kurgepoana, men baa kɔ a fin kewu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ, menyi alɛ e sa maa kuŋ ŋgbar mo nɛ amo be begbarpo maa nu amo be kegbar ekpa ashi menyi to. 40Ama a daga fanɛ men baa wora kusɔ kama nɛnɛ ekpa niŋiso so.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 15
Content:
Kristo be ketiŋi luwu to be asheŋ
1Naniere, ŋ kurgepoana, mee sha fanɛ n nyiŋi menyi baru lela mo nɛ n daŋ bɔ n sa menyi nɛ men sɔ a yil kumo to na be asheŋ nna. 2Baru lela na so nɛ menyee nya kumɔlga, nɛ men baa kɔ kumo to kpakpa nna na, ama men daŋ yirda jiga nna. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ n daŋ nya nɛ ma alɛ gba daŋ ta m bɔɔ menyi enɔ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ k juŋkpar e la fanɛ: Kristo wu nna ŋkpal anyi be alubi so fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ 4b daŋ puli mo, ama e tiŋi ashi luwu na to kumo be kachɛ sasopo to fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na. 5E ka tiŋi na e daŋ lar Pita nawule so nseŋ naŋ lar bumo bebɛsopo kuduanyɔ na kikɛ so. 6Amo be kaman nɛ e lar bekurgepo mo nɛ b chɔ basa alfa anu so ashi kaboŋ koŋwule. Bumo be galeŋga kraa wɔ ŋkpa to kabre, ama beko bre wu. 7E daŋ lar Jeems gba so nseŋ naŋ lar beshuŋipoana na kikɛ so. 8Ade kikɛ nyam be kaman nɛ e lar ma alɛ so, k daa du fanɛ b ka kurge ma saŋɛ gela nna.
9Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma e la beshuŋipoana na kikɛ be emantopo, a maŋ daga fanɛ b ka tre ma eshuŋipo gba, ŋkpal manɛ so, n tɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be asɔri. 10Ama ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ so nɛ n du kananɛ n du ere na, mo alɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ k ba ma so ere maŋ la jiga nna. Ama nɛ fo keni to, ma e shuŋ ga a chɔ bumo kikɛ, mannɛ ma gbagba bre, Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na e wɔ ma to a shuŋ. 11Amoso, nɛ ma kutɔ nɛ kamalga na daŋ shi ŋko bumo kutɔ nɛ k daŋ shi, kusɔ nɛ anyee ta a sa menyi nna na, kumo alɛ nɛ men yirda na.
Bubuni be ketiŋi luwu to be asheŋ
12Ama nɛ fanɛ baa bɔ Kristo be baru na a kaŋɛ fanɛ e tiŋi luwu to, nuso nɛ men be beko bee wora a kaŋɛ fanɛ ketiŋi luwu to maŋ wɔtɔ? 13Nɛ fanɛ ketiŋi luwu to maŋ wɔtɔ, kumo ere Kristo gba maŋ tiŋi luwu to. 14Nɛ fanɛ Kristo malɛ baa maŋ tiŋi luwu to, kumo ere, anyi be kubɔya nɛ anyee bɔ na, maŋ kɔ kifito, nɛ men be yirda gba maŋ kɔ kifito. 15Kumo be buushi, nɛ k baa la kashenteŋ nna fanɛ bubuni maa tiŋi luwu to bre, kumo ere anyee ku efɛ nna a deŋi Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal an ka ji shɛda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ tiŋi Kristo ashi luwu to, nɛ mo alɛ maŋ tiŋi mo ashi luwu na to so so. 16Ŋkpal manɛ so nɛ bubuni baa maa tiŋi ashi luwu to bre, kumo ere Kristo gba maŋ tiŋi luwu to. 17Nɛ Kristo malɛ daa maŋ tiŋi ashi luwu na to, kumo ere, men be yirda na daa maaŋ baa kɔ tɔnɔ nɛ menyi alɛ kraa wɔ men be alubi to 18nɛ bumo nɛ b daŋ yirda Kristo pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu na malɛ foe bumo be alubi to kuraa. 19Nɛ fanɛ durnya ere to be kebaawɔtɔ to nawule so nna nɛ an kɔ tama Kristo to, kumo ere a daga fanɛ basa ka shu anyi so a chɔ basa kikɛ nyam.
20Ama kashenteŋ malɛ nna fanɛ Kristo juŋkpar bumo nɛ b wu na kikɛ n tiŋi luwu to. 21Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa koŋwule so nɛ luwu bɔla m ba durnya to, esa koŋwule malɛ so nɛ ketiŋi luwu to gba ba durnya to. 22Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ ekama beeŋ wu ŋkpal e ka shi Adam to so na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa ekama nɛ e shi Kristo to na ŋkpa. 23Ama ekama nɛ mbe saŋɛ nna, sososo Kristo nɛ e la ejuŋkparso na e tiŋi, mo alɛ kaŋ naŋ ba, bumo nɛ b la mo peya na e naaŋ tiŋi m bɛ so. 24Kumo be kaman nɛ e mur kuwurji kikɛ nɛ kenimuji kikɛ nɛ eleŋana kikɛ nɛ durnya be ekar na e fo nɛ e ta kuwura na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na enɔ. 25Ŋkpal manɛ so, a daga fanɛ e baa ji kuwura loŋ n ya fo saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta mo doŋana kikɛ n wɔtɔ mbe enɔ to na. 26Edoŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ mur lalaloge e la luwu. 27Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ ta kusɔ kama m bɔɔ mo enɔ,” ama kananɛ k bee kaŋɛ fanɛ kusɔ kama ere maa ŋini fanɛ Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e bee ta kusɔ kama a bɔɔ Kristo enɔ na gba ti kusɔ kama na so nna. 28Nɛ kusɔ kama malɛ baa wɔ mo ere Ebɔrɛ be enɔ to, kumo ere Ebinyɛn na malɛ gbagba beeŋ baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e ta kusɔ kama n wɔtɔ mbe enɔ to na be enɔ to, saŋɛ na so Ebɔrɛ beeŋ baa la kusɔ kikɛ a sa esa kikɛ.
29Basa ko wɔtɔ nɛ baa bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr ŋkpal basa nɛ b wu so. To, nɛ fanɛ basa maa tiŋi luwu to kuraa, manɛ e ba nɛ basa bee yili bubuni be katelamu to a shin nɛ baa bɛr bumo kabɔrɛbɛr? 30To, nɛ anyi alɛ ai? Manɛ e ba nɛ anyee luri kenishipere to le saŋkama ere? 31Ŋ kurgepoana, mee kaŋɛ menyi nna fanɛ kachɛ kama mee wu nna. Kede malɛ baa kɔ kashenteŋ nna fanɛ kananɛ mee wu ma kumu ŋkpal men ka la Kristo Yesu, an Nyɛnpe peya na so. 32Saŋɛ nɛ n daa wɔ Ɛfeses na basa daa sa a sa ma tɔrɔ nna fanɛ ma nɛ asɔbɔya lubi ka daa kɔ na. To, nɛ fanɛ bubuni maa tiŋi luwu to nna, manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ n nya? Nɛ bubuni baa maa tiŋi ashi luwu to, kumo ere kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na bɔla nna na fanɛ: “Men shin nɛ an baa ji nsaa nuu anyi be kepar, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi maŋ nyi ŋko echefo anyeeŋ wu.” 33Men sa maŋ kaŋ fule men be amu. Beteri lubi e naa jija da lela. 34Men naŋ bɛta n nya nfɛra nsaa maŋ naa wora alubi kashenteŋto. Menyi be beko maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ. Kesheŋ nɛ mee kaŋɛ menyi ere la men be anishinyɔr nna.
Ketiŋi luwu to be eyur na be asheŋ
35Ama shere esa ko beeŋ bishi: “Nuso nɛ bubuni bee tiŋi ashi luwu to? Nuso be eyur nɛ baaŋ ba kaa kɔ?” 36Ewulpo ere, fo maŋ nyi fanɛ kusɔ nɛ fo duu na gbagba maa wora, ama k baŋ wu nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ kɔr n wora a? 37Kusɔ nɛ fee kaa duu na maŋ la keduuso na be kedibi gbagba nna. Shere k la kuyu ŋko kusɔ duuso be yiri ko be keduuso nna pɔɛŋ nɛ k kɔr n daŋ. 38Ebɔrɛ malɛ e naa sa keduuso na kedibi mo nɛ e bee sha, keduuso kama malɛ nɛ kumo be yiri to be kedibi. 39Mannɛ eyur kama e la kukoŋwule. Edimɛdi peya kɔr asɔbɔya peya to nɛ mbuibi peya kɔr ekɔrɔtɔ malɛ gba peya to. 40Ebɔrɛso be eyurana malɛ gba wɔtɔ nɛ kasawule so malɛ gba peya wɔtɔ. Ebɔrɛso be eyurana na malɛ be kela kɔr kasawule so be eyurana be kela to. 41Kananɛ epeŋi bee fuli to kɔr kananɛ kufɔl nɛ achɛkpabiana bee fuli to to. Achɛkpabiana malɛ gba to amo be kefulto kɔr abar to. 42To, kananɛ k beeŋ baa du saŋɛ nɛ bubuni bee tiŋi ashi luwu to nna na. Eyur mo nɛ baa ta a puli na la kusɔ nɛ k bee bɛ nna, kumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee tiŋi ashi luwu to na bre maa bɛ. 43Kumo be kepuli to, k maŋ kɔ bunyaŋ, ama kumo be ketiŋi bre to, kumo nɛ kemaŋkura nna. Kumo be kepuli to, kapɔshi nɛ k kɔ, kumo be ketiŋi bre to, kumo nɛ eleŋ nna. 44Kumo be kepuli to, durnya ere to be eyur nna, kumo be ketiŋi bre to, kiyoyu to be eyur e naaŋ baa la.
Nɛ fanɛ durnya ere to be eyur ere baa wɔtɔ, loŋ koŋwule na nna nɛ kiyoyu to be eyur na gba wɔtɔ. 45Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Sososo be Adam na daŋ ki kusɔ futeso nna,” nɛ lalaloge be Adam na malɛ daŋ ki ŋkpasapo be Kiyoyu. 46Mannɛ fanɛ kiyoyu to be asheŋ e juŋkpar m ba, durnya ere to be asheŋ e juŋkpar m ba, amo alɛ be kaman pɔɛŋ nɛ kiyoyu to be asheŋ ba. 47Sososo be esa na daŋ shi kasawule ere so nna, shishɛr to be esa. Esa nyɔsopo na bre shi ebɔrɛso nna. 48Bumo nɛ b shi durnya ere to na du fanɛ emo nɛ b ta shishɛr m pɔr na nna, bumo nɛ b la ebɔrɛso peya na du fanɛ emo nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso m ba na nna. 49Kananɛ an daŋ baa kɔ shishɛr be esa na be kaduli anyi so na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ anyeeŋ ba kaa kɔ esa nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso na gba be kaduli.
50Bekurgepoana, mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ b ta eyur nɛ ŋklaŋ n wora maaŋ tiŋ n nya Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to n luri, kusɔ nɛ k bee bɛ malɛ kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n nya kakpa nɛ luwu maŋ wɔtɔ n luri. 51Men keni nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi wulo to be kesheŋ ko fanɛ mannɛ anyi kikɛ e naaŋ wu, ama anyi kikɛ beeŋ chɛrga. 52K beeŋ wora epul to nna manaŋ fanɛ kenishi ka ŋe to na, saŋɛ nɛ lalaloge be kabel na beeŋ shu na. Kabel na kaŋ shu, bubuni beeŋ tiŋi n nya kiyoyu to be eyur nɛ a maaŋ naŋ mur na, saŋɛ na malɛ nɛ anyi kikɛ bee chɛrga na. 53Ŋkpal manɛ so, a daga fanɛ eyur mo nɛ k bee mur ere ka ba ki eyur mo nɛ k maa mur. A daga fanɛ eyur mo nɛ k bee wu ere ka ba ki eyur nɛ k maa wu.
54Amoso, nɛ eyur nɛ k bee mur ere baŋ ki eyur mo nɛ k maa mur na nɛ eyur nɛ k bee wu ere malɛ ki eyur nɛ k maa wu na, kumo ere kusɔ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na bee bɔla ekpa nna na fanɛ:
“Naniere luwu mur. Kekɔmpɔɔso e ka.
55Luwu, nnɛ nɛ feeŋ naŋ nya basa m pɔɔ so?
O luwu nnɛ nɛ fo kedoro be eleŋ na naa wɔ?”
56Kulubi so nɛ luwu kɔ eleŋ a doro anyi, mbra na malɛ so nɛ kulubi kɔ eleŋ anyi so. 57Ama anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa bɔla an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so a shin nɛ anyee kɔ a pɔɔ so.
58Amoso ŋ kurgepo shasoana, men baa yil to kpakpa. Men sa maŋ shin nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ e tia menyi ashi to. Saŋkikɛ men baa ta men be ŋgbene kikɛ a wɔtɔ Enyɛnpe be kushuŋ na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi alɛ gba baa nyi fanɛ men be kegben nɛ menyee gben a sa Enyɛnpe na maaŋ to jiga kikɛ.

Title: 1 KƆRINTEBI 16
Content:
Toto mo nɛ baaŋ to n chɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa to be asheŋ
1To, naniere men shin nɛ an keni keto toto n sa Ebɔrɛ be basa na be asheŋ to. Men baa wora kananɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Galeeshaebi be asɔriana fanɛ b baa wora na. 2Alediachɛ kama, men be ekama e ta amansherbi kanaŋkamaso nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ n nase, saŋɛ na so men maaŋ baa jo nɛ m ba pɔɛŋ nɛ men naa wora toto na. 3Ma alɛ kaŋ ba meeŋ ta nwɔl mo nɛ a bee ŋini basa nɛ men lara na n shuŋi loŋ be basa na nɛ b ta menyi be kakɛ na n yɔ Jerusalɛm. 4Nɛ k kaŋ daga fanɛ ma alɛ gba e yɔ, kumo ere baaŋ tu ma n yɔ.
Asɔ nɛ Pɔɔl bee sha kewora be asheŋ
5Mee fɛ kebɔla Masɛdonia be efuli so nna. Ma alɛ kaŋ yɔ ndoŋ, meeŋ ba chɔrɔ menyi. 6Shere meeŋ wora nchɛnnyɔ menyi kutɔ, fo maŋ de so gba meeŋ baa wɔ ndoŋ awo be jemanɛ ere to kikɛ gba, saŋɛ na so kumo be kaman menyeeŋ chɛ ma to ashi ma enite to kaplɛkama nɛ meeŋ yɔ. 7M maa sha fanɛ m baa choŋ naniere le nseŋ wu menyi. Mee fɛ nna fanɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe shuli nɛ n nya saŋɛ, meeŋ chena menyi kutɔ n wora nchɛnnyɔ. 8Ama ŋ kraa beeŋ baa wɔ Ɛfeses nfe n ya fo Pɛntekɔst be saŋɛ, 9ŋkpal manɛ so, kushuŋ lela gboŋgboŋi be ekpa bugi nna n sa ma nɛ n shuŋ, ama basa nɛ b maa sa ma kashuli malɛ shi.
10Timoti kaŋ ba, men keta mo nɛnɛ nsaa maŋ shin nɛ kufu e pɛ mo fanɛ efɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo alɛ gba bee shuŋ Enyɛnpe na be kushuŋ nna fanɛ ma. 11Amoso, esa kama e sa maŋ kaŋ kini mo. Men chɛ mo to nɛ e nya ekpa n lar ndoŋ kagbenewushiso m ba ŋ kutɔ nfe. Mo nɛ bekurgepoana na nɛ mee keni ekpa na.
12An kurgepo Apɔlɔs bre be asheŋ, n leŋ mo to ga fanɛ e tu bekurgepo mo na n ya bɔɔ menyi so, ama k daa maŋ wɔ mbe nfɛra to kuraa fanɛ e yɔ menyi kutɔ naniere. E kaŋ nya ekpa, e beeŋ ba.
Pɔɔl be ŋkela be mmalga be asheŋ
13Men baa da so a yil men be yirda na to kpakpa a kɔ kenyɛn nseŋ naa kɔ eleŋ. 14Kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora, men shin nɛ k baa shi kasha to.
15Bekurgepoana, men nyi fanɛ Stɛfanas nɛ mbe kowu to ebi e la bekurgepo juŋkparsoana ashi Akaya be kasawule so, bumo alɛ ta bumo be amu kikɛ nna a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso. 16Amoso, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa nu a sa le be basa nɛ bekama malɛ gba nɛ b luri loŋ be kushuŋ na to a wɔtɔ a shuŋ kumo na. 17Stɛfanas nɛ Fɔɔchunates nɛ Akaikɔs ka ba, ma kagbene fuli ma ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, men ka maŋ wɔ nfe ere, bumo e ba tal to. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, b leŋ ma to nseŋ leŋ menyi alɛ gba to loŋ. Loŋ be basa na daga fanɛ men baa sa bumo bunyaŋ.
Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
19Asɔriana to ebi nɛ b wɔ Eeshia be kasawule so nfe ere kikɛ bee chɔrɔ menyi. Akwila nɛ Prisila nɛ asɔriebi nɛ baa shɛr bumo pe na kikɛ bugi kagbene a chɔrɔ menyi ga ashi Enyɛnpe to. 20Bekurgepoana nɛ b wɔ nfe na kikɛ bee chɔrɔ menyi. Men ta kagbenefuli be kechɔrɔ cheembi n chɔrɔ abar.
21Ma, Pɔɔl gbagba e naa ta ma enɔ a sibɛ le be kechɔrɔ be kawɔl ere na. 22Ekama nɛ e maa sha Enyɛnpe na, kɔnɔso e baa wɔ amodoŋwura na so. An Nyɛnpe e naaŋ bɛta m ba. 23Enyɛnpe Yesu be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi so. 24Ma kasha e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ so ashi Kristo Yesu to. Amɛn.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ m bɔla Ebɔrɛ be keparso so a la Kristo Yesu be eshuŋipo na nɛ an kurgepo Timoti kutɔ nna a yɔ Ebɔrɛ be asɔriebi nɛ b wɔ Kɔrint be kade to nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b wɔ Griis be kasawule so kikɛ na kutɔ. 2An Tuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo e sa menyi kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi.
Pɔɔl ka bee di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ be asheŋ
3Men shin nɛ an baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ, an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo mo Tuto na. Mo e la Etuto nɛ e kɔ kuwɔr nseŋ naa la esa nɛ keleŋto kikɛ bee shi mo kutɔ na. 4Mo e naa leŋ anyi to ashi anyi be etɔrɔ kikɛ to, saŋɛ na so anyi alɛ beeŋ tiŋ n ta keleŋto mo nɛ an gbagba nya ashi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na n leŋ bekama malɛ nɛ b wɔ etɔrɔ be yiri kikɛ to. 5Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ an baa tu Kristo a ji mbe awurfoŋ damta na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ anyee bɔla Kristo so a nya keleŋto damta gba. 6Nɛ an baŋ ji awurfoŋ, menyi be keleŋto nɛ kumɔlga so so nɛ an ji loŋ be awurfoŋ na. Nɛ an baa nya keleŋto, kumo ere, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ nya loŋ be keleŋto nna na. Kumo alɛ e naa shin nɛ menyee nya eleŋ nɛ men tiŋ n nyiti awurfoŋ koŋwule nɛ anyee ji na. 7Tama mo nɛ anyi alɛ kɔ menyi so na maa gbuŋgbuŋ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi fanɛ kananɛ men baa tu anyi a ji an be awurfoŋ na, loŋ koŋwule na malɛ nɛ men naa tu anyi a nya anyi be keleŋto gba.
8Bekurgepoana, anyee sha fanɛ men pin kekɔrfɛ mo nɛ b kɔrfɛ anyi ashi Eeshia be kasawule so nna. Kashenteŋto, asheŋ nɛ b daŋ ta n tu anyi na daŋ wora anyi egbɛ ga n ya kaa pɔɔ anyi so, nɛ an daa fɛ fanɛ anyi be ŋkpaana loge durnya to. 9Kashenteŋto, an daa fɛ anyi be ŋgbene to nna fanɛ b ta luwu be mbra nna n ji m bri anyi. Ama le be kesheŋ ere daŋ ba loŋ nna nɛ an sa maŋ kaa yirda anyi gbagba be amu, ama anyeeŋ baa yirda Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee tiŋi basa ashi luwu to na. 10Loŋ be kenishipere lubi be asheŋ na to nɛ e daŋ mɔlga anyi ashi to, mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ mɔlga anyi. An ta anyi be tama nna n deŋi mo so fanɛ e beeŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ m mɔlga anyi 11nɛ menyi alɛ e baa ta men be kabɔrɛkule a kule a chɛ anyi to. Ebɔrɛ malɛ beeŋ nu men be kabɔrɛkule damta nɛ menyee kule a sa anyi na n nɛfa anyi nɛ k shin nɛ basa damta e bugi bumo be nnɔ n di Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ ŋkpal anyi so.
Pɔɔl ka chɛrga asheŋ nɛ e daa fɛ kewora be asheŋ
12Naniere le be kesheŋ ere so nɛ anyee puchi fanɛ: Anyi be ŋgbene bee kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ an tiŋ ŋ keta anyi be amu nɛnɛ ashi durnya ere to, fɔnfɔŋ anyi nɛ menyi be kebaawɔtɔ be kaplɛa so. Ŋgbene mo nɛ a shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ a maŋ kɔ kulubi nseŋ niŋi na nɛ an ta n wora asheŋ. Amoso, mannɛ durnya ere be kanyiasheŋ so nɛ an ta n wora loŋ. Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ so nɛ loŋ be asheŋ tiŋ n wora. 13Mannɛ asɔ nɛ menyi maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kraŋ ŋko m pin to nɛ anyee sibɛ a sa menyi. Amoso, mee tama fanɛ kananɛ men fara a pin asheŋ to ashi anyi kutɔ gbrɛgbrɛ ere, menyeeŋ ba pin amo to nɛnɛ. 14Kumo e la fanɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ ŋkpal anyi so n ji njɔŋ fanɛ kananɛ anyeeŋ kpal menyi so n ji njɔŋ Enyɛnpe Yesu be kachɛ na.
15Ŋkpal ŋ ka daŋ baa nyi kesheŋ ere geeŋ so, n daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ meeŋ ba chɔrɔ menyi pɔɛŋ, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ nu ebel ale anyɔ. 16Ŋkpal manɛ so, n daŋ yili kumo nna fanɛ ŋ kaa yɔ Masɛdonia, meeŋ bɔɔ menyi so. Ma alɛ naŋ ya shi Masɛdonia a bɛta a choŋ nɛ m ba shin nɛ men chɛ ma to nɛ n yɔ Judiya. 17To, kananɛ n daŋ fɛ kewora ere na daa la alefashaso be kusɔ nna a? Ŋko n fɛ asheŋ nɛ meeŋ wora nna fanɛ durnya ere to be esa a kaŋɛ fanɛ mm, mm, nseŋ naa yili epul na malɛ to a kaŋɛ m-m, m-m? 18Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ maa chɛrga kɔnɔ na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ anyi alɛ gba be kamalga maŋ la mm nɛ m-m be kamalga. 19Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo na nɛ ma nɛ Sailas nɛ Timoti bɔ mbe kubɔya n sa menyi na daa maa kaŋɛ mm nseŋ naŋ kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ m-m epul na to, saŋkikɛ mm e daa wɔ mo to. 20Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be nnɔ naseso baa sha a baa shi kanaŋkamaso, amo kikɛ la mm be mmalga nna ashi Kristo to. Amoso, mo so nɛ anyee bɔla a shuli ‘Amɛn’ a ta kemaŋkura a sa Ebɔrɛ. 21Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na malɛ e naa shin nɛ anyi nɛ menyi kikɛ bee yili kpakpa ashi Kristo to. Mo e nɛfa anyi n yili 22nseŋ ta mbe kenya be ndulgi n dulgi anyi nseŋ ta mbe Kiyoyu n wɔtɔ anyi be ŋgbene to a ŋini fanɛ mo e wɔ anyi.
23Mo alɛ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na nɛ mee tre fanɛ e baa la ma shɛdajipo n ji kashenteŋ fanɛ ŋ ka daa maa sha nɛ men be ŋgbene e jija so nɛ n daa maŋ naŋ bɛta m ba Kɔrint na. 24Men baa nyi fanɛ mannɛ fanɛ anyee sha keŋini menyi kenimu nna ashi yirda na to, ama kusɔ nɛ anyee wora e la fanɛ anyee tu menyi nna a wora asheŋ ŋkpal men be kenya kagbenefuliso so. Yirda malɛ so nɛ men yil kpakpa na.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 2
Content:
1Amoso, n yili kumo ma kagbene to nna fanɛ m maaŋ naŋ ba bɔɔ menyi so n naŋ sa menyi kagbenejija. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ m baŋ jija men be ŋgbene, wanɛ e naa wɔtɔ n naŋ ti menyi nɛ n jija men be ŋgbene na so nɛ e naŋ leŋ ma to? 3N daŋ sibɛ kawɔl na n sa menyi nna, saŋɛ na so, ŋ kaŋ ba, menyi basa nɛ baaŋ shin nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma na maaŋ jija ma kagbene, ŋkpal manɛ so, m baa kɔ menyi kikɛ be yirda fanɛ ma kagbenefuli la menyi kikɛ be kagbenefuli nna. 4Tɔrɔgboŋ nɛ kagbenejija to nɛ n daa wɔ n ta anishichubi damta n sibɛ menyi kawɔl na nɛ n shin nɛ men pin kananɛ mee sha menyi kikɛ nɛnɛ, mannɛ fanɛ n jija menyi be ŋgbene.
Ketampaŋ alubiworapo be asheŋ
5Nɛ esa baŋ bar kagbenejija anyi to, mannɛ ma kagbene nɛ amodoŋwura jija, ama nɛ fo keni to, menyi kikɛ be ŋgbene nɛ e jija. M maa sha fanɛ n ta kenishipere ga n tu amodoŋwura na. 6Ŋkpal manɛ so, kasogberge nɛ amodoŋwura na teŋ nya ashi basa galeŋga kutɔ kukwe. 7Naniere kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men baa wora e la fanɛ men ta m paŋ mo nseŋ leŋ mo to, saŋɛ na so mbe kagbenejija damta na maaŋ pɔɔ mo so. 8Amoso, men jande, men ŋini mo fanɛ menyee sha mo kashenteŋto. 9Amoso nɛ n daŋ sibɛ menyi kawɔl na nɛ n wora menyi ŋ keni ŋko men kɔ kasonu ashi kusɔ kama to a. 10Nɛ esa baŋ wora kulubi nɛ men ta m paŋ mo, ma alɛ gba ta m paŋ amodoŋwura na. Nɛ kusɔ nɛ ma alɛ baŋ ta m paŋ, nɛ ketampaŋ be kesheŋ ko malɛ baa wɔtɔ nna na, n ta nna m paŋ ashi Kristo be anishito ŋkpal menyi so. 11Saŋɛ na so, Setani maaŋ nya anyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi mbe nfɛra.
Pɔɔl be kagbene ka kaa Trowas be kade to be asheŋ
12Ŋ ka daŋ ba Trowas be kade to nɛ m ba bɔ Kristo be baru lela na, n wu fanɛ kashenteŋto Enyɛnpe bugi kushuŋ na be ekpa. 13Ama ma kagbene daa maŋ dese ma kuraa ŋkpal ŋ ka daa maŋ tu an kurgepo Taites na so. Amoso, n daŋ kela ndoŋebi na nna nseŋ yɔ Masɛdonia.
Kebɔla Kristo to a kɔ eleŋ be asheŋ
14Ama anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa shin nɛ anyee tu Kristo a nite kekɔmpɔɔso be ekpa so nseŋ naa bɔla anyi so a shin nɛ Kristo be kenyi bee sɔ kaplɛkama fanɛ efɛa belbelso na. 15Ŋkpal manɛ so, an du fanɛ Kristo be efɛa belbelso nna a sa Ebɔrɛ a wɔ basa nɛ baa nya kumɔlga nɛ bumo nɛ baa mur bumo be alubi to to. 16Bumo nɛ baa mur na, k la fanɛ kɔrtɔ lubi nna a mɔ, ama bumo nɛ baa nya kumɔlga na bre, k la fanɛ efɛa belbelso nna a bar ŋkpa. To, nɛ wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n wora le be kesheŋ ere? 17Anyi alɛ maŋ du fanɛ basa damta nɛ b kɔ Ebɔrɛ be kawɔl to na a fin kenya tɔnɔ ko n ji na nna. Anyi ere, Ebɔrɛ e shuŋi anyi, amoso, nfɛra niŋiso nɛ an kɔ a malga asheŋ Kristo be ketre to ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 3
Content:
Kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre popɔr na be anya be asheŋ
1To, kede bee ŋini fanɛ an naŋ fara nna a kpaŋ anyi be amu nna ŋko? Ŋko a daga fanɛ anyi alɛ gba ka naŋ nya eleŋ be nwɔl nna nɛ an ta n yɔ men kutɔ fanɛ kananɛ beko bee wora na a? 2Menyi gbagba e la anyi be kawɔl nɛ b sibɛ n deŋi an be ŋgbeneana so nɛ basa kikɛ e baa wu nsaa kraŋ amo. 3Menyi alɛ gba bee ŋini fanɛ men la kawɔl nna n shi Kristo kutɔ a la anyi be kushuŋ ere be tɔnɔ. Mannɛ kleembi nɛ b ta n sibɛ amo, bumo alɛ maŋ sibɛ amo n deŋi ajembu so, ama Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to be Kiyoyu nɛ b ta n sibɛ amo dimɛdi be ŋgbene so.
4Le be tama ere nɛ an bɔla Kristo so a kɔ ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 5Ama mannɛ fanɛ an gbagba ka kɔ eleŋ ko fanɛ an gbagba e wora kushuŋ na, Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nɛ anyi be eleŋ na bee shi. 6Mo e shin nɛ an ki kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre popɔr be beshumpo, k la kiyoyu to be kesheŋ nna, mannɛ mbra to be kasibɛ be kesheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbra to be kasibɛ na bee bar luwu nna nɛ Kiyoyu na malɛ bee sa ŋkpa.
Kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre popɔr na be kemaŋkura na be asheŋ
7B daŋ sibɛ mbra na n deŋi ajembu so nna. Saŋɛ nɛ anebi Mosis daŋ ta amo n sa Israɛlebi na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura lar efuli hale n shin nɛ Mosis be anishiakpa daa kpa edɛ nɛ Israɛlebi daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ keni mo. Nɛ kumo be kekpa edɛ na malɛ ka daa beeŋ ba loge gba nde! 8To, nɛ mbra ere be kushuŋ nɛ k bee bar luwu na ka kɔ le be kemaŋkura ere, Kiyoyu na be kushuŋ maaŋ baa kɔ kemaŋkura a chɔ loŋ a? 9Nɛ fanɛ kushuŋ nɛ k bee ji a bri basa baa kɔ kemaŋkura kumo to, kumo ere, kushuŋ nɛ k bee ji a mɔlga basa na beeŋ baa kɔ kemaŋkura a chɔ loŋ. 10Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an ta le be kemaŋkura ere m ber sososo peya na, sososo peya na maaŋ baa la shɛŋ. 11Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ kusɔ nɛ k maaŋ chɛr ŋkeŋ loge daa kɔ kemaŋkura kumo to, kumo ere kusɔ nɛ k maaŋ loge bre be kemaŋkura beeŋ baa chɔ loŋ ga.
12Ŋkpal an ka kɔ le be tama ere so, an kɔ kenyɛn nɛ an baa wora asheŋ. 13Anyi maŋ du fanɛ Mosis nɛ e daŋ ta kusɔ kuŋso ŋ kuŋ mbe anishiakpa nɛ Israɛlebi e sa maŋ wu kananɛ mbe anishiakpa be kekpa edɛ daa chɛrga nsaa loge na. 14Ama kashenteŋto bumo be ŋgbeneana daŋ ti nna a du kpakpa, hale kabre b baŋ kraŋ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre dra na, kusɔ kuŋso na kraa wɔtɔ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo nawule so nɛ kusɔ kuŋso na bee lar ashi to. 15Kashenteŋto, b baŋ kraŋ Mosis be mbraana na hale mbre, kusɔ kuŋso kraŋ buu bumo be ŋgbeneana so nna a shin nɛ baa pin amo to a gben. 16Ama nɛ esa baŋ kilgi n ta mbe kumu n sa Enyɛnpe bre, kusɔ kuŋso na bee lar nna ashi to. 17Enyɛnpe e la Kiyoyu na, kaplɛkama malɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe be Kiyoyu malɛ wɔ, ndoŋ nɛ kamooji wɔ. 18Ama anyi ere kikɛ ka maŋ kɔ kusɔ kuŋso nɛ k buu anyi be anishiakpaana so nsaa nyaŋɛ Enyɛnpe be kemaŋkura be kefulto na a ŋini basa na bee chɛrga nna a duli mo a ti so a nya kemaŋkura nɛ k bee wora keshi a ti so. Kesheŋ ere shi Enyɛnpe nɛ e la Kiyoyu na kutɔ nna.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 4
Content:
Abɔrɛsheŋ be kanya be asheŋ
1To, ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka wu anyi kuwɔr n sa anyi le be kushuŋ ere so, anyi maa pɔ aba. 2Naniere, an yige wulo to be asheŋ nɛ anishinyɔr be ekpaana. Anyi maa ta kafule a wora asheŋ, anyi alɛ maa chɛrga Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na. Ama kashenteŋ nɛ an lara n dii efuli. Loŋ malɛ, ekama be nfɛra fɛso beeŋ ŋini mo fanɛ an walɛ nna ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 3Hale nɛ kusɔ kuŋso buu anyi be baru lela nɛ anyi bɔ ere so gba, k wora loŋ nna n sa basa nɛ baa mur bumo be alubi to na. 4Bumo alɛ maŋ yirda nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya ere to be ebɔrɛ na e tan bumo be anishiana, saŋɛ na so b maaŋ baa wu Kristo nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be kaduli gbagba na be kemaŋkura be baru lela na be kefulto na. 5Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ anyi gbagba be asheŋ be baru nɛ anyee bɔ, Yesu Kristo be baru nɛ anyee bɔ a kaŋɛ fanɛ mo e la Enyɛnpe na nɛ anyi alɛ la men be beshumpo ŋkpal Yesu so. 6Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Men shin nɛ kefulto e shi tentembiri to n lar n nyaŋɛ,” koŋwule na e naa shin nɛ mbe kefulto bee nyaŋɛ anyi be ŋgbeneana to a bar anyi Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura be kanyiasheŋ be kefulto nɛ k bee nyaŋɛ Kristo be anishito na.
7Ama anyi, bumo nɛ an kɔ le be kanya ere du fanɛ mba nna a ŋini fanɛ eleŋ nɛ k chɔ kekama na la Ebɔrɛ peya nna, mannɛ anyeya. 8Saŋɛ damta baa nyaŋ anyi nna, ama anyi alɛ maa bɛa to. Saŋko anyee wulto to, ama anyi alɛ maa wulto to cheche. 9Baa tɔrɔ anyi, ama Ebɔrɛ maa kini anyi. Baa ŋmɛa anyi a lɛ, ama anyi alɛ maa mur. 10Saŋkikɛ an kɔ Yesu be luwu nna an be eyurana to a na, saŋɛ na so Yesu na be ŋkpa gba beeŋ baa lar anyi be eyurana to a ŋini basa. 11Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋkikɛ, anyi nɛ an wɔ ŋkpa to ere nɛ luwu maŋ wɔ kufɔ ŋkpal Yesu so, saŋɛ na so basa beeŋ wu mbe ŋkpa malɛ gba ashi anyi be eyurana nɛ luwu bee pɔɔ amo so ere to. 12Amoso, luwu wɔ anyi to nna a shuŋ nɛ ŋkpa malɛ gba wɔ menyi to a shuŋ. 13Abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ewura Deevid kaŋɛ: “N yirda nna so nɛ m malga.” To, loŋ be yirda be kiyoyu koŋwule na nɛ anyi alɛ gba kɔ a yirda nsaa malga na. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi fanɛ esa nɛ e tiŋi Enyɛnpe Yesu luwu to na beeŋ tiŋi anyi alɛ gba nɛ Yesu na nseŋ ta anyi nɛ menyi kikɛ n yɔ mo gbagba be anishito. 15Menyi alɛ be kechɛto so nɛ ade malɛ kikɛ du loŋ na, saŋɛ na so Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ beeŋ baa salga to a tu basa damta a ti so nɛ b baa kɔ kechɔrɔ be kabɔrɛkule damta a ti so a sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ e nya kemaŋkura.
16Amoso, an maa pɔ aba. Anyi be eyur so bre bee nya kapɔshi nna a ti so, anyi be ayoyu bre to bee wora eleŋ nna kapa nɛ kanyɛ a ti so. 17Kabre nawule be etɔrɔbi ere beeŋ kaŋ bar anyi kemaŋkuragboŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar nsaa bɔ etɔrɔ ere ga. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be nfɛra yuu asɔ nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n wu kenishiso na nna, mannɛ asɔ nɛ basa bee wu kenishiso. Kusɔ nɛ anishi malɛ bee wu maa chɛr ko, ama kusɔ nɛ basa maaŋ tiŋ n wu kenishiso bre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 5
Content:
Anyi be ebɔrɛso be kowu be asheŋ
1Ŋkpal manɛ so, an baa nyi fanɛ eyur mo nɛ k du fanɛ wajɛbu nɛ an wɔ kumo to durnya ere to ere baŋ jija, an kɔ kowu ashi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ, ebu nɛ b maŋ ta enɔ m pɔr kumo nɛ k wɔ ebɔrɛso mbaanaayɔ. 2Naniere bre an wɔtɔ nna a shu to nsaa jo anyi be ebɔrɛso be kowu nɛ baaŋ ta m buu anyi fanɛ kusɔbuuso na kenishipereso. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baŋ buu kusɔbuuso na, an maaŋ naŋ delge so a wɔtɔ. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, an ka kraa wɔ eyur mo nɛ k du fanɛ wajɛbu ere to bre, anyee shu to nna nsaa wɔ kafɔŋ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, an maa sha fanɛ an delge so. Anyee sha fanɛ an buu anyi be ebɔrɛso be kusɔbuuso nna, saŋɛ na so ŋkpa beeŋ mur kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wu na kikɛ nyam. 5Ebɔrɛ e bela anyi ase n yili le be kesheŋ ere nseŋ ta mbe Kiyoyu n sa anyi nɛ e baa la asɔ nɛ e kɔ a sa anyi kikɛ be tɔɔnɛ.
6Amoso, saŋkikɛ anyi maa pɔ aba, ŋkpal manɛ so, an nyi fanɛ an ka baa wɔ epe ashi anyi be eyur ere to ere, anyi nɛ Enyɛnpe na wɔ kufɔ. 7Ŋkpal manɛ so, yirda nɛ an kɔ a na, mannɛ anishi fuful. 8Anyi maa pɔ aba kikɛ nsaa sha ga fanɛ nɛ an daŋ nya nna an daa beeŋ lar anyi be eyur ere nɛ k la anyi pe ere to nseŋ daŋ ya kaa wɔ epe ashi an Nyɛnpe na kutɔ. 9Ama kusɔ nɛ an baŋ yili e la fanɛ anyeeŋ baa wora mbe aparsheŋ. K maŋ tir ŋko an wɔ epe nfe ashi anyi be eyur ere to ŋko an wɔ kufɔ nna. 10Ŋkpal manɛ so, kachako an kikɛ beeŋ yili Kristo be anishito nɛ e ji anyi demu. Ekama beeŋ nya kusɔ nɛ k daga mo ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ amodoŋwura wora ashi mbe eyur ere to so, kelela ŋko kulubi.
Kenamba abar so be kubɔya be asheŋ
11Ŋkpal anyi alɛ ka nyi kusɔ nɛ baa tre Ebɔrɛ be kaŋana na so, anyee wora ania nna ga a chɛ basa to nɛ b pin kusɔ nɛ k wɔtɔ. Ebɔrɛ e nyi kananɛ an du nɛnɛ nɛ ma alɛ bee tama fanɛ loŋ nɛ menyi alɛ gba nyi anyi ashi men be ŋgbene to. 12To, kede bee ŋini fanɛ an naa sha kekpaŋ anyi be amu nna n sa menyi ŋko? Ayai, kusɔ nɛ anyee wora e la fanɛ anyee sa menyi ekpa nna nɛ men kpal anyi so n ji njɔŋ. Saŋɛ na so, menyeeŋ tiŋ n nya kusɔ ko ŋ kaŋɛ basa nɛ baa keni dimɛdi be eyilikpa nawule so a ji njɔŋ nsaa maa keni kusɔ nɛ k wɔ kagbene to na. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baa maa kɔ nfɛra, keshuŋ Ebɔrɛ so nɛ anyi maŋ kɔ nfɛra, nɛ anyi alɛ naa kɔ anyi be nfɛra kleembi, menyi so nɛ an kɔ amo. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo be kasha e kɔ anyi a wora asheŋ ŋkpal an ka baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ esa koŋwule e yili ekama be katelamu to n wu so so. Kumo e la fanɛ ekama malɛ e wu. 15Mo alɛ wu nna n sa ekama, saŋɛ na so, bumo nɛ b wɔ ŋkpa to na maaŋ naa wɔtɔ ŋkpal bumo gbagba be amuana so, ama baaŋ baa wɔtɔ nna ŋkpal esa nɛ e kpal bumo so n wu nɛ Ebɔrɛ tiŋi mo luwu na to na so.
16Amoso, naniere mannɛ dimɛdi be kaplɛa so nɛ an naa bɔla so a keni kananɛ esa du. Saŋko bre, loŋ nɛ an daa keni Kristo na, ama naniere bre anyi maŋ naa keni mo loŋ. 17Amoso, nɛ esa kama baa wɔ Kristo na to, kepɔrso popɔr e la mo, asheŋ dra na kikɛ choŋ nɛ asheŋ popɔr ba. 18Le be asheŋ ere malɛ kikɛ shi Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bɔla Kristo so n shin nɛ anyi nɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ naŋ nyalɛ nseŋ ta mo nɛ basa be kenyalɛ be kushuŋ m bɔɔ anyi enɔ na kutɔ nna. 19Kumo e la fanɛ Kristo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla ŋ kplaŋ durnya be alubi so nseŋ shin nɛ mo nɛ basa naŋ nyalɛ. Ama kananɛ e bee shin nɛ mo nɛ basa bee nyalɛ be kubɔya nɛ e ta m bɔɔ anyi enɔ.
20Amoso, anyi e la Ebɔrɛ be katelamushuŋipoana a du fanɛ basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee bɔla bumo so a kule menyi nsaa fiɛ menyi so. Amoso, anyee ta Kristo be ketre nna a kule menyi ga fanɛ: Men shin nɛ menyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ e naaŋ nyalɛ. 21Anyi so nɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mo ere, esa nɛ e maŋ nyi kulubi na ki kulubi, saŋɛ na so mo so nɛ anyeeŋ ki Ebɔrɛ be anishito be belelapo.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 6
Content:
Pɔɔl be kebaawɔtɔ kpakpasoana be asheŋ
1Naniere anyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ ka bee shuŋ ere, anyee kule nsaa fiɛ menyi so nna fanɛ men sa maa sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na kenyanyaŋɛso. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ:
“Ma kepar be kachɛ nɛ n nu men be ebɔl,
nseŋ naŋ chɛ menyi to kumɔlgaachɛ na.”
To, ma alɛ e naa kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ naniere e la Ebɔrɛ be kepar be kachɛ, kabre e la kumɔlga be kachɛ na.
3An maa sha esa kama ka wu anyi be kushuŋ ere kulubi, amoso, anyi maa sha keta shɛŋ shɛŋ ŋ kagle esa kama ekpa. 4Ama kusɔ kama nɛ anyee wora, anyee ta kanyitigboŋ nna a nyiti etɔrɔ nɛ kebaawɔtɔ kpakpaso nɛ kekɔrfɛ ŋkpal an ka la Ebɔrɛ be beshumpo na so. 5B daŋ kebri anyi n ti anyi ebu n shɛr agboso ŋ kulti anyi, an shuŋ m baŋ anyi be amu so ŋ gal edi nseŋ di akoŋ malɛ gba. 6An bɔla an be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k maŋ kɔ eyurpi so nɛ anyi be kanyiasheŋ so nɛ anyi be kanyitiso nɛ anyi be kebaala basa so ŋ ŋini fanɛ an la Ebɔrɛ be beshumpo nna ashi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ kashenteŋ be kasha to. 7Amo alɛ nseŋ naŋ shi kashenteŋ be kamalga nɛ Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ to. An kɔ Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ nna fanɛ akɔsɔ a ta bena nɛ jiso a kɔ. 8Basa bee bunyaŋ anyi nsaa ŋaba anyi, baa tege anyi nsaa chɔrɔ anyi, baa tre anyi befɛpo nɛ anyi alɛ bee ji kashenteŋ. 9B yɛ basa maŋ nyi anyi nɛ basa damta malɛ nyi anyi nɛnɛ, b yɛ anyee wu nna, ama anyi alɛ baa wɔ ŋkpa to nna a yɔ, baa gberge anyi kusoe, ama anyi alɛ maa wu. 10An wɔ kagbenejija to, ama an be ŋgbene malɛ baa fuli anyi nna saŋkikɛ. Betirpo e la anyi, ama saŋkikɛ anyi alɛ bee wɔtɔ basa dama to nna. Anyi maŋ kɔ shɛŋ, anyi alɛ nsaa kɔ asɔ kikɛ.
11Kɔrintebi, an bugi to nna m malga asheŋ ere n sa menyi na nɛ anyi alɛ be ŋgbene malɛ baŋ bugi n sa menyi. 12Anyi maa ta anyi be kasha a ŋana menyi so, menyi ere e naa ta menyeya a ŋana anyi so. 13Naniere mee malga nna a sa menyi fanɛ ma mbia gbagba fanɛ men baa kɔ kasha koŋwule mo nɛ an kɔ a sa menyi na a sa anyi alɛ gba. Men bugi men be ŋgbene kikɛ to.
Kananɛ k maŋ daga fanɛ b baa wea nnyamase be asheŋ to be asheŋ
14Men sa maŋ shin nɛ menyi nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ la bebɛsopo e baa gama a wora asheŋ fanɛ men kurgepoana, ŋkpal manɛ so, manɛ e wɔ kelela nɛ kulubi be nferinto? Ŋko nuso nɛ kefulto nɛ tentembiri bee wora asheŋ abar so? 15Nuso nɛ Kristo nɛ alubipo Beelial na bee wora a kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule a wɔtɔ? Manɛ e wɔ ebɛsopo nɛ emo nɛ e maŋ la ebɛsopo be nferinto? 16Manɛ be ŋkre e wɔ Ebɔrɛ be lambu nɛ agbirana be nferinto? Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi e la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na be lambu. Kumo be asheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“Meeŋ baa wɔ bumo to nsaa na bumo to
a la bumo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ bumo alɛ e baa la ma basa.
17Amoso ma, Enyɛnpe na e naa yɛ menyi
na fanɛ men lara men be amu ashi bumo to a kɔr to.
Men sa maŋ kaa beta kusɔ kama
nɛ k kɔ eyurpi nɛ n sɔ menyi.
18Ma, Enyɛnpetale e naa yɛ menyi na fanɛ meeŋ baa la men tuto
nɛ menyi alɛ e baa la ma mbinyɛnsoana nɛ mbichesoana.”

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 7
Content:
1N teri shasoana, ŋkpal an ka kɔ le be nnɔ nasesoana ere kikɛ so, men shin nɛ an fɔr kusɔ kama nɛ k bee sa dimɛdi be eyur nɛ mbe kiyoyu eyurpi n lɛ ŋkeŋ shin nɛ an baa pere kenishi a sha kebaaki cheembi nɛnɛ a wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kaŋana be kebaawɔtɔ to.
Pɔɔl be kagbenefuli be asheŋ
2Men shin nɛ an be asheŋ e baa wɔ men be ŋgbene to. Anyi maŋ wora esa kikɛ kulubi, anyi maŋ jija esa kama, anyi alɛ maŋ naŋ ta esa kama n nyalɛ. 3M maŋ malga kesheŋ nɛ m malga ere nna nɛ n wu menyi kulubi, ŋkpal manɛ so, n teŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men be asheŋ wɔ anyi be ŋgbene to ga, amoso, anyeeŋ tiŋ a wɔtɔ ŋko n wu n sa menyi. 4Ma yirda shi menyi so ga nɛ mee ji njɔŋ ga ŋkpal menyi so. Ma kagbene kikɛ baa dese ma nna, hale anyi be kekɔrfɛ ere kikɛ to, ma kagbene baŋ fuli ma nna parr.
5Hale an ka ba Masɛdonia, anyi be eyurana ere maŋ nya ewushi kikɛ. Anyi nɛ kekɔrfɛ e daa la kaplɛkama, anyi nɛ basa be nlu malɛ e daa la nɛ kufu malɛ daŋ bɔlɔ anyi be ŋgbene to. 6Ama Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee wushi kagbenejijawuraana na, wushi anyi be ŋgbene ŋkpal Taites ka ba so. 7Ama mannɛ mbe keba nawule so, mbe kubɔya nɛ e bar m ba kaŋɛ kananɛ men leŋ mo to na gba wushi anyi be ŋgbene n ti so. E kaŋɛ anyi kananɛ men baa sha kewu ma be asheŋ, kananɛ men be ŋgbene jija menyi ga be asheŋ nɛ kananɛ men yili ma kaman ŋ kɔ n sa ma be asheŋ. Ade kikɛ so ma kagbene baŋ naŋ fuli ma nna n ti so.
8Hale nɛ kawɔl nɛ n sibɛ na daŋ jija men be ŋgbene gba, m maa kaŋɛ fanɛ n daa nyi m maŋ sibɛ kumo. Saŋko bre k daŋ wora ma kanaŋ ko, ŋkpal manɛ so, n wu fanɛ kawɔl na daŋ jija men be ŋgbene, kumo alɛ saŋɛ gbrɛbi ko nɛ k daŋ ta menyi. 9Ama naniere ma kagbene fuli ma nna, mannɛ men be ŋgbene ka daŋ jija na so, ama ma kagbene fuli ma nna ŋkpal men be kagbenejija na ka shin nɛ men lar men be alubi to so. Amoso, men be kagbenejija na daa la kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili nna, amoso, menyi maŋ paŋ shɛŋ ashi ekpa kama so ŋkpal anyi so. 10Ŋkpal manɛ so, kagbenejija mo nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ bee bar kagbenechɛrga nna a yɛr esa kumɔlga to, k maa bar ‘n daa nyi’. Ama durnya ere to be kagbenejija bre bee bar luwu nna. 11Men keni kusɔ nɛ le be kagbenejija nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ ere bar menyi, kananɛ k ta menyi ŋ ki kenishiperewuraana. Men keni kananɛ k bar menyi men be amu be kekɔnsɔ be eleŋ loŋ nseŋ keni kananɛ k shin nɛ men be ŋgbene kaa nɛ kananɛ k bar menyi kufu nɛ kasha nɛ ŋgbene mo nɛ a maa lar esa kaman. Men naŋ keni kananɛ k shin nɛ menyee sha kewu asheŋ nɛ amo be kashenteŋ be ekpa so loŋ. Kashenteŋto, men ŋini fanɛ ekpa kama so, men maŋ wora n da so ashi le be asheŋ ere to. 12Amoso, kashenteŋ nna nɛ n sibɛ menyi kawɔl na, ama mannɛ esa nɛ e wora n da so na so ŋko esa nɛ b wora n da mo so na so nɛ n daŋ sibɛ kumo, n daŋ sibɛ kumo nna nɛ men pin ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito fanɛ kananɛ men be ŋgbene wɔ anyi so.
13To, kusɔ nɛ k baŋ leŋ anyi to ga nna na. Ama kusɔ nɛ k ti anyi be keleŋto ere so e la fanɛ anyi be ŋgbene fuli anyi ga ŋkpal Taites be kagbenefuliso Mbe kagbene baŋ fuli mo nna ŋkpal men kikɛ ka daŋ wushi mo kagbene so. 14N daŋ ji men be njɔŋ n sa mo, kashenteŋto malɛ, men maŋ ta anishinyɔr m mɔ ma. Men nyi fanɛ saŋkikɛ kashenteŋ nɛ anyee malga a sa menyi. Kumo koŋwule na nɛ njɔŋ mo nɛ n ji n sa Taites na bɔla ekpa na. 15Mo gbagba malɛ be kasha nɛ e kɔ a sa menyi baa ti so nna ŋkpal kananɛ e bee nyiŋi menyi kikɛ be kasonu so nɛ kananɛ men daŋ ta kufu nɛ kechicha chicha n sɔ mo na so. 16K par ma ga fanɛ meeŋ tiŋ n yirda menyi ashi ekpa kama so.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 8
Content:
Kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ a daga fanɛ ebɛsopo e baa la esa be asheŋ
1To, an kurgepoana, naniere anyee sha fanɛ men pin kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa Masɛdonia be asɔriana na be asheŋ nna. 2B luri etɔrɔ damta kpakpasoana to n lar nɛ ketir pɛ bumo, ama bumo alɛ be ŋgbene daŋ fuli bumo ga. Kumo alɛ nɛ ketir gboŋgboŋi na shin nɛ b bugi enɔ ŋ kɛ nɛnɛ. 3Ma alɛ e kaŋɛ menyi kashenteŋto na fanɛ b sa kananɛ b tiŋ hale n ya baŋ kananɛ bumo be eleŋ sa gba so. 4Bumo gbagba be kasha so nɛ b kule anyi ga fanɛ baa sha fanɛ bumo alɛ gba e nya ekpa nna n tiŋ n chɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa to. 5B wora m baŋ kusɔ nɛ an daa tama so, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k juŋkpar e la fanɛ b ta bumo be amu n sa Enyɛnpe na nseŋ naŋ bɔla Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ so n ta bumo be amu m bɔɔ anyi alɛ gba enɔ. 6Amoso, an kule Taites mo nɛ e teŋ fara le be kushuŋ ere na ga nna fanɛ e baa kraa wɔ kumo to loŋ a chɛ menyi to n ya loge men be le be kasha be kushuŋgboŋ ere. 7Men juŋkpar ekama nna ashi kusɔ kama to, ashi yirda to nɛ mmalga to nɛ kanyiasheŋ to nɛ kagbene koŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ kasha mo nɛ men kɔ a sha anyi na so. Amoso, anyee sha fanɛ men baa kɔ kakɛ be kagbene ashi le be kasha be kushuŋ ere to.
8Mannɛ fanɛ mee nase kamalga ko nna a sa menyi, ama mee wora menyi nna a keni nsaa ta men be kasha a ber basa ko be kagbene koŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ so nɛ m pin fanɛ men be kasha na la kashenteŋ peya nna a. 9Ŋkpal manɛ so, men nyi Kristo, Enyɛnpe Yesu be kuwɔr be kakɛ na be asheŋ, fanɛ e ka la damawura, ama menyi so nɛ e ki etirpo, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ bɔla mbe ketir so ŋ ki damawuraana. 10Kusɔ nɛ ma nfɛra bee sa ma ashi kesheŋ ere to nde fanɛ: Kusɔ nɛ k walɛ fanɛ men wora e la fanɛ men loge kusɔ nɛ men fara kewora kafɛnde na. Menyi e baa la bumo nɛ b baa maŋ juŋkpar n wora kusɔ na nawule, ama bumo nɛ b juŋkpar n sha kewora kumo gba. 11To, naniere mee sha fanɛ men baa kɔ to nna n ya loge kumo. Kananɛ men baŋ bugi kagbene n yili kumo fanɛ menyeeŋ wora kesheŋ na, men naŋ ta loŋ be kagbene n loge kumo. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ men kɔ, men ta n wora kumo. 12Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ esa baŋ bugi kagbene n yili kumo fanɛ e beeŋ sa, kumo ere kusɔ nɛ amodoŋwura kɔ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ yili n sɔ loŋ be kakɛ na, mannɛ kusɔ nɛ e maŋ kɔ so. 13Men baa nyi fanɛ mannɛ fanɛ anyee sha ketɔrɔ menyi nna n shin nɛ beko bre e nu ebel. Ayai, kusɔ nɛ anyee sha e la fanɛ menyi kikɛ e baa sasa. 14Naniere bre menyi e kɔ ga nɛ men tiŋ n chɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ to, ama saŋko nɛ a tir menyi, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ lara bumo be kanya damta to n chɛ menyi to, saŋɛ na so men kikɛ sasa nna na. 15Fanɛ kananɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Ekama nɛ e chala ga na maŋ nya m baŋ mbe kumu so, nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e chala gbrɛbi nya nɛ a kukwe mo.”
Keshuŋi Taites Kɔrint be asheŋ
16Mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga ŋkpal e ka ta kagbene koŋwule be kasha mo nɛ an kɔ a sa menyi na n wɔtɔ Taites be kagbene to so. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ fanɛ e baŋ sɔ kusɔ nɛ an kaŋɛ na nawule nna, ama mo gbagba be keparso nɛ e yili kumo kagbene koŋwuleso fanɛ e beeŋ yɔ menyi kutɔ. 18Esa nɛ anyee shuŋi n ti mo so e la ekurgepo mo nɛ e kɔ ketre ashi asɔriana na kikɛ to ŋkpal mbe baru lela na be kebɔ so. 19Ade malɛ be kaman mo nɛ asɔriana na kikɛ lara fanɛ e tu anyi n nite anyi be kasha be kushuŋ be enite nɛ anyee nite ere to nɛ an maŋkura Enyɛnpe gbagba na nseŋ naŋ ŋini ekama kananɛ an bugi kagbene a chɛ basa to. 20Anyee wora ania nna nɛ esa kama e sa maŋ kaŋ wu anyi kulubi ashi kakɛ gboŋgboŋi ere be kushuŋ to. 21Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ kusɔ nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito nawule nɛ anyi be anishi yuu so, kusɔ nɛ k kɔ kemaŋkura dimɛdi be anishito gba nɛ anyee fin. 22Esa nɛ an naŋ shuŋi n ti bumo so e la an kurgepo mo nɛ an wora ale damta ŋ keni n wu fanɛ e kɔ kagbene koŋwule be kasha ashi asheŋ damta to nna. Mo alɛ be loŋ be kagbene koŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ na naŋ wora keshi nna n ti so ŋkpal mbe yirdagboŋ nɛ k wɔ menyi so na so. 23Taites bre, m barkasa nna nɛ ma nɛ mo bee shuŋ nɛ an chɛ menyi to. Ama bekurgepo mo nɛ b tu mo a yɔ na bre, asɔriana na be katelamu to nɛ b yil a yɔ menyi kutɔ na a sa Kristo na kemaŋkura. 24Amoso, men ŋini bumo kasha, saŋɛ na so asɔriana na kikɛ beeŋ wu kumo geeŋ nseŋ pin fanɛ mannɛ jiga nna nɛ anyee puchi menyi so.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 9
Content:
Kechɛ abarana bebɛsopo to be asheŋ
1Kashenteŋto, naniere a maŋ naŋ daga ŋ ka naŋ sibɛ menyi ŋ kaŋɛ kechɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa to be kushuŋ ere be asheŋ. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so, n nyi kananɛ men bugi kagbene a sha kechɛto, ma alɛ bee ji men be loŋ be njɔŋ a sa Masɛdoniaebi a kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ kafɛnde kikɛ nɛ menyi nɛ men wɔ Akaya ere fara n wora shiriya. Loŋ be kagbene koŋwule be kushuŋ malɛ sa galeŋga nfɛra nɛ b fara a wora kusɔ ko. 3To, mee shuŋi bekurgepo ere men kutɔ nna, saŋɛ na so anyi be njɔŋ mo nɛ anyee ji men be asheŋ kesheŋ ere to na maaŋ baa la mmalga fuloŋ nɛ men wora shiriya fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ menyeeŋ wora na. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ nna nɛ Masɛdoniaebi ko tu anyi m ba men kutɔ m ba wu fanɛ men maŋ wora shiriya, anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ anyi ga ŋkpal an ka ji men be njɔŋ ga le so, esa malɛ maŋ naa ji menyi gbagba be anishinyɔr be asheŋ. 5Amoso nɛ n wu fanɛ a daga fanɛ n shin nɛ bekurgepoana ere e juŋkpar ma n yɔ men kutɔ n ya shin nɛ men bela men be kakɛ gboŋgboŋi nɛ men nase kɔnɔ fanɛ menyeeŋ sa na n yili. Saŋɛ na so, kakɛ na beeŋ baa yil fanɛ kashaso be kakɛ, mannɛ fanɛ kanyaŋso be kakɛ.
6Men baa nyiŋi fanɛ esa kama nɛ e bee duu asɔ miiriso, beeŋ teŋi miiriso be asɔ nna nɛ esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee duu asɔ damaso beeŋ teŋi asɔ damaso nna. 7Kanaŋkama nɛ ekama fɛ mbe kagbene to fanɛ e beeŋ sa, e sa nsaa maa shin nɛ k naa besa mo ŋko a wora fanɛ b kaa bee tintiŋ mo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e bee sa kagbenefuliso nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha. 8Ebɔrɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n sa menyi asɔ a chɔ kananɛ menyee sha, saŋɛ na so saŋkikɛ menyeeŋ baa kɔ kusɔ kama nɛ menyee sha ekpa kama so nseŋ naa kɔ amo yɛlyɛla so a yɔ kushuŋ lela kama be ekpa so. 9Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“Mo e naa bugi kagbene a sa betirpo asɔ,
mbe kelela malɛ maŋ kɔ ekar.”
10Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa bedɔpo asɔ duuso nɛ baa duu nseŋ naa sa menyi kusɔ jiso koŋwule na e naaŋ sa menyi asɔ duuso kikɛ n shin nɛ a wora keshi n ti so nseŋ shin nɛ men nya kasɔteŋi damta ashi men be kelela to. 11Ekpa kama so, e beeŋ shin nɛ men baa la damawuraana a sha kebaakɛ basa asɔ saŋkikɛ, saŋɛ na so basa damta beeŋ baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal men be kakɛ mo nɛ baa nya ashi anyi be enɔ to so so. 12Ŋkpal manɛ so, kushuŋ nɛ menyee wora ere maa sa Ebɔrɛ be basa asɔ nɛ a daga bumo nawule nna, ama ekpa damtaana so gba nɛ k bee shin nɛ basa bee bɔla a chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ. 13Ŋkpal menyi alɛ be kushuŋ lela nɛ men shuŋ ŋ ŋini basa nɛ men la ere so, basa beeŋ chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal men ka ta kasonu n ti men be shɛda mo nɛ menyee ji a kaŋɛ Kristo be baru lela na be asheŋ na so nɛ kananɛ menyee sha kebaakɛ bumo nɛ basa kama men be kanya to be asɔ na so. 14Amoso, b baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa menyi, bumo be nfɛra wɔ menyi so nna ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛgboŋ damta nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n sa menyi na so. 15Anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga ŋkpal mbe kakɛ gboŋgboŋi nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n ji kumo be asheŋ ere so.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 10
Content:
Pɔɔl ka bee malga a sɔ mbe kushuŋ na a yige be asheŋ
1Ma, Pɔɔl gbagba nɛ b yɛ: “E baa wɔ men kutɔ e la bawala nna, ama nɛ e baa wɔ kufɔ e bee ŋini mbe kenyɛn nna”, mee kule menyi nna ŋkpal Kristo be kebaala esa nɛ bawala so fanɛ: 2Men jande, men sa maŋ shin nɛ ŋ kaŋ ba nɛ m ba ŋini menyi ma kenyɛn fanɛ kananɛ m baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ meeŋ ŋini basa nɛ baa fɛ fanɛ durnya ere to be ekpaana so nɛ an kɔ a wora asheŋ na.
3Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ durnya ere to nɛ an wɔ, ama mannɛ durnya ere to be kena nɛ anyee kɔ. 4Asɔ nɛ an kɔ a kɔ na maŋ la durnya ere to be akɔsɔ. A la Ebɔrɛ be akɔsɔ lempoana nɛ b kɔ a jija asɔ lempoana na nna. 5Amo nɛ an kɔ a jija emɔrɔana nɛ kamoowu be kusɔ kama nɛ k bee kuŋ esa kepin Ebɔrɛ be ekpa nseŋ naa kɔ amo a pɔɔ nfɛra fɛso lubiana so a shin nɛ a bee nu a sa Kristo. 6Nɛ men baa maa tɔr kasonu be kaplɛa so, anyi alɛ gba wora shiriya fanɛ anyeeŋ gberge kasomaanuwuraana kama kusoe.
7Asheŋ be kaman nɛ menyi ere bee keni, ama esa kama nɛ e baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ e la Kristo peya nna, amodoŋwura na e baa nyi fanɛ kananɛ e baa la Kristo peya na, loŋ nɛ anyi alɛ gba la mo peya. 8Hale nɛ m puchi eleŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe sa anyi fanɛ an ta a chɛ menyi to nɛ men baa yɔ anishito, mannɛ fanɛ an ta n jija menyi na so n ti so gba, k maaŋ pɛ ma anishinyɔr kikɛ. 9M maa sha fanɛ k baa du fanɛ ŋ kɔ ma nwɔl nna a funti menyi. 10Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ beko bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Mbe mmalga nɛ a wɔ mbe nwɔl to wɔ egbɛ nsaa kɔ eleŋ, ama fo wu mo gbagba kenishiso, e maŋ la elempo, mbe kɔnɔ to be mmalga malɛ maŋ kɔ shɛŋ.” 11Men shin nɛ loŋ be basa na e baa nyi fanɛ asheŋ nɛ an baa malga nwɔl to saŋɛ nɛ an maŋ wɔtɔ na koŋwule na nɛ anyeeŋ wora saŋɛ nɛ an wɔtɔ gba.
12Mannɛ fanɛ anyee nya kagbene nna a kaŋɛ fanɛ anyi nɛ bumo nɛ baa maŋ bumo be amu so gba na e sa. Anyi alɛ maa ta anyi be amu nna a ber bumo. Kananɛ b kɔ abar a keni kananɛ b sasaana ere nsaa kɔ abar a ber abar le ere e naa ŋini fanɛ b maŋ nyi asheŋ. 13Ama anyi ere maaŋ ji njɔŋ m baŋ kananɛ k daga so. Kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa anyi eleŋ n ya fo nɛ anyee tar nɛ an tiŋ n fo menyi. 14Nɛ an daa maŋ fo menyi, an be keji njɔŋ daa maaŋ baa kɔ ekpa. Ama anyi alɛ ta Kristo be baru lela na n fo menyi. 15Anyi alɛ maa kpal kushuŋ mo nɛ basa pɔtɛ shuŋ so nna a puchi a baŋ anyi be amu so. Anyi be tama kikɛ e baa la fanɛ nɛ men be yirda baa wora keshi a yɔ anishito, kakpa nɛ an wɔ menyi to a shuŋ na malɛ beeŋ baa wora keshi a ti so. 16Saŋɛ na so, anyeeŋ tiŋ m bɔ kubɔya na nsawule mo nɛ a wɔ men be anishitoana na so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi maa sha kepuchi kushuŋ kama nɛ b teŋ wora esa ko be kakpa so.
17Kumo alɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Esa kama nɛ e bee puchi, e puchi Enyɛnpe nawule so.” 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ esa nɛ e bee chɔrɔ mbe kumu e kɔ ekpa, ama esa nɛ Enyɛnpe bee chɔrɔ e kɔ ekpa.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 11
Content:
Pɔɔl nɛ beshuŋipo fɛpoana be asheŋ
1Men jande, men ji ma kanyiti ashi ma kawulishembi ere to. Ama n nyi men ka tea wora loŋ bre. 2Kashenteŋto, kasha be kayurbesa nɛ k du fanɛ Ebɔrɛ peya na nɛ ŋ kɔ a keni menyi so, ŋkpal manɛ so, men du fanɛ kasuŋgurbia nna nɛ n ta menyi n sa enyɛn mo nɛ e la Kristo na nɛ kachako nɛ n ta menyi cheembi m bɔɔ ekul koŋwule na enɔ. 3Ama men be asheŋ bee keta ma kufu fanɛ nɛ men maŋ de so, kananɛ kusɔkpaŋ na daŋ ta mbe nambara n fule Hawa na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ e beeŋ lara men be nfɛra ashi kagbene koŋwule be Kristo be kasha cheembi to. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa baŋ ba men kutɔ m ba malga Yesu pɔtɛ ko nɛ e maŋ la Yesu mo nɛ an malga mbe asheŋ na malɛ be asheŋ ŋko nɛ men baŋ nya kiyoyu pɔtɛ ko nɛ e maŋ la emo nɛ men daŋ nya na nna ŋko baru lela pɔtɛ ko nna nɛ k maŋ la kumo nɛ men daŋ sɔ na, menyee sɔ kumo nna manaŋ manaŋ. 5Ma alɛ bee tama fanɛ men be beshuŋipo mo nɛ baa tre beshuŋipogboŋana ere maŋ chɔ ma gbrɛ kama gba. 6Hale nɛ m maŋ la esa nɛ e nyi kamalga to gba, kanyiasheŋ bre, ŋ kɔ kumo, anyi alɛ bɔla ekpa kama so n lara le be kanyiasheŋ ere ŋ ŋini menyi ashi kusɔ kama to.
7Ŋ ka daŋ bɔ Ebɔrɛ be baru lela n sa menyi na, n daa maŋ sɔ menyi shɛŋ. Ŋ ka daŋ bar ma kumu kaseto loŋ nɛ menyi ere e dii na, kulubi ko nɛ n daŋ wora a? 8Asɔriana ko nɛ n daŋ suge a wɔtɔ a shuŋ menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, n daa nya kechɛto nna ashi bumo kutɔ. 9Saŋɛ nɛ n daa wɔ menyi kutɔ na nɛ k ba fanɛ n daa sha kusɔ ko, m maŋ dese menyi so, ŋkpal manɛ so, bekurgepo mo nɛ b daŋ shi Masɛdonia na e daa sa ma kumo. N daa maa sha fanɛ n dese menyi so ekpa kama so, ma alɛ maaŋ dese menyi so kikɛ. 10Kananɛ Kristo be kashenteŋ baa wɔ ma to ere bre, esa kama maŋ wɔ Akaya be kasawule so kikɛ nɛ e lo ma kɔnɔ fanɛ n sa maŋ ji njɔŋ mo nɛ mee ji ere. 11Manɛ e ba nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ ere? Ŋ ka maa sha menyi so a? Ayai, Ebɔrɛ gba nyi ŋ ka bee sha menyi!
12Ma alɛ beeŋ baa kraa wɔtɔ a wora asɔ nɛ mee wora ere, saŋɛ na so, meeŋ kuŋ bumo nɛ baa fin ekpa nɛ b puchi ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ anyi nɛ bumo bee shuŋ nna a sasa na ekpa. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be basa na la beshuŋipo fɛpoana nna nseŋ naa la beshumpo nɛ baa fule basa nɛ b wɔtɔ a ta bumo be amu fanɛ Kristo be beshuŋipoana na. 14Kumo alɛ maŋ la mamachi be kesheŋ ko nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Setani gba bee kaa wora mbe kumu fanɛ kefultoso be malaika. 15Amoso, nɛ mbe anya gba bee wora bumo be amu fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ be anya, k maŋ la ashenfɔ. Bumo be lalaloge be tɔnɔ beeŋ ba shi bumo be aworbi to nna.
Pɔɔl ka bee puchi mbe etɔrɔ be asheŋ
16Men shin nɛ n naŋ lɔŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ tre ma ewulpo kikɛ. Nɛ ekama nɛ e tre ma loŋ gba, amodoŋwura e baa kɔ ma to loŋ, saŋɛ na so meeŋ nya ekpa gbrɛ m puchi. 17Men baa nyi fanɛ kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ naniere maŋ la kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, mee puchi nna a malga fanɛ ewulpo. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ basa damta baa kɔ durnya be asɔ a puchi na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ ma alɛ gba beeŋ puchi. 19Menyi ere ka la benyiashempoana na so, menyee tiŋ a nyiti bewulpo. 20Kashenteŋto, menyee tiŋ a nyiti ekama nɛ e bee ta menyi fanɛ anya ŋko ekama nɛ e bee ji menyi so ŋko emo nɛ e bee dese kasawule a nya menyi ŋko emo nɛ e bee keni menyi a bɔl ŋko emo nɛ e bee kpa menyi etaŋ. 21Kashenteŋto, n shuli kejija fanɛ anyi ere ka daa maŋ tiŋ n nya kagbene n wora loŋ. Ama kusɔ kama nɛ esa kama beeŋ tiŋ n nya kagbene m puchi kumo so, mee malga fanɛ ewulpo nna na, ma alɛ gba beeŋ tiŋ n nya kagbene m puchi loŋ! 22Mannɛ Hibruwebi e la bumo a? To, eko e la ma alɛ gba. Mannɛ Israɛlebi e la bumo a? To, eko e la ma alɛ gba. Mannɛ Eebraham mo nanabiana e la bumo a? To, eko e la ma alɛ gba. 23Mannɛ Kristo be anya e la bumo a? Keni ŋ kaa bee malga fanɛ ebompo loŋ, ama ma loŋ be kenyaya chɔ bumo peya. N shuŋ ga a chɔ bumo be ekama nɛ b ti ma ebu a chɔ bumo be ekama, b kuya ma so a chɔ bumo be ekama, saŋɛ damta ma alɛ bee taga luwu to a chɔ bumo be ekama. 24Ela anu nɛ Juwebi sa ma ale adesa nɛ akpanu be kekuyaso na. 25Ela asa nɛ b ta bulala ŋ kuya ma so ŋ kpa ma ajembu kela koŋwule, ale asa nɛ n daa shin nɛ n ji nchu ekuloŋ to, kela koŋwule nɛ n ji kachɛ lelemu nɛ kanyɛ lelemu teku so. 26Saŋkikɛ enite to nɛ m baa wɔ a luri kachuji be kenishipere to a luri beyu to a luri kenishipere to ashi m braana Juwebi nɛ nnyamase to a luri kenishipere to ashi ndegboŋana to, a luri kenishipere to kiyi to a luri kenishipere to etekuana so nsaa luri kenishipere to bekurgepo fɛpoana to. 27Saŋkikɛ ma nɛ kegben nɛ kebaawɔtɔ kpakpaso e wɔtɔ. Saŋɛ damta ma nɛ kadigal nna, akoŋ mɔ ma nɛ achukoŋ pɛ ma. Saŋɛ damta m maŋ kɔ ajibi nɛ n ji saŋko nɛ n dese awo to saŋko m maaŋ ba kɔ asɔbuuso. 28Nɛ m maŋ naŋ ti asɔ ko gba n ti so, kachɛ kama be kafɔŋ nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa asɔriana kikɛ na shi ma so ga. 29Wanɛ e la epɔsopo nɛ m maaŋ tu amodoŋwura n luri mbe kapɔshi na to ŋko wanɛ e naaŋ tɔr alubi to nɛ ma kagbene maaŋ jija na?
30Nɛ k ba fanɛ m puchi, asɔ nɛ a bee ŋini ma kapɔshi so nɛ mee puchi. 31Enyɛnpe Yesu na be Ebɔrɛ nɛ mo Tuto nɛ e daga epaŋ be kedi saŋkikɛ na nyi fanɛ m maa fule nna. 32Ŋ ka daa wɔ Damaskɔs na, gomena mo nɛ e daa wɔ Ewura Aritas be kaseto na daŋ shin nɛ bekumpo ya kuŋ kade na be mbunaakpa nna fanɛ b pɛ ma. 33Ama basa ko daŋ ta efɔlana nna n chɛ kelantaŋɛ nseŋ ta ma n wɔtɔ kelantaŋɛ na to n ta ma m bɔla tokuro to ŋ gbelge to nɛ m bɔl n shile mbe enɔ to n choŋ.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 12
Content:
Pɔɔl be ebɔrɛdare nɛ mbe kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
1A daga fanɛ m baa puchi hale nɛ k maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ gba. Ama naniere bre meeŋ malga ebɔrɛdareana nɛ kewuŋkaŋɛana nɛ Enyɛnpe sa na be asheŋ. 2N nyi Kristo be kanyɛn ko ka daa wɔ Kristo to nɛ b maŋ mo so n yɔ ebɔrɛso be kakpa sasopo na. Kumo be nfɛ kuduana kabre. Ma alɛ maŋ nyi ŋko e daa wɔ eyur ere to nna nɛ loŋ wora ŋko e daŋ lar eyur ere to nna pɔɛŋ nɛ loŋ wora, Ebɔrɛ nawule e nyi. 3M baa nyi b ka pɛ amo be kanyɛn n yɔ Paradisi nna, ama kumo nɛ n teŋ kaŋɛ na fanɛ m maŋ nyi ŋko e daa wɔ eyur to nna nɛ loŋ wora ŋko e daŋ lar eyur ere to nna pɔɛŋ nɛ loŋ wora, Ebɔrɛ nawule e nyi. 4Ndoŋ nɛ e ya nu asheŋ nɛ a maŋ daga dimɛdi ka malga, asheŋ nɛ dimɛdi maaŋ tiŋ n ji amo be asheŋ. 5Meeŋ puchi ŋkpal le be esa so, ama m maaŋ puchi ŋkpal ma ere gbagba so she ma kapɔshi nawule be asheŋ so. 6Hale nɛ n daa sha kepuchi gba n daa maaŋ baa la ewulpo, ŋkpal manɛ so, kashenteŋ nɛ n daa beeŋ baa ji. Ŋkeshin nɛ ma alɛ maaŋ wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, m maa sha fanɛ esa kama e baa fɛ nfɛragboŋ ko a sa ma a chɔ kananɛ e beeŋ bɔla ma aworbi nɛ ma mmalga to so n fɛ ma asheŋ. 7Ŋkpal kananɛ k beeŋ wora nɛ n sa maŋ kpal kewuŋkaŋɛ damta gboŋana mo nɛ n nya na so ŋ kpaŋ ma kumu so so, Ebɔrɛ sa ma ebesa ko nna, k la Setani be kabɔ nna nɛ e bee tɔrɔ ma. Saŋɛ na so, m maaŋ baa nya ekpa a maŋ ma kumu so m baŋ so. 8Ela asa nɛ ŋ kule Enyɛnpe fanɛ e lara loŋ be ebesa na ashi ma to. 9Ama e maŋ lara kumo nseŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Ma kuwɔr be kakɛ kukwe fo, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo kapɔshi to nɛ ma eleŋ bee dii efuli nɛnɛ.” Amoso, meeŋ baa kɔ ma kapɔshi ere a ji njɔŋ kagbenefuliso a ti so, saŋɛ na so, Kristo be eleŋ beeŋ baa wɔ ma so. 10Amoso, ŋkpal Kristo so ma kagbene bee fuli ma kapɔshi to nna nɛ kategeana to nɛ kebaawɔtɔ kpakpasoana to nɛ etɔrɔana to nɛ ŋgbenejijaana to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, kapɔshi baa wɔ ma to, kumo ere ŋ kɔ eleŋ nna na.
Kananɛ Kɔrintebi na be asheŋ wɔ Pɔɔl be kagbene to be asheŋ
11Mee wora asheŋ fanɛ ewulpo nna, ama menyi e shin nɛ ŋ ki loŋ. Menyi e daŋ daga fanɛ men baa chɔrɔ ma. Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ m maŋ la shɛŋ gba, beshuŋipo nɛ menyee tre beshuŋipogboŋ ere maŋ bɔ ma. 12Asɔ nɛ a bee ŋini fanɛ esa la eshuŋipo nɛ n daŋ ta kanyiti kikɛ n wora menyi to na. Asɔ na e la etɔɔnɛshuŋ nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ asheŋ purgiase. 13To, nɛ manɛ be kechɛto nɛ asɔriebi pɔtɛana nɛ b ka na daŋ nya nɛ menyi ere maŋ nya? Kusɔ nɛ k baa wɔtɔ e la fanɛ ma ere gbagba daa maŋ dese menyi so. Kumo alɛ be kulubi nɛ mee kule menyi fanɛ men ta m paŋ ma.
14Ma keba mo nɛ n wora shiriya nɛ m ba bɔɔ menyi so ere e naa ti ma kela sasopo so, ma alɛ maa ba nna nɛ m ba kaa dese menyi so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ menyi be asɔ nɛ mee sha, menyi gbagba nɛ mee sha, ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ mbia e naa ji a ka a yili bumo nawuraana, ama bumo nawuraana bre e naa ji a ka a yili bumo. 15Amoso, meeŋ baa sha kemɔ ma kumu n wora kusɔ kama n sa menyi nseŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ b mɔ ma n sa menyi. Nɛ kananɛ m baa sha menyi ga le ere, a daga fanɛ men be kasha nɛ men kɔ a sa ma e baa duga so a? 16Shere menyeeŋ shuli fanɛ n daa maŋ dese menyi so, ama eko beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ n daŋ bɔla kanyiasheŋ be ekpa ko so nna n ta efɛ m pɛ menyi. 17N daŋ bɔla basa nɛ n shuŋi menyi kutɔ na be ekama so n ji menyi so a? 18Taites nɛ n daŋ kule fanɛ e yɔ menyi kutɔ nseŋ shuŋi ekurgepo mo na fanɛ e shuŋi mo n yɔ. To, menyee fɛ fanɛ Taites e daŋ ji menyi so nna ŋko nuso? Ma nɛ Taites kikɛ maŋ kɔ nfɛra koŋwule nɛ kebaawɔtɔ koŋwule nna a?
19Shere men baa wɔtɔ nna a fɛ fanɛ anyee malga nna a sa menyi a kuŋ anyi be amu. Ayai, mannɛ aloŋ nna. Kananɛ Kristo bee sha fanɛ an malga nɛ anyee malga ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ anyee wora, men be keyɔ anishito so nɛ anyee wora kumo. 20K bee wora ma nna fanɛ ŋ kaŋ ba men kutɔ meeŋ ba wu fanɛ mannɛ kananɛ mee sha fanɛ men baa du na nɛ men du, nɛ menyi alɛ gba e wu fanɛ mannɛ kananɛ menyee sha fanɛ m baa du na nɛ n du n sa menyi. Mee lɔ kufu nna fanɛ shere meeŋ ba wu nlu nɛ kayurbesaana nɛ agboana ka bee kaa nɛ kejimuniana nɛ kategeana nɛ ŋkuli nɛ kamoowu nɛ kebarga to menyi to. 21Mee lɔ kufu nna fanɛ ŋ kaŋ ba, ma Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ m bar ma kumu kaseto men be anishito nɛ ma kagbene e jija ma ŋkpal basa damta nɛ b wora alubi dra dra na kikɛ nsaa maŋ lar bumo be loŋ be kesakalea be asheŋ na to nɛ kusɔ jigaya be kulubi na to nɛ bumo be eyurpishuŋ nɛ b daŋ wora na kikɛ to so.

Title: 2 KƆRINTEBI 13
Content:
Lalaloge be kefiɛso nɛ kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
1Ŋ ka bee ba nɛ m ba bɔɔ menyi so ere e ti so kela sasopo. Abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ e naa kaŋɛ loŋ fanɛ a daga fanɛ kesheŋ kama, basa anyɔ ŋko besa e ji kumo be shɛda pɔɛŋ nɛ k nya edesekpa. 2Naniere mee sha kenaŋ n fiɛ menyi nɛ men daŋ kewora alubi na so nna nɛ bekama malɛ nɛ b ka na so. Ma kebɔɔ menyi so nyɔsopo to nɛ n daŋ wora loŋ men be anishito, ama naniere m maŋ wɔ menyi to, ma alɛ nseŋ kraa sa menyi kumo. Kumo e la fanɛ, nɛ ŋ kaŋ ba kede to, m maaŋ yige ekama. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, men yɛ menyee sha kepin fanɛ Kristo e naa malga ma to. E maŋ la epɔsopo a shuŋ menyi to, e la elempo nna. 4Kashenteŋto, kapɔshi to nɛ b daŋ gbir mo kedibi largato so, ama Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ nɛ e kɔ a wɔ ŋkpa to naniere. Loŋ nɛ anyi alɛ gba la bepɔshipo mo to, ama ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ so, an tu Kristo na nna a wɔ ŋkpa to nɛ an shuŋ menyi.
5Men keni men be ŋgbene to ŋ keni ŋko men maŋ wɔ yirda na to a? Men wora men be amu ŋ keni. Men maŋ nyi Yesu Kristo ka wɔ menyi to a? Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, men tɔr nna na. 6Mee tama fanɛ menyeeŋ pin fanɛ anyi ere maŋ tɔr. 7Anyee kule Ebɔrɛ nna fanɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ wora n da so kikɛ. Mannɛ ŋkpal basa ka beeŋ wu fanɛ anyee ji kɔŋkɔŋ so, ama fanɛ menyi e wora kusɔ nɛ k bɔla ekpa, hale nɛ k ba kaa du fanɛ an tɔr gba. 8Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi maaŋ tiŋ n wora shɛŋ nɛ kumo nɛ kashenteŋ na maŋ la kukoŋwule. Kusɔ kama nɛ anyee wora, kashenteŋ na nɛ anyee wora a sa. 9Nɛ anyi maŋ kɔ eleŋ nɛ menyi ere kɔ eleŋ, anyi be ŋgbene bee fuli anyi nna. Anyi alɛ bee kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ men ba ki basa cheembi.
10Amoso nɛ m maŋ wɔ menyi kutɔ nsaa sibɛ menyi na, saŋɛ na so, ŋ kaŋ ba, m maaŋ ta ma eleŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe ta n sa ma fanɛ n ta a chɛ menyi to nɛ men baa yɔ anishito na, mannɛ fanɛ n ta kumo n jija menyi a ŋmenyaŋ menyi na.
11To, bekurgepoana, Ebɔrɛ e chɛ menyi to. Men baa kɔ a fin kebaawɔtɔ niŋiso. Men baa du fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kule menyi na nsaa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule a wɔtɔ nseŋ naa wɔ kagbenewushi to, nɛ kasha nɛ kagbenewushi be Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ menyi to.
12Men ta kegbumpipe cheembi be kechɔrɔ a chɔrɔ abar. 13Ebɔrɛ be basa larasoana na kikɛ bee chɔrɔ menyi. 14Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kasha na nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ na e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ so.

Title: GALEESHAEBI 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ n la eshuŋipo na kutɔ nna a yɔ menyi Galeesha be efuli so ebi be asɔriana na kutɔ. M maŋ la esa nɛ edimɛdi tre n shuŋi ŋko esa nɛ b bɔla edimɛdi so n tre n shuŋi nna, ama n la esa nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto nɛ e tiŋi mo koŋwule Kristo ashi luwu to na tre n shuŋi nna. 2Bekurgepoana nɛ b wɔ nfe ere kikɛ na gba ti kawɔl ere be kasibɛ be asheŋ to so a chɔrɔ menyi. 3An Tuto Ebɔrɛ na nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na e sa menyi Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi. 4Mo Yesu Kristo na e kpal kumɔlga anyi ashi alubi be jemanɛ be kebaawɔtɔ ere to so n nu n sa anyi be Ebɔrɛ nɛ Etuto na n ta mbe kumu n lara anyi alubi be kewora be eleŋ to. 5Kemaŋkura e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ na so hale mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.
Baru lela nɛ kebaawɔtɔ na be asheŋ
6Men be asheŋ bee chinchiŋ ma kashenteŋto pasaa, ŋkpal kananɛ men tea yige Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bɔla Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na so n tre menyi na a to nsaa sɔ baru pɔtɛ nɛ basa ko bee tre baru lela na. 7Kashenteŋto bre, baru lela kama maŋ naa wɔtɔ n ti anyeya ere so, ama ŋkpal basa ko ka wɔtɔ a wul menyi to a sha kechɛrga Kristo be baru lela na so e shin nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ na. 8Ama nɛ anyi alɛ gba ŋko malaika gba shi ebɔrɛso m ba malga baru pɔtɛ ko nɛ k kɔr kumo nɛ an daŋ malga n sa menyi na to, Ebɔrɛ e yɛr mo Setani be edɛ to. 9An teŋ kaŋɛ kumo, ama meeŋ naŋ laŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ kumo n ti so fanɛ nɛ esa kama naŋ malga baru pɔtɛ kama nɛ k naa kɔr kumo nɛ men daŋ nu n sɔ na to, Ebɔrɛ e yɛr amodoŋwura Setani be edɛ to. 10To, kananɛ m malga le ere maa ŋini ŋ ka bee sha kenya ketre basa kutɔ, ama Ebɔrɛ nawule kutɔ. Ŋko basa nɛ mee sha fanɛ n wora asheŋ nɛ a par bumo a? Cha, nɛ n daa sha kebaawora basa be aparsheŋ nna n daa maaŋ tiŋ a la Kristo be kenya.
Kananɛ Pɔɔl ki eshuŋipo be asheŋ
11Ŋ kurgepoana mee sha fanɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi nna fanɛ baru lela nɛ mee malga na maŋ la kusɔ nɛ k shi dimɛdi gbagba kutɔ nna. 12Mannɛ nyiŋgbasa ko kutɔ nɛ n nya kumo ŋko ŋ koya kumo. Yesu Kristo e lara kumo efuli n sa ma. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so men daŋ nu kebaawɔtɔ dra nɛ n daa kɔ a wɔtɔ saŋɛ nɛ n daa wɔ Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso na to na. Men nyi kananɛ n daŋ pere kenishi n tɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be asɔriebi, n daa sha kemur bumo nna. 14Ma sara Juwebiana be bedamta to ma e daŋ fara nɛ n sɔ kejuŋkpar ashi Juwebi be kabɔrɛbɛso na to nseŋ daŋ naŋ pere kenishi n wɔtɔ an nanaana be asheŋ ŋiniso nɛ b yige n sa anyi na to ga. 15Ama ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na so e lara ma nseŋ tre ma nna pɔɛŋ gba nɛ b kurge ma nɛ m ba shuŋ mo. 16Mo alɛ ka naŋ yili kumo mbe kagbene to n lara mo Pibinyɛn ŋ ŋini ma nɛ n tiŋ m bɔ baru lela n sa nnyamase, m maŋ yɔ esa kama kutɔ epul na to n ya bishi asheŋ to m pin. 17Ma alɛ maŋ naŋ yɔ Jerusalɛm n ya wu basa nɛ b daa la beshuŋipo pɔɛŋ nɛ ma alɛ ba ki eko na. Areebia be efuli so nɛ n daŋ baŋ juŋkpar n yɔ pɔɛŋ nseŋ bɛta n yɔ Damaskɔs be kade to. 18Ŋ ka yɔ Damaskɔs na be nfɛ asa be kaman nɛ n yɔ Jerusalɛm nɛ n ya wu Pita. Nchɛ kuduanu nɛ n daŋ ji mo kutɔ ndoŋ, 19ama n daa maŋ wu beshuŋipo na be bekama n naŋ ti so she Enyɛnpe mo sipo Jeems nawule. 20Kashenteŋ nɛ mee sibɛ a ji menyi Ebɔrɛ be anishito na, m maa fule nna. 21Kede be kaman nɛ n naŋ yɔ Siriya nɛ Silisia be efuliana so. 22Saŋɛ na so, Judiya be efuli so be asɔriana na to ebi nɛ b wɔ Kristo to na maŋ naŋ wu ma kenishiso ŋ ku so. 23Kusɔ nɛ b daŋ baa nyi kikɛ e la kusɔ nɛ b daa nu fanɛ: Kanyɛn nɛ e daa tɔrɔ anyi na naa wɔtɔ nna a malga yirda koŋwule na be asheŋ a sa basa. 24Amoso, b daŋ di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nna ŋkpal ma so.

Title: GALEESHAEBI 2
Content:
Pɔɔl nɛ beshuŋipo mo na be asheŋ
1Nfɛ kuduana be kaman nɛ ma nɛ Baanabas naŋ bɛta n yɔ Jerusalɛm. N daŋ keta Taites nna n ti so n yɔ. 2N daŋ yɔ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e daŋ lara ŋ ŋini ma fanɛ n yɔ. Bumo nɛ b daa la fanɛ benimuana na nɛ n daŋ shɛr wulo to ŋ kaŋɛ bumo baru lela nɛ mee malga a sa nnyamase na be asheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, n daa maa sha fanɛ kushuŋ nɛ n fara na e to jiga nɛ kananɛ ŋ kraa wɔ kumo to ere malɛ gba maaŋ baa la kusɔ jiga. 3Amo be saŋɛ na nɛ Taites wɔ ŋ kutɔ nɛ b nyi e ka la Griik be esa, ama bumo alɛ daa maŋ tintiŋ mo nɛ e ku kututu. 4Ama kesheŋ na daŋ ba koso, ŋkpal manɛ so, bekurgepo fɛpo ko daŋ luri anyi to nna n daŋ fin kekeni anyi be kamooji nɛ an kɔ Kristo Yesu to na to nɛ b nya n jija kumo nseŋ ta anyi ŋ ki anya. 5An daa maŋ shuli gbrɛ kama gba n sa bumo, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ baa kɔ baru lela na be kashenteŋ na to a wɔtɔ. 6Bumo nɛ b daa du fanɛ benimuana na bre, kanaŋkama nɛ b daa du daa maŋ la shɛŋ ŋ kutɔ, Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba maa kpɛa basa to, b maŋ ta shɛŋ n ti ma kubɔya na so. 7Ama kusɔ nɛ b daŋ baŋ wu bre e daa la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ta baru lela na nna m bɔɔ ma enɔ nɛ m bɔ kubɔya na n sa nnyamase fanɛ kananɛ e ta kubɔya koŋwule na n sa Pita fanɛ e bɔ n sa Juwebi na. 8Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa Pita eleŋ n shin nɛ e ki eshuŋipo n sa Juwebi na gbagba gbiiŋ nɛ e sa ma eleŋ nɛ ŋ ki eshuŋipo n sa nnyamase. 9Jeems nɛ Pita nɛ Jɔn nɛ ekama daa nyi b ka la benimu na, e daŋ shuli n sa ma nɛ Baanabas fanɛ an baa la bumo braana beshuŋipo ŋkpal kananɛ b daŋ wu Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ e daŋ sa ma na so. B daŋ shuli nna fanɛ an yɔ nnyamase kutɔ nɛ bumo alɛ yɔ Juwebi kutɔ. 10Kusɔ nɛ b daŋ baŋ kaŋɛ n ti so e la fanɛ an baa kraa chɛ betirpo to, loŋ malɛ gbagba nɛ n daa baŋ pere kenishi a wora.
Kananɛ Pɔɔl fiɛ Pita so be asheŋ
11Pita ka daŋ ba Antiɔk, n fiɛ mo so ashi bebɛsopo na be anishito nna kacha ko, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ wora kusɔ ko nna nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekpa. 12Kananɛ kesheŋ na daŋ ji nde: Mo nɛ nnyamase be bebɛsopo na daa wɔtɔ nna a bɔ enɔ a wɔtɔ kawie koŋwule to a ji.
