Ama kachako basa ko ka shi Jeems kutɔ m ba nɛ e fara a lar kaman a lara mbe kumu ashi nnyamase na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa ŋana basa nɛ b daa wɔ katutuku be katuŋ to na nna. 13K maŋ chɛr nɛ Juwebi be bebɛsopo nɛ b daŋ ka na malɛ gba bɛ mbe kebirkɔnshi be kesheŋ na so hale nɛ Baanabas gba foe ekpa koŋwule na so m bɛ bumo so. 14Ŋ ka wu fanɛ kesheŋ nɛ b wora na maŋ bɔla kashenteŋ be baru lela na be ekpa so nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ Pita le ashi bebɛsopo na kikɛ be anishito: “To, Juw e la fo nɛ fo daa wɔ nfe fanɛ kanyamase, mannɛ fanɛ Juw. Nɛ nuso nɛ feeŋ wora n tintiŋ nnyamase nɛ b baa wɔtɔ a bɛ Juwebi be edaŋkaresheŋ so?”
Kananɛ nnyamase nɛ Juwebi gba bee nya kumɔlga be asheŋ
15Anyi nɛ b kurge Juwebi gbagba, mannɛ nnyamase nɛ Juwebi bee tre alubiworapoana ere, 16baa nyi fanɛ esa be kebaabɛ mbra na so maa shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ e ji n lar ama e bɔla Yesu Kristo so nna n yirda. Amoso, anyi alɛ gba ta anyi be yirda nna n deŋi Yesu so nɛ Ebɔrɛ e bɔla Kristo na so n shin nɛ an ji n lar, ama mannɛ ŋkpal anyi be kebaabɛ mbra na so so, ŋkpal manɛ so, kebaabɛ mbra na so maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ esa kikɛ e ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito kikɛ. 17Ama kananɛ anyee sha kebɔla Kristo to n ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito ere nɛ k ba fanɛ anyi alɛ gba la alubiworapoana nna, loŋ beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini fanɛ Kristo na e naa shin nɛ alubi be kewora bee nya eleŋ a ti so a? Kaarɛ, mannɛ aloŋ nna. 18Nɛ m baŋ fara a pɔr kusɔ nɛ n daŋ da n lɛ, kumo ere k bee ŋini fanɛ n la mbrafɛlpo nna na. 19Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbra na be kaplɛa so, n wu nna, mbra na mɔ ma, saŋɛ na so nɛ m baa wɔ ŋkpa to a sa Ebɔrɛ. 20Ma nɛ Kristo nɛ b daŋ gbir m mata kedibi largato so, amoso, mannɛ ŋ gbagba e naa wɔtɔ, Kristo e wɔ ma to. Kebaawɔtɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ a wɔtɔ ere, keyirda Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn nɛ e sha ma n ta mbe kumu n sa ma na to nɛ n wɔ.
21M maa keni Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na nna jiga, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ b daa bɛ mbra na so nna a ji a lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito, dafanɛ Kristo be luwu na daa maŋ kɔ kifito.

Title: GALEESHAEBI 3
Content:
Mbra ŋko yirda be asheŋ
1Ama menyi Galeeshaebi paŋ nfɛra pasaa! Wanɛ e wora menyi bre? To, men be anishito gbagba nɛ b bugi Yesu Kristo be kewu kedibi largato na so na be asheŋ n sa menyi. To nɛ mannɛ nna? 2Kusɔ koŋwule nɛ m baa sha kebishi menyi nde: Men ka daŋ nya Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na, mbra na so nɛ men daŋ bɛ so n nya Kiyoyu na ŋko baru lela na nɛ men daŋ nu nseŋ yirda pɔɛŋ n nya Kiyoyu na a? 3Manɛ e ba nɛ men paŋ nfɛra loŋ? To, Kiyoyu be eleŋ to nɛ men fara men be kabɔrɛbɛso ere nseŋ naa sha fanɛ men bɔla men gbagba be asheŋ woraso to n loge asheŋ a? 4Asheŋ nɛ men be kenishi wu na kikɛ ki jiga nna ere ŋko? Cha, mannɛ fanɛ k ka la kusɔ jiga nna bre. 5Men ka bee bɛ mbra na so so nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sa menyi mbe Kiyoyu na nsaa wora emamachisheŋ menyi to nna ŋko men ka bee nu baru lela na nsaa yirda kumo na so nɛ e bee wora loŋ a?
6Men ta fanɛ Eebraham le, e daŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ kpal loŋ so n nase kumo fanɛ e la elelapo mbe anishito. 7Amoso, men baa nyi fanɛ basa kama nɛ b yirda Ebɔrɛ e la Eebraham mo nanabiana. 8Abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ wu kumo nna n yili fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ka beeŋ kpal nnyamase be yirda so n shin nɛ b ji n lar mbe anishito so so nseŋ wule m bɔ baru lela na n sa Eebraham fanɛ: “Fo so nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla n nɛfa durnya ere to ebi kikɛ.” 9Amoso, bumo nɛ b kɔ yirda na nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee ta a ti Eebraham nɛ e la yirdawura na so a nɛfa.
10Bumo nɛ b ta bumo be nfɛra n wɔtɔ mbra na be kebɛso na to na wɔ kɔnɔso to nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔso wɔ ekama nɛ e maa bɛ mbra na be kawɔl na so nɛnɛ saŋkikɛ na so nna.” 11Kumo alɛ baŋ fuli nna a dese fanɛ esa kama maaŋ tiŋ m bɔla mbra na so n ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito, ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ, esa kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ kpal mbe yirda so n shin nɛ e ji n lar mo ere Ebɔrɛ be anishito na, beeŋ nya ŋkpa a wɔtɔ. 12Mbra na be kebɛso malɛ maŋ yil yirda so. Kusɔ nɛ k la nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Esa kama nɛ e bee wora asɔ nɛ mbra na bee ŋini na wɔ mbra na be kebaawɔtɔ to nna na.” 13Ama Kristo sɔ anyi ashi kɔnɔso nɛ mbra na bee bar na to nna n yige. E yili anyi be katelamu to nna n shin nɛ b so mo gbagba kɔnɔ n sa anyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔso wɔ esa kama nɛ baa ta a shiga kedibi so nna.” 14E sɔ anyi nna n yige nɛ nɛfa nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n sa Eebraham na e bɔla Yesu Kristo so m ba nnyamase so, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ nya Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na.
Mbra na nɛ kɔnɔ naseso na be asheŋ
15Bekurgepoana, men shin nɛ n ta durnya ere to be kesheŋ ŋ kesar kesheŋ ere. Nɛ fanɛ durnya ere to be basa anyɔ baŋ nase kɔnɔ n sa abar, bumo be ekama maaŋ tiŋ n naŋ wora n da kɔnɔ naseso na so ŋko n ta kusɔ ko n naŋ ti kumo so. To, loŋ nɛ kesheŋ na du Ebɔrɛ be kaplɛa so. 16Eebraham nɛ mbe kamanto be esa nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase nnɔ na n sa. Abɔrɛsibɛ na maa kaŋɛ fanɛ fo Eebraham nɛ fo kaman to ebi, kumo e la fanɛ, a ber bumo fanɛ basa damta. Abɔrɛsibɛ na yɛ: “Nɛ fo kamanto be esa”, a ŋini fanɛ esa koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ de na. Mo e la Kristo na. 17Kusɔ nɛ mee ŋini nde fanɛ: Ebɔrɛ e daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ bɛ kɔnɔ na so. Kumo be nfɛ alfa ana nɛ adesa be kaman nɛ mbra na lar, ama mbra na maaŋ tiŋ m ba jija Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso na nseŋ kpra kumo. 18Amoso, nɛ mbra na be kebɛso so nɛ esa bee bɔla a nya Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa na bre, kumo ere mannɛ kɔnɔ naseso na so nɛ yirda na naa deŋ so na. Ama ŋkpal kuwɔr be kakɛ na so nɛ e daŋ bɔla mbe kɔnɔ naseso na so n ta nɛfa na n sa Eebraham.
19To, nɛ manɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ mbra na malɛ daa kɔ? B daŋ ta kumo nna n ti so nɛ k ŋini kusɔ nɛ k baa la kulubi nsaa wɔtɔ loŋ nɛ Eebraham be kamanto be esa nɛ b nase kɔnɔ na n sa na e ya ba. Emalaika so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla n shin nɛ nyiŋgbasa, anebi Mosis nna na yili Ebɔrɛ nɛ basa be nferinto m bar mbra na. 20Nɛ esa baa la esa koŋwule, ematapo maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ n sa mo. Ebɔrɛ malɛ la esa koŋwule nna.
Mbra na be kifito be asheŋ
21To, ama an kaŋɛ fanɛ mbra na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nnɔ nasesoana maa kukwe nna ŋko? Ayai, mannɛ loŋ nna kuraa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ mbra ko daŋ ba na m ba kaa tiŋ a sa ŋkpa, kumo ere basa daa beeŋ bɔla mbra na so ŋ ki belelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 22Ama abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ durnya kikɛ wɔ alubi be enɔ to nna, amoso, basa nɛ b yirda beeŋ nya kakɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na ŋkpal b ka bee yirda Yesu Kristo so.
23Pɔɛŋ nɛ yirda ere be jemanɛ na fo, mbra na daŋ nyaŋ anyi nna a wɔtɔ fanɛ ebutipoana nɛ an baa wɔtɔ loŋ hale pɔɛŋ nɛ le be yirda be jemanɛ be kefo ere ba lar efuli ere. 24Amoso, mbra na e daa wɔ anyi a ŋini anyi kebaawɔtɔ hale le pɔɛŋ nɛ Kristo ba, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ bɔla yirda to n ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 25Naniere, yirda be jemanɛ ere ka ba ere bre, mbra na maŋ naa wɔ anyi.
26Yirda so nɛ men kikɛ la Ebɔrɛ be mbia ashi Kristo Yesu to. 27Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ bɛr menyi kabɔrɛbɛr nna nɛ men baa wɔ Kristo Yesu to n shin nɛ naniere men ta Kristo be edasheŋ ŋ ki menyeya na. 28Amoso, Ebɔrɛ be anishito Juw maŋ kɔr kanyamase to, kenya maŋ kɔr esa nɛ e wɔ mbe kumu to, benyɛn maŋ kɔr beche to, men kikɛ la kukoŋwule nna ashi Kristo Yesu to. 29Nɛ men baa la Kristo peya bre, kumo ere Eebraham be kaman to ebi e la menyi nɛ menyi alɛ nya kakɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ a sa mbe mbia na.

Title: GALEESHAEBI 4
Content:
Kananɛ beyirdapo maŋ naa la anya be asheŋ
1Kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ nde fanɛ, nɛ esa pibi nɛ e beeŋ ba kaa wɔ mo tuto be asɔ kraa la kebibi, e maŋ la shɛŋ. Mo nɛ laŋ na to be kenya maŋ kɔr abar to, ŋkeshin nɛ mo alɛ e wɔ mo tuto be asɔ na kikɛ. 2E kraŋ baa la kebibi, basa e naa keni mo so nsaa wora mbe asheŋ loŋ nɛ kachɛ nɛ mo tuto yili na e ya fo. 3To, anyi alɛ gba ka daa du fanɛ mbibi abɔrɛsheŋ to na, loŋ e daa la. An daa la durnya ere to be sososo be asɔ ŋiniso be anya nna. 4Ama jemanɛ nɛ k daga na ka ba fo nɛ Ebɔrɛ shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn nɛ e bɔla durnya be eche to n lar a wɔ mbra na to na 5nɛ e ba sɔ bumo nɛ b wɔ mbra na to na n yige, saŋɛ na so nɛ an ki Ebɔrɛ be mbia gbagba. 6Kusɔ nɛ k bee ŋini fanɛ men la Ebɔrɛ be mbia nde: Mo ere Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn be Kiyoyu na anyi be ŋgbene to, Kiyoyu na e naa tre Ebɔrɛ ‘Aba’, kumo e la fanɛ n Tuto na. 7Amoso, naniere men maŋ naa la anya, men ki Ebɔrɛ be mbia nna. Menyi alɛ ka ki loŋ ere so, asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ a sa mbe mbia na malɛ gba kikɛ ki menyeya.
Pɔɔl be kafɔŋ nɛ e kɔ a sa Galeeshaebi be asheŋ
8Saŋɛ na men daa maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ, amoso, men daa la ayoyuana nɛ basa bee fɛ fanɛ a la Ebɔrɛ nɛ amo alɛ maŋ la na be anya nna. 9Ama naniere bre men ba pin Ebɔrɛ. Kusɔ nɛ mee sha nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e ba pin menyi de. Nɛ nuso nɛ a ji nɛ men naa bɛta a ta men be amu a sa le be durnya ere to be sososo be asɔ ŋiniso pɔso nɛ amo be asheŋ kɔ kuwɔr ere? Menyee sha fanɛ men naŋ bɛta ŋ ki amo be anya nna a? 10Men keni kananɛ men naa wɔtɔ a bɛ nchɛgboŋana ko so nɛ afɔlana ko nɛ saŋɛana ko nɛ nfɛgboŋana ko so. 11Men be asheŋ bee ku ma kagbene nna nɛ mee fɛ fanɛ shere ŋ gben menyi so jiga nna na.
12Ŋ kurgepoana, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa du fanɛ ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, ma alɛ gba baŋ ba ki fanɛ menyi nna. Dra na men daa maŋ wora ma kulubi kama, ama naniere bre menyee wora. 13Men nyi fanɛ kulɔ ka daŋ pɔɔ ma so so e shin nɛ m bɔ baru lela na n sa menyi sososo na. 14Kulɔ na daa la kechɔŋkeni gboŋgboŋi nna n sa menyi, ama men maŋ keni ma jiga ŋko ŋ kini ma. Men daŋ sɔ ma nna fanɛ ŋ ka la malaika ŋko fanɛ Kristo Yesu gbagba na. 15Naniere, manɛ e wora men be kagbenefuli nɛ men daŋ nya na? Nɛ esa bishi ma, n daa beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ nɛ k daa la kewora kusɔ ko nna gba, men daa beeŋ chule men be anishi gba n sa ma. 16To, naniere bre ŋ ki men doŋ nna ŋkpal ŋ ka ji menyi kashenteŋ so ŋko? 17Basa nɛ anyee malga bumo be asheŋ ere bee wora fanɛ men be asheŋ ka wɔ bumo to ga nna, ama nfɛra nɛ a wɔ bumo be loŋ be asheŋ woraso na be kaman na maŋ walɛ. Kusɔ nɛ baa sha e la fanɛ kananɛ baaŋ wora m barga ma nɛ menyi abar to nɛ bumo ere be asheŋ e baa wɔ menyi to. 18Keshin nɛ asheŋ e baa wɔ menyi to walɛ nɛ asheŋ na baa la alelasheŋ nna na a wɔ menyi to saŋkikɛ, mannɛ saŋɛ nɛ n wɔ men kutɔ nawule. 19Ma mbi shasoana, ebesa nɛ k wɔ ma to a sa menyi ere baa du fanɛ eche be kakurge be ebesa nna a wɔ ma to ama n ya wu fanɛ Kristo be kebaawɔtɔ na kikɛ ya luri nna m bɔlɔ menyi to. 20N daa wɔ menyi kutɔ nna naniere n tiŋ n chɛrga mmalga kpakpaso nɛ mee malga a sa menyi ere, k daa beeŋ par ma ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, men be asheŋ baŋ wul ma to nna.
Pɔɔl ka ta Heega nɛ Sɛɛra be asheŋ ŋ kesar be asheŋ
21Men shin nɛ m bishi menyi nɛ menyee sha kebaata mbra na a juŋkpar menyi be amu na le: Men maa nu kusɔ nɛ mbra na bee kaŋɛ nna a? 22A yɛ: “Eebraham daa kɔ mbinyɛnbi anyɔ nna nɛ ekoŋwule daa la kenyache pibi nɛ eko malɛ daa la eche nɛ e maŋ la kenya pibi.” 23Eyur be kasha so nɛ b daŋ bɔla m ba abar so ŋ kurge kenyache pibi na nseŋ bɔla Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso so malɛ m ba abar so ŋ kurge emo na malɛ. 24Anyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ koya kesheŋ ko ashi le be adrasheŋ ere to. Beche anyɔ na du fanɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre anyɔ nna. Amo be kuko shi Sainai be kebee na so nna nɛ kumo be kaplɛa so be mbia la anya. To, Heega peya nna na. 25Nɛ esa baa malga Heega be asheŋ, kumo ere Sainai be kebee nɛ k wɔ Areebia be efuli so na be asheŋ nɛ e bee ji na. Mo nɛ baa ta a ber Jerusalɛm nɛ anyee wu ere nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, kumo nɛ kumo be mbia la anya nna a wɔtɔ. 26Ama ebɔrɛso be Jerusalɛm na bre maŋ wɔ kenyaya to. To, loŋ be Jerusalɛm ere du fanɛ an nio nna. 27Ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ:
“Fo egbentepo nɛ fo maŋ naŋ kurge ŋ ku so,
fo alɛ ŋkaa maŋ naŋ nya kakurge be ebesa ere,
baa kɔ kagbenefuli nseŋ bugi kɔnɔ n wora kagbenefuliso be awɔr.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, eche nɛ b kini na beeŋ nya bibi
a chɔ emo nɛ e kɔ ekul a wɔtɔ na.”
28Amoso, menyi ŋ kurgepoana, men la Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso be mbia nna fanɛ kananɛ Aizek daa la na. 29Amo be saŋɛ na ebinyɛn nɛ b daŋ bɔla eyur be kasha so m ba abar so ŋ kurge na, daa wɔtɔ nna a tɔrɔ ebinyɛn nɛ b daŋ bɔla Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso so m ba abar so ŋ kurge na nna. Hale mbre, loŋ malɛ e kraa la. 30Ama nuso nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ Eebraham? E yɛ: “Ju kenyache na nɛ mo pibinyɛn na, ŋkpal manɛ so, kenyache pibinyɛn na maaŋ tiŋ n tu eche nɛ e maŋ la kenya na pibinyɛn na n ji etuto na be asɔ nɛ e kɔ a sa mbia na be tɔnɔ.” 31Ŋ kurgepoana, anyi maŋ la kenyache na be mbia, an la eche nɛ e maŋ la kenya na be mbia nna.

Title: GALEESHAEBI 5
Content:
Kananɛ an kɔ kamooji Kristo to be asheŋ
1Kebaawɔ anyi be amu so nɛ Kristo shin nɛ an nya anyi be amu. Amoso, naniere men baa yil kpakpa nsaa maŋ shin nɛ b naŋ ta menyi ŋ ki anya.
2Men nu nfe. Ma Pɔɔl e naa kaŋɛ menyi na fanɛ nɛ men bɛ mbra na so n shin nɛ b ku menyi atutu, Kristo na maaŋ baa la shɛŋ n sa menyi. 3Men shin nɛ n naŋ laŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kenishipereso, ekama nɛ e shin nɛ b ku mo kututu, kumo ere a daga fanɛ amodoŋwura ka bɛ mbra na so kikɛ nyam. 4Menyi, bumo nɛ menyee wora ania a sha kebɛ mbra na so n ji n lar Ebɔrɛ be anishito ere, barga men be amu ashi Kristo na kutɔ nna na. Men lar kuwɔr be kakɛ be kebaawɔtɔ to. 5Kusɔ nɛ anyi ere bee tama e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ anyi nɛ mo e ba abar so. Mbe Kiyoyu na be eleŋ to so nɛ loŋ be kesheŋ beeŋ bɔla anyi be yirda to n wora, kumo be loŋ malɛ nɛ anyee jo na. 6Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baa wɔ Kristo to, emo nɛ e ku kututu nɛ emo nɛ e maŋ ku kututu maŋ kɔr abar to. Kusɔ koŋwule nɛ k baa tir e la yirda nɛ k bee bɔla kasha so a shuŋ.
7To, men daa bɛ ekpa na so nna nɛnɛ nɛ wanɛ e naaŋ ba kaa kagle menyi ashi kashenteŋ be kebɛso be ekpa na to? 8Le be kafɛrachɛrga ere maŋ shi Ebɔrɛ nɛ e tre menyi na kutɔ. 9Yiisi gbrɛbi ko e naa kaa luri nyifu to a shin nɛ amo kikɛ bee tiŋ fɔŋgrɔŋ. 10Ama ŋ kraa kɔ tama ashi Enyɛnpe na to fanɛ men maaŋ chɛrga men be nfɛra n yɔ kakpa ko. Ma alɛ nseŋ naa nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge esa nɛ e kɔ menyi a wɔ kebagato to ere kusoe, e bee sha e baa du kanaŋkama.
11Bekurgepoana, menyee tama fanɛ n daŋ kraa malga katutuku be kamalga nna, meeŋ baa nya tɔrɔ le a? Nɛ n daa wora loŋ nna, dafanɛ Kristo be kedibi largato be kubɔya na daa maaŋ naa fɛl basa. 12Alako basa nɛ baa tɔrɔ menyi ere daa beeŋ baŋ ku bumo be atutu kikɛ gba nna n lɛ kuraa.
Kebaakɔ kebaawɔtɔ ashi Kiyoyu na to be asheŋ
13Ŋ kurgepoana, Ebɔrɛ tre menyi ere nna nɛ men ba kaa wɔ men be amu. Ama men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ le be kamoowɔ ere e sa menyi ekpa nɛ men shin nɛ men be eyur to be ayɛlgasɔ e baa wɔ menyi. Ama men shin nɛ kasha e baa shin nɛ men baa shuŋ abar. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbraana na kikɛ wɔ mbra nɛ k bee kaŋɛ le: “Sha fo barkasa dimɛdi fanɛ fo kumu” na to nna. 15Ama nɛ men baa wɔtɔ a bile a wɔtɔ abar ebesa to bre, men baa da so, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ menyeeŋ mur abar cheche.
16Amoso, mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na fanɛ men baa wɔ Kiyoyu na be kebaawɔtɔ to nsaa maa wora kapɔr lubi ere be ayɛlgasheŋ. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, kapɔr lubi ere be ayɛlgasɔ maa kukwe Kiyoyu na be ayɛlgasɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na malɛ be ayɛlgasɔ maa kukwe kapɔr lubi ere be ayɛlgasɔ. Loŋ be asɔ anyɔ na la bedoŋ nna nɛ kumo alɛ bee ŋini fanɛ men maaŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ kama nɛ menyee sha. 18Nɛ Kiyoyu na baa juŋkpar menyi, kumo ere men maŋ naa wɔ mbra na to. 19Kapɔr lubi ere be asheŋ woraso malɛ baŋ dii efuli nna. Amo nde: Kesakaleasheŋ nɛ eyurpisheŋ nɛ asheŋ jiga be ashuŋ 20nɛ agbirshunsheŋ nɛ kegbaya nɛ kekishi nɛ nlusheŋ nɛ abar be asɔ be kebaayɛlga nɛ kanya agbo nɛ nfɛragboŋ be kebaafɛ nɛ amu be kebarga a wɔ ntuŋ so be kebaawɔtɔ. 21Kayurbesa, kasanuu jijiga nɛ amo be nfɛra lubiana n ta asheŋ lubi damta ko malɛ gba n ti so. N chɛr n fiɛ menyi so, ama men shin nɛ n naŋ lɔŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ bekama nɛ baa wora le be asheŋ ere maaŋ luri Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to kikɛ. 22Ama nɛ Kiyoyu na baa wɔ esa to, le be asɔ lela ere e du fanɛ kusɔrso a wɔ amodoŋwura to nɛ e bee wora: Kasha nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ kagbenewushi nɛ kanyiti nɛ kebaala esa nɛ alelasheŋ nɛ kebaayɛ a wora 23nɛ kebaa bar kumu kaseto nɛ kamootiŋ. Mbra na maa pɛ basa nɛ b wɔ le be asheŋ ere to. 24Basa nɛ b la Kristo peya na maŋ naa shin nɛ bumo be kapɔr lubiana ere bee wɔ bumo, naniere a du fanɛ b ka ta kapɔr lubiana ere nɛ amo be asɔ sha so nɛ ayɛlgasɔ nna ŋ gbir m mata kedibi so m mɔ.
25Naniere Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e sa anyi ŋkpa, amoso, men shin nɛ e baa juŋkpar anyi. 26Men sa maŋ shin nɛ an baa kɔ kamoowu ŋko a ta abar a wɔtɔ agbo to ŋko a besa abar eyur.

Title: GALEESHAEBI 6
Content:
Kebaachɛ abar to be asheŋ
1Ŋ kurgepoana, nɛ men be ekama baŋ tɔr kulubi to, menyi nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bee juŋkpar na e bar men be amu kaseto n chɛ mo to nɛ e lar alubi na to. Ama nɛ menyee wora loŋ, men baa de men be amu so nɛ menyi alɛ gbagba e sa maŋ luri kechɔŋkeni to n tɔr.
2Men baa chɛ abar to ashi men be asheŋ tirso to, loŋ na menyeeŋ baa bɛ Kristo be mbra na so. 3Nɛ ekama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ e la esagboŋ ko nna, mo alɛ ŋkaa maa la shɛŋ, bee fule mo gbagba be kumu nna na. 4Ekama e baa keni mo gbagba be asheŋ woraso to a nyi kananɛ a du, nɛ a baa walɛ, e chɔrɔ mbe kumu. Ama e sa maa ta mbe asheŋ woraso a kesar esa pɔtɛ peya so. 5Ekama e baa de mo gbagba be asheŋ woraso so.
6Ekama nɛ e bee nya abɔrɛsheŋ na be keŋini malɛ gba e baa kɔ mbe asɔ lela be ako a chɛ mbe eŋinipo na to.
7Men sa maŋ kaŋ fule men be amu. Esa maaŋ tiŋ n wora Ebɔrɛ eyurto. Kusɔ kama nɛ esa baŋ duu, kumo gbagba nɛ e beeŋ ba teŋi kacha ko. 8Nɛ e bee duu kapɔr lubi ere be aparsheŋ be asɔ, kapɔr lubi na to nɛ e beeŋ bɔla n nya luwu. Nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee duu Kiyoyu na be aparsheŋ be asɔ, Kiyoyu na to nɛ e beeŋ bɔla n nya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. 9Amoso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ kelela be kewora e baa gben menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baa maŋ pɔ aba nsaa kɔ to loŋ, kachako anyeeŋ nya kelela be kewora be asɔ.
10Amoso, kananɛ an kraŋ baa kɔ ekpa naniere bre, men shin nɛ an baa wora basa kikɛ kelela, fɔnfɔŋ bumo nɛ b la an braana beyirdapo na.
Lalaloge be kefiɛso nɛ kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
11Naniere men wu kasibɛbi gboŋgboŋi ere ŋko? To, ŋ gbagba be enɔ to be kasibɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa menyi nna na.
12Bumo nɛ baa sha keta asɔ nɛ basa bee wu kenishiso a ji njɔŋ ere e la basa nɛ baa wora ania a sha fanɛ b tintiŋ menyi nɛ men ku atutu na. Bumo alɛ kusɔ nɛ k baŋ ba nɛ baa wora loŋ na e la kananɛ baaŋ wora a maaŋ luri tɔrɔ to. Le be tɔrɔ ere bee shi Kristo be luwu nɛ e wu kedibi largato na so to nna. 13To, bumo nɛ b ku atutu na gba maa bɛ mbra na so, ama bumo alɛ nsaa sha fanɛ men ku atutu, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya ekpa n ji njɔŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ men bɛ loŋ be kesheŋ na so. 14Ama ma ere, kaarɛ gba fanɛ ŋ ka beeŋ ji njɔŋ ko she an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be luwu nɛ e wu kedibi largato na so nawule so, nɛ durnya maŋ naa la shɛŋ ma anishito. 15Nɛ esa maŋ kɔ kusholi ŋko e kɔ, k maŋ tir kuraa, kusɔ nɛ k tir e la kebaakɔ kebaawɔtɔ popɔr na. 16Ebɔrɛ be kagbenewushi nɛ mbe kuwɔr e baa wɔ bekama nɛ baa bɛ le be kesheŋ ere so n ti Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ so.
17Ade kikɛ be kaman, esa kama e sa maŋ naŋ bar ma tɔrɔ kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Yesu be ndulgi wɔ ma eyur so nna.
18Ŋ kurgepoana, an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na e baa wɔ men kikɛ so nyam. Amɛn.

Title: ƐFESESEBI 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ n la Kristo Yesu be eshuŋipo ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be keparso na kutɔ nna a yɔ menyi, Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ men wɔ Ɛfeses be kade to a bugi epunto a bɛ Kristo Yesu so na kutɔ. 2An Tuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo e sa menyi kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi.
Nɛfa nɛ anyee nya ashi Yesu Kristo to be asheŋ
3Men shin nɛ an chɔrɔ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la mo Tuto na ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, e bɔla Kristo so n nɛfa anyi n ta abɔrɛsheŋ be kakɛ be yiri kikɛ ashi ebɔrɛso n sa anyi. 4Kashenteŋto, pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ to durnya ere gba, e lara anyi nna fanɛ an baa la mo peya ashi Kristo to, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ baa du cheembi a maa kɔ kulubi kikɛ mbe anishito. 5Ŋkpal mbe kasha so, mo ere Ebɔrɛ na yili kumo nna dra dra na kikɛ fanɛ e beeŋ bɔla Yesu Kristo to m bar anyi mo gbagba kutɔ fanɛ mbe mbia. Kusɔ nɛ k baa par mo nseŋ naa la kusɔ nɛ e yili nna na. 6Men shin nɛ an baa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal mbe le be mamachi be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ e bɔla mo Pibinyɛn shaso so n ta ŋ kɛ anyi na so. 7Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo be luwu na so e shin nɛ an nya an be amu na. Ebɔrɛ ta anyi be alubi m paŋ anyi. Kashenteŋto malɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ e bugi kagbene kikɛ n sa anyi na shi pasaa. 8Mbe kanyiasheŋ kikɛ to nɛ mbe lakal kikɛ to nɛ e yili kumo loŋ 9nseŋ naŋ bugi wulo be kesheŋ naseso nɛ e yili fanɛ e beeŋ bɔla Kristo so n shin nɛ loŋ e wora na n sa anyi. 10Ebɔrɛ be kusɔ nɛ e nase nɛ e wora amo jemanɛ na gbagba kaŋ fo na e la fanɛ e beeŋ bar kepɔrso kikɛ abar so, amo nɛ a wɔ esoso nɛ kasawule so kikɛ nyam nɛ Kristo e baa la amo kikɛ be kumu. 11Kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kre nsaa nase so nɛ kusɔ kikɛ bee bɔla a wora. Mo koŋwule Ebɔrɛ na malɛ e nase kumo dra dra na kikɛ fanɛ e beeŋ bɔla Kristo so nna n lara anyi nɛ an ba kaa la mbe basa gbagba. 12Men shin nɛ anyi nɛ an juŋkpar n nya tama ashi Kristo to na e baa la bumo nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ bee di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nsaa maŋkura mo. 13Ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora na so, menyi alɛ gba ka daŋ nu kashenteŋ be kubɔya nɛ k bee bar menyi kumɔlga na, men yirda Kristo, nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mbe ndulgi n dulgi menyi na. Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na nɛ e ta n sa a ŋini fanɛ e dulgi anyi. 14Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e la anyi be tɔɔnɛ a sa anyi tama fanɛ anyeeŋ nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa mbe basa na fanɛ bekama nɛ b la mo peya beeŋ nya bumo be amu nsaa la bumo nɛ bumo be kebaawɔtɔ bee di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ nsaa maŋkura mo.
Pɔɔl be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
15Ŋkpal le ere so, baŋ yili saŋɛ nɛ n nu kananɛ men yirda an Nyɛnpe Yesu na nɛ kananɛ menyee sha Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ so, m maŋ naŋ yige kebaachɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal menyi so, 16nsaa nyiŋi menyi ashi ma kabɔrɛkuleana to a kule an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be Ebɔrɛ, Etuto nɛ kemaŋkura wɔ mo so ga na, 17fanɛ e sa menyi Kiyoyu mo nɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ men baa kɔ kanyiasheŋ nseŋ naŋ lara Ebɔrɛ ŋ ŋini menyi nɛ men pin mo kashenteŋto. 18Ma alɛ nseŋ kraŋ naa kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ men bugi men be ŋgbene to n tiŋ m pin tama mo nɛ men nya ŋkpal e ka tre menyi na so to, nseŋ naa pin mamachi be enɛfagboŋ nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa mbe basa na to. 19Kumo be kaman nɛ men naŋ pin mbe eleŋgboŋ nɛ k wɔ anyi nɛ an yirda ere to. 20Le be eleŋ ere nɛ eleŋ damta nɛ e ta n tiŋi Kristo ashi luwu to nseŋ ta mo n chena mbe jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa ashi ebɔrɛso na. 21Kristo na e naa ji kuwura koŋwule esoso be kenimuji kikɛ nɛ kejuŋkpar kikɛ nɛ eleŋana kikɛ nɛ kenyɛnpeji kikɛ so. Mo e chɔ eleŋana kikɛ nɛ amo be adelebiana kikɛ ashi jemanɛ ere to nɛ kumo nɛ k bee ba na kikɛ to. 22Ebɔrɛ ta kusɔ kikɛ nna n wɔtɔ mbe enɔ to nseŋ lara mo fanɛ e baa la kusɔ kikɛ be kumu a sa asɔri na. 23Asɔri na e la Kristo be eyur na. Mo e naa shin nɛ kusɔ kama bee bɔla so a loge nɛnɛ ashi ekpa kama so.

Title: ƐFESESEBI 2
Content:
Kelar luwu to n luri ŋkpa to be asheŋ
1To, menyi alɛ gba du fanɛ basa nɛ b wu nna ŋkpal men ka daŋ foe ekpa a wɔtɔ a wora alubi na so. 2Loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ men daa wɔ saŋɛ nɛ men daa bɛ durnya ere be asheŋ woraso so nseŋ daa bɛ esoso be eleŋana be ewura so, mo e la kiyoyu nɛ e wɔ basa nɛ b maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ na to a shuŋ naniere na. 3Loŋ malɛ nɛ anyi kikɛ gba daa du saŋko a wɔ amo to a wora anyi be kapɔr lubi ere be aparsheŋ nsaa wora kumo be ayɛlgasɔ a fɛ kumo be nfɛra. Ŋkpal anyi be kapɔr lubi ere so anyi alɛ gba daa du fanɛ ekama nna a wɔ Ebɔrɛ be demuji be agbo to. 4Ama ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr ka shi ga so nɛ ŋkpal e ka bee sha anyi ga so 5e tiŋi anyi nɛ Kristo nna m bar anyi ŋkpa to saŋɛ nɛ an daa wɔ kasomaanu be luwu to na. Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ so nɛ men nya kumɔlga. 6E tiŋi anyi nɛ Kristo nna nseŋ shin nɛ anyi nɛ mo chena ebɔrɛso ashi mo koŋwule Kristo Yesu na to. 7E wora loŋ nna nɛ e ŋini jemanɛ kama nɛ k bee ba to ebi fanɛ kananɛ e ta mbe kuwɔr be kakɛgboŋ damtaana nɛ e bɔla mbe kasha so n sa anyi na ŋ kɛ anyi ashi Kristo Yesu to. 8Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ so e shin nɛ men bɔla yirda so n nya kumɔlga, mannɛ men gbagba be ashuŋ shunso so nɛ men nya kumo. K la Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ nna. 9Mannɛ ashuŋ shunso so nɛ baa nya kumo, saŋɛ na so esa kama maaŋ nya ekpa m puchi. 10Ŋkpal manɛ so, an la mbe apɔrso nna nɛ e sa anyi kebaawɔtɔ popɔr ashi Kristo Yesu to nseŋ ta anyi n wɔtɔ kelela be asheŋ nɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ na yili kumo dra dra na kikɛ to fanɛ an ba kaa shuŋ na.
Kananɛ an la kukoŋwule Kristo to be asheŋ
11Amoso, men baa nyiŋi fanɛ menyi nɛ b kurge nnyamase nɛ bumo nɛ edimɛdi ta enɔana ŋ ku bumo atutu nɛ bumo koŋwule na bee tre menyi asoliwuraana ere, fanɛ menyi nɛ Kristo na daŋ barga abar nna. 12Men daa la befɔ nna ashi Israɛl be efuli so ebi to. Menyi alɛ be shɛŋ daa maŋ wɔ nnɔkoŋwule nɛ a wɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ Israɛlebi be nferinto na to, ŋkpal mbe nnɔ naseso nɛ e nase n sa mbe basa na so. Men daa wɔ durnya ere to nna a maŋ kɔ tama kikɛ, menyi alɛ daa maa ta Ebɔrɛ a wɔtɔ men be asheŋ to. 13Ama naniere ashi Kristo to, menyi nɛ saŋko men daa maŋ taga Ebɔrɛ to na, Ebɔrɛ bɔla Kristo be luwu na so nna n shin nɛ men ba taga mo to.
14Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo gbagba e la anyi be kagbenewushi nɛ esa nɛ e bee bar anyi basa yiri ntuŋ anyɔ abar so. E jija kebarga to nɛ k daa wɔ anyi nɛ basa be nferinto na, kumo e la kekishi be kebarga to na. 15E ta mbe kumu ŋ kpra Juwebi be mbra na nɛ kumo be ntaŋana nɛ loŋ e shin nɛ basa yiri ntuŋ anyɔ na e ba abar so m ba ki basa koŋwule, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ bar kagbenewushi bumo to. 16Loŋ na basa anyɔ na beeŋ ki basa koŋwule nɛ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ e nyalɛ ŋkpal kedibi largato na so, saŋɛ na so malɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ kebarga to na e loge. 17Le be kagbenewushi be baru lela ere nɛ e ba bɔ n sa menyi nɛ men daa maŋ taga mo to na nɛ bumo nɛ b taga mo to na kikɛ. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, mo so nɛ anyi nɛ bumo kikɛ bee bɔla a nya ekpa a yɔ Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ ashi Kiyoyu koŋwule na to. 19Amoso, menyi nnyamase maŋ naa la befɔ n shi efuli ko so. Naniere menyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa la kukoŋwule nna a la kakpa koŋwule so ebi nseŋ naa la Ebɔrɛ be kowu to ebi be basa. 20Men du fanɛ egbal be kaba nna nɛ kumo be kifi la beshuŋipo nɛ anebiana na, nɛ Kristo Yesu malɛ gbagba la kumo be gbaltɔlase. 21Mo e kɔ ebu na be kaplɛkama to a shin nɛ k wɔ abar so a yɔ anishito a ti so a ki bɔrɛlambu cheembi ashi Enyɛnpe na to. 22Menyi alɛ gba, baa pɔr menyi nna a wɔtɔ mo to nɛ men ba ki ebu nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla Kiyoyu na to a wɔ to na.

Title: ƐFESESEBI 3
Content:
Pɔɔl be kushuŋ nɛ e shuŋ n sa nnyamase be asheŋ
1Ŋkpal le so nɛ ma Pɔɔl la Kristo Yesu be kabutipo ŋkpal menyi nnyamase so. 2Ma alɛ baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ men nu fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ so nna n sa ma kushuŋ na ŋkpal men be kelela so. 3Kumo e la wulo be kesheŋ naseso nɛ Ebɔrɛ bugi to ŋ ŋini ma na, kumo be asheŋ nɛ n teŋ sibɛ gbrɛ n sa menyi na. 4Nɛ menyi alɛ baŋ kraŋ kawɔl ere, menyeeŋ pin kananɛ ma nfɛra sa ashi Kristo be wulo be kesheŋ ere be kaplɛa so. 5Saŋɛ na be esa kikɛ daa maŋ nyi le be wulo be kesheŋ nɛ e bɔla Kiyoyu na to m bugi to ŋ ŋini mbe beshuŋipo cheembiana nɛ mbe anebiana ere. 6Wulo na nde fanɛ baru lela na so nɛ nnyamase nɛ Juwebi kikɛ beeŋ gama n nya Ebɔrɛ be enɛfa na. B la eyur koŋwule to be mba nna ŋ gama a kɔ Ebɔrɛ be nnɔ naseso nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla Kristo Yesu so n nase na. 7Le be baru lela ere be kenya nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ so n ta ma ŋ ki na. Mbe eleŋ na so nɛ e bɔla n wora loŋ. 8Kashenteŋto nna fanɛ m maŋ fo Ebɔrɛ be basa to be ekekarso gba kuraa, ama Ebɔrɛ ta le be kuwɔr be kakɛ ere nna n sa ma nɛ m bɔ Kristo be enɛfa damta be baru lela na n sa nnyamase 9nseŋ naŋ shin nɛ basa kikɛ e wu kananɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ mbe wulo be kesheŋ naseso na e wora. Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to kusɔ kikɛ na e shin nɛ wulo nɛ mee malga kumo be asheŋ ere maŋ lar efuli jemanɛ damta nɛ k choŋ ere kikɛ. 10Saŋɛ na so e beeŋ bɔla asɔriebi na to n shin nɛ mbe kashennyi damta e dii efuli n sa esoso be kenimujipoana nɛ bejuŋkparpo ashi ebɔrɛso. 11Ebɔrɛ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal mbe kesheŋ naseso nɛ e bɔla an Nyɛnpe Kristo Yesu so n wora dra dra na kikɛ so. 12Mo to nɛ keyirda mo so nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ m ba Ebɔrɛ be anishito a maa wora shikashika kikɛ. 13Amoso, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men sa maa pɔ aba ŋkpal ŋ ka bee wu tɔrɔ a sa menyi so so, men be kelela so nɛ loŋ be asheŋ bee nya ma.
Kristo be kasha be asheŋ
14Amoso nɛ mee gbir Etuto 15nɛ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so be kebɛso be kakurge kikɛ bee nya kumo be ketre ashi mo to na kumuli na. 16Mee kule mo fanɛ e keni mbe kemaŋkura damta nɛ e kɔ na to m bɔla mbe Kiyoyu na to a ta eleŋ n leŋ menyi to ashi men be ŋgbeneana to 17nɛ Kristo e tiŋ m bɔla men be yirda so a wɔ men be ŋgbeneana to. Ma alɛ nseŋ naa kule mo fanɛ e shin nɛ men tɔl to m pɛ kasha to a yil kpakpa fanɛ nliŋi na. 18Saŋɛ na so menyi, n ta Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ n ti so, beeŋ nya nfɛra m pin kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kasha wɔ mpar nɛ kananɛ k wɔ nteŋ nɛ kananɛ k du jeŋgreŋ nɛ kananɛ k du chiŋgeliŋ. 19Kashenteŋto esa ba maaŋ tiŋ m pin mbe kasha na to n ya loge, ama kumo nɛ mee kule mo fanɛ e shin nɛ men ba pin nɛ k tiŋ n shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ e bɔlɔ men be kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to nyam.
20Kemaŋkura e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe eleŋ wɔ anyi to a tiŋ a wora asheŋ ga a chɔ kananɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ m pin ŋ kule mo ŋko n tiŋ n fɛ amo be nfɛra gba na so. 21Kemaŋkura koŋwule na e baa la mo peya ashi asɔri na to nɛ Kristo Yesu to jemanɛ kikɛ to naniere hale mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

Title: ƐFESESEBI 4
Content:
Kananɛ eyur na la kukoŋwule be asheŋ
1Ma Pɔɔl nɛ n wɔ kabuti to ŋkpal Enyɛnpe so na e naa leŋ menyi to a kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k maa ji ketre nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre menyi na emɔrɔ. 2Saŋkikɛ men baa bar men be amu ase a du boeŋ nsaa kɔ kanyiti a chɛ abar to a ŋini kasha nɛ k wɔ menyi to na. 3Men baa wora ania ga a kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso be kebaawɔtɔ be kagbenewushi nɛ k bee shi Kiyoyu na kutɔ nsaa bar menyi abar so na to kpakpa. 4Eyur koŋwule nɛ Kiyoyu koŋwule e wɔtɔ fanɛ kananɛ tama koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre menyi m ba wɔtɔ kumo to na gba wɔtɔ na. 5Enyɛnpe koŋwule nɛ yirda koŋwule nɛ kabɔrɛbɛr koŋwule e wɔtɔ. 6Ebɔrɛ koŋwule nɛ e la ekama mo tuto nsaa la esa nɛ e chɔ ekama nɛ emo nɛ e bɔla ekama to a shuŋ nsaa wɔ ekama to na e wɔtɔ.
7Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ e wɔ anyi kikɛ to, ama e sa anyi be ekama kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ k sa fanɛ kananɛ Kristo na yili kumo fanɛ k baa sa na. 8Amoso nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ le na fanɛ:
“E ka daŋ dii n yɔ esoso na,
e daŋ yɛr anya nna nseŋ kɛ basa ŋkɛana.”
9Ama kekaŋɛ fanɛ e daŋ dii n yɔ esoso maŋ naa kɔ kifito n naŋ ti kede so fanɛ e daŋ gbelge nna m ba kasawule so be kaseto pɔɛŋ. 10Amoso, mo koŋwule nɛ e daŋ gbelge m ba na e naŋ dii n yɔ kufɔ a chɔ esoso be kaplɛkama, saŋɛ na so mbe kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ beeŋ sɔ kaplɛkama verr. 11Mo koŋwule na e daŋ ta basa ko ŋ ki beshuŋipo n shin nɛ bede malɛ ki abɔrɛsheŋ be bewuŋkaŋɛpoana nɛ bede malɛ ki baru lela be mbɔ nseŋ shin nɛ bede malɛ ki epasta nɛ beŋinipo. 12E wora loŋ nna nɛ e chɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ to nɛ b nya eleŋ kabɔrɛshuŋana na to, saŋɛ na so loŋ beeŋ chɛ Kristo be eyur to ebi na to nɛ b nya eleŋ n yɔ anishito ashi kebɛso na to. 13Loŋ na an kikɛ beeŋ baa wɔ abar so ashi anyi be yirda nɛ anyi be kananɛ an nyi Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na loŋ hale nɛ an ya kaa kɔ kebɛso na to be kenimufɛra n duli Kristo gbagba kusɔ kama to. 14Saŋɛ na so an maaŋ naa du fanɛ mbia nɛ basa e baa ta efɛ be keŋini be yiri kikɛ a kɔ a kpata anyi a lɛ a yɔ a ba fanɛ afu ka shin nɛ nchu koso a baga to na. Basa nɛ baa wora loŋ na wɔtɔ nna a kɔ bumo gbagba be efɛ be kanyiasheŋ a shin nɛ basa bee foe ekpa. 15Ama anyeeŋ baa la basa nɛ baa ji abar kashenteŋ kashaso, loŋ na nɛ anyeeŋ yɔ anishito ashi kebɛso na to n duli Kristo nɛ e la an be kumu na ekpa kama so nyam. 16Mo to nɛ eyur na kikɛ to m pɛ to kpakpa a wɔ abar so a du fanɛ kananɛ awibichɛkpa nɛ achin bee pɛ esa be eyur a wɔ abar so nɛ mbaana na be kekama bee nya a shuŋ kumo be ashuŋ nɛnɛ na. Nɛ loŋ malɛ baa wora, eyur na bee bɔla kasha be kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ to nna a daŋ a yɔ anishito.
Kebaawɔ kebaawɔtɔ popɔr na to be asheŋ
17Amoso, ma kamalga mo nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa menyi nsaa fiɛ menyi so ashi Enyɛnpe na be ketre to e la fanɛ men sa maŋ naa wɔtɔ fanɛ basa nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ nɛ b kɔ nfɛra fuloŋ a wɔtɔ na. 18Alubi tegsi bumo nna n shin nɛ bumo be ŋgbene biri to tuum a maŋ naa pin asheŋ to ŋkpal bumo be ŋgbene kpakpaso nɛ kemaa nyi nɛ k bee ji kuwura bumo so na so. Naniere bumo nɛ ŋkpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sa na barga abar cheche. 19Naniere ŋkpal b ka maŋ naa kɔ kelela nɛ kulubi be kenyi na so b ta bumo be amu kikɛ nna m bɛ beche nɛ benyɛn be kedi abar be asheŋ woraso so nsaa wɔtɔ a wora eyurpisheŋ be yiri kikɛ a kɔ a fin kesakalea so be ayɛlgasɔ a ti so. 20Ama mannɛ aloŋ nɛ men daŋ wu Yesu be kebaawɔtɔ ka du. 21M baa nyi men ka daŋ nu mbe asheŋ nɛ b naŋ ŋini menyi kashenteŋ nɛ k wɔ mo koŋwule Kristo to na. 22Amoso, men lara men be kapɔr dra nɛ k daa wɔ men be kebaawɔtɔ to n jija ŋkpal efɛ be ayɛlgasɔ na so ashi to. 23A daga fanɛ men be ŋgbene nɛ nfɛra kikɛ ka ki asɔ popɔr nyam. 24Men luri kapɔr popɔr nɛ Ebɔrɛ pɔr nɛ k du fanɛ mo gbagba be kapɔr a yɔ kashenteŋ be alelasheŋ nɛ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi be kaplɛa so na to.
25Amoso, men be ekama e lara efɛsheŋ ashi mbe kebaawɔtɔ to nsaa malga kashenteŋ be mmalga a sa mo braana, ŋkpal manɛ so, an kikɛ la eyur koŋwule to be mba nna. 26Fo kama nɛ agbo pɛ fo, fo sa maŋ shin nɛ agbo na e shin nɛ fo luri alubi to, fo alɛ e sa maŋ naŋ keta agbo na n tɔr epeŋi. 27Sa maŋ kaŋ sa alubipo na ekpa kikɛ. 28Ekama nɛ e daa yuri e yige kayu na naniere nseŋ fara a ta mbe enɔana a wora asheŋ lela a shuŋ, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ nya kusɔ nɛ k daga n tiŋ n chɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ to. 29Men sa maa shin nɛ mmalga lubi kikɛ e baa lar men be nnɔ to. Men baa malga kechɛto nawule be mmalga, mmalga nɛ a bee yɛr basa anishito a chɛ bumo to ashi bumo be asheŋ tirsoana to, saŋɛ na so a beeŋ baa kɔ tɔnɔ a sa bekama nɛ baa nu amo na. 30Menyi alɛ e sa maa jija Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n dulgi menyi n yili kesɔnyigeachɛ na. 31Men lara ŋgbene nɛ a maa yige asheŋ a paŋ na menyi to, nseŋ lara kenyaŋɛto nɛ agbo nɛ kaponte nɛ katege nɛ kekishiso be nfɛra be yiri kikɛ menyi to. 32Kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men baa kɔ e la fanɛ men baa la basa a wu abar kuwɔr nsaa ta abar be alubi a paŋ abar fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla Kristo so n ta men be alubi m paŋ menyi na.

Title: ƐFESESEBI 5
Content:
Kebaawɔ kefulto na to be kebaawɔtɔ to be asheŋ
1Ŋkpal men ka la Ebɔrɛ be mbia shaso so, men wora ania a du fanɛ mo gbagba. 2A daga fanɛ kasha e baa juŋkpar menyi kebaawɔtɔ ere to fanɛ kananɛ Kristo sha anyi nseŋ ta mbe kumu n sa anyi nɛ loŋ be kakɛ na walɛ a la sarga nɛ kumo be efɛa bee dufɛ viim a par Ebɔrɛ na.
3Ŋkpal men ka la Ebɔrɛ be basa so, a maŋ daga beche nɛ benyɛn be kedi abar kesakalea so be mmalga ka wɔ menyi to. Kumo alɛ maŋ naŋ daga eyurpisheŋ be yiri kikɛ ŋko kejimuni be asheŋ ka wɔ menyi to, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be asɔ na maŋ daga a ka wɔ Ebɔrɛ be basa cheembi to. 4Kumo alɛ maŋ naŋ daga men ka wɔ kawuli be mmalga ŋko epel lubiana be kebaawɔtɔ to. Loŋ be asheŋ maŋ daga. Kusɔ nɛ k daga men ka kɔ men be kebaawɔtɔ to e la kabɔrɛchɔrɔ. 5Men baa nyi kesheŋ ere geeŋ fanɛ esa kama nɛ e kɔ kesakalea be kebaawɔtɔ ŋko eyurpisheŋ ŋko esa kama nɛ e kɔ kejimuni maaŋ luri Kristo nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to. Kejimuni du fanɛ kagbirshuŋ nna.
6Men sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kama e ta mmalga fuloŋ n fule menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be asheŋ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ be demuji be agbo bee ba bumo nɛ b maa nu a sa mo na so. 7Men sa maŋ kaŋ tu bumo a wora loŋ be asheŋ. 8Ŋkpal manɛ so, dra na menyi alɛ gba daa wɔ tentembiri to nna, ama naniere bre men wɔ kefulto to nna ashi Enyɛnpe na to. Amoso, men baa wɔtɔ fanɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kefulto to. 9Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa baa wɔ kefulto na to, alelasheŋ be yiri kikɛ nɛ asheŋ niŋiso nɛ kashenteŋ e naa lar mo to. 10Men baa wora ania a pin asɔ nɛ a bee par Ebɔrɛ. 11Men shin nɛ men be asheŋ e sa maa wɔ tentembiri be chilchil be asheŋ woraso to, ama men baa lara loŋ be asheŋ na efuli. 12Ŋkpal manɛ so, kemalga asheŋ nɛ basa ŋana a wora ere be asheŋ gba kɔ anishinyɔr nna. 13Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ kefulto na ba kumo to bee dii efuli nna nɛ basa bee wu kumo. Nɛ kusɔ kikɛ nɛ k bee dii efuli nɛ basa bee wu kumo ki kefulto be kusɔ. 14Amoso nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ le na fanɛ:
“Edipo koso, niŋi to ŋ koso ashi luwu to
nɛ Kristo e nyaŋɛ kefulto n yuu fo so.”
15Amoso, men baa de men be kebaawɔtɔ so nɛnɛ fanɛ benyiashempo, mannɛ fanɛ bewulpo. 16Saŋɛ lubi to nɛ an wɔ na, amoso, men sa maa jija saŋɛ gbrɛbi kikɛ nɛ men nya. 17Amoso, men sa maa la bewulpo. Men baa wora ania a pin kusɔ nɛ Enyɛnpe bee sha fanɛ an baa wora. 18Men sa maa boo nsa, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ bee jija kumu nna. Kusɔ nɛ k daga e la fanɛ men shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e luri m bɔlɔ menyi to kiŋkiŋ. 19Men baa ta Ebɔrɛ be kawɔl to be nshɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa be kedi epaŋ be nshɛ nɛ abɔrɛsheŋ be nshɛ a boŋ a kute asheŋ a sa abar nsaa ta men be ŋgbene kikɛ a boŋ nshɛ a di Ebɔrɛ Enyɛnpe na epaŋ. 20Saŋkikɛ men baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na ŋkpal kusɔ kikɛ so ashi an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre to.
Beche kilpo nɛ bekulana be asheŋ
21Men baa bar men be amu kaseto a sa abar ŋkpal men be bunyaŋ nɛ men kɔ a sa Kristo na so. 22Beche kilpo, men baa bar men be amu kaseto a sa men kulana fanɛ kananɛ menyee wora a sa Enyɛnpe na. 23Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekul na e la mbe eche be kumu fanɛ kananɛ Kristo la asɔri be kumu nɛ k la mbe eyur nɛ e la kumo be emɔlgapo na. 24Amoso, kananɛ asɔri bee bar kumo be kumu kaseto a sa Kristo na, loŋ koŋwule na e daga fanɛ bechekilpoana e baa ta bumo be amu a sa bumo kulana kusɔ kama to.
25Benyɛn, men baa sha men be becheana fanɛ kananɛ Kristo sha asɔri na nseŋ ta mbe kumu n sa kumo na. 26E wora loŋ nna nɛ e ta asɔri na m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ nseŋ bɔla Ebɔrɛ be kamalga so n fɔr kumo fanɛ kachubɛr na. 27Saŋɛ na so e beeŋ ta asɔri na nɛ kumo be kela kikɛ nɛ kumo be kananɛ k ki cheembi nɛ kananɛ k maŋ kɔ kulubi kikɛ ŋko nɛ kananɛ kulubi kikɛ maŋ do kumo so nɛ kananɛ k maŋ nɔkɔr to ŋko kananɛ k maaŋ baa du bubɔrɔ kikɛ na m bɔɔ mo gbagba be kumu enɔ. 28To, kananɛ k daga fanɛ benyɛn e baa wora nna na, kumo e la fanɛ b baa sha bumo be beche fanɛ kananɛ baa sha bumo gbagba be amu na. Enyɛn kama nɛ e bee sha mbe eche bee sha mo gbagba be kumu nna na. 29Esa malɛ kikɛ maŋ naŋ kishi mo gbagba be eyur. Kusɔ nɛ e bee wora e la fanɛ e bee kaa sa kumo ajibi nna nsaa keni kumo so fanɛ kananɛ Kristo bee wora a sa asɔri na. 30Anyi alɛ la mbe eyur na be mba ko nna. 31Loŋ malɛ nɛ enyɛn nɛ mbe eche du. Amoso nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ le na: “Ŋkpal le so, enyɛn beeŋ yige mo nio nɛ mo tuto nseŋ ya far n chɛ mbe eche nɛ bumo benyɔ na e ki kukoŋwule.” 32Loŋ be kesheŋ ere malɛ la wulo be kashenteŋgboŋ nna n sa anyi, ama kashenteŋto, Kristo nɛ asɔri na be kaplɛa so nɛ mee malga. 33Ama a daga fanɛ men be ekama gba e baa sha mbe eche fanɛ kananɛ e bee sha mo gbagba be kumu, nɛ eche kama malɛ e baa bunyaŋ mo kul.

Title: ƐFESESEBI 6
Content:
Mbia nɛ bekurgepoana be asheŋ
1Mbia, men baa nu a sa basa nɛ b kurge menyi, ŋkpal Enyɛnpe na so, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ e daga. 2Men baa bunyaŋ men tutoana nɛ men nioana, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be ntaŋ na e baa la ntaŋ koŋwule nɛ k kɔ le be nɛfa be kɔnɔ naseso ere: 3“Men baa nu a sa bumo nɛ asheŋ e tiŋ n nyalɛ n sa menyi nɛ men tiŋ n chɛr kasawule ere so.”
4Betutoana, menyi alɛ gba e sa maa lute bumo nnɔ a wɔtɔ bumo agbo to. Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men baa wora e la fanɛ men baa ta Enyɛnpe be keŋini nɛ keniŋi ekpa a keni bumo so nɛ b baa daŋ.
Anya nɛ benyɛnpe be asheŋ
5Anya, men baa nu a sa men be durnya ere to be benyɛnpe a ŋana bumo a chicha. Men baa ta kagbene koŋwule a wora kumo fanɛ Kristo gbagba nɛ menyee shuŋ. 6Saŋkikɛ men baa nu a sa bumo, mannɛ fanɛ nɛ b wu menyi nɛ men nya ketre bumo kutɔ so, ama men baa ta men be ŋgbene kikɛ a wora asɔ nɛ a bee par Ebɔrɛ nɛ men baa du fanɛ Kristo be anya. 7Men baa ta men be ŋgbene kikɛ a shuŋ men be ashuŋ a nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe nɛ menyee shuŋ, mannɛ dimɛdi nɛ menyee shuŋ 8a nyi fanɛ kelela kama nɛ esa wora, Enyɛnpe na beeŋ sa mo kumo be tɔnɔ, nɛ amodoŋwura wɔ mbe kumu ŋko e la kenya gba, k maŋ tir.
9Benyɛnpe, menyi alɛ gba e baa wora menyi be anya loŋ. Men sa maa funti a funti bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi alɛ gba nyi fanɛ esa nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso a la menyi nɛ anya na kikɛ be Enyɛnpe na maŋ kɔ ŋkpɛato.
Ebɔrɛ be akɔsɔ be keta be asheŋ
10Ade kikɛ be kaman, men baa kɔ eleŋ Enyɛnpe na nɛ mbe eleŋgboŋ na to. 11Men baa ta Ebɔrɛ be akɔsɔ kikɛ nyam a buu a kre to, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tiŋ n yili n tu Setani na be kafulesheŋ ana. 12Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ anyi nɛ edimɛdi e naa kɔ, ama anyi nɛ esoso be kenimujipoana nɛ bejuŋkparpoana nɛ tentembiri to be durnya ere to be eleŋana nɛ esoso be ayoyu lubiana e naa kɔ. 13Amoso, men ta Ebɔrɛ be akɔsɔ naniere m buu ŋ kre to, saŋɛ na so kachɛ lubi na kaŋ tu menyi, menyeeŋ tiŋ n nya aya n yili. Nɛ menyi alɛ baŋ tiŋ n wora kusɔ kama, menyeeŋ nya n yili to kpakpa. 14Amoso, men yili to nɛnɛ n ta kashenteŋ ŋ kre kashɛr to kpakpa fanɛ kreso nseŋ ta alelasheŋ malɛ fanɛ kebɛlso be kekpaŋkale. 15Nɛ men baa sha kebaabɔ kagbenewushi be baru lela na fanɛ loŋ be kasha ka la asɛbta a wɔ men be aya to na. 16Saŋkikɛ men baa kɔ yirda to fanɛ kebɛlso be kusɔ kuŋkumuso. Yirda na nɛ menyeeŋ tiŋ n ta n duŋ Setani be atanyembi nɛ a bɛl m pere fanɛ ajanwulɛbi nɛ e kɔ a tu menyi na. 17Men baa shin nɛ kumɔlga na e baa la menyeya a kuŋ menyi fanɛ kebɛlso be kekpaŋwuro nseŋ naa ta kiyoyu na be tokobi nɛ k la Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na gba a kɔ. 18Jemanɛ kikɛ, men baa kule Ebɔrɛ ashi kiyoyu na to a ta kabɔrɛkule be yiri kikɛ nɛ asheŋ nɛ menyee sha fanɛ a wora kikɛ a kule Ebɔrɛ. Men baa kɔ le be asheŋ ere men be ŋgbene to nsaa keni so a de so nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ saŋkama a sa Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ. 19Men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa ma alɛ gba fanɛ saŋkama nɛ m bugi kɔnɔ nɛ m malga abɔrɛsheŋ na, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa ma mmalga nɛ m bugi baru lela na be wulo na to be asheŋ kenyɛnso n sa basa. 20Baru lela na malɛ be katelamuyilipo e la ma nɛ n wɔ kabuti to na. Men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa ma nɛ m baa tiŋ a kɔ kenyɛn a bɔ baru lela na a sa basa fanɛ kananɛ k daga fanɛ m baa wora.
Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be mmalga be asheŋ
21An kurgepo shaso Tikikes nɛ e bee shuŋ Enyɛnpe na kagbene koŋwuleso beeŋ sa menyi ma baru nɛ men pin ma kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ. 22Amoso nɛ mee shuŋi mo men kutɔ na nɛ e ya kaŋɛ menyi kananɛ an kikɛ du nseŋ naŋ leŋ menyi to.
23Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo e sa bekurgepoana na kagbenewushi nɛ kasha nɛ yirda. 24Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ bekama nyam nɛ b kɔ kasha nɛ k maa loge a sha an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na so.

Title: FILIPAIEBI 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ Timoti nɛ an la Kristo Yesu be anya na kutɔ nna. K bee yɔ menyi kikɛ nɛ men la Ebɔrɛ be basa ashi Yesu Kristo to nɛ men be asɔriana to be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ bechɛtopoana nɛ men kikɛ wɔ Filipai be kade to na kutɔ nna. 2Ebɔrɛ an Tuto na nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na e sa menyi kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi.
Pɔɔl be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
3Saŋkama nɛ n nyiŋi menyi be asheŋ, mee chɔrɔ ma Ebɔrɛ nna. 4Saŋkama malɛ ashi ma kabɔrɛkule nɛ mee kule a sa menyi kikɛ to, ŋ kɔ kagbenefuli nna a kule a sa menyi kikɛ, 5ŋkpal kananɛ men chɛ ma to ashi baru lela na be kebɔ be kushuŋ na to so baŋ yili kachɛ sososo nɛ n yɔ men kutɔ na m ba fo mbre. 6Amoso, m baa nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e baŋ fara le be kushuŋ lela menyi to ere beeŋ shin nɛ k baa wɔ menyi to loŋ n ya loge nɛnɛ kachɛ nɛ Kristo Yesu beeŋ naŋ ba na. 7Saŋkama men be asheŋ baa wɔ ma kagbene to nna, amoso, k baŋ dii efuli nna fanɛ meeŋ baa fɛ le be nfɛra ere a yɔ men be kaplɛa so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, men kikɛ tu ma nna n nya kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa ma naniere ashi ma kabuti ere to nɛ saŋɛ nɛ n daa wɔ ma kumu a wɔtɔ a kɔ a fin baru lela na be kelela nseŋ naa malga a ŋini basa fanɛ kashenteŋ wɔ Kristo to na. 8Ŋ ka kaŋɛ fanɛ men kikɛ be asheŋ wɔ ma kagbene to ere, Ebɔrɛ e la ma shɛdajipo fanɛ kasha damta nɛ ŋ kɔ a sa menyi na kikɛ la Kristo Yesu be kasha nna.
9Ma kabɔrɛkule nɛ mee kule a sa menyi e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ men be kasha e baa wora keshi a ti so ashi kashennyi nɛ kenya lakal ashi asheŋ to to. 10Saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tiŋ m pin kusɔ nɛ k chɔ kekama kela n lara kumo. Nɛ loŋ e shin nɛ kulubi kikɛ e sa maŋ mata menyi so nsaa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ b kaŋɛ fanɛ men ji n lar ŋ gben kachɛ nɛ Kristo beeŋ naŋ ba na. 11Nɛ menyi alɛ baa wɔ loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to, kashenteŋ be edalelasheŋ nɛ a shi Yesu Kristo nawule kutɔ e naaŋ bɔlɔ menyi to nɛ basa e ta kemaŋkura nɛ epaŋ be kedi n sa Ebɔrɛ.
Kananɛ Pɔɔl be kabuti ki nɛfa be asheŋ
12Ŋ kurgepoana mee sha men ka pin fanɛ asheŋ nɛ a nya ma na kilgi nna n chɛ ma to nɛ baru lela na be kebɔ na yɔ anishito. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so, naniere k baŋ dii efuli ewurkpa be bekumpo kutɔ nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ nfe ere kutɔ nna fanɛ Kristo na so e shin nɛ n wɔ kabuti ere to. 14Ŋkpal loŋ be kabuti na malɛ so, bekurgepo be bedamta be keyirda Enyɛnpe na wora eleŋ nna n ti so nɛ baa nya kagbene a ti so a wɔtɔ a bɔ kubɔya na kenyɛnso. 15Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ basa nɛ baa bɔ kubɔya na be beko bee bɔ kumo nna ŋkpal kayurbesa nɛ kolusha so, ama beko bugi bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ nna a bɔ kumo kelela so. 16Kasha so nɛ bumo ere bee bɔ kumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, b nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ n wɔ nfe nna nɛ ŋ ŋini basa fanɛ baru lela na kɔ kashenteŋ. 17Ama bumo na bre maa bugi ŋgbene a bɔ Kristo na be asheŋ, kajɛ be ketresha so nɛ baa bɔ kubɔya na a fɛ fanɛ nɛ b wora loŋ baaŋ shin nɛ n nya tɔrɔ n ti so ashi ma kabuti ere to.
18Ama le be asheŋ ere malɛ tir nna a? Ayai, a maŋ tir, kumo alɛ bee par ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ basa kɔ kebirkɔnshi be nfɛra nna a bɔ kubɔya na ŋko b kɔ nfɛra lela nna a bɔ kumo, kusɔ nɛ k bee lar amo kikɛ to e la fanɛ baa bɔ Kristo be asheŋ nna a sa basa. Kumo be loŋ malɛ so nɛ ma kagbene bee fuli ma na. 19Kashenteŋto, meeŋ shin nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, m baa nyi fanɛ ŋkpal men be kabɔrɛkule so nɛ Yesu Kristo be Kiyoyu na be eleŋ to so meeŋ nya ma kumu n lar kabuti ere to. 20Kusɔ nɛ m baa sha ga nsaa tama e la fanɛ m maaŋ pɔ aba ashi ma kushuŋ to, ama saŋkama, fɔnfɔŋ naniere meeŋ baa kɔ kenyɛn nɛnɛ, saŋɛ na so nɛ n wu nna ŋko n wɔ ŋkpa to nna meeŋ ta ma eyur ere kikɛ m bar Yesu Kristo bunyaŋ. 21Ŋkpal manɛ so, ma ere kutɔ n wɔ ŋkpa ere to nna ŋkpal Kristo so, nɛ ma alɛ naaŋ wu nna, luwu na la nɛfa nna. 22Ama nɛ fanɛ ŋ ka wɔ ŋkpa to ere nɛ meeŋ tiŋ n shuŋ ashuŋ nɛ a kɔ kifito bre, kumo ere m maŋ nyi asɔ anyɔ na to be kumo nɛ meeŋ lara. 23M baŋ ki nna cham a wɔ asɔ anyɔ na to be nferinto, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ mee sha e la kelar durnya ere to n ya kaa wɔ Kristo kutɔ, kusɔ nɛ k baa bɔ malɛ nna na. 24Ama ma alɛ be kebaawɔ eyur ere to e bɔ n sa menyi. 25M baa kɔ kumo be yirda nna nɛnɛ, amoso, n nyi ma nɛ menyi ka beeŋ baa wɔtɔ nɛ n tiŋ n chɛ menyi to nɛ men yɔ anishito ashi yirda na nɛ kagbenefuli to n ti so. 26Saŋɛ na so, ŋ ka naŋ ba men kutɔ menyeeŋ bɔla Kristo Yesu so n nya ekpa m puchi n ti so ŋkpal ma so.
27Amoso, kusɔ kama nɛ k la gba, men baa kɔ men be amu to nɛnɛ a du fanɛ kananɛ Kristo be baru lela na bee ŋini na. Saŋɛ na so, nɛ m ba wu menyi nna ŋko n wɔ kufɔ nna nsaa nu menyi be asheŋ, n nyi men ka yil to nɛnɛ kɔnɔkoŋwuleso a kɔ fanɛ esa koŋwule ŋkpal yirda nɛ k shi baru lela na to na so. 28Menyi alɛ e sa maa ŋana men doŋana. Men baa kɔ kenyɛn ashi kusɔ kama nɛ baa wora menyi to nɛ loŋ e tiŋ ŋ ŋini bumo fanɛ baaŋ shin nɛ menyi ere e ji n lar ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka sa menyi kumɔlga so. 29Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ sa menyi ekpa nna fanɛ men yirda Kristo na nawule, ama e ta tɔrɔ gba nna n ti yirda na so n sa menyi ŋkpal Kristo koŋwule na so. 30To, menyi alɛ gba tu mo nna a kɔ nna na. Kekɔ koŋwule nɛ men daŋ wu ŋ ka kɔ dra dra na koŋwule na nɛ ŋ kraa kɔ nɛ menyee nu kumo be asheŋ na.

Title: FILIPAIEBI 2
Content:
Yesu be kumu be kebar kaseto nɛ mbe keshi be asheŋ
1Nɛ fanɛ fo kɔ keleŋ n wɔtɔ be kebaawɔtɔ ŋkpal fo ka wɔ Kristo to so, mbe kasha bee wushi fo kagbene to nɛ fo nɛ Kiyoyu na kɔ kebaawɔtɔ koŋwule nna ŋko nɛ men la basa nna a sa abar nsaa wu abar kuwɔr kashenteŋto, 2men baa kɔ loŋ be nfɛra koŋwule na a ŋini abar kasha koŋwule na nsaa la basa koŋwule ashi men be ayoyu nɛ nfɛra to nɛ loŋ e fuli ma kagbene nɛnɛ m baŋ so. 3Sa maŋ ta kejimuni be ketresha n juŋkpar n wora asheŋ, fo alɛ e sa maa kɔ kamoowu fuloŋ. Ama baa bar fo kumu kaseto kusɔ kama to a ta basa fanɛ bumo e bɔ fo. 4Men be ekama e sa maa wɔtɔ a de mo gbagba nawule be aparsheŋ so, a daga fanɛ e baa de mo braana gba be aparsheŋ so. 5A daga fanɛ men be nfɛra e baa du fanɛ Kristo Yesu be nfɛra na.
6Mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ la kukoŋwule nna saŋkikɛ,
ama e daa maŋ ta tintiŋ ŋ kɔ n fin fanɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ e baa sasa.
7Ayai, e maŋ wora loŋ,
mo gbagba e yili kumo n sa mbe kumu
nseŋ yige kusɔ kama n nase
nseŋ shin nɛ b kurge mo fanɛ nyiŋgbasa
nɛ e wɔtɔ a kɔ kenya be kebaawɔtɔ gbagba chap.
8E daa la nyiŋgbasa loŋ nna nseŋ bar mbe kumu kaseto a wɔ kasonu be kebaawɔtɔ to loŋ n ya luri luwu to hale kedibi largato so be luwu gba kuraa.
9Ŋkpal loŋ so Ebɔrɛ maŋ mo so nna ga n yɔ kakpa nɛ k chɔ kusɔ kikɛ nseŋ sa mo ketre mo nɛ k chɔ ketre kikɛ nyam.
10Nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ kumuli kikɛ nɛ k wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so nɛ durnya nɛ k wɔ kaseto beeŋ gbir m bunyaŋ Yesu be ketre na.
11Ekama beeŋ gbir loŋ nseŋ bugi kɔnɔ basa kikɛ to ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu Kristo e la Enyɛnpe na nɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na e nya kemaŋkura.
Kebaanyaŋɛ a fuli to ashi durnya ere to be asheŋ
12Amoso, n teri shasoana, men baa kraa nu a sa ma fanɛ kananɛ men chɛr a wora na, mannɛ fanɛ saŋɛ nɛ n wɔ menyi kutɔ nawule, ama saŋɛ nɛ m maŋ wɔ menyi kutɔ gba a chɔ ŋ ka wɔ men kutɔ. Men baa ta kagbene ŋana asheŋ ŋ kraa kɔ a fin men be kumɔlga kikɛ be kenya. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e wɔ menyi to a shuŋ saŋkikɛ a shin nɛ menyee sha Ebɔrɛ nsaa tiŋ a nu a sa mo gbagba be aparsheŋ. 14Men baa shuŋ ashuŋ kikɛ nsaa maa bile asheŋ ŋko a ji emɔrɔ. 15Saŋɛ na so esa kama maaŋ wu kulubi kikɛ menyi so, ama menyeeŋ baa du cheembi a la Ebɔrɛ be mbia lela nɛ b wea nfɛralubiwuraana nɛ asheŋlubiwuraana to a wɔ durnya ere to. Men baa wɔ bumo to loŋ a du fanɛ achɛkpabi a fuli to a nyɛkpɛ a sa bumo, 16nsaa kɔ ŋkpa be kamalga na to kpakpa. Loŋ malɛ e naaŋ shin nɛ n ji njɔŋ kachɛ nɛ Kristo beeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba na nɛ loŋ malɛ e ŋini fanɛ m maŋ shile kebɛso na to jiga ŋko m pere kenishi n shuŋ jiga. 17Nɛ fanɛ b lara ma ŋklaŋ ere ma to n chulgi amo n wurge n ti men be yirda nɛ men kɔ a deŋi Ebɔrɛ so fanɛ sarga na so gba, k par ma. Ma alɛ beeŋ tu menyi a kɔ kagbenefuli. 18Menyi alɛ gba e shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa dese menyi nɛ men tu ma n shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa fuli menyi.
Timoti nɛ Epafrodaites be asheŋ
19Nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu malɛ shuli, mee tama fanɛ k maaŋ chɛr nɛ n shuŋi Timoti menyi kutɔ, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ ya bar ma men be baru nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma. 20Mo nawule nɛ ma nɛ mo baa kɔ nfɛra koŋwule nseŋ naa la esa nɛ men be kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ wɔ mo to fanɛ kananɛ k wɔ ma to na. 21Bumo nɛ b ka na kikɛ be ekama wɔtɔ nna a de mo gbagba nawule be asheŋ so, ekama maŋ de Kristo be asheŋ so. 22Ama Timoti bre, menyi alɛ gba nyi kananɛ mo ere maŋ kɔ le be kebaawɔtɔ ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, men nyi fanɛ ma nɛ mo e baa wɔ baru lela ere be kushuŋ ere to a shuŋ fanɛ kananɛ ebi nɛ mo tuto bee shuŋ na. 23Amoso, mee ta mo fanɛ ŋ kaŋ ba kaa wu kananɛ ma asheŋ ere bee nite, meeŋ shuŋi mo menyi kutɔ manaŋ. 24Ma alɛ naa kɔ yirda Enyɛnpe so fanɛ k maaŋ chɛr nɛ ma ere gbagba e ba.
25Mee fɛ nna fanɛ a daga fanɛ n naŋ shin nɛ Epafrodaites e bɛta n yɔ menyi kutɔ. E la ŋ kurgepo nɛ m barkasa eshumpo nɛ m barkasa ekɔpo nɛ mo koŋwule na naa la men be kabɔ nɛ men shuŋi mo fanɛ e ba kaa chɛ ma to ashi ma asheŋ tirso to na. 26Ŋkpal manɛ so, e baŋ pere kenishi nna a sha kenaŋwu menyi kikɛ. Kumo be kaman, mbe kagbene baŋ jija mo nna ŋkpal men ka nu fanɛ e daa lɔ so. 27Kashenteŋ malɛ nna fanɛ e ka daa lɔ, hale nɛ k daŋ ka gbrɛ nɛ e wu. Ama Ebɔrɛ wu mo kuwɔr nseŋ wu ma alɛ gba kuwɔr n ti so n shin nɛ e maŋ wu nɛ n sa maŋ nya ŋgbenejija n deŋi abar so. 28Amoso, naniere k baa wɔ ma kagbene to nna nɛnɛ n ti so fanɛ n shin nɛ e ba menyi kutɔ. Saŋɛ na so, men kaŋ wu mo, men be ŋgbene beeŋ naŋ dese menyi nɛ ma alɛ gbagba be kafɔŋ e lar ma to. 29Amoso, men ta kagbenefuli kikɛ n sɔ mo fanɛ ekurgepo ashi Enyɛnpe to. Ekama malɛ nɛ e du fanɛ mo, men sa amodoŋwura bunyaŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, a daŋ ka gbrɛbi nɛ e wu ŋkpal Kristo be kushuŋ na so. 30E daŋ ta mbe kumu nna a sha kesa ma kechɛto nɛ menyi ere gbagba daa maaŋ tiŋ n sa ma.

Title: FILIPAIEBI 3
Content:
Kebaala elelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito be asheŋ
1Ŋ kurgepoana, ma lalaloge be kamalga nde fanɛ Enyɛnpe e sa menyi kagbenefuli nɛnɛ. Kashenteŋto, ma kenaŋ n sibɛ asheŋ koŋwule ere gbagba n sa menyi maŋ tir ma, kumo be loŋ malɛ e naaŋ chɛ menyi to gba.
2Men baa de basa nɛ b du fanɛ njɔnɔ na so. Bumo e naa wora alubi nsaa wɔtɔ a sha eyur ere be keku na. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi e la kashenteŋ be katutukuebi a bɔla Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na so a bunyaŋ mo nsaa ji anyi be ŋkpa nɛ an kɔ ashi Kristo Yesu to ere be njɔŋ. Anyi nɛ anyee wora asheŋ ere maa ta anyi be yirda a wɔtɔ eyur ere be kedulgi to. 4Kashenteŋto, ma ere gbagba kɔ ekpa nɛ n tiŋ n ta ma yirda n wɔtɔ eyur ere be asheŋ to.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ esa kama nɛ e bee fɛ fanɛ e kɔ ekpa nɛ e tiŋ ŋkpal kumo so n ta mbe yirda n wɔtɔ eyur ere be asheŋ to, meya chɔ amodoŋwura peya. 5Ŋkpal manɛ so, b kurge ma Israɛl be efuli so be esa nna nɛ n shi Bɛnjamin be kanaŋ to. N la Hibruw kashenteŋto nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, n tuto nɛ n nio kikɛ la Hibruwebi nna. B ka kurge ma be kachɛ burwasopo to nɛ b ku ma kututu, mbra na be kaplɛa so n daa la Farisi nna. 6Keshuŋ Ebɔrɛ malɛ be asheŋ daŋ pere ma kenishi ga hale nɛ n daa wɔtɔ a tɔrɔ asɔri to ebi. Mbra na malɛ be kebɛso be kulubi kikɛ daa maŋ wɔ ma to. 7Ama naniere bre, asɔ nɛ a daa kɔ tɔnɔ ma kutɔ na kikɛ, m maŋ naa tre amo shɛŋ ŋkpal Kristo Yesu so. 8Kashenteŋto, naniere shɛŋ maŋ naa kɔ tɔnɔ ma anishito ŋkpal kebaanyi Kristo Yesu n Nyɛnpe na ka chɔ kusɔ kikɛ na so. Mo so nɛ m paŋ asɔ kikɛ nseŋ naa ta kusɔ kama fanɛ asɔ fuloŋ ŋkpal kananɛ meeŋ wora n nya Kristo na so nɛ n tiŋ n nya a wɔ mo to. 9Ama mannɛ fanɛ ŋ gbagba ka bɔla mbra na so a kɔ alelasheŋ Ebɔrɛ be anishito so. M bɔla Kristo so nna n nya alelasheŋ Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Yirda nɛ baa ta a nya amo ashi mo koŋwule na kutɔ. 10Kusɔ nɛ m baa sha asheŋ ere kikɛ to e la fanɛ m baa nyi Kristo na nsaa tiŋ a wu mbe ketiŋi luwu to be eleŋ na ma kebaawɔtɔ to nseŋ naa tiŋ a tu mo a ji mbe awurfoŋ na n tiŋ ŋ ki fanɛ mo gbagba ashi mbe luwu na to. 11Saŋɛ na so kachako Ebɔrɛ beeŋ tiŋi ma alɛ gba ashi luwu to.
Kepere kenishi n yɔ anishito be asheŋ
12M maa ŋini fanɛ n teŋ nya asɔ nɛ ma anishi yuu so ere nna ŋko fanɛ n teŋ ki esa cheembi nna, ama m baa pere kenishi nna a kɔ to a yɔ anishito a fin kenya ma tɔnɔ, kumo alɛ so nɛ Kristo Yesu teŋ sɔ ma n sa mbe kumu na. 13Ŋ kurgepoana, ma ere kutɔ m maa fɛ fanɛ n teŋ nya le be asɔ ere nna, ama kusɔ koŋwule nɛ m baa wora e la fanɛ mee teŋ asheŋ dra nɛ a choŋ na so nna nsaa wora ania nɛ n tiŋ n fo kusɔ nɛ k kraa wɔ ma anishito na. 14Amoso, m baŋ niŋi tinini nna a yɔ nɛ n ya ji ŋkpa be tɔnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kpal kumo so a bɔla Kristo Yesu so a tre basa esoso fanɛ b ba sɔ na.
15A daga fanɛ anyi nɛ an kɔ kebɛso ere to be kenimufɛra ere e baa kɔ asheŋ nɛ n teŋ kaŋɛ ere be nfɛra loŋ. Ama nɛ fo kama nɛ fo nfɛra kɔr le be asheŋ ere be ako to, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bugi amo alɛ gba to n sa fo. 16Kusɔ nɛ k tir e la fanɛ men shin nɛ an ba kraa wɔtɔ a bɛ asɔ nɛ an chɛr a bɛ so na so.
17Ŋ kurgepoana, men chala a kute ma kebaawɔtɔ to nsaa pɛshɛ bekama nɛ baa bɛ kebɛso na so fanɛ kananɛ an nase na. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ koŋwule na gbagba nɛ mee kaa kaŋɛ menyi nsaa sha kenaŋ n lɔŋɛ n ta anishichubi ŋ kaŋɛ menyi n ti so na fanɛ basa damta be kebaawɔtɔ du fanɛ b ka bee kishi Kristo be kedibi largato na be asheŋ nna. 19Bumo be ekar la kemur nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be epunana e la bumo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ bumo be kemaŋkura malɛ la anishinyɔr be asɔ. Kashenteŋto, bumo be ŋgbene kikɛ wɔ durnya ere to be asɔ to nna. 20Ama anyi ere, ebɔrɛso be basa e la anyi nɛ an baa jɔŋ anyi be aya so a jo anyi be Emɔlgapo, Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo nɛ e shi ebɔrɛso m ba. 21E kaŋ ba, e beeŋ chɛrga an be eyur pɔsoana ere n shin nɛ an ki fanɛ mo gbagba be eyur na. Eleŋ koŋwule nɛ e beeŋ ta n ji kusɔ kikɛ so kuwura na nɛ e beeŋ ta n chɛrga anyi.

Title: FILIPAIEBI 4
Content:
Asheŋ ŋiniso be asheŋ
1Amoso, ŋ kurgepoana, mee sha men be asheŋ ga nsaa sha kewu menyi. Menyi e naa shin nɛ ma kagbene bee fuli ma, menyi alɛ nseŋ naa la ma kegben be tɔnɔ. N teriana, amoso nɛ a daga fanɛ men baa kɔ Enyɛnpe na to a yil kpakpa na.
2Yuodia nɛ Sintiki, men jande, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men wora ania n lɔŋɛ abar a wɔtɔ fanɛ besipoche nɛ b la Enyɛnpe na peya. 3Mee kule fo, ma kagbene koŋwuleso be echɛtopo fanɛ fo chɛ bumo beche anyɔ na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, b chɛ ma to n shuŋ baru lela na be kebɔ be kushuŋ na ga. Bumo nɛ Klɛment nɛ m braana beshumpo nɛ bumo be atre wɔ Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa be kawɔl na to na kikɛ nna.
4Men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa fuli menyi ashi Enyɛnpe to saŋkikɛ. Kashenteŋto, meeŋ naŋ lɔŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ fanɛ: Men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa fuli menyi. 5Men shin nɛ ekama nyam e baa wu kananɛ men du boeŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe na be keba taga to. 6Men sa maa fɔŋ kusɔ kama so men be kebaawɔtɔ to, ama kusɔ kama to men baa kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ men be asheŋ tirso be asheŋ a kule mo fanɛ e chɛ menyi to nsaa chɔrɔ mo. 7Nɛ men wora loŋ, kagbene wushi nɛ k bee shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ a ba nsaa chɔ kananɛ dimɛdi beeŋ fɛ na beeŋ shin nɛ men be ŋgbene nɛ men be nfɛra e nya edesekpa ashi Kristo Yesu to.
8Ŋ kurgepoana, ma kamalga be ekar nde fanɛ men shin nɛ asɔ lela nɛ a daga kapandi e bɔlɔ men be nfɛra to. Loŋ be asɔ na e la kashenteŋ be asɔ nɛ asɔ nɛ a maŋ kɔ eyurpi amo to nɛ asɔ nɛ amo be asheŋ bee bɔla ekpa nɛ asɔ nɛ a bee par basa nɛ asɔ nɛ a walɛ kenya nɛ asɔ nɛ a daga kesa bunyaŋ. Loŋ be asɔ ere kikɛ e daga fanɛ men baa fɛ amo be asheŋ. 9Men baa kraa wora asɔ nɛ men koya ashi ma kutɔ nɛ amo nɛ ŋ ŋini menyi na nɛ amo nɛ men nu ŋko n wu ŋ ka wora na kikɛ. Saŋɛ na so Ebɔrɛ nɛ kagbenewushi wɔ mo to na beeŋ baa wɔ menyi to.
Pɔɔl be kechɔrɔ Filipaiebi be asheŋ
10Ma kagbene bee fuli ma ga ashi Enyɛnpe to fanɛ men ka naŋ lɔŋɛ n fara nɛ men chɛ ma to so. Kashenteŋto, ma asheŋ wɔ men be ŋgbene to, ama ekpa nɛ men maŋ nya nɛ men ŋini kumo be loŋ. 11Mannɛ fanɛ ŋ ka bee sha kechɛto so e shin nɛ mee malga le ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, naniere ŋ koya fanɛ a daga fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ ŋ kɔ n shin nɛ k baa kukwe ma. 12N nyi kusɔ nɛ k la ketir nseŋ naa nyi kusɔ nɛ k la kanya damta malɛ gba. Ŋ koya amo kikɛ be asheŋ nna, amoso, kaplɛkama nɛ n yɔ saŋkikɛ, kusɔ nɛ ŋ kɔ bee kukwe ma nna. Nɛ m moɛ nna ŋko nɛ akoŋ kɔ ma nna ŋko nɛ fanɛ ŋ kɔ ga nna ŋko gbrɛbi gba nna, a bee kukwe ma nna. 13Meeŋ tiŋ m bɔla Kristo nɛ e bee sa ma eleŋ na so n wora kusɔ kikɛ nyam. 14Ama mee chɔrɔ menyi ga ŋkpal kananɛ men chɛ ma to ashi ma etɔrɔ na to so. 15Menyi Filipaiebi malɛ gba baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ ŋ ka lar Masɛdonia be efuli so, saŋɛ nɛ n daŋ baŋ fara a bɔ baru lela na a sa basa na, menyi nawule e daa la asɔriebi nɛ b daŋ chɛ ma to ashi kesa nɛ kesɔ to. 16Hale ŋ ka daa wɔ Tɛsalɔnika be kade to, men daŋ yɛr ma kechɛto. 17Mannɛ fanɛ mee sha kechɛto nna so nɛ mee malga le ere, ama nɛfa nɛ mee sha fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e ta n ti menyi so so. 18Men teŋ sa ma kusɔ kama nɛ k daga hale a chɔ kananɛ mee sha gba. Ŋ ka wu men be kakɛ nɛ Epafrodaites bar na, a bɔlɔ ma kenishi tain. K du fanɛ sarga lela nna, nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ nɛ kumo be efɛa wɔ ebel ga. 19Ma Ebɔrɛ kɔ dama nɛnɛ, mo alɛ beeŋ bɔla Kristo Yesu so n sa menyi men be asheŋ tirso kikɛ nyam. 20Kemaŋkura e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ an Tuto na so mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.
Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
21Mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b la Kristo Yesu peya na kikɛ. Bekurgepo nɛ b wɔ ŋ kutɔ nfe ere bee chɔrɔ menyi. 22Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b wɔ nfe ere kikɛ, fɔnfɔŋ bumo nɛ b shi Romebi be ewurgboŋ pe na bee chɔrɔ menyi.
23Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ men kikɛ so nyam.

Title: KƆLƆSIEBI 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ n la Yesu Kristo be eshuŋipo ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be keparso nɛ an kurgepo Timoti kutɔ nna 2a yɔ menyi nɛ men la Ebɔrɛ peya a wɔ Kɔlɔsi nseŋ naa la an kurgepoana nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ kɔnɔleŋi ashi Yesu Kristo to na kutɔ. An Tuto Ebɔrɛ e sa menyi mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na nɛ kagbenewushi.
Kabɔrɛkule nɛ kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
3Saŋkama nɛ anyee kule Ebɔrɛ a sa menyi, anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ, an Nyɛnpe Yesu mo Tuto na nna, 4ŋkpal manɛ so, an nu kananɛ men kraa yirda Yesu Kristo nɛ kananɛ men kraa sha bumo nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ peya kikɛ 5ŋkpal men ka bee tama asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bela n yili menyi ebɔrɛso so. 6Men chɛr n nu amo be asheŋ kashenteŋ be kubɔya na to, kumo e la baru lela nɛ Epafras bɔ n sa menyi na. Baru lela na e naa shin nɛ basa bee wora kelela durnya to kikɛ. Basa nɛ baa yirda baru na gba bee wora keshi nna fanɛ kananɛ k bee wora menyi to yili jemanɛ nɛ men nu baru lela na m pin nɛnɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ kɛ basa mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ kashenteŋto nna. 7Epafras, an barkasa kebɔrɛnya shaso ŋini menyi kananɛ Ebɔrɛ kɛ basa mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na. Mo e la Yesu Kristo be eshumpo kagbene koŋwuleso a yil an be katelamu to nna. 8Mo e kaŋɛ anyi kananɛ menyee sha Ebɔrɛ be basa ashi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na to.
9Kumo so nɛ saŋkama nɛ anyee kule Ebɔrɛ a sa menyi, yili jemanɛ nɛ an nu men be asheŋ na. Anyee kule mo nna fanɛ e shin nɛ men baa pin asɔ nɛ e bee sha nɛnɛ, kumo e la fanɛ nɛ men nya kashennyi m pin kusɔ nɛ e bee sha ashi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na to. 10Loŋ nɛ menyeeŋ baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k daga Enyɛnpe na be basa ka kɔ nɛ men be asheŋ e baa par mo nɛnɛ nɛ men baa wora kelela be yiri kikɛ m baa pin Ebɔrɛ nɛnɛ a ti so. 11An be kabɔrɛkule e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e sa menyi eleŋgboŋ ashi mbe eleŋgboŋ na to nɛ men baa nyiti awurfoŋ kikɛ kagbenefuliso a chɔrɔ Etuto na ga, 12ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e shin nɛ men daga kenya asɔ nɛ e kɔ a sa mbe basa na be ako ashi ebɔrɛso, kakpa nɛ kefulto wɔ na. 13An Tuto na sɔ anyi ashi Setani be tentembiri be kuwurji to n yige nseŋ ta anyi n wɔtɔ mo Pibinyɛn shaso na be kuwurji to. 14Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mo Pibinyɛn sɔ anyi n yige, kumo e la fanɛ e ta an be asheŋ lubi m paŋ anyi.
Kristo ka chɔ kusɔ kama be asheŋ
15Ebɔrɛ Pibi na du fanɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ basa maaŋ tiŋ n wu kikɛ na nna. Mo e la kusɔtoso kikɛ be enimu, 16ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mo Pibi to asɔ kikɛ, amo nɛ a wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ amo nɛ a wɔ kasawule so, amo nɛ basa beeŋ tiŋ n wu nɛ amo nɛ basa maaŋ tiŋ n wu, kuwurjiana nɛ eleŋana, esoso be kenimujipoana nɛ bejuŋkparpoana. Ebi na e to amo kikɛ nɛ b baa bunyaŋ mo. 17Mo e daŋ asɔ kikɛ kebaawɔtɔ, mo e kɔ amo kikɛ to. Mo e wɔ asɔriebi fanɛ kananɛ esa wɔ mbe kumu na, mo e naa sa bumo ŋkpa, 18ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e la ejuŋkparpo nɛ e tiŋi luwu to ashi bumo nɛ b wu na kikɛ to. 19Amoso, mo e chɔ asɔ kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Etuto na be keparso nɛ Ebi na du fanɛ mo gbagba chap. 20An Tuto na e shin nɛ mo Pibi bar asɔtoso kikɛ abar so nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ asɔtoso na naŋ wora kɔnɔkoŋwule, asɔtoso nɛ a wɔ kasawule so nɛ amo nɛ a wɔ ebɔrɛso kikɛ, kumo e la fanɛ, mo Pibi na bar kagbenewushi Ebɔrɛ nɛ asɔtoso kikɛ be nferinto ashi mbe ŋklaŋ nɛ a lar saŋɛ nɛ e wu kedibi largato na so na.
21Saŋɛ na menyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ barga abar nna nɛ men daa la mo doŋana, ŋkpal men be nfɛra nɛ asheŋ lubi so. 22Ama naniere, Etuto na shin nɛ menyi nɛ mo naŋ nyalɛ ŋkpal Yesu be luwu nɛ e wu na so. Kumo e naaŋ shin nɛ men baa du cheembi nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ tiŋ n wu menyi alubi ŋko n ji men be kebaawɔtɔ emɔrɔ jemanɛ nɛ Yesu Kristo beeŋ yɛr menyi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na. 23Kananɛ Yesu Kristo beeŋ yɛr menyi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna na, nɛ men baŋ yirda baru lela na a maa chɛrga men be ŋgbene nsaa tama asɔ nɛ men nu baru lela na to nna na. Baru lela na nɛ baa malga a sa basa kama nɛ ma Pɔɔl gba ki kumo be emalgapo na.
Kushuŋ nɛ Pɔɔl bee shuŋ a sa asɔri na be asheŋ
24Naniere ma kagbene fuli ma ŋkpal awurfoŋ nɛ mee ji ŋkpal menyi so na so. Awurfoŋ nɛ Yesu Kristo kaŋɛ fanɛ meeŋ ji na be tɔrɔ nɛ mee ji a bɔlɔ mbe tɔrɔ na so na ŋkpal mbe asɔriebi, bumo nɛ baa tre Yesu Kristo be eyur na so. 25M ba ki asɔriebi na be eshumpo nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e lara ma fanɛ n chɛ menyi to nseŋ bɔ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya na n sa basa kikɛ. 26Kubɔya na daa la wulo be kubɔya nna, kumo alɛ be saŋɛ na Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ bugi kumo to ŋ kaŋɛ basa, ama naniere e bugi kumo to ŋ kaŋɛ mbe basa. 27Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ daa sha keŋini bumo kananɛ e ŋini mbe wulo be eleŋgboŋ basa kikɛ to nna, kumo e la fanɛ, Yesu Kristo wɔ menyi to, kumo so nɛ men kɔ tama fanɛ menyeeŋ nu Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura na be ebel na. 28Yesu Kristo be asheŋ nɛ anyee malga a sa basa kikɛ a fiɛ ekama so nsaa ŋini bumo kanyiashenso nɛ an shin nɛ ekama e pin Yesu Kristo nɛnɛ. 29Kede so nɛ m baa mɔ ma kumu a ta eleŋ nɛ Yesu Kristo bee sa ma a shuŋ na.

Title: KƆLƆSIEBI 2
Content:
1Mee kaŋɛ menyi kesheŋ ere nna ŋkpal ŋ ka bee sha men ka pin kananɛ mee mɔ ma kumu a sa menyi nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ Laodisiya nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ naŋ wu ma kikɛ na, 2saŋɛ na so meeŋ leŋ menyi to nɛ men baa kɔ kasha a wɔ abar so nsaa kɔ kenyi kikɛ nyam. Kumo e la fanɛ nɛ men ba pin mbe wulo na kikɛ. 3Wulo na e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ lara Yesu Kristo nɛ mo nawule shin nɛ an nya kanyiasheŋ kashenteŋto nseŋ shin nɛ an pin kashenteŋ na kikɛ.
4Mee kaŋɛ menyi ade kikɛ nna nɛ men sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e tiŋ n ta efɛ be kamɔrɔji n shin nɛ men foe ekpa. 5M baa maa wɔ menyi kutɔ geeŋ, ama men be asheŋ wɔ ma kagbene to ga. Ma kagbene malɛ fuli ma ga ŋkpal ŋ ka nyi men ka kɔ men be amu nɛnɛ nsaa yirda Yesu Kristo na kagbene koŋwuleso.
Keshin nɛ Kristo e bɔlɔ fo to be asheŋ
6Amoso, men ka sɔ Yesu Kristo fanɛ men Nyɛnpe ere, men keta men be amu fanɛ basa nɛ bumo nɛ mo ki kukoŋwule a kɔ mo to kpakpa 7a yil fanɛ kananɛ nliŋi bee pɛ ndibi to a yil na ŋ kraa pin mbe asheŋ a ti so m baa yirda kashenteŋ na kikɛ nyam, fanɛ kananɛ b ŋini menyi na nɛ men baa wɔtɔ a chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ.
8Men baa da so nɛ ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ ta efɛ nɛ kanyiasheŋ fuloŋ n fule menyi m bɛ mbe kumu so, kumo e la fanɛ nyiŋgbasa be edaŋkaresheŋ nɛ a maŋ kɔ shɛŋ nsaa la sososo be asɔ ŋiniso na nɛ a maŋ shi Yesu Kristo na kutɔ na, 9ŋkpal manɛ so, Yesu Kristo na to nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe kusɔ kama wɔ. 10Ŋkpal menyi nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ e la eleŋ be yiri kikɛ be enimu na ka ki kukoŋwule so, men kɔ ŋkpa kikɛ. 11Ŋkpal menyi nɛ Yesu Kristo ka la kukoŋwule na so, e ku menyi be kebaawɔtɔ lubi ashi menyi so, ama mannɛ enɔ be kushuŋ nna fanɛ kananɛ baa ta enɔ a ku kututu ŋkpal eyurpi so na. 12B ka daŋ bɛr menyi kabɔrɛbɛr na, k du fanɛ b ka puli menyi nɛ Yesu Kristo nna. Menyi nɛ mo malɛ e naŋ tiŋi nɛ menyi nɛ mo naŋ tiŋ n nya Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa ŋkpal men ka yirda Ebɔrɛ nɛ e tiŋi Yesu Kristo luwu to na be eleŋ to so. 13Men ka daŋ wu ŋkpal men be alubi nɛ men be kebaawɔtɔ lubi na so, jemanɛ nɛ men daa maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ na, Ebɔrɛ tiŋi menyi nɛ Yesu Kristo na luwu to n sa menyi ŋkpa n ta anyi be alubi m paŋ anyi. 14An kini kewora kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sibɛ mbe mbra na to na, ama e kplaŋ loŋ be kulubi na so ŋ kpra anyi be kemur nɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbra na kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ anyeeŋ mur na, kumo e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ta an be alubi nna n lɛ ŋkpal b ka gbir Yesu Kristo m mata kedibi largato na so so. 15E ka wu kedibi largato na so na, e sɔ esoso be eleŋana nɛ kenimujipoana na kikɛ be eleŋ m pɔɔ bumo so ŋ ŋaba bumo ŋ ŋini durnya. 16Amoso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ ekama e wu menyi kulubi ŋkpal kusɔ jiso ŋko kusɔnuuso so ŋko ŋkpal men ka maa bunyaŋ nchɛgboŋ ŋko kufɔl popɔr ŋko kewushiachɛ so. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, ade ere bre kikɛ daŋ ŋini nna fanɛ kusɔ nɛ k bɔ ade kikɛ ka beeŋ ba, ama kusɔ nɛ k la kashenteŋ na malɛ shi Yesu Kristo to nna. 18Men sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e kute n wu menyi kulubi a kaŋɛ fanɛ men baa koya bunyaŋ a bunyaŋ emalaika a ta kamoowu fuloŋ ŋkpal asɔ nɛ a lar mo so nɛ e wu amo na so. Mbe nfɛra lubi na so nɛ e kɔ loŋ be kamoowu fuloŋ na. 19Mo alɛ nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ e la an be enimu na maŋ la kukoŋwule. Yesu Kristo na e la an be enimu a shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa bee nya Ebɔrɛ be kenyi a ti so a du kananɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha a wɔ abar so fanɛ kananɛ awibichɛkpa nɛ achin bee pɛ esa be eyur a kukwe abar so na.
20Ŋkpal menyi nɛ Yesu Kristo ka wu nɛ men maŋ naa tuge durnya ere to be edaŋkaresheŋ be keŋini na so, men sa maŋ naa tuge basa be amu to be mbraana fanɛ men ka kraa wɔ men be kebaawɔtɔ dra na to na. 21Mbraana na e la fanɛ: Men sa maa ji le nɛ le be asɔ ere, men sa maa da le nɛ le be asɔ ere a keni, men sa maa bɛta le nɛ le be asɔ ere gba kuraa. 22Kusɔ jiso kikɛ nɛ esa ji kumo, kumo be asheŋ baŋ loge nna na. Loŋ nɛ nyiŋgbasa be mbraana nɛ amo be keŋini gba du. 23Mbraana ere du fanɛ a ka kɔ kanyiasheŋ nna, baa nase bumo gbagba be kabɔrɛshuŋ ko a kaŋɛ fanɛ basa e baa koya le nɛ le be ebunyaŋsheŋ ŋko b baa tɔrɔ bumo be eyur, ama kanyiasheŋ kikɛ maŋ wɔ le be asheŋ ŋiniso na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo be kekama maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ nyiŋgbasa e yige kulubi be kebaawora.

Title: KƆLƆSIEBI 3
Content:
1Ŋkpal menyi nɛ Kristo ka tiŋi luwu to na so, men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa wɔ ebɔrɛso be asɔ so. Ndoŋ nɛ Yesu Kristo chena, Ebɔrɛ be jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa na. 2Men shin nɛ men be nfɛra e baa wɔ ebɔrɛso be asɔ so, men sa maŋ shin nɛ durnya ere to be asheŋ wurbi e baa wɔ men be nfɛra to. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, naniere men du fanɛ basa nɛ b wu nna nɛ bumo be shɛŋ maŋ naa wɔ asheŋ jiga to nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ la kukoŋwule na e wɔ men be ŋkpa popɔr a keni so. 4Amoso, saŋɛ nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ e la an be ŋkpa na kaŋ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini durnya na, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ lar n nya mbe kemaŋkura.
Kebaawɔtɔ popɔr na be asheŋ
5Amoso, men yige men be kebaawɔtɔ dra nɛ kumo be asheŋ lubi na, men yige kacheji kpalakpala nɛ kubojuaji nɛ asheŋ jiga nɛ kayɛlga fuloŋ, men sa maa yɛlga alubi, men yige kejimuni. Kejimuni du fanɛ kagbirshuŋ nna. 6Ebɔrɛ malɛ beeŋ gberge bumo nɛ b maa nu mbe kɔnɔ nsaa wɔtɔ a wora le be asheŋ na kusoe. 7Menyi alɛ gba nɛ bumo e daa wora asheŋ na, jemanɛ nɛ men daa wɔ asheŋ lubi to na.
8Ama naniere, men yige asheŋ lubi be kebaawora n yige kebaakɔ agbo, kebaanya agbo kenyɛnso, kebaala basa lubi, basa be kebaakuli nɛ kusɔ jigaya be kamalga. 9Men sa maa fule abar, ŋkpal manɛ so, men lar men be kebaawɔtɔ dra nɛ k daa shin nɛ menyee wora alubi na to 10n nya kebaawɔtɔ popɔr lela nɛ Ebɔrɛ to nsaa wɔtɔ a lɔŋɛ kumo nɛ k ba kaa du fanɛ mo gbagba peya na nɛ men baa pin mo nɛnɛ. 11Loŋ na bumo nɛ b kɔ kebaawɔtɔ popɔr na maaŋ naa kɔ ŋkpɛato a kaŋɛ fanɛ eko la kanyamase nɛ eko malɛ la Juwebi be esa, ŋko ede ku, ede bre maŋ ku kututu, ede la efɔ, ede la edɔtopo, ŋko ede la kenya nɛ ede wɔ mbe kumu. Yesu Kristo na nawule e la bumo be kusɔ kama.
12Amoso, men baa wora le be kelela ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka lara menyi ŋ kɔr a sha menyi a shin nɛ men baa du cheeŋ na so. Men baa wu kuwɔr, men baa la basa, men baa kɔ bunyaŋ, men baa kɔ kushuso, men baa kɔ kanyiti. 13Men baa kɔ kanyiti a kɔ abar to a ta abar be asheŋ a paŋ abar. Kananɛ Enyɛnpe na ta m paŋ menyi na, menyi alɛ gba e baa ta a paŋ abar. 14Ade kikɛ be buushi men ta kasha n wɔtɔ men be ŋgbene to, kasha e naa sa anyi kikɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule. 15Men shin nɛ kagbenewushi nɛ Yesu Kristo bee sa na e baa wɔ menyi to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ lara menyi nna nɛ men baa kɔ kagbenewushi abar so, ŋkpal men ka la kukoŋwule na so. Men baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ. 16Men bɛ kubɔya nɛ Yesu Kristo sa anyi na so saŋkama, men baa kɔ kanyiasheŋ a ŋini abar a leŋ abar to a boŋ Ebɔrɛ be kawɔl to be nshɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa be kapandi be nshɛ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bee ŋini na a di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ men be ŋgbene to. 17Kusɔ kama nɛ k shi men be nnɔ to ŋko nɛ menyee wora, men shin nɛ amo kikɛ e daga esa nɛ e yil Yesu Kristo be katelamu to be kushuŋ nɛ men baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na ŋkpal Yesu Kristo so.
Bebɛsopo be kowu to be kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ
18Beche kilpo, men baa ta men be amu a sa men kulana kananɛ k daga ŋkpal men ka la Enyɛnpe na peya so.
19Bekulana, men baa sha men be beche, men sa maa nyaŋ bumo.
20Mbia, men baa bunyaŋ men nioana nɛ men tutoana kusɔ kama to ŋkpal men ka la Enyɛnpe na peya so, aloŋ e naa par Enyɛnpe na.
21Betuto nɛ benio, men sa maa ŋmenyaŋ men be mbia ga nɛ bumo be aba e baa pɔ bumo.
22Anya, men baa bunyaŋ men nyɛnpeana kusɔ kama to, mannɛ fanɛ men ya kaa shuŋ nɛ baa keni menyi so nawule ŋkpal men ka baa sha men be asheŋ e baa par bumo so, ama men baa kɔ kagbene koŋwule a shuŋ ŋkpal men ka bee bunyaŋ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na so. 23Kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora, men baa wora kumo nɛ kagbene koŋwule a nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na nɛ menyee shuŋ a sa, mannɛ nyiŋgbasa nawule 24a nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na beeŋ ka menyi n sa menyi kusɔ kama nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ sa menyi ebɔrɛso na. 25Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na nɛ menyee shuŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e wora alubi, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ka mo amo be kukɔ a maa kɔ ŋkpɛato.

Title: KƆLƆSIEBI 4
Content:
1Benyɛnpeana, men baa kɔ men be anya to kpakpa a keni bumo so nɛnɛ nsaa nyi fanɛ menyi alɛ gba kɔ Enyɛnpe ebɔrɛso.
Asheŋ ŋiniso nɛ a naŋ ti so be asheŋ
2Men baa wɔ kabɔrɛkule kpakpaso to a de so nsaa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ men be kabɔrɛkule na to. Men baa kule a sa anyi alɛ gba nɛ Ebɔrɛ e sa anyi ekpa nɛ an kaŋɛ Yesu Kristo be asheŋ, kede e la wulo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ naŋ bugi to ŋ ŋini basa na. 3Kubɔya na so nɛ n wɔ kabuti to na. 4Men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa ma nɛ n tiŋ m bugi wulo na be kubɔya na to nɛnɛ fanɛ kananɛ k daga ŋ ka malga.
5Men baa kɔ kanyiasheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ a ŋini bumo nɛ b maŋ nyi Yesu Kristo bumo be ŋgbene to na. Men sa maa gal kumo be loŋ be kelela be kewora a lɛ. 6Men shin nɛ men be kelejima e baa wɔ ebel saŋkama a kɔ kanyiasheŋ kumo to nɛ men pin kananɛ a daga men ka bee tuge basa be mmalga.
Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
7An kurgepo shaso Tikikes nɛ e la m barkasa kebɔrɛnya a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ kagbene koŋwuleso na beeŋ sa menyi ma baru. 8Amoso nɛ mee shuŋi mo menyi kutɔ nɛ e ya shin nɛ men pin anyi be kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ nɛ men be ŋgbene e wushi menyi na. 9Mo nɛ Onisimɔs nɛ e la menyi be eko nsaa la ekurgepo shaso kagbene koŋwuleso na nɛ an shuŋi. Baaŋ kaŋɛ menyi kusɔ kama nɛ k bee wora nfe.
10Aristaakes nɛ ma nɛ mo kikɛ wɔ kabuti to nfe ere bee chɔrɔ menyi. Maak, Baanabas mo kurgepo na gba bee chɔrɔ menyi. N daŋ ŋini menyi kananɛ menyeeŋ wora mo. E kaŋ ba ndoŋ, men keni mo so nɛnɛ. 11Jizes nɛ baa tre Jɛstes na gba bee chɔrɔ menyi. Bumo basa asa na nawule e la Juwebi be basa nɛ b nyi Yesu Kristo bumo be ŋgbene to nɛ ma nɛ bumo bee shuŋ nfe a malga Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to be asheŋ. B shin nɛ ma kagbene wushi ma ga.
12Epafras nɛ e la Yesu Kristo be eshumpo nsaa la menyi yiri koŋwule na bee chɔrɔ menyi. Saŋkama e bee bugi mbe kagbene to nna a kule Ebɔrɛ a sa menyi nɛ men baa kɔ men be yirda na to kpakpa nɛ men be abɔrɛsheŋ be kenyi e baa wora keshi a ti so nsaa nyi kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha a maa kɔ yalayala. 13Mee malga Epafras be asheŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, mee sha keji shɛda nna fanɛ e ka bee mɔ mbe kumu a shuŋ menyi Laodisiyaebi nɛ Hiɛrapɔlisebi. 14Luuk nɛ e la dɔkta nɛ anyee sha mo na bee chɔrɔ menyi. Diimas gba bee chɔrɔ menyi.
15Men chɔrɔ bekurgepoana nɛ b wɔ Laodisiya be kade to na. Men chɔrɔ Nimfa nɛ asɔriebi nɛ baa shɛr mbe laŋ to na gba. 16Men kaŋ kraŋ kawɔl ere n sa abar n loge, men shin nɛ esa ko e kraŋ kumo n sa Laodisiya be asɔriebi na gba. Ma kawɔl nɛ n sibɛ n sa Laodisiyaebi na, menyi Kɔlɔsiebi gba e ya sɔ kumo m ba kraŋ. 17Men kaŋɛ Akipes le: “Baa de kushuŋ nɛ fo sɔ ŋkpal fo ka la Enyɛnpe peya na so na so a wora kumo.”
18Ma Pɔɔl gbagba e naa sibɛ kechɔrɔ ere na. Men baa nyiŋi ma men be kabɔrɛkule to ŋkpal ŋ ka wɔ kabuti to so.
Ebɔrɛ e baa kɛ menyi mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na. Amɛn.

Title: 1 TƐSALƆNIKAEBI 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas nɛ Timoti kutɔ nna a yɔ Tɛsalɔnika be asɔriebi nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ an Tuto nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo peya na kutɔ. Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi e baa la menyi peya.
Tɛsalɔnikaebi na be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ yirda be asheŋ
2Saŋkama anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ nna ŋkpal menyi kikɛ so a nyiŋi menyi an be kabɔrɛkule to. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, an baa kule anyi be Ebɔrɛ Etuto na, anyee nyiŋi kananɛ men ta men be yirda a shuŋ kushuŋ nɛ kananɛ men be kasha shin nɛ men mɔ men be amu a shuŋ. Anyee kaa nyiŋi kananɛ men kɔ tama kpakpaso an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so ashi an be Ebɔrɛ Etuto na be anishito. 4An kurgepoana, Ebɔrɛ be basa shaso, an nyi Ebɔrɛ ka lara menyi nɛ men ki mo peya, 5ŋkpal manɛ so, baru lela nɛ an bar menyi na maŋ la kafule be mmalga nna, ama amo nɛ eleŋ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nɛ kashenteŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ yalayala kikɛ nna. Saŋɛ nɛ an daa wɔ menyi kutɔ na, men nyi kananɛ an be kebaawɔtɔ daa du. Menyi so nɛ an daa du loŋ na. 6Men kute anyi nɛ Enyɛnpe na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, men sɔ kubɔya na awurfoŋ damta to nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ k shi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kutɔ. 7Amoso, men be kebaawɔtɔ ki Masɛdonia nɛ Akaya be bebɛsopo kikɛ be tɔnɔ nɛ baa keni so a wora asheŋ. 8Mannɛ Masɛdonia nɛ Akaya nawule nɛ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na shi men kutɔ n yɔ, ama kananɛ men yirda Ebɔrɛ na be baru sɔ kaplɛkama, amoso, anyi ere maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ a kaŋɛ. 9Le be basa ere malɛ kikɛ bee kaa malga kananɛ men daŋ sɔ anyi saŋɛ nɛ an daŋ bɔɔ menyi so na be asheŋ nɛ kananɛ men yige agbir nsaa bɛ kashenteŋ nɛ ŋkpa be Ebɔrɛ na so a wɔtɔ a jo mo Pibi Yesu 10nɛ e shin nɛ e tiŋi luwu to na fanɛ e shi ebɔrɛso m ba. Mo koŋwule Yesu na e naa mɔlga anyi ashi Ebɔrɛ be agbo nɛ k bee ba na to.

Title: 1 TƐSALƆNIKAEBI 2
Content:
Pɔɔl be kushuŋ ashi Tɛsalɔnika be asheŋ
1Bekurgepoana, men gbagba nyi fanɛ anyi be kebɔɔso nɛ an bɔɔ menyi so na maŋ la kebɔɔso fuloŋ. 2Men nyi kananɛ b tɔrɔ anyi n tege anyi ashi Filipai pɔɛŋ nɛ an ba menyi kutɔ ashi Tɛsalɔnika. Kɔnɔgberge damta daa wɔtɔ, ama anyi be Ebɔrɛ sa anyi kenyɛn nɛ an bɔ kubɔya lela nɛ k shi mo kutɔ na n sa menyi. 3Anyi be kubɔya nɛ an kɔ a leŋ menyi to na maŋ shi efɛ to ŋko kusɔ jigaya be nfɛra to ŋko kafule to. 4Ama kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha nɛ anyee malga saŋkama, ŋkpal manɛ so, e yirda anyi nna nseŋ ta baru lela na m bɔɔ anyi enɔ. Mannɛ basa be aparsheŋ nɛ anyee wora ania a fin, ama Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e bee wora anyi be nfɛra a keni na peya nɛ anyee fin. 5Men baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ an ka daŋ ba menyi kutɔ na, mannɛ kafule be mmalga nɛ an daŋ bar. Menyi alɛ naa nyi fanɛ an maŋ ta mmalga tenteŋ nna m buu anyi be kajɛ so. Ebɔrɛ e la anyi be shɛdajipo. 6An daa beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ men wora kusɔ kikɛ n sa anyi ŋkpal an ka la Yesu be beshuŋipo so, ama an daa maŋ fin mbo ashi esa kikɛ kutɔ ŋko menyi gbagba kutɔ ŋko basa pɔtɛ kutɔ. 7Ama saŋɛ nɛ an daa wɔ menyi kutɔ na, an daa du boeŋ nna fanɛ kananɛ ebinio bee keni mbe mbia so a lɔlɔ bumo na. 8Mannɛ fanɛ baru lela nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na nawule nɛ an daŋ bugi kagbene n sa menyi, ama an daŋ ta an be amu kikɛ gba nna n sa menyi kashaso, ŋkpal manɛ so, men be asheŋ daa wɔ an be ŋgbene to ga. 9Bekurgepoana, m baa nyi fanɛ menyee nyiŋi kananɛ an mɔ anyi be amu n shuŋ saŋɛ nɛ an daa wɔ men kutɔ a malga Ebɔrɛ be baru lela na a sa menyi na ŋko? Kapa nɛ kanyɛ kikɛ nɛ an daa shuŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, an daa maa sha keshin nɛ men be ekama e baa wɔ kegben to.
10Menyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ e la an be eshɛdajipoana. An daa maŋ ta da lubi n tu menyi nɛ men yirda na, anyi be da daa du cheembi a kɔ kashenteŋ nna. 11Men nyi fanɛ an daa ŋini menyi be ekama nna fanɛ kananɛ etuto bee ŋini mbe mbia na. 12An daa leŋ menyi to a lɔlɔ menyi nseŋ daa kaŋɛ menyi kananɛ menyeeŋ baa wora nɛ menyi be kebaawɔtɔ e baa par Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee tre menyi a ba mbe kuwura nɛ kemaŋkura na to na.
13Saŋkama anyee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ga ŋkpal kananɛ men sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya nɛ an daŋ bar menyi na so. Men sɔ kubɔya na fanɛ Ebɔrɛ peya. Kashenteŋ malɛ nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kubɔya nna, kumo alɛ e wɔ menyi beyirdapo to a shuŋ na. 14Ŋ kurgepoana, kusɔ nɛ k wora menyi na koŋwule na e wora bumo nɛ baa bɛ Ebɔrɛ so a wɔ Judiya na gba. Bumo e la bumo nɛ b la Yesu Kristo peya na. Kananɛ men be efuli so ebi bee tɔrɔ menyi na nɛ Juwebi na ta n tu bebɛsopo nɛ b wɔ Judiya to na gba. 15Juwebi koŋwule na e mɔ Enyɛnpe Yesu nɛ anebiana na nseŋ tɔrɔ anyi alɛ. Bumo be asheŋ maa par Ebɔrɛ kikɛ. Bumo nɛ basa kikɛ malɛ maŋ wɔ ebel. 16Kumɔlga be kubɔya nɛ an daŋ bar nnyamase na gba, Juwebi na daa maa sha an ka bɔ kumo n sa nnyamase na. Loŋ so, bumo be asheŋ lubi daa ti so nna saŋkama. Naniere malɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo kaa bumo so.
Kananɛ Pɔɔl bee sha keyaa bɔɔ bumo so be asheŋ
17Bekurgepoana, b ka daŋ barga anyi ashi men kutɔ na an daŋ barga menyi eyur to, ama an be ŋgbene bre to anyi nɛ menyi e daa la. Anyi be kenishi daŋ pere menyi so ga nɛ an yɛlga ga fanɛ an naŋ wu menyi. 18An daa naa sha kenaŋ bɛta n yɔ menyi kutɔ nna, ama Setani maŋ yige anyi kikɛ. Ma Pɔɔl gbagba fin ekpa kanaŋkama ŋ gben. 19Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa mo malɛ so nɛ anyi be tama nɛ kagbenefuli nɛ kekɔmpɔɔso be kakɛ nɛ anyeeŋ nya na naa wɔ? Menyi nawule so nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n nya kemaŋkura ashi an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be anishito saŋɛ nɛ e beeŋ naŋ ba na. Menyi e la anyi be tama nɛ kagbenefuli. 20Kashenteŋto, menyi e la anyi be kemaŋkura nɛ kagbenefuli.

Title: 1 TƐSALƆNIKAEBI 3
Content:
1Anyi be kewu menyi na be asheŋ ka ba tir anyi ga nɛ an gben n shuŋi an kurgepo Timoti nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ be eshumpo a bɔ Yesu Kristo be baru lela na nseŋ shir a wɔ Atens be kade to. 2An shuŋi mo nna fanɛ e ya leŋ menyi to nseŋ chɛ menyi to nɛ men baa wɔ men be yirda na to. Loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ men be ekama e sa maŋ foe ekpa ŋkpal etɔrɔ ere so. 3Menyi alɛ gba nyi fanɛ etɔrɔ na gba la asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili fanɛ a wora nna. 4Anyi nɛ menyi ka daa wɔtɔ, an chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ baaŋ tɔrɔ anyi.
