Loŋ malɛ gbagba nɛ men wu a ka wora na. 5Amoso, nɛ m ba gben n shuŋi Timoti nɛ e ya keni ŋko men kraa kɔ men be yirda na to ŋko Setani chɔ menyi ŋ keni n shin nɛ an be kushuŋ ki kushuŋ fuloŋ a.
6Timoti ka shi menyi kutɔ m ba, mo alɛ bar anyi menyi be yirda nɛ kasha be kubɔya lela. E kaŋɛ anyi men ka bee nyiŋi an be asheŋ a fin kewu anyi fanɛ kananɛ anyee fin kewu menyi na. 7Bekurgepoana, ŋkpal menyi so an be awurfoŋ nɛ tɔrɔ kikɛ maŋ tir anyi. Men be yirda e daŋ leŋ anyi to. 8Naniere nɛ men kɔ Enyɛnpe na to kpakpa nɛ kagbene koŋwule, anyeeŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to be kebaawɔtɔ lela to ŋkpal menyi so. 9Naniere anyeeŋ tiŋ n chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal menyi so. Anyee chɔrɔ anyi be Ebɔrɛ na ŋkpal kagbenefuli nɛ e sa anyi ŋkpal menyi so na so. 10Kapa nɛ kanyɛ anyee bugi anyi be ŋgbene to nna a kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ e shin nɛ an gbagba e wu menyi n sa menyi yirda na be kusɔ nɛ k ka.
11Kusɔ nɛ anyee kule e la fanɛ anyi be Ebɔrɛ Etuto na gbagba nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu e bugi ekpa n sa anyi nɛ an nya m ba bɔɔ menyi so. 12Enyɛnpe na e shin nɛ men be abar be kasha nɛ basa kikɛ be kasha e baa wora keshi menyi to a ti so n ya fo kananɛ anyee sha menyi na. 13Loŋ nɛ e beeŋ shin nɛ yirda kpakpaso e baa wɔ men be ŋgbene to nɛ men maaŋ baa kɔ kulubi kikɛ, ama menyeeŋ baa du cheembi ashi an be Ebɔrɛ Etuto na be anishito saŋɛ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo nɛ bumo nɛ b la mo peya na kikɛ beeŋ ba na.

Title: 1 TƐSALƆNIKAEBI 4
Content:
Kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Bekurgepoana, an shin nɛ men pin kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ. Loŋ malɛ be kebaawɔtɔ to nɛ men chɛr a wɔ to na, ama anyee kule menyi Enyɛnpe Yesu be ketre to fanɛ men pere kenishi n nya kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ saŋkama a ti so. 2Men nyi kasheŋ ŋini nɛ an daŋ bɔla Enyɛnpe Yesu be eleŋ to n sa menyi na. 3Ebɔrɛ be kusɔ nɛ e bee sha nde: E bee sha men ka bee gelge abojuasheŋ nna nɛnɛ a du cheembi. 4E bee sha fanɛ men be ekama ka pin kacheta nɛ k du cheembi a kɔ bunyaŋ nna. 5Men sa maa kɔ kayɛlga fuloŋ be kacheta fanɛ kananɛ nnyamase nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ bee wora na. 6Amoso, ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ wora kulubi kikɛ ŋ gbiti mo barkasa ŋko m puni mo. An chɛr m malga le be kamalga kenishipereso n sa menyi fanɛ ekama nɛ e wora le be asheŋ, Enyɛnpe na beeŋ gberge mo kusoe. 7Ebɔrɛ maŋ tre anyi nna nɛ an ba kaa wɔ amɔmɔshiasheŋ to, e tre anyi nna nɛ an ba kaa wɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi to. 8Amoso, ekama nɛ e kini keŋini ere, mannɛ nyiŋgbasa nɛ e kini, ama Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa menyi mbe Kiyoyu na nɛ e kini.
9Kananɛ menyeeŋ baa sha men braana beyirdapo bre maŋ naŋ daga an ka naŋ sibɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kumo be asheŋ. Ebɔrɛ teŋ ŋ ŋini menyi gbagba kananɛ menyeeŋ baa sha abar. 10Kashenteŋ nɛ menyee ŋini beyirdapo nɛ b wɔ Masɛdonia kikɛ na men be kasha. Amoso, an kurgepoana, men pere kenishi n nya kasha nɛ k beeŋ baa chɔ kumo nɛ men kɔ ere.
11Ekama e pere kenishi a fin kananɛ e beeŋ baa du boeŋ a maa luri basa be asheŋ to nsaa keni mbe kumu so fanɛ kananɛ an daŋ kaŋɛ menyi na. 12Loŋ nɛ bumo nɛ b maa bɛ Ebɔrɛ so na beeŋ bunyaŋ menyi.
Enyɛnpe be kebɛta m ba be asheŋ
13Bekurgepoana, anyee sha men ka pin beyirdapo nɛ b wu na be asheŋ nɛ men be ŋgbene e sa maŋ kaŋ jija menyi fanɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ tama na. 14An kɔ yirda fanɛ Yesu wu n tiŋi luwu to. Amoso, an nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ Yesu nɛ basa nɛ b yirda mo pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu na e ba.
15Kusɔ nɛ anyee kaŋɛ menyi ere la Enyɛnpe na be keŋini nna fanɛ kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe na beeŋ ba na, anyi nɛ an kraa wɔ ŋkpa to ere maaŋ juŋkpar bumo nɛ b wu na n yɔ ebɔrɛso. 16Kumo be kamɔnchɛ menyeeŋ nu kaponte nɛ malaika nimuso be ebɔl nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kabel be kushu, saŋɛ na so nɛ Enyɛnpe na gbagba e shi ebɔrɛso m ba. Bumo nɛ b yirda Yesu Kristo pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu na e naaŋ juŋkpar n tiŋi luwu to. 17Kumo be kaman, baaŋ chala anyi nɛ an yirda nseŋ kraa wɔ ŋkpa to na n ti bumo nɛ b yirda pɔɛŋ nseŋ wu na so nɛ an kikɛ e ya tu Enyɛnpe na awɔlpa to, nɛ anyi nɛ Enyɛnpe na e baa wɔtɔ saŋkama mbaanaayɔ. 18Amoso, men baa kɔ mmalga ere to a leŋ abar to.

Title: 1 TƐSALƆNIKAEBI 5
Content:
Kewora shiriya a jo Enyɛnpe be keba na be asheŋ
1Bekurgepoana, a maŋ daga esa ka naŋ sibɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi jemanɛ nɛ saŋɛ nɛ asheŋ ere beeŋ wora, 2ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi ere gbagba baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe be kachɛ na beeŋ ba fanɛ kananɛ eyu bee ba kanyɛso na. 3Saŋɛ nɛ basa ya kaa kaŋɛ: “Naniere bre kaboŋ nyalɛ nɛ kagbenewushi ba,” epul na malɛ to nɛ kemur be tɔrɔ beeŋ tɔr bumo so fanɛ kananɛ kakurge be ebesa bee purgi edampoche na. Bumo be ekama maaŋ lar. 4Ama bekurgepoana, menyi alɛ maŋ wɔ tentembiri to, amoso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ kachɛ na e purgi menyi fanɛ eyu. 5Menyi kikɛ la kefulto to be basa nna, kapaso be basa. Anyi maŋ la kanyɛ ŋko tentembiri to be basa. 6Amoso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ an baa di fanɛ basa pɔtɛ. Men shin nɛ an baa keni a keta anyi be amu nɛnɛ. 7Kanyɛso nɛ bediipo bee di nɛ nsanuupoana malɛ bee boo nsa, ama anyi ere, kapaso ŋko kefulto to be basa e la anyi. 8Amoso, a daga fanɛ an baa du boeŋ a maa boo nsa. An baa shin nɛ yirda nɛ kasha e baa buu anyi so fanɛ kebɛlso be kekpaŋkale nseŋ naa shin nɛ anyi be kumɔlga be tama malɛ gba e baa buu anyi so fanɛ kebɛlso be kekpaŋwuro. 9Ebɔrɛ maŋ lara anyi nna nɛ e ta mbe agbo n lɛ anyi so, ama e lara anyi nna nɛ an baa nya kumɔlga ashi Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo to. 10Yesu na e wu n sa anyi, loŋ na e kaŋ ya bɛta m ba nɛ an wu ŋko an kraa keni, anyi nɛ mo beeŋ baa wɔtɔ. 11Amoso, men baa leŋ abar to a chɛ abar to fanɛ kananɛ men chɛr a wora na.
Lalaloge be asheŋ ŋiniso nɛ kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
12Bekurgepoana, anyee kule menyi fanɛ men baa bunyaŋ bumo nɛ b wɔ menyi to a shuŋ na, bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara nɛ b baa la menyi be benimuana a ŋini menyi na. 13Men baa sa bumo bunyaŋ nɛ kasha kpakpaso ŋkpal kushuŋ nɛ baa shuŋ na so. Men baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule abar so.
14Anyee kule menyi bekurgepoana, men fiɛ betɔlpoana na so nseŋ leŋ befupo to n chɛ bepɔshipo malɛ gba to a ji bumo kikɛ kanyiti. 15Men baa da so nɛ men be ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ ta kulubi ŋ ka kulubi be kukɔ, ama saŋkama men baa wora abar nɛ basa kikɛ kelela.
16Men baa kɔ kagbenefuli saŋkama 17a kule Ebɔrɛ saŋkama. 18Men baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ kebaawɔtɔ kama nɛ men wɔtɔ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ e bee sha nɛ men baa wora Yesu Kristo to nna na.
19Men sa maŋ kuŋ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na ekpa. 20Men sa maa gal kewu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ na a lɛ. 21Men baa wora asɔ kikɛ a keni, kusɔ kama nɛ k walɛ, men baa kɔ kumo to kpakpa 22m barga menyi be amu ashi kulubi be yiri kikɛ to.
23Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa kagbenewushi na e wora menyi cheembi n shin nɛ menyi be amu kikɛ nɛ kiyoyu nɛ kagbene nɛ eyur e lar kulubi kikɛ to jemanɛ nɛ anyi nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo beeŋ ya ba na. 24Emo nɛ e tre menyi na beeŋ wora le be asheŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, e la emo nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda nna.
25Bekurgepoana, men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa anyi alɛ gba.
26Men ta kegbumpipe cheembi n chɔrɔ bekurgepoana na kikɛ.
27Mee kule menyi ashi Enyɛnpe na be eleŋ to fanɛ men kraŋ kawɔl ere nɛ bekurgepoana na kikɛ e nu.
28Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na e baa la menyeya.

Title: 2 TƐSALƆNIKAEBI 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ Sailas nɛ Timoti kutɔ nna a yɔ Tɛsalɔnika be asɔriebi nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ an Tuto nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo peya na kutɔ. 2Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo e sa menyi mo ere Ebɔrɛ na be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi.
Kristo be keba be kachɛ be demu be keji be asheŋ
3Bekurgepoana, a daga an ka bee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ saŋkama ŋkpal menyi so. An kɔ ekpa nɛ an chɔrɔ mo ŋkpal kananɛ men be yirda bee wora keshi a ti so so. Kananɛ men be ekama bee sha mo braana na gba bee ti so. 4Amoso nɛ anyi gbagba wɔ Ebɔrɛ be asɔriana to a ji njɔŋ ŋkpal menyi so na. Men be yirda nɛ kanyiti nɛ men kɔ a wɔ awurfoŋ nɛ tɔrɔ damta ere to so nɛ anyee ji njɔŋ loŋ na.
5Kede ere e naaŋ ŋini Ebɔrɛ be demu be keji ka du cheembi, ŋkpal manɛ so, ade kikɛ e shin nɛ men daga mbe kuwura nɛ men kpal kumo so a ji awurfoŋ na. 6Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ bee wora asɔ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna. Basa nɛ baa tɔrɔ menyi ere, e beeŋ shin nɛ tɔrɔ e ba bumo so. 7Mo e naaŋ sa anyi nɛ menyi nɛ menyee ji awurfoŋ ere ewushi kachɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu beeŋ lara mbe kumu ŋ ŋini durnya saŋɛ nɛ mo nɛ mbe emalaika lempo beeŋ shi ebɔrɛso m ba nɛ edɛ chɔɔso 8m ba gberge basa nɛ b maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ nɛ bumo nɛ b maa bɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu be baru lela na so kusoe. 9Baaŋ nya kemur be kasogberge mbaanaayɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ e barga bumo ashi mo kutɔ nɛ mbe eleŋ be kemaŋkuragboŋ na to. 10Kachɛ nɛ e beeŋ ba nya kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ ashi mbe basa nɛ b yirda mo na kutɔ na, menyi alɛ gba beeŋ ti loŋ be basa na so ŋkpal men ka yirda kubɔya nɛ an daŋ bɔ n sa menyi na so.
11Amoso nɛ anyee kule anyi be Ebɔrɛ saŋkama a sa menyi fanɛ e shin nɛ men be kebaawɔtɔ e baa du fanɛ kananɛ e tre menyi fanɛ men ba kaa kɔ na. Anyee kule mo fanɛ e ta mbe eleŋ na n shin nɛ men be kelela be kasha na e wora kashenteŋ n shin nɛ men be yirda be kushuŋ na e bɔlɔ so nyam. 12Loŋ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu be ketre beeŋ nya kemaŋkura menyi kutɔ, nɛ menyi alɛ gba e bɔla an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo nɛ an be Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ so n nya kemaŋkura ashi mo kutɔ.

Title: 2 TƐSALƆNIKAEBI 2
Content:
Alubipo na be asheŋ
1To, bekurgepoana, an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kebɛta m ba na nɛ anyi be kechala a wɔ mo kutɔ na malɛ be asheŋ nde: 2Anyee kule menyi nna fanɛ men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ men be nfɛra e wul menyi to ŋko n shin nɛ kananɛ basa ko bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Enyɛnpe be kachɛ na teŋ ba na e baa jija men be ŋgbene. Shere esa ko e kaŋɛ fanɛ e wu kumo loŋ nna ŋko esa ko e malga abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ loŋ ŋko basa e naa kaŋɛ fanɛ anyi e sibɛ kumo anyi be kawɔl to. 3Men sa maŋ kaŋ shin nɛ esa kama e bɔla ekpa kikɛ so n fule menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe be kachɛ na maaŋ ba ama kenyaŋɛto m buu Ebɔrɛ na ba na nɛ alubipo nɛ mbe kelamba la edɛ to be keluri na lar na pɔɛŋ. 4Kusɔ kama nɛ enyiŋgbasa bee bɛ so a kaŋɛ fanɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna ŋko a tre kumo kabɔrɛshuŋ, alubipo na beeŋ ji kumo emɔrɔ ŋ ki kumo doŋ. E beeŋ wu mbe kumu hale n ya luri n chena bɔrɛlambu na to a tre mbe kumu Ebɔrɛ.
5Men maŋ nyiŋi fanɛ ŋ ka daa wɔ menyi kutɔ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi asheŋ ere kikɛ a? 6Naniere menyi alɛ gba nyi kusɔ nɛ k bee shin nɛ alubipo na maaŋ tiŋ m ba, ama mbe jemanɛ na ya fo nna nɛ e lar efuli. 7Daŋga be asheŋ lubi be kewora na bre teŋ fara, ama asɔ nɛ a beeŋ wora na be eleŋ gbagba maŋ naŋ lar efuli she emo nɛ e bee kuŋ amo ekpa na lar ashi to nna. 8Kachɛ na kaŋ fo, alubipo na beeŋ ba lara mbe kumu efuli nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu e fute mbe kɔnɔ to be afu m mɔ mo n shin nɛ mo ere Yesu be kemaŋkura be keba na e mur alubipo na. 9Alubipo na beeŋ bɔla Setani be eleŋ to n wora efɛ be edaŋga nɛ emamachisheŋ damta. 10E beeŋ bar efɛ be edalubisheŋ damta m ba fule bumo nɛ baaŋ mur na. Baaŋ wu kasogberge be luwu na ŋkpal b ka kini kashenteŋ nɛ baaŋ bɔla kumo so n nya kumɔlga na so. 11Amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee shin nɛ kefoe ekpa be eleŋ ba bumo to na. Loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ b yirda kusɔ nɛ k la efɛ. 12Bekama malɛ nɛ b maŋ yirda kashenteŋ na nseŋ ta alubi ŋ ki bumo be aparsheŋ na kikɛ beeŋ mur.
Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ lara Tɛsalɔnikaebi nɛ b nya kumɔlga be asheŋ
13Bekurgepoana, a daga an ka chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ saŋkama ŋkpal menyi nɛ Enyɛnpe bee sha na so. Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ fara nna n lara menyi nɛ men nya kumɔlga ashi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na to nseŋ ki Ebɔrɛ be basa cheembi a wɔ keyirda kashenteŋ na to. 14Baru lela nɛ an malga n sa menyi na to nɛ Ebɔrɛ bɔla n tre menyi. E tre menyi nna nɛ menyi alɛ e ba nya an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kemaŋkura na. 15Amoso, bekurgepoana, men baa kɔ men be amu to kpakpa a kɔ kashenteŋ nɛ an ta abɔrɛsheŋ be kemalga nɛ kawɔl be kesibɛ ŋ ŋini menyi na to kpakpa.
16An Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo gbagba nɛ Ebɔrɛ an Tuto nɛ e sha anyi nseŋ bɔla mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ so a leŋ anyi to mbaanaayɔ nsaa sa anyi tama lela na 17e baa leŋ menyi to nɛnɛ nsaa sa menyi eleŋ nɛ men baa wora asheŋ lela kikɛ nsaa malga mmalga lela.

Title: 2 TƐSALƆNIKAEBI 3
Content:
Kebaakule Ebɔrɛ a sa beshuŋipo be asheŋ
1Ade kikɛ be buushi, bekurgepoana, men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa anyi nɛ Enyɛnpe be kubɔya na e nya manaŋ n sɔ kakpa kikɛ n nya kemaŋkura fanɛ kananɛ k daŋ wora menyi kutɔ na. 2Men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa anyi nɛ e baa pete anyi basa lubi be yiri kikɛ to. Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ basa kikɛ e kɔ yirda.
3Ama Enyɛnpe bre maa chɛrga mbe asheŋ to kikɛ. E beeŋ sa menyi eleŋ nseŋ pete menyi ashi kulubi to. 4Enyɛnpe na so an yirda menyi a nyi men ka bee wora ŋ kraa beeŋ wora asɔ nɛ anyee kaŋɛ menyi.
5Enyɛnpe na e ŋini menyi be ŋgbene Ebɔrɛ be kasha nɛ Kristo be kanyiti na.
Betɔlpo be asheŋ
6Bekurgepoana, naniere anyee fiɛ menyi so Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre to fanɛ men baa gelge ekurgepo kikɛ nɛ e wɔ ntɔl be kebaawɔtɔ to a maa bɛ keŋini nɛ an sa menyi na so. 7Menyi gbagba e baa nyi a ka daga men ka bee kute anyi to. An ka daa wɔ menyi kutɔ, an daa maŋ kɔ ntɔl. 8An daa maŋ ji ekama be kejibi a maŋ ka mo, ama kapa nɛ kanyɛ an daa mɔ an be amu nna a shuŋ nɛ an sa maŋ bɔ ekama kukɔ. 9Mannɛ fanɛ an daa maa kɔ kumo be ekpa nna, ama an daa maŋ wora loŋ nna nɛ men wu anyi be kebaawɔtɔ na ŋ kute anyi to. 10Anyi nɛ menyi ka daa wɔtɔ na gba, an chɛr ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ: “Ekama nɛ e maŋ shuŋ, men sa maŋ shin nɛ e ji.”
11Ŋkpal manɛ so, an nu fanɛ men be beko wɔ ntɔl be kebaawɔtɔ to nna a maa shuŋ shɛŋ nsaa wɔtɔ a kilgi to fanɛ menyi ka bee shuŋ na. 12Anyee kaŋɛ nsaa fiɛ le be basa so Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be ketre to fanɛ b ta bumo be amu boeŋ a wora bumo be ashuŋ a bela bumo gbagba be amu.
13Bekurgepoana, men sa maŋ shin nɛ kelela be kewora e baa gben menyi. 14Nɛ ekama nɛ e kini kewora kusɔ nɛ anyee kaŋɛ menyi kawɔl ere to ere, men baa de amodoŋwura so a gelge mo nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ mo. 15Men sa maŋ ta mo ŋ ki men doŋ, ama men fiɛ mo so fanɛ ekurgepo.
Lalaloge be mmalga be asheŋ
16To, kagbenewushi be Enyɛnpe na gbagba e sa menyi kagbenewushi saŋkama ashi kusɔ kama to. Enyɛnpe na e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ to.
17Ma Pɔɔl gbagba be enɔ to be kechɔrɔ be kasibɛ nde. Kananɛ mee dulgi ma nwɔl kikɛ nna na. Loŋ nɛ mee sibɛ.
18An Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ so.

Title: 1 TIMOTI 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ n la Kristo Yesu be eshuŋipo ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ an be Emɔlgapo be keparso nɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ an be tama wɔ mo so na kutɔ nna 2a yɔ fo Timoti nɛ fo la m pibi kashenteŋto ashi yirda na to na kutɔ. Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Kristo Yesu an Nyɛnpe e baa sa fo kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kuwɔr nɛ kagbenewushi.
Befɛpo ŋinipo be asheŋ
3Ŋ ka daa yɔ Masɛdonia, ŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ fo shir a wɔ Ɛfeses. Mee sha fanɛ fo baa kraa wɔ ndoŋ ŋkpal basa nɛ b wɔ ndoŋ a ŋini keŋini pɔtɛ nɛ a daga fo ka ju bumo loŋ to na so. 4Shin nɛ b lar ablɔmbi fuloŋ nɛ kakurge to be mmalga tenteŋana na to. Loŋ be mmalga bee bar emɔrɔ nna a maa ŋini kabɔrɛbɛso nɛ k bee shi yirda to na. 5Anyi ere be keŋini ere be kumu e la kasha nɛ k shi kagbene cheembi nɛ nfɛra lela nɛ yirda kpakpaso to na nna. 6Basa ko bre lar le be asheŋ ere to n foe a wɔ emɔrɔ fuloŋana to. 7Baa sha kebaala mbra na be beŋinipo nna, ama b maa pin bumo gbagba be mmalga na nɛ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a malga kenyiso na to.
8An nyi fanɛ mbra na la kusɔ lela nna nɛ esa baa bɛ kumo so nɛ kumo be ekpa so nna na. 9Anyi alɛ naa nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ bar mbra na nna ŋkpal basa lela so. E bar kumo nna ŋkpal basa nɛ baa wora a da ntaŋ na so ŋko bumo nɛ b maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ ŋko a bunyaŋ mo na so so. Alubiworapoana nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ du cheembi nɛ bɔrɛkinipoana nɛ bumo nɛ baa mɔ bumo tutoana nɛ bumo nioana nɛ basa pɔtɛ na so e shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ bar mbra na. 10Mo alɛ naŋ bar mbra na nna ŋkpal kesakaleawuraana nɛ benyɛn nɛ bumo gbagba kɔ abar a di na nɛ bumo nɛ baa yuri basa a fin kasɔji na nɛ befɛpo nɛ basa nɛ b maa yɛ asheŋ a wora na nɛ bumo nɛ baa wora asheŋ nɛ a maa bɛ kashenteŋ be keŋini na so kuraa na kikɛ so. 11Le nɛ nɛfa be Ebɔrɛ na be baru lela nɛ kemaŋkura wɔ kumo to nɛ b ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na bee ŋini.
Pɔɔl ka bee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
12Mee chɔrɔ Yesu Kristo an Nyɛnpe ŋkpal e ka sa ma le be kushuŋ ere be eleŋ nseŋ yirda ma n lara ma fanɛ n shuŋ mbe kushuŋ nsaa maŋ ta dra na be mmalga lubi nɛ n daŋ malga ŋ gbiti mo na nɛ kananɛ n tɔrɔ mbe basa nseŋ fɛl mo na n wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to so. 13Ama e wu ma kuwɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ ka daa maŋ yirda na so e shin nɛ n wora kawulisheŋ na. 14An Nyɛnpe bugi kagbene n wu ma kuwɔr ga nseŋ sa ma yirda nɛ kasha ashi Kristo Yesu to. 15Le be kamalga ere la kashenteŋ nna, kumo alɛ maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ kikɛ fanɛ: Kristo Yesu ba durnya to nna nɛ e ba mɔlga basa ashi bumo be alubi to, ma alɛ be alubi e shi a chɔ ekama peya. 16Ama Ebɔrɛ wu ma, alubiworapoana be ejuŋkparpo na kuwɔr nɛ e ŋini durnyaebi kananɛ Kristo Yesu be kanyiti ka shi nɛ b yirda mo nseŋ nya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.
17Bunyaŋ nɛ epaŋ be kedi e baa wɔ Ewurgboŋ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to saŋkikɛ na nɛ mo koŋwule nɛ e la kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ta kenishi fuful n wu mo kikɛ na so mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.
18M pibi Timoti, mee ta asheŋ nɛ ŋ ŋini fo ere nna a bɔla mmalga nɛ anebiana na daŋ wu ŋ kaŋɛ fo asheŋ na so a bɔɔ fo enɔ. Baa ta amo a wɔtɔ fo kagbene to nsaa kɔ yirda nɛ nfɛra lela a ki fo akɔsɔ a kɔ yirda be kena lela na. 19Basa ko bre kplaŋ le be akɔsɔ ere so nseŋ foe yirda be ekpa na so cheche. 20Loŋ be basa na be beko e la Haimɛneeyes nɛ Alɛkzaanda nɛ n ta m bɔɔ Setani enɔ nɛ b pin fanɛ k daga b ka lar kebaamalga a gbiti Ebɔrɛ to.

Title: 1 TIMOTI 2
Content:
Asɔri to be kabɔrɛshuŋ be asheŋ
1To, kusɔ nɛ mee sha kejuŋkpar ŋ kaŋɛ e la fanɛ a daga fanɛ bebɛsopo e baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa basa kikɛ. B baa kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ basa be asheŋ tirso be asheŋ nsaa kule mo asɔ a sa bumo nseŋ naa chɔrɔ mo a sa bumo a ti so. 2B baa wora asheŋ ere a sa basa kikɛ, fɔnfɔŋ bewura nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ kenimu be yiri kikɛ to na. Loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ an baa wɔ abɔrɛsheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to boeŋ nɛ bunyaŋ nsaa kɔ kagbenewushi. 3Le be asɔ la asɔ lela nna 4nsaa par Ebɔrɛ nɛ e mɔlga anyi nsaa sha fanɛ basa kikɛ e nya kumɔlga nseŋ pin kashenteŋ be keŋini na. 5Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ koŋwule nɛ enyiŋgbasa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be nferinto be ematapo koŋwule nɛ baa tre Kristo Yesu Nyiŋgbasa na nawule e wɔtɔ. 6Mo e ta mbe kumu n sɔ basa kikɛ n yige. Kumo e naa ŋini kumo be jemanɛ na gbagba chap fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha basa kikɛ ka nya kumɔlga. 7Amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara ma fanɛ m baa la eshuŋipo nɛ nnyamase be eŋinipo a bɔ yirda nɛ kashenteŋ be kubɔya na. M maa fule nna, kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji.
8Mee sha nna fanɛ kaplɛkama benyɛn nɛ b maa ta bumo be enɔana a shuŋ alubi e baa maŋ amo so kabɔrɛkule to nsaa maa keta kanya agbo ŋko a kini keyirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee nu kabɔrɛkule.
9Mee sha nna fanɛ beche malɛ e baa nyi asheŋ nsaa buu asɔ nɛ a bee kukwe a yulge bumo so nɛnɛ. B sa maa kre bumo be amu kenyishaso ŋko a buu yawu kpakpaso be asɔbuuso ŋko a wɔtɔ shuwa nɛ yawu kpakpaso be abitasɔ nsaa wu bumo be amu kamoowuso. 10Asɔ nɛ a daga b ka wora nɛ basa e wu e la alelasheŋ nɛ a daga beche nɛ b yɛ baa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ. 11A daga fanɛ beche e baa yɔɔ bumo be amu a lo to boeŋ a nu keŋini. 12Ma alɛ maŋ sa ekpa fanɛ eche kama e baa ŋini benyɛn abɔrɛsheŋ ŋko e baa kɔ eleŋ benyɛn so. Ama a daga fanɛ e baa lo mbe kɔnɔ boeŋ. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so, Adam nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ pɔr pɔɛŋ nseŋ pɔr Hawa. 14Mannɛ Adam malɛ nɛ Setani daŋ juŋkpar n fule, eche na nɛ Setani daŋ fule nɛ e tɔr alubi to. 15Ama nɛ eche baa wɔtɔ a kurge nsaa yirda Ebɔrɛ nseŋ naa sha basa a kɔ kanyiasheŋ a wɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi to nsaa du boeŋ a wɔtɔ, e beeŋ nya kumɔlga.

Title: 1 TIMOTI 3
Content:
Basa nɛ b daga kenimu asɔri to be asheŋ
1Le be kamalga ere maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ fanɛ esa kama nɛ e yili kumo mbe kagbene to fanɛ e beeŋ ki asɔri to be ejuŋkparpo lara ashuŋ kikɛ to be kelela. 2Amoso, a daga fanɛ asɔri to be ejuŋkparpo e baa la esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ amoso. A daga fanɛ e baa la eche koŋwule wura a nyi asheŋ a maa nya agbo jigajiga, ama e baa fɛ nfɛra dede a la esa nɛ basa bee sa bunyaŋ. A daga fanɛ e baa la esa a sha basa nsaa tiŋ a ŋini basa abɔrɛsheŋ na nɛnɛ. 3E sa maa nuu nsa ga ŋko a la esa brembreŋ, ama a daga fanɛ e baa du boeŋ nsaa maa la elushapo ŋko a ta mbe kagbene a wɔtɔ amansherbi to. 4Ama a daga fanɛ e baa tiŋ a keni mbe eche nɛ mbia so nsaa tiŋ a shin nɛ mbe mbia e baa nu a sa mo bunyanso. 5Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e maŋ nyi kananɛ e beeŋ keni mo gbagba be kowu to ebi so, nuso nɛ e beeŋ wora ŋ keni Ebɔrɛ be asɔri to ebi so? 6Esa nɛ e la asɔri to be ejuŋkparpo na daga e ka chɛr kebɛso na to nna, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, e beeŋ luri kamoowu to nɛ Ebɔrɛ e ji mo kumo be demu fanɛ kananɛ Setani daŋ wora nɛ Ebɔrɛ gberge mo kusoe na. 7A daga fanɛ loŋ be enimu e baa kɔ ketre basa pɔtɛ nɛ b maŋ wɔ asɔri to na to, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, e beeŋ nya ketre lubi nseŋ tɔr Setani be kejigbelɛ to n wora alubi.
Asɔri to be bechɛtopo be asheŋ
8A daga fanɛ asɔri to be bechɛtopo gba e baa kɔ da lela nsaa maa la besheŋjipo ŋko nsanuupoana ŋko a kɔ kejimuni. 9A daga fanɛ b baa kɔ kashenteŋ be wulo nɛ Ebɔrɛ bugi to ŋ ŋini na to kpakpa nɛ nfɛra lela. 10Pɔɛŋ nɛ b ki bechɛtopo asɔri to, a daga basa ka keni bumo be kebaawɔtɔana to nɛnɛ ŋ keni ŋko loŋ be kenimu daga bumo a. 11Bumo be beche gba e baa kɔ da lela nsaa maa ji bumo braana be asheŋ. A daga fanɛ b baa fɛ nfɛra dede a la beshenteŋjipo. 12A daga fanɛ asɔri to be bechɛtopo e baa la beche koko wuraana nsaa tiŋ a shin nɛ bumo be beche nɛ mbia e baa nu a sa bumo nɛnɛ. 13Nɛ bechɛtopo baa shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ nɛnɛ, basa bee sa bumo bunyaŋ nna nɛ b baa tiŋ a kaŋɛ basa kenyɛnso fanɛ b yirda Kristo Yesu kashenteŋ.
Wulogboŋ na be asheŋ
14K maaŋ naŋ chɛr ko nɛ m ba wu fo, ama mee sibɛ asɔ ere nna a sa fo, 15saŋɛ na so ŋ kaŋ maŋ naŋ tiŋ m ba manaŋ, kawɔl ere beeŋ ŋini fo kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ anyi nɛ an la Ebɔrɛ be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ baa tre ŋkpa to be Ebɔrɛ be asɔri na ka wora. Asɔri na e kɔ kashenteŋ be keŋini na to nsaa keni kumo so. 16Kashenteŋto,
esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ
anyi be keŋini ere nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara ŋ ŋini ere
maŋ la keŋinigboŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
k bee ŋini esa nɛ e ta nyiŋgbasa be eyur nna
n shi ebɔrɛso m ba durnya to be asheŋ.
Mo nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na daŋ kaŋɛ anyi fanɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi na,
emalaika daŋ wu mo
nɛ basa bɔ mbe kubɔya nnyamase to
nɛ durnya to be basa yirda mo.
Mo koŋwule na nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin
nɛ e luri to n yɔ kemaŋkura be ŋkpa na to.

Title: 1 TIMOTI 4
Content:
Befɛpo be keŋini be asheŋ
1Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na baŋ kaŋɛ geeŋ fanɛ lalaloge be nchɛ ere to basa ko beeŋ lar kashenteŋ be keŋini ere to nsaa nu a sa efɛ be mbuibi lubi a wɔtɔ a koya amo be keŋini. 2Le be keŋini ere shi kebirkɔnshi be befɛpo nɛ nfɛra lubi deŋ bumo na kutɔ nna. 3Asɔ nɛ basa na bee ŋini na e la fanɛ a maŋ daga beche nɛ benyɛn e baa kil abar, kumo alɛ maŋ naŋ daga basa ka ji ajibi ko. Le be ajibi ere malɛ, Ebɔrɛ to amo nna n sa basa, nɛ basa nɛ b yirda Yesu Kristo a nyi kashenteŋ na e chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ n sɔ amo nɛ enɔ anyɔ. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ to walɛ nna, amoso, a maŋ daga basa ka kini kumo. A daga fanɛ basa ka sɔ kumo kabɔrɛkule so nɛ enɔ anyɔ. 5Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na nɛ kabɔrɛkule na nɛfa kumo nɛ k ki kusɔ lela Ebɔrɛ be anishito.
Yesu Kristo be kenya be asheŋ
6Nɛ fo ŋini bekurgepoana na asheŋ ere, feeŋ baa la Kristo Yesu be kenya lela a kɔ yirda be mmalga nɛ keŋini lela nɛ fo bɛ so na be eleŋ. 7Baa gelge chilchil be mmalga nɛ edaŋkare be mmalga nɛ a maa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nseŋ ŋini fo kumu abɔrɛsheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ. 8Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa be kebaakeni mbe eyur so la kusɔ lela nna, ama esa baa ŋini mbe kumu abɔrɛsheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ, loŋ e bɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, k beeŋ tiŋ n chɛ mo to durnya ere to nfe nseŋ naŋ chɛ mo to saŋɛ nɛ e beeŋ yɔ ebɔrɛso na. 9Le be kamalga ere la kashenteŋ nna, kumo alɛ maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ kikɛ kumo to. 10Anyee shuŋ ga a maŋ kɔ kachena ŋkpal an ka ta anyi be yirda n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e kɔ ŋkpa nsaa la basa kikɛ be Emɔlgapo, fɔnfɔŋ bumo nɛ b yirda mo na to so.
11Ŋini basa asɔ ere nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo kenishipereso fanɛ b baa bɛ amo so. 12Sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kama e fɛl fo ŋkpal fo ka la kabrantiɛbia so, ama shin nɛ beyirdapo na e keni fo kebaawɔtɔ to ŋ koya asɔ ashi fo mmalga nɛ fo da to nɛ fo kasha nɛ fo yirda nɛ kananɛ fo maŋ kɔ kusɔ jigaya be nfɛra to. 13Pɔɛŋ nɛ m ba, baa kraŋ abɔrɛsibɛ na a sa asɔri to ebi a leŋ bumo to nsaa ŋini bumo abɔrɛsheŋ na. 14Loŋ na fo maaŋ gal kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ fanɛ fo wora saŋɛ nɛ basa wu fo asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ nɛ benimu daŋ ta enɔana n deŋi fo so ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa fo na n lɛ. 15Baa wora asɔ ere nseŋ ta fo kagbene kikɛ n wɔtɔ amo to nɛ basa kikɛ e wu kananɛ fo abɔrɛsheŋ be kenyi bee wora keshi a ti so. 16Baa de so a keni fo kumu nɛ fo abɔrɛsheŋ be keŋini na so nɛnɛ. Baa wora asɔ ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ e naaŋ mɔlga fo nɛ bumo nɛ baa nu fo mmalga na.

Title: 1 TIMOTI 5
Content:
Kebaakeni bebɛsopo kikɛ so be asheŋ
1Sa maŋ kaa ponte enyɛnnimu so, ama baa malga mo kutɔ a leŋ mo to fanɛ kananɛ feeŋ wora fo tuto kurgeso. Baa leŋ mbrantiɛbia to fanɛ kananɛ feeŋ wora fo sipoana gbagba. 2Baa leŋ bechenimu to fanɛ kananɛ feeŋ wora fo nio kurgeso. Baa leŋ besuŋgurbi to fanɛ kananɛ feeŋ wora fo sipocheana gbagba nsaa maa kɔ kusɔ jigaya be nfɛra.
3Baa bunyaŋ bekulpoche nɛ b maŋ kɔ bechɛtopo na. 4Ama ekulpoche kama nɛ e kɔ mbia ŋko benanabi, a daga fanɛ mbe mbia na nɛ mo nanabiana na ka pin fanɛ bumo e daga b ka nu n sa Ebɔrɛ ŋ keni bumo gbagba be kanaŋ to be esa so. Loŋ na kelela nɛ baa wora a tal bumo nioana nɛ bumo tutoana nɛ bumo nanaana na to na, kumo alɛ be loŋ e naa par Ebɔrɛ. 5Ekulpoche gbagba nɛ e maŋ kɔ esa kikɛ nɛ e bee keni mo so be tama wɔ Ebɔrɛ so nna fanɛ e baa chɛ mo to. Mo alɛ baa wɔtɔ nna a kule Ebɔrɛ kapa nɛ kanyɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e chɛ mo to. 6Ama ekulpoche nɛ e ta mbe nfɛra n wɔtɔ ebel be keji to wu nna nsaa wɔ basa to na. 7Ta le be mmalga ere n fiɛ asɔri to ebi na so nɛ b bɛ amo so nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ wu kulubi bumo so. 8Ama eche kama nɛ e maa keni mo kurgepoana so, fɔnfɔŋ basa nɛ b mata mo na, yige kebaakɔ anyi be yirda na to nna na. Esa nɛ e maŋ yirda Yesu Kristo na malɛ gba bɔ loŋ be esa.
9Ekulpoche nɛ e chɔ nfɛ adeshe, mo alɛ nseŋ naa la eche nɛ e kil kela koŋwule ŋ ku so, nɛ esa nɛ ekama nyi e ka la alelashenworapo 10nɛ emo nɛ e tiŋ ŋ keni mbe mbia so nɛnɛ nɛ b daŋ, nɛ emo nɛ e la esa, nɛ emo nɛ e bar mbe kumu kaseto n sa Ebɔrɛ be bebɛsopo ŋko n chɛ awurfoŋ ŋko tɔrɔ be mbia to nseŋ wora kelela be yiri kikɛ, ber mo n wɔtɔ bekulpoche nɛ b daga kechɛto na to.
11Sa maŋ kaŋ ber bekulpoche nɛ b maŋ la beche kpar n wɔtɔ bumo nɛ b daga kechɛto na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ benyɛn be kayɛlga baŋ ba pɛ bumo nɛ b naa sha kekil, baa lar Yesu Kristo be kebɛso na to nna, 12saŋɛ na so n tɔr kɔnɔ nɛ b juŋkpar n nase fanɛ baaŋ bɛ Yesu Kristo na so na be ntaŋ. 13Kumo be kaman b wɔtɔ nna a jija bumo be saŋɛ a na basa pe, kumo alɛ be buushi nɛ b fara a ji asheŋ nsaa luri basa be asheŋ to a wɔtɔ a malga mmalga nɛ a maŋ nya bumo. 14Amoso, ma ere kutɔ, a daga fanɛ bekulpoche nɛ b maŋ la beche kpar ka kil ŋ kurge mbia nseŋ keni bumo be nwu so nsaa maa wora asheŋ kama nɛ a beeŋ shin nɛ edompo kama e nya ekpa n wu bumo kulubi. 15Mee malga asheŋ ere nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, bekulpoche ko nɛ b maŋ la beche kpar teŋ foe kashenteŋ be ekpa na so nsaa bɛ Setani so. 16A daga fanɛ ebɛsopo kama nɛ e kɔ bekulpoche mbe kanaŋ to ka bee keni bumo so nsaa maŋ baŋ yige bumo n sa asɔri to ebi. Nɛ le be bekulpoche bee nya kechɛto bumo kurgepoana kutɔ, asɔri na to ebi beeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni bekulpoche gbagba so.
Fo nɛ benimu be asheŋ
17Asɔri to be benimu nɛ baa juŋkpar bumo be basa nɛnɛ daga b ka bunyaŋ bumo ga, fɔnfɔŋ bumo nɛ baa bɔ kubɔya na nɛ bumo nɛ baa ŋini abɔrɛsibɛ na. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “A maŋ daga esa ka kre kena nɛ e bee shuŋ ajibi akpa be kɔnɔ,” nɛ “A daga eshumpo ka nya mbe kakɔka.” 19Esa koŋwule baŋ ba kaŋɛ fo enimu ko be kulubi be asheŋ, sa maŋ nu n sa mo epul na to she eshɛdajipoana wora benyɔ ŋko besa nna. 20Benimu nɛ b wɔ alubi to na, fiɛ bumo so asɔri to ebi na kikɛ be anishito nɛ kufu e pɛ bumo nɛ b ka na. 21Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ emalaika nɛ b lara n yili na be anishito nɛ n yil a kaŋɛ fanɛ fo nu n sa le be keŋiniana ere nsaa maŋ kpal fo ka nyi esa ko be kebaawɔtɔ so a ji mo ŋkpɛatoso be demu. 22Sa maa nya manaŋ a ta fo enɔ a deŋi esa kikɛ so a ta mo a bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ kabɔrɛkule to. Fo alɛ e sa maŋ kaŋ luri basa pɔtɛ be alubi to ŋko kusɔ jigaya be kebaawɔtɔ to.
23Sa maŋ naa nuu nchu nawule, baa nuu waindibi be nsa gba gbrɛgbrɛ nɛ a baa chɛ fo epun to be alɔ.
24Basa ko be alubi baŋ fuli nna geeŋ a juŋkpar bumo a yɔ kasogberge to. Beko malɛ be alubi bee ŋana nna loŋ pɔɛŋ n ya lar efuli kacha ko. 25Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ basa bee wu alelasheŋ gba ka fuli a dese geeŋ, hale amo nɛ a ŋana naniere gba beeŋ lar efuli so kacha ko.

Title: 1 TIMOTI 6
Content:
Anya be asheŋ
1A daga fanɛ anya kikɛ e baa sa bumo nyɛnpeana bunyaŋ kikɛ nɛ k daga nɛ basa pɔtɛ e sa maŋ nya ekpa m malga kulubi kikɛ ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ be ketre ŋko anyi be keŋini na. 2Anya nɛ bumo nyɛnpeana la beyirdapo e sa maŋ kpal b ka la bumo to ebi so a fɛl bumo. Bumo e daga fanɛ b bugi kagbene n shuŋ gba nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, beyirdapo nɛ beshapo e naa ji bumo be kushuŋ be tɔnɔ. Ŋini basa asheŋ ere kikɛ nseŋ leŋ bumo to nɛ b bɛ amo so.
Befɛpo nɛ kashenteŋ be dama be asheŋ
3Esa kama nɛ e kɔ keŋini pɔtɛ a ŋini nsaa maa nu a sa Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kashenteŋ be mmalga na nɛ kashenteŋ be abɔrɛsheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ an baa wɔtɔ na la esa nɛ kamoowu tan nna nɛ e maŋ nyi shɛŋ. 4Loŋ be esa bee kaa ta mbe kasha kikɛ nna a wɔtɔ emɔrɔ be keji to nsaa kpal mmalga so a bile. Asheŋ ere kikɛ malɛ e naa bar yurkishi nɛ kolu nɛ basa be kebaatege abar nɛ kebirkɔnshi be kebaawora abar basa to 5nɛ basa be kebaaji abar emɔrɔ fanɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ nfɛra a maŋ naa nyi kashenteŋ be ekpa na ŋkpal b ka bee tama fanɛ abɔrɛsheŋ to nɛ baaŋ bɔla n nya amansherbi so.
6Ama esa nɛ e wɔ abɔrɛsheŋ na be kebaawɔtɔ to nsaa shin nɛ asɔ nɛ e kɔ bee bɔlɔ mbe kenishi a kukwe mo na nawule e la damawura. 7An ka bee ba durnya ere to an maŋ bar shɛŋ, anyi alɛ naa lar kumo to, anyi maaŋ tiŋ n ta shɛŋ n lar. 8Amoso, nɛ an baa kɔ ajibi nɛ asɔbuuso, a kukwe anyi. 9Ama basa nɛ baa sha kedii dama bee luri kechɔŋkeni to nna n tɔr kawulisheŋ nɛ ayɛlgasɔ damta be kejigbelɛ to nɛ a doro bumo m mur bumo. 10Ŋkpal manɛ so, amansherbi be kasha ga to nɛ kulubi be yiri kikɛ bee shi. Ŋkpal amansherbi be kasha ga so basa ko foe yirda be ekpa na so n luri kagbenejija damta to.
Asɔ nɛ Pɔɔl ta m bɔɔ Timoti enɔ be asheŋ
11Ama fo ere ka la Ebɔrɛ be esa ere, baa gelge le be asɔ ere kikɛ nsaa kɔ a fin alelasheŋ nɛ abɔrɛsheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ yirda nɛ kasha nɛ awurfoŋ to be kanyiti nsaa du boeŋ. 12Pere kenishi a kɔ yirda to be kolu lela na. Baa kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar nɛ b tre fo n wɔtɔ kumo to saŋɛ nɛ fo yili basa damta to n ji fo shɛda na to. 13Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee sa kusɔ kikɛ ŋkpa nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ e yili Gomena Pɔnshes Pailat be anishito n ji shɛda lela na be anishito nɛ n yil a kaŋɛ fo fanɛ fo baa nu a sa asɔ nɛ ŋ ŋini fo na kikɛ 14nsaa maŋ shin nɛ kulubi be yiri kikɛ e gbiti amo n chɛrga amo hale nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo e naaŋ ya lar m ba. 15Ebɔrɛ, bewura to be Ewura nɛ benyɛnpe to be Enyɛnpe nɛ durnya kikɛ be Ekenipo koŋwule nɛ e kɔ nɛfa na malɛ e naaŋ shin nɛ Yesu Kristo be kenamba na e fo jemanɛ na gbagba. 16Mo nawule kpeŋ e maa wu kikɛ nsaa wɔ kefulto parrbi nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ keni kumo kikɛ na to. Esa kama malɛ maŋ naŋ wu mo ŋ ku so, ekama malɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wu mo kikɛ. Bunyaŋ nɛ kuwurji nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar e baa wɔ mo so. Amɛn.
Damawura be asheŋ
17Ŋini bumo nɛ b kɔ dama durnya ere to na fanɛ b sa maa wu bumo be amu ŋko a ta bumo be yirda a deŋi bumo be asɔ so, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m pin kananɛ mbe asɔ beeŋ chɛr a wɔ mo kutɔ. Kusɔ nɛ k daga damawuraana ka wora e la b ka yirda Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e naa bugi kagbene a kɛ anyi asɔ yɛlyɛla so nɛ an baa ta a wushi an be ŋgbene. 18Ŋini bumo fanɛ b baa wora kelela nsaa la basa a bugi ŋgbene a sa basa bumo be asɔ na be ako. 19Le be asheŋ ere e naaŋ shin nɛ b nya asɔ nɛ baaŋ fute n yige so kachako so. Nɛ baa wora loŋ, baaŋ nya ŋkpa gbagba na.
20Timoti, baa de kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ na so nɛnɛ nsaa gelge chilchil be emɔrɔ be mmalga nɛ a maa par Ebɔrɛ nɛ efɛ be keŋini nɛ baa tre kashennyi be keŋini na. 21Ŋkpal manɛ so, basa ko ka kaŋɛ fanɛ b kɔ le be kashennyi na maŋ naa wɔ yirda na to.
Ebɔrɛ e sa menyi kikɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na.

Title: 2 TIMOTI 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ n la Kristo Yesu be eshuŋipo ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be keparso nɛ ŋkpal kɔnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ sa basa nɛ b yirda Kristo Yesu ŋkpa na so kutɔ nna 2a yɔ fo, m pibi shaso Timoti kutɔ. Ebɔrɛ Etuto nɛ Kristo Yesu an Nyɛnpe na e sa fo kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kuwɔr nɛ kagbenewushi.
Kabɔrɛchɔrɔ nɛ keleŋ n wɔtɔ yirda na to be asheŋ
3Mee chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ ŋ kɔ nfɛra lela a shuŋ fanɛ kananɛ n nananyɛnana shuŋ mo na. Saŋkama, kapa nɛ kanyɛ nɛ n nyiŋi fo asheŋ, mee di mo epaŋ nna. 4M baŋ nyiŋi fo anishichubi na be asheŋ, m baa sha kewu fo nna nɛ ma kagbene e fuli ma. 5Mee kaa nyiŋi kagbene koŋwuleso be yirda nɛ fo kɔ. Yirda koŋwule nɛ fo nanache Lowis nɛ fo nio Yunis daa kɔ na gbagba chap nɛ m baa nyi fanɛ fo alɛ gba kɔ na. 6Amoso nɛ mee nyiŋi fo fanɛ fo shin nɛ kakɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta n wɔtɔ fo to saŋɛ nɛ n daŋ ta ma enɔana n deŋi fo so kabɔrɛkule to na e baa wora keshi a nyɛrga a ti so fanɛ edɛ na. 7Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kiyoyu nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa anyi na maŋ la kufu peya nna, k la eleŋ nɛ kasha nɛ kamootiŋ be kiyoyu nna.
8Amoso, sa maŋ shin nɛ keji an Nyɛnpe na be shɛda be asheŋ ŋko ma nɛ n wɔ kabuti to ŋkpal mo so ere be asheŋ e baa wora fo anishinyɔr kikɛ. Ama fo alɛ gba e baa bɔla eleŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa fo na so a shuli a ji awurfoŋ ŋkpal baru lela na so. 9Ebɔrɛ mɔlga anyi nna nseŋ tre anyi fanɛ an ba ki mbe basa ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ mo gbagba yili nɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ so, mannɛ kusɔ nɛ an wora so, Kristo Yesu so nɛ e bɔla n wu anyi kuwɔr pɔɛŋ nɛ kusɔ kikɛ fara dra dra na kikɛ. 10Ama naniere le be kesheŋ ere lar efuli ŋkpal anyi be Emɔlgapo Kristo Yesu be keba na so. Mo e bar luwu be eleŋ kikɛ ekar nseŋ bɔla baru lela na so ŋ ŋini anyi ŋkpa nɛ k maa loge na.
11Ebɔrɛ lara ma nna fanɛ m baa la baru lela na be emalgapo nɛ eshuŋipo nɛ eŋinipo. 12Kumo alɛ so nɛ mee ji le be awurfoŋ ere na. Ama kumo alɛ maŋ kɔ ma anishinyɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, n nyi esa nɛ n yirda, ma alɛ maa ji kumo emɔrɔ fanɛ e beeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni kusɔ kama nɛ e ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ so hale n ya fo kachɛ na. 13Baa kɔ kashenteŋ be mmalga nɛ ŋ ŋini fo na to kpakpa a bɛ amo so nɛ yirda nɛ kasha nɛ a wɔ Kristo Yesu to na. 14Baa kɔ asheŋ lela nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ e wɔ anyi to na ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ na to kpakpa.
15Fo nyi fanɛ Eeshia be efuli so ebi kikɛ hale Figɛles nɛ Hɛmɔjines gba yige ma n to ŋko? 16Enyɛnpe e baa wu Onɛsifɔres be kowu to ebi kuwɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, e leŋ ma to ale damta. E daa maŋ wora ma kabuti ere be anishinyɔr kikɛ, 17mo alɛ ka baŋ ba Rom nɛ e kɔ n fin ma loŋ hale n ya wu ma. 18Enyɛnpe e shin nɛ e nya kuwɔr ashi mo kutɔ kachɛ na. Fo alɛ gba nyi asɔ damta nɛ e wora n sa ma ashi Ɛfeses.

Title: 2 TIMOTI 2
Content:
Yesu be ekɔpo be asheŋ
1Amoso, fo ere m pibi, baa wɔ eleŋ nɛ k bee shi Yesu Kristo kutɔ a ba ŋkpal mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na so to 2nseŋ ta mmalga nɛ fo nu ŋ ka bugi to m malga basa damta be anishito na m bɔɔ basa nɛ fo yirda fanɛ bumo alɛ beeŋ tiŋ ŋ ŋini beko enɔ.
3Fo alɛ gba e baa kɔ kagbene a shuli a tu anyi a ji awurfoŋ fanɛ Yesu Kristo be soja lela. 4Soja kama nɛ e wɔ mbe kushuŋ to maa ta mbe nfɛra a wɔtɔ asheŋ pɔtɛ to a shin nɛ a baa tir mo, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, mbe asheŋ maaŋ par mbe enimu nɛ e bee keni mo so na. 5Eshilepo kama malɛ nɛ e maa bɛ eshile na be mbraana so maaŋ tiŋ n ji shɛŋ eshile na to. 6Baa kraa nyiŋi fanɛ edɔpo nɛ e bee shuŋ kushuŋ na ga na gbagba nawule e kɔ ekpa nɛ e tiŋ n fara a ji mbe adɔjibi popɔr. 7Baa fɛ le be asheŋ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fo ere be asheŋ nɛ Enyɛnpe e chɛ fo to nɛ fo pin kusɔ kama to.
8Baa nyiŋi baru lela nɛ ŋ kɔ a malga fanɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ e shi Ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to wu n tiŋi na. 9Baru lela na malɛ so nɛ mee ji awurfoŋ ere hale a wɔ ŋgbuliŋ to fanɛ esa nɛ e wora kulubi ko na. Ama esa malɛ kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga bre kegbuleŋ. 10Amoso nɛ mee ji awurfoŋ ere be kanyiti ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso na so nɛ bumo alɛ gba e tiŋ m bɔla Kristo Yesu so n nya kumɔlga nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.
11Le be kamalga ere la kashenteŋ nna fanɛ,
nɛ kashenteŋ nna fanɛ anyi nɛ mo e daŋ wu,
kumo ere anyi nɛ mo malɛ e naaŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to.
12Nɛ anyi maŋ pɔ aba nseŋ kraa ji kanyiti,
anyi nɛ mo e naaŋ ji kuwura basa so.
Ama nɛ an kini mo,
mo alɛ gba beeŋ kini anyi.
13Nɛ anyi ere kɔ nnɔkilgi gba,
mo ere maŋ kɔ kɔnɔkilgi, ŋkpal manɛ so,
e maaŋ tiŋ n wora asheŋ n da mbe da so.
Ebɔrɛ be eshumpo lela be asheŋ
14Baa ŋini fo basa asheŋ ere nseŋ fiɛ bumo so kpakpa Ebɔrɛ be anishito fanɛ b lar mmalga koko be emɔrɔana be nlu to, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be nlu maŋ kɔ kechɛto kikɛ amo to, a bee mur basa nɛ baa nu amo nna. 15Wora ania ga n ta fo kumu m bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ a shuŋ mo nɛnɛ. Baa la esa nɛ e bee ŋini kashenteŋ be mmalga na kumo be ekpa so. Loŋ na fo maaŋ luri kushuŋ na be anishinyɔr to. 16Baa gelge mmalga nɛ a maa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, a bee lara basa abɔrɛsheŋ be nfɛra to nna a shin nɛ baa luri alubi damta to a ti so. 17Keŋini nɛ basa wɔtɔ a ŋini na du fanɛ ketamɛ lubi nna a nyɛrga a sɔ esa be eyur kikɛ so. Le be beŋinipoana ere be beko e la Haimɛneeyes nɛ Failites. 18B foe kashenteŋ be ekpa na so ŋkpal b ka wɔtɔ a ŋini fanɛ basa be ketiŋi luwu to be jemanɛ na choŋ na so so. Baa wul basa ko to ashi bumo be yirda na to nna na. 19Ama kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ tɔl n yili maŋ kɔ kegbuŋgbuŋ kikɛ. Kasibɛ nɛ a deŋ kumo so malɛ nde: “Enyɛnpe na nyi basa nɛ b la mo peya.” Kusɔ nɛ k naŋ ti so e la: “Esa kama nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ e la Enyɛnpe peya, e lar alubi be kewora to.”
20Damawura be kowugboŋ to asɔ jito be yiri kikɛ e naa kaa wɔ ndoŋ. Gbiti nɛ b ta n lɔŋɛ ako nseŋ ta shuwa n lɔŋɛ ako. Ako malɛ, ndibi nɛ b ta n shɛl amo nseŋ ta ebɔ m pɔr ako malɛ. Nchɛgboŋ peya e la amo be ako nɛ ako malɛ la kachɛ kama be kejito peya. 21To, esa kama malɛ nɛ e lara mbe kumu ashi asheŋ jiga to, kumo ere e beeŋ baa la esa nɛ Enyɛnpe na bee lara nna nɛ e shuŋ kenishipereso be ashuŋ. Amodoŋwura mo Nyɛnpe beeŋ baa fute a yige mo so nseŋ ta kushuŋ lela kikɛ m bɔɔ mo enɔ. 22Amoso, baa gelge kebrantiɛ to be ayɛlgasɔ nsaa ta fo nfɛra a wɔtɔ alelasheŋ nɛ yirda nɛ kasha nɛ kagbenewushi to nɛ fo nɛ bumo nɛ b kɔ kagbene koŋwule cheembi a kule Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to. 23Baa gelge kawuliso nɛ chilchil be emɔrɔ fuloŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo nyi a ka bee bar nlu. 24A maŋ daga Enyɛnpe malɛ be kenya ka bee kɔ nlu. A daga fanɛ e baa la esa basa kikɛ kutɔ nseŋ naa la eŋinipo lela nɛ e kɔ kanyiti 25a wɔtɔ a yɔɔ mbe kumu nsaa ŋini basa nɛ baa ji mo emɔrɔ asheŋ amo be ekpa so. Nɛ e bee wora loŋ, shere Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bugi ekpa n sa bumo nɛ b tuba m bɛ kashenteŋ be ekpa na so 26nseŋ nya nfɛra n lar Setani be kejigbelɛ nɛ e ta m pɛ bumo n shin nɛ baa nu a sa mo na to.

Title: 2 TIMOTI 3
Content:
Lalaloge be nchɛ be asheŋ
1Baa nyi fanɛ lalaloge be nchɛ na to, tɔrɔ damta beeŋ tɔr basa so. 2Kumo be jemanɛ na so, basa beeŋ baa sha bumo nawule be amu nɛ amansherbi nsaa kɔ mpuchi damta nɛ kamoowu. Baaŋ baa kɔ nfɛl nsaa kini kenu n sa bumo tutoana nɛ bumo nioana nsaa la ebutuli a wɔtɔ a kplaŋ abɔrɛsheŋ so. 3Basa maaŋ ba kaa kɔ kasha nseŋ lar kuwɔr to nsaa kɔ efɛ be eshɛda. Baaŋ ba kaa wɔtɔ a diewu, bumo alɛ nsaa la basa ŋana so nseŋ ba kaa kishi kelela be yiri kikɛ. 4Baaŋ ba kaa la bedebɔrpoana nɛ basa brembreŋ nseŋ ta kamoowu m bɔlɔ bumo to nsaa sha durnya ere to be ebel a chɔ Ebɔrɛ. 5Baaŋ ba kaa kɔ abɔrɛsheŋ na ketreso nsaa kini amo be eleŋ. Baa gelge loŋ be basa! 6Bumo to be beko e naa ŋana a luri basa peana a pɔɔ beche nɛ b maa tiŋ a keta bumo be amu so na. Loŋ be beche, alubi e nyaŋ bumo ŋ keta nɛ ayɛlgasɔ be yiri kikɛ kɔ bumo to a wora kusɔ kama. 7Loŋ be beche beeŋ nu kusɔ kikɛ nɛ esa kikɛ bee kaŋɛ bumo, ama bumo alɛ maa tiŋ a nya kusɔ kama be ekpa be kanyiasheŋ. 8Kananɛ Janes nɛ Jambres daa maŋ nu n sa Mosis na gbagba chap nɛ le be benyɛn ere gba maa nu a sa kashenteŋ na. Bumo be nfɛra maŋ walɛ nɛ bumo be yirda malɛ la yirda fuloŋ. 9Bumo alɛ nɛ bumo be eda na maaŋ fo koshipe, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be alubi na beeŋ lar efuli nɛ ekama e wu amo fanɛ kananɛ Janes nɛ Jambres be asheŋ daŋ ki na.
Asheŋ nɛ Pɔɔl ta a bɔɔ Timoti enɔ be asheŋ
10Ama fo ere nyi ma keŋini na kikɛ nɛ ma da nɛ ma kebaawɔtɔ be kifi to. Fo alɛ naŋ wu ma yirda nɛ ma kanyiti nɛ ma kasha nɛ kananɛ ŋ kɔ tɔrɔ be kanyiti. 11Fo alɛ kraa naa nyi etɔrɔ nɛ awurfoŋ nɛ n nya ashi Antiɔk nɛ Ikoniam nɛ Listra be asheŋ. N nyiti amo nɛ Enyɛnpe malɛ lara ma amo kikɛ to. 12Kashenteŋto, esa kama nɛ e bugi kagbene a sha kebɛ Kristo Yesu so, baaŋ tɔrɔ amodoŋwura. 13Ama basa lubi nɛ kebirkɔnshiwuraana bre, baa wɔtɔ nna a wora alubi a ti so nsaa fule beko nɛ Setani bee fule bumo alɛ gbagba.
14Ama fo ere, baa kɔ asɔ nɛ fo koya nseŋ yirda na to kpakpa nsaa nyiŋi esa nɛ fo koya amo mo kutɔ na. 15Baa nyiŋi kananɛ fo kebiato kikɛ nɛ fo pin abɔrɛsibɛ cheembi nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ n sa fo kanyiasheŋ nɛ k beeŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ fo bɔla keyirda Kristo Yesu so n nya kumɔlga na. 16Ebɔrɛ e wɔ abɔrɛsibɛ ere kikɛ be kaman nɛ amo alɛ walɛ keta ŋ ŋini kashenteŋ na nɛ keta n fiɛ bumo nɛ baa wora a jija so nɛ keta n lara esa kewora n foe to nɛ keta ŋ ŋini esa kebaawɔtɔ lela. 17Ade kikɛ e naaŋ shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be esa e tiŋ m bela ase ŋ kre to nɛnɛ n shuŋ kushuŋ lela kikɛ.

Title: 2 TIMOTI 4
Content:
1Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kristo Yesu nɛ e beeŋ ji bumo nɛ baaŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to nɛ bumo nɛ b wu na demu be anishito nɛ n yil nsaa kpal mbe kenamba na nɛ mbe kuwura na so a kaŋɛ fo fanɛ 2fo baa bɔ kubɔya na a sa basa. Kelela ŋko kulubi to kikɛ baa sha kebaabɔ kubɔya na a sa basa a shin nɛ b baa wu kananɛ kashenteŋ na baa dese geeŋ. Baa ta kubɔya na a fiɛ basa so ŋko a leŋ bumo to nsaa kɔ kanyiti a ŋini bumo abɔrɛsheŋ na. 3Saŋko beeŋ fo nɛ basa maaŋ naŋ nu kashenteŋ be keŋini na nsaa wɔtɔ a bɛ bumo gbagba be ayɛlgasɔ so. Baaŋ baa chala beŋinipo damta nɛ b baa ŋini bumo asɔ nɛ baa sha kebaanu. 4Baaŋ ti bumo be asoe n sa kashenteŋ na nseŋ bugi amo a nu edaŋkaresheŋ be ablɔmbi nɛ a maŋ kɔ kifi. 5Fo ere, baa kɔ fo kumu to nɛnɛ kusɔ kama to. Baa ji tɔrɔ be kanyiti nsaa wora kushuŋ nɛ k daga fanɛ baru lela be emalgapo kaa bee wora. Baa shuŋ kushuŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ na kikɛ nyam.
6Ma ere, jemanɛ nɛ baaŋ ta ma n lara sarga na fo nɛ jemanɛ nɛ meeŋ lar durnya ere to na fo n loge. 7Ŋ kɔ kolu lela na n loge nseŋ shile eshile na n loge, ma alɛ nseŋ naŋ keta yirda na m ba fo ekar. 8Naniere bre ma kejinlar be kakɛ e ka a jo ma nɛ n sɔ. Kumo be kamɔnchɛ Enyɛnpe nɛ e maa ji demu a puni na beeŋ ta kumo ŋ kɛ ma. Mannɛ n nawule, ama e beeŋ ta kumo ŋ kɛ bekama nɛ b kɔ kasha a jo mbe kelar m ba na gba n ti so.
Pɔɔl gbagba be mmalga nɛ e kɔ a sa Timoti be asheŋ
9Timoti, wora ania m ba ŋ kutɔ. 10Diimas bre luri durnya to be ayɛlgasɔ to nseŋ shile ma n yɔ Tɛsalɔnika. Krɛsent yɔ Galeesha nɛ Taites malɛ yɔ Dalmeesha. 11Luuk nawule e wɔ ŋ kutɔ. Fo kaa ba, fo shin nɛ fo nɛ Maak e ba, ŋkpal manɛ so, e kɔ kechɛto ga ma kushuŋ na to.
12N shuŋi Tikikes Ɛfeses. 13Fo kaa ba, ta ma piŋi nɛ n yige Kaapes kutɔ ashi Trowas na. Ta ebuku na, fɔnfɔŋ amo nɛ b ta kusɔbɔya be kawɔl n lɔŋɛ na.
14Alɛkzaanda bɔyɛpo shuŋ ma ashuŋ lubi damta ga. Enyɛnpe bee ka mo mbe ashuŋ na be kukɔ. 15Fo alɛ gba e baa de mo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa maŋ sa anyi be kubɔya na kashuli hale gbrɛ kikɛ.
16Kachɛ nɛ n fara m malga nɛ m mɔlga ma kumu na, ekama shile ma nna. Ebɔrɛ e ta m paŋ bumo. 17Ama Enyɛnpe bre maŋ shile ma, e sa ma eleŋ nna nɛ n tiŋ m bɔ kubɔya na kikɛ nyam n sa nnyamase na kikɛ nseŋ nya ŋ gelge ebuluŋ be nnɔ to be keluri. 18Enyɛnpe malɛ beeŋ lara ma ashi kulubi kikɛ to nseŋ yɛr ma mbe ebɔrɛso be kuwura to. Kemaŋkura e baa wɔ mo so hale mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.
Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
19Chɔrɔ Priska nɛ Akwila nɛ Onɛsifɔres be kowu to ebi n sa ma.
20Irastes shir a wɔ Kɔrint nɛ n yige Trɔfimes malɛ Mailites, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa lɔ nna.
21Wora ania m ba pɔɛŋ nɛ kechali e fo. Yubeles nɛ Pudɛns nɛ Laines nɛ Klawdia nɛ bekurgepoana nɛ b ka na kikɛ bee chɔrɔ fo.
22Enyɛnpe e baa kɔ fo kiyoyu to.
Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi so.

Title: TAITES 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pɔɔl nɛ n la Ebɔrɛ be kenya nɛ Yesu Kristo be eshuŋipo na kutɔ nna. B shuŋi ma nna nɛ m ba shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso be yirda e wora keshi n ti so nɛ loŋ e shin nɛ b baa kɔ kabɔrɛŋana bumo to nseŋ naa pin kashenteŋ nɛ anyi be kabɔrɛbɛso ere bee ŋini 2nɛ kumo be tama wɔ kenya ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na to na. Kumo be kɔnɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase pɔɛŋ nɛ kusɔ kikɛ fara na. Mo alɛ maa ku efɛ kikɛ. 3Jemanɛ nɛ mo ere Ebɔrɛ an be Emɔlgapo na gbagba bee sha na nɛ e bugi mbe kubɔya na to n sa basa nseŋ yili kumo fanɛ kubɔya na be kebɔ n sa basa be kushuŋ e baa la meya.
4Mee sibɛ kawɔl ere nna a sa fo Taites, m pibi kashenteŋto ashi yirda koŋwule nɛ an kɔ na to.
Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi nɛ a shi Ebɔrɛ Etuto nɛ an be Emɔlgapo Kristo Yesu kutɔ na e baa wɔ fo to.
Taites be kushuŋ ashi Kriit be asheŋ
5N daŋ yige fo Kriit nna nɛ fo wora asheŋ nɛ a daŋ ka kewora na nna. Asheŋ nɛ n daŋ ta m bɔɔ fo enɔ na e daa la fanɛ kade kama be asɔri to, fo lara benimu n sa ndoŋebi. 6Ŋ kaŋɛ fo fanɛ a maŋ daga loŋ be basa ka kɔ eda lubi. A daga fanɛ loŋ be basa e baa la beche koko wuraana nɛ bumo be mbia malɛ e baa la beyirdapo a kɔ kasonu nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ nya ekpa ŋ kuli bumo ŋkpal bumo be kusɔjigaya be kebaawɔtɔ so. A daga fanɛ b baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ lela. 7A daga fanɛ asɔri to be enimu ŋinipo nɛ e bee keni Ebɔrɛ be asɔri to ebi so na e sa maa kɔ kulubi kikɛ mbe kebaawɔtɔ to. A maŋ daga fanɛ e baa sha mo nawule be aparsheŋ ŋko a nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ ŋko a sha nsa ga ŋko a du nyaŋnyaŋ ŋko a ŋana a wɔ alubi be ekpa ko to a fin amansherbi. 8A daga fanɛ e baa la esa a sha befɔ nsaa sha kelela be yiri kikɛ. A daga fanɛ e baa tiŋ mbe kumu a wora asheŋ a ji asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so a sha abɔrɛsheŋ nsaa kɔ da lela nɛ e kɔ a wora asheŋ. 9A daga fanɛ e baa kɔ kubɔya nɛ k bɛ anyi be keŋini nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda na so to kpakpa. Loŋ na e beeŋ tiŋ n ta keŋini lela n leŋ basa to nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n ji m bri bumo nɛ baa ji emɔrɔ na.
10Ŋkpal manɛ so, amuleŋwuraana damta nɛ bumo be efɛ nɛ mmalga fuloŋ shi ndoŋ ga, fɔnfɔŋ bebɛsopo nɛ b shi Juwebi be kanaŋ to na. 11A daga fanɛ fo shin nɛ bumo kikɛ e lo bumo be nnɔ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, baa shin nɛ nwuchu lelemu bee bure nseŋ kpal amansherbi so a wɔtɔ a ŋini anishinyɔr be asheŋ nɛ a maŋ daga. 12Bumo gbagba to be eko nɛ baa tre anebi na e daŋ kaŋɛ le: “Saŋkama Kriitebi la befɛpo nɛ asɔbɔya lubi nɛ ajibishapo tɔlpoana nna.” 13Kashenteŋ be kamalga nna, amoso, baa fiɛ bumo so kenishipereso nɛ b baa wɔ kashenteŋ be yirda na to. 14Shin nɛ b sa maŋ naa nu a sa Juwebi be adrasheŋ be ablɔmbi nɛ mbra nɛ a shi basa nɛ b kini kashenteŋ na kutɔ na. 15Basa nɛ b du cheembi, kusɔ kama malɛ du cheembi nna bumo kutɔ, ama bekama nɛ b maŋ du cheembi bumo alɛ nsaa maŋ kɔ yirda na, shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ du cheembi bumo kutɔ. Bumo be ŋgbene nɛ bumo be nfɛra fɛso kikɛ maŋ lar so. 16B yɛ b nyi Ebɔrɛ, bumo alɛ nsaa kini mo ashi bumo be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ asheŋ woraso to. Bumo be alubisheŋ nɛ bumo be amuleŋ maŋ kɔ ebarkasa, b maŋ walɛ kelela be kusɔ kama be kewora.

Title: TAITES 2
Content:
Kashenteŋ be keŋini be asheŋ
1A daga fanɛ fo ere e baa ŋini asɔ nɛ a bɛ kashenteŋ be keŋini na so. 2Kaŋɛ benyɛnnimuana na fanɛ b sa maa du brembreŋ. B baa kɔ nfɛra nsaa tiŋ bumo be amu nseŋ naa kɔ kashenteŋ be yirda na nɛ kasha nɛ kanyiti. 3Loŋ koŋwule na e daga fo ka kaŋɛ bechekparana na fanɛ b baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi. A maŋ daga fanɛ b baa la emalaŋfiki ŋko n shin nɛ kasanuu e baa pɔɔ bumo so. 4A daga fanɛ b baa ŋini asɔ nɛ a walɛ nsaa ŋini beche kurgepoana kananɛ baaŋ baa sha bumo kulana nɛ bumo be mbia, 5nɛ kananɛ baaŋ baa tiŋ a keta bumo be amu a maŋ kɔ kulubi nsaa maa kɔ ntɔl epe nsaa la basa a wɔtɔ a nu a sa bumo kulana nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ nya ekpa m malga kulubi kikɛ ŋ gbiti kubɔya nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na.
6Loŋ koŋwule na e daga fo ka kaŋɛ mbrantiɛbiana na fanɛ b baa tiŋ bumo be amu. 7Kusɔ kama nɛ fo alɛ gbagba bee wora, shin nɛ k baa la kesheŋ nɛ basa beeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni so n wora asheŋ lela. Baa kɔ kashenteŋ nɛ kenishipere a wɔtɔ fo keŋini to. 8Shin nɛ kusɔ kama nɛ fee malga e baa kɔ kashenteŋ nɛ anishinyɔr e ji edoŋ kama nɛ e sa maŋ nya kulubi kikɛ m malga ŋ gbiti anyi.
9Kaŋɛ anya nɛ b baa nu a sa bumo nyɛnpeana nsaa wora bumo be aparsheŋ kusɔ kama to. A maŋ daga fanɛ bumo nyɛnpeana e fiɛ bumo so nɛ bumo alɛ e malga, ŋko nɛ b baa yuri bumo nyɛnpeana be asɔ. 10A daga fanɛ b baa ŋini fanɛ saŋkama b la anya lela nna a maŋ kɔ kebirkɔnshi a wora asheŋ. Loŋ na Ebɔrɛ, anyi be Emɔlgapo be asheŋ ŋiniso na beeŋ nya mbo ashi asheŋ nɛ baa wora kikɛ to.
11Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ k bee bar kumɔlga basa kikɛ so na lar efuli. 12Le be kuwɔr be kakɛ ere e naa ŋini anyi fanɛ an yige kabɔrɛfɛl nɛ durnya to be ayɛlgasɔ nsaa wɔ kamootiŋ nɛ kashenteŋ nɛ kabɔrɛŋana be kebaawɔtɔ to anyi be jemanɛ ere to. 13An baa wɔ amo to nsaa jo kachɛ nɛ b nɛfa nɛ anyi be tama wɔ kumo so na. Kumo be kamɔnchɛ nɛ an be Ebɔrɛ Gboŋ, Emɔlgapo Yesu Kristo na be kemaŋkura beeŋ lar efuli. 14E ta mo gbagba be kumu n sa anyi nɛ e tiŋ m mɔlga anyi ashi alubisheŋ kikɛ to nseŋ ta anyi ŋ ki basa cheembi nɛ an baa la mo nawule peya m bugi kagbene a wɔtɔ a sha kebaawora alelasheŋ.
15Baa ŋini asheŋ ere a leŋ basa na to nsaa ta fo kejuŋkpar be eleŋ kikɛ na a fiɛ bumo so. Sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e fɛl fo.

Title: TAITES 3
Content:
Bebɛsopo be kebaawɔtɔ be asheŋ
1Baa nyiŋi fo basa nɛ b baa ta bumo be amu a sa basa nɛ baa keni bumo so nɛ bumo be efuli so be bewuraana nsaa shuli a wora ashuŋ lela kikɛ. 2Kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b sa maa malga alubi a gbiti esa kikɛ, bumo alɛ e sa maŋ la basa nɛ baa bar kebagato, ama b baa sha basa keteri nsaa ta da nɛ k du boeŋ a ŋini basa kikɛ. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋko anyi alɛ gba daŋ wuli nna a kɔ kumuleŋ nɛ ashuŋ lubi. An daa la anyi be eyurana be ayɛlgasɔ nɛ ebel be yiri kikɛ be anya nna. An daa wɔ kayurbesa be nfɛra lubi to nna a kishi beko nɛ beko malɛ daŋ kishi anyi. 4Ama Ebɔrɛ, an be Emɔlgapo ka ba lara mbe kelela nɛ kasha ŋ ŋini basa kikɛ na nɛ e mɔlga anyi. Mannɛ anyi gbagba be kelela be asheŋ woraso ko so nɛ e mɔlga anyi. 5E mɔlga anyi nna ŋkpal mo gbagba ka bee wu kuwɔr na so. E bɔla kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ bee bɔla kumo so a sa anyi kakurge popɔr nɛ kebaawɔtɔ popɔr na so nna m mɔlga anyi. 6E bɔla Yesu Kristo, an be Emɔlgapo so n shin nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na ba buu anyi so nyam. 7Ŋkpal mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ na so e kpra anyi be alubi ashi anyi so nɛ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar nɛ anyee tama na e ki anyeya.
8Kesheŋ ere la kashenteŋ nna. Mee sha fanɛ fo ta kenishipere nna n wɔtɔ le be asheŋ ere to nɛ bumo nɛ b ba yirda Ebɔrɛ na e baa wɔ ashuŋ lela be kebaawɔtɔ to. Le be mmalga ere la kashenteŋ nna nɛ a beeŋ chɛ basa to. 9Ama baa gelge kawuliso be emɔrɔ nɛ kekurgeso be mmalga nɛ nlu. Fo alɛ e sa maŋ naŋ kpal mbra na so a wɔ kɔnɔgberge to, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo kikɛ la asheŋ fuloŋ nna a maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ. 10Esa kama nɛ e bee ta basa be amu a ŋmɛa abar a shin nɛ baa barga abar, fiɛ amodoŋwura so ale anyɔ, nɛ e kraŋ kini a wora loŋ, fo shin nɛ fo nɛ mo e sa maŋ naa kɔ shɛŋ. 11Baa nyi fanɛ loŋ be esa be nfɛra maŋ walɛ. Alubi nɛ e wɔtɔ a wora nɛ alubi na malɛ gba bee ŋini e ka maŋ kɔ kashenteŋ.
Lalaloge be keŋini be asheŋ
12Ŋ kaŋ shuŋi Aatemas ŋko Tikikes fo kutɔ, wora ania m ba ma kutɔ ashi Nikɔpɔlis, ŋkpal manɛ so, ndoŋ nɛ mee sha fanɛ m baa wɔ awo be jemanɛ ere to. 13Wora ania n chɛ Zinas demujipo na to nɛ Apɔlɔs to nɛ b nya bumo be enite na be ekpa nseŋ naŋ nya kusɔ kama nɛ k daga fanɛ b nya. 14Shin nɛ an peebiana na e ŋini bumo be amu alelasheŋ be kebaawora, saŋɛ na so, baaŋ baa tiŋ a nya karechɛ kama be asɔ nɛ a daga nsaa maŋ baa wɔtɔ jiga loŋ a maa bar asɔrso kama.
15Bekama nɛ b wɔ ma kutɔ nfe ere bee chɔrɔ fo. Chɔrɔ bekama nɛ baa sha anyi ashi yirda na to na.
Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ so.

Title: FAILIMƆN 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma, Pɔɔl nɛ n wɔ kabuti to ŋkpal Kristo Yesu so nɛ an kurgepo Timoti kutɔ nna a yɔ an teri lela nɛ an barkasa eshumpo Failimɔn 2nɛ an sipoche Apfia nɛ Akipes nɛ e la an barkasa soja na nɛ asɔriebi nɛ baa shɛr fo Failimɔn pe na kutɔ.
3Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ an Tuto nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo kutɔ na e baa wɔ menyi so.
Kabɔrɛkule nɛ kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
4Saŋkama mee nyiŋi menyi kabɔrɛkule to nna nsaa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal menyi so. 5Ŋkpal manɛ so, mee nu kasha nɛ yirda nɛ men kɔ a sa Enyɛnpe Yesu nɛ beyirdapoana na kikɛ be asheŋ. 6Ma alɛ naa kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ kananɛ menyee malga men be yirda be asheŋ a sa basa na beeŋ shin nɛ men nya kanyiasheŋ n ti so nseŋ pin asɔ lela damta nɛ an bɔla Kristo so a kɔ na kikɛ nyam. 7Ekurgepo, kasha nɛ fo kɔ na leŋ ma to ga n shin nɛ ma kagbene fuli ma ga, ŋkpal manɛ so, fo leŋ beyirdapoana na to.
Pɔɔl ka kule n sa Onisimɔs be asheŋ
8Ŋkpal Kristo so n nyi ŋ ka daa beeŋ tiŋ n nya kagbene ŋ kaŋɛ fo kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ fo wora, 9ama kasha so nɛ ma Pɔɔl bel le nseŋ naa wɔ kabuti to ŋkpal Kristo Yesu so 10a kule fo a sa m pibi Onisimɔs nɛ ŋ ki mo tuto abɔrɛsheŋ na be kaplɛa so ashi kabuti ere to nfe na. 11Saŋɛ na e daa maa kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ a sa fo, ama naniere bre e kɔ tɔnɔ a sa ma nɛ fo kikɛ kashenteŋto.
12Mee bɛta mo nna a bar fo a sha fo ka pin fanɛ ma ere kutɔ ŋ gbagba be kaba nɛ mee ta a shoŋi fo na. 13N daa beeŋ baa sha fanɛ e yili fo katelamu to nfe a shuŋ ma kabuti nɛ n wɔ to ŋkpal baru lela na so ere. 14Ama m maa sha kelar fo kaman n wora kusɔ nɛ k maaŋ par fo nɛ fo gbagba be kelela e ki fanɛ tintiŋ be kusɔ, ama kusɔ nɛ k shi fo gbagba be kagbene to.
15Shere kumo so nɛ e daŋ lar fo kutɔ nchɛnnyɔ na nɛ e naŋ ya bɛta m ba kaa wɔ fo kutɔ mbaanaayɔ. 16Naniere e maŋ naa la kenya, e chɔ kenya. E ki ma nɛ fo kikɛ be ekurgepo shaso naniere. Mee sha mo ga, ama kasha nɛ feeŋ baa kɔ a sa mo beeŋ baa shi a chɔ meya ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, e la fo kenya nna nseŋ naa yirda Enyɛnpe na.
17Amoso, nɛ fo baa nyi fanɛ ma nɛ fo la kukoŋwule nna, kumo ere fo sɔ mo fanɛ kananɛ fo daa beeŋ sɔ ma gbagba. 18Nɛ fanɛ e wora fo kulubi ko nna ŋko n ji fo kukɔ, fo ta kumo be kukɔ na n deŋi ma. 19Ma Pɔɔl gbagba e naa ta ma enɔ a sibɛ fo kede ere a kaŋɛ fo le na fanɛ meeŋ ka loŋ be kukɔ kikɛ, ma alɛ maaŋ bishi fo kɔnɔ kikɛ fanɛ fo alɛ gba ji ma kukɔ nna ŋkpal fo ŋkpa ere so. 20Amoso, ekurgepo, jande kpal Enyɛnpe na so n wora ma kelela. Leŋ ma to fanɛ fo kurgepo ashi Kristo to.
21Ŋ ka bee sibɛ kawɔl ere a sa fo ere, m baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ feeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ mee kaŋɛ fo ere, hale n wora asheŋ nɛ a chɔ loŋ gba kuraa. 22Kumo be kaman, lɔŋɛ ebu ko n yili ma, ŋkpal manɛ so, ŋ kɔ tama fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nu men kikɛ be kabɔrɛkule nseŋ lara ma n sa menyi.
Ŋkela be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
23Epafras nɛ e la m barkasa kabutipo ŋkpal Kristo Yesu so na bee chɔrɔ fo. 24Maak gba nɛ Aristaakes nɛ Diimas nɛ Luuk nɛ bumo kikɛ la m braana beshumpo na bee chɔrɔ fo.
25Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ men be ayoyu to.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 1
Content:
Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ sa anyi mbe kamalga be asheŋ
1Dra na Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔla anebiana so nna m malga ale damta ashi ekpa damtaana so n sa an nananyɛnana. 2Ama naniere, lalaloge be nchɛ ere bre to mo Pibinyɛn so nɛ e bɔla m malga n sa anyi. Mo Pibinyɛn na so nɛ e to esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ. Ebi na malɛ nɛ e lara fanɛ mo e naaŋ ba kaa wɔ kusɔ kikɛ. 3Ebi na nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura bɔla mo so n nyaŋɛ n dii efuli fanɛ kefulto na. Mo e la Ebɔrɛ be da be kaduli gbagba chap nsaa ta mbe kamalga nɛ k kɔ eleŋ ga na a kɔ durnya ere to. Mo alɛ ka daŋ kpra basa be alubi ashi bumo to n loge na, e ya chena ebɔrɛso Enyɛnpetale be jisoso nna, ebunyampo be kakpa.
Ebinyɛn na ka chɔ emalaika kikɛ be asheŋ
4Ebinyɛn na malɛ baa chɔ emalaika kikɛ nna fanɛ kananɛ ketre nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa mo na malɛ gba chɔ bumo be atreana na.
5Ŋkpal manɛ so, malaika mo malɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ le:
“M Pibinyɛn e la fo. Kabre ŋ ki fo Tuto”?
Ŋko kede be kaman, malaika mo malɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ:
“Meeŋ baa la mo Tuto nɛ mo alɛ gba e baa la m Pibinyɛn”?
6Ade be kaman, Ebɔrɛ ka daa sha kebar mo Pibinyɛn juŋkparso na durnya to na, le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ:
“A daga fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be emalaika kikɛ ka bunyaŋ mo.”
7Le nɛ mo alɛ naŋ malga mbe emalaika koŋwule na be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Ma, Ebɔrɛ bee shin nɛ ma emalaika bee wora fanɛ afu nna
nɛ ma anya malɛ bee wora fanɛ edɛ
a chɔɔ wuloŋwuloŋ.”
8Ama Ebinyɛn na bre be asheŋ, le nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ:
“O Ebɔrɛ, fo kuwura beeŋ baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
Kashenteŋ malɛ nɛ feeŋ baa kɔ a ji kuwura fo basa so
ashi fo kuwura na to.
9Fo sha asheŋ nɛ a bɔla ekpa Ebɔrɛ be anishito nseŋ kishi alubisheŋ,
amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ, fo Ebɔrɛ na lara fo nseŋ ta fo ŋ ki ejuŋkparpo na.
Kagbenefuliso be ŋku nɛ e ta ŋ gbiti fo
m bunyaŋ fo a chɔ fo braana.”
10Ebɔrɛ koŋwule na e naŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ:
“Faraŋko na fo, Enyɛnpe na e to kasawule
nseŋ ta fo gbagba be enɔana n wora esoso.
11Kachako esa maaŋ naŋ wu amo kikɛ, ama fo alɛ beeŋ ka a wɔtɔ.
Amo kikɛ beeŋ ki adra fanɛ asɔbuuso na.
12Feeŋ bɔɔ amo to fanɛ piŋi na nɛ a chɛrga fanɛ asɔbuuso.
Ama fo alɛ maa chɛrga kikɛ, fo alɛ maa bel kikɛ.”
13To, nɛ malaika mo malɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Ba chena ma jisoso nfe
hale nɛ n ya ta fo doŋana nɛ b ba gbir fo kumuli”?
14To, kananɛ emalaika be asheŋ du Ebɔrɛ be anishito nna na. Bumo kikɛ la ayoyu nna a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee shuŋi bumo nɛ baa chɛ bumo nɛ baaŋ nya kumɔlga na to.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 2
Content:
Kumɔlgagboŋ na be asheŋ
1Amoso, a daga fanɛ an ka bugi asoe to nɛnɛ n nu asɔ, nɛ an nu na, saŋɛ na so, an maaŋ firgi n foe ekpa n choŋ. 2Baru mo nɛ k daŋ bɔla emalaika so m ba na daa la kashenteŋ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e daa maŋ bɛ bumo so ŋko n nu n sa loŋ be kubɔya na, amodoŋwura daa nya kumo be kasogberge nɛ k daga mo nna. 3To, nɛ an baŋ kplaŋ le be kumɔlga gboŋgboŋi ere so, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora ŋ gelge kasogberge? Enyɛnpe gbagba e daŋ fara m bɔ kumɔlga na be kubɔya n sa basa, nɛ bumo nɛ b daŋ nu kumo mo kutɔ na malɛ ŋini anyi fanɛ k la kashenteŋ nna. 4Kumo alɛ be buushi, Ebɔrɛ gba bee bɔla etɔɔnɛsheŋ nɛ emamachisheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ be nnaŋ to be aworbi to nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na be ŋkɛana nɛ e bee chige to a sa basa ashi mo gbagba be keparso na to a ji shɛda fanɛ kumɔlga na la kashenteŋ nna.
Yesu ka ki fanɛ dimɛdi be asheŋ
5Ebɔrɛ malɛ maŋ ta durnya nɛ k beeŋ ba kachako so nɛ anyeeŋ malga kumo be asheŋ ere m bɔɔ emalaika enɔ. 6Ama esa ko malga kesheŋ ere abɔrɛsibɛ na to be kakpa ko fanɛ:
“Manɛ e baa la dimɛdi nɛ mbe asheŋ wɔ fo Ebɔrɛ be kagbene to ere,
ŋko manɛ e baa la dimɛdi be kusɔ kurgeso
nɛ fo Ebɔrɛ bee keni mo so ere?
7Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ gbrɛbi ko fo daŋ shin nɛ emalaika daa chɔ mo nna.
Keni, fo ta kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ m buu mo fanɛ kuwura na,
8nseŋ ta kusɔ kikɛ m bɔɔ mo enɔ.”
Kekaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ ta kusɔ kikɛ m bɔɔ mo enɔ ere bee ŋini fanɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ ti asɔ na so. Naniere bre, anyi maŋ naa wu kusɔ kama ka bee nu a sa mo. 9Ama Yesu bre, an wu b ka ta kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ m buu mo fanɛ kuwura. Ama saŋɛ gbrɛbi ko Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ emalaika daa chɔ mo nna ŋkpal luwu be awurfoŋ nɛ e ji na so, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ wu n sa basa kikɛ ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kakɛ so.
10Kumo alɛ baŋ fuli nna a dese fanɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ asɔ kikɛ wɔtɔ ŋkpal mo so nseŋ naa wɔtɔ a sa mo na e shin nɛ Yesu bɔla awurfoŋ to ŋ ki esa cheembi, saŋɛ na so emo nɛ e yɛr bumo kumɔlga to na beeŋ bar basa damta nɛ b ba tu mo a ji mbe kemaŋkura be ebel na be ako. 11Basa nɛ b lara nɛ b ki Ebɔrɛ be basa na nɛ bumo be elarapo Yesu kikɛ shi kanaŋ koŋwule to nna. Amoso nɛ ketre bumo mo niopibiana maa wora mo anishinyɔr na. 12Loŋ malɛ so e shin nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ:
“Ebɔrɛ, meeŋ malga fo asheŋ n sa n niopibiana,
nseŋ di fo epaŋ ashi nshɛr to ebi na kikɛ be anishito.”
13Mo koŋwule na e kaŋɛ le:
“Meeŋ yirda mo.”
Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Ma nɛ basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ ma enɔ na kikɛ nde.”
14Kumo alɛ ŋkpal basa na ka kɔ dimɛdi be eyur nɛ ŋklaŋ na so mo gbagba sɔ bumo be kapɔr koŋwule na nna, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ bɔla luwu to m mur esa nɛ e kɔ luwu be eleŋ na. Mo e la Setani na. 15Saŋɛ na malɛ so, e beeŋ sɔ basa nɛ b la luwu be kenya be anya ashi bumo be kebiato na kikɛ n yige. 16Ŋkpal manɛ so, k baŋ fuli nna geeŋ fanɛ mannɛ emalaika nɛ e bee chɛ to, Eebraham mo nanabiana nɛ e bee chɛ to. 17Ŋkpal le malɛ so, a daga fanɛ mo gbagba e ki fanɛ mo niopibiana ashi ekpa kama so, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ baa la bumo be kuwɔrwupo be bɔrɛmatapo nɛ basa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Nɛ mo alɛ wora loŋ, basa beeŋ nya bumo be alubi be ketampaŋ bumo. 18To, naniere, ŋkpal mo gbagba ka luri kechɔŋkeni to n lar nseŋ ji amo be awurfoŋ na so, e beeŋ tiŋ n chɛ bumo nɛ baa luri kechɔŋkeni to na to.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 3
Content:
Yesu ka chɔ anebi Mosis be asheŋ
1Amoso, n niopibi larasoana nɛ men la bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre a yɔ ebɔrɛso na, men ta menyi be anishi n yuu Yesu nɛ e la anyi be yirda ere be eshuŋipo nɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na so ŋ keni kananɛ e du. 2E daa maŋ lar esa nɛ e shuŋi mo na kaman fanɛ kananɛ anebi Mosis daŋ bugi kagbene n shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be kowu to ebi kikɛ na. 3Ama Yesu e chɔ anebi Mosis bunyaŋ ga fanɛ kananɛ ebupɔrpo chɔ ebu na gbagba bunyaŋ na. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa e naa pɔr ebu fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ bee pɔr kusɔ kikɛ nyam na. 5Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ anebi Mosis ka daa maŋ lar Ebɔrɛ kaman fanɛ kayɛrbi ashi Ebɔrɛ be kowu to ebi kikɛ to nseŋ daa ji asheŋ nɛ a beeŋ wora kachako so be shɛda na. 6Ama Kristo bre bugi kagbene nna fanɛ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn a keni Ebɔrɛ be kowu to ebi so. Nɛ anyi alɛ baa kɔ anyi be kenyɛn na nɛ tama nɛ anyee puchi kumo so na to kpakpa, kumo ere an la Ebɔrɛ na be kowu to ebi nna na.
Kenambɛta kaman be asheŋ
7To, loŋ malɛ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“Men baŋ nu Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl kabre,
8men sa maŋ wora menyi be ŋgbene kpakpa fanɛ kananɛ b daŋ koso a kɔ Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ na.
Kumo be jemanɛ na e daa la kiyi to be kechɔŋkeni be saŋɛ na.
9Ebɔrɛ yɛ: Ndoŋ nɛ men nananyɛnana daŋ chɔ ma ŋ keni nseŋ daŋ wora ma ŋ keni na. Ama bumo alɛ daŋ wu kusɔ nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ daŋ wora nfɛ adena na kikɛ to.
10Amoso nɛ n daŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ bumo saŋɛ na ebi
nseŋ kaŋɛ le na fanɛ: ‘Saŋɛ na kikɛ bumo be ŋgbene bee foe ekpa nna
nɛ b maa pin ma ekpaana be asheŋ.’
11Amoso, n daŋ ta agbo nna m bɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ:
‘B maaŋ luri ma kewushi na to kikɛ.’ ”
12Ŋ kurgepoana, men baa da so nɛ menyi to be ekama e sa maa kɔ kagbene mo nɛ k lubi nɛ kumo nɛ k maŋ yirda nɛ e sa maŋ shin nɛ amodoŋwura e foe Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na be ekpa na so. 13Nɛ saŋɛ baa wɔtɔ nɛ baa tre kabre be saŋɛ, men baa leŋ abar to, saŋɛ na so, alubi be kafulesheŋ kama maaŋ shin nɛ menyi be ekama be kagbene e ki kpakpa. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an baa kɔ anyi be sososo be tama na to kpakpa n ya fo ekar, kumo ere anyi nɛ Kristo e kɔ kachige koŋwule. 15Kumo alɛ nɛ men teŋ nu na fanɛ:
“Men baŋ nu Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl kabre,
men sa maŋ wora menyi be ŋgbene kpakpa
fanɛ kananɛ b daŋ koso saŋko
a kɔ Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ na.”
16To, nɛ basa mo e koso a kɔ mbe eleŋ na? Mannɛ basa nɛ anebi Mosis daŋ juŋkpar n lar Ijipt be efuli so na e daa la a? 17Nɛ basa mo nɛ e daŋ nya agbo n wɔtɔ nfɛ adena kikɛ na? Mannɛ bumo nɛ b daŋ wora alubi kiyi to nɛ bumo be eyurana daŋ shir ndoŋ na a? 18To, nɛ basa mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ bɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ b maaŋ luri mbe kewushi na to na? Mannɛ bumo nɛ b daa maŋ nu n sa Ebɔrɛ na a? 19To, an wu fanɛ b ka daa maŋ tiŋ n luri Ebɔrɛ be kewushi na to na yirda nɛ b daa maŋ kɔ so.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 4
Content:
Kewushiachɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa kɔ be asheŋ
1Amoso, ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kewushi na to be keluri be kɔnɔ naseso na ka kraa dese so, men shin nɛ an baa da so nɛ kumo be saŋɛ kaŋ fo, b maaŋ wu anyi be ekama ka paŋ keluri kumo to. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so, kananɛ baru lela na daŋ ba anyi to nɛ an nu kumo na gbagba na nɛ bumo alɛ gba daŋ nya kumo. Ama kumo alɛ daa maŋ wora bumo shɛŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, b ka daŋ nu kumo na, b daa maŋ ta yirda n sɔ kumo. 3To, naniere anyi nɛ an yirda ere e naa luri Ebɔrɛ be kewushi na to na. Loŋ malɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“N daŋ nya agbo nna nseŋ bɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ:
‘B maaŋ luri ma kewushi na to kikɛ.’ ”
Ama baŋ yili saŋɛ nɛ e to durnya na kikɛ m ba fo kabre mbe kushuŋ loge. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ e malga kakpa ko ŋ kaŋɛ kachɛ shunusopo na be asheŋ fanɛ: “Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ wushi kachɛ shunusopo na ashi mbe ashuŋ na kikɛ to nyam.” 5Kumo alɛ nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ nfe na fanɛ: “B maaŋ luri ma kewushi na to.” 6Bumo nɛ b daŋ fara n nu baru lela na daa maŋ luri kewushi na to ŋkpal b ka daa maŋ kɔ kasonu so, ama basa ko kraa wɔtɔ nɛ b nya kewushi na to n luri. 7Amoso, e naŋ yili kachako n tre kumo kabre. Kumo be kaman pɔɛŋ nɛ e naŋ ba bɔla Ewura Deevid so ŋ kaŋɛ kesheŋ nɛ an teŋ kraŋ fanɛ:
“Kabre nɛ men baŋ nu Ebɔrɛ be ebɔl,
men sa maŋ wora menyi be amu kpakpa na.”
8Kede e naa ŋini fanɛ nɛ Joshuwa daŋ shin nɛ b luri kewushi na to nna, Ebɔrɛ daa maaŋ naŋ malga kachako malɛ be asheŋ. 9Amoso, k bee ŋini fanɛ kewushi ko nɛ kachɛ shunusopo peya na kraa jo Ebɔrɛ be basa nna na. 10Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e luri Ebɔrɛ be kewushi to bee wushi ashi mo gbagba be ashuŋ to fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ wushi ashi mbe ashuŋ to na.
11Amoso, men shin nɛ an wora ania ga n luri kewushi na to nɛ esa kama maaŋ ta kasomaanu m bɛ bedarapo na be aya so n foe ekpa.
12Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na kɔ ŋkpa nɛ eleŋ nna a ji a chɔ tokobi jinnɔnyɔ. K bee tiŋ a ku a barga nfɛra nɛ kiyoyu to nseŋ naa tiŋ a barga awibichɛkpa nɛ nfɔ to, ŋ gbrɛ a tiŋ a ji basa be nfɛra to be asɔ shaso nɛ bumo be ŋgbene to be nfɛra fɛsoana demu. 13Kusɔ toso kikɛ maŋ wɔtɔ a ŋana Ebɔrɛ so. Kusɔ kikɛ nyam dii efuli nna n dese mbe anishito, mo alɛ nɛ anyi kikɛ beeŋ yili mbe anishito ŋ kaŋɛ mo ashuŋ nɛ an wora kikɛ nɛ kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ an wora amo.
Yesu ka la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be asheŋ
14An ka kɔ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nɛ baa tre mo Yesu, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn, nɛ e yɔ Ebɔrɛ gbagba be anishito na so, men shin nɛ an baa kɔ anyi be yirda nɛ anyee ji kumo be shɛda na be asheŋ to kpakpa. 15Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ fanɛ anyi be bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na la esa nɛ e maa wu anyi be asheŋ gbenso kuwɔr nna, ama e la esa nɛ e luri kechɔŋkeni kama to nna n lar fanɛ kananɛ anyi alɛ gba bee luri amo to na. Ama mo ere maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ. 16Amoso, naniere, men shin nɛ an nya kagbene m ba Ebɔrɛ na be kuwurputiakpa, kakpa nɛ kuwɔr be kakɛ wɔ na. Ndoŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wu anyi kuwɔr nɛ an nya kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ k beeŋ chɛ anyi to saŋɛ nɛ k daga na.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 5
Content:
Yesu ka la kuwɔrwupo be bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be asheŋ
1Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso kikɛ, mo braana edimɛdi to nɛ baa lara mo nɛ e bee yili bumo be katelamu to a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ nsaa bar Ebɔrɛ ŋkɛana nɛ esarga ŋkpal alubiana so. 2Ŋkpal asheŋ ka bee gben mo alɛ gba ashi ekpa damtaana to so e nyi kananɛ e beeŋ ta kanyiti a keni bumo nɛ b maŋ nyi nɛ basa mo nɛ baa foe na so. 3Ŋkpal loŋ so Ebɔrɛ nase kumo nna fanɛ e lara sarga. Mannɛ ŋkpal basa pɔtɛ be alubi nawule so, ama ŋkpal mo alɛ gbagba peya gba so. 4Esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n ta le be bunyaŋ be kushuŋ ere n sa mo gbagba be kumu. Ebɔrɛ nawule e naaŋ tre esa n ta loŋ be kushuŋ m bɔɔ mo enɔ fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ tre Ɛɛrɔn na nɛ e daŋ juŋkpar ŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na. 5To, loŋ nɛ Kristo gba daa maŋ ta bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be keki na be bunyaŋ n sa mbe kumu. Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ mo fanɛ:
“M Pibinyɛn e la fo, amoso,
kabre ŋ ki fo Tuto”
6Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ kakpa ko fanɛ:
“Feeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapo
nsaa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo
nɛ e shi Mɛlkizedɛk be kanaŋ to.”
7Yesu ka daa wɔ ŋkpa to durnya ere to na e daa ta kushu nɛ anishichubi nna a wɔ kabɔrɛkule to nseŋ daa kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e daa beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga mo ashi luwu to na mbe asheŋ tirso. Ebɔrɛ malɛ daŋ nu mbe kekule na ŋkpal mbe kabɔrɛŋana so. 8Kashenteŋto mo e daa la Ebinyɛn na, ama e daŋ bɔla mbe tɔrɔ to nna ŋ koya kusɔ nɛ k la kasonu. 9Ebɔrɛ malɛ ka baŋ shin nɛ e ki cheembi n loge so, mo so nɛ ekama nɛ e bee nu a sa mo beeŋ bɔla n nya kumɔlga nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na. 10Nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ ta mo ŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo nimuso ashi Mɛlkizedɛk be ekpa so.
Kebaade kefoe ekpa so be asheŋ
11Le be demu ere to an kɔ asɔ damta nɛ an malga, ama kekaŋɛ menyi asheŋ na nɛ men pin amo to du kpakpa nna ŋkpal men ka maŋ naa pin asheŋ na to manaŋ manaŋ na so. 12A daŋ daga fanɛ men baa la beŋinipo naniere, ama hale mbre she esa e naaŋ laŋɛ ŋ ŋini menyi kashenteŋ be abɔrɛsheŋ be sososo na, men maa pin to. A daŋ daga fanɛ men baa tiŋ a ji ajibi gbɛgbɛso naniere, ama kenyipo nɛ menyi alɛ kraa nuu na. 13Esa kama malɛ nɛ e kraa nuu kenyipo kraa la kebibi nna na, e maŋ naŋ pin Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ be keŋini to. 14Ama ajibi gbɛgbɛso bre la basa kpar nɛ bumo gbagba koya nsaa nyi kelela nɛ kulubi to na peya nna.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 6
Content:
1Amoso, men shin nɛ an baa yige sososo be asheŋ nɛ a bee kute Kristo na to nseŋ yɔ anishito n ya luri kenimufɛra be kebaawɔtɔ to. A maŋ naŋ daga an ka naŋ fara sososo be keŋiniana na a ŋini fanɛ an ka naa tɔl kelar aworbi nɛ a maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ Ebɔrɛ be anishito na to kikɛ. 2A maŋ daga fanɛ an naa ŋini keyirda Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ ŋko n naa ŋini menyi kabɔrɛbɛrana be keŋini nɛ enɔana be kebaata a deŋi basa so ŋko basa be ketiŋi luwu to be asheŋ nɛ demuji be kasogberge nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na be asheŋ kuraa. 3Men shin nɛ an baa yɔ anishito. Ebɔrɛ malɛ shuli, loŋ nɛ anyeeŋ baa wora.
4Ama basa nɛ b daŋ bar kefulto na to nɛ b ba ji ebɔrɛso be kakɛ na be ebel ŋ keni na nseŋ nya bumo be kachige ashi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na to pɔɛŋ nseŋ foe ekpa na bre be kenaŋ bɛta m ba Ebɔrɛ kutɔ maaŋ tiŋ n wora kikɛ. 5B tea nyi kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na walɛ n sa bumo nsaa nyi Ebɔrɛ be jemanɛ nɛ k bee ba na be eleŋ be asheŋ. 6Ade malɛ kikɛ nɛ b nyi nseŋ foe ekpa na. Amoso, kenaŋ bɛta bumo m ba kelar bumo be alubi to maaŋ tiŋ n wora, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo ere naa gbir Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na nna a mata kedibi largato na so nna na n naa ŋaba mo basa kikɛ be anishito.
7Ŋkpal manɛ so, kasawule kama nɛ k bee nu bɔrɛchu nɛ a bee kaa tɔr kumo so nsaa sɔr asɔrso nɛ a daga a sa basa nɛ b duu asɔ kumo so na bee nya Ebɔrɛ be nɛfa nna. 8Ama kasawule kama nɛ k bee kɔr ewidibiana nɛ ajinjɛ nawule la kasawule jiga nna, nɛ kumo alɛ maŋ de so, k beeŋ nya kɔnɔso nɛ kumo be kaman b chɔɔ kumo edɛ.
9Ŋ kurgepo shasoana, kashenteŋ nna nɛ anyee kaŋɛ le be asheŋ ere, ama menyi ere, an kɔ yirda fanɛ asheŋ lela wɔ menyi to. 10Ebɔrɛ maŋ la esa nɛ e maa wora asheŋ nɛ amo be ekpa so nna nɛ e teŋ menyi be kushuŋ na so nseŋ naŋ teŋ kechɛto nɛ men kpal kasha mo nɛ men kɔ a sha mo na so n chɛ mbe basa to nseŋ kraa chɛ bumo to na so. 11To, loŋ gbagba na nɛ anyee sha fanɛ menyi be ekama e baa kraa pere kenishi a du n ya fo ekar na, saŋɛ na so, asɔ nɛ menyee tama na beeŋ bɔla ekpa. 12Anyi maa sha fanɛ men ki betɔlpo, ama anyee sha fanɛ men baa kute bumo nɛ b ta yirda nɛ kanyiti n nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na to.
Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ naseso nɛ k maa chɛrga na be asheŋ
13Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ nase kɔnɔ n sa Eebraham na e daŋ bɔ mo gbagba be kumu nna fanɛ e beeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ e daŋ nase na, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kikɛ daa maŋ naa wɔtɔ a chɔ mo nɛ e bɔ n ti amodoŋwura be ketre. 14Le nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ Eebraham: “Kashenteŋ nɛ mee ji fo na fanɛ meeŋ nɛfa fo n sa fo kaman to ebi damta.” 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ Eebraham ji kanyiti loŋ n ya nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yɛ e beeŋ wora na. 16Nɛ basa baa bɔ ntaŋ, esa nɛ e chɔ bumo be ketre nɛ baa kaa ti a bɔ ntaŋ na a ji kashenteŋ a mɔ emɔrɔ kama nɛ k wɔ bumo be nfɛra to. 17Ebɔrɛ daa sha keŋini basa nɛ baaŋ nya kusɔ nɛ e nase kɔnɔ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ wora na fanɛ e maaŋ chɛrga mbe kɔnɔ naseso na kikɛ, amoso nɛ e bɔ ntaŋ n sa bumo na. 18Naniere an nya asɔ anyɔ nɛ a maaŋ tiŋ n chɛrga, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ ku efɛ kikɛ. Asɔ anyɔ na so nɛ anyi nɛ an shuli m mata Ebɔrɛ na beeŋ nya kagbene a kɔ kumɔlga be tama nɛ k wɔ anishito na to kpakpa. 19Le be tama ere e shin nɛ anyi be yirda nɛ k wɔ anyi be ŋgbene to na bee wora eleŋ nɛnɛ a yili fanɛ kananɛ baa chɛ ekuloŋ a muni na a jo saŋɛ nɛ anyeeŋ nya n luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi to na. 20Ndoŋ nɛ Kristo kpal anyi so n juŋkpar anyi n ya kaa wɔ na. Mo koŋwule na e ki bɔrɛmatapo nimuso ashi Mɛlkizedɛk be ekpa so.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 7
Content:
Bɔrɛmatapo Mɛlkizedɛk be asheŋ
1Mɛlkizedɛk nɛ anyee malga mbe asheŋ ere daa la Seelɛm be ewura nna nseŋ daŋ naa la Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be bɔrɛmatapo. Kachako Eebraham ya mɔ bewura ko ashi kena to nseŋ bɛta a yɔ epe nɛ Mɛlkizedɛk ya tu mo ekpa to nseŋ nɛfa mo. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ Eebraham sa Mɛlkizedɛk kusɔ kama nɛ e daŋ nya na be kudukudusopo. Kusɔ nɛ k juŋkpar Mɛlkizedɛk be asheŋ to e la fanɛ mbe ketre be kifito e la Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ be ewura. Kede malɛ be kaman Seelɛm be ewura e la mo, kumo e la fanɛ kagbenewushi be ewura. 3Esa maŋ nyi mo nio nɛ mo tuto be asheŋ ŋko mbe kanaŋ to be asheŋ. Esa malɛ maŋ naa nyi mbe kakurgeachɛ be jemanɛ ŋko saŋɛ mo nɛ e wu. E du fanɛ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn nna a la bɔrɛmatapo mo nɛ e wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ.
4Nɛ fo keni to feeŋ pin fanɛ Mɛlkizedɛk daa la esagboŋ nna pasaa, ŋkpal manɛ so, an nananyɛn Eebraham gba daŋ sa mo mbe kena to be kanya kikɛ be kudukudusopo nna. 5Anebi Mosis be mbra na malɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ a daga fanɛ Livai be kanaŋ to ebi nɛ b ki bɔrɛmatapoana na e baa sɔ bumo peebi Israɛlebi kudukudusopo ŋkeshin nɛ bumo alɛ gba la Eebraham mo nanabiana nna. 6Mɛlkizedɛk daa maŋ shi Livai be kanaŋ to, ama mo alɛ daŋ sɔ asɔ be kudukudusopo ashi Eebraham kutɔ nseŋ nɛfa mo Eebraham koŋwule nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta mbe nnɔ naseso n sa na. 7Ekama malɛ baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ esa nɛ e bee nɛfa mo barkasa e chɔ emo nɛ e bee nya nɛfa na ŋko? 8Nɛ fo keni to feeŋ wu fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na bre be kaplɛa so, basa nɛ baa wu e naa sɔ kudukudusopo na, ama Mɛlkizedɛk bre, esa nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ bee kaŋɛ fanɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na e daŋ sɔ kudukudusopo na. 9Amoso, esa beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Livai nɛ e bee sɔ kudukudusopo na gba bɔla Eebraham so nna ŋ ka mbe kudukudusopo nna na. 10Ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋɛ nɛ Eebraham tu Mɛlkizedɛk na nɛ b maŋ naŋ kurge Livai, amoso, anyi alɛ beeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ saŋɛ na so nɛ Livai kraa wɔ mo nananyɛn Eebraham na to.
Kananɛ Yesu nɛ Mɛlkizedɛk duli abar be asheŋ
11Nɛ fanɛ esa daŋ baŋ tiŋ m bɔla Livai be kanaŋ to be bɔrɛmatapoana na be ekpa so nna n nya kebaawɔtɔ cheembi loŋ malɛ be ekpa so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta mbra na n sa basa, a ji nuso nna nɛ a daŋ naŋ daga fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo pɔtɛ ka naŋ ba kaa du fanɛ Mɛlkizedɛk be ekpa so, mannɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso Ɛɛrɔn be ekpa so? 12Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ b baŋ chɛrga bɔrɛmatapoana na be keji ekpa, kumo ere, a daga b ka chɛrga mbra na gba. 13Esa nɛ asheŋ ere bee ji mbe asheŋ ere malɛ shi kanaŋ pɔtɛ to nna, esa kama maŋ naŋ lar kanaŋ na to n shuŋ bɔrɛsure na akpa kikɛ. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so, k baŋ fuli nna fanɛ Juda be kanaŋ to nɛ an Nyɛnpe na lar. Mosis malɛ maŋ malga shɛŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kanaŋ na ti bɔrɛmatapoana na so.
15Kusɔ nɛ an naa kaŋɛ ere malɛ gba e naa bugi ashuŋ na to nɛnɛ gba kuraa fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo popɔr ko malɛ fanɛ Mɛlkizedɛk naŋ lar. 16Mo ere, mannɛ dimɛdi be ekpaana so nɛ e bɔla ŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo, ŋkpa nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n jija so nɛ e bɔla ŋ ki. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ Yesu fanɛ: “Feeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapo mbaanaayɔ Mɛlkizedɛk be ekpa so.” 18Amoso, kesheŋ naseso dra na maŋ naa wɔ asheŋ to nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, k daa maŋ kɔ eleŋ, kumo alɛ maŋ naa kɔ tɔnɔ. 19Ŋkpal manɛ so, Mosis be mbra na daa maŋ tiŋ n ta shɛŋ ŋ ki cheembi. Ama naniere tama popɔr naŋ ba nɛ an bɔla kumo so n firgi n taga Ebɔrɛ to.
20Kumo be kaman Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋ gba wɔtɔ, ama bumo na bre ka ki bɔrɛmatapoana, ntaŋ kama daa maŋ wɔ loŋ be asheŋ to. 21Ama Yesu bre, ntaŋ so nɛ e daŋ bɔla ŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ma, Enyɛnpe bɔ ntaŋ, ma alɛ maaŋ chɛrga ma nfɛra fanɛ feeŋ baa la bɔrɛmatapo mbaanaayɔ na.” 22Le be ntaŋ ere malɛ e naa ta Yesu a ki esa nɛ e yili anyi be katelamu to a sa kɔnɔ naseso mo nɛ k bɔ kedra na.
23Kusɔ nɛ k daŋ naŋ ti so malɛ nde fanɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b daa wɔtɔ na daa shi nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa wu a wu nna nsaa ka bumo be kushuŋ na. 24Ama Yesu bre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ, amoso, esa kikɛ maŋ naa sɔ mo so ashi kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ na to. 25Amoso, e beeŋ tiŋ m mɔlga basa nɛ baa bɔla mo so a yɔ Ebɔrɛ kutɔ naniere nɛ saŋkama, ashi bumo be alubi to, ŋkpal manɛ so, saŋkikɛ e wɔtɔ nna a kule Ebɔrɛ a sa anyi.
26Amoso, mo e la bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni anyi be asheŋ to nɛnɛ n sa anyi. Mo e du cheembi nɛ shɛŋ maŋ gbiti mo, kulubi kama malɛ maŋ wɔ mo to. Ebɔrɛ lara mo nna nɛ e maŋ wɔ alubiworapoana to nseŋ maŋ mo so n yɔ esoso a chɔ awɔlpa so. 27Mo alɛ maŋ du fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimusoana nɛ b daa wɔtɔ a lara esarga kachɛ kama ŋkpal bumo gbagba be alubi so pɔɛŋ nseŋ daa lara esarga ŋkpal basa pɔtɛ malɛ be alubi so na. Mo ere, sarga koŋwule kpeiŋ nɛ e baŋ lara n sa basa kikɛ saŋɛ nɛ e daŋ ta mbe kumu n sa fanɛ sarga na. 28Basa nɛ asheŋ ere gben bumo nɛ mbra na bre daa lara nɛ baa ki bɔrɛmatapo nimusoana. Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋ nɛ k bɛ mbra na so m ba na bre lara Ebinyɛn nɛ e ki cheembi mbaanaayɔ na nna.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 8
Content:
Yesu ka la anyi be bɔrɛmatapo nimuso be asheŋ
1Kusɔ nɛ anyee malga ere kikɛ nde fanɛ an kɔ bɔrɛmatapo nimuso mo nɛ e chena Ebɔrɛ be jisoso ashi mbe kemaŋkuragboŋ be kuwurputi ase ebɔrɛso. 2Mo koŋwule na e naa shuŋ mbe kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ ashi mboŋ cheembiana to be kakpa cheembi to na, ndoŋ e la kashenteŋ be wajɛlambu nɛ Enyɛnpe gbagba yuu na. Mannɛ nyiŋgbasa gbagba e ta enɔ n wora kumo.
3Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso kikɛ, baa lara mo nna nɛ e baa ta ŋkɛana a bar Ebɔrɛ nsaa lara esarga Ebɔrɛ be anishito. Amoso, k daŋ daga fanɛ anyi be bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na gba ka daŋ ta kusɔ ko n lara sarga. 4Nɛ e daa wɔ kasawule ere so nna e daa maaŋ ki bɔrɛmatapo kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa nɛ baa ta ŋkɛana a bar Ebɔrɛ mbra na be ekpa so tea wɔtɔ. 5Le be basa ere shuŋ kakpa cheembi nɛ k du fanɛ ebɔrɛso be kakpa cheembi be kiyoyu na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, anebi Mosis ka daa shin nɛ e yuu wajɛlambu cheembi na, le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ŋini mo kumo be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ: “Nyiŋi n wora kusɔ kama nɛ k bɛ kakpa cheembi be kaduli mo nɛ n daŋ ŋini fo ashi kebee na so na so.” 6Ama kananɛ k du ere, Ebɔrɛ sa Kristo kabɔrɛmata be kushuŋ mo nɛ k chɔ bɔrɛmatapoana dra na kikɛ peya nna. Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ Ebɔrɛ nɛ dimɛdi be nferinto be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na bɔla kumo so a yil anyi nɛ mo be nferinto na gba chɔ kedra na ŋkpal kepopɔr na be aworbi ka yil Ebɔrɛ be nnɔ naseso na so.
7To, nɛ fanɛ shɛŋ daa maa kɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ dimɛdi be nferinto be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre dra na nna, dafanɛ kepopɔr kama daa maaŋ naŋ bɛ so n lar. 8Ama Ebɔrɛ daŋ wu kulubi mbe basa Israɛlebi so nna nseŋ daŋ kaŋɛ le fanɛ:
“Ma Enyɛnpe e naa kaŋɛ le na fanɛ saŋko bee fo
nɛ n nase kɔnɔ naseso popɔr ashi ma nɛ ma basa Israɛlebi
nɛ Juda be kanaŋ to ebi be nferinto.
9Ma Enyɛnpe na naŋ kaŋɛ:
Loŋ be kɔnɔ naseso na maaŋ baa du fanɛ
kumo nɛ n nase n sa bumo nananyɛnana
kachɛ nɛ m pɛ bumo be enɔana
n lara bumo ashi Ijipt be kasawule so na.
Ŋkpal b ka daa maŋ ji bumo be amu kashenteŋ
m bɛ ma kɔnɔ naseso so n ya fo ekar na so,
m pal ma kaman nna n sa bumo.
10Ma, Enyɛnpe na naŋ kaŋɛ: Amo be saŋɛ na be kaman le be kɔnɔ naseso ere nɛ meeŋ nase n sa Israɛlebi fanɛ:
Meeŋ ta ma mbraana n wɔtɔ bumo be nfɛraana to
nseŋ sibɛ amo n deŋi bumo be ŋgbeneana so.
Meeŋ baa la bumo be Ebɔrɛ nɛ bumo alɛ e baa la ma basa.
11Saŋɛ na baŋ fo, bumo be ekama maaŋ kaŋɛ mo barkasa ŋko ŋ kaŋɛ mbe efuli so be esa kama fanɛ:
‘Pin Enyɛnpe na.’
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
baŋ yili bumo be ebibiso
n ya fo bumo be ejuŋkparpo,
ekama nyam beeŋ baa nyi ma.
12Meeŋ ta bumo be alubisheŋ m paŋ bumo
ŋkaa maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo be alubi na kikɛ.”
13To, kananɛ e bee tre kɔnɔ naseso ere kusɔ popɔr ere bee ŋini fanɛ e ta sososo peya na nna ŋ ki kedra na. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ k chɛr bee dra to nna a maŋ naa chɛr ko nsaa choŋ kuraa.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 9
Content:
Kasawule so nɛ ebɔrɛso be kabɔrɛshuŋ be asheŋ
1To, sososo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na gba daa kɔ kumo be atande nna nɛ basa daa bɔla so a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ nseŋ daŋ naa kɔ kasawule so be kakpa cheembi. 2B daŋ yuu wajɛlambu nna, nɛ kumo be ebu juŋkparso nɛ baa tre kakpa cheembi na daa kɔ patisa. Ndoŋ nɛ fitila na nɛ teebɔl na nɛ bodobodo nɛ b kɔ a sa Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ daa wɔ na. 3Patisa nyɔsopo ko malɛ daa wɔtɔ nɛ fo baŋ baŋ kumo so, fee luri ebu mo nɛ baa tre acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to nna. 4Ndoŋ nɛ shuwa be bɔrɛsure nɛ baa chɔɔ duwu kumo so na wɔ. Ndoŋ koŋwule na nɛ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka nɛ duwu mata m mata kumo kikɛ so na daa wɔ nɛ shuwa be kapuya nɛ k kɔ manna na. Ɛɛrɔn be kekpabi nɛ k bee purge afantaŋ na nɛ ajembu anyɔ nɛ b sibɛ mbraana na n deŋi so na malɛ kikɛ daa wɔ deka na to nna. 5Asɔ pɔrso anyɔ ko nɛ baa tre chɛrubim nɛ a daa ŋini fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura wɔ ndoŋ na daa yuu deka na be kumu so nna m parga to m buu kakpa nɛ baa tre kuwɔr be kakpa na. Ama anyi maaŋ tiŋ m malga m malga asheŋ ere to n luri to n loge.
6To, kananɛ asheŋ na daa du m bɛ abar so nna na nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana na daa luri a luri ebu juŋkparso na to n ya kaa shuŋ bumo be ashuŋana saŋkama nseŋ daa lar. 7Ama bɔrɛmatapo nimuso na nawule e daa luri ebu nyɔsopo na to kela koŋwule kafɛ kama to.
