Mo alɛ gba daa maaŋ tiŋ n luri ndoŋ ama e ta ŋklaŋ nna n luri n ya lara mo gbagba be alubi so be sarga nseŋ naŋ yili basa na be katelamu to n lara sarga ŋkpal bumo be alubi nɛ b wora a maŋ de so na so. 8Ade kikɛ nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kɔ a ŋini geeŋ fanɛ ekpa mo nɛ esa beeŋ bɔla so n yɔ acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to na daa maŋ naŋ bugi n sa basa ŋkpal ebu juŋkparso na ka daŋ kraa yil na so. 9Kede malɛ la kusɔ nɛ k bee ŋini jemanɛ ere so be asheŋ nna fanɛ ŋkɛana nɛ asɔbɔya be keta n lara sarga na daa maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ esa nɛ e kɔ asɔ na a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na e ki esa cheembi ashi mbe nfɛra to. 10Asɔ na be asheŋ la asɔ jiso nɛ asɔ nuusoana nɛ daŋkare be eyurana so be kefɔr nna. Amo alɛ nseŋ naa la eyur so be atande nɛ a baa wɔtɔ n ya fo jemanɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ asɔ kikɛ e naŋ bɔla ekpa na.
Yesu Kristo be ŋklaŋ be asheŋ
11Ama naniere bre Kristo ki alelasheŋ nɛ a ba na be bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nna. E bɔla lambu nɛ k shibi a chɔ wajɛlambu dra na to nna m ba. Kede bre, mannɛ nyiŋgbasa e pɔr kumo, kumo e la fanɛ mannɛ durnya ere to be kusɔ e la kumo. 12E ka daŋ luri lambu na to kela koŋwule pati na, mannɛ mboe nɛ anabi be ŋklaŋ nɛ e daŋ ta n luri ndoŋ. Mo gbagba be ŋklaŋ nɛ e daŋ ta n luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to n ya nya kesɔnyige be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na n sa anyi. 13Nɛ kananɛ b daŋ ta mboeana nɛ egboluana be ŋklaŋ nɛ ana fɔlbi be nsunɔ ŋ ŋmenyaŋ n wurge basa nɛ b daa kɔ eyurpi bumo so na so nɛ a lar bumo so nɛ b nyalɛ so ere, 14kumo ere, kusɔ nɛ Yesu be ŋklaŋ na bre beeŋ tiŋ n wora shi pasaa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, e bɔla Kiyoyu nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to saŋkama na so nna n ta mo gbagba be kumu nɛ k maŋ kɔ kulubi kikɛ na n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ. Mbe ŋklaŋ na e naa fɔr anyi be ŋgbeneana to be nfɛra fɛsoana ashi amo be aworbi jiga to na, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ tiŋ n shuŋ Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na.
15Amoso, mo e la kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre popɔr na be ematapo, saŋɛ na so bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre na beeŋ nya kɔnɔ naseso na be enɛfa nɛ a wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na. Le be kesheŋ beeŋ tiŋ n wora nna ŋkpal Kristo ka wu nɛ mbe luwu na bee tiŋ a sɔ basa ashi bumo be alubi nɛ b daa kɔ a wɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre dra na to a yige so.
16Kaplɛkama nɛ esa nase mbe luwu be kaman be aparsheŋ be kɔnɔ, mbe luwu be kaman nɛ kesheŋ nɛ e kaŋɛ na beeŋ tiŋ n wora, mannɛ saŋɛ nɛ e kraa wɔ ŋkpa to na. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa baa maŋ naŋ wu, mbe luwu be kaman be kɔnɔ naseso maaŋ tiŋ n shuŋ ama e baŋ wu nna. 18To, amoso nɛ sososo be kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre na gba daa maŋ la shɛŋ ama b daŋ ta ŋklaŋ nna n shuŋ kumo be ashuŋ na. 19Ŋkpal manɛ so, an ta fanɛ Mosis le. E ka daŋ kaŋɛ basa na kikɛ mbra na be ntaŋana na kikɛ n loge, e daŋ ta ateebi nɛ b nyɔɔ kepeper nna ŋ kre kedibi ko nɛ baa tre hisɔp na so. Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ ta kumo n nyɔɔ anabiana be ŋklaŋ to nɛ nchu to nseŋ ta ŋ ŋmenyaŋ n wurge basa na kikɛ nɛ mbra be kawɔl na so 20nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be mbra nɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ men baa bɛ kumo so na nna na.” 21Ekpa koŋwule na gbagba so nɛ Mosis daŋ naa kilgi a ta ŋklaŋ na a ŋmenyaŋ a wurge wajɛlambu na nɛ kumo be asɔ nɛ b daa kɔ a bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ so nyam. 22Kashenteŋto malɛ, mbra na bee ŋini fanɛ ŋklaŋ nɛ baa ta a fɔr asɔ be galeŋga so, nɛ ŋklaŋ malɛ baa maŋ lar, Ebɔrɛ be keta alubi m paŋ basa maŋ wɔtɔ.
Kristo be sarga nawule ka bee ta alubi a paŋ be asheŋ
23Asɔ ere la ebɔrɛso be kaduli be asɔ nna nɛ a daga b ka bɔla le be aworbi ere so n fɔr amo so. Ama ebɔrɛso be asɔ bre gbagba, esarga nɛ k chɔ ade peyaana ere nawule e naaŋ tiŋ n fɔr amo so. 24Ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ lambu cheembi nɛ dimɛdi gbagba daŋ wora nɛ k daŋ duli lambu cheembi gbagba na to nɛ Kristo daŋ luri. Ebɔrɛso gbagba nɛ e daŋ luri n ya kaa yil naniere anyi be katelamu to a shuŋ Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 25Mo nawule e maŋ du fanɛ bɔrɛmatapo nimusoana nɛ b daa ta ŋklaŋ nɛ a maŋ la bumo gbagba peyaana a luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi kafɛ kafɛ a lar na. Mo ere daa maŋ luri n ta mbe kumu n lara sarga ale damta. 26Nɛ mannɛ aloŋ nna e daa beeŋ yili kasɔto be jemanɛ na kikɛ n ji tɔrɔ ale damta loŋ m ba fo kabre. Ama kumo alɛ, kela koŋwule pati nɛ e lar efuli so saŋɛ nɛ jemanɛ kama to be ekar beeŋ fo na nseŋ ta mo gbagba be kumu n lara sarga nɛ k kpra alubi ashi basa kikɛ so. 27Ebɔrɛ malɛ yili kumo nna fanɛ a daga fanɛ basa kikɛ ka wu kela koŋwule nɛ luwu na be kaman nɛ demu be keji malɛ e ba bumo so. 28To, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ b daŋ ta Kristo gba n lara sarga kela koŋwule pati nɛ e kpra basa damta be alubi ashi bumo so. Mo alɛ beeŋ naŋ bɛta kela nyɔsopo n lar m ba, ama kede bre, mannɛ alubi be kekpara so nɛ e bee ba, e kɔ kumɔlga nna a ba nɛ e ba sa bumo nɛ baa jo mo na kikɛ.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 10
Content:
1Kashenteŋto, mbra na daa la kashenteŋ be asɔ nɛ a bee ba na be nduliana nawule nna, k maŋ la asɔ na gbagba. Amo be kaplɛa so, esarga koŋwule na nɛ baa lara a lara kafɛ kikɛ, amoso, le be mbra ere maŋ tiŋ n ta esa kama nɛ e ba Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ŋ ki esa cheembi kikɛ. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ fanɛ loŋ be esarga na daa tiŋ a lara basa be alubi ashi bumo to nna, dafanɛ b daa maŋ naŋ lara esargaana ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daŋ lar bumo be alubi na to kela koŋwule pati a maŋ naa kɔ alubi be nfɛra bumo to kikɛ. 3Ama esarga mo nɛ b daŋ lara kafɛ kafɛ na e daa ŋini a ŋini bumo alubi ka wɔ bumo to. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, egbolu nɛ mboe be ŋklaŋ maaŋ tiŋ n lara esa be alubi ashi mo to kikɛ.
5Amoso, Kristo ka daŋ ba durnya to na, le nɛ e daŋ malga Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Mannɛ esarga nɛ ŋkɛana nɛ fo daa sha,
ama eyur nɛ fo wora n sa ma na.
6Mannɛ fanɛ asɔbɔya nɛ b chɔɔ n lara esarga
nɛ esarga nɛ a bee kule alubi be ketampaŋ nɛ fee sha.
7Ade so nɛ n daŋ kaŋɛ fo le na: ‘Ebɔrɛ, ma nde nɛ n wora fo aparsheŋ fanɛ kananɛ b sibɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na to a kaŋɛ ma asheŋ na.’ ”
8Men keni kusɔ nɛ e fara ŋ kaŋɛ. E yɛ: “Fo maa sha esarga nɛ ŋkɛana nɛ asɔbɔya nɛ b chɔɔ a lara esarga nɛ esarga mo nɛ a bee kule alubi be ketampaŋ. Fo maa sha amo nɛ amo alɛ maa par fo,” ŋkeshin nɛ mbra na to nɛ b daŋ yili amo fanɛ loŋ e baa wora. 9Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ, ma nde nɛ n wora fo aparsheŋ.” Kede e naa ŋini fanɛ e lara esarga dra na nna ashi to nseŋ ta kepopɔr na n tal to. 10Ŋkpal Yesu Kristo ka daŋ wora kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa sha e ka wora na so, an kikɛ fɔr so n nyalɛ so, ŋkpal sarga mo nɛ e ta mo gbagba be kumu n lara na so.
11Kachɛ kama bɔrɛmatapo kama na yil mbe kushuŋ to nna a lara a lara esarga koŋwule gbiiŋ nɛ a maaŋ tiŋ n lara esa be alubi mo to kikɛ na. 12Ama mo Yesu ere, sarga koŋwule pati nɛ e lara ŋkpal alubi so nɛ k bee kukwe a sa saŋkikɛ. Kumo be kaman nɛ e chena Ebɔrɛ be jisoso, ebunyampo be kakpa na. 13Naniere e bee jo nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ e ya ta mo doŋana n shin nɛ b gbir mo kumuli. 14Amoso, sarga koŋwule nɛ e baŋ ta n shin nɛ basa nɛ baa ki cheembi na bee ki basa cheembi na mbaanaayɔ.
15Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na gba bee ji kesheŋ koŋwule na be shɛda a kaŋɛ anyi loŋ. Kusɔ nɛ e bee juŋkpar a kaŋɛ anyi e la fanɛ Enyɛnpe na yɛ:
16“Ade be kaman kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ ma nɛ bumo beeŋ kre na nde:
‘Meeŋ ta ma mbraana n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbeneana to
nseŋ sibɛ amo n deŋi bumo be nfɛraana so.’ ”
17Kede be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ le:
“M maaŋ naŋ nyiŋi bumo be alubi nɛ edalubisheŋ kikɛ.”
18To, nɛ e baŋ ta le be asɔ ere bre m paŋ basa, kumo ere k maŋ daga esa ka naŋ kpal alubi so n lara sarga.
Kefirgi n taga Ebɔrɛ to be asheŋ
19Amoso, bekurgepoana, naniere bre ekpa baŋ bugi pal nna n dese nɛ an luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to ŋkpal Yesu be ŋklaŋ na so. 20Mo e bugi ekpa popɔr, ŋkpa be ekpa n sa anyi. E bɔla patisa na to nna, kumo e la fanɛ mbe eyur na to nna n wora loŋ. 21Amoso, kananɛ an kɔ bɔrɛmatapogboŋ nɛ e bee keni Ebɔrɛ be kowu so ere, 22men shin nɛ an ta kashenteŋ be ŋgbene nɛ yirda nɛ k maŋ kɔ shikashika nɛ ŋgbene mo nɛ b fɔr amo be nfɛra fɛso lubi n lɛ na nɛ eyurana nɛ b ta nchu mo nɛ a maŋ kɔ eyurpi amo to n fɔr na n firgi n taga Ebɔrɛ to. 23Men shin nɛ an baa kɔ anyi be shɛda na to kpakpa nsaa maa gbuŋgbuŋ to, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e nase kɔnɔ n sa anyi na maa yɛ asheŋ a chɛrga kɔnɔ kikɛ. 24Men shin nɛ an baa nyiŋi a leŋ abar to a wɔtɔ kasha nɛ aworbi lela to. 25Men sa maŋ shin nɛ an baa kini kebaatu abar a shɛr fanɛ kananɛ basa ko bee kaa wora na. Ama men shin nɛ an baa leŋ abar to, fɔnfɔŋ kananɛ men wu lalaloge be kachɛ na ka bee fo le ere so.
26Ŋkpal manɛ so, b ka baŋ bugi kashenteŋ na to n sa anyi ere be kaman nɛ an kraŋ kini a wɔtɔ a wora alubi, sarga kama maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ k tiŋ ŋ kpra alubi na n lɛ. 27Kusɔ nɛ k baŋ ka n daga kaŋana e la fanɛ b baa tama kasogberge nɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ nɛ a beeŋ chɔɔ Ebɔrɛ mo doŋana kikɛ m mur na. 28Esa kama nɛ e keni anebi Mosis be mbra na jiga nɛ basa anyɔ baŋ ji kumo be loŋ be shɛda, amodoŋwura bee wu nna, kuwɔr maŋ wɔtɔ n sa mo. 29To, nɛ kananɛ k du le ere nɛ esa bee keni Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na jiga ŋko a ta Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔkoŋwule na be ŋkre be ŋklaŋ nɛ baa ta amo a fɔr basa so nɛ baa ki cheembi na fanɛ kusɔ nɛ k maŋ la shɛŋ ŋko a tege kuwɔr be kakɛ be Kiyoyu na bre, amodoŋwura be kasogberge beeŋ baa shi ga a chɔ Mosis be mbra na peya. 30Ŋkpal manɛ so, an kikɛ nyi esa nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ le na fanɛ: “Keka esa be kulubi la ma asheŋ nna. Ma, Enyɛnpe na e naaŋ ka esa be kulubi nɛ kumo be ekpa so.” Anyi alɛ nseŋ naa nyi esa nɛ e kaŋɛ le na gba: “Enyɛnpe beeŋ gberge mbe basa kusoe.” 31Kashenteŋto, shɛŋ shɛŋ maŋ naŋ lubi a chɔ esa be ketɔr Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na be enɔ to kikɛ.
32Men baa nyiŋi kananɛ asheŋ daa du n sa menyi dra na, saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kefulto na daŋ ba menyi to be kaman na. Kumo be jemanɛ na men daŋ ji etɔrɔ damta, ama amo be saŋɛ na menyi daa maŋ tɔr. 33Men nyiŋi saŋko b ka daa bugi to a tege menyi nseŋ daa tɔrɔ menyi nɛ saŋko malɛ b daa wora basa nɛ men daa maŋ lar bumo kaman na loŋ ŋko? 34Men daŋ tu basa nɛ b ti ebuana n ji awurfoŋ nɛ saŋɛ nɛ b daŋ ba suge menyi be asɔ na gba, men daŋ ta kagbenefuli n nyiti loŋ be kesheŋ na gba ŋkpal men ka daa nyi fanɛ men kɔ kusɔ nɛ k chɔ asɔ na ga nsaa maŋ kɔ ekar na so.
35Amoso, men sa maŋ kaŋ lɛ menyi be kenyɛn na, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ men baa kɔ kumo to loŋ, menyeeŋ ba nya kumo be tɔnɔ. 36A daga fanɛ men baa kɔ kanyiti a kɔ to n tiŋ n wora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ n nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na. 37Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“A ka gbrɛbi
nɛ esa nɛ e bee ba na e ba,
e maaŋ chɛr.
38Ama ma basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ alubi ashi ma,
Ebɔrɛ be anishito na bre beeŋ baa kɔ yirda a wɔtɔ.
Ama nɛ bumo be ekama baŋ laŋɛ kaman bre,
amodoŋwura be asheŋ maaŋ par ma.”
39Ama anyi maŋ la basa nɛ baa bɛta kaman a mur na nna, an la basa nɛ baa yirda nna a nya kumɔlga.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 11
Content:
Kananɛ basa ta yirda m bɛ Ebɔrɛ so be asheŋ
1To, manɛ e la yirda? Yirda la kebaanyi geeŋ fanɛ anyeeŋ nya asɔ nɛ anyee tama na nseŋ naa nyi fanɛ asɔ nɛ anyi maaŋ tiŋ n wu kenishiso na kikɛ wɔtɔ nna kashenteŋto. 2Le be yirda ere so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kpaŋ bedrapo na.
3Yirda so nɛ an pin fanɛ kamalga nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta n to esoso nɛ kasawule kikɛ. Amoso, asɔ nɛ anyee wu ere shi kusɔ nɛ esa daa maŋ wu kenishiso nna.
4Yirda so nɛ Ebel daŋ lara sarga lela n sa Ebɔrɛ a chɔ Keen peya. Kumo alɛ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kpaŋ mo fanɛ elelapo ashi mo ere Ebɔrɛ be anishito, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ gbagba daŋ sɔ mbe ŋkɛana na. Yirda malɛ so nɛ Ebel wu nseŋ kraa malga na.
5Inɔk be yirda so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta mo n yɔ esoso nɛ e daa maŋ luri luwu to na. B daŋ fin mo nna ŋ gben ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ ta mo na so. Pɔɛŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ daŋ ta mo na, b daŋ kpaŋ mo nna ŋkpal mbe aworbi ka daŋ par Ebɔrɛ so. 6Nɛ esa malɛ baa maa kɔ yirda, e maaŋ tiŋ n wora Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e ba Ebɔrɛ kutɔ, a daga fanɛ e fara n yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ wɔ ŋkpa to nsaa nɛfa bekama nɛ baa fin mo kenishipereso.
7Yirda so nɛ Nowa daŋ nu Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ a yɛ asheŋ nɛ a daa beeŋ ba kachako so nɛ esa maŋ naŋ wu na. Ebɔrɛ ka daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ na e daŋ nu n sa mo nseŋ gbir kuloŋgboŋ nɛ mo nɛ mbe kanaŋ luri m mɔlga bumo be amu. Ŋkpal loŋ na so durnyaebi daa maŋ nya kashenteŋ, kumo be kaman nɛ e nya yirda be tɔnɔ, kumo e la fanɛ e ki elelapo Ebɔrɛ be anishito.
8Eebraham be yirda so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ tre mo nɛ e daŋ nu n sa mo nseŋ daŋ lar mbe kade to n yɔ kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ sa mo na. E daŋ lar mbe efuli so, ama e daa maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e daa yɔ.
9Yirda so nɛ e daŋ ya kaa wɔ efuli mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa mo na so fanɛ efɔ na. Mo nɛ Aizek nɛ Jeekɔb nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa bumo alɛ gba kɔnɔ naseso koŋwule na, e daŋ ya kaa wɔ wajɛbu to fanɛ befɔ na. 10Ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa jo kadegboŋ nɛ k kɔ egbaltɔlase lempo nɛ kumo be epɔrpo nɛ esa nɛ e yili kumo kananɛ k daga fanɛ b pɔr kumo na la Ebɔrɛ gbagba na nna.
11Yirda e daŋ shin nɛ mbe eche Sɛɛra daŋ bel nseŋ daŋ nya eleŋ n di kedampo, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ esa nɛ e daŋ sa mo loŋ be kɔnɔ naseso na daa beeŋ wora kusɔ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e beeŋ wora na. 12Ŋkpal le be yirda ere so nɛ basa damta daŋ shi enyɛn koŋwule nɛ e daa maŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nseŋ daa du fanɛ esa nɛ e teŋ wu na to. Naniere b shi fanɛ achɛkpabi mo nɛ a wɔ awɔlpa to na nna. Esa malɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga bumo fanɛ kananɛ b maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga teku ase be ajembubi na.
13Yirda to nɛ basa ere kikɛ daa wɔ nseŋ wu nɛ b maŋ naŋ nya asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na. B daŋ to kenishi nna n yɔ kufɔ n wu amo n sɔ amo a nyi fanɛ b shi efuli pɔtɛ so nna a la befɔ kasawule ere so. 14Basa nɛ baa tre bumo be amu le ere bee ŋini nna geeŋ fanɛ bumo gbagba be efuli so nɛ baa fin na. 15Mannɛ efuli mo nɛ b daŋ shi na be asheŋ nɛ b daa fɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ekpa daa wɔtɔ nɛ b daŋ naŋ tiŋ m bɛta n yɔ ndoŋ. 16Ama kashenteŋto, efuli mo nɛ k bɔ ade kikɛ ere nɛ b daa fin. Kumo e la fanɛ ebɔrɛso be efuli na. Amoso nɛ ketre Ebɔrɛ bumo be Ebɔrɛ na maa keta Ebɔrɛ anishinyɔr na, ŋkpal manɛ so, mo e pɔr kadegboŋ na n yili bumo.
17Yirda so nɛ Eebraham daŋ ta Aizek a shin nɛ e lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ saŋɛ nɛ b daŋ wora mo ŋ keni na. Mo alɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta mbe nnɔ nasesoana n sa, ama e daŋ shuli fanɛ e beeŋ ta mo pibi koŋwule na m mɔ n lara sarga. 18Le nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ kaŋɛ mo pibi be asheŋ: “Aizek to nɛ feeŋ bɔla n nya kaman to ebi na.” 19Eebraham daa nyi Ebɔrɛ ka kɔ eleŋ nɛ e tiŋ n tiŋi bubuni ashi luwu to, kumo ere anyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ Aizek daŋ wu nna nseŋ naŋ ba Eebraham be enɔ to.
20Yirda so nɛ Aizek koŋwule ere malɛ daŋ nɛfa mbe mbia, Jeekɔb nɛ Isɔɔ a yili kachako na.
21Yirda so nɛ Jeekɔb daa shin nɛ e wu nseŋ daŋ nɛfa n nɛfa Josɛf be mbia na. E daa yirgi mbe kekpabi so nna nseŋ daa bunyaŋ Ebɔrɛ.
22Yirda so nɛ Josɛf daa shin nɛ e wu nseŋ daŋ malga Israɛlebi be kelar Ijipt to be asheŋ nseŋ kaŋɛ kusɔ nɛ baaŋ ta mbe kebuni n wora na be asheŋ.
23Yirda so nɛ Mosis mo nio nɛ mo tuto daŋ ta mo ŋ ŋana afɔl asa na. B daŋ wu fanɛ kayɛrbi e daa la mo nseŋ daa maŋ ŋana kekplaŋ Ijipt be ewura na be ntaŋ na so.
24Yirda so nɛ Mosis daŋ ba daŋ nseŋ daa maŋ shuli fanɛ b tre mo ewura Fɛɛro pibi na. 25Ketu Ebɔrɛ be basa na a wɔ tɔrɔ to daŋ par mo a chɔ kedaa wɔ alubi be ebel to nchɛnnyɔ ko. 26E daa sha kekpal Mesaya na so n ji anishinyɔr ga a chɔ keji Ijipt be damaso be asɔ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe anishi daa yuu tɔnɔ mo nɛ e daa beeŋ nya kachako na so nna.
27Yirda so nɛ e daŋ lar Ijipt to nseŋ daa maŋ ŋana ewura na be agbo na. E daa kɔ mbe yirda na to nna kpakpa fanɛ e ka wu esa nɛ b maa wu kenishiso na.
28Yirda so nɛ e daŋ fara Kebansonchoŋ be kejigboŋ nseŋ daŋ shin nɛ b ta ŋklaŋ ŋ gbiti mbunaana nɛ malaika murpo na e sa maŋ beta Israɛlebi be kowu kama to be kebinyɛnbi juŋkparso na.
29Yirda so nɛ Israɛlebi na daŋ tiŋ m bɔla teku peper na to n nite n lar fanɛ kasawule wɔlso na, ama Ijiptebi na ka ba kaa sha kenite loŋ n choŋ nɛ b ji nchu.
30Yirda so nɛ Jɛriko be kade to be egbalana daŋ tɔr saŋɛ nɛ Israɛlebi daŋ nite ŋ kulti kumo nchɛnshunu na be kaman na.
31Sakaleche Reehab be yirda so nɛ Israɛlebi daa maŋ mɔ mo n ti basa nɛ b daa maŋ kɔ kasonu ana so na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Reehab daŋ sɔ bumo nɛ b daŋ yɔ kade na be kebɔɔso ŋ keni na so nna nɛnɛ.
32To, ade kikɛ be kaman, a naŋ daga ŋ ka naŋ malga beyirdapo ko malɛ be asheŋ n ti so a? Saŋɛ maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ n naŋ malga Gidiɔn nɛ Barak nɛ Samsen nɛ Jɛfta nɛ Deevid nɛ Samuɛl nɛ anebiana na be asheŋ. 33Ŋkpal yirda so b daŋ kɔ efuliana ko ebi nna kena m pɔɔ bumo so n wora asheŋ nɛ a daga nseŋ nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na. B daŋ tiŋ n ti ebuluŋana be nnɔ nseŋ daŋ tiŋ n duŋ edɛgboŋana nseŋ daŋ tiŋ ŋ gelge etokobi be keta m mɔ bumo. 34B daa la bepɔshipo nna, ama b daŋ ki belempo. B daa kɔ eleŋ ashi kena to n daŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ befɔ be esoji so nɛ b shile n choŋ. 35Ŋkpal yirda so, beche ko be bubuni daŋ tiŋi ashi luwu to nna n sa bumo. Le be basa ere be beko daŋ kini kesɔ kamooji be kebaawɔtɔ nna nseŋ shuli n shin nɛ b tɔrɔ bumo, saŋɛ na so baaŋ ba tiŋi luwu to n luri ŋkpa nɛ k bɔ na to. 36Ŋkpal yirda so b daŋ wora beko eyurto nna nseŋ kuya bumo so nseŋ daŋ pɛ bede malɛ ŋ kre n ta bumo n ti ebuana. 37Ŋkpal yirda so, b daŋ kpa beko ajembu m mɔ nseŋ daŋ chaŋɛ bede to ntuŋnyɔso nseŋ ta tokobi m mɔ bede malɛ. Ŋkpal yirda koŋwule na so beko daŋ dela mbolpɔ be nwɔl nɛ mboe be nwɔl nna a wɔ ketir to nɛ tɔrɔ nɛ nfɛlso be kekɔrfɛ to. 38Le be basa ere kikɛ, durnya be kelela daa maŋ fo bumo peya so, amoso bumo be beko daa na kiyi to nna nɛ abeeana so nɛ abeelaŋana to nɛ amaŋana to nna.
39Kashenteŋto, bede kikɛ daŋ nya mbo, ŋkpal bumo be yirda so, ama bumo alɛ be ekama daa maŋ nya kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa na. 40Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ daa kɔ kusɔ nɛ k bɔ kede ere gba nna n nase anyi. Mbe kusɔ nɛ e daŋ yili e la fanɛ anyi nɛ bumo be kegama nawule to nɛ baaŋ fɔr so n nyalɛ so.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 12
Content:
An Tuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe mbia be asheŋ
1To, naniere a daga fanɛ anyi, bumo nɛ le be eshɛda ere kulti anyi ere ka ta asɔ kama nɛ a bee kagle anyi ekpa ashi kebɛso na to na nɛ alubi mo nɛ a mar anyi so kpakpa na n lɛ nseŋ ta kenishipere n shile eshile nɛ k dese a jo anyi ere kanyitiso. 2Men shin nɛ an ta anyi be anishi n yuu Yesu nɛ e la anyi be yirda ere be ejuŋkparpo nɛ esa nɛ e bee shin nɛ yirda bee yili to nɛnɛ a fo kumo be ekar na so. Mo e daŋ kpal kachako so be kagbenefuli mo nɛ k jo mo na so a maŋ ta kewu kedibi largato so be luwu na n tre shɛŋ nseŋ ji kumo nseŋ ya kaa tase Ebɔrɛ be kuwurputi be jisoso na. 3Men fɛ kananɛ e maŋ ta kekishi damta mo nɛ alubiworapoana daŋ ta n tu mo na kikɛ n tre shɛŋ na be asheŋ ŋ keni, saŋɛ na so men maaŋ pɔ aba n shin nɛ menyi be ŋgbene e baa jija menyi.
4Ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi be kekɔ alubi n ju amo ashi menyi to kikɛ, men maŋ naŋ fo saŋɛ nɛ a daga fanɛ menyi be ŋklaŋ ka lar menyi to. 5Men teŋ keleŋto be mmalga nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee malga a sa menyi fanɛ mbe mbia na so a? E yɛ:
“M pibi, sa maŋ ta kananɛ Enyɛnpe niŋi fo ekpa na fanɛ kusɔ fɔmbi
nsaa maa pɔ aba ŋkpal e ka gberge fo kusoe so.
6Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ ma, Enyɛnpe na bee sha nɛ mee niŋi ekpa
nsaa gberge ekama nɛ mee tre m pibi kusoe.”
7Men baa ji menyi be tɔrɔ nɛ k la ekpa be keniŋi na be kanyiti a nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee wora menyi fanɛ mbe mbia nna na, ŋkpal manɛ so, ebi mo e wɔtɔ nɛ mo tuto maa niŋi mo ekpa? 8Nɛ men la mbia a wɔtɔ nɛ men tuto maa niŋi menyi ekpa kananɛ e bee wora mbe mbia kikɛ, kumo ere men baa nyi fanɛ mannɛ mbe mbia e la menyi na, ayurbi e la menyi na. 9Nɛ men ta fanɛ an tuto kurgesoana durnya ere to, menyeeŋ wu fanɛ saŋko b daa niŋi a niŋi anyi ekpa nna nɛ an daa sa bumo bunyaŋ ŋkpal loŋ so. To, nɛ fo keni anyi be ayoyu be Etuto na, a maŋ daga fanɛ an nu n sa mo nseŋ nya ŋkpa a wɔtɔ a? 10An tuto kurgesoana daŋ niŋi n niŋi anyi ekpaana kananɛ b daa fɛ fanɛ k walɛ nɛnɛ n sa bumo nchɛnnyɔ ko nna, ama Ebɔrɛ bre bee niŋi anyi ekpa nna ŋkpal anyi gbagba be kechɛto so, saŋɛ na so nɛ an tiŋ n tu mo n nya mbe kebaawɔtɔ cheembi na. 11Ama kashenteŋ bre, saŋɛ nɛ b baa niŋi esa ekpa, mbe kagbene bee jija mo nna. Ama keniŋi na be kaman ekama nɛ e bii keniŋi na be kifito daŋ nya alelasheŋ be kebaawɔtɔ be kagbenefuli be tɔnɔ nna.
Asɔ niŋiso be kefiɛso be asheŋ
12Amoso, men koso n wora menyi be enɔ pɔsoana nɛ amuli chichasoana ere eleŋto. 13Men lɔŋɛ ekpa niŋiso nɛ menyee bɔla so na, saŋɛ na so, menyi to be bumo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ na maaŋ foe ekpa, ama baaŋ baa kɔ eleŋ.
14Men wora ania nɛ menyi nɛ basa kikɛ e baa wɔ ebel nɛ men baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembiana, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama maaŋ wu Ebɔrɛ na ama amodoŋwura baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi nna. 15Men baa de so nɛ ekama e sa maŋ kaŋ lar Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ na to nseŋ naa de so nɛ kekishi be nfɛra kama e sa maŋ luri menyi to n wul basa damta to n jija bumo be kebaawɔtɔ. 16Men baa de so nɛ ekama e sa maŋ kaa kɔ kesakalea be kebaawɔtɔ ŋko a wɔtɔ a kplaŋ abɔrɛsheŋ so fanɛ kananɛ Isɔɔ daŋ kpal kejibi koŋwule pati so n ta mbe kenimu be nɛfa n fa na. 17Menyi alɛ gba nyi fanɛ kumo be kaman e ka daa naa sha kesɔ nɛfa na ashi mo tuto kutɔ, e daa maŋ naŋ nya kumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daŋ kɔ kenishipereso nɛ e nya ekpa n chɛrga ashi kusɔ nɛ e daŋ wora na to, ama e daa maŋ naŋ nya kumo be loŋ be ekpa.
18Men baa nyiŋi fanɛ men maŋ ba kebee mo nɛ baaŋ tiŋ m beta na ase nɛ edɛ wuloŋwuloŋ daa wɔ kumo so na. Ndoŋ nɛ tentembiri daŋ sɔ kakpa nɛ kaboŋ daŋ wora gbrum nɛ kumo be kaman nɛ afugboŋ ko daŋ ba na. 19Kebee koŋwule na so nɛ kabel daŋ shu nɛ ebɔl daŋ ponte to na. Basa na ka nu ebɔl na nɛ b kule Mosis fanɛ b sa maŋ naŋ nu mmalga kama n ti so. 20Ŋkpal manɛ so, b daa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ keta kamalga mo nɛ k daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Hale nɛ kusɔbɔya gba beta kebee ere, b kpa mo ajembu m mɔ” na. 21Kashenteŋto, kakpa na kikɛ daŋ ba ki kanaŋ ko nna hale nɛ Mosis gba kaŋɛ: “Kufu pɛ ma nna nɛ mee chicha.” 22Ama menyi ere ba Zayɔn be kebee na so, ebɔrɛso be Jerusalɛm nɛ k la Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to be kade to na. Ndoŋ nɛ emalaika ŋgboŋto ŋgboŋto wɔ na. 23Men ba Ebɔrɛ be ewurkoŋ nyɛnsoana nɛ Ebɔrɛ sibɛ bumo be atre n nase ebɔrɛso na be kagbenefuliso be nshɛr to nna na. Men ba Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la basa kikɛ be demujipo na kutɔ nna nseŋ naŋ ba belelapo nɛ e ta bumo be ayoyu ŋ ki cheembi na kutɔ nna na. 24Men ba Yesu nɛ e la kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre popɔr be elɔŋɛpo nsaa la esa nɛ b ta mbe ŋklaŋ ŋ ŋmenyaŋ n wurge nɛ ŋklaŋ na bee ji kusɔ nɛ k chɔ Ebel be ŋklaŋ na be asheŋ peya na kutɔ.
25Men baa de so nsaa maŋ kaŋ kini kenu esa nɛ e bee malga na be mmalga na. Basa nɛ b daŋ kini kenu durnya ere to be ebɔl nɛ k daŋ fiɛ bumo so na daa maŋ tiŋ ŋ gelge bumo be kasogberge. Nɛ ebɔl ka shi ebɔrɛso ba fiɛ anyi ere so nɛ an kini kenu, nuso nɛ anyeeŋ wora ŋ gelge kumo be kasogberge! 26Amo be jemanɛ na mbe ebɔl daŋ gbuŋgbuŋ kasawule nna, ama naniere bre e nase kɔnɔ nna ŋ kaŋɛ le: “Kela koŋwule nɛ meeŋ naŋ gbuŋgbuŋ kasawule, ama mannɛ fanɛ kasawule nawule, meeŋ gbuŋgbuŋ ebɔrɛso gba n ti so.” 27Kananɛ e kaŋɛ ere ŋini fanɛ e beeŋ tia asɔ nɛ b to nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ ŋ gbuŋgbuŋ to na nna na. E beeŋ wora loŋ nɛ asɔ nɛ a maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gbuŋgbuŋ to na e ka.
28Amoso, men shin nɛ an baa chɔrɔ Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal an ka beeŋ nya kuwura mo nɛ k maaŋ tiŋ ŋ gbuŋgbuŋ to na n luri to so. Men shin nɛ an baa bɔla ekpa mo nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ so a ta kabɔrɛŋana nɛ kufu a bunyaŋ mo. 29Ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be Ebɔrɛ na du fanɛ edɛ chɔɔso nna a mur basa.

Title: HIBRUWEBI 13
Content:
Kewora asheŋ m par Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ
1Men ba kraa wɔtɔ a sha abar fanɛ keniopibiana ashi Kristo to. 2Men nyiŋi a sɔ befɔ ashi men peana, ŋkpal manɛ so, beko daŋ wora loŋ n sɔ emalaika bumo peana a maŋ pin b ka la emalaika. 3Men baa nyiŋi bumo nɛ b wɔ kabuti to na fanɛ menyi nɛ bumo kikɛ nɛ b ti ebu na nseŋ naa nyiŋi bumo nɛ baa tɔrɔ nfɛlso na fanɛ menyi alɛ gba ka bee ji loŋ be tɔrɔ na.
4A daga fanɛ ekama e baa bunyaŋ kakil nsaa maŋ ta eyurpi a wɔ kakil to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge bekama nɛ b kɔ kesakalea nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔtɔ a kɔ kusɔjigaya be kebaawɔtɔ kusoe.
5Men lara menyi be ŋgbeneana ashi kemansherbisha to nseŋ shin nɛ asɔ nɛ men kɔ na e baa kukwe menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ fanɛ: “M maaŋ yige menyi kikɛ, ma alɛ maaŋ kplaŋ menyi so kikɛ.” 6Amoso, menyeeŋ tiŋ m puchi ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ:
“Enyɛnpe e la ma echɛtopo, m maaŋ baa lɔ kufu.
Manɛ nɛ nyiŋgbasa beeŋ tiŋ n wora ma?”
7Men baa nyiŋi menyi be benimuana nɛ b daŋ malga abɔrɛsheŋ n sa menyi na n fɛ kananɛ bumo be lalaloge be kebaawɔtɔ daŋ ba kaa du nsaa kute bumo be yirda na to.
8Ndere nɛ kabre nɛ saŋkikɛ, Yesu Kristo wɔ ŋkpa to nna mbaanaayɔ. E maa chɛrga kikɛ.
9Men sa maŋ shin nɛ keŋini be nnaŋ to nɛ a wɔtɔ ere e fule menyi kikɛ nɛ men foe ekpa. Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ e daga kebaaleŋ menyi be ŋgbeneana to, mannɛ edaŋkaresheŋ be ekpaana be ajibi nɛ a maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ n sa basa nɛ b ji amo na. 10An kɔ anyi be bɔrɛsure mo nɛ bumo nɛ baa shuŋ wajɛlambu na akpa na maŋ kɔ ekpa nɛ b ji bɔrɛsure na so be sargajibi na. 11Bɔrɛmatapo nimuso nɛ e daa ta asɔbɔya be ŋklaŋ a luri acheembiana to be kakpa cheembi na to lara sarga ŋkpal alubiana so, ama asɔbɔya na bre, b daa ta amo nna a lar keeyi to a yɔ kiyi to be kakpa nɛ basa maŋ wɔ n ya chɔɔ. 12To, loŋ so nɛ Yesu gba daŋ ji tɔrɔ kade na be ekarso nɛ e tiŋ m bɔla mo gbagba be ŋklaŋ so n shin nɛ mbe basa e ki cheembi na. 13Amoso, men shin nɛ an lar keeyi na to n yɔ mo kutɔ n ya tu mo n ji mbe ŋaba nɛ b ŋaba mo na. 14Ŋkpal manɛ so, nfe ere, anyi maŋ kɔ kade mo nɛ k baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ, kade mo nɛ k beeŋ ba na be ekpa nɛ anyee keni.
15Amoso, men shin nɛ an baa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ saŋkikɛ fanɛ anyi be sarga mo nɛ anyee bɔla Yesu so a ta anyi be nnɔ a ji mbe ketre be eleŋ be shɛda na. 16Menyi alɛ e sa maŋ teŋ kebaawora kelela nɛ kebaata menyi be asɔana a chɛ abar to so, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ be esarga e naa par Ebɔrɛ.
17Men baa nu a sa menyi be bejuŋkparpoana nsaa sɔ bumo be atande. Bumo e naa keni menyi be ayoyu so fanɛ basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ba bishi bumo menyi be asheŋ. Men baa nu a sa bumo nɛ b tiŋ n shuŋ bumo be ashuŋ kagbenefuliso, mannɛ kagbenejijaso, ŋkpal manɛ so, keshuŋ ashuŋ kagbenejijaso maaŋ chɛ menyi to kuraa.
18Men baa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa anyi. An baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ anyi be nfɛra ka niŋi, anyi alɛ be kasha e la fanɛ, saŋkikɛ an baa wora asɔ nɛ a bɔla ekpa. 19Kusɔ nɛ m baa sha keŋini menyi nɛ men baa wora ga a ti so e la fanɛ men baa kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ e shin nɛ n nya ekpa manaŋ n yɔ menyi kutɔ.
Esibɛpo na be kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
20Ebɔrɛ bɔla ŋklaŋ nɛ a bee ti kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na so n tiŋi an Nyɛnpe Yesu nɛ e la mbolpɔkenipogboŋ nɛ e bee keni mbe mbolpɔ so na ashi luwu to.
21Kagbenewushi be Ebɔrɛ na e shin nɛ kusɔ lela kama nɛ k walɛ keta n shuŋ mbe kushuŋ na e bɔla menyi to. Ma alɛ naa kule mo fanɛ e bɔla Kristo so n wora kusɔ nɛ k bee par mo ashi anyi to. Kemaŋkura e baa la Yesu Kristo na peya mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.
Lalaloge be mmalga be asheŋ
22Ŋ kurgepoana, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men ji kanyiti n nu ma keleŋto be kamalga ere, ŋkpal manɛ so, kawɔl ere ŋ ka sibɛ menyi ere baa maŋ shi ko.
23Mee sha fanɛ men pin fanɛ b lara an kurgepo Timoti ashi kabuti to. Amoso, nɛ e kaŋ wule m ba nfe, ma nɛ mo e naaŋ ba wu menyi.
24Men chɔrɔ menyi be bejuŋkparpoana nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ. Bekurgepo mo nɛ b shi Itali na bee chɔrɔ menyi.
25Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ menyi kikɛ so.

Title: JEEMS 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Jeems nɛ n la Ebɔrɛ nɛ Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be kenya na kutɔ nna a yɔ menyi Israɛlebi be nnaŋ kuduanyɔ nɛ men pesaŋ to a wɔ durnya kikɛ to na kutɔ. Mee chɔrɔ menyi kikɛ.
Yirda nɛ kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ
2Ŋ kurgepoana, saŋkama nɛ men baŋ luri kechɔŋkeni be yiri kikɛ to, men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa fuli menyi. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, men nyi fanɛ nɛ men baŋ pɔɔ kechɔŋkeni na so a yirda Ebɔrɛ, menyeeŋ nya eleŋ n ti so a tiŋ a pɔɔ kechɔŋkeni be yiri kikɛ so. 4Men baa shin nɛ men be kechɔŋkeni be eleŋ e baa yɔ anishito a wora keshi saŋkama a ti so nɛ men be eda e ba kaa walɛ nɛnɛ a maa paŋ kelela kikɛ.
5Ama menyi to be ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ kanyiasheŋ nsaa pin kusɔ nɛ e beeŋ wora a gben, amodoŋwura e kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ e chɛ mo to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e naa bugi kagbene a sa basa asɔ nsaa maa bishi bumo nnɔ. Amoso, fo kama nɛ fo kule mo kanyiasheŋ, fo maaŋ paŋ kumo. 6Ama fo kama nɛ fo kule mo kusɔ kama, fo yirda fanɛ e beeŋ sa fo kumo nsaa maa wora shikashika, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e bee kule Ebɔrɛ asɔ nsaa wora shikashika, du fanɛ afugboŋ ka bee kaa ketili nchu so a yɔ a ba na nna. 7Loŋ be esa e sa maa fɛ kenya shɛŋ Ebɔrɛ kutɔ, 8ŋkpal manɛ so, nfɛranyɔnyɔwura be asheŋ woraso kikɛ maa lar anishi.
Keshin nɛ fo kagbene e baa fuli fo be asheŋ
9Ekurgepo kama nɛ e maŋ la shɛŋ basa kutɔ e shin nɛ mbe kagbene e baa fuli mo fanɛ mbe ketre dii Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 10Ekurgepo kama malɛ nɛ e la damawura e baa shin nɛ mbe kagbene e baa fuli mo fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bar mo kaseto, ŋkpal manɛ so, e maaŋ chɛr nɛ mo nɛ mbe asɔ na e mur fanɛ kananɛ kusɔ duuso be atoto maa chɛr nsaa wɔl a buri to a tɔr na. 11Epeŋi e naa kaa nyaŋɛ le nyaŋnyaŋ a chɔɔ keduuso nɛ k bee wɔl a jija kumo be atoto be kela nsaa gbete a tɔr. To, loŋ gbagba chap e naa wora damawura. E bee kaa wɔ mbe ashuŋ to nna nɛ luwu e ba tu mo.
Kewora esa ŋ keni be asheŋ
12Ekama nɛ e pɔɔ kechɔŋkeni so, kagbenefuli beeŋ baa wɔ mo to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Setani baŋ chɔ mo ŋ keni ŋ gben. Ebɔrɛ beeŋ sa mo mbe ŋkpa nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa bekama nɛ baa sha mo na. 13Ekama nɛ e luri kechɔŋkeni to e sa maŋ kaŋɛ le: “Ebɔrɛ e fule ma n wɔtɔ kulubi na to,” ŋkpal manɛ so, shɛŋ shɛŋ maaŋ tiŋ n shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ e wora kulubi, mo alɛ gbagba maa fule esa a wɔtɔ kulubi to. 14Kusɔ nɛ k bee fule esa a wɔtɔ kulubi to e la mo gbagba be kayɛlga lubi. Le be kayɛlga ere baŋ pɔɔ mo so, k bee gberge mo nna a luri kulubi to. 15Kulubi malɛ baŋ ba wora keshi, kumo be lalaloge e la luwu.
16Ŋ kurgepo shasoana, men sa maŋ fule men be amu.
17Kelela be yiri kikɛ nɛ kakɛ lela kikɛ bee shi ebɔrɛso nna a ba. Ebɔrɛ nɛ e to kefulto na kutɔ nɛ asɔ na kikɛ bee shi a ba. Ebɔrɛso be kefulto bee kaa chɛrga a bar tentembiri, ama Ebɔrɛ bre maa chɛrga kikɛ. 18Mo gbagba e yili kumo fanɛ e bɔla mbe kashenteŋ be kamalga na to n shin nɛ an ki mbe kepɔrso kikɛ be basa juŋkparso.
Kebaanu nsaa wora be asheŋ
19Ŋ kurgepo shasoana, men ta kesheŋ ere n wɔtɔ ŋgbene to a nyi fanɛ ekama e baa nya manaŋ a nu asheŋ, ama e sa maa nya manaŋ a malga asheŋ ŋko a nya agbo manaŋ manaŋ, 20ŋkpal manɛ so, mannɛ kanya agbo so nɛ esa bee bɔla a wora alelasheŋ nɛ a bee par Ebɔrɛ. 21Amoso, men lara kulubi be yiri kikɛ menyi to nsaa gelge asheŋ lubi nɛ a kulti menyi na kikɛ. Men sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga nɛ e ta n wɔtɔ men be ŋgbene to na a du boeŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, kamalga na e naa tiŋ a mɔlga men be ayoyu ashi luwu to. 22Ama men baa la benupo nɛ baa nu a wora nsaa maa nu kamalga na jiga a fule men be amu. 23Nɛ men baa nu kamalga na nsaa maa wora asɔ nɛ k bee ŋini na, men du fanɛ esa nɛ e keni digi to n wu mbe kumu 24nseŋ ta digi na n nase nseŋ teŋ kananɛ mbe anishiakpa du epul na to na nna. 25Ama nɛ esa baa ta mbe nfɛra kikɛ a wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be mbraana nɛ a maŋ kɔ kulubi amo to kikɛ nsaa tiŋ a lara basa alubi to na to a maa teŋ asɔ nɛ e koya na so nsaa kɔ amo to kpakpa a wora asɔ nɛ a bee ŋini na, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ nɛfa amodoŋwura.
26Esa kama nɛ e yɛ e bee bɛ Ebɔrɛ so nsaa maa de mmalga nɛ a bee lar mbe kɔnɔ to so bee fule mbe kumu nna, nɛ mbe kebɛso na malɛ la kebɛso fuloŋ. 27Kashenteŋ nɛ kagbene koŋwuleso be kebɛso nɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na bee sha fanɛ basa e baa kɔ e la kebaachɛ amunibi nɛ bekulpocheana nɛ b wɔ awurfoŋ to to nsaa de mo gbagba be kumu so nɛ durnya to ebi be alubi e sa maŋ jija mo.

Title: JEEMS 2
Content:
Men sa maa kɔ ŋkpɛato be asheŋ
1Ŋ kurgepoana, ŋkpal men ka yirda an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo nɛ kemaŋkuragboŋ wɔ mo so na so, men sa maa kɔ ŋkpɛato. 2An ta fanɛ basa anyɔ ko e ba men be nshɛr to nɛ eko la damawura m buu asɔ lela nseŋ wɔtɔ eshuwa be mpinibi ashilbi to, nɛ emo na malɛ la etirpo nseŋ buu asɔ farbi, 3nɛ men sa damawura na bunyaŋ ga nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ba chena kabɛ lela ere so nfe,” kumo be kaman nɛ men kilgi ŋ kaŋɛ etirpo na malɛ le: “Choŋ n yili ndoŋ ere,” ŋko “Ya chena ekarso ndoŋ ere.” 4Le be mmalga ere maŋ walɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, nfɛra lubi so nɛ men yil a kpɛa to na.
5Ŋ kurgepo shasoana, men baa nyi fanɛ basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ shɛŋ basa be anishito na nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara fanɛ b yirda Yesu Kristo nseŋ ki damawuraana ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito nseŋ nya n luri mbe kuwura mo nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa basa nɛ baa sha mo na to. 6Ama le be basa ere nɛ menyi ere bee fɛl ŋkeshin nɛ mannɛ damawuraana e naa kaa tɔrɔ menyi nsaa nyaŋ menyi a yɔ edemujikpaana na a? 7Bumo damawuraana koŋwule na chap e naa kaa malga a gbiti Yesu Kristo be ketre lela nɛ basa ta a tre menyi na. 8Le nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ: “Baa sha fo barkasa fanɛ kananɛ fee sha fo kumu.” Le be mbra ere shi Ebɔrɛ be kuwura na to nna m ba, nɛ fo kama nɛ fo bɛ kumo so, fo wora nɛnɛ. 9Ama nɛ fo kpal kananɛ basa du so a bunyaŋ bumo nsaa fɛl beko, kulubi nɛ fee wora na, Ebɔrɛ malɛ kutɔ fo tɔr ntaŋ. 10Nɛ esa kaŋɛ fanɛ e bee bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mbraana na kikɛ so nseŋ wora n da amo to be kukoŋwule gba so, amodoŋwura tɔr Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋana kikɛ. 11Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ koŋwule nɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Men sa maa kɔ kesakalea” na koŋwule na e kaŋɛ le: “Men sa maa mɔ abar.” Amoso, nɛ esa maŋ tɔr kesakalea be ntaŋ gba nseŋ mɔ esa, e tɔr Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋana na kikɛ. 12Amoso, men be mmalga nɛ men be asheŋ woraso kikɛ to, men baa nyiŋi fanɛ kachako Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla mbe mbraana nɛ a bee lara basa alubi to na so ŋ keni ekama be kebaawɔtɔ to n ji mo demu. 13Esa nɛ e maa wu mo braana kuwɔr, kachɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee ji amodoŋwura demu e maaŋ wu mo alɛ gba kuwɔr. Ama esa nɛ e bee wu basa kuwɔr, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ wu amodoŋwura kuwɔr a chɔ loŋ.
Yirda nɛ asheŋ woraso be asheŋ
14Ŋ kurgepoana, esa baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e yirda Ebɔrɛ nsaa maa wora yirda be ashuŋ shunso, manɛ be kifi e wɔ mbe yirda na to? Ebɔrɛ beeŋ kpal le be yirda so m mɔlga mo a? 15An ta fanɛ fo barkasa ebɛsopo kɔ asɔ farbi nna a buu, mo alɛ maŋ naa kɔ kusɔ jiso nɛ e ji, 16nɛ fo wu mo nseŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ebɔrɛ e chɛ fo to nseŋ sa fo asɔbuuso lela nɛ ajibi,” fo alɛ maŋ chɛ mo to n sa mo asɔ nɛ a daga, mannɛ asheŋ fuloŋ nɛ fo wora ere a? 17To, loŋ gbagba chap nɛ keyirda Ebɔrɛ du fanɛ nɛ esa baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e yirda Ebɔrɛ nsaa maa kɔ yirda be ashuŋ shunso, amodoŋwura be yirda na la yirda wuso nna.
18Nɛ menyi to be ekama kaŋɛ ma fanɛ esa ko wɔtɔ a kɔ yirda nɛ eko malɛ wɔtɔ a kɔ yirda be ashuŋ shunso, meeŋ kaŋɛ amodoŋwura fanɛ e ŋini ma kananɛ esa beeŋ wora ŋ kini yirda be ashuŋ shunso be kewora nsaa bɛ Ebɔrɛ so nɛ kashenteŋ. Kumo be kaman nɛ ma alɛ e bɔla ma ashuŋ shunso so ŋ ŋini mo kananɛ kashenteŋ be yirda du. 19Fo yirda fanɛ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule e wɔtɔ. To, fo wora nɛnɛ, ama baa nyi fanɛ mbuibi lubi gba bee shuli fanɛ Ebɔrɛ koŋwule e wɔtɔ nɛ kumo alɛ bee keta bumo kufu nɛ baa chicha. 20Ewulpo e la fo nɛ fo maŋ nyi fanɛ esa baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ e yirda Ebɔrɛ nsaa maa wora yirda be ashuŋ shunso, mbe yirda na la yirda fuloŋ nna a! 21An ta fanɛ an nananyɛn Eebraham ŋ keni kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ yili kumo fanɛ mo ere Eebraham maŋ kɔ kulubi mo to na. E ka daŋ shuli n ta mo pibi Aizek nɛ e ya lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ na so so nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ yili kumo fanɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi mo to na. 22To, kede e naa ŋini fanɛ Eebraham be kebaawɔtɔ to yirda nɛ kumo be ashuŋ shunso e naa yɔ. E daŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ nseŋ daŋ naa wora alelasheŋ. Le malɛ be kebaawɔtɔ ere e naa ŋini e ka daŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ kashenteŋto. 23Loŋ malɛ e naa shin nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na be kɔnɔ bee bɔlɔ fanɛ Eebraham yirda Ebɔrɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ yili kumo fanɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi mo to na. Amoso nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ tre mo mo teri na. 24To, le e naa ŋini fanɛ esa be ashuŋ shunso so nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee yili kumo fanɛ esa na maŋ kɔ kulubi mo to, mannɛ amodoŋwura be yirda nawule so.
25An naŋ ta sakaleche Reehab, mannɛ kelela nɛ e daŋ wora Israɛlebi be mbɔ ŋ keta bumo kufɔ nseŋ ŋini bumo ekpa nɛ b bɔla ŋ gelge bumo doŋana n yɔ na so e shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ yili kumo fanɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi mo to na a?
26To, ade kikɛ e naa ŋini fanɛ yirda nɛ k maŋ kɔ ashuŋ shunso du jiga nna fanɛ esa be kiyoyu ka lar mo to nɛ e ki ebuni a dese na nna.

Title: JEEMS 3
Content:
Kudonduloŋ be asheŋ
1Ŋ kurgepoana, men be bedamta e sa maa kɔ a fin fanɛ men ki beŋinipoana, ŋkpal manɛ so, asheŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ yili so n ji anyi beŋinipo demu shi a chɔ basa pɔtɛ peya. 2An kikɛ bee kaa wora a foe ekpa. Amoso, esa nɛ mo ere maa malga a foe ekpa, kumo ere kulubi kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to nɛ mo alɛ bee tiŋ a pɔɔ kulubi be yiri kikɛ so ashi mbe kebaawɔtɔ to. 3An ta fanɛ gbaŋɛ. Nɛ esa baa sha fanɛ gbaŋɛ e nu n sa mo, e bee ta kebarga nna n wɔtɔ kumo be kɔnɔ to nɛ e tiŋ n shin nɛ k yɔ kaplɛkama nɛ e bee sha. 4An naŋ ta fanɛ ekuloŋgboŋ nɛ afugboŋ bee kaa kɔ a na nchu so na. Kebaŋɛ nɛ katɛrɛ bee kaa ta a niŋi kumo a yɔ kaplɛkama nɛ e bee sha. 5To, loŋ gbagba chap nɛ esa be kudonduloŋ du. K maŋ shi, ama kumo alɛ bee ji asɔgboŋ be njɔŋ ga.
Ekama nyi kananɛ edɛ be kudondulombi ka bee tiŋ a chɔɔ kupuŋgboŋ ŋko? 6To, nyiŋgbasa be kudonduloŋ malɛ gba du fanɛ edɛ nna. K la kusɔbi nna a wɔ esa be kɔnɔ to, ama kumo alɛ kulubi be yiri kikɛ e bɔla kumo to a shin nɛ alubi na bee sɔ mbe eyur kikɛ to a jija mbe kebaawɔtɔ kikɛ nyam. K du fanɛ kudonduloŋ na ka kɔ edɛ nna nɛ edɛ na malɛ shi Setani gbagba kutɔ a chɔɔ basa. 7Basa bee tiŋ a bela nseŋ tiŋ m bela kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya nɛ mbuibi nɛ asɔ gbeyeso nɛ nchu to be asɔ keniso kikɛ, 8ama esa kama maaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ kudonduloŋ bre so. K bee juge asheŋ to ga nsaa kɔ kɔrtɔ lubi nɛ k bee bar luwu. 9Anyi be adonduloŋ na nɛ anyee kaa ta a di an Nyɛnpe Etuto na epaŋ nseŋ naa ta amo a tege an braana nɛ Ebɔrɛ pɔr nɛ b du fanɛ mo gbagba na. 10Kɔnɔ koŋwule na to nɛ epaŋ be kedi be mmalga nɛ katege be mmalga kikɛ bee shi. Ŋ kurgepoana, loŋ maŋ daga kikɛ. 11Kebuye koŋwule maa pete nchu lela kleŋklembi nɛ nchu bɛso. 12Ŋ kurgepoana, menyi alɛ gba baa nyi mangodibi ka maaŋ tiŋ n sɔr apɔl nseŋ naa nyi kapibidibi ka maaŋ tiŋ n sɔr emaŋgo ŋko? Loŋ koŋwule na nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n nya nchu belbelso ashi nchu kerkra to.
Ebɔrɛso be kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ
13Menyi to be emo e kɔ kanyiasheŋ nsaa nyi ashuŋ to? Amodoŋwura e ta mbe kebaawɔtɔ lela a du boeŋ nsaa wora asheŋ nɛ a daga. 14Ama fo kama nɛ fo la kumukpakpasowura nsaa kɔ yurkishi a fɛ fo nawule be asheŋ so, kumo ere fo sa maa ji njɔŋ a ku efɛ a kaŋɛ fanɛ fo kɔ kanyiasheŋ. 15Mannɛ ebɔrɛso nɛ loŋ be kanyiasheŋ shi, durnya ere to nɛ k shi a la basa be nfɛra lubiana be asheŋ nɛ a shi ayoyu lubi kutɔ. 16Kaplɛkama nɛ yurkishi wɔ nɛ basa bee fɛ bumo nawule be asheŋ so, kɔnɔkoŋwule maŋ wɔ ndoŋ she kulubi be yiri kikɛ. 17Kanyiasheŋ nɛ k shi ebɔrɛso na bre maŋ kɔ kulubi kikɛ kumo to. Kumo e naa bar kagbenewushi nsaa shin nɛ basa du boeŋ nsaa shuli a nu asheŋ nɛ basa pɔtɛ bee kaŋɛ. Kuwɔr nɛ alelasheŋ e bɔlɔ kumo to. Esa nɛ e kɔ loŋ be kanyiasheŋ maŋ la nfɛranyɔnyɔwura, mo alɛ maŋ kɔ kebirkɔnshi. 18Bumo nɛ b kɔ kagbenewushi e naa bar kagbenewushi basa to nɛ kumo alɛ be lalaloge la alelasheŋ be kewora.

Title: JEEMS 4
Content:
Durnya be kasha be asheŋ
1Manɛ e naa bar ana? Manɛ e naa bar nlu nɛ a wɔ menyi to na malɛ? Kusɔ nɛ k bee bar amo nde: Men be nyɛlga lubi e naa kaa kɔ menyi to a leŋ menyi a wɔtɔ nlu na to. 2Kumo e la fanɛ asɔ ko nɛ menyee kaa kɔ a fin kenishipereso a gben nsaa kpal loŋ so a sha kemɔ men braana. Menyee kaa yɛlga men braana gba be asɔ ŋkaa maa nya nsaa kpal loŋ so a kɔ nlu nɛ ana. Men ka maa kule Ebɔrɛ so e shin nɛ men maŋ kɔ asɔ nɛ menyee sha na. 3Menyee kaa kule Ebɔrɛ asɔ saŋko malɛ ŋkaa maa nya amo, ŋkpal manɛ so, nfɛra lubi nɛ men kɔ a kule amo a sha fanɛ men ta amo n wora men gbagba be kejimuni be aparsheŋ. 4Basa nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n yirda ere! Men maŋ nyi fanɛ nɛ esa baa la Ebɔrɛ mo teri, amodoŋwura malɛ nɛ durnya ere to be asɔ maa ji a kra abar ŋko? To, esa kama nɛ e bee ta mbe kasha a wɔtɔ durnya ere be asɔ to, bee ta mbe kumu nna a ki Ebɔrɛ mo doŋ na. 5Ŋko menyee tama fanɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na ka bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ be kenishi pere kiyoyu nɛ e ta n wɔtɔ anyi to na so ga na,” maŋ kɔ kifi nna a? 6K kɔ kifi, ama Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr e shi ga. Abɔrɛsibɛ na malɛ e naa kaŋɛ loŋ fanɛ: “Ebɔrɛ maa shuli a sa kamoowuwuraana, basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ kamoowu nɛ e bee wu kuwɔr.”
7Amoso, men baa ta men be amu a bɔɔ Ebɔrɛ enɔ. Men sa maa sa Setani kashuli kikɛ. Loŋ e naaŋ shin nɛ e baa shile menyi. 8Men firgi n taga to Ebɔrɛ nɛ e firgi n taga to menyi. Alubiworapoana nɛ nfɛraanyɔnyɔwuraana ere, men lara men be enɔana nɛ ŋgbene ashi alubi be kewora to. 9Men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa jija menyi nɛ men baa boŋ to a shu ŋkpal men be alubi na so. Men shin nɛ men be emushe nɛ men be ŋgbenefuli e ki kushu nɛ kenawule be ŋgbenejija. 10Men baa yɔɔ men be amu Ebɔrɛ be anishito nɛ e maŋ menyi so.
11Ŋ kurgepoana, men sa maa ji abar be asheŋ a wu abar kulubi. Ekama nɛ e ji mo barkasa be asheŋ n wu mo kulubi e bee ji mbra na be asheŋ a wu kumo kulubi nna na. Fo kama malɛ nɛ fo wu mbra na kulubi, kumo ere fo maŋ naa nu a sa mbra na nna na, ama fo ki esa nɛ e bee ji kumo demu. 12Ebɔrɛ nawule e la esa nɛ e bee nase mbra na, mo alɛ nawule e la kumo be Demujipo. Mo nawule e naaŋ tiŋ m mɔ nseŋ naaŋ tiŋ n sa ŋkpa. Nɛ fo alɛ nyiŋgbasa e la wanɛ nɛ fo tiŋ n ji fo barkasa demu?
Kebaaji njɔŋ be asheŋ
13Menyi nɛ menyee kaa kaŋɛ le: “Kabre ŋko echefo anyeeŋ yɔ le nɛ le be kade to n ya chena ndoŋ kafɛ n ji yawu n dii dama na” e nu nfe. 14Men maŋ nyi kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ wora echefo gba. Manɛ e la men be ŋkpaana ere? Men be ŋkpaana ere du fanɛ kenyɔlɔ nna, a maa chɛr nseŋ naa yɔ epul na to. 15Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men baa kaŋɛ e la: “Nɛ Ebɔrɛ shuli nɛ ŋkpa kraa wɔtɔ, anyeeŋ wora le nɛ le.” 16Ama menyi ka maa kaŋɛ loŋ ere, menyee wu men be amu nna na nsaa ji njɔŋ. Loŋ malɛ maŋ walɛ.
17Fo kama malɛ nɛ fo nyi kusɔ nɛ k daga nsaa maŋ wora kumo, fo wora kulubi nna na.

Title: JEEMS 5
Content:
Damawura lubiana be asheŋ
1To, damawuraana, men nu nfe. Men baa boŋ to a shu ŋkpal alemaŋkar be tɔrɔ nɛ k bee ba menyi so na so. 2Men be ekpanjawu to be asɔ teŋ fara a jija nɛ elala fara a ji men be asɔbuuso. 3Men be eshuwa nɛ egbiti gba kreŋ so a jija. Amo be kananɛ a du na e naa ŋini fanɛ men maŋ wora n nyalɛ nɛ kumo alɛ naa ji a luri men be eyurana to fanɛ edɛ na. Lalaloge be nchɛ to nɛ an wɔ na, ama men keni kananɛ men bela asɔ damta m miiri so n yili loŋ. 4Basa nɛ men shin nɛ b dɔ menyi, men kini keka bumo nɛ baa shu a ŋini basa kikɛ, bumo nɛ men ber paa nɛ b teŋi men be asɔ na gba be eyur nyaŋ bumo nɛ baa shu, bumo be kushu na malɛ luri Ebɔrɛ be asoe to. 5Asɔ lela nɛ ebel be keji to nɛ men baa wɔ durnya ere to. Men daŋ nna a du fanɛ ana nɛ b bela nɛ a daŋ nɛ b kɔ a yɔ nɛ b ya mɔ na nna. 6Men wu basa cheembi kulubi nseŋ mɔ bumo. Bumo alɛ maŋ nya kɔnɔ m bugi.
Tama be asheŋ
7Ŋ kurgepoana, ŋkpal le so, men baa ji kanyiti a jo saŋɛ nɛ an Nyɛnpe beeŋ naŋ bɛta m ba na. An ta fanɛ edɔpo ŋ keni kananɛ e bee kaa ji kanyiti. E bee kaa jo nna le nɛ bɔrɛ e ba nɛ mbe asɔ e kɔr n daŋ n wora nɛ e teŋi amo be alela na. 8To, menyi alɛ gba e baa kɔ kanyiti loŋ a yil to nɛnɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, an Nyɛnpe be kenaŋ bɛta mba be saŋɛ na bee taga to.
9Ŋ kurgepoana, men sa maa bile asheŋ a sa abar nɛ Ebɔrɛ e kaŋɛ fanɛ men wora kulubi. Men keni, a ka gbrɛbi nɛ an kikɛ be Demujipo na e tu anyi. 10Ŋ kurgepoana an ta fanɛ anebiana nɛ b daŋ bɔla Ebɔrɛ be ketre so m malga asheŋ na ŋ keni kananɛ b daŋ ji kanyiti. B daŋ luri tɔrɔ to, ama b daŋ ji kanyiti ga. Menyi alɛ gba e bɛ bumo be aya so n wora loŋ. 11Basa nɛ b daŋ ji loŋ be kanyiti a yil to na nɛ anyee kaŋɛ fanɛ b wɔ nɛfa to. Job le, men nu kananɛ e daŋ ji kanyiti tɔrɔ to, nɛ amo be kaman kananɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ shin nɛ e nu ebel na ŋko? Kashenteŋto, an Nyɛnpe bee shu anyi so ga nsaa wu anyi kuwɔr.
12Ŋ kurgepoana, men baa nyiŋi le be kenishipere be kamalga ere fanɛ saŋkama nɛ men baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ menyee wora kesheŋ, men sa maa bɔ a ti so. Men sa maa ta ebɔrɛso ŋko kasawule so be ketre ŋko kusɔ kikɛ be ketre a bɔ. Men shin nɛ men be mm e baa la mm nɛ men be m-m e baa la m-m. Nɛ menyee wora loŋ, men maaŋ wora n da so nɛ Ebɔrɛ e ji menyi demu.
Kabɔrɛkule be asheŋ
13Nɛ tɔrɔ kɔ menyi to be ekama, e kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ e chɛ mo to. Nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ kagbenefuli wɔ mo to, e boŋ nshɛ n di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ. 14Nɛ menyi to be ekama malɛ bee lɔ, e shuŋi n tre asɔri to be benimu nɛ b ba bɔla an Nyɛnpe be ketre so n duga ŋku n do mo so nseŋ kule Ebɔrɛ n sa amodoŋwura. 15Nɛ b baŋ kule Ebɔrɛ yirdaso, elɔpo na beeŋ nya eleŋ. Enyɛnpe beeŋ chɛ mo nɛ e niŋi to nɛ alubi kama malɛ nɛ e wora, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta m paŋ mo. 16Amoso, men baa bugi men be alubiana to a kaŋɛ abar nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ a sa abar nɛ Ebɔrɛ e baa chɛ menyi be alɔana. Kashenteŋto, kabɔrɛkule kama nɛ k shi esa nɛ kulubi maŋ wɔ mo to, bee tiŋ a wora asheŋgboŋ ga ŋkpal eleŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta n wɔtɔ kumo to so. 17An ta fanɛ Elaija. E daa la nyiŋgbasa nna fanɛ anyi nseŋ daŋ ta kenishipere ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ fanɛ bɔrɛ e sa maŋ ba nɛ bɔrɛ maŋ ba kasawule na so nfɛ asa nɛ bargato. 18Nfɛ nsa nɛ bargato na be kaman nɛ e naŋ kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ bɔrɛ bugi n shin nɛ asɔ kɔr n daŋ. To, Elaija ka kule Ebɔrɛ kusɔ nɛ k wora nna na.
Kechɛ bumo nɛ b foe ekpa to be asheŋ
19Ŋ kurgepoana nɛ menyi to be ekama baŋ foe kashenteŋ be kebɛso be ekpa na so nɛ eko chɛ amodoŋwura to n naŋ ŋini mo ekpa na 20esa nɛ e chɛ mo to na e baa nyi fanɛ esa kama nɛ e chɛ alubiworapo to nɛ e lar mbe alubi na to mɔlga amodoŋwura be kiyoyu ashi luwu to nseŋ shin nɛ Ebɔrɛ kpra alubi damta n lɛ.

Title: 1 PITA 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Pita nɛ n la Yesu Kristo be eshuŋipo na kutɔ nna a yɔ Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso nɛ b pesaŋ to a wɔ durnya ere to fanɛ befɔ a wɔ Pɔntes nɛ Galeesha nɛ Kapadosia nɛ Eeshia nɛ Bitinia be nsawuleana so na kutɔ nna. 2Ebɔrɛ Etuto na bɔla mbe kanyiasheŋ so nna a nyi kusɔ kama nseŋ lara bumo n naŋ bɔla Kiyoyu na to n ta bumo ŋ ki basa cheembi nɛ b baa nu a sa Yesu Kristo nɛ e ta mbe ŋklaŋ n fɔr bumo so na.
Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi e baa wora keshi menyi to a ti so.
Tama mo nɛ k wɔtɔ saŋkikɛ na be asheŋ
3Anyee di Ebɔrɛ nɛ e la an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo mo Tuto na epaŋ. Ŋkpal mbe kuwɔrgboŋ so e shin nɛ an nya ŋkpa popɔr ŋkpal Yesu Kristo ka tiŋi luwu to na so. 4Kede e shin nɛ an kɔ tama nɛ k maa chɛrga nseŋ naa keni enɛfa damta nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ a jo mbe basa na ekpa. Ebɔrɛso nɛ e kɔ amo a jo menyi, kakpa nɛ a maaŋ tiŋ m bɛ ŋko n jija ŋko ŋ kpeŋ kikɛ na. 5Loŋ be enɛfa na la menyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ kpal men be yirda so n ta mbe eleŋ a keni menyi so a jo saŋɛ nɛ kumɔlga beeŋ lar efuli lalaloge be jemanɛ na peya nna.
6Kashenteŋ nna fanɛ shere naniere naniere bre, men be ŋgbene beeŋ jija menyi nchɛnnyɔ ko ŋkpal kechɔŋkeni be etɔrɔ be nnaŋ to mo nɛ a bee tu menyi so, ama men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa fuli menyi ŋkpal enɛfa na so. 7Le be kechɔŋkeni ere bee ba menyi so nna nɛ a ba keni ŋko menyi be yirda na kɔ eleŋ a. Men baa nyi fanɛ hale shuwa nɛ k bee jija ere gba, baa kaa ta edɛ a wora kumo a keni. To, loŋ koŋwule na e daga fanɛ men be yirda mo nɛ k chɔ shuwa na gba, b ka chɔ kumo ŋ keni ŋko k beeŋ tiŋ n yili a. Saŋɛ na so baaŋ di menyi epaŋ nseŋ sa menyi kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ kacha nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ lara Yesu Kristo ŋ ŋini na.
8Men maŋ naŋ wu mo nna na pɔɛŋ ŋkaa sha mo na. Men maŋ naŋ wu mo naniere, ama menyi alɛ yirda mo nsaa kɔ kagbenefuli damta nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n ji kumo be asheŋ nɛ kemaŋkura wɔ kumo to na e bɔlɔ menyi to nna. 9Ŋkpal manɛ so, men be ayoyu be kumɔlga nɛ k la men be yirda ere be tɔnɔ na nɛ menyee nya.
10Le be kumɔlga ere be asheŋ nɛ anebiana na daŋ pere kenishi ŋ keni to nɛnɛ n fin nseŋ daŋ wu loŋ be kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ k beeŋ ki menyeya ere be asheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ na. 11Kristo be Kiyoyu mo nɛ e daa wɔ bumo to na daŋ wu Kristo be etɔrɔ nɛ kemaŋkura mo nɛ k beeŋ lar etɔrɔ na be kaman na nna ŋ kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b wora ania a fin saŋɛ nɛ asheŋ na kikɛ beeŋ wora. 12Ebɔrɛ daŋ lara nna ŋ ŋini anebiana na fanɛ mannɛ bumo gbagba so nɛ b daa shuŋ, ama menyi so nɛ b daŋ shuŋ fanɛ kananɛ b daŋ malga asheŋ nɛ naniere menyee nu Baru Lela na be mbɔ ka kɔ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ nɛ b shi ebɔrɛso n shuŋi na be eleŋ a bɔ kubɔya na. Le be asheŋ ere la asɔ nɛ emalaika gba daa beeŋ baa sha kepinto nna.
Kebaadu cheembi be asheŋ
13Amoso, men bela men be amu ase nɛnɛ ashi men be nfɛraana to a jo asheŋ be kewora. Men baa kɔ nfɛra cheembi nseŋ ta men be tama kikɛ n wɔtɔ nɛfa mo nɛ menyeeŋ nya saŋɛ nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ lara Yesu Kristo ŋ ŋini na. 14Kananɛ naniere men la kasonu be mbia ere bre, men sa maŋ naŋ shin nɛ men be ayɛlgasɔ nɛ men daa kɔ saŋɛ nɛ men daa maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ be ekpa na e naa wɔ menyi. 15Ama men baa du cheembi kusɔ kama nɛ menyee wora to fanɛ kananɛ emo nɛ e tre menyi na du na. 16Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kaŋɛ: “Men baa du cheembi, ŋkpal manɛ so, n du cheembi nna.”
17Ŋkpal men ka bee tre esa nɛ e bee ji dimɛdi kikɛ be aworbi demu ŋkaa maa kpɛa mo to na men Tuto ere so, a daga fanɛ men baa wɔ durnya ere to fanɛ befɔ a ŋana Ebɔrɛ. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, men nyi fanɛ mannɛ asɔ nɛ a beeŋ tiŋ n jija fanɛ egbiti nɛ eshuwa nɛ b daŋ ta n sɔ menyi ashi men be kebaawɔtɔ fuloŋ mo nɛ men nya ashi men nanaana kutɔ na n yige. 19Kristo nɛ e du fanɛ kpakpafɔlbi a maŋ dulgi kikɛ na ŋko nɛ saŋgre kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to na be ŋklaŋ nɛ b ta n sɔ menyi n yige. 20Ebɔrɛ lara mo nna pɔɛŋ nseŋ to durnya ere, ama lalaloge be nchɛ ere to nɛ e lara mo ŋ ŋini ŋkpal menyi so. 21Mo so nɛ men ta men be yirda n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e tiŋi mo ashi luwu to nseŋ maŋkura mo na, amoso, men be yirda nɛ tama wɔ Ebɔrɛ na to nna. 22Naniere bre men ka nu n sa kashenteŋ na nɛ b fɔr men be ŋgbeneana to nɛ men nyalɛ so a kɔ kashenteŋ be kasha a sha men kurgepoana ere, men baa ta men be ŋgbene kikɛ a sha abar kagbene koŋwuleso. 23Ŋkpal manɛ so, b naŋ lɔŋɛ ŋ kurge menyi kela nyɔsopo nna, loŋ be kakurge na malɛ maŋ shi kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ tiŋ n jija to, ama Ebɔrɛ be kamalga mo nɛ k wɔtɔ saŋkikɛ a maŋ kɔ ekar na to nɛ b bɔla ŋ kurge menyi. 24Loŋ malɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ:
“Basa kikɛ du fanɛ kefitiri nna
nɛ bumo be kemaŋkura malɛ kikɛ du fanɛ kefitiri na be ketoto.
Kefitiri na bee kaa wɔl nna
nɛ ketoto na e chuge n tɔr,
25ama Enyɛnpe be kamalga na bre wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ.”
Loŋ be kamalga na e la baru lela mo nɛ b daŋ bɔ n sa menyi na.

Title: 1 PITA 2
Content:
1Amoso, men lara alubi kikɛ ashi menyi to. Men sa maŋ naa ku efɛ ŋko a kɔ kebirkɔnshi ŋko yurkishi ŋko katege be mmalga. 2Men baa sha kashenteŋ be abɔrɛsheŋ na ga fanɛ kananɛ mbi popɔrbi bee sha kenyipo na, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ bɔla amo so n yɔ anishito ashi men be kumɔlga ere to. 3Ŋkpal manɛ so, naniere men da Enyɛnpe be kebaawɔtɔ ŋ keni m pin fanɛ e walɛ. 4Men baa ba Enyɛnpe nɛ e bee sa ŋkpa na kutɔ. Mo e du fanɛ kejembu nɛ k kɔ ŋkpa nɛ basa keni jiga ŋ kini mo na, ama Ebɔrɛ bre kutɔ, e la mbe esa laraso nɛ mbe kenishi nna. 5Men shin nɛ b ta menyi alɛ gba fanɛ ajembu nɛ a kɔ ŋkpa nɛ b ta m pɔr na nɛ men ki Ebɔrɛ be ebu a la bɔrɛmatapo cheembiana a bɔla Yesu Kristo so a lara kiyoyu to be esarga nɛ a bee par Ebɔrɛ. 6Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ bee kaŋɛ le nna:
“Men keni, kejembu nɛ n lara
nɛ k la ma kenishi nɛ n ta n nase Zayɔn to na,
k la kebonfu to be gbaltɔlasejembu nna
nɛ esa kama malɛ nɛ e yirda mo maaŋ ji anishinyɔr kikɛ.”
7Loŋ be kejembu ere la tɔnɔ be kusɔ gboŋgboŋi nna ga n sa menyi nɛ men yirda ere, ama bumo nɛ b maŋ yirda na bre, abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Kejembu mo nɛ bepɔrpo keni jiga na e ba ki ajembu to kikɛ be kelela ga na.” 8Baa fiti a tɔr nna ŋkpal b ka maŋ yirda kamalga na so, kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ yili bumo nna na. 9Ama menyi ere la kanaŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara nna nɛ men baa la bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b shi kuwurji be kanaŋ to nseŋ naa la kanaŋ cheembi to ebi nɛ b la Ebɔrɛ be basa gbagba nɛ men ba kute esa nɛ e tre menyi ashi tentembiri to a yɔ mo gbagba be mamachi be kefulto to na be asheŋgboŋ be asheŋ n sa basa. 10Saŋko men daa maŋ la Ebɔrɛ be basa, ama naniere men la mbe basa nna. Saŋko Ebɔrɛ daa maŋ wu menyi kuwɔr, ama naniere men nya mbe kuwɔr.
Ebɔrɛ be anya be asheŋ
11N teri lelaana, mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa gelge ayɛlgasɔ lubiana nɛ a wɔ men be eyurana to a kɔ men be ayoyuana kena, a na fanɛ befɔ nɛ benitepo ashi durnya ere to. 12Men baa kɔ da lela a wɔ basa nɛ b maŋ la bebɛsopo na to, saŋɛ na so nɛ b kaa malga a gbiti menyi fanɛ alubiworapoana, baaŋ wu men be alelasheŋ nseŋ ta kemaŋkura n sa Ebɔrɛ kachɛ nɛ e beeŋ ba na.
13Men baa kpal Enyɛnpe so a nu a sa kenimuji kikɛ nɛ k wɔ basa to. K beeŋ tiŋ a la men be efuli so be ewurgboŋ nɛ e la ejuŋkparpo ashi kenimuji kikɛ to na 14ŋko mbe beyaasepo mo nɛ ewurgboŋ na bee kaa shuŋi fanɛ b ya kaa gberge alubiworapoana kusoe nsaa sa alelashenworapoana na mbo. 15Ŋkpal manɛ so, kusɔ nɛ k bee par Ebɔrɛ e la fanɛ men baa wora kelela, nɛ loŋ e tiŋ n shin nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ nyi nsaa malga kawuliso be mmalga na e lo bumo be nnɔ. 16Men baa wɔtɔ fanɛ basa nɛ b wɔ bumo be amu a ji, ama men sa maa kɔ loŋ be kamooji na a buu kulubi kama so. Men baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ mo nɛ k du fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be anya peya a wɔtɔ. 17Men baa sa basa kikɛ bunyaŋ nsaa sha bekurgepoana na kikɛ. Men baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa bunyaŋ men be efuli so be ewurgboŋ na.
Kananɛ Kristo be awurfoŋ la keŋini be asheŋ
18Anya, men baa nu a sa men nyɛnpeana nsaa sa bumo bunyaŋ kikɛ nɛ k daga, mannɛ bumo nɛ b la benyɛnpe lela nsaa shu basa so na nawule, bumo nɛ b du nyaŋnyaŋ na gba ti so. 19Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ men baa ji kasogberge be ebesa mo nɛ k maŋ daga ŋkpal men ka bee fɛ Ebɔrɛ be asheŋ so, menyeeŋ nya nɛfa damta. 20Ama nɛ fanɛ b kpal men be alubi so nna m bri menyi nɛ men nyiti loŋ be kebri na, manɛ be mbo e wɔ kumo to? Ama nɛ fanɛ b kpal kelela ko so nna n tɔrɔ menyi nɛ men nyiti loŋ be tɔrɔ na, kumo ere, k kɔ mbo ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 21Kashenteŋto malɛ, loŋ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ tre menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ Kristo gba ji tɔrɔ m bugi loŋ be ekpa na n nase fanɛ men bɛ mbe aya so. 22E daa maŋ wora kulubi kikɛ, kafulesheŋ malɛ kikɛ daa maŋ lar mbe kɔnɔ to. 23B daŋ tege mo, ama mo alɛ daa maŋ laŋɛ katege n sa bumo. B daŋ tɔrɔ mo, ama e daa maŋ nyaŋɛ to n tu bumo. Ama e daŋ ta mbe kumu nna m bɔɔ esa nɛ e bee ji asheŋ amo be ekpa so na enɔ. 24Mo ere gbagba e ta mbe eyur n ta an be alubi n yɔ kedibi largato na so nɛ an baa la basa nɛ b wu alubi be kaplɛa so nsaa wɔtɔ ŋkpal alelasheŋ so. Mbe eyur be kemurgi so nɛ men nya kechɛ. 25Ŋkpal manɛ so, men daa du fanɛ mbolpɔ ka yeŋ to nna, ama naniere bre, men bɛta m ba men be ayoyu be Ekpapo nɛ Ekenipo kutɔ.

Title: 1 PITA 3
Content:
Beche kilpo nɛ bumo kulana be asheŋ
1Beche, menyi alɛ gba e baa nu a sa men kulana, saŋɛ na so nɛ bumo be ekama maŋ yirda kamalga na, nɛ men maŋ malga n sa bumo gba, baaŋ wu men be kebaawɔtɔ nseŋ ba yirda. 2Ŋkpal manɛ so, baaŋ wu kananɛ men du cheembi nɛ kananɛ men be kabɔrɛŋana be kebaawɔtɔ du. 3Men sa maŋ shin nɛ men be kebita e baa shi eyur so be kelɔŋɛ fanɛ amu be kekre ŋko eshuwa be abitasɔ be kewɔtɔ nɛ asɔbuuso lela be kebaabuu to. 4A daga fanɛ men be kela e baa shi men be ŋgbene to gbagba to, kumo e la fanɛ men baa kɔ ŋgbene nɛ a du boeŋ a maa gbri. Loŋ be kela na e maa terge kikɛ nsaa walɛ ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 5Ŋkpal manɛ so, loŋ nɛ dra na be beche mo nɛ b daa du cheembi nseŋ daŋ ta bumo be tama n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ to na daa ji bumo be kebita nseŋ daa nu a sa bumo kulana. 6An ta fanɛ Sɛɛra le, e daŋ nu n sa mo kul Eebraham nseŋ daŋ tre mo mo nyɛnpe. To, nɛ menyi alɛ gba baa wora asheŋ nɛ a daga ŋkaa maa lɔ kufu, menyeeŋ baa la mbe mbichesoana.
7Bekul, loŋ koŋwule na a daga fanɛ menyi alɛ gba e baa kɔ kushuso ashi menyi nɛ men be beche be kebaawɔtɔana to nsaa bunyaŋ bumo a ta bumo fanɛ men braana mo nɛ b maŋ kɔ eleŋ, bumo alɛ ŋkaa beeŋ tu menyi n nya Ebɔrɛ be ŋkpa be kakɛ na. Men baa wora loŋ nɛ shɛŋ shɛŋ e sa maŋ kagle men be kabɔrɛkuleana ekpa nɛ a fo Ebɔrɛ ŋ gben.
Keji awurfoŋ ŋkpal kelela be kewora so be asheŋ
8Kusɔ nɛ k baa wɔtɔ kikɛ e la fanɛ men kikɛ e baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule a wɔ abar so. Men baa shu abar so a kɔ keniopibi be kasha a sha abar nsaa la basa nseŋ naa bar men be amu kaseto. 9Men sa maa laŋɛ kulubi a ka kulubi ŋko a laŋɛ katege a ka katege. Ama kusɔ nɛ k daga e la fanɛ men baa nɛfa basa nɛ baa wora menyi loŋ be alubiana, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ ka tre menyi na, nɛfa nɛ e nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa menyi. 10Kumo alɛ nɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na bee kaŋɛ na fanɛ:
“Esa kama nɛ e bee sha ŋkpa
nsaa sha kewu nchɛ lela,
kumo ere, amodoŋwura
e sa maŋ shin nɛ mbe kɔnɔ
e baa malga asheŋ lubi ŋko ku efɛ.
11A daga fanɛ amodoŋwura e baa lar alubi to nsaa wora alela.
A daga fanɛ e baa fin kagbenewushi nsaa bɛ kumo so saŋkikɛ.
12Ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe be anishi wɔ belelapo kikɛ so nna,
mo alɛ nsaa kaŋ kusoe a nu bumo be kabɔrɛkule,
ama bekama nɛ baa wora alubi bre, e bee pal kaman nna a sa bumo.”
13Nɛ men baŋ pere kenishi a sha kelela be kebaawora, wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n tɔrɔ menyi? 14Hale nɛ men wora kelela nɛ b kpal loŋ so n tɔrɔ menyi gba, nɛfa la menyeya nna. Men sa maa ŋana bumo be kafunti, menyi alɛ e sa maŋ naa shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa ku. 15Ama men baa sa Kristo bunyaŋ fanɛ Enyɛnpe ashi men be ŋgbene to. Men baa wora shiriya saŋkikɛ a jo esa kama nɛ e beeŋ ba bishi menyi tama mo nɛ men kɔ ere be kifito, nɛ men kaŋɛ mo. 16Ama men baa kɔ amu be kebar kaseto nɛ bunyaŋ a wora loŋ nsaa maŋ shin nɛ kesheŋ lubi e baa wɔ men be nfɛra fɛsoana to, saŋɛ na so anishinyɔr beeŋ pɛ bekama nɛ baa malga asheŋ lubi a gbiti menyi ŋkpal men ka la Kristo be basa a wora alelasheŋ na so. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so nɛ k la Ebɔrɛ be kepar be kusɔ fanɛ men nya tɔrɔ nɛ men nya loŋ be tɔrɔ na ŋkpal kelela mo nɛ men wora so, k walɛ a chɔ men ka wora alubi ŋkaa nya tɔrɔ. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo gba wu kela koŋwule nna pati, ŋkpal basa be alubi so, esa nɛ e maŋ kɔ kulubi e wu n sa basa lubi na, saŋɛ na so e beeŋ yɛra menyi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ. B daŋ mɔ mbe eyur, ama Ebɔrɛ shin nɛ e nya ŋkpa ashi mbe Kiyoyu na to. 19Saŋko Kiyoyu na ka ba bɔla mo to na nɛ e daŋ ya bɔ baru lela na n sa bubuni be ayoyu mo nɛ a wɔ kabuti to na. 20Ayoyu na la basa nɛ b daŋ kini kenu n sa Ebɔrɛ saŋɛ mo nɛ e daŋ ji bumo kanyiti jemanɛ mo nɛ Nowa daa gbir kuloŋgboŋ mo nɛ basa aburwa nawule daŋ luri to n nya kumɔlga ashi nchu na to na. 21Loŋ be nchu na daa la kabɔrɛbɛr nɛ k bee mɔlga menyi naniere be kaduli nna, ama k maŋ la kusɔ nɛ k bee fɔr eyur to be alubi a lɛ. K la nfɛra niŋiso be kɔnɔ naseso mo nɛ esa bee nase nna a sa Ebɔrɛ. Yesu Kristo be ketiŋi luwu to na to nɛ k bee bɔla a mɔlga menyi. 22Mo, Yesu Kristo koŋwule na e yɔ ebɔrɛso n ya kaa tase Ebɔrɛ be jisoso, kakpa nɛ ebunyampo bee chena, a ji emalaika kikɛ nɛ bejuŋkparpoana kikɛ nɛ eleŋana kikɛ so kuwura na.

Title: 1 PITA 4
Content:
Kebaawɔtɔ popɔr be kebaakɔ be asheŋ
1To, ŋkpal Kristo ka ji tɔrɔ mbe eyur to so, menyi alɛ gba e leŋ menyi be amu to a kɔ loŋ be kagbene, ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e ji tɔrɔ mbe eyur to lar alubi to nna na. 2Nɛ loŋ malɛ baŋ wora, loŋ be esa na maŋ naa kɔ mbe durnya ere to be kebaawɔtɔ a wɔ edimɛdi be ayɛlgasɔ lubiana to, ama Ebɔrɛ be aparsheŋ to nɛ e kɔ mbe kebaawɔtɔ a wɔ. 3Naniere bre a daga fanɛ men ka pin fanɛ asɔ nɛ nnyamase bee sha kewora nɛ menyi alɛ gba daa wora amo na be kewora kukwe. Asɔ nɛ men daa wora saŋɛ na e daa la kusɔjigaya be aworbi nɛ kesakalea be kayɛlga be aworbi nɛ kasanuu nɛ keshɛr abar n ji nseŋ boo ana be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ kushuŋ jiga fanɛ kagbirshuŋ be aworbi. 4Naniere k bee chinchiŋ bumo nna, ŋkpal men ka maŋ naa tu bumo a wora loŋ be asheŋ jiga na so. Amoso nɛ baa tege menyi na. 5Ama esa ko wɔtɔ n wora shiriya nɛ e ji basa nɛ b kraa wɔ ŋkpa to nɛ bumo nɛ b wu na kikɛ demu. Baaŋ yili mbe anishito ŋ kaŋɛ ŋ kaŋɛ bumo be asheŋ woraso kikɛ nɛ kusɔ nɛ k ba nɛ b wora amo. 6To, amoso nɛ b daŋ bɔ baru lela na n sa basa nɛ b maŋ naa wɔ ŋkpa to naniere na, saŋɛ na so, dimɛdi be kaplɛa so, baaŋ ji bumo demu, ama Ebɔrɛ bre be kaplɛa so, baaŋ baa wɔ ŋkpa to ashi kiyoyu na to.
Kebaakeni Ebɔrɛ be ŋkɛana so be asheŋ
7Asɔ kikɛ be ekar be jemanɛ na bee taga to nna na, amoso, men baa kɔ nfɛra niŋiso nsaa tiŋ men be amu, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tiŋ ŋ kule Ebɔrɛ nɛnɛ. 8Ade kikɛ be kaman, men baa sha abar kashenteŋto, ŋkpal manɛ so, kasha e naa buu alubi damta so. 9Men baa sɔ abar men peana nsaa maa muni to. 10Kiyoyu Cheeŋ be kakɛ kama nɛ ekama kɔ, e baa ta loŋ be kakɛ na a shuŋ mo braana fanɛ kenya lela nɛ b ta Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ damtaana m bɔɔ mo enɔ. 11Ekama nɛ e bee malga e shin nɛ mbe mmalga na e baa la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga gbagba, nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee shuŋ mo braana e baa ta eleŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sa mo na a wora loŋ, saŋɛ na so, kusɔ kama to, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ bɔla Yesu Kristo so n nya epaŋ be kedi. Kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ e baa la mo peya mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.
Keji awurfoŋ ŋkpal Yesu so be asheŋ
12Ma basa shaso, men sa maŋ shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa wora menyi kanaŋ ko kechɔŋkeni nɛ k bee ba menyi so fanɛ edɛ be kuwuloŋ na so a fɛ fanɛ mamachi be kesheŋ ko e naa nya menyi. 13Ama men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e baa fuli menyi parr fanɛ men ka bee ji Yesu be tɔrɔ na be ako, saŋɛ na so men be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli menyi saŋɛ nɛ mbe kemaŋkura beeŋ lar efuli na. 14Nɛ b baŋ tege menyi ŋkpal men ka la Kristo be bebɛsopo so, kumo ere nɛfa la menyeya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu nɛ e kɔ kemaŋkura na e wɔ menyi to. 15Men sa maŋ shin nɛ tɔrɔ e baa ba menyi to be ekama so ŋkpal e ka la emɔpo ŋko eyu ŋko alubiworapo ŋko esa nɛ e bee luri basa be asheŋ to so. 16Ama nɛ men luri tɔrɔ to ŋkpal men ka la bebɛsopo so, men sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa wora menyi anishinyɔr. Men baa di Ebɔrɛ epaŋ ŋkpal men ka bee ji mbe ketre so. 17Demu be kejiachɛ na taga to, Ebɔrɛ malɛ be kowu to ebi to nɛ k bee fara. Nɛ k baŋ fara anyi to bre, nuso nɛ asheŋ beeŋ ba kaa du n sa basa nɛ b maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ be baru lela na? 18Nɛ asheŋ baa du kpakpa n sa elelapo nɛ e nya kumɔlga, nuso nɛ a beeŋ ba kaa du n sa bɔrɛkinipo nɛ alubiworapo! 19Amoso, bumo nɛ b wɔ tɔrɔ mo nɛ a la Ebɔrɛ be keparso peya ere to ere, b baa ta bumo be amu kikɛ a bɔɔ bumo be Epɔrpo mo nɛ e maŋ kɔ kɔnɔkilgi na nsaa wɔtɔ a wora kelela na enɔ.

Title: 1 PITA 5
Content:
Asɔ nɛ a daga bejuŋkparpo nɛ basa fɔlbi ka pin be asheŋ
1To, naniere a ka menyi to be bejuŋkparpo nɛ b du fanɛ kananɛ ma alɛ gba la men barkasa ejuŋkparpo ere nsaa la esa nɛ n la Kristo be tɔrɔ be shɛdajipo nseŋ naa la esa nɛ meeŋ tu bumo nɛ baaŋ nya kemaŋkura na saŋɛ nɛ k lar efuli na. 2Mee kule menyi nna fanɛ men baa keni Ebɔrɛ be basa nɛ b wɔ men be enɔ to a du fanɛ mbolpɔ na so. Men sa maŋ ta bumo be kekeniso na fanɛ katiŋ be kusɔ. Men baa bugi ŋgbene a keni bumo so fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ bee sha fanɛ men baa du na. Men sa maŋ baa wɔtɔ a kɔ kajɛso a fin kakɔka, men baa bugi kagbene a sha kebaashuŋ basa. 3Men sa maa ŋini bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta m bɔɔ menyi enɔ na kenimu, men baa la basa nɛ mbolpɔbi na beeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni so n wora asheŋ. 4Saŋɛ na so, Ekenipo Nimuso na kaŋ ya lar m ba, menyeeŋ nya kemaŋkurawuro mo nɛ k maa terge kikɛ na.
5Mbrantiɛ, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ a daga fanɛ men baa nu a sa benyɛnnimuana. Men ta kumu be kebar kaseto m mea to fanɛ wajɛ a wɔtɔ a sa abar, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ maa sa kamoowuwuraana kashuli, ama bumo nɛ baa bar bumo be amu kaseto bre, e bee wu bumo kuwɔr nna.
6Amoso, men baa bar men be amu kaseto a wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be enɔgboŋana to nɛ e maŋ menyi so mo gbagba be saŋɛ. 7Men ta men be asheŋ tirso kikɛ a lɛ mo so, ŋkpal manɛ so, men be asheŋ wɔ mbe kagbene to ga.
8Men baa da so n shin nɛ men be nfɛra e baa niŋi, ŋkpal manɛ so, men doŋ alubipo na wɔtɔ nna a kilgi to fanɛ buluŋ a fin esa nɛ e beeŋ mur. 9Men baa kɔ men be yirda to kpakpa a tu mo nsaa maa sa mo kashuli, ŋkpal manɛ so, menyi alɛ gba nyi fanɛ loŋ nɛ men braana bebɛsopo ashi durnya ere to be kaplɛkama gba bee nya tɔrɔ.
10Ama nɛ men baŋ ji tɔrɔ ere gbrɛbi m ba lar, kuwɔr be kakɛ kikɛ be Ebɔrɛ nɛ e bee tre menyi fanɛ men ba tu Kristo nɛ men gama n nya mbe kemaŋkura mo nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na gbagba beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ kusɔ kama e nyalɛ n sa menyi nseŋ wɔtɔ menyi eleŋ to n shin nɛ men baa yil to nɛnɛ a maa gbuŋgbuŋ to kikɛ. 11Eleŋ e baa la mo peya hale mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.
Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
12Ekurgepo Silvanes mo nɛ n nyi fanɛ meeŋ tiŋ n yirda na so so nɛ mee bɔla a sibɛ menyi kawɔlbi ere na. N sibɛ kumo nna gbrɛbi loŋ nɛ n leŋ menyi to nseŋ naŋ ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ kuwɔr be kakɛ mo nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ kashenteŋ na nna na. Men baa yil kumo to kpakpa.
13Babilɔn be asɔri nɛ k du fanɛ men sipoche na be basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara menyi nɛ bumo kikɛ na bee chɔrɔ menyi. M pibi Maak gba bee chɔrɔ menyi.
14Men baa ta kasha be kegbuŋ be kepipeso be kechɔrɔ a chɔrɔ abar.
Kagbenewushi e baa wɔ menyi nɛ men wɔ Kristo to na kikɛ so.

Title: 2 PITA 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma, Saimɔn Pita nɛ n la Yesu Kristo be kenya nɛ mbe eshuŋipo na kutɔ nna a yɔ menyi nɛ men bɔla Yesu Kristo an be Ebɔrɛ nɛ an be Emɔlgapo be kananɛ e niŋi ekpa so so n nya yirda koŋwule nɛ anyi alɛ gba kɔ na kutɔ. Anyi be yirda na maŋ kɔ ebarkasa kikɛ. 2Ebɔrɛ e bɔla men be kebaanyi mo nɛ Yesu an Nyɛnpe na so n shin nɛ mbe kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi e baa la menyeya m bɔlɔ menyi to kiŋkiŋ.
Ebɔrɛ be ketre nɛ mbe kelara esa be asheŋ
3Ebɔrɛ bɔla mbe eleŋ so n sa anyi kusɔ kama nɛ k daga fanɛ an baa kɔ n tiŋ a wɔ kabɔrɛŋana be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ k daga to. Anyi be kebaanyi emo nɛ e bɔla mo gbagba be kemaŋkura nɛ mbe kelela so n tre anyi na so nɛ e wora loŋ. 4Ade malɛ kikɛ so nɛ e bɔla n sa anyi mbe nnɔ naseso gboŋana nɛ a maŋ kɔ abraana kikɛ na, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ bɔla amo so ŋ gelge kafulesheŋ nɛ k wɔ durnya ere to ŋkpal kumo be ayɛlgasɔ so nseŋ ba tu Ebɔrɛ a kɔ mbe kapɔr na. 5Amoso, ŋkpal le ere so, men wora ania ga n ta kelela n ti men be yirda so. Kelela na malɛ be kaman nɛ men ta kanyiasheŋ m bɛ so. 6Kanyiasheŋ na be kaman nɛ men ta kamootiŋ n ti so. Kamootiŋ na malɛ be kaman men ta kebaayilto kpakpa be kebaawɔtɔ n ti so nseŋ ta kabɔrɛŋana malɛ n ti kebaayilto kpakpa be kebaawɔtɔ so. 7Kabɔrɛŋana malɛ be kaman men ta keniopibi be kasha n ti so nseŋ ta kasha gbagba malɛ n ti keniopibi be kasha so. 8To, nɛ men baa kɔ asɔ ere nsaa kɔ amo to ga menyi to, a beeŋ shin nɛ men baa du wurɛwurɛbi a kɔ tɔnɔ ashi kananɛ men nyi Enyɛnpe Yesu Kristo na to. 9Esa kama nɛ e maŋ kɔ loŋ be asɔ na tan nna na, mo alɛ maa wu a yɔ kufɔ, mo alɛ nseŋ naŋ teŋ so fanɛ Ebɔrɛ kpra mbe alubi nɛ a daa wɔ mo so na kikɛ ashi mo so. 10Amoso, ŋ kurgepoana, men baa wora ania ga kebaawɔtɔ ere to a ti so n shin nɛ men be ketre nɛ kelara nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara menyi na e baa dii efuli men be kebaawɔtɔ to. Nɛ menyi alɛ baa wora loŋ be asheŋ na men maaŋ tɔr kikɛ. 11Saŋɛ na so baaŋ bugi ekpa pawu n sa menyi nɛ men luri an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo Yesu Kristo be kuwura nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na to.
Abɔrɛsibɛ be kewuŋkaŋɛ be asheŋ
12N nyi men ka nyi asɔ ere kikɛ, ma alɛ nseŋ naa nyi men ka yil kashenteŋ nɛ men kɔ naniere na to kpakpa, ama saŋkikɛ meeŋ baa nyiŋi menyi asheŋ ere kikɛ. 13Ŋkpal manɛ so, mee fɛ fanɛ ŋ ka kraa wɔ eyur ere to ere bre, a daga fanɛ m baa nyiŋi menyi asheŋ na kikɛ a leŋ menyi to. 14N nyi fanɛ k maaŋ naŋ chɛr nɛ ŋ gbaŋ ma eyur ere n lɛ, kumo alɛ be loŋ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo bugi to ŋ ŋini ma na. 15Ama pɔɛŋ nɛ n wu, meeŋ wora ania ga n fin ekpa mo nɛ menyeeŋ baa bɔla so a nyiŋi asɔ nɛ n nase menyi ere saŋkikɛ. 16Men baa nyi fanɛ mannɛ dimɛdi be kanyiashenso be nfɛra fɛso be ablɔmbi so nɛ an daa bɛ saŋɛ nɛ an daŋ kaŋɛ menyi an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be eleŋ nɛ mbe keba be asheŋ na. An daŋ wu kemaŋkura na kenishiso. 17Ebɔrɛ Etuto na daŋ sa mo bunyaŋ nɛ kemaŋkura na saŋɛ nɛ ebɔl na daŋ shi Kemaŋkuraana kikɛ to be kakpa m ba kaŋɛ le na: “Ŋ gbagba Pibinyɛn shaso nɛ ma kagbene fuli mo so nde.” 18Ebɔl na ka daŋ shi ebɔrɛso m ba saŋɛ nɛ anyi nɛ mo daa la kebee cheembi na so na, anyi alɛ gba daŋ nu kumo. 19Amoso, anyee yirda asheŋ nɛ anebiana wu ŋ kaŋɛ ana an be ŋgbene to a ti so. Nɛ men baa bɛ amo so fanɛ fitila ka bee sa kefulto tentembiri be kakpa to na, menyeeŋ baa wora asɔ. Men baa kɔ to loŋ hale nɛ kachɛ na e ya kaa fo nɛ karechɛso be kechɛkpabi na e ya nyaŋɛ kefulto n wɔtɔ men be ŋgbene to. 20Ade kikɛ nyam be kaman, men baa nyi fanɛ esa kama maaŋ tiŋ n ta mo gbagba be nfɛra ŋ kute abɔrɛsibɛ be kewuŋkaŋɛ kama. 21Ŋkpal manɛ so, abɔrɛsheŋ wuŋkaŋɛ kama maŋ naŋ shi dimɛdi be katiŋ so m ba, ama Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na e daŋ ta basa nɛ b malga baru nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ na.

Title: 2 PITA 2
Content:
Befɛpo ŋinipoana be asheŋ
1Kananɛ anebi fɛpoana daŋ lar n luri dra na to ebi to na, loŋ koŋwule na nɛ beŋinipo fɛpoana beeŋ lar n luri menyi to. Baaŋ ŋana m bar efɛ be keŋiniana nɛ a bee mur basa nseŋ kini Enyɛnpe nɛ e sɔ bumo n yige na, saŋɛ na so n ta kemur purgiase m bar bumo be amu. 2Basa damta beeŋ bɛ bumo be anishinyɔr be asheŋ so n shin nɛ basa e malga ŋ gbiti kashenteŋ be ekpa na. 3Beŋinipoana ere beeŋ bɔla bumo be kajɛ so n ta bumo gbagba be ablɔmbi n ta menyi n nyalɛ. Bumo alɛ be kasogberge dese n chɛr a jo bumo nɛ bumo be esa nɛ e beeŋ mur bumo na maa di. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ Ebɔrɛ maŋ yige emalaika mo nɛ b daŋ wora alubi na gba nseŋ daŋ yɛra bumo kemaŋ nɛ baa tre abis to na nɛ b ya kaa kɔ bumo to tentembiri to mina a jo demujiachɛ na, 5ŋko nɛ e daa maŋ yige saŋɛ na be durnyaebi nseŋ daŋ bar nchu m ba sɔ durnya kikɛ nɛ kumo to be basa lubi mur nseŋ daŋ lara Nowa nɛ e daa la Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelashemmalgapo na nɛ basa ashunu ko na, e beeŋ yige le be beŋinipo fɛpoana ere a? 6Ŋko nɛ e daŋ wu Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra be nde na to ebi be alubi nseŋ daŋ chɔɔ amo edɛ nyam n ta kusɔ nɛ k daŋ wora bumo na a ŋini kusɔ nɛ k beeŋ ba wora bɔrɛkinipoana na, e beeŋ yige le be befɛpo ere bre a? 7Ŋko nɛ e daŋ lara Lɔt nɛ e daa la elelapo ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito na nɛ mbe kagbene daa maŋ dese mo ŋkpal mbrakinipoana na be kebaawɔtɔ jijaso na so, 8ŋkpal manɛ so, e ka daa la esa lela nseŋ daa wɔ bumo to kapa nɛ kanyɛ na so, mbe kagbene daa maŋ dese mo ŋkpal asɔ jiga nɛ e daa wu nɛ amo nɛ e daa nu so. 9Amoso, men baa nyi fanɛ Enyɛnpe na nyi kananɛ e bee lara bɔrɛshapoana ashi bumo be kechɔŋkeniana to nseŋ naa nyi kananɛ e beeŋ baa kɔ bɔrɛkinipoana nɛ e kɔ a wɔ kasogberge to a jo demujiachɛ na, 10fɔnfɔŋ bumo nɛ b wɔtɔ a bɛ bumo be eyurana be nyɛlga lubiana so nsaa kini Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ na so. Loŋ be basa na nya kagbene nna a wɔtɔ a wu bumo be amu nsaa tege bebunyampoana nɛ b wɔ ebɔrɛso na ŋkaa maa ŋana, 11ŋkeshin nɛ emalaika gba e baa chɔ beŋinipo fɛpoana na eleŋ nɛ kemaŋkura ga ere maa wu bebunyampoana na kulubi nsaa tege bumo Enyɛnpe na be anishito. 12Ama loŋ be basa ere bee malga a gbiti asheŋ nɛ b maa pin to nna. B du fanɛ asɔbɔya nna a maŋ kɔ nfɛra a wora asheŋ. B kurge bumo nna nɛ b baa pɛ nsaa jija bumo. To, loŋ nɛ beŋinipoana na gba beeŋ mur fanɛ asɔbɔya na. 13Tɔrɔ mo nɛ baa bar ere, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta tɔrɔ ŋ ka bumo. Kusɔ nɛ k la ebel bumo kutɔ e la kewora kusɔ kama nɛ bumo be eyurana bee sha kapaso parr. Bumo be asheŋ la anishinyɔr nɛ ŋaba nna nɛ baa tu menyi a ji a wɔtɔ a nu bumo be kafulesheŋ be ebel na. 14Kesakaleasheŋ e baŋ bɔlɔ bumo be nfɛraana to, bumo alɛ maa wora alubi a gben kikɛ. Bumo e naa fule basa nɛ b maa kra ketɔr a wɔtɔ asheŋ jiga to, bumo alɛ nseŋ naa la kejimuni be bejuŋkparpo. B wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔso to nna. 15B yige ekpa niŋiso na nseŋ foe m bɔla Biyɔɔ pibi Balaam nɛ e daŋ sha kebɔlɔ alubi so n dii dama na be ekpa. 16Mo e la esa nɛ kurma nɛ k la kusɔbɔya a maa malga, ama kumo alɛ nseŋ daŋ malga fanɛ dimɛdi n fiɛ mo so na. Mbe alubi so nɛ kurma na daŋ wora loŋ n shin nɛ mo ere anebi na lar mbe ebonsheŋ na to. 17Le be basa ere du fanɛ abombi nɛ a maŋ kɔ nchu nna ŋko kenyɔlɔ nna nɛ afugboŋ bee kpata a yɔ. Ebɔrɛ kɔ tentembiri nna le mina a jo bumo. 18Ŋkpal manɛ so, njɔŋ be mmalga fuloŋ e naa lar bumo be nnɔ to, bumo alɛ nseŋ naa kɔ anishinyɔr be kayɛlgasɔ ashi bumo be eyurana to a pɛ basa nɛ b baŋ fara a sha kelara bumo be amu basa nɛ b wɔ kafule to. 19Baa kaŋɛ basa pɔtɛ fanɛ baaŋ nya kamooji nɛ bumo gbagba wɔ kafule be kenyaya to. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ k bee pɔɔ esa so, kumo e la amodoŋwura mo nyɛnpe. 20Bekama nɛ b daŋ pin an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo Yesu Kristo na pɔɛŋ ŋkeŋ nya n lar durnya ere to be kebaawɔtɔ bɛso ere be aworbi to, kumo be kaman nɛ loŋ be asheŋ na naŋ pɛ bumo m pɔɔ bumo so, loŋ be basa be kebaawɔtɔ naa lubi nna ga a chɔ bumo be faraŋko be kebaawɔtɔ na. 21Nɛ b daa maŋ pin Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ be ekpa nna, k daa beeŋ baa bɔ bumo so a chɔ b ka ba pin kumo nseŋ naŋ pal kaman n sa Ebɔrɛ be kamalga naseso cheembi nɛ e daŋ ta n sa bumo na. 22Bumo be loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na e naa ŋini aŋasa mo nɛ a bee kaŋɛ le na ka la kashenteŋ, a yɛ: “Jɔnɔ ka naa bɛta a yɔ kumo be ekwiɛ to,” ŋko: “B ka bɛr preku nɛ k naa bɛta n ya kaa milti depɔ to.”

Title: 2 PITA 3
Content:
Enyɛnpe be kachɛ be asheŋ
1N teri shasoana, ma kawɔl nyɔsopo nde nɛ mee sibɛ a sa menyi. N sibɛ amo kikɛ nna nɛ n nyiŋi menyi nseŋ naŋ leŋ menyi to n wɔtɔ nfɛra niŋiso to. 2Mee sha fanɛ men nyiŋi mmalga nɛ anebi cheembiana na daŋ malga dra na nɛ kamalga nɛ an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo daŋ bɔla men be beshuŋipoana so m malga n nase na. 3Kusɔ nɛ k daga fanɛ men fara m pin e la fanɛ, lalaloge be nchɛ na to befɛpo beeŋ ba kaa wora basa shia nsaa bɛ bumo gbagba be nyɛlga lubiana so. 4Baaŋ kaŋɛ le: “Mannɛ mo e nase kumo fanɛ e beeŋ naŋ ba na a? To, nɛ e wɔ nnɛ? An tutoana ka baŋ wu kikɛ, asheŋ baa du kananɛ a du yili durnya be faraŋko na kikɛ nna.” 5Ama le be basa ere bee kute nna a kini kepin fanɛ dra na Ebɔrɛ daŋ malga nna nɛ esosoana nɛ kasawule daŋ fara kebaawɔtɔ. Nchu nɛ e daŋ ta nseŋ naŋ bɔla amo so ŋ jɔŋɛ kasawule. 6Nchu malɛ so nɛ e daŋ bɔla n jija saŋɛ na be durnya nɛ k mur. 7Kamalga koŋwule na so nɛ naniere be esosoana nɛ kasawule ere wɔtɔ a jo edɛ be keta m mur kumo na. A bee jo demujiachɛ nna, kachɛ nɛ bɔrɛkinipoana beeŋ mur na.
8Ama n teri shasoana, men sa maŋ kaŋ teŋ kesheŋ koŋwule ere so fanɛ Enyɛnpe bre kutɔ kachɛ koŋwule du fanɛ nfɛ kagboŋ nna nɛ nfɛ kagboŋ malɛ du fanɛ kachɛ koŋwule mo kutɔ. 9Amoso, Enyɛnpe na maŋ wushi ashi mbe kɔnɔ nɛ e nase fanɛ e beeŋ wora na to nna fanɛ kananɛ basa ko bee fɛ esa be kewushi na nna. Kanyiti nɛ e bee ji menyi a maa sha fanɛ esa kikɛ e mur, ama e bee sha fanɛ ekama e lar mbe alubi to nna.
10Ama Enyɛnpe be kachɛ na beeŋ purgi basa nna fanɛ eyu na. Kumo be kachɛ na, esosoana beeŋ ta awɔr chilili n foe basa be anishito. Esoso be asɔana beeŋ chɔɔ edɛ m mur. Nɛ kasawule nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ kumo so ere kikɛ e dii efuli.
11Nɛ kananɛ asɔ kikɛ ka beeŋ ba mur le ere, nuso be basa a daga fanɛ men baa du? A daga fanɛ men baa kɔ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi a wɔ kabɔrɛŋana be kebaawɔtɔ to 12a keni Ebɔrɛ be kachɛ na ekpa n shin nɛ k ba manaŋ. Kumo be kachɛ na, esosoana beeŋ chɔɔ edɛ m mur nɛ kuwuloŋ na e ŋalga esoso be asɔana na. 13Ama mbe kɔnɔ nɛ e nase na so nɛ anyee keni esoso popɔrana na nɛ kasawule popɔr na ekpa, ndoŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be anishito be alelasheŋ wɔ na.
14Amoso, n teri shasoana, ŋkpal men ka bee keni le be kesheŋ ere ekpa so, men baa wora ania ga a la basa nɛ Ebɔrɛ maaŋ wu kulubi bumo so nɛ b maŋ kɔ saŋgre kikɛ nɛ menyi nɛ mo malɛ e naa kɔ kagbenewushi abar so. 15Men baa nyi men be ŋgbene to fanɛ Enyɛnpe be kanyiti e la kumɔlga fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ sa an niopibi Pɔɔl kanyiasheŋ nɛ e sibɛ menyi na. 16Mbe nwɔl malɛ kikɛ to loŋ nɛ e bee malga a kaŋɛ loŋ be asheŋ. Ama asɔ ko wɔ mbe nwɔlana na to nna a maa tiŋ a pin to nɛ basa nɛ b maŋ nyi ŋkaa maa tiŋ a yil to kpakpa na bee bɔla ekpa nɛ k maŋ niŋi so a ŋini asheŋ gbɛto fanɛ kananɛ baa ta abɔrɛsibɛ nɛ a ka na a wora na. Loŋ malɛ, bumo gbagba be amu so nɛ baa bar kemur na.
17Ama n teri lelaana, menyi ere tea nyi asheŋ ere kikɛ, amoso, men baa da so nɛ mbrakinipoana be alubi e sa maŋ shin nɛ men foe ekpa n lar kakpa lela nɛ men yil ere so n tɔr. 18Ama men baa wɔtɔ a yɔ anishito ashi an Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Emɔlgapo Yesu Kristo be kuwɔr be kakɛ na nɛ kashennyi na to. Kemaŋkura e baa la mo peya naniere nɛ saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn.

Title: 1 JƆN 1
Content:
Kamalga nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa na be asheŋ
1Yesu Kristo nɛ baa tre Kamalga nɛ k bee sa ŋkpa nsaa wɔtɔ durnya be sososo kikɛ na be asheŋ nɛ anyee sibɛ a sa menyi na. E malga nɛ an nu nseŋ wu mo kenishiso ŋ keni mo nseŋ ta an be enɔana m beta mo. 2Le be ŋkpa ere ka ba lar efuli nɛ an wu kumo, amoso nɛ anyee ji kumo be shɛda a sa menyi a kaŋɛ menyi ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar ere be asheŋ na. K daa wɔ Ebɔrɛ na kutɔ nna pɔɛŋ nɛ b lara kumo efuli n sa anyi. 3Asɔ nɛ an wu nseŋ nu nɛ anyee ta a kaŋɛ menyi alɛ gba na, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ tu anyi a wɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ mo nɛ anyi nɛ Etuto Ebɔrɛ nɛ mo Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo kɔ na to. 4Anyi alɛ naa sibɛ kawɔl ere nna nɛ anyi be ŋgbene e fuli anyi parr.
Kebaana kefulto to be asheŋ
5Baru mo nɛ an nu ashi Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na kutɔ nsaa bɔ kumo a sa menyi na nde fanɛ Ebɔrɛ la kefulto nna nɛ tentembiri malɛ kikɛ maŋ wɔ mo to kuraa. 6To, nɛ anyee kaŋɛ fanɛ anyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ nsaa na tentembiri to, efɛ nɛ anyee ku na, anyi alɛ nsaa maŋ naa wɔ kashenteŋ be kebaawɔtɔ to. 7Ama nɛ fanɛ an baa na kefulto to fanɛ kananɛ e wɔ kefulto to na bre, kumo ere anyi nɛ an braana beeŋ baa kɔ kɔnɔkoŋwule be kebaawɔtɔ nɛ mo Pibinyɛn Yesu be ŋklaŋ nɛ a lar saŋɛ nɛ e wu na e baa fɔr kulubi kikɛ nyam ashi anyi be ŋgbene to. 8Nɛ an baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ an maŋ kɔ kulubi bre, anyee fule anyi be amu nna nɛ kashenteŋ malɛ maŋ wɔ anyi to kuraa. 9Ama nɛ fanɛ an bugi to ŋ kaŋɛ Ebɔrɛ anyi be alubi bre, e la esa nɛ e niŋi nna nɛ anyeeŋ tiŋ n yirda mo nɛ e ta anyi be alubi kikɛ nyam m paŋ anyi nseŋ fɔr kulubi kikɛ nyam ashi anyi be ŋgbene to. 10Nɛ an baŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ an maŋ wora alubi bre, kumo ere anyee tre Ebɔrɛ efɛpo nna na nɛ mbe kamalga na malɛ maŋ wɔ anyi to.

Title: 1 JƆN 2
Content:
1Ma mbi shasoana, mee sibɛ kawɔl ere nna a sa menyi nɛ men sa maŋ wora alubi. Ama nɛ k ba fanɛ ekama nɛ e ba wora kulubi bre, an kɔ ematapo ashi anyi nɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na be nferinto. Mo e la Yesu Kristo, esa nɛ e la esa lela Ebɔrɛ be anishito na. 2Mo e wu m mata be luwu nɛ k shin nɛ an nya alubi be ketampaŋ. Mannɛ anyi nawule be alubi so nɛ e wu, durnyaebi kikɛ be alubi so nɛ e wu.
Kebaabɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso so be asheŋ
3Nɛ an baa bɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso so bre, kumo ere an baa nyi geeŋ fanɛ an nyi mo. 4Esa kama nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Ma ere nyi mo,” mo alɛ nsaa maa bɛ Ebɔrɛ na be mmalga naseso so, amodoŋwura la efɛpo nna nɛ kashenteŋ na malɛ maŋ wɔ mo to. 5Ama esa kama nɛ e bee bɛ Ebɔrɛ na be mmalga naseso so, amodoŋwura e la esa nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kasha bɔlɔ mo to felɛlɛ kashenteŋto Loŋ malɛ nɛ anyee ta a pin fanɛ an ka wɔ Ebɔrɛ to. 6Ekama malɛ nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ e wɔ Ebɔrɛ na to, a daga fanɛ amodoŋwura e baa wora asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ Yesu daa wora na.
Mbra popɔr na be asheŋ
7N teri shasoana, mannɛ kamalga naseso popɔr nɛ mee sibɛ a sa menyi, kedra nna. Kumo alɛ nɛ men nya sososo kikɛ na. Kamalga naseso dra na e la kubɔya mo nɛ men teŋ nu na. 8Ama kamalga naseso mo nɛ mee sibɛ a sa menyi ere malɛ du fanɛ kepopɔr nna. Menyi nɛ Kristo be kebaawɔtɔ malɛ to nɛ baa wu kumo be loŋ be kashenteŋ na, ŋkpal manɛ so, tentembiri na bee choŋ nna nɛ kashenteŋ be kefulto na tea fuli to. 9Esa kama nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ e wɔ kefulto na to, mo alɛ nsaa kishi mo niopibi, kraa wɔ tentembiri to nna na. 10Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee sha mo niopibi wɔ kefulto na to nna na nɛ shɛŋ malɛ maŋ naa wɔ mo to a kagle mo ekpa a shin nɛ e bee fiti a tɔr. 11Ama ekama nɛ e bee kishi mo niopibi wɔ tentembiri to nna na, mo alɛ nsaa na tentembiri to. E maŋ nyi kakpa nɛ e bee yɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, tentembiri na e naa shin nɛ e maa wu.
12Ma mbi shasoana, mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka ta menyi be alubi m paŋ menyi ŋkpal Yesu so na. 13Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi betutoana ŋkpal men ka nyi mo ere esa nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to sososo kikɛ na so. Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi mbrantiɛbia ŋkpal men ka pɔɔ alubipo na so so. 14Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi mbia ŋkpal men ka nyi etuto na so. Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi betutoana ŋkpal men ka nyi mo ere esa nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to sososo kikɛ na so. Mee sibɛ nna a sa menyi mbrantiɛbia ŋkpal men ka kɔ eleŋ nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na wɔ menyi to nɛ men pɔɔ alubipo na so so.
Durnya be kasha be asheŋ
15Men sa maa sha durnya ere ŋko kusɔ kama nɛ k la durnya ere peya. Esa kama nɛ e bee sha durnya ere maŋ kɔ kasha a sa Etuto Ebɔrɛ na. 16Ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔ nɛ a la durnya ere to be asɔ fanɛ asɔ nɛ dimɛdi be kapɔr lubi ere bee sha nɛ asɔ nɛ basa bee wu nsaa yɛlga nɛ durnya ere to be kamoowusheŋ kikɛ nyam maŋ shi Etuto na kutɔ, a la durnya ere to be asɔ nna. 17Durnya ere malɛ nɛ kumo be ayɛlgasɔ kikɛ nyam bee choŋ nna, ama esa kama nɛ e bee wora Ebɔrɛ na be aparsheŋ bre wɔ ŋkpa to nna mbaanaayɔ.
Kristo mo doŋ be asheŋ
18Ma mbi shasoana, lalaloge be saŋɛ na bee fo nna na. Men daŋ nu fanɛ Kristo mo doŋ beeŋ ba, naniere malɛ Kristo mo doŋana damta ba, amoso nɛ an pin fanɛ lalaloge be jemanɛ na fo. 19Le be basa ere daŋ shi anyi be katuŋ to nna, ama kashenteŋto, b daa maŋ la anyi to be basa, amoso nɛ b lar anyi to n yɔ na. Nɛ b daa la anyi to be basa nna b daa maaŋ lar. Ama bumo be kelar anyi to na e naa ŋini fanɛ mannɛ bumo be ekama e la anyi to be eko.
20Ama menyi ere, Yesu Kristo ta Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nna n wɔtɔ menyi to nɛ menyi kikɛ e pin kashenteŋ na. 21Mannɛ fanɛ men ka maŋ nyi kashenteŋ na so e shin nɛ mee sibɛ asɔ ere a sa menyi, ama menyi ka nyi kumo so nseŋ naa nyi fanɛ efɛ kikɛ maŋ wɔ kashenteŋ na to so nɛ mee sibɛ amo a sa menyi.
22Esa mo malɛ e baa la efɛpo nɛ mannɛ esa nɛ e bee kaŋɛ fanɛ mannɛ Yesu e la Kristo, Ebɔrɛ be esa laraso na.
