Loŋ be esa e la Kristo mo doŋ na, emo nɛ e bee kini Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Ebinyɛn na kikɛ na. 23Ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e bee kini Ebinyɛn na maŋ kɔ Etuto na nna na, nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee sɔ Ebinyɛn na kɔ Etuto na gba.
24Ama menyi ere e shin nɛ kusɔ nɛ men nu sososo kikɛ na e shir a wɔ menyi to. Nɛ kusɔ nɛ men nu sososo kikɛ na baa wɔ menyi to bre, kumo ere menyi alɛ gba beeŋ baa wɔ Ebinyɛn na nɛ Etuto na to. 25Kusɔ nɛ mo alɛ nase kɔnɔ fanɛ e beeŋ sa anyi e la ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.
26Mee sibɛ asɔ ere nna a sa menyi nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi basa nɛ baa sha kefule menyi na be asheŋ. 27Ama menyi ere, Yesu Kristo ta Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na nna n wɔtɔ menyi to nɛ e shir a wɔ menyi to. A maŋ daga fanɛ men naŋ nya esa ko nɛ e ŋini menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe Kiyoyu na e naa ŋini menyi asɔ kikɛ. Kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ e bee ŋini la kashenteŋ nna, mannɛ efɛ. Amoso, men baa bɛ Kiyoyu na be keŋini so nseŋ shir a wɔ Kristo na to.
Ebɔrɛ be mbia be asheŋ
28To, naniere ma mbi shasoana, men baa kraa wɔ mo to, saŋɛ na so, e kaŋ ba, anyi maaŋ baa shika to kikɛ, anyi alɛ maaŋ naŋ ji anishinyɔr mbe anishito ŋkpal menyi so. 29Menyi alɛ gba baa nyi Kristo na ka niŋi kusɔ kikɛ to. Kumo ere a daga fanɛ men baa nyi fanɛ esa kama nɛ e bee wora asɔ nɛ a niŋi la Ebɔrɛ pibi nna na.

Title: 1 JƆN 3
Content:
1Men keni kananɛ Etuto na sha anyi loŋ n shin nɛ baa tre anyi mbe mbia, kumo alɛ maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ malɛ fanɛ an ka la mbe mbia. Amoso nɛ durnyaebi maa pin anyi to na. Ebɔrɛ nɛ b maŋ pin to pɔɛŋ. 2N teri shasoana, naniere an la Ebɔrɛ be mbia nna na, ama kananɛ anyeeŋ ba kaa du kachako so bre e maŋ naŋ lar efuli. Kusɔ nɛ an baa nyi kikɛ e la fanɛ Kristo kaŋ ba lar efuli, anyeeŋ baa du fanɛ mo gbagba nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyeeŋ wu mo kananɛ e baa du. 3Esa kama nɛ e kɔ le be tama ere ashi Kristo to bee keni mbe kumu so nna a du cheembi fanɛ kananɛ Kristo du cheembi na. 4Esa kama nɛ e bee wora alubi bee wora nna a da Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba so na, ŋkpal manɛ so, kewora kulubi la ketɔr Ebɔrɛ be ntaŋ nna. 5Men nyi Kristo ka ba nɛ e ba ta basa be alubi n lɛ n sa bumo. Kulubi kikɛ malɛ maŋ wɔ mo to. 6Amoso, esa kama malɛ nɛ e shir a wɔ mo to maa wora alubi. Esa kama nɛ e baa wɔtɔ a wora alubi bre maŋ naŋ wu mo ŋko m pin mo Yesu na nna na.
7Ma mbi shasoana, men sa maŋ shin nɛ esa kikɛ e shin nɛ men foe ekpa. Ekama nɛ e bee wora asheŋ nɛ a niŋi la esa niŋiso nna ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito fanɛ kananɛ Kristo niŋi na. 8Esa kama malɛ nɛ e bee wora asheŋ lubi la alubipo na peya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, durnya be sososo na kikɛ nɛ alubipo na wɔtɔ a wora alubi m ba fo mbre. To, loŋ malɛ so nɛ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na lar m ba nɛ e ba jija alubipo na be ashuŋ.
9Esa kama nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ pibi maa wora alubi. Ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ be kapɔr gbagba ka wɔ mo to so nɛ ŋkpal Ebɔrɛ ka la mo Tuto na so so, e maaŋ tiŋ n shir a wɔ alubi to a wora amo. 10To, loŋ malɛ nɛ anyee ta a pin Ebɔrɛ be mbia nɛ bumo nɛ bumo alɛ la alubipo na be mbia. Esa kama nɛ e bee wora asɔ nɛ a maa niŋi, maŋ la Ebɔrɛ pibi. Ekama malɛ gba nɛ e maa sha mo niopibi, maŋ la Ebɔrɛ pibi.
Kebaasha abar be asheŋ
11Kubɔya ere nɛ men daŋ nu sososo kikɛ na fanɛ a daga fanɛ an baa sha abar. 12A maŋ daga fanɛ an baa du fanɛ Keen nɛ e daa la alubipo na peya nseŋ bri mo sipo m mɔ na. Nɛ manɛ e daŋ ba nɛ e daŋ bri mo m mɔ? Kusɔ nɛ k daŋ ba e la fanɛ mbe asheŋ woraso daa maa niŋi nna nɛ mo sipo bre peya daa niŋi. 13Amoso, n niopibiana, nɛ durnya ere to ebi kishi menyi, men sa maŋ shin nɛ k baa chinchiŋ menyi. 14Esa kama nɛ e maa sha mo braana kraa wɔ luwu to nna na. Ama anyi ere nyi fanɛ an lar luwu to m ba luri ŋkpa to nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyee sha an niopibiana. 15Esa kama nɛ e kishi mo niopibi la emɔpo nna, menyi alɛ nyi fanɛ emɔpo kikɛ maŋ kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na mo to. 16Le nɛ an bɔla m pin kusɔ nɛ k la kasha. Yesu Kristo e shin nɛ b lara mbe ŋkpa ashi mo to n sa anyi. Amoso, a daga fanɛ anyi alɛ gba ka ta anyi be ŋkpaana n sa an niopibiana. 17Ama esa kama nɛ e kɔ durnya ere to be asɔ nseŋ wu fanɛ mo niopibi daga kechɛto, mo alɛ nseŋ ti mbe kagbene a maŋ chɛ mo to, nuso nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kasha bee wora a chena esa na wura to?
Kristo mo doŋana be asheŋ
18Ma mbi shasoana, men sa maŋ shin nɛ an baa kɔ mmalga ŋko nnɔ nawule a sha basa, men shin nɛ an baa kɔ aworbi nɛ kashenteŋ a sha basa.
19Loŋ nɛ anyeeŋ pin an ka wɔ kashenteŋ na to nɛ saŋkama malɛ nɛ an be ŋgbene bee ji a bri anyi, anyeeŋ wushi amo ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 20Anyi alɛ beeŋ tiŋ n wora ade kikɛ nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e chɔ anyi be ŋgbene, mo alɛ nseŋ naa nyi kusɔ kama. 21Beshapo, nɛ an be ŋgbene baa maa ji a bri anyi, kumo ere anyi maa shika to Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 22Anyi alɛ naa tiŋ a nya kusɔ kama nɛ anyee kule mo ŋkpal an ka bee bɛ mbe mmalga naseso so so nsaa wora asɔ nɛ a bee par mo na so. 23Mbe kamalga naseso na malɛ nde fanɛ, a daga fanɛ an ka yirda mo Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo be ketre na nsaa sha abar fanɛ kananɛ e yili anyi fanɛ an baa wora na. 24Bekama malɛ nɛ baa bɛ mbe mmalga nasesoana na so shir a wɔ mo to nna nɛ mo alɛ gba wɔ bumo to. To, kananɛ anyee wora a pin fanɛ e wɔ anyi to nde: Mbe Kiyoyu nɛ e ta n sa anyi na so so nɛ an pin loŋ.

Title: 1 JƆN 4
Content:
Kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu na nɛ efɛ be ayoyu be asheŋ
1N teri shasoana, men sa maa yirda basa kama nɛ baa kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu wɔ bumo to. Men baa wora bumo a keni ŋko ayoyu mo nɛ b kɔ na shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna ŋko a maŋ shi mo kutɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, anebi fɛpo damtaana lar n luri durnya to. 2To, kananɛ menyeeŋ wora m pin Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na esa to nde: Kiyoyu kama nɛ e wɔ esa to a bugi to a kaŋɛ fanɛ Yesu Kristo ta eyur nna m ba durnya ere to na, shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna. 3Ama kiyoyu kama nɛ e maa ji Yesu be asheŋ be shɛda, loŋ be kiyoyu maŋ shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ. Loŋ be kiyoyu na e la edoŋ na be kiyoyu mo nɛ men nu fanɛ e bee ba na. Mo e teŋ ba durnya ere to na.
4Ama menyi ere, ma mbi shasoana, men la Ebɔrɛ be basa nna m pɔɔ loŋ be anebi fɛpoana so, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e wɔ menyi to na e chɔ emo nɛ e wɔ durnya ere to na. 5Durnya ere to be basa e la bumo, amoso, durnya ere to be mmalga nɛ baa malga nɛ durnya ere to ebi malɛ bee nu bumo be mmalga na. 6Anyi ere la Ebɔrɛ be basa nna, ekama malɛ nɛ e nyi Ebɔrɛ bee nu anyi be mmalga nna. Ama ekama malɛ nɛ e maŋ la Ebɔrɛ peya maa nu kusɔ nɛ anyee kaŋɛ. Loŋ malɛ nɛ anyee ta a pin kashenteŋ be Kiyoyu na nɛ efɛ be kiyoyu na to.
Ebɔrɛ be kasha nɛ anyi be kasha be asheŋ
7N teri shasoana, men shin nɛ an baa sha abar, ŋkpal manɛ so, kasha shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ nna. Esa kama nɛ e kɔ kasha la Ebɔrɛ pibi nna na, mo alɛ nsaa nyi Ebɔrɛ. 8Ama ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ kasha maŋ nyi Ebɔrɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ e la kashawura. 9Kananɛ Ebɔrɛ ŋini anyi mbe kasha nde: E shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn koŋwule nna durnya ere to fanɛ an bɔla mo so n nya ŋkpa. 10Kede nɛ baa tre kasha gbagba na, mannɛ anyi gbagba be kasha nɛ an ta n sha Ebɔrɛ, mo e sha anyi nseŋ shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn fanɛ e ba wu m mata be luwu nɛ k shin nɛ an nya alubi be ketampaŋ.
11N teri shasoana, ŋkpal kananɛ Ebɔrɛ sha anyi ere so, a daga fanɛ anyi alɛ gba e baa sha abar. 12Esa kama maŋ naŋ wu Ebɔrɛ kenishiso, ama nɛ an baa sha abar bre, kumo ere Ebɔrɛ wɔ anyi to nɛ mbe kasha malɛ bɔlɔ anyi to felɛlɛ kashenteŋto.
13Kananɛ anyee wora a pin fanɛ an wɔ mo to nɛ mo alɛ gba wɔ anyi to nde: E ta mo gbagba be Kiyoyu nna n sa anyi. 14Anyi alɛ wu nseŋ ji kumo be shɛda fanɛ Etuto na shuŋi mo Pibinyɛn fanɛ e ba kaa la durnya ere to be Emɔlgapo. 15Ekama nɛ e bee bugi to a kaŋɛ basa fanɛ Yesu e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na, Ebɔrɛ e wɔ amodoŋwura to nɛ mo alɛ gba wɔ Ebɔrɛ to. 16Anyi alɛ gba ba pin nseŋ yirda kasha mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ kɔ a sa anyi na.
Ebɔrɛ e la kashawura. Ekama malɛ nɛ e wɔ kasha be kebaawɔtɔ to, wɔ Ebɔrɛ to nna na nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ gba wɔ amodoŋwura to.
17Kasha malɛ bɔlɔ anyi to nna felɛlɛ, saŋɛ na so demujiachɛ na anyi maaŋ shika to, ŋkpal manɛ so, anyi be kebaawɔtɔ durnya ere to nɛ kananɛ Kristo du na la kukoŋwule nna. 18Kakpa nɛ kasha wɔ, kufu maŋ wɔtɔ. Kashenteŋ be kasha bee ju kufu nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, nɛ an kraŋ baa ŋana fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge anyi kusoe, kumo ere anyi maa sha mo nɛnɛ nna na. Amoso, esa nɛ e bee lɔ kufu, kasha maŋ naŋ bɔlɔ mo to felɛlɛ nna na. 19Ebɔrɛ e daŋ kesha anyi so shin nɛ anyi alɛ kɔ kasha na. 20Esa kama nɛ e bee kaŋɛ le: “Mee sha Ebɔrɛ,” mo alɛ nsaa kishi mo niopibi la efɛpo nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, esa nɛ e bee wu mo niopibi ŋkaa maaŋ tiŋ n sha mo, maaŋ tiŋ n sha Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e maŋ naŋ wu kikɛ na. 21To, le be kamalga naseso ere nɛ e ta m bɔɔ anyi enɔ fanɛ, esa kama nɛ e bee sha Ebɔrɛ e baa sha mo niopibi gba.

Title: 1 JƆN 5
Content:
Anyi be eleŋ ka chɔ durnya ere to ebi peya be asheŋ
1Esa kama nɛ e yirda fanɛ Yesu e la Kristo na la Ebɔrɛ pibi nna nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e bee sha esa nɛ e kurge ebi na beeŋ baa sha ebi na gba. 2Nɛ an baa sha Ebɔrɛ nsaa bɛ mbe mmalga naseso so bre, loŋ nɛ anyeeŋ pin an ka bee sha Ebɔrɛ be mbia gba. 3Kesha Ebɔrɛ malɛ e la kebɛ mbe mmalga nasesoana so, amo alɛ maŋ du kpakpa. 4Ŋkpal manɛ so, esa kama nɛ e la Ebɔrɛ pibi bee pɔɔ durnya ere so nna. Eleŋ mo nɛ k bee pɔɔ durnya so e la anyi be yirda. 5Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ m pɔɔ durnya ere so nɛ mannɛ esa nɛ e yirda fanɛ Yesu e la Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na?
Bumo nɛ b ji shɛda ŋ kaŋɛ Yesu be asheŋ
6Yesu ere e la emo nɛ e daŋ yili kabɔrɛbɛr be nchu nɛ mbe luwu be ŋklaŋ so m ba na. Mannɛ nchu na malɛ nawule so nɛ e daŋ yili so m ba, nchu na nɛ ŋklaŋ na kikɛ so nɛ e daŋ yili so m ba. 7Kiyoyu na malɛ e la shɛdajipo na, ŋkpal manɛ so, Kiyoyu na e la kashenteŋ na. 8Eshɛdajipo asa e wɔtɔ. Kiyoyu na wɔtɔ nɛ nchu na wɔtɔ nɛ ŋklaŋ na gba wɔtɔ. Kɔnɔkoŋwule nɛ amo alɛ kikɛ kɔ. 9Anyi maa kplaŋ dimɛdi be shɛda so, ama an nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be shɛda e chɔ dimɛdi peya, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be shɛda na nɛ e ta a ji mo Pibinyɛn be asheŋ. 10Esa kama malɛ nɛ e yirda Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na kɔ loŋ be shɛda na mbe kagbene to. Ama ekama nɛ e maŋ yirda Ebɔrɛ ta mo Ebɔrɛ na ŋ ki efɛpo nna na ŋkpal amodoŋwura na ka maŋ yirda shɛda mo nɛ e bee ji mo Pibinyɛn na be asheŋ na so. 11Shɛda na malɛ nde fanɛ, Ebɔrɛ sa anyi ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar nɛ loŋ be ŋkpa na wɔ mo Pibinyɛn na to. 12Esa kama nɛ e kɔ Ebinyɛn na kɔ ŋkpa na, ama ekama nɛ e maŋ kɔ Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na maŋ kɔ ŋkpa na.
Ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na be asheŋ
13Menyi bumo nɛ men yirda Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn be ketre na nɛ mee sibɛ asɔ ere a sa na nɛ men baa nyi fanɛ men kɔ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.
14Kusɔ nɛ k bee shin nɛ anyi maa shika to ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito nde fanɛ, kusɔ kama nɛ an baŋ bɔla Ebɔrɛ be keparso ŋ kule mo, e beeŋ nu an be kekule. 15To, nɛ an baa nyi fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ anyee kule mo e bee nu an be kekule, kumo ere an nyi fanɛ kusɔ kama nɛ anyee kule mo anyeeŋ nya kumo.
16Esa kama nɛ e wu mo niopibi ka bee wora kulubi nɛ k maŋ la luwu be kulubi, amodoŋwura e kule Ebɔrɛ nɛ e sa mo ŋkpa. Basa nɛ bumo be alubi maa yɛr bumo luwu to na nɛ n de na. Kulubi ko wɔtɔ a yɛr esa luwu to, mannɛ loŋ be kulubi na be kabɔrɛkule nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ amodoŋwura na e kule. 17Kewora n jija kikɛ la kulubi nna, ama kulubi ko wɔtɔ ŋkaa maa yɛr esa luwu to.
18An baa nyi fanɛ Ebɔrɛ pibi kama maa shir a wɔ alubi to a wora amo, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn e naa kuŋ mo nɛ alubipo na e sa maŋ tiŋ n doro mo.
19Anyi alɛ naa nyi fanɛ an ka la Ebɔrɛ peya, ama durnya ere bre kikɛ wɔ alubipo na be enɔ to nna.
20Anyi alɛ nseŋ naa nyi Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn na ka ba m ba sa anyi nfɛra nɛ an pin kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na, anyi alɛ wɔ mo kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na to nna, hale mo Pibinyɛn Yesu Kristo na to. Mo e la kashenteŋ be Ebɔrɛ na, nɛ ŋkpa nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na.
21Ma mbi shasoana, men baa gelge agbir.

Title: 2 JƆN 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma nɛ baa tre Enimu na kutɔ nna a yɔ kowurche nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara na nɛ mbe mbia kutɔ. Amo be kache na be asheŋ nɛ mee sha kashenteŋto na. Mannɛ n nawule malɛ gba e naa sha mbe asheŋ, bekama nɛ b nyi kashenteŋ be keŋini na gba bee sha mbe asheŋ, 2ŋkpal kashenteŋ be keŋini na ka wɔ anyi to, kumo alɛ ŋkaa beeŋ shir a wɔ anyi to mbaanaayɔ na so. 3Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nɛ Yesu Kristo nɛ e la Etuto na Pibinyɛn na sa anyi kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kuwɔr nɛ kagbenewushi n shin nɛ an nya kashenteŋ be kasha.
Kashenteŋ nɛ kasha be asheŋ
4Kowurche, ŋ ka pin fanɛ fo mbia ko wɔ kashenteŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na to fanɛ kananɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na nase na, ma kagbene fuli ma paa. 5Naniere malɛ mee kule fo nna fanɛ fo shin nɛ an kikɛ e baa sha abar be asheŋ, kumo alɛ maŋ la kamalga naseso popɔr ko nna nɛ mee sibɛ a sa fo, kumo nɛ an nya sososo na kikɛ na nna. 6Keŋini kasha e la kebaabɛ Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso so. Menyi alɛ kikɛ chɛr n nu dra dra na kikɛ fanɛ kusɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ na nase e la fanɛ a daga fanɛ men kikɛ e baa wɔ kasha be kebaawɔtɔ to.
7Befɛpo damta mo nɛ b maa yirda fanɛ Yesu Kristo ba durnya ere to nna fanɛ dimɛdi, lar n luri durnya to. Loŋ be basa na be ekama e la efɛpo nɛ Kristo mo doŋ na. 8Amoso, men baa de so n sa maŋ paŋ kusɔ nɛ men kpal kumo so n shuŋ na, ama men wora ania n nya men be tɔnɔ kikɛ nyam.
9Esa kama nɛ e maa shir a wɔ Kristo be keŋini na to nsaa ta asheŋ a ti amo so, maŋ kɔ Ebɔrɛ mo to. Ama ekama nɛ e shir a wɔ Kristo be keŋini na to, kɔ Etuto na nɛ Ebinyɛn na kikɛ mo to. 10Esa kama nɛ e ba men kutɔ nsaa maŋ bar le be keŋini ere, men sa maŋ chɔrɔ mo ŋko n sɔ mo n wɔtɔ men peana, 11ŋkpal manɛ so, ekama nɛ e chɔrɔ mo bee chɛ mo to a wora mbe ashuŋ lubi na nna na.
Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be mmalga be asheŋ
12Ŋ kraa kɔ asɔ damta nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ama m maa sha kesibɛ amo kawɔl to. Kusɔ nɛ mee tama e la fanɛ meeŋ ba bɔɔ menyi so nɛ ma nɛ menyi e chena m malga, saŋɛ na so an kikɛ be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli anyi parr.
13Fo sipo cheso nɛ Ebɔrɛ lara na gba be mbia bee chɔrɔ fo.

Title: 3 JƆN 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma nɛ baa tre Enimu na kutɔ nna a yɔ n teri kpakpaso Gayes nɛ mee sha kashenteŋto ga na kutɔ.
2N teri shaso, ma kabɔrɛkule nɛ ŋ kɔ a kule a sa fo e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ e shin nɛ kusɔ kama e baŋ nyalɛ n sa fo nɛ fo baa kɔ eyur be alenfia fanɛ kananɛ fo kɔ eleŋ fo kiyoyu to na. 3Bekurgepo ko ka ba kaŋɛ ma kananɛ fo kɔ kagbene koŋwule a bɛ kashenteŋ be keŋini na so nɛ kananɛ fo baa wɔ kashenteŋ na be kebaawɔtɔ to, ma kagbene fuli ma ga. 4Shɛŋ shɛŋ maa fuli ma kagbene a chɔ kebaanu fanɛ ma mbia wɔ kashenteŋ na be kebaawɔtɔ na to.
Gayes ka nya kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
5N teri shaso, kananɛ fo ta kagbene koŋwule a wora ashuŋ a sa bekurgepoana na ŋkeshin nɛ b la befɔ gba nna na, esa beeŋ tiŋ n fute n yige fo so. 6B ba ji fo kasha be asheŋ asɔri ere to nfe. Jande chɛ bumo to nɛ b naŋ nya bumo be enite na to be ekpa a yɔ fanɛ kananɛ asheŋ daga Ebɔrɛ be anishito. 7Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kristo be ketre na so nɛ b lar a wɔ bumo be enite na to a maa sɔ shɛŋ ashi bumo nɛ b maŋ yirda Yesu na kutɔ. 8Amoso, loŋ be basa e daga fanɛ anyi alɛ e baa chɛ bumo to, saŋɛ na so anyi nɛ bumo beeŋ baa chɛ abar to kashenteŋ be keŋini be kushuŋ na to.
Dayɔtrefis nɛ Demitrias be asheŋ
9N sibɛ kusɔ ko n shoŋi asɔriebi na, ama Dayɔtrefis nɛ e baa sha kejuŋkpar ga ashi bumo to na maa sha kenu n sa anyi. 10Amoso, ŋ kaŋ ba, meeŋ lara asheŋ nɛ e bee wora na kikɛ efuli. Meeŋ malga mbe mmalga lubi nɛ e kɔ a na a ji ma asheŋ na kikɛ. Ade malɛ be buushi, mo gbagba kini kesɔ bekurgepoana na, mo alɛ nsaa maa sa bumo nɛ baa sha kechɛ bumo to na ekpa nseŋ naa wɔtɔ a ju loŋ be basa na ashi asɔri to.
11N teri shaso, sa maa kute asheŋ lubi to, baa kute asheŋ lela to. Esa kama nɛ e bee wora alela la Ebɔrɛ peya nna, ama ekama nɛ e bee wora alubi maŋ naŋ wu Ebɔrɛ. 12Demitrias bre, ekama bee malga mbe kebaawɔtɔ lela be asheŋ nɛ loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na malɛ nɛ kashenteŋ be keŋini na maa lar abar kaman. Anyi alɛ gba bee ji mbe kebaawɔtɔ lela be shɛda nɛ fo alɛ nyi anyi be shɛda ka la kashenteŋ.
Lalaloge be kechɔrɔ be asheŋ
13Ŋ kraa kɔ asɔ damta nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi, ama m maa sha kesibɛ amo kawɔl to. 14Ŋ kɔ tama fanɛ k maaŋ chɛr nɛ n wu fo, saŋɛ na so anyeeŋ chena m malga abar kutɔ.
15Ebɔrɛ e sa menyi kagbenewushi. Fo teriana na kikɛ bee chɔrɔ fo. Chɔrɔ an teriana na kikɛ kukoko to n sa ma.

Title: JUUD 1
Content:
1Kawɔl ere shi ma Juud, Jeems mo sipo nɛ n la Yesu Kristo be kenya na kutɔ nna a yɔ bumo nɛ Ebɔrɛ Etuto na bee sha nseŋ tre bumo m ba kaa keni bumo so ŋkpal Yesu Kristo so na kutɔ. 2Ebɔrɛ e wu menyi kuwɔr nseŋ sa menyi kagbenewushi nɛ kasha nɛ a baa wɔ menyi to a ti so saŋkikɛ.
Beŋinipo fɛpoana be asheŋ
3Ma beshapo, k daa wɔ ma kagbene to nna ga fanɛ n sibɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi kumɔlga mo nɛ an kikɛ kɔ na be asheŋ, ama n naŋ wu fanɛ a daga fanɛ n sibɛ menyi ŋ kule menyi ga fanɛ men baa wora ania a kɔ a sa abɔrɛsheŋ mo nɛ an yirda nɛ Ebɔrɛ ta kela koŋwule pati m bɔɔ mbe basa laraso enɔ na. 4Mee kaŋɛ le nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, basa ko mo nɛ b maa nu a sa Ebɔrɛ ŋana n nyia n luri menyi to a sha kechɛrga Ebɔrɛ be kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ e kɔ a sa anyi na be kifito, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya ekpa a wora kulubi kama nɛ baa sha. Baa kini Yesu Kristo gbagba mo nɛ mo nawule la an Nyɛnpe mo nɛ e bee ji anyi so kuwura na. Dra na malɛ kikɛ nɛ b sibɛ abɔrɛsibɛ na to a kaŋɛ fanɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge loŋ be basa na kikɛ kusoe.
5N nyi men ka tea nyi asheŋ nɛ mee sha kekaŋɛ menyi ere kikɛ, ama mee sha kenyiŋi menyi kananɛ Enyɛnpe daŋ mɔlga mbe basa Israɛlebi ashi Ijipt be kasawule so nna. Kumo be kaman nɛ e mur bumo to be bumo nɛ b daa maŋ yirda mo na. 6Men baa nyiŋi emalaika mo nɛ b daa maŋ shuli a wɔ kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ daa sha fanɛ b baa wɔ na be asheŋ. B daŋ shile ndoŋ nna ŋkpal k ka daa maŋ bɔlɔ bumo kenishi so. Naniere b ta ŋgbɛlɛbi mo nɛ esa maaŋ tiŋ n tuge kikɛ nna ŋ kre bumo n wɔtɔ tentembiri be kakpa a jo kachɛgboŋ mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ji bumo demu na. 7Men baa nyiŋi nde mo nɛ baa tre Sodɔm nɛ Gomɔra nɛ nde mo nɛ a daŋ taga amo to na gba be asheŋ. Ndoŋebi gba daa wora kesakalea be asheŋ nɛ alubi kama nɛ a maŋ daga dimɛdi ka wora nna. B wɔ edɛ mo nɛ a maa duŋ kikɛ na to nɛ k bee ŋini anyi kananɛ Ebɔrɛ beeŋ gberge bekama nɛ baa wora asheŋ fanɛ loŋ be basa na kusoe. 8Loŋ koŋwule na malɛ nɛ bumo nɛ b luri menyi to na du. B wɔtɔ nna a ku edare nsaa wora alubi a gbiti bumo gbagba be eyurana, baa kini Ebɔrɛ be eleŋ nsaa tege emalaika mo nɛ b kɔ kemaŋkura ashi ebɔrɛso na.
9Hale Maikel mo nɛ e la emalaika kikɛ be ejuŋkparpo na daa maŋ shoduu Setani saŋɛ nɛ mo nɛ mo daa ji emɔrɔ ŋkpal anebi Mosis be eyur so na. E daa maŋ maŋ mbe kumu so n tege Setani, kusɔ nɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ e la: “Ebɔrɛ e fiɛ fo so!” 10Ama le be basa ere bre bee tege kusɔ kama nɛ b maa pin to nna. B baa du fanɛ kupuŋ to be asɔbɔya nɛ a maŋ kɔ nfɛra lela nna nseŋ baa wɔtɔ a wora asɔ kama nɛ a bee ba amo be amu to na nna, loŋ malɛ be asɔ na gbagba e naa mur bumo na. 11Cha, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa bumo kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, ekpa nɛ Keen daŋ ta na nɛ b bɛ so na. Ŋkpal amansherbi so b luri alubi to fanɛ kananɛ Balaam daŋ wora na. B daŋ ji kenimu kikɛ emɔrɔ fanɛ kananɛ Koora daŋ wora na, amoso, bumo alɛ gba beeŋ mur fanɛ mo.
12Nɛ le be basa ere baŋ tu menyi n chena kakpa nɛ asɔriebi bee shɛr a ji a ŋini abar kasha, k du fanɛ asɔ lubi ka do kusɔ fuful so nna. Baa paŋ anishinyɔr nna a tase a ji a nuu a keni bumo nawule be amu so. B du fanɛ bɔrɛ ka mɔl nna nɛ afu ta awɔlpa na n choŋ nɛ bɔrɛ na gboŋi na nna. K maŋ kɔ tɔnɔ kikɛ kuraa. B naa du fanɛ ndibi sɔrso mo nɛ a maŋ kɔ asɔrso amo be kesɔr be saŋɛ na nna, amoso, b du fanɛ ndibi mo nɛ a wu nɛ b tia amo nna nɛ k ki fanɛ a wu nna na kuraa. 13B du fanɛ teku so be atili lubi nna a shin nɛ bumo be anishinyɔr bee kaa fanɛ atili na be eyurpi. Bumo alɛ naa du fanɛ achɛkpabi mo nɛ a bee tia a tia ashi amo be mboŋana nna. Ebɔrɛ malɛ lɔŋɛ kakpa nna n yili bumo nɛ b ya kaa wɔ ndoŋ mbaanaayɔ ashi tentembiri mina to.
14Le malɛ be basa ere be asheŋ nɛ Inɔk nɛ e la esa nɛ e yili Adam be jemanɛ na so m bɛ so esa shunusopo na daŋ wu ŋ kaŋɛ na fanɛ: “Men keni Enyɛnpe nɛ mbe emalaika ŋgboŋ to ŋgboŋ to ba 15nɛ e ba ji basa kikɛ demu. E beeŋ ji m bri bɔrɛkinipoana kikɛ ŋkpal alubi mo nɛ b wora ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ ashi le be kabɔrɛkini be ekpa so kikɛ so nɛ mmalga lubiana nɛ bɔrɛkinipo lubipo ere malga ŋ gbiti mo Ebɔrɛ na kikɛ so so.”
16Saŋkikɛ le be basa ere wɔtɔ nna a bile asheŋ a wu basa pɔtɛ kulubi. Baa bɛ bumo gbagba be ayɛlgasɔ lubiana so nna a wɔtɔ a puchi nsaa ta mmalga belbelso a fule basa pɔtɛ, saŋɛ na so baaŋ nya kusɔ nɛ baa sha.
Kefiɛso be mmalga be asheŋ
17Ama menyi ere, n teri lelaana, men baa nyi asɔ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo be beshuŋipoana na daŋ kaŋɛ fanɛ a beeŋ wora na. 18B daŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ: “Lalaloge be nchɛ na kaŋ fo, basa beeŋ lar n wora menyi eyurto, basa nɛ baaŋ ba kaa bɛ bumo gbagba be kabɔrɛkiniso be ayɛlgasɔ lubiana so.” 19Le be basa ere e naa bar kebarga to basa to na, durnya to be basa nɛ b maŋ kɔ Ebɔrɛ be Kiyoyu na. 20Ama menyi ere, n teri lelaana, men baa wora ania ga a chɛ abar to a yɔ anishito ashi abɔrɛsheŋ cheembi nɛ men yirda ga na to nsaa kule Ebɔrɛ ashi Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na to. 21Men baa kɔ men be amu a wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kasha to a jo saŋɛ nɛ an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo beeŋ wu anyi kuwɔr n shin nɛ anyi nɛ mo e baa wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na. 22Men baa wu bumo nɛ baa shika to na kuwɔr. 23Men baa mɔlga beko a suge bumo ashi edɛ to, men baa wu beko malɛ kuwɔr nsaa ŋana bumo be alubiana a de so nɛ a sa maŋ kaŋ gbiti menyi.
Kedi Ebɔrɛ epaŋ be mmalga be asheŋ
24Men shin nɛ an baa di Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e beeŋ tiŋ ŋ keni menyi so nɛ men sa maŋ tɔr na epaŋ. Mo e naaŋ tiŋ n chɛ menyi to nɛ men yige alubi be kebaawora nseŋ tiŋ n yili mbe anishito cheembi n wu mbe kemaŋkura kagbenefuliso 25Mo nawule e la Ebɔrɛ. Mo e mɔlga anyi ŋkpal an Nyɛnpe Yesu Kristo so, mo alɛ e naa kɔ eleŋ kikɛ nɛ kusɔ kikɛ to pɔɛŋ nɛ saŋkikɛ fara. Mo alɛ beeŋ baa kraa kɔ amo to saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ. Amoso, men baa sa mo kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ eleŋ nɛ kenimuji saŋkama. Amɛn.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 1
Content:
1Yesu Kristo be asɔ nɛ Ebɔrɛ sa mo nɛ e lara ŋ ŋini mbe anya nde. A la asɔ nɛ a maaŋ chɛr nseŋ wora nna nɛ e shuŋi mbe kabɔ fanɛ e ba lara amo ŋ ŋini ma, mbe kenya Jɔn 2nɛ ma alɛ ji asɔ nɛ n wu na kikɛ be shɛda, amo e la fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be kamalga nɛ asɔ nɛ Yesu Kristo malga na kikɛ be asheŋ. 3Nɛfa la ekama nɛ e bee kraŋ abɔrɛsheŋ be kewuŋkaŋɛ be mmalga ere nɛ bekama nɛ baa nu amo nsaa ta asɔ nɛ n sibɛ n wɔtɔ amo to a wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to na peya nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo be saŋɛ na bee taga to.
Jɔn ka bee chɔrɔ asɔri ashunu na be asheŋ
4Kawɔl ere shi ma Jɔn kutɔ nna a yɔ asɔri ashunu mo nɛ a wɔ Eeshia be kasawule so na kutɔ. Kuwɔr be kakɛ nɛ kagbenewushi e shi esa nɛ e daa wɔtɔ nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ ŋkeŋ naa ba na nɛ ayoyu ashunu mo nɛ a wɔ mbe kuwurputi be anishito na kutɔ a la menyeya. 5Loŋ be kuwɔr be kakɛ koŋwule na nɛ kagbenewushi na e shi Yesu Kristo nɛ e la shɛdajipo nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda na, mo alɛ nseŋ juŋkpar bubuni kikɛ n tiŋi luwu to nseŋ naa la kasawule ere so be bewura be esa nɛ e bee ji bumo so kuwura na kutɔ m ba.
E bee sha anyi nna ga nseŋ bɔla mbe ŋklaŋ so na n sɔ anyi ashi alubi to n yige, 6nseŋ ta anyi ŋ ki mbe kuwura to ebi nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ an baa shuŋ mbe Ebɔrɛ nɛ Etuto na. Kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ e baa la Yesu Kristo peya saŋkikɛ mbaanaayɔ. Amɛn. 7Men keni mo nɛ awɔlpa kulti a ba na, kenishi kama malɛ beeŋ wu mo n ta bumo nɛ b ta kusɔ n da mo m mɔ na n ti so nɛ kasawule ere so be basa kikɛ e shu ŋkpal mo so. Kumo be loŋ bre maŋ kɔ emɔrɔ. Amɛn.
8Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na yɛ: “Ma e la Alfa nɛ Omega, Enyɛnpetale mo nɛ e daa wɔtɔ nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ nseŋ naa ba na.”
Kewuŋkaŋɛ na be sososo be asheŋ
9Kachako b shin nɛ ma Jɔn, men kurgepo nɛ an kikɛ bee ji awurfoŋ nsaa la kuwura na to be basa a kɔ kanyiti a yil to ŋkpal Yesu so na ya kaa wɔ kepla nɛ baa tre Patmɔs na so ŋkpal ŋ ka daŋ malga Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na nseŋ daŋ ji Yesu be shɛda so. 10Enyɛnpe be kachɛ ko mbe kiyoyu koso ma kikɛ to nɛ n nu ebɔl ka wora awɔr ma kamanto fanɛ kabel na. 11Ebɔl na yɛ: “Sibɛ asɔ nɛ feeŋ wu ere n wɔtɔ kawɔl to nseŋ ta kawɔl na n sa nɛ b ya sa asɔri ashunu na. Asɔriana nɛ a wɔ Ɛfeses nɛ Smɛɛna nɛ Pɛɛgamem nɛ Tayataira nɛ Saadis nɛ Filadɛlfia nɛ Laodisiya na.”
12Ŋ ka nu asheŋ ere nɛ ŋ kilgi nɛ ŋ keni ebɔl na wura nseŋ wu shuwa be kefitilatɔl ashunu. 13Shuwa be kefitilatɔl ashunu na malɛ to n wu esa ko fanɛ dimɛdi pibinyɛnso ka buu piŋi nɛ k gbelge n ya fo mbe ayadra so nɛ shuwa be kreso paŋgelambi ko ŋ kre mbe nteto. 14Mbe kumu nɛ emin daŋ fuli nna parr fanɛ ateebi ŋko abɔrɛjembubi nɛ mbe anishi malɛ daa du fanɛ edɛ be adondulombi. 15Mbe ayadra daa du fanɛ katishaŋ peper nna a kpa edɛ fanɛ b ka lara amo edɛ to m bel amo na nɛ mbe ebɔl malɛ daa gbri fanɛ nchu damta ka bee shile na. 16E daa kɔ achɛkpabi ashunu nna mbe enɔjiso to nɛ tokobi jinnɔnyɔ jiso ko shi mbe kɔnɔ to n lar. Mbe anishiakpa malɛ daa kpa edɛ nna fanɛ epeŋi ka bee nyaŋɛ ga na.
17Ŋ ka wu mo na nɛ n tɔr mbe anishito fanɛ ŋ ka wu na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ e ta mbe enɔjiso n deŋi ma so nseŋ kaŋɛ: “Sa maa lɔ kufu, ma e la Faraŋko nɛ Lalaloge, 18ma e la emo nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na. N daŋ wu nna, ama naniere n tiŋi nna a wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ. Ma alɛ e kɔ luwu nɛ bubuni to be kakpa be eleŋ. 19Amoso, sibɛ asɔ nɛ fo wu ere, asɔ nɛ a wɔtɔ naniere nɛ amo nɛ a beeŋ wora kachako so na n nase. 20Achɛkpabi ashunu nɛ fo wu ma enɔjiso to na nɛ shuwa be kefitilatɔl ashunu na be wulo na be afito nde: Achɛkpabi ashunu na e la asɔri ashunu na be emalaika nɛ kefitilatɔl ashunu na malɛ la asɔri ashunu na.”

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 2
Content:
Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Ɛfeses be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ
1E yɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Ɛfeses be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le:
‘Mmalga ere shi esa nɛ e kɔ achɛkpabi ashunu mbe enɔjiso to nsaa na shuwa be kefitilatɔl ashunu na to na kutɔ nna. 2N nyi men be aworbi kikɛ a nyi kananɛ men shuŋ ga nseŋ naa nyi kananɛ men kɔ kanyiti a yil to. N nyi kananɛ menyi nɛ basa lubi maaŋ tiŋ n chena nsaa nyi fanɛ men wora basa nɛ b yɛ b la beshuŋipoana, bumo alɛ ŋkaa maŋ la na ŋ keni n wu fanɛ befɛpo e la bumo. 3N nyi kananɛ men kɔ kanyiti a yil to nɛ kananɛ menyee ji tɔrɔ ŋkpal ma ketre so, menyi alɛ ŋkaa maa pɔ aba.
4Ama kusɔ lubi nɛ n wu menyi so nde fanɛ men lɛ men be sososo be kasha na. 5Men keni ketɔr gboŋgboŋi nɛ men tɔr na. Men lar men be alubi to nseŋ naa wora asheŋ nɛ men daa wora sososo na. Nɛ men baa maŋ lar men be alubi na to, meeŋ ba menyi kutɔ m ba ta men be kefitilatɔl ashi kumo be eyilikpa. 6Ama kusɔ nɛ k walɛ menyi e la fanɛ men kishi katuŋ nɛ baa tre Nikolawsebi na be asheŋ fanɛ kananɛ ma alɛ gba kishi kumo be asheŋ na.
7Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe, e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na.
Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so, meeŋ sa mo ekpa nɛ e ji ŋkpa be kedibi nɛ k wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kakpa lela nɛ baa tre ndoŋ Paradisi to na be kusɔrso na.’ ”
Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Smɛɛna be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ
8Kede be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Smɛɛna be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le:
‘Mmalga ere shi emo nɛ e la sososo nɛ lalaloge nseŋ daŋ wu n naŋ tiŋi a wɔ ŋkpa to na kutɔ nna. 9N nyi men be etɔrɔ nsaa nyi men be ketir be asheŋ, ama kashenteŋ bre, damawuraana e la menyi. Ma alɛ kraŋ naa nyi mmalga lubi mo nɛ basa nɛ baa tre bumo be amu Juwebi, bumo alɛ ŋkaa maŋ la na bee malga a gbiti menyi, ama bumo alɛ la Setani be katuŋ to be basa nna. 10Men sa maŋ kaa ŋana asheŋ nɛ a bee shin nɛ a ba menyi so ere. Mee kaŋɛ menyi nna na fanɛ alubipo na beeŋ shin nɛ b ta menyi be beko n ti ebu nɛ e wora menyi ŋ keni nɛ men ji tɔrɔ nchɛ kudu. Ama men baa yil to kpakpa loŋ n ya kaa fo luwu to be keluri to gba nɛ n sa menyi ŋkpa be kuwurwuro na.
11Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na.
Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so, luwu nyɔsopo na maaŋ doro mo kikɛ.’ ”
Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Pɛɛgamem be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ
12Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Pɛɛgamem be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le:
‘Mmalga ere shi emo nɛ e kɔ tokobi jinnɔnyɔ jiso to na kutɔ nna. 13N nyi kakpa nɛ men wɔ ere be asheŋ, kakpa nɛ Setani baa tase gbagba. Ŋkeshin nɛ menyi alɛ maa lar ma ketre na kaman. Men maŋ lar men be yirda nɛ men kɔ ma so na kaman kikɛ, hale ma shɛdajipo nɛ esa beeŋ tiŋ n yirda na Antipas nɛ b daŋ mɔ men be kadegboŋ na to, kakpa nɛ Setani baa wɔ na be jemanɛ na kikɛ. 14Ama asɔ lubi gbrɛbi nɛ n wu menyi so nde: Men kɔ basa ko menyi to ndoŋ nɛ baa bɛ Balaam be keŋini so, Balaam mo nɛ e daŋ ŋini Balak kananɛ e beeŋ fule Israɛlebi nɛ b ji nlɔŋɛjibi nseŋ naŋ fule bumo n wɔtɔ kesakalea be keji to na. 15Beko malɛ gba wɔ menyi to a bɛ katuŋ nɛ baa tre Nikolawsebi na be keŋini so. 16Amoso, men lar loŋ be alubi na to, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, m maaŋ chɛr nseŋ ba menyi kutɔ m ba ta ma kɔnɔ to be tokobi m ba kɔ bumo.
17Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na.
Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so, meeŋ sa mo manna ŋana so na be ako. Kumo be kaman nɛ n naŋ sa mo kejembu fuful mo nɛ b sibɛ kumo so ketre popɔr mo nɛ esa nɛ e bee sɔ kejembu na nawule nyi na.’ ”
Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Tayataira be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ
18Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Tayataira be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le:
‘Mmalga ere shi Ebɔrɛ Pibinyɛn mo nɛ mbe anishi du fanɛ edɛ be adondulombi nɛ mbe ayadra malɛ bee kpa edɛ fanɛ katishaŋ peper na kutɔ nna.
19N nyi men be aworbi nɛ men be kasha nɛ yirda, nɛ kananɛ menyee shuŋ beko nseŋ naa nyi kanyiti nɛ men kɔ a yil to. Ma alɛ naa nyi fanɛ naniere menyee wora asheŋ ga a chɔ kananɛ men daa wora sososo na. 20Ama kusɔ nɛ n wu menyi so e la fanɛ, men sa kache Jɛzebel mo nɛ e bee tre mbe kumu abɔrɛsheŋ be ewuŋkaŋɛpo na ekpa nna nɛ e wɔtɔ a ŋini nsaa shin nɛ ma anya bee luri kesakalea be keji to nseŋ naa shin nɛ baa ji nlɔŋɛjibi. 21N sa mo saŋɛ nɛ e lar mbe alubi to, ama e maa sha kelar mbe kesakalea na to. 22Amoso, meeŋ ta kulɔ n lɛ mo so nɛ e dese kelaŋ so ŋkeŋ shin nɛ bumo nɛ baa tu mo a ji kesakalea na malɛ e nu ebesa ga ama b baŋ lar bumo be alubi na to nna. 23Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ shin nɛ mbe mbia e wu n wu nɛ asɔriana na kikɛ to ebi e pin fanɛ ma e la esa nɛ e bee mige ŋgbene nɛ nfɛraana to a wu amo to na. Ma alɛ beeŋ ka ekama be kusɔ nɛ e wora kikɛ be kukɔ. 24Ama menyi Tayatairaebi nɛ men ka ŋkaa maa bɛ loŋ be keŋini na so nseŋ maŋ naŋ bii asɔ nɛ beko bee tre Setani be wulo be keŋini chiŋgeliŋana na so na bre, m maaŋ naŋ ta kegben kama n ti menyi so. 25Ama men baa kɔ asɔ nɛ men tea kɔ ere to hale nɛ n ya ba.
26Esa kama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so ŋkaa kɔ ma aworbi na to n ya fo lalaloge na, meeŋ sa amodoŋwura eleŋ nɛ k bee ji efuliana so 27nɛ amodoŋwura na e ta kagbene kpakpaso n ji kuwura bumo so n wora bumo fanɛ kananɛ esa bee kaa buri kaba to na. Eleŋ na beeŋ baa du fanɛ kananɛ ŋ gbagba nya eleŋ ashi n Tuto kutɔ na. 28Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ sa amodoŋwura karechɛso be kechɛkpabi na.
29Amoso, ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na.’ ”

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 3
Content:
Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Saadis be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ
1Nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Saadis be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le:
‘Mmalga ere shi esa nɛ e kɔ Ebɔrɛ be ayoyu ashunu nɛ achɛkpabi ashunu na to na kutɔ nna. N nyi men be aworbi kikɛ, n nyi men ka kɔ ketre basa kutɔ fanɛ men wɔ ŋkpa to nna, ama men wu nna a wɔtɔ. 2Men tiŋi ashi loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na to nseŋ wɔtɔ men be kabɔrɛbɛso na be mboŋ nɛ a ka a shin nɛ a mur na eleŋ to, nɛ mannɛ aloŋ, amo alɛ gba beeŋ mur kuraa. Ŋkpal manɛ so, m maŋ wu men be aworbi ka walɛ a bɔlɔ ma Ebɔrɛ be kenishi. 3Amoso, men baa nyiŋi asɔ nɛ men daŋ sɔ nseŋ nu na kikɛ. Men baa bɛ amo so nseŋ lar alubi to. Nɛ men baŋ maŋ tiŋi men be loŋ be kebaawɔtɔ na to, meeŋ ba fanɛ eyu nɛ men maaŋ pin saŋɛ nɛ meeŋ purgi menyi. 4Men kraa kɔ basa gbrɛbi ko ashi Saadis to nɛ eyurpi kama maŋ gbiti bumo be asɔbuuso na. Bumo alɛ beeŋ tu ma n nite m buu asɔ fuful, ŋkpal manɛ so, b daga loŋ.
5Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so beeŋ buu asɔ fuful fanɛ bumo. M maaŋ kpra mbe ketre ashi ŋkpa be kawɔl na to kikɛ, ama meeŋ ji mbe shɛda n sa n Tuto nɛ mbe emalaika.
6Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na.’ ”
Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Filadɛlfia be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ
7Nɛ e kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Filadɛlfia be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le:
‘Mmalga ere shi ma, emo nɛ e du cheembi nsaa la kashenteŋwura nsaa kɔ Ewura Deevid be sɔfi to na kutɔ nna. Kusɔ nɛ m bugi, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ti kumo, kusɔ kama malɛ nɛ n ti, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ m bugi kumo. 8N nyi men be aworbi. Men nu nfe, m bugi kabuna mo nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n ti na n yili menyi. N nyi men ka maŋ kɔ eleŋ ga, ama men ta ma mmalga n wɔtɔ men be ŋgbene to ŋkaa maŋ lar ma ketre na kaman. 9Men nu nfe, basa nɛ b wɔ Setani be katuŋ to, befɛpo na, bumo e wɔtɔ a tre bumo be amu Juwebi, bumo alɛ maŋ la na, meeŋ shin nɛ b ba gbir men be anishito n shin nɛ b pin fanɛ ma e sha menyi. 10Ŋkpal men ka bɛ kusɔ nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ menyi fanɛ men baa yili to kanyitiso na so so, ma alɛ gba beeŋ kuŋ menyi ashi kechɔŋkeni be jemanɛ mo nɛ k bee ba durnyaebi kikɛ so m ba wora basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule so kikɛ ŋ keni na. 11M maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba, men baa kɔ kusɔ nɛ men tea kɔ to na to kpakpa nɛ esa kikɛ e sa maŋ tiŋ n sɔ men be kekɔmpɔɔso be tɔnɔ.
12Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so, meeŋ ta mo ŋ ki ma Ebɔrɛ be lambu to be shabɔrɛ. Mo alɛ maaŋ naŋ lar kumo to kikɛ nɛ n sibɛ ma Ebɔrɛ be ketre nɛ ma Ebɔrɛ be kadegboŋ be ketre n deŋi mo so. Kade na e la Jerusalɛm popɔr nɛ k bee shi ma Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ashi ebɔrɛso a ba na. Ma alɛ beeŋ naŋ sibɛ ma ketre popɔr n deŋi mo so.
13Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe, e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na.’ ”
Kubɔya nɛ k yɔ Laodisiya be kade to be asɔri to be asheŋ
14Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ: “Sibɛ kawɔl ere n sa Laodisiya be kade to be asɔri be malaika na ŋ kaŋɛ mo le:
‘Mmalga ere shi ma nɛ n la Amɛn nɛ kashenteŋ be shɛdajipo nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n yirda na nɛ n la Ebɔrɛ be kepɔrso kikɛ be gbaltɔlase na kutɔ nna. 15N nyi men be aworbi kikɛ fanɛ men la basa nɛ men maŋ wushi, menyi alɛ maŋ naa tushi. Men daŋ baa la basa nɛ b wushi ŋko bumo nɛ baa tushi, k daa beeŋ baa kɔ kifito. 16Ama ŋkpal men ka du yulɛyulɛbi fanɛ nchu a maa tushi, menyi alɛ maŋ naŋ wushi na so, meeŋ luu menyi ashi ma kɔnɔ to n lɛ. 17Men yɛ: An dii dama n nya kusɔ kama nyam nɛ anyee sha, anyi maŋ naa sha shɛŋ. Ama menyi alɛ maŋ nyi fanɛ men la awurfoŋwuraana nɛ basa nɛ bumo be asheŋ kɔ kuwɔr nɛ betirpo nɛ betanpo nɛ basa delgeso nna. 18Amoso, mee sa menyi nfɛra nna fanɛ men tɔ shuwa mo nɛ a maŋ kɔ saŋgre kikɛ amo to ŋ kutɔ, saŋɛ na so menyeeŋ dii dama. Men tɔ asɔbuuso fuful gba ashi ŋ kutɔ m buu men be anishinyɔr be eyurkpaŋ na so nseŋ tɔ kudur malɛ gba n fɔr men be anishiana so n tiŋ a wu. 19Ma ere, basa nɛ mee sha nɛ mee fiɛ so nsaa ŋini bumo ekpa, amoso, men yeŋi so n lar men be alubi to.
20Men nu nfe, n yil kabuna to nna a ŋmɛa, ekama nɛ e nu ma ebɔl nseŋ bugi kabuna n sa ma, meeŋ luri mo kutɔ n tu mo n ji nɛ mo alɛ gba e tu ma n ji.
21Esa kama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so, meeŋ sa mo ekpa nɛ e tu ma n chena ma kuwurputi so fanɛ kananɛ ŋ kɔ m pɔɔ so nseŋ chena n Tuto kutɔ ashi mbe kuwurputi so na.
22Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe, e baa nu asɔ nɛ Kiyoyu na bee kaŋɛ asɔriana na.’ ”

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 4
Content:
Kabɔrɛbunyaŋ ashi ebɔrɛso be asheŋ
1Ade kikɛ be kaman nɛ ŋ keni nɛ kabuna bugi a yil ebɔrɛso. Nɛ ebɔl mo nɛ n daŋ juŋkpar n nu nɛ k bee malga ŋ kutɔ fanɛ kabel na kaŋɛ ma le: “Dii m ba nfe nɛ ŋ ŋini fo asɔ nɛ a beeŋ wora asheŋ ere kikɛ be kaman.” 2Epul na to nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na koso ma kikɛ to nɛ ŋ keni n wu kuwurputi ebɔrɛso nɛ esa ko tase kumo so. 3Esa nɛ e daa tase ndoŋ na daa kpa edɛ nna palpal, a du fanɛ kejembu nɛ baa tre jaspa na nna, nseŋ pere kpaiŋ fanɛ kejembu nɛ baa tre saadie na. Kabɔrɛnyaŋgelambi ko malɛ daa du fanɛ ɛmeraldi be kejembu nɛ k la kefitiri bumbuŋ nawule na daŋ kulti kuwurputi na. 4Nwurputi adunyɔ nɛ ana ko malɛ gba daŋ chambɔ ŋ kulti kuwurputi mo na nɛ bejuŋkparpo adunyɔ nɛ ana chena n chena amo so. B daŋ buu asɔ fuful nna nseŋ buu shuwa be nwurwuro. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛ shi kuwurputi na akpa a ponte to a gbri le gbrugbru nsaa nyɛkpɛ palpal nɛ efitila ashunu yil kuwurputi na be anishito a suse. Ndia ashunu na e la Ebɔrɛ be ayoyu ashunu na. 6Kusɔ ko malɛ daa du fanɛ digi a dese fanɛ teku kuwurputi koŋwule na be anishito a wu to kleembi. Asɔbɔya keniso ana ko malɛ gba daa yil kuwurputi na be mboŋ ana nna nsaa kɔ anishi amo be anishito nɛ amo be mmanto be kaplɛkama. 7Sososo be kusɔbɔya keniso na daa du fanɛ buluŋ nna nɛ kenyɔsopo daa du fanɛ kena nɛ kesasopo daa kɔ anishiakpa fanɛ nyiŋgbasa nɛ kenasopo malɛ daa du fanɛ kusore ka bee firgi. 8Asɔbɔya keniso ana na be kekama daa kɔ atɛ ashe nna nɛ anishi malɛ sɔ bumo be eyurana kikɛ so hale bumo be atɛana to kikɛ. Kapa nɛ kanyɛ b daa maa lo to kikɛ, b daŋ baa boŋ le nna:
“Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ e la cheembi cheembi cheembi.
Mo e daa wɔtɔ nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ ŋkeŋ naa ba na.”
9Saŋkama malɛ asɔbɔya keniso na bee sa esa nɛ e tase kuwurputi na so na nsaa wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ na kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ kechɔrɔ nna. 10Bejuŋkparpo adunyɔ nɛ ana na bee jɔŋɛ esa nɛ e tase kuwurputi so na nna nseŋ bunyaŋ mo koŋwule nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ na. Baa bugi bumo be nwurwuro nna a nase kuwurputi na be anishito nsaa kaŋɛ le:
11“An Nyɛnpe nɛ an be Ebɔrɛ,
fo e daga kenya kemaŋkura nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ eleŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo e to kusɔ kikɛ,
fo alɛ be keparso nɛ b to kusɔ kama nɛ k wɔ ŋkpa to.”

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 5
Content:
Kawɔl sibɛso nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu kawɔl sibɛso ka wɔ esa nɛ e daŋ chena kuwurputi na so be enɔjiso so. Kasibɛ e daŋ bɔlɔ kumo be anishito nɛ kamanto kikɛ nɛ b ta tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi ashunu m pɛ kumo. 2Ndoŋ nɛ n wu malaika lempo ko ka bee ponte awɔrso a bishi le: “Wanɛ e daga nɛ e tiŋ m bu m bu kawɔl sibɛso be tɔɔnɛ be abersobi ashunu na?” 3Ama esa kikɛ daa maŋ wɔ ebɔrɛso ŋko kasawule so ŋko kasawule be kaseto nɛ e tiŋ m bugi kawɔl sibɛso na ŋko nɛ e tiŋ ŋ keni kumo to gba. 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ n shu ga ŋkpal esa kikɛ ka daa maŋ wɔtɔ nɛ e daga nɛ e tiŋ m bugi kawɔl sibɛso na ŋko nɛ e tiŋ ŋ keni kumo to na so. 5Ŋ ka bee shu na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na be eko kaŋɛ ma: “Sa maa shu, keni Juda be kanaŋ to be buluŋ, Ewura Deevid mo Nanabigboŋ na kɔ m pɔɔ so ŋkaa beeŋ tiŋ m bu m bu abersobi ashunu na nseŋ tiŋ m bugi kawɔl sibɛso na.”
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu Kpakpafɔlbi ka yil kuwurputi na akpa be nferinto nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana na nɛ bejuŋkparpo na kulti kumo. Kpakpafɔlbi na daa du fanɛ b ka mɔ mo nna. E daa kɔ alambɛ ashunu nɛ anishi ashunu nɛ a la Ebɔrɛ be ayoyu ashunu nɛ e shuŋi amo m ba kasawule ere so na nna. 7Mo e daŋ ba esa nɛ e daŋ chena kuwurputi na so na kutɔ m ba sɔ kawɔl sibɛso na ashi mbe enɔjiso to.
8E ka sɔ kawɔl sibɛso na nɛ asɔbɔya ana na nɛ bejuŋkparpo adunyɔ nɛ ana na gbir Kpakpafɔlbi na be anishito. Bumo be ekama daa kɔ goji nɛ shuwa be ntishaŋ mo nɛ duwu bɔlɔ m bɔlɔ amo to a la Ebɔrɛ be basa be kabɔrɛkuleana nna. 9Nɛ b boŋ kashɛ popɔr ko a kaŋɛ:
“Fo e daga nɛ fo ta kawɔl sibɛso na
nseŋ tiŋ m bu m bu kumo be
tɔɔnɛ be abersobi na,
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo nɛ b daŋ mɔ
nɛ fo ta fo ŋklaŋ n tɔ basa n sa Ebɔrɛ ashi yiri kama to
ebi to nɛ ŋgbar kikɛ to ebi to
nɛ basa kama to ebi to nɛ efuli kama so ebi to na.
10Fo ta bumo ŋ ki an be Ebɔrɛ be kuwura to ebi
nɛ bɔrɛmatapoana nɛ b baa shuŋ mo
nɛ b ba ji kuwura kasawule so.”
11Kumo be kaman nɛ n naŋ keni nseŋ nu emalaika damtaana nɛ ŋgboŋ to be ŋgboŋ kudu be ebɔlana. B daŋ kulti kuwurputi na nna nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana nɛ bejuŋkparpo na 12nsaa boŋ le awɔrso a kaŋɛ:
“Kpakpafɔlbi nɛ b mɔ na e daga
nɛ e nya eleŋ nɛ dama nɛ kanyiasheŋ
nɛ kuwibi to be eleŋ nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ epaŋ be kedi.”
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu kusɔtoso kikɛ nɛ k wɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule so nɛ kasawule be kaseto nɛ etekuana so nɛ amo nɛ a wɔ amo to kikɛ verr ka bee boŋ a kaŋɛ le:
“Kapandi nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ e baa la emo nɛ
e tase mbe kuwurputi so na
nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na peya
mbaanaayɔ.”
14Ndoŋ nna nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana na kikɛ shuli ŋ kaŋɛ: “Amɛn.” Nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na gbir n dese kasawule m maŋ mo so.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 6
Content:
Tɔɔnɛ be abersobi na be asheŋ
1Nɛ n wu Kpakpafɔlbi na ka bu tɔɔnɛ be abersobi ashunu na be kuko to nseŋ nu asɔbɔya keniso ana na be kuko ka ta ebɔl ŋ kaŋɛ awɔrso fanɛ bɔrɛ be egbri ŋ kaŋɛ: “Ba!” 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni nɛ gbaŋɛ fuful e yil. Kumo be ediipo daa kɔ keta to nna nɛ b ta kuwurwuro n sa mo nɛ e dii gbaŋɛ na n lar ndoŋ fanɛ ekɔmpɔɔsopo nɛ e ya kɔ m pɔɔ so.
3Kpakpafɔlbi na ka naŋ bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi nyɔsopo na to nɛ n nu kusɔbɔya keniso nyɔsopo ka tre: “Ba!” 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ gbaŋɛ ko malɛ naŋ lar m ba m pere le kpaw. B daŋ sa kumo be ediipo eleŋ nna fanɛ e lara kagbenewushi ashi kasawule so nɛ basa e baa mɔ abar. B daŋ ta tokobi gboŋgboŋi ko nna n sa mo.
5Kpakpafɔlbi na ka bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi sasopo na to nɛ n nu kusɔbɔya keniso sasopo na ka tre: “Ba!” Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni nɛ gbaŋɛ lembir ko e yil. Kumo be ediipo daa kɔ kusɔ nɛ b kɔ a ta egbɛ na nna ashi mbe enɔ to. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu kusɔ ko ka shi asɔbɔya keniso ana na to ŋ gbri m ba fanɛ ebɔl na a kaŋɛ le: “Ta aboyu be kurwa be bargato malɛ be bargato nɛ amo be yawu la lebra be kachɛ koŋwule be kakɔka na nseŋ ta gari be kurwa be bargato malɛ be bargato asa n sɔ lebra be kachɛ koŋwule be kakɔka. Ama sa maŋ kaŋ tɔrɔ ŋku na nɛ yabra belbelso na bre.”
7Kpakpafɔlbi na ka bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi nasopo na to nɛ n nu kusɔbɔya keniso nasopo na ka kaŋɛ: “Ba!” 8Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ keni nɛ gbaŋɛ peperbi ko yil. Kumo be ediipo nɛ b daa tre Luwu, nɛ emo nɛ b daa tre Bubuni be Kakpa na malɛ bɛ mo so. B daŋ sa bumo eleŋ nɛ baaŋ ta m mɔ kasawule so be kenasopo na nna nɛ b ta tokobi m mɔ nseŋ naŋ bar akoŋ nɛ alɔ nɛ asɔbɔya lubiana.
9Nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi nusopo na nɛ n wu basa nɛ b mɔ ŋkpal b ka daŋ malga Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na so nɛ ŋkpal shɛda mo nɛ b ji na so na be ayoyu ashi bɔrɛsure na be kaseto. 10Nɛ b ponte awɔrso ga m bishi: “Enyɛnpe Lempo nɛ fo du cheembi nsaa kɔ kashenteŋ, nuso be kechɛr nɛ fo kraa shin nɛ fo chɛr ga pɔɛŋ nseŋ ji kasawule ere so be basa demu m bishi anyi be luwu be kuwule?” 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ta epiŋi fuful n sa bumo be ekama nseŋ kaŋɛ bumo fanɛ b baa kraa jo gbrɛ pɔɛŋ nɛ bumo braana anya nɛ bumo kurgepoana mo nɛ basa beeŋ mɔ fanɛ kananɛ b daŋ mɔ bumo alɛ gba na nyam e ya ba abar so.
12Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ keni n wu Kpakpafɔlbi na ka naŋ bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi shesopo na to nɛ kasawule be kebembeŋgboŋ ko gbuŋgbuŋ kasawule ga nɛ epeŋi kilgi m biri to a du fanɛ fusa lembir na nɛ kufɔl malɛ pere to le kpaiŋ fanɛ ŋklaŋ na. 13Nɛ achɛkpabi mo nɛ a wɔ awɔlpa so na tɔr kasawule yɛɛr fanɛ afugboŋ ka bee gbaŋgbaŋ mpoli bumbuŋ a lɛ na. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ awɔlpa na fara a foe ma anishito fanɛ b ka bee bɔɔ kelaŋ to na, nɛ kebee kikɛ nɛ kepla kikɛ tia ashi amo be eyilikpaana. 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ kasawule so be bewurgboŋ nɛ bumo nɛ baa ji kuwura beko so nɛ esoji be benimu nɛ damawuraana nɛ belempo nɛ basa kikɛ, anya nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo be amu kikɛ ŋana abeelaŋana nɛ abee be afaltagboŋana to. 16Ade be kaman nɛ b fara a tre abeegboŋana na nɛ afaltaana na fanɛ a ka la enyiŋgbasa a kaŋɛ amo le: “Men tɔr anyi so n ta anyi ŋ ŋana esa nɛ e tase mbe kuwurputi so na nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be agbo so. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, kachɛgboŋ nɛ k la bumo be agbo be kachɛ na fo nɛ wanɛ malɛ e naaŋ tiŋ n yili bumo be anishito?”

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 7
Content:
Israɛlebi be basa ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ ŋgboŋ adena nɛ ŋgboŋ ana be asheŋ
1Asheŋ ere kikɛ be kaman nɛ n wu emalaika ana ka yil a yil kasawule ere be abonfu ana akpa m pɛ kasawule ere so be afu ana na to ŋ keta, saŋɛ na so afu kikɛ maaŋ ber kasawule so ŋko m ber eteku so ŋko m ber kedibi kama so. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu malaika ko ka shi bɔrɛfito a ba nsaa kɔ Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to na be tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi to. Nɛ e tre emalaika ana nɛ b ta eleŋ m bɔɔ bumo enɔ na fanɛ b tɔrɔ kasawule ere nɛ eteku na awɔrso 3ŋ kaŋɛ bumo le: “Men sa maŋ tɔrɔ kasawule ere ŋko teku ŋko ndibi pɔɛŋ nɛ an ya ta tɔɔnɛ be abersobi n dulgi Ebɔrɛ be anya kikɛ be nsɔto.”
4Le be kamalga ere be kaman nɛ n nu kananɛ basa nɛ b dulgi na kikɛ sa. B daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ ŋgboŋ adena nɛ ŋgboŋ ana ashi Israɛlebi be nnaŋ na kikɛ to. Kanaŋkama nɛ kananɛ bumo be basa dulgiso daa sa nde: 5Juda be kanaŋ to ebi daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ nɛ Ruben be kanaŋ to ebi daa wɔ ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ nɛ Gad be kanaŋ to ebi gba daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ. 6Nɛ Ashɛr be kanaŋ to ebi daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ nɛ Naftali be kanaŋ to ebi daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ nɛ Manase be kanaŋ to ebi daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ, 7Simiɔn be kanaŋ to ebi gba daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ nɛ Livai be kanaŋ to ebi gba daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ nɛ Isakar gba peya daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ. 8Nɛ Zɛbyulɔn be kanaŋ to ebi daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ nɛ Josɛf be kanaŋ to ebi malɛ gba daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ n ta Bɛnjamin malɛ gba peya ŋgboŋ kuduanyɔ n ti so.
Jimaŋ damta nɛ b buu epiŋi fuful na be asheŋ
9Ade be kaman nɛ ŋ keni n wu jimaŋ damta ko nɛ esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ ŋ karga bumo ka yil kuwurputi na nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be anishito. B daŋ shi efuli kama so nɛ yiri kama to nɛ basa kama to nɛ ŋgbar kama to nna m buu epiŋi fuful nseŋ daŋ keta abii be ayabiana. 10Nɛ b boŋ to awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Kumɔlga kikɛ shi an be Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e tase mbe kuwurputi so
nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na kutɔ nna.”
11Saŋɛ ere malɛ kikɛ nɛ emalaika na kikɛ yili ŋ kulti kuwurputi na nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana na. Ndoŋ nna nɛ b gbir nseŋ dese kasawule kuwurputi na be anishito m maŋ Ebɔrɛ so 12ŋ kaŋɛ le:
“Amɛn.
Kapandi nɛ kemaŋkura
nɛ kanyiasheŋ nɛ kechɔrɔ
nɛ bunyaŋ nɛ eleŋ
nɛ kuwibi to be eleŋ
e baa la an be Ebɔrɛ na peya mbaanaayɔ.
Amɛn.”
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ bejuŋkparpoana na be eko bishi ma: “Nuso be basa e la basa nɛ b buu epiŋi fuful ere nɛ nnɛ nɛ b shi?” 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ebunyampo, fo e nyi.” Nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Bumo e la basa nɛ b ji n lar tɔrɔgboŋ to na nseŋ fɔr bumo be epiŋi n ta amo n wɔtɔ Kpakpafɔlbi na be ŋklaŋ to nɛ a fuli parr na. 15Amoso, b baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ be kuwurputi be anishito a shuŋ mo kapa nɛ kanyɛ ashi mbe bɔrɛlambu to nna nɛ mo koŋwule nɛ e tase mbe kuwurputi so na malɛ bee ta mbe kebaawɔtɔ a kuŋ bumo. 16Akoŋ maaŋ naŋ pɛ bumo, achukoŋ malɛ gba maaŋ pɛ bumo. Epeŋi maaŋ mɔ bumo, ebeldɛ malɛ gba maaŋ mɔ bumo. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, Kpakpafɔlbi nɛ e wɔ kuwurputi na be nferinto na e naaŋ ki bumo be ekpapo n yɛr bumo mboŋ nɛ ŋkpa be nchuana bee bul nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ e kpra anishichubi kikɛ ashi bumo be anishiana to.”

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 8
Content:
Kebersobi shunusopo na be asheŋ
1Kpakpafɔlbi na ka bu tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi shunusopo na to nɛ kakpa wora shruum fanɛ awa be bargato ashi ebɔrɛso. 2Nɛ n wu emalaika ashunu mo nɛ b yil Ebɔrɛ be anishito na nɛ b ta mbel ashunu m bɔɔ bumo enɔ.
3Nɛ malaika ko malɛ ka kɔ shuwa be kusɔjɔduwu to m ba yili bɔrɛsure na akpa. B daŋ ta duwu damta ko nna fanɛ e ta n wea Ebɔrɛ be basa be kabɔrɛkuleana to n ta m ba deŋi shuwa be bɔrɛsure na so ashi kuwurputi na be anishito. 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ duwu na be edishi nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa be kabɔrɛkuleana na shi malaika nɛ e yil Ebɔrɛ be anishito na be enɔ to n dii n yɔ. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na ta shuwa be kusɔjɔduwu na n lara edɛ ashi bɔrɛsure na to m bɔlɔ kumo n ta edɛ na ŋ kpa n wurge kasawule so. E ka wora loŋ na nɛ bɔrɛ ponte ŋ gbri n nyɛkpɛ pɛlpɛl nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to.
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ emalaika ashunu mo nɛ b daa kɔ mbel ashunu na to na wora shiriya nɛ b foŋ mbel na.
7Malaika juŋkparso na ka foŋ mbe kabel nɛ abɔrɛjembubi nɛ edɛ wea ŋklaŋ to m ba wurge kasawule so nɛ kasawule be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso chɔɔ nɛ ndibi kikɛ be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso chɔɔ nɛ kefitiri bumbuŋ kama chɔɔ.
8Nɛ malaika nyɔsopo na malɛ foŋ mbe kabel nɛ kusɔ ko fanɛ kebee gboŋgboŋi lar a suse edɛ le wuloŋwuloŋ n ya tɔr teku to nɛ teku na be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso kilgi ŋklaŋ. 9Nɛ asɔ keniso mo nɛ a wɔ teku na to na be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso wu nɛ ekuloŋgboŋ be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso mur.
10Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika sasopo na malɛ foŋ mbe kabel nɛ kechɛkpabi gboŋgboŋi ko shi awɔlpa so a suse fanɛ kabulpi na m ba tɔr elɔrana nɛ mbombiana be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso to. 11Kechɛkpabi na be ketre e la Kerkra. K ka tɔr nchuana na to na nɛ amo be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso ki kerkra nɛ basa damta nu amo nseŋ wu ŋkpal a ka ki kerkra na so.
12Ade be kaman nɛ malaika nasopo na malɛ foŋ mbe kabel nɛ kusɔ ko ŋmɛa epeŋi be mba asa be kaba koŋwuleso nɛ kufɔl be mba asa be kaba koŋwuleso nɛ achɛkpabi be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso, saŋɛ na so, kefulto be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso ki m biri to nɛ karechɛ be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso nɛ kanyɛso be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso kikɛ paŋ kefulto.
13Nɛ n naŋ keni n wu kusore ka wɔ esoso kumu so a firgi nsaa tre awɔrso a kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ, asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule ere so kikɛ ŋkpal mbel be kushu mo nɛ emalaika asa mo nɛ b ka na bee shin nɛ b foŋ nɛ a wora na so.”

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 9
Content:
1Nɛ malaika nusopo foŋ mbe kabel nɛ n wu kechɛkpabi ka shi awɔlpa so m ba tɔr kasawule nɛ b ta kemaŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na nɛ baa tre kumo Abis na be esɔfi n sa kumo. 2Kechɛkpabi na ka bugi kemaŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar na nɛ edishi lar fanɛ a ka shi edɛgboŋ ko to na. Nɛ epeŋi nɛ awɔlpa kikɛ biri to ŋkpal edishi mo nɛ a shi kemaŋ na to so. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ elotɔr malɛ shi edishi na to m ba kasawule so a kɔ eleŋ a duŋ a besa fanɛ kasawule so be nna. 4B daŋ kaŋɛ loŋ be elotɔr na nna fanɛ b sa maŋ wora kasawule so be afitiri ŋko asɔ duuso ŋko kedibi kikɛ shɛŋ she basa nɛ b daa maa kɔ Ebɔrɛ be tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi bumo be nsɔto so na. 5B daa maŋ sa bumo eleŋ na nna nɛ b mɔ basa na, ama b daŋ sa bumo eleŋ na nna nɛ b tɔrɔ bumo afɔl anu. Ebesa mo nɛ b daa beeŋ nu na malɛ daa du fanɛ kana ka duŋ esa na nna. 6Amo be jemanɛ na basa beeŋ fin luwu ŋ gben, baaŋ yɛlga luwu, ama luwu beeŋ shile bumo. 7Elotɔr na daa du fanɛ egbaŋɛ mo nɛ b bela ase n yili nɛ a yɔ kena to na nna. Asɔ ko daa buu bumo be amu so nna fanɛ b ka buu shuwa be nwurwuro na nɛ bumo be anishiakpaana malɛ daa du fanɛ edimɛdi be anishiakpaana. 8Bumo be eminana daa du fanɛ beche be emin nna nɛ bumo be anyii malɛ daa du fanɛ ebuluŋ be anyii. 9Bumo be ŋgbene so be asɔ kuŋso daa du fanɛ abɛlso peya nna nɛ bumo be atɛana to be egbri daa du fanɛ egbaŋɛ damta nɛ egbaŋɛturko ka bee shile a luri kena to na nna. 10B daa kɔ ndu nɛ mboŋ duŋsoana nna fanɛ nna peyaana. Ndu na malɛ to nɛ b daa kɔ eleŋ mo nɛ k bee tiŋ a tɔrɔ basa afɔl anu na. 11Bumo be ewura mo nɛ e daa ji kuwura bumo so daa la kemaŋ nɛ k maŋ kɔ ekar nɛ baa tre kumo Abis na to be malaika nna nɛ Hibruwebi bee tre mo Abadɔn nɛ Griikebi malɛ bee tre mo Apɔliɔn.
12‘Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa’ juŋkparso be saŋɛ na choŋ, naniere a ka ‘asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa’ nyɔsopo be saŋɛ nɛ k ba.
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika shesopo na foŋ mbe kabel nɛ n nu ebɔl ka shi shuwa be bɔrɛsure mo nɛ k daa yil Ebɔrɛ be anishito na n lar. Asɔ ana ko daa yuu a yuu kumo so fanɛ kumo be alambɛ 14ŋ kaŋɛ malaika shesopo nɛ e daa kɔ kabel to na le: “Shin nɛ emalaika ana mo nɛ b kre lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes akpa na e nya bumo be amu n yɔ.” 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ b lara emalaika ana nɛ b daŋ ta bumo n yili awa ere to gbagba nɛ kabre be kachɛ ere gbagba nɛ kufɔl ere gbagba to nɛ kafɛ ere gbagba to na fanɛ b mɔ dimɛdi be kepɔrso to be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso. 16Benapo mo nɛ b daa maa na aya so daa wɔ basa ŋgboŋ to be ŋgboŋ alfa anyɔ. N daŋ nu kananɛ b sa na. 17Egbaŋɛ nɛ bediipo mo nɛ n daŋ wu bɔrɛdare na to na daa du le nna: Bumo be ŋgbene so be asɔ kuŋso daŋ pere nna kpaiŋ fanɛ ŋklaŋ nseŋ naŋ nyɔɔ tuum fanɛ gra n naa la kachɔnɔnyifu fanɛ jɛrbi. Egbaŋɛ na be amu daa du fanɛ ebuluŋ be amu nna nɛ edɛ nɛ edishi nɛ asɔ chɔɔso ko fanɛ jɛrbi shi bumo be nnɔ to n lar. 18Ndoŋ nna nɛ kɔnɔso be etɔrɔ be asɔ asa na, amo e la edɛ nɛ edishi nɛ jɛrbi nɛ a shi amo be nnɔ na to m mɔ edimɛdi be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso na. 19Egbaŋɛana na be eleŋana daa wɔ bumo be nnɔ to nɛ amo be ndu to nna, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be ndu daa du fanɛ awɔ nna a kɔ amu mo nɛ a bee tɔrɔ basa. 20Edimɛdi mo nɛ asɔ na daa maŋ mɔ nɛ b daŋ ka na daa maŋ lar bumo be alubi mo nɛ b daŋ ta bumo be enɔana n wora na to, bumo alɛ daa maŋ yige kebaashuŋ alizinaana nɛ eshuwa nɛ egbiti nɛ ntishaŋana be agbirana nɛ ajembu nɛ ndibi mo nɛ a maaŋ tiŋ n nu ŋko n tiŋ n wu asɔ ŋko n nite na to. 21Bumo alɛ maŋ naŋ lar bumo be kamɔ nɛ ŋkilgi nɛ kesakaleasheŋ nɛ bumo be kayu to.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 10
Content:
Malaika ko nɛ kawɔl sibɛso be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu malaika lempo ko malɛ gba ka shi ebɔrɛso a ba nɛ kuwɔlpa mea mo kikɛ so nɛ kabɔrɛnyaŋgelambi ko chambɔ mbe kumu so. Mbe anishiakpa daa du fanɛ epeŋi nna nɛ mbe aya daa du fanɛ edɛ ka lara adondulombi nɛ a du fanɛ eshabɔrɛ na. 2E daa kɔ kawɔl sibɛsobi ko to nna nɛ k bugi a wɔ mbe enɔ to nseŋ ta mbe keya jiso n yuu teku so nseŋ ta mbe bena be keya malɛ n yuu kasawule so 3nseŋ wora awɔr ko fanɛ buluŋ ka munto na. E ka wora awɔr na nɛ bɔrɛ be egbri ashunu na sɔ n shuli so.
4Bumo alɛ ka baŋ shuli so na nɛ n daa shin nɛ n sibɛ nseŋ naŋ nu ebɔl ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ ma: “Ta tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi m ber asɔ nɛ bɔrɛ be egbri ashunu na ka kaŋɛ na nsaa maŋ sibɛ asheŋ na n nase.” 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika mo nɛ n daŋ wu nɛ e yil teku nɛ kasawule so na maŋ mbe enɔjiso so n yɔ ebɔrɛso 6nseŋ bɔ esa nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ na, emo nɛ e to ebɔrɛso nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ kumo to na kikɛ nseŋ to kasawule nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ kumo to na kikɛ nseŋ naŋ to teku nɛ asɔ nɛ a wɔ kumo to na kikɛ nseŋ kaŋɛ le: “K maaŋ naŋ chɛr nɛ saŋɛ na e fo. 7Ama saŋɛ nɛ malaika shunusopo na beeŋ foŋ mbe kabel na, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ shin nɛ mbe wulo be kesheŋ naseso na e fo kumo be ekar n lar efuli fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ kaŋɛ mbe anya nɛ b la anebiana na.”
8Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ nu ebɔl mo nɛ k daŋ shi ebɔrɛso m ba nɛ n nu kumo na ka naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Choŋ n ya deŋi kawɔl sibɛsobi mo nɛ k bugi to a deŋ malaika mo nɛ e yil teku nɛ kasawule so na be enɔ to.” 9Nɛ n yɔ malaika na kutɔ n ya kaŋɛ mo fanɛ e ta kawɔl sibɛsobi na n sa ma nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Ta kumo n we. K beeŋ ki kerkra fo epun to, ama fo kɔnɔ to bre, k beeŋ wora ebel fanɛ mushoŋ.” 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ n deŋi kawɔl sibɛsobi na ashi malaika na be enɔ to n ta n we. K daŋ baŋ wora ma kɔnɔ to ebel nna fanɛ mushoŋ, ama ŋ ka ta kumo m min nɛ ma epun to wora ma kerkra. 11Ndoŋ nna nɛ b naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “A daga fanɛ fo naŋ lɔŋɛ n wu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ basa damta nɛ efuliana so ebi damta nɛ ŋgbarana to ebi damta nɛ bewura damta be asheŋ.”

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 11
Content:
Eshɛdajipo anyɔ be asheŋ
1B daŋ ta kedibi ko fanɛ kekpabi nna n sa ma nseŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Ta kumo n ya karga kananɛ Ebɔrɛ be lambu na sa nseŋ naŋ karga bɔrɛsure na nɛ basa nɛ b wɔ lambu na to a maŋ Ebɔrɛ so na gba. 2Ama sa maŋ ta kusɔ kargaso na ŋ karga lambu na be laŋ na bre, ŋkpal manɛ so, b ta ndoŋ nna n sa nnyamase, bumo alɛ beeŋ nɔkɔr kadegboŋ cheembi na to afɔl adena nɛ anyɔ. 3Ma alɛ beeŋ sa ma shɛdajipoana anyɔ eleŋ nɛ b wu abɔrɛsheŋ ŋ kaŋɛ amo be nchɛ kagboŋ nɛ alfa anyɔ nɛ adeshe na kikɛ to, amo be saŋɛ malɛ kikɛ to baaŋ buu kagbenejija be asɔbuuso.” 4Eshɛdajipo anyɔ na e la Ɔlif be ndibi anyɔ nɛ kefitilatɔl anyɔ mo nɛ amo kikɛ yil Enyɛnpe mo nɛ e wɔ kasawule ere na be anishito na. 5Nɛ ekama baa sha ketɔrɔ bumo, edɛ beeŋ shi bumo be nnɔ to m ba mur bumo doŋana. Kananɛ esa kama nɛ e beeŋ baa sha ketɔrɔ bumo beeŋ wu nna na. 6Basa anyɔ ere beeŋ baa kɔ eleŋ nɛ b tiŋ n shin nɛ bɔrɛ e sa maŋ shi awɔlpa so m ba, saŋɛ nɛ baaŋ baa wu abɔrɛsheŋ a kaŋɛ na kikɛ. Bumo alɛ nseŋ naa kɔ eleŋ nɛ b tiŋ n shin nɛ nchuana e ki ŋklaŋ nseŋ naŋ tiŋ n ta tɔrɔ be yiri kama saŋɛ damta kama nɛ baa sha n lɛ kasawule so.
7B kaŋ ji bumo be shɛda n loge, kusɔbɔya lubi mo nɛ e shi kakpa nɛ baa tre Abis na beeŋ ba kɔ bumo kena m pɔɔ bumo so nseŋ mɔ bumo 8nɛ bumo be eyurana e baa dese kadegboŋ na to be kubɔrbi ko so. Kade na du fanɛ Sodɔm nɛ Ijipt nna, amoso, Sodɔm nɛ Ijipt nɛ b nase kumo, kakpa koŋwule mo nɛ b daŋ kegbir bumo Nyɛnpe kedibi largato so na. 9Basa beeŋ shi basa kama to nɛ yiri kama to nɛ ŋgbar kama to nɛ efuliana so ebi to ŋ keni bumo be eyurana ka dese nchɛ asa nɛ bargato nseŋ kini keshin nɛ b puli amo. 10Kasawule so be basa be ŋgbene beeŋ fuli bumo ŋkpal basa anyɔ na be luwu so. Baaŋ ji bumo be amuana nseŋ kɛ ŋ kɛ abar asɔ ŋkpal kananɛ anebi anyɔ na daŋ bar kasawule ere so ebi tɔrɔ nsaa maŋ naa wɔtɔ na so.
11Nchɛ nsa nɛ bargato na be kaman nɛ ŋkpa be efute shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ m ba luri bumo to nɛ b niŋi to nɛ kufu pɛ basa na be ekama nɛ e wu bumo na ga. 12Ndoŋ nna nɛ b nu ebɔl ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ bumo: “Men dii a ba nfe.” Ndoŋ nna nɛ b luri awɔlpa to a yɔ ebɔrɛso nɛ bumo doŋana yil a keni bumo.
13Amo be saŋɛ na malɛ gbagba to nɛ kasawule be kebembeŋgboŋ ko ba beeŋ ndoŋ nɛ kadegboŋ na to be ntuŋ kudu be katuŋ koŋwuleso tɔr nɛ kebembeŋ na mɔ basa ŋgboŋ ashunu. Nɛ kufu pɛ basa nɛ b daŋ ka na nɛ b sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na kemaŋkura.
14‘Asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa basa’ nyɔsopo be saŋɛ na choŋ nna na, a ka gbrɛbi nɛ kesasopo e ba.
Kabel shunusopo na be asheŋ
15Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika shunusopo na foŋ mbe kabel nɛ awɔr damtaana chɛ ashi ebɔrɛso a kaŋɛ le:
“Eleŋ mo nɛ k bee ji kuwura durnya ere so na ki an
Nyɛnpe nɛ mbe Kristo peya,
mo alɛ beeŋ ji kuwura na mbaanaayɔ.”
16Ndoŋ nna nɛ bejuŋkparpo adunyɔ nɛ ana nɛ b daŋ chena bumo be nwurputi so ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito na gbir nseŋ dese kasawule m maŋ Ebɔrɛ so 17a kaŋɛ le:
“Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e daa wɔtɔ nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ na,
anyee chɔrɔ fo ga fanɛ fo ta fo eleŋgboŋ na n shuŋ
nseŋ fara nɛ fo ji kuwura naniere.
18Efuli so ebi daŋ nya agbo nna,
ama fo agbo be saŋɛ nɛ baaŋ ji bubuni demu na fo,
saŋɛ nɛ feeŋ ka fo anya kukɔ,
fo anebiana nɛ fo basa kikɛ, bekama nɛ baa ŋana fo ketre,
bewurbi nɛ begboŋi nyam be saŋɛ na fo.
Saŋɛ na fo nɛ fo mur basa nɛ baa jija
kasawule ere na.”
19Ndoŋ nna nɛ Ebɔrɛ be lambu nɛ k wɔ ebɔrɛso na bugi nɛ an wu mbe kɔnɔkoŋwule be ŋkre be deka ashi mbe lambu na to. Nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ palpal m ponte to ŋ gbri n wɔtɔ nɛ kasawule gbuŋgbuŋ to nɛ abɔrɛjembubi gbɛgbɛsoana ko ba tɔr.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 12
Content:
Kache ko nɛ kusɔ gbeyeso ko be asheŋ
1N yil nna nɛ alemaŋkar be tɔɔnɛ be kusɔ ko lar ebɔrɛso. Kache ko daŋ buu epeŋi nsaa yil kufɔl malɛ so nɛ kuwurwuro ko malɛ kɔ achɛkpabi kuduanyɔ kumo to a wɔ mbe kumu so. 2E daŋ di kedampo nna n fara nɛ e kurge nɛ k bee besa mo nɛ e bee shu awɔrso. 3Ndoŋ nna nɛ tɔɔnɛ be kusɔ ko malɛ naŋ lar ebɔrɛso. Kusɔ gbeyeso peper gboŋgboŋi ko nna nɛ k daa du fanɛ laŋchaŋ n daa kɔ amu ashunu nɛ alambɛ kudu nɛ nwurwuro ashunu malɛ wɔ mbe amu so. 4Ndoŋ nna nɛ kusɔ na ta kumo be kodu ŋ kpata achɛkpabi be ntuŋ nsa be katuŋ koŋwuleso ashi awɔlpa so m ba lɛ kasawule.
Kumo be kaman nɛ kusɔ gbeyeso na kilgi a yil kache nɛ e di kedampo na be anishito nɛ kache na e kurge nɛ e ta kebia na n we epul na to. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ kache na kurge ebinyɛn mo nɛ e beeŋ ba ta kagbene kpakpaso n ji efuli kama so ebi kuwura. Kache na ka kurge kebia na nɛ b ba fuu kebia na epul na to n yɔ Ebɔrɛ nɛ mbe kuwurputi ase. 6Nɛ kache na malɛ shile n luri kiyi to be kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ lɔŋɛ n yili mo fanɛ e baa wɔ ndoŋ a nya kekeniso nchɛ kagboŋ nɛ alfa anyɔ nɛ adeshe na.
B ka kɔ kena ashi ebɔrɛso be asheŋ
7Kumo be kaman nɛ kena ku ebɔrɛso. Malaika nɛ baa tre Maikel na nɛ mbe emalaika nɛ kusɔ gbeyeso na nɛ mbe emalaika e daa kɔ abar. 8Ama kusɔ gbeyeso na nɛ mbe emalaika be eleŋ daa maŋ fo Maikel nɛ mbe emalaika peya so, amoso, b daa maŋ naŋ nya kakpa ebɔrɛso n chena. 9B daŋ ta kusɔ gbeyeso gboŋgboŋi na nna n lɛ kasawule so. Mo e la kusɔkpaŋ dra nɛ baa tre alubipo ŋko Setani mo nɛ e bee fule durnya kikɛ na. B daŋ ta mo nɛ mbe kaman to ebi kikɛ nna n lɛ kasawule.
10Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ko awɔrso ashi ebɔrɛso ka bee kaŋɛ le:
“Naniere bre Ebɔrɛ ŋini mbe eleŋ
fanɛ mo e la Ewurgboŋ na
nɛ mbe kumɔlga na ba.
Naniere bre mbe Kristo na ŋini mbe eleŋ,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
b ta an niopibiana be alubiwupo mo
nɛ e bee wu bumo kulubi kapa nɛ kanyɛ
ashi Ebɔrɛ be anishito na n lɛ kasawule.
11Kpakpafɔlbi na be ŋklaŋ na
nɛ bumo be shɛda be kamalga na
nɛ b ta m pɔɔ mo so,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
b daa maŋ sha bumo be amu ga hale saŋɛ
nɛ b daa shin nɛ b luri luwu to gba na.
12Amoso, ebɔrɛsoana nɛ menyi
nɛ men wɔ amo to na kikɛ,
men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi.
Ama asheŋ maaŋ nyalɛ n sa
kasawule nɛ etekuana bre,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
alubipo na gbelge n yɔ menyi kutɔ nɛ agbo damta,
ŋkpal manɛ so,
e nyi mbe saŋɛ ka maŋ naa shi.”
Kusɔ gbeyeso nɛ kache na be asheŋ
13Kusɔ gbeyeso na ka wu fanɛ b ta mo n lɛ kasawule so nɛ e ta m bɛ kache mo nɛ e daŋ kurge ebiyɛn na so. 14Ama b daŋ sa kache na kusoregboŋ be atɛ anyɔ nna fanɛ e ta n firgi n shile kusɔkpaŋ na n yɔ kiyi to, mbe kakpa, fanɛ b ya kaa keni mo so nfɛ asa nɛ bargato. 15Ama kusɔkpaŋ na daŋ fuu nchu nna ashi mbe kɔnɔ to fanɛ lɔr na a sha fanɛ a tu kache na n ta amo be eleŋ ŋ kpata mo n lɛ. 16Ama kasawule e daŋ chɛ kache na to m bugi kumo be kɔnɔ to n ta lɔr mo nɛ kusɔ gbeyeso na daŋ fuu ashi kumo be kɔnɔ to na n nuu. 17Ndoŋ nna nɛ kusɔ gbeyeso na diewu ga n wora kache na nseŋ kilgi m bɛta n yɔ nɛ e ya kɔ kache na be kaman to ebi nɛ b ka na kena. Bumo e la basa nɛ baa ta Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso a wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to nsaa ji Yesu be shɛda na.
18Nɛ kusɔ gbeyeso na kilgi a yil teku ase be shishɛr so.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 13
Content:
Asɔbɔya anyɔ ko be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu kusɔbɔya gboŋgboŋi ko ka shi teku to a lar a kɔ alambɛ kudu nɛ amu ashunu nɛ nwurwuro kudu wɔ mbe alambɛana na so. Amu na malɛ be kekama so b daŋ sibɛ ketre mo nɛ k bee ji Ebɔrɛ emɔrɔ nna n deŋi kumo so. 2Kusɔbɔya mo nɛ n daŋ wu na daa du fanɛ karmɛ nna nɛ mbe aya malɛ daa du fanɛ shishiri be aya nɛ mbe kɔnɔ malɛ daa du fanɛ buluŋ be kɔnɔ. Kusɔ gbeyeso na daŋ sa kusɔbɔya na mo gbagba be eleŋ nɛ mbe kuwurputi nɛ eleŋ damta nna. 3Kusɔbɔya na be amu na be kuko daa du fanɛ k ka daŋ nya doro mo nɛ k beeŋ tiŋ m mɔ mo nna, ama b daŋ chɛ loŋ be doro na, nɛ mamachi pɛ durnya kikɛ nɛ b bɛ kusɔbɔya na so. 4Basa daa maŋ kusɔ gbeyeso na so nna ŋkpal e ka daŋ ta mbe eleŋ n sa kusɔbɔya na so nseŋ maŋ kusɔbɔya na gba so nseŋ bishi le: “Wanɛ malɛ e naa du fanɛ kusɔbɔya ere? Wanɛ e naaŋ tiŋ ŋ kɔ mo kena?” 5B daŋ sa kusɔbɔya na kɔnɔ nna nɛ e malga ŋkpenso be mmalga nɛ mmalga mo nɛ a bee ji Ebɔrɛ emɔrɔ nseŋ nya ekpa nɛ e ji mbe eleŋ afɔl adena nɛ anyɔ. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ e bugi mbe kɔnɔ a malga a gbiti Ebɔrɛ nseŋ ta mmalga lubi n jija mbe ketre nɛ kakpa nɛ e wɔ nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ ebɔrɛso na kikɛ. 7B daŋ sa mo ekpa nna fanɛ e kɔ Ebɔrɛ be basa kena m pɔɔ bumo so. B daŋ naŋ sa mo eleŋ yiri kama to ebi so nɛ basa kama to ebi so nɛ ŋgbar kama to ebi so nɛ efuli kama so ebi so nna. 8Basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule ere so kikɛ beeŋ ba maŋ kusɔbɔya na so. Loŋ be basa na e la bekama nɛ b maŋ sibɛ bumo be atre n wɔtɔ Kpakpafɔlbi nɛ b daŋ mɔ durnya be sososo na kikɛ be kawɔl na to na.
9Ekama nɛ e kɔ asoe e nu. 10Ekama nɛ k dese fanɛ e yɔ kenyaya to, e beeŋ yɔ kenyaya to. Ekama nɛ k dese fanɛ tokobi nɛ baaŋ ta m mɔ mo, tokobi nɛ baaŋ ta m mɔ mo.
Kede e naa ŋini fanɛ a daga fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa e baa kɔ kanyiti nɛ yirda.
Kusɔbɔya nɛ k shi kasawule so n lar na be asheŋ
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu kusɔbɔya ko ka shi kasawule so n lar. E daa kɔ alambɛ anyɔ nna fanɛ Kpakpafɔlbi peya, ama mo alɛ daa malga nna fanɛ kusɔ gbeyeso gboŋgboŋi nɛ k du fanɛ laŋchaŋ na nna. 12E daŋ ta kusɔbɔya juŋkparso na be eleŋ kikɛ nna n wora asheŋ ashi mbe anishito nseŋ shin nɛ kasawule nɛ kumo be basa e maŋ kusɔbɔya juŋkparso nɛ b daŋ chɛ mbe doro mo nɛ k daa beeŋ tiŋ m mɔ mo na so. 13E daŋ wora emamachisheŋ gboŋgboŋi nna hale n shin nɛ edɛ shi ebɔrɛso m ba kasawule nɛ ekama wu amo. 14Ŋkpal emamachisheŋ mo nɛ b daŋ sa mo eleŋ fanɛ e wora ashi kusɔbɔya juŋkparso na be anishito so, e daŋ fule durnya ere to ebi nna. E daŋ kaŋɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to kikɛ fanɛ b pɔr kaduli nɛ k baa la bunyaŋ a sa kusɔbɔya mo nɛ b daŋ ta tokobi n doro ama nɛ e kraa wɔtɔ na. 15B daŋ sa kusɔbɔya nyɔsopo na eleŋ nna fanɛ e fute ŋkpa n wɔtɔ kusɔbɔya juŋkparso na be kaduli to, saŋɛ na so, e beeŋ malga nseŋ shin nɛ b mɔ bekama nɛ b kini kemaŋ mo so na. 16Kusɔbɔya na daŋ tintiŋ ekama nna, bewurbi nɛ begboŋi kikɛ, damawuraana nɛ betirpo, anya nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo be amu fanɛ ekama e nya ndulgi mbe enɔjiso so ŋko mbe kɔsɔto so. 17Saŋɛ na so, esa kikɛ maaŋ tiŋ n tɔ shɛŋ ŋko n fa kusɔ ko ama amodoŋwura baa kɔ ndulgi mo nɛ k la kusɔbɔya na be ketre na nna ŋko mbe ketre be lamba nna.
18Kede bre la kanyiasheŋ be asheŋ nna. Ekama malɛ nɛ e kɔ nfɛra e pin kusɔbɔya na be lamba na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, k la dimɛdi be lamba nna. Lamba na e la alfa ashe nɛ adeshe nɛ ashe.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 14
Content:
Bumo nɛ b sɔ n yige na be kashɛ be asheŋ
1Nɛ n naŋ keni n wu Kpakpafɔlbi na ka yil Zayɔn be kebee so. Mo nɛ basa ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ ŋgboŋ adena nɛ ŋgboŋ ana nɛ b daŋ sibɛ mbe ketre nɛ mo Tuto na be ketre n deŋi bumo be nsɔto so na e daa yil. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ gbri m ba fanɛ nchu damta ka bee shile nseŋ daŋ naa du fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee gbri eleŋso na. Ebɔl mo nɛ n daŋ nu na daŋ naa du fanɛ ejaŋjilaŋlampoana ka bee laŋ bumo be ejaŋjilaŋ nna. 3Nɛ b boŋ kashɛ popɔr ashi kuwurputi na be anishito nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana nɛ bejuŋkparpo na be anishito. Esa kikɛ daa maaŋ tiŋ ŋ koya kashɛ na she basa ŋgboŋ kalfa nɛ ŋgboŋ adena nɛ ŋgboŋ ana mo nɛ b sɔ n yige kasawule so na. 4Bumo e la basa nɛ b maŋ di beche n jija bumo be amu na, b daa maŋ nyi beche. Kaplɛkama nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na bee yɔ, b bɛ mo so nna. B daŋ sɔ bumo ashi edimɛdi to nna n yige n shin nɛ b du fanɛ asɔrso juŋkparso mo nɛ baaŋ ta n lara sarga n sa Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na. 5Efɛsheŋ kama daa maŋ shi bumo be nnɔ to n lar kikɛ, kulubisheŋ kama daa maŋ do bumo be ekama so.
Emalaika asa na be asheŋ
6Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu malaika ko ka wɔ esoso kumu so a firgi nsaa kɔ baru lela nɛ k wɔtɔ mbaanaayɔ na to nɛ e bɔ kumo n sa basa nɛ b wɔ kasawule ere so n sa efuli kama so ebi nɛ yiri kama to ebi nɛ ŋgbar kama to ebi nɛ basa kama to ebi. 7Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ awɔrso fanɛ: “Men baa ŋana Ebɔrɛ nsaa maŋkura mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe demuji be saŋɛ na fo naniere. Men baa maŋ emo nɛ e to ebɔrɛso nɛ kasawule nɛ teku nɛ mbombiana kikɛ na so.”
8Kede be kaman nɛ n naŋ wu malaika nyɔsopo ka ta m bɛ ejuŋkparso na so a kaŋɛ le: “E tɔr, Babilɔn be kade lempo na tɔr. E shin nɛ efuli kikɛ so ebi nuu mbe kesakalealubisheŋ be nsa na.”
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika sasopo ta m bɛ bumo so a kaŋɛ awɔrso le: “Ekama nɛ e bee maŋ kusɔbɔya na nɛ mbe kaduli na so nseŋ nya mbe ndulgi mbe kɔsɔto so ŋko mbe enɔ so, 10amodoŋwura beeŋ nuu Ebɔrɛ be agboso be nsa nɛ b maŋ ta shɛŋ n cha amo to na nseŋ duga amo n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be agbo be kawiebi to na gba. Baaŋ ta edɛ nɛ jɛrbi n wɔtɔ mo ebesa to, emalaika cheembiana na nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be anishito. 11Edɛ mo nɛ a bee sa bumo ebesa na be edishi baa wɔtɔ nna mbaanaayɔ. Kapa nɛ kanyɛ bumo nɛ baa maŋ kusɔbɔya na nɛ mbe kaduli na so ŋko ekama nɛ e nya mbe ketre be lamba na daa maa kɔ ewushi kikɛ.”
12Kede e naa ŋini fanɛ a daga fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa, bumo e la basa nɛ baa ta Ebɔrɛ be mmalga naseso a wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to nsaa maa lar Yesu kaman na e baa kɔ kanyiti.
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Sibɛ le n nase: Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b wɔ Enyɛnpe to nseŋ wu naniere mbaanaayɔ na peya nna.” Nɛ Kiyoyu Cheeŋ na kaŋɛ: “Kashenteŋto, baaŋ wushi ashi bumo be kegben ere to, ŋkpal manɛ so, bumo be aworbi beeŋ ba bɛ bumo so n yɔ.”
Kasawule be kasɔteŋi na be asheŋ
14Ŋ ka naŋ keni nɛ n wu kuwɔlpa fuful ko nɛ esa ko malɛ du fanɛ nyiŋgbasa pibinyɛn na ka tase ndoŋ a kɔ shuwa be kuwurwuro mbe kumu so nɛ loji jiso ko malɛ wɔ mbe enɔ to. 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika ko malɛ lar ebɔrɛso be bɔrɛlambu na to n tre esa nɛ e daa tase kuwɔlpa na so na awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ta fo loji n teŋi asɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, kasɔteŋi be jemanɛ fo, ŋkpal manɛ so, kasawule be asɔ nɛ baaŋ teŋi na be jemanɛ na fo.” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ emo nɛ e daa tase kuwɔlpa na so na fili mbe loji na to ŋ gbaari kasawule so nɛ kasawule so be asɔ kikɛ teŋi.
17Nɛ malaika ko malɛ ba shi ebɔrɛso be bɔrɛlambu na to n lar, mo alɛ gba a kɔ loji jiso to. 18Bede malɛ kikɛ be kaman nɛ malaika ko malɛ nɛ e daa kɔ edɛ be eleŋ shi bɔrɛsure na akpa m ba tre emo nɛ e daa kɔ loji jiso na to na awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Ta fo loji jiso na ŋ ku kasawule so be waindibi be asɔrso na, ŋkpal manɛ so, asɔrso na bel.” 19Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na fili mbe loji na to m ba kasawule so n chala kumo be waindibi be asɔrso na nseŋ ta amo ŋ kpa n wɔtɔ Ebɔrɛ be agbo be kusɔ nyaŋasɔrso na to. 20Nɛ b nyaŋ asɔrso na ashi kusɔ nyaŋasɔrso na to ashi kadegboŋ na be ekarso nɛ ŋklaŋ lar asɔ na to ashi amo be kemaŋ na to n teŋi to n dese n fo emayɛl alfa anyɔ nɛ amo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ daŋ fo fanɛ kekargato be ayadra anu.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 15
Content:
Emalaika ashunu nɛ etɔrɔ ashunu na be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu alemaŋkar be kesheŋ ko awɔlpa so. K daa la mamachi be kesheŋ gboŋ ko nna. Emalaika ashunu nɛ etɔrɔ ashunu mo nɛ a daa la lalaloge be etɔrɔ na e daa la, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo be kaman nɛ Ebɔrɛ be agbo bee wushi.
2Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu kusɔ ko ka du fanɛ digi nɛ edɛ be weato a dese fanɛ teku nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ kɔ kusɔbɔya na nɛ mbe kaduli na nɛ mbe ketre be lamba na m pɔɔ so na yil m mata teku na. B daa yil nna a kɔ ejaŋjilaŋ ko nɛ Ebɔrɛ daŋ ta n sa bumo na to. 3B daa yil nna a kɔ amo a boŋ anebi Mosis, Ebɔrɛ be kenya na be kashɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be kashɛ a kaŋɛ:
“Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ,
Enyɛnpe fo asheŋ woraso kɔ mamachi pasaa!
Fo nɛ fo la efuli kama be Ewura na,
fo ekpa niŋi nsaa kɔ kashenteŋ amo to pasaa!
4O, Enyɛnpe, wanɛ e wɔtɔ ŋkaa maaŋ ŋana fo
nsaa maaŋ sa fo ketre na kemaŋkura?
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
fo nawule e du cheembi.
Efuli kama so ebi malɛ kikɛ beeŋ ba kachako
m ba maŋ fo so,
ŋkpal manɛ so, fo demuji niŋisoana na lar efuli.”
5Kede be kaman nɛ ŋ keni n wu shɛda be wajɛbu na be bɔrɛlambu ka bugi a yil ebɔrɛso. 6Ndoŋ nna nɛ emalaika ashunu ko nɛ etɔrɔ ashunu ko shi bɔrɛlambu na to n lar. B daŋ buu m buu asɔbuuso lela nna nɛ a walɛ so n fuli le parrbi nseŋ ta shuwa be kreso peŋgeleŋ peŋgelembi ko ŋ kre bumo be ntetoana so. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana na be eko ta shuwa be ntishaŋ ashunu mo nɛ Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e wɔ ŋkpa to mbaanaayɔ na be agbo daŋ bɔlɔ m bɔlɔ amo na n sa emalaika ashunu na. 8Ade be kaman nɛ edishi shi Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura to nɛ mbe eleŋ to n sɔ bɔrɛlambu na kikɛ to nɛ esa kikɛ malɛ daa maŋ tiŋ n luri bɔrɛlambu na to hale nɛ emalaika ashunu na be etɔrɔ ashunu na ya loge.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 16
Content:
Ebɔrɛ be agbo be ntishaŋ ashunu be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu ebɔl ko ka shi ebɔrɛso be bɔrɛlambu na to m ba malga awɔrso a kaŋɛ a kaŋɛ emalaika ashunu na le: “Men ya chulgi Ebɔrɛ be agbo nɛ k bɔlɔ ntishaŋ ashunu na to n wurge kasawule so.”
2Nɛ malaika juŋkparso na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge kasawule so nɛ achuu lubi besaso ko ba basa nɛ b kɔ kusɔbɔya na be ndulgi nɛ bumo nɛ b maŋ kumo be kaduli so na so.
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika nyɔsopo na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge teku so nɛ nchu na ki fanɛ dimɛdi mo nɛ e wu be ŋklaŋ nɛ kusɔ keniso kama nɛ k daa wɔ teku na to na wu.
4Malaika nyɔsopo na be kaman nɛ esasopo na malɛ ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge elɔrana nɛ mbombiana so nɛ a kilgi ŋklaŋ. 5Ndoŋ nna nɛ n nu malaika mo nɛ e daa kɔ nchuana na be eleŋ na ka kaŋɛ le:
“Fo nɛ fo daa wɔtɔ nseŋ kraa wɔtɔ na,
wora asheŋ m bɔla ekpa ashi le be demuji ere to.
6Ŋkpal b ka mɔ fo basa laraso nɛ anebiana n lara bumo be ŋklaŋ so,
fo alɛ gba ta ŋklaŋ n sa bumo nɛ b nuu.
Kusɔ nɛ k baŋ daga bumo nna na.”
7Nɛ n nu ebɔl ka shi bɔrɛsure na akpa ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Enyɛnpetale Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ,
fo demuji kɔ kashenteŋ nseŋ niŋi pasaa.”
8Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika nasopo na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge epeŋi so nɛ k nya eleŋ n chɔɔ basa fanɛ edɛ. 9Edɛ damta na daŋ chɔɔ basa ga nɛ b malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e kɔ etɔrɔ na be eleŋ na be ketre nseŋ kini kelar bumo be alubi to m maŋkura mo.
10Malaika nasopo na be kaman nɛ enusopo na malɛ ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge kusɔbɔya na be kuwurputi so, nɛ mbe kakpa nɛ e bee ji kuwura kikɛ ki tentembiri gbrum nɛ basa duŋ bumo be adonduloŋ ebesa so ga 11nseŋ malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ nɛ e wɔ ebɔrɛso na. B daŋ wora loŋ nna ŋkpal bumo be ebesa na nɛ bumo be achuuana na so so, ama b daŋ kini kelar bumo be alubi mo nɛ b daŋ wora na bre to.
12Nɛ malaika shesopo na malɛ ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge lɔrgboŋ nɛ baa tre Yufreetes na so nɛ kumo be nchu kikɛ feeto nɛ k wɔl n lɔŋɛ ekpa a dese a jo bewura mo nɛ b shi bɔrɛfito na.
13Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu ayoyu lubi asa ko ka du fanɛ etaŋgbaga n shi kusɔ gbeyeso na nɛ kusɔbɔya juŋkparso na nɛ anebi fɛpo na be nnɔ to n lar. 14A la mbuibi lubiana be ayoyu nna a wora emamachisheŋ a yɔ durnya ere kikɛ be bewura kutɔ n ya kaa chala bumo a jo Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be kachɛgboŋ be kena na.
15“Men nu nfe, meeŋ ba menyi to fanɛ eyu. Kagbenefuli baa la ekama nɛ e maa di, mo alɛ nsaa kɔ mbe asɔbuuso to na peya nna, saŋɛ na so, e maaŋ delge so n nite nɛ anishinyɔr e pɛ mo.” 16Ndoŋ nna nɛ ayoyu na bar bewura abar so ashi kakpa nɛ Hibruwebi bee tre Aamagɛdɔn na.
17Nɛ malaika shunusopo na ta mbe katishaŋ nɛ agbo na n chulgi n wurge esoso nɛ ebɔl ko shi bɔrɛlambu na to awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ: “Asheŋ na wora.” 18Ndoŋ nna nɛ bɔrɛ nyɛkpɛ pelpel nseŋ gbri m ponte to n wɔtɔ nɛ kebembeŋgboŋ ko beeŋ kasawule so ga. Dimɛdi ka fara a wɔ kasawule so kikɛ kebembeŋ kama maŋ naŋ lubi fanɛ kumo. Kede e daŋ lubi ga a chɔ kebembeŋ kama. 19Nɛ kadegboŋ na barga to ntuŋ nsa so nɛ durnya to be ndegboŋ kama mur. Nɛ Ebɔrɛ nyiŋi Babilɔn lempo nseŋ ta katishaŋ mo nɛ k bɔlɔ mbe agbo damta be nsa na n sa fanɛ e nuu. 20Esa daa maŋ naa wu kebeegboŋ kama, nɛ kepla kama malɛ daŋ foe. 21Nɛ abɔrɛjembubi gboŋgboŋiana ko nɛ amo be egbɛ daa la egbɛ to be pɔŋ kalfa na shi awɔlpa so m ba tɔr basa so. Nɛ basa malga ŋ gbiti Ebɔrɛ ŋkpal abɔrɛjembubi na be tɔrɔ na so, ŋkpal manɛ so, tɔrɔ lubi gbagba e daa la.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 17
Content:
Sakalechegboŋ na be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ emalaika ashunu mo nɛ b daa kɔ ntishaŋ ashunu na be eko ba ŋ kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ ma: “Ba nɛ ŋ ŋini fo kananɛ baaŋ gberge sakalechegboŋ na kusoe. Mo e chena nchu damtaana so na. 2Kasawule ere so be bewurgboŋ nɛ sakalechegboŋ na ji abar kesakalea so nɛ durnya ere to be basa malɛ nuu mbe kesakalea be nsa m boo.” 3Kede be kaman nɛ malaika na keta ma kiyoyu to n yɔ kiyi to, ndoŋ nɛ n ya wu kache ko nɛ e tase kusɔbɔya peper ko so nɛ b sibɛ kabɔrɛtegeso be atre n deŋi kusɔbɔya na kikɛ so. Kusɔbɔya na daa kɔ amu ashunu nɛ alambɛ kudu nna. 4Kache na daŋ buu jilmaso be wajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ wajɛ peper soo nna nɛ shuwa nɛ ajembubi lela nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa na nɛ abitasɔ kikɛ wɔ mo so a nyɛkpɛ palpal. E daa kɔ shuwa be kawiebi mo nɛ k bɔlɔ alemaŋkar be alubi be asɔ nɛ kesakalea be eyurpi to nna. 5Le be wulo be ketre ere nɛ b daŋ sibɛ n deŋi mbe kasɔto so: “Babilɔn lempo, kesakaleajipoana bumo nio nɛ emo nɛ kasawule so be alemaŋkar be alubi kikɛ shi mo kutɔ.” 6N daŋ wu fanɛ kache na daŋ nuu Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso be ŋklaŋ nɛ bumo nɛ b daŋ ji Yesu be shɛda na be ŋklaŋ nna m boo.
Ŋ ka wu mo nɛ k wora ma kanaŋ ko ga. 7Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ ma: “Manɛ e ba nɛ kesheŋ ere wora fo kanaŋ ko loŋ? Meeŋ bugi kache na nɛ kusɔbɔya nɛ e bee dii nɛ e kɔ amu ashunu nɛ alambɛ kudu na be wulo be kesheŋ na to ŋ ŋini fo.
8Kusɔbɔya mo nɛ fo wu na daa wɔ ŋkpa to nna, ama naniere e maŋ naa wɔ ŋkpa to. A ka gbrɛbi nɛ e shi kemaŋ nɛ baa tre Abis na to n lar nɛ b mur mo. Basa nɛ b wɔ durnya ere to nɛ b maŋ sibɛ bumo be atre n wɔtɔ ŋkpa be kawɔl na to saŋɛ nɛ durnya ere fara kikɛ na kaŋ wu kusɔbɔya na, bumo be nnɔ beeŋ mɔ bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, e daa wɔ ŋkpa to nna, ama naniere e maŋ naa wɔtɔ, ama mo alɛ kraa beeŋ naŋ ba. 9Kede bre la kagbene mo nɛ k kɔ kanyiasheŋ be demu nna. Amu ashunu na la abeebi ashunu mo nɛ kache na tase so nna, nɛ amo alɛ la bewurgboŋ ashunu. 10Bumo be benu maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ ekoŋwule kraa wɔtɔ nɛ a ka ekoŋwule nɛ e lar. Mo alɛ kaŋ ba, a daga fanɛ e chena gbrɛbi. 11Kusɔbɔya mo nɛ e daa wɔ ŋkpa to ŋkaa maŋ naa wɔtɔ na e la ewura burwasopo. E la beshunu mo nɛ b fara m ba na to be eko nna a yɔ nɛ e ya mur. 12Alambɛ kudu mo nɛ fo wu na la bewurgboŋ kudu ko nna nɛ b maŋ naŋ fara a ji kuwura, ama baaŋ nya ekpa n tu kusɔbɔya na n ji kuwura awa koŋwule. 13Bumo basa kudu na kikɛ kɔ nfɛra koŋwule nna a kɔ bumo be eleŋ nɛ ekpa nɛ b kɔ kikɛ a sa kusɔbɔya na. 14Baaŋ kɔ Kpakpafɔlbi na kena, ama Kpakpafɔlbi na beeŋ pɔɔ bumo so, mo e la benyɛnpe to be Enyɛnpe nɛ bewura to be Ewura na. Saŋɛ na so, mo nɛ mbe basa treso nɛ bumo koŋwule na la basa laraso nseŋ naa la mbe bebɛsopo mo nɛ b maa lar mo kaman na beeŋ baa wɔtɔ.” 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na naŋ kaŋɛ ma: “Nchuana nɛ fo daŋ wu na, kakpa nɛ sakaleche na tase na be kifi to e la basa be nnaŋ to nɛ ejimaŋ nɛ efuliana so ebi nɛ ŋgbarana to ebi. 16Kusɔbɔya na nɛ alambɛ kudu mo nɛ fo wu na beeŋ kishi sakaleche na. Baaŋ sɔ kusɔ kama nɛ e kɔ ŋ ka mo eyurkpaŋ n yili. Baaŋ we mo nseŋ ta edɛ m mur mo. 17Ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ ta kusɔ nɛ e bee sha nɛ k wora na n wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to nɛ baa sha kewora loŋ. Bumo kikɛ beeŋ nya kɔnɔkoŋwule n ta bumo be eleŋ n sa kusɔbɔya na nɛ e ji kuwura loŋ hale nɛ Ebɔrɛ be kɔnɔ e ya bɔla. 18Kache mo nɛ fo wu na e la kadegboŋ mo nɛ k bee ji kuwura kasawule so be bewura so na.”

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 18
Content:
Babilɔn be ketɔr be asheŋ
1Kede be kaman nɛ n wu malaika ko ka shi ebɔrɛso a ba. E daa kɔ eleŋ ga nɛ mbe kananɛ e bee kpa edɛ na malɛ daŋ fuli to n sɔ kasawule so be kaplɛkama. 2E ka bee ba na nɛ e ponte eleŋso ŋ kaŋɛ:
“K tɔr, Babilɔn be kade lempo tɔr!
Babilɔn ki alizinaana be kowu nɛ ayoyu lubiana kikɛ be eŋanakpa
nɛ mbuibi jiga mo nɛ basa kishi kikɛ be eŋanakpa.
3Ŋkpal manɛ so,
efuli kama so ebi nuu mbe
kesakalealubisheŋ be nsa na.
Kasawule ere so be bewurgboŋ
tu mo n ji kesakalea
nɛ durnya to be yawujipoana na malɛ bɔla mbe dama
be kebaawɔtɔ to n dii dama.”
4N daŋ naŋ nu ebɔl ko ka shi ebɔrɛso ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Ma basa, men lar mbe asheŋ to,
saŋɛ na so men maaŋ tu mo
n luri mbe alubi na to,
saŋɛ na so men maaŋ nya mbe etɔrɔ na be kekama.
5Ŋkpal manɛ so, mbe alubi dii n deŋi abar so nna n ya fo ebɔrɛso
nɛ Ebɔrɛ malɛ bee nyiŋi mbe alubi na kikɛ.
6Men wora mo kananɛ e wora menyi na gbagba chap.
Men laŋɛ kusɔ kama nɛ e wora menyi na
ŋ ka mo loŋ be ale anyɔ.
Men shin nɛ mbe kawiebi
nɛ e ta n wora nsa n sa menyi na e bɔlɔ a kɔ eleŋ
ale anyɔ a chɔ amo nɛ e sa menyi na.
7Men sa mo tɔrɔ nɛ kagbenejija ga
nɛ a fo fanɛ kananɛ e daŋ sa mbe kumu kemaŋkura nɛ dama na,
ŋkpal manɛ so, le nɛ e wɔtɔ a kaŋɛ mbe kumu:
‘Ewurche e la ma nɛ n tase.
M maŋ la ekulpoche, kagbenejija maaŋ tu ma kikɛ.’
8Ŋkpal loŋ so,
mbe etɔrɔ kikɛ beeŋ tu mo kachɛ koŋwule.
A beeŋ baa la luwu nɛ kushu nɛ akoŋ.
Edɛ beeŋ ji mo, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ
nɛ e bee ji mo demu na
la elempo nna.”
9Kasawule so be bewura mo nɛ b ji kesakalea nseŋ naŋ tu mo n ji mbe dama na kaŋ wu edɛ mo nɛ a bee chɔɔ mo na be edishi, baaŋ boŋ to n shu anishichubi ŋkpal mo so. 10Ebesa mo nɛ e beeŋ ji na be asheŋ beeŋ pɛ bumo kufu nɛ b yili kufɔ nseŋ kaŋɛ:
“O fo, kadegboŋ ere,
asheŋ nya fo, asheŋ nya fo.
O Babilɔn, eleŋ be kadegboŋ,
awa koŋwule nawule to nɛ fo ta
n nya fo kasogberge na.”
11Kasawule so be yawujipoana malɛ gba beeŋ boŋ to nseŋ shu ŋkpal mo so, ŋkpal esa kikɛ ka maaŋ naŋ tɔ bumo be asɔ so. 12B nyi esa kikɛ ka maaŋ naŋ tɔ bumo be eshuwa nɛ egbiti nɛ ajembubi lela nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa na nɛ abitasɔ nɛ ewajɛ fuful lela nɛ jilmaso be ewajɛ peper kpaw nɛ ago be ewajɛ nɛ ewajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nɛ ndibi be nnaŋ to nɛ amo be efɛa wɔ ebel nɛ asɔ nɛ b ta ejebotenyi n lɔŋɛ nɛ asɔwurbi kikɛ nɛ b ta yawu kpakpaso be ndibi ŋko ntishaŋ peper ŋko abɛlsoana ŋko awarabi lelaana n lɔŋɛ. 13Baaŋ shu, ŋkpal manɛ so, b nyi esa kikɛ ka maaŋ naŋ tɔ bumo be ndibi be asɔrso mo nɛ basa kɔ a wora ŋku dufɛsoana na nseŋ naa nyi b ka maaŋ tɔ asɔ nɛ b kɔ a wora ŋku mɛlɛmɛlɛbi nɛ bumo be duwu nɛ mir nɛ fraŋkinsensi nɛ bumo be nsa nɛ ɔlifs be ŋku nɛ nyifu peso nɛ bumo be atuwe nɛ bumo be ana nɛ mbolpɔ nɛ egbaŋɛ nɛ egbaŋɛturkoana nɛ anya, kumo e la fanɛ basa be ayoyu gbagba na. 14Baaŋ kaŋɛ mo le: “Asɔ lela mo nɛ fo daŋ ta fo kagbene n wɔtɔ fanɛ fo nya na kikɛ choŋ nna na. Fo dama nɛ fo kemaŋkura na kikɛ foe, esa kama malɛ maaŋ naŋ wu asɔ na kikɛ.” 15Eyawujipoana nɛ b fa asɔ na m bɔla fo so n ji yawu n dii dama na beeŋ ŋana mbe tɔrɔ na nseŋ yili kufɔ m boŋ to n shu anishichubi. 16Baaŋ boŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ le: “O kadegboŋ, asheŋ nya fo, asheŋ nya fo, fo nɛ fo daa buu asɔ fuful lela nɛ jilmaso be ewajɛ peper kpaw nɛ ewajɛ peper kunɔkunɔ nseŋ daŋ ta eshuwa nɛ ajembubi lela nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa na nɛ abitasɔ a mea fo eyur kikɛ so na, ama keni, awa koŋwule to nɛ loŋ be dama damta na kikɛ mur na.” 17Ekuloŋgboŋ be katɛrɛ nimuso kikɛ nɛ bekama nɛ b wɔ ekuloŋgboŋ to a nite teku so, befarpoana na kikɛ nɛ bekama nyam nɛ baa bɔla nchu so a ji na kikɛ beeŋ yili kufɔ 18n shu awɔrso ŋkpal b ka wu edɛ mo nɛ a bee chɔɔ mo na be edishi so ŋ kaŋɛ: “Cha, kade mo malɛ e daŋ naŋ fo kadegboŋ ere so?” 19Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta shishɛr n wurge bumo be amuana so ŋkeŋ boŋ to n shu anishichubi ŋ kaŋɛ:
“O kadegboŋ,
asheŋ nya fo, asheŋ nya fo.
Kadegboŋ ere to nɛ bekama nɛ b kɔ ekuloŋgboŋana
a shuŋ tekuana so na bɔla mbe
dama so n dii dama,
ŋkeshin nɛ awa koŋwule to nɛ e mur kuraa!
20Ebɔrɛsoebi,
men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi,
ŋkpal mbe kemur ere so.
Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso nɛ beshuŋipoana nɛ anebiana,
men shin nɛ men be ŋgbene e fuli menyi, ŋkpal manɛ so,
Ebɔrɛ gberge mo kusoe nna ŋkpal kusɔ nɛ e wora menyi na so.”
