21Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika lempo ko maŋ kejembu ko so,
kumo nɛ kuboogboŋ sasa
n ta kumo ŋ kpa n wɔtɔ teku to nseŋ kaŋɛ:
“Loŋ nɛ baaŋ ta Babilɔn be kadegboŋ n lɛ kasawule so eleŋso
nɛ ekama maaŋ naŋ wu kumo kikɛ.
22Esa maaŋ naŋ nu ejaŋjilaŋlampoana
be asheŋ ŋko nshɛbompoana
be asheŋ ŋko nlopifompoana
be asheŋ ŋko mbelfompoana be asheŋ fo to kikɛ.
Esa maaŋ naŋ wu basa
nɛ baa shuŋ a ji yawu kama fo to.
Esa malɛ maŋ naŋ
nu kubo kikɛ be egbri fo to.
23Esa maaŋ naŋ wu fitila be kefulto fo to kikɛ ŋko n naŋ
nu kejafɔ bumo kulana nɛ kejafɔana be ebɔlana ashi fo to.
Fo yawujipoana e daa la durnya ere to kikɛ be bejuŋkparpo,
fo alɛ be ŋkilgi e daŋ shin nɛ durnya kikɛ foe ekpa.”
24Mo, Babilɔn na to nɛ b daŋ wu anebiana
nɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso nɛ bekama nyam
nɛ b daŋ mɔ kasawule ere so na be ŋklaŋ.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 19
Content:
1Ade be kaman nɛ n nu kusɔ ko fanɛ jimaŋ damta ko be ebɔlana ka shi ebɔrɛso a boŋ to awɔrso a kaŋɛ le:
“Halleluya.
Kumɔlga nɛ kemaŋkura nɛ eleŋ la an be Ebɔrɛ na peya nna.
2Mo alɛ be demuji kɔ kashenteŋ nna nseŋ niŋi.
E gberge sakalechegboŋ mo nɛ e ta mbe kesakaleasheŋ
n jija kasawule ere na kusoe.
E bishi mo kuwule ŋkpal mbe anya be ŋklaŋ so.”
3Ndoŋ nna nɛ basa na naŋ boŋ to ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Halleluya. Edishi mo nɛ a bee shi mo to
a lar na bee dii nna mbaanaayɔ.”
4Nɛ bejuŋkparpo adunyɔ nɛ ana na nɛ asɔbɔya keniso ana gbir n dese kasawule m maŋ Ebɔrɛ mo nɛ e daa tase kuwurputi so na so nseŋ kaŋɛ awɔrso:
“Amɛn. Halleluya.”
5Ndoŋ nna nɛ ebɔl shi kuwurputi na akpa ŋ kaŋɛ:
“Menyi nɛ men la mbe anya na,
men di an be Ebɔrɛ na epaŋ,
menyi nɛ men ŋana mo na kikɛ,
bewurbi nɛ begboŋi kikɛ,
men di mo epaŋ.”
6Mmalga ere be kaman nɛ n nu kusɔ ko ka gbri fanɛ jimaŋ damta ka wora awɔr na. Awɔr na daŋ naa gbri fanɛ nchu damta ka bee shile nna nseŋ daŋ naa gbri fanɛ bɔrɛ ka bee ponte to a boŋ to a kaŋɛ le:
“Halleluya.
Ŋkpal manɛ so, an Nyɛnpetale Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ na e wɔ kuwura a ji.
7Men shin nɛ anyi be ŋgbene
e fuli anyi n dese nɛ an sa mo kemaŋkura.
Ŋkpal manɛ so,
Kpakpafɔlbi be kejafɔachɛ na fo
nɛ mbe kejafɔ malɛ gba bela ase n loge.
8E nya wajɛ fuful lela nyɛkpɛso nɛ k walɛ so nɛ e buu.
Kusɔbuuso lela na
e naa yili fanɛ Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso
be alelasheŋ be aworbi.”
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ ma le: “Sibɛ n nase fanɛ: Kagbenefuli la bumo nɛ b tre fanɛ b ba Kpakpafɔlbi na be kejafɔ be kejigboŋ to na.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ le n ti so: “Ade la Ebɔrɛ be kashenteŋ be mmalga nna.” 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ ŋ gbir n dese kasawule mbe anishito nɛ m maŋ mo so nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “A maŋ daga fanɛ fo wora loŋ, ŋkpal manɛ so, n la fo barkasa kenya nna fanɛ fo nɛ fo niopibiana nɛ b bɛ Yesu be shɛda be ekpa so na, Ebɔrɛ e daga fanɛ fo baa maŋ mo so.” Ŋkpal manɛ so, kashenteŋ mo nɛ Yesu lara ŋ ŋini na e la Kiyoyu mo nɛ e bee leŋ anebiana na to.
Gbaŋɛ fuful be ediipo na be asheŋ
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu ebɔrɛso ka bugi nɛ gbaŋɛ fuful yil. Kumo be ediipo be ketre e la Kebaayɛawora nɛ Kashenteŋ. Ekpa niŋiso nɛ e bee bɔla a ji demu nsaa kɔ kumo a kɔ kena. 12Mbe anishi daa du fanɛ edɛ nɛ a bee suse nna wuloŋwuloŋ nɛ nwurwuro damta malɛ wɔ mbe kumu so. B daŋ sibɛ ketre ko nna n deŋi mo so nɛ mo nawule kpeŋ nyi kumo. 13Mbe kusɔbuuso naŋ nyɔɔ ŋklaŋ nna nɛ mbe ketre daa la Ebɔrɛ be Kamalga. 14Ebɔrɛso be benapo daŋ buu wajɛ fuful lela nɛ a walɛ so n fuli parr nna n dii egbaŋɛ fuful m bɛ mo so. 15Ndoŋ nna nɛ tokobi jiso ko mo nɛ e beeŋ ta ŋ ŋe efuliana so ebi n nase lar mbe kɔnɔ to. E beeŋ ta kagbene kpakpaso n ji kuwura bumo so. Mo gbagba e naaŋ nyaŋ asɔ nɛ a wɔ Enyɛnpetale Ebɔrɛ be agbo be kusɔ nyaŋasɔrso na to. 16Ketre mo nɛ k daa deŋ mbe piŋi nɛ mbe kebembi so e la:
“BEWURA TO BE EWURA NƐ BENYƐNPE TO BE ENYƐNPE.”
17Nɛ n wu malaika ko ka yil epeŋi so nseŋ malga awɔrso ŋ kaŋɛ mbuibi nɛ a bee firgi kumu so na kikɛ le: “Men ba. Men shɛr Ebɔrɛ be kejigboŋ na ase 18n ji bewurgboŋana be eyurana nɛ benapo be benimuana be eyurana nɛ basa lempoana be eyurana nɛ egbaŋɛ nɛ amo be bediipo nɛ basa kikɛ be eyurana nɛ bumo nɛ b wɔ bumo be amu nɛ bumo nɛ b la anya nɛ bewurbi nɛ begboŋi kikɛ be eyurana.”
19Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu kusɔbɔya na nɛ kasawule ere so be bewura nɛ bumo be benapo ka shɛr m ba nɛ b ba kɔ gbaŋɛ na be ediipo na nɛ mbe benapo kena. 20Nɛ b pɛ kusɔbɔya na n ta anebi fɛpo mo nɛ e daŋ wora emamachisheŋ damta kusɔbɔya na be anishito na n ti so. Emamachisheŋ na nɛ e daŋ ta n fule bumo nɛ b daŋ nya kusɔbɔya na be ndulgi na nseŋ maŋ mbe kaduli so na. B daŋ ta kusɔbɔya na nɛ anebi fɛpo na nna ŋ kpa n wɔtɔ edɛ mo nɛ jɛrbi wɔ amo to a chɔɔ na to nna nɛ b kraa keni. 21Kumo be kaman nɛ b ta tokobi mo nɛ k daŋ shi gbaŋɛ na be ediipo na be kɔnɔ to n lar m mɔ bumo nɛ b daŋ ka na kikɛ nɛ mbuibi ba ji bumo be eyurana m moɛ ŋ kini.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 20
Content:
Nfɛ kagboŋ na be asheŋ
1Nɛ n wu malaika ko ka shi ebɔrɛso a ba nɛ kemaŋ mo nɛ baa tre Abis na be esɔfi wɔ mo kutɔ, mo alɛ nseŋ naa kɔ ŋgbɛlɛbi gboŋgboŋi ko mbe enɔ to. 2Ndoŋ nna nɛ e ya nyaŋ kusɔ gbeyeso, mo e la dra na kikɛ be kusɔkpaŋ nɛ baa tre mo koŋwule alubipo ŋko Setani na ŋ kre mo n nase nfɛ kagboŋ. 3E ka kre mo n loge nɛ e ta mo n lɛ n wɔtɔ kemaŋ nɛ baa tre Abis to na nseŋ ber kumo so n ta tɔɔnɛ be kebersobi n dulgi kumo n ti so, saŋɛ na so e maaŋ naŋ nya n fule efuliana so ebi, ama nfɛ kagboŋ na ya choŋ nna. Nfɛ kagboŋ na be kaman a daga fanɛ b saŋɛ mo n lɛ gbrɛbi.
4Nɛ n naŋ wu kuwurputiana nɛ bumo nɛ b daa tase amo so na kikɛ. B daŋ sa bumo ekpa nna fanɛ b ji basa demu. Ma alɛ daŋ naŋ wu basa nɛ b daŋ mɔ ŋkpal b ka daŋ ji Yesu be shɛda so nɛ ŋkpal b ka daŋ malga Ebɔrɛ be kamalga na so na be ayoyu. Bumo alɛ daa maŋ maŋ kusɔbɔya na ŋko mbe kaduli na so, bumo alɛ daa maŋ naa kɔ mbe ndulgi na bumo be nsɔto so ŋko bumo be enɔana so. B daŋ naŋ nya ŋkpa nna n tu Kristo n ji kuwura nfɛ kagboŋ. 5Bubuni mo nɛ b daŋ ka na bre daa maŋ tiŋi luwu to ama nfɛ kagboŋ na e ba choŋ.
6Ketiŋi luwu to juŋkparso nna na. Kagbenefuli nɛ kebaawɔtɔ cheembi la bekama nɛ b ti bumo nɛ baaŋ tiŋi luwu be ketiŋi juŋkparso na to so. Luwu nyɔsopo na maŋ kɔ eleŋ bumo so. Baaŋ ki Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kristo be bɔrɛmatapoana, bumo alɛ beeŋ tu mo n ji kuwura nfɛ kagboŋ.
Setani be kemur be asheŋ
7Nfɛ kagboŋ na be kaman, baaŋ saŋɛ Setani ashi mbe kabuti to. 8Nɛ e lar n fule efuliana so ebi ashi kasawule so be abonfu ana kikɛ, bumo e la Gɔg nɛ Magɔg ebi na n shɛr bumo nɛ b kɔ kena. Bumo be keshi daa sa fanɛ teku ase be shishɛr. 9Nɛ b yili kasawule be mparto be kaba ko n nite m ba choŋ kaba ko ŋ kulti Ebɔrɛ be basa laraso n wɔtɔ bumo be kakpa, kumo e la kadegboŋ shaso na. Ama edɛ daŋ shi esoso nna m ba mur basa nɛ b daŋ kulti Ebɔrɛ be basa n wɔtɔ na. 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ta alubipo mo nɛ e daŋ fule bumo na n lɛ n wɔtɔ edɛ mo nɛ jɛrbi wɔ amo to a chɔɔ na be kepa to, kakpa nɛ b daŋ ta kusɔbɔya na nɛ anebi fɛpo na n lɛ to na. Baaŋ tɔrɔ bumo ga kapa nɛ kanyɛ mbaanaayɔ.
B ka ji bumo nɛ b wu na demu be asheŋ
11Ndoŋ nna nɛ n naŋ wu kuwurputigboŋ fuful ko nɛ esa nɛ e daa tase kumo so. Nɛ kasawule nɛ awɔlpa foe mbe anishito a maŋ naa kɔ kakpa ndoŋ. 12Nɛ n wu bubuni, begboŋi nɛ bewurbi kikɛ nɛ b yil kuwurputi na akpa nɛ b bugi nwɔl. Amo be kaman nɛ b bugi kawɔl ko malɛ, kumo e la ŋkpa be kawɔl na. Nɛ b bɔla nwɔlana na to ŋ keni n wu asɔ nɛ ebuni kama daŋ wora n yili amo so n ji mo demu. 13Nɛ etekuana shin nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ wu amo to na lar nɛ luwu nɛ bubuni be kakpa malɛ gba shin nɛ basa nɛ b daŋ wu a wɔ amo to na malɛ gba lar nɛ b yili asɔ nɛ ekama daŋ wora so n ji mo demu. 14Ndoŋ nna nɛ b ta luwu nɛ bubuni be kakpa malɛ n lɛ n wɔtɔ edɛ be kepa to. Edɛ be kepa na e la luwu nyɔsopo na. 15Esa kama nɛ b daa maŋ sibɛ mbe ketre n wɔtɔ ŋkpa be kawɔl na to, b ta mo nna n lɛ edɛ be kepa na to.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 21
Content:
Ebɔrɛso popɔr nɛ kasawule popɔr na be asheŋ
1Ndoŋ nna nɛ n wu ebɔrɛso popɔr nɛ kasawule popɔr, ŋkpal manɛ so, ebɔrɛso dra na nɛ kasawule dra na daa maŋ naa wɔtɔ nɛ etekuana malɛ gba daa maŋ naa wɔtɔ. 2Nɛ n wu kadegboŋ cheembi na, kumo e la Jerusalɛm popɔr na ka shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ashi ebɔrɛso fanɛ kejafɔ ka mea to nɛ e tu mo kul na. 3Kumo be kaman nɛ n nu ebɔl ko awɔrso ka shi kuwurputi na akpa ŋ kaŋɛ: “Naniere bre, basa to e ki kakpa nɛ Ebɔrɛ ba nɛ e ba kaa wɔ. Mo nɛ basa beeŋ ba kaa wɔtɔ nɛ b baa la mbe basa. Ebɔrɛ gbagba e naaŋ ba kaa wɔ bumo to a la bumo be Ebɔrɛ. 4E beeŋ kpra anishichubi kikɛ ashi bumo be anishito, luwu maaŋ naa wɔtɔ, luwu so be kagbenejija nɛ kushu maaŋ naa wɔtɔ, ebesa malɛ gba maaŋ naa wɔtɔ, ŋkpal manɛ so, amo be saŋɛ nɛ sososo be asheŋ kikɛ beeŋ choŋ.” 5Nɛ emo nɛ e daa tase kuwurputi na so na kaŋɛ le: “Mee ta kusɔ kama nna a ki kepopɔr.” Kumo be kaman nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ ma le: “Sibɛ asɔ ere n nase, ŋkpal manɛ so, a la mmalga mo nɛ a la kashenteŋ nna nseŋ naa la asɔ nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n yirda.” 6Nɛ e naŋ kaŋɛ: “K teŋ wora. Ma e la Alfa nɛ Omega, Faraŋko nɛ Lalaloge. Ekama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo, meeŋ jɔ nchu ashi ŋkpa be kebuye to n sa mo nɛ e nuu ŋkaa maaŋ ka shɛŋ. 7Ekama nɛ e kɔ m pɔɔ so beeŋ nya ade kikɛ, nɛ m baa la amodoŋwura be Ebɔrɛ nɛ mo alɛ e baa la m pibi. 8Ama befupo bre nɛ bumo nɛ b maa yirda na nɛ basa jiga nɛ bemɔpo nɛ kesakaleasheŋ wuraana nɛ bumo nɛ baa wora ŋ kilgi nɛ agbirshumpoana nɛ befɛpo kikɛ bre kikɛ be kaboŋ e la edɛ be kepa nɛ jɛrbi wɔ kumo to a chɔɔ na to. Ndoŋ be luwu e la luwu nyɔsopo na.”
Jerusalɛm popɔr na be asheŋ
9Ndoŋ nna nɛ emalaika ashunu mo nɛ b daa kɔ ntishaŋ ashunu nɛ a daŋ bɔlɔ lalaloge be etɔrɔ ashunu na be eko ba ŋ kutɔ m ba kaŋɛ ma le: “Ba nɛ ŋ ŋini fo kejafɔ na, Kpakpafɔlbi na be eche na.” 10Ndoŋ nna nɛ e ta ma kiyoyu to n yɔ kebee gboŋgboŋi jeŋgreŋ ko so n ya ŋini ma kadegboŋ cheembi na, kumo e la Jerusalɛm na nɛ k shi Ebɔrɛ kutɔ ashi ebɔrɛso a ba. 11Nɛ kadegboŋ na kikɛ sɔ Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura a nyɛkpɛ so palpal fanɛ kejembubi mo nɛ baa tre jaspa nɛ k bee wu to fanɛ abɔrɛjembubi na. 12Kade na daa kɔ egbal gboŋgboŋi ko nna nsaa kɔ mbuna kuduanyɔ nɛ emalaika kuduanyɔ yil a keni amo so. B daŋ sibɛ Israɛl be nnaŋ kuduanyɔ na be ekama be ketre nna n deŋi kabuna kama so. 13Mbuna asa e daa wɔ epeŋilarkpa be kaba so nɛ mbuna asa wɔ kelargato be esoso be kaba so nɛ mbuna asa wɔ kelargato be kaseto be kaba so nɛ mbuna asa wɔ epeŋitɔrkpa be kaba so. 14Kadegboŋ na be egbal daa kɔ egbaltɔlase kuduanyɔ nɛ gbaltɔlase kama malɛ daa kɔ Kpakpafɔlbi na be beshuŋipo kuduanyɔ na be ekoŋwule kama be ketre.
15Malaika mo nɛ e daŋ malga ŋ kutɔ na daa kɔ shuwa be kekpabi nɛ b kɔ a karga asɔ enɔ to nna nɛ e ta ŋ karga kadegboŋ na nɛ kumo be mbuna nɛ kumo be egbal. 16Kade na kikɛ daŋ bonte nna a dese nɛ kumo be nteŋ nɛ mparto kikɛ sasa. Malaika na ka ta mbe kekpabi na ŋ karga kade na, kumo be nteŋ daa wɔ emayɛl kagboŋ nɛ alfa anu nɛ kumo be mparto nɛ kumo be jeŋgreŋ malɛ gba kikɛ daa sa loŋ. 17Kumo be kaman nɛ malaika na karga egbal na be jeŋgreŋ n nya ayadra alfa anyɔ nɛ kuduashe. Basa be kekargato nɛ malaika na daŋ ta ŋ karga na. 18Jaspa be ajembu nɛ b daŋ ta m pɔr egbal na nseŋ ta shuwa gbagba malɛ nɛ a bee wu to fanɛ digi n wora kadegboŋ na malɛ kikɛ. 19Ajembu nɛ amo be yawu du kpakpa be yiri kikɛ malɛ nɛ b daŋ ta n ji kadegboŋ na be egbaltɔlaseana kebita. Jaspa be kejembu nɛ b daŋ ta m mea gbaltɔlase juŋkparso na n ta kejembu mo nɛ baa tre safiri na n wora kenyɔsopo na n ta chalkedoni malɛ n wora gbaltɔlase sasopo na nseŋ ta kejembu mo nɛ baa tre ɛmeraldi na n wora kenasopo. 20Sardɔniksi nɛ b daŋ ta n wora gbaltɔlase nusopo nseŋ ta sardie n wora keshesopo na n ta krisolit n wora keshunusopo na. Kuburwasopo na peya e la berɛl, kekpanusopo e la kejembu mo nɛ baa tre topas na, kudusopo peya e la krisoprasi nɛ kudukakosopo peya la jasinɛf. Kejembu kuduanyɔsopo mo nɛ b daŋ ta n wora gbaltɔlase kuduanyɔsopo na nɛ baa tre ametiste. 21Mbuna kuduanyɔ na daa la asɔ nɛ baa tre apɛl na nna. Pɛɛl koŋwule nɛ b daŋ ta n lɔŋɛ kabuna na be kekama. Kadegboŋ na be kubɔrbi daa la shuwa gbagba nna a wu to fanɛ digi.
22N daa maŋ wu bɔrɛlambu kama kadegboŋ na to, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpetale Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na e la ndoŋ be bɔrɛlambu. 23Epeŋi be kenyaŋɛ ŋko kufɔl be kefulto ndoŋ be asheŋ daa maŋ tir kadegboŋ na to ebi kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, Ebɔrɛ be kemaŋkura e daa nyaŋɛ a yuu kade na so nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na malɛ la kumo be fitila. 24Kumo be kefulto nɛ efuliana so ebi beeŋ wu n nite nɛ kasawule ere so be bewurgboŋana e bar bumo be kemaŋkura kumo to. 25Ndoŋ be mbuna maa ti kikɛ, ŋkpal manɛ so, kanyɛ maa biri ndoŋ kikɛ. 26Baaŋ bar efuliana so be kemaŋkura nɛ amo be bunyaŋ kade na to. 27Eyurpi be kusɔ kikɛ maaŋ luri ndoŋ kikɛ. Esa kama malɛ gba nɛ e bee wora anishinyɔrsheŋ ŋko a fule, e maaŋ luri ndoŋ kikɛ. Bumo nɛ b sibɛ bumo be atre n wɔtɔ Kpakpafɔlbi na be ŋkpa be kawɔl na to na nawule e naaŋ luri ndoŋ.

Title: KELARAŊŊINI 22
Content:
Ŋkpa be lɔr be asheŋ
1Malaika na daŋ ŋini ma ŋkpa be lɔr be nchu gba nɛ a bee wu to fanɛ abɔrɛjembubi ashi Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi be kuwurputiakpa 2a shile a bɔla kadegboŋ na be kubɔrbi be nferinto so. Ŋkpa be kedibi daa yil lɔr na be kaba kama so nna a sɔr kumo be asɔrso ale kuduanyɔ, kumo e la fanɛ kufɔl kikɛ to nɛ kumo be asɔrso. Kedibi na be afantaŋ e la efuliana be kechɛ be asɔ. 3Kusɔ kama nɛ Ebɔrɛ so kɔnɔ maaŋ naa wɔ ndoŋ. Ebɔrɛ nɛ Kpakpafɔlbi na be kuwurputi e naaŋ baa wɔ ndoŋ nɛ mbe anya e baa maŋ mo so. 4Baaŋ wu mbe anishiakpa nɛ mbe ketre malɛ e baa deŋ bumo be nsɔtoana so. 5Kanyɛ maaŋ naa wɔ ndoŋ. Fitila be kefulto ŋko epeŋi be kefulto be asheŋ maaŋ naŋ tir bumo, ŋkpal manɛ so, Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ e naaŋ baa sa bumo kefulto. Bumo alɛ beeŋ ji kuwura mbaanaayɔ.
6Nɛ malaika na kaŋɛ ma le: “Mmalga ere la kashenteŋ nna nɛ baaŋ tiŋ n yirda amo. Amo alɛ so nɛ Enyɛnpe Ebɔrɛ malɛ ta mbe Kiyoyu na n sa mbe anebi nseŋ shuŋi mbe malaika fanɛ e ba ŋini mbe anya asɔ nɛ a maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ wora na kikɛ. 7Yesu yɛ: ‘Men keni, m maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba. Kagbenefuli beeŋ baa la ekama nɛ e bee ta mmalgawuŋkaŋɛ nɛ a wɔ kawɔl ere to ere a wɔtɔ mbe kagbene to peya nna.’ ”
8Ma Jɔn e nu nseŋ wu asɔ ere kikɛ. Ma alɛ ka daŋ nu amo nseŋ wu amo nɛ ŋ gbir n dese kasawule malaika mo nɛ e daa ŋini ma asɔana na be anishito nɛ m maŋ mo so 9nɛ e kaŋɛ ma le: “A maŋ daga fanɛ fo wora loŋ. Ma alɛ gba la fo nɛ fo niopibiana anebiana nɛ bumo nɛ baa ta kawɔl ere to be mmalga a wɔtɔ bumo be ŋgbene to na bumo barkasa kenya nna. Ebɔrɛ e daga fanɛ fo baa maŋ mo so.”
10Kede be kaman nɛ e kaŋɛ ma: “Sa maŋ kaŋ ta le be mmalgawuŋkaŋɛ ere ŋ ŋana wulo to, ŋkpal manɛ so, jemanɛ na bee taga to. 11Esa kama nɛ e bee wora alubi e baa kraa wora amo, ekama malɛ nɛ e kɔ eyurpi mo to e baa kraa du loŋ. Ekama nɛ e bee wora alela e baa kraa wora alela na nɛ ekama malɛ nɛ e du cheembi e baa kraa du cheembi loŋ.”
12E yɛ: “Keni nfe, m maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba. Ma alɛ kɔ ma kakɔka nna a ba nɛ m ba yili kanaŋkama nɛ ekama shuŋ so ŋ ka mo. 13Ma e la Alfa nɛ Omega, Faraŋko nɛ Lalaloge nɛ Ejuŋkparpo nɛ Emantopo na. 14Kagbenefuli la bekama nɛ b fɔr bumo be epiŋi nɛ a lar so nseŋ nya ekpa nɛ b ji ŋkpa be kedibi na be asɔrso nseŋ naŋ nya m bɔla mbuna to na n luri kadegboŋ na to na peya nna. 15Bumo nɛ b la njɔnɔ nɛ basa nɛ baa wora ŋ kilgi nɛ kesakaleawuraana nɛ bemɔpo nɛ agbirshumpoana nɛ esa kama nɛ e bee sha nsaa bɛ efɛsheŋ kama so na nawule e maŋ wɔ kadegboŋ na to.
16Ma Yesu e shuŋi ma malaika nɛ e ba ta le be shɛda be kubɔya ere m bɔ n sa asɔriana na. N la Ewura Deevid be kanaŋ to be Ejuŋkparpo nna nseŋ naa la mo Nanabi nɛ kachipurso be Nyanwuleji fuliso parr nna.”
17Ndoŋ nna nɛ Kiyoyu na nɛ kejafɔ na kaŋɛ: “Ba.” Ekama malɛ gba nɛ e nu loŋ e kaŋɛ: “Ba.” Ekama nɛ achukoŋ kɔ mo e ba, ekama malɛ nɛ e bee sha e ba sɔ ŋkpa be nchu na n nuu ŋkaa maaŋ ka shɛŋ.
18Mee fiɛ ekama nɛ e nu kewuŋkaŋɛ ere be mmalga mo nɛ a wɔ kawɔl ere to ere so nna fanɛ ekama nɛ e ta kusɔ kama n ti amo so, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ ta etɔrɔ mo nɛ b malga amo be asheŋ kawɔl ere to ere n ti amodoŋwura so. 19Ekama malɛ nɛ e lara mmalga ashi abɔrɛsheŋ wuŋkaŋɛ be kawɔl ere to, Ebɔrɛ beeŋ lara mbe kachigeso ashi ŋkpa be kedibi be asɔrso na to nseŋ naŋ lara mbe kachigeso ashi kadegboŋ cheembi nɛ b malga kumo nɛ ŋkpa be kedibi sɔrso be kananɛ a du be asheŋ ashi kawɔl ere to na.
20Esa nɛ e bee ji asheŋ ere be shɛda e naa kaŋɛ fanɛ: “Kashenteŋto, m maaŋ naŋ chɛr nseŋ ba.” Amɛn, Enyɛnpe Yesu, ba naniere! 21Enyɛnpe Yesu be kuwɔr be kakɛ e baa wɔ Ebɔrɛ be basa kikɛ so. Amɛn.
